*Word for word:* kukkura-shabaka lana — taking a puppy; khelaya thakura — the Thakura plays; dekhiya — seeing; sakala loka — all the people; ananda prachura — abundant joy

**68.** the Thakura plays with a puppy —
seeing it, everyone is full of joy;

বালকের সঙ্গে খেলা করে রাজপথে ।
গুপ্ত বেজা প্রকাশ দেখিল যেনমতে ॥ ৬৯ ॥

*bālakera saṅge khelā kare rājapathe |*
*gupta bejā prakāśa dekhila yenamate || 69 ||*

*Word for word:* balakera sange — with the children; khela kare — plays; rajapathe — on the royal road; gupta beja — Gupta the vaidya; prakasha dekhila — saw the revelation; yenamate — how

**69.** He plays with the children on the royal road —
and how Gupta the vaidya beheld His revelation;

বালক-সহিতে হরিসঙ্কীর্তনে নৃত্য ।
দেখিয়া সকল লোক আনন্দিত-চিত্ত ॥ ৭০ ॥

*bālaka-sahite harisaṅkīrtane nṛtya |*
*dekhiẏā sakala loka ānandita-citta || 70 ||*

*Word for word:* balaka-sahite — with the boys; hari-sankirtane nritya — dancing in Hari's sankirtana; dekhiya — seeing; sakala loka — all the people; anandita-chitta — joyful at heart

**70.** with the boys He dances in the sankirtana of Hari —
seeing it, everyone rejoices at heart;

যেনমতে হাতে খড়ি দিলা তাঁর বাপ ।
যা শুনিলে দূরে যায় অমঙ্গল-তাপ ॥ ৭১ ॥

*yenamate hāte khaṛi dilā tāṁra bāpa |*
*yā śunile dūre yāẏa amaṅgala-tāpa || 71 ||*

*Word for word:* yenamate — how; hate khadi dila — put the chalk in His hand (start of writing lessons); tanra bapa — His father; ya shunile — hearing which; dure yaya — goes far away; amangala-tapa — the fever of misfortune

**71.** how His father put the chalk [for writing] in His hand —
hearing of it, the fever of misfortune goes far away;

তবে ত কহিব কথা শুন সাবধানে ।
খেলে বিশ্বম্ভর বিশ্বরূপ জ্যেষ্ঠ-সনে ॥ ৭২ ॥

*tabe ta kahiba kathā śuna sābadhāne |*
*khele biśbambhara biśbarūpa jyeṣṭha-sane || 72 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe ta kahiba katha — then I shall tell; shuna savadhane — listen attentively; khele vishvambhara — Vishvambhara plays; vishvarupa jyeshtha-sane — with the elder, Vishvarupa

**72.** then I shall tell — listen attentively —
how Vishvambhara plays with the elder, Vishvarupa:

ইন্দ্র উপেন্দ্র যেন দুই সহোদর ।
কহিব তাহার কথা শুনিবে উত্তর ॥ ৭৩ ॥

*indra upendra yena dui sahodara |*
*kahiba tāhāra kathā śunibe uttara || 73 ||*

*Word for word:* indra upendra — Indra and Upendra; yena — as if; dui sahodara — two brothers of one womb; kahiba tahara katha — I shall tell of them; shunibe uttara — you will hear later

**73.** like two brothers born of one womb, Indra and Upendra;
I shall tell of them — you will hear later;

বিশ্বরূপ সন্ন্যাস করিলা যেনমতে ।
বিশ্বম্ভর পিতা-মাতা প্রবোধে কথাতে ॥ ৭৪ ॥

*biśbarūpa sannyāsa karilā yenamate |*
*biśbambhara pitā-mātā prabodhe kathāte || 74 ||*

*Word for word:* vishvarupa — Vishvarupa; sannyasa karila — took sannyasa; yenamate — how; vishvambhara — Vishvambhara; pita-mata prabodhe — consoles father and mother; kathate — with words

**74.** how Vishvarupa took sannyasa,
and how Vishvambhara consoled father and mother with words;

তবে ত কহিব বিশ্বম্ভরের চরিত ।
বালক-সহিতে খেলা খেলে বিপরীত ॥ ৭৫ ॥

*tabe ta kahiba biśbambharera carita |*
*bālaka-sahite khelā khele biparīta || 75 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe ta kahiba — then I shall tell; vishvambharera charita — Vishvambhara's deeds; balaka-sahite — with the children; khela khele viparita — He plays wild (lit. "contrary") games

**75.** then I shall tell of Vishvambhara's deeds:
how He played wild games with the children —

সকল বালক মেলি জাহ্নবীর কূলে ।
বালুকায় পক্ষ-পদচিহ্ন দেখি বুলে ॥ ৭৬ ॥

*sakala bālaka meli jāhnabīra kūle |*
*bālukāẏa pakṣa-padacihna dekhi bule || 76 ||*

*Word for word:* sakala balaka meli — all the boys together; jahnavira kule — on the bank of the Jahnavi; balukaya — on the sand; paksha-pada-chihna — bird tracks; dekhi bule — following them they roam

**76.** all the boys together on the bank of the Jahnavi
run over the sand, following the tracks of birds;

দেখিয়া তাঁহার পিতা দুঃখী হৈল মন ।
ঘরেরে আনিয়া কৈলা তর্জন-গর্জন ॥ ৭৭ ॥

*dekhiẏā tāṁhāra pitā duḥkhī haila mana |*
*gharere āniẏā kailā tarjana-garjana || 77 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhiya — seeing; tanhara pita — His father; duhkhi haila mana — was grieved at heart; gharere aniya — bringing Him home; kaila tarjana-garjana — scolded and shouted

**77.** seeing this, His father was grieved at heart,
brought Him home and scolded Him;

স্বপনে তাঁহারে কৃপা কৈলা যেনমতে ।
কহিব সকল কথা শুন একচিতে ॥ ৭৮ ॥

*sbapane tāṁhāre kṛpā kailā yenamate |*
*kahiba sakala kathā śuna ekacite || 78 ||*

*Word for word:* svapane — in a dream; tanhare kripa kaila — showed him mercy; yenamate — how; kahiba sakala katha — I shall tell all; shuna eka-chite — listen with one mind

**78.** how [the Lord] showed him mercy in a dream —
I shall tell it all, listen with one mind;

কর্ণবেধ চূড়াকর্ম আর উপবীত ।
কহিব সকল কথা আনন্দিত-চিত ॥ ৭৯ ॥

*karṇabedha cūṛākarma āra upabīta |*
*kahiba sakala kathā ānandita-cita || 79 ||*

*Word for word:* karnavedha — ear-piercing; chuda-karma — chudakarana (first tonsure); ara upavita — and the sacred thread; kahiba sakala katha — I shall tell it all; anandita-chita — with a joyful heart

**79.** the ear-piercing, the chudakarana and the sacred thread —
I shall tell it all with a joyful heart;

বাল্যসমাধানে হৈলে যৌবনপ্রবেশ ।
দিনে দিনে করে প্রেমার প্রকাশ অশেষ ॥ ৮০ ॥

*bālyasamādhāne haile yaubanaprabeśa |*
*dine dine kare premāra prakāśa aśeṣa || 80 ||*

*Word for word:* balya-samadhane — at the close of childhood; haile yauvana-pravesha — when youth began; dine dine — day by day; kare premara prakasha — He manifests prema; ashesha — without end

**80.** childhood ended, He enters youth,
day by day manifesting prema without end;

গুরুস্থানে পড়িলেন সতীর্থের সনে ।
বঙ্গজের কথায় পরিহাসয়ে যেমনে ॥ ৮১ ॥

*gurusthāne paṛilena satīrthera sane |*
*baṅgajera kathāẏa parihāsaẏe yemane || 81 ||*

*Word for word:* guru-sthane — at the guru's place; padilena — He studied; satirthera sane — with fellow students; bangajera kathaya — at the speech of the East Bengalis; parihasaye yemane — how He made fun

**81.** He studied with His guru together with His fellow students,
how He mimicked the speech of the people of East Bengal;[^01-19]

[^01-1]: The summary printed in Bhaktisiddhanta's edition before this section is almost wholly illegible in the OCR (only scattered words can be made out — a list of the coming pastimes: Vishvarupa's sannyasa, the passing of Jagannatha Mishra, the journey to East Bengal, etc.). We therefore give his own brief summary of this section from the *Khanda-vivarana* (survey of the parts) at the beginning of the same edition.
[^01-2]: In Bhaktisiddhanta's edition the shloka is followed by his Sanskrit commentary. He explains: "in the age of Kali" — "in the age of quarrel"; "to free the devotees from their distress" — to give the Lord's servants a joy free of thorns when they are troubled by disputants opposed to shruti; "descended in full" — appeared in His original form as Bhagavan (svayam-rupa); "crest-jewel of sannyasis" — the jewel in the crown of renunciants, full of beauty; "bhakti and prema" — service of the Lord, and prema, which is nothing but the desire to please Krishna's senses — these are the priceless jewels, and "giving away" means bestowing them freely; "the devotees" — those devoted to pure service; "the unbelievers" — those hostile to the devotees and turned away from Hari; "crushes" — subdues completely; "glory to" — may He abide above all.
[^01-3]: Ganesha, Shiva with Parvati, and Sarasvati are praised here after the custom of the Bengali *mangala* poems. For Gaudiya Vaishnavas the gods are honoured as devotees of the Lord: Ganesha worships Govinda (*Brahma-samhita* 5.50), and Shiva is the greatest of Vaishnavas (*Bhag.* 12.13.16); so too Bhaktisiddhanta, in his summary of the next section, calls Shambhu "the best of Vaishnavas". The words "the sole doers in the three worlds" are poetic praise; for the tradition the source of all the worlds is Krishna Himself, and Shiva and Parvati are His servants, "granting bhakti to Vishnu", as the same line says.
[^01-4]: Literally "unknown to the three worlds, in greatness — to the Lord of speech"; the Lord of speech (Vaninatha) is Brahma, husband of Sarasvati. The 1903 edition reads "to the golden [Lord], the Lord of speech"; the sense of the line is not quite clear in either reading.
[^01-5]: So in Bhaktisiddhanta's text (and in his index of names — "Garga"): Garga Muni, the family priest of the Yadavas, who in Gaura-lila is Nilambara Chakravarti, the Lord's maternal grandfather (*Gaura-ganoddesha-dipika*). The 1983 edition reads here "brimming over, enraptured with pride in Gora's virtues" and refers the line to Nityananda.
[^01-6]: The Lord's first wife, Lakshmipriya, left the world while the Lord was in East Bengal (see en/02, v. 86).
[^01-7]: In the 1983 edition this couplet stands right after the praise of Shachi (v. 20); we follow the order of Bhaktisiddhanta's edition.
[^01-8]: Pandita Gosani is Gadadhara Pandita.
[^01-9]: That is, Murari Gupta the physician (*vaidya*, physician, also the physician caste).
[^01-10]: "Master of the family" and "chosen Deity" (*ishta-devata*) here mean Narahari himself, the author's guru, named in the next couplet.
[^01-11]: Vrindavana Dasa's *Sri Chaitanya-bhagavata*.
[^01-12]: Literally "the Thakura of our house"; this usually means the household Deity (at Shrikhanda, Gopinatha). The 1983 edition reads: "I praise the Thakura of our house, Sri Raghunandana", i.e. Raghunandana himself is so called.
[^01-13]: V. 36+1 is found only in the 1983 edition; it is absent from Bhaktisiddhanta's edition and from the 1903 edition. On Raghunandana and his father Mukunda Dasa cf. *Chaitanya-charitamrita*, Madhya 15.112–131.
[^01-14]: Sri Murti — the Deity. According to the tradition of Shrikhanda, the boy Raghunandana, son of Mukunda Dasa (Narahari's brother), gave a laddu to the Deity of Gopinatha, and the Deity ate it.
[^01-15]: The line is damaged in the OCR of Bhaktisiddhanta's edition; translated from the legible reading. The 1903 and 1983 editions have: "Sing the virtues of Gora — this is my hope; Lochana Dasa says: fulfil my desire."
[^01-16]: The identification of Murari Gupta with Hanuman is also accepted by Kavi Karnapura's *Gaura-ganoddesha-dipika*.
[^01-17]: Murari Gupta's *Sri Krishna-chaitanya-charitamrita*, a Sanskrit poem framed as Murari's dialogue with Damodara Pandita (translated in `murari-gupta/`). Bhaktisiddhanta in his survey of the parts calls it *Sri Chaitanya-charita*.
[^01-18]: Advaita Acharya.
[^01-19]: The people of East Bengal (*bangaja*) spoke a dialect that was thought comic in Navadvipa; in His youth the Lord loved to mimic it.

---

# Sutra-khanda, part 2 (portion 02)

*The end of the "sutra": a list of the pastimes of the Adi- and Madhya-khanda; praise of Chaitanya, Nityananda and Advaita; the narrative begins — Damodara's question about the reasons for Gauranga's appearance, Murari's answer on the decline of dharma in Kali, and Narada's grief*

মায়ে আজ্ঞা দিলা একাদশী করিবারে ।
অনেক প্রকাশ-কথা কহিব সে কালে ॥ ৮২ ॥

*māẏe ājñā dilā ekādaśī karibāre |*
*aneka prakāśa-kathā kahiba se kāle || 82 ||*

*Word for word:* maye ajna dila — He bade His mother; ekadashi karibare — to keep Ekadashi; aneka prakasha-katha — many accounts of revelation; kahiba se kale — I shall tell at that time

**82.** how He bade His mother keep Ekadashi —
of His many revelations I shall tell in due time;

হেনই সময়ে জগন্নাথ পরলোক ।
কান্দয়ে যেমতে প্রভু পাঞা পিতৃশোক ॥ ৮৩ ॥

*henai samaẏe jagannātha paraloka |*
*kāndaẏe yemate prabhu pāñā pitṛśoka || 83 ||*

*Word for word:* henai samaye — at that time; jagannatha paraloka — Jagannatha [went to] the other world; kandaye yemate — how He wept; prabhu — the Lord; pana pitri-shoka — grieving for His father

**83.** how at that time Jagannatha [Mishra] passed to the other world,
and how the Lord wept, grieving for His father.

তবে ত কহিব কথা অপরূপ আর ।
বিবাহ করিলা প্রভু আনন্দ অপার ॥ ৮৪ ॥

*tabe ta kahiba kathā aparūpa āra |*
*bibāha karilā prabhu ānanda apāra || 84 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe ta kahiba — then I shall tell; katha aparupa ara — another wondrous tale; vivaha karila prabhu — the Lord married; ananda apara — boundless joy

**84.** Then I shall tell another wondrous tale:
the Lord married — joy without bounds;

গঙ্গা-সন্দর্শনে আর যে হৈল রহস্য ।
সাবধানে শুন ইহা কহিব অবশ্য ॥ ৮৫ ॥

*gaṅgā-sandarśane āra ye haila rahasya |*
*sābadhāne śuna ihā kahiba abaśya || 85 ||*

*Word for word:* ganga-sandarshane — on seeing the Ganga; ara ye haila rahasya — and the secret that came about; savadhane shuna iha — listen to it attentively; kahiba avashya — I shall surely tell

**85.** and the secret that came about when He saw the Ganga[^02-1] —
listen attentively, I shall surely tell it;

পূর্বদেশ-গমন কহিব ভালমতে ।
লক্ষ্মী-স্বর্গ-আরোহণ হৈল যেনমতে ॥ ৮৬ ॥

*pūrbadeśa-gamana kahiba bhālamate |*
*lakṣmī-sbarga-ārohaṇa haila yenamate || 86 ||*

*Word for word:* purvadesha-gamana — the journey to the Eastern land (Bengal); kahiba bhalamate — I shall tell well; lakshmi-svarga-arohana — Lakshmi's ascent to heaven; haila yenamate — how it happened

**86.** I shall tell well of the journey to East Bengal
and of how Lakshmi ascended to heaven;

দেশেরে আসিয়া পুন বিবাহ করিলা ।
শিষ্যে বিদ্যাদান দিয়া গয়ারে চলিলা ॥ ৮৭ ॥

*deśere āsiẏā puna bibāha karilā |*
*śiṣye bidyādāna diẏā gaẏāre calilā || 87 ||*

*Word for word:* deshere asiya — coming back to His land; puna vivaha karila — married again; shishye vidyadana diya — giving knowledge to disciples; gayare chalila — went to Gaya

**87.** returning to His own land He married again,
imparted knowledge to His disciples and set out for Gaya.

প্রত্যেকে কহিব কথা শুন সর্বজন ।
অনেক আনন্দ পাবে না ছাড় যতন ॥ ৮৮ ॥

*pratyeke kahiba kathā śuna sarbajana |*
*aneka ānanda pābe nā chāṛa yatana || 88 ||*

*Word for word:* pratyeke kahiba katha — I shall tell of each; shuna sarvajana — listen, everyone; aneka ananda pabe — you will find great joy; na chhada yatana — do not give up effort

**88.** Of each I shall tell — listen, all of you:
you will find great joy; do not give up your effort.

দেশ-আগমন-কথা কহিব বিশেষ ।
প্রেম প্রকাশয়ে নিরন্তর রসাবেশ ॥ ৮৯ ॥

*deśa-āgamana-kathā kahiba biśeṣa |*
*prema prakāśaẏe nirantara rasābeśa || 89 ||*

*Word for word:* desha-agamana-katha — the tale of the return home; kahiba vishesha — I shall tell especially; prema prakashaye — He manifests prema; nirantara — unceasingly; rasavesha — absorbed in rasa

**89.** Especially I shall tell of the return home:
He constantly manifests prema, absorbed in rasa.

মধ্যখণ্ড-কথা ভাই অনেক আনন্দ ।
শুনিতে পুলক বান্ধে অমিয়া অখণ্ড ॥ ৯০ ॥

*madhyakhaṇḍa-kathā bhāi aneka ānanda |*
*śunite pulaka bāndhe amiẏā akhaṇḍa || 90 ||*

*Word for word:* madhyakhanda-katha — the tale of the Madhya-khanda; bhai — brothers; aneka ananda — great joy; shunite — on hearing; pulaka bandhe — hair stands on end; amiya akhanda — unbroken nectar

**90.** The tale of the Madhya-khanda, brothers, is a great joy:
hearing it the hair stands on end — nectar without end.

ভক্ত-সন্দর্শন-কথা প্রেমার প্রকাশ ।
কহিবার আগে উঠে হৃদয়ে উল্লাস ॥ ৯১ ॥

*bhakta-sandarśana-kathā premāra prakāśa |*
*kahibāra āge uṭhe hṛdaẏe ullāsa || 91 ||*

*Word for word:* bhakta-sandarshana-katha — the tale of meeting the devotees; premara prakasha — manifestation of prema; kahibara age — before the telling; uthe hridaye ullasa — joy rises in the heart

**91.** The tale of the meeting with the devotees is the manifestation of prema:
even before I begin to tell it, my heart rejoices.

মধ্যখণ্ড-কথা ভাই নদীয়া-বিহার ।
অমিয়ার ধারা যেন প্রেমার প্রচার ॥ ৯২ ॥

*madhyakhaṇḍa-kathā bhāi nadīẏā-bihāra |*
*amiẏāra dhārā yena premāra pracāra || 92 ||*

*Word for word:* madhyakhanda-katha bhai — the tale of the Madhya-khanda, brothers; nadiya-vihara — the play in Nadia; amiyara dhara yena — like a stream of nectar; premara prachara — the spreading of prema

**92.** The tale of the Madhya-khanda, brothers, is the play in Nadia:
like a stream of nectar — so prema was spread.

অতি অপরূপ লীলা প্রকাশিলা প্রভু ।
চারি যুগে ভক্ত যাহা নাহি শুনে কভু ॥ ৯৩ ॥

*ati aparūpa līlā prakāśilā prabhu |*
*cāri yuge bhakta yāhā nāhi śune kabhu || 93 ||*

*Word for word:* ati aparupa lila — most unprecedented pastimes; prakashila prabhu — the Lord revealed; chari yuge — in the four yugas; bhakta yaha nahi shune kabhu — which devotees never heard

**93.** The Lord revealed most unprecedented pastimes,
such as devotees never heard of in any of the four yugas.

হেন অদ্ভুত কথা ভক্তি-পরচার ।
কহিব সে মধ্যখণ্ডে নদীয়া-বিহার ॥ ৯৪ ॥

*hena adbhuta kathā bhakti-paracāra |*
*kahiba se madhyakhaṇḍe nadīẏā-bihāra || 94 ||*

*Word for word:* hena adbhuta katha — this wondrous tale; bhakti-parachara — the spreading of bhakti; kahiba se madhyakhande — I shall tell in the Madhya-khanda; nadiya-vihara — the play in Nadia

**94.** This wondrous tale, the spreading of bhakti,
I shall tell in the Madhya-khanda — the play in Nadia.

সকল ভকত মেলি হইল যেনমতে ।
প্রত্যেকে কহিব ইহা যে জানি কহিতে ॥ ৯৫ ॥

*sakala bhakata meli haila yenamate |*
*pratyeke kahiba ihā ye jāni kahite || 95 ||*

*Word for word:* sakala bhakata meli — all the devotees together; haila yenamate — how they gathered; pratyeke kahiba iha — I shall tell of each; ye jani kahite — as far as I know how to tell

**95.** How all the devotees came together —
of each I shall tell, as far as I know how to tell.

প্রথমে কহিব শচী পাইল প্রেমদান ।
পথেতে যেমতে শুনে বংশীর নিস্বান ॥ ৯৬ ॥

*prathame kahiba śacī pāila premadāna |*
*pathete yemate śune baṃśīra nisbāna || 96 ||*

*Word for word:* prathame kahiba — first I shall tell; shachi paila premadana — [how] Shachi received the gift of prema; pathete yemate shune — how on the road He heard; vamshira nisvana — the sound of the flute

**96.** First I shall tell how Shachi received the gift of prema,
how on the road He heard the sound of the flute,

প্রেমায় বিহ্বল হৈলা ভাবের আবেশে ।
আচম্বিতে দেববাণী উঠিল আকাশে ॥ ৯৭ ॥

*premāẏa bihbala hailā bhābera ābeśe |*
*ācambite debabāṇī uṭhila ākāśe || 97 ||*

*Word for word:* premaya vihvala haila — He was overwhelmed with prema; bhavera aveshe — seized by bhava; achambite — suddenly; devavani uthila akashe — a heavenly voice arose in the sky

**97.** how, seized by bhava, He was overwhelmed with prema,
and suddenly a voice from heaven sounded in the sky;

মুরারিরে কৃপা কৈলা বরাহ-আবেশে ।
ব্রহ্মা-আদি দেব দেখে আপন-আবেশে ॥ ৯৮ ॥

*murārire kṛpā kailā barāha-ābeśe |*
*brahmā-ādi deba dekhe āpana-ābeśe || 98 ||*

*Word for word:* murarire kripa kaila — He showed mercy to Murari; varaha-aveshe — absorbed as Varaha; brahma-adi deva — Brahma and the other gods; dekhe — behold; apana-aveshe — themselves enraptured

**98.** how in the form of Varaha He showed mercy to Murari;
Brahma and the other gods behold [it], themselves enraptured;

শুক্লাম্বর ব্রহ্মচারী প্রেম পাইল তবে ।
কহিব সকল কথা শুন সর্বভাবে ॥ ৯৯ ॥

*śuklāmbara brahmacārī prema pāila tabe |*
*kahiba sakala kathā śuna sarbabhābe || 99 ||*

*Word for word:* shuklambara brahmachari — Shuklambara Brahmachari; prema paila tabe — then obtained prema; kahiba sakala katha — I shall tell it all; shuna sarvabhave — listen with all your heart

**99.** how Shuklambara Brahmachari then obtained prema —
I shall tell it all, listen with all your heart;

পণ্ডিত শ্রীগদাধর প্রভুর পরাণ ।
প্রেমায় বিভোর হঞা দিবানিশি কান্দে ॥ ১০০ ॥

*paṇḍita śrīgadādhara prabhura parāṇa |*
*premāẏa bibhora hañā dibāniśi kānde || 100 ||*

*Word for word:* pandita sri-gadadhara — Pandita Sri Gadadhara; prabhura parana — the Lord's life; premaya vibhora haina — overwhelmed with prema; diva-nishi kande — weeps day and night

**100.** Pandita Sri Gadadhara, [dear to] the Lord as life,[^02-2]
overwhelmed with prema, weeps day and night;

একে একে দিল সর্বজনে প্রেমদান ।
কহিব সকল কথা যেমন বিধান ॥ ১০১ ॥

*eke eke dila sarbajane premadāna |*
*kahiba sakala kathā yemana bidhāna || 101 ||*

*Word for word:* eke eke — one by one; dila sarvajane premadana — He gave prema to all; kahiba sakala katha — I shall tell it all; yemana vidhana — as is fitting

**101.** one by one He gave prema to all —
I shall tell it all as is fitting;

ভক্তকে প্রসাদ আম্রবীজ-আরোপণে ।
যা শুনিলে সর্বজনের দ্বিধা ঘুচে মনে ॥ ১০২ ॥

*bhaktake prasāda āmrabīja-āropaṇe |*
*yā śunile sarbajanera dbidhā ghuce mane || 102 ||*

*Word for word:* bhaktake prasada — mercy to a devotee; amra-bija-aropane — by planting a mango stone; ya shunile — hearing which; sarvajanera dvidha ghuche mane — everyone's doubts vanish from the mind

**102.** His mercy to a devotee — how He planted a mango stone:
hearing of it, all will be freed from doubt;

অধ্যাত্ম আচ্ছাদি প্রভু প্রেম প্রকাশয় ।
জ্ঞানগম্য নহে প্রভু সভারে বুঝায় ॥ ১০৩ ॥

*adhyātma ācchādi prabhu prema prakāśaẏa |*
*jñānagamya nahe prabhu sabhāre bujhāẏa || 103 ||*

*Word for word:* adhyatma achchhadi — eclipsing the doctrine of the Self; prabhu prema prakashaya — the Lord reveals prema; jnana-gamya nahe — not reached by knowledge; prabhu sabhare bujhaya — the Lord explains to all

**103.** the Lord, eclipsing the doctrine of the Self (*adhyatma*), reveals prema:
He is not reached by knowledge — so He explains to all.

তবে ত কহিব কথা অপূর্বকথন ।
যেমতে হইল নিত্যানন্দ-সন্দর্শন ॥ ১০৪ ॥

*tabe ta kahiba kathā apūrbakathana |*
*yemate haila nityānanda-sandarśana || 104 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe ta kahiba katha — then I shall tell; apurva-kathana — an unprecedented account; yemate haila — how there came about; nityananda-sandarshana — the meeting with Nityananda

**104.** Then I shall tell an unprecedented account —
how the meeting with Nityananda came about,

হরিদাস প্রভু-সনে মিলয়ে যেমনে ।
অদ্বৈত-আচার্য-নিত্যানন্দের মিলনে ॥ ১০৫ ॥

*haridāsa prabhu-sane milaẏe yemane |*
*adbaita-ācārya-nityānandera milane || 105 ||*

*Word for word:* haridasa prabhu-sane milaye yemane — how Haridasa meets the Lord; advaita-acharya-nityanandera milane — of the meeting of Advaita Acharya and Nityananda

**105.** how Haridasa meets the Lord,
of the meeting of Advaita Acharya with Nityananda,

যেনমতে জগাই-মাধাই নিস্তারিলা ।
পিতা-পুত্র ব্রাহ্মণেরে যেন কৃপা কৈলা ॥ ১০৬ ॥

*yenamate jagāi-mādhāi nistārilā |*
*pitā-putra brāhmaṇere yena kṛpā kailā || 106 ||*

*Word for word:* yenamate — how; jagai-madhai nistarila — He delivered Jagai and Madhai; pita-putra brahmanere — to the father and son, brahmanas; yena kripa kaila — how He showed mercy

**106.** how He delivered Jagai and Madhai,
how He showed mercy to a father and son, brahmanas,

শিবের গায়নে কৃপা কৈলা যেনমতে ।
আচম্বিতে খেদ উঠে ব্রাহ্মণ-চরিতে ॥ ১০৭ ॥

*śibera gāẏane kṛpā kailā yenamate |*
*ācambite kheda uṭhe brāhmaṇa-carite || 107 ||*

*Word for word:* shivera gayane — to the singer of Shiva; kripa kaila yenamate — how He showed mercy; achambite — suddenly; kheda uthe — grief arises; brahmana-charite — from a brahmana's deed

**107.** how He showed mercy to a singer [of songs] of Shiva;
how suddenly grief arose from a brahmana's deed,[^02-3]

যেনমতে জাহ্নবীতে দিলা প্রভু ঝাঁপ ।
যা শুনিলে তিনলোকে উঠে হিয়া-কাঁপ ॥ ১০৮ ॥

*yenamate jāhnabīte dilā prabhu jhāṁpa |*
*yā śunile tinaloke uṭhe hiẏā-kāṁpa || 108 ||*

*Word for word:* yenamate — how; jahnavite dila prabhu jhanpa — the Lord leapt into the Jahnavi; ya shunile — hearing which; tina-loke — in the three worlds; uthe hiya-kanpa — hearts tremble

**108.** how the Lord threw Himself into the Jahnavi —
hearing of it, hearts will tremble in the three worlds;

তবে আর অপরূপ শুনিবে বিধানে ।
দেবালয় মার্জনা প্রভু করিলা যেমনে ॥ ১০৯ ॥

*tabe āra aparūpa śunibe bidhāne |*
*debālaẏa mārjanā prabhu karilā yemane || 109 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe ara aparupa — then another wonder; shunibe vidhane — you will hear in order; devalaya marjana — the cleansing of the temple; prabhu karila yemane — how the Lord did it

**109.** then you will hear in due order another wonder —
how the Lord cleansed the temple;

শুনিবে অনেক কথা অতি অপরূপ ।
কুষ্ঠব্যাধি নিস্তারিলা এ বড় কৌতুক ॥ ১১০ ॥

*śunibe aneka kathā ati aparūpa |*
*kuṣṭhabyādhi nistārilā e baṛa kautuka || 110 ||*

*Word for word:* shunibe aneka katha — you will hear much; ati aparupa — most unprecedented; kushtha-vyadhi nistarila — He delivered a leper; e bada kautuka — this is a great marvel

**110.** you will hear many quite unprecedented things:
He delivered a leper — a great marvel;

বলরাম-আবেশ-কথা কহিব বিশেষ ।
যা শুনিলে সভে পাবে আনন্দ অশেষ ॥ ১১১ ॥

*balarāma-ābeśa-kathā kahiba biśeṣa |*
*yā śunile sabhe pābe ānanda aśeṣa || 111 ||*

*Word for word:* balarama-avesha-katha — the tale of how the bhava of Balarama took hold [of Him]; kahiba vishesha — I shall tell especially; ya shunile — hearing which; sabhe pabe ananda ashesha — all will find endless joy

**111.** especially I shall tell how the bhava of Balarama took hold of Him —
hearing of it, all will find joy without end;

শ্রীচন্দ্রশেখরাচার্যের বাড়ীতে প্রকাশ ।
প্রেম-পরকাশে ছায় এ ভূমি আকাশ ॥ ১১২ ॥

*śrīcandraśekharācāryera bāṛīte prakāśa |*
*prema-parakāśe chāẏa e bhūmi ākāśa || 112 ||*

*Word for word:* sri-chandrashekharacharyera badite — in the house of Sri Chandrashekhara Acharya; prakasha — revelation; prema-parakashe — with the radiance of prema; chhaya — are covered; e bhumi akasha — this earth and sky

**112.** the revelation in the house of Sri Chandrashekhara Acharya:
the radiance of prema floods earth and sky;

অনেক রহস্য কথা কহিব তাহাতে ।
বৈরাগ্য অদ্ভুত প্রভুর উঠে যেনমতে ॥ ১১৩ ॥

*aneka rahasya kathā kahiba tāhāte |*
*bairāgya adbhuta prabhura uṭhe yenamate || 113 ||*

*Word for word:* aneka rahasya katha — many secret matters; kahiba tahate — I shall tell therein; vairagya adbhuta — wondrous renunciation; prabhura uthe yenamate — how it arose in the Lord

**113.** many secrets I shall tell there —
how wondrous renunciation awoke in the Lord,

শ্রীকেশবভারতী দেখি নদীয়া-নগরে ।
সন্ন্যাস করিব বলি উল্লাস অন্তরে ॥ ১১৪ ॥

*śrīkeśababhāratī dekhi nadīẏā-nagare |*
*sannyāsa kariba bali ullāsa antare || 114 ||*

*Word for word:* sri-keshava-bharati dekhi — seeing Sri Keshava Bharati; nadiya-nagare — in the town of Nadia; sannyasa kariba bali — saying "I will take sannyasa"; ullasa antare — joy in the heart

**114.** how, seeing Keshava Bharati in the town of Nadia,
He rejoices at heart: "I will take sannyasa!";

যেনমতে সর্বভক্তগণের বিলাপ ।
শচী-বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া শোকসাগরে দিল ঝাঁপ ॥ ১১৫ ॥

*yenamate sarbabhaktagaṇera bilāpa |*
*śacī-biṣṇupriẏā śokasāgare dila jhāṁpa || 115 ||*

*Word for word:* yenamate — how; sarva-bhakta-ganera vilapa — the lament of all the devotees; shachi-vishnupriya — Shachi and Vishnupriya; shoka-sagare dila jhanpa — plunged into an ocean of grief

**115.** how all the devotees lamented,
how Shachi and Vishnupriya plunged into an ocean of grief;

সন্ন্যাস-আশয়ে নবদ্বীপ ছাড়ি যায় ।
সন্ন্যাস করিলা প্রভু ভারতী-সহায় ॥ ১১৬ ॥

*sannyāsa-āśaẏe nabadbīpa chāṛi yāẏa |*
*sannyāsa karilā prabhu bhāratī-sahāẏa || 116 ||*

*Word for word:* sannyasa-ashaye — in hope of sannyasa; navadvipa chhadi yaya — He leaves Navadvipa; sannyasa karila prabhu — the Lord took sannyasa; bharati-sahaya — with Bharati's help

**116.** in hope of sannyasa He leaves Navadvipa
and takes sannyasa with Bharati's help.

কহিব সম্যক্ কথা যত বিবরণ ।
আচার্যপ্রভুর ঘর গেলা যেনমন ॥ ১১৭ ॥

*kahiba samyak kathā yata bibaraṇa |*
*ācāryaprabhura ghara gelā yenamana || 117 ||*

*Word for word:* kahiba samyak katha — I shall tell properly; yata vivarana — all the details; acharya-prabhura ghara — to the house of Acharya Prabhu; gela yenamana — how He went

**117.** I shall tell properly all the details:
how He went to the house of Acharya Prabhu,[^02-4]

সভা-সন্দর্শনে আর যে হইল কথা ।
সভা প্রবোধিয়া প্রভু যাত্রা কৈলা তথা ॥ ১১৮ ॥

*sabhā-sandarśane āra ye haila kathā |*
*sabhā prabodhiẏā prabhu yātrā kailā tathā || 118 ||*

*Word for word:* sabha-sandarshane — on meeting everyone; ara ye haila katha — and what was said; sabha prabodhiya — consoling all; prabhu yatra kaila tatha — the Lord set out thither

**118.** what was said at the meeting with everyone,
how, consoling all, the Lord set out on His way,

পুরুষোত্তম দেখিবারে চলিলা যেমতে ।
কহিব রহস্য-কথা গ্রাম রেমুণাতে ॥ ১১৯ ॥

*puruṣottama dekhibāre calilā yemate |*
*kahiba rahasya-kathā grāma remuṇāte || 119 ||*

*Word for word:* purushottama dekhibare — to see Purushottama; chalila yemate — how He set out; kahiba rahasya-katha — I shall tell the secret; grama remunate — at the village of Remuna

**119.** how He went to see Purushottama;
I shall tell the secret of the village of Remuna;

ক্রমে ক্রমে কহিব সে পথের চরিত ।
যাহা শুনি সর্বলোক পাইবে পিরীত ॥ ১২০ ॥

*krame krame kahiba se pathera carita |*
*yāhā śuni sarbaloka pāibe pirīta || 120 ||*

*Word for word:* krame krame — little by little; kahiba se pathera charita — I shall tell the events on the road; yaha shuni — hearing which; sarvaloka paibe pirita — all people will find love

**120.** little by little I shall tell of the events on the road —
hearing of them, all people will be filled with love;

যাজপুর যাইতে প্রভুর যে হৈল রহস্য ।
একাম্রনগর-কথা কহিব অবশ্য ॥ ১২১ ॥

*yājapura yāite prabhura ye haila rahasya |*
*ekāmranagara-kathā kahiba abaśya || 121 ||*

*Word for word:* yajapura yaite — on going to Jajpur; prabhura ye haila rahasya — the wonder (secret) that befell the Lord; ekamranagara-katha — the tale of the town of Ekamra; kahiba avashya — I shall surely tell

**121.** what wonder the Lord worked on coming to Jajpur —
I shall surely tell of the town of Ekamra too;

জগন্নাথ-সন্দর্শন হৈল যেনমতে ।
সার্বভৌমে প্রকাশ শুনিবে একচিতে ॥ ১২২ ॥

*jagannātha-sandarśana haila yenamate |*
*sārbabhaume prakāśa śunibe ekacite || 122 ||*

*Word for word:* jagannatha-sandarshana — the meeting with Jagannatha; haila yenamate — how it came about; sarvabhaume prakasha — the revelation to Sarvabhauma; shunibe eka-chite — you will hear with one mind

**122.** how the meeting with Jagannatha came about,
the revelation to Sarvabhauma — you will hear; listen with one mind.

মধ্যখণ্ড-কথা ভাই অমৃতের সার ।
শেষখণ্ড-কথা আছে কহি শুন আর ॥ ১২৩ ॥

*madhyakhaṇḍa-kathā bhāi amṛtera sāra |*
*śeṣakhaṇḍa-kathā āche kahi śuna āra || 123 ||*

*Word for word:* madhyakhanda-katha bhai — the tale of the Madhya-khanda, brothers; amritera sara — the essence of nectar; sheshakhanda-katha achhe — the tale of the Shesha-khanda remains; kahi — I shall tell; shuna ara — listen further

**123.** The tale of the Madhya-khanda, brothers, is the essence of nectar;
the tale of the Shesha-khanda remains — I shall tell it; hear further.

মধ্যখণ্ড সায় পুথে প্রেমার প্রকাশ ।
আনন্দ-হৃদয়ে কহে এ লোচনদাস ॥ ১২৪ ॥

*madhyakhaṇḍa sāẏa puthe premāra prakāśa |*
*ānanda-hṛdaẏe kahe e locanadāsa || 124 ||*

*Word for word:* madhyakhanda saya — the Madhya-khanda ends; puthe — in the book; premara prakasha — manifestation of prema; ananda-hridaye — with a jubilant heart; kahe e lochanadasa — says this Lochana Dasa

**124.** The Madhya-khanda in this book[^02-5] is the manifestation of prema —
so says Lochana Dasa with a jubilant heart.

*Raga dhanashi; taraja metre*

জয় রে জয় রে জয়, শ্রীকৃষ্ণচৈতন্য, আপনি অবনী অবতার ।
অহহ লোকের ভাগ্যে, পৃথিবী সোহাগ করে, শ্রীপদ যাহার অলঙ্কার ॥ ১২৫ ॥

*jaẏa re jaẏa re jaẏa, śrīkṛṣṇacaitanya, āpani abanī abatāra |*
*ahaha lokera bhāgye, pṛthibī sohāga kare, śrīpada yāhāra alaṅkāra || 125 ||*

*Word for word:* jaya re jaya re jaya — glory, glory, glory; sri-krishna-chaitanya — to Sri Krishna Chaitanya; apani avani avatara — Himself descended to earth; ahaha — ah; lokera bhagye — by people's fortune; prithivi sohaga kare — the earth glories (is cherished); sri-pada yahara alankara — whose ornament is the holy feet

**125.** Glory, glory, glory to Sri Krishna Chaitanya —
He Himself has descended to earth!
Ah, what fortune for the people! The earth is full of pride:
her ornament is His holy feet.

ত্রিজগত-দীপ, নবদ্বীপেরে উদয় কৈল, করুণা-কিরণ পরকাশে ।
অনেক দিনের যত, ভকত পিয়াসী ছিল, পাওল প্রেম-প্রতি-আশে ॥ ১২৬ ॥

*trijagata-dīpa, nabadbīpere udaẏa kaila, karuṇā-kiraṇa parakāśe |*
*aneka dinera yata, bhakata piẏāsī chila, pāola prema-prati-āśe || 126 ||*

*Word for word:* tri-jagata-dipa — the lamp of the three worlds; navadvipere udaya kaila — rose in Navadvipa; karuna-kirana parakashe — shining with rays of compassion; aneka dinera yata — for many days; bhakata piyasi chhila — devotees were thirsting; paola — obtained; prema-prati-ashe — the hope of prema

**126.** The lamp of the three worlds has risen in Navadvipa,
shining with rays of compassion;
the devotees who had thirsted for many days
have obtained [what they hoped for] — the hope of prema.

মধুময় কমলে যেন, ষট্পদ ভ্রমরা বুলে, যেন চন্দ্র-চকোরের মেলি ।
বরিষার মেঘ দেখি, চাতক ফুকারে যেন, পিউ পিউ ডাকে মাতোয়ালি ॥ ১২৭ ॥

*madhumaẏa kamale yena, ṣaṭpada bhramarā bule, yena candra-cakorera meli |*
*bariṣāra megha dekhi, cātaka phukāre yena, piu piu ḍāke mātoẏāli || 127 ||*

*Word for word:* madhumaya kamale yena — as at a honeyed lotus; shatpada bhramara bule — six-footed bees circle; yena chandra-chakorera meli — like the meeting of moon and chakora; varishara megha dekhi — seeing the rain-cloud; chataka phukare — the chataka cries; piu piu dake — calls "piu, piu"; matoyali — in rapture

**127.** Like six-footed bees circling a honeyed lotus,
like the meeting of moon and chakora,
like the chataka bird that, seeing a rain-cloud,
cries out in rapture: "Piu, piu!"

নাচয়ে ভাবুক ভোরা, প্রেম বরিষয়ে গোরা, হুঙ্কার গর্জন সিংহনাদে ।
অধনের ধন যেন, হারাঞা পাইঞা হেন, অনুগত আরতিয়া কান্দে ॥ ১২৮ ॥

*nācaẏe bhābuka bhorā, prema bariṣaẏe gorā, huṅkāra garjana siṃhanāde |*
*adhanera dhana yena, hārāñā pāiñā hena, anugata āratiẏā kānde || 128 ||*

*Word for word:* nachaye bhavuka bhora — the enraptured devotees dance; prema varishaye gora — Gora rains prema; hunkara garjana simhanade — hunkaras, roars, lion-cries; adhanera dhana yena — like a poor man's wealth; harana paina hena — lost and found again; anugata aratiya kande — the longing followers weep

**128.** The enraptured devotees dance, Gora rains down prema,
hunkaras thunder, roars, lion-like cries;
like a poor man who lost his wealth and has found it again —
so His followers weep in their longing.

বনের হাতিয়া যেন, বন-দাবানলে পড়ি, অমিয়া-সায়রে দিল ঝাঁপ ।
এছন প্রেমার রঙ্গে, অঙ্গ ডুবায়ল সঙ্গে, পাশরল পূরবের তাপ ॥ ১২৯ ॥

*banera hātiẏā yena, bana-dābānale paṛi, amiẏā-sāẏare dila jhāṁpa |*
*echana premāra raṅge, aṅga ḍubāẏala saṅge, pāśarala pūrabera tāpa || 129 ||*

*Word for word:* banera hatiya yena — like a forest elephant; bana-davanale padi — caught in a forest fire; amiya-sayare dila jhanpa — leapt into an ocean of nectar; echhana premara range — so in the play of prema; anga dubayala sange — plunged in wholly; pasharala puravera tapa — forgot the former burning

**129.** Like a forest elephant caught in a forest fire
that plunges into an ocean of nectar,
so in the play of prema they were immersed entirely
and forgot the former burning.

ভালি রে ঠাকুর বোলে, কেহো মালসাট মারে, প্রেমানন্দে আপনা পাশরে ।
যে প্রেম লখিমী মাগে, কর জুড়ি অনুরাগে, অবিচারে বিলায় সভারে ॥ ১৩০ ॥

*bhāli re ṭhākura bole, keho mālasāṭa māre, premānande āpanā pāśare |*
*ye prema lakhimī māge, kara juṛi anurāge, abicāre bilāẏa sabhāre || 130 ||*

*Word for word:* bhali re thakura bole — "Bravo, Thakura!" they cry; keho malasata mare — someone slaps his arms; premanande — in the bliss of prema; apana pashare — they forget themselves; ye prema lakhimi mage — the prema Lakshmi begs for; kara judi — joining palms; anurage — with ardent love; avichare — without discrimination; vilaya sabhare — He distributes to all

**130.** "Bravo, Thakura!" they cry; someone slaps his arms;
in the bliss of prema they forget themselves.
The prema that Lakshmi begs for with joined palms and ardent love,
He gives away to all without discrimination.

কি কহিব আর কথা, অনন্ত ভুলিল যথা, কিবা রস প্রেমার মাধুরী ।
শেষ বলিয়ে যারে, শিরে ধরে এ সংসারে, সে আজু নিতাই নাম ধরি ॥ ১৩১ ॥

*ki kahiba āra kathā, ananta bhulila yathā, kibā rasa premāra mādhurī |*
*śeṣa baliẏe yāre, śire dhare e saṃsāre, se āju nitāi nāma dhari || 131 ||*

*Word for word:* ki kahiba ara katha — what more shall I say; ananta bhulila yatha — where [even] Ananta forgot Himself; kiba rasa — what rasa; premara madhuri — the sweetness of prema; shesha baliye yare — He who is called Shesha; shire dhare e samsare — holds this world on His head; se aju nitai nama dhari — today bears the name Nitai

**131.** What more can I say? Even Ananta forgot where He was —
what rasa, what sweetness of prema!
He who is called Shesha, who holds the world upon His head,
now bears the name Nitai.

প্রেমরসে গরগর, না চিনে আপনা পর, সভারে বুঝায় এই কথা ।
পদতল-তাল-ভরে, ধরণী টলমল করে, যেন মদমত্ত হাতী মাতা ॥ ১৩২ ॥

*premarase garagara, nā cine āpanā para, sabhāre bujhāẏa ei kathā |*
*padatala-tāla-bhare, dharaṇī ṭalamala kare, yena madamatta hātī mātā || 132 ||*

*Word for word:* prema-rase garagara — brimming with the rasa of prema; na chine apana para — knows no own or other; sabhare bujhaya ei katha — He explains this to all; padatala-tala-bhare — under the measured tread of His feet; dharani talamala kare — the earth sways; yena mada-matta hati mata — like a maddened elephant in rut

**132.** Brimming with the rasa of prema, knowing no difference between own and other,
He explains this to all;
under the measured tread of His feet the earth sways,
as when a maddened elephant in rut goes by.

আর অপরূপ শুন, মহেশ অদ্বৈত নাম, যাঁর গুণগানে অগেয়ান ।
চৈতন্য-ঠাকুর-সনে, প্রেমরস-আলাপনে, পাশরিল এ যোগ গেয়ান ॥ ১৩৩ ॥

*āra aparūpa śuna, maheśa adbaita nāma, yāṁra guṇagāne ageẏāna |*
*caitanya-ṭhākura-sane, premarasa-ālāpane, pāśarila e yoga geẏāna || 133 ||*

*Word for word:* ara aparupa shuna — hear another wonder; mahesha advaita nama — Mahesha named Advaita; yanra guna-gane — in the singing of whose virtues; ageyana — beyond understanding; chaitanya-thakura-sane — with Thakura Chaitanya; prema-rasa-alapane — in talks of the rasa of prema; pasharila — forgot; e yoga geyana — yoga and knowledge

**133.** Hear of another wonder: Mahesha, named Advaita,[^02-6]
whose virtues, when sung, surpass understanding,
in His talks with Thakura Chaitanya on the rasa of prema
forgot His knowledge and His yoga.

রসিক সঙ্গীর সঙ্গে, প্রেমবিলাস-রঙ্গে, সভারে বুঝায় অবিরোধে ।
এ দুই ঠাকুর বহি, দয়ার ঠাকুর নাহি, যা লাগি উদয় গোরাচাঁদে ॥ ১৩৪ ॥

*rasika saṅgīra saṅge, premabilāsa-raṅge, sabhāre bujhāẏa abirodhe |*
*e dui ṭhākura bahi, daẏāra ṭhākura nāhi, yā lāgi udaẏa gorācāṁde || 134 ||*

*Word for word:* rasika sangira sange — with rasika companions; prema-vilasa-range — in the sport of love's pastimes; sabhare bujhaya avirodhe — they explain to all without dispute; e dui thakura bahi — apart from these two Thakuras; dayara thakura nahi — there is no Thakura of mercy; ya lagi — for whose sake; udaya gorachande — Gorachanda rose

**134.** With their rasika companions, in the sport of love's pastimes,
They explain everything to all without dispute;
apart from these two Thakuras there is no Thakura of mercy —
it is for Their sake that Gorachand rose.

জয় জয় মঙ্গল পড়ে, জগজনে হরি বলে, সভে করে প্রেম-প্রতি আশ ।
ব্রহ্মার দুর্লভ প্রেম, সভে অভিলাষী ইহা, হাসি কহে এ লোচনদাস ॥ ১৩৫ ॥

*jaẏa jaẏa maṅgala paṛe, jagajane hari bale, sabhe kare prema-prati āśa |*
*brahmāra durlabha prema, sabhe abhilāṣī ihā, hāsi kahe e locanadāsa || 135 ||*

*Word for word:* jaya jaya mangala pade — auspicious cries of "glory, glory" ring out; jagajane hari bale — the world's people say "Hari"; sabhe kare prema-prati asha — all hope for prema; brahmara durlabha prema — prema rare for Brahma; sabhe abhilashi iha — all long for it; hasi kahe — smiling, says; e lochanadasa — this Lochana Dasa

**135.** "Glory, glory!" — auspicious cries ring out, the people of the world say "Hari!",
all are hoping for prema;
prema, rare even for Brahma — all long for it —
so says Lochana Dasa, smiling.

## Grantharambha (The Narrative Begins)

> *Summary by Srila Bhaktisiddhanta Sarasvati.* At the beginning of the narrative the author, relying on the conversation of Narada and Uddhava from the *Jaimini-bharata*, which is related in the dialogue of Damodara and Murari, has set down the reason why Krishna descended in the form of Gaura.
>
> Once the devarshi Narada, grieved by the sufferings of the living beings stricken by Kali and pondering how to save them, resolved to move the protector of dharma, Bhagavan Sri Krishna, to descend into the mortal world, and set out for Dvaraka. Sri Krishna was then staying in the palace of Rukmini-devi. Rukmini-devi, having learned that Krishna, accepting the bhava of Radha, would descend in the form of Gaura, was in the greatest distress at the thought of the coming separation; she was glorifying His lotus feet and confiding her grief to Him when the devarshi Narada arrived. Received by Krishna with honour, he told the reason for his coming, and Krishna revealed to him that He would descend in the form of Gaura in the house of Shachi and Jagannatha at Navadvipa, and at once showed him His form as Gaura.
>
> Seeing the supremely lovely form of Gaura, the devarshi Narada, beside himself with rapture, went on from there meditating on the form of Gaura and singing the glory of Gaura, the essence of all avataras, and came to Naimisharanya. There the best of devotees, Uddhava, asked the great sage how the living beings stricken by Kali could be saved; the devarshi Narada told him all that had happened, sang the glory of the Kali-yuga, the essence of all yugas, and of the dharma of that age, the sankirtana of Hari-nama, and came to Kailasa, to the best of Vaishnavas, Shambhu. There Narada, wishing to remind Parvati of her former vow, [related]: how, learning of the greatness of mahaprasada, he served Lakshmi for twelve years to obtain it, and by her grace obtained mahaprasada and gave a portion to Shiva; how Shiva, having tasted the mahaprasada, broke into a wild dance; how the Earth, unable to bear Shiva's dance, came to Parvati; and then the greatness of mahaprasada and Parvati's vow to distribute mahaprasada to all living beings; and he sang much of the descent of Gaura.
>
> Then Narada came to Brahma and told of Gaurasundara's descent in the Kali-yuga. Brahma quoted and explained to Narada the verses of the *Srimad-Bhagavata* concerning this descent, supported the sense of these verses of the *Bhagavata* with the words of other scriptures, and said that at the time of Gaura's descent he himself would appear on earth with all the gods. Next comes the proposal of the gods to take birth in the mortal world; [the account of how] Krishna, accepting the bhava and lustre of Srimati Radhika, together with the special qualities of His eternal consorts Rukmini, Satyabhama and others, taking up the weapon of the sankirtana of the Name, descends as Gaura, Balarama as Nityananda, Shiva as Advaita Prabhu, and the other associates as Murari, Mukunda, Srinivasa, Raya Ramananda, Ishvara Puri, Madhava Puri; having described this, the author sang the glory of his guru Thakura Narahari and of his nephew Raghunandana and concluded the Sutra-khanda.[^02-7]

*Raga varadi; disha: "O, o! — Murchha: — I would die taking on myself every ill that threatens Gora,[^02-8] taking on myself the ills that threaten His beauty and His virtues! In rapture He gave away prema, filling the whole world"*

জয় জয় শ্রীকৃষ্ণচৈতন্য নিত্যানন্দ ।
জয় জয় অদ্বৈত-আচার্য সুখানন্দ ॥ ১ ॥

*jaẏa jaẏa śrīkṛṣṇacaitanya nityānanda |*
*jaẏa jaẏa adbaita-ācārya sukhānanda || 1 ||*

*Word for word:* jaya jaya — glory, glory; sri-krishna-chaitanya nityananda — to Sri Krishna Chaitanya and Nityananda; advaita-acharya — to Advaita Acharya; sukhananda — full of bliss

**1.** Glory, glory to Sri Krishna Chaitanya and Nityananda,
glory, glory to Advaita Acharya, full of bliss!

গদাধর-প্রাণ জয় জয় নরহরি ।
জয় জয় শ্রীনিবাস ভক্তি-অধিকারী ॥ ২ ॥

*gadādhara-prāṇa jaẏa jaẏa narahari |*
*jaẏa jaẏa śrīnibāsa bhakti-adhikārī || 2 ||*

*Word for word:* gadadhara-prana — the life of Gadadhara; jaya jaya narahari — glory, glory to Narahari; shrinivasa — to Srinivasa; bhakti-adhikari — worthy of bhakti

**2.** Glory, glory to Narahari, [dear as] life to Gadadhara,[^02-9]
glory, glory to Srinivasa, worthy of bhakti!

চৈতন্য-গোসাঞির যত প্রিয় ভক্তগণ ।
সভার চরণ হৃদে করিয়ে বন্দন ॥ ৩ ॥

*caitanya-gosāñira yata priẏa bhaktagaṇa |*
*sabhāra caraṇa hṛde kariẏe bandana || 3 ||*

*Word for word:* chaitanya-gosanira — of Chaitanya Gosani; yata priya bhakta-gana — all the beloved devotees; sabhara charana — the feet of all; hride — in the heart; kariye bandana — I praise

**3.** All the beloved devotees of Chaitanya Gosani —
the feet of them all, [holding them] in my heart, I praise.

কহিব চৈতন্যকথা শুন সাবধানে ।
দামোদর-পণ্ডিত পুছিলা গুপ্ত-স্থানে ॥ ৪ ॥

*kahiba caitanyakathā śuna sābadhāne |*
*dāmodara-paṇḍita puchilā gupta-sthāne || 4 ||*

*Word for word:* kahiba chaitanya-katha — I shall tell of Chaitanya; shuna savadhane — listen attentively; damodara-pandita — Damodara Pandita; puchhila gupta-sthane — asked of Gupta

**4.** I shall tell of Chaitanya — listen attentively:
Damodara Pandita asked Gupta:[^02-10]

কহ শুনি কি লাগি গৌরাঙ্গ-অবতার ।
শুনিতে আনন্দ মনে হইছে আমার ॥ ৫ ॥

*kaha śuni ki lāgi gaurāṅga-abatāra |*
*śunite ānanda mane haiche āmāra || 5 ||*

*Word for word:* kaha shuni — tell, I shall hear; ki lagi — for what reason; gauranga-avatara — the descent of Gauranga; shunite — in hearing; ananda mane haichhe amara — joy arises in my heart

**5.** "Tell me, and I shall listen: for what reason did Gauranga appear?
To hear of it is a joy to my heart.

কেনে শ্যামবর্ণ ত্যজি হৈলা গৌরতনু ।
কেনে বা কীর্তনে লুটি গায় মাখে রেণু ॥ ৬ ॥

*kene śyāmabarṇa tyaji hailā gauratanu |*
*kene bā kīrtane luṭi gāẏa mākhe reṇu || 6 ||*

*Word for word:* kene — why; shyama-varna tyaji — leaving the dark colour; haila gaura-tanu — became golden of body; kene ba — why; kirtane luti — rolling in kirtana; gaya makhe renu — smears dust on His body

**6.** Why did He leave His dark colour and become Gaura?
Why in kirtana does He roll on the ground and cover His body with dust?

কেনে বা নাগর-বেশ ছাড়িয়া সন্ন্যাস ।
কেনে দেশে দেশে বুলে হইয়া হতাশ ॥ ৭ ॥

*kene bā nāgara-beśa chāṛiẏā sannyāsa |*
*kene deśe deśe bule haiẏā hatāśa || 7 ||*

*Word for word:* kene ba — why; nagara-vesha chhadiya — leaving the nagara's dress; sannyasa — sannyasa; kene deshe deshe bule — why He wanders land to land; haiya hatasha — as if in despair

**7.** Why did He exchange the dress of a *nagara*[^02-11] for sannyasa?
Why does He wander from land to land as though in despair?

কেনে কান্দে রাধা রাধা গোবিন্দ বলিয়া ।
ঘরে ঘরে বুলে কেনে প্রেম যাচাইয়া ॥ ৮ ॥

*kene kānde rādhā rādhā gobinda baliẏā |*
*ghare ghare bule kene prema yācāiẏā || 8 ||*

*Word for word:* kene kande — why He weeps; radha radha govinda baliya — calling "Radha, Radha, Govinda"; ghare ghare bule kene — why He goes from house to house; prema yachaiya — offering prema

**8.** Why does He weep, calling out, 'Radha! Radha! Govinda!'?
Why does He go from house to house offering prema?

কহিবে সকল কথা পরম নিগূঢ় ।
যা শুনিলে ত্রাণ পায় অখিলের মূঢ় ॥ ৯ ॥

*kahibe sakala kathā parama nigūṛha |*
*yā śunile trāṇa pāẏa akhilera mūṛha || 9 ||*

*Word for word:* kahibe — please tell; sakala katha — all this; parama nigudha — the deepest secret; ya shunile — hearing which; trana paya — are saved; akhilera mudha — the most foolish of all

**9.** Tell me all this — the deepest secret,
hearing which even the most foolish of fools are saved."

শুনিয়া মুরারি কহে শুনহ পণ্ডিত ।
এই সব তত্ত্ব তোমা করিব বিদিত ॥ ১০ ॥

*śuniẏā murāri kahe śunaha paṇḍita |*
*ei saba tattba tomā kariba bidita || 10 ||*

*Word for word:* shuniya — having heard; murari kahe — Murari says; shunaha pandita — listen, Pandita; ei saba tattva — all this truth; toma kariba vidita — I shall make known to you

**10.** Having heard, Murari says: "Listen, Pandita;
all this truth I will reveal to you.

সত্যযুগে চারি অংশ ধর্ম শাস্ত্রে কহে ।
ত্রেতাতে ত্রিভাগ ধর্ম কহিয়ে তোমারে ॥ ১১ ॥

*satyayuge cāri aṃśa dharma śāstre kahe |*
*tretāte tribhāga dharma kahiẏe tomāre || 11 ||*

*Word for word:* satya-yuge — in the Satya-yuga; chari amsha dharma — four quarters of dharma; shastre kahe — the shastras say; tretate — in the Treta; tribhaga dharma — three quarters of dharma; kahiye tomare — I tell you

**11.** In the Satya-yuga dharma has four quarters — so say the shastras;
in the Treta-yuga, I tell you, dharma has three quarters;

দ্বাপরে অর্ধেক ধর্ম কহিয়ে তোমারে ।
কলিযুগে এক অংশ ধর্মের বিচারে ॥ ১২ ॥

*dbāpare ardheka dharma kahiẏe tomāre |*
*kaliyuge eka aṃśa dharmera bicāre || 12 ||*

*Word for word:* dvapare — in the Dvapara; ardheka dharma — half of dharma; kahiye tomare — I tell you; kali-yuge eka amsha — in the Kali-yuga one quarter; dharmera vichare — by the reckoning of dharma

**12.** in the Dvapara-yuga, I tell you, dharma is half;
in the Kali-yuga, by the reckoning of dharma, one quarter.

অধর্ম বাড়িল ধর্ম হইল যে ক্ষীণ ।
স্বধর্ম ছাড়িল বর্ণ-আশ্রম-বিহীন ॥ ১৩ ॥

*adharma bāṛila dharma haila ye kṣīṇa |*
*sbadharma chāṛila barṇa-āśrama-bihīna || 13 ||*

*Word for word:* adharma badila — adharma grew; dharma haila ye kshina — dharma became weak; svadharma chhadila — they abandoned their duty; varna-ashrama-vihina — without varnas and ashramas

**13.** Adharma grew, dharma dwindled;
[people] abandoned their own duty; there are neither varnas nor ashramas.

পাপময় ঘোর আন্ধিয়ার হৈল কলি ।
মজিল সকল লোক অধর্ম-বিকলি ॥ ১৪ ॥

*pāpamaẏa ghora āndhiẏāra haila kali |*
*majila sakala loka adharma-bikali || 14 ||*

*Word for word:* papamaya — sinful; ghora andhiyara — dense darkness; haila kali — Kali became; majila sakala loka — all people sank; adharma-vikali — crippled by adharma

**14.** Kali became a sinful, impenetrable darkness;
all people sank, crippled by adharma.

ধর্মহীন দেখিয়া নারদ মহামুনি ।
কলি তরিবারে দয়া করিলা আপনি ॥ ১৫ ॥

*dharmahīna dekhiẏā nārada mahāmuni |*
*kali taribāre daẏā karilā āpani || 15 ||*

*Word for word:* dharma-hina dekhiya — seeing [the world] without dharma; narada mahamuni — the great sage Narada; kali taribare — to deliver Kali; daya karila apani — himself showed compassion

**15.** Seeing that there was no dharma, the great sage Narada
was himself moved to compassion, [wishing] to save [the people of] Kali.

ভাবিলেন কলিসর্প গিলিল সভারে ।
মনে হৈল ধর্ম সংস্থাপন করিবারে ॥ ১৬ ॥

*bhābilena kalisarpa gilila sabhāre |*
*mane haila dharma saṃsthāpana karibāre || 16 ||*

*Word for word:* bhavilena — he thought; kali-sarpa gilila sabhare — the serpent Kali has swallowed all; mane haila — it came to his mind; dharma samsthapana karibare — to establish dharma

**16.** He thought: 'The serpent Kali has swallowed everyone,'
and he wished to establish dharma:

কৃষ্ণ বিনু ধর্ম কেহো না পারে স্থাপিতে ।
অবশ্য আনিব কৃষ্ণ কলিতে ত্বরিতে ॥ ১৭ ॥

*kṛṣṇa binu dharma keho nā pāre sthāpite |*
*abaśya āniba kṛṣṇa kalite tbarite || 17 ||*

*Word for word:* krishna vinu — without Krishna; dharma keho na pare sthapite — no one can establish dharma; avashya aniba krishna — I shall surely bring Krishna; kalite tvarite — into Kali quickly

**17.** 'Without Krishna no one can establish dharma;
I shall surely bring Krishna into Kali, and quickly.

ভক্ত-ইচ্ছা গোবিন্দের হয় সর্বকাল ।
বেদাগমশাস্ত্রে ইহা আছয়ে বিচার ॥ ১৮ ॥

*bhakta-icchā gobindera haẏa sarbakāla |*
*bedāgamaśāstre ihā āchaẏe bicāra || 18 ||*

*Word for word:* bhakta-ichchha — the devotee's wish; govindera haya sarvakala — is always Govinda's; vedagama-shastre — in the Vedas, agamas and shastras; iha achhaye vichara — this is the conclusion

**18.** The devotee's wish is ever Govinda's wish:
such is the conclusion of the Vedas, agamas and shastras.

যদি কৃষ্ণদাস মুঞি হঙ সর্বথায় ।
কলিতে আনিব তবে প্রভু যদুরায় ॥ ১৯ ॥

*yadi kṛṣṇadāsa muñi haṅa sarbathāẏa |*
*kalite āniba tabe prabhu yadurāẏa || 19 ||*

*Word for word:* yadi — if; krishna-dasa muni hau — I am Krishna's servant; sarvathaya — in every way; kalite aniba tabe — then I shall bring into Kali; prabhu yaduraya — the Lord, king of the Yadus

**19.** If I am in every way a servant of Krishna,
I shall bring into Kali the Lord, the king of the Yadus.

দেখোঁ আগে কলিযুগ করে কোন্ কর্ম ।
তবে সে আনিব কৃষ্ণ সর্বময় ধর্ম ॥ ২০ ॥

*dekhoṁ āge kaliyuga kare kon karma |*
*tabe se āniba kṛṣṇa sarbamaẏa dharma || 20 ||*

*Word for word:* dekho age — let me first see; kali-yuga kare kon karma — what deeds the Kali-yuga does; tabe se aniba krishna — then I shall bring Krishna; sarvamaya dharma — the all-embracing dharma

**20.** Let me first see what the Kali-yuga does,
and then I shall bring Krishna, the all-embracing dharma.

আনিব সকল দেব তাঁহার সঙ্গে ।
অস্ত্র-পারিষদ-আদি সকল সাঙ্গোপাঙ্গে ॥ ২১ ॥

*āniba sakala deba tāṁhāra saṅge |*
*astra-pāriṣada-ādi sakala sāṅgopāṅge || 21 ||*

*Word for word:* aniba sakala deva — I shall bring all the gods; tanhara sange — with Him; astra-parishada-adi — weapons, associates and others; sakala sangopange — all intimates and retinue

**21.** I shall bring all the gods with Him —
His weapons, His associates, all His intimates and retinue.'

ব্রহ্মা আদি দেবগণ নারদাদি মুনি ।
পৃথিবীতে জনম লৈলা দেবী কাত্যায়নী ॥ ২২ ॥

*brahmā ādi debagaṇa nāradādi muni |*
*pṛthibīte janama lailā debī kātyāẏanī || 22 ||*

*Word for word:* brahma adi deva-gana — Brahma and the other gods; naradadi muni — Narada and the other sages; prithivite janama laila — took birth on earth; devi katyayani — the goddess Katyayani

**22.** Brahma and the other gods, Narada and the other sages,
the goddess Katyayani took birth on earth;[^02-12]

দ্বারকায় আর যত ছিল যদুবংশে ।
পৃথিবীতে জনম লৈল নিজ নিজ অংশে ॥ ২৩ ॥

*dbārakāẏa āra yata chila yadubaṃśe |*
*pṛthibīte janama laila nija nija aṃśe || 23 ||*

*Word for word:* dvarakaya — in Dvaraka; ara yata chhila yaduvamshe — and all who were of the Yadu line; prithivite janama laila — took birth on earth; nija nija amshe — each by his own portion

**23.** all who were in Dvaraka, in the line of Yadu,
took birth on earth, each by his own portion.

কহিব সকল কথা শুন সাবধানে ।
পৃথিবীতে অবতার হইল যেমনে ॥ ২৪ ॥

*kahiba sakala kathā śuna sābadhāne |*
*pṛthibīte abatāra haila yemane || 24 ||*

*Word for word:* kahiba sakala katha — I shall tell it all; shuna savadhane — listen attentively; prithivite avatara — the descent upon earth; haila yemane — how it came about

**24.** I shall tell it all — listen attentively —
how the descent upon earth came about.

সব অবতার-সার গোরা-অবতার ।
এমন করুণা কভু নাহি হয় আর ॥ ২৫ ॥

*saba abatāra-sāra gorā-abatāra |*
*emana karuṇā kabhu nāhi haẏa āra || 25 ||*

*Word for word:* saba avatara-sara — the essence of all descents; gora-avatara — the descent of Gora; emana karuna — such compassion; kabhu nahi haya ara — never was before

**25.** The descent of Gora is the essence of all descents:
such compassion never was before.

পরদুঃখে দুঃখিত নারদ মহামুনি ।
কৃষ্ণকথা-রস-গান দিবস-রজনী ॥ ২৬ ॥

*paraduḥkhe duḥkhita nārada mahāmuni |*
*kṛṣṇakathā-rasa-gāna dibasa-rajanī || 26 ||*

*Word for word:* para-duhkhe duhkhita — grieved by others' sorrow; narada mahamuni — the great sage Narada; krishna-katha-rasa-gana — singing the rasa of Krishna's tales; dibasa-rajani — day and night

**26.** The great sage Narada, grieved by the sorrow of others,
sings day and night the rasa of the tales of Krishna.

কৃষ্ণকথা-লোভে বুলে সংসার ভ্রমিয়া ।
না শুনিল কৃষ্ণনাম সংসার চাহিয়া ॥ ২৭ ॥

*kṛṣṇakathā-lobhe bule saṃsāra bhramiẏā |*
*nā śunila kṛṣṇanāma saṃsāra cāhiẏā || 27 ||*

*Word for word:* krishna-katha-lobhe — greedy for Krishna's tales; bule samsara bhramiya — he roams the whole world; na shunila krishna-nama — he did not hear Krishna's name; samsara chahiya — looking over the world

**27.** Thirsting for tales of Krishna, he roams the whole world,
but, looking over the world, he did not hear the name of Krishna.

কৃষ্ণরসে গদগদ আধ আধ ভাষ ।
ক্ষণেক রোদন ক্ষণে অট্ট অট্ট হাস ॥ ২৮ ॥

*kṛṣṇarase gadagada ādha ādha bhāṣa |*
*kṣaṇeka rodana kṣaṇe aṭṭa aṭṭa hāsa || 28 ||*

*Word for word:* krishna-rase gadagada — choking with Krishna's rasa; adha adha bhasha — half-words; kshaneka rodana — now weeping; kshane atta atta hasa — now loud laughter

**28.** Choking with the rasa of Krishna, he babbles in half-words,
now weeping, now laughing aloud;

বীণা-সনে গুণ গায় ঝরে আঁখি-নীর ।
কৃষ্ণরসাবেশ মুনির অন্তর-বাহির ॥ ২৯ ॥

*bīṇā-sane guṇa gāẏa jhare āṁkhi-nīra |*
*kṛṣṇarasābeśa munira antara-bāhira || 29 ||*

*Word for word:* vina-sane — with the vina; guna gaya — he sings the virtues; jhare ankhi-nira — tears stream from the eyes; krishna-rasavesha — absorption in Krishna's rasa; munira antara-bahira — the sage's inside and outside

**29.** he sings [Krishna's] virtues to the vina, tears stream from his eyes:
within and without, the sage is absorbed in the rasa of Krishna.

এছন প্রেমার রঙ্গে অঙ্গ গড়াইয়া ।
না শুনিল কৃষ্ণনাম সংসার ঘুরিয়া ॥ ৩০ ॥

*echana premāra raṅge aṅga gaṛāiẏā |*
*nā śunila kṛṣṇanāma saṃsāra ghuriẏā || 30 ||*

*Word for word:* echhana premara range — in such play of prema; anga gadaiya — rolling his body; na shunila krishna-nama — he did not hear Krishna's name; samsara ghuriya — going round the world

**30.** In such play of prema, rolling on the ground,
he did not hear the name of Krishna, though he went round the world.

অন্তরে দুঃখিত মুনি বিস্মিত হিয়ায় ।
লোক-নিস্তারণ-হেতু না দেখি উপায় ॥ ৩১ ॥

*antare duḥkhita muni bismita hiẏāẏa |*
*loka-nistāraṇa-hetu nā dekhi upāẏa || 31 ||*

*Word for word:* antare duhkhita muni — the sage pained at heart; vismita hiyaya — amazed in mind; loka-nistarana-hetu — for the deliverance of people; na dekhi upaya — sees no means

**31.** Pained at heart, the sage was amazed:
he sees no way to save the people.

দংশিল সকল লোকে কলি-কালসর্পে ।
নিরন্তর দগধ মুগধ মায়া-দর্পে ॥ ৩২ ॥

*daṃśila sakala loke kali-kālasarpe |*
*nirantara dagadha mugadha māẏā-darpe || 32 ||*

*Word for word:* damshila sakala loke — has bitten all people; kali-kalasarpe — the black serpent Kali; nirantara dagadha — ever burning; mugadha — bewildered; maya-darpe — by the pride of maya

**32.** The black serpent Kali has bitten all people:
they burn unceasingly, blinded by the pride of maya.

[^02-1]: The Adi-khanda tells of the goddess Ganga's love for the young Nimai (so in Bhaktisiddhanta's survey of the parts and in the 1983 edition).
[^02-2]: So in Bhaktisiddhanta's text (A: "prabhura prana"); the 1983 edition has "by the Lord's grace".
[^02-3]: In the Madhya-khanda — the curse a brahmana pronounced upon the Lord (see Bhaktisiddhanta's summary of that chapter).
[^02-4]: Advaita Acharya's, at Shantipur.
[^02-5]: Literally "The Madhya-khanda ends: in the book, the manifestation of prema." Contrary to expectation, nothing is said here of the contents of the Shesha-khanda: Lochana Dasa only promises to tell of it; the meeting with Sarvabhauma he still assigns to the Madhya-khanda.
[^02-6]: Mahesha is Shiva. According to the *Gaura-ganoddesha-dipika* and the *Chaitanya-charitamrita* (Adi 6), Advaita Acharya is Maha-Vishnu, non-different from Hari, and at the same time Sadashiva; Lochana Dasa names here only the second aspect.
[^02-7]: The summary covers the whole section "Grantharambha" to the end of the Sutra-khanda (portions 02–08 of our translation). A few words are corrupt in the OCR and have been restored from the same summary in the *Khanda-vivarana* at the beginning of the edition.
[^02-8]: *Nichhani* is the rite in which one waves something around a beloved person to "take off" all harm and take it upon oneself; *balai laya*, "I take your ill upon myself", is an expression of tender love.
[^02-9]: So in Bhaktisiddhanta's text (A: "gadadhara-prana"); the 1983 edition has "Glory to Gadadhara Pandita, glory to Narahari".
[^02-10]: The 1983 edition has two couplets here instead of this one (a different redaction): "I shall tell of Chaitanya — listen attentively — how He descended in the age of Kali. Murari Gupta, the vaidya, knows the truth about the Lord; Pandita Damodara asked him." A (and the 1903 edition) has a single couplet coinciding with the first and last lines of B; we follow A.
[^02-11]: *Nagara*, an elegant townsman; here the fine dress of a fashionable householder that the Lord wore in His youth, as opposed to the garb of a sannyasi.
[^02-12]: In Bhaktisiddhanta's edition (A) couplets 22–23 are already narrative ("took birth"); in the 1983 edition they continue Narada's thought ("will take birth on earth"), and instead of "Narada and the other sages" it has "Sanaka and the other sages".

---

# Sutra-khanda, part 3 (portion 03)

*Narada comes to Dvaraka; Rukmini washes Krishna's feet and weeps, glorifying the greatness of His feet and the love of Radha; Krishna resolves to taste prema and to appear in the Kali-yuga, and reveals to Narada His form as Gaura; at Naimisharanya Narada tells everything to Uddhava*

শিশ্নোদরপরায়ণ জগত ভরিয়া ।
মূর্চ্ছিত সকল লোক কৃষ্ণ পাশরিয়া ॥ ৩৩ ॥

*śiśnodaraparāẏaṇa jagata bhariẏā |*
*mūrcchita sakala loka kṛṣṇa pāśariẏā || 33 ||*

*Word for word:* shishnodara-parayana — devoted to belly and genitals; jagata bhariya — filling the world; murchchhita sakala loka — all people senseless; krishna pashariya — having forgotten Krishna

**33.** The world is full of those who live only for belly and lust;
all people lie senseless, having forgotten Krishna.

লোভ মোহ কাম ক্রোধ মদ অভিমানে ।
নিরন্তর সিঞ্চে হিয়া অমিয়া-সেচনে ॥ ৩৪ ॥

*lobha moha kāma krodha mada abhimāne |*
*nirantara siñce hiẏā amiẏā-secane || 34 ||*

*Word for word:* lobha moha kama krodha mada abhimane — with greed, delusion, lust, anger, intoxication, pride; nirantara sinche hiya — they ceaselessly sprinkle the heart; amiya-sechane — as with a sprinkling of nectar

**34.** With greed, delusion, lust, anger, intoxication and pride
they ceaselessly sprinkle their hearts as though with nectar.[^03-1]

এ আমি আমার বলি মরে অকারণে ।
কে আপনি কে আপনা কিছুই না জানে ॥ ৩৫ ॥

*e āmi āmāra bali mare akāraṇe |*
*ke āpani ke āpanā kichui nā jāne || 35 ||*

*Word for word:* e ami amara bali — saying "I" and "mine"; mare akarane — they perish for nothing; ke apani — who oneself is; ke apana — what is one's own; kichhui na jane — they know nothing

**35.** Saying "I" and "mine", they perish for nothing;
who they themselves are, what is their own — they know nothing.

হেন লোকের দুঃখ দেখি মহামুনি ।
অন্তরে চিন্তিত হঞা মনে মনে গুণি ॥ ৩৬ ॥

*hena lokera duḥkha dekhi mahāmuni |*
*antare cintita hañā mane mane guṇi || 36 ||*

*Word for word:* hena lokera duhkha dekhi — seeing such sorrow of the people; mahamuni — the great sage; antare chintita haina — troubled at heart; mane mane guni — pondering within

**36.** Seeing such sorrow of the people, the great sage
grew anxious at heart and pondered within himself.

ঘোর কলিকালে লোকের না দেখি নিস্তার ।
ভ্রমিতে ভ্রমিতে গেলা দ্বারকার দ্বার ॥ ৩৭ ॥

*ghora kalikāle lokera nā dekhi nistāra |*
*bhramite bhramite gelā dbārakāra dbāra || 37 ||*

*Word for word:* ghora kali-kale — in the terrible age of Kali; lokera na dekhi nistara — seeing no deliverance for people; bhramite bhramite — wandering on; gela dvarakara dvara — he went to the gates of Dvaraka

**37.** Seeing no deliverance for people in the terrible age of Kali,
wandering on, he came to the gates of Dvaraka.

দ্বারকার ঠাকুর দেব-দেব-শিরোমণি ।
সত্যভামা-গৃহে সুখে বঞ্চিয়া রজনী ॥ ৩৮ ॥

*dbārakāra ṭhākura deba-deba-śiromaṇi |*
*satyabhāmā-gṛhe sukhe bañciẏā rajanī || 38 ||*

*Word for word:* dvarakara thakura — the Thakura of Dvaraka; deva-deva-shiromani — crest-jewel of the God of gods; satyabhama-grihe — in Satyabhama's apartments; sukhe vanchiya rajani — having happily spent the night

**38.** The Thakura of Dvaraka, God of gods, the crest-jewel of all,[^03-2]
had happily passed the night in the apartments of Satyabhama;

প্রভাতে উঠিয়া কৈলা যে বিধি উচিত ।
রুক্মিণীর ঘরে যাব করিলা ইঙ্গিত ॥ ৩৯ ॥

*prabhāte uṭhiẏā kailā ye bidhi ucita |*
*rukmiṇīra ghare yāba karilā iṅgita || 39 ||*

*Word for word:* prabhate uthiya — rising in the morning; kaila ye vidhi uchita — did what was fitting; rukminira ghare yaba — "I shall go to Rukmini's apartments"; karila ingita — He signalled

**39.** rising in the morning, He did all that was fitting
and let it be known that He would go to Rukmini's apartments.

বুঝিয়া রুক্মিণীদেবী আপনা-মঙ্গল ।
ধরিতে না পারে অঙ্গ করে টলমল ॥ ৪০ ॥

*bujhiẏā rukmiṇīdebī āpanā-maṅgala |*
*dharite nā pāre aṅga kare ṭalamala || 40 ||*

*Word for word:* bujhiya — understanding; rukmini-devi — Rukmini-devi; apana-mangala — her good fortune; dharite na pare — cannot contain [herself]; anga kare talamala — her body trembles

**40.** Realizing what good fortune had come to her, Rukmini-devi
cannot contain herself — her body trembles.

গৃহ সম্মার্জন করে অঙ্গের সুবেশ ।
নানাবিধ বাদ্য বাজে আনন্দ অশেষ ॥ ৪১ ॥

*gṛha sammārjana kare aṅgera subeśa |*
*nānābidha bādya bāje ānanda aśeṣa || 41 ||*

*Word for word:* griha sammarjana kare — she cleans the house; angera suvesha — adorns her body; nanavidha vadya baje — many instruments play; ananda ashesha — endless joy

**41.** She cleans the house, adorns herself;
instruments of many kinds are playing — joy without end;

সুমঙ্গল পূর্ণঘট ঘৃত-বাতি জ্বলে ।
প্রভু শুভ আগমন কৈলা হেনকালে ॥ ৪২ ॥

*sumaṅgala pūrṇaghaṭa ghṛta-bāti jbale |*
*prabhu śubha āgamana kailā henakāle || 42 ||*

*Word for word:* sumangala purna-ghata — auspicious full jars; ghrita-bati jvale — ghee lamps burn; prabhu shubha agamana kaila — the Lord graciously arrived; henakale — at that time

**42.** auspicious jars full of water, lamps of ghee burning —
and at that time the Lord graciously arrived.

মিত্রবিন্দা নগ্নজিতা সুশীলা সুবালা ।
প্রভু নির্মঞ্ছন করে আনন্দে বিহ্বলা ॥ ৪৩ ॥

*mitrabindā nagnajitā suśīlā subālā |*
*prabhu nirmañchana kare ānande bihbalā || 43 ||*

*Word for word:* mitravinda nagnajita sushila subala — Mitravinda, Nagnajiti, Sushila, Subala; prabhu nirmanchhana kare — perform nirmanchhana for the Lord; anande vihvala — overwhelmed with joy

**43.** Mitravinda, Nagnajiti, Sushila, Subala[^03-3]
in bliss wave [lamps] around the Lord.[^03-4]

সুবাসিত গন্ধজল প্রভু-কাছে আনি ।
পাদ প্রক্ষালন করে দেবী শ্রীরুক্মিণী ॥ ৪৪ ॥

*subāsita gandhajala prabhu-kāche āni |*
*pāda prakṣālana kare debī śrīrukmiṇī || 44 ||*

*Word for word:* suvasita gandha-jala — fragrant scented water; prabhu-kachhe ani — bringing to the Lord; pada prakshalana kare — washes the feet; devi sri-rukmini — the goddess Sri Rukmini

**44.** Bringing fragrant water to the Lord,
Sri Rukmini washes His feet.

আপন-সম্পদ-পদ ধরি নিজ-বুকে ।
অনুরাগে নেহারই ক্ষণে দেই মুখে ॥ ৪৫ ॥

*āpana-sampada-pada dhari nija-buke |*
*anurāge nehārai kṣaṇe dei mukhe || 45 ||*

*Word for word:* apana-sampada-pada — the feet, her own treasure; dhari nija-buke — holding to her breast; anurage neharai — gazes with love; kshane dei mukhe — now presses them to her face

**45.** Holding the feet, her own treasure, to her breast,
she gazes [at them] with love, now presses them to her face.

হৃদয়ে শ্রীপদ ধরি কান্দয়ে রুক্মিণী ।
বিস্মিত হইয়া কিছু পুছে চক্রপাণি ॥ ৪৬ ॥

*hṛdaẏe śrīpada dhari kāndaẏe rukmiṇī |*
*bismita haiẏā kichu puche cakrapāṇi || 46 ||*

*Word for word:* hridaye sri-pada dhari — holding the holy feet to her heart; kandaye rukmini — Rukmini weeps; vismita haiya — amazed; kichhu puchhe — asks; chakrapani — the Holder of the Discus

**46.** Pressing the holy feet to her heart, Rukmini weeps;
amazed, the Holder of the Discus asks:

কান্দনার হেতু কিছু না বুঝি তোমার ।
কি লাগি কান্দহ দেবি কহ সমাচার ॥ ৪৭ ॥

*kāndanāra hetu kichu nā bujhi tomāra |*
*ki lāgi kāndaha debi kaha samācāra || 47 ||*

*Word for word:* kandanara hetu — the reason for weeping; kichhu na bujhi tomara — I cannot understand yours; ki lagi kandaha — why do you weep; devi — goddess; kaha samachara — tell what happened

**47.** "I cannot understand why you weep;
what are you weeping for, goddess? Tell Me what has happened.

তুমি প্রাণাধিকা মোর জগজনে জানি ।
তোমার অধিক কেবা কহ ত আপনি ॥ ৪৮ ॥

*tumi prāṇādhikā mora jagajane jāni |*
*tomāra adhika kebā kaha ta āpani || 48 ||*

*Word for word:* tumi pranadhika mora — you are dearer to Me than life; jagajane jani — the world's people know it; tomara adhika keba — who is dearer than you; kaha ta apani — tell Me yourself

**48.** You are dearer to Me than life — the whole world knows it;
who is dearer to Me than you? — tell Me yourself.

কিবা অবজ্ঞায় তোর আজ্ঞা না পালিল ।
স্বরূপে কহ না দেবি কি দোষ করিল ॥ ৪৯ ॥

*kibā abajñāẏa tora ājñā nā pālila |*
*sbarūpe kaha nā debi ki doṣa karila || 49 ||*

*Word for word:* kiba avajnaya — perhaps out of neglect; tora ajna na palila — [someone] did not carry out your order; svarupe kaha na — tell plainly; devi — goddess; ki dosha karila — what wrong was done

**49.** Has someone, out of neglect, failed to carry out your order?
Tell Me plainly, goddess, who has done wrong?

একমাত্র পুরুবে যে পরিহাস কৈল ।
আজিহ অন্তরে তোর সে দুঃখ আছিল ॥ ৫০ ॥

*ekamātra purube ye parihāsa kaila |*
*ājiha antare tora se duḥkha āchila || 50 ||*

*Word for word:* ekamatra purube — only once before; ye parihasa kaila — that I jested; ajiha antare tora — even today in your heart; se duhkha achhila — that grief remained

**50.** Only once before did I tease you[^03-5] —
is that grievance still in your heart today?

কত বা মিনতি কৈল কাতর হইয়া ।
তভু না ঘুচিল তোর এ কঠিন হিয়া ॥ ৫১ ॥

*kata bā minati kaila kātara haiẏā |*
*tabhu nā ghucila tora e kaṭhina hiẏā || 51 ||*

*Word for word:* kata ba minati kaila — how much I pleaded; katara haiya — piteously; tabhu na ghuchila — still did not yield; tora e kathina hiya — this hard heart of yours

**51.** How much I pleaded with you then, humbly and piteously —
and still your hard heart did not soften."

এছন নিঠুর বাণী প্রভু-মুখে শুনি ।
সরস সম্ভাষে কিছু কহয়ে রুক্মিণী ॥ ৫২ ॥

*echana niṭhura bāṇī prabhu-mukhe śuni |*
*sarasa sambhāṣe kichu kahaẏe rukmiṇī || 52 ||*

*Word for word:* echhana nithura vani — such pitiless words; prabhu-mukhe shuni — hearing from the Lord's mouth; sarasa sambhashe — with tender speech; kichhu kahaye rukmini — Rukmini answers

**52.** Hearing such pitiless words from the Lord's mouth,
Rukmini answers tenderly, with a gentle reproach:

অন্তর কঠিন মোর কভু নহে জ্ঞান ।
এক মহাভাগ্য সবে তুমি মোর প্রাণ ॥ ৫৩ ॥

*antara kaṭhina mora kabhu nahe jñāna |*
*eka mahābhāgya sabe tumi mora prāṇa || 53 ||*

*Word for word:* antara kathina mora — my heart is hard; kabhu nahe jnana — I have no understanding; eka mahabhagya sabe — one great fortune only; tumi mora prana — You are my life

**53.** "My heart is hard; I cannot understand [Your words];
I have but one great good fortune — You are my life.

তোমার পদারবিন্দ তো হৈতে অধিক ।
আজিহ নাচয়ে শিব পিবই মাধ্বীক ॥ ৫৪ ॥

*tomāra padārabinda to haite adhika |*
*ājiha nācaẏe śiba pibai mādhbīka || 54 ||*

*Word for word:* tomara padaravinda — Your lotus feet; to haite adhika — greater than You; ajiha nachaye shiva — even now Shiva dances; pibai madhvika — drinking [their] honey

**54.** Your lotus feet are greater than You Yourself:
even now Shiva dances, drunk on their honey.

জগতে যতেক সব তোর সুগোচর ।
সবে না জানহ পদ-প্রেমার উত্তর ॥ ৫৫ ॥

*jagate yateka saba tora sugocara |*
*sabe nā jānaha pada-premāra uttara || 55 ||*

*Word for word:* jagate yateka saba — all that is in the world; tora sugochara — is known to You; sabe na janaha — only You do not know; pada-premara uttara — the answer (secret) of love for the feet

**55.** All that is in the world is known to You;
only the secret answer of love for [Your] feet You do not know.

যদি রাধাভাব হৃদে কর আরোপণ ।
তবে সে জানিবে নিজ-প্রেমার লক্ষণ ॥ ৫৬ ॥

*yadi rādhābhāba hṛde kara āropaṇa |*
*tabe se jānibe nija-premāra lakṣaṇa || 56 ||*

*Word for word:* yadi — if; radha-bhava — Radha's bhava; hride kara aropana — You place in Your heart; tabe se janibe — then You will know; nija-premara lakshana — the marks of Your own love (love for You)

**56.** If You place in Your heart the bhava of Radha,
then You will know what love for You is."[^03-6]

এ বোল শুনিঞা প্রভুর হিয়া চমৎকার ।
কি বৈলে কি বৈলে দেবি কহ আরবার ॥ ৫৭ ॥

*e bola śuniñā prabhura hiẏā camatkāra |*
*ki baile ki baile debi kaha ārabāra || 57 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shunina — hearing these words; prabhura hiya chamatkara — the Lord's heart was amazed; ki vaile ki vaile — what did you say, what did you say; devi — goddess; kaha arabara — say it again

**57.** Hearing these words, the Lord was amazed at heart:
"What did you say, what did you say, goddess? Say it again.

ভালমতে না শুনিল যে বলিলে তুমি ।
এছন কি আছে যাহা নাহি জানি আমি ॥ ৫৮ ॥

*bhālamate nā śunila ye balile tumi |*
*echana ki āche yāhā nāhi jāni āmi || 58 ||*

*Word for word:* bhalamate na shunila — I did not hear well; ye balile tumi — what you said; echhana ki achhe — is there such a thing; yaha nahi jani ami — that I do not know

**58.** I did not quite hear what you said;
can there be something that I do not know?

এহেন অদ্ভুত কথা শুনি মোর হিয়া ।
বাঢ়য়ে আরতি কিছু বিস্ময় পাইয়া ॥ ৫৯ ॥

*ehena adbhuta kathā śuni mora hiẏā |*
*bāṛhaẏe ārati kichu bismaẏa pāiẏā || 59 ||*

*Word for word:* ehena adbhuta katha — such wondrous words; shuni mora hiya — hearing, My heart; badhaye arati — longing grows; kichhu vismaya paiya — seized with some amazement

**59.** Hearing these wondrous words, I feel in My heart
a longing and some amazement.

হেন কি দুর্লভ পদ আছে ত্রিজগতে ।
আশ্চর্য মানিয়ে যাহা দেখিতে শুনিতে ॥ ৬০ ॥

*hena ki durlabha pada āche trijagate |*
*āścarya māniẏe yāhā dekhite śunite || 60 ||*

*Word for word:* hena ki durlabha pada — is there anything so hard to reach; achhe tri-jagate — in the three worlds; ashcharya maniye — one marvels; yaha dekhite shunite — at seeing it and hearing of it

**60.** Is there in the three worlds anything so hard to reach
that people marvel at seeing it and hearing of it?

তোর মুখে শুনি মোর অগোচর আছে ।
আনন্দে আমার মন কি জানি করিছে ॥ ৬১ ॥

*tora mukhe śuni mora agocara āche |*
*ānande āmāra mana ki jāni kariche || 61 ||*

*Word for word:* tora mukhe shuni — I hear from your lips; mora agochara achhe — there is something beyond Me; anande amara mana — for joy My heart; ki jani karichhe — knows not what it is doing

**61.** From your lips I hear that there is something beyond My reach —
for joy My heart does not know what to do.

কহ কহ কহ দেবি এহেন বিশ্বাস ।
চরণ-মহিমা কহে এ লোচনদাস ॥ ৬২ ॥

*kaha kaha kaha debi ehena biśbāsa |*
*caraṇa-mahimā kahe e locanadāsa || 62 ||*

*Word for word:* kaha kaha kaha — tell, tell, tell; devi — goddess; ehena vishvasa — [that I may have] such certainty; charana-mahima — the greatness of the feet; kahe e lochanadasa — says this Lochana Dasa

**62.** Tell Me, tell Me, tell Me, goddess — so I may be sure"; —
the greatness of the feet is sung by Lochana Dasa.

*Raga dhanashi; dirgha metre*

বোলে দেবী রুক্মিণী, শুন প্রভু গুণমণি, চিত্তে কিছু না করিহ আন ।
যা লাগি কান্দিয়ে আমি, সে কথা না জান তুমি, আর যত সব তুমি জান ॥ ৬৩ ॥

*bole debī rukmiṇī, śuna prabhu guṇamaṇi, citte kichu nā kariha āna |*
*yā lāgi kāndiẏe āmi, se kathā nā jāna tumi, āra yata saba tumi jāna || 63 ||*

*Word for word:* bole devi rukmini — says the goddess Rukmini; shuna prabhu gunamani — listen, Lord, jewel of virtues; chitte kichhu na kariha ana — think nothing else in Your heart; ya lagi kandiye ami — what I weep for; se katha na jana tumi — that You do not know; ara yata saba tumi jana — all else You know

**63.** The goddess Rukmini says: "Listen, Lord, jewel of virtues,
think nothing else in Your heart:
what I weep for — that You do not know,
though all else You know.

তুয়া চরণ-কমলে, কি আছে কতেক বলে, ভাল না জানহ তুমি ইহা ।
এ পদ আমার ঘরে, ছাড়ি যাবে অন্যান্তরে, তা লাগি কান্দয়ে মোর হিয়া ॥ ৬৪ ॥

*tuẏā caraṇa-kamale, ki āche kateka bale, bhāla nā jānaha tumi ihā |*
*e pada āmāra ghare, chāṛi yābe anyāntare, tā lāgi kāndaẏe mora hiẏā || 64 ||*

*Word for word:* tuya charana-kamale — in Your lotus feet; ki achhe — what lies; kateka bale — how much power; bhala na janaha tumi iha — this You do not know well; e pada amara ghare — these feet in my house; chhadi yabe anyantare — will leave and go to another; ta lagi kandaye mora hiya — for that my heart weeps

**64.** What lies hidden in Your lotus feet, how great their power —
this You do not know well;
these feet will leave my house and go to another —
that is why my heart weeps.

এ পদ-পদ্ম-গন্ধে, যায় যেই দিগন্তে, সে দিক ছাড়য়ে জরা-মৃত্যু ।
পদ-মকরন্দ-পানে, জীয়ে যেই যেই জনে, তারে কিবা দিবা-নিশি-ঋতু ॥ ৬৫ ॥

*e pada-padma-gandhe, yāẏa yei digante, se dika chāṛaẏe jarā-mṛtyu |*
*pada-makaranda-pāne, jīẏe yei yei jane, tāre kibā dibā-niśi-ṛtu || 65 ||*

*Word for word:* e pada-padma-gandhe — the fragrance of these lotus feet; yaya yei digante — wherever to the horizon it goes; se dika chhadaye jara-mrityu — old age and death leave that region; pada-makaranda-pane — drinking the honey of the feet; jiye yei yei jane — those who live; tare kiba diva-nishi-ritu — what to them are day, night, seasons

**65.** Wherever, to the ends of the earth, the fragrance of these lotus feet is carried,
old age and death leave those regions;
and for those who live drinking the honey of these feet,
what are day and night, what are the seasons?

পাদপদ্ম-সুপরাগে, যে ধরয়ে অনুরাগে, তার পদ পাই পুণ্যভাগে ।
কান্দিয়া কহিয়ে কথা, যত আছে মনে ব্যথা, সব নিবেদিয়ে তুয়া আগে ॥ ৬৬ ॥

*pādapadma-suparāge, ye dharaẏe anurāge, tāra pada pāi puṇyabhāge |*
*kāndiẏā kahiẏe kathā, yata āche mane byathā, saba nibediẏe tuẏā āge || 66 ||*

*Word for word:* pada-padma-suparage — the lovely pollen of the lotus feet; ye dharaye anurage — who lovingly holds; tara pada pai — I might touch his feet; punya-bhage — by great fortune; kandiya kahiye katha — weeping I speak; yata achhe mane vyatha — all the pain in my mind; saba nivediye tuya age — I lay it all before You

**66.** He who lovingly holds the lovely pollen of the lotus feet —
his feet I might touch only by great good fortune;
weeping I speak of all the pain in my heart —
I lay it all before You.

তুমি ঠাকুর সভাকার, তোমার ঠাকুর আর, কে আছয়ে সকল সংসারে ।
তুয়া পদ-অনুরাগে, এ রস-আস্বাদ লাগে, এই পহুঁ নিবেদিয়ে তোরে ॥ ৬৭ ॥

*tumi ṭhākura sabhākāra, tomāra ṭhākura āra, ke āchaẏe sakala saṃsāre |*
*tuẏā pada-anurāge, e rasa-āsbāda lāge, ei pahuṁ nibediẏe tore || 67 ||*

*Word for word:* tumi thakura sabhakara — You are master of all; tomara thakura ara — a master over You; ke achhaye sakala samsare — who is there in the whole world; tuya pada-anurage — in love for Your feet; e rasa-asvada lage — this rasa is tasted; ei pahun nivediye tore — this, Lord, I tell You

**67.** You are the master of all; is there in the whole world
anyone who is master over You?
In love for Your feet this rasa is tasted —
this, Lord, is what I am telling You.

রাধামাত্র জানে ইহা, ও রস পিরীতি পাঞা, যত সুখ যতেক সোহাগ ।
ভকত বিস্ময় গুণে, এই কথা রাত্রিদিনে, কিবা রস প্রেম অনুরাগ ॥ ৬৮ ॥

*rādhāmātra jāne ihā, o rasa pirīti pāñā, yata sukha yateka sohāga |*
*bhakata bismaẏa guṇe, ei kathā rātridine, kibā rasa prema anurāga || 68 ||*

*Word for word:* radha-matra jane iha — Radha alone knows this; o rasa piriti pana — having found that rasa of love; yata sukha yateka sohaga — all its joy and tenderness; bhakata vismaya gune — the devotees marvel, pondering; ei katha ratri-dine — this day and night; kiba rasa prema anuraga — what rasa, prema, anuraga

**68.** Radha alone knows this, having found that rasa of love —
all its joy, all its tenderness;
the devotees marvel at it, [speaking of it] day and night:
what rasa, what prema, what anuraga!

ব্রহ্মা আদি দেবা দেবী, লখিমী-চরণ-সেবী, সে পুন আপন অনুরাগে ।
কর-কমলে কমলা, অতি-আরতি-বিভোলা, এ পাদপদ্ম-সেবা মাগে ॥ ৬৯ ॥

*brahmā ādi debā debī, lakhimī-caraṇa-sebī, se puna āpana anurāge |*
*kara-kamale kamalā, ati-ārati-bibholā, e pādapadma-sebā māge || 69 ||*
