*Word for word:* brahma adi deva devi — Brahma and the other gods and goddesses; lakhimi-charana-sevi — serve Lakshmi's feet; se puna apana anurage — and she in her own love; kara-kamale kamala — Kamala, a lotus in her lotus hand; ati-arati-vibhola — beside herself with longing; e pada-padma-seva mage — begs service of these lotus feet

**69.** Brahma and the other gods and goddesses serve the feet of Lakshmi,
and she herself, out of her own love —
Kamala, a lotus in her lotus hand, beside herself with longing —
begs for service to these lotus feet.

সে পুন হৃদয়ে রহি, শয্যাতে শুতয়ে নাহি, বদনে বদন রহু রমা ।
এ পদ-মাধুরী-আশে, সেহো তাহা নাহি বাসে, কেবা কহু চরণ-মহিমা ॥ ৭০ ॥

*se puna hṛdaẏe rahi, śayyāte śutaẏe nāhi, badane badana rahu ramā |*
*e pada-mādhurī-āśe, seho tāhā nāhi bāse, kebā kahu caraṇa-mahimā || 70 ||*

*Word for word:* se puna hridaye rahi — though she dwells on [Your] breast; shayyate shutaye nahi — does not lie [apart] on a bed; vadane vadana rahu rama — Rama face to face; e pada-madhuri-ashe — longing for the sweetness of these feet; seho taha nahi vase — she values not even that; keba kahu charana-mahima — who can tell the greatness of the feet

**70.** Though Rama dwells on Your breast, not lying [apart] upon a bed,
face to face with You,
yet, longing for the sweetness of these feet, she does not value even that:[^03-7]
who then can tell the greatness of the feet?

লখিমী আপন-সুখ, সে চাহে কাতর মুখ, হেন পদ-পরসাদ প্রেমা ।
রাধামাত্র ইহা জানে, যে ভুঞ্জিল বৃন্দাবনে, তার ভাগ্যপথে নাহি সীমা ॥ ৭১ ॥

*lakhimī āpana-sukha, se cāhe kātara mukha, hena pada-parasāda premā |*
*rādhāmātra ihā jāne, ye bhuñjila bṛndābane, tāra bhāgyapathe nāhi sīmā || 71 ||*

*Word for word:* lakhimi apana-sukha — Lakshmi, for all her happiness; se chahe katara mukha — looks with a pleading face; hena pada-parasada prema — such is the grace of love for the feet; radha-matra iha jane — Radha alone knows it; ye bhunjila vrindavane — who tasted [it] in Vrindavana; tara bhagya-pathe nahi sima — Her fortune knows no limit

**71.** Lakshmi, for all her own happiness, looks [at them] in supplication:
such is the grace of love for the feet;
Radha alone knows this — She who tasted [it] in Vrindavana:
there is no limit to Her good fortune.

এ পুন জগতে ধান্ধা, তারি গুণে তুমি বান্ধা, আজিহ না ছাড় হিয়া-জাপ ।
রাধানাম লৈতে আঁখি, ছলছল করে দেখি, হেন পদ-প্রেমার প্রতাপ ॥ ৭২ ॥

*e puna jagate dhāndhā, tāri guṇe tumi bāndhā, ājiha nā chāṛa hiẏā-jāpa |*
*rādhānāma laite āṁkhi, chalachala kare dekhi, hena pada-premāra pratāpa || 72 ||*

*Word for word:* e puna jagate dhandha — here is a riddle for the world; tari gune tumi bandha — You are bound by Her virtues; ajiha na chhada hiya-japa — even now Your heart repeats [Her name]; radha-nama laite — uttering Radha's name; ankhi chhalachhala kare dekhi — I see Your eyes brim with tears; hena pada-premara pratapa — such is the might of love for the feet

**72.** And here is a riddle for the world: You are bound by Her virtues,
and even now Your heart repeats [Her name];
when You utter the name of Radha, Your eyes, I see, brim with tears:
such is the might of love for the feet.

এ পদ আমার ঘরে, উল্লসিত অন্তরে, কান্দি পুন বিচ্ছেদের ডরে ।
তোমার অধিক তোর, শ্রীপদপঙ্কজ জোর, অনুভবি করহ বিচারে ॥ ৭৩ ॥

*e pada āmāra ghare, ullasita antare, kāndi puna bicchedera ḍare |*
*tomāra adhika tora, śrīpadapaṅkaja jora, anubhabi karaha bicāre || 73 ||*

*Word for word:* e pada amara ghare — these feet in my house; ullasita antare — the heart rejoices; kandi puna vichchhedera dare — yet I weep again for fear of separation; tomara adhika tora sri-pada-pankaja jora — Your holy lotus feet are stronger than You; anubhavi karaha vichare — feel it and judge

**73.** These feet are in my house — and my heart rejoices,
yet I weep again for fear of separation;
Your holy lotus feet are stronger than You Yourself —
feel it and judge.

তুমি যাহার ধেয়ান, তুমি সমাধি-গেয়ান, তুমি মাত্র সর্বত্র সহায় ।
এ হেন তোমার দাস, তুয়া পদে করে আশ, এই অপরূপ বড় মোয় ॥ ৭৪ ॥

*tumi yāhāra dheẏāna, tumi samādhi-geẏāna, tumi mātra sarbatra sahāẏa |*
*e hena tomāra dāsa, tuẏā pade kare āśa, ei aparūpa baṛa moẏa || 74 ||*

*Word for word:* tumi yahara dheyana — You are whose meditation; tumi samadhi-geyana — You are the knowledge of [his] samadhi; tumi matra sarvatra sahaya — You alone are the support in all; e hena tomara dasa — such a servant of Yours; tuya pade kare asha — hopes for Your feet; ei aparupa bada moya — this is a great wonder to me

**74.** You are the object of his meditation, You are the knowledge of his samadhi,
You alone are his support in all things;
and such a servant of Yours sets his hope on Your feet[^03-8] —
this is what amazes me.

যে পদে লখিমী দাসী, সে কেনে তা অভিলাষী, হেন তোমার ঠাকুরাল ।
ঠাকুর হইয়া পুন, তার ভাল নাহি গুণ, অবিচারে দেহ তারে শাল ॥ ৭৫ ॥

*ye pade lakhimī dāsī, se kene tā abhilāṣī, hena tomāra ṭhākurāla |*
*ṭhākura haiẏā puna, tāra bhāla nāhi guṇa, abicāre deha tāre śāla || 75 ||*

*Word for word:* ye pade lakhimi dasi — the feet whose maidservant Lakshmi is; se kene ta abhilashi — why does she long for them; hena tomara thakurala — such is Your lordship; thakura haiya puna — being master; tara bhala nahi guna — You do not think of her good; avichare deha tare shala — without a thought You pierce her with a spear

**75.** The feet whose maidservant Lakshmi is — why does she long for them?
Such is Your lordship:
though You are her master, You do not think of her good;
without a thought You pierce her with a spear.

পদ-মকরন্দ-রসে, যে ভুঞ্জয়ে অভিলাষে, অক্ষয় অব্যয় সে ভাণ্ডার ।
কিবা বাণী লখিমী, আপনাকে ধন্য মানি, বিনি সেবা পরশ তার ॥ ৭৬ ॥

*pada-makaranda-rase, ye bhuñjaẏe abhilāṣe, akṣaẏa abyaẏa se bhāṇḍāra |*
*kibā bāṇī lakhimī, āpanāke dhanya māni, bini sebā paraśa tāra || 76 ||*

*Word for word:* pada-makaranda-rase — the rasa of the feet's honey; ye bhunjaye abhilashe — who tastes with longing; akshaya avyaya se bhandara — inexhaustible, imperishable is that treasury; kiba vani lakhimi — what of Vani and Lakshmi; apanake dhanya mani — they think themselves blessed; vini seva parasha tara — by a mere touch of it, [even] without service

**76.** Whoever with longing tastes the rasa of the honey of these feet
has a treasury inexhaustible and imperishable;
what then of Vani and Lakshmi — they think themselves blessed
by a mere touch of it.

সালোক্যাদি মুক্তি চারি, তার পাছে অনুসারী, নাহি চাহে নয়ানের কোণে ।
যে পড়িল প্রেমরসে, আর কিবা তারে বাসে, বৈকুণ্ঠাদি তুচ্ছ করি মানে ॥ ৭৭ ॥

*sālokyādi mukti cāri, tāra pāche anusārī, nāhi cāhe naẏānera koṇe |*
*ye paṛila premarase, āra kibā tāre bāse, baikuṇṭhādi tuccha kari māne || 77 ||*

*Word for word:* salokya-adi mukti chari — the four liberations beginning with salokya; tara pachhe anusari — follow behind him; nahi chahe nayanera kone — he does not look even from the corner of his eye; ye padila prema-rase — who has sunk into the rasa of prema; ara kiba tare vase — what else does he care for; vaikuntha-adi tuchchha kari mane — he counts Vaikuntha and the rest as nothing

**77.** The four liberations, beginning with salokya, follow at his heels,
yet he will not glance at them even from the corner of his eye;
he who has sunk into the rasa of prema — what else is dear to him?
He counts even Vaikuntha as nothing.

কর জুড়ি বলি পহুঁ, ও পদ-কমল-মহু, মধুকর করি দেহ বর ।
ও পদ-বিচ্ছেদ-ডরে, এ পাপ পরাণ ঝরে, কভু না ছাড়িহ মোর ঘর ॥ ৭৮ ॥

*kara juṛi bali pahuṁ, o pada-kamala-mahu, madhukara kari deha bara |*
*o pada-biccheda-ḍare, e pāpa parāṇa jhare, kabhu nā chāṛiha mora ghara || 78 ||*

*Word for word:* kara judi bali pahun — joining my palms I pray, Lord; o pada-kamala-mahu — of the honey of those lotus feet; madhukara kari deha vara — make me a bee, grant this boon; o pada-vichchheda-dare — for fear of separation from those feet; e papa parana jhare — this sinful life ebbs away; kabhu na chhadiha mora ghara — never leave my house

**78.** With joined palms I pray, Lord: of those lotus feet
make me a bee — grant me this boon;
from fear of separation from those feet this sinful life is ebbing away:
never leave my house."

পদ-অরবিন্দ-গুণ, রুক্মিণী কহিল শুন, কেবল প্রেমের পরকাশ ।
তাহে সে প্রভুর দয়া, খলবল করে হিয়া, গুণ গায় এ লোচনদাস ॥ ৭৯ ॥

*pada-arabinda-guṇa, rukmiṇī kahila śuna, kebala premera parakāśa |*
*tāhe se prabhura daẏā, khalabala kare hiẏā, guṇa gāẏa e locanadāsa || 79 ||*

*Word for word:* pada-aravinda-guna — the virtues of the lotus feet; rukmini kahila — Rukmini told; shuna — listen; kevala premera parakasha — love itself manifest; tahe se prabhura daya — and so, by the Lord's mercy; khalabala kare hiya — the heart trembles; guna gaya e lochanadasa — Lochana Dasa sings the glories

**79.** Listen: Rukmini told the glories of the lotus feet —
it is love itself made manifest;
and so, by the Lord's mercy, with a trembling heart,
Lochana Dasa sings [His] glories.

*Raga dhanashi; madhya metre; disha: "Ah, ah, oh! — Murchha: — Here is a wondrous tale, its very name a blessing to the ear; hear further the tale of Gora's virtues"*

শুনিঞা রুক্মিণী-বাণী অন্তর-উল্লাসে ।
অরুণ কমল-আঁখি করুণা-জলে ভাসে ॥ ৮০ ॥

*śuniñā rukmiṇī-bāṇī antara-ullāse |*
*aruṇa kamala-āṁkhi karuṇā-jale bhāse || 80 ||*

*Word for word:* shunina rukmini-vani — hearing Rukmini's words; antara-ullase — rejoicing at heart; aruna kamala-ankhi — eyes like red lotuses; karuna-jale bhase — swim in tears of compassion

**80.** Hearing Rukmini's words, rejoicing at heart,
[the Lord] — His eyes, red lotuses, swimming in tears of compassion —

অঙ্গ হেলাইয়া পহুঁ লহু লহু বোলে ।
সিংহাসনে বসিয়া রুক্মিণী করি কোলে ॥ ৮১ ॥

*aṅga helāiẏā pahuṁ lahu lahu bole |*
*siṃhāsane basiẏā rukmiṇī kari kole || 81 ||*

*Word for word:* anga helaiya — leaning [towards her]; pahun lahu lahu bole — the Lord speaks very softly; simhasane vasiya — sitting on the throne; rukmini kari kole — taking Rukmini on His lap

**81.** drew her to Him and speaks very softly,
sitting on the throne with Rukmini on His lap.

চিবুকে দক্ষিণ-কর বয়ান নেহালে ।
উথলিল প্রেমসিন্ধু অমিয়া-হিল্লোলে ॥ ৮২ ॥

*cibuke dakṣiṇa-kara baẏāna nehāle |*
*uthalila premasindhu amiẏā-hillole || 82 ||*

*Word for word:* chibuke dakshina-kara — right hand at her chin; vayana nehale — He gazes at her face; uthalila prema-sindhu — the ocean of prema surges; amiya-hillole — in waves of nectar

**82.** Taking her by the chin with His right hand, He looks into her face —
and the ocean of prema heaves in waves of nectar.

হেন অদভুত কথা কভু নাহি শুনি ।
ভুঞ্জিব প্রেমার সুখ কহিলা আপনি ॥ ৮৩ ॥

*hena adabhuta kathā kabhu nāhi śuni |*
*bhuñjiba premāra sukha kahilā āpani || 83 ||*

*Word for word:* hena adabhuta katha — such a wondrous thing; kabhu nahi shuni — never have I heard; bhunjiba premara sukha — I shall taste the happiness of prema; kahila apani — He Himself said

**83.** "Never have I heard anything so wondrous!
I Myself shall taste the happiness of prema," He said.[^03-9]

হেনকালে নারদ আইলা আচম্বিত ।
বয়ান বিরস মুনির অন্তর চিন্তিত ॥ ৮৪ ॥

*henakāle nārada āilā ācambita |*
*baẏāna birasa munira antara cintita || 84 ||*

*Word for word:* henakale — at that time; narada aila achambita — Narada suddenly came; vayana virasa — face joyless; munira antara chintita — the sage's heart troubled

**84.** At that time Narada suddenly arrived;
the sage's face was joyless, his heart troubled.

উঠিয়া সম্ভ্রমে দেবী পাদ্য অর্ঘ্য দিয়া ।
বসাইল দিব্যাসনে কুশল পুছিয়া ॥ ৮৫ ॥

*uṭhiẏā sambhrame debī pādya arghya diẏā |*
*basāila dibyāsane kuśala puchiẏā || 85 ||*

*Word for word:* uthiya sambhrame — rising in haste; devi — the goddess; padya arghya diya — offering water for the feet and arghya; vasaila divyasane — seated him on a splendid seat; kushala puchhiya — asking after his welfare

**85.** Rising hastily, the goddess offered him water for his feet and arghya,
seated him on a splendid seat and asked after his welfare.

ঠাকুর উঠিয়া কৈল নিবিড় আশ্লেষে ।
সরস কথায় কৃষ্ণ নারদ সম্ভাষে ॥ ৮৬ ॥

*ṭhākura uṭhiẏā kaila nibiṛa āśleṣe |*
*sarasa kathāẏa kṛṣṇa nārada sambhāṣe || 86 ||*

*Word for word:* thakura uthiya — the Thakura, rising; kaila nivida ashleshe — embraced him tightly; sarasa kathaya — with tender words; krishna narada sambhashe — Krishna greets Narada

**86.** The Thakura, rising, embraced him tightly
and spoke to Narada with tender words.

অনুরাগে রাঙ্গা দুই আঁখি ছলছল ।
গদগদ ভাষ মুনি করে টলমল ॥ ৮৭ ॥

*anurāge rāṅgā dui āṁkhi chalachala |*
*gadagada bhāṣa muni kare ṭalamala || 87 ||*

*Word for word:* anurage ranga — reddened with love; dui ankhi chhalachhala — both eyes brimming; gadagada bhasha — choked speech; muni kare talamala — the sage sways

**87.** For love both his eyes brim with tears;
the sage babbles, choking, he sways.

অঙ্গ নিরখিতে আঁখি ভাসে প্রেমনীরে ।
কহিবারে চাহে কিছু কহিতে না পারে ॥ ৮৮ ॥

*aṅga nirakhite āṁkhi bhāse premanīre |*
*kahibāre cāhe kichu kahite nā pāre || 88 ||*

*Word for word:* anga nirakhite — gazing at [His] form; ankhi bhase prema-nire — eyes swim in tears of prema; kahibare chahe kichhu — he wants to say something; kahite na pare — cannot speak

**88.** As he gazes [at the Lord], his eyes swim in tears of prema;
he wants to say something and cannot.

প্রভু সুধাইল মুনি কহ সুনিশ্চিত ।
এহেন দুর্বল কেনে অন্তর চিন্তিত ॥ ৮৯ ॥

*prabhu sudhāila muni kaha suniścita |*
*ehena durbala kene antara cintita || 89 ||*

*Word for word:* prabhu sudhaila — the Lord asked; muni — sage; kaha sunishchita — tell Me truly; ehena durbala kene — why so weak; antara chintita — troubled at heart

**89.** The Lord asked: "Sage, tell Me truly:
why are you so weak, why so troubled at heart?

তুমি মোর প্রাণাধিক মুঞি তোর প্রাণ ।
তোমারে দুঃখিত দেখি হরিল গেয়ান ॥ ৯০ ॥

*tumi mora prāṇādhika muñi tora prāṇa |*
*tomāre duḥkhita dekhi harila geẏāna || 90 ||*

*Word for word:* tumi mora pranadhika — you are dearer to Me than life; muni tora prana — I am your life; tomare duhkhita dekhi — seeing you in sorrow; harila geyana — My senses are lost

**90.** You are dearer to Me than life, and I am your life;
seeing you in sorrow, I lose My senses."

নারদ কহয়ে প্রভু কি কহিব আমি ।
তুমি সর্বেশ্বরেশ্বর সর্ব-অন্তর্যামী ॥ ৯১ ॥

*nārada kahaẏe prabhu ki kahiba āmi |*
*tumi sarbeśbareśbara sarba-antaryāmī || 91 ||*

*Word for word:* narada kahaye — Narada says; prabhu — Lord; ki kahiba ami — what shall I say; tumi sarveshvareshvara — You are the Lord of lords; sarva-antaryami — the inner witness of all

**91.** Narada says: "Lord, what shall I say?
You are the Lord of lords, You are the inner witness of all.

তোর গুণগানে মোর অমিয়া-আহার ।
তোর গুণলোভে বুলোঁ সকল সংসার ॥ ৯২ ॥

*tora guṇagāne mora amiẏā-āhāra |*
*tora guṇalobhe buloṁ sakala saṃsāra || 92 ||*

*Word for word:* tora guna-gane — singing Your virtues; mora amiya-ahara — my nectar food; tora guna-lobhe — greedy for Your virtues; bulo sakala samsara — I roam the whole world

**92.** To sing Your virtues is my nectar food;
thirsting for Your virtues, I go round the whole world.

কৃষ্ণনাম না শুনিল সংসার ভ্রমিয়া ।
নিজ মদে মত্ত লোক তোমা পাশরিয়া ॥ ৯৩ ॥

*kṛṣṇanāma nā śunila saṃsāra bhramiẏā |*
*nija made matta loka tomā pāśariẏā || 93 ||*

*Word for word:* krishna-nama na shunila — I did not hear Krishna's name; samsara bhramiya — roaming the world; nija made matta loka — people drunk with their own intoxication; toma pashariya — having forgotten You

**93.** Going round the world, I did not hear the name of Krishna:
people are drunk with their own intoxication, having forgotten You.

অহঙ্কারে মুগধ মূর্চ্ছিত সর্বলোক ।
কৃষ্ণহীন লোক দেখি এই মোর শোক ॥ ৯৪ ॥

*ahaṅkāre mugadha mūrcchita sarbaloka |*
*kṛṣṇahīna loka dekhi ei mora śoka || 94 ||*

*Word for word:* ahankare mugadha — bewildered by pride; murchchhita sarvaloka — all people senseless; krishna-hina loka dekhi — seeing people without Krishna; ei mora shoka — this is my grief

**94.** All people lie senseless, blinded by pride;
seeing people without Krishna — that is my grief.

লোকের নিস্তারহেতু না দেখি উপায় ।
এই মনঃকথা মন সদাই ধেয়ায় ॥ ৯৫ ॥

*lokera nistārahetu nā dekhi upāẏa |*
*ei manaḥkathā mana sadāi dheẏāẏa || 95 ||*

*Word for word:* lokera nistara-hetu — for the deliverance of people; na dekhi upaya — I see no means; ei manah-katha — this thought; mana sadai dheyaya — the mind ever ponders

**95.** I see no way to save the people;
my mind thinks only of this, unceasingly.

নিবেদিল অন্তরের যত ছিল দুঃখ ।
তোর পদ-পরসাদে আর সব সুখ ॥ ৯৬ ॥

*nibedila antarera yata chila duḥkha |*
*tora pada-parasāde āra saba sukha || 96 ||*

*Word for word:* nivedila — I have laid before You; antarera yata chhila duhkha — all the grief that was in my heart; tora pada-parasade — by the grace of Your feet; ara saba sukha — all else is happiness

**96.** I have laid before You all the grief that was in my heart;
by the grace of Your feet all else is happiness."

হাসিয়া কহেন প্রভু শুন মহামুনি ।
পূরবের যত কথা পাশরিলে তুমি ॥ ৯৭ ॥

*hāsiẏā kahena prabhu śuna mahāmuni |*
*pūrabera yata kathā pāśarile tumi || 97 ||*

*Word for word:* hasiya kahena prabhu — smiling, the Lord says; shuna mahamuni — listen, great sage; puravera yata katha — all that happened before; pasharile tumi — you have forgotten

**97.** Smiling, the Lord says: "Listen, great sage:
you have forgotten all that happened before —

কাত্যায়নী প্রতিজ্ঞা করিল যেনমতে ।
মহেশ-সংবাদ মহাপ্রসাদ-নিমিত্তে ॥ ৯৮ ॥

*kātyāẏanī pratijñā karila yenamate |*
*maheśa-saṃbāda mahāprasāda-nimitte || 98 ||*

*Word for word:* katyayani pratijna karila — Katyayani made a vow; yenamate — how; mahesha-samvada — the talk with Mahesha; mahaprasada-nimitte — for the sake of mahaprasada

**98.** how Katyayani made a vow
in her talk with Mahesha for the sake of mahaprasada.[^03-10]

আর অপরূপ কথা রুক্মিণী কহিল ।
শুনিঞা বিহ্বল আমি প্রতিজ্ঞা করিল ॥ ৯৯ ॥

*āra aparūpa kathā rukmiṇī kahila |*
*śuniñā bihbala āmi pratijñā karila || 99 ||*

*Word for word:* ara aparupa katha — and something unprecedented; rukmini kahila — Rukmini said; shunina vihvala ami — hearing it, I, overwhelmed; pratijna karila — made a vow

**99.** And Rukmini has said something unprecedented;
hearing it, I was moved and made a vow:

ভুঞ্জিব প্রেমার সুখ ভুঞ্জাইব লোকে ।
দীনভাব প্রকাশ করিব কলিযুগে ॥ ১০০ ॥

*bhuñjiba premāra sukha bhuñjāiba loke |*
*dīnabhāba prakāśa kariba kaliyuge || 100 ||*

*Word for word:* bhunjiba premara sukha — I shall taste the happiness of prema; bhunjaiba loke — I shall make people taste it; dina-bhava prakasha kariba — I shall show a humble mood; kali-yuge — in the Kali-yuga

**100.** I shall taste the happiness of prema and give it to the people to taste;
I shall show a humble mood in the Kali-yuga;

ভকত-জনের সঙ্গে ভকতি করিয়া ।
নিজ প্রেম বিলাইব ঈশ্বর হইয়া ॥ ১০১ ॥

*bhakata-janera saṅge bhakati kariẏā |*
*nija prema bilāiba īśbara haiẏā || 101 ||*

*Word for word:* bhakata-janera sange — with the devotees; bhakati kariya — practising bhakti; nija prema vilaiba — I shall distribute My prema; ishvara haiya — being Ishvara

**101.** together with the devotees, practising bhakti,
I, though I am Ishvara, shall distribute My prema;

নিজগুণ-সংকীর্তন প্রকাশ করিব ।
নবদ্বীপে শচীগৃহে জনম লভিব ॥ ১০২ ॥

*nijaguṇa-saṃkīrtana prakāśa kariba |*
*nabadbīpe śacīgṛhe janama labhiba || 102 ||*

*Word for word:* nija-guna-sankirtana — the sankirtana of My virtues; prakasha kariba — I shall reveal; navadvipe shachi-grihe — in Navadvipa, in Shachi's house; janama labhiba — I shall take birth

**102.** I shall reveal the sankirtana of My virtues and names,
I shall be born in the house of Shachi in Navadvipa;

গৌর দীর্ঘ কলেবর বাহু জানু সম ।
সুমেরু সুন্দর তনু অতি অনুপম ॥ ১০৩ ॥

*gaura dīrgha kalebara bāhu jānu sama |*
*sumeru sundara tanu ati anupama || 103 ||*

*Word for word:* gaura dirgha kalevara — a golden, tall body; bahu janu sama — arms reaching the knees; sumeru sundara tanu — a body beautiful as Sumeru; ati anupama — beyond compare

**103.** My body will be golden and tall, My arms reaching the knees,
beautiful as Sumeru, beyond compare."

কহিতে কহিতে প্রভু গৌরতনু হৈলা ।
দেখিয়া নারদ অতি আরতি বাঢ়িলা ॥ ১০৪ ॥

*kahite kahite prabhu gauratanu hailā |*
*dekhiẏā nārada ati ārati bāṛhilā || 104 ||*

*Word for word:* kahite kahite — while speaking; prabhu gaura-tanu haila — the Lord became golden of body; dekhiya narada — seeing, Narada; ati arati badhila — was filled with great longing

**104.** As He said this, the Lord became golden;
seeing it, Narada was filled with great longing.

সুমেরু সুন্দর তনু প্রেমার আবেশে ।
কহয়ে লোচন গোরা-প্রথম-প্রকাশে ॥ ১০৫ ॥

*sumeru sundara tanu premāra ābeśe |*
*kahaẏe locana gorā-prathama-prakāśe || 105 ||*

*Word for word:* sumeru sundara tanu — a body beautiful as Sumeru; premara aveshe — in the rapture of prema; kahaye lochana — Lochana tells; gora-prathama-prakashe — of Gora's first manifestation

**105.** A body beautiful as Sumeru, in the rapture of prema —
so Lochana tells of Gora's first manifestation.

*Shri-raga; disha: "Ah, Gauranga, glory, glory! — Murchha: — Ah, my prema for Gauranga — nectar! Ah, my [treasure], glory, glory!"*

দেখিয়া নারদমুনি হরিষ-হিয়ায় ।
বরিষয়ে আঁখি-নীর সহস্র-ধারায় ॥ ১০৬ ॥

*dekhiẏā nāradamuni hariṣa-hiẏāẏa |*
*bariṣaẏe āṁkhi-nīra sahasra-dhārāẏa || 106 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhiya narada-muni — gazing, the sage Narada; harisha-hiyaya — with a jubilant heart; varishaye ankhi-nira — sheds tears; sahasra-dharaya — in a thousand streams

**106.** Gazing [at Him] with a jubilant heart, the sage Narada
sheds tears in a thousand streams.

কোটি-ইন্দু জিনি জ্যোতি কোটি-রবি-তেজে ।
কোটি-কাম জিনি রূপ গৌরবর রাজে ॥ ১০৭ ॥

*koṭi-indu jini jyoti koṭi-rabi-teje |*
*koṭi-kāma jini rūpa gaurabara rāje || 107 ||*

*Word for word:* koti-indu jini jyoti — radiance surpassing millions of moons; koti-ravi-teje — the brilliance of millions of suns; koti-kama jini rupa — beauty surpassing millions of Kamadevas; gaura-vara raje — the peerless Gaura shines (lit. "the best golden one")

**107.** A radiance surpassing millions of moons, a brilliance of millions of suns,
a beauty surpassing millions of Kamadevas: so shines the peerless Gaura.

ঝলমল অঙ্গতেজ চাহিতে না পারি ।
আঁখি মুদি রহে মুনি কাঁপে থরহরি ॥ ১০৮ ॥

*jhalamala aṅgateja cāhite nā pāri |*
*āṁkhi mudi rahe muni kāṁpe tharahari || 108 ||*

*Word for word:* jhalamala anga-teja — the dazzling radiance of the body; chahite na pari — cannot be looked at; ankhi mudi rahe muni — the sage stays with eyes shut; kanpe tharahari — trembling all over

**108.** The dazzling radiance of the body — one cannot look at it;
the sage sits with eyes shut, trembling all over.

তেজ সম্বরিয়া প্রভু নারদে নেহারে ।
অবশ নারদ দেখি ডাকে উচ্চস্বরে ॥ ১০৯ ॥

*teja sambariẏā prabhu nārade nehāre |*
*abaśa nārada dekhi ḍāke uccasbare || 109 ||*

*Word for word:* teja sambariya — restraining His radiance; prabhu narade nehare — the Lord looks at Narada; avasha narada dekhi — seeing Narada powerless; dake uchchasvare — calls in a loud voice

**109.** Restraining His radiance, the Lord looks at Narada
and, seeing him powerless, calls him in a loud voice.

সম্বিত পাইয়া মুনি সে-রূপ-ধেয়ানে ।
পুনঃ দরশন লাগি পিয়াস-নয়ানে ॥ ১১০ ॥

*sambita pāiẏā muni se-rūpa-dheẏāne |*
*punaḥ daraśana lāgi piẏāsa-naẏāne || 110 ||*

*Word for word:* samvita paiya — regaining his senses; muni se-rupa-dheyane — the sage in meditation on that form; punah darashana lagi — for another sight; piyasa-nayane — with thirsting eyes

**110.** Coming to himself, the sage [is lost] in meditation on that form,
and his eyes thirst to see [it] again.

ঠাকুর কহয়ে মুনি শুন মহাভাগ ।
অব্যাহত গতি তোর সর্বত্র সোহাগ ॥ ১১১ ॥

*ṭhākura kahaẏe muni śuna mahābhāga |*
*abyāhata gati tora sarbatra sohāga || 111 ||*

*Word for word:* thakura kahaye — the Thakura says; muni shuna mahabhaga — sage, listen, greatly fortunate one; avyahata gati tora — your movement is unobstructed; sarvatra sohaga — everywhere you are cherished

**111.** The Thakura says: "Sage, listen, greatly fortunate one:
your path is barred by nothing, everywhere you are honoured.

ঘোষণা করহ শিব-ব্রহ্মা-আদি-লোকে ।
গৌর অবতার মুঞি হব কলিযুগে ॥ ১১২ ॥

*ghoṣaṇā karaha śiba-brahmā-ādi-loke |*
*gaura abatāra muñi haba kaliyuge || 112 ||*

*Word for word:* ghoshana karaha — proclaim; shiva-brahma-adi-loke — in the worlds of Shiva, Brahma and others; gaura avatara — as the descent of Gaura; muni haba kali-yuge — I shall come in the Kali-yuga

**112.** Proclaim in the worlds of Shiva, Brahma and the others:
I shall appear in the Kali-yuga as Gaura.

গুণ-নাম-সংকীর্তন প্রকাশ করিব ।
নিজ-ভক্তি-প্রেমরস-সুখ প্রচারিব ॥ ১১৩ ॥

*guṇa-nāma-saṃkīrtana prakāśa kariba |*
*nija-bhakti-premarasa-sukha pracāriba || 113 ||*

*Word for word:* guna-nama-sankirtana — the sankirtana of virtues and name; prakasha kariba — I shall reveal; nija-bhakti-prema-rasa-sukha — the happiness of the rasa of bhakti and prema for Me; prachariba — I shall spread

**113.** I shall reveal the sankirtana of virtues and name,
I shall spread the happiness of the rasa of bhakti and prema for Me.

শত শত শাখা ভক্তিপথে নাহি সীমা ।
একমুখ হউ লোক প্রচারিব প্রেমা ॥ ১১৪ ॥

*śata śata śākhā bhaktipathe nāhi sīmā |*
*ekamukha hau loka pracāriba premā || 114 ||*

*Word for word:* shata shata shakha — hundreds upon hundreds of branches; bhakti-pathe nahi sima — the paths of bhakti are limitless; eka-mukha hau loka — let people face one way; prachariba prema — I shall spread prema

**114.** Hundreds upon hundreds of branches — the paths of bhakti are without limit;
turning people towards one, I shall spread prema.[^03-11]

নিজ নিজ ভক্তজন আর পারিষদ ।
পৃথিবীতে জনম লঞা প্রেমভক্তি-সাধ ॥ ১১৫ ॥

*nija nija bhaktajana āra pāriṣada |*
*pṛthibīte janama lañā premabhakti-sādha || 115 ||*

*Word for word:* nija nija bhakta-jana — My own devotees; ara parishada — and associates; prithivite janama lana — taking birth on earth; prema-bhakti-sadha — [I shall fulfil] the longing for prema-bhakti

**115.** Together with My own devotees and associates,
born on earth, [I shall fulfil] the longing for prema-bhakti."

এছন শ্রীমুখ-বাণী শুনিঞা নারদ ।
খণ্ডিল সকল দুঃখ পদ-পরসাদ ॥ ১১৬ ॥

*echana śrīmukha-bāṇī śuniñā nārada |*
*khaṇḍila sakala duḥkha pada-parasāda || 116 ||*

*Word for word:* echhana sri-mukha-vani — such words from the holy mouth; shunina narada — hearing, Narada; khandila sakala duhkha — was freed from all sorrow; pada-parasada — by the grace of the feet

**116.** Hearing such words from the holy mouth, Narada,
by the grace of [the Lord's] feet, was freed from all sorrow.

চলিলা নারদমুনি বীণা বাজাইয়া ।
এই মনঃকথা-রসে পরবশ হঞা ॥ ১১৭ ॥

*calilā nāradamuni bīṇā bājāiẏā |*
*ei manaḥkathā-rase parabaśa hañā || 117 ||*

*Word for word:* chalila narada-muni — the sage Narada went; vina bajaiya — playing his vina; ei manah-katha-rase — in the rasa of these thoughts; paravasha haina — absorbed

**117.** The sage Narada went on, playing his vina,
absorbed in these thoughts:

কি দেখিনু গোরারূপ অপরূপ ঠাম ।
কি দেখিনু সকরুণ অরুণ নয়ান ॥ ১১৮ ॥

*ki dekhinu gorārūpa aparūpa ṭhāma |*
*ki dekhinu sakaruṇa aruṇa naẏāna || 118 ||*

*Word for word:* ki dekhinu — what have I seen; gora-rupa aparupa thama — the wondrous form of Gora; ki dekhinu — what have I seen; sakaruna aruna nayana — red eyes full of compassion

**118.** "What a wondrous form of Gora I have seen!
What red eyes full of compassion I have seen!

কি দেখিনু অমিয়া-অধিক পরকাশ ।
কি দেখিনু শ্রীমুখের মধুরিম হাস ॥ ১১৯ ॥

*ki dekhinu amiẏā-adhika parakāśa |*
*ki dekhinu śrīmukhera madhurima hāsa || 119 ||*

*Word for word:* ki dekhinu — what have I seen; amiya-adhika parakasha — radiance sweeter than nectar; ki dekhinu — what have I seen; sri-mukhera madhurima hasa — the sweet smile of the holy lips

**119.** What a radiance I have seen — sweeter than nectar!
What a sweet smile on the holy lips I have seen!

যত যত অবতার সভা হৈতে সার ।
কভু নাহি দেখি হেন প্রেমার ভাণ্ডার ॥ ১২০ ॥

*yata yata abatāra sabhā haite sāra |*
*kabhu nāhi dekhi hena premāra bhāṇḍāra || 120 ||*

*Word for word:* yata yata avatara — all the descents there have been; sabha haite sara — the essence of them all; kabhu nahi dekhi — never have I seen; hena premara bhandara — such a treasure-house of prema

**120.** Of all the descents there have been, this is the essence;
never have I seen such a treasure-house of prema.

সফল জনম মোর সফল নয়ান ।
কি দেখিনু গোরারূপ প্রসন্ন বয়ান ॥ ১২১ ॥

*saphala janama mora saphala naẏāna |*
*ki dekhinu gorārūpa prasanna baẏāna || 121 ||*

*Word for word:* saphala janama mora — fruitful is my birth; saphala nayana — fruitful my eyes; ki dekhinu gora-rupa — I have seen Gora's form; prasanna vayana — the serene face

**121.** Blessed is my birth, blessed are my eyes:
I have seen the form of Gora, His serene face.

এহেন করুণানিধি কভু নাহি দেখি ।
পাশরিতে নারি হিয়া জুড়াইল আঁখি ॥ ১২২ ॥

*ehena karuṇānidhi kabhu nāhi dekhi |*
*pāśarite nāri hiẏā juṛāila āṁkhi || 122 ||*

*Word for word:* ehena karuna-nidhi — such an ocean of mercy; kabhu nahi dekhi — never have I seen; pasharite nari hiya — the heart cannot forget; judaila ankhi — the eyes are soothed

**122.** Never have I seen such an ocean of mercy:
the heart cannot forget, my eyes are satisfied."

চিন্তিতে চিন্তিতে মুনি চলি যায় পথে ।
নৈমিষ-অরণ্যে দেখা উদ্ধবের সাথে ॥ ১২৩ ॥

*cintite cintite muni cali yāẏa pathe |*
*naimiṣa-araṇye dekhā uddhabera sāthe || 123 ||*

*Word for word:* chintite chintite — pondering; muni chali yaya pathe — the sage goes on his way; naimisha-aranye — in the forest of Naimisha; dekha uddhavera sathe — meets Uddhava

**123.** Pondering thus, the sage goes on his way,
and in the forest of Naimisha he meets Uddhava.

উদ্ধব সম্ভ্রমে উঠি পাদ্য অর্ঘ্য দিয়া ।
দণ্ডবত করে ভূমে চরণে পড়িয়া ॥ ১২৪ ॥

*uddhaba sambhrame uṭhi pādya arghya diẏā |*
*daṇḍabata kare bhūme caraṇe paṛiẏā || 124 ||*

*Word for word:* uddhava sambhrame uthi — Uddhava, rising respectfully; padya arghya diya — offering water for the feet and arghya; dandavata kare bhume — prostrates on the ground; charane padiya — falling at the feet

**124.** Uddhava, rising respectfully, offered water for the feet and arghya
and lay prostrate on the ground, falling at his feet.

শুভদিন হেন মানে আপনাকে ধন্য ।
শুভক্ষণে আইলা মুনি নৈমিষ-অরণ্য ॥ ১২৫ ॥

*śubhadina hena māne āpanāke dhanya |*
*śubhakṣaṇe āilā muni naimiṣa-araṇya || 125 ||*

*Word for word:* shubha-dina hena mane — he deems the day auspicious; apanake dhanya — himself fortunate; shubha-kshane — at an auspicious hour; aila muni — the sage came; naimisha-aranya — to the forest of Naimisha

**125.** He thinks the day auspicious and himself fortunate:
"At an auspicious hour the sage has come to the forest of Naimisha."

নারদ তুলিয়া কৈলা গাঢ় আলিঙ্গন ।
চুম্বন করিয়া লৈলা মস্তকের ঘ্রাণ ॥ ১২৬ ॥

*nārada tuliẏā kailā gāṛha āliṅgana |*
*cumbana kariẏā lailā mastakera ghrāṇa || 126 ||*

*Word for word:* narada tuliya — Narada, lifting [him]; kaila gadha alingana — embraced him tightly; chumbana kariya — kissing; laila mastakera ghrana — smelled the crown of his head

**126.** Narada lifted him up, embraced him tightly,
kissed him and smelled the crown of his head.

উদ্ধব আনিঞা দিল আসন বসিতে ।
নিজ মনঃকথা কহে হাসিতে হাসিতে ॥ ১২৭ ॥

*uddhaba āniñā dila āsana basite |*
*nija manaḥkathā kahe hāsite hāsite || 127 ||*

*Word for word:* uddhava anina dila — Uddhava brought and gave; asana vasite — a seat to sit on; nija manah-katha kahe — tells what is in his heart; hasite hasite — smiling

**127.** Uddhava brought him a seat,
[Narada sat,] and, smiling, [Uddhava] tells what is in his heart:

সফল জনম মোর দিন স্বতন্তর ।
এক নিবেদিয়ে চির-বেদনা অন্তর ॥ ১২৮ ॥

*saphala janama mora dina sbatantara |*
*eka nibediẏe cira-bedanā antara || 128 ||*

*Word for word:* saphala janama mora — fruitful is my birth; dina svatantara — a special day; eka nivediye — I shall lay before you one; chira-vedana antara — long-standing pain of the heart

**128.** "Blessed is my birth, special is this day;
let me lay before you one long-standing pain of my heart.

পূরবে ত ব্যাস এই নৈমিষ-অরণ্যে ।
বেদ বিচারিয়া জাড্য না ঘুচিল মনে ॥ ১২৯ ॥

*pūrabe ta byāsa ei naimiṣa-araṇye |*
*beda bicāriẏā jāḍya nā ghucila mane || 129 ||*

*Word for word:* purave ta vyasa — long ago Vyasa; ei naimisha-aranye — in this forest of Naimisha; veda vichariya — having studied the Vedas; jadya na ghuchila mane — the heaviness did not leave his mind

**129.** Long ago Vyasa, here in the forest of Naimisha,
having studied the Vedas, was not freed from the heaviness of his mind;

তব পরসাদে কথা নিগূঢ় শুনিল ।
লোকনিস্তারণ-হেতু ভাগবত কৈল ॥ ১৩০ ॥

*taba parasāde kathā nigūṛha śunila |*
*lokanistāraṇa-hetu bhāgabata kaila || 130 ||*

*Word for word:* taba parasade — by your grace; katha nigudha shunila — he heard the hidden truth; loka-nistarana-hetu — for the deliverance of people; bhagavata kaila — composed the Bhagavata

**130.** by your grace he heard the hidden truth
and for the deliverance of people composed the *Bhagavata*.[^03-12]

তুমি মাত্র তত্ত্ববেত্তা প্রভুতত্ত্ব জান ।
বুঝিয়া ঠাকুর-মন ভবিষ্য বাখান ॥ ১৩১ ॥

*tumi mātra tattbabettā prabhutattba jāna |*
*bujhiẏā ṭhākura-mana bhabiṣya bākhāna || 131 ||*

*Word for word:* tumi matra tattva-vetta — you alone know the truth; prabhu-tattva jana — you know the truth about the Lord; bujhiya thakura-mana — understanding the Lord's mind; bhavishya bakhana — explain the future

**131.** You alone know the truth, you know the truth about the Lord;
understanding the Lord's purpose, reveal the future:

কলিযুগে লোকের নিস্তার কেনমতে ।
পাপাবৃত অন্ধ লোক হৃদয়-নয়নে ॥ ১৩২ ॥

*kaliyuge lokera nistāra kenamate |*
*pāpābṛta andha loka hṛdaẏa-naẏane || 132 ||*

*Word for word:* kali-yuge — in the Kali-yuga; lokera nistara kenamate — how will people be saved; papavrita — wrapped in sin; andha loka hridaya-nayane — people blind in the eyes of the heart

**132.** how will people be saved in the Kali-yuga —
wrapped in sin, the eyes of their hearts blind?

সত্য ত্রেতা দ্বাপরে লোকের ধর্ম জানি ।
ঘোর কলিযুগে আর নাহি পাপ বিনি ॥ ১৩৩ ॥

*satya tretā dbāpare lokera dharma jāni |*
*ghora kaliyuge āra nāhi pāpa bini || 133 ||*

*Word for word:* satya treta dvapare — in the Satya, Treta and Dvapara; lokera dharma jani — I know the people's dharma; ghora kali-yuge — in the terrible Kali-yuga; ara nahi papa vini — there is nothing but sin

**133.** I know what the dharma of people is in the Satya, Treta and Dvapara yugas;
but in the terrible Kali-yuga there is nothing but sin.

দয়া করি কহ যদি ঘুচাহ সন্দেহ ।
তোমার অধিক আর দয়াবন্ত কেহ ॥ ১৩৪ ॥

*daẏā kari kaha yadi ghucāha sandeha |*
*tomāra adhika āra daẏābanta keha || 134 ||*

*Word for word:* daya kari kaha — be merciful, tell; yadi ghuchaha sandeha — if you would dispel my doubt; tomara adhika ara — who more than you; dayavanta keha — is merciful

**134.** Be merciful, tell me, dispel my doubt:
who is more merciful than you?"

হাসিয়া কহয়ে মুনি অন্তর-উল্লাস ।
ভাল সুধাইলে হে উদ্ধব হরিদাস ॥ ১৩৫ ॥

*hāsiẏā kahaẏe muni antara-ullāsa |*
*bhāla sudhāile he uddhaba haridāsa || 135 ||*

*Word for word:* hasiya kahaye muni — smiling, the sage says; antara-ullasa — rejoicing at heart; bhala sudhaile — well have you asked; he uddhava haridasa — O Uddhava, servant of Hari

**135.** Rejoicing at heart, the sage says, smiling:
"Well have you asked, Uddhava, servant of Hari!

পরম নিগূঢ় কথা কহি তোর সনে ।
এছন আছিল শোক বড় মোর মনে ॥ ১৩৬ ॥

*parama nigūṛha kathā kahi tora sane |*
*echana āchila śoka baṛa mora mane || 136 ||*

*Word for word:* parama nigudha katha — the deepest secret; kahi tora sane — I tell you; echhana achhila shoka — such grief there was; bada mora mane — great in my heart

**136.** I will tell you the deepest secret:
the very same grief was in my heart too.

এখনে জানিল মুঞি কলিযুগ ধন্য ।
কলিলোক বহি ধন্য আর নাহি অন্য ॥ ১৩৭ ॥

*ekhane jānila muñi kaliyuga dhanya |*
*kaliloka bahi dhanya āra nāhi anya || 137 ||*

*Word for word:* ekhane janila muni — now I have understood; kali-yuga dhanya — the Kali-yuga is blessed; kali-loka bahi — apart from the people of Kali; dhanya ara nahi anya — none other is so blessed

**137.** Now I have understood: the Kali-yuga is blessed;
apart from the people of Kali, there is no one else so blessed.

সত্য-আদি-যুগধর্ম আচার কঠিন ।
কলিযুগ-ধর্ম হরিনাম পরবীণ ॥ ১৩৮ ॥

*satya-ādi-yugadharma ācāra kaṭhina |*
*kaliyuga-dharma harināma parabīṇa || 138 ||*

*Word for word:* satya-adi-yuga-dharma — the dharma of Satya and other yugas; achara kathina — severe practices; kali-yuga-dharma — the dharma of the Kali-yuga; hari-nama paravina — the excellent Hari-nama

**138.** The dharma of the Satya and the other yugas is a severe discipline;
the dharma of the Kali-yuga is the excellent Hari-nama.[^03-13]

নাম-গুণ-সংকীর্তনে মুক্তবন্ধ হঞা ।
নৃত্যগীতে বুলে যমভয় এড়াইয়া ॥ ১৩৯ ॥

*nāma-guṇa-saṃkīrtane muktabandha hañā |*
*nṛtyagīte bule yamabhaẏa eṛāiẏā || 139 ||*

*Word for word:* nama-guna-sankirtane — by the sankirtana of the name and virtues; mukta-bandha haina — freed from bondage; nritya-gite bule — they go about dancing and singing; yama-bhaya edaiya — escaping the fear of Yama

**139.** By the sankirtana of the name and virtues they are freed from bondage;
they go about dancing and singing, free from the fear of Yama.

আর অপরূপ কথা শুন সাবধানে ।
দ্বারকায় দেখিলাম আপন নয়ানে ॥ ১৪০ ॥

*āra aparūpa kathā śuna sābadhāne |*
*dbārakāẏa dekhilāma āpana naẏāne || 140 ||*

*Word for word:* ara aparupa katha — another wonder; shuna savadhane — listen attentively; dvarakaya dekhilama — what I saw in Dvaraka; apana nayane — with my own eyes

**140.** And here is another wonder — listen attentively —
which I saw with my own eyes in Dvaraka.

এই কথা-রসে প্রভু রুক্মিণীর সাথে ।
নিজ প্রেম বিলসিব করি হেন চিতে ॥ ১৪১ ॥

*ei kathā-rase prabhu rukmiṇīra sāthe |*
*nija prema bilasiba kari hena cite || 141 ||*

*Word for word:* ei katha-rase — in the delight of this talk; prabhu rukminira sathe — the Lord with Rukmini; nija prema vilasiba — I will unfold My prema; kari hena chite — so resolved in His heart

**141.** Speaking of this with Rukmini, the Lord
resolved in His heart: 'I will unfold My prema.'

সিংহাসনে বসিয়া রুক্মিণী করি কোলে ।
অন্তর-চিন্তিত মুঞি গেনু হেনকালে ॥ ১৪২ ॥

*siṃhāsane basiẏā rukmiṇī kari kole |*
*antara-cintita muñi genu henakāle || 142 ||*

*Word for word:* simhasane vasiya — sitting on the throne; rukmini kari kole — with Rukmini on His lap; antara-chintita — troubled at heart; muni genu henakale — I came at that time

**142.** He was sitting on the throne with Rukmini on His lap —
at that time I arrived, troubled at heart.

দুঃখিত দেখিয়া প্রভু পুছিল আমারে ।
এহেন মূরতি কেনে দেখিয়ে তোমারে ॥ ১৪৩ ॥

*duḥkhita dekhiẏā prabhu puchila āmāre |*
*ehena mūrati kene dekhiẏe tomāre || 143 ||*

*Word for word:* duhkhita dekhiya — seeing me sorrowful; prabhu puchhila amare — the Lord asked me; ehena murati — in such a state; kene dekhiye tomare — why do I see you

**143.** Seeing me in sorrow, the Lord asked me:
'Why do I see you like this?'

এই মনঃকথা মুঞি কহিনু পদ পাঞা ।
প্রসন্ন বয়ানে প্রভু কহিলা হাসিয়া ॥ ১৪৪ ॥

*ei manaḥkathā muñi kahinu pada pāñā |*
*prasanna baẏāne prabhu kahilā hāsiẏā || 144 ||*

*Word for word:* ei manah-katha — this thought; muni kahinu — I told; pada pana — reaching His feet; prasanna vayane — with a serene face; prabhu kahila hasiya — the Lord said, smiling

**144.** Falling at His feet, I told Him what was in my heart;
the Lord, His face serene, said smiling:

রুক্মিণী কহিল পদ-প্রেমার মহিমা ।
শুনিঞা বিহ্বল প্রভু আরতি-গরিমা ॥ ১৪৫ ॥

*rukmiṇī kahila pada-premāra mahimā |*
*śuniñā bihbala prabhu ārati-garimā || 145 ||*

*Word for word:* rukmini kahila — Rukmini told; pada-premara mahima — the greatness of love for the feet; shunina vihvala prabhu — hearing it, the Lord is overwhelmed; arati-garima — so great the longing

**145.** 'Rukmini has told the greatness of love for [My] feet;
hearing it, I am overwhelmed — so great is [this] longing.

ভুঞ্জিব প্রেমার সুখ ভুঞ্জাইব লোকে ।
দীনভাব প্রকাশ করিব কলিযুগে ॥ ১৪৬ ॥

*bhuñjiba premāra sukha bhuñjāiba loke |*
*dīnabhāba prakāśa kariba kaliyuge || 146 ||*

*Word for word:* bhunjiba premara sukha — I shall taste the happiness of prema; bhunjaiba loke — I shall make people taste it; dina-bhava prakasha kariba — I shall show a humble mood; kali-yuge — in the Kali-yuga

**146.** I shall taste the happiness of prema and give it to the people to taste;
I shall show a humble mood in the Kali-yuga.

ঘোর কলিযুগ পাপময় ধর্মহীন ।
লোক বুঝাবার তরে হব মুঞি দীন ॥ ১৪৭ ॥

*ghora kaliyuga pāpamaẏa dharmahīna |*
*loka bujhābāra tare haba muñi dīna || 147 ||*

*Word for word:* ghora kali-yuga — the terrible Kali-yuga; papamaya dharmahina — sinful, without dharma; loka bujhabara tare — to make people understand; haba muni dina — I shall become humble

**147.** The terrible Kali-yuga is sinful, without dharma;
to bring people to understanding, I shall become very humble.'

প্রেমময় গৌর দীর্ঘ সুবরণ তনু ।
বিশাল হৃদয় বাহু-যুগ সম জানু ॥ ১৪৮ ॥

*premamaẏa gaura dīrgha subaraṇa tanu |*
*biśāla hṛdaẏa bāhu-yuga sama jānu || 148 ||*

*Word for word:* premamaya — full of prema; gaura dirgha suvarana tanu — a golden, tall body of lovely hue; vishala hridaya — a broad chest; bahu-yuga sama janu — both arms reaching the knees

**148.** A body full of prema, golden, tall, of lovely hue,
a broad chest, arms reaching the knees —

কহিতে কহিতে প্রভু গৌরতনু হৈলা ।
নিজ প্রেম বিলাইব প্রতিজ্ঞা করিলা ॥ ১৪৯ ॥

*kahite kahite prabhu gauratanu hailā |*
*nija prema bilāiba pratijñā karilā || 149 ||*

*Word for word:* kahite kahite — while speaking; prabhu gaura-tanu haila — the Lord became golden of body; nija prema vilaiba — "I shall give away My prema"; pratijna karila — He vowed

**149.** as He said this, the Lord became golden
and vowed to give away His prema.

যে দেখিল যে শুনিল কহিল তোমারে ।
ঘোষণা দিবারে যাব সকল সংসারে ॥ ১৫০ ॥

*ye dekhila ye śunila kahila tomāre |*
*ghoṣaṇā dibāre yāba sakala saṃsāre || 150 ||*

*Word for word:* ye dekhila — what I saw; ye shunila — what I heard; kahila tomare — I have told you; ghoshana dibare — to proclaim; yaba sakala samsare — I shall go through the whole world

**150.** What I saw, what I heard, I have told you;
I shall go and proclaim it throughout the world.

পৃথিবীতে জন্ম গিয়া প্রেমভক্তি-লোভে ।
হেন অপরূপ প্রভু হবে কলিযুগে ॥ ১৫১ ॥

*pṛthibīte janma giẏā premabhakti-lobhe |*
*hena aparūpa prabhu habe kaliyuge || 151 ||*

*Word for word:* prithivite janma giya — taking birth on earth; prema-bhakti-lobhe — out of longing for prema-bhakti; hena aparupa prabhu — so wondrous a Lord; habe kali-yuge — will be in the Kali-yuga

**151.** Taking birth on earth out of longing for prema-bhakti,
so wondrous [the Lord] will appear in the Kali-yuga."

শুনিয়া নারদ-বাণী উদ্ধব বিকল ।
চরণে পড়িয়া কান্দে আনন্দে বিহ্বল ॥ ১৫২ ॥

*śuniẏā nārada-bāṇī uddhaba bikala |*
*caraṇe paṛiẏā kānde ānande bihbala || 152 ||*

*Word for word:* shuniya narada-vani — hearing Narada's words; uddhava vikala — Uddhava beside himself; charane padiya kande — weeps fallen at his feet; anande vihvala — overwhelmed with joy

**152.** Hearing Narada's words, Uddhava, beside himself,
weeps, fallen at his feet, overwhelmed with joy:

হেন অদভুত কথা কহিলে আমারে ।
জীব সঞ্চারিলে যেন নির্জীব শরীরে ॥ ১৫৩ ॥

*hena adabhuta kathā kahile āmāre |*
*jība sañcārile yena nirjība śarīre || 153 ||*

*Word for word:* hena adabhuta katha — such a wondrous thing; kahile amare — you have told me; jiva sancharile yena — as though you breathed life; nirjiva sharire — into a lifeless body

**153.** "You have told me such a wondrous thing —
as though life were breathed into a lifeless body.

[^03-1]: So in Bhaktisiddhanta's text (A: "amiya"): people take these passions for nectar. The 1983 edition has "sprinkle their hearts with poison".
[^03-2]: Literally "the Thakura of Dvaraka, crest-jewel of the God of gods".
[^03-3]: Mitravinda and Nagnajiti are among Krishna's principal queens (*Bhag.* 10.58). Sushila and Subala may also be names of queens, or epithets ("good-natured, youthful"); we take them as names.
[^03-4]: *Nirmanchhana*: the rite of waving a lamp or other object around a beloved person to ward off all harm.
[^03-5]: Cf. *Bhag.* 10.60: Krishna in jest told Rukmini that she should have chosen a king equal to her as husband, and she fainted from grief.
[^03-6]: Literally "then You will know the marks of Your own love", i.e. the love directed to You. This directly echoes how Gaudiya Vaishnavas understand the reason for Sri Chaitanya's appearance: Krishna wishes to know the greatness of Radha's love, the sweetness of Himself that She tastes, and Her bliss, and therefore comes, accepting Her bhava and lustre (*Chaitanya-charitamrita*, Adi 1.6 and ch. 4). Bhaktisiddhanta says the same in his summary of this section: Krishna descends as Gaura "accepting the bhava of Radha".
[^03-7]: Rama is Lakshmi. Cf. *Bhag.* 10.16.36: Lakshmi performed austerities desiring to touch the dust of Krishna's feet.
[^03-8]: Probably Shiva is meant (cf. v. 54): he contemplates the Lord in samadhi and himself longs for His feet.
[^03-9]: The 1983 edition likewise: "'I shall taste the happiness of prema,' He Himself said." This is the first statement of the vow spoken in full in v. 100.
[^03-10]: The story of the mahaprasada, Shiva and Katyayani (Parvati) is told by Lochana Dasa further on, in the account of Narada's visit to Kailasa.
[^03-11]: Literally "let people be turned in one direction" — towards the one prema-bhakti.
[^03-12]: In the *Bhagavata-purana* (1.4–1.7) Narada instructs the dejected Vyasa at his ashrama on the bank of the Sarasvati (Shamyaprasa), while it is Suta who recites the *Bhagavata* to the sages at Naimisharanya; Lochana Dasa, following his source, joins these accounts.
[^03-13]: Cf. *Bhag.* 12.3.52: what was attained in the Satya-yuga by meditation, in the Treta by sacrifice and in the Dvapara by worship is attained in the Kali-yuga by the chanting of Hari's name.

---

# Sutra-khanda, part 4 (portion 04)

*Narada parts from Uddhava and comes to Kailasa; Narada's account of the mahaprasada: Uddhava's words on the remnants of the Lord's meal, Narada's service to Lakshmi, the dance of Shiva after tasting mahaprasada, the Earth's complaint; Parvati's vow to give mahaprasada to all living beings; the Lord of Vaikuntha approves her vow and promises to appear in the Kali-yuga as Gaura*

জুড়াইল দেহ মোর তোমার সম্ভাষে ।
চলিলা নারদ বীণা বাজাঞা উল্লাসে ॥ ১৫৪ ॥

*juṛāila deha mora tomāra sambhāṣe |*
*calilā nārada bīṇā bājāñā ullāse || 154 ||*

*Word for word:* judaila — was soothed; deha mora — my body; tomara sambhashe — by your words; chalila narada — Narada went; vina bajana — playing the vina; ullase — joyfully

**154.** You have refreshed my very body with your words"; —
and Narada went on, rejoicing, playing his vina.

জৈমিনিভারতে নারদ-উদ্ধব-সংবাদ ।
শুনিঞা লোচনদাসের আনন্দ-উন্মাদ ॥ ১৫৫ ॥

*jaiminibhārate nārada-uddhaba-saṃbāda |*
*śuniñā locanadāsera ānanda-unmāda || 155 ||*

*Word for word:* jaimini-bharate — in the Jaimini-bharata; narada-uddhava-samvada — the dialogue of Narada and Uddhava; shuniya — hearing; lochanadasera — Lochana Dasa's; ananda-unmada — frenzy of joy

**155.** The dialogue of Narada and Uddhava from the *Jaimini-bharata* —
hearing it, Lochana Dasa is mad with joy.

আমার বচনে যে বা প্রতীত না যায় ।
বিচার করুক পুথি বত্রিশ অধ্যায় ॥ ১৫৬ ॥

*āmāra bacane ye bā pratīta nā yāẏa |*
*bicāra karuka puthi batriśa adhyāẏa || 156 ||*

*Word for word:* amara bachane — my words; ye ba — whoever; pratita na yaya — does not believe; vichara karuka — let him examine; puthi — the book; batrisha adhyaya — the thirty-second chapter

**156.** Whoever does not believe my words,
let him examine the book — the thirty-second chapter.[^04-1]

*Raga bhatiyari; disha: "Ah, my life — Gorachand!"*

চলিলা নারদমুনি বীণা গায় গুণ ।
শুনিঞা বিহ্বল হিয়া পড়ে পুনঃপুনঃ ॥ ১৫৭ ॥

*calilā nāradamuni bīṇā gāẏa guṇa |*
*śuniñā bihbala hiẏā paṛe punaḥpunaḥ || 157 ||*

*Word for word:* chalila naradamuni — the sage Narada went on; vina gaya guna — the vina sings [His] virtues; shuniya — hearing; vihvala hiya — his heart overwhelmed; pade punah-punah — he falls again and again

**157.** The sage Narada goes on, and his vina sings [His] virtues;
hearing it, his heart overwhelmed, he falls again and again.

ক্ষণেক রোদন ক্ষণে অট্ট অট্ট হাস ।
ক্ষণে কাঁপে ক্ষণে ক্ষণে আধ আধ ভাষ ॥ ১৫৮ ॥

*kṣaṇeka rodana kṣaṇe aṭṭa aṭṭa hāsa |*
*kṣaṇe kāṁpe kṣaṇe kṣaṇe ādha ādha bhāṣa || 158 ||*

*Word for word:* kshaneka rodana — now weeping; kshane atta atta hasa — now loud laughter; kshane kampe — now he trembles; kshane kshane — at moments; adha adha bhasha — half-uttered words

**158.** Now he weeps, now laughs aloud,
now trembles, now stammers in half-words;

ক্ষণে হুহুঙ্কার ছাড়ে মারে মালসাট ।
গোরা গোরা বলি কান্দে অন্তরে উচাট ॥ ১৫৯ ॥

*kṣaṇe huhuṅkāra chāṛe māre mālasāṭa |*
*gorā gorā bali kānde antare ucāṭa || 159 ||*

*Word for word:* kshane huhunkara chhade — now he roars; mare malasata — slaps his arms like a wrestler; gora gora bali — crying "Gora, Gora"; kande — he weeps; antare uchata — restless at heart

**159.** now he roars and slaps his arms like a wrestler;[^04-2]
crying "Gora, Gora!" he weeps, his heart restless.

পাশরিতে নারে গোরার সুমধুর প্রেম ।
অঙ্গ ঝলমল তেজ দিনকর যেন ॥ ১৬০ ॥

*pāśarite nāre gorāra sumadhura prema |*
*aṅga jhalamala teja dinakara yena || 160 ||*

*Word for word:* pasharite nare — he cannot forget; gorara sumadhura prema — Gora's sweetest prema; anga jhalamala — his body blazes; teja — with radiance; dinakara yena — like the sun

**160.** He cannot forget Gora's sweetest prema;
his body blazes with radiance like the sun.

চলিতে না পারে প্রেমে অন্তর-উল্লাস ।
আঁখির নিমিখে গেলা শিবের কৈলাস ॥ ১৬১ ॥

*calite nā pāre preme antara-ullāsa |*
*āṁkhira nimikhe gelā śibera kailāsa || 161 ||*

*Word for word:* chalite na pare — he cannot walk; preme — from prema; antara-ullasa — joy within; akhira nimikhe — in the twinkling of an eye; gela shivera kailasa — he reached Shiva's Kailasa

**161.** For prema he cannot walk, his heart exults —
and in the twinkling of an eye he was at Shiva's Kailasa.

মহেশ দেখিব বলি বাড়িল আনন্দ ।
কহিব কৃষ্ণের কথা করিয়া প্রবন্ধ ॥ ১৬২ ॥

*maheśa dekhiba bali bāṛila ānanda |*
*kahiba kṛṣṇera kathā kariẏā prabandha || 162 ||*

*Word for word:* mahesha dekhiba bali — thinking "I shall see Mahesha"; badila ananda — his joy grew; kahiba krishnera katha — "I shall tell of Krishna"; kariya prabandha — in a well-ordered account

**162.** "I shall see Mahesha!" — and his joy grew:
"I shall tell him of Krishna, all in due order.

এছন আনন্দ-কথা নাহি তিনলোকে ।
বৃন্দাবন-ধন প্রকাশিব কলিযুগে ॥ ১৬৩ ॥

*echana ānanda-kathā nāhi tinaloke |*
*bṛndābana-dhana prakāśiba kaliyuge || 163 ||*

*Word for word:* echhana ananda-katha — such joyful news; nahi tina-loke — is not in the three worlds; vrindavana-dhana — the treasure of Vrindavana; prakashiba — He will reveal; kali-yuge — in the Kali-yuga

**163.** There is no such joyful news in the three worlds:
the treasure of Vrindavana [the Lord] will reveal in the Kali-yuga;

যে প্রেম যাচয়ে শিব বিরিঞ্চি অনন্ত ।
তাহা বিলসিব কলি অধম দুরন্ত ॥ ১৬৪ ॥

*ye prema yācaẏe śiba biriñci ananta |*
*tāhā bilasiba kali adhama duranta || 164 ||*

*Word for word:* ye prema yachaye — the prema begged for by; shiva virinchi ananta — Shiva, Brahma, Ananta; taha vilasiba — that will be enjoyed by; kali — [the people of] Kali; adhama duranta — the fallen and wild

**164.** the prema for which Shiva, Brahma and Ananta pray
the fallen and unruly [people] of Kali will enjoy.

হেন অদভুত কথা কহিব মহেশে ।
শুনিঞা ঠাকুর পাবে বড়ই সন্তোষে ॥ ১৬৫ ॥

*hena adabhuta kathā kahiba maheśe |*
*śuniñā ṭhākura pābe baṛai santoṣe || 165 ||*

*Word for word:* hena adabhuta katha — such wondrous news; kahiba maheshe — I shall tell Mahesha; shuniya — hearing; thakura — the lord; pabe badai santoshe — will be greatly pleased

**165.** I shall tell Mahesha this wondrous news —
hearing it, the lord will be greatly pleased.

কাত্যায়নী-প্রসাদ লইব পদধূলি ।
যাঁর পদ-পরসাদে হরিনাম বলি ॥ ১৬৬ ॥

*kātyāẏanī-prasāda laiba padadhūli |*
*yāṁra pada-parasāde harināma bali || 166 ||*

*Word for word:* katyayani-prasada — Katyayani's grace; laiba pada-dhuli — I shall take, the dust of [her] feet; yara pada-parasade — by the grace of whose feet; hari-nama bali — I utter Hari's name

**166.** By Katyayani's grace I shall take the dust of her feet —
by the grace of [those] feet I utter Hari's name."[^04-3]

চিন্তিতে চিন্তিতে গেলা মহেশের দ্বার ।
সম্ভ্রমে উঠিলা দেখি নন্দী মহাকাল ॥ ১৬৭ ॥

*cintite cintite gelā maheśera dbāra |*
*sambhrame uṭhilā dekhi nandī mahākāla || 167 ||*

*Word for word:* chintite chintite — musing thus; gela maheshera dvara — he came to Mahesha's gate; sambhrame uthila — rose respectfully; dekhi — seeing [him]; nandi mahakala — Nandi and Mahakala

**167.** Musing thus, he came to Mahesha's gate;
seeing him, Nandi and Mahakala rose respectfully.[^04-4]

পরণাম করি নন্দী গেলা অভ্যন্তরে ।
পার্বতী-মহেশ যথা নিজ অন্তঃপুরে ॥ ১৬৮ ॥

*paraṇāma kari nandī gelā abhyantare |*
*pārbatī-maheśa yathā nija antaḥpure || 168 ||*

*Word for word:* paranama kari — bowing; nandi gela abhyantare — Nandi went inside; parvati-mahesha yatha — where Parvati and Mahesha were; nija antahpure — in their inner apartments

**168.** Bowing, Nandi went inside,
where Parvati and Mahesha were in their inner apartments,

জানাইলা দ্বারেতে নারদ-আগমন ।
আনন্দ-হৃদয়ে দোঁহে চলিলা তখন ॥ ১৬৯ ॥

*jānāilā dbārete nārada-āgamana |*
*ānanda-hṛdaẏe doṁhe calilā takhana || 169 ||*

*Word for word:* janaila — he announced; dvarete narada-agamana — Narada's arrival at the gate; ananda-hridaye — with joyful hearts; donhe chalila — both went; takhana — at once

**169.** and announced that Narada was at the gate;
both came out at once with joyful hearts.

নারদ দেখিয়া হাসি সম্ভাষে ঠাকুর ।
চরণে পড়িলা মুনি ভক্ত সুচতুর ॥ ১৭০ ॥

*nārada dekhiẏā hāsi sambhāṣe ṭhākura |*
*caraṇe paṛilā muni bhakta sucatura || 170 ||*

*Word for word:* narada dekhiya — seeing Narada; hasi sambhashe thakura — the lord greets [him] smiling; charane padila muni — the sage fell at his feet; bhakta suchatura — the wise devotee

**170.** Seeing Narada, the lord greets him with a smile;
the sage, a wise devotee, fell at his feet.

মহেশ বিশেষ জানে বৈষ্ণবমহিমা ।
নারদে গৌরব করে প্রকাশিয়া প্রেমা ॥ ১৭১ ॥

*maheśa biśeṣa jāne baiṣṇabamahimā |*
*nārade gauraba kare prakāśiẏā premā || 171 ||*

*Word for word:* mahesha vishesha jane — Mahesha especially knows; vaishnava-mahima — the greatness of Vaishnavas; narade gaurava kare — he honours Narada; prakashiya prema — showing love

**171.** Mahesha, like no other, knows the greatness of Vaishnavas:
showing his love, he honours Narada.

গাঢ় আলিঙ্গন করি বসাইলা পাশে ।
চরণে পড়িয়া মুনি দেবীকে সম্ভাষে ॥ ১৭২ ॥

*gāṛha āliṅgana kari basāilā pāśe |*
*caraṇe paṛiẏā muni debīke sambhāṣe || 172 ||*

*Word for word:* gadha alingana kari — embracing [him] tightly; basaila pashe — he seated [him] beside; charane padiya — falling at her feet; muni devike sambhashe — the sage greets the goddess

**172.** Embracing him tightly, he seated him beside himself;
the sage, falling at the goddess's feet, greets her.

করে ধরি লৈয়া গেলা নারদ তপোধনে ।
গৌরব করিয়া দিল বসিতে আসনে ॥ ১৭২+১ ॥

*kare dhari laiẏā gelā nārada tapodhane |*
*gauraba kariẏā dila basite āsane || 172+1 ||*

*Word for word:* kare dhari — taking by the hand; laiya gela — led (the subject is not named); narada tapodhane — Narada, rich in austerity; gaurava kariya — with honour; dila vasite asane — seated [him] on a seat

**172+1.** Narada, rich in austerity, was taken by the hand and led,
and with honour seated on a seat.[^04-5]

পুত্রস্নেহে নারদেরে পুছে কাত্যায়নী ।
কুশল মঙ্গল কহ প্রিয় মহামুনি ॥ ১৭৩ ॥

*putrasnehe nāradere puche kātyāẏanī |*
*kuśala maṅgala kaha priẏa mahāmuni || 173 ||*

*Word for word:* putra-snehe — with a mother's affection; naradere puchhe katyayani — Katyayani asks Narada; kushala mangala kaha — tell of your welfare; priya mahamuni — dear great sage

**173.** With a mother's tenderness Katyayani asks Narada:
"Tell me of your welfare, dear great sage.

চতুর্দশভুবনের তুমি তত্ত্ব জান ।
আজি কোথা হৈতে তব শুভ আগমন ॥ ১৭৪ ॥

*caturdaśabhubanera tumi tattba jāna |*
*āji kothā haite taba śubha āgamana || 174 ||*

*Word for word:* chaturdasha-bhuvanera — of the fourteen worlds; tumi tattva jana — you know the truth; aji kotha haite — from where today; taba shubha agamana — your auspicious coming

**174.** You know the truth of the fourteen worlds;
from where have you come today — to our good fortune?"

নারদ কহয়ে—শুন অদভুত কথা ।
জগত-নিস্তার-হেতু তুমি মাতাপিতা ॥ ১৭৫ ॥

*nārada kahaẏe—śuna adabhuta kathā |*
*jagata-nistāra-hetu tumi mātāpitā || 175 ||*

*Word for word:* narada kahaye — Narada says; shuna adabhuta katha — hear wondrous news; jagata-nistara-hetu — for the deliverance of the world; tumi mata-pita — you are mother and father

**175.** Narada says: "Hear wondrous news;
you are mother and father, [come] for the deliverance of the world.

পুরুব-রহস্য-কথা পাশরিলে তুমি ।
চরণে ধরিয়া এবে স্মরাইব আমি ॥ ১৭৬ ॥

*puruba-rahasya-kathā pāśarile tumi |*
*caraṇe dhariẏā ebe smarāiba āmi || 176 ||*

*Word for word:* puruba-rahasya-katha — the former secret; pasharile tumi — you have forgotten; charane dhariya — clasping your feet; ebe smaraiba ami — now I shall remind [you]

**176.** You have forgotten a former secret;
clasping your feet, I shall now remind you of it.

আদ্যোপান্ত যত কথা কহি তব স্থানে ।
শুনিঞা প্রসাদ মোরে করিবে আপনে ॥ ১৭৭ ॥

*ādyopānta yata kathā kahi taba sthāne |*
*śuniñā prasāda more karibe āpane || 177 ||*

*Word for word:* adyopanta yata katha — all from beginning to end; kahi taba sthane — I tell you; shuniya — having heard; prasada more karibe apane — you yourself will show me grace

**177.** I shall tell you everything from beginning to end;
having heard it, you yourself will show me grace.

প্রভুরে পুরুবে কিছু পুছিল উদ্ধব ।
তব অন্তর্ধানে কিবা পৃথিবী রহিব ॥ ১৭৮ ॥

*prabhure purube kichu puchila uddhaba |*
*taba antardhāne kibā pṛthibī rahiba || 178 ||*

*Word for word:* prabhure — the Lord; purube — formerly; kichhu puchhila uddhava — Uddhava asked something; taba antardhane — at Your disappearance; kiba prithivi rahiba — will the earth remain

**178.** Once Uddhava asked the Lord:
'When You withdraw from sight, will the earth remain?

ভকত রহিব কিবা এই মহীমাঝে ।
শুনিঞা ঠাকুর যোগ কহে নিজ কাজে ॥ ১৭৯ ॥

*bhakata rahiba kibā ei mahīmājhe |*
*śuniñā ṭhākura yoga kahe nija kāje || 179 ||*

*Word for word:* bhakata rahiba kiba — will devotees remain; ei mahi-majhe — on this earth; shuniya — hearing; thakura — the Lord; yoga kahe — expounds yoga; nija kaje — concerning His own workings

**179.** Will devotees remain on this earth?'
Hearing this, the Thakura explained to him the yoga of what He Himself is:[^04-6]

আমি জল আমি স্থল আমি মহী বৃক্ষ ।
আমি দেব গন্ধর্ব আমি যক্ষ রক্ষ ॥ ১৮০ ॥

*āmi jala āmi sthala āmi mahī bṛkṣa |*
*āmi deba gandharba āmi yakṣa rakṣa || 180 ||*

*Word for word:* ami jala — I am water; ami sthala — I am land; ami mahi vriksha — I am earth and trees; ami deva gandharva — I am gods and gandharvas; ami yaksha raksha — I am yakshas and rakshasas

**180.** 'I am water, I am land, I am earth and trees,
I am gods and gandharvas, I am yakshas and rakshasas;

উৎপত্তি প্রলয় আমি সর্বজীব-প্রাণ ।
আমি সর্বময় আমার কাঁহা অন্তর্ধান ॥ ১৮১ ॥

*utpatti pralaẏa āmi sarbajība-prāṇa |*
*āmi sarbamaẏa āmāra kāṁhā antardhāna || 181 ||*

*Word for word:* utpatti pralaya ami — I am origin and dissolution; sarvajiva-prana — the life of all beings; ami sarvamaya — I am all-pervading; amara kanha antardhana — where is My disappearance?

**181.** I am origin and dissolution, the life of all beings;
I pervade all — how can I vanish?'[^04-7]

এছন ঠাকুর-বাণী শুনিঞা উদ্ধব ।
বুকে কর হানি কহে নিজ অনুভব ॥ ১৮২ ॥

*echana ṭhākura-bāṇī śuniñā uddhaba |*
*buke kara hāni kahe nija anubhaba || 182 ||*

*Word for word:* echhana thakura-vani — such words of the Lord; shuniya uddhava — hearing, Uddhava; buke kara hani — striking his breast with his hand; kahe nija anubhava — speaks his own realization

**182.** Hearing such words of the Thakura, Uddhava,
striking his breast with his hand, speaks his own realization:

তুমি সর্বময় প্রভু—আমি ইহা জানি ।
তোমার অধিক তোর পদ দুইখানি ॥ ১৮৩ ॥

*tumi sarbamaẏa prabhu—āmi ihā jāni |*
*tomāra adhika tora pada duikhāni || 183 ||*

*Word for word:* tumi sarvamaya prabhu — You are the all-pervading Lord; ami iha jani — I know this; tomara adhika — greater than You; tora pada duikhani — are Your two feet

**183.** 'You are the all-pervading Lord, this I know;
but greater than You [Yourself] are Your two feet.

যে পড়িল পদ-নখ-চন্দ্রিকার পাশে ।
আর কি কহিব গুণ মুখে নাহি আসে ॥ ১৮৪ ॥

*ye paṛila pada-nakha-candrikāra pāśe |*
*āra ki kahiba guṇa mukhe nāhi āse || 184 ||*

*Word for word:* ye padila — whoever has fallen; pada-nakha-chandrikara pashe — into the noose of the moonlight of the toenails; ara ki kahiba — what more shall I say; guna — [his] glory; mukhe nahi ase — does not come to the lips

**184.** Whoever is caught in the net of the moonlight of Your toenails —
what more can I say? — his glory cannot be put into words.'

*So in the* Srimad-Bhagavata *(11.6.46):*

ত্বয়োপভুক্তস্রগ্গন্ধবাসোঽলঙ্কারচর্চিতাঃ ।
উচ্ছিষ্টভোজিনো দাসাস্তব মায়াং জয়েম হি ॥ ১৮৫ ॥

*tbaẏopabhuktasraggandhabāso'laṅkāracarcitāḥ |*
*ucchiṣṭabhojino dāsāstaba māẏāṃ jaẏema hi || 185 ||*

*Word for word:* tvaya upabhukta — enjoyed by You; srak-gandha-vasah-alankara — garlands, scents, garments, ornaments; charchitah — adorned with; uchchhishta-bhojinah — eating the remnants; dasah — servants; tava mayam — Your maya; jayema hi — we shall surely conquer

**185.** "Adorned with the garlands, scents, garments and ornaments that You have enjoyed,
we, Your servants who eat Your remnants, shall surely conquer Your maya."[^04-8]

মোর বল—উচ্ছিষ্ট ভুঞ্জিয়া হরিদাস ।
তোর মায়া জিনি তোর উচ্ছিষ্টের আশ ॥ ১৮৬ ॥

*mora bala—ucchiṣṭa bhuñjiẏā haridāsa |*
*tora māẏā jini tora ucchiṣṭera āśa || 186 ||*

*Word for word:* mora bala — my strength; uchchhishta bhunjiya — eating the remnants; hari-dasa — Hari's servant; tora maya jini — I conquer Your maya; tora uchchhishtera asha — my hope is Your remnants

**186.** 'My strength is this: I, Hari's servant, eat the remnants;
I conquer Your maya — all my hope is in Your remnants.'

এছন ঠাকুর আর উদ্ধবের কথা ।
শুনিঞা হৃদয়ে মোর লাগি গেল ব্যথা ॥ ১৮৭ ॥

*echana ṭhākura āra uddhabera kathā |*
*śuniñā hṛdaẏe mora lāgi gela byathā || 187 ||*

*Word for word:* echhana — such; thakura ara uddhavera katha — talk of the Lord and Uddhava; shuniya — hearing; hridaye mora — in my heart; lagi gela vyatha — pain arose

**187.** Hearing such a conversation of the Thakura and Uddhava,
I felt pain in my heart:

এতদিন ধরি মোর পথ-পরিচয় ।
আজিহ না জানি হেন উচ্ছিষ্ট নিশ্চয় ॥ ১৮৮ ॥

*etadina dhari mora patha-paricaẏa |*
*ājiha nā jāni hena ucchiṣṭa niścaẏa || 188 ||*

*Word for word:* etadina dhari — all this time; mora patha-parichaya — I have known the path; ajiha na jani — yet till today I did not know; hena uchchhishta — such remnants; nishchaya — for certain

**188.** for so long I have known the path [of bhakti],
yet until today I did not know for certain [the power of] such remnants.

উচ্ছিষ্টের বলে হরিদাস বল ধরে ।
প্রভু-বিদ্যমানে উচ্ছিষ্টের পুরস্কারে ॥ ১৮৯ ॥

*ucchiṣṭera bale haridāsa bala dhare |*
*prabhu-bidyamāne ucchiṣṭera puraskāre || 189 ||*

*Word for word:* uchchhishtera bale — by the strength of the remnants; hari-dasa bala dhare — Hari's servant holds power; prabhu-vidyamane — in the Lord's presence; uchchhishtera puraskare — honouring the remnants

**189.** By the strength of the remnants Hari's servant gains strength —
that is why in the Lord's presence he praised them so.[^04-9]

হেন মহাপ্রসাদ মুঞি না ভুঞ্জিলুঁ কভু ।
অন্তরে জানিলুঁ মোরে বঞ্চিয়াছে প্রভু ॥ ১৯০ ॥

*hena mahāprasāda muñi nā bhuñjiluṁ kabhu |*
*antare jāniluṁ more bañciẏāche prabhu || 190 ||*

*Word for word:* hena mahaprasada — such mahaprasada; munji na bhunjilun kabhu — I never tasted; antare janilun — I realized within; more vanchiyachhe prabhu — the Lord has deprived me

**190.** Such mahaprasada I have never tasted —
I realized in my heart that the Lord had deprived me.

এই মহাপ্রসাদ ভুঞ্জিয়ে কোন্ বুদ্ধি ।
কেমন উপায়ে পরসন্ন হবে বিধি ॥ ১৯১ ॥

*ei mahāprasāda bhuñjiẏe kon buddhi |*
*kemana upāẏe parasanna habe bidhi || 191 ||*

*Word for word:* ei mahaprasada — this mahaprasada; bhunjiye — I may eat; kon buddhi — by what device; kemana upaye — by what means; parasanna habe vidhi — will fate be favourable

**191.** How might I taste this mahaprasada?
By what means could I win fate's favour?

এই মনঃকথা-রসে বৈকুণ্ঠেরে গেলুঁ ।
লখিমীদেবীর সেবা বহুবিধ কৈলুঁ ॥ ১৯২ ॥

*ei manaḥkathā-rase baikuṇṭhere geluṁ |*
*lakhimīdebīra sebā bahubidha kailuṁ || 192 ||*

*Word for word:* ei manah-katha-rase — absorbed in this thought; vaikunthere gelun — I went to Vaikuntha; lakhimi-devira seva — service to Lakshmi-devi; bahuvidha kailun — I did in many ways

**192.** Absorbed in this thought, I went to Vaikuntha
and served Lakshmi-devi in every way.

পরসন্ন হঞা দেবী পরিতোষে বৈল ।
"মাগ বর দিব" বলি প্রতিজ্ঞা করিল ॥ ১৯৩ ॥

*parasanna hañā debī paritoṣe baila |*
*"māga bara diba" bali pratijñā karila || 193 ||*

*Word for word:* parasanna haina — being pleased; devi paritoshe baila — the goddess said in satisfaction; maga bara — ask a boon; diba — I shall give; bali pratijna karila — saying so, she vowed

**193.** The goddess, pleased, said graciously:
'Ask a boon — I shall give it,' and she made a vow.

প্রতিজ্ঞা শুনিঞা হিয়া প্রতি-আশ কৈল ।
সেই সে কুশল-বাণী পুনঃ দঢ়াইল ॥ ১৯৪ ॥

*pratijñā śuniñā hiẏā prati-āśa kaila |*
*sei se kuśala-bāṇī punaḥ daṛhāila || 194 ||*

*Word for word:* pratijna shuniya — hearing the vow; hiya prati-asha kaila — my heart took hope; sei se kushala-vani — those very kind words; punah dadhaila — I had her confirm again

**194.** Hearing the vow, my heart took hope,
and I had her confirm those kind words once more.

কাতর-বয়ানে বৈলুঁ করযোড় করি ।
চিরদিন অন্তরে বেদনা বড় মোরি ॥ ১৯৫ ॥

*kātara-baẏāne bailuṁ karayoṛa kari |*
*ciradina antare bedanā baṛa mori || 195 ||*

*Word for word:* katara-bayane — with a pleading voice; bailun — I said; karayoda kari — with folded palms; chiradina antare — for long in my heart; vedana bada mori — I have great pain

**195.** With a pleading voice and folded palms I said:
'For long there has been a great pain in my heart.

সর্বজন জানে—তোর সেবক নারদ ।
না ভুঞ্জিল মহাপ্রভুর উচ্ছিষ্ট-প্রসাদ ॥ ১৯৬ ॥

*sarbajana jāne—tora sebaka nārada |*
*nā bhuñjila mahāprabhura ucchiṣṭa-prasāda || 196 ||*

*Word for word:* sarvajana jane — everyone knows; tora sevaka narada — Narada is your servant; na bhunjila — he has not tasted; mahaprabhura uchchhishta-prasada — the remnants of the Great Lord's meal

**196.** Everyone knows that Narada is your servant,
yet he has not tasted the remnants of the Great Lord's meal.[^04-10]

প্রভুর প্রসাদ মোরে দেহ একমুষ্টি ।
এই বর দেহ মোরে চাহি শুভদৃষ্টি ॥ ১৯৭ ॥

*prabhura prasāda more deha ekamuṣṭi |*
*ei bara deha more cāhi śubhadṛṣṭi || 197 ||*

*Word for word:* prabhura prasada — the Lord's prasada; more deha ekamushti — give me a handful; ei bara deha more — give me this boon; chahi shubha-drishti — looking [on me] kindly

**197.** Give me a handful of the Lord's prasada —
this is the boon I ask; look on me with kindness.'

শুনিঞা লখিমীদেবী বয়ান-বিস্ময় ।
কহিতে লাগিলা কিছু করিয়া বিনয় ॥ ১৯৮ ॥

*śuniñā lakhimīdebī baẏāna-bismaẏa |*
*kahite lāgilā kichu kariẏā binaẏa || 198 ||*

*Word for word:* shuniya — hearing; lakhimi-devi — Lakshmi-devi; bayana-vismaya — her face showing surprise; kahite lagila kichhu — began to say; kariya vinaya — humbly

**198.** Hearing this, Lakshmi-devi, astonished,
began to speak humbly:

প্রভু-আজ্ঞা নাহি কারে দিবারে উচ্ছিষ্ট ।
আজ্ঞা লঙ্ঘি মুনি তোরে দিব অবশিষ্ট ॥ ১৯৯ ॥

*prabhu-ājñā nāhi kāre dibāre ucchiṣṭa |*
*ājñā laṅghi muni tore diba abaśiṣṭa || 199 ||*

*Word for word:* prabhu-ajna nahi — there is no order of the Lord; kare dibare uchchhishta — to give anyone the remnants; ajna langhi — transgressing the order; muni — O sage; tore diba avashishta — shall I give you the remnants?

**199.** 'There is no order of the Lord to give His remnants to anyone;
how can I, O sage, transgress His order and give you the remnants?

বিলম্ব করহ কিছু আমারে চাহিয়া ।
বিলম্বে সে দিতে পারি সঞ্চয় করিয়া ॥ ২০০ ॥

*bilamba karaha kichu āmāre cāhiẏā |*
*bilambe se dite pāri sañcaẏa kariẏā || 200 ||*

*Word for word:* vilamba karaha kichhu — wait a while; amare chahiya — for my sake; vilambe se — in time; dite pari — I can give; sanchaya kariya — having saved some

**200.** Wait a little for my sake:
in time I may be able to give, having saved [some].'

এছন মধুর বাণী বৈল ঠাকুরাণী ।
ভাল ভাল বৈলুঁ কাজ বুঝিয়া আপনি ॥ ২০১ ॥

*echana madhura bāṇī baila ṭhākurāṇī |*
*bhāla bhāla bailuṁ kāja bujhiẏā āpani || 201 ||*

*Word for word:* echhana madhura vani — such sweet words; baila thakurani — the queen spoke; bhala bhala bailun — I said, "Good, good"; kaja bujhiya apani — understanding the matter myself

**201.** So sweetly the queen spoke;
I answered, 'Good, good,' understanding the matter myself.

কথোদিন বহি একদিন পঁহু রসে ।
কর পরশিয়া দেবী বসাইলা পাশে ॥ ২০২ ॥

*kathodina bahi ekadina paṁhu rase |*
*kara paraśiẏā debī basāilā pāśe || 202 ||*

*Word for word:* katho-dina vahi — some days having passed; ekadina — one day; panhu rase — the Lord in a loving mood; kara parashiya — touching her hand; devi basaila pashe — seated the goddess beside Him

**202.** Some days passed, and one day the Lord, in a tender mood,
took the goddess by the hand and seated her beside Him.

হাসিয়া কহয়ে কথা সরস সম্ভাষে ।
অনুমতি লঞা দেবী অন্তর-তরাসে ॥ ২০৩ ॥

*hāsiẏā kahaẏe kathā sarasa sambhāṣe |*
*anumati lañā debī antara-tarāse || 203 ||*

*Word for word:* hasiya kahaye katha — smiling, He talks; sarasa sambhashe — in tender conversation; anumati lana — taking leave [to speak]; devi — the goddess; antara-tarase — with fear at heart

**203.** Smiling, He talks lovingly with her;
the goddess, asking leave to speak, with fear at heart,

প্রণতি করিয়া বৈল—নিবেদন আছে ।
হৃদয়-তরাস মোর সঙ্কট সঙ্কোচে ॥ ২০৪ ॥

*praṇati kariẏā baila—nibedana āche |*
*hṛdaẏa-tarāsa mora saṅkaṭa saṅkoce || 204 ||*

*Word for word:* pranati kariya — bowing; baila — she said; nivedana achhe — I have a petition; hridaya-tarasa mora — my heart is afraid; sankata sankoche — in distress and shyness

**204.** bowed and said: 'I have a petition;
my heart is afraid — I am in distress and abashed.

সঙ্কট ঘুচাহ প্রভু রাখ নিজ দাসী ।
চরণে ধরিয়া বোলোঁ শুন গুণরাশি ॥ ২০৫ ॥

*saṅkaṭa ghucāha prabhu rākha nija dāsī |*
*caraṇe dhariẏā boloṁ śuna guṇarāśi || 205 ||*

*Word for word:* sankata ghuchaha — remove the trouble; prabhu — Lord; rakha nija dasi — protect Your maidservant; charane dhariya bolon — I speak clasping Your feet; shuna gunarashi — hear, treasury of virtues

**205.** Remove my trouble, Lord, protect Your maidservant;
clasping Your feet I beg: hear me, treasury of virtues.'

লখিমী কাতরে কহে প্রভুকে তরাসে ।
সুদর্শন-পানে চাহে সবিস্ময় হাসে ॥ ২০৬ ॥

*lakhimī kātare kahe prabhuke tarāse |*
*sudarśana-pāne cāhe sabismaẏa hāse || 206 ||*

*Word for word:* lakhimi katare kahe — Lakshmi speaks piteously; prabhuke tarase — to the Lord in fear; sudarshana-pane chahe — [He] looks at Sudarshana; savismaya hase — with a surprised smile

**206.** Lakshmi speaks piteously to the Lord, in fear;
He looks at Sudarshana with a surprised smile.[^04-11]

কাঁপে চক্র সুদর্শন বলে কাকুবাণী ।
লখিমী-সঙ্কট প্রভু আমি নাহি জানি ॥ ২০৭ ॥

*kāṁpe cakra sudarśana bale kākubāṇī |*
*lakhimī-saṅkaṭa prabhu āmi nāhi jāni || 207 ||*

*Word for word:* kanpe chakra sudarshana — the disc Sudarshana trembles; bale kaku-vani — speaks pleadingly; lakhimi-sankata — of Lakshmi's trouble; prabhu — Lord; ami nahi jani — I know nothing

**207.** The disc Sudarshana trembles and says pleadingly:
'Lord, I know nothing of Lakshmi's trouble.'

লখিমী কহয়ে—সুদর্শনের নাহি দোষ ।
নারদের কথায় মোর হৈল হিয়া-শোষ ॥ ২০৮ ॥

*lakhimī kahaẏe—sudarśanera nāhi doṣa |*
*nāradera kathāẏa mora haila hiẏā-śoṣa || 208 ||*

*Word for word:* lakhimi kahaye — Lakshmi says; sudarshanera nahi dosha — Sudarshana is not at fault; naradera kathaya — because of Narada's words; mora haila hiya-shosha — my heart has withered

**208.** Lakshmi says: 'Sudarshana is not to blame:
because of Narada's words my heart has withered.

দ্বাদশ বৎসর মোর অজ্ঞাত-সেবা কৈল ।
পরিতোষ পাঞা আমি প্রতিজ্ঞা করিল ॥ ২০৯ ॥

*dbādaśa batsara mora ajñāta-sebā kaila |*
*paritoṣa pāñā āmi pratijñā karila || 209 ||*

*Word for word:* dvadasha vatsara — for twelve years; mora ajnata-seva kaila — he served me without my knowing [why]; paritosha pana — being pleased; ami pratijna karila — I made a vow

**209.** For twelve years he served me without revealing [his aim];
pleased, I made a vow —

মাগ বর দিব বলি বৈলুঁ সত্য সত্য ।
পুনঃ দঢ়াইল মুনি সেই কথা নিত্য ॥ ২১০ ॥

*māga bara diba bali bailuṁ satya satya |*
*punaḥ daṛhāila muni sei kathā nitya || 210 ||*

*Word for word:* maga bara diba bali — saying "Ask a boon, I shall give"; bailun satya satya — I said, "Truly, truly"; punah dadhaila muni — the sage made it fast again; sei katha nitya — that word for ever

**210.** "Ask a boon, I shall give it," I said: "Truly, truly";
and the sage made that word fast for ever.

মাগিল যে বর তোর উচ্ছিষ্টের তরে ।
মোর শক্তি কিবা তোর আজ্ঞা লঙ্ঘিবারে ॥ ২১১ ॥

*māgila ye bara tora ucchiṣṭera tare |*
*mora śakti kibā tora ājñā laṅghibāre || 211 ||*

*Word for word:* magila ye bara — the boon he asked; tora uchchhishtera tare — is for Your remnants; mora shakti kiba — what power have I; tora ajna langhibare — to transgress Your order

**211.** The boon he asked is Your remnants;
but what power have I to transgress Your order?

এই কথা কৈলুঁ মোর প্রমাদ নিকট ।
রাখ নিজ দাসী প্রভু ঘুচাহ সঙ্কট ॥ ২১২ ॥

*ei kathā kailuṁ mora pramāda nikaṭa |*
*rākha nija dāsī prabhu ghucāha saṅkaṭa || 212 ||*

*Word for word:* ei katha kailun — I have told this; mora pramada nikata — calamity is near me; rakha nija dasi — protect Your maidservant; prabhu — Lord; ghuchaha sankata — remove the trouble

**212.** So I have told You — calamity is upon me;
protect Your maidservant, Lord, remove my trouble.'

বুঝিয়া কহিল কথা—শুনহ লখিমী ।
বড়ই প্রমাদ-কথা কহিলে যে তুমি ॥ ২১৩ ॥

*bujhiẏā kahila kathā—śunaha lakhimī |*
*baṛai pramāda-kathā kahile ye tumi || 213 ||*

*Word for word:* bujhiya — understanding; kahila katha — He said; shunaha lakhimi — listen, Lakshmi; badai pramada-katha — a very grave matter; kahile ye tumi — is what you have told

**213.** Understanding all, He said: 'Listen, Lakshmi:
a very grave matter is what you have told.

নিভৃতে সে দিহ যেন আমি নাহি জানি ।
শুনিঞা সন্তোষ পাইল প্রভু-আজ্ঞাবাণী ॥ ২১৪ ॥

*nibhṛte se diha yena āmi nāhi jāni |*
*śuniñā santoṣa pāila prabhu-ājñābāṇī || 214 ||*

*Word for word:* nibhrite se diha — give it in secret; yena ami nahi jani — so that I do not know; shuniya — hearing; santosha paila — she was glad; prabhu-ajna-vani — the Lord's words of leave

**214.** Give it to him in secret — so that I do not know.'
Hearing the Lord's words of leave, she was glad.

কথোদিন রহি সেই জগত-জননী ।
মহাপ্রসাদ মোরে দিলা ডাক দিয়া আনি ॥ ২১৫ ॥

*kathodina rahi sei jagata-jananī |*
*mahāprasāda more dilā ḍāka diẏā āni || 215 ||*

*Word for word:* kathodina rahi — after some days; sei jagata-janani — that Mother of the world; mahaprasada more dila — gave me mahaprasada; dak diya ani — calling me to her

**215.** After some days that Mother of the world
called me and gave me mahaprasada.

লখিমী-প্রসাদে মহাপ্রসাদ পাইনু ।
পূর্ণ মনোরথে মহাপ্রসাদ ভুঞ্জিনু ॥ ২১৬ ॥

*lakhimī-prasāde mahāprasāda pāinu |*
*pūrṇa manorathe mahāprasāda bhuñjinu || 216 ||*

*Word for word:* lakhimi-prasade — by Lakshmi's grace; mahaprasada painu — I obtained mahaprasada; purna manorathe — my desire fulfilled; mahaprasada bhunjinu — I ate the mahaprasada

**216.** By Lakshmi's grace I obtained mahaprasada
and, my desire fulfilled, I ate the mahaprasada.

কোটি-ইন্দু-জিনি জ্যোতিঃ কোটি-কামরূপ ।
কোটি-দিবাকর-তেজঃ হৈল অপরূপ ॥ ২১৭ ॥

*koṭi-indu-jini jyotiḥ koṭi-kāmarūpa |*
*koṭi-dibākara-tejaḥ haila aparūpa || 217 ||*

*Word for word:* koti-indu-jini jyotih — light surpassing millions of moons; koti-kama-rupa — beauty of millions of Kamadevas; koti-divakara-tejah — splendour of millions of suns; haila aparupa — became wondrous

**217.** A light surpassing millions of moons, the beauty of millions of Kamadevas,
the splendour of millions of suns — so wondrous did I become.

শতগুণ তেজঃ মহাপ্রসাদ-পরশে ।
বীণা বাজাইয়া সুখে আইনু কৈলাসে ॥ ২১৮ ॥

*śataguṇa tejaḥ mahāprasāda-paraśe |*
*bīṇā bājāiẏā sukhe āinu kailāse || 218 ||*

*Word for word:* shataguna tejah — a hundredfold splendour; mahaprasada-parashe — by the touch of mahaprasada; vina bajaiya — playing the vina; sukhe ainu kailase — happily I came to Kailasa

**218.** At the touch of mahaprasada my splendour grew a hundredfold;
playing my vina, happy, I came to Kailasa.

আমারে দেখিয়া প্রভু পুছিলা মহেশ ।
হাসিয়া কহিলা—আজি অপরূপ বেশ ॥ ২১৯ ॥

*āmāre dekhiẏā prabhu puchilā maheśa |*
*hāsiẏā kahilā—āji aparūpa beśa || 219 ||*

*Word for word:* amare dekhiya — seeing me; prabhu puchhila mahesha — lord Mahesha asked; hasiya kahila — smiling he said; aji aparupa vesha — today [you have] a wondrous look

**219.** Seeing me, lord Mahesha
said with a smile: 'What a wondrous look you have today!

অতি অপরূপ তেজঃ দেখিতে বিস্ময় ।
আজি কেনে হেন রূপ কহ না নিশ্চয় ॥ ২২০ ॥

*ati aparūpa tejaḥ dekhite bismaẏa |*
*āji kene hena rūpa kaha nā niścaẏa || 220 ||*

*Word for word:* ati aparupa tejah — most wondrous splendour; dekhite vismaya — amazing to see; aji kene hena rupa — why such a form today; kaha na nishchaya — do tell me truly

**220.** Your splendour is so wondrous that it amazes the eye;
why do you have such a form today? Tell me truly.'

আদ্য-অন্ত যত কথা সকলি কহিল ।
শুনিঞা মহেশ পুনঃ আমারে গঞ্জিল ॥ ২২১ ॥

*ādya-anta yata kathā sakali kahila |*
*śuniñā maheśa punaḥ āmāre gañjila || 221 ||*

*Word for word:* adya-anta yata katha — all from first to last; sakali kahila — I told everything; shuniya mahesha — hearing, Mahesha; punah amare ganjila — then reproached me

**221.** I told him everything from first to last;
having heard it, Mahesha reproached me:

এছন দুর্লভ মহাপ্রসাদ পাইয়া ।
একেলা ভুঞ্জিলা মুনি আমারে না দিয়া ॥ ২২২ ॥

*echana durlabha mahāprasāda pāiẏā |*
*ekelā bhuñjilā muni āmāre nā diẏā || 222 ||*

*Word for word:* echhana durlabha mahaprasada — such rare mahaprasada; paiya — having got; ekela bhunjila — you ate it alone; muni — O sage; amare na diya — without giving me any

**222.** 'Having got such rare mahaprasada,
you, O sage, ate it alone without giving me any!

আমা দেখিবারে পুনঃ আসিয়াছ প্রেমে ।
এহেন দুর্লভ ধন নাহি আন কেনে ॥ ২২৩ ॥

*āmā dekhibāre punaḥ āsiẏācha preme |*
*ehena durlabha dhana nāhi āna kene || 223 ||*

*Word for word:* ama dekhibare — to see me; punah asiyachha preme — you have come again with love; ehena durlabha dhana — so rare a treasure; nahi ana kene — why did you not bring?

**223.** You have come again with love to see me —
why did you not bring so rare a treasure?'

শুনিঞা মহেশ-বাণী লজ্জিত হইয়া ।
নমিত-নয়ানে চাহে নখে নখ দিয়া ॥ ২২৪ ॥

*śuniñā maheśa-bāṇī lajjita haiẏā |*
*namita-naẏāne cāhe nakhe nakha diẏā || 224 ||*

*Word for word:* shuniya mahesha-vani — hearing Mahesha's words; lajjita haiya — ashamed; namita-nayane chahe — he looks with lowered eyes; nakhe nakha diya — rubbing nail on nail

**224.** Hearing Mahesha's words, ashamed,
[I] look down with lowered eyes, rubbing nail against nail.

আছে মহাপ্রসাদ-কণা বলি দিল সুখে ।
পাছু না গণিল প্রভু দিল নিজ মুখে ॥ ২২৫ ॥

*āche mahāprasāda-kaṇā bali dila sukhe |*
*pāchu nā gaṇila prabhu dila nija mukhe || 225 ||*

*Word for word:* achhe mahaprasada-kana — "there is a particle of mahaprasada"; bali dila sukhe — saying so, I gave it gladly; pachhu na ganila — without a second thought; prabhu — the lord; dila nija mukhe — put it in his mouth
