সুদর্শন-আদি অস্ত্র যত পারিষদ ।
সংহতি আইলা সভে প্রহ্লাদ নারদ ॥ ৩৫৪ ॥

*sudarśana-ādi astra yata pāriṣada |*
*saṃhati āilā sabhe prahlāda nārada || 354 ||*

*Word for word:* sudarshana-adi astra — weapons such as Sudarshana; yata parishada — all associates; samhati aila sabhe — all came together; prahlada narada — Prahlada, Narada

**354.** The weapons — Sudarshana and the rest — and all the associates,
Prahlada, Narada — all came together [with Him].

পূর্ব অবতারে আর দাস দাসী যত ।
সাঙ্গোপাঙ্গে অবতার নাম লৈব কত ॥ ৩৫৫ ॥

*pūrba abatāre āra dāsa dāsī yata |*
*sāṅgopāṅge abatāra nāma laiba kata || 355 ||*

*Word for word:* purva avatare — in former descents; ara dasa dasi yata — and all the servants and maidservants; sanga-upange avatara — the descent with all His own; nama laiba kata — how many shall I name?

**355.** The servants and maidservants of former descents —
He descended with all His own: how many shall I name?

এতেক বৈষ্ণব সব কহে অনুভবে ।
যে নাম আছিল তথা যেবা নাম এবে ॥ ৩৫৬ ॥

*eteka baiṣṇaba saba kahe anubhabe |*
*ye nāma āchila tathā yebā nāma ebe || 356 ||*

*Word for word:* eteka vaishnava saba — all these Vaishnavas; kahe anubhave — tell from realization; ye nama achhila tatha — what name was there; yeba nama ebe — and what name now

**356.** Of all this the Vaishnavas speak from their realization:
what name each had there and what name now.[^06-4]

সামান্য মানুষে ইহা জানিব কেমনে ।
বিশ্বাস করিতে নারে অধমের মনে ॥ ৩৫৭ ॥

*sāmānya mānuṣe ihā jāniba kemane |*
*biśbāsa karite nāre adhamera mane || 357 ||*

*Word for word:* samanya manushe — an ordinary man; iha janiba kemane — how will he know this; vishvasa karite nare — cannot believe; adhamera mane — the mind of the fallen

**357.** How can an ordinary man know this?
The mind of the fallen cannot believe it.

এই ত কারণে মুনি কহিল বচন ।
সেই সে জানিব ইহা সুমেধা যে জন ॥ ৩৫৮ ॥

*ei ta kāraṇe muni kahila bacana |*
*sei se jāniba ihā sumedhā ye jana || 358 ||*

*Word for word:* ei ta karane — for this reason; muni kahila vachana — the sage spoke the word; sei se janiba iha — he will know it; sumedha ye jana — who is intelligent

**358.** For this reason the sage said:
only he who is intelligent will know it.

সঙ্কীর্তনপ্রায় যজ্ঞ ধর্ম পরকাশ ।
সুমেধা যে জন তাতে পরম উল্লাস ॥ ৩৫৯ ॥

*saṅkīrtanaprāẏa yajña dharma parakāśa |*
*sumedhā ye jana tāte parama ullāsa || 359 ||*

*Word for word:* sankirtana-praya yajna — the sacrifice consisting of sankirtana; dharma parakasha — is revealed as dharma; sumedha ye jana — who is intelligent; tate parama ullasa — finds supreme joy in it

**359.** The sacrifice consisting of sankirtana is revealed as dharma —
he who is intelligent finds supreme joy in it.

এতেকে কহিয়ে ইহা না মানে যে জন ।
চারিযুগে তিন বর্ণ তাহার বাখান ॥ ৩৬০ ॥

*eteke kahiẏe ihā nā māne ye jana |*
*cāriyuge tina barṇa tāhāra bākhāna || 360 ||*

*Word for word:* eteke kahiye — therefore I say; iha na mane ye jana — whoever does not accept this; chari-yuge tina varna — three colours in four yugas; tahara bakhana — is his explanation

**360.** Therefore I say: whoever does not accept this
has the explanation "three colours for four yugas".

কান্তি কৃষ্ণ বর্ণ কৃষ্ণ দুই হৈল এক ।
আর দুই যুগের বর্ণ ইহা নাহি দেখ ॥ ৩৬১ ॥

*kānti kṛṣṇa barṇa kṛṣṇa dui haila eka |*
*āra dui yugera barṇa ihā nāhi dekha || 361 ||*

*Word for word:* kanti krishna varna krishna — "dark in lustre" and "dark in colour"; dui haila eka — the two become one; ara dui yugera varna — the colours of the other two yugas; iha nahi dekha — are not so

**361.** [For him] "dark in lustre" and "dark in colour" merge into one,
while the colours of the other two yugas are not so:

কলি বা দ্বাপর দুই যুগে এক বর্ণ ।
দুই যুগে বর্ণ এক এই তার মর্ম ॥ ৩৬২ ॥

*kali bā dbāpara dui yuge eka barṇa |*
*dui yuge barṇa eka ei tāra marma || 362 ||*

*Word for word:* kali ba dvapara — Kali and Dvapara; dui yuge eka varna — one colour in two yugas; dui yuge varna eka — in two yugas the colour is one; ei tara marma — this is his meaning

**362.** in the Kali and in the Dvapara — in two yugas — one colour;
in two yugas the colour is one — that is his meaning;

সত্য ত্রেতা শ্বেত রক্ত দুই বর্ণ আছে ।
কলি দ্বাপরেতে এক বর্ণ হৈল পাছে ॥ ৩৬৩ ॥

*satya tretā śbeta rakta dui barṇa āche |*
*kali dbāparete eka barṇa haila pāche || 363 ||*

*Word for word:* satya treta — in Satya and Treta; shveta rakta dui varna achhe — there are two colours, white and red; kali dvaparete — in Kali and Dvapara; eka varna haila pachhe — then a single colour

**363.** in Satya and Treta there are two colours, white and red,
and then, in Kali and Dvapara, one colour.[^06-5]

গর্গমুনির বাক্য কেনে বোল ক্রমভঙ্গ ।
ক্রমভঙ্গ নহে শুন আছে বড় রঙ্গ ॥ ৩৬৪ ॥

*gargamunira bākya kene bola kramabhaṅga |*
*kramabhaṅga nahe śuna āche baṛa raṅga || 364 ||*

*Word for word:* garga-munira vakya — Garga Muni's words; kene bola kramabhanga — why call them a break in order; kramabhanga nahe — there is no break; shuna — listen; achhe bada ranga — there is great charm in it

**364.** Why do you say that the order is broken in Garga Muni's words?
The order is not broken — listen, there is great charm in it.

ভূত ভবিষ্যৎ বর্তমান কহিবার তরে ।
তিন কাল কহে চারিযুগের ভিতরে ॥ ৩৬৫ ॥

*bhūta bhabiṣyat bartamāna kahibāra tare |*
*tina kāla kahe cāriyugera bhitare || 365 ||*

*Word for word:* bhuta bhavishyat vartamana — past, future, present; kahibara tare — in order to express; tina kala kahe — he speaks of three times; chari-yugera bhitare — within the four yugas

**365.** To express past, future and present,
he speaks of three times within the four yugas:

সত্য ত্রেতা বহি দ্বাপর বর্তমান ।
দ্বাপরেতে কৃষ্ণ-অবতার কৃষ্ণনাম ॥ ৩৬৬ ॥

*satya tretā bahi dbāpara bartamāna |*
*dbāparete kṛṣṇa-abatāra kṛṣṇanāma || 366 ||*

*Word for word:* satya treta vahi — Satya and Treta past; dvapara vartamana — Dvapara present; dvaparete krishna-avatara — in Dvapara the descent of Krishna; krishna-nama — named Krishna

**366.** Satya and Treta are past, Dvapara is present;
in the Dvapara is the descent of Krishna, and His name is Krishna.

ইদানীং বলিয়া তেঞি বোলে গর্গমুনি ।
ভূতকাল-ভিতরে ভবিষ্যকাল গণি ॥ ৩৬৭ ॥

*idānīṃ baliẏā teñi bole gargamuni |*
*bhūtakāla-bhitare bhabiṣyakāla gaṇi || 367 ||*

*Word for word:* idanim baliya — saying "now"; tenji bole gargamuni — therefore Garga Muni speaks; bhutakala-bhitare — within the past tense; bhavishya-kala gani — counting the future

**367.** That is why Garga Muni says "now",
and within the past tense he means the future.

ভবিতব্যতা যাহার আছে ইহা জানি ।
ভূতের ভিতরে তার ভবিষ্য বাখানি ॥ ৩৬৮ ॥

*bhabitabyatā yāhāra āche ihā jāni |*
*bhūtera bhitare tāra bhabiṣya bākhāni || 368 ||*

*Word for word:* bhavitavyata yahara achhe — what is destined to be; iha jani — knowing this; bhutera bhitare — within the past; tara bhavishya bakhani — its future is described

**368.** Knowing what is certain to be,
one speaks of its future in the past tense:

ভবিষ্যৎ অর্থে ভূত প্রমাণে পণ্ডিত ।
নিশ্চয়তা আছে তার এই ত ইঙ্গিত ॥ ৩৬৯ ॥

*bhabiṣyat arthe bhūta pramāṇe paṇḍita |*
*niścaẏatā āche tāra ei ta iṅgita || 369 ||*

*Word for word:* bhavishyat arthe bhuta — the past in the sense of the future; pramane pandita — the learned accept; nishchayata achhe tara — it carries certainty; ei ta ingita — this is the hint

**369.** the learned accept the past tense in the sense of the future —
it points to certainty; that is the hint.[^06-6]

তথাপি তাহাতে তথা শব্দ দিল মুনি ।
শুক্ল রক্ত বলি তথা কি কাজ কাহিনী ॥ ৩৭০ ॥

*tathāpi tāhāte tathā śabda dila muni |*
*śukla rakta bali tathā ki kāja kāhinī || 370 ||*

*Word for word:* tathapi — and yet; tahate — in it; tatha shabda dila muni — the sage put the word "tatha"; shukla rakta bali — after saying "white, red"; tatha ki kaja — what use is "tatha"; kahini — in the account

**370.** And yet the sage put the word "tatha" ("likewise") there:
after saying "white, red", what use is "tatha" in the account?

তথা শব্দে পূর্ব-উক্ত শুক্ল রক্ত যথা ।
কলিযুগে পীতবর্ণ হবে হরি তথা ॥ ৩৭১ ॥

*tathā śabde pūrba-ukta śukla rakta yathā |*
*kaliyuge pītabarṇa habe hari tathā || 371 ||*

*Word for word:* tatha shabde — by the word "tatha"; purva-ukta shukla rakta yatha — as the previously named white and red; kali-yuge pitavarna — yellow in the Kali-yuga; habe hari tatha — so will Hari be

**371.** By the word "tatha" it is said: just as the white and red named before,
so in the Kali-yuga Hari will be yellow.

এবে দ্বাপরে এই কৃষ্ণতাকে গেল ।
গর্গমুনি চারিযুগে তিন কাল কহিল ॥ ৩৭২ ॥

*ebe dbāpare ei kṛṣṇatāke gela |*
*gargamuni cāriyuge tina kāla kahila || 372 ||*

*Word for word:* ebe dvapare — now in Dvapara; ei krishnatake gela — this one has become Krishna; gargamuni — Garga Muni; chari-yuge tina kala kahila — expressed three times within four yugas

**372.** Now, in the Dvapara, this one has become Krishna;
so Garga Muni expressed three times within the four yugas.

আমার বচন যেবা না লয় অবজ্ঞাতে ।
কি কারণে তথা শব্দ কহে ভাগবতে ॥ ৩৭৩ ॥

*āmāra bacana yebā nā laẏa abajñāte |*
*ki kāraṇe tathā śabda kahe bhāgabate || 373 ||*

*Word for word:* amara vachana — my words; yeba na laya avajnate — whoever rejects with contempt; ki karane — for what reason; tatha shabda kahe bhagavate — does the Bhagavata say the word "tatha"

**373.** Whoever contemptuously rejects my words,
let him say why the *Bhagavata* uses the word "tatha".

এতেক কহিয়ে আমি শুন মোর বোল ।
কহয়ে লোচন কথা না ঠেলিহ মোর ॥ ৩৭৪ ॥

*eteka kahiẏe āmi śuna mora bola |*
*kahaẏe locana kathā nā ṭheliha mora || 374 ||*

*Word for word:* eteka kahiye ami — this I say; shuna mora bola — hear my words; kahaye lochana — says Lochana; katha na theliha mora — do not push my words aside

**374.** This is what I say — hear my words;
says Lochana: do not push my words aside.

আর অপরূপ শুন শ্লোকের ব্যাখ্যান ।
এইমাত্র ব্যাখ্যা ইহা পরম প্রমাণ ॥ ৩৭৫ ॥

*āra aparūpa śuna ślokera byākhyāna |*
*eimātra byākhyā ihā parama pramāṇa || 375 ||*

*Word for word:* ara aparupa — another wonder; shuna shlokera vyakhyana — hear the explanation of the verse; eimatra vyakhya — this alone is the explanation; iha parama pramana — this is the highest proof

**375.** Hear yet another wondrous explanation of the verse —
it alone is right, it is the highest proof.

এই ত ব্যাখ্যার আছে অপূর্ব পূর্বপক্ষ ।
যুগ-অবতার কৃষ্ণ এ বড় অশক্য ॥ ৩৭৬ ॥

*ei ta byākhyāra āche apūrba pūrbapakṣa |*
*yuga-abatāra kṛṣṇa e baṛa aśakya || 376 ||*

*Word for word:* ei ta vyakhyara — to this explanation; achhe apurva purvapaksha — there is a remarkable objection; yuga-avatara krishna — Krishna a yuga-avatara; e bada ashakya — this is quite impossible

**376.** To this explanation there is a remarkable objection:
Krishna a yuga-avatara? That is quite impossible.

আর যুগ-অবতার অংশ কলা লিখি ।
আপনেই ভগবান্ ভাগবত সাক্ষী ॥ ৩৭৭ ॥

*āra yuga-abatāra aṃśa kalā likhi |*
*āpanei bhagabān bhāgabata sākṣī || 377 ||*

*Word for word:* ara yuga-avatara — the other yuga-avataras; amsha kala likhi — are written as portions and parts; apanei bhagavan — [Krishna] is Bhagavan Himself; bhagavata sakshi — the Bhagavata is witness

**377.** The other yuga-avataras are described as portions and parts,
[but Krishna] is Bhagavan Himself; the *Bhagavata* is witness.

*So in the* Srimad-Bhagavata *(1.3.28):*

এতে চাংশকলাঃ পুংসঃ কৃষ্ণস্তু ভগবান্ স্বয়ম্ ।
ইন্দ্রারিব্যাকুলং লোকং মৃড়য়ন্তি যুগে যুগে ॥ ৩৭৮ ॥

*ete cāṃśakalāḥ puṃsaḥ kṛṣṇastu bhagabān sbaẏam |*
*indrāribyākulaṃ lokaṃ mṛṛaẏanti yuge yuge || 378 ||*

*Word for word:* ete cha — and these; amsha-kalah — portions and parts; pumsah — of the Purusha; krishnah tu — but Krishna; bhagavan svayam — is Bhagavan Himself; indra-ari-vyakulam — troubled by Indra's enemies; lokam — the world; mridayanti — they gladden; yuge yuge — age after age

**378.** "All these [avataras] are portions and parts of the Purusha, but Krishna is Bhagavan Himself;
age after age they gladden the world troubled by the enemies of Indra."

যুগ-অবতার কৃষ্ণ কহিব কেমতে ।
এ বচন তবে কেনে কহে ভাগবতে ॥ ৩৭৯ ॥

*yuga-abatāra kṛṣṇa kahiba kemate |*
*e bacana tabe kene kahe bhāgabate || 379 ||*

*Word for word:* yuga-avatara krishna — Krishna a yuga-avatara; kahiba kemate — how can one call; e vachana — these words; tabe kene kahe bhagavate — why then does the Bhagavata say

**379.** How then can one call Krishna a yuga-avatara?
Why then does the *Bhagavata* say these words?

বৃন্দাবনচন্দ্র যুগ-অবতার নহে ।
পূর্ণ পূর্ণ ব্রহ্ম কৃষ্ণ ভাগবতে কহে ॥ ৩৮০ ॥

*bṛndābanacandra yuga-abatāra nahe |*
*pūrṇa pūrṇa brahma kṛṣṇa bhāgabate kahe || 380 ||*

*Word for word:* vrindavana-chandra — the moon of Vrindavana; yuga-avatara nahe — is not a yuga-avatara; purna purna brahma krishna — Krishna is the most complete Brahman; bhagavate kahe — says the Bhagavata

**380.** The moon of Vrindavana is not a yuga-avatara:
Krishna is the most complete Brahman, says the *Bhagavata*.[^06-7]

এই ত কারণে কিছু কহি তাহা শুন ।
অবজ্ঞা না করে কেহ কর অবধান ॥ ৩৮১ ॥

*ei ta kāraṇe kichu kahi tāhā śuna |*
*abajñā nā kare keha kara abadhāna || 381 ||*

*Word for word:* ei ta karane — for this reason; kichhu kahi — I say something; taha shuna — hear it; avajna na kare keha — let no one disregard it; kara avadhana — pay attention

**381.** For this reason I shall say something — listen;
let no one disregard it; pay attention.

*So in the* Srimad-Bhagavata *(10.8.13):*

আসন্ বর্ণাস্ত্রয়ো হ্যস্য গৃহ্ণতোঽনুযুগং তনূঃ ।
শুক্লো রক্তস্তথা পীত ইদানীং কৃষ্ণতাং গতঃ ॥ ৩৮২ ॥

*āsan barṇāstraẏo hyasya gṛhṇato'nuyugaṃ tanūḥ |*
*śuklo raktastathā pīta idānīṃ kṛṣṇatāṃ gataḥ || 382 ||*

*Word for word:* see v. 319

**382.** "Taking bodies yuga after yuga, He had three colours —
white, red and likewise yellow; now He has become Krishna."

গর্গমুনি কহিল গভীর বড় বোধে ।
কেমনে বুঝিব ইহা আমরা অবোধে ॥ ৩৮৩ ॥

*gargamuni kahila gabhīra baṛa bodhe |*
*kemane bujhiba ihā āmarā abodhe || 383 ||*

*Word for word:* gargamuni kahila — Garga Muni spoke; gabhira bada bodhe — with very deep understanding; kemane bujhiba iha — how shall we understand it; amara abodhe — we who lack understanding

**383.** Garga Muni spoke this with the deepest understanding —
how can we who lack understanding grasp it?

বুদ্ধিমান্ হয় যদি জানে ভক্তজনে ।
বুদ্ধিমান্ লোক তাহা করয়ে প্রমাণে ॥ ৩৮৪ ॥

*buddhimān haẏa yadi jāne bhaktajane |*
*buddhimān loka tāhā karaẏe pramāṇe || 384 ||*

*Word for word:* buddhiman haya yadi — if one is intelligent; jane bhakta-jane — he knows [it] from devotees; buddhiman loka — intelligent people; taha karaye pramane — accept it as proof

**384.** He who is intelligent learns [its meaning] from devotees;
intelligent people accept it as proof.

চারিযুগে চারি বর্ণ কহিলেন মুনি ।
ভূত ভবিষ্যৎ বর্তমান ত্রিকাল-কাহিনী ॥ ৩৮৫ ॥

*cāriyuge cāri barṇa kahilena muni |*
*bhūta bhabiṣyat bartamāna trikāla-kāhinī || 385 ||*

*Word for word:* chari-yuge chari varna — four colours in four yugas; kahilena muni — the sage spoke; bhuta bhavishyat vartamana — past, future, present; trikala-kahini — an account of the three times

**385.** The sage named four colours in four yugas —
an account of the three times: past, future and present.

চারিযুগে তিন কাল কহিবারে চাহে ।
এই সব কথা ব্যাস এক শ্লোকে কহে ॥ ৩৮৬ ॥

*cāriyuge tina kāla kahibāre cāhe |*
*ei saba kathā byāsa eka śloke kahe || 386 ||*

*Word for word:* chari-yuge tina kala — three times within four yugas; kahibare chahe — he wishes to express; ei saba katha — all this; vyasa eka shloke kahe — Vyasa says in one verse

**386.** He wishes to express three times within four yugas —
all this Vyasa says in one verse.

সত্য ত্রেতা দ্বাপর আর যুগ কলি ।
শ্বেত রক্ত পীত কৃষ্ণ চারি যুগে বলি ॥ ৩৮৭ ॥

*satya tretā dbāpara āra yuga kali |*
*śbeta rakta pīta kṛṣṇa cāri yuge bali || 387 ||*

*Word for word:* satya treta dvapara — Satya, Treta, Dvapara; ara yuga kali — and the Kali yuga; shveta rakta pita krishna — white, red, yellow, dark; chari yuge bali — are said of the four yugas

**387.** Satya, Treta, Dvapara and the Kali yuga;
white, red, yellow and dark — are said of the four yugas.

চারি যুগ আছে চারি কাল হয় যবে ।
আর তিন অবতার ক্রমে হয় তবে ॥ ৩৮৮ ॥

*cāri yuga āche cāri kāla haẏa yabe |*
*āra tina abatāra krame haẏa tabe || 388 ||*

*Word for word:* chari yuga achhe — there are four yugas; chari kala haya yabe — if they were four times; ara tina avatara — then the other three avataras; krame haya tabe — would come in order

**388.** If the four yugas had been [named as] four times,
then the three [other] avataras too would have come in order,

তবে সে কহিলে হয় যথাক্রম কথা ।
যথা অবতার কথা অনুসারে তথা ॥ ৩৮৯ ॥

*tabe se kahile haẏa yathākrama kathā |*
*yathā abatāra kathā anusāre tathā || 389 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe se kahile — then, if spoken; haya yathakrama katha — the words would be in order; yatha avatara — as the avataras [come]; katha anusare tatha — so the words would follow

**389.** and the statement would be sequential:
as the avataras [come], so the words would follow.

এতেকে সে ক্রমভঙ্গ হেন শ্লোকে দেখে ।
তথা শব্দে ভবিষ্যকাল গর্গমুনি লেখে ॥ ৩৯০ ॥

*eteke se kramabhaṅga hena śloke dekhe |*
*tathā śabde bhabiṣyakāla gargamuni lekhe || 390 ||*

*Word for word:* eteke se — therefore; kramabhanga — a break of order; hena shloke dekhe — they see in such a verse; tatha shabde — by the word "tatha"; bhavishya-kala — the future time; gargamuni lekhe — Garga Muni indicates

**390.** That is why people see a break of order in such a verse;
[but] by the word "tatha" Garga Muni indicates the future time.[^06-8]

কেবা অবতার আর চারি বর্ণ কার ।
কেবা অবতারী কিবা বিচার ইহার ॥ ৩৯১ ॥

*kebā abatāra āra cāri barṇa kāra |*
*kebā abatārī kibā bicāra ihāra || 391 ||*

*Word for word:* keba avatara — who is the avatara; ara chari varna kara — and whose are the four colours; keba avatari — who is the source of avataras; kiba vichara ihara — what is the judgment on this

**391.** Who is the avatara, and whose are the four colours?
Who is the source of avataras — how is this to be judged?

আপনেহি ভগবান্ জন্মি যদুবংশে ।
পৃথিবীতে অবতার করে আর অংশে ॥ ৩৯২ ॥

*āpanehi bhagabān janmi yadubaṃśe |*
*pṛthibīte abatāra kare āra aṃśe || 392 ||*

*Word for word:* apanehi bhagavan — Bhagavan Himself; janmi yaduvamshe — born in the Yadu dynasty; prithivite avatara kare — descends on earth; ara amshe — [at other times] by portions

**392.** Bhagavan Himself is born in the Yadu dynasty,
[while at other times] He descends to earth by His portions.

বিশেষ্য বিশেষণ করি বাখানহ কেনে ।
এই সে সন্দেহ ইথে দ্বিধা তে-কারণে ॥ ৩৯৩ ॥

*biśeṣya biśeṣaṇa kari bākhānaha kene |*
*ei se sandeha ithe dbidhā te-kāraṇe || 393 ||*

*Word for word:* visheshya visheshana kari — making [one] the qualified and [the other] the qualifier; bakhanaha kene — why do you explain; ei se sandeha ithe — this is the doubt here; dvidha te-karane — hence the ambiguity

**393.** Why do you explain [the verse] making one word the qualified and the other the qualifier?
This is the doubt here, and hence the ambiguity.[^06-9]

যতেক চৌযুগ তাথে অংশ অবতার ।
যুগ-অনুরূপ বর্ণ হয় তা সভার ॥ ৩৯৪ ॥

*yateka cauyuga tāthe aṃśa abatāra |*
*yuga-anurūpa barṇa haẏa tā sabhāra || 394 ||*

*Word for word:* yateka chauyuga — in all the four-yuga cycles; tathe amsha avatara — there are partial avataras; yuga-anurupa varna — a colour according to the yuga; haya ta sabhara — they all have

**394.** In all four yugas [come] partial avataras,
and all of them have a colour according to the yuga.

ধর্মসংস্থাপন অধর্মবিনাশ-নিমিত্তে ।
প্রতিযুগে অংশ অবতার হয় তাতে ॥ ৩৯৫ ॥

*dharmasaṃsthāpana adharmabināśa-nimitte |*
*pratiyuge aṃśa abatāra haẏa tāte || 395 ||*

*Word for word:* dharma-samsthapana — for establishing dharma; adharma-vinasha-nimitte — and destroying irreligion; pratiyuge — in every yuga; amsha avatara haya tate — therefore a partial avatara comes

**395.** To establish dharma and destroy irreligion
there is a partial avatara in every yuga.

আপনেই দ্বাপরে ভগবান্ হরি ।
অবতারশিরোমণি সভার উপরি ॥ ৩৯৬ ॥

*āpanei dbāpare bhagabān hari |*
*abatāraśiromaṇi sabhāra upari || 396 ||*

*Word for word:* apanei dvapare — Himself in the Dvapara; bhagavan hari — Bhagavan Hari; avatara-shiromani — the crest-jewel of avataras; sabhara upari — above all

**396.** But in the Dvapara [comes] Bhagavan Hari Himself,
the crest-jewel of avataras, above all.

এবে কৃষ্ণতাকে গেলা গর্গমুনি কহে ।
শ্যামসুন্দর কৃষ্ণ বর্ণ কৃষ্ণ নহে ॥ ৩৯৭ ॥

*ebe kṛṣṇatāke gelā gargamuni kahe |*
*śyāmasundara kṛṣṇa barṇa kṛṣṇa nahe || 397 ||*

*Word for word:* ebe krishnatake gela — "now He has become Krishna"; gargamuni kahe — says Garga Muni; shyamasundara krishna — [this is] Shyamasundara Krishna; varna krishna nahe — "krishna" [here] is not a colour

**397.** "Now He has become Krishna," says Garga Muni:
[this is] Shyamasundara Krishna, and "krishna" here is not a colour.

প্রতি দ্বাপরে অংশ কৃষ্ণনাম বর্ণ ।
তদ্রূপতাকে গেল প্রভু এই শুন মর্ম ॥ ৩৯৮ ॥

*prati dbāpare aṃśa kṛṣṇanāma barṇa |*
*tadrūpatāke gela prabhu ei śuna marma || 398 ||*

*Word for word:* prati dvapare — in every Dvapara; amsha — a portion; krishna-nama varna — with the name and colour "krishna"; tadrupatake gela prabhu — the Lord [Himself] assumed that form; ei shuna marma — hear this meaning

**398.** In every Dvapara [comes] a portion with the name and colour "krishna";
[this time] the Lord Himself assumed that form — hear, this is the meaning.[^06-10]

যেন দ্বাপরে কৃষ্ণ তেন গৌরচন্দ্র ।
কলি-দ্বাপর-যুগে এ দুই স্বতন্ত্র ॥ ৩৯৯ ॥

*yena dbāpare kṛṣṇa tena gauracandra |*
*kali-dbāpara-yuge e dui sbatantra || 399 ||*

*Word for word:* yena dvapare krishna — as Krishna in the Dvapara; tena gaurachandra — so Gaurachandra; kali-dvapara-yuge — in the Kali and Dvapara yugas; e dui svatantra — these two are independent

**399.** As Krishna in the Dvapara, so [in Kali] Gaurachandra:
in Kali and Dvapara these two are independent.

এই দুই যুগে এক পূর্ণ অবতার ।
ব্যাস কহিলেন উদাহরণ ইহার ॥ ৪০০ ॥

*ei dui yuge eka pūrṇa abatāra |*
*byāsa kahilena udāharaṇa ihāra || 400 ||*

*Word for word:* ei dui yuge — in these two yugas; eka purna avatara — one full descent; vyasa kahilena — Vyasa gave; udaharana ihara — an example of this

**400.** In these two yugas [comes] one full avatara;
Vyasa gave an example of this.

*So in the* Brihat-sahasranama-stotra:

ত্বামারাধ্য তথা শম্ভো গ্রহীষ্যামি বরং সদা ।
দ্বাপরাদৌ যুগে ভূত্বা কলয়া মানুষাদিষু ॥
স্বাগমৈঃ কল্পিতৈস্ত্বঞ্চ জনান্ মদ্বিমুখান্ কুরু ।
মাঞ্চ গোপয় যেন স্যাৎ সৃষ্টিরেষোত্তরোত্তরা ॥ ৪০১ ॥

*tbāmārādhya tathā śambho grahīṣyāmi baraṃ sadā |*
*dbāparādau yuge bhūtbā kalaẏā mānuṣādiṣu ||*
*sbāgamaiḥ kalpitaistbañca janān madbimukhān kuru |*
*māñca gopaẏa yena syāt sṛṣṭireṣottarottarā || 401 ||*

*Word for word:* tvam aradhya — worshipping you; tatha — thus; shambho — O Shambhu; grahishyami varam sada — I always accept a boon; dvapara-adau yuge — in Dvapara and the following yugas; bhutva — appearing; kalaya — as a portion; manusha-adishu — among men and others; sva-agamaih kalpitaih — with your own invented scriptures; tvam cha — you; janan mat-vimukhan kuru — make people averse to Me; mam cha gopaya — and conceal Me; yena syat — so that; srishtih esha uttarottara — this creation [may grow] ever more

**401.** "Worshipping you, O Shambhu, I always accept this boon:
in the Dvapara and the following yugas, appearing as a portion among men and others,
you, by your own invented scriptures, turn people away from Me
and conceal Me, so that this creation may increase ever more."[^06-11]

আর কিছু কহি শুন ভগবদ্গীতা ।
শ্রীমুখোদিত প্রভুর নিজ নিজ কথা ॥ ৪০২ ॥

*āra kichu kahi śuna bhagabadgītā |*
*śrīmukhodita prabhura nija nija kathā || 402 ||*

*Word for word:* ara kichhu kahi — I tell something more; shuna bhagavad-gita — hear the Bhagavad-gita; shri-mukhodita — spoken from the holy mouth; prabhura nija nija katha — the Lord's own words

**402.** I shall say more — hear the *Bhagavad-gita*,
the Lord's own words from His holy mouth.

*So in the* Srimad-Bhagavad-gita *(4.8):*

পরিত্রাণায় সাধূনাং বিনাশায় চ দুষ্কৃতাম্ ।
ধর্মসংস্থাপনার্থায় সম্ভবামি যুগে যুগে ॥ ৪০৩ ॥

*paritrāṇāẏa sādhūnāṃ bināśāẏa ca duṣkṛtām |*
*dharmasaṃsthāpanārthāẏa sambhabāmi yuge yuge || 403 ||*

*Word for word:* paritranaya sadhunam — to protect the righteous; vinashaya cha dushkritam — and to destroy the wicked; dharma-samsthapana-arthaya — to establish dharma; sambhavami yuge yuge — I appear age after age

**403.** "To protect the righteous, to destroy the wicked
and to establish dharma, I appear age after age."[^06-12]

সাধুজন-পরিত্রাণ ধর্ম-সংস্থাপন ।
অধর্ম-বিনাশ-হেতু কহিল এ মর্ম ॥ ৪০৪ ॥

*sādhujana-paritrāṇa dharma-saṃsthāpana |*
*adharma-bināśa-hetu kahila e marma || 404 ||*

*Word for word:* sadhu-jana-paritrana — protection of the righteous; dharma-samsthapana — establishment of dharma; adharma-vinasha-hetu — for the destruction of irreligion; kahila e marma — this meaning was spoken

**404.** Protection of the righteous, establishment of dharma,
destruction of irreligion — this is the meaning of what was said.

যুগে যুগে জন্ম আমি লভিয়ে আপনি ।
এই দুই যুগে জন্ম আপনেই আমি ॥ ৪০৫ ॥

*yuge yuge janma āmi labhiẏe āpani |*
*ei dui yuge janma āpanei āmi || 405 ||*

*Word for word:* yuge yuge — "yuge yuge"; janma ami labhiye apani — I Myself take birth; ei dui yuge — in these two yugas; janma apanei ami — I am born Myself

**405.** "Yuge yuge" — I Myself take birth;
in these two yugas I am born Myself.

এক যুগ-শব্দে কহি আর নাম যুগে ।
বিশেষণ-বিশেষ্য করি বাখানয় লোকে ॥ ৪০৬ ॥

*eka yuga-śabde kahi āra nāma yuge |*
*biśeṣaṇa-biśeṣya kari bākhānaẏa loke || 406 ||*

*Word for word:* eka yuga-shabde kahi — with one word "yuga" I mean [the age]; ara nama yuge — the other "yuga" names [a pair]; visheshana-visheshya kari — as qualifier and qualified; bakhanaya loke — people explain

**406.** With one word "yuga" I mean [the age], and the other "yuga" means [a pair]:
people explain [them] as qualifier and qualified.

যুগ বিশেষণ যুগের তেঞি যুগ বলি ।
এক দ্বাপর যুগ আর যুগ কলি ॥ ৪০৭ ॥

*yuga biśeṣaṇa yugera teñi yuga bali |*
*eka dbāpara yuga āra yuga kali || 407 ||*

*Word for word:* yuga visheshana yugera — "yuga" qualifies "yuga"; tenji yuga bali — therefore I say "pair"; eka dvapara yuga — one is the Dvapara yuga; ara yuga kali — the other the Kali yuga

**407.** "Yuga" qualifies "yuga" — therefore I say "pair":
one is the Dvapara yuga, the other the Kali yuga.[^06-13]

যুগে যুগে চারিযুগ করি কেনে বল ।
পূর্ণ কৃষ্ণ-অবতার অংশ কেনে বল ॥ ৪০৮ ॥

*yuge yuge cāriyuga kari kene bala |*
*pūrṇa kṛṣṇa-abatāra aṃśa kene bala || 408 ||*

*Word for word:* yuge yuge — "yuge yuge"; chari-yuga kari kene bala — why do you take it as the four yugas; purna krishna-avatara — Krishna's descent is full; amsha kene bala — why call it partial

**408.** Why do you take "yuge yuge" as the four yugas?
Krishna's descent is full; why do you call it partial?

সে চারিযুগের কথা আর ঠাঁই কহে ।
তাহাও কহিব আমি মন দেহ তাহে ॥ ৪০৯ ॥

*se cāriyugera kathā āra ṭhāṁi kahe |*
*tāhāo kahiba āmi mana deha tāhe || 409 ||*

*Word for word:* se chari-yugera katha — the statement about the four yugas; ara thain kahe — is made elsewhere; tahao kahiba ami — that too I shall tell; mana deha tahe — attend to it

**409.** Of those four yugas it is spoken elsewhere;
that too I shall tell — attend to it.

*So in the same (4.7):*

যদা যদা হি ধর্মস্য গ্লানির্ভবতি ভারত ।
অভ্যুত্থানমধর্মস্য তদাত্মানং সৃজাম্যহম্ ॥ ৪১০ ॥

*yadā yadā hi dharmasya glānirbhabati bhārata |*
*abhyutthānamadharmasya tadātmānaṃ sṛjāmyaham || 410 ||*

*Word for word:* yada yada hi — whenever; dharmasya glanih bhavati — there is a decline of dharma; bharata — O descendant of Bharata; abhyutthanam adharmasya — and a rise of irreligion; tada atmanam srijami aham — then I manifest Myself

**410.** "Whenever dharma declines, O Bharata,
and irreligion rises, then I manifest Myself."

যে যে কালে যে যে যুগে ধর্মের হয় হানি ।
অধর্মের অভ্যুত্থান সে সে কালে জানি ॥ ৪১১ ॥

*ye ye kāle ye ye yuge dharmera haẏa hāni |*
*adharmera abhyutthāna se se kāle jāni || 411 ||*

*Word for word:* ye ye kale — at whatever time; ye ye yuge — in whatever yuga; dharmera haya hani — dharma declines; adharmera abhyutthana — irreligion rises; se se kale jani — at that time, know

**411.** At whatever time, in whatever yuga, dharma declines
and irreligion rises — know that at that very time

তদা কালে আপনাকে করিয়ে সৃজন ।
প্রতিযুগে অবতার অংশের কারণ ॥ ৪১২ ॥

*tadā kāle āpanāke kariẏe sṛjana |*
*pratiyuge abatāra aṃśera kāraṇa || 412 ||*

*Word for word:* tada kale — at that time; apanake kariye srijana — I manifest Myself; pratiyuge avatara — the descent in every yuga; amshera karana — is by means of a portion

**412.** I manifest Myself; [this] descent in every yuga
[takes place] by means of a portion.[^06-14]

এতেকে কহিয়ে আমি শুন মোর বোল ।
কহয়ে লোচন কথা না ঠেলিহ মোর ॥ ৪১৩ ॥

*eteke kahiẏe āmi śuna mora bola |*
*kahaẏe locana kathā nā ṭheliha mora || 413 ||*

*Word for word:* eteke kahiye ami — therefore I say; shuna mora bola — hear my words; kahaye lochana — says Lochana; katha na theliha mora — do not push my words aside

**413.** This is what I say — hear my words;
says Lochana: do not push my words aside.

কলিযুগে গোরা কৃষ্ণ জানিয়াছি আমি ।
বিশেষ সন্দেহ মোর ঘুচাইলে তুমি ॥ ৪১৪ ॥

*kaliyuge gorā kṛṣṇa jāniẏāchi āmi |*
*biśeṣa sandeha mora ghucāile tumi || 414 ||*

*Word for word:* kali-yuge gora krishna — that in the Kali-yuga Gora is Krishna; janiyachhi ami — I have come to know; vishesha sandeha mora — my great doubt; ghuchaile tumi — you have dispelled

**414.** "That in the Kali-yuga Gora is Krishna I have come to know;
you have dispelled my great doubt.

আর অপরূপ শুন কলিযুগ-মর্ম ।
আশ্রমে নিস্তারে লোক সঙ্কীর্তনধর্ম ॥ ৪১৫ ॥

*āra aparūpa śuna kaliyuga-marma |*
*āśrame nistāre loka saṅkīrtanadharma || 415 ||*

*Word for word:* ara aparupa — another wonder; shuna kali-yuga-marma — hear the essence of the Kali-yuga; ashrame — in [any] ashrama; nistare loka — delivers people; sankirtana-dharma — the dharma of sankirtana

**415.** Hear another wonder — the essence of the Kali-yuga:
in any ashrama the dharma of sankirtana delivers people.[^06-15]

দান ব্রত তপ হোম স্বাধ্যায় সংযম ।
বাসনা বিষয় যত এ বিধি নিয়ম ॥ ৪১৬ ॥

*dāna brata tapa homa sbādhyāẏa saṃyama |*
*bāsanā biṣaẏa yata e bidhi niẏama || 416 ||*

*Word for word:* dana vrata tapa homa — charity, vows, austerity, fire offerings; svadhyaya samyama — Vedic study, self-restraint; vasana vishaya yata — [are all] desires and worldly aims; e vidhi niyama — these rules and observances

**416.** Charity, vows, austerity, fire offerings, Vedic study, self-restraint —
these rules and observances [serve only] desires and worldly aims;

ফলভোগ-শ্রুতি শুনি সব মায়াবন্ধ ।
নাম-গুণ-মহিমা না জানে ছার অন্ধ ॥ ৪১৭ ॥

*phalabhoga-śruti śuni saba māẏābandha |*
*nāma-guṇa-mahimā nā jāne chāra andha || 417 ||*

*Word for word:* phalabhoga-shruti shuni — hearing the Vedic promises of fruits; saba maya-bandha — all are bound by maya; nama-guna-mahima — the glory of the name and virtues; na jane chhara andha — the wretched blind do not know

**417.** hearing the shruti's promises of fruits, all fall into the bonds of maya;
the glory of [the Lord's] name and virtues the wretched blind do not know.

কর্মসূত্রে বন্দী জীব ভ্রমিতে ভ্রমিতে ।
নিবৃত্তি নাহিক কর্ম নারে সম্বরিতে ॥ ৪১৮ ॥

*karmasūtre bandī jība bhramite bhramite |*
*nibṛtti nāhika karma nāre sambarite || 418 ||*

*Word for word:* karma-sutre bandi jiva — the soul bound by the thread of karma; bhramite bhramite — wandering on; nivritti nahika — there is no cessation; karma nare sambarite — cannot restrain karma

**418.** The soul bound by the thread of karma wanders on,
and there is no end [for it]: karma cannot be restrained.

প্রলয়ের কালে সব কর্মবন্ধ ঘুচে ।
হেন বন্ধ ঘুচে কৃষ্ণকথা যবে পুছে ॥ ৪১৯ ॥

*pralaẏera kāle saba karmabandha ghuce |*
*hena bandha ghuce kṛṣṇakathā yabe puche || 419 ||*

*Word for word:* pralayera kale — at the time of dissolution; saba karma-bandha ghuche — all bonds of karma are loosed; hena bandha ghuche — such bonds are loosed; krishna-katha yabe puchhe — when one asks about Krishna

**419.** [Only] at the dissolution of the world are all the bonds of karma loosed —
but these bonds are loosed when one asks about Krishna.[^06-16]

হেন গুণসঙ্কীর্তন কলিযুগ-ধর্ম ।
ঘোর পাপময় বোলে না জানিয়া মর্ম ॥ ৪২০ ॥

*hena guṇasaṅkīrtana kaliyuga-dharma |*
*ghora pāpamaẏa bole nā jāniẏā marma || 420 ||*

*Word for word:* hena guna-sankirtana — such sankirtana of virtues; kali-yuga-dharma — is the dharma of the Kali-yuga; ghora papamaya bole — they call [Kali] terrible and sinful; na janiya marma — not knowing its essence

**420.** Such sankirtana of [the Lord's] virtues is the dharma of the Kali-yuga;
not knowing its essence, people call [Kali] terrible and sinful.

যুগধর্ম সঙ্কীর্তন ঘুচাবে কেমনে ।
কে বা ধর্মসংস্থাপন করে প্রভু বিনে ॥ ৪২১ ॥

*yugadharma saṅkīrtana ghucābe kemane |*
*ke bā dharmasaṃsthāpana kare prabhu bine || 421 ||*

*Word for word:* yuga-dharma sankirtana — the yuga-dharma, sankirtana; ghuchabe kemane — how could [anyone] abolish; ke ba dharma-samsthapana kare — who establishes dharma; prabhu vine — but the Lord

**421.** How could [anyone] abolish the dharma of the yuga, sankirtana?
Who but the Lord establishes dharma?

পূর্ব-প্রতিজ্ঞা গীতায় প্রভুর বচনে ।
প্রভু অবতার হয় যেই যেই কারণে ॥ ৪২২ ॥

*pūrba-pratijñā gītāẏa prabhura bacane |*
*prabhu abatāra haẏa yei yei kāraṇe || 422 ||*

*Word for word:* purva-pratijna — the former vow; gitaya prabhura vachane — in the Gita, in the Lord's words; prabhu avatara haya — the Lord descends; yei yei karane — for what reasons

**422.** [Such is] the Lord's former vow in the *Gita*, in His words:
for what reasons the Lord descends.

*So in the* Srimad-Bhagavad-gita *(4.8):*

পরিত্রাণায় সাধূনাং বিনাশায় চ দুষ্কৃতাম্ ।
ধর্মসংস্থাপনার্থায় সম্ভবামি যুগে যুগে ॥ ৪২৩ ॥

*paritrāṇāẏa sādhūnāṃ bināśāẏa ca duṣkṛtām |*
*dharmasaṃsthāpanārthāẏa sambhabāmi yuge yuge || 423 ||*

*Word for word:* see v. 403

**423.** "To protect the righteous, to destroy the wicked
and to establish dharma, I appear age after age."

সাধুজন-পরিত্রাণ অধর্ম-বিনাশ ।
ধর্মসংস্থাপন প্রতিযুগেতে প্রকাশ ॥ ৪২৪ ॥

*sādhujana-paritrāṇa adharma-bināśa |*
*dharmasaṃsthāpana pratiyugete prakāśa || 424 ||*

*Word for word:* sadhu-jana-paritrana — protection of the righteous; adharma-vinasha — destruction of irreligion; dharma-samsthapana — establishment of dharma; pratiyugete prakasha — are manifested in every yuga

**424.** Protection of the righteous, destruction of irreligion,
establishment of dharma are manifested in every yuga.

কলিযুগে সঙ্কীর্তন ধর্ম ইহা মান ।
কলি-গোরা-অবতার কভু নহে আন ॥ ৪২৫ ॥

*kaliyuge saṅkīrtana dharma ihā māna |*
*kali-gorā-abatāra kabhu nahe āna || 425 ||*

*Word for word:* kali-yuge sankirtana dharma — in the Kali-yuga the dharma is sankirtana; iha mana — accept this; kali-gora-avatara — Gora, the avatara of Kali; kabhu nahe ana — it is never otherwise

**425.** Accept this, then: in the Kali-yuga the dharma is sankirtana,
and the avatara of Kali is Gora; it is never otherwise."

ইহা বলি কোলাকুলি করে মুনিসনে ।
আনন্দে বিহ্বল ব্রহ্মা আপনা না জানে ॥ ৪২৬ ॥

*ihā bali kolākuli kare munisane |*
*ānande bihbala brahmā āpanā nā jāne || 426 ||*

*Word for word:* iha bali — saying this; kolakuli kare muni-sane — he embraces the sage; anande vihvala brahma — Brahma, overwhelmed with joy; apana na jane — is unaware of himself

**426.** Saying this, [Brahma] embraces the sage;
beside himself with joy, Brahma forgets himself.

এক কহে আর উঠে গোরা-গুণের প্রভায় ।
সকল ইন্দ্রিয়-সুখ করিবারে চায় ॥ ৪২৭ ॥

*eka kahe āra uṭhe gorā-guṇera prabhāẏa |*
*sakala indriẏa-sukha karibāre cāẏa || 427 ||*

*Word for word:* eka kahe — he says one thing; ara uthe — another rises; gora-gunera prabhaya — by the splendour of Gora's virtues; sakala indriya-sukha — the joy of all the senses; karibare chaya — he wishes to give

**427.** He says one thing — and another rises [in his heart] by the splendour of Gora's virtues:
he longs to delight all his senses [with them].

আর কথা শুন প্রভুর সহস্রেক-নামে ।
এককালে দুই নাম হৈল এক ঠামে ॥ ৪২৮ ॥

*āra kathā śuna prabhura sahasreka-nāme |*
*ekakāle dui nāma haila eka ṭhāme || 428 ||*

*Word for word:* ara katha shuna — hear something more; prabhura sahasreka-name — in the Thousand Names of the Lord; eka-kale dui nama — names of two [periods] of one [appearance]; haila eka thame — stand in one place

**428.** "Hear more: in the Thousand Names of the Lord
names from two [periods] of one [appearance] stand in one place.[^06-17]

*So in the* Mahabharata, *Shanti-parva:*

সুবর্ণবর্ণো হেমাঙ্গো বরাঙ্গশ্চন্দনাঙ্গদী ।
সন্ন্যাসকৃচ্ছমঃ শান্তো নিষ্ঠাশান্তিপরায়ণঃ ॥ ৪২৯ ॥

*subarṇabarṇo hemāṅgo barāṅgaścandanāṅgadī |*
*sannyāsakṛcchamaḥ śānto niṣṭhāśāntiparāẏaṇaḥ || 429 ||*

*Word for word:* suvarna-varnah — of golden colour; hema-angah — with limbs like molten gold; vara-angah — of beautiful form; chandana-angadi — adorned with sandal; sannyasa-krit — who takes sannyasa; shamah — equipoised; shantah — peaceful; nishtha-shanti-parayanah — devoted to steadfastness and peace

**429.** 'Golden in colour, with limbs like molten gold, of beautiful form, adorned with sandal;
taking sannyasa, equipoised, peaceful, devoted to steadfastness and peace.'

হেমগৌর-কলেবর সুবরণ-দ্যুতি ।
সন্ন্যাস-করণে সে পরম মহামতি ॥ ৪৩০ ॥

*hemagaura-kalebara subaraṇa-dyuti |*
*sannyāsa-karaṇe se parama mahāmati || 430 ||*

*Word for word:* hema-gaura-kalevara — body golden like molten gold; suvarana-dyuti — the lustre of gold; sannyasa-karane — in taking sannyasa; se parama mahamati — He is the supremely wise

**430.** His body is molten gold, His lustre golden;
having taken sannyasa, He is the supremely wise.

ভবিষ্যপুরাণে শুন কৃষ্ণের প্রতিজ্ঞা ।
কলৌ জনমিব তিনবার এই আজ্ঞা ॥ ৪৩১ ॥

*bhabiṣyapurāṇe śuna kṛṣṇera pratijñā |*
*kalau janamiba tinabāra ei ājñā || 431 ||*

*Word for word:* bhavishya-purane — in the Bhavishya-purana; shuna krishnera pratijna — hear Krishna's vow; kalau janamiba — "I shall be born in Kali"; tinabara ei ajna — this word [is said] three times

**431.** Hear Krishna's vow in the *Bhavishya-purana*:
'In Kali I shall be born' — three times this word is said.

*So in the* Bhavishya-purana:

অজায়ধ্বমজায়ধ্বমজায়ধ্বং ন সংশয়ঃ ।
কলৌ সঙ্কীর্তনারম্ভে ভবিষ্যামি শচীসুতঃ ॥ ৪৩২ ॥

*ajāẏadhbamajāẏadhbamajāẏadhbaṃ na saṃśaẏaḥ |*
*kalau saṅkīrtanārambhe bhabiṣyāmi śacīsutaḥ || 432 ||*

*Word for word:* ajayadhvam ajayadhvam ajayadhvam — "be born, be born, be born" (per Bhaktisiddhanta: "I shall be born" thrice); na samshayah — without doubt; kalau — in Kali; sankirtana-arambhe — at the beginning of sankirtana; bhavishyami shachi-sutah — I shall be the son of Shachi

**432.** 'I shall be born, I shall be born, I shall be born — there is no doubt:
in Kali, at the beginning of sankirtana, I shall be the son of Shachi.'[^06-18]

আর অপরূপ কথা শুন সাবধানে ।
কলিযুগ-ধর্ম-মর্ম বিচারহ মনে ॥ ৪৩৩ ॥

*āra aparūpa kathā śuna sābadhāne |*
*kaliyuga-dharma-marma bicāraha mane || 433 ||*

*Word for word:* ara aparupa katha — another wonder; shuna savadhane — hear attentively; kali-yuga-dharma-marma — the essence of the dharma of Kali; vicharaha mane — consider in your mind

**433.** Hear attentively yet another wonder
and consider in your mind the essence of the dharma of the Kali-yuga.

পাপময় কলিযুগ বোলে সর্বজনে ।
অধর্ম প্রকট ধর্ম ক্ষীণ আচরণে ॥ ৪৩৪ ॥

*pāpamaẏa kaliyuga bole sarbajane |*
*adharma prakaṭa dharma kṣīṇa ācaraṇe || 434 ||*

*Word for word:* papamaya kali-yuga — "the Kali-yuga is sinful"; bole sarvajane — say all; adharma prakata — irreligion is manifest; dharma kshina acharane — dharma is weak in conduct

**434.** Everyone says the Kali-yuga is sinful:
irreligion is manifest, dharma is weak in conduct.

হরিনাম-সঙ্কীর্তন এই ধর্ম তার ।
এই পুনঃ হরিনাম সর্বধর্মসার ॥ ৪৩৫ ॥

*harināma-saṅkīrtana ei dharma tāra |*
*ei punaḥ harināma sarbadharmasāra || 435 ||*

*Word for word:* hari-nama-sankirtana — the sankirtana of Hari's name; ei dharma tara — is its dharma; ei punah hari-nama — and this name of Hari; sarva-dharma-sara — is the essence of all dharmas

**435.** [But] the sankirtana of Hari's name is its dharma,
and this name of Hari is the essence of all dharmas.

দান ব্রত তপো হোম জ্ঞান জপ-ফল ।
অনায়াসে মুক্তি দেই এক নাম-বল ॥ ৪৩৬ ॥

*dāna brata tapo homa jñāna japa-phala |*
*anāẏāse mukti dei eka nāma-bala || 436 ||*

*Word for word:* dana vrata tapo homa — charity, vows, austerity, fire offerings; jnana japa-phala — the fruits of knowledge and japa; anayase mukti dei — easily grants liberation; eka nama-bala — the power of the name alone

**436.** The fruits of charity, vows, austerity, fire offerings, knowledge and japa,
and liberation without effort, the power of the name alone bestows.

বিষয়ী বিষয়ভোগে নাম করে চিন্তা ।
আগে ভোগ দেই পাছে হরিভক্তি-দাতা ॥ ৪৩৭ ॥

*biṣaẏī biṣaẏabhoge nāma kare cintā |*
*āge bhoga dei pāche haribhakti-dātā || 437 ||*

*Word for word:* vishayi — a worldly man; vishaya-bhoge — amid sense enjoyment; nama kare chinta — thinks of the name; age bhoga dei — first [the name] gives enjoyment; pachhe hari-bhakti-data — afterwards it bestows devotion to Hari

**437.** Even a worldly man who, amid his pleasures, thinks of the name —
[the name] first gives him enjoyment and then bestows devotion to Hari.[^06-19]

শ্রদ্ধাবন্ত জন যদি হরিগুণ গায় ।
সব সুখ ছাড়ি প্রভু তার পাছে ধায় ॥ ৪৩৮ ॥

*śraddhābanta jana yadi hariguṇa gāẏa |*
*saba sukha chāṛi prabhu tāra pāche dhāẏa || 438 ||*

*Word for word:* shraddhavanta jana — a person of faith; yadi hari-guna gaya — if he sings Hari's virtues; saba sukha chhadi — leaving all pleasures; prabhu tara pachhe dhaya — the Lord runs after him

**438.** If a person of faith sings Hari's virtues,
the Lord, leaving all pleasures, runs after him.

এ হেন কৃষ্ণের নাম গুণ সঙ্কীর্তন ।
পাপময় কলিযুগে কৈলা ধর্ম হেন ॥ ৪৩৯ ॥

*e hena kṛṣṇera nāma guṇa saṅkīrtana |*
*pāpamaẏa kaliyuge kailā dharma hena || 439 ||*

*Word for word:* e hena krishnera nama guna sankirtana — such sankirtana of Krishna's name and virtues; papamaya kali-yuge — in the sinful Kali-yuga; kaila dharma hena — He made the dharma

**439.** Such sankirtana of Krishna's name and virtues
He made the dharma for the sinful Kali-yuga.

যুগের স্বভাব আর যুগধর্ম কহি ।
পাপময় কলিযুগে পরধর্ম এহি ॥ ৪৪০ ॥

*yugera sbabhāba āra yugadharma kahi |*
*pāpamaẏa kaliyuge paradharma ehi || 440 ||*

*Word for word:* yugera svabhava — the nature of the yuga; ara yuga-dharma kahi — and its dharma I tell; papamaya kali-yuge — in the sinful Kali-yuga; para-dharma ehi — this is the highest dharma

**440.** The nature of the yuga is one thing, and the dharma of the yuga that I name is another:
in the sinful Kali-yuga this is the highest dharma.

যদি বা বলিবা পাপ দুশ্ছেদ্য-কারণে ।
প্রকাশিলা মহাখড়্গ নামসঙ্কীর্তনে ॥ ৪৪১ ॥

*yadi bā balibā pāpa duśchedya-kāraṇe |*
*prakāśilā mahākhaṛga nāmasaṅkīrtane || 441 ||*

*Word for word:* yadi ba baliba — if you ask [why]; papa duchchhedya-karane — because sin is hard to cut; prakashila mahakhadga — He revealed the great sword; nama-sankirtane — in the sankirtana of the name

**441.** If you ask why — because sin is hard to cut:
[for this] He revealed the great sword, the sankirtana of the name.

সত্য-আদি প্রজা কেনে কলিজন্ম মাগে ।
হরিনাম-পরায়ণ হৈব কলিযুগে ॥ ৪৪২ ॥

*satya-ādi prajā kene kalijanma māge |*
*harināma-parāẏaṇa haiba kaliyuge || 442 ||*

*Word for word:* satya-adi praja — the people of Satya and the other yugas; kene kali-janma mage — why do they ask for birth in Kali; hari-nama-parayana — devoted to Hari's name; haiba kali-yuge — they will be in the Kali-yuga

**442.** Why do the people of Satya and the other yugas ask to be born in Kali?
[Because] in the Kali-yuga they will become devoted to Hari's name.

*So in the* Srimad-Bhagavata *(11.5.38):*

কৃতাদিষু প্রজা রাজন্ কলাবিচ্ছন্তি সম্ভবম্ ।
কলৌ খলু ভবিষ্যন্তি নারায়ণপরায়ণাঃ ॥ ৪৪৩ ॥

*kṛtādiṣu prajā rājan kalābicchanti sambhabam |*
*kalau khalu bhabiṣyanti nārāẏaṇaparāẏaṇāḥ || 443 ||*

*Word for word:* krita-adishu prajah — the people of Krita and other yugas; rajan — O king; kalau ichchhanti sambhavam — desire birth in Kali; kalau khalu bhavishyanti — for in Kali there will be; narayana-parayanah — those devoted to Narayana

**443.** 'The people of Krita and the other yugas, O king, desire to be born in Kali,
for in Kali there will be [people] wholly devoted to Narayana.'

কৃষ্ণ-অবতারে কেনে লঞা সর্বশক্তি ।
পাপাশয় জনে নাহি দেই প্রেমভক্তি ॥ ৪৪৪ ॥

*kṛṣṇa-abatāre kene lañā sarbaśakti |*
*pāpāśaẏa jane nāhi dei premabhakti || 444 ||*

*Word for word:* krishna-avatare — in the descent of Krishna; kene lana sarva-shakti — why, having taken all potencies; papashaya jane — to people of sinful hearts; nahi dei prema-bhakti — He did not give prema-bhakti

**444.** Why, in the descent of Krishna, appearing with all His potencies,
did He not give prema-bhakti to people of sinful hearts?[^06-20]

এছন করুণা কহ কোন্ যুগে আর ।
না ভজিতে প্রেম দেই কোন্ অবতার ॥ ৪৪৫ ॥

*echana karuṇā kaha kon yuge āra |*
*nā bhajite prema dei kon abatāra || 445 ||*

*Word for word:* echhana karuna — such mercy; kaha kon yuge ara — tell, in what other yuga; na bhajite — to those who do not worship; prema dei — gives prema; kon avatara — which avatara

**445.** Tell me: in what other yuga was there such mercy?
Which avatara gives prema to those who do not worship?

পাপনাশ-হেতু আছে ধর্ম কর্ম তীর্থ ।
কি জানহ ধর্মশীল পায় হেন অর্থ ॥ ৪৪৬ ॥

*pāpanāśa-hetu āche dharma karma tīrtha |*
*ki jānaha dharmaśīla pāẏa hena artha || 446 ||*

*Word for word:* papa-nasha-hetu — for destroying sin; achhe dharma karma tirtha — there are dharma, rites, holy places; ki janaha — do you know whether; dharmashila — the righteous; paya hena artha — obtain such a treasure

**446.** For destroying sin there are dharma, rites, holy places —
but do you know whether the righteous obtain such a treasure?

এতেকে জানিল কলি সর্বযুগসার ।
সঙ্কীর্তনধর্ম বহি ধর্ম নাহি আর ॥ ৪৪৭ ॥

*eteke jānila kali sarbayugasāra |*
*saṅkīrtanadharma bahi dharma nāhi āra || 447 ||*

*Word for word:* eteke janila — therefore know; kali sarva-yuga-sara — Kali is the essence of all yugas; sankirtana-dharma vahi — apart from the dharma of sankirtana; dharma nahi ara — there is no other dharma

**447.** Know, then: Kali is the essence of all yugas,
and there is no dharma other than the dharma of sankirtana."

এতেক বিচার-কথা কহিল বিরিঞ্চি ।
শুনিঞা নারদ বীণা বাজায় সুসঞ্চি ॥ ৪৪৮ ॥

*eteka bicāra-kathā kahila biriñci |*
*śuniñā nārada bīṇā bājāẏa susañci || 448 ||*

*Word for word:* eteka vichara-katha — such a discourse; kahila virinchi — Brahma spoke; shuniya — hearing; narada vina bajaya — Narada plays the vina; susanchi — skilfully

**448.** Such a discourse Brahma set forth;
having heard it, Narada skilfully plays his vina.

এহেন অদ্ভুত ব্রহ্মা-নারদ-সম্ভাষ ।
শুনিঞা আনন্দ হিয়া এ লোচনদাস ॥ ৪৪৯ ॥

*ehena adbhuta brahmā-nārada-sambhāṣa |*
*śuniñā ānanda hiẏā e locanadāsa || 449 ||*

*Word for word:* ehena adbhuta — such a wondrous; brahma-narada-sambhasha — conversation of Brahma and Narada; shuniya — hearing; ananda hiya — the heart rejoices; e lochanadasa — of this Lochana Dasa

**449.** Hearing such a wondrous conversation of Brahma and Narada,
the heart of this Lochana Dasa rejoices.

[^06-1]: *Krishna-varna*: literally "dark in colour" or "whose utterance (*varna*) is 'Krishna'"; *tvisha akrishna*, "not dark in lustre". In the edition the verse is followed by Bhaktisiddhanta's anvaya and translation (OCR damaged): *krishna-varna* — He who describes Krishna; "not dark in lustre" — golden; the "limbs" (*anga*) — Nityananda and Advaita; the "sub-limbs" (*upanga*) — Srivasa and others; the "weapons" (*astra*) — Hari-nama and the like; the "associates" (*parshada*) — Gadadhara and others. In translation: "The intelligent worship with the sacrifice of sankirtana the Mahapurusha who always reveals the virtues of Krishna and is golden in lustre, together with His limbs, sub-limbs, weapons and associates."
[^06-2]: A play on words: *varna* means both "colour" and "letter, sound". Cf. *Chaitanya-charitamrita*, Adi 3.53.
[^06-3]: Lochana Dasa's interpretation: the "limb" (*anga*) is Balarama, i.e. Nityananda; the "sub-limbs" (*upanga*) are ornaments. Krishnadasa Kaviraja (*Chaitanya-charitamrita*, Adi 3.66–76) and Bhaktisiddhanta in his anvaya take the "limbs and sub-limbs" as Nityananda, Advaita, Srivasa and the other associates, and the "weapon" as the holy name.
[^06-4]: Cf. Kavi Karnapura's *Gaura-ganoddesha-dipika*, which states which associates of Krishna appeared as whom in Gaura-lila.
[^06-5]: Vv. 360–363 set out the opponent's view: for him verse 11.5.32 speaks of a dark avatara of Kali, so that Kali and Dvapara have one colour, and the four yugas only three colours.
[^06-6]: Lochana Dasa has in mind the form *asan* ("were") in Garga's verse: the "yellow" one, not yet appeared, is spoken of in the past tense because His appearance is certain.
[^06-7]: Cf. *Chaitanya-charitamrita*, Adi 2 and 3: Krishna is the original Lord (*svayam bhagavan*), the source of all avataras; when He descends Himself, the yuga-avatara too is present in Him.
[^06-8]: The reasoning of vv. 385–390 is condensed: had the verse listed four colours one after another as four past yugas, the order would be strict; since Garga lists white, red and yellow in the past tense and says "now" of the dark one, the order seems broken; but "tatha" shows that yellow is the colour of the future, of the Kali-yuga.
[^06-9]: The sense of the verse is unclear. Perhaps the words "but Krishna is Bhagavan Himself" (*Bhag.* 1.3.28) are meant: which of them is the qualified and which the qualifier (cf. *Chaitanya-charitamrita*, Adi 2, where it is discussed which word in this verse is subject and which predicate).
[^06-10]: Lochana Dasa takes *krishnatam gatah* not as "has become dark" but as "has become Krishna": the yuga-avatara of every Dvapara is dark, but in this Dvapara Krishna Himself took his place. Cf. *Chaitanya-charitamrita*, Adi 3.5–10: Krishna appears once in a day of Brahma, at the end of the Dvapara (of the twenty-eighth *chatur-yuga*), and in the Kali that follows appears as Sri Chaitanya.
[^06-11]: This verse (from the *Padma-purana*) is also quoted in the *Chaitanya-charitamrita* (Madhya 6.182), as the Lord's order to Shiva to spread Mayavada scriptures in Kali. In Bhaktisiddhanta's translation in this edition: "I, ever worshipping Shambhu, shall accept this boon: you, appearing as a portion among men in the Dvapara and the following yugas, turn people away from Me by invented scriptures and conceal Me, so that creation may increase." Lochana Dasa cites the verse for the words "in the Dvapara and the following yugas" as an example of the Lord Himself descending in these yugas; this is his own interpretation.
[^06-12]: Bhaktisiddhanta's anvaya: "the righteous" are those devoted to the Lord's service; "the wicked" are those hostile to devotees; "to establish dharma" is Himself to practise the dharma of each yuga and teach it to living beings.
[^06-13]: A play on words: *yuga* means both "age" and "pair". According to Lochana Dasa, *yuge yuge* in *Gita* 4.8 means "in the pair of yugas" — Dvapara and Kali, when the Lord Himself descends — while the partial avataras of every yuga are the subject of verse 4.7 (vv. 409–412).
[^06-14]: So Lochana Dasa. The Gaudiya commentators usually refer both 4.7 and 4.8 to the Lord's descents in general; here the author distinguishes: in every yuga a partial avatara, in Dvapara and Kali the Lord Himself.
[^06-15]: A has "in an ashrama" (any of the ashramas); the 1983 edition, "under the supreme shelter".
[^06-16]: Line 1 is obscure; probably "the bonds of karma fall away only at the dissolution of the world [, and even then not for ever]".
[^06-17]: That is, one verse of the *Vishnu-sahasranama* gives names from two periods of Gaura's life. In Bhaktisiddhanta's translation (the text is partly damaged): the first four names ("golden", "with limbs like gold", "of beautiful form", "adorned with sandal") are marks of the pastimes of household life; the rest, of the pastimes in sannyasa: "taking sannyasa", "equipoised" (absorbed in contemplating Hari's mysteries), "peaceful" (firm in the great sacrifice of Hari-kirtana), "devoted to steadfastness and peace" (to the mahabhava that restrains the non-devotees).
[^06-18]: So Bhaktisiddhanta understands this verse: "In Kali, at the beginning of sankirtana, I shall be born as the son of Shachi — I shall be born, I shall be born, I shall be born, there is no doubt." In the 1983 edition the first line differs: "Be born on earth, be born, be born in the form of devotees" — the Lord's command to the gods.
[^06-19]: Cf. *Bhag.* 2.3.10: even one who has all desires, or desires liberation, should worship the Supreme Lord with intense devotion.
[^06-20]: Cf. *Chaitanya-charitamrita*, Adi 3.14–20 and ch. 4: Krishna reflects that for long He has not given prema-bhakti to the world, and appears as Gaura, giving prema to all without discrimination; cf. Rupa Gosvami's verse *anarpita-charim chirat…*

---

# Sutra-khanda, part 7 (portion 07)

*Narada answers Brahma: on service to the Vaishnavas, on the hidden prema of the gopis and how the Lord will spread it in Kali; the rejoicing of the three worlds; Narada sees the coming of Kali, hears the voice of Jagannatha and comes to Nilachala; Jagannatha describes Goloka and sends him to Gaura; Narada with the Lord of Vaikuntha, who calls Himself a portion of Gaura; in Goloka Narada beholds the bathing of Gaurasundara*

*Raga sindhura*

নারদ কহেন ব্রহ্মা কি কহিব আর ।
যে কিছু কহিলা এই হৃদয় আমার ॥ ৪৫০ ॥

*nārada kahena brahmā ki kahiba āra |*
*ye kichu kahilā ei hṛdaẏa āmāra || 450 ||*

*Word for word:* narada kahena — Narada says; brahma — Brahma; ki kahiba ara — what more shall I say; ye kichhu kahila — whatever you said; ei hridaya amara — this is my heart

**450.** Narada says: "Brahma, what more shall I say?
All that you have said is my very heart.

কর্মবন্ধে ভ্রমিতে ভ্রমিতে কত কল্প ।
দৈবে বৈষ্ণবসেবা ঘটে যদি অল্প ॥ ৪৫১ ॥

*karmabandhe bhramite bhramite kata kalpa |*
*daibe baiṣṇabasebā ghaṭe yadi alpa || 451 ||*

*Word for word:* karma-bandhe — in the bonds of karma; bhramite bhramite — wandering and wandering; kata kalpa — how many kalpas; daive — by fortune; vaishnava-seva — service to Vaishnavas; ghate yadi alpa — if a little befalls

**451.** Wandering in the bonds of karma, [a soul] roams for so many kalpas!
If by fortune a little service to the Vaishnavas falls to its lot,

তার মহোত্তম কথা নিগূঢ় শুনিঞা ।
পালয়ে পরম যত্নে সাবধান হঞা ॥ ৪৫২ ॥

*tāra mahottama kathā nigūṛha śuniñā |*
*pālaẏe parama yatne sābadhāna hañā || 452 ||*

*Word for word:* tara — their (the Vaishnavas'); mahottama katha nigudha — exalted secret word; shunina — having heard; palaye — keeps; parama yatne — with the utmost care; savadhana hana — attentively

**452.** and it hears from them the exalted secret word,
then it keeps it with the utmost care, attentively.

তবে মুক্তবন্ধ হঞা কৃষ্ণপর হয় ।
সালোক্যাদি মুক্তি চারি অঙ্গুলে না ছোঁয় ॥ ৪৫৩ ॥

*tabe muktabandha hañā kṛṣṇapara haẏa |*
*sālokyādi mukti cāri aṅgule nā choṁẏa || 453 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe — then; mukta-bandha hana — freed from bonds; krishna-para haya — becomes devoted to Krishna; salokya-adi mukti chari — the four liberations, salokya and the rest; angule na chhonya — does not touch with a finger

**453.** Then, freed from bondage, it becomes devoted to Krishna
and will not touch with a finger the four liberations, salokya and the rest.

তার পর প্রেমভক্তি গোপিকার ভাব ।
কে আছয়ে অধিকারী সে সব আলাপ ॥ ৪৫৪ ॥

*tāra para premabhakti gopikāra bhāba |*
*ke āchaẏe adhikārī se saba ālāpa || 454 ||*

*Word for word:* tara para — beyond that; prema-bhakti — prema-bhakti; gopikara bhava — the bhava of the gopis; ke achhaye adhikari — who is qualified; se saba alapa — [for] talk of all that

**454.** And beyond that is prema-bhakti, the bhava of the gopis:
who is qualified even to speak of all that?

যাঁর রসে বশ প্রভু ত্রিজগতনাথ ।
প্রাকৃতজনের যেন কুলটার সাথ ॥ ৪৫৫ ॥

*yāṁra rase baśa prabhu trijagatanātha |*
*prākṛtajanera yena kulaṭāra sātha || 455 ||*

*Word for word:* yanra rase — by whose rasa; vasha prabhu — the Lord is subdued; trijagata-natha — Master of the three worlds; prakrita-janera — to worldly people; yena kulatara satha — as if [consorting] with an unchaste woman

**455.** By their rasa the Lord, the Master of the three worlds, is conquered —
yet to worldly people [their love] seems like consorting with an unchaste woman.[^07-1]

তার প্রেমভক্তি-কথা কে কহিতে জানে ।
গুল্মলতা জন্ম উদ্ধব মাগে যার গুণে ॥ ৪৫৬ ॥

*tāra premabhakti-kathā ke kahite jāne |*
*gulmalatā janma uddhaba māge yāra guṇe || 456 ||*

*Word for word:* tara prema-bhakti-katha — the tale of their prema-bhakti; ke kahite jane — who knows how to tell; gulma-lata janma — birth as a bush or creeper; uddhava mage — Uddhava begs; yara gune — for whose virtues

**456.** Who can tell of their prema-bhakti?
For the sake of their virtues Uddhava begs to be born a bush or a creeper.

*So in the* Srimad-Bhagavata *(10.47.61):*

আসামহো চরণরেণুজুষামহং স্যাং
বৃন্দাবনে কিমপি গুল্মলতৌষধীনাম্ ।
যা দুস্ত্যজং স্বজনমার্যপথঞ্চ হিত্বা
ভেজুর্মুকুন্দপদবীং শ্রুতিভির্বিমৃগ্যাম্ ॥ ৪৫৭ ॥

*āsāmaho caraṇareṇujuṣāmahaṃ syāṃ*
*bṛndābane kimapi gulmalatauṣadhīnām |*
*yā dustyajaṃ sbajanamāryapathañca hitbā*
*bhejurmukundapadabīṃ śrutibhirbimṛgyām || 457 ||*

*Word for word:* asam — of them (the gopis); aho — oh; charana-renu-jusham — serving the dust of the feet; aham syam — may I be; vrindavane — in Vrindavana; kim api — any one; gulma-lata-oshadhinam — of the bushes, creepers and herbs; ya — who; dustyajam svajanam — kinsmen hard to abandon; arya-patham cha — and the path of the noble; hitva — abandoning; bhejuh — attained; mukunda-padavim — the way of Mukunda; shrutibhih vimrigyam — sought by the shrutis

**457.** 'Oh, that I might be anything at all — a bush, a creeper or a herb — in Vrindavana,
[to serve] the dust of the feet of those who, abandoning kinsmen hard to abandon and the path of the noble,
attained the way of Mukunda, which the shrutis seek!'[^07-2]

যে প্রভুর চরণ ব্রহ্মা মহেশ ধেয়ায় ।
যোগীন্দ্র মুনীন্দ্র খুঁজি উদ্দেশ না পায় ॥ ৪৫৮ ॥

*ye prabhura caraṇa brahmā maheśa dheẏāẏa |*
*yogīndra munīndra khuṁji uddeśa nā pāẏa || 458 ||*

*Word for word:* ye prabhura charana — the feet of that Lord; brahma mahesha dheyaya — Brahma and Mahesha meditate on; yogindra munindra — the best of yogis and sages; khunji — searching; uddesha na paya — find no trace

**458.** That Lord on whose feet Brahma and Mahesha meditate,
whom the best of yogis and sages seek and find not even a trace of;

অশেষ লখিমী যার করে পদসেবা ।
বাক্য-অগোচর যার পদমধু-প্রভা ॥ ৪৫৯ ॥

*aśeṣa lakhimī yāra kare padasebā |*
*bākya-agocara yāra padamadhu-prabhā || 459 ||*

*Word for word:* ashesha lakhimi — countless Lakshmis; yara kare pada-seva — whose feet they serve; vakya-agochara — beyond the reach of words; yara pada-madhu-prabha — the honeyed radiance of whose feet

**459.** whose feet are served by countless Lakshmis,
the honeyed radiance of whose feet is beyond the reach of words;

চারি বেদে যাঁহার মহত্ত্ব নিত্য গায় ।
অনন্ত মহিমা গুণ ওর নাহি পায় ॥ ৪৬০ ॥

*cāri bede yāṁhāra mahattba nitya gāẏa |*
*ananta mahimā guṇa ora nāhi pāẏa || 460 ||*

*Word for word:* chari vede — the four Vedas; yanhara mahattva — whose greatness; nitya gaya — ever sing; ananta mahima guna — of the endless glory and virtues; ora nahi paya — find no limit

**460.** whose greatness the four Vedas ever sing,
finding no limit to His endless glory and virtues;

শেষ মহাশয় যার শয়নের শয্যা ।
হেন প্রভু কৈল গোপিকার পরিচর্যা ॥ ৪৬১ ॥

*śeṣa mahāśaẏa yāra śaẏanera śayyā |*
*hena prabhu kaila gopikāra paricaryā || 461 ||*

*Word for word:* shesha mahashaya — the great Shesha; yara shayanera shayya — whose bed for sleeping; hena prabhu — such a Lord; kaila gopikara paricharya — served the gopis

**461.** whose bed is the great Shesha —
such a Lord served the gopis.

আর কত ভকত আছয়ে শত শত ।
হেন রূপে বশ কৈল গোপী অনুগত ॥ ৪৬২ ॥

*āra kata bhakata āchaẏe śata śata |*
*hena rūpe baśa kaila gopī anugata || 462 ||*

*Word for word:* ara kata bhakata — how many other devotees; achhaye shata shata — there are hundreds; hena rupe — in such a way; vasha kaila — conquered; gopi — the gopis; anugata — [so that He became] obedient

**462.** There are hundreds of other devotees too,
but only the gopis so conquered Him that He became obedient to them.

কোথা কৃষ্ণ পরমাত্মা নিগূঢ় যে প্রেমা ।
কোথা গোপী বনচারী ব্যভিচারী কামা ॥ ৪৬৩ ॥

*kothā kṛṣṇa paramātmā nigūṛha ye premā |*
*kothā gopī banacārī byabhicārī kāmā || 463 ||*

*Word for word:* kotha krishna paramatma — where is Krishna, the Supreme Self; nigudha ye prema — and so hidden a prema; kotha gopi — where the gopis; vanachari — forest-dwellers; vyabhichari — unchaste; kama — lustful

**463.** Where is Krishna, the Supreme Self — and so hidden a prema —
and where the gopis, forest-dwellers, 'unchaste', 'lustful'?[^07-3]

এছন ভকতিতত্ত্ব বুঝিবারে চাই ।
পরম নিগূঢ় ভক্তি ইহা বই নাই ॥ ৪৬৪ ॥

*echana bhakatitattba bujhibāre cāi |*
*parama nigūṛha bhakti ihā bai nāi || 464 ||*

*Word for word:* aichhana bhakati-tattva — such a truth of bhakti; bujhibare chai — I want to understand; parama nigudha bhakti — more hidden bhakti; iha bai nai — there is none but this

**464.** Such is the truth of bhakti I long to understand:
there is no bhakti more hidden than this.

হেন ভক্তি প্রচারিব কলিযুগে প্রভু ।
লখিমী অনন্ত যাহা নাহি শুনে কভু ॥ ৪৬৫ ॥

*hena bhakti pracāriba kaliyuge prabhu |*
*lakhimī ananta yāhā nāhi śune kabhu || 465 ||*

*Word for word:* hena bhakti — such bhakti; prachariba kali-yuge prabhu — the Lord will spread in the Kali-yuga; lakhimi ananta — Lakshmi and Ananta; yaha nahi shune kabhu — which they never heard of

**465.** This bhakti the Lord will spread in the Kali-yuga —
that which even Lakshmi and Ananta have never heard of.

সভারে বোলহ ব্রহ্মা সব ব্রহ্মলোকে ।
নিজ নিজ অংশে জন্ম লহ কলিযুগে ॥ ৪৬৬ ॥

*sabhāre bolaha brahmā saba brahmaloke |*
*nija nija aṃśe janma laha kaliyuge || 466 ||*

*Word for word:* sabhare bolaha — tell everyone; brahma — Brahma; saba brahmaloke — throughout Brahmaloka; nija nija amshe — each by his portion; janma laha kali-yuge — take birth in the Kali-yuga

**466.** Tell everyone, Brahma, throughout Brahmaloka:
'Take birth by your portions in the Kali-yuga!'"

ইহা বলি মহামুনি অন্তর উল্লাস ।
চলিলা নারদ কহে এ লোচনদাস ॥ ৪৬৭ ॥

*ihā bali mahāmuni antara ullāsa |*
*calilā nārada kahe e locanadāsa || 467 ||*

*Word for word:* iha bali — saying this; mahamuni — the great sage; antara ullasa — with jubilation in heart; chalila narada — Narada set out; kahe e lochanadasa — says this Lochana Dasa

**467.** Having said this, with jubilation in his heart,
the great sage Narada went on his way, says this Lochana Dasa.

*Raga mallara, tripadi metre; disha: "O my life, Gorachand!"*[^07-4]

চলিলা নারদমুনি, বীণার গর্জন শুনি,
লহু লহু শ্রবণমঙ্গল গীত না ।
অমিয় সিঞ্চিল যেন, জগতজনের মন,
ভুবনে আনন্দ-চমকিত না ॥ ৪৬৮ ॥

*calilā nāradamuni, bīṇāra garjana śuni,*
*lahu lahu śrabaṇamaṅgala gīta nā |*
*amiẏa siñcila yena, jagatajanera mana,*
*bhubane ānanda-camakita nā || 468 ||*

*Word for word:* chalila naradamuni — Narada Muni set out; vinara garjana shuni — the roar of the vina is heard; lahu lahu — softly; shravana-mangala gita — a song delightful to the ear; amiya sinchila yena — as if sprinkled nectar; jagata-janera mana — the minds of the world's people; bhuvane ananda-chamakita — the worlds thrilled with joy

**468.** Narada Muni set out; the roar of his vina is heard,
softly flows a song that delights the ear;
as if it sprinkled nectar on the minds of the world's people —
the worlds thrilled with joy.

জয় জয় হরিবোল, আনন্দে মগন ভেল,
ঘোষণা পড়িল তিনলোকে না ।
অস্ত্র-পারিষদ-সঙ্গে, জনম লভিব রঙ্গে,
গোরা অবতার কলিযুগে না ॥ ৪৬৯ ॥

*jaẏa jaẏa haribola, ānande magana bhela,*
*ghoṣaṇā paṛila tinaloke nā |*
*astra-pāriṣada-saṅge, janama labhiba raṅge,*
*gorā abatāra kaliyuge nā || 469 ||*

*Word for word:* jaya jaya haribola — "jaya, jaya, Haribol!"; anande magana bhela — were immersed in bliss; ghoshana padila tinaloke — a proclamation went through the three worlds; astra-parishada-sange — with weapons and associates; janama labhiba range — will joyfully take birth; gora avatara kali-yuge — Gora, the avatara in the Kali-yuga

**469.** "Jaya, jaya! Haribol!" — all were immersed in bliss;
a proclamation went through the three worlds:
"With [His] weapons and associates, joyfully He will take birth —
Gora, the avatara for the Kali-yuga!

এছন করুণাকর, দেখিব নয়ান মোর,
অমিয়া সিঞ্চিব কলেবরে না ।
জয় জয় জগন্নাথ, ভকতজনের সাথ,
নিজভক্তি করিব প্রচার না ॥ ৪৭০ ॥

*echana karuṇākara, dekhiba naẏāna mora,*
*amiẏā siñciba kalebare nā |*
*jaẏa jaẏa jagannātha, bhakatajanera sātha,*
*nijabhakti kariba pracāra nā || 470 ||*

*Word for word:* aichhana karunakara — such an ocean of mercy; dekhiba nayana mora — my eyes will see; amiya sinchiba kalevare — will sprinkle nectar on the body; jaya jaya jagannatha — jaya, jaya, Jagannatha; bhakata-janera satha — together with the devotees; nija-bhakti kariba prachara — will spread devotion to Himself

**470.** Such an ocean of mercy my eyes will see;
He will sprinkle nectar on my body.
Jaya, jaya, Jagannatha! Together with the devotees
He will spread devotion to Himself.

কলিযুগ ধনি ধনি, লোক প্রজা সব ধনি,
অবনী নদীয়া তার মাঝে না ।
ধনি মিশ্র পুরন্দর, ভবনেতে যাহার,
জনম লভিলা গোরারাজে না ॥ ৪৭১ ॥

*kaliyuga dhani dhani, loka prajā saba dhani,*
*abanī nadīẏā tāra mājhe nā |*
*dhani miśra purandara, bhabanete yāhāra,*
*janama labhilā gorārāje nā || 471 ||*

*Word for word:* kali-yuga dhani dhani — blessed is the Kali-yuga; loka praja saba dhani — blessed are all the people; avani — the earth; nadiya tara majhe — Nadiya upon it; dhani mishra purandara — blessed is Mishra Purandara; bhavanete yahara — in whose house; janama labhila gora-raja — Gora-raja has taken birth

**471.** Blessed, blessed is the Kali-yuga, blessed are all its people,
[blessed] the earth, and Nadia upon it;
blessed is Mishra Purandara, in whose house
Gora-raja has taken birth.[^07-5]

এই ভকতসঙ্গে, হরিগুণ-গান রঙ্গে,
বায় শঙ্খ মৃদঙ্গ করতাল না ।
এ ভুবন চতুর্দশ, প্রেম-বরিষণ-রস,
গুণকীর্তন করিব পরচার না ॥ ৪৭২ ॥

*ei bhakatasaṅge, hariguṇa-gāna raṅge,*
*bāẏa śaṅkha mṛdaṅga karatāla nā |*
*e bhubana caturdaśa, prema-bariṣaṇa-rasa,*
*guṇakīrtana kariba paracāra nā || 472 ||*

*Word for word:* ei bhakata-sange — with these devotees; hariguna-gana range — joyfully singing Hari's virtues; vaya shankha mridanga karatala — conches, mridangas and kartals sound; e bhuvana chaturdasha — these fourteen worlds; prema-barishana-rasa — the rasa of the rain of prema; guna-kirtana kariba parachara — will spread the kirtana of virtues

**472.** With these devotees, joyfully singing the virtues of Hari —
conches, mridangas and kartals sounding —
through the fourteen worlds, raining down the rasa of prema,
He will spread the kirtana of [His] virtues.

বৃন্দাবন-গুণ-রস, প্রণয় সে সরবস,
আপনে আস্বাদি দিব সভে না ।
দেব-নাগ-নরগণে, আচণ্ডাল সব জনে,
পিয়াইব যাহা করি লোভে না ॥ ৪৭৩ ॥

*bṛndābana-guṇa-rasa, praṇaẏa se sarabasa,*
*āpane āsbādi diba sabhe nā |*
*deba-nāga-naragaṇe, ācaṇḍāla saba jane,*
*piẏāiba yāhā kari lobhe nā || 473 ||*

*Word for word:* vrindavana-guna-rasa — the rasa of Vrindavana's virtues; pranaya se sarabasa — love, which is all in all; apane asvadi — tasting Himself; diba sabhe — will give to all; deva-naga-naragane — to gods, nagas and men; achandala saba jane — to all down to the chandala; piyaiba — will give to drink; yaha kari lobhe — that for which He awakens their thirst

**473.** The rasa of the virtues of Vrindavana — love, which is all in all —
He will taste Himself and give to all;
to gods, nagas and men, to everyone down to the chandala,
He will give to drink that for which He awakens their thirst."

আনন্দে আনন্দ গুণ, মঙ্গলে মঙ্গল শুন,
বৃন্দাবন-ধন পরকাশ না ।
সকল-ভুবনপতি, জনম লভিল ক্ষিতি,
আনন্দে ভুলিল এ লোচনদাস না ॥ ৪৭৪ ॥

*ānande ānanda guṇa, maṅgale maṅgala śuna,*
*bṛndābana-dhana parakāśa nā |*
*sakala-bhubanapati, janama labhila kṣiti,*
*ānande bhulila e locanadāsa nā || 474 ||*

*Word for word:* anande ananda guna — bliss upon bliss are the virtues; mangale mangala shuna — good upon good, hear; vrindavana-dhana parakasha — the treasure of Vrindavana revealed; sakala-bhuvanapati — the Lord of all the worlds; janama labhila kshiti — has taken birth on earth; anande bhulila e lochanadasa — in bliss this Lochana Dasa forgot himself

**474.** Bliss upon bliss are [His] virtues; hear: good upon good —
the treasure of Vrindavana is revealed;
the Lord of all the worlds has taken birth on earth —
in bliss this Lochana Dasa forgot himself.

*Raga varadi; disha: "My Lord, O my life, oh, Gorachand!"*

যোগী মুনীন্দ্র ইন্দ্র চন্দ্র আদি লোকে ।
শুনিঞা আনন্দময় নাচয়ে কৌতুকে ॥ ৪৭৫ ॥

*yogī munīndra indra candra ādi loke |*
*śuniñā ānandamaẏa nācaẏe kautuke || 475 ||*

*Word for word:* yogi munindra indra chandra adi loke — yogis, great sages, Indra, Chandra and the rest in the worlds; shunina — hearing; anandamaya — full of bliss; nachaye kautuke — dance in delight

**475.** Yogis, great sages, Indra, Chandra and the rest in their worlds,
hearing [the news], filled with bliss, dance in delight.

নারদ আনন্দময় ভ্রময়ে কৌতুকে ।
অঙ্কুরিত মৃততরু যেন দেখে লোকে ॥ ৪৭৬ ॥

*nārada ānandamaẏa bhramaẏe kautuke |*
*aṅkurita mṛtataru yena dekhe loke || 476 ||*

*Word for word:* narada anandamaya — Narada, full of bliss; bhramaye kautuke — roams in delight; ankurita mrita-taru — a dead tree that has sprouted; yena dekhe loke — as if people see

**476.** Narada, full of bliss, roams in delight —
it seems to people as if a dead tree had put forth shoots.

হেনমতে ভ্রমিতে ভ্রমিতে আচম্বিত ।
ধর্মবিপর্যয় দেখে লোকের চরিত ॥ ৪৭৭ ॥

*henamate bhramite bhramite ācambita |*
*dharmabiparyaẏa dekhe lokera carita || 477 ||*

*Word for word:* henamate — thus; bhramite bhramite — roaming; achambita — suddenly; dharma-viparyaya — the overturning of dharma; dekhe lokera charita — sees in people's conduct

**477.** Roaming thus, he suddenly
sees that dharma has been overturned in people's conduct:

দান ব্রত তপস্যা ছাড়িয়া সর্বজন ।
স্ত্রীয়ের গৌরব করে কায়-বাক্য-মন ॥ ৪৭৮ ॥

*dāna brata tapasyā chāṛiẏā sarbajana |*
*strīẏera gauraba kare kāẏa-bākya-mana || 478 ||*

*Word for word:* dana vrata tapasya — charity, vows, austerity; chhadiya sarvajana — abandoning, all people; striyera gaurava kare — honour their wives; kaya-vakya-mana — with body, speech and mind

**478.** abandoning charity, vows and austerity, all people
with body, speech and mind honour [only] their wives.[^07-6]

ইহা অনুমানি মুনি জানিল নিশ্চয় ।
এই কলিযুগ ইথে নাহিক সংশয় ॥ ৪৭৯ ॥

*ihā anumāni muni jānila niścaẏa |*
*ei kaliyuga ithe nāhika saṃśaẏa || 479 ||*

*Word for word:* iha anumani — reflecting on this; muni janila nishchaya — the sage knew for certain; ei kali-yuga — this is the Kali-yuga; ithe nahika samshaya — there is no doubt of it

**479.** Reflecting on this, the sage knew for certain:
this is the Kali-yuga, there is no doubt of it.

যা লাগিয়া তিন লোকে ঘোষণা পড়িল ।
কারে নিবেদিব এই কলিযুগ আইল ॥ ৪৮০ ॥

*yā lāgiẏā tina loke ghoṣaṇā paṛila |*
*kāre nibediba ei kaliyuga āila || 480 ||*

*Word for word:* ya lagiya — for which; tina loke ghoshana padila — a proclamation went through the three worlds; kare nivediba — to whom shall I tell; ei kali-yuga aila — here the Kali-yuga has come

**480.** "That for which a proclamation went through the three worlds —
to whom shall I tell it? — here it is, the Kali-yuga has come!"

চিন্তিত হইয়া মুনি বসিলা ধেয়ানে ।
আচম্বিতে শুভবাণী উঠিল গগনে ॥ ৪৮১ ॥

*cintita haiẏā muni basilā dheẏāne |*
*ācambite śubhabāṇī uṭhila gagane || 481 ||*

*Word for word:* chintita haiya — becoming troubled; muni basila dheyane — the sage sat in meditation; achambite — suddenly; shubha-vani uthila gagane — an auspicious voice arose in the sky

**481.** Troubled, the sage sat down in meditation,
and suddenly an auspicious voice arose in the sky:

জগন্নাথ দারুব্রহ্ম আমি নীলাচলে ।
লোক-নিস্তারণ-হেতু সমুদ্রের কূলে ॥ ৪৮২ ॥

*jagannātha dārubrahma āmi nīlācale |*
*loka-nistāraṇa-hetu samudrera kūle || 482 ||*

*Word for word:* jagannatha — Jagannatha; daru-brahma — Brahman in wood; ami nilachale — I [am] in Nilachala; loka-nistarana-hetu — for the deliverance of people; samudrera kule — on the shore of the ocean

**482.** "I am Jagannatha, the Daru-brahman,[^07-7] in Nilachala,
on the shore of the ocean, for the deliverance of people.

পূর্ববৃত্তান্ত নাহি স্মরণ যে তোর ।
কাত্যায়নী-প্রতিজ্ঞায় আজ্ঞা পাইলে মোর ॥ ৪৮৩ ॥

*pūrbabṛttānta nāhi smaraṇa ye tora |*
*kātyāẏanī-pratijñāẏa ājñā pāile mora || 483 ||*

*Word for word:* purva-vrittanta — the former account; nahi smarana ye tora — do you not remember; katyayani-pratijnaya — through Katyayani's vow; ajna paile mora — you received My command

**483.** Do you not remember the former account?
Through Katyayani's vow you received My command.[^07-8]

চল চল মুনিরাজ নীলাচলপুরী ।
আচরিহ জগন্নাথ-আজ্ঞা-অনুসারি ॥ ৪৮৪ ॥

*cala cala munirāja nīlācalapurī |*
*ācariha jagannātha-ājñā-anusāri || 484 ||*

*Word for word:* chala chala — go, go; muniraja — king of sages; nilachala-puri — to the city of Nilachala; achariha — act; jagannatha-ajna-anusari — according to Jagannatha's command

**484.** Go, go, king of sages, to the city of Nilachala
and act according to the command of Jagannatha."

চলিলা নারদমুনি আনন্দ হিয়ায় ।
উঠিল বীণার ধ্বনি জগত জড়ায় ॥ ৪৮৫ ॥

*calilā nāradamuni ānanda hiẏāẏa |*
*uṭhila bīṇāra dhbani jagata jaṛāẏa || 485 ||*

*Word for word:* chalila naradamuni — Narada Muni set out; ananda hiyaya — with joy in his heart; uthila vinara dhvani — the sound of the vina arose; jagata jadaya — enfolding the world

**485.** Narada Muni set out with joy in his heart;
the sound of his vina arose, filling the world.

হাহা জগন্নাথ বলি অনুরাগে ধায় ।
দেখিল শ্রীমুখচন্দ্র ত্রিজগতরায় ॥ ৪৮৬ ॥

*hāhā jagannātha bali anurāge dhāẏa |*
*dekhila śrīmukhacandra trijagatarāẏa || 486 ||*

*Word for word:* haha jagannatha bali — crying "Ha, ha, Jagannatha!"; anurage dhaya — runs in love; dekhila shri-mukha-chandra — saw the moon-like face; trijagata-raya — of the King of the three worlds

**486.** Crying "Ha, ha, Jagannatha!" he runs in love
and beheld the moon-like face of the King of the three worlds —

যত অবতার তার আশ্রয়-সদন ।
সব-কলা-রসময় প্রসন্ন বদন ॥ ৪৮৭ ॥

*yata abatāra tāra āśraẏa-sadana |*
*saba-kalā-rasamaẏa prasanna badana || 487 ||*

*Word for word:* yata avatara — of all the avataras; tara ashraya-sadana — their shelter and abode; saba-kala-rasamaya — full of the rasa of all arts; prasanna vadana — a gracious face

**487.** the abode and shelter of all avataras,
a gracious face full of the rasa of all arts.

চরণে পড়িয়া মুনি বোলে কর জুড়ি ।
কৃপা কর জগন্নাথ আইল যুগ কলি ॥ ৪৮৮ ॥

*caraṇe paṛiẏā muni bole kara juṛi |*
*kṛpā kara jagannātha āila yuga kali || 488 ||*

*Word for word:* charane padiya — falling at the feet; muni bole kara judi — the sage says with joined palms; kripa kara jagannatha — be merciful, Jagannatha; aila yuga kali — the Kali-yuga has come

**488.** Falling at His feet, the sage says with joined palms:
"Be merciful, Jagannatha — the Kali-yuga has come!

মহাঘোর পাপেতে পড়িল সব লোকে ।
শিশ্নোদর-পরায়ণ ভ্রান্ত মহাশোকে ॥ ৪৮৯ ॥

*mahāghora pāpete paṛila saba loke |*
*śiśnodara-parāẏaṇa bhrānta mahāśoke || 489 ||*

*Word for word:* mahaghora papete — into the most terrible sin; padila saba loke — all people have fallen; shishnodara-parayana — devoted to lust and belly; bhranta — gone astray; mahashoke — in great sorrow

**489.** All people have fallen into the most terrible sin;
devoted to lust and belly, they have gone astray, in great sorrow."

শুনিঞা ঠাকুর কিছু হাসিয়া কহিল ।
কর পরশিয়া তারে নিভৃতে কহিল ॥ ৪৯০ ॥

*śuniñā ṭhākura kichu hāsiẏā kahila |*
*kara paraśiẏā tāre nibhṛte kahila || 490 ||*

*Word for word:* shunina — hearing; thakura — the Lord; kichhu hasiya kahila — smiling a little, spoke; kara parashiya tare — touching him with His hand; nibhrite kahila — told in private

**490.** Hearing this, the Lord, smiling a little, spoke;
touching him with His hand, He told him in private:

পরম নিগূঢ় এই কহি তোর স্থানে ।
গোলোকে চলহ তুমি আমার বচনে ॥ ৪৯১ ॥

*parama nigūṛha ei kahi tora sthāne |*
*goloke calaha tumi āmāra bacane || 491 ||*

*Word for word:* parama nigudha ei — this supreme secret; kahi tora sthane — I tell you; goloke chalaha tumi — go to Goloka; amara vachane — at My word

**491.** "I tell you this supreme secret:
at My word go to Goloka.

*Raga pahida, tripadi metre*

বৈকুণ্ঠ-উপরি স্থান, গোলোক যাহার নাম,
শ্রীগৌরসুন্দর তাহে রাজা ।
লখিমী-আদিক নারী, একই পুরুষ হরি,
সুখময় সকল পরজা ॥ ৪৯২ ॥

*baikuṇṭha-upari sthāna, goloka yāhāra nāma,*
*śrīgaurasundara tāhe rājā |*
*lakhimī-ādika nārī, ekai puruṣa hari,*
*sukhamaẏa sakala parajā || 492 ||*

*Word for word:* vaikuntha-upari sthana — an abode above Vaikuntha; goloka yahara nama — whose name is Goloka; shri-gaurasundara tahe raja — Sri Gaurasundara is king there; lakhimi-adika nari — the women are Lakshmi and the others; ekai purusha hari — the one Purusha is Hari; sukhamaya sakala paraja — all the subjects are full of happiness

**492.** Above Vaikuntha there is an abode whose name is Goloka;
Sri Gaurasundara is king there;[^07-9]
the women are Lakshmi and the others, the one Purusha is Hari,
and all the subjects are full of happiness.

রাধা আর রুক্মিণী, এই দুই ঠাকুরাণী,
তার অংশে যতেক নাগরী ।
শত শত শাখা-ভক্তি, এ দোঁহার ধরি শক্তি,
সেবা করে হঞা অনুচরী ॥ ৪৯৩ ॥

*rādhā āra rukmiṇī, ei dui ṭhākurāṇī,*
*tāra aṃśe yateka nāgarī |*
*śata śata śākhā-bhakti, e doṁhāra dhari śakti,*
*sebā kare hañā anucarī || 493 ||*

*Word for word:* radha ara rukmini — Radha and Rukmini; ei dui thakurani — these two queens; tara amshe yateka nagari — all the nagaris are their portions; shata shata shakha-bhakti — hundreds of branches of bhakti; e donhara dhari shakti — holding the power of these two; seva kare hana anuchari — serve as attendants

**493.** Radha and Rukmini — these two queens;
all the nagaris are their portions;
hundreds upon hundreds of branches of bhakti, holding the power of these two,
serve [Him] as their attendants.[^07-10]

আর দেবী সত্যভামা, রূপে গুণে অনুপমা,
সব বৈদগ্ধী-রস-সীমা ।
লীলা-বিলাস-লাবণ্য, সর্ব-কলা-রসে ধন্যা,
ত্রিজগতে রমণী পরমা ॥ ৪৯৪ ॥

*āra debī satyabhāmā, rūpe guṇe anupamā,*
*saba baidagdhī-rasa-sīmā |*
*līlā-bilāsa-lābaṇya, sarba-kalā-rase dhanyā,*
*trijagate ramaṇī paramā || 494 ||*

*Word for word:* ara devi satyabhama — and the goddess Satyabhama; rupe gune anupama — incomparable in beauty and virtue; saba vaidagdhi-rasa-sima — the limit of the rasa of all wit; lila-vilasa-lavanya — with lila, play, loveliness; sarva-kala-rase dhanya — blessed with the rasa of all arts; trijagate ramani parama — the supreme woman of the three worlds

**494.** And the goddess Satyabhama, incomparable in beauty and virtue,
the limit of the rasa of all clever wit;
blessed with lila, play and loveliness, with the rasa of all arts —
the supreme woman of the three worlds.

সঙ্গীত বলিয়ে যারে, তাল-সঞ্চারণ স্বরে,
শব্দব্রহ্ম জগতে বাখানে ।
বলিয়ে পঞ্চম বেদ, যে বুঝয়ে স্বরভেদ,
বুদ্ধিরূপা সর্বত্র সমানে ॥ ৪৯৫ ॥

*saṅgīta baliẏe yāre, tāla-sañcāraṇa sbare,*
*śabdabrahma jagate bākhāne |*
*baliẏe pañcama beda, ye bujhaẏe sbarabheda,*
*buddhirūpā sarbatra samāne || 495 ||*

*Word for word:* sangita baliye yare — she who is called Music; tala-sancharana svare — with rhythm and movement of tones; shabda-brahma jagate bakhane — the world praises as Shabda-brahman; baliye panchama veda — she is called the fifth Veda; ye bujhaye svarabheda — [for one] who understands the distinction of notes; buddhi-rupa — in the form of understanding; sarvatra samane — equally everywhere

**495.** She who is called Music — with rhythm and the movement of tones —
the world praises as Shabda-brahman;
she is called the fifth Veda — [for one] who understands the distinctions of notes —
