she is understanding itself, present equally in all.[^07-11]

পুরুষ ঠাকুর-অংশ, সকল বৈষ্ণব-বংশ,
রসময় রঙ্গ-নামা পুরী ।
এছন মহিমা তার, কহিতে শকতি কার,
এক-মুখে কহিতে না পারি ॥ ৪৯৬ ॥

*puruṣa ṭhākura-aṃśa, sakala baiṣṇaba-baṃśa,*
*rasamaẏa raṅga-nāmā purī |*
*echana mahimā tāra, kahite śakati kāra,*
*eka-mukhe kahite nā pāri || 496 ||*

*Word for word:* purusha thakura-amsha — the men are portions of the Lord; sakala vaishnava-vamsha — all of Vaishnava lineage; rasamaya — full of rasa; ranga-nama puri — the city named Ranga; aichhana mahima tara — such is its greatness; kahite shakati kara — who has the power to tell; eka-mukhe kahite na pari — I cannot tell with one mouth

**496.** The men are portions of the Lord, all of Vaishnava lineage;
the city, full of rasa, is named Ranga.[^07-12]
Such is the greatness of that [abode] — who has the power to tell it?
I cannot tell it with one mouth.

যতেক গোপিকাগণে, রাস কৈল বৃন্দাবনে,
রাধা আগে করি করে সেবা ।
দ্বারকায় আছিল যত, রুক্মিণীর অনুগত,
আর যত রস-অনুভবা ॥ ৪৯৭ ॥

*yateka gopikāgaṇe, rāsa kaila bṛndābane,*
*rādhā āge kari kare sebā |*
*dbārakāẏa āchila yata, rukmiṇīra anugata,*
*āra yata rasa-anubhabā || 497 ||*

*Word for word:* yateka gopikagane — all the gopis; rasa kaila vrindavane — who danced the rasa in Vrindavana; radha age kari — placing Radha at their head; kare seva — serve; dvarakaya achhila yata — all who were in Dvaraka; rukminira anugata — follow Rukmini; ara yata rasa-anubhava — and all others who taste rasa

**497.** All the gopis who danced the rasa in Vrindavana
serve [Him] with Radha at their head;
all who were in Dvaraka follow Rukmini —
and all the others who taste rasa.

ভক্তি বিনু নাহি তায়, নিরবধি যশঃ গায়,
স্বতন্ত্র হইয়া পরাধীন ।
মুক্ত পুনঃ সর্বজন, প্রাকৃতজনের হেন,
ভকতি করয়ে যেন দীন ॥ ৪৯৮ ॥

*bhakti binu nāhi tāẏa, nirabadhi yaśaḥ gāẏa,*
*sbatantra haiẏā parādhīna |*
*mukta punaḥ sarbajana, prākṛtajanera hena,*
*bhakati karaẏe yena dīna || 498 ||*

*Word for word:* bhakti vinu nahi taya — there is nothing there but bhakti; niravadhi yashah gaya — unceasingly they sing [His] glory; svatantra haiya paradhina — though independent, dependent; mukta punah sarvajana — all are liberated, and yet; prakrita-janera hena — like ordinary people; bhakati karaye yena dina — practise bhakti as if humble

**498.** There is nothing there but bhakti; unceasingly they sing [His] glory;
though independent, they are dependent [on Him];
all are liberated, and yet, like ordinary people,
they practise bhakti as if humble.

সালোক্যাদি চারি মুক্তি, বৈকুণ্ঠনাথের শক্তি,
ভক্তিহীন আপনে স্বতন্ত্র ।
লখিমী-সম্পদময়, দীনভাব নাহি রয়,
ভকতি কেবল পরতন্ত্র ॥ ৪৯৯ ॥

*sālokyādi cāri mukti, baikuṇṭhanāthera śakti,*
*bhaktihīna āpane sbatantra |*
*lakhimī-sampadamaẏa, dīnabhāba nāhi raẏa,*
*bhakati kebala paratantra || 499 ||*

*Word for word:* salokya-adi chari mukti — the four liberations, salokya and the rest; vaikunthanathera shakti — the power of the Lord of Vaikuntha; bhakti-hina — devoid of bhakti; apane svatantra — independent in themselves; lakhimi-sampadamaya — full of Lakshmi's riches; dina-bhava nahi raya — keep no humility; bhakati kevala paratantra — bhakti alone depends on Another

**499.** The four liberations, salokya and the rest, are the power of the Lord of Vaikuntha;
devoid of bhakti, they are independent in themselves;
full of the riches of Lakshmi, they keep no humility —
bhakti alone depends on Another.

শর্করা সে আপনে, নিজ স্বাদ নাহি জানে,
পর জন করে উপভোগ ।
এছন মুকতি-পদ, ভক্তিপথে দেই বাধ,
সব-পর প্রেমভক্তিযোগ ॥ ৫০০ ॥

*śarkarā se āpane, nija sbāda nāhi jāne,*
*para jana kare upabhoga |*
*echana mukati-pada, bhaktipathe dei bādha,*
*saba-para premabhaktiyoga || 500 ||*

*Word for word:* sharkara se apane — sugar itself; nija svada nahi jane — does not know its own taste; para jana kare upabhoga — another enjoys it; aichhana mukati-pada — such is the station of liberation; bhakti-pathe dei badha — it bars the path of bhakti; saba-para prema-bhakti-yoga — above all is the yoga of prema-bhakti

**500.** Sugar itself does not know its own sweetness —
another enjoys it;
such is the station of liberation: it bars the path of bhakti —
above all is the yoga of prema-bhakti.

বিধাতার অগোচর, সে পুরী আমার ঘর,
দয়ার কারণে আইলু এথা ।
শ্রীচৈতন্য সর্বেশ্বর, গৌর দীর্ঘ কলেবর,
দেখিয়া ঘুচাহ মনোব্যথা ॥ ৫০১ ॥

*bidhātāra agocara, se purī āmāra ghara,*
*daẏāra kāraṇe āilu ethā |*
*śrīcaitanya sarbeśbara, gaura dīrgha kalebara,*
*dekhiẏā ghucāha manobyathā || 501 ||*

*Word for word:* vidhatara agochara — beyond the reach of the Creator; se puri amara ghara — that abode is My home; dayara karane ailu etha — out of mercy I came here; shri-chaitanya sarveshvara — Sri Chaitanya, Lord of all; gaura dirgha kalevara — golden, tall of body; dekhiya ghuchaha manovyatha — seeing Him, dispel the pain of your heart

**501.** That abode, beyond the reach of the Creator, is My home;
out of mercy I have come here.
Behold Sri Chaitanya, the Lord of all, golden and tall of stature,
and the pain of your heart will go.

যে রূপে দেখিবে তথা, সে রূপে আসিব হেথা,
গুণকীর্তন করিব প্রচার ।
ঘুচাব সকল দুঃখ, প্রচারিব প্রেমসুখ,
কলিলোক করিব নিস্তার ॥ ৫০২ ॥

*ye rūpe dekhibe tathā, se rūpe āsiba hethā,*
*guṇakīrtana kariba pracāra |*
*ghucāba sakala duḥkha, pracāriba premasukha,*
*kaliloka kariba nistāra || 502 ||*

*Word for word:* ye rupe dekhibe tatha — in whatever form you see there; se rupe asiba hetha — in that form I shall come here; guna-kirtana kariba prachara — I shall spread the kirtana of virtues; ghuchaba sakala duhkha — I shall remove all suffering; prachariba prema-sukha — I shall spread the joy of prema; kali-loka kariba nistara — I shall deliver the people of Kali

**502.** In whatever form you see Me there, in that form I shall come here;
I shall spread the kirtana of [My] virtues,
remove all suffering, spread the joy of prema
and deliver the people of Kali."

চলিলা নারদমুনি, শুনি অপরূপ বাণী,
বেদ-অগোচর এই কথা ।
বৈকুণ্ঠ-উপর আর, গোলোক দেখিব যার,
সকল ভুবনে গুণগাথা ॥ ৫০৩ ॥

*calilā nāradamuni, śuni aparūpa bāṇī,*
*beda-agocara ei kathā |*
*baikuṇṭha-upara āra, goloka dekhiba yāra,*
*sakala bhubane guṇagāthā || 503 ||*

*Word for word:* chalila naradamuni — Narada Muni set out; shuni aparupa vani — hearing wondrous words; veda-agochara ei katha — this speech is beyond the Vedas; vaikuntha-upara ara — above Vaikuntha, further; goloka dekhiba — I shall see Goloka; yara sakala bhuvane guna-gatha — whose glory is sung in all worlds

**503.** Narada Muni set out, having heard these wondrous words:
"This speech is beyond the reach of the Vedas:
above Vaikuntha, further still, I shall see Goloka,
whose glory is sung in all the worlds.

মুক্তি পরমুক্তি আর, ভাগবত-বিচার,
শুনিল নিগূঢ় যত কথা ।
লোক-বেদ-অবিদিত, অবিদিত অবেকত,
বেকত দেখিব আজি তথা ॥ ৫০৪ ॥

*mukti paramukti āra, bhāgabata-bicāra,*
*śunila nigūṛha yata kathā |*
*loka-beda-abidita, abidita abekata,*
*bekata dekhiba āji tathā || 504 ||*

*Word for word:* mukti paramukti ara — of liberation and supreme liberation; bhagavata-vichara — the reasoning of the Bhagavata; shunila nigudha yata katha — I have heard all secret words; loka-veda-avidita — unknown to the world and Vedas; avidita abekata — unknown, unmanifest; bekata dekhiba aji tatha — today I shall see it manifest there

**504.** Of liberation and supreme liberation, of the reasoning of the *Bhagavata*
I have heard all the secret words;
what is unknown to the world and the Vedas, unknown, unmanifest —
today I shall see it manifest there."

অনুরাগে ধায় মুনি, বীণার শবদ শুনি,
বৈকুণ্ঠের প্রজা হরষিত ।
বৈকুণ্ঠের দ্বারে গিয়া, আনন্দে বিহ্বল হঞা,
সুমঙ্গল গায় গুণগীত ॥ ৫০৫ ॥

*anurāge dhāẏa muni, bīṇāra śabada śuni,*
*baikuṇṭhera prajā haraṣita |*
*baikuṇṭhera dbāre giẏā, ānande bihbala hañā,*
*sumaṅgala gāẏa guṇagīta || 505 ||*

*Word for word:* anurage dhaya muni — in love the sage runs; vinara shabada shuni — the sound of the vina is heard; vaikunthera praja harashita — the people of Vaikuntha rejoiced; vaikunthera dvare giya — reaching the gate of Vaikuntha; anande vihvala hana — overwhelmed with bliss; sumangala gaya guna-gita — sings an auspicious song of virtues

**505.** In love the sage runs; the sound of his vina is heard —
the people of Vaikuntha rejoiced;
reaching the gate of Vaikuntha, overwhelmed with bliss,
he sings an auspicious song of [His] virtues.

দেখিল বৈকুণ্ঠনাথ, সব পারিষদ-সাথ,
বসিয়াছে রত্নসিংহাসনে ।
পড়িয়া চরণতলে, মুনি পরণাম করে,
তুলি পহুঁ কৈল আলিঙ্গনে ॥ ৫০৬ ॥

*dekhila baikuṇṭhanātha, saba pāriṣada-sātha,*
*basiẏāche ratnasiṃhāsane |*
*paṛiẏā caraṇatale, muni paraṇāma kare,*
*tuli pahuṁ kaila āliṅgane || 506 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhila vaikunthanatha — he saw the Lord of Vaikuntha; saba parishada-satha — with all associates; basiyachhe ratna-simhasane — seated on a jewelled throne; padiya charanatale — falling at the feet; muni paranama kare — the sage bows; tuli panhu kaila alingane — the Lord, raising him, embraced him

**506.** He saw the Lord of Vaikuntha with all His associates,
seated on a jewelled throne;
falling at His feet, the sage bows down,
and the Lord, raising him, embraced him.

হাসি হাসি কহে পহুঁ, কি তোর অন্তরে রহুঁ,
কহ মুনি হৃদয় সত্বরে ।
উৎকণ্ঠ হৃদয়ে মোর, পালিব বচন তোর,
অগোচর করিব গোচরে ॥ ৫০৭ ॥

*hāsi hāsi kahe pahuṁ, ki tora antare rahuṁ,*
*kaha muni hṛdaẏa satbare |*
*utkaṇṭha hṛdaẏe mora, pāliba bacana tora,*
*agocara kariba gocare || 507 ||*

*Word for word:* hasi hasi kahe panhu — smiling, the Lord says; ki tora antare rahu — what is in your heart; kaha muni hridaya satvare — tell quickly, sage, your mind; utkantha hridaye mora — My heart is eager; paliba vachana tora — I shall fulfil your word; agochara kariba gochare — I shall make the unseen seen

**507.** Smiling, the Lord says: "What is in your heart?
Tell Me quickly, sage, what is in your mind.
My heart is eager: I shall fulfil your word,
I shall make the unseen seen."

করযোড়ে বোলে মুনি, তুমি সর্ব-অন্তর্যামী,
তোরে মুঞি কি বলিব আর ।
দারুব্রহ্মরূপে মোরে, যে কহিলে অন্তরে,
সেই রূপ দেখিব তোমার ॥ ৫০৮ ॥

*karayoṛe bole muni, tumi sarba-antaryāmī,*
*tore muñi ki baliba āra |*
*dārubrahmarūpe more, ye kahile antare,*
*sei rūpa dekhiba tomāra || 508 ||*

*Word for word:* karajode bole muni — with joined palms the sage says; tumi sarva-antaryami — You are the Indweller of all; tore munji ki baliba ara — what more shall I tell You; daru-brahma-rupe more — in the form of the Daru-brahman, to me; ye kahile antare — of which You spoke within; sei rupa dekhiba tomara — that form of Yours I shall see

**508.** With joined palms the sage says: "You are the Indweller of all,
what more shall I tell You?
That form of Yours of which You told me within, in the form of the Daru-brahman —
that is what I [wish] to see."

পুনঃ কহে গুণমণি, নিভৃতে কহিয়ে আমি,
সেই রূপ সহজ-স্বরূপে ।
তার মায়া ছায়া যত, অবতার শত শত,
আরাধয়ে পরম উদ্যোগে ॥ ৫০৯ ॥

*punaḥ kahe guṇamaṇi, nibhṛte kahiẏe āmi,*
*sei rūpa sahaja-sbarūpe |*
*tāra māẏā chāẏā yata, abatāra śata śata,*
*ārādhaẏe parama udyoge || 509 ||*

*Word for word:* punah kahe gunamani — again the Jewel of virtues says; nibhrite kahiye ami — I tell you in private; sei rupa sahaja-svarupe — that form is the innate, original form; tara maya chhaya yata — His maya, all His reflections; avatara shata shata — hundreds of avataras; aradhaye parama udyoge — worship with the greatest zeal

**509.** Again the Jewel of virtues says: "I tell you in private:
that form is [My] original, innate form;
His maya,[^07-13] His reflections — hundreds of avataras —
worship Him with the greatest zeal.

যার কায়ব্যূহ আমি, ব্যাপিত সকল ভূমি,
সর্বময় বিষ্ণু সর্বসর্ব ।
লক্ষ্মী মোর অনুচরী, আর যেই মুক্তি চারি,
তাহা আর কহিয়ে সন্দর্ভ ॥ ৫১০ ॥

*yāra kāẏabyūha āmi, byāpita sakala bhūmi,*
*sarbamaẏa biṣṇu sarbasarba |*
*lakṣmī mora anucarī, āra yei mukti cāri,*
*tāhā āra kahiẏe sandarbha || 510 ||*

*Word for word:* yara kaya-vyuha ami — I am His bodily expansion; vyapita sakala bhumi — pervading all lands; sarvamaya vishnu sarva-sarva — the all-pervading Vishnu, all in all; lakshmi mora anuchari — Lakshmi is My attendant; ara yei mukti chari — and the four liberations; taha ara kahiye sandarbha — that connection too I tell

**510.** I am His bodily expansion, pervading all lands,
the all-pervading Vishnu, all in all;
Lakshmi is My attendant, and the four liberations too —
this connection also I tell you.

যার অংশ বিষ্ণু আমি, সম্পদ হয় লখিমিনী,
বৈকুণ্ঠের অংশ এ বৈকুণ্ঠ ।
মুক্তি-ছায়া চারি মুক্তি, সবে আবরিয়া ভক্তি,
সেবে নাথ সে পহুঁ বৈকুণ্ঠ ॥ ৫১১ ॥

*yāra aṃśa biṣṇu āmi, sampada haẏa lakhiminī,*
*baikuṇṭhera aṃśa e baikuṇṭha |*
*mukti-chāẏā cāri mukti, sabe ābariẏā bhakti,*
*sebe nātha se pahuṁ baikuṇṭha || 511 ||*

*Word for word:* yara amsha vishnu ami — I, Vishnu, am His portion; sampada haya lakhimini — Lakshmi is [His] wealth; vaikunthera amsha e vaikuntha — this Vaikuntha is a portion of [His] Vaikuntha; mukti-chhaya chari mukti — the four liberations are a shadow of freedom; sabe avariya bhakti — all, clothed in bhakti; seve natha — serve the Master; se panhu vaikuntha — that Lord of Vaikuntha

**511.** I, Vishnu, am His portion; Lakshmi is [His] wealth;
this Vaikuntha is a portion of [His] Vaikuntha;
the four liberations are a shadow of [true] freedom; all, clothed in bhakti,
serve that Master — that Lord of Vaikuntha.[^07-14]

রাধা মাত্র প্রকৃতি, প্রেমময় আকৃতি,
যার বশ পুরুষ প্রধান ।
বৈকুণ্ঠের এক ধাম, মহাবৈকুণ্ঠ যার নাম,
তিন গুণ শকতি সন্ধান ॥ ৫১২ ॥

*rādhā mātra prakṛti, premamaẏa ākṛti,*
*yāra baśa puruṣa pradhāna |*
*baikuṇṭhera eka dhāma, mahābaikuṇṭha yāra nāma,*
*tina guṇa śakati sandhāna || 512 ||*

*Word for word:* radha matra prakriti — Radha alone is prakriti; premamaya akriti — Her form is prema; yara vasha purusha pradhana — to Her the supreme Purusha is subject; vaikunthera eka dhama — in Vaikuntha one abode; maha-vaikuntha yara nama — named Maha-Vaikuntha; tina guna shakati sandhana — the union of the three qualities of shakti (sense obscure)

**512.** Radha alone is the prakriti, Her form is prema itself;
to Her the supreme Purusha is subject;
in Vaikuntha there is one abode named Maha-Vaikuntha —
there is the union of the three qualities of shakti.[^07-15]

নিশ্চয় বচন মোরি, অমায়া সে গৌরহরি,
প্রকট করুণা-কল্পতরু ।
চল মুনি চলি যাই, সেই মহাপ্রভু ঠাঁই,
সকল ভুবনে শিক্ষাগুরু ॥ ৫১৩ ॥

*niścaẏa bacana mori, amāẏā se gaurahari,*
*prakaṭa karuṇā-kalpataru |*
*cala muni cali yāi, sei mahāprabhu ṭhāṁi,*
*sakala bhubane śikṣāguru || 513 ||*

*Word for word:* nishchaya vachana mori — firm is My word; amaya — without guile; se gaurahari — that Gaurahari; prakata karuna-kalpataru — the manifest wish-tree of mercy; chala muni chali yai — go, sage, go; sei mahaprabhu thani — to that Mahaprabhu; sakala bhuvane shiksha-guru — teacher of all the worlds

**513.** Firm is My word, without guile: Gaurahari
is the manifest wish-fulfilling tree of mercy.
Go, sage, go to that Mahaprabhu,
the teacher of all the worlds."

চলিলা মুনীন্দ্ররায়, বীণা হরিগুণ গায়,
আনন্দে অবশ অঙ্গ কাঁপে ।
পুলকিত সব গা, আপাদ-মস্তক যা,
প্রেমবারি দুনয়নে ঝাঁপে ॥ ৫১৪ ॥

*calilā munīndrarāẏa, bīṇā hariguṇa gāẏa,*
*ānande abaśa aṅga kāṁpe |*
*pulakita saba gā, āpāda-mastaka yā,*
*premabāri dunaẏane jhāṁpe || 514 ||*

*Word for word:* chalila munindraraya — the king of sages set out; vina hari-guna gaya — the vina sings Hari's virtues; anande avasha anga kanpe — the body, helpless with bliss, trembles; pulakita saba ga — the whole body thrills; apada-mastaka ya — from foot to head; prema-vari dunayane jhanpe — tears of prema flood both eyes

**514.** The king of sages set out, his vina singing Hari's virtues,
his body, helpless with bliss, trembling;
his whole frame thrilled, from foot to head,
tears of prema flooding both his eyes.

প্রেমমদে মাতোয়ার, ক্ষণে হয় চমৎকার,
ক্ষণে ডাকে গৌরাঙ্গ বলিয়া ।
ক্ষণে আধ-পদ যায়, ক্ষণে ফিরি ফিরি চায়,
ক্ষণে কান্দে ক্ষণে চলে ধাঞা ॥ ৫১৫ ॥

*premamade mātoẏāra, kṣaṇe haẏa camatkāra,*
*kṣaṇe ḍāke gaurāṅga baliẏā |*
*kṣaṇe ādha-pada yāẏa, kṣaṇe phiri phiri cāẏa,*
*kṣaṇe kānde kṣaṇe cale dhāñā || 515 ||*

*Word for word:* prema-made matoyara — drunk with the wine of prema; kshane haya chamatkara — now he is amazed; kshane dake gauranga baliya — now calls out "Gauranga!"; kshane adha-pada yaya — now goes half a step; kshane phiri phiri chaya — now looks back again and again; kshane kande kshane chale dhana — now weeps, now runs on

**515.** Drunk with the wine of prema, now he is amazed,
now he calls out "Gauranga!",
now he goes half a step, now looks back again and again,
now he weeps, now he runs on.

আচম্বিতে বায়ু বহে, জুড়ায় সকল দেহে,
কোটি চাঁদ জিনি যেন জ্যোতিঃ ।
শ্রীপাদপদ্ম-গন্ধে, আউলায় শরীরবন্ধে,
যে দেখিয়ে তঁহি কাম-কীর্তি ॥ ৫১৬ ॥

*ācambite bāẏu bahe, juṛāẏa sakala dehe,*
*koṭi cāṁda jini yena jyotiḥ |*
*śrīpādapadma-gandhe, āulāẏa śarīrabandhe,*
*ye dekhiẏe taṁhi kāma-kīrti || 516 ||*

*Word for word:* achambite vayu vahe — suddenly a breeze blows; judaya sakala dehe — cooling the whole body; koti chanda jini yena jyotih — a radiance as if surpassing millions of moons; shri-pada-padma-gandhe — with the fragrance of the lotus feet; aulaya sharira-bandhe — the body's bonds grow loose; ye dekhiye tanhi — whatever one sees there; kama-kirti — the glory of Kama

**516.** Suddenly a breeze blew, cooling the whole body;
a radiance as if surpassing millions of moons;
with the fragrance of the lotus feet the body's bonds grow loose;
whatever one sees there is the glory of Kama.[^07-16]

অনেক মদনরায়, অনুগত কাজে ধায়,
প্রেম বিনু না দেখিয়ে লোক ।
না দিবা-রজনী জানি, না দেখিয়ে ভিনাভিনি,
সর্বজন হরিষ অশোক ॥ ৫১৭ ॥

*aneka madanarāẏa, anugata kāje dhāẏa,*
*prema binu nā dekhiẏe loka |*
*nā dibā-rajanī jāni, nā dekhiẏe bhinābhini,*
*sarbajana hariṣa aśoka || 517 ||*

*Word for word:* aneka madana-raya — many Madanas; anugata kaje dhaya — run obediently to serve; prema vinu na dekhiye loka — no one is seen without prema; na diva-rajani jani — no knowing of day or night; na dekhiye bhinabhini — no seeing of "mine" and "another's"; sarvajana harisha ashoka — all joyful, without sorrow

**517.** Many Madanas run obediently to serve;
one sees no one there without prema;
there is no knowing of day or night, no seeing of "mine" and "another's";
all are joyful, without sorrow.

গমন নটনলীলা, বচন সঙ্গীতকলা,
নয়ান-চাহনি আকর্ষণ ।
রঙ্গ বিনু নাহি ভঙ্গ, ভাব বিনু নাহি সঙ্গ,
রসময় দেহের গঠন ॥ ৫১৮ ॥

*gamana naṭanalīlā, bacana saṅgītakalā,*
*naẏāna-cāhani ākarṣaṇa |*
*raṅga binu nāhi bhaṅga, bhāba binu nāhi saṅga,*
*rasamaẏa dehera gaṭhana || 518 ||*

*Word for word:* gamana natana-lila — walking is the play of dance; vachana sangita-kala — speech is the art of music; nayana-chahani akarshana — a glance of the eyes is attraction; ranga vinu nahi bhanga — no movement without play; bhava vinu nahi sanga — no companionship without bhava; rasamaya dehera gathana — bodies formed of rasa

**518.** Walking is the play of dance, speech the art of music,
a glance of the eyes is attraction;
there is no movement without play, no companionship without bhava;
the bodies there are formed of rasa.

তনু চিদানন্দময়, ভূমি চিন্তামণি হয়,
কল্পতরু সর্বতরু তথা ।
সুরভি যতেক সব, কামধেনু যেন নব,
উদ্ধবাদির আশ গুল্মলতা ॥ ৫১৯ ॥

*tanu cidānandamaẏa, bhūmi cintāmaṇi haẏa,*
*kalpataru sarbataru tathā |*
*surabhi yateka saba, kāmadhenu yena naba,*
*uddhabādira āśa gulmalatā || 519 ||*

*Word for word:* tanu chidanandamaya — bodies of consciousness and bliss; bhumi chintamani haya — the ground is chintamani; kalpataru sarvataru tatha — all trees there are wish-fulfilling trees; surabhi yateka saba — all the cows; kamadhenu yena nava — like new kamadhenus; uddhavadira asha gulma-lata — the bushes and creepers are the longing of Uddhava and others

**519.** Bodies are of consciousness and bliss, the ground is chintamani,
all the trees there are wish-fulfilling trees,
all the cows are like new kamadhenus,
the bushes and creepers are what Uddhava and others long for.

সব তরু কল্পদ্রুম, তঁহি এক নিরুপম,
রত্নবেদী তার দুই পাশে ।
স্বর্ণ-সিংহাসন তায়, বসিয়া গৌরাঙ্গরায়,
সরস মধুর লহু হাসে ॥ ৫২০ ॥

*saba taru kalpadruma, taṁhi eka nirupama,*
*ratnabedī tāra dui pāśe |*
*sbarṇa-siṃhāsana tāẏa, basiẏā gaurāṅgarāẏa,*
*sarasa madhura lahu hāse || 520 ||*

*Word for word:* saba taru kalpadruma — all trees are wish-trees; tanhi eka nirupama — among them one beyond compare; ratna-vedi tara dui pashe — jewelled altars on both its sides; svarna-simhasana taya — on it a golden throne; basiya gaurangaraya — seated, Lord Gauranga; sarasa madhura lahu hase — sweetly, tenderly, softly smiles

**520.** All the trees are wish-fulfilling trees; among them is one beyond compare,
with jewelled altars on both sides;
on it a golden throne, where Lord Gauranga sits
and sweetly, tenderly, softly smiles.

সশাখ মঙ্গলঘটে, সিংহাসন-সুনিকটে,
বামপদাঙ্গুষ্ঠ পরশিয়া ।
রতনপ্রদীপ জ্বলে, যেন দিবাকর-করে,
আলোকিত জগত ভরিয়া ॥ ৫২১ ॥

*saśākha maṅgalaghaṭe, siṃhāsana-sunikaṭe,*
*bāmapadāṅguṣṭha paraśiẏā |*
*ratanapradīpa jbale, yena dibākara-kare,*
*ālokita jagata bhariẏā || 521 ||*

*Word for word:* sashakha mangala-ghate — an auspicious pot with twigs; simhasana-sunikate — right by the throne; vama-padangushtha parashiya — touching the great toe of the left foot; ratana-pradipa jvale — jewelled lamps burn; yena divakara-kare — as if with the sun's rays; alokita jagata bhariya — illuminating and filling the world

**521.** An auspicious pot with [mango] twigs right by the throne
touches the great toe of His left foot;
jewelled lamps burn, as if with the rays of the sun,
illuminating and filling the world.

রাধিকা দক্ষিণপাশে, অনুচরী করি কাছে,
রত্ন-কলস করি করে ।
বামপাশে রুক্মিণী, কাছে করি সঙ্গিনী,
স্বর্ণঘটে রত্নজল ভরে ॥ ৫২২ ॥

*rādhikā dakṣiṇapāśe, anucarī kari kāche,*
*ratna-kalasa kari kare |*
*bāmapāśe rukmiṇī, kāche kari saṅginī,*
*sbarṇaghaṭe ratnajala bhare || 522 ||*

*Word for word:* radhika dakshina-pashe — Radhika on the right; anuchari kari kachhe — keeping maidservants near; ratna-kalasa kari kare — a jewelled pitcher in hand; vama-pashe rukmini — Rukmini on the left; kachhe kari sangini — keeping companions near; svarna-ghate ratna-jala bhare — fills a golden pot with jewel-bright water

**522.** Radhika on the right, keeping Her maidservants near,
a jewelled pitcher in Her hand;
on the left Rukmini, keeping her companions near,
fills a golden pot with water bright as jewels.[^07-17]

নগ্নজিতা জল ভরে, দেই মিত্রবৃন্দা-করে,
মিত্রবৃন্দা সুলক্ষণা-করে ।
সে দেই রুক্মিণী-হাথে, দেবী ঢালে প্রভু-মাথে,
অভিষেক সুরনদী-জলে ॥ ৫২৩ ॥

*nagnajitā jala bhare, dei mitrabṛndā-kare,*
*mitrabṛndā sulakṣaṇā-kare |*
*se dei rukmiṇī-hāthe, debī ḍhāle prabhu-māthe,*
*abhiṣeka suranadī-jale || 523 ||*

*Word for word:* nagnajita jala bhare — Nagnajiti draws water; dei mitravrinda-kare — gives into Mitravinda's hands; mitravrinda sulakshana-kare — Mitravinda into Sulakshana's hands; se dei rukmini-hathe — she gives into Rukmini's hands; devi dhale prabhu-mathe — the goddess pours on the Lord's head; abhisheka suranadi-jale — a bathing with the water of the heavenly river

**523.** Nagnajiti draws water and gives it into Mitravinda's hands,
Mitravinda into Sulakshana's hands,
she gives it into Rukmini's hands, and the goddess pours it on the Lord's head —
a bathing with the water of the heavenly river.

তিলোত্তমা জল ভরে, দেই মধুপ্রিয়া-করে,
মধুপ্রিয়া চন্দ্রমুখী-করে ।
সে দেই রাধিকা-হাথে, রাই ঢালে প্রভু-মাথে,
অভিষেক করে গঙ্গাজলে ॥ ৫২৪ ॥

*tilottamā jala bhare, dei madhupriẏā-kare,*
*madhupriẏā candramukhī-kare |*
*se dei rādhikā-hāthe, rāi ḍhāle prabhu-māthe,*
*abhiṣeka kare gaṅgājale || 524 ||*

*Word for word:* tilottama jala bhare — Tilottama draws water; dei madhupriya-kare — gives into Madhupriya's hands; madhupriya chandramukhi-kare — Madhupriya into Chandramukhi's hands; se dei radhika-hathe — she gives into Radhika's hands; rai dhale prabhu-mathe — Rai pours on the Lord's head; abhisheka kare ganga-jale — performs the bathing with Ganga water

**524.** Tilottama draws water and gives it into Madhupriya's hands,
Madhupriya into Chandramukhi's hands,
she gives it into Radhika's hands, and Rai pours it on the Lord's head —
a bathing with the water of the Ganga.

সত্যভামা অন্তরে, দিব্য গন্ধ করি করে,
দিব্য মাল্য বস্ত্র অলঙ্কার ।
লক্ষণা সুভদ্রা ভদ্রা, সত্যভামা-পরতন্ত্রা,
অনুক্রমে করে দেই তার ॥ ৫২৫ ॥

*satyabhāmā antare, dibya gandha kari kare,*
*dibya mālya bastra alaṅkāra |*
*lakṣaṇā subhadrā bhadrā, satyabhāmā-paratantrā,*
*anukrame kare dei tāra || 525 ||*

*Word for word:* satyabhama antare — Satyabhama near; divya gandha kari kare — holding divine scents in her hands; divya malya vastra alankara — divine garlands, garments, ornaments; lakshana subhadra bhadra — Lakshmana, Subhadra, Bhadra; satyabhama-paratantra — obedient to Satyabhama; anukrame kare dei tara — in turn give into her hands

**525.** Satyabhama is near, holding divine scents in her hands,
divine garlands, garments and ornaments;
Lakshmana, Subhadra and Bhadra, obedient to Satyabhama,
in turn hand [everything] to her.

আর দিব্য নারী যত, চারি-পাশে শত শত,
দিব্য ভূষা দিব্য উপহার ।
রতনস্তবক করে, রহে প্রভু বরাবরে,
জয় জয় মঙ্গল-উচ্চার ॥ ৫২৬ ॥

*āra dibya nārī yata, cāri-pāśe śata śata,*
*dibya bhūṣā dibya upahāra |*
*ratanastabaka kare, rahe prabhu barābare,*
*jaẏa jaẏa maṅgala-uccāra || 526 ||*

*Word for word:* ara divya nari yata — and all the other divine women; chari-pashe shata shata — by hundreds on every side; divya bhusha divya upahara — divine ornaments, divine gifts; ratana-stavaka kare — jewelled bouquets in hand; rahe prabhu barabare — stand before the Lord; jaya jaya mangala-uchchara — crying the auspicious "jaya, jaya"

**526.** And all the other divine women, by hundreds on every side,
with divine ornaments and divine gifts,
holding jewelled bouquets, stand before the Lord,
crying the auspicious "Jaya, jaya!"

গোলোকনাথের স্নান, ইহা বহি নাহি আন,
আগমে কহিল মহাধ্যান ।
হেমগৌর কলেবর, মন্ত্র চারি অক্ষর,
সহজ বৈকুণ্ঠনাথ শ্যাম ॥ ৫২৭ ॥

*golokanāthera snāna, ihā bahi nāhi āna,*
*āgame kahila mahādhyāna |*
*hemagaura kalebara, mantra cāri akṣara,*
*sahaja baikuṇṭhanātha śyāma || 527 ||*

*Word for word:* golokanathera snana — the bathing of the Lord of Goloka; iha bahi nahi ana — there is no other than this; agame kahila maha-dhyana — the Agamas told the great meditation; hema-gaura kalevara — a body golden-fair; mantra chari akshara — a mantra of four syllables; sahaja vaikunthanatha shyama — the Lord of Vaikuntha is by nature dark

**527.** Such is the bathing of the Lord of Goloka — there is no other;
the Agamas have told the great meditation [on Him]:
a body golden-fair, a mantra of four syllables;[^07-18]
the Lord of Vaikuntha is by nature dark.

শ্যাম-দেহে চারি হাথ, ধরয়ে বৈকুণ্ঠনাথ,
চারি হস্তে চারি অস্ত্র তার ।
হেম-কিরণিয়া পহুঁ, হেম-অঙ্গে হাসে লহুঁ,
দ্বিভুজ শরীর শুন সার ॥ ৫২৮ ॥

*śyāma-dehe cāri hātha, dharaẏe baikuṇṭhanātha,*
*cāri haste cāri astra tāra |*
*hema-kiraṇiẏā pahuṁ, hema-aṅge hāse lahuṁ,*
*dbibhuja śarīra śuna sāra || 528 ||*

*Word for word:* shyama-dehe chari hatha — a dark body with four arms; dharaye vaikunthanatha — has the Lord of Vaikuntha; chari haste chari astra tara — in four hands His four weapons; hema-kiraniya panhu — the Lord radiant with gold; hema-ange hase lahu — golden-limbed, softly smiles; dvibhuja sharira — a two-armed body; shuna sara — hear the essence

**528.** A dark body with four arms has the Lord of Vaikuntha,
in His four hands four weapons;
but the Lord radiant with gold, golden-limbed, softly smiles —
hear the essence: His body is two-armed.

এছন সময়ে মুনি, দেখি গোরা গুণমণি,
বিভোর পড়িল পদতলে ।
আঁখি মিলিবারে নারে, পুনঃ চাহে দেখিবারে,
সিনাইল নয়নের জলে ॥ ৫২৯ ॥

*echana samaẏe muni, dekhi gorā guṇamaṇi,*
*bibhora paṛila padatale |*
*āṁkhi milibāre nāre, punaḥ cāhe dekhibāre,*
*sināila naẏanera jale || 529 ||*

*Word for word:* aichhana samaye muni — at that moment the sage; dekhi gora gunamani — seeing Gora, the Jewel of virtues; vibhora padila padatale — fell enraptured at the feet; ankhi milibare nare — cannot open his eyes; punah chahe dekhibare — again longs to look; sinaila nayanera jale — bathed [Him] with the tears of his eyes

**529.** At that moment the sage, seeing Gora, the Jewel of virtues,
fell enraptured at His feet;
he cannot open his eyes — and again he longs to look;
he bathed [Him] with the tears of his eyes.

স্নান সমাপিয়া পহুঁ, হাসি কহে লহু লহু,
নারদ তুলিয়া লৈল কোলে ।
ঘুচিল সংশয় চিন্তা, খণ্ডিল মনের ব্যথা,
প্রভু প্রিয় লহু লহু বোলে ॥ ৫৩০ ॥

*snāna samāpiẏā pahuṁ, hāsi kahe lahu lahu,*
*nārada tuliẏā laila kole |*
*ghucila saṃśaẏa cintā, khaṇḍila manera byathā,*
*prabhu priẏa lahu lahu bole || 530 ||*

*Word for word:* snana samapiya panhu — the Lord, having finished His bath; hasi kahe lahu lahu — smiling, speaking very softly; narada tuliya laila kole — lifted Narada and took him on His lap; ghuchila samshaya chinta — doubts and anxieties went; khandila manera vyatha — the pain of the heart was broken; prabhu priya lahu lahu bole — the Lord very softly speaks loving words

**530.** Having finished His bath, the Lord, smiling, speaking very softly,
lifted Narada up and took him on His lap;
doubt and anxiety went, the pain of his heart was broken;
the Lord speaks loving words very softly.

[^07-1]: That is, worldly people, judging by appearances, see in the gopis' love for Krishna only a breach of marital fidelity. The Gaudiya Vaishnavas, following the *Bhagavata* (10.33.26–39) and the *Chaitanya-charitamrita* (Adi 4), teach that the gopis' *parakiya-rasa* is the purest prema, wholly unlike worldly passion; Lochana Dasa himself says that by this prema the Lord is conquered.
[^07-2]: The words of Uddhava. In the edition the verse is followed by Bhaktisiddhanta's anvaya and translation: "Oh! The gopis in Vrindavana, abandoning kinsmen hard to abandon — husbands, fathers-in-law and others — and the path of dharma, served the lotus feet of Mukunda, which the Vedas seek. Shall I obtain any birth at all in Vrindavana among the bushes, creepers and herbs that serve the dust of the gopis' feet?"
[^07-3]: An echo of the *Bhagavata* (10.47.59), where Uddhava says: "Where are these forest women, tainted by infidelity, and where is this love for Krishna, the Supreme Self!" — to show that such love is given irrespective of merit. The words "unchaste", "lustful" express the worldly view; in the Gaudiya understanding the *kama* of the gopis is pure prema, whose only desire is Krishna's joy (*Chaitanya-charitamrita*, Adi 4.164–171).
[^07-4]: The raga and disha are given after the 1983 edition; in A the line is illegible.
[^07-5]: A has the past tense ("has taken birth"); the 1983 edition the future ("will take birth"), as also in v. 474.
[^07-6]: The 1983 edition has four couplets here: people have abandoned charity, vows and austerity and toil only for the belly; brahmanas have abandoned the worship of Krishna, and kshatriyas, vaishyas and shudras the service of brahmanas; abandoning respect for father and mother, all honour their wives with body, speech and mind. A has a single couplet (from the first and last lines).
[^07-7]: *Daru-brahman*, "Brahman in wood": the Lord Himself, manifest in the wooden Deity of Jagannatha at Puri (Nilachala).
[^07-8]: See vv. 257–271: the Lord promised Katyayani (Parvati) to fulfil her vow concerning mahaprasada and to appear in Kali as Gaura; Narada then proclaimed this at His command.
[^07-9]: So Lochana Dasa: in Goloka, the highest abode above Vaikuntha, Gaurasundara Himself is king. In the Gaudiya Vaishnava understanding (Bhaktivinoda Thakura, Bhaktisiddhanta) Gaura's abode, Navadvipa-dhama, is non-different from Goloka-Vrindavana and is part of it; Gaura is Krishna Himself with the bhava and lustre of Radha.
[^07-10]: Lochana Dasa sets side by side Radha (source of the gopis) and Rukmini (source of the queens of Dvaraka). The Gaudiya Vaishnavas, following the *Chaitanya-charitamrita* (Adi 4.75–81), teach that Radha is the original *hladini-shakti* and the source of all the Lord's beloveds: the Lakshmis of Vaikuntha, the queens of Dvaraka and the gopis.
[^07-11]: The subject of the stanza is not named; probably the description of Satyabhama as the embodiment of music continues — or the deity of music is introduced as another dweller of Goloka.
[^07-12]: Perhaps "Ranga" ("Play") is the name of the city; it may also be understood as "the city full of rasa and play".
[^07-13]: *Maya* here is His energy, not an illusion that rules Him; the "reflections" (*chhaya*) are His expansions. The expression is Lochana Dasa's own; in Gaudiya theology all avataras are portions and parts (*amsha, kala*) of Krishna (*Bhag.* 1.3.28). In the 1983 edition the second half of the stanza reads: "…hundreds of avataras — He alone is the merciful King".
[^07-14]: This stanza (like the previous one) differs in the 1983 edition: "I, Vishnu, am His reflection (*chhaya*), Lakshmi the reflection of [His] wealth, this Vaikuntha the reflection of [His] Vaikuntha"; we follow A ("portion"). The thought agrees with Gaudiya teaching: Narayana of Vaikuntha is a *vilasa* expansion of Krishna, and Vaikuntha an expansion of Goloka (*Chaitanya-charitamrita*, Adi 5). Line 3 is obscure; the 1983 edition has "all, established in bhakti, serve…".
[^07-15]: Lines 3–4 are obscure; perhaps the "three qualities of shakti" are the Lord's three energies: *hladini*, *sandhini* and *samvit* (*Chaitanya-charitamrita*, Adi 4.62). In the 1983 edition line 3 differs: "prakriti on the right and left, named Lalita and Vishakha".
[^07-16]: Kama (Madana) is the god of love. Here not the worldly Cupid is meant: the spiritual beauty of Goloka is described, where, in the words of the Gaudiya scriptures, Krishna (and Gaura) is *aprakrita-Madana*, the transcendental Cupid who enchants Cupid himself.
[^07-17]: The bathing (*abhisheka*) of Gaura in Goloka. Among those taking part are queens of Dvaraka (Rukmini, Satyabhama, Nagnajiti, Mitravinda, Lakshmana-Sulakshana, Bhadra), Radhika and companions from Vraja (Chandramukhi, Madhupriya), and Tilottama; Lochana Dasa unites the consorts of Dvaraka and Vraja in one vision.
[^07-18]: Which four-syllable mantra is meant the author does not say.

---

# Sutra-khanda, part 8 (portion 08)

*Narada glorifies Gaura, who sends him to Balarama in Shvetadvipa; the Lord reveals to His associates why He will be born on earth; Narada with Balarama, who on hearing the command bids His own to take birth on earth; the descent of the associates — Advaita, Nityananda, Sita and many others; praise of Narahari Sarakara, Raghunandana and Mukunda Dasa; the author's humility; the end of the Sutra-khanda*

মুনি বোলে মহাপ্রভু, হেন অপরূপ কভু,
না দেখিল না শুনিল আমি ।
জনম সফল আজি, দেখিল অমিয়া-রাজি,
ধনি ধনি আপনাকে মানি ॥ ৫৩১ ॥

*muni bole mahāprabhu, hena aparūpa kabhu,*
*nā dekhila nā śunila āmi |*
*janama saphala āji, dekhila amiẏā-rāji,*
*dhani dhani āpanāke māni || 531 ||*

*Word for word:* muni bole mahaprabhu — the sage says: Mahaprabhu; hena aparupa kabhu — such a wonder ever; na dekhila na shunila ami — I have not seen nor heard; janama saphala aji — today my life bore fruit; dekhila amiya-raji — I have seen a treasury of nectar; dhani dhani apanake mani — I count myself blessed

**531.** The sage says: "Mahaprabhu, such a wonder I have never
seen nor heard of.
Today my life has borne fruit — I have seen a treasury of nectar,
and I count myself blessed, blessed.

ব্রহ্মাদি না জানে তত্ত্ব, অবতার অবিদিত,
অচিন্ত্য বলিয়া বলি তোমা ।
জ্যোতির্ময় বোলে কেহো, মুখে না নির্বচে সেহো,
কহিবারে নাহিক উপমা ॥ ৫৩২ ॥

*brahmādi nā jāne tattba, abatāra abidita,*
*acintya baliẏā bali tomā |*
*jyotirmaẏa bole keho, mukhe nā nirbace seho,*
*kahibāre nāhika upamā || 532 ||*

*Word for word:* brahmadi na jane tattva — Brahma and the rest do not know the truth; avatara avidita — the descent is unknown; achintya baliya bali toma — I call You inconceivable; jyotirmaya bole keho — some call [You] effulgence; mukhe na nirvache seho — even they cannot express in words; kahibare nahika upama — there is no comparison to tell

**532.** Brahma and the others do not know the truth; Your coming is unknown [to them];
I call You inconceivable.
Some call [You] effulgence — but even they cannot express [You] in words:
there is no comparison to tell it.

কেহ বলে পরাৎপর, প্রধান পুরুষবর,
বিচারে না করে নিরূপণ ।
সর্বময় তোর শক্তি, দেখিয়া না পায় মুক্তি,
অগোচর তোর আচরণ ॥ ৫৩৩ ॥

*keha bale parātpara, pradhāna puruṣabara,*
*bicāre nā kare nirūpaṇa |*
*sarbamaẏa tora śakti, dekhiẏā nā pāẏa mukti,*
*agocara tora ācaraṇa || 533 ||*

*Word for word:* keha bale paratpara — some say: higher than the highest; pradhana purusha-vara — the chief, best Purusha; vichare na kare nirupana — by reasoning do not determine; sarvamaya tora shakti — Your shakti is in all; dekhiya na paya mukti — seeing, they do not attain liberation; agochara tora acharana — Your deeds are beyond reach

**533.** Some say, 'Higher than the highest, the chief, the best Purusha' —
but by reasoning they cannot determine [You].
Seeing that Your shakti is in all, they do not attain liberation;
Your deeds are beyond reach.

সহস্রফণা অনন্ত, না পাঞা গুণের অন্ত,
দ্বিজিহ্বা ধরিল সব মুখে ।
না পাঞা গুণের ওর, এছন ঠাকুর গৌর,
কপালে দেখিলাম তোকে ॥ ৫৩৪ ॥

*sahasraphaṇā ananta, nā pāñā guṇera anta,*
*dbijihbā dharila saba mukhe |*
*nā pāñā guṇera ora, echana ṭhākura gaura,*
*kapāle dekhilāma toke || 534 ||*

*Word for word:* sahasra-phana ananta — thousand-hooded Ananta; na pana gunera anta — not finding the end of virtues; dvijihva dharila saba mukhe — took two tongues in every mouth; na pana gunera ora — not finding the limit of virtues; aichhana thakura gaura — such a Lord, Gaura; kapale dekhilama toke — by fortune I have seen You

**534.** Thousand-headed Ananta, finding no end to [Your] virtues,
has taken two tongues in every mouth;
finding no limit to Your virtues — such a Lord are You, Gaura —
by good fortune I have seen You!

যে পুনঃ আরতি করে, তুয়া-পদ অনুসারে,
নানাবুদ্ধি নহে একমত ।
কেহ বলে সর্বব্যাপী, সূক্ষ্মবাদী সাংখ্যযোগী,
স্থূলসেবা করয়ে ভকত ॥ ৫৩৫ ॥

*ye punaḥ ārati kare, tuẏā-pada anusāre,*
*nānābuddhi nahe ekamata |*
*keha bale sarbabyāpī, sūkṣmabādī sāṃkhyayogī,*
*sthūlasebā karaẏe bhakata || 535 ||*

*Word for word:* ye punah arati kare — those who long; tuya-pada anusare — following Your feet; nana-buddhi nahe ekamata — of various understanding, not of one mind; keha bale sarvavyapi — some say: all-pervading; sukshmavadi sankhya-yogi — Sankhya-yogis who speak of the subtle; sthula-seva karaye bhakata — devotees serve the visible form

**535.** And those who long [for You], following Your feet,
are of various understanding, not of one opinion:
some say, 'The All-pervading' — these are the Sankhya-yogis who speak of the subtle;
the devotees serve [Your] visible form.

কেহ বেদ-অনুসারে, নিত্য ধর্ম কর্ম করে,
বর্ণাশ্রম-ধর্ম-অনুগত ।
বেদান্ত-সিদ্ধান্ত যেই, সমাধান নাহি পাই,
না বুঝিয়া কহে নানা মত ॥ ৫৩৬ ॥

*keha beda-anusāre, nitya dharma karma kare,*
*barṇāśrama-dharma-anugata |*
*bedānta-siddhānta yei, samādhāna nāhi pāi,*
*nā bujhiẏā kahe nānā mata || 536 ||*

*Word for word:* keha veda-anusare — some, following the Vedas; nitya dharma karma kare — perform the eternal dharma and rites; varnashrama-dharma-anugata — adhering to the dharma of varna and ashrama; vedanta-siddhanta yei — the conclusion of Vedanta; samadhana nahi pai — I do not find; na bujhiya kahe nana mata — not understanding, they say many things

**536.** Others, following the Vedas, perform the eternal dharma and rites,
adhering to the dharma of varna and ashrama;
and the conclusion of Vedanta I do not find [with them]:
not understanding, they say many things.

অন্যোন্যে বিরোধ কেনে, ইহা নাহি অনুমানে,
কহে পুনঃ একই অদ্বৈত ।
না বুঝি তোমার মর্ম, পক্ষ ধরি করে কর্ম,
তোর কথা সর্ব-অবিদিত ॥ ৫৩৭ ॥

*anyonye birodha kene, ihā nāhi anumāne,*
*kahe punaḥ ekai adbaita |*
*nā bujhi tomāra marma, pakṣa dhari kare karma,*
*tora kathā sarba-abidita || 537 ||*

*Word for word:* anyonye virodha kene — why there is mutual contradiction; iha nahi anumane — they do not consider; kahe punah ekai advaita — again they say: one, non-dual; na bujhi tomara marma — not understanding Your heart; paksha dhari kare karma — holding to a side, perform rites; tora katha sarva-avidita — Your word is unknown to all

**537.** Why there is contradiction among them they do not consider,
and again they say, 'All is one, non-dual'.
Not understanding Your heart, each holding to his side, they perform their rites —
Your word is unknown to all.

এবে পদ-পরসাদে, নিরবধি প্রাণ কাঁদে,
ছাড়ি ইহা প্রাকৃত-মূরতি ।
পুনঃ জনমিয়ে আর, করি কৃষ্ণ-সংসার,
আচরিয়ে এই প্রেমভক্তি ॥ ৫৩৮ ॥

*ebe pada-parasāde, nirabadhi prāṇa kāṁde,*
*chāṛi ihā prākṛta-mūrati |*
*punaḥ janamiẏe āra, kari kṛṣṇa-saṃsāra,*
*ācariẏe ei premabhakti || 538 ||*

*Word for word:* ebe pada-parasade — now by the grace of the feet; niravadhi prana kande — the heart weeps unceasingly; chhadi iha prakrita-murati — leaving this perishable form; punah janamiye ara — may I be born again; kari krishna-samsara — making Krishna my world; achariye ei prema-bhakti — may I practise this prema-bhakti

**538.** Now by the grace of [Your] feet my heart weeps unceasingly:
leaving this perishable form,
may I be born again, make Krishna my whole world
and practise this prema-bhakti."[^08-1]

এছন নারদবাণী, শুনি কহে গুণমণি,
চল চল চল মুনিরাজ ।
কলিলোক নিস্তারিব, নিজভক্তি প্রচারিব,
জনমিব নদিয়া-সমাজ ॥ ৫৩৯ ॥

*echana nāradabāṇī, śuni kahe guṇamaṇi,*
*cala cala cala munirāja |*
*kaliloka nistāriba, nijabhakti pracāriba,*
*janamiba nadiẏā-samāja || 539 ||*

*Word for word:* aichhana narada-vani — such words of Narada; shuni kahe gunamani — hearing, the Jewel of virtues says; chala chala chala muniraja — go, go, go, king of sages; kali-loka nistariba — I shall deliver the people of Kali; nija-bhakti prachariba — I shall spread devotion to Myself; janamiba nadiya-samaja — I shall be born among the people of Nadiya

**539.** Hearing such words of Narada, the Jewel of virtues says:
"Go, go, go, king of sages!
I shall deliver the people of Kali, spread devotion to Myself,
I shall be born among the people of Nadia.

পৃথিবী চলহ তুমি, শ্বেতদ্বীপে আছি আমি,
বলরাম নাম সহোদর ।
অনন্ত যাহার অংশ, একাদশ রুদ্রবংশ,
সেবা করে মহেশ ঈশ্বর ॥ ৫৪০ ॥

*pṛthibī calaha tumi, śbetadbīpe āchi āmi,*
*balarāma nāma sahodara |*
*ananta yāhāra aṃśa, ekādaśa rudrabaṃśa,*
*sebā kare maheśa īśbara || 540 ||*

*Word for word:* prithivi chalaha tumi — go to the earth; shvetadvipe achhi ami — in Shvetadvipa I abide; balarama nama sahodara — a brother named Balarama; ananta yahara amsha — Ananta is His portion; ekadasha rudra-vamsha — the eleven Rudras His line; seva kare mahesha ishvara — Lord Mahesha serves

**540.** Go [down] to the earth: in Shvetadvipa I abide
[in the form of] a brother named Balarama;
Ananta is His portion, the eleven Rudras are His line,
Lord Mahesha serves Him.[^08-2]

রেবতী-রমণী-সঙ্গে, আছয়ে বিলাস-রঙ্গে,
ক্ষীরজলনিধি-মহী-মাঝে ।
যত অবতার হয়, সেই মাত্র সহায়,
আগে করি করি নিজ কাজে ॥ ৫৪১ ॥

*rebatī-ramaṇī-saṅge, āchaẏe bilāsa-raṅge,*
*kṣīrajalanidhi-mahī-mājhe |*
*yata abatāra haẏa, sei mātra sahāẏa,*
*āge kari kari nija kāje || 541 ||*

*Word for word:* revati-ramani-sange — with His beloved Revati; achhaye vilasa-range — abides in joyful play; kshira-jalanidhi-mahi-majhe — amid the land in the Ocean of Milk; yata avatara haya — whatever avataras there are; sei matra sahaya — He alone is the helper; age kari kari nija kaje — in My own work I place Him first

**541.** With His beloved Revati He dwells in joyful play
amid the land in the Ocean of Milk;
whatever avataras there are, He alone is their helper;
in every work of Mine I place Him first.

চল চল মুনিরাজ, গোচর করহ কাজ,
কহিও করিয়া পরবন্ধ ।
নিজ নিজ অংশ লঞা, পৃথিবীতে জনম গিয়া,
স্বনাম ধরহ নিত্যানন্দ ॥ ৫৪২ ॥

*cala cala munirāja, gocara karaha kāja,*
*kahio kariẏā parabandha |*
*nija nija aṃśa lañā, pṛthibīte janama giẏā,*
*sbanāma dharaha nityānanda || 542 ||*

*Word for word:* chala chala muniraja — go, go, king of sages; gochara karaha kaja — make the task known; kahio kariya parabandha — tell in due order; nija nija amsha lana — taking all Your portions; prithivite janama giya — going to take birth on earth; svanama dharaha nityananda — bear the name Nityananda

**542.** Go, go, king of sages, make this task known to Him,
tell Him all in due order:
'Taking all Your portions, go and take birth on earth,
and bear the name Nityananda.'"

আনন্দে নারদমুনি, শুনিঞা ঠাকুরবাণী,
হিয়াসুখে বোলে হরিবোল ।
কহয়ে লোচনদাস, এ দোঁহার সম্ভাষ,
শুনি উঠে আনন্দ-হিল্লোল ॥ ৫৪৩ ॥

*ānande nāradamuni, śuniñā ṭhākurabāṇī,*
*hiẏāsukhe bole haribola |*
*kahaẏe locanadāsa, e doṁhāra sambhāṣa,*
*śuni uṭhe ānanda-hillola || 543 ||*

*Word for word:* anande naradamuni — in bliss Narada Muni; shunina thakura-vani — hearing the Lord's words; hiya-sukhe bole haribola — from the joy of his heart cries "Haribol!"; kahaye lochanadasa — says Lochana Dasa; e donhara sambhasha — the conversation of these two; shuni uthe ananda-hillola — hearing it, a wave of bliss arises

**543.** In bliss Narada Muni, hearing the Lord's words,
cries "Haribol!" from the joy of his heart.
Says Lochana Dasa: whoever hears the conversation of these two,
in him a wave of bliss arises.

*Raga dhanashi, short metre; disha: "I give myself to the crimson lotus feet! Go, go, give out prema, madden the world with prema!"*

নারদে বিদায় দিয়া বসিলা ঠাকুর ।
আপন অন্তর-কথা তুলিলা অঙ্কুর ॥ ৫৪৪ ॥

*nārade bidāẏa diẏā basilā ṭhākura |*
*āpana antara-kathā tulilā aṅkura || 544 ||*

*Word for word:* narade vidaya diya — having dismissed Narada; basila thakura — the Lord sat; apana antara-katha — the words of His heart; tulila ankura — sprang up as a shoot

**544.** Having sent Narada off, the Lord sat down,
and the words of His heart sprang up like a shoot.

পৃথিবীতে জনম লভিব যে কারণে ।
তত্ত্ব কহি সর্বজন শুন সাবধানে ॥ ৫৪৫ ॥

*pṛthibīte janama labhiba ye kāraṇe |*
*tattba kahi sarbajana śuna sābadhāne || 545 ||*

*Word for word:* prithivite janama labhiba — He will be born on earth; ye karane — for what reason; tattva kahi — I tell the essence; sarvajana shuna savadhane — listen, all, attentively

**545.** For what reason He will be born on earth —
I shall tell the essence; listen, all, attentively.

নিজবৃন্দ লঞা প্রভু কহে নিজকথা ।
মহামহেশ্বর করে পৃথিবীর চিন্তা ॥ ৫৪৬ ॥

*nijabṛnda lañā prabhu kahe nijakathā |*
*mahāmaheśbara kare pṛthibīra cintā || 546 ||*

*Word for word:* nija-vrinda lana — gathering His own; prabhu kahe nija-katha — the Lord speaks of Himself; maha-maheshvara — the Supreme Lord of lords; kare prithivira chinta — thinks of the earth

**546.** Gathering His own, the Lord speaks of Himself:
the Supreme Lord of lords is thinking of the earth.

ডাহিনে রাধিকা বামে দেবী শ্রীরুক্মিণী ।
তাহার অন্তরে যত প্রধান রঙ্গিণী ॥ ৫৪৭ ॥

*ḍāhine rādhikā bāme debī śrīrukmiṇī |*
*tāhāra antare yata pradhāna raṅgiṇī || 547 ||*

*Word for word:* dahine radhika — on the right Radhika; vame devi shri-rukmini — on the left the goddess Sri Rukmini; tahara antare — next to them; yata pradhana rangini — all the chief companions of play

**547.** On the right is Radhika, on the left the goddess Sri Rukmini,
nearest to them all the chief companions of play,

তাহার অন্তরে যত প্রিয় পারিষদ ।
তাহার অন্তরে যত আর অনুগত ॥ ৫৪৮ ॥

*tāhāra antare yata priẏa pāriṣada |*
*tāhāra antare yata āra anugata || 548 ||*

*Word for word:* tahara antare — after them; yata priya parishada — all the dear associates; tahara antare — after them; yata ara anugata — all the other followers

**548.** after them all the dear associates,
after them all the other followers.

প্রাণনাথ-প্রিয়কথা শুনিব শ্রবণে ।
লাখ লাখ আঁখি এক সুন্দর বদনে ॥ ৫৪৯ ॥

*prāṇanātha-priẏakathā śuniba śrabaṇe |*
*lākha lākha āṁkhi eka sundara badane || 549 ||*

*Word for word:* prananatha-priya-katha — the dear words of the Lord of their life; shuniba shravane — to hear with their ears; lakha lakha ankhi — hundreds of thousands of eyes; eka sundara vadane — on one beautiful face

**549.** Longing to hear the dear words of the Lord of their life,
hundreds of thousands of eyes [are fixed] on one beautiful face:

অনেক চকোর যেন একচন্দ্র-আশে ।
পিবই অমিয়া রাশি মুখ-পরকাশে ॥ ৫৫০ ॥

*aneka cakora yena ekacandra-āśe |*
*pibai amiẏā rāśi mukha-parakāśe || 550 ||*

*Word for word:* aneka chakora yena — like many chakoras; eka-chandra-ashe — hoping for one moon; pibai amiya rashi — drink heaps of nectar; mukha-parakashe — from the shining face

**550.** like many chakoras hoping for one moon,
they drink heaps of nectar from the shining face.

যুগে যুগে জন্ম মোর পৃথিবীর মাঝে ।
সাধুজন-ত্রাণ ধর্ম রাখিবার কাজে ॥ ৫৫১ ॥

*yuge yuge janma mora pṛthibīra mājhe |*
*sādhujana-trāṇa dharma rākhibāra kāje || 551 ||*

*Word for word:* yuge yuge — yuga after yuga; janma mora prithivira majhe — My birth on earth; sadhu-jana-trana — the deliverance of the righteous; dharma rakhibara kaje — for the protection of dharma

**551.** "Yuga after yuga I take birth on earth
to deliver the righteous and to protect dharma.[^08-3]

ধর্মসংস্থাপন করি না বুঝই কেহো ।
অধিকে বাঢ়য়ে পাপ পরমাদ সেহো ॥ ৫৫২ ॥

*dharmasaṃsthāpana kari nā bujhai keho |*
*adhike bāṛhaẏe pāpa paramāda seho || 552 ||*

*Word for word:* dharma-samsthapana kari — I establish dharma; na bujhai keho — no one understands; adhike badhaye papa — sin grows even more; paramada seho — that is a calamity

**552.** I establish dharma — but no one understands,
and sin grows ever more: what a calamity!

সত্যযুগ-অধিক ত্রেতায় বাড়ে পাপ ।
দ্বাপরে তাহার অধিক এ বড় সন্তাপ ॥ ৫৫৩ ॥

*satyayuga-adhika tretāẏa bāṛe pāpa |*
*dbāpare tāhāra adhika e baṛa santāpa || 553 ||*

*Word for word:* satya-yuga-adhika — more than in the Satya-yuga; tretaya bade papa — in the Treta sin grows; dvapare tahara adhika — in the Dvapara more still; e bada santapa — this is great sorrow

**553.** More than in the Satya-yuga sin grows in the Treta,
in the Dvapara still more: great is the sorrow!

কলি ঘোর অন্ধকার নাহি ধর্মলেশ ।
করুণা বাড়িল দেখি সর্বজন-ক্লেশ ॥ ৫৫৪ ॥

*kali ghora andhakāra nāhi dharmaleśa |*
*karuṇā bāṛila dekhi sarbajana-kleśa || 554 ||*

*Word for word:* kali ghora andhakara — Kali is pitch darkness; nahi dharma-lesha — not a trace of dharma; karuna badila — compassion grew; dekhi sarvajana-klesha — seeing the sufferings of all

**554.** Kali is pitch darkness, not a trace of dharma is there;
seeing the sufferings of all, I am filled with compassion.

অধর্ম-বিনাশ-হেতু মোর অবতার ।
অধর্ম বাঢ়য়ে পুনঃ কি কাজ আমার ॥ ৫৫৫ ॥

*adharma-bināśa-hetu mora abatāra |*
*adharma bāṛhaẏe punaḥ ki kāja āmāra || 555 ||*

*Word for word:* adharma-vinasha-hetu — for the destruction of adharma; mora avatara — My descent; adharma badhaye punah — [if] adharma grows again; ki kaja amara — what is My work

**555.** My descent is for the destruction of adharma;
if adharma grows again, what then is My work?

এছন জানিঞা দয়া উপজিল চিতে ।
জনম লভিব নিজ প্রেম প্রকাশিতে ॥ ৫৫৬ ॥

*echana jāniñā daẏā upajila cite |*
*janama labhiba nija prema prakāśite || 556 ||*

*Word for word:* aichhana janina — knowing this; daya upajila chite — compassion arose in the heart; janama labhiba — I shall take birth; nija prema prakashite — to reveal My prema

**556.** Knowing this, compassion arose in My heart:
I shall take birth to reveal My prema.

এমত দুর্লভ প্রেমভক্তি প্রকাশিয়া ।
বুঝাইব লোকে ধর্মাধর্ম বিচারিয়া ॥ ৫৫৭ ॥

*emata durlabha premabhakti prakāśiẏā |*
*bujhāiba loke dharmādharma bicāriẏā || 557 ||*

*Word for word:* emata durlabha prema-bhakti — such rare prema-bhakti; prakashiya — revealing; bujhaiba loke — I shall make people understand; dharmadharma vichariya — discerning dharma and adharma

**557.** Revealing such rare prema-bhakti,
I shall make people understand, discerning dharma from adharma.

নবদ্বীপে জন্ম মোর শচীর উদরে ।
গঙ্গার সমীপে জগন্নাথমিশ্র-ঘরে ॥ ৫৫৮ ॥

*nabadbīpe janma mora śacīra udare |*
*gaṅgāra samīpe jagannāthamiśra-ghare || 558 ||*

*Word for word:* navadvipe janma mora — My birth in Navadvipa; shachira udare — from the womb of Shachi; gangara samipe — near the Ganga; jagannatha-mishra-ghare — in the house of Jagannatha Mishra

**558.** I shall be born in Navadvipa, of Shachi,
near the Ganga, in the house of Jagannatha Mishra.

আর অবতার হেন অবতার নহে ।
অসুর-সংহার-হেতু পৃথিবী বিজয়ে ॥ ৫৫৯ ॥

*āra abatāra hena abatāra nahe |*
*asura-saṃhāra-hetu pṛthibī bijaẏe || 559 ||*

*Word for word:* ara avatara — the other avataras; hena avatara nahe — are not like this avatara; asura-samhara-hetu — for slaying the asuras; prithivi vijaye — come to the earth

**559.** The other avataras are not like this avatara:
they come to earth to slay the asuras.

মহাকায় মহাসুর মহা-অস্ত্র মোর ।
মহারণে সংহার করিয়া করোঁ চূর ॥ ৫৬০ ॥

*mahākāẏa mahāsura mahā-astra mora |*
*mahāraṇe saṃhāra kariẏā karoṁ cūra || 560 ||*

*Word for word:* mahakaya mahasura — huge great asuras; maha-astra mora — with My great weapons; maharane samhara kariya — slaying in great battles; karon chura — I crushed

**560.** Huge great asuras, with My great weapons,
in great battles I struck down and crushed.

এবে সর্বজন সেই হৃদয়-আসুরী ।
খড়্গ-ছেদ্য নহে অস্ত্রবলে কিবা করি ॥ ৫৬১ ॥

*ebe sarbajana sei hṛdaẏa-āsurī |*
*khaṛga-chedya nahe astrabale kibā kari || 561 ||*

*Word for word:* ebe sarvajana sei — now all people; hridaya-asuri — are asuras in the heart; khadga-chhedya nahe — cannot be cut by a sword; astra-bale kiba kari — what can I do by force of arms

**561.** But now all people are asuras in their hearts:
they cannot be cut by a sword — what can be done by force of arms?

নাম গুণ সঙ্কীর্তন বৈষ্ণবের শক্তি ।
প্রকাশ করিব আর নিজ প্রেমভক্তি ॥ ৫৬২ ॥

*nāma guṇa saṅkīrtana baiṣṇabera śakti |*
*prakāśa kariba āra nija premabhakti || 562 ||*

*Word for word:* nama guna sankirtana — the name, the virtues, sankirtana; vaishnavera shakti — the Vaishnava's power; prakasha kariba ara — and further I shall reveal; nija prema-bhakti — prema-bhakti for Myself

**562.** The name, the virtues, sankirtana — this is the Vaishnava's power;
and further I shall reveal prema-bhakti for Myself.

এই মতে কলি-পাপ করিব সংহার ।
সভে চল আগে পাছে না কর বিচার ॥ ৫৬৩ ॥

*ei mate kali-pāpa kariba saṃhāra |*
*sabhe cala āge pāche nā kara bicāra || 563 ||*

*Word for word:* ei mate — thus; kali-papa kariba samhara — I shall destroy the sin of Kali; sabhe chala — come, all; age pachhe na kara vichara — do not consider who goes before and who after

**563.** In this way I shall destroy the sin of Kali;
come, all, do not consider who goes before and who after.

এবে নাম-সঙ্কীর্তন খড়্গ তীক্ষ্ণ লঞা ।
অন্তর-অসুর জীবের ফেলিব কাটিয়া ॥ ৫৬৪ ॥

*ebe nāma-saṅkīrtana khaṛga tīkṣṇa lañā |*
*antara-asura jībera pheliba kāṭiẏā || 564 ||*

*Word for word:* ebe — now; nama-sankirtana khadga tikshna lana — taking the sharp sword of the sankirtana of the name; antara-asura jivera — the asuras within the hearts of beings; pheliba katiya — I shall cut down

**564.** Now, taking the sharp sword of the sankirtana of the name,
I shall cut down the asuras within the hearts of living beings.

যদি পাপী ছাড়ি ধর্ম দূর দেশে যায় ।
মোর সেনাপতি ভক্ত যাইবে তথায় ॥ ৫৬৫ ॥

*yadi pāpī chāṛi dharma dūra deśe yāẏa |*
*mora senāpati bhakta yāibe tathāẏa || 565 ||*

*Word for word:* yadi papi — if a sinner; chhadi dharma — abandoning dharma; dura deshe yaya — goes to a distant land; mora senapati bhakta — My generals, the devotees; yaibe tathaya — will go there

**565.** If a sinner, abandoning dharma, goes to a distant land,
My generals, the devotees, will go there.

নিজপ্রেমে ভাসাইব এ ব্রহ্মাণ্ড সব ।
কভু না রাখিব দুঃখ-শোক এক-লব ॥ ৫৬৬ ॥

*nijapreme bhāsāiba e brahmāṇḍa saba |*
*kabhu nā rākhiba duḥkha-śoka eka-laba || 566 ||*

*Word for word:* nija-preme bhasaiba — with My prema I shall flood; e brahmanda saba — this whole universe; kabhu na rakhiba — I shall never leave; duhkha-shoka eka-laba — a drop of grief and sorrow

**566.** With My prema I shall flood this whole universe
and not leave a single drop of grief and sorrow.

ভাসাইব স্থাবর জঙ্গম দেবগণে ।
শুনি আনন্দিত কহে এ দাস লোচনে ॥ ৫৬৭ ॥

*bhāsāiba sthābara jaṅgama debagaṇe |*
*śuni ānandita kahe e dāsa locane || 567 ||*

*Word for word:* bhasaiba — I shall flood; sthavara jangama devagane — the unmoving, the moving and the gods; shuni anandita — hearing, joyfully; kahe e dasa lochane — speaks this servant Lochana

**567.** I shall flood the moving and the unmoving, and the gods."
Hearing this, joyfully speaks this servant Lochana.

*Raga varadi, tripadi metre*

চলিলা নারদমুনি, উঠিল বীণার ধ্বনি,
পাণি-পদ না চলয়ে আর ।
যাইতে না পথ দেখে, প্রেমজলে আঁখি ঝাঁপে,
টলমল যেন মাতোয়ার ॥ ৫৬৮ ॥

*calilā nāradamuni, uṭhila bīṇāra dhbani,*
*pāṇi-pada nā calaẏe āra |*
*yāite nā patha dekhe, premajale āṁkhi jhāṁpe,*
*ṭalamala yena mātoẏāra || 568 ||*

*Word for word:* chalila naradamuni — Narada Muni set out; uthila vinara dhvani — the sound of the vina arose; pani-pada na chalaye ara — hands and feet no longer move; yaite na patha dekhe — going, he does not see the way; prema-jale ankhi jhanpe — tears of prema flood the eyes; talamala yena matoyara — staggering as if drunk

**568.** Narada Muni set out, the sound of his vina arose;
his hands and feet no longer obey him;
he walks but does not see the way — tears of prema flood his eyes —
he staggers as if drunk.

পদ দুই চারি যাই, পুনঃ পড়ে সেই ঠাঁই,
প্রভু-নাম আধ আধ বোলে ।
অনেক শকতি উঠি, ধরিয়া ধরণী কোঁড়ি,
নদী বহে নয়নের জলে ॥ ৫৬৯ ॥

*pada dui cāri yāi, punaḥ paṛe sei ṭhāṁi,*
*prabhu-nāma ādha ādha bole |*
*aneka śakati uṭhi, dhariẏā dharaṇī koṁṛi,*
*nadī bahe naẏanera jale || 569 ||*

*Word for word:* pada dui chari yai — going two or four steps; punah pade sei thani — falls again on that spot; prabhu-nama adha adha bole — half utters the Lord's name; aneka shakati uthi — rising with great effort; dhariya dharani kondri — clutching at the ground; nadi vahe nayanera jale — a river flows with the tears of his eyes

**569.** He goes two or four steps and falls again on the same spot,
half uttering the name of the Lord;
with great effort he rises, clutching at the ground,[^08-4]
and a river of tears flows from his eyes.

ক্ষণে মহা উনমাদ, হুহুঙ্কার সিংহনাদ,
গোরারূপ হিয়ে ধেয়ান ।
বাহ্য নাহি অন্তরে, না চিনে আপনা পরে,
সবে এক গৌর-গেয়ান ॥ ৫৭০ ॥

*kṣaṇe mahā unamāda, huhuṅkāra siṃhanāda,*
*gorārūpa hiẏe dheẏāna |*
*bāhya nāhi antare, nā cine āpanā pare,*
*sabe eka gaura-geẏāna || 570 ||*

*Word for word:* kshane maha unamada — now great madness; huhunkara simhanada — cries of "hum!", a lion's roar; gorarupa hiye dheyana — meditation on Gora's form in the heart; bahya nahi antare — no outer awareness; na chine apana pare — does not tell himself from others; sabe eka gaura-geyana — in all only the awareness of Gaura

**570.** Now great madness, cries of "hum!", a lion's roar,
in his heart meditation on Gora's form;
he has no outer awareness, does not tell himself from others —
in all there is only the awareness of Gaura.

কোটি-রবি-তেজঃ যেন, অঙ্গের কিরণ হেন,
নারদ চলিলা অন্তরীক্ষে ।
উত্তরিলা সেই ঠাম, যথা প্রভু বলরাম,
চমক লাগিল শ্বেতদ্বীপে ॥ ৫৭১ ॥

*koṭi-rabi-tejaḥ yena, aṅgera kiraṇa hena,*
*nārada calilā antarīkṣe |*
*uttarilā sei ṭhāma, yathā prabhu balarāma,*
*camaka lāgila śbetadbīpe || 571 ||*

*Word for word:* koti-ravi-tejah yena — like the splendour of millions of suns; angera kirana hena — such the radiance of his body; narada chalila antarikshe — Narada flies through the sky; uttarila sei thama — descended at that abode; yatha prabhu balarama — where Lord Balarama is; chamaka lagila shvetadvipe — Shvetadvipa flashed with light

**571.** Like the splendour of millions of suns — such is the radiance of his body;
Narada flies through the sky
and descended at that abode where Lord Balarama is —
Shvetadvipa was lit up.

পুরী-পরিসরে রহি, চমকি চৌদিকে চাহি,
লাখ লাখ হিমকর-দ্যুতি ।
বায়ু বহে মন্দ মন্দ, দিব্য সুকুসুম-গন্ধ,
প্রতিদ্বারে লম্বে গজমতি ॥ ৫৭২ ॥

*purī-parisare rahi, camaki caudike cāhi,*
*lākha lākha himakara-dyuti |*
*bāẏu bahe manda manda, dibya sukusuma-gandha,*
*pratidbāre lambe gajamati || 572 ||*

*Word for word:* puri-parisare rahi — stopping at the city's bounds; chamaki chaudike chahi — looks in amazement on all sides; lakha lakha himakara-dyuti — the radiance of hundreds of thousands of moons; vayu vahe manda manda — a soft breeze blows; divya sukusuma-gandha — divine fragrance of flowers; pratidvare lambe gajamati — pearls hang at every gate

**572.** Stopping at the city's bounds, he looks in amazement on every side:
the radiance of hundreds of thousands of moons;
a soft, soft breeze blows, [bearing] the divine fragrance of flowers,
pearls hang at every gate.

সত্ত্বগুণ সর্বলোক, নাহি জরা মৃত্যু শোক,
সর্বজন সভাকার বন্ধু ।
যখন যে দিগে দিঠি, সেই সর্বজন মিঠি,
বলদেবময় ক্ষীরসিন্ধু ॥ ৫৭৩ ॥

*sattbaguṇa sarbaloka, nāhi jarā mṛtyu śoka,*
*sarbajana sabhākāra bandhu |*
*yakhana ye dige diṭhi, sei sarbajana miṭhi,*
*baladebamaẏa kṣīrasindhu || 573 ||*

*Word for word:* sattvaguna sarvaloka — all people in sattva; nahi jara mrityu shoka — no old age, death, sorrow; sarvajana sabhakara bandhu — everyone a friend of all; yakhana ye dige dithi — wherever one looks; sei sarvajana mithi — all people are lovely; baladevamaya kshirasindhu — the Ocean of Milk is full of Baladeva

**573.** All the people there are in sattva; there is no old age, death or sorrow;
everyone is the friend of all;
wherever one looks, all the people are lovely;
the Ocean of Milk is full of Baladeva.

দেখিয়া নারদমুনি, ধনি ধনি মনে গণি,
ধনি ধনি আপনাকে মানে ।
ত্রিজগত-নাথ স্বামী, দেখিব নয়ানে আমি,
কান্দিয়া পড়িব দু-চরণে ॥ ৫৭৪ ॥

*dekhiẏā nāradamuni, dhani dhani mane gaṇi,*
*dhani dhani āpanāke māne |*
*trijagata-nātha sbāmī, dekhiba naẏāne āmi,*
*kāndiẏā paṛiba du-caraṇe || 574 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhiya naradamuni — seeing, Narada Muni; dhani dhani mane gani — counting "blessed, blessed" in his mind; dhani dhani apanake mane — deems himself blessed; trijagata-natha svami — the Lord of the three worlds, the Master; dekhiba nayane ami — I shall see with my eyes; kandiya padiba du-charane — weeping I shall fall at His feet

**574.** Seeing this, Narada Muni says in his mind, "Blessed, blessed!"
and counts himself blessed, blessed:
"The Lord of the three worlds, the Master, I shall see with my eyes
and fall weeping at His feet.

সেই বলরামরায়, যুগে যুগে সহায়,
করি কৃষ্ণ করে অবতার ।
খেলায় বিবিধ খেলা, অনন্ত-বিনোদ-লীলা,
করি করে অসুর-সংহার ॥ ৫৭৫ ॥

*sei balarāmarāẏa, yuge yuge sahāẏa,*
*kari kṛṣṇa kare abatāra |*
*khelāẏa bibidha khelā, ananta-binoda-līlā,*
*kari kare asura-saṃhāra || 575 ||*

*Word for word:* sei balaramaraya — this Lord Balarama; yuge yuge sahaya — the helper yuga after yuga; kari krishna kare avatara — making [Him so], Krishna descends; khelaya vividha khela — playing games of every kind; ananta-vinoda-lila — in endless joyful lilas; kari kare asura-samhara — destroys the asuras

**575.** This Lord Balarama is the helper yuga after yuga:
making Him [His helper], Krishna descends;
playing games of every kind, in endless joyful lilas
He destroys the asuras.

সেই প্রভু বলরাম, নিজ অংশে তিন ঠাম,
রহি করে কৃষ্ণের পীরিতি ।
আদ্য মধ্য আর অন্ত, যার অংশ অনন্ত,
এক-ফণায় ধরি রহে ক্ষিতি ॥ ৫৭৬ ॥

*sei prabhu balarāma, nija aṃśe tina ṭhāma,*
*rahi kare kṛṣṇera pīriti |*
*ādya madhya āra anta, yāra aṃśa ananta,*
*eka-phaṇāẏa dhari rahe kṣiti || 576 ||*

*Word for word:* sei prabhu balarama — this Lord Balarama; nija amshe tina thama — by His portions in three abodes; rahi kare krishnera piriti — abiding, serves Krishna with love; adya madhya ara anta — beginning, middle and end; yara amsha ananta — His portion is Ananta; eka-phanaya dhari rahe kshiti — holds the earth on one hood

**576.** This Lord Balarama, by His portions in three abodes,[^08-5]
abides and serves Krishna with love;
at the beginning, the middle and the end — His portion is Ananta,
who holds the earth upon one hood.

আপনে ঈশ্বর হঞা, শ্বেতদ্বীপ-মাঝে রঞা,
বিলাস করয়ে নানারঙ্গে ।
সর্বোপরি পরিণাম, সেই মহাপ্রভু-ঠাম,
সেবা করে অপরূপ রঙ্গে ॥ ৫৭৭ ॥

*āpane īśbara hañā, śbetadbīpa-mājhe rañā,*
*bilāsa karaẏe nānāraṅge |*
*sarbopari pariṇāma, sei mahāprabhu-ṭhāma,*
*sebā kare aparūpa raṅge || 577 ||*

*Word for word:* apane ishvara hana — Himself being the Lord; shvetadvipa-majhe rana — dwelling in Shvetadvipa; vilasa karaye nana-range — enjoys pastimes in many ways; sarvopari parinama — the highest fulfilment; sei mahaprabhu-thama — with that Mahaprabhu; seva kare aparupa range — He serves in wondrous ways

**577.** Himself being the Lord, dwelling in Shvetadvipa,
He enjoys pastimes in many ways;
His highest fulfilment is service
to that Mahaprabhu, in wondrous ways.

গমনের কালে ছত্র, বসিতে আসন বস্ত্র,
শয়নের কালে হয় শয্যা ।
প্রলয়ে সে বটপত্র, মহারণে দিব্য অস্ত্র,
নানারূপে করে পরিচর্যা ॥ ৫৭৮ ॥

*gamanera kāle chatra, basite āsana bastra,*
*śaẏanera kāle haẏa śayyā |*
*pralaẏe se baṭapatra, mahāraṇe dibya astra,*
*nānārūpe kare paricaryā || 578 ||*

*Word for word:* gamanera kale chhatra — when He walks, the umbrella; basite asana vastra — when He sits, the seat and garments; shayanera kale haya shayya — when He lies, the bed; pralaye se vatapatra — at dissolution the banyan leaf; maharane divya astra — in great battle the divine weapon; nana-rupe kare paricharya — serves in many forms

**578.** When [the Lord] walks he is the umbrella, when He sits the seat and garments,
when He lies down the bed;
at the dissolution the banyan leaf, in great battle the divine weapon:
in many forms he serves.

এক অংশে সেবা করে, আর অংশে মহী ধরে,
হেন প্রভু বলরাম মোর ।
ত্রিজগত-অধিরাজ, দেখিব ক্ষীরোদ-মাঝ,
প্রভু-আজ্ঞা করিব গোচর ॥ ৫৭৯ ॥

*eka aṃśe sebā kare, āra aṃśe mahī dhare,*
*hena prabhu balarāma mora |*
*trijagata-adhirāja, dekhiba kṣīroda-mājha,*
*prabhu-ājñā kariba gocara || 579 ||*

*Word for word:* eka amshe seva kare — with one portion He serves; ara amshe mahi dhare — with another holds the earth; hena prabhu balarama mora — such is my Lord Balarama; trijagata-adhiraja — the supreme King of the three worlds; dekhiba kshiroda-majha — I shall see amid the Ocean of Milk; prabhu-ajna kariba gochara — I shall convey the Lord's command

**579.** With one portion He serves, with another portion He holds the earth —
such is my Lord Balarama.
The supreme King of the three worlds I shall see amid the Ocean of Milk
and convey to Him the Lord's command."

এই দুই প্রভু মাত্র, যেন রাজা মহাপাত্র,
পৃথিবী পালয়ে এক-যুক্তি ।
আর যত রুদ্রবংশ, সেহো যার অংশাংশ,
অবতার করিবেন ক্ষিতি ॥ ৫৮০ ॥

*ei dui prabhu mātra, yena rājā mahāpātra,*
*pṛthibī pālaẏe eka-yukti |*
*āra yata rudrabaṃśa, seho yāra aṃśāṃśa,*
*abatāra karibena kṣiti || 580 ||*

*Word for word:* ei dui prabhu matra — these two Lords; yena raja mahapatra — like a king and chief minister; prithivi palaye eka-yukti — protect the earth with one counsel; ara yata rudra-vamsha — and all others of the Rudras' line; seho yara amshamsha — they too, portions of His portions; avatara karibena kshiti — will descend to earth

**580.** These two Lords are like a king and his chief minister:
with one counsel they protect the earth;
and all the others of the Rudras' line — they too, portions of His portions —
will descend to earth.

হেন মনঃকথা-রসে, মুনি ভেল পরবশে,
পুরী প্রবেশিল মহানন্দে ।
দেখি ত্রিজগত-নাথ, সব-পারিষদ সাথ,
অপরূপ বলরামচান্দে ॥ ৫৮১ ॥

*hena manaḥkathā-rase, muni bhela parabaśe,*
*purī prabeśila mahānande |*
*dekhi trijagata-nātha, saba-pāriṣada sātha,*
*aparūpa balarāmacānde || 581 ||*

*Word for word:* hena manah-katha-rase — in the rasa of these thoughts; muni bhela parabashe — the sage was beside himself; puri praveshila mahanande — entered the city in great bliss; dekhi trijagata-natha — saw the Lord of the three worlds; saba-parishada satha — with all associates; aparupa balarama-chande — the wondrous moon-like Balarama

**581.** Absorbed in the rasa of these thoughts, the sage, beside himself,
entered the city in great bliss
and beheld the Lord of the three worlds with all His associates —
the wondrous moon-like Balarama.

অমৃত-পর্বত যেন, বসি শ্বেত-সিংহাসন,
অমৃত-মধুর লহু হাসে ।
রাতা-উতপল আঁখি, ঢুলু ঢুলু হেন দেখি,
আধবাণী মুখেতে নিকষে ॥ ৫৮২ ॥

*amṛta-parbata yena, basi śbeta-siṃhāsana,*
*amṛta-madhura lahu hāse |*
*rātā-utapala āṁkhi, ḍhulu ḍhulu hena dekhi,*
*ādhabāṇī mukhete nikaṣe || 582 ||*

*Word for word:* amrita-parvata yena — like a mountain of nectar; basi shveta-simhasana — sitting on a white throne; amrita-madhura lahu hase — smiles softly, sweet as nectar; rata-utapala ankhi — eyes like red lotuses; dhulu dhulu hena dekhi — seen drooping languidly; adha-vani mukhete nikashe — half-words come from the lips

**582.** Like a mountain of nectar He sits on a white throne,[^08-6]
smiling softly, sweet as nectar;
His eyes red lotuses, seen drooping languidly,
half-words come from His lips.

তারক ভ্রমরা আধ, আচ্ছাদিল তার সাথ,
আধ উদাস দুই আঁখি ।
মণি মুকুতা প্রবাল, দিব্য রত্নময় হার,
অঙ্গ অলঙ্কারে নাহি লখি ॥ ৫৮৩ ॥

*tāraka bhramarā ādha, ācchādila tāra sātha,*
*ādha udāsa dui āṁkhi |*
*maṇi mukutā prabāla, dibya ratnamaẏa hāra,*
*aṅga alaṅkāre nāhi lakhi || 583 ||*

*Word for word:* taraka bhramara adha — the bee-like pupils half; achchhadila tara satha — covered [by the lids]; adha udasa dui ankhi — both eyes half drowsy; mani mukuta pravala — gems, pearls, coral; divya ratnamaya hara — divine jewelled necklaces; anga alankare nahi lakhi — the limbs not seen for ornaments

**583.** The pupils, like bees, are half covered [by the lids],
both eyes half drowsy;
gems, pearls, coral, divine necklaces of jewels —
the limbs cannot be seen for the ornaments.

আলিস-বালিশ করে, বামকর করি শিরে,
ডাহিনে রেবতী-কর ধরে ।
রেবতী তাম্বুল করে, দেই প্রভু-অধরে,
অনুরাগে বয়ান নেহারে ॥ ৫৮৪ ॥

*ālisa-bāliśa kare, bāmakara kari śire,*
*ḍāhine rebatī-kara dhare |*
*rebatī tāmbula kare, dei prabhu-adhare,*
*anurāge baẏāna nehāre || 584 ||*

*Word for word:* alisa-balisha kare — leaning idly on a pillow; vamakara kari shire — left hand under his head; dahine revati-kara dhare — with the right holds Revati's hand; revati tambula kare — Revati, betel in hand; dei prabhu-adhare — puts it to her lord's lips; anurage bayana nehare — lovingly gazes at his face

**584.** Leaning idly on a pillow, his left hand under his head,
with his right he holds Revati's hand;
Revati, betel in hand, puts it to his lips
and gazes lovingly at his face.

অনুচরী চারি-পাশে, চামর ঢুলায় হাসে,
কঙ্কণ-কিঙ্কিণী-ধ্বনি শুনি ।
কেহো বীণা বেণু বায়, কেহো বা সঙ্গীত গায়,
তাল সঞ্চে পরম-রমণী ॥ ৫৮৫ ॥

*anucarī cāri-pāśe, cāmara ḍhulāẏa hāse,*
*kaṅkaṇa-kiṅkiṇī-dhbani śuni |*
*keho bīṇā beṇu bāẏa, keho bā saṅgīta gāẏa,*
*tāla sañce parama-ramaṇī || 585 ||*

*Word for word:* anuchari chari-pashe — maidservants on every side; chamara dhulaya hase — smiling, wave chamaras; kankana-kinkini-dhvani shuni — the tinkling of bracelets and girdle-bells is heard; keho vina venu vaya — some play the vina and flute; keho va sangita gaya — some sing; tala sanche parama-ramani — the loveliest women keep the beat

**585.** Maidservants on every side, smiling, wave chamaras;
the tinkling of bracelets and girdle-bells is heard;
some play the vina and the flute, some sing,
the loveliest women keep the beat.

তাহার অন্তরে যত, অনুগত শত শত,
যার যেই নিজ নিয়োজিত ।
এছন সময়ে মুনি, করিল বীণার ধ্বনি,
ঠাকুর দেখিল আচম্বিত ॥ ৫৮৬ ॥

*tāhāra antare yata, anugata śata śata,*
*yāra yei nija niẏojita |*
*echana samaẏe muni, karila bīṇāra dhbani,*
*ṭhākura dekhila ācambita || 586 ||*

*Word for word:* tahara antare yata — beyond them all; anugata shata shata — hundreds of followers; yara yei nija niyojita — each at his own appointed task; aichhana samaye muni — at that moment the sage; karila vinara dhvani — sounded his vina; thakura dekhila achambita — the Lord suddenly saw

**586.** Beyond them are hundreds and hundreds of followers,
each at his appointed service.
At that moment the sage sounded his vina,
and the Lord suddenly saw him.

বিহ্বল নারদমুনি, টলমল পড়ে ভূমি,
ঠাকুর তুলিয়া নিল কোলে ।
চিরদিন-অনুরাগে, দেখিল সে মহাভাগে,
তুষিল শীতল মহা বোলে ॥ ৫৮৭ ॥

*bihbala nāradamuni, ṭalamala paṛe bhūmi,*
*ṭhākura tuliẏā nila kole |*
*ciradina-anurāge, dekhila se mahābhāge,*
*tuṣila śītala mahā bole || 587 ||*

*Word for word:* vihvala naradamuni — overwhelmed, Narada Muni; talamala pade bhumi — staggering, falls to the ground; thakura tuliya nila kole — the Lord lifted him onto His lap; chiradina-anurage — with long-held love; dekhila se mahabhage — looked on that great fortunate one; tushila shitala maha bole — comforted him with cool, great words

**587.** Overwhelmed, Narada Muni staggers and falls to the ground;
the Lord lifted him and took him on His lap,
and, with long-held love, looked on that great fortunate one
and comforted him with cool, great words.

হাসি সম্ভাষণে পহুঁ, কহ কোথা হৈতে তুহুঁ,
রহস্য কহিবে হেন বাসি ।
কহনা কেমন কাজ, শুনিতে হৃদয়-মাঝ,
আনন্দ উঠয়ে রাশি রাশি ॥ ৫৮৮ ॥

*hāsi sambhāṣaṇe pahuṁ, kaha kothā haite tuhuṁ,*
*rahasya kahibe hena bāsi |*
*kahanā kemana kāja, śunite hṛdaẏa-mājha,*
*ānanda uṭhaẏe rāśi rāśi || 588 ||*

*Word for word:* hasi sambhashane panhu — greeting with a smile, the Lord; kaha kotha haite tuhu — say where you are from; rahasya kahibe hena basi — I feel you will tell a secret; kahana kemana kaja — tell, what is the task; shunite hridaya-majha — as I listen, within the heart; ananda uthaye rashi rashi — bliss rises in heaps

**588.** Greeting him with a smile, the Lord says: "Where have you come from?
I feel you will tell [Me] a secret.
Tell Me, what is the task? As I listen, within My heart
bliss rises beyond counting."

সম্ভ্রমে কহয়ে মুনি, কি কহিতে জানি আমি,
তুমি প্রভু সর্ব-অন্তর্যামী ।
যে কিছু কহিতে জানি, সেই কথা অনুমানি,
যে জুয়ায় কর প্রভু তুমি ॥ ৫৮৯ ॥

*sambhrame kahaẏe muni, ki kahite jāni āmi,*
*tumi prabhu sarba-antaryāmī |*
*ye kichu kahite jāni, sei kathā anumāni,*
*ye juẏāẏa kara prabhu tumi || 589 ||*

*Word for word:* sambhrame kahaye muni — respectfully the sage says; ki kahite jani ami — what can I know how to say; tumi prabhu sarva-antaryami — You, Lord, are the Indweller of all; ye kichhu kahite jani — whatever I can say; sei katha anumani — that I say as I understand; ye juyaya kara prabhu tumi — do what is fitting, Lord

**589.** Respectfully the sage says: "What can I know how to say?
You, Lord, are the Indweller of all.
What I can say, I shall say as I understand;
do what is fitting, Lord.

কলি পাপময় যুগে, না দেখি নিস্তার লোকে,
দয়া উপজিল প্রভু-চিতে ।
পালিব ভকতজন, আর ধর্ম-সংস্থাপন,
জনম লভিব পৃথিবীতে ॥ ৫৯০ ॥

*kali pāpamaẏa yuge, nā dekhi nistāra loke,*
*daẏā upajila prabhu-cite |*
*pāliba bhakatajana, āra dharma-saṃsthāpana,*
*janama labhiba pṛthibīte || 590 ||*

*Word for word:* kali papamaya yuge — in the sinful Kali-yuga; na dekhi nistara loke — I see no deliverance for people; daya upajila prabhu-chite — compassion arose in the Lord's heart; paliba bhakata-jana — I shall protect the devotees; ara dharma-samsthapana — and establish dharma; janama labhiba prithivite — I shall be born on earth

**590.** 'In the sinful Kali-yuga I see no deliverance for people' —
compassion arose in the Lord's heart —
'to protect the devotees and establish dharma
I shall be born on earth.

অধর্ম-বিনাশ-কাজে, আর কিবা ধর্ম আছে,
হেন বুঝি আকার-ইঙ্গিতে ।
আজ্ঞা দিলা আমারে, ঘোষণা দিবার তরে,
শুনি লোক ভেল আনন্দিতে ॥ ৫৯১ ॥

*adharma-bināśa-kāje, āra kibā dharma āche,*
*hena bujhi ākāra-iṅgite |*
*ājñā dilā āmāre, ghoṣaṇā dibāra tare,*
*śuni loka bhela ānandite || 591 ||*

*Word for word:* adharma-vinasha-kaje — for destroying adharma; ara kiba dharma achhe — what other dharma is there; hena bujhi akara-ingite — so I understood from bearing and signs; ajna dila amare — He commanded me; ghoshana dibara tare — to make the proclamation; shuni loka bhela anandite — hearing, people rejoiced

**591.** For the destruction of adharma, what other dharma is there?' —
so I understood from His bearing and signs.
He commanded me to make the proclamation,
and on hearing it people rejoiced.

রাধাভাব অন্তরে, রাধাবর্ণ বাহিরে,
অন্তর্বাহ্য রাধাময় হঞা ।
সঙ্গে সখা-সখীবৃন্দ, আর ভক্ত অনন্ত,
ব্রজভাবে অখিল মাতাঞা ॥ ৫৯২ ॥

*rādhābhāba antare, rādhābarṇa bāhire,*
*antarbāhya rādhāmaẏa hañā |*
*saṅge sakhā-sakhībṛnda, āra bhakta ananta,*
*brajabhābe akhila mātāñā || 592 ||*

*Word for word:* radha-bhava antare — Radha's bhava within; radha-varna bahire — Radha's colour without; antarbahya radhamaya hana — filled with Radha inside and out; sange sakha-sakhi-vrinda — with friends and girl-companions; ara bhakta ananta — and endless devotees; vraja-bhave akhila matana — maddening the whole world with the bhava of Vraja

**592.** With the bhava of Radha within and the colour of Radha without,
filled with Radha inside and out,
with His friends and girl-companions and endless devotees
He will madden the whole world with the bhava of Vraja.[^08-7]

সাঙ্গোপাঙ্গে পারিষদে, জনমহ পৃথিবীতে,
স্বনাম ধরহ নিত্যানন্দ ।
তোর অগোচর নহে, তার মর্ম কর্ম দেহে,
কহিল যে আজ্ঞা গৌরচন্দ্র ॥ ৫৯৩ ॥

*sāṅgopāṅge pāriṣade, janamaha pṛthibīte,*
*sbanāma dharaha nityānanda |*
*tora agocara nahe, tāra marma karma dehe,*
*kahila ye ājñā gauracandra || 593 ||*

*Word for word:* sanga-upange parishade — with limbs, sub-limbs and associates; janamaha prithivite — take birth on earth; svanama dharaha nityananda — bear the name Nityananda; tora agochara nahe — not unknown to You; tara marma karma dehe — the heart of His deeds and form; kahila ye ajna gaurachandra — the command Gaurachandra spoke

**593.** 'With limbs, sub-limbs and associates take birth on earth
and bear the name Nityananda' —
the heart of His deeds and form is not unknown to You —
this is the command that Gaurachandra spoke."

শুনি বলরামরায়, আনন্দে চৌদিকে চায়,
অট্ট অট্ট হাসে উচ্চনাদে ।
ঘন ঘন হুহুঙ্কার, প্রকাশয়ে চমৎকার,
আপনা পাসরে প্রেমানন্দে ॥ ৫৯৪ ॥

*śuni balarāmarāẏa, ānande caudike cāẏa,*
*aṭṭa aṭṭa hāse uccanāde |*
*ghana ghana huhuṅkāra, prakāśaẏe camatkāra,*
*āpanā pāsare premānande || 594 ||*

*Word for word:* shuni balaramaraya — hearing, Lord Balarama; anande chaudike chaya — in bliss looks on every side; atta atta hase uchchanade — laughs in loud peals; ghana ghana huhunkara — again and again roars "hum!"; prakashaye chamatkara — displays wonders; apana pasare premanande — forgets Himself in the bliss of prema

**594.** Hearing this, Lord Balarama looks around in bliss
and laughs aloud with great peals;
again and again He roars "hum!", displays wonders,
forgets Himself in the bliss of prema.

আজ্ঞা দিল নিজজনে, পৃথিবী কর গমনে,
প্রভু-আজ্ঞা পালিবার তরে ।
চলহ নারদ তুমি, জনম লভিব আমি,
অগোচর করিব গোচরে ॥ ৫৯৫ ॥

*ājñā dila nijajane, pṛthibī kara gamane,*
*prabhu-ājñā pālibāra tare |*
*calaha nārada tumi, janama labhiba āmi,*
*agocara kariba gocare || 595 ||*

*Word for word:* ajna dila nija-jane — He commanded His own; prithivi kara gamane — go to the earth; prabhu-ajna palibara tare — to carry out the Lord's command; chalaha narada tumi — go, Narada; janama labhiba ami — I shall take birth; agochara kariba gochare — I shall make the unseen seen

**595.** He commanded His own: "Go to the earth
to carry out the Lord's command.
Go, Narada: I shall take birth
and make the unseen seen."

এছন অদ্ভুত কথা, শুন গৌর-গুণগাথা,
সর্বজন কর অবধানে ।
সব-অবতার-সার, কলি-গোরা-অবতার,
বিচার করহ সভে মনে ॥ ৫৯৬ ॥

*echana adbhuta kathā, śuna gaura-guṇagāthā,*
*sarbajana kara abadhāne |*
*saba-abatāra-sāra, kali-gorā-abatāra,*
*bicāra karaha sabhe mane || 596 ||*

*Word for word:* aichhana adbhuta katha — such a wondrous tale; shuna gaura-guna-gatha — hear the story of Gaura's virtues; sarvajana kara avadhane — all be attentive; saba-avatara-sara — the essence of all avataras; kali-gora-avatara — Gora, the avatara of Kali; vichara karaha sabhe mane — consider, all, in your minds

**596.** Such a wondrous tale, the story of Gaura's virtues — hear it,
all of you, be attentive:
the essence of all avataras is Gora, the avatara of Kali —
consider this, all, in your minds.

তৃণ ধরি দশনে, বলোঁ মো কাতর-মনে,
গোরা-গুণে না করিহ হেলা ।
সংসারে না দিয়া মতি, কর কৃষ্ণে পীরিতি,
সংসার তরিতে এই ভেলা ॥ ৫৯৭ ॥

*tṛṇa dhari daśane, baloṁ mo kātara-mane,*
*gorā-guṇe nā kariha helā |*
