*saṃsāre nā diẏā mati, kara kṛṣṇe pīriti,*
*saṃsāra tarite ei bhelā || 597 ||*

*Word for word:* trina dhari dashane — holding a straw between the teeth; balon mo katara-mane — I say with a contrite heart; gora-gune na kariha hela — do not neglect Gora's virtues; samsare na diya mati — not giving the mind to worldly life; kara krishne piriti — love Krishna; samsara tarite ei bhela — this is the raft to cross worldly existence

**597.** Holding a straw between my teeth, with a contrite heart I say:
do not neglect Gora's virtues;
do not give your mind to worldly life, love Krishna —
this is the raft for crossing the ocean of worldly existence.

কভু নাহি হয় যেই, গোরা-অবতার সেই,
হইব পরম-পরকাশ ।
নির্জীব জীবন পাবে, অন্ধে পথ বিচারিবে,
গুণ গায় এ লোচনদাস ॥ ৫৯৮ ॥

*kabhu nāhi haẏa yei, gorā-abatāra sei,*
*haiba parama-parakāśa |*
*nirjība jībana pābe, andhe patha bicāribe,*
*guṇa gāẏa e locanadāsa || 598 ||*

*Word for word:* kabhu nahi haya yei — what has never been; gora-avatara sei — that Gora-avatara; haiba parama-parakasha — will be fully manifest; nirjiva jivana pabe — the lifeless will gain life; andhe patha vicharibe — the blind will discern the path; guna gaya e lochanadasa — sings the virtues this Lochana Dasa

**598.** What has never been — that Gora-avatara
will be fully manifest;
the lifeless will gain life, the blind will discern the path —
so sings His virtues this Lochana Dasa.

*Raga bhatiyari; disha: "Brothers, sing, sing the tale of the virtues of Nitai and Chaitanya!"*

হেনরূপে মহাপ্রভু আজ্ঞা যবে কৈলা ।
নিজ নিজ অংশে সভে জনম লভিলা ॥ ৫৯৯ ॥

*henarūpe mahāprabhu ājñā yabe kailā |*
*nija nija aṃśe sabhe janama labhilā || 599 ||*

*Word for word:* henarupe — thus; mahaprabhu ajna yabe kaila — when Mahaprabhu commanded; nija nija amshe — by their portions; sabhe janama labhila — all took birth

**599.** When Mahaprabhu had so commanded,
all took birth by their portions.

মহেশঠাকুর সর্ব-আগে আগুয়ান ।
ব্রাহ্মণের কুলে জন্ম কমলাক্ষ নাম ॥ ৬০০ ॥

*maheśaṭhākura sarba-āge āguẏāna |*
*brāhmaṇera kule janma kamalākṣa nāma || 600 ||*

*Word for word:* mahesha-thakura — Mahesha Thakura; sarva-age aguyana — went forth before all; brahmanera kule janma — born in a brahmana family; kamalaksha nama — named Kamalaksha

**600.** Mahesha Thakura went forth before all:
He was born in a brahmana family, named Kamalaksha.

পঢ়িয়া শুনিঞা গুণে পরবীণ হৈলা ।
অদ্বৈত-আচার্য বলি পদবী লভিলা ॥ ৬০১ ॥

*paṛhiẏā śuniñā guṇe parabīṇa hailā |*
*adbaita-ācārya bali padabī labhilā || 601 ||*

*Word for word:* padhiya shunina — by study and hearing; gune paravina haila — became accomplished in virtue; advaita-acharya bali — as "Advaita Acharya"; padavi labhila — received the title

**601.** By study and hearing He became accomplished in virtue
and received the title "Advaita Acharya".[^08-8]

সেই মহামহেশ্বর সত্ত্বগুণ ধরে ।
তমোগুণ বলি যারে ঘোষয়ে সংসারে ॥ ৬০২ ॥

*sei mahāmaheśbara sattbaguṇa dhare |*
*tamoguṇa bali yāre ghoṣaẏe saṃsāre || 602 ||*

*Word for word:* sei maha-maheshvara — this great Maheshvara; sattvaguna dhare — bears sattva; tamoguna bali yare — whom as tamo-guna; ghoshaye samsare — the world proclaims

**602.** This great Maheshvara is endowed with sattva —
yet the world proclaims Him [the embodiment of] tamo-guna.

অন্তর্বাহ্য বিচার না করে কেহো পুনঃ ।
বাহ্য আচরণ দেখি বোলে তমোগুণ ॥ ৬০৩ ॥

*antarbāhya bicāra nā kare keho punaḥ |*
*bāhya ācaraṇa dekhi bole tamoguṇa || 603 ||*

*Word for word:* antarbahya vichara — consideration of within and without; na kare keho punah — no one makes; bahya acharana dekhi — seeing outer conduct; bole tamoguna — they say "tamo-guna"

**603.** No one considers what He is within and without:
seeing His outer conduct, they say "tamo-guna".

কৃষ্ণের কেবল আত্মা নামে হরিহর ।
পরাকৃত তমোগুণ গুণের ভিতর ॥ ৬০৪ ॥

*kṛṣṇera kebala ātmā nāme harihara |*
*parākṛta tamoguṇa guṇera bhitara || 604 ||*

*Word for word:* krishnera kevala atma — Krishna's very self; name harihara — named Hari-Hara; parakrita tamoguna — tamo-guna set aside (or: worldly tamo-guna); gunera bhitara — among his qualities

**604.** [Shiva] is Krishna's very self; their name is Hari-Hara;
the worldly tamo-guna is set aside among his qualities.[^08-9]

প্রাকৃত ভকত বলি যেই তমোগুণী ।
অধম বলিয়ে অল্প জনে যবে জানি ॥ ৬০৫ ॥

*prākṛta bhakata bali yei tamoguṇī |*
*adhama baliẏe alpa jane yabe jāni || 605 ||*

*Word for word:* prakrita bhakata bali — calling him a worldly devotee; yei tamoguni — whoever [calls him] "tamoguni"; adhama baliye — I call low; alpa jane — a petty man; yabe jani — when I know

**605.** Whoever, taking him for a worldly devotee, calls him "tamoguni" —
when I know of him, I shall call him low, a petty man.

এ কেমনে হরিহর বোল তমোগুণ ।
অবজ্ঞা না কর যবে মোর বোল শুন ॥ ৬০৬ ॥

*e kemane harihara bola tamoguṇa |*
*abajñā nā kara yabe mora bola śuna || 606 ||*

*Word for word:* e kemane — how then; harihara bola tamoguna — you call Hari-Hara tamo-guna; avajna na kara — show no disrespect; yabe mora bola shuna — if you listen to my words

**606.** How can you say that Hari-Hara is tamo-guna?
Show no disrespect, if you listen to my words.

মনে অনুমান করি করহ বিচার ।
এতেকে বলিয়ে গোরা অবতার-সার ॥ ৬০৭ ॥

*mane anumāna kari karaha bicāra |*
*eteke baliẏe gorā abatāra-sāra || 607 ||*

*Word for word:* mane anumana kari — reflecting in the mind; karaha vichara — consider; eteke baliye — therefore I say; gora avatara-sara — Gora is the essence of avataras

**607.** Reflect in your minds and consider:
this is why I say that Gora is the essence of all avataras.

সব অবতারে তার খেলার সংহতি ।
বলরাম জনম লভিলা এই ক্ষিতি ॥ ৬০৮ ॥

*saba abatāre tāra khelāra saṃhati |*
*balarāma janama labhilā ei kṣiti || 608 ||*

*Word for word:* saba avatare — in all avataras; tara khelara samhati — companion of His play; balarama janama labhila — Balarama took birth; ei kshiti — on this earth

**608.** In all the avataras the companion of His play,
Balarama, took birth on this earth —

ব্রাহ্মণের কুলে যুগধর্ম-অনুরূপ ।
নিত্য আনন্দকন্দ সহজ-স্বরূপ ॥ ৬০৯ ॥

*brāhmaṇera kule yugadharma-anurūpa |*
*nitya ānandakanda sahaja-sbarūpa || 609 ||*

*Word for word:* brahmanera kule — in a brahmana family; yugadharma-anurupa — as befits the dharma of the yuga; nitya ananda-kanda — eternal root of bliss; sahaja-svarupa — His innate form

**609.** in a brahmana family, as befits the dharma of the yuga:
the eternal (*nitya*) root of bliss (*ananda*) is His innate form.

এক অংশে যাঁহার সহস্র ফণা ধরে ।
এক ফণে মহী ধরে সৃষ্টি রাখিবারে ॥ ৬১০ ॥

*eka aṃśe yāṁhāra sahasra phaṇā dhare |*
*eka phaṇe mahī dhare sṛṣṭi rākhibāre || 610 ||*

*Word for word:* eka amshe yanhara — one portion of whom; sahasra phana dhare — bears a thousand hoods; eka phane mahi dhare — holds the earth on one hood; srishti rakhibare — to preserve creation

**610.** One portion of Him bears a thousand hoods,
and on one hood holds the earth to preserve creation.

পদ্মাবতী-উদরে জনম বলরাম ।
পিতা হাড়ো ওঝা সে পরমানন্দ নাম ॥ ৬১১ ॥

*padmābatī-udare janama balarāma |*
*pitā hāṛo ojhā se paramānanda nāma || 611 ||*

*Word for word:* padmavati-udare — from the womb of Padmavati; janama balarama — Balarama was born; pita hado ojha — the father, Hado Ojha; se paramananda nama — by name also Paramananda

**611.** Balarama was born of Padmavati;
His father was Hado Ojha, by name also Paramananda.[^08-10]

পিতা মাতা নাম থুইল কুবের পণ্ডিত ।
সন্ন্যাস-আশ্রমে নিত্যানন্দ সুচরিত ॥ ৬১২ ॥

*pitā mātā nāma thuila kubera paṇḍita |*
*sannyāsa-āśrame nityānanda sucarita || 612 ||*

*Word for word:* pita mata nama thuila — father and mother gave the name; kuvera pandita — Kuvera Pandita; sannyasa-ashrame — in the ashrama of sannyasa; nityananda sucharita — Nityananda of wondrous deeds

**612.** His father and mother named Him Kuvera Pandita;
in the ashrama of sannyasa He is Nityananda of wondrous deeds.[^08-11]

শুক্লা ত্রয়োদশী শুভযোগ মাঘমাসে ।
পৃথিবীতে জনম লৈলা পরম হরিষে ॥ ৬১৩ ॥

*śuklā traẏodaśī śubhayoga māghamāse |*
*pṛthibīte janama lailā parama hariṣe || 613 ||*

*Word for word:* shukla trayodashi — the bright thirteenth; shubha-yoga — under an auspicious conjunction; magha-mase — in the month of Magha; prithivite janama laila — took birth on earth; parama harishe — in great joy

**613.** Under an auspicious conjunction, on the bright thirteenth of the month of Magha,
He took birth on earth in great joy.

কাত্যায়নী জনম লভিল মহী-মাঝে ।
সীতা নাম ধরে বিপ্রকুলের সমাজে ॥ ৬১৪ ॥

*kātyāẏanī janama labhila mahī-mājhe |*
*sītā nāma dhare biprakulera samāje || 614 ||*

*Word for word:* katyayani — Katyayani; janama labhila mahi-majhe — took birth on earth; sita nama dhare — bears the name Sita; vipra-kulera samaje — in the society of brahmanas

**614.** Katyayani took birth on earth
and bears the name Sita in the society of brahmanas.

অদ্বৈত-ঠাকুর-সঙ্গে একত্রে নিবাস ।
দোঁহে মিলি প্রেমভক্তি করে পরকাশ ॥ ৬১৫ ॥

*adbaita-ṭhākura-saṅge ekatre nibāsa |*
*doṁhe mili premabhakti kare parakāśa || 615 ||*

*Word for word:* advaita-thakura-sange — together with Advaita Thakura; ekatre nivasa — she lives; donhe mili — the two together; prema-bhakti kare parakasha — reveal prema-bhakti

**615.** She lives together with Advaita Thakura,
and the two together reveal prema-bhakti.

আমি অল্পবুদ্ধি কার কিবা তত্ত্ব জানি ।
অবতার-নির্ণয় বা কেমনে বাখানি ॥ ৬১৬ ॥

*āmi alpabuddhi kāra kibā tattba jāni |*
*abatāra-nirṇaẏa bā kemane bākhāni || 616 ||*

*Word for word:* ami alpabuddhi — I am small of mind; kara kiba tattva jani — what do I know of who is what; avatara-nirnaya — determination of avataras; va kemane bakhani — how shall I expound

**616.** I am small of mind — what do I know of who is what?
How can I expound whose avatara anyone is?

মহান্তের মুখে যেই শুনিঞাছি কাণে ।
তাহাও কহিতে নারি সঙ্কোচ পরাণে ॥ ৬১৭ ॥

*mahāntera mukhe yei śuniñāchi kāṇe |*
*tāhāo kahite nāri saṅkoca parāṇe || 617 ||*

*Word for word:* mahantera mukhe — from the mouths of mahantas; yei shuninachhi kane — what I have heard with my ears; tahao kahite nari — even that I cannot tell; sankocha parane — my heart shrinks

**617.** Even what I have heard with my ears from the mouths of mahantas
I cannot repeat: my heart shrinks back.

আমার শকতি নাহি করিতে নির্ণয় ।
নাম লই এইমাত্র যার যেই হয় ॥ ৬১৮ ॥

*āmāra śakati nāhi karite nirṇaẏa |*
*nāma lai eimātra yāra yei haẏa || 618 ||*

*Word for word:* amara shakati nahi — I have no power; karite nirnaya — to determine; nama lai eimatra — I only take the names; yara yei haya — of whoever is

**618.** I have no power to determine it —
I only name those who are.

আগে পাছে বিচার না কর কেহ মনে ।
অক্ষর-অনুরোধে গ্রন্থ নহে অনুক্রমে ॥ ৬১৯ ॥

*āge pāche bicāra nā kara keha mane |*
*akṣara-anurodhe grantha nahe anukrame || 619 ||*

*Word for word:* age pachhe — before or after; vichara na kara keha mane — let no one consider in his mind; akshara-anurodhe — for the sake of the syllables (metre); grantha nahe anukrame — the book is not in order

**619.** Let no one consider in his mind who is named before and who after:
for the sake of the metre the book keeps no order [of rank].

শচীদেবী জগন্নাথমিশ্র পুরন্দর ।
আপনে ঠাকুর জন্ম কৈলা যার ঘর ॥ ৬২০ ॥

*śacīdebī jagannāthamiśra purandara |*
*āpane ṭhākura janma kailā yāra ghara || 620 ||*

*Word for word:* shachidevi — Shachi-devi; jagannatha-mishra purandara — Jagannatha Mishra Purandara; apane thakura — the Lord Himself; janma kaila yara ghara — took birth in whose house

**620.** Shachi-devi and Jagannatha Mishra Purandara,
in whose house the Lord Himself took birth;

গোপীনাথ নাম কাশীমিশ্র ঠাকুর ।
চৈতন্য-সম্মত-পথে আনন্দ প্রচুর ॥ ৬২১ ॥

*gopīnātha nāma kāśīmiśra ṭhākura |*
*caitanya-sammata-pathe ānanda pracura || 621 ||*

*Word for word:* gopinatha nama — Gopinatha by name; kashimishra thakura — Kashi Mishra Thakura; chaitanya-sammata-pathe — on the path approved by Chaitanya; ananda prachura — abundant bliss

**621.** Gopinatha by name, and Kashi Mishra Thakura,[^08-12]
on the path approved by Chaitanya, in abundant bliss;

পণ্ডিত শ্রীগদাধর গদাধরদাস ।
মুরারি মুকুন্দদত্ত আর শ্রীনিবাস ॥ ৬২২ ॥

*paṇḍita śrīgadādhara gadādharadāsa |*
*murāri mukundadatta āra śrīnibāsa || 622 ||*

*Word for word:* pandita shri-gadadhara — Pandita Sri Gadadhara; gadadharadasa — Gadadhara Dasa; murari mukundadatta — Murari, Mukunda Datta; ara shrinivasa — and Srinivasa

**622.** Pandita Sri Gadadhara, Gadadhara Dasa,
Murari, Mukunda Datta and Srinivasa;

রায় রামানন্দ আর বাসুদেব দত্ত ।
হরিদাস ঠাকুর আর গোবিন্দ অনুগত ॥ ৬২৩ ॥

*rāẏa rāmānanda āra bāsudeba datta |*
*haridāsa ṭhākura āra gobinda anugata || 623 ||*

*Word for word:* raya ramananda — Raya Ramananda; ara vasudeva datta — and Vasudeva Datta; haridasa thakura — Haridasa Thakura; ara govinda anugata — and Govinda the attendant

**623.** Raya Ramananda and Vasudeva Datta,
Haridasa Thakura and Govinda the attendant;

ঈশ্বর মাধবপুরী বিষ্ণুপুরী আর ।
বক্রেশ্বর পরমানন্দপুরী শুদ্ধাচার ॥ ৬২৪ ॥

*īśbara mādhabapurī biṣṇupurī āra |*
*bakreśbara paramānandapurī śuddhācāra || 624 ||*

*Word for word:* ishvara — Ishvara [Puri]; madhavapuri — Madhava Puri; vishnupuri ara — and Vishnupuri; vakreshvara — Vakreshvara; paramananda-puri — Paramananda Puri; shuddhachara — of pure conduct

**624.** Ishvara [Puri], Madhava Puri and Vishnupuri,
Vakreshvara, Paramananda Puri of pure conduct;

পণ্ডিত জগদানন্দ আর বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া ।
রাঘব পণ্ডিত আদি পৃথিবী আসিয়া ॥ ৬২৫ ॥

*paṇḍita jagadānanda āra biṣṇupriẏā |*
*rāghaba paṇḍita ādi pṛthibī āsiẏā || 625 ||*

*Word for word:* pandita jagadananda — Pandita Jagadananda; ara vishnupriya — and Vishnupriya; raghava pandita adi — Raghava Pandita and others; prithivi asiya — coming to earth

**625.** Pandita Jagadananda and Vishnupriya,
Raghava Pandita and others came to earth;

রামদাস গৌরীদাস আর ত সুন্দর ।
কৃষ্ণদাস পুরুষোত্তম শ্রীকমলাকর ॥ ৬২৬ ॥

*rāmadāsa gaurīdāsa āra ta sundara |*
*kṛṣṇadāsa puruṣottama śrīkamalākara || 626 ||*

*Word for word:* ramadasa — Ramadasa; gauridasa — Gauridasa; ara ta sundara — and Sundara; krishnadasa — Krishnadasa; purushottama — Purushottama; shri-kamalakara — Sri Kamalakara

**626.** Ramadasa, Gauridasa and Sundara,
Krishnadasa, Purushottama, Sri Kamalakara,

কালা কৃষ্ণদাস আর উদ্ধারণ দত্ত ।
দ্বাদশ গোপাল ব্রজে ইহার মহত্ত্ব ॥ ৬২৭ ॥

*kālā kṛṣṇadāsa āra uddhāraṇa datta |*
*dbādaśa gopāla braje ihāra mahattba || 627 ||*

*Word for word:* kala krishnadasa — Kala Krishnadasa; ara uddharana datta — and Uddharana Datta; dvadasha gopala vraje — the twelve gopalas of Vraja; ihara mahattva — such is their greatness

**627.** Kala Krishnadasa and Uddharana Datta —
the twelve cowherd boys (*gopalas*) of Vraja: such is their greatness;[^08-13]

পরমেশ্বর দাস আর বৃন্দাবন দাস ।
কাশীশ্বর শ্রীল রূপ সনাতন প্রকাশ ॥ ৬২৮ ॥

*parameśbara dāsa āra bṛndābana dāsa |*
*kāśīśbara śrīla rūpa sanātana prakāśa || 628 ||*

*Word for word:* parameshvara dasa — Parameshvara Dasa; ara vrindavana dasa — and Vrindavana Dasa; kashishvara — Kashishvara; shrila rupa sanatana — Srila Rupa and Sanatana; prakasha — appeared

**628.** Parameshvara Dasa and Vrindavana Dasa,
Kashishvara, Srila Rupa and Sanatana appeared;

গোবিন্দ মাধবঘোষ বাসুঘোষ আর ।
সভে মিলি আসি কৈল পৃথিবী প্রচার ॥ ৬২৯ ॥

*gobinda mādhabaghoṣa bāsughoṣa āra |*
*sabhe mili āsi kaila pṛthibī pracāra || 629 ||*

*Word for word:* govinda — Govinda; madhava-ghosha — Madhava Ghosha; vasu-ghosha ara — and Vasu Ghosha; sabhe mili asi — all coming together; kaila prithivi prachara — spread over the earth

**629.** Govinda, Madhava Ghosha and Vasu Ghosha —
all came together and spread [bhakti] over the earth.

দামোদর পণ্ডিত মিলিয়া পাঁচ ভাই ।
জনম লভিলা পৃথিবীতে এক ঠাঞি ॥ ৬৩০ ॥

*dāmodara paṇḍita miliẏā pāṁca bhāi |*
*janama labhilā pṛthibīte eka ṭhāñi || 630 ||*

*Word for word:* damodara pandita miliya — together with Damodara Pandita; pancha bhai — five brothers; janama labhila prithivite — took birth on earth; eka thani — in one place

**630.** Together with Damodara Pandita, five brothers
took birth on earth in one place.[^08-14]

পুরন্দর পণ্ডিত আর পরমানন্দ বৈদ্য ।
পৃথিবী আইলা যত ছিলা অন্ত আদ্য ॥ ৬৩১ ॥

*purandara paṇḍita āra paramānanda baidya |*
*pṛthibī āilā yata chilā anta ādya || 631 ||*

*Word for word:* purandara pandita — Purandara Pandita; ara paramananda vaidya — and Paramananda Vaidya; prithivi aila — came to earth; yata chhila anta adya — all who were, last and first

**631.** Purandara Pandita and Paramananda Vaidya —
all who were, from the first to the last, came to earth.

শ্রীনরহরিদাস ঠাকুর আমার ।
বিশেষ কহিব কিছু চরিত্র তাঁহার ॥ ৬৩২ ॥

*śrīnaraharidāsa ṭhākura āmāra |*
*biśeṣa kahiba kichu caritra tāṁhāra || 632 ||*

*Word for word:* shri-naraharidasa — Sri Narahari Dasa; thakura amara — my Thakura; vishesha kahiba kichhu — I shall say something in particular; charitra tanhara — of his deeds

**632.** Sri Narahari Dasa is my Thakura:
of his deeds I shall say something in particular.

তাঁহার চরিত্র আমি কি কহিতে জানি ।
আপন বুদ্ধির শক্তি যেই অনুমানি ॥ ৬৩৩ ॥

*tāṁhāra caritra āmi ki kahite jāni |*
*āpana buddhira śakti yei anumāni || 633 ||*

*Word for word:* tanhara charitra — of his deeds; ami ki kahite jani — what can I know how to tell; apana buddhira shakti — by the power of my mind; yei anumani — what I grasp

**633.** What can I know how to tell of his deeds?
[I tell] only what I grasp by the power of my mind.

অভিমান কেহো কিছু না করিহ মনে ।
প্রণতি করিয়ে নিজ গুরুর চরণে ॥ ৬৩৪ ॥

*abhimāna keho kichu nā kariha mane |*
*praṇati kariẏe nija gurura caraṇe || 634 ||*

*Word for word:* abhimana keho kichhu — any resentment, anyone; na kariha mane — let no one keep in mind; pranati kariye — I bow; nija gurura charane — at the feet of my guru

**634.** Let no one harbour any resentment:
I bow at the feet of my own guru,

যাঁর পদ-পরসাদে আমি হেন ছার ।
তোমার ঠাকুর-গুণ কহোঁ তো সভার ॥ ৬৩৫ ॥

*yāṁra pada-parasāde āmi hena chāra |*
*tomāra ṭhākura-guṇa kahoṁ to sabhāra || 635 ||*

*Word for word:* yanra pada-parasade — by the grace of whose feet; ami hena chhara — I, such a wretch; tomara thakura-guna — to you the Lord's virtues; kahon to sabhara — I tell all of you

**635.** by the grace of whose feet I, such a wretch,
tell you all of the Lord's virtues.

শ্রীনরহরিদাস ঠাকুর আমার ।
বৈদ্যকুলে মহাকুল-প্রভাব যাঁহার ॥ ৬৩৬ ॥

*śrīnaraharidāsa ṭhākura āmāra |*
*baidyakule mahākula-prabhāba yāṁhāra || 636 ||*

*Word for word:* shri-naraharidasa — Sri Narahari Dasa; thakura amara — my Thakura; vaidya-kule — in the vaidya lineage; mahakula-prabhava yanhara — whose power is the glory of the clan

**636.** Sri Narahari Dasa is my Thakura,
whose power is the glory of the vaidya lineage.

অনর্গল কৃষ্ণপ্রেম কৃষ্ণময় তনু ।
অনুগত জনে না বুঝায় প্রেম বিনু ॥ ৬৩৭ ॥

*anargala kṛṣṇaprema kṛṣṇamaẏa tanu |*
*anugata jane nā bujhāẏa prema binu || 637 ||*

*Word for word:* anargala krishna-prema — unchecked love for Krishna; krishnamaya tanu — a body full of Krishna; anugata jane — to followers; na bujhaya prema vinu — teaches nothing but prema

**637.** Unchecked is his love for Krishna, his body is full of Krishna;
to his followers he teaches nothing but prema.

অসংখ্য জীবেরে দয়া কাতর হৃদয় ।
কৃষ্ণ-অনুরাগে সদা অস্থির আশয় ॥ ৬৩৮ ॥

*asaṃkhya jībere daẏā kātara hṛdaẏa |*
*kṛṣṇa-anurāge sadā asthira āśaẏa || 638 ||*

*Word for word:* asankhya jivere daya — compassion for countless beings; katara hridaya — an aching heart; krishna-anurage — with love for Krishna; sada asthira ashaya — the soul ever restless

**638.** His heart aches with compassion for countless beings,
his soul is ever restless with love for Krishna.

রাধাকৃষ্ণ-রসে তনু গঢ়িয়াছে যেন ।
ভাবের উদয় হয় যখন যেমন ॥ ৬৩৯ ॥

*rādhākṛṣṇa-rase tanu gaṛhiẏāche yena |*
*bhābera udaẏa haẏa yakhana yemana || 639 ||*

*Word for word:* radha-krishna-rase — of the rasa of Radha and Krishna; tanu gadhiyachhe yena — the body seems moulded; bhavera udaya haya — bhavas arise; yakhana yemana — now this, now that

**639.** His body seems moulded of the rasa of Radha and Krishna:
bhavas rise in him, now this, now that.

রাধাকৃষ্ণ-রসে যাঁর নির্মল কীরিতি ।
শ্রীখণ্ড-ভূখণ্ড-মাঝে যাঁর অবস্থিতি ॥ ৬৪০ ॥

*rādhākṛṣṇa-rase yāṁra nirmala kīriti |*
*śrīkhaṇḍa-bhūkhaṇḍa-mājhe yāṁra abasthiti || 640 ||*

*Word for word:* radha-krishna-rase — in the rasa of Radha and Krishna; yanra nirmala kiriti — his pure fame; shrikhanda-bhukhanda-majhe — in the land of Shrikhanda; yanra avasthiti — his dwelling

**640.** In the rasa of Radha and Krishna lies his pure fame;[^08-15]
he dwells in the land of Shrikhanda.

নরহরি চৈতন্য বলিয়া প্রভুর খ্যাতি ।
সে চরণ বিনু মোর আর নাহি গতি ॥ ৬৪১ ॥

*narahari caitanya baliẏā prabhura khyāti |*
*se caraṇa binu mora āra nāhi gati || 641 ||*

*Word for word:* narahari chaitanya baliya — as "Narahari of Chaitanya"; prabhura khyati — the master is renowned; se charana vinu — apart from those feet; mora ara nahi gati — I have no other refuge

**641.** "Narahari of Chaitanya" — so this master is renowned;
apart from his feet I have no other refuge.

ক্ষণে কৃষ্ণ ক্ষণে রাধা ভাবের আবেশে ।
রাধাকৃষ্ণ-রস মূর্তিমন্ত পরকাশে ॥ ৬৪২ ॥

*kṣaṇe kṛṣṇa kṣaṇe rādhā bhābera ābeśe |*
*rādhākṛṣṇa-rasa mūrtimanta parakāśe || 642 ||*

*Word for word:* kshane krishna kshane radha — now Krishna, now Radha; bhavera aveshe — rapt in the bhavas; radha-krishna-rasa murtimanta — the embodied rasa of Radha and Krishna; parakashe — he displays

**642.** Now Krishna, now Radha — rapt in their bhavas,
he displays the rasa of Radha and Krishna embodied.

চৈতন্য-সম্মত-পথে সে শুদ্ধ বিচার ।
অতুল সরস ভাব সব অবতার ॥ ৬৪৩ ॥

*caitanya-sammata-pathe se śuddha bicāra |*
*atula sarasa bhāba saba abatāra || 643 ||*

*Word for word:* chaitanya-sammata-pathe — on the path approved by Chaitanya; se shuddha vichara — his judgement is pure; atula sarasa bhava — peerless bhavas full of rasa; saba avatara — [as of] all the avataras

**643.** On the path approved by Chaitanya his judgement is pure;
peerless and full of rasa are his bhavas, [as of] all the avataras.

সকল বৈষ্ণবে যোগ্য সম্মান পীরিতি ।
সকল সংসারে যাঁর নির্মল কীরিতি ॥ ৬৪৪ ॥

*sakala baiṣṇabe yogya sammāna pīriti |*
*sakala saṃsāre yāṁra nirmala kīriti || 644 ||*

*Word for word:* sakala vaishnave — to all Vaishnavas; yogya sammana piriti — due honour and love; sakala samsare — in all the world; yanra nirmala kiriti — his pure fame

**644.** To all Vaishnavas due honour and love;
through all the world his pure fame.

বৃন্দাবনে মধুমতী নাম ছিল যাঁর ।
রাধাপ্রিয় সখী তিঁহো মধুর-ভাণ্ডার ॥ ৬৪৫ ॥

*bṛndābane madhumatī nāma chila yāṁra |*
*rādhāpriẏa sakhī tiṁho madhura-bhāṇḍāra || 645 ||*

*Word for word:* vrindavane — in Vrindavana; madhumati nama chhila yanra — whose name was Madhumati; radha-priya sakhi tinho — she was a dear companion of Radha; madhura-bhandara — a treasury of sweetness

**645.** In Vrindavana he was named Madhumati,
a dear companion of Radha, a treasury of sweetness.[^08-16]

এবে কলিকালে গৌরসঙ্গে নরহরি ।
রাধাকৃষ্ণ-প্রেম-ভাণ্ডারে অধিকারী ॥ ৬৪৬ ॥

*ebe kalikāle gaurasaṅge narahari |*
*rādhākṛṣṇa-prema-bhāṇḍāre adhikārī || 646 ||*

*Word for word:* ebe kalikale — now in the Kali age; gaura-sange narahari — Narahari, companion of Gaura; radha-krishna-prema-bhandare — of the treasury of the prema of Radha and Krishna; adhikari — the keeper

**646.** Now, in the Kali age, Narahari, companion of Gaura,
is the keeper of the treasury of the prema of Radha and Krishna.

তাঁর ভ্রাতুষ্পুত্র শ্রীরঘুনন্দন ঠাকুর ।
সকল সংসারে যশঃ ঘোষয়ে প্রচুর ॥ ৬৪৭ ॥

*tāṁra bhrātuṣputra śrīraghunandana ṭhākura |*
*sakala saṃsāre yaśaḥ ghoṣaẏe pracura || 647 ||*

*Word for word:* tanra bhratushputra — his nephew; shri-raghunandana thakura — Sri Raghunandana Thakura; sakala samsare — throughout the world; yashah ghoshaye prachura — widely proclaimed

**647.** His nephew, Sri Raghunandana Thakura,
is widely proclaimed throughout the world.

শ্রীমূর্তিকে লাড়ু খাওয়াইল যেই জন ।
তারে অল্পবুদ্ধি করে কোন মূঢ় জন ॥ ৬৪৮ ॥

*śrīmūrtike lāṛu khāoẏāila yei jana |*
*tāre alpabuddhi kare kona mūṛha jana || 648 ||*

*Word for word:* shri-murtike — the Sri Murti; ladu khavaila — fed a laddu; yei jana — he who; tare alpabuddhi kare — would think him of little understanding; kona mudha jana — what foolish man

**648.** He who fed the Sri Murti a sweet ball (*laddu*) —[^08-17]
what fool would think him of little understanding?

সহজে বৈষ্ণব নহে বর্ণের ভিতর ।
কৃষ্ণসঙ্গে যার কথা সে কৃষ্ণ কেবল ॥ ৬৪৯ ॥

*sahaje baiṣṇaba nahe barṇera bhitara |*
*kṛṣṇasaṅge yāra kathā se kṛṣṇa kebala || 649 ||*

*Word for word:* sahaje vaishnava — a Vaishnava by nature; nahe varnera bhitara — is not within varna; krishna-sange yara katha — whose converse is with Krishna; se krishna kevala — for him Krishna alone

**649.** A Vaishnava by nature is beyond the bounds of varna;
he who converses with Krishna has Krishna alone.[^08-18]

শ্রীমূর্তির সনে কথা যার অনুব্রত ।
তাঁহারে কেমনে জান কেমন মহত্ত্ব ॥ ৬৫০ ॥

*śrīmūrtira sane kathā yāra anubrata |*
*tāṁhāre kemane jāna kemana mahattba || 650 ||*

*Word for word:* shri-murtira sane katha — converse with the Sri Murti; yara anuvrata — whose constant vow; tanhare kemane jana — how can you know him; kemana mahattva — what greatness

**650.** He whose constant vow is converse with the Sri Murti —
how can you know what he is, what his greatness is?

যাহারে চৈতন্য বৈল মোর প্রাণ তুমি ।
প্রকাশ করিলা যারে অভিরাম গোস্বামী ॥ ৬৫১ ॥

*yāhāre caitanya baila mora prāṇa tumi |*
*prakāśa karilā yāre abhirāma gosbāmī || 651 ||*

*Word for word:* yahare chaitanya baila — to whom Chaitanya said; mora prana tumi — you are My life; prakasha karila yare — whom revealed; abhirama gosvami — Abhirama Gosvami

**651.** He to whom Chaitanya said, "You are My life",
whom Abhirama Gosvami revealed,

মদন বলিয়া অবতার জানাইল ।
চৈতন্যের কোলে সভে তেমনি দেখিল ॥ ৬৫২ ॥

*madana baliẏā abatāra jānāila |*
*caitanyera kole sabhe temani dekhila || 652 ||*

*Word for word:* madana baliya — as Madana; avatara janaila — made known [his] avatara; chaitanyera kole — on Chaitanya's lap; sabhe temani dekhila — all saw him so

**652.** making known that he was the avatara of Madana —
and all saw him so on Chaitanya's lap.[^08-19]

কৃষ্ণের আবেশে নৃত্য জগমন মোহে ।
নাহি ভিন্নাভিন্ন সভে সমান সিনেহে ॥ ৬৫৩ ॥

*kṛṣṇera ābeśe nṛtya jagamana mohe |*
*nāhi bhinnābhinna sabhe samāna sinehe || 653 ||*

*Word for word:* krishnera aveshe nritya — dancing rapt in Krishna; jaga-mana mohe — enchants the world's heart; nahi bhinnabhinna — no "mine" and "another's"; sabhe samana sinehe — equal love for all

**653.** When he dances absorbed in Krishna he enchants the world's heart;
he has no "mine" and "another's" — the same love for all.

সর্বদা মধুর বাণী বোলয়ে বদনে ।
সর্বকাল না শুনিল উৎকট কথনে ॥ ৬৫৪ ॥

*sarbadā madhura bāṇī bolaẏe badane |*
*sarbakāla nā śunila utkaṭa kathane || 654 ||*

*Word for word:* sarvada madhura vani — always sweet words; bolaye vadane — his lips speak; sarvakala na shunila — never was heard; utkata kathane — harsh speech

**654.** Always sweet words come from his lips;
no one ever heard a harsh word from him.

চাতুরী মাধুরী লীলা বিলাস লাবণ্য ।
রসময় দেহ তার এ সংসারে ধন্য ॥ ৬৫৫ ॥

*cāturī mādhurī līlā bilāsa lābaṇya |*
*rasamaẏa deha tāra e saṃsāre dhanya || 655 ||*

*Word for word:* chaturi madhuri — skill, sweetness; lila vilasa lavanya — lila, play, loveliness; rasamaya deha tara — his body full of rasa; e samsare dhanya — is blessed in this world

**655.** Skill, sweetness, lila, play, loveliness —
his body, full of rasa, is blessed in this world.

পিতা যাঁর মহামতি শ্রীমুকুন্দদাস ।
চৈতন্য-সম্মত-পথে নির্মল বিশ্বাস ॥ ৬৫৬ ॥

*pitā yāṁra mahāmati śrīmukundadāsa |*
*caitanya-sammata-pathe nirmala biśbāsa || 656 ||*

*Word for word:* pita yanra — whose father; mahamati shri-mukundadasa — the wise Sri Mukunda Dasa; chaitanya-sammata-pathe — on the path approved by Chaitanya; nirmala vishvasa — pure faith

**656.** His father is the wise Sri Mukunda Dasa,
pure in faith on the path approved by Chaitanya.

ময়ূরের পাখা দেখি রাজ-সন্নিধানে ।
পড়িলেন কৃষ্ণরূপ আকর্ষিয়া মনে ॥ ৬৫৭ ॥

*maẏūrera pākhā dekhi rāja-sannidhāne |*
*paṛilena kṛṣṇarūpa ākarṣiẏā mane || 657 ||*

*Word for word:* mayurera pakha dekhi — seeing a peacock feather; raja-sannidhane — in the king's presence; padilena — he fell [senseless]; krishna-rupa akarshiya mane — the form of Krishna drawing his mind

**657.** Seeing a peacock feather in the king's presence,
he fell senseless, the form of Krishna drawing his mind.[^08-20]

কে জানে কেমন রস চৈতন্যের সঙ্গী ।
জানয়ে অনন্ত-আদি যাঁরা অঙ্গ-সঙ্গী ॥ ৬৫৮ ॥

*ke jāne kemana rasa caitanyera saṅgī |*
*jānaẏe ananta-ādi yāṁrā aṅga-saṅgī || 658 ||*

*Word for word:* ke jane — who knows; kemana rasa — what the rasa is; chaitanyera sangi — of Chaitanya's companions; janaye ananta-adi — Ananta and the others know; yanra anga-sangi — His limbs and companions

**658.** Who knows what the rasa of Chaitanya's companions is?
Ananta and the others know it — His limbs and companions.

জীবে কি দেখিতে পায় কৃষ্ণের বৈভব ।
সেই জন দেখে যাতে কৃষ্ণ-অনুভব ॥ ৬৫৯ ॥

*jībe ki dekhite pāẏa kṛṣṇera baibhaba |*
*sei jana dekhe yāte kṛṣṇa-anubhaba || 659 ||*

*Word for word:* jive ki dekhite paya — can a being see; krishnera vaibhava — Krishna's glory; sei jana dekhe — he sees; yate krishna-anubhava — in whom is realization of Krishna

**659.** Can [an ordinary] being see the glory of Krishna?
He alone sees in whom there is realization of Krishna.

কি কহিব আর অস্ত্র-পারিষদ যত ।
পৃথিবী আইলা সভে নাম নিব কত ॥ ৬৬০ ॥

*ki kahiba āra astra-pāriṣada yata |*
*pṛthibī āilā sabhe nāma niba kata || 660 ||*

*Word for word:* ki kahiba ara — what more shall I say; astra-parishada yata — all the warriors and associates; prithivi aila sabhe — all came to earth; nama niba kata — how many shall I name

**660.** What more shall I say? All His warriors and associates
came to earth — how many shall I name?

সমুদ্রের জল যবে কলসে পরিমাণি ।
পৃথিবীর রেণু যবে একে একে গণি ॥ ৬৬১ ॥

*samudrera jala yabe kalase parimāṇi |*
*pṛthibīra reṇu yabe eke eke gaṇi || 661 ||*

*Word for word:* samudrera jala — the water of the ocean; yabe kalase parimani — if I measure with a pitcher; prithivira renu — the dust of the earth; yabe eke eke gani — if I count grain by grain

**661.** If I could measure the water of the ocean with a pitcher,
if I could count the dust of the earth grain by grain,

আকাশের তারা যবে গণিবারে পারি ।
তভু গোরা-অবতার লেখিবারে নারি ॥ ৬৬২ ॥

*ākāśera tārā yabe gaṇibāre pāri |*
*tabhu gorā-abatāra lekhibāre nāri || 662 ||*

*Word for word:* akashera tara — the stars of the sky; yabe ganibare pari — if I can count; tabhu gora-avatara — still the avatara of Gora; lekhibare nari — I cannot describe

**662.** if I could count the stars of the sky —
still I could not describe the avatara of Gora.

মুঞি অতি অল্পবুদ্ধি কি কহিব আর ।
মূরুখ হইয়া করোঁ বেদের বিচার ॥ ৬৬৩ ॥

*muñi ati alpabuddhi ki kahiba āra |*
*mūrukha haiẏā karoṁ bedera bicāra || 663 ||*

*Word for word:* munji ati alpabuddhi — I am very small of mind; ki kahiba ara — what more shall I say; murukha haiya — being a fool; karon vedera vichara — I reason on the Vedas

**663.** I am very small of mind — what more shall I say?
A fool, I venture to reason on the Vedas.

অন্ধ যেন দৃষ্টিহীন দিব্য রত্ন চাহে ।
খর্ব যেন চাঁদ ধরিবারে মেলে বাহে ॥ ৬৬৪ ॥

*andha yena dṛṣṭihīna dibya ratna cāhe |*
*kharba yena cāṁda dharibāre mele bāhe || 664 ||*

*Word for word:* andha yena drishtihina — as a blind man without sight; divya ratna chahe — wants a divine jewel; kharva yena — as a dwarf; chanda dharibare mele bahe — stretches his arms to catch the moon

**664.** As a blind man without sight wants to see a divine jewel,
as a dwarf stretches out his arms to catch the moon,

পঙ্গু মহী লঙ্ঘিবারে করে অহঙ্কার ।
ক্ষুদ্র পিপীলিকা গিরি চাহে বহিবার ॥ ৬৬৫ ॥

*paṅgu mahī laṅghibāre kare ahaṅkāra |*
*kṣudra pipīlikā giri cāhe bahibāra || 665 ||*

*Word for word:* pangu — a lame man; mahi langhibare — to stride across the earth; kare ahankara — boasts; kshudra pipilika — a tiny ant; giri chahe vahibara — wants to carry a mountain

**665.** as a lame man boasts that he will stride across the earth,
as a tiny ant wants to carry a mountain —

এছন হৃদয়ে আশ বিলাস আমার ।
গোরা-অবতার-কথন করিতে প্রচার ॥ ৬৬৬ ॥

*echana hṛdaẏe āśa bilāsa āmāra |*
*gorā-abatāra-kathana karite pracāra || 666 ||*

*Word for word:* aichhana hridaye — thus in my heart; asha vilasa amara — my desire has arisen; gora-avatara-kathana — the tale of the avatara of Gora; karite prachara — to proclaim

**666.** such a desire has arisen in my heart:
to proclaim the tale of the avatara of Gora.

করজোড় করি বোলোঁ শুন সর্বজন ।
বাচাল করয়ে গোরা এ মূকজন ॥ ৬৬৭ ॥

*karajoṛa kari boloṁ śuna sarbajana |*
*bācāla karaẏe gorā e mūkajana || 667 ||*

*Word for word:* karajoda kari — with joined palms; bolon shuna sarvajana — I say: listen, all; vachala karaye gora — Gora makes eloquent; e muka-jana — this mute one

**667.** With joined palms I say: listen, all!
Gora makes this mute one eloquent.

নির্জিহ্ব কহয়ে সে প্রকট চাটুবাণী ।
না পঢ়ি মূরুখ কহে ব্রহ্মের কাহিনী ॥ ৬৬৮ ॥

*nirjihba kahaẏe se prakaṭa cāṭubāṇī |*
*nā paṛhi mūrukha kahe brahmera kāhinī || 668 ||*

*Word for word:* nirjihva — the tongueless; kahaye se prakata chatu-vani — speaks clear, sweet words; na padhi murukha — the unlettered fool; kahe brahmera kahini — tells the tale of Brahman

**668.** The tongueless speaks clear and sweet words,
the unlettered fool tells the tale of Brahman.

পৃথিবী জনমি মহা মহা ভাগবত ।
কৃষ্ণের গোপত কথা করয়ে বেকত ॥ ৬৬৯ ॥

*pṛthibī janami mahā mahā bhāgabata |*
*kṛṣṇera gopata kathā karaẏe bekata || 669 ||*

*Word for word:* prithivi janami — born on earth; maha maha bhagavata — great, great devotees; krishnera gopata katha — Krishna's secret words; karaye bekata — make manifest

**669.** Great, great devotees, born on earth,
make manifest the secret words of Krishna.

অকারণে করুণা করয়ে সর্বজীবে ।
মাতা যেন দুরন্ত তনয় পরিষেবে ॥ ৬৭০ ॥

*akāraṇe karuṇā karaẏe sarbajībe |*
*mātā yena duranta tanaẏa pariṣebe || 670 ||*

*Word for word:* akarane — without cause; karuna karaye sarvajive — are merciful to all beings; mata yena — as a mother; duranta tanaya parisheve — nurses a wayward son

**670.** Without cause they are merciful to all beings,
as a mother nurses a wayward son.

এছন প্রভুর দয়া দেখিয়া অগাধ ।
অধম হইয়া অমৃতের করোঁ সাধ ॥ ৬৭১ ॥

*echana prabhura daẏā dekhiẏā agādha |*
*adhama haiẏā amṛtera karoṁ sādha || 671 ||*

*Word for word:* aichhana prabhura daya — such mercy of the Lord; dekhiya agadha — seeing boundless; adhama haiya — though low; amritera karon sadha — I long for nectar

**671.** Seeing such boundless mercy of the Lord,
I, though low, long for nectar.

শ্রীনরহরিদাসের দয়াময় দেহে ।
পাতকী দেখিয়া দয়া অবাধ সিনেহে ॥ ৬৭২ ॥

*śrīnaraharidāsera daẏāmaẏa dehe |*
*pātakī dekhiẏā daẏā abādha sinehe || 672 ||*

*Word for word:* shri-naraharidasera — of Sri Narahari Dasa; dayamaya dehe — whose body is mercy; pataki dekhiya — seeing a sinner; daya avadha sinehe — boundless mercy and love

**672.** Sri Narahari Dasa, whose body is mercy itself,
seeing a sinner, has boundless mercy and love.

দুরন্ত পাতকী অন্ধ অতি দুরাচারে ।
অনাথ দেখিয়া দয়া করিল আমারে ॥ ৬৭৩ ॥

*duranta pātakī andha ati durācāre |*
*anātha dekhiẏā daẏā karila āmāre || 673 ||*

*Word for word:* duranta pataki — an incorrigible sinner; andha ati durachare — blind, of evil conduct; anatha dekhiya — seeing helpless; daya karila amare — showed mercy to me

**673.** Me, an incorrigible sinner, blind, of evil conduct,
seeing me helpless, he showed mercy.

তাঁর দয়াবলে আর বৈষ্ণব-প্রসাদে ।
এই ভরসায় পুথি হইবে অবাধে ॥ ৬৭৪ ॥

*tāṁra daẏābale āra baiṣṇaba-prasāde |*
*ei bharasāẏa puthi haibe abādhe || 674 ||*

*Word for word:* tanra daya-bale — by the power of his mercy; ara vaishnava-prasade — and by the grace of the Vaishnavas; ei bharasaya — trusting in this; puthi haibe avadhe — the book will be done without hindrance

**674.** By the power of his mercy and by the grace of the Vaishnavas —
in this I trust — the book will be completed without hindrance.

করজোড় করি বোলে কাতর-বয়ানে ।
আত্ম নিবেদিয়ে মুঞি বৈষ্ণবচরণে ॥ ৬৭৫ ॥

*karajoṛa kari bole kātara-baẏāne |*
*ātma nibediẏe muñi baiṣṇabacaraṇe || 675 ||*

*Word for word:* karajoda kari — with joined palms; bole katara-bayane — says in a humble voice; atma nivediye munji — I give myself; vaishnava-charane — to the feet of the Vaishnavas

**675.** With joined palms I say in a humble voice:
I give myself to the feet of the Vaishnavas.

মোর অধিক অধম নাহিক মহী-মাঝে ।
বৈষ্ণবের কৃপাবলে সিদ্ধি হউক কাজে ॥ ৬৭৬ ॥

*mora adhika adhama nāhika mahī-mājhe |*
*baiṣṇabera kṛpābale siddhi hauka kāje || 676 ||*

*Word for word:* mora adhika adhama — lower than I; nahika mahi-majhe — there is none on earth; vaishnavera kripa-bale — by the power of the Vaishnavas' mercy; siddhi hauka kaje — may the work succeed

**676.** There is no one on earth lower than I;
by the power of the Vaishnavas' mercy may the work succeed.

দশনে ধরিয়া তৃণ এ লোচনদাস ।
প্রণতি মিনতি করে পূর মোর আশ ॥ ৬৭৭ ॥

*daśane dhariẏā tṛṇa e locanadāsa |*
*praṇati minati kare pūra mora āśa || 677 ||*

*Word for word:* dashane dhariya trina — holding a straw between the teeth; e lochanadasa — this Lochana Dasa; pranati minati kare — bows and entreats; pura mora asha — fulfil my hope

**677.** Holding a straw between his teeth, this Lochana Dasa
bows and entreats: fulfil my hope!

সূত্রখণ্ড সায় পুথি শুন সর্বজন ।
অবতার আদিখণ্ডে কহিব এখন ॥ ৬৭৮ ॥

*sūtrakhaṇḍa sāẏa puthi śuna sarbajana |*
*abatāra ādikhaṇḍe kahiba ekhana || 678 ||*

*Word for word:* sutrakhanda saya puthi — the book of the Sutra-khanda is ended; shuna sarvajana — listen, all; avatara — of the descent; adikhande kahiba ekhana — now I shall tell in the Adi-khanda

**678.** The book of the Sutra-khanda is ended — listen, all:
now in the Adi-khanda I shall tell of the descent.

সূত্রকথা সায় এবে প্রেমের বিলাস ।
আনন্দ হৃদয়ে কহে এ লোচনদাস ॥ ৬৭৯ ॥

*sūtrakathā sāẏa ebe premera bilāsa |*
*ānanda hṛdaẏe kahe e locanadāsa || 679 ||*

*Word for word:* sutra-katha saya — the telling of the "sutra" is ended; ebe premera vilasa — now the pastimes of prema; ananda hridaye — with joy in heart; kahe e lochanadasa — says this Lochana Dasa

**679.** The telling of the "sutra" is ended; now come the pastimes of prema —
with joy in his heart says this Lochana Dasa.

*Thus ends the Sutra-khanda of the* Sri Chaitanya-mangala *composed by Sri Lochana Dasa Thakura.*

[^08-1]: Narada, the Lord's eternal associate, speaks thus out of humility, as a devotee who longs for service.
[^08-2]: In the 1983 edition line 1 reads: "Go, Narada: in Shvetadvipa I abide." Balarama is the Lord's second body; according to Gaudiya teaching, from Him (as Sankarshana) come Ananta-Shesha, and Shiva with the Rudras (*Chaitanya-charitamrita*, Adi 5).
[^08-3]: Cf. *Bhagavad-gita* 4.8.
[^08-4]: The line is damaged in A ("ধরিয়া ব্রণী-কোডি"); after the 1983 edition, "leaning on the earth".
[^08-5]: Probably the three abodes of the Purusha-avataras — Karanodakashayi, Garbhodakashayi and Kshirodakashayi Vishnu — who, according to the *Chaitanya-charitamrita* (Adi 5), are expansions of Sankarshana-Balarama.
[^08-6]: "Mountain of nectar" after the 1903 edition ("অমৃত-পর্বত"); in A and the 1983 edition the first word is corrupt.
[^08-7]: Cf. *Chaitanya-charitamrita* (Adi 4.55 ff.): Krishna appears as Gaura, taking the bhava and lustre of Radha, to taste Her love.
[^08-8]: Lochana Dasa calls Advaita an avatara of Mahesha (Shiva). According to the *Chaitanya-charitamrita* (Adi 6.4–27) Advaita is Maha-Vishnu and also Sada-Shiva; Bhaktisiddhanta in the summary of this section says: "Shiva [appears] as Advaita Prabhu."
[^08-9]: The line admits two readings: *parakrita* (Sanskrit "rejected, set aside") — tamo-guna is set aside in him; or *prakrita* ("worldly") — the worldly tamo-guna [appears only] among his outward qualities. The thought is the same in either case: Shiva (and Advaita) is not under the sway of tamas; cf. *Bhag.* 12.13.16: "Shambhu is the best of Vaishnavas."
[^08-10]: Nityananda's father is usually called Hadai Pandita (Hadai Ojha), and His mother Padmavati. The name "Paramananda" is Lochana Dasa's.
[^08-11]: The 1983 edition has "with renunciation in His heart — Nityananda of wondrous deeds". The name "Kuvera Pandita" is found only in Lochana Dasa.
[^08-12]: Probably Gopinatha Acharya, Sarvabhauma's brother-in-law, and Kashi Mishra, in whose house the Lord lived at Puri; the line can also be read as one person: "Kashi Mishra Thakura, named Gopinatha".
[^08-13]: Cf. the *Chaitanya-charitamrita* (Adi 11) and the *Gaura-ganoddesha-dipika*: the twelve gopalas are cowherd boys of Vraja who appeared as associates of Nityananda (among them Abhirama, Sundarananda, Gauridasa Pandita, Kala Krishnadasa, Purushottama, Kamalakara, Uddharana Datta, Parameshvara Dasa and others).
[^08-14]: The sense is unclear: perhaps Damodara Pandita and his brothers (so in A and in the 1983 edition).
[^08-15]: In A the beginning of the line is corrupt ("ক্ষণে…"); in the 1983 edition stanzas 640–644 are in a different order and lack the second line of v. 641.
[^08-16]: So also the *Gaura-ganoddesha-dipika* (177): Narahari Sarakara is Madhumati, a companion of Radha in Vraja.
[^08-17]: A well-known tradition: the boy Raghunandana, entrusted by his father with the worship, persuaded the Deity of Gopinatha at Shrikhanda to eat a laddu, and the Deity ate it.
[^08-18]: The line also admits the reading "he is Krishna himself"; we follow the understanding consistent with Gaudiya teaching: the devotee does not become Krishna, but for him there is Krishna alone.
[^08-19]: Abhirama Thakura (Ramadasa), one of the twelve gopalas, is said to have recognized the Lord's eternal associates in people. "Madana" is Kamadeva; according to the *Gaura-ganoddesha-dipika* Raghunandana is Pradyumna (Kandarpa) of Dvaraka.
[^08-20]: Cf. *Chaitanya-charitamrita* (Madhya 15.121–125): Mukunda Dasa, a court physician, on seeing a fan of peacock feathers above the king's head, remembered Krishna and fell senseless.

# Adi-khanda, part 1 (portion 09)

*The beginning of the Adi-khanda: the Lord enters Shachi's womb; Advaita Acharya worships Shachi's womb; the praises of the gods; Gaura's appearance on the full moon of Phalguna during an eclipse; the infant's form and marks; the rapture of the people of Nadia; the name Nimai, the festivals of the eighth and ninth days; the beginning of the Balya-lila*

## Janma-lila (The Birth)

> *Summary by Srila Bhaktisiddhanta Sarasvati.* In this khanda first of all the appearance on earth of the transcendental Sri Gaurahari is described. He who is the original cause of all causes, Parabrahman Narayana, appeared in the womb of Shachi. As her womb grew day by day, so day by day the lustre of her body increased. Seeing the wondrous lustre of her body, all were amazed and concluded: "Surely some great personage has appeared in Shachi's womb." When six months were complete, one day Advaita Acharya Prabhu came to the house of Shachi and Jagannatha, bowed to Shachi's womb and circumambulated it; the reason for this neither Shachi nor Jagannatha could then understand. On some days Shachi-devi saw Brahma, Shiva and the other gods come before her womb, offer praise and pray to the Lord, who gives prema even to chandalas, for the love never given before; and in bliss her heart was filled with compassion for all beings. Gradually ten months were completed. Then, on the full moon of Phalguna, on the pretext of an eclipse, accompanied by the sankirtana of Hari's name, Bhagavan Gaurachandra descended to earth from the ocean of Shachi's womb; the ten directions were filled with bliss, and gods and goddesses, men and women, all longing to see the moon-like face of Shachi's son, came to Shachi's house; at that time her house became Vaikuntha. Jagannatha Mishra and the men and women of Nadia (who had come to see) were all amazed to see on the lotus feet of the child — with a lion's neck, an elephant's shoulders and a broad chest — the marks of the flag, the thunderbolt and the goad, and various superhuman marks on His other limbs; all concluded that this child was surely not human. Then are described the distribution of the eight kinds of pulses on the eighth day, the festival on the ninth, and the one-pointed love of the neighbours, men and women, for [Shachi's] son.

*Raga dhanashi; disha: "Glory to Narahari and Gadadhara, the Lords of my life! Cast, O Lord, an auspicious glance upon living beings! Lord Gorachand — glory, glory!"*[^09-1]

জয় জয় গদাধর গৌরাঙ্গ নরহরি ।
জয় জয় নিত্যানন্দ সর্বশক্তিধারী ॥ ১ ॥

*jaẏa jaẏa gadādhara gaurāṅga narahari |*
*jaẏa jaẏa nityānanda sarbaśaktidhārī || 1 ||*

*Word for word:* jaya jaya — glory, glory; gadadhara gauranga narahari — to Gadadhara, Gauranga, Narahari; nityananda — to Nityananda; sarva-shakti-dhari — bearer of all energies

**1.** Glory, glory to Gadadhara, Gauranga and Narahari!
Glory, glory to Nityananda, the bearer of all energies!

জয় জয় অদ্বৈত-আচার্য মহেশ্বর ।
জয় জয় গৌরাঙ্গের ভক্ত মহাবর ॥ ২ ॥

*jaẏa jaẏa adbaita-ācārya maheśbara |*
*jaẏa jaẏa gaurāṅgera bhakta mahābara || 2 ||*

*Word for word:* jaya jaya advaita-acharya maheshvara — glory to Advaita Acharya, Maheshvara; jaya jaya gaurangera bhakta mahavara — glory to the great devotees of Gauranga

**2.** Glory, glory to Advaita Acharya, Maheshvara!
Glory, glory to the great devotees of Gauranga!

সভার চরণধূলি মস্তকে ধরিয়া ।
আদিখণ্ড-কথা কহি শুন মন দিয়া ॥ ৩ ॥

*sabhāra caraṇadhūli mastake dhariẏā |*
*ādikhaṇḍa-kathā kahi śuna mana diẏā || 3 ||*

*Word for word:* sabhara charana-dhuli — the dust of the feet of all; mastake dhariya — placing on my head; adikhanda-katha kahi — I tell the story of the Adi-khanda; shuna mana diya — listen attentively

**3.** Placing on my head the dust of the feet of all,
I tell the story of the Adi-khanda — listen attentively.

সর্ব নিজজন যবে জনম লভিল ।
সাজ সাজ বলি শব্দ ঘোষণা পড়িল ॥ ৪ ॥

*sarba nijajana yabe janama labhila |*
*sāja sāja bali śabda ghoṣaṇā paṛila || 4 ||*

*Word for word:* sarva nijajana — all His own; yabe janama labhila — when they took birth; saja saja bali — "make ready, make ready!"; shabda ghoshana padila — the cry was proclaimed

**4.** When all His own had taken birth,
the cry rang out: "Make ready, make ready!"

পৃথিবী চলিব আর নাহিক বিলম্ব ।
আপনি ঠাকুর শচীগর্ভে অবলম্ব ॥ ৫ ॥

*pṛthibī caliba āra nāhika bilamba |*
*āpani ṭhākura śacīgarbhe abalamba || 5 ||*

*Word for word:* prithivi chaliba — I go to earth; ara nahika vilamba — no more delay; apani thakura — the Lord Himself; shachi-garbhe avalamba — took shelter in Shachi's womb

**5.** "I go to earth, there must be no more delay" —
and the Lord Himself took shelter in Shachi's womb.

জয় জয় শব্দ হৈল ব্রহ্মাণ্ড ভরিয়া ।
দেব নাগ নর দেখে প্রেমাবিষ্ট হঞা ॥ ৬ ॥

*jaẏa jaẏa śabda haila brahmāṇḍa bhariẏā |*
*deba nāga nara dekhe premābiṣṭa hañā || 6 ||*

*Word for word:* jaya jaya shabda haila — cries of "jaya, jaya" arose; brahmanda bhariya — filling the universe; deva naga nara dekhe — gods, nagas and men look on; premavishta hana — overcome with prema

**6.** Cries of "Jaya, jaya!" filled the universe;
gods, nagas and men look on, overcome with prema.

কেহো যারে বোলে জ্যোতির্ময় সনাতন ।
কেহো যারে বোলে সূক্ষ্ম স্থূল নারায়ণ ॥ ৭ ॥

*keho yāre bole jyotirmaẏa sanātana |*
*keho yāre bole sūkṣma sthūla nārāẏaṇa || 7 ||*

*Word for word:* keho yare bole — whom some call; jyotirmaya sanatana — the eternal Effulgence; keho yare bole — whom others call; sukshma sthula narayana — Narayana, subtle and gross

**7.** He whom some call the eternal Effulgence,
whom others call Narayana, subtle and gross,

কেহো যারে বোলে স্থূল সূক্ষ্ম পরব্রহ্ম ।
সে জন করিল শচীগর্ভে অবলম্ব ॥ ৮ ॥

*keho yāre bole sthūla sūkṣma parabrahma |*
*se jana karila śacīgarbhe abalamba || 8 ||*

*Word for word:* keho yare bole — whom others call; sthula sukshma parabrahma — Parabrahman, gross and subtle; se jana — He; karila shachi-garbhe avalamba — took shelter in Shachi's womb

**8.** whom others call Parabrahman, gross and subtle —
He took shelter in Shachi's womb.

তেজোময় বায়ুরূপ গর্ভ বাঢ়ে নিতি ।
দেখিয়া ত সর্বলোকের বাঢ়য়ে পীরিতি ॥ ৯ ॥

*tejomaẏa bāẏurūpa garbha bāṛhe niti |*
*dekhiẏā ta sarbalokera bāṛhaẏe pīriti || 9 ||*

*Word for word:* tejomaya — radiant; vayu-rupa — airlike; garbha badhe niti — the burden of the womb grows daily; dekhiya ta — seeing it; sarvalokera badhaye piriti — the love of all people grows

**9.** Radiant, airlike,[^09-2] the burden of the womb grows daily;
seeing it, the love of all people grows.

এক দুই তিন চারি পাঁচ ছয় মাসে ।
শচীর উদরে মহানন্দ পরকাশে ॥ ১০ ॥

*eka dui tina cāri pāṁca chaẏa māse |*
*śacīra udare mahānanda parakāśe || 10 ||*

*Word for word:* eka dui tina chari pancha chhaya mase — one, two, three, four, five, six months; shachira udare — in Shachi's womb; mahananda parakashe — great bliss reveals itself

**10.** One, two, three, four, five, six months —
in Shachi's womb great bliss reveals itself.

দিনে দিনে তেজঃ বাঢ়ে শচীর শরীরে ।
দেখিয়া সকল লোক হরিষ অন্তরে ॥ ১১ ॥

*dine dine tejaḥ bāṛhe śacīra śarīre |*
*dekhiẏā sakala loka hariṣa antare || 11 ||*

*Word for word:* dine dine — day by day; tejah badhe shachira sharire — the radiance of Shachi's body grows; dekhiya sakala loka — seeing it, all people; harisha antare — rejoice at heart

**11.** Day by day the radiance of Shachi's body grows;
seeing it, all the people rejoice at heart.

না জানিয়ে কোন জন আইল শচীর ঘরে ।
ঘরে ঘরে এই মনে সভাই বিচারে ॥ ১২ ॥

*nā jāniẏe kona jana āila śacīra ghare |*
*ghare ghare ei mane sabhāi bicāre || 12 ||*

*Word for word:* na janiye — we do not know; kona jana aila shachira ghare — who has come into Shachi's house; ghare ghare — in every house; ei mane sabhai vichare — so all ponder

**12.** "We do not know who has come into Shachi's house" —
so in every house all are pondering.

ছয় মাস পূর্ণ হৈলে শচীর উদর ।
অঙ্গের ছটায় ঝলমল করে ঘর ॥ ১৩ ॥

*chaẏa māsa pūrṇa haile śacīra udara |*
*aṅgera chaṭāẏa jhalamala kare ghara || 13 ||*

*Word for word:* chhaya masa purna haile — when six months were complete; shachira udara — of Shachi's womb; angera chhataya — with the splendour of her body; jhalamala kare ghara — the house shone

**13.** When six months of Shachi's womb were complete,
the house shone with the splendour of her body.

হেনই সময়ে এক অদ্ভুত কথা ।
আচম্বিতে অদ্বৈত-আচার্য আইলা তথা ॥ ১৪ ॥

*henai samaẏe eka adbhuta kathā |*
*ācambite adbaita-ācārya āilā tathā || 14 ||*

*Word for word:* henai samaye — at that time; eka adbhuta katha — a wondrous event; achambite — suddenly; advaita-acharya aila tatha — Advaita Acharya came there

**14.** At that time a wondrous thing took place:
suddenly Advaita Acharya came there.

ঘরে বসি আছে জগন্নাথ দ্বিজবর্য ।
সম্ভ্রমে উঠিলা দেখি অদ্বৈত-আচার্য ॥ ১৫ ॥

*ghare basi āche jagannātha dbijabarya |*
*sambhrame uṭhilā dekhi adbaita-ācārya || 15 ||*

*Word for word:* ghare basi achhe — sat in the house; jagannatha dvijavarya — Jagannatha, best of the twice-born; sambhrame uthila — rose respectfully; dekhi advaita-acharya — seeing Advaita Acharya

**15.** In the house sat Jagannatha, best of the twice-born;
seeing Advaita Acharya, he rose respectfully.

অদ্বৈত-আচার্য গোসাঞি সর্বগুণধাম ।
ত্রিজগতে ধন্য তাঁর নাহিক উপাম ॥ ১৬ ॥

*adbaita-ācārya gosāñi sarbaguṇadhāma |*
*trijagate dhanya tāṁra nāhika upāma || 16 ||*

*Word for word:* advaita-acharya gosani — Advaita Acharya Gosani; sarva-guna-dhama — abode of all virtues; trijagate dhanya — blessed in the three worlds; tanra nahika upama — He has no equal

**16.** Advaita Acharya Gosani is the abode of all virtues,
blessed in the three worlds, without equal.

দেখি মিশ্র পুরন্দর বড়ই সম্ভ্রমে ।
বসিতে আসন আনি দিলেন আপনে ॥ ১৭ ॥

*dekhi miśra purandara baṛai sambhrame |*
*basite āsana āni dilena āpane || 17 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhi — seeing; mishra purandara — Mishra Purandara; badai sambhrame — with great respect; basite asana ani — bringing a seat to sit on; dilena apane — himself offered

**17.** Seeing Him, Mishra Purandara with great respect
himself brought a seat for Him to sit on,

চরণের ধূলি লৈল মস্তক উপর ।
সম্ভ্রমে আচার্য কৈল বিনয় বিস্তর ॥ ১৮ ॥

*caraṇera dhūli laila mastaka upara |*
*sambhrame ācārya kaila binaẏa bistara || 18 ||*

*Word for word:* charanera dhuli laila — took the dust of the feet; mastaka upara — upon his head; sambhrame — abashed; acharya kaila vinaya vistara — the Acharya showed much humility

**18.** and placed the dust of His feet on his head;
the Acharya, abashed, showed much humility.

পাদপ্রক্ষালনে জল দিল শচীদেবী ।
শচী দেখি সম্ভ্রমে উঠিলা অনুরাগী ॥ ১৯ ॥

*pādaprakṣālane jala dila śacīdebī |*
*śacī dekhi sambhrame uṭhilā anurāgī || 19 ||*

*Word for word:* pada-prakshalane — for washing the feet; jala dila shachidevi — Shachi-devi gave water; shachi dekhi — seeing Shachi; sambhrame uthila anuragi — full of love, He rose respectfully

**19.** Shachi-devi gave water to wash His feet;
seeing Shachi, He, full of love, rose respectfully.

অনুরাগে রাঙ্গা দুই কমললোচন ।
বাষ্প ঝলমল আঁখি অরুণ বদন ॥ ২০ ॥

*anurāge rāṅgā dui kamalalocana |*
*bāṣpa jhalamala āṁkhi aruṇa badana || 20 ||*

*Word for word:* anurage — with love; ranga dui kamala-lochana — the two lotus eyes red; bashpa jhalamala ankhi — eyes brimming with tears; aruna vadana — face flushed

**20.** With love His two lotus eyes grew red,
His eyes brimmed with tears, His face was flushed,

সকম্প অধর গদগদ কণ্ঠস্বর ।
ধরিতে না পারে অঙ্গ করে টলমল ॥ ২১ ॥

*sakampa adhara gadagada kaṇṭhasbara |*
*dharite nā pāre aṅga kare ṭalamala || 21 ||*

*Word for word:* sakampa adhara — trembling lips; gadgada kanthasvara — faltering voice; dharite na pare anga — cannot hold His body; kare talamala — staggers

**21.** His lips trembled, His voice faltered;
He could not hold His body steady — He staggered.

শচী প্রদক্ষিণ করি করে পরণাম ।
চমকিত শচীদেবী দেখি অবিধান ॥ ২২ ॥

*śacī pradakṣiṇa kari kare paraṇāma |*
*camakita śacīdebī dekhi abidhāna || 22 ||*

*Word for word:* shachi pradakshina kari — circumambulating Shachi; kare paranama — bows; chamakita shachidevi — Shachi-devi started; dekhi avidhana — seeing the breach of custom

**22.** Circumambulating Shachi, He bows to her;
Shachi-devi started, seeing this breach of custom.[^09-3]

জগন্নাথ সসন্দেহ শচী সবিস্মিতা ।
কি কর কি কর বোলে হৃদয়ে দুঃখিতা ॥ ২৩ ॥

*jagannātha sasandeha śacī sabismitā |*
*ki kara ki kara bole hṛdaẏe duḥkhitā || 23 ||*

*Word for word:* jagannatha sasandeha — Jagannatha perplexed; shachi savismita — Shachi amazed; ki kara ki kara bole — "what are you doing?" she says; hridaye duhkhita — pained at heart

**23.** Jagannatha is perplexed, Shachi amazed:
"What are you doing, what are you doing?" she says, pained at heart.

জগন্নাথ বোলে শুন আচার্য গোসাঞি ।
তোমার চরিত্র কেহো বুঝিবারে নাঞি ॥ ২৪ ॥

*jagannātha bole śuna ācārya gosāñi |*
*tomāra caritra keho bujhibāre nāñi || 24 ||*

*Word for word:* jagannatha bole — Jagannatha says; shuna acharya gosani — listen, Acharya Gosani; tomara charitra — Your conduct; keho bujhibare nani — no one can understand

**24.** Jagannatha says: "Listen, Acharya Gosani:
no one can understand Your conduct.

দয়া করি কহ যদি ঘুচাও সন্দেহ ।
নহে বা এ চিন্তা-অগ্নি পোড়াইবে দেহ ॥ ২৫ ॥

*daẏā kari kaha yadi ghucāo sandeha |*
*nahe bā e cintā-agni poṛāibe deha || 25 ||*

*Word for word:* daya kari kaha — be kind and tell; yadi ghuchao sandeha — dispel the doubt; nahe va — or else; e chinta-agni podaibe deha — this fire of anxiety will burn the body

**25.** Be kind and tell us, dispel our doubt,
or else the fire of this anxiety will burn my body."

আচার্য কহিল শুন মিশ্র পুরন্দর ।
জানিবে সকল পাছে কহিল উত্তর ॥ ২৬ ॥

*ācārya kahila śuna miśra purandara |*
*jānibe sakala pāche kahila uttara || 26 ||*

*Word for word:* acharya kahila — the Acharya said; shuna mishra purandara — listen, Mishra Purandara; janibe sakala pachhe — later you will know all; kahila uttara — He answered

**26.** The Acharya said: "Listen, Mishra Purandara:
later you will know everything" — such was His answer.

পুলকিত সব অঙ্গ জানিঞা সন্দর্ভ ।
গন্ধ-চন্দনেতে লেপে শচীর শ্রীগর্ভ ॥ ২৭ ॥

*pulakita saba aṅga jāniñā sandarbha |*
*gandha-candanete lepe śacīra śrīgarbha || 27 ||*

*Word for word:* pulakita saba anga — the whole body thrilling; janina sandarbha — knowing the matter; gandha-chandanete lepe — anoints with fragrant sandal; shachira shri-garbha — Shachi's holy womb

**27.** His whole body thrilled: knowing the matter,
He anointed Shachi's holy womb with fragrant sandal,

সাত প্রদক্ষিণ করি করে পরণাম ।
না কিছু কহিলা গেলা আপনার স্থান ॥ ২৮ ॥

*sāta pradakṣiṇa kari kare paraṇāma |*
*nā kichu kahilā gelā āpanāra sthāna || 28 ||*

*Word for word:* sata pradakshina kari — circumambulating seven times; kare paranama — bows; na kichhu kahila — saying nothing; gela apanara sthana — went to His own place

**28.** circumambulated [her] seven times, bowed down,
and without saying anything went to His own place.

এথা শচী জগন্নাথ মনে অনুমানে ।
মোর গর্ভবন্দনা করিলা কি কারণে ॥ ২৯ ॥

*ethā śacī jagannātha mane anumāne |*
*mora garbhabandanā karilā ki kāraṇe || 29 ||*

*Word for word:* etha — here; shachi jagannatha — Shachi and Jagannatha; mane anumane — ponder in their minds; mora garbha-vandana — worship of my womb; karila ki karane — why did He do

**29.** Here Shachi and Jagannatha ponder:
"Why did He worship my womb?"

আচার্য-গোসাঞি কৈল গর্ভের বন্দনা ।
শতগুণ তেজ শচী পাসরে আপনা ॥ ৩০ ॥

*ācārya-gosāñi kaila garbhera bandanā |*
*śataguṇa teja śacī pāsare āpanā || 30 ||*

*Word for word:* acharya-gosani kaila — Acharya Gosani performed; garbhera vandana — worship of the womb; shataguna teja — a hundredfold radiance; shachi pasare apana — Shachi forgets herself

**30.** Acharya Gosani worshipped the womb —
and Shachi's radiance grew a hundredfold; she forgets herself.

সব সুখময় দেখে না দেখয়ে দুঃখ ।
সব দেবগণ দেখে আপনা-সম্মুখ ॥ ৩১ ॥

*saba sukhamaẏa dekhe nā dekhaẏe duḥkha |*
*saba debagaṇa dekhe āpanā-sammukha || 31 ||*

*Word for word:* saba sukhamaya dekhe — sees all as joy; na dekhaye duhkha — sees no sorrow; saba devagana dekhe — sees all the gods; apana-sammukha — before her

**31.** She sees all as joy, sees no sorrow;
she sees all the gods before her.

ব্রহ্মা শিব সনকাদি যত দেবগণ ।
উদর সম্মুখ করি করয়ে স্তবন ॥ ৩২ ॥

*brahmā śiba sanakādi yata debagaṇa |*
*udara sammukha kari karaẏe stabana || 32 ||*

*Word for word:* brahma shiva sanakadi — Brahma, Shiva, Sanaka and the rest; yata devagana — all the gods; udara sammukha kari — facing the womb; karaye stavana — offer praise

**32.** Brahma, Shiva, Sanaka and the others — all the gods,
facing her womb, offer praise:

জয় জয় অনন্ত অদ্বৈত সনাতন ।
জয়াচ্যুতানন্দ নিত্যানন্দ জনার্দন ॥ ৩৩ ॥

*jaẏa jaẏa ananta adbaita sanātana |*
*jaẏācyutānanda nityānanda janārdana || 33 ||*

*Word for word:* jaya jaya — glory, glory; ananta advaita sanatana — to the Infinite, Non-dual, Eternal; jaya achyutananda — glory to the Bliss of Achyuta; nityananda — Eternal Bliss; janardana — Janardana

**33.** "Glory, glory to the Infinite, the Non-dual, the Eternal!
Glory to the Bliss of Achyuta, the Eternal Bliss, Janardana![^09-4]

জয় সত্ত্ব রজস্তম প্রকৃতির পর ।
জয় মহাবিষ্ণু কারণ-সমুদ্র-ভিতর ॥ ৩৪ ॥

*jaẏa sattba rajastama prakṛtira para |*
*jaẏa mahābiṣṇu kāraṇa-samudra-bhitara || 34 ||*

*Word for word:* jaya — glory; sattva rajas-tama prakritira para — to Him beyond prakriti — sattva, rajas, tamas; jaya mahavishnu — glory to Maha-Vishnu; karana-samudra-bhitara — within the Causal Ocean

**34.** Glory to Him who is beyond prakriti — sattva, rajas and tamas!
Glory to Maha-Vishnu [abiding] in the Causal Ocean!

জয় পরব্যোমনাথ মহিমা-বিস্তার ।
জয় সত্ত্ব পরসত্ত্ব বিশুদ্ধসত্ত্বাকার ॥ ৩৫ ॥

*jaẏa parabyomanātha mahimā-bistāra |*
*jaẏa sattba parasattba biśuddhasattbākāra || 35 ||*

*Word for word:* jaya paravyoma-natha — glory to the Lord of Paravyoma; mahima-vistara — whose greatness is boundless; jaya sattva parasattva — glory to sattva, the highest sattva; vishuddha-sattvakara — whose form is pure sattva

**35.** Glory to the Lord of Paravyoma, whose greatness is boundless!
Glory to [Him who is] sattva, the highest sattva, whose form is pure sattva!

জয় গোলোকের পতি রাধার নাগর ।
জয় জয় অনন্ত-বৈকুণ্ঠ-অধীশ্বর ॥ ৩৬ ॥

*jaẏa golokera pati rādhāra nāgara |*
*jaẏa jaẏa ananta-baikuṇṭha-adhīśbara || 36 ||*

*Word for word:* jaya golokera pati — glory to the Lord of Goloka; radhara nagara — beloved of Radha; jaya jaya — glory, glory; ananta-vaikuntha-adhishvara — supreme Lord of the countless Vaikunthas

**36.** Glory to the Lord of Goloka, the beloved of Radha!
Glory, glory to the supreme Lord of the countless Vaikunthas!

জয় জয় নিশ্চিন্ত ধীরললিত ।
জয় জয় সর্বমনোহর নন্দসুত ॥ ৩৭ ॥

*jaẏa jaẏa niścinta dhīralalita |*
*jaẏa jaẏa sarbamanohara nandasuta || 37 ||*

*Word for word:* jaya jaya — glory, glory; nishchinta — to the carefree; dhira-lalita — playful hero; sarva-manohara — all-enchanting; nanda-suta — son of Nanda

**37.** Glory, glory to the carefree, playful hero (*dhira-lalita*)!
Glory, glory to the all-enchanting son of Nanda!

এবে কলিযুগে শচীগর্ভেতে প্রকাশ ।
আপনে ভুঞ্জিতে আইলা আপন-বিলাস ॥ ৩৮ ॥

*ebe kaliyuge śacīgarbhete prakāśa |*
*āpane bhuñjite āilā āpana-bilāsa || 38 ||*

*Word for word:* ebe kali-yuge — now in the Kali-yuga; shachi-garbhete prakasha — appearing in Shachi's womb; apane bhunjite — to taste Yourself; aila apana-vilasa — You came, Your own play

**38.** Now, in the Kali-yuga, appearing in Shachi's womb,
You have come to taste Your own play Yourself.

জয় জয় পরানন্দ-দাতা এই প্রভু ।
এ হেন করুণা আর নাহি হয় কভু ॥ ৩৯ ॥

*jaẏa jaẏa parānanda-dātā ei prabhu |*
*e hena karuṇā āra nāhi haẏa kabhu || 39 ||*

*Word for word:* jaya jaya — glory, glory; parananda-data — to the giver of supreme bliss; ei prabhu — this Lord; e hena karuna — such mercy; ara nahi haya kabhu — never has been

**39.** Glory, glory to this Lord, the giver of supreme bliss!
Such mercy has never been.

আপনি আপন-দাতা হৈলা কলিকালে ।
পাত্রাপাত্র-বিচার না হৈব গদাধরে ॥ ৪০ ॥

*āpani āpana-dātā hailā kalikāle |*
*pātrāpātra-bicāra nā haiba gadādhare || 40 ||*

*Word for word:* apani apana-data — You, the giver of Yourself; haila kalikale — have become in the age of Kali; patrapatra-vichara — judging of worthy and unworthy; na haiba gadadhare — there will be none with Gadadhara

**40.** In the age of Kali You have become the giver of Yourself:
with Gadadhara there will be no judging of worthy and unworthy.[^09-5]

যে প্রেম যাচিঞা করোঁ মোরা সব দেবে ।
না পাইলুঁ লবলেশ গন্ধ-অনুভবে ॥ ৪১ ॥

*ye prema yāciñā karoṁ morā saba debe |*
*nā pāiluṁ labaleśa gandha-anubhabe || 41 ||*

*Word for word:* ye prema — that prema; yachina karon mora saba deve — which we, all the gods, beg for; na pailun — we did not obtain; laba-lesha — a particle; gandha-anubhave — nor a sense of its fragrance

**41.** That prema for which we, all the gods, beg
we have not obtained — not a particle, not even its fragrance.

সে প্রেম মধুর রস আপনি খাইয়া ।
ভুঞ্জাইবে আচণ্ডালে দোষ না দেখিয়া ॥ ৪২ ॥

*se prema madhura rasa āpani khāiẏā |*
*bhuñjāibe ācaṇḍāle doṣa nā dekhiẏā || 42 ||*

*Word for word:* se prema madhura rasa — that prema, the sweet rasa; apani khaiya — tasting Yourself; bhunjaibe achandale — You will give to taste down to the chandala; dosha na dekhiya — not looking at faults

**42.** That prema, that sweet rasa, You will taste Yourself
and give to all to taste, down to the chandala, not looking at faults.

তুয়া প্রেম-লব-লেশ মোরা যেন পাই ।
তোর সঙ্গে রাধাকৃষ্ণ-গুণ যেন গাই ॥ ৪৩ ॥

*tuẏā prema-laba-leśa morā yena pāi |*
*tora saṅge rādhākṛṣṇa-guṇa yena gāi || 43 ||*

*Word for word:* tuya prema-laba-lesha — a particle of Your prema; mora yena pai — may we obtain; tora sange — with You; radha-krishna-guna yena gai — may we sing the virtues of Radha and Krishna

**43.** May we too obtain a particle of Your prema,
may we sing with You the virtues of Radha and Krishna.

জয় জয় সঙ্কীর্তনদাতা গৌরহরি ।
ইহা বলি দেবগণ প্রদক্ষিণ করি ॥ ৪৪ ॥

*jaẏa jaẏa saṅkīrtanadātā gaurahari |*
*ihā bali debagaṇa pradakṣiṇa kari || 44 ||*

*Word for word:* jaya jaya — glory, glory; sankirtana-data gaurahari — to Gaurahari, giver of sankirtana; iha bali — so saying; devagana pradakshina kari — the gods circumambulate

**44.** Glory, glory to Gaurahari, the giver of sankirtana!"
So saying, the gods circumambulate [her].

চারিমুখে ব্রহ্মা করে বহুবিধ স্তুতি ।
তরাসিল শচীদেবী চমকিত-মতি ॥ ৪৫ ॥

*cārimukhe brahmā kare bahubidha stuti |*
*tarāsila śacīdebī camakita-mati || 45 ||*

*Word for word:* chari-mukhe — with four mouths; brahma kare bahuvidha stuti — Brahma offers many praises; tarasila shachidevi — Shachi-devi grew afraid; chamakita-mati — her mind startled

**45.** With four mouths Brahma offers many kinds of praise;
Shachi-devi grew afraid, her mind startled.

সর্বজীবে দয়া ভেল শচীর অন্তরে ।
আত্মজ্ঞানে দয়া করে নাহি ভিন্ন পরে ॥ ৪৬ ॥

*sarbajībe daẏā bhela śacīra antare |*
*ātmajñāne daẏā kare nāhi bhinna pare || 46 ||*

*Word for word:* sarvajive daya bhela — compassion for all beings arose; shachira antare — in Shachi's heart; atma-jnane daya kare — she is kind as to herself; nahi bhinna pare — no distinction of own and other

**46.** Shachi's heart was filled with compassion for all beings:
she is kind [to all] as to herself, not distinguishing her own from others.

দশ মাস পূর্ণ ভেল গর্ভ দিশে দিশে ।
আপনা পাসরে দেবী মনের হরিষে ॥ ৪৭ ॥

*daśa māsa pūrṇa bhela garbha diśe diśe |*
*āpanā pāsare debī manera hariṣe || 47 ||*

*Word for word:* dasha masa purna bhela garbha — ten months of pregnancy were complete; dishe dishe — on every side; apana pasare devi — the goddess forgets herself; manera harishe — with the joy of her heart

**47.** Ten months of the pregnancy were complete; [joy] on every side —
the goddess forgets herself with the joy of her heart.

শুভদিন শুভক্ষণ পূর্ণিমার তিথি ।
ফাল্গুনের শুভনিশি হিমকর-দ্যুতি ॥ ৪৮ ॥

*śubhadina śubhakṣaṇa pūrṇimāra tithi |*
*phālgunera śubhaniśi himakara-dyuti || 48 ||*

*Word for word:* shubha-dina shubha-kshana — an auspicious day, an auspicious hour; purnimara tithi — the lunar day of the full moon; phalgunera shubha-nishi — the auspicious night of Phalguna; himakara-dyuti — the radiance of the moon

**48.** An auspicious day, an auspicious hour, the lunar day of the full moon,
the auspicious night of Phalguna, the radiance of the moon.

রাহু চন্দ্র গরাসয়ে অদ্ভুত বেলে ।
উঠিল চৌদিগ ভরি হরি হরি বোলে ॥ ৪৯ ॥

*rāhu candra garāsaẏe adbhuta bele |*
*uṭhila caudiga bhari hari hari bole || 49 ||*

*Word for word:* rahu chandra garasaye — Rahu swallows the moon; adbhuta vele — at a wondrous hour; uthila chaudiga bhari — arose, filling all around; hari hari bole — cries of "Hari, Hari"

**49.** At a wondrous hour Rahu swallows the moon —
and on every side arose the cry: "Hari, Hari!"[^09-6]

চৌদিগ ভরিল আর দিব্য চারু গন্ধে ।
পরসন্ন দশদিগ বায়ু মন্দ মন্দে ॥ ৫০ ॥

*caudiga bharila āra dibya cāru gandhe |*
*parasanna daśadiga bāẏu manda mande || 50 ||*

*Word for word:* chaudiga bharila ara — all around was filled; divya charu gandhe — with divine lovely fragrance; parasanna dashadiga — the ten directions grew bright; vayu manda mande — the breeze soft and gentle

**50.** All around was filled with a divine, lovely fragrance;
the ten directions grew bright, the breeze blew soft and gentle.

ষড়ঋতু উদয় ভৈ গেল সেই কালে ।
প্রভু-শুভজন্ম পৃথিবীতে হেন বেলে ॥ ৫১ ॥

*ṣaṛaṛtu udaẏa bhai gela sei kāle |*
*prabhu-śubhajanma pṛthibīte hena bele || 51 ||*

*Word for word:* shad-ritu udaya bhai gela — the six seasons appeared; sei kale — at that time; prabhu-shubha-janma — the Lord's auspicious birth; prithivite hena vele — on earth at such an hour

**51.** At that time all six seasons appeared at once —
at such an hour the Lord took His auspicious birth on earth.

অন্তরীক্ষে দেবগণ দিব্য যানে চাহে ।
গৌর-অঙ্গ দেখিবারে অনুরাগে ধাহে ॥ ৫২ ॥

*antarīkṣe debagaṇa dibya yāne cāhe |*
*gaura-aṅga dekhibāre anurāge dhāhe || 52 ||*

*Word for word:* antarikshe devagana — in the sky the gods; divya yane chahe — look from celestial cars; gaura-anga dekhibare — to see Gaura's body; anurage dhahe — run in love

**52.** In the sky the gods look on from their celestial cars,
running in love to see the body of Gaura.

একমাত্র শুনি ধ্বনি হরি হরি বোল ।
জন্মমাত্র প্রকাশ করিল প্রভু মোর ॥ ৫৩ ॥

*ekamātra śuni dhbani hari hari bola |*
*janmamātra prakāśa karila prabhu mora || 53 ||*

*Word for word:* ekamatra shuni dhvani — only one sound is heard; hari hari bola — "Haribol, Haribol"; janma-matra — the moment He was born; prakasha karila prabhu mora — my Lord revealed

**53.** Only one sound is heard: "Haribol, Haribol!" —
this my Lord revealed the moment He was born.

শচীর সদনে ভেল বৈকুণ্ঠ-সম্পদ ।
আনন্দে বিভোল শচী বোলে গদগদ ॥ ৫৪ ॥

*śacīra sadane bhela baikuṇṭha-sampada |*
*ānande bibhola śacī bole gadagada || 54 ||*

*Word for word:* shachira sadane — in Shachi's house; bhela vaikuntha-sampada — the riches of Vaikuntha appeared; anande vibhola shachi — Shachi beside herself with bliss; bole gadgada — speaks falteringly

**54.** In Shachi's house the riches of Vaikuntha appeared;[^09-7]
beside herself with bliss, Shachi speaks in a faltering voice;

জগন্নাথ-পণ্ডিতেরে ডাকে হাথসানে ।
জনম সফল দেখ পুত্রের বয়ানে ॥ ৫৫ ॥

*jagannātha-paṇḍitere ḍāke hāthasāne |*
*janama saphala dekha putrera baẏāne || 55 ||*

*Word for word:* jagannatha-panditere — Jagannatha Pandita; dake hathasane — calls with a gesture; janama saphala — life has borne fruit; dekha putrera bayane — look at the son's face

**55.** with a gesture she calls Jagannatha Pandita:
"Our life has borne fruit — look at our son's face!"

পুরনারীগণ জয় জয় দেই সুখে ।
আনন্দে বিভোর সভে দেখিয়া বালকে ॥ ৫৬ ॥

*puranārīgaṇa jaẏa jaẏa dei sukhe |*
*ānande bibhora sabhe dekhiẏā bālake || 56 ||*

*Word for word:* puranarigana — the women of the town; jaya jaya dei sukhe — joyfully cry "jaya, jaya"; anande vibhora sabhe — all beside themselves with bliss; dekhiya balake — seeing the child

**56.** The women of the town joyfully cry "Jaya, jaya!",
all beside themselves with bliss at the sight of the child.

বেদ-দেব-নাগকন্যা সভাই আইলা ।
দেখিয়া গৌরাঙ্গ জয় জয় ধ্বনি কৈলা ॥ ৫৭ ॥

*beda-deba-nāgakanyā sabhāi āilā |*
*dekhiẏā gaurāṅga jaẏa jaẏa dhbani kailā || 57 ||*

*Word for word:* veda-deva-naga-kanya — [wives] of sages, goddesses and naga maidens; sabhai aila — all came; dekhiya gauranga — seeing Gauranga; jaya jaya dhvani kaila — raised the cry "jaya, jaya"

**57.** The wives of sages, goddesses and naga maidens all came —
seeing Gauranga, they raised the cry "Jaya, jaya!"

গৌর-গরিমা-গন্ধে ভরিল ব্রহ্মাণ্ড ।
প্রতি অঙ্গ রসরাশি অমিয়া অখণ্ড ॥ ৫৮ ॥

*gaura-garimā-gandhe bharila brahmāṇḍa |*
*prati aṅga rasarāśi amiẏā akhaṇḍa || 58 ||*

*Word for word:* gaura-garima-gandhe — with the fragrance of Gaura's majesty; bharila brahmanda — the universe was filled; prati anga rasa-rashi — each limb a treasury of rasa; amiya akhanda — unbroken nectar

**58.** The fragrance of Gaura's majesty filled the universe;
each of His limbs is a treasury of rasa, unbroken nectar.

দেখিতে দেখিতে সভার জুড়াইল নয়ান ।
সভার মনে হৈল ব্রজ-নাগরীর প্রাণ ॥ ৫৯ ॥

*dekhite dekhite sabhāra juṛāila naẏāna |*
*sabhāra mane haila braja-nāgarīra prāṇa || 59 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhite dekhite — gazing and gazing; sabhara judaila nayana — the eyes of all were soothed; sabhara mane haila — it seemed to all; vraja-nagarira prana — [this is] the life of the nagaris of Vraja

**59.** Gazing and gazing, all their eyes were soothed;
to all it seemed: this is the life of the nagaris of Vraja.

এ হেন বালক কভু দেখি নাহি শুনি ।
ইহারে দেখিয়া হিয়া করয়ে কি জানি ॥ ৬০ ॥

*e hena bālaka kabhu dekhi nāhi śuni |*
*ihāre dekhiẏā hiẏā karaẏe ki jāni || 60 ||*

*Word for word:* e hena balaka — such a child; kabhu dekhi nahi shuni — never seen nor heard of; ihare dekhiya — looking at Him; hiya karaye ki jani — the heart does we know not what

**60.** "Such a child we have never seen or heard of;
looking at Him, the heart does — we know not what!

মানুষের হেন চিহ্ন না দেখিয়ে কভু ।
দিব্য বিলাসিনী বোলে জানিব ইহা পাছু ॥ ৬১ ॥

*mānuṣera hena cihna nā dekhiẏe kabhu |*
*dibya bilāsinī bole jāniba ihā pāchu || 61 ||*

*Word for word:* manushera hena chihna — such marks in human beings; na dekhiye kabhu — we have never seen; divya vilasini bole — say the celestial beauties; janiba iha pachhu — later we shall know

**61.** Such marks we have never seen in a human being,"
say the celestial beauties; "later we shall know [who He is]."

জগন্নাথ বিভোল দেখিয়া পুত্রমুখ ।
ব্রহ্মাণ্ডে না ধরে তাঁর অন্তর-কৌতুক ॥ ৬২ ॥

*jagannātha bibhola dekhiẏā putramukha |*
*brahmāṇḍe nā dhare tāṁra antara-kautuka || 62 ||*

*Word for word:* jagannatha vibhola — Jagannatha beside himself; dekhiya putra-mukha — looking at the son's face; brahmande na dhare — the universe cannot contain; tanra antara-kautuka — the delight of his heart

**62.** Jagannatha is beside himself, looking at his son's face:
the universe cannot contain the delight of his heart.

কত চান্দ-উদয় দেখিয়া মুখখানি ।
প্রফুল্ল কমলদল বয়ান বাখানি ॥ ৬৩ ॥

*kata cānda-udaẏa dekhiẏā mukhakhāni |*
*praphulla kamaladala baẏāna bākhāni || 63 ||*

*Word for word:* kata chanda-udaya — how many moons rising; dekhiya mukhakhani — seeing the little face; praphulla kamala-dala — a blossoming lotus; bayana bakhani — the face is described

**63.** How many moons are rising — so looks His little face!
His face is likened to a blossoming lotus.

উন্নত নাসিকা তিলকুসুম জিনিঞা ।
ঝলমল গোরা-অঙ্গ-কিরণ অমিয়া ॥ ৬৪ ॥

*unnata nāsikā tilakusuma jiniñā |*
*jhalamala gorā-aṅga-kiraṇa amiẏā || 64 ||*

*Word for word:* unnata nasika — a high nose; tila-kusuma jinina — surpassing the sesame flower; jhalamala — sparkles; gora-anga-kirana amiya — the radiance of Gora's body, nectar

**64.** His high nose surpasses the sesame flower,
the radiance of Gora's body sparkles — nectar.

অধর অরুণ আর চারু গণ্ড-দ্যুতি ।
সুন্দর চিবুক দেখি উঠয়ে পীরিতি ॥ ৬৫ ॥

*adhara aruṇa āra cāru gaṇḍa-dyuti |*
*sundara cibuka dekhi uṭhaẏe pīriti || 65 ||*

*Word for word:* adhara aruna — lips red; ara charu ganda-dyuti — and lovely shining cheeks; sundara chibuka dekhi — seeing the beautiful chin; uthaye piriti — love wells up

**65.** His lips are red, His cheeks lovely and shining;
seeing His beautiful chin, love wells up.

সিংহগ্রীব গজস্কন্ধ বিশাল হৃদয় ।
আজানুলম্বিত ভুজ তনু রসময় ॥ ৬৬ ॥

*siṃhagrība gajaskandha biśāla hṛdaẏa |*
*ājānulambita bhuja tanu rasamaẏa || 66 ||*

*Word for word:* simha-griva — a lion's neck; gaja-skandha — an elephant's shoulders; vishala hridaya — a broad chest; ajanu-lambita bhuja — arms reaching the knees; tanu rasamaya — a body full of rasa

**66.** A lion's neck, an elephant's shoulders, a broad chest,
arms reaching to the knees, a body full of rasa.

বিশাল নিতম্ব ঊরু কদলীর যেন ।
অরুণ-কমলদল দুখানি চরণ ॥ ৬৭ ॥

*biśāla nitamba ūru kadalīra yena |*
*aruṇa-kamaladala dukhāni caraṇa || 67 ||*

*Word for word:* vishala nitamba — broad hips; uru kadalira yena — thighs like plantain stems; aruna-kamala-dala — petals of a red lotus; dukhani charana — the two feet

**67.** Broad hips, thighs like plantain stems,
two feet like petals of a red lotus.

ধ্বজ বজ্র অঙ্কুশ সে পঙ্কজ-পদতলে ।
রথ ছত্র চামর স্বস্তিক জম্বুফলে ॥ ৬৮ ॥

*dhbaja bajra aṅkuśa se paṅkaja-padatale |*
*ratha chatra cāmara sbastika jambuphale || 68 ||*

*Word for word:* dhvaja vajra ankusha — flag, thunderbolt, goad; se pankaja-padatale — on the lotus soles; ratha chhatra chamara — chariot, umbrella, chamara; svastika jambu-phale — svastika, jambu fruit

**68.** On the lotus soles — the flag, the thunderbolt, the goad,
the chariot, the umbrella, the chamara, the svastika, the jambu fruit,

ঊর্ধ্বরেখা ত্রিকোণ কুঞ্জর-কুম্ভবরে ।
সব অপরূপ রূপ অমিয়া উগরে ॥ ৬৯ ॥

*ūrdhbarekhā trikoṇa kuñjara-kumbhabare |*
*saba aparūpa rūpa amiẏā ugare || 69 ||*

*Word for word:* urdhva-rekha — the upward line; trikona — the triangle; kunjara-kumbha-bare — the elephant's kumbha; saba aparupa rupa — the whole wondrous form; amiya ugare — pours out nectar

**69.** the upward line, the triangle, the elephant's kumbha[^09-8] —
this whole wondrous form pours out nectar.

হেন অপরূপ রূপ পৃথিবীর মাঝে ।
মহারাজ-রাজাধিক লক্ষণ বিরাজে ॥ ৭০ ॥

*hena aparūpa rūpa pṛthibīra mājhe |*
*mahārāja-rājādhika lakṣaṇa birāje || 70 ||*

*Word for word:* hena aparupa rupa — in such a wondrous form; prithivira majhe — on the earth; maharaja-rajadhika — surpassing great kings; lakshana viraje — marks shine

**70.** In such a wondrous form upon the earth
shine marks surpassing [those of] great kings.

ইন্দ্র চন্দ্র গন্ধর্ব কিন্নর দেবগণ ।
পৃথিবী আইলা কিবা কৌতুক কারণ ॥ ৭১ ॥

*indra candra gandharba kinnara debagaṇa |*
*pṛthibī āilā kibā kautuka kāraṇa || 71 ||*

*Word for word:* indra chandra gandharva kinnara devagana — Indra, Chandra, gandharvas, kinnaras and gods; prithivi aila — came to earth; kiba kautuka karana — what a joyous wonder

**71.** Indra, Chandra, gandharvas, kinnaras and gods
came to earth — what a joyous wonder!

নয়নে লাগিল সভার অমিয়া-অঞ্জন ।
চির-অনুরাগে যেন প্রিয়-দরশন ॥ ৭২ ॥

*naẏane lāgila sabhāra amiẏā-añjana |*
*cira-anurāge yena priẏa-daraśana || 72 ||*

*Word for word:* nayane lagila sabhara — the eyes of all were touched; amiya-anjana — with a salve of nectar; chira-anurage — after long love; yena priya-darashana — as if seeing the beloved

**72.** The eyes of all seemed anointed with a salve of nectar —
as if after long love they saw their beloved.

জন্মমাত্র বালক হইল যেই দেখা ।
কত কাল ছিল পুরুবের যেন সখা ॥ ৭৩ ॥

*janmamātra bālaka haila yei dekhā |*
*kata kāla chila purubera yena sakhā || 73 ||*

*Word for word:* janma-matra balaka — the newborn child; haila yei dekha — whoever saw; kata kala chhila — had long been; puruvera yena sakha — as if a friend of old

**73.** The child was just born — yet to those who saw Him
it seemed He had long been their friend of old.

প্রতি-অঙ্গে অমিয়া সঞ্চরে রাশি রাশি ।
নিরখিতে নয়নে হৃদয়ে কেনে বাসি ॥ ৭৪ ॥

*prati-aṅge amiẏā sañcare rāśi rāśi |*
*nirakhite naẏane hṛdaẏe kene bāsi || 74 ||*

*Word for word:* prati-ange — from each limb; amiya sanchare rashi rashi — nectar flows in heaps; nirakhite nayane — when the eyes behold; hridaye kene basi — why do I feel so in my heart

**74.** From each limb He pours nectar in heaps;
why, when the eyes behold [Him], does the heart [so stir]?

বালক দেখিয়া বুক ভরল আনন্দে ।
আলসিত আঁখি কেনে শ্লথ নীবিবন্ধে ॥ ৭৫ ॥

*bālaka dekhiẏā buka bharala ānande |*
*ālasita āṁkhi kene ślatha nībibandhe || 75 ||*

*Word for word:* balaka dekhiya — seeing the child; buka bharala anande — bosoms filled with joy; alasita ankhi kene — why are the eyes languid; shlatha nivibandhe — loosened the knots of garments

**75.** Seeing the child, [the women's] bosoms filled with joy;
why are their eyes languid, why have the knots of their garments loosened?[^09-9]

জন্মমাত্র বালক দেখিল যেই ক্ষণে ।
কত কোটি কাম জিনি সুন্দর বদনে ॥ ৭৬ ॥

*janmamātra bālaka dekhila yei kṣaṇe |*
*kata koṭi kāma jini sundara badane || 76 ||*

*Word for word:* janma-matra balaka — the newborn child; dekhila yei kshane — the moment they saw; kata koti kama jini — surpassing millions of Kamas; sundara vadane — with His beautiful face

**76.** The moment the newborn child was seen,
His beautiful face surpassed millions of Kamas.

হেন অনুমানি সভে দেই জয় জয় ।
স্বরূপে মানুষ নহে শচীর তনয় ॥ ৭৭ ॥

*hena anumāni sabhe dei jaẏa jaẏa |*
*sbarūpe mānuṣa nahe śacīra tanaẏa || 77 ||*

*Word for word:* hena anumani — so reflecting; sabhe dei jaya jaya — all cry "jaya, jaya"; svarupe manusha nahe — by nature not human; shachira tanaya — Shachi's son

**77.** So reflecting, all cry "Jaya, jaya!
Shachi's son by His very nature is not human.

অভিনব কামদেব শচীর নন্দন ।
শ্রবণে অমৃত যবে করয়ে ক্রন্দন ॥ ৭৮ ॥

*abhinaba kāmadeba śacīra nandana |*
*śrabaṇe amṛta yabe karaẏe krandana || 78 ||*

*Word for word:* abhinava kamadeva — a new Kamadeva; shachira nandana — Shachi's son; shravane amrita — nectar to the ears; yabe karaye krandana — when He cries

**78.** Shachi's son is a new Kamadeva:
even His crying is nectar to the ears."
