আপনে গোলোকনাথ কৈলা অবতার ।
নির্ধারিল নারীগণ অনুমান-সার ॥ ৭৯ ॥

*āpane golokanātha kailā abatāra |*
*nirdhārila nārīgaṇa anumāna-sāra || 79 ||*

*Word for word:* apane golokanatha — the Lord of Goloka Himself; kaila avatara — has descended; nirdharila narigana — the women concluded; anumana-sara — the essence of their reflection

**79.** "The Lord of Goloka Himself has descended" —
such was the conclusion the women reached.

সর্বলোকনাথ এ অবনী-পরকাশ ।
আনন্দে বিভোর কহে এ লোচনদাস ॥ ৮০ ॥

*sarbalokanātha e abanī-parakāśa |*
*ānande bibhora kahe e locanadāsa || 80 ||*

*Word for word:* sarvaloka-natha — the Lord of all worlds; e avani-parakasha — has appeared on earth; anande vibhora — beside himself with bliss; kahe e lochanadasa — says this Lochana Dasa

**80.** The Lord of all the worlds has appeared on earth —
beside himself with bliss says this Lochana Dasa.

*Raga mangala-gurjari; disha: "Rejoice, celebrate! In bliss, in Shachi's house, sing of Gora's virtues!"*

*Mishra Purandara, overflowing with bliss —
his voice faltering —
summoning his kin and friends without delay,
celebrates the festival of his son's birth.*[^09-10]

জয় জয় জয়, চৌদিগে সুখময়,
আনন্দে ভরল নগরী ।
কুলবধূ যত, আওল শত শত,
বিলাইল সিন্দুর পিঠালি ॥ ৮১ ॥

*jaẏa jaẏa jaẏa, caudige sukhamaẏa,*
*ānande bharala nagarī |*
*kulabadhū yata, āola śata śata,*
*bilāila sindura piṭhāli || 81 ||*

*Word for word:* jaya jaya jaya — "jaya, jaya, jaya!"; chaudige sukhamaya — all around full of joy; anande bharala nagari — the town filled with bliss; kulavadhu yata — all the wives of good families; aola shata shata — came by hundreds; vilaila sindura pithali — distributed sindura and pithali

**81.** "Jaya, jaya, jaya!" — all around is full of joy,
the town is filled with bliss;
all the wives of good families came by hundreds
and distribute sindura and pithali.[^09-11]

পুত্র করি কোলে, আনন্দে প্রেমভরে,
গদগদ বোলে শচীদেবী ।
আশীর্বাদ কর, পদধূলি দেহ বর,
বালক হউ চিরজীবী ॥ ৮২ ॥

*putra kari kole, ānande premabhare,*
*gadagada bole śacīdebī |*
*āśīrbāda kara, padadhūli deha bara,*
*bālaka hau cirajībī || 82 ||*

*Word for word:* putra kari kole — taking her son on her lap; anande prema-bhare — in bliss, full of love; gadgada bole shachidevi — Shachi-devi speaks falteringly; ashirvada kara — give your blessing; padadhuli deha bara — give the dust of your feet as a boon; balaka hau chirajivi — may the boy live long

**82.** Taking her son on her lap, in bliss, full of love,
Shachi-devi speaks in a faltering voice:
"Give your blessing, give the dust of your feet as a boon —
may the boy live long!

বালক নহে মোর, আপন বলি বর,
দেহ না সব নারীগণে ।
অমিয়াধিক দেহ, পরিণাম বিপর্যয়,
নিমাই বলিয়া থুইল নামে ॥ ৮৩ ॥

*bālaka nahe mora, āpana bali bara,*
*deha nā saba nārīgaṇe |*
*amiẏādhika deha, pariṇāma biparyaẏa,*
*nimāi baliẏā thuila nāme || 83 ||*

*Word for word:* balaka nahe mora — the boy is not mine; apana bali bara — calling Him your own, a blessing; deha na saba narigane — give, all you women; amiyadhika deha — a body sweeter than nectar; parinama viparyaya — [to avert] an evil outcome; nimai baliya thuila name — they gave the name Nimai

**83.** The boy is not mine — call Him your own and bless Him,
all you women!"
His body is sweeter than nectar; to ward off an evil outcome
they gave Him the name Nimai.[^09-12]

এ অষ্ট-দিবসে, শিশুগণ-সন্তোষে,
এ অষ্ট-কলাই বিলাই ।
নবরাত্রি মহোৎসব, আনন্দময় সব,
বাজয়ে আনন্দ-বাধাই ॥ ৮৪ ॥

*e aṣṭa-dibase, śiśugaṇa-santoṣe,*
*e aṣṭa-kalāi bilāi |*
*nabarātri mahotsaba, ānandamaẏa saba,*
*bājaẏe ānanda-bādhāi || 84 ||*

*Word for word:* e ashta-divase — on this eighth day; shishugana-santoshe — for the children's delight; e ashta-kalai vilai — the eight kinds of pulses are given out; navaratri mahotsava — the festival of the ninth night; anandamaya saba — all is bliss; bajaye ananda-badhai — joyful music plays

**84.** On this eighth day, for the children's delight,
the "eight kinds of pulses" are given out;
the festival of the ninth night — all is bliss,
joyful music plays.[^09-13]

বাঢ়য়ে দিনে দিনে, শচীর নন্দনে,
অবনী-পূর্ণিমার চান্দে ।
কাজরে উজোর, নয়ানযুগল,
গোরোচনা-তিলক-ছান্দে ॥ ৮৫ ॥

*bāṛhaẏe dine dine, śacīra nandane,*
*abanī-pūrṇimāra cānde |*
*kājare ujora, naẏānayugala,*
*gorocanā-tilaka-chānde || 85 ||*

*Word for word:* badhaye dine dine — grows day by day; shachira nandane — Shachi's son; avani-purnimara chande — a full moon on earth; kajare ujora — bright with kajal; nayana-yugala — both eyes; gorochana-tilaka-chhande — a gorochana tilaka beautifully drawn

**85.** Day by day Shachi's son grows —
a full moon upon the earth;
His two eyes bright with kajal,
a gorochana tilaka beautifully drawn.

এ কর-চরণ, সঘন চালন,
ঈষত হাসয়ে মুচকি ।
শচী জগন্নাথ, দেখি অদ্ভুত,
নিরখে অনিমিখ আঁখি ॥ ৮৬ ॥

*e kara-caraṇa, saghana cālana,*
*īṣata hāsaẏe mucaki |*
*śacī jagannātha, dekhi adbhuta,*
*nirakhe animikha āṁkhi || 86 ||*

*Word for word:* e kara-charana — the little hands and feet; saghana chalana — moves again and again; ishata hasaye muchaki — smiles ever so slightly; shachi jagannatha — Shachi and Jagannatha; dekhi adbhuta — seeing the wonder; nirakhe animikha ankhi — gaze without blinking

**86.** Again and again He moves His little hands and feet,
smiling ever so slightly;
Shachi and Jagannatha, seeing this wonder,
gaze without blinking.

শ্রীঅঙ্গ-মার্জন, করয়ে নিতি নিতি,
সুগন্ধি-তৈল হরিদ্রা ।
বদন চুম্বয়ে, হিয়া ভরি থুয়ে,
ধন্য শচী সুচরিতা ॥ ৮৭ ॥

*śrīaṅga-mārjana, karaẏe niti niti,*
*sugandhi-taila haridrā |*
*badana cumbaẏe, hiẏā bhari thuẏe,*
*dhanya śacī sucaritā || 87 ||*

*Word for word:* shri-anga-marjana — rubbing of the holy body; karaye niti niti — she does every day; sugandhi-taila haridra — with fragrant oil and turmeric; vadana chumbaye — kisses the face; hiya bhari thuye — holds to her heart; dhanya shachi sucharita — blessed is virtuous Shachi

**87.** Every day she rubs His holy body
with fragrant oil and turmeric,
kisses His face and holds Him to her heart —
blessed is virtuous Shachi!

এছন দিনে দিনে, বাঢ়য়ে অনুক্ষণে,
আনন্দ নদিয়ানগরে ।
কিবা দিবা রাতি, না জানে বার তিথি,
প্রেমায় আপনা পাসরে ॥ ৮৮ ॥

*echana dine dine, bāṛhaẏe anukṣaṇe,*
*ānanda nadiẏānagare |*
*kibā dibā rāti, nā jāne bāra tithi,*
*premāẏa āpanā pāsare || 88 ||*

*Word for word:* aichhana dine dine — so day by day; badhaye anukshane — grows every moment; ananda nadiya-nagare — bliss in the town of Nadiya; kiba diva rati — whether day or night; na jane bara tithi — they know not weekday nor lunar day; premaya apana pasare — in prema they forget themselves

**88.** So day by day, moment by moment, bliss
grows in the town of Nadia;
they know not day or night, nor weekday nor lunar day;
in prema they forget themselves.

নদীয়ানগরে, আনন্দ ঘরে ঘরে,
না জানি কি নারীপুরুষে ।
বাল বৃদ্ধ অন্ধ, প্রেম-পরবন্ধ,
মাতল অতুল হরিষে ॥ ৮৯ ॥

*nadīẏānagare, ānanda ghare ghare,*
*nā jāni ki nārīpuruṣe |*
*bāla bṛddha andha, prema-parabandha,*
*mātala atula hariṣe || 89 ||*

*Word for word:* nadiya-nagare — in the town of Nadiya; ananda ghare ghare — bliss in every house; na jani ki nari-purushe — what to speak of men and women; bala vriddha andha — children, old men, the blind; prema-parabandha — bound by prema; matala atula harishe — drunk with matchless joy

**89.** In the town of Nadia there is bliss in every house —
what to speak of men and women:
children, old men, the blind, bound by prema,
are drunk with matchless joy.

শারদ-শশী জিনি, বদন অনুমানি,
মদন-সদনে বিরাজে ।
যুবতী যত ছিল, উমতি সভে ভেল,
ছাড়ল গুরু-গৃহ-কাজে ॥ ৯০ ॥

*śārada-śaśī jini, badana anumāni,*
*madana-sadane birāje |*
*yubatī yata chila, umati sabhe bhela,*
*chāṛala guru-gṛha-kāje || 90 ||*

*Word for word:* sharada-shashi jini — surpassing the autumn moon; vadana anumani — the face, they fancy; madana-sadane viraje — shines as Madana's abode; yuvati yata chhila — all the young women; umati sabhe bhela — all went mad; chhadala guru-griha-kaje — left the household duties of their elders

**90.** A face surpassing the autumn moon — they fancy
Madana himself dwells in it;
all the young women, as many as there were, went mad
and left their household duties to their elders.

দিনে তিন বেরি, ধায় পুরনারী,
বালক দেখিবার তরে ।
দেখি দেখি বলি, সভে কোলে করি,
পুলক ভরল কলেবরে ॥ ৯১ ॥

*dine tina beri, dhāẏa puranārī,*
*bālaka dekhibāra tare |*
*dekhi dekhi bali, sabhe kole kari,*
*pulaka bharala kalebare || 91 ||*

*Word for word:* dine tina beri — three times a day; dhaya puranari — the women of the town run; balaka dekhibara tare — to see the child; dekhi dekhi bali — "let me see!"; sabhe kole kari — all take Him on their laps; pulaka bharala kalevare — their bodies thrill with rapture

**91.** Three times a day the women of the town run
to see the child;
"Let me see, let me see!" — all take Him on their laps,
and their bodies thrill with rapture.

এছন দিনে দিনে, প্রতি ক্ষণে ক্ষণে,
আনন্দ কহিল কি যায় ।
নরহরিদাস, পদ করি আশ,
লোচনদাস গুণ গায় ॥ ৯২ ॥

*echana dine dine, prati kṣaṇe kṣaṇe,*
*ānanda kahila ki yāẏa |*
*naraharidāsa, pada kari āśa,*
*locanadāsa guṇa gāẏa || 92 ||*

*Word for word:* aichhana dine dine — so day by day; prati kshane kshane — moment by moment; ananda kahila ki yaya — can the bliss be told; naraharidasa-pada — the feet of Narahari Dasa; kari asha — hoping for; lochanadasa guna gaya — Lochana Dasa sings the virtues

**92.** So day by day, moment by moment —
can the bliss be told?
Hoping for the feet of Narahari Dasa,
Lochana Dasa sings [His] virtues.

*Thus ends the description of the Janma-lila.*

## Balya-lila (The Childhood Pastimes)

> *Summary by Srila Bhaktisiddhanta Sarasvati.* When six months had passed, Gaurasundara's first feeding with rice and naming were performed according to rule; since with His appearance the whole world was filled with bliss, the wise named Him Vishvambhara. Gradually Vishvambhara, holding His father's finger, began to walk about the courtyard. Before the lustre of Gaurasundara's body, adorned with armlets, bracelets, a pearl necklace and other ornaments, the radiance of millions of moons grows dim. [The moon] can dispel only outer darkness, not inner darkness, but the moon of Gaura dispels darkness both outer and inner. Shachi-devi used to lull her son to sleep singing "Come, come, O moon, come" and other songs; at times she saw various gods and goddesses come and praise her son, and was greatly amazed. At times, seeing Gaurahari dance wildly with the gods, crying "Radha-Govinda", she fell senseless. At times she heard the sound of ankle-bells on His bare feet and was astonished; at times, fearing some coming misfortune, she became very anxious; and the next moment, seeing her son's face, she forgot everything and kissed His face again and again. When some time had passed in this way, Gaurasundara began to play outside the house with His playmates. When Shachi-devi tried to catch Gaurasundara, He would run away; and at times, growing angry, He would come home and spoil everything in the house. At times He explained to His mother the worthlessness of worldly notions of pure and impure and instructed her in the transcendental knowledge that Krishna is the Lord of all. Then are described: how He sat in a pit full of pots of leftover food and instructed His mother; how He struck His mother and, seeing her fall senseless, brought a coconut; various childish pranks; His play with a puppy; how Gaurahari, angry with His mother for letting the puppy go, wept; how the puppy, in a divine body, singing of Hari, went to Vaikuntha; how Brahma and others, seeing the puppy's good fortune, praised Gaura; how Gaurahari wept when Shachi-devi prepared an offering for the worship of Shashthi, and under the guise of words revealed to Shachi that He is the Lord of all.

*Raga sindhura*

এই মত দিনে দিনে শচীর কুমার ।
বাঢ়য়ে শরীর যেন অমৃতের ধার ॥ ৯৩ ॥

*ei mata dine dine śacīra kumāra |*
*bāṛhaẏe śarīra yena amṛtera dhāra || 93 ||*

*Word for word:* ei mata dine dine — so day by day; shachira kumara — Shachi's son; badhaye sharira — the body grows; yena amritera dhara — like a stream of nectar

**93.** So day by day the body of Shachi's son
grows — like a stream of nectar.

কি দিব উপমা তার দিতে নাহি পারি ।
খলবল করে প্রাণ কহিতে না পারি ॥ ৯৪ ॥

*ki diba upamā tāra dite nāhi pāri |*
*khalabala kare prāṇa kahite nā pāri || 94 ||*

*Word for word:* ki diba upama tara — what comparison to give Him; dite nahi pari — I cannot give; khalabala kare prana — the heart trembles; kahite na pari — I cannot tell

**94.** What comparison shall I give Him? I can find none;
my heart trembles — I cannot tell it.

নিতি ষোলকলা-পূর্ণ ইন্দু মুখচন্দ্র ।
সাধে দেখিবারে ধায় জনমের অন্ধ ॥ ৯৫ ॥

*niti ṣolakalā-pūrṇa indu mukhacandra |*
*sādhe dekhibāre dhāẏa janamera andha || 95 ||*

*Word for word:* niti shola-kala-purna indu — a moon full in all sixteen digits every day; mukha-chandra — the moon-like face; sadhe dekhibare dhaya — run longing to see; janamera andha — those blind from birth

**95.** His moon-like face is a moon full in all sixteen digits every day;
even those blind from birth run, longing to see Him.

আবেশে অধরে আধ মুচকি হাসিতে ।
অমিয়ার সাগর যেন হিল্লোল-সহিতে ॥ ৯৬ ॥

*ābeśe adhare ādha mucaki hāsite |*
*amiẏāra sāgara yena hillola-sahite || 96 ||*

*Word for word:* aveshe — in rapture; adhare adha muchaki hasite — a half-smile on the lips; amiyara sagara yena — like an ocean of nectar; hillola-sahite — with rolling waves

**96.** In rapture a half-smile plays on His lips,
like an ocean of nectar with rolling waves.

রসে ডুবুডুবু রাতা নয়নযুগল ।
কাজর-অমিয়া-পঙ্কে কে বান্ধ বান্ধল ॥ ৯৭ ॥

*rase ḍubuḍubu rātā naẏanayugala |*
*kājara-amiẏā-paṅke ke bāndha bāndhala || 97 ||*

*Word for word:* rase dubudubu — drowning in rasa; rata nayana-yugala — the two red eyes; kajara-amiya-panke — with the nectar-mud of kajal; ke bandha bandhala — who built a dam

**97.** His two red eyes are drowning in rasa —
who has built a dam of the nectar-mud of kajal?

শচী পুণ্যবতী জগন্নাথ ভাগ্যবান ।
সাদরে নিরখে দোঁহে পুত্রের বয়ান ॥ ৯৮ ॥

*śacī puṇyabatī jagannātha bhāgyabāna |*
*sādare nirakhe doṁhe putrera baẏāna || 98 ||*

*Word for word:* shachi punyavati — virtuous Shachi; jagannatha bhagyavana — fortunate Jagannatha; sadare nirakhe donhe — both gaze lovingly; putrera bayana — at the son's face

**98.** Virtuous Shachi and fortunate Jagannatha
both gaze lovingly at their son's face.

ক্ষণে হাসে ক্ষণে রোয়ে ক্ষণে খটি করে ।
ক্ষণে কোলে ক্ষণে দোলে হিয়ার উপরে ॥ ৯৯ ॥

*kṣaṇe hāse kṣaṇe roẏe kṣaṇe khaṭi kare |*
*kṣaṇe kole kṣaṇe dole hiẏāra upare || 99 ||*

*Word for word:* kshane hase — now laughs; kshane roye — now cries; kshane khati kare — now frolics; kshane kole — now on the lap; kshane dole hiyara upare — now swings on the breast

**99.** Now He laughs, now He cries, now He frolics,
now He is on her lap, now He swings on her breast.

শচী-স্তনযুগে দুটি চরণ রাখিয়া ।
দোলে যেন সোণার লতিকা বায়ু পাঞা ॥ ১০০ ॥

*śacī-stanayuge duṭi caraṇa rākhiẏā |*
*dole yena soṇāra latikā bāẏu pāñā || 100 ||*

*Word for word:* shachi-stana-yuge — on Shachi's breast; duti charana rakhiya — planting both feet; dole — sways; yena sonara latika — like a golden creeper; vayu pana — catching the breeze

**100.** Planting both His feet on Shachi's breast,
He sways like a golden creeper in the breeze.

অতি দীর্ঘ নয়ান সুন্দর অট্টহাসি ।
অধরে অমিয়া রাশি পড়ে যেন খসি ॥ ১০১ ॥

*ati dīrgha naẏāna sundara aṭṭahāsi |*
*adhare amiẏā rāśi paṛe yena khasi || 101 ||*

*Word for word:* ati dirgha nayana — very long eyes; sundara attahasi — beautiful ringing laughter; adhare amiya rashi — heaps of nectar from the lips; pade yena khasi — seem to spill

**101.** Very long eyes, beautiful ringing laughter —
nectar seems to spill from His lips.

নাসিকা শুকের ওষ্ঠ জিনি মনোহর ।
গণ্ডযুগ জ্যোতির্ময় গঠন সুন্দর ॥ ১০২ ॥

*nāsikā śukera oṣṭha jini manohara |*
*gaṇḍayuga jyotirmaẏa gaṭhana sundara || 102 ||*

*Word for word:* nasika — the nose; shukera oshtha jini — surpassing a parrot's beak; manohara — charming; ganda-yuga jyotirmaya — both cheeks radiant; gathana sundara — the form beautiful

**102.** His nose more charming than a parrot's beak,
both cheeks radiant, His form beautiful.

[^09-1]: A has "upon living beings"; the 1983 edition "upon me".
[^09-2]: That is, not gross-bodied. The Gaudiya Vaishnavas stress that the Lord's birth is not a worldly conception: the eternal Lord, full of knowledge and bliss, first enters the heart of the father, then of the mother, and reveals Himself, as Krishna does in the *Bhagavata* (10.2.16–18); cf. *Chaitanya-charitamrita* (Adi 13.83–88).
[^09-3]: An elder brahmana bowing to a young woman and circumambulating her goes against custom; but Advaita is worshipping the Lord in her womb.
[^09-4]: A play on words in the praise: "Advaita" ("non-dual") and "Nityananda" ("eternal bliss") are both epithets of the Lord and names of His closest associates.
[^09-5]: "Gadadhara" ("holder of the mace") is a name of Vishnu; perhaps there is also an allusion to Gadadhara Pandita, Gaura's inseparable companion.
[^09-6]: Cf. *Chaitanya-charitamrita* (Adi 13.89–98): the Lord appeared on the full moon of Phalguna during a lunar eclipse, when everyone, according to custom, was chanting the names of Hari.
[^09-7]: So after Bhaktisiddhanta's summary ("her house became Vaikuntha"); in A the line is corrupt; the 1983 edition has "in Shachi's womb the riches of the great Vaikuntha".
[^09-8]: Marks on the feet and body of a *mahapurusha*. The rendering of the last mark ("the elephant's kumbha", i.e. the frontal globe on an elephant's head) is tentative.
[^09-9]: Here and further on (vv. 59, 75, 90) Lochana Dasa describes the attraction of the women of Nadia to Gaura in the spirit of his *nagari-bhava*, in which Gaura is the *nagara*, the beloved of the townswomen. The Gaudiya tradition, following Vrindavana Dasa and Krishnadasa Kaviraja, does not accept worship of Gaura in such a bhava; Bhaktisiddhanta counts the "Gaura-nagari" among the deviant schools. We translate the text as it stands.
[^09-10]: In A this stanza is given in brackets together with the disha and is unnumbered; in the 1983 edition it is the first stanza of the song.
[^09-11]: Sindura is red powder, the mark of a married woman; pithali is rice paste for auspicious designs; they are distributed to women at a birth festival.
[^09-12]: The name comes from *nim*, the bitter neem tree: by custom a child is given a "bitter" name to avert misfortune and the evil eye. According to the *Chaitanya-charitamrita* (Adi 13.118), the name Nimai was given by Sita Thakurani to protect Him from witches.
[^09-13]: *Ashtakalai* — the distribution to children of eight kinds of pulses and grains on the eighth day after birth; on the ninth night, a festival with music.

---

# Adi-khanda, part 2 (portion 10)

*Balya-lila (continued): the first rice-feeding and the name Vishvambhara; the first steps; Shachi's lullaby; at night the gods enthrone the child, and He dances with them singing of Radha and Krishna; the sound of ankle-bells on bare feet; pranks and broken pots; a rite for the boy's welfare; the Lord sits among discarded pots and teaches His mother about pure and impure*

এক দুই তিন চারি পাঁচ ছয় মাসে ।
নামকরণ হইল অন্নপ্রাশন-দিবসে ॥ ১০৩ ॥

*eka dui tina cāri pāṁca chaẏa māse |*
*nāmakaraṇa haila annaprāśana-dibase || 103 ||*

*Word for word:* eka dui tina chari pancha chhaya mase — in one, two, three, four, five, six months; namakarana haila — the naming took place; annaprashana-divase — on the day of the first rice-feeding

**103.** One, two, three, four, five, six months [passed] —
and on the day of the first rice-feeding the naming was performed.

পুত্র-মহোৎসব করে মিশ্র পুরন্দর ।
অলঙ্কারে ভূষিত সোণার কলেবর ॥ ১০৪ ॥

*putra-mahotsaba kare miśra purandara |*
*alaṅkāre bhūṣita soṇāra kalebara || 104 ||*

*Word for word:* putra-mahotsava kare — holds a great festival for the son; mishra purandara — Mishra Purandara; alankare bhushita — adorned with ornaments; sonara kalevara — the golden body

**104.** Mishra Purandara celebrates a festival for his son;
the golden body [of the child] is decked with ornaments:

অঙ্গদ কঙ্কণ করে গলে মতিহার ।
কটি স্বর্ণ-শিকলি মগরা পায়ে আর ॥ ১০৫ ॥

*aṅgada kaṅkaṇa kare gale matihāra |*
*kaṭi sbarṇa-śikali magarā pāẏe āra || 105 ||*

*Word for word:* angada kankana kare — armlets and bracelets on the arms; gale matihara — a pearl necklace on the neck; kati svarna-shikali — a golden chain at the waist; magara paye ara — and anklets on the feet

**105.** armlets and bracelets on His arms, a pearl necklace on His neck,
a golden chain around His waist, and anklets on His feet.

মাড়িল হিঙ্গুল যেন কর-পদতলে ।
অধর বান্ধুলি আঁখি রাতা উতপলে ॥ ১০৬ ॥

*māṛila hiṅgula yena kara-padatale |*
*adhara bāndhuli āṁkhi rātā utapale || 106 ||*

*Word for word:* madila hingula yena — as if vermilion were rubbed; kara-pada-tale — on palms and soles; adhara bandhuli — the lips a bandhuli flower; ankhi rata utapale — the eyes red lotuses

**106.** His palms and soles look as if rubbed with vermilion,
His lips are a bandhuli flower, His eyes red lotuses.

বিজুরী মাজিল গোরা-অঙ্গে ঠাঁই ঠাঁই ।
ঝলমল অঙ্গতেজ চাহিতে না পাই ॥ ১০৭ ॥

*bijurī mājila gorā-aṅge ṭhāṁi ṭhāṁi |*
*jhalamala aṅgateja cāhite nā pāi || 107 ||*

*Word for word:* bijuri majila — lightning is rubbed; gora-ange — on Gora's limbs; thain thain — here and there; jhalamala anga-teja — the body's radiance glitters; chahite na pai — one cannot look

**107.** It is as if lightning had been rubbed onto Gora's limbs here and there:
His body glitters so that one cannot look at it.

বিশ্বপালনে থুইল বিশ্বম্ভর নাম ।
সরস্বতী-সংবাদ এ পুরুষপ্রধান ॥ ১০৮ ॥

*biśbapālane thuila biśbambhara nāma |*
*sarasbatī-saṃbāda e puruṣapradhāna || 108 ||*

*Word for word:* vishva-palane — for sustaining the world; thuila vishvambhara nama — the name Vishvambhara was given; sarasvati-samvada — the message of Sarasvati; e purusha-pradhana — this is the Supreme Person

**108.** Because He sustains the world, He was given the name Vishvambhara[^10-1]:
such was the message of Sarasvati — this is the Supreme Person.

ক্ষণে পিতা-মাতা-কর-অঙ্গুলি ধরিয়া ।
অথির শরীর পড়ে পদ দুই যাঞা ॥ ১০৯ ॥

*kṣaṇe pitā-mātā-kara-aṅguli dhariẏā |*
*athira śarīra paṛe pada dui yāñā || 109 ||*

*Word for word:* kshane — now; pita-mata-kara-anguli dhariya — holding the fingers of father and mother; athira sharira — unsteady in body; pade — falls; pada dui yana — after going two steps

**109.** Now, holding the fingers of father and mother,
He takes two steps and falls, unsteady on His feet.

অব্যকত আধ আধ লহু লহু বোলে ।
চান্দের সায়রে যেন অমিয়া উথলে ॥ ১১০ ॥

*abyakata ādha ādha lahu lahu bole |*
*cāndera sāẏare yena amiẏā uthale || 110 ||*

*Word for word:* abyakata — indistinctly; adha adha — by halves; lahu lahu bole — speaks softly, softly; chandera sayare — in the ocean of the moon; yena amiya uthale — as if nectar wells up

**110.** Indistinctly, by halves, softly, softly He babbles —
as if nectar were welling up in an ocean of moonlight.

এইমতে দিনে দিনে আঙ্গিনা বেড়ায় ।
ঘুচিল বিবিধ তাপ জগত জুড়ায় ॥ ১১১ ॥

*eimate dine dine āṅginā beṛāẏa |*
*ghucila bibidha tāpa jagata juṛāẏa || 111 ||*

*Word for word:* ei-mate dine dine — thus day by day; angina bedaya — wanders about the courtyard; ghuchila vividha tapa — sufferings of all kinds vanished; jagata judaya — the world is cooled

**111.** So day by day He toddles about the courtyard;
sufferings of every kind are gone, the world is cooled.

লখিমী-লালিত পদ ধরণীর কোলে ।
প্রেমায় পৃথিবী দেবী আপনা পাসরে ॥ ১১২ ॥

*lakhimī-lālita pada dharaṇīra kole |*
*premāẏa pṛthibī debī āpanā pāsare || 112 ||*

*Word for word:* lakhimi-lalita pada — the feet caressed by Lakshmi; dharanira kole — on the lap of the earth; premaya — from love; prithivi devi — the goddess Prithivi; apana pasare — forgets herself

**112.** The feet that Lakshmi caresses are on the lap of the earth:
from love the goddess Prithivi forgets herself.

গগনে একলা চান্দ ভূমে দশ চান্দ ।
কিরণের তেজে যে যে আঁখি পাইল আন্ধ ॥ ১১৩ ॥

*gagane ekalā cānda bhūme daśa cānda |*
*kiraṇera teje ye ye āṁkhi pāila āndha || 113 ||*

*Word for word:* gagane ekala chanda — in the sky a single moon; bhume dasha chanda — on the ground ten moons; kiranera teje — by the brilliance of the rays; ye ye ankhi — whatever eyes [look]; paila andha — were blinded

**113.** In the sky there is one moon, but on the ground ten moons[^10-2]:
the brilliance of their rays blinds the eyes of those who look.

আর দশ চান্দ কর-অঙ্গুলির আগে ।
পাতকী দেখিয়া হিয়া-আন্ধিয়ার ভাগে ॥ ১১৪ ॥

*āra daśa cānda kara-aṅgulira āge |*
*pātakī dekhiẏā hiẏā-āndhiẏāra bhāge || 114 ||*

*Word for word:* ara dasha chanda — ten more moons; kara-angulira age — at the tips of the fingers; pataki dekhiya — a sinner seeing; hiya-andhiyara bhage — the darkness of the heart flees

**114.** And ten more moons are at the tips of His fingers:
if a sinner but looks, the darkness flees from his heart.

শ্রীমুখ-চান্দ কত কোটি চান্দের রাজা ।
ভুরু-কামধনু দিয়া কাম কৈল পূজা ॥ ১১৫ ॥

*śrīmukha-cānda kata koṭi cāndera rājā |*
*bhuru-kāmadhanu diẏā kāma kaila pūjā || 115 ||*

*Word for word:* shrimukha-chanda — the moon of the beautiful face; kata koti chandera raja — king of many millions of moons; bhuru-kama-dhanu diya — offering the brows, Kama's bow; kama kaila puja — Kama worshipped

**115.** The moon of His beautiful face is king of many millions of moons;
His brows are Kama's bow: Kama worshipped [Him] by offering his bow.

কি কহিব আর তার করুণা-চন্দ্রিমা ।
অন্তরে তিমির কাটে নাহি করে ক্ষমা ॥ ১১৬ ॥

*ki kahiba āra tāra karuṇā-candrimā |*
*antare timira kāṭe nāhi kare kṣamā || 116 ||*

*Word for word:* ki kahiba ara — what more shall I say; tara karuna-chandrima — of the moonlight of His mercy; antare timira kate — cuts the darkness within; nahi kare kshama — shows no mercy [to it]

**116.** What more can I say of the moonlight of His mercy?
It cuts through the darkness in the heart and does not spare it.[^10-3]

কে কহিতে পারে তার বালক-চরিত্র ।
লৌকিক আচারে কৈল পৃথিবী পবিত্র ॥ ১১৭ ॥

*ke kahite pāre tāra bālaka-caritra |*
*laukika ācāre kaila pṛthibī pabitra || 117 ||*

*Word for word:* ke kahite pare — who can tell; tara balaka-charitra — His childhood deeds; laukika achare — by ordinary conduct; kaila prithivi pavitra — made the earth holy

**117.** Who can tell of His childhood pastimes?
Behaving like an ordinary child, He sanctified the earth.

অগ্রজ তাহার বিশ্বরূপ মহাশয় ।
অল্পকালে সর্বশাস্ত্র জানে গুণময় ॥ ১১৮ ॥

*agraja tāhāra biśbarūpa mahāśaẏa |*
*alpakāle sarbaśāstra jāne guṇamaẏa || 118 ||*

*Word for word:* agraja tahara — His elder brother; vishvarupa mahashaya — the worthy Vishvarupa; alpa-kale — in a short time; sarva-shastra jane — knows all the scriptures; gunamaya — full of virtues

**118.** His elder brother is the worthy Vishvarupa:
endowed with every virtue, in a short time he mastered all the scriptures.

তাঁহার মহিমা-তত্ত্ব কে কহিতে পারে ।
যাহার অনুজ মহাপ্রভু বিশ্বম্ভরে ॥ ১১৯ ॥

*tāṁhāra mahimā-tattba ke kahite pāre |*
*yāhāra anuja mahāprabhu biśbambhare || 119 ||*

*Word for word:* tanhara mahima-tattva — the truth of his greatness; ke kahite pare — who can tell; yahara anuja — whose younger brother; mahaprabhu vishvambhare — is Mahaprabhu Vishvambhara

**119.** Who can tell the truth of his greatness —
of him whose younger brother is Mahaprabhu Vishvambhara?

দিনে দিনে করে প্রভু করুণা প্রকাশ ।
শুনি আনন্দিত হিয়া এ লোচনদাস ॥ ১২০ ॥

*dine dine kare prabhu karuṇā prakāśa |*
*śuni ānandita hiẏā e locanadāsa || 120 ||*

*Word for word:* dine dine — day by day; kare prabhu karuna prakasha — the Lord manifests mercy; shuni — hearing; anandita hiya — the heart rejoices; e lochanadasa — of this Lochana Dasa

**120.** Day by day the Lord reveals His mercy;
hearing of it, the heart of this Lochana Dasa rejoices.

*Raga varadi*

*Moon, moon, moon up in the sky —
who will pluck it and bring it to me?
Wiping off its stain,
I will paint a design on my Gora's forehead.
Come, come, come! My golden little son Nimai
is crying — He wants to sleep;
when He is fretful, every little word of His
is sweeter than nectar.*

এখনি আসিবে, নিমাইর বাপ,
ক্ষীর-কদলক লঞা ।
হের আসিছে বাপু, হাউ দুরন্ত রে,
নিন্দ যাহ আঁখি মুদিয়া ॥ ১২১ ॥

*ekhani āsibe, nimāira bāpa,*
*kṣīra-kadalaka lañā |*
*hera āsiche bāpu, hāu duranta re,*
*ninda yāha āṁkhi mudiẏā || 121 ||*

*Word for word:* ekhani asibe — will come now; nimaira bapa — Nimai's father; kshira-kadalaka lana — bringing thickened milk and bananas; hera asichhe bapu — look, child, is coming; hau duranta re — the dreadful bogey; ninda yaha — go to sleep; ankhi mudiya — closing the eyes

**121.** "Nimai's father will come right now,
bringing thickened milk and bananas.
Look, little one, here comes the dreadful bogey[^10-4] —
close Your eyes and go to sleep!"

সোণার পদ্ম মুখ, রাতা-পদ্ম আঁখি,
মুদিত আধটি তারা ।
হেন বুঝি পারা, মধুর পাথারে,
ডুবিল আধ ভ্রমরা ॥ ১২২ ॥

*soṇāra padma mukha, rātā-padma āṁkhi,*
*mudita ādhaṭi tārā |*
*hena bujhi pārā, madhura pāthāre,*
*ḍubila ādha bhramarā || 122 ||*

*Word for word:* sonara padma mukha — the face a golden lotus; rata-padma ankhi — the eyes red lotuses; mudita adhati tara — the pupils half closed; hena bujhi para — it seems as if; madhura pathare — in a sea of honey; dubila adha bhramara — bees half drowned

**122.** His face a golden lotus, His eyes red lotuses,
the pupils half closed —
it seems as if in a sea of honey
bees had half drowned.

পাটের গিলাপ, তাথে নেতের তুলি,
রচিয়া শয্যাখানি ।
কোলে করি পুত্র, পাথালি হইয়া,
শুতিলা শচী ঠাকুরাণী ॥ ১২৩ ॥

*pāṭera gilāpa, tāthe netera tuli,*
*raciẏā śayyākhāni |*
*kole kari putra, pāthāli haiẏā,*
*śutilā śacī ṭhākurāṇī || 123 ||*

*Word for word:* patera gilapa — a silk coverlet; tathe netera tuli — on it a fine-cloth quilt; rachiya shayyakhani — making the bed; kole kari putra — taking the son in her arms; pathali haiya — lying on her side; shutila shachi thakurani — Shachi Thakurani lay down

**123.** Making a bed — a silk coverlet
with a fine-cloth quilt upon it —
Shachi Thakurani, taking her son in her arms,
lay down on her side.

এক স্তন মুখে, রহি রহি চাখে,
অঙ্গুলি নাড়য়ে আর ।
লোচন বোলে সব, দেব-শিরোমণি,
বালক-বপু-ব্যবহার ॥ ১২৪ ॥

*eka stana mukhe, rahi rahi cākhe,*
*aṅguli nāṛaẏe āra |*
*locana bole saba, deba-śiromaṇi,*
*bālaka-bapu-byabahāra || 124 ||*

*Word for word:* eka stana mukhe — one breast in the mouth; rahi rahi chakhe — sucks now and then; anguli nadaye ara — fingers the other; lochana bole — Lochana says; saba — all [this]; deva-shiromani — of the Crest-jewel of the gods; balaka-vapu-vyavahara — the behaviour in a child's body

**124.** One breast He holds in His mouth and sucks now and then,
and fingers the other with His little hand.
Lochana says: all this
is the play of the Crest-jewel of the gods in the body of a child.

*Raga dhanashi; disha: "Are are haya!" (murchha). "Listen to this wondrous tale, the song of Gora's virtues — a name auspicious to the ear! O-ki are, o-ki are haya!"*

আর দিন এক কথা শুন সাবধানে ।
আপনা প্রকাশ প্রভু কৈল যেন মনে ॥ ১২৫ ॥

*āra dina eka kathā śuna sābadhāne |*
*āpanā prakāśa prabhu kaila yena mane || 125 ||*

*Word for word:* ara dina eka katha — a story of another day; shuna savadhane — listen carefully; apana prakasha — self-revelation; prabhu kaila yena mane — how the Lord made by His will

**125.** Listen carefully to what happened on another day —
how the Lord of His own will revealed Himself.

এক গৃহে জগন্নাথ গৃহান্তরে শচী ।
পুত্র কোলে করি শচী সুখে শুতি আছি ॥ ১২৬ ॥

*eka gṛhe jagannātha gṛhāntare śacī |*
*putra kole kari śacī sukhe śuti āchi || 126 ||*

*Word for word:* eka grihe jagannatha — Jagannatha in one room; grihantare shachi — Shachi in another room; putra kole kari — taking the son in her arms; shachi sukhe shuti achhi — Shachi lies sleeping happily

**126.** In one room is Jagannatha, in another Shachi:
taking her son with her, Shachi sleeps happily.

শূন্য ঘরে কত সৈন্য-সামন্ত ভরিল ।
ঐছন দেখিয়া শচী তরাসিত হৈল ॥ ১২৭ ॥

*śūnya ghare kata sainya-sāmanta bharila |*
*aichana dekhiẏā śacī tarāsita haila || 127 ||*

*Word for word:* shunya ghare — the empty room; kata sainya-samanta bharila — filled with many soldiers and nobles; aichhana dekhiya — seeing such; shachi tarasita haila — Shachi was frightened

**127.** The empty room filled with many soldiers and nobles;
seeing such a thing, Shachi was frightened.

যত দেবগণ আসি শচী-কোল হৈতে ।
বসাইল রত্ন-সিংহাসনেতে ত্বরিতে ॥ ১২৮ ॥

*yata debagaṇa āsi śacī-kola haite |*
*basāila ratna-siṃhāsanete tbarite || 128 ||*

*Word for word:* yata devagana asi — all the gods, coming; shachi-kola haite — from Shachi's lap; vasaila ratna-simhasanete — seated on a jewelled throne; tvarite — quickly

**128.** All the gods came and, taking [Him] from Shachi's arms,
quickly seated [Him] on a jewelled throne.

অভিষেক করি নানাবিধ পূজা করি ।
প্রদক্ষিণ করি পড়ে চরণেতে ধরি ॥ ১২৯ ॥

*abhiṣeka kari nānābidha pūjā kari |*
*pradakṣiṇa kari paṛe caraṇete dhari || 129 ||*

*Word for word:* abhisheka kari — performing the bathing rite; nanavidha puja kari — performing worship of many kinds; pradakshina kari — circumambulating; pade charanete dhari — fall, clasping the feet

**129.** Performing the bathing rite (abhisheka) and worship of many kinds,
they circle [Him] and fall down, clasping [His] feet.

শঙ্খ-ঘণ্টা-ধ্বনি সভে করে বারবার ।
জয়-জয়-হরিধ্বনি করিছে বিস্তার ॥ ১৩০ ॥

*śaṅkha-ghaṇṭā-dhbani sabhe kare bārabāra |*
*jaẏa-jaẏa-haridhbani kariche bistāra || 130 ||*

*Word for word:* shankha-ghanta-dhvani — the sound of conches and bells; sabhe kare barabara — all make again and again; jaya-jaya-hari-dhvani — cries of "jaya, jaya" and "Hari"; karichhe vistara — spread abroad

**130.** All of them sound conches and bells again and again,
and cries of "Jaya, jaya!" and "Hari!" spread all around:

জয় জয় জগন্নাথ সভার পালন ।
কলিযুগে মো-সভারে করিবে পোষণ ॥ ১৩১ ॥

*jaẏa jaẏa jagannātha sabhāra pālana |*
*kaliyuge mo-sabhāre karibe poṣaṇa || 131 ||*

*Word for word:* jaya jaya jagannatha — glory, glory to Jagannatha; sabhara palana — the protector of all; kali-yuge — in the Kali-yuga; mo-sabhare karibe poshana — will nourish us all

**131.** "Glory, glory to Jagannatha, the protector of all![^10-5]
In the Kali-yuga You will nourish us all.

বৃন্দাবন-ধন-রস দিবে মো-সভারে ।
নিবেদন তোমার চরণে বিশ্বম্ভরে ॥ ১৩২ ॥

*bṛndābana-dhana-rasa dibe mo-sabhāre |*
*nibedana tomāra caraṇe biśbambhare || 132 ||*

*Word for word:* vrindavana-dhana-rasa — the rasa, the treasure of Vrindavana; dibe mo-sabhare — You will give to us all; nivedana — the prayer; tomara charane — at Your feet; vishvambhare — O Vishvambhara

**132.** You will give us all the rasa that is the treasure of Vrindavana.
This is our prayer at Your feet, O Vishvambhara!"

দেখি শচীমাতা বারংবার চমকিত ।
পুত্র পুত্র করি শচী ভেল মহাভীত ॥ ১৩৩ ॥

*dekhi śacīmātā bāraṃbāra camakita |*
*putra putra kari śacī bhela mahābhīta || 133 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhi — seeing; shachimata — mother Shachi; barambara chamakita — startled again and again; putra putra kari — crying "son, son"; shachi bhela mahabhita — Shachi became greatly afraid

**133.** Seeing this, mother Shachi starts again and again;
"My son, my son!" Shachi cries in great fear.

আপনাকে নাহি ভয় পুত্রগত প্রাণ ।
বালক পাঠাঞা দিল জগন্নাথ-স্থান ॥ ১৩৪ ॥

*āpanāke nāhi bhaẏa putragata prāṇa |*
*bālaka pāṭhāñā dila jagannātha-sthāna || 134 ||*

*Word for word:* apanake nahi bhaya — no fear for herself; putra-gata prana — her life is in her son; balaka pathana dila — sent the boy; jagannatha-sthana — to Jagannatha

**134.** She has no fear for herself — her life is in her son:
she sent the boy away to Jagannatha:

তোর পিতা শুতি আছে ঐ না দেবঘরে ।
তথা গিয়া সুখে নিদ্রা যাহ তার কোলে ॥ ১৩৫ ॥

*tora pitā śuti āche ai nā debaghare |*
*tathā giẏā sukhe nidrā yāha tāra kole || 135 ||*

*Word for word:* tora pita shuti achhe — your father is sleeping; ai na deva-ghare — there in the Deity's room; tatha giya — going there; sukhe nidra yaha — sleep happily; tara kole — in his arms

**135.** "Your father is sleeping there, in the Deity's room;
go there and sleep happily in his arms."

চলিলা সে বিশ্বম্ভর মায়ের বচনে ।
নূপুরের ধ্বনি শুনি শূন্য চরণে ॥ ১৩৬ ॥

*calilā se biśbambhara māẏera bacane |*
*nūpurera dhbani śuni śūnya caraṇe || 136 ||*

*Word for word:* chalila se vishvambhara — Vishvambhara went; mayera vachane — at His mother's word; nupurera dhvani shuni — the sound of ankle-bells is heard; shunya charane — from bare feet

**136.** Vishvambhara went as His mother told Him —
and from His bare feet came the sound of ankle-bells.

বাহিরে আইলা যবে দেব-শিরোমণি ।
সকল দেবতা আইলা পাছে জোড়পাণি ॥ ১৩৭ ॥

*bāhire āilā yabe deba-śiromaṇi |*
*sakala debatā āilā pāche joṛapāṇi || 137 ||*

*Word for word:* bahire aila yabe — when He came out; deva-shiromani — the Crest-jewel of the gods; sakala devata aila — all the gods came; pachhe — behind; jodapani — with joined palms

**137.** When the Crest-jewel of the gods came out,
all the gods followed Him with joined palms.

প্রভু কহে দেবগণ নাচাহ আমারে ।
গাহ রাধাকৃষ্ণ-লীলা কহিল সভারে ॥ ১৩৮ ॥

*prabhu kahe debagaṇa nācāha āmāre |*
*gāha rādhākṛṣṇa-līlā kahila sabhāre || 138 ||*

*Word for word:* prabhu kahe — the Lord says; devagana — O gods; nachaha amare — make Me dance; gaha radhakrishna-lila — sing the pastimes of Radha and Krishna; kahila sabhare — He told them all

**138.** The Lord said: "O gods, make Me dance:[^10-6]
sing of the pastimes of Radha and Krishna," — so He told them all.

দেবে রাধাকৃষ্ণ-প্রেম গানেতে মিশাঞা ।
দিলেন আনন্দে গৌরচন্দ্র যে ধরিয়া ॥ ১৩৯ ॥

*debe rādhākṛṣṇa-prema gānete miśāñā |*
*dilena ānande gauracandra ye dhariẏā || 139 ||*

*Word for word:* deve — the gods; radhakrishna-prema — the prema of Radha and Krishna; ganete mishana — blending into the song; dilena anande — offered in bliss; gaurachandra ye dhariya — Gaurachandra taking it up

**139.** The gods blended the prema of Radha and Krishna into their song
and offered it in bliss — and Gaurachandra took it up.

আপনি কান্দেন কান্দায়েন দেবগণে ।
রাধা রাধা গোবিন্দ প্রভু বলিছে প্রাঙ্গণে ॥ ১৪০ ॥

*āpani kāndena kāndāẏena debagaṇe |*
*rādhā rādhā gobinda prabhu baliche prāṅgaṇe || 140 ||*

*Word for word:* apani kandena — He Himself weeps; kandayena devagane — makes the gods weep; radha radha govinda — "Radha, Radha, Govinda"; prabhu balichhe prangane — the Lord cries in the courtyard

**140.** He Himself weeps and makes the gods weep;
"Radha, Radha, Govinda!" the Lord cries in the courtyard.

কালিন্দী যমুনা বৃন্দাবন বলি ডাকে ।
রাধা রাধা বলিয়া ডাকেন মহাসুখে ॥ ১৪১ ॥

*kālindī yamunā bṛndābana bali ḍāke |*
*rādhā rādhā baliẏā ḍākena mahāsukhe || 141 ||*

*Word for word:* kalindi yamuna vrindavana — "Kalindi, Yamuna, Vrindavana"; bali dake — calls out; radha radha baliya — saying "Radha, Radha"; dakena mahasukhe — calls in great bliss

**141.** He calls out: "Kalindi, Yamuna, Vrindavana!" —
He calls "Radha, Radha!" in great bliss.

দেখিয়া পুত্রের লীলা মূর্চ্ছা শচী হইলা ।
শব্দ শুনি জগন্নাথ অস্থিরে আইলা ॥ ১৪২ ॥

*dekhiẏā putrera līlā mūrcchā śacī hailā |*
*śabda śuni jagannātha asthire āilā || 142 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhiya putrera lila — seeing her son's play; murchchha shachi haila — Shachi fainted; shabda shuni — hearing the sound; jagannatha asthire aila — Jagannatha came in alarm

**142.** Seeing her son's play, Shachi fainted;
hearing the noise, Jagannatha came running in alarm.

জগন্নাথ ডাকে শচী কিনা ধ্বনি শুনি ।
উচ্চস্বরে ডাকে তরাসিত শচীরাণী ॥ ১৪৩ ॥

*jagannātha ḍāke śacī kinā dhbani śuni |*
*uccasbare ḍāke tarāsita śacīrāṇī || 143 ||*

*Word for word:* jagannatha dake — Jagannatha calls; shachi — Shachi; kina dhvani shuni — what sound do I hear; uchchasvare dake — calls loudly; tarasita shachirani — frightened Shachi-rani

**143.** Jagannatha calls: "Shachi, what sounds are these I hear?" —
and frightened Shachi-rani calls out loudly too.

বাহিরে আসিয়া দোঁহে পুত্র কৈল কোলে ।
শূন্য চরণ দেখি আপনা পাসরে ॥ ১৪৪ ॥

*bāhire āsiẏā doṁhe putra kaila kole |*
*śūnya caraṇa dekhi āpanā pāsare || 144 ||*

*Word for word:* bahire asiya — coming out; donhe — both; putra kaila kole — took the son in their arms; shunya charana dekhi — seeing the bare feet; apana pasare — forget themselves

**144.** Coming outside, both took their son in their arms;
seeing His bare feet, they forget themselves.

ততক্ষণে কৃষ্ণের চরিত্র মনে পড়ে ।
শচীদেবী কহিল যে দেখিল নিজঘরে ॥ ১৪৫ ॥

*tatakṣaṇe kṛṣṇera caritra mane paṛe |*
*śacīdebī kahila ye dekhila nijaghare || 145 ||*

*Word for word:* tatkshane — at once; krishnera charitra — the deeds of Krishna; mane pade — come to mind; shachidevi kahila — Shachi-devi told; ye dekhila nija-ghare — what she saw in her room

**145.** At once the deeds of Krishna came to their minds;
Shachi-devi told what she had seen in her room:

চারিমুখ পাঁচমুখ-আদি যত দেবা ।
দিব্য যানে আসি কৈল বালকের সেবা ॥ ১৪৬ ॥

*cārimukha pāṁcamukha-ādi yata debā |*
*dibya yāne āsi kaila bālakera sebā || 146 ||*

*Word for word:* charimukha — the Four-faced; panchamukha — the Five-faced; adi yata deva — and all the other gods; divya yane asi — coming in celestial vehicles; kaila balakera seva — served the boy

**146.** "The Four-faced one, the Five-faced one[^10-7] and all the other gods
came in celestial vehicles and served the boy.

প্রাঙ্গণে নাচিল পুত্র রাধাকৃষ্ণ বলি ।
আমিহ শুনিল স্বপ্নবত মনে করি ॥ ১৪৭ ॥

*prāṅgaṇe nācila putra rādhākṛṣṇa bali |*
*āmiha śunila sbapnabata mane kari || 147 ||*

*Word for word:* prangane nachila putra — in the courtyard the son danced; radhakrishna bali — saying "Radha-Krishna"; amiha shunila — I too heard; svapnavata mane kari — thinking it like a dream

**147.** In the courtyard our son danced, crying 'Radha-Krishna' —
I heard it too, but it seemed to me like a dream.

দেখিয়া তরাসে তব ঠাঞি পাঠাইল ।
শূন্য চরণে নূপুর-শবদ শুনিল ॥ ১৪৮ ॥

*dekhiẏā tarāse taba ṭhāñi pāṭhāila |*
*śūnya caraṇe nūpura-śabada śunila || 148 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhiya — seeing; tarase — in fear; taba thani pathaila — I sent to you; shunya charane — from bare feet; nupura-shabada shunila — heard the sound of ankle-bells

**148.** Seeing this, I sent Him to you in fear —
and I heard the sound of ankle-bells from His bare feet.

এহেন বালক দিব্য মূরতি সুঠান ।
না জানি কখন কেবা করয়ে কুজ্ঞান ॥ ১৪৯ ॥

*ehena bālaka dibya mūrati suṭhāna |*
*nā jāni kakhana kebā karaẏe kujñāna || 149 ||*

*Word for word:* ehena balaka — such a boy; divya murati suthana — a divine, beautiful form; na jani — I do not know; kakhana keba — when someone; karaye kujnana — may cast the evil eye

**149.** Such a boy, such a divine, beautiful form —
who knows when someone may cast an evil eye on Him?

সাত কন্যা মরি মোর এইটি ছাওয়াল ।
ইহার যে কিছু হৈলে না জীব মো আর ॥ ১৫০ ॥

*sāta kanyā mari mora eiṭi chāoẏāla |*
*ihāra ye kichu haile nā jība mo āra || 150 ||*

*Word for word:* sata kanya mari — seven daughters having died; mora eiti chhaoyala — this child of mine; ihara ye kichhu haile — if anything happens to Him; na jiba mo ara — I shall live no more

**150.** Seven daughters of mine have died — this child is what is left;[^10-8]
if anything happens to Him, I shall not live any longer.

সাত পাঁচ নাই মোর এই আঁখি-তারা ।
আন্ধলের লড়ি যেন এই ধন মোরা ॥ ১৫১ ॥

*sāta pāṁca nāi mora ei āṁkhi-tārā |*
*āndhalera laṛi yena ei dhana morā || 151 ||*

*Word for word:* sata pancha nai mora — I have not many ("seven or five"); ei ankhi-tara — this apple of my eye; andhalera ladi yena — like a blind man's staff; ei dhana mora — this my treasure

**151.** I have not many — [He is] the apple of my eye;
like a blind man's staff — such is my treasure.

ঘর সরবস ধন দেহে আত্মা তনু ।
না রহে জীবন মোর গোরাচান্দ বিনু ॥ ১৫২ ॥

*ghara sarabasa dhana dehe ātmā tanu |*
*nā rahe jībana mora gorācānda binu || 152 ||*

*Word for word:* ghara sarabasa dhana — home, all I own, wealth; dehe atma tanu — the soul in the body, the body; na rahe jivana mora — my life will not remain; gorachanda vinu — without Gorachand

**152.** Home, all I possess, wealth, the soul in the body, the body itself — [all this is He];
without Gorachand I cannot live.

বিঘ্ন-নিবারণ-হেতু প্রতিকার চিন্ত ।
বালক-মঙ্গল করু দেব আদি অন্ত ॥ ১৫৩ ॥

*bighna-nibāraṇa-hetu pratikāra cinta |*
*bālaka-maṅgala karu deba ādi anta || 153 ||*

*Word for word:* vighna-nivarana-hetu — for warding off misfortune; pratikara chinta — think of a remedy; balaka-mangala karu — may they bless the boy; deva adi anta — the gods from first to last

**153.** Think of a remedy to ward off misfortune:
may all the gods, from first to last, grant the boy their blessing."

হেনমতে অনুমানে রাত্রি সুপ্রভাতে ।
খেলায় শচীর সুত বালক-সহিতে ॥ ১৫৪ ॥

*henamate anumāne rātri suprabhāte |*
*khelāẏa śacīra suta bālaka-sahite || 154 ||*

*Word for word:* hena-mate anumane — in such musings; ratri — the night; suprabhate — in the morning; khelaya shachira suta — Shachi's son plays; balaka-sahite — with the boys

**154.** In such musings [the] night [passed], and in the morning
Shachi's son is playing with the boys.

ক্ষণে আঙ্গিনায় লুঠি ধূলায়ে ধূসর ।
দেখিয়া জননী বোলে বচন কাতর ॥ ১৫৫ ॥

*kṣaṇe āṅgināẏa luṭhi dhūlāẏe dhūsara |*
*dekhiẏā jananī bole bacana kātara || 155 ||*

*Word for word:* kshane anginay luthi — now rolling in the courtyard; dhulaye dhusara — grey with dust; dekhiya janani — seeing, the mother; bole vachana katara — speaks plaintive words

**155.** Now He rolls about the courtyard, grey with dust;
seeing it, His mother speaks plaintively:

সোণার পুতলী তনু বদন সুছান্দ ।
উপমা দিবার নারি আকাশের চান্দ ॥ ১৫৬ ॥

*soṇāra putalī tanu badana suchānda |*
*upamā dibāra nāri ākāśera cānda || 156 ||*

*Word for word:* sonara putali tanu — the body a golden doll; badana suchhanda — the face lovely; upama dibara nari — I cannot compare; akashera chanda — [with] the moon in the sky

**156.** "Your body a golden doll, Your little face so lovely —
[even] the moon in the sky I cannot compare with it.

এহেন সুন্দর গায় ধূলায়ে পড়িয়া ।
লুটাঞা বুলহ কেনে মায়ের মাথা খাঞা ॥ ১৫৭ ॥

*ehena sundara gāẏa dhūlāẏe paṛiẏā |*
*luṭāñā bulaha kene māẏera māthā khāñā || 157 ||*

*Word for word:* ehena sundara gaya — with such a beautiful body; dhulaye padiya — falling in the dust; lutana bulaha kene — why do You roll about; mayera matha khana — I implore You by Your mother's life ("head")

**157.** Why do You, with such a beautiful body, fall in the dust
and roll about in it? I implore You by Your mother's life!"

ইহা বলি ধূলা ঝাড়ি চুম্বয়ে বদন ।
পুলকে পূরল অঙ্গ অরুণ নয়ন ॥ ১৫৮ ॥

*ihā bali dhūlā jhāṛi cumbaẏe badana |*
*pulake pūrala aṅga aruṇa naẏana || 158 ||*

*Word for word:* iha bali — saying this; dhula jhadi — brushing off the dust; chumbaye badana — kisses the face; pulake purala anga — the body is filled with thrills; aruna nayana — the eyes are red

**158.** Saying this, she brushes off the dust and kisses His face;
her body thrills with rapture, her eyes grow red.

তবে আর কথোদিনে শচীর নন্দন ।
বয়স্য-সহিতে করে বাহিরে পর্যটন ॥ ১৫৯ ॥

*tabe āra kathodine śacīra nandana |*
*baẏasya-sahite kare bāhire paryaṭana || 159 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe ara katho-dine — then after some days; shachira nandana — Shachi's son; vayasya-sahite — with His companions; kare bahire paryatana — roams outside

**159.** Then, some days later, Shachi's son
began to roam outside the house with His companions.

গঙ্গাতীরে তরুমূলে খেলাঞা বেড়ায় ।
মর্কট-খেলা খেলে একচরণে দাণ্ডায় ॥ ১৬০ ॥

*gaṅgātīre tarumūle khelāñā beṛāẏa |*
*markaṭa-khelā khele ekacaraṇe dāṇḍāẏa || 160 ||*

*Word for word:* gangatire — on the bank of the Ganga; tarumule — at the foot of the trees; khelana bedaya — wanders playing; markata-khela khele — plays the monkey game; eka-charane dandaya — stands on one leg

**160.** Under the trees on the bank of the Ganga He wanders, playing;
He plays the "monkey game" — standing on one leg.

শুনিলেন শচী গঙ্গাতীরে গৌরহরি ।
ধরিতে চলিলা শচী হাতে ছড়ি করি ॥ ১৬১ ॥

*śunilena śacī gaṅgātīre gaurahari |*
*dharite calilā śacī hāte chaṛi kari || 161 ||*

*Word for word:* shunilena shachi — Shachi heard; gangatire gaurahari — Gaurahari is on the Ganga's bank; dharite chalila shachi — Shachi went to catch [Him]; hate chhadi kari — with a switch in hand

**161.** Shachi heard that Gaurahari was on the bank of the Ganga
and went to catch Him with a switch in her hand.

জানুর উপরে জানু রহে একপদে ।
দেখিয়া জননী ডাকে উৎকট শবদে ॥ ১৬২ ॥

*jānura upare jānu rahe ekapade |*
*dekhiẏā jananī ḍāke utkaṭa śabade || 162 ||*

*Word for word:* janura upare janu — knee upon knee; rahe eka-pade — stands on one foot; dekhiya janani — seeing, the mother; dake utkata shabade — calls in a piercing voice

**162.** Knee upon knee — He stands on one leg;
seeing it, His mother calls in a piercing voice.

মায়েরে দেখিয়া প্রভু পলাইয়া যায় ।
মাতিল-কুঞ্জর যেন উলটিয়া চায় ॥ ১৬৩ ॥

*māẏere dekhiẏā prabhu palāiẏā yāẏa |*
*mātila-kuñjara yena ulaṭiẏā cāẏa || 163 ||*

*Word for word:* mayere dekhiya — seeing His mother; prabhu palaiya yaya — the Lord runs away; matila-kunjara yena — like a frolicking elephant; ulatiya chaya — looks back

**163.** Seeing His mother, the Lord runs away,
looking back like a frolicking elephant.

ধর ধর বলি ডাক ছাড়ে শচীরাণী ।
আগে আগে ধায় মোর প্রভু দ্বিজমণি ॥ ১৬৪ ॥

*dhara dhara bali ḍāka chāṛe śacīrāṇī |*
*āge āge dhāẏa mora prabhu dbijamaṇi || 164 ||*

*Word for word:* dhara dhara bali — crying "catch, catch"; daka chhade shachirani — Shachi-rani shouts; age age dhaya — ahead runs; mora prabhu dvijamani — my Lord, the jewel of brahmanas

**164.** "Catch Him, catch Him!" shouts Shachi-rani;
ahead runs my Lord, the jewel of brahmanas.

ধরিবারে চাহে শচী ধরিতে না পারে ।
ধাঞা সাম্ভাইল প্রভু ঘরের ভিতরে ॥ ১৬৫ ॥

*dharibāre cāhe śacī dharite nā pāre |*
*dhāñā sāmbhāila prabhu gharera bhitare || 165 ||*

*Word for word:* dharibare chahe shachi — Shachi wants to catch; dharite na pare — cannot catch; dhana sambhaila prabhu — the Lord ran in; gharera bhitare — into the house

**165.** Shachi wants to catch Him and cannot;
the Lord ran into the house.

ঘর-মধ্যে যত ভাণ্ড ভাজন আছিল ।
ধর ধর করিতে সর্ব আছাড়ি ভাঙ্গিল ॥ ১৬৬ ॥

*ghara-madhye yata bhāṇḍa bhājana āchila |*
*dhara dhara karite sarba āchāṛi bhāṅgila || 166 ||*

*Word for word:* ghara-madhye — in the house; yata bhanda bhajana achhila — all the pots and vessels there were; dhara dhara karite — while [she cried] "catch, catch"; sarva achhadi bhangila — He smashed them all, dashing them down

**166.** All the pots and vessels that were in the house,
while [His mother cried] "catch Him, catch Him!", He smashed, dashing them to the ground.

নাসায় অঙ্গুলি শচী দাণ্ডাইয়া চাহে ।
হেঁট বদন করি প্রভু বিশ্বম্ভর রহে ॥ ১৬৭ ॥

*nāsāẏa aṅguli śacī dāṇḍāiẏā cāhe |*
*heṁṭa badana kari prabhu biśbambhara rahe || 167 ||*

*Word for word:* nasaya anguli — a finger to the nose; shachi dandaiya chahe — Shachi stands and looks; henta badana kari — with face lowered; prabhu vishvambhara rahe — the Lord Vishvambhara stands

**167.** Shachi stands with a finger to her nose and looks;
the Lord Vishvambhara stands with His face lowered.

অতি বড় কম্পিত হইল লজ্জাভরে ।
দাণ্ডাইল হেঁটমুখে অশ্রু নেত্রে ঝরে ॥ ১৬৮ ॥

*ati baṛa kampita haila lajjābhare |*
*dāṇḍāila heṁṭamukhe aśru netre jhare || 168 ||*

*Word for word:* ati bada kampita haila — trembled greatly; lajja-bhare — with shame; dandaila henta-mukhe — stood with downcast face; ashru netre jhare — tears stream from the eyes

**168.** He trembles all over with shame;
He stands with downcast face, tears streaming from His eyes —

চন্দ্রের উপরে যেন খঞ্জন বসিয়া ।
উগারয়ে মতিহার যেমন গিলিয়া ॥ ১৬৯ ॥

*candrera upare yena khañjana basiẏā |*
*ugāraẏe matihāra yemana giliẏā || 169 ||*

*Word for word:* chandrera upare — upon the moon; yena khanjana vasiya — as if wagtails sitting; ugaraye matihara — let fall a pearl necklace; yemana giliya — as if having swallowed [it]

**169.** as if wagtails sitting on the moon
were letting fall a pearl necklace they had swallowed.[^10-9]

দেখি শচী গোরামুখ প্রেমে পূর্ণ হঞা ।
আইস কোলে করি বোলে মোর দুলালিয়া ॥ ১৭০ ॥

*dekhi śacī gorāmukha preme pūrṇa hañā |*
*āisa kole kari bole mora dulāliẏā || 170 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhi shachi goramukha — Shachi, seeing Gora's face; preme purna hana — filled with love; aisa kole — come into my arms; kari bole — she says; mora dulaliya — my darling

**170.** Seeing Gora's face, Shachi was filled with love
and says: "Come into my arms, my darling!"

করে ধরি কোলে করি বোলে শচীরাণী ।
ঘর-সরবস যাও তোমার নিছনি ॥ ১৭১ ॥

*kare dhari kole kari bole śacīrāṇī |*
*ghara-sarabasa yāo tomāra nichani || 171 ||*

*Word for word:* kare dhari — taking His hand; kole kari — lifting Him into her arms; bole shachirani — Shachi-rani says; ghara-sarabasa yao — may home and all I own go; tomara nichhani — as Your ransom

**171.** Taking His hand, lifting Him into her arms, Shachi-rani says:
"May my home and all I own be given up as Your ransom (nichhani)!"

এইমতে নানা লীলা করে গৌরহরি ।
বুঝিতে না পারে শচী পুত্রের চাতুরী ॥ ১৭২ ॥

*eimate nānā līlā kare gaurahari |*
*bujhite nā pāre śacī putrera cāturī || 172 ||*

*Word for word:* ei-mate — thus; nana lila kare gaurahari — Gaurahari performs various pastimes; bujhite na pare shachi — Shachi cannot understand; putrera chaturi — her son's cleverness

**172.** Thus Gaurahari performs various pastimes;
Shachi cannot fathom her son's clever ways.

লোক-বেদ-অগোচর চরিত্র অপার ।
ঔদ্ধত্য জানিল শচী না বুঝি বেভার ॥ ১৭৩ ॥

*loka-beda-agocara caritra apāra |*
*auddhatya jānila śacī nā bujhi bebhāra || 173 ||*

*Word for word:* loka-veda-agochara — beyond the world and the Vedas; charitra apara — boundless deeds; auddhatya janila shachi — Shachi took for naughtiness; na bujhi bebhara — not understanding the conduct

**173.** His boundless deeds are beyond the reach of worldly sense and of the Vedas;
not understanding His conduct, Shachi took it for naughtiness.

সুদৃঢ় চঞ্চল পুত্র জানিল নিমাই ।
দুঃখভাবে শচীদেবী সোঙরে গোসাঞি ॥ ১৭৪ ॥

*sudṛṛha cañcala putra jānila nimāi |*
*duḥkhabhābe śacīdebī soṅare gosāñi || 174 ||*

*Word for word:* sudridha chanchala putra — a thoroughly restless son; janila nimai — she judged Nimai; duhkha-bhave — in sorrow; shachidevi songare gosani — Shachi-devi remembers God

**174.** She decided that Nimai was an incorrigibly restless boy,
and in her sorrow Shachi-devi calls upon God.

একদিন পরিণত আনি যত নারী ।
পুছিলেন সভাকারে অনুনয় করি ॥ ১৭৫ ॥

*ekadina pariṇata āni yata nārī |*
*puchilena sabhākāre anunaẏa kari || 175 ||*

*Word for word:* ekadina — one day; parinata ani yata nari — gathering all the elderly women; puchhilena sabhakare — asked them all; anunaya kari — humbly

**175.** One day, gathering all the elderly women,
she humbly asked them all:

কত সাধে পুত্র মোরে দিলেন গোসাঞি ।
ক্ষিপ্ত-মত আচরণ বুদ্ধি কিছু নাঞি ॥ ১৭৬ ॥

*kata sādhe putra more dilena gosāñi |*
*kṣipta-mata ācaraṇa buddhi kichu nāñi || 176 ||*

*Word for word:* kata sadhe — after so much longing; putra more dilena gosani — God gave me a son; kshipta-mata acharana — behaves like a madman; buddhi kichhu nani — has no sense at all

**176.** "How I prayed — and God gave me a son;
but He behaves like a madman, He has no sense at all.

এক করে আর বোলে বুঝিতে না পারি ।
আচার পবিত্র কিছু না করে বিচারি ॥ ১৭৭ ॥

*eka kare āra bole bujhite nā pāri |*
*ācāra pabitra kichu nā kare bicāri || 177 ||*

*Word for word:* eka kare — does one thing; ara bole — says another; bujhite na pari — I cannot understand; achara pavitra — custom and purity; kichhu na kare vichari — does not consider at all

**177.** He does one thing and says another — I cannot understand;
He pays no heed to custom or to purity."

শুনি সভে কান্দিতে লাগিলা দুঃখভরে ।
কোলে করি গোরাচান্দে সভে মেলি বোলে ॥ ১৭৮ ॥

*śuni sabhe kāndite lāgilā duḥkhabhare |*
*kole kari gorācānde sabhe meli bole || 178 ||*

*Word for word:* shuni sabhe — hearing, all; kandite lagila — began to weep; duhkha-bhare — with sorrow; kole kari gorachande — taking Gorachand on their laps; sabhe meli bole — all together say

**178.** Hearing this, they all began to weep with sorrow;
taking Gorachand on their laps, they all say together:

কেনে কেনে বাপ এত কর অমঙ্গল ।
শুনি বিশ্বম্ভর হৈলা অত্যন্ত চঞ্চল ॥ ১৭৯ ॥

*kene kene bāpa eta kara amaṅgala |*
*śuni biśbambhara hailā atyanta cañcala || 179 ||*

*Word for word:* kene kene bapa — why, why, child; eta kara amangala — do You do so much ill; shuni vishvambhara — hearing, Vishvambhara; haila atyanta chanchala — became exceedingly restless

**179.** "Why, why, child, do You do so much that is wrong?"
Hearing this, Vishvambhara became more restless than ever.

দেখি নারীগণ ব্যথা পাইল অন্তরে ।
শচী যে কহিল তাহা দেখিল সত্বরে ॥ ১৮০ ॥

*dekhi nārīgaṇa byathā pāila antare |*
*śacī ye kahila tāhā dekhila satbare || 180 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhi narigana — seeing, the women; vyatha paila antare — were pained at heart; shachi ye kahila — what Shachi had said; taha dekhila satvare — they saw at once

**180.** Seeing it, the women were pained at heart:
what Shachi had told, they saw [for themselves] at once.

কবে হৈতে এমন হইল পুত্র তোর ।
শচী বোলে না পারি কহিতে কিছু ওর ॥ ১৮১ ॥

*kabe haite emana haila putra tora |*
*śacī bole nā pāri kahite kichu ora || 181 ||*

*Word for word:* kabe haite — since when; emana haila putra tora — has your son become like this; shachi bole — Shachi says; na pari kahite — I cannot tell; kichhu ora — the end of it

**181.** "Since when has your son been like this?"
Shachi says: "I cannot even tell all of it.

একদিন রাত্রে পুত্র ছিনু কোলে করি ।
আসি সব দেবতা রহিল ঘর ভরি ॥ ১৮২ ॥

*ekadina rātre putra chinu kole kari |*
*āsi saba debatā rahila ghara bhari || 182 ||*

*Word for word:* ekadina ratre — one night; putra chhinu kole kari — I was holding my son; asi saba devata — all the gods came; rahila ghara bhari — and stayed filling the room

**182.** One night I was sleeping with my son in my arms;
all the gods came and filled the room.

দিব্য সিংহাসনে মোর নিমাঞি রাখিয়া ।
দণ্ডবত করে তারা চরণে পড়িয়া ॥ ১৮৩ ॥

*dibya siṃhāsane mora nimāñi rākhiẏā |*
*daṇḍabata kare tārā caraṇe paṛiẏā || 183 ||*

*Word for word:* divya simhasane — on a divine throne; mora nimani rakhiya — placing my Nimai; dandavata kare tara — they prostrate themselves; charane padiya — falling at His feet

**183.** Seating my Nimai on a divine throne,
they fell at His feet and prostrated themselves.

জাগিয়া দেখিনু মুঞি এত চমৎকার ।
সেই হৈতে কিবা তন্ত্র হইল ইহার ॥ ১৮৪ ॥

*jāgiẏā dekhinu muñi eta camatkāra |*
*sei haite kibā tantra haila ihāra || 184 ||*

*Word for word:* jagiya — waking; dekhinu muni — I saw; eta chamatkara — such a wonder; sei haite — since then; kiba tantra haila ihara — what spell has come upon Him

**184.** Waking, I saw such a wonder;
since then — I do not know what spell is upon Him."

শুনি সভে এই মত বলিলেন বাণী ।
কোন দেব ইহাতে রহিল অনুমানি ॥ ১৮৫ ॥

*śuni sabhe ei mata balilena bāṇī |*
*kona deba ihāte rahila anumāni || 185 ||*

*Word for word:* shuni sabhe — hearing, all; ei mata balilena vani — spoke words to this effect; kona deva — some god; ihate rahila — dwells in Him; anumani — we suppose

**185.** Hearing this, they all gave this opinion:
"It seems some god is dwelling in Him.

সব-দেব-নামে এক যজ্ঞ আরম্ভিয়া ।
সব বিপ্র লঞা আইস মিশ্রেরে বলিয়া ॥ ১৮৬ ॥

*saba-deba-nāme eka yajña ārambhiẏā |*
*saba bipra lañā āisa miśrere baliẏā || 186 ||*

*Word for word:* saba-deva-name — in the name of all the gods; eka yajna arambhiya — beginning a sacrifice; saba vipra lana aisa — bring all the brahmanas; mishrere baliya — telling Mishra

**186.** Begin a sacrifice in the name of all the gods:
tell Mishra to bring all the brahmanas.

স্বস্ত্যয়ন করি কর বালক-কল্যাণ ।
পূজা পাঞা দেব যেন যায় নিজস্থান ॥ ১৮৭ ॥

*sbastyaẏana kari kara bālaka-kalyāṇa |*
*pūjā pāñā deba yena yāẏa nijasthāna || 187 ||*

*Word for word:* svastyayana kari — performing a svastyayana; kara balaka-kalyana — secure the boy's welfare; puja pana — receiving worship; deva yena yaya nijasthana — so that the god goes to his abode

**187.** Perform a svastyayana[^10-10] for the boy's welfare,
so that the god, having received worship, may go back to his abode.

চিন্তা না করিহ শচী কহিল নিশ্চয় ।
পূজা পাইলে দেব তোরে করিবে অভয় ॥ ১৮৮ ॥

*cintā nā kariha śacī kahila niścaẏa |*
*pūjā pāile deba tore karibe abhaẏa || 188 ||*

*Word for word:* chinta na kariha shachi — do not worry, Shachi; kahila nishchaya — they said with certainty; puja paile — having received worship; deva tore karibe abhaya — the god will free you from fear

**188.** Do not worry, Shachi," they said with certainty,
"having received worship, the god will free you from fear."

সভারে বিদায় দিল পদধূলি লঞা ।
কহিলেন সব শচী মিশ্রেরে যাইয়া ॥ ১৮৯ ॥

*sabhāre bidāẏa dila padadhūli lañā |*
*kahilena saba śacī miśrere yāiẏā || 189 ||*

*Word for word:* sabhare vidaya dila — bade them all farewell; padadhuli lana — taking the dust of their feet; kahilena saba shachi — Shachi told everything; mishrere yaiya — going to Mishra

**189.** Taking the dust of their feet, [Shachi] bade them all farewell
and, going to Mishra, told him everything.

শুনি মিশ্র সচিন্তিত দ্রব্য সব করি ।
যজ্ঞ করে ব্রাহ্মণের গণকে আহুরি ॥ ১৯০ ॥

*śuni miśra sacintita drabya saba kari |*
*yajña kare brāhmaṇera gaṇake āhuri || 190 ||*

*Word for word:* shuni mishra — hearing, Mishra; sachintita — anxious; dravya saba kari — preparing all the articles; yajna kare — performs the sacrifice; brahmanera ganake ahuri — summoning the assembly of brahmanas

**190.** Hearing this, the anxious Mishra prepared all that was needed
and, summoning the brahmanas, performed the sacrifice.

এথা শচী গৌরচন্দ্র লঞা গঙ্গাস্নানে ।
চঞ্চল ঘুচিল পুত্র করি এই মনে ॥ ১৯১ ॥

*ethā śacī gauracandra lañā gaṅgāsnāne |*
*cañcala ghucila putra kari ei mane || 191 ||*

*Word for word:* etha shachi — meanwhile Shachi; gaurachandra lana — taking Gaurachandra; ganga-snane — to bathe in the Ganga; chanchala ghuchila putra — the son's restlessness is gone; kari ei mane — thinking thus

**191.** Meanwhile Shachi took Gaurachandra to bathe in the Ganga,
thinking: "Now my son's restlessness is over."

শচী আগে আগে যায় বিশ্বম্ভর রায় ।
খেলিতে খেলিতে সে অশুচি-দেশে যায় ॥ ১৯২ ॥

*śacī āge āge yāẏa biśbambhara rāẏa |*
*khelite khelite se aśuci-deśe yāẏa || 192 ||*

*Word for word:* shachi age age yaya — goes ahead of Shachi; vishvambhara raya — Vishvambhara Raya; khelite khelite — playing; se ashuchi-deshe yaya — He goes into an impure place

**192.** Ahead of Shachi goes Vishvambhara Raya;
playing, He goes into an impure place.

ত্যক্ত-ভাণ্ড পরশ করিয়া চলি যায় ।
দেখিয়া জননী দেবী করে হায় হায় ॥ ১৯৩ ॥

*tyakta-bhāṇḍa paraśa kariẏā cali yāẏa |*
*dekhiẏā jananī debī kare hāẏa hāẏa || 193 ||*

*Word for word:* tyakta-bhanda — discarded pots; parasha kariya — touching; chali yaya — walks on; dekhiya janani devi — seeing, the mother-goddess; kare haya haya — cries "alas, alas"

**193.** Touching discarded pots, He walks on;
seeing it, His mother cries: "Alas, alas!

অধিক চঞ্চল পুত্র হইল আমার ।
স্বস্ত্যয়নের ধর্ম আর হইল বিস্তার ॥ ১৯৪ ॥

*adhika cañcala putra haila āmāra |*
*sbastyaẏanera dharma āra haila bistāra || 194 ||*

*Word for word:* adhika chanchala — more restless; putra haila amara — my son has become; svastyayanera dharma — the effect of the svastyayana; ara haila vistara — has only spread further

**194.** My son has become more restless still:
so this is what the svastyayana has done!"

ছি ছি বলিয়া ডাকে বোলে কটূত্তর ।
শুনিয়া সদয় বাণী বোলে বিশ্বম্ভর ॥ ১৯৫ ॥

*chi chi baliẏā ḍāke bole kaṭūttara |*
*śuniẏā sadaẏa bāṇī bole biśbambhara || 195 ||*

*Word for word:* chhi chhi baliya dake — cries "shame, shame"; bole katuttara — speaks harsh words; shuniya — hearing; sadaya vani — kind words; bole vishvambhara — Vishvambhara speaks

**195.** "Shame, shame!" she cries and scolds Him harshly;
having heard her, Vishvambhara replies with kindly words:

কি শুচি অশুচি কিবা ধর্মাধর্ম তত্ত্ব ।
না বুঝি বিচার কিছু ভ্রময়ে জগত ॥ ১৯৬ ॥

*ki śuci aśuci kibā dharmādharma tattba |*
*nā bujhi bicāra kichu bhramaẏe jagata || 196 ||*

*Word for word:* ki shuchi ashuchi — what is pure and impure; kiba dharmadharma tattva — what is the truth of dharma and adharma; na bujhi vichara kichhu — not discerning at all; bhramaye jagata — the world wanders

**196.** "What is pure and impure, what is the truth of dharma and adharma?
Not discerning this, the world wanders astray.

ক্ষিতি জল বায়ু অগ্নি আকাশ আকার ।
জগতে যতেক ইহা বহি নাহি আর ॥ ১৯৭ ॥

*kṣiti jala bāẏu agni ākāśa ākāra |*
*jagate yateka ihā bahi nāhi āra || 197 ||*

*Word for word:* kshiti jala vayu agni akasha — earth, water, air, fire, ether; akara — the forms; jagate yateka — whatever is in the world; iha vahi nahi ara — there is nothing besides these

**197.** Earth, water, air, fire, ether — these are [all] the forms;
in the whole world there is nothing but these.

শ্রীকৃষ্ণ-চরণ বিনু নাহি অন্য ধর্ম ।
কৃষ্ণ সর্বেশ্বরেশ্বর কহিল এ মর্ম ॥ ১৯৮ ॥

*śrīkṛṣṇa-caraṇa binu nāhi anya dharma |*
*kṛṣṇa sarbeśbareśbara kahila e marma || 198 ||*

*Word for word:* shrikrishna-charana vinu — apart from the feet of Sri Krishna; nahi anya dharma — there is no other dharma; krishna sarveshvareshvara — Krishna is the Lord of all lords; kahila e marma — He told this essence

**198.** There is no other dharma than the feet of Sri Krishna:
Krishna is the Lord of lords" — such was the essence He told.[^10-11]

ইহা শুনি শচীদেবী বিস্ময় হইয়া ।
সুরনদী-স্নান কৈলা গৌরাঙ্গ লইয়া ॥ ১৯৯ ॥

*ihā śuni śacīdebī bismaẏa haiẏā |*
*suranadī-snāna kailā gaurāṅga laiẏā || 199 ||*

*Word for word:* iha shuni — hearing this; shachidevi vismaya haiya — Shachi-devi, amazed; suranadi-snana kaila — bathed in the heavenly river; gauranga laiya — taking Gauranga

**199.** Hearing this, Shachi-devi was amazed
and, taking Gauranga, bathed in the heavenly river.

ঘরে গিয়া শচীদেবী জগন্নাথে কয় ।
বালক-চরিত্র কিছু শুন মহাশয় ॥ ২০০ ॥

*ghare giẏā śacīdebī jagannāthe kaẏa |*
*bālaka-caritra kichu śuna mahāśaẏa || 200 ||*

*Word for word:* ghare giya — going home; shachidevi jagannathe kaya — Shachi-devi says to Jagannatha; balaka-charitra kichhu — something of the boy's doings; shuna mahashaya — listen, my lord

**200.** Returning home, Shachi-devi says to Jagannatha:
"Listen, my lord, to what the boy has been doing.

সর্বযজ্ঞময় এই তোমার তনয় ।
নিশ্চয় জানিল ইহা বিঘ্ন কিছু নয় ॥ ২০১ ॥

*sarbayajñamaẏa ei tomāra tanaẏa |*
*niścaẏa jānila ihā bighna kichu naẏa || 201 ||*

*Word for word:* sarva-yajna-maya — the embodiment of all sacrifices; ei tomara tanaya — this son of yours; nishchaya janila — I know for certain; iha vighna kichhu naya — this is no affliction

**201.** This son of yours is the embodiment of all sacrifices:[^10-12]
I know for certain — this is no evil affliction.

অশুচি-দেশেতে গিয়া কহে হেন বার্তা ।
না দেখিল না শুনিল বালকের কথা ॥ ২০২ ॥

*aśuci-deśete giẏā kahe hena bārtā |*
*nā dekhila nā śunila bālakera kathā || 202 ||*

*Word for word:* ashuchi-deshete giya — going to an impure place; kahe hena varta — He speaks such words; na dekhila na shunila — never seen nor heard; balakera katha — such words from a child

**202.** Going into an impure place, He spoke such words —
never was it seen or heard that a child spoke so."

ইহা শুনি জগন্নাথ পুত্র কোলে কৈল ।
ছুঁইলে অশুচি-দেশ সব ভাল হৈল ॥ ২০৩ ॥

*ihā śuni jagannātha putra kole kaila |*
*chuṁile aśuci-deśa saba bhāla haila || 203 ||*

*Word for word:* iha shuni — hearing this; jagannatha putra kole kaila — Jagannatha took his son in his arms; chhuile ashuchi-desha — though He touched an impure place; saba bhala haila — all became good

**203.** Hearing this, Jagannatha took his son in his arms:
though He had touched what is impure — all became auspicious.

কুলের প্রদীপ মোর নয়নের তারা ।
এ দেহের আত্মা তোমা বহি নাহি মোরা ॥ ২০৪ ॥

*kulera pradīpa mora naẏanera tārā |*
*e dehera ātmā tomā bahi nāhi morā || 204 ||*

*Word for word:* kulera pradipa — lamp of the family; mora nayanera tara — apple of my eye; e dehera atma — the soul of this body; toma vahi nahi mora — I have none but You

**204.** "Lamp of our family, apple of my eye!
This body has no other soul than You."

ইহা বলি দোঁহে পুত্র-বদন নেহারে ।
প্রেমে গরগর তনু আপনা পাসরে ॥ ২০৫ ॥

*ihā bali doṁhe putra-badana nehāre |*
*preme garagara tanu āpanā pāsare || 205 ||*

*Word for word:* iha bali — saying this; donhe — both; putra-badana nehare — gaze at the son's face; preme garagara tanu — bodies overflowing with love; apana pasare — forget themselves

**205.** Saying this, both gaze at their son's face;
overflowing with love, they forget themselves.

অরুণ-নয়নে জল শতধারা গলে ।
পুলকিত সব অঙ্গ আধ-আধ বোলে ॥ ২০৬ ॥

*aruṇa-naẏane jala śatadhārā gale |*
*pulakita saba aṅga ādha-ādha bole || 206 ||*

*Word for word:* aruna-nayane — from reddened eyes; jala shatadhara gale — tears flow in a hundred streams; pulakita saba anga — the whole body thrills; adha-adha bole — they speak in halves

**206.** From their reddened eyes tears flow in a hundred streams,
their whole bodies thrill, their words come in halves.

তবে সেই বিশ্বম্ভর বিশ্বরূপ-সনে ।
খেলায় বিবিধ খেলা এ গীত-নাচনে ॥ ২০৬+১ ॥

*tabe sei biśbambhara biśbarūpa-sane |*
*khelāẏa bibidha khelā e gīta-nācane || 206+1 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe — then; sei vishvambhara — that Vishvambhara; vishvarupa-sane — together with Vishvarupa; khelaya — plays; vividha khela — various games; e gita-nachane — with these songs and dances

**206+1.** Then Vishvambhara, together with Vishvarupa,[^10-13]
plays various games, with these songs and dances.

ইন্দ্র উপেন্দ্র যেন দুই সহোদর ।
দেখি শচী জগন্নাথ হরিষ-অন্তর ॥ ২০৬+২ ॥

*indra upendra yena dui sahodara |*
*dekhi śacī jagannātha hariṣa-antara || 206+2 ||*

*Word for word:* indra upendra yena — like Indra and Upendra; dui sahodara — two brothers born of one mother; dekhi — seeing [them]; shachi jagannatha — Shachi and Jagannatha; harisha-antara — rejoice at heart

**206+2.** They are like Indra and Upendra, two brothers born of one mother;[^10-14]
seeing them, Shachi and Jagannatha rejoice at heart.

দোঁহে দোঁহা-মুখ হেরি উপজিল হাস ।
গোরাগুণ গায় সুখে এ লোচনদাস ॥ ২০৭ ॥

*doṁhe doṁhā-mukha heri upajila hāsa |*
*gorāguṇa gāẏa sukhe e locanadāsa || 207 ||*

*Word for word:* donhe donha-mukha heri — looking at each other's faces; upajila hasa — laughter arose; goraguna gaya sukhe — happily sings Gora's virtues; e lochanadasa — this Lochana Dasa

**207.** Looking into each other's faces, both burst out laughing;
happily this Lochana Dasa sings of Gora's virtues.

[^10-1]: Vishvambhara — "He who sustains (supports) the universe". In Bhaktisiddhanta's summary the name is given by the wise, because with the Lord's appearance the whole world was filled with bliss; in Murari Gupta (1.06.3) the father gives the name.
[^10-2]: The ten moons on the ground are His toenails; in the next couplet, His fingernails.
[^10-3]: Cf. Bhaktisiddhanta's summary: the moon dispels only outer darkness, but the moon of Gaura dispels both outer and inner darkness.
[^10-4]: *Hau* — a bogey with which children are frightened in Bengal.
[^10-5]: "Jagannatha" — "Lord of the universe"; it is both an epithet of the Lord and the name of His father.
[^10-6]: So in the 1983 and 1903 editions (*nachaha amare*); the OCR of Bhaktisiddhanta's edition can also be read *na chaha amare* — "do not look at Me (do not worship Me)". The following lines (the gods sing, the Lord dances) support the first reading.
[^10-7]: The Four-faced one is Brahma, the Five-faced one Shiva.
[^10-8]: According to the *Chaitanya-charitamrita* (Adi 13.73), before Vishvarupa eight daughters were born to Shachi one after another and died; Lochana Dasa speaks of seven.
[^10-9]: The eyes are wagtails (*khanjana*), the face the moon, the tears pearls.
[^10-10]: *Svastyayana* — a rite to avert misfortune and invoke well-being.
[^10-11]: Cf. Bhaktisiddhanta's summary: the Lord explained to His mother the worthlessness of worldly notions of pure and impure and instructed her in the transcendental knowledge that Krishna is the Lord of all. The point of v. 197 is not that only matter exists: distinctions of pure and impure concern combinations of the same material elements, while true dharma is service to Krishna's feet. Cf. Murari Gupta (1.06.13–17).
[^10-12]: Shachi guesses that her son is the Yajna-purusha Himself, the Lord of all sacrifices, so that a rite to appease a "possessing god" is out of place here.
[^10-13]: Vv. 206+1 – 206+2 are found only in the 1983 edition (absent from Bhaktisiddhanta's edition); the 1903 edition has them in brackets — the way that editor marks lines found in only some manuscripts.
[^10-14]: Upendra is Lord Vamana, the younger brother of Indra (both are sons of Aditi); so here Vishvarupa is the elder brother and Vishvambhara the younger.

---

# Adi-khanda, part 3 (portion 11)

*Balya-lila (continued): Nimai pretends not to hear His mother; He sits again on the discarded pots, throws a brick at His mother and brings two coconuts; Shachi for a moment realizes that her son is Narayana, but forgets it again in love for her son and recites protective names over Him; Nimai cries for the moon from the sky; His play with a puppy*

*Raga shri; disha: "O-ki ho re, Gauranga, jaya, jaya!" (murchha). "O-ki na, my prema for Gauranga — nectar and bliss! Ki na, my Gauranga, ki are, jaya, jaya!"*

এইমতে দিনে দিনে ক্ষণে ক্ষণে আন ।
বাঢ়য়ে শরীর যেন সুমেরু-সুঠাম ॥ ২০৮ ॥

*eimate dine dine kṣaṇe kṣaṇe āna |*
*bāṛhaẏe śarīra yena sumeru-suṭhāma || 208 ||*

*Word for word:* ei-mate dine dine — thus day by day; kshane kshane ana — different every moment; badhaye sharira — the body grows; yena sumeru-suthama — shapely as Sumeru

**208.** So day by day, changing every moment,
His body grows, shapely as Mount Sumeru.

অমৃতের ধারা যেন বচন-মাধুরী ।
শুনি শচীদেবী মনে অতি কুতূহলী ॥ ২০৯ ॥

*amṛtera dhārā yena bacana-mādhurī |*
*śuni śacīdebī mane ati kutūhalī || 209 ||*

*Word for word:* amritera dhara yena — like a stream of nectar; vachana-madhuri — the sweetness of speech; shuni shachidevi — hearing, Shachi-devi; mane ati kutuhali — is very delighted at heart

**209.** The sweetness of His speech is like a stream of nectar;
hearing it, Shachi-devi rejoices at heart.

কথাচ্ছলে কথা শুনিবারে চাহে রাণী ।
প্রভু কহে শুনিতে না পাই তোর বাণী ॥ ২১০ ॥

*kathācchale kathā śunibāre cāhe rāṇī |*
*prabhu kahe śunite nā pāi tora bāṇī || 210 ||*

*Word for word:* kathachchhale — on the pretext of talk; katha shunibare chahe rani — the queen wants to hear [Him] speak; prabhu kahe — the Lord says; shunite na pai — I cannot hear; tora vani — your words

**210.** On the pretext of conversation the queen wants to hear Him speak;
the Lord says: "I can't hear what you say."

উচ্চ করি শচী ডাকে মহাকুতূহলী ।
শুনিতে না পাই কহে গোরা বনমালী ॥ ২১১ ॥

*ucca kari śacī ḍāke mahākutūhalī |*
*śunite nā pāi kahe gorā banamālī || 211 ||*

*Word for word:* uchcha kari shachi dake — Shachi calls loudly; maha-kutuhali — in great merriment; shunite na pai — I cannot hear; kahe gora vanamali — says Gora, wearer of the forest garland

**211.** Shachi calls Him loudly, in great merriment;
"I can't hear!" says Gora, who wears the forest garland.

বাৎসল্য-প্রেমেতে মুগ্ধ হৈলা শচীমাতা ।
ক্রোধ করি ছড়ি লঞা ধায় উনমতা ॥ ২১২ ॥

*bātsalya-premete mugdha hailā śacīmātā |*
*krodha kari chaṛi lañā dhāẏa unamatā || 212 ||*

*Word for word:* vatsalya-premete — by parental love; mugdha haila shachimata — mother Shachi was enchanted; krodha kari — in anger; chhadi lana — taking a switch; dhaya unamata — runs like a madwoman

**212.** Mother Shachi, enchanted by parental love (vatsalya),
angrily seizes a switch and runs like a madwoman:

আজি বাক্য নাহি শুন উদ্ধতের মত ।
বৃদ্ধকালে তুমি মোরে নাহি দিবে ভাত ॥ ২১৩ ॥

*āji bākya nāhi śuna uddhatera mata |*
*bṛddhakāle tumi more nāhi dibe bhāta || 213 ||*

*Word for word:* aji vakya nahi shuna — today You don't listen to words; uddhatera mata — like a naughty one; vriddha-kale — in old age; tumi more nahi dibe bhata — You will not give me rice

**213.** "Today You won't listen to [my] words, like a naughty boy —
in my old age You won't even give me rice to eat!"

আর কথোদিনে সেই শচীর নন্দন ।
খটি করি না শুনয়ে মায়ের বচন ॥ ২১৪ ॥

*āra kathodine sei śacīra nandana |*
*khaṭi kari nā śunaẏe māẏera bacana || 214 ||*

*Word for word:* ara kathodine — some days later; sei shachira nandana — that son of Shachi; khati kari — being stubborn; na shunaye mayera vachana — does not listen to His mother's words

**214.** And some days later the son of Shachi,
being stubborn, does not listen to His mother's words.

রুষিলা সে শচীদেবী চাহে একদিঠে ।
ধাঞা ধরিবারে যায় হাথে করি ছাটে ॥ ২১৫ ॥

*ruṣilā se śacīdebī cāhe ekadiṭhe |*
*dhāñā dharibāre yāẏa hāthe kari chāṭe || 215 ||*

*Word for word:* rushila se shachidevi — Shachi-devi grew angry; chahe ekadithe — stares fixedly; dhana dharibare yaya — runs to catch [Him]; hathe kari chhate — with a switch in hand

**215.** Shachi-devi grew angry, stared at Him fixedly,
and ran to catch Him with a switch in her hand.

ধাঞা বিশ্বম্ভর গেলা অশুচির স্থানে ।
ত্যক্ত মৃত্তিকার ভাণ্ড বর্জয়ে যেখানে ॥ ২১৬ ॥

*dhāñā biśbambhara gelā aśucira sthāne |*
*tyakta mṛttikāra bhāṇḍa barjaẏe yekhāne || 216 ||*

*Word for word:* dhana vishvambhara gela — Vishvambhara ran off; ashuchira sthane — to the impure place; tyakta mrittikara bhanda — useless earthen pots; varjaye yekhane — where they are thrown away

**216.** Vishvambhara ran off to the impure place
where useless earthen pots are thrown away.

দেখিয়া জননী নিজ-শিরে কর হানি ।
হাহাকার করে শচী বোলে কটুবাণী ॥ ২১৭ ॥

*dekhiẏā jananī nija-śire kara hāni |*
*hāhākāra kare śacī bole kaṭubāṇī || 217 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhiya janani — seeing, the mother; nija-shire kara hani — strikes her own head with her hand; hahakara kare shachi — Shachi laments; bole katuvani — speaks harsh words

**217.** Seeing it, His mother strikes her head with her hand;
Shachi laments and scolds Him with harsh words.

অধিক সে বিশ্বম্ভর রুষিল হিয়ায় ।
উপরি উপরি ভাণ্ডে উঠিয়া দাণ্ডায় ॥ ২১৮ ॥

*adhika se biśbambhara ruṣila hiẏāẏa |*
*upari upari bhāṇḍe uṭhiẏā dāṇḍāẏa || 218 ||*

*Word for word:* adhika — even more; se vishvambhara rushila hiyay — Vishvambhara grew angry at heart; upari upari bhande — on the pots piled one upon another; uthiya dandaya — climbs and stands

**218.** Vishvambhara grew angrier still at heart:
He climbed onto the pots heaped one upon another and stood on them.

কুপিত বচন শুনি করে বিপরীত ।
বুঝিয়া জননী কিছু করয়ে পিরীত ॥ ২১৯ ॥

*kupita bacana śuni kare biparīta |*
*bujhiẏā jananī kichu karaẏe pirīta || 219 ||*

*Word for word:* kupita vachana shuni — hearing angry words; kare viparita — does the opposite; bujhiya janani — understanding, the mother; kichhu karaye pirita — shows some affection

**219.** Hearing angry words, He does the opposite;
understanding this, His mother spoke gently:

আইস আইস বাপ ছাড় জুগুপ্সিত কর্ম ।
এ নহে উচিত তোর ব্রাহ্মণের ধর্ম ॥ ২২০ ॥

*āisa āisa bāpa chāṛa jugupsita karma |*
*e nahe ucita tora brāhmaṇera dharma || 220 ||*

*Word for word:* aisa aisa bapa — come, come, child; chhada jugupsita karma — leave this disgusting act; e nahe uchita tora — this is not fitting for You; brahmanera dharma — [it is not] a brahmana's dharma

**220.** "Come, come here, child, leave this disgusting business!
It is not fitting for You — it is not the dharma of a brahmana.

ব্রাহ্মণ-কুমার তাহে কুলীনের পুত্র ।
শুনি কি বলিব লোকে কুৎসিত চরিত্র ॥ ২২১ ॥

*brāhmaṇa-kumāra tāhe kulīnera putra |*
*śuni ki baliba loke kutsita caritra || 221 ||*

*Word for word:* brahmana-kumara — a brahmana's son; tahe kulinera putra — and a kulina's son besides; shuni ki baliba loke — what will people say on hearing; kutsita charitra — of shameful conduct

**221.** You are a brahmana's son, and of a noble (kulina) family besides;
what will people say when they hear of such shameful conduct?

আইস আইস বাপু স্নান কর গঙ্গাজলে ।
মায়ের পরাণ ফাটে চড় আসিয়া কোলে ॥ ২২২ ॥

*āisa āisa bāpu snāna kara gaṅgājale |*
*māẏera parāṇa phāṭe caṛa āsiẏā kole || 222 ||*
