*Word for word:* charanera dhuli — the dust of your feet; deha nija bali — give, calling Him your own; mora vishvambhara-shire — on my Vishvambhara's head; e mora chhaoyala — this child of mine; badai chanchala — is very restless; buddhi haya yena sthire — may His mind become steady

**377.** Calling [Him] your own, place the dust of your feet
on the head of my Vishvambhara;
this child of mine is very restless —
may His mind become steady."

দন্তে তৃণ ধরি, বোলে শচীরাণী,
সভার চরণ সেবি ।
সভে দেহ বর, মোর বিশ্বম্ভর,
পুত্র হউ চিরজীবী ॥ ৩৭৮ ॥

*dante tṛṇa dhari, bole śacīrāṇī,*
*sabhāra caraṇa sebi |*
*sabhe deha bara, mora biśbambhara,*
*putra hau cirajībī || 378 ||*

*Word for word:* dante trina dhari — holding grass between her teeth; bole shachirani — Shachi-rani says; sabhara charana sevi — serving the feet of all; sabhe deha vara — all give a blessing; mora vishvambhara putra — my son Vishvambhara; hau chirajivi — may He live long

**378.** Holding a blade of grass between her teeth,[^12-7] Shachi-rani says,
serving the feet of all:
"Bless Him, all of you — may my son Vishvambhara
live long!"

ষষ্ঠীপূজা করি, পুত্র করে ধরি,
ঘরেরে চলিলা দেবী ।
জগন্নাথ-সনে, করে অনুমানে,
মনে অনুভব ভাবি ॥ ৩৭৯ ॥

*ṣaṣṭhīpūjā kari, putra kare dhari,*
*gharere calilā debī |*
*jagannātha-sane, kare anumāne,*
*mane anubhaba bhābi || 379 ||*

*Word for word:* shashthi-puja kari — having worshipped Shashthi; putra kare dhari — taking her son by the hand; gharere chalila devi — the goddess went home; jagannatha-sane — with Jagannatha; kare anumane — reflects; mane anubhava bhavi — pondering her experience

**379.** Having performed the worship of Shashthi and taking her son by the hand,
the goddess went home;
with Jagannatha she reflects,
pondering what she had experienced.

কি কহিব আর, সর্বদেব-সার,
পৃথিবীতে পরকাশ ।
বালকের সঙ্গে, খেলে নানা রঙ্গে,
কহয়ে লোচনদাস ॥ ৩৮০ ॥

*ki kahiba āra, sarbadeba-sāra,*
*pṛthibīte parakāśa |*
*bālakera saṅge, khele nānā raṅge,*
*kahaẏe locanadāsa || 380 ||*

*Word for word:* ki kahiba ara — what more shall I say; sarvadeva-sara — the essence of all the gods; prithivite parakasha — manifest on earth; balakera sange — with the boys; khele nana range — plays in many ways; kahaye lochanadasa — says Lochana Dasa

**380.** What more shall I say? The essence of all the gods
has appeared on earth
and plays with the boys in many ways —
says Lochana Dasa.

*Raga varadi*[^12-8]

তবে আর কথোদিনে, সেই শচীনন্দনে,
ধূলায় খেলায় রাজপথে ।
এ ধূলি-ধূসর, হেমগিরি-কলেবর,
অনুগত বয়স্য-সহিতে ॥ ৩৮১ ॥

*tabe āra kathodine, sei śacīnandane,*
*dhūlāẏa khelāẏa rājapathe |*
*e dhūli-dhūsara, hemagiri-kalebara,*
*anugata baẏasya-sahite || 381 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe ara kathodine — then some days later; sei shachinandane — that son of Shachi; dhulaya khelaya rajapathe — plays in the dust on the highway; e dhuli-dhusara — grey with dust; hemagiri-kalevara — His body a golden mountain; anugata vayasya-sahite — with devoted companions

**381.** And some days later that son of Shachi
plays in the dust on the highway;
His body a golden mountain, grey with dust,
with Him His devoted companions.

শিশু শিশু ধূলা খেলি, ক্ষণে হয় গালাগালি,
ধূলা-রণে অঙ্গ দিগম্বাস ।
সমান সে বয়ঃক্রম, সভে মেলি একমর্ম,
ঘর্মবিন্দু খেলায় আয়াস ॥ ৩৮২ ॥

*śiśu śiśu dhūlā kheli, kṣaṇe haẏa gālāgāli,*
*dhūlā-raṇe aṅga digambāsa |*
*samāna se baẏaḥkrama, sabhe meli ekamarma,*
*gharmabindu khelāẏa āẏāsa || 382 ||*

*Word for word:* shishu shishu dhula kheli — children playing with dust; kshane haya galagali — now and then squabble; dhula-rane — in the dust-battle; anga digambasa — bodies bare; samana se vayahkrama — all of one age; sabhe meli eka-marma — all of one mind; gharma-bindu khelaya ayasa — sweat-drops from the effort of play

**382.** The children play with dust, now and then they squabble,
in the dust-battle their bodies are bare;
all of one age, all of one mind,
drops of sweat from the effort of play.

সভে মেলি খেলা খেলে, গুপ্ত-বেজা হেনকালে,
সেই পথে আইলা আচম্বিত ।
তার যত নিজজন, সঙ্গে করে গমন,
জ্ঞানপথ-বিচারে পণ্ডিত ॥ ৩৮৩ ॥

*sabhe meli khelā khele, gupta-bejā henakāle,*
*sei pathe āilā ācambita |*
*tāra yata nijajana, saṅge kare gamana,*
*jñānapatha-bicāre paṇḍita || 383 ||*

*Word for word:* sabhe meli khela khele — while all were playing together; gupta-beja henakale — then Gupta the vaidya; sei pathe aila achambita — suddenly came that way; tara yata nijajana — all his own people; sange kare gamana — go with him; jnanapatha-vichare pandita — a scholar in discussing the path of knowledge

**383.** While they were all playing together, Gupta the vaidya[^12-9]
suddenly came along that road;
all his own people went with him,
and he, a scholar, was discoursing on the path of knowledge.

তার সনে অনুমানে, যোগশাস্ত্র বাখানে,
কর শির করিয়া চালন ।
দেখি বিশ্বম্ভর রায়, তার পাছে পাছে ধায়,
অনুসরি গমন বচন ॥ ৩৮৪ ॥

*tāra sane anumāne, yogaśāstra bākhāne,*
*kara śira kariẏā cālana |*
*dekhi biśbambhara rāẏa, tāra pāche pāche dhāẏa,*
*anusari gamana bacana || 384 ||*

*Word for word:* tara sane anumane — reasoning with them; yogashastra vakhane — expounds the yoga-shastra; kara shira kariya chalana — moving hands and head; dekhi vishvambhara raya — seeing, Vishvambhara Raya; tara pachhe pachhe dhaya — runs right behind him; anusari gamana vachana — imitating his gait and speech

**384.** Reasoning with them, he expounds the yoga-shastra,
shaking his head and waving his hands;
seeing this, Vishvambhara Raya runs right behind him,
imitating his gait and speech.

দেখি বৈদ্য মুরারি, কটাক্ষে তিলেক হেরি,
পুনঃ করে যোগের বাখান ।
সেইমতে বিশ্বম্ভর, যোগের বাখান করে,
তেন নাড়ে হাথ মুখখান ॥ ৩৮৫ ॥

*dekhi baidya murāri, kaṭākṣe tileka heri,*
*punaḥ kare yogera bākhāna |*
*seimate biśbambhara, yogera bākhāna kare,*
*tena nāṛe hātha mukhakhāna || 385 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhi vaidya murari — seeing, Murari the vaidya; katakshe tileka heri — glancing sidelong for a moment; punah kare yogera vakhana — again expounds yoga; sei-mate vishvambhara — just so Vishvambhara; yogera vakhana kare — expounds yoga; tena nade hatha mukhakhana — just so moves His hands and face

**385.** Murari the vaidya, glancing [at Him] for a moment,
again expounds yoga;
just so Vishvambhara expounds yoga,
just so He moves His hands and head.

এইমতে বেরি বেরি, পরিহাসে গৌরহরি,
শিশুগণ সংহতি করিয়া ।
দেখিয়া মুরারি বৈদ্য, নিজ আচরণে গদ্য,
কুবচন কহিল রুষিয়া ॥ ৩৮৬ ॥

*eimate beri beri, parihāse gaurahari,*
*śiśugaṇa saṃhati kariẏā |*
*dekhiẏā murāri baidya, nija ācaraṇe gadya,*
*kubacana kahila ruṣiẏā || 386 ||*

*Word for word:* ei-mate beri beri — thus again and again; parihase gaurahari — Gaurahari mimics; shishugana samhati kariya — together with the children; dekhiya murari vaidya — seeing, Murari the vaidya; nija acharane gadya — [his] own manners mimicked; kuvachana kahila rushiya — angrily spoke rude words

**386.** So again and again Gaurahari
mimics him together with the children;
Murari the vaidya, seeing his own manners mimicked,
grew angry and spoke rude words:

এছারে কে বলে ভাল, দেখিল ত ছাওয়াল,
মিশ্র-পুরন্দর-সুত এই ।
সর্বত্র শুনিয়ে কথা, ইহার সে গুণগাথা,
ভাল নাম ইহার নিমাই ॥ ৩৮৭ ॥

*echāre ke bale bhāla, dekhila ta chāoẏāla,*
*miśra-purandara-suta ei |*
*sarbatra śuniẏe kathā, ihāra se guṇagāthā,*
*bhāla nāma ihāra nimāi || 387 ||*

*Word for word:* echhare ke bale bhala — who calls this one good; dekhila ta chhaoyala — I've seen the boy; mishra-purandara-suta ei — this is Mishra Purandara's son; sarvatra shuniye katha — everywhere I hear talk; ihara se gunagatha — the songs of his virtues; bhala nama ihara nimai — a fine name he has, Nimai

**387.** "Who would call this one good? I've seen the boy —
this is Mishra Purandara's son;
everywhere I hear talk and songs of his virtues —
a fine name he has: Nimai!"[^12-10]

ঐছন শুনিয়া বাণী, রুষিলা সে গৌরমণি,
অনুগত-কৃপার কারণে ।
ভ্রুকুটি বদন করি, বোলে বাক্-চাতুরী,
জানাইব ভোজনের ক্ষণে ॥ ৩৮৮ ॥

*aichana śuniẏā bāṇī, ruṣilā se gauramaṇi,*
*anugata-kṛpāra kāraṇe |*
*bhrukuṭi badana kari, bole bāk-cāturī,*
*jānāiba bhojanera kṣaṇe || 388 ||*

*Word for word:* aichhana shuniya vani — hearing such words; rushila se gauramani — the jewel Gaura grew angry; anugata-kripara karane — for the sake of mercy to His devotee; bhrukuti badana kari — frowning; bole vak-chaturi — speaks teasingly (lit. "with cleverness of speech"); janaiba bhojanera kshane — I'll let you know at mealtime

**388.** Hearing such words, the jewel Gaura grew angry —
for the sake of mercy to His devotee;
frowning, He says teasingly:
"You'll find out at mealtime!"[^12-11]

শুনি বিশ্বম্ভর-বাণী, মুরারি সে মনে গুণি,
ঘর গেলা বিস্মিত-হিয়ায় ।
গৃহকার্য-ব্যাপৃতে, পাসরিল আন-চিতে,
হৈল তবে ভোজন-সময় ॥ ৩৮৯ ॥

*śuni biśbambhara-bāṇī, murāri se mane guṇi,*
*ghara gelā bismita-hiẏāẏa |*
*gṛhakārya-byāpṛte, pāsarila āna-cite,*
*haila tabe bhojana-samaẏa || 389 ||*

*Word for word:* shuni vishvambhara-vani — hearing Vishvambhara's words; murari se mane guni — Murari pondered; ghara gela vismita-hiyay — went home with a wondering heart; griha-karya-vyaprite — busy with household tasks; pasarila ana-chite — forgot, his mind elsewhere; haila tabe bhojana-samaya — then came mealtime

**389.** Hearing Vishvambhara's words, Murari pondered
and went home with a wondering heart;
busy with household affairs, his mind turned elsewhere and he forgot,
and then it was time to eat.

এথা বিশ্বম্ভর হরি, অঙ্গের সুবেশ করি,
কটিতে টানিঞা পিন্ধে ধড়া ।
শিরে শোভে তিন ঝুঁটি, গলায়ে সে রসকাঁটি,
কণ্ঠলগ্ন মুকুতা দুবেড়া ॥ ৩৯০ ॥

*ethā biśbambhara hari, aṅgera subeśa kari,*
*kaṭite ṭāniñā pindhe dhaṛā |*
*śire śobhe tina jhuṁṭi, galāẏe se rasakāṁṭi,*
*kaṇṭhalagna mukutā dubeṛā || 390 ||*

*Word for word:* etha vishvambhara hari — meanwhile Vishvambhara Hari; angera subesha kari — dressing finely; katite tanina pindhe dhada — wraps the dhoti tightly round His waist; shire shobhe tina jhunti — three tufts adorn His head; galaye se rasakanti — rasakanti beads on His neck; kantha-lagna mukuta dubeda — a double pearl string at the throat

**390.** Meanwhile Vishvambhara Hari dressed Himself finely:
He wrapped His dhoti tightly round His waist,
three tufts adorn His head, rasakanti beads hang on His neck,
a double string of pearls at His throat.

নয়নে কাজর-রেখা, পাঁচথুপী বান্ধে শিখা,
ঝলমল হেম-অলঙ্কার ।
চরণে মগরা খাড়ু, হাথে করি ক্ষীর-লাড়ু,
চলিলা ঠাকুর বিশ্বম্ভর ॥ ৩৯১ ॥

*naẏane kājara-rekhā, pāṁcathupī bāndhe śikhā,*
*jhalamala hema-alaṅkāra |*
*caraṇe magarā khāṛu, hāthe kari kṣīra-lāṛu,*
*calilā ṭhākura biśbambhara || 391 ||*

*Word for word:* nayane kajara-rekha — a line of kajal in the eyes; pancha-thupi bandhe shikha — topknot tied with five knots; jhalamala hema-alankara — golden ornaments glitter; charane magara khadu — magara anklets on the feet; hathe kari kshira-ladu — holding a milk laddu in hand; chalila thakura vishvambhara — the Lord Vishvambhara set out

**391.** A line of kajal in His eyes, His topknot tied with five knots,
golden ornaments glittering,
magara anklets on His feet; holding a milk laddu in His hand,
the Lord Vishvambhara set out.

মুরারি গুপ্তের ঘরে, গেলা নিজ অভ্যন্তরে,
ভোজন করিছে বৈদ্যরাজ ।
মেঘগম্ভীর-নাদে, নিজ মন-পরসাদে,
মুরারি বলিয়া দিলা ডাক ॥ ৩৯২ ॥

*murāri guptera ghare, gelā nija abhyantare,*
*bhojana kariche baidyarāja |*
*meghagambhīra-nāde, nija mana-parasāde,*
*murāri baliẏā dilā ḍāka || 392 ||*

*Word for word:* murari guptera ghare — in Murari Gupta's house; gela nija abhyantare — went into the inner rooms; bhojana karichhe vaidyaraja — where the king of vaidyas was eating; megha-gambhira-nade — in a voice deep as thunder; nija-mana-parasade — by His own grace; murari baliya dila daka — called "Murari!"

**392.** He entered Murari Gupta's house, into the inner rooms,
where the best of vaidyas was eating his meal,
and in a voice deep as thunder, by His own grace,
He called: "Murari!"

স্বর শুনি সোঙরিল, বিশ্বম্ভর যে বলিল,
গুপ্ত-বেজা চমকিত চিত ।
তবে সেই গৌরহরি, কি কর কি কর বলি,
সেইখানে হৈল উপনীত ॥ ৩৯৩ ॥

*sbara śuni soṅarila, biśbambhara ye balila,*
*gupta-bejā camakita cita |*
*tabe sei gaurahari, ki kara ki kara bali,*
*seikhāne haila upanīta || 393 ||*

*Word for word:* svara shuni songarila — hearing the voice, he remembered; vishvambhara ye balila — what Vishvambhara had said; gupta-beja chamakita chita — Gupta the vaidya was startled; tabe sei gaurahari — then Gaurahari; ki kara ki kara bali — saying "what are you doing, what are you doing"; seikhane haila upanita — came right up there

**393.** Hearing the voice, Gupta the vaidya remembered
what Vishvambhara had said, and was startled;
and Gaurahari, saying "What are you doing, what are you doing?",
came right up to the spot.

তরস্ত না হও তুমি, এইখানে আছি আমি,
ভোজন করহ বাণী বৈল ।
মধ্য-ভোজন-বেলা, ধীরে ধীরে নিয়ড়ে গেলা,
থাল ভরি মূত মুতিলা ॥ ৩৯৪ ॥

*tarasta nā hao tumi, eikhāne āchi āmi,*
*bhojana karaha bāṇī baila |*
*madhya-bhojana-belā, dhīre dhīre niẏaṛe gelā,*
*thāla bhari mūta mutilā || 394 ||*

*Word for word:* tarasta na hao tumi — don't be alarmed; eikhane achhi ami — I am here; bhojana karaha — go on eating; vani baila — He said; madhya-bhojana-bela — in the middle of the meal; dhire dhire niyade gela — slowly came close; thala bhari muta mutila — urinated, filling the plate

**394.** "Don't be alarmed: I am here —
go on eating," He said;
and in the middle of the meal, approaching very slowly,
He filled his plate with urine.

কি কি বলি ছি ছি করি, উঠিলা সে মুরারি,
করতালি দিয়া বোলে গোরা ।
কর শির নাড়িয়া, ভক্তিপথ ছাড়িয়া,
যোগ বলে এই অভিপারী ॥ ৩৯৫ ॥

*ki ki bali chi chi kari, uṭhilā se murāri,*
*karatāli diẏā bole gorā |*
*kara śira nāṛiẏā, bhaktipatha chāṛiẏā,*
*yoga bale ei abhipārī || 395 ||*

*Word for word:* ki ki bali — crying "what, what"; chhi chhi kari — saying "shame, shame"; uthila se murari — Murari jumped up; karatali diya — clapping His hands; bole gora — Gora says; kara shira nadiya — moving hands and head; bhaktipatha chhadiya — having left the path of bhakti; yoga bale ei abhipari — this trickster speaks of yoga

**395.** "What's this, what?! Shame, shame!" — up jumped Murari;
and Gora, clapping His hands, says:
"Shaking his head and waving his hands, having left the path of bhakti,
this trickster expounds yoga!

জ্ঞান-কর্ম উপেখিয়া, কৃষ্ণ ভজ মন দিয়া,
রসিক বিদগ্ধ চিদানন্দ ।
ভৌতিকে যাহার দৃষ্টি, এ নহে ভজন-পুষ্টি,
নাহি বুঝ বুদ্ধি অতি মন্দ ॥ ৩৯৬ ॥

*jñāna-karma upekhiẏā, kṛṣṇa bhaja mana diẏā,*
*rasika bidagdha cidānanda |*
*bhautike yāhāra dṛṣṭi, e nahe bhajana-puṣṭi,*
*nāhi bujha buddhi ati manda || 396 ||*

*Word for word:* jnana-karma upekhiya — disregarding knowledge and ritual; krishna bhaja mana diya — worship Krishna wholeheartedly; rasika vidagdha chidananda — the relisher of rasa, expert, consciousness and bliss; bhautike yahara drishti — one whose sight is on the material; e nahe bhajana-pushti — has no nourishment of bhajana; nahi bujha — you don't understand; buddhi ati manda — intelligence very dull

**396.** Disregarding knowledge and ritual, worship Krishna wholeheartedly —
the relisher of rasa, the expert, full of consciousness and bliss.
One whose sight is fixed on the material finds no nourishment for bhajana;
you do not understand — your intelligence is very dull.

পরম দয়ালু হরি, তেঁহো সর্বশক্তিধারী,
জীবেতে সম্ভবে এ কি কথা ।
তেঁহো ব্রহ্ম সনাতন, গোপীর জীবন-ধন,
না ভজিয়া কেনে দেহ ব্যথা ॥ ৩৯৭ ॥

*parama daẏālu hari, teṁho sarbaśaktidhārī,*
*jībete sambhabe e ki kathā |*
*teṁho brahma sanātana, gopīra jībana-dhana,*
*nā bhajiẏā kene deha byathā || 397 ||*

*Word for word:* parama dayalu hari — Hari is supremely merciful; tenho sarva-shakti-dhari — He holds all energies; jivete sambhave e ki katha — is such a thing possible for a jiva; tenho brahma sanatana — He is the eternal Brahman; gopira jivana-dhana — the treasure of the gopis' life; na bhajiya — not worshipping [Him]; kene deha vyatha — why cause pain

**397.** Hari is supremely merciful, He holds all energies;
is such a thing possible for a jiva?[^12-12]
He is the eternal Brahman, the treasure of the gopis' life;
why, not worshipping Him, do you cause [yourself] pain?"

ইহা বলি গোরামণি, কতি গেলা নাহি জানি,
মুরারি দেখিতে নাহি পায় ।
মনে মনে অনুমান, এ কভু নহে আন,
সত্য পঁহু শচীর তনয় ॥ ৩৯৮ ॥

*ihā bali gorāmaṇi, kati gelā nāhi jāni,*
*murāri dekhite nāhi pāẏa |*
*mane mane anumāna, e kabhu nahe āna,*
*satya paṁhu śacīra tanaẏa || 398 ||*

*Word for word:* iha bali goramani — saying this, the jewel Gora; kati gela nahi jani — went none knows where; murari dekhite nahi paya — Murari cannot see; mane mane anumana — reflects within; e kabhu nahe ana — this is surely no other; satya panhu shachira tanaya — truly Shachi's son is the Lord

**398.** Saying this, the jewel Gaura vanished — none knows where;
Murari cannot see Him
and reflects within himself: "This is surely no one else —
truly, the son of Shachi is the Lord."

এত অনুমান করি, তবে সেই মুরারি,
আস্তে ব্যস্তে চলিলা সত্বর ।
চলিতে না পারে পথে, অতি আনন্দিত চিতে,
গেলা যথা মিশ্র পুরন্দর ॥ ৩৯৯ ॥

*eta anumāna kari, tabe sei murāri,*
*āste byaste calilā satbara |*
*calite nā pāre pathe, ati ānandita cite,*
*gelā yathā miśra purandara || 399 ||*

*Word for word:* eta anumana kari — having reflected thus; tabe sei murari — then Murari; aste vyaste chalila satvara — hastily set out in agitation; chalite na pare pathe — cannot walk on the road; ati anandita chite — with a heart full of joy; gela yatha mishra purandara — went to where Mishra Purandara was

**399.** Having reflected thus, Murari
set out at once, in haste and agitation;
from great joy he can hardly walk on the road,
[yet] he came to where Mishra Purandara was.

[^12-1]: In the 1903 edition the whole account of the puppy's deliverance (vv. 324–357) is enclosed in brackets — this editor's way of marking lines found not in all manuscripts. In Bhaktisiddhanta's summary the puppy "in a divine body, singing of Hari, went to Vaikuntha"; the text says Goloka ("becoming a dweller of Krishna's realm"; the 1983 edition: "of Vishnu's realm"). Cf. the *Chaitanya-charitamrita* (Antya 1.16–33): Shivananda Sena's dog, having received the remnants of Mahaprabhu's meal and chanting "Krishna", attained Vaikuntha.
[^12-2]: In Bhaktisiddhanta's edition the numbering jumps here from 330 to 340; we keep the edition's numbers.
[^12-3]: That is, even Krishna in His earlier pastimes did not bestow mercy so freely. Cf. the *Chaitanya-charitamrita* (Madhya 19.53): Gaura is "the most magnanimous", the giver of prema for Krishna.
[^12-4]: Shashthi — the goddess who protects children; women honour her with fasting and offerings under a banyan tree for the welfare of their children.
[^12-5]: This is not an assertion of impersonal oneness: all that exists is the energy of the Lord and does not exist apart from Him, while He remains the personal Lord. Cf. the *Bhagavata* (2.9.33): "Before creation I alone existed…", and Mahaprabhu's teaching of inconceivable oneness and difference (*achintya-bhedabheda*). This is the sense the following shloka brings out.
[^12-6]: In the edition the shloka is followed by Bhaktisiddhanta's anvaya and translation (the OCR is almost illegible); the translation runs: "As watering the root of a tree satisfies its trunk, branches, twigs and so on, and as food offered to the prana satisfies all the senses, so by worshipping Achyuta alone all the gods are worshipped." In the 1903 edition the shloka is given in square brackets as an editorial insertion.
[^12-7]: A blade of grass between the teeth is a sign of utmost humility before those whose favour is asked.
[^12-8]: In A the raga line is corrupt; "varadi" follows the 1983 edition.
[^12-9]: Murari Gupta, a vaidya (physician) by caste, later one of Mahaprabhu's closest associates and author of the Sanskrit biography *Sri Krishna-chaitanya-charitamrita*. Here he is still devoted to yoga and the path of knowledge.
[^12-10]: A gibe: "Nimai" comes from the bitter neem tree (see en/09, note 12).
[^12-11]: Lochana Dasa stresses that the Lord's "anger" is mercy: He breaks Murari's attachment to dry yoga and knowledge so as to turn him to bhakti.
[^12-12]: That is, the perfections of which yoga speaks are attributes of the Lord; the jiva cannot acquire them by its own efforts — its path is service to Him.

---

# Adi-khanda, part 5 (portion 13)

*Balya-lila (conclusion): Murari Gupta prostrates himself before the child Nimai, reveals to His parents that their son is Bhagavan, and tells Advaita Acharya about Him; Nimai and the boys hold a kirtana, and passing pandits join them; Murari tells Damodara Pandita of Vishvarupa's sannyasa; the grief of Shachi and Jagannatha; Vishvambhara promises to take care of His parents*

এথা শচী-জগন্নাথ মেলি, পুত্রের দুলাল করি,
তুমি মোর সরবস ধন ।
যেখানে সেখানে যাই, যথা যে বা দুঃখ পাই,
দেখি পাশরিয়ে চান্দবদন ॥ ৪০০ ॥

*ethā śacī-jagannātha meli, putrera dulāla kari,*
*tumi mora sarabasa dhana |*
*yekhāne sekhāne yāi, yathā ye bā duḥkha pāi,*
*dekhi pāśariẏe cāndabadana || 400 ||*

*Word for word:* etha — here; shachi-jagannatha meli — Shachi and Jagannatha together; putrera dulala kari — fondling the son; tumi mora sarabasa dhana — You are my whole wealth; yekhane sekhane yai — wherever I go; yatha ye ba duhkha pai — whatever sorrow I meet anywhere; dekhi — seeing; pasariye — I forget; chandavadana — the moonlike face

**400.** Here, meanwhile, Shachi and Jagannatha together
are fondling their son: "You are my whole wealth!
Wherever I go, whatever sorrow I meet,
I look at Your moonlike face, and all is forgotten."

ইহা বলি দোঁহে মেলি, দুই গালে চুম্ব দেই,
কোলে করিবারে টানাটানি ।
হেনকালে মুরারি, সেইখানে বরাবরি,
আনন্দে না নিঃসরয়ে বাণী ॥ ৪০১ ॥

*ihā bali doṁhe meli, dui gāle cumba dei,*
*kole karibāre ṭānāṭāni |*
*henakāle murāri, seikhāne barābari,*
*ānande nā niḥsaraẏe bāṇī || 401 ||*

*Word for word:* iha bali — saying this; donhe meli — both together; dui gale chumba dei — kiss on both cheeks; kole karibare tanatani — vie to take on the lap; henakale — at that time; murari — Murari; seikhane barabari — straight to that place; anande — from joy; na nihsaraye vani — no word comes out

**401.** Saying this, both kiss Him on both cheeks
and vie with each other to take Him on their lap.
At that very moment Murari came straight there —
from joy he cannot utter a word.

দেখিয়া ত্রস্ত হৈয়া, শচী-জগন্নাথ গিয়া,
বৈদ্যেরে করিল অভ্যুত্থান ।
কারে কিছু না বলিল, আর সব পাশরিল,
দেখি গোরাচাঁদের বয়ান ॥ ৪০১ ॥

*dekhiẏā trasta haiẏā, śacī-jagannātha giẏā,*
*baidyere karila abhyutthāna |*
*kāre kichu nā balila, āra saba pāśarila,*
*dekhi gorācāṁdera baẏāna || 401 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhiya — seeing; trasta haiya — hastily; shachi-jagannatha giya — Shachi and Jagannatha, going; vaidyere karila abhyutthana — rose to greet the vaidya; kare kichhu na balila — [he] said nothing to anyone; ara saba pasarila — and forgot all else; dekhi — seeing; gorachandera bayana — Gorachand's face

**401a.** Seeing him, Shachi and Jagannatha hastily
rose and went to greet the vaidya;
but he said nothing to anyone and forgot everything else,
gazing at Gorachand's face.[^13-1]

পুলকিত সব গা, আপাদ-মস্তক যা,
ধারা বহে নয়ানের জলে ।
অরুণ-বরণ আঁখি, এ সে প্রেমার সাক্ষী,
গদগদ আধ-আধ বোলে ॥ ৩৯৩ ॥

*pulakita saba gā, āpāda-mastaka yā,*
*dhārā bahe naẏānera jale |*
*aruṇa-baraṇa āṁkhi, e se premāra sākṣī,*
*gadagada ādha-ādha bole || 393 ||*

*Word for word:* pulakita saba ga — the whole body thrills; apada-mastaka ya — from foot to head; dhara vahe nayanera jale — streams of tears flow from the eyes; aruna-barana ankhi — reddened eyes; e se premara sakshi — these are the witnesses of prema; gadagada — choked; adha-adha bole — speaks half-words

**393a.** His whole body thrills with ecstasy
from head to foot; streams of tears flow from his eyes;
his reddened eyes — these are the witnesses of prema;
in a faltering voice he babbles half-words.

থির দাঁড়াইতে নারে, পড়িয়া চরণতলে,
পুনঃ পুনঃ করে পরণাম ।
দেখিয়া সে বিশ্বম্ভর, মায়ের কোল-ভিতর,
প্রবেশিল যেনক অজান ॥ ৩৯৪ ॥

*thira dāṁṛāite nāre, paṛiẏā caraṇatale,*
*punaḥ punaḥ kare paraṇāma |*
*dekhiẏā se biśbambhara, māẏera kola-bhitara,*
*prabeśila yenaka ajāna || 394 ||*

*Word for word:* thira danraite nare — cannot stand steady; padiya charanatale — falling at the feet; punah punah kare paranama — bows again and again; dekhiya se vishvambhara — seeing this, Vishvambhara; mayera kola-bhitara praveshila — went into His mother's lap; yenaka ajana — as if unknowing

**394a.** Unable to stand steady, he falls at His feet
and bows down again and again;
seeing this, Vishvambhara crept
into His mother's lap, as if He understood nothing.

শচী-জগন্নাথ বোলে, অহহ কি কৈলে কৈলে,
তোরে দেখি দেবতাসমান ।
আশীর্বাদযোগ্য তোরি, এ অতি বালক মোরি,
কি করিলে বড় অবিধান ॥ ৩৯৫ ॥

*śacī-jagannātha bole, ahaha ki kaile kaile,*
*tore dekhi debatāsamāna |*
*āśīrbādayogya tori, e ati bālaka mori,*
*ki karile baṛa abidhāna || 395 ||*

*Word for word:* shachi-jagannatha bole — Shachi and Jagannatha say; ahaha ki kaile kaile — ah, what have you done, done; tore dekhi devatasamana — we regard you as equal to a god; ashirvada-yogya tori — fit for your blessing; e ati balaka mori — this very little boy of mine; ki karile bada avidhana — what a great impropriety you have done

**395a.** Shachi and Jagannatha say: "Ah, what have you done, what have you done!
We regard you as equal to a god.
This very little boy is fit for your blessing —
what a great breach of custom you have committed![^13-2]

তোরে বলি শূদ্রমুনি, সর্বলোকে বাখানি,
মোর বালকে কি কৈলে অপরাধ ।
মো দিয়া যে হয় হউ, বাঢ়ু শিশু-পরমাউ,
চিরাউ বলি দেহ আশীর্বাদ ॥ ৩৯৬ ॥

*tore bali śūdramuni, sarbaloke bākhāni,*
*mora bālake ki kaile aparādha |*
*mo diẏā ye haẏa hau, bāṛhu śiśu-paramāu,*
*cirāu bali deha āśīrbāda || 396 ||*

*Word for word:* tore bali shudramuni — calling you a sage among shudras; sarvaloke vakhani — all people extol; mora balake ki kaile aparadha — what offence has my boy committed; mo diya ye haya hau — let whatever happens fall on me; badhu shishu-paramau — may the child's lifespan grow; chirau bali — saying "long life"; deha ashirvada — give blessing

**396a.** All people extol you, calling you a sage among the shudras;[^13-3]
what offence has my boy committed against you?
Whatever may come, let it fall on me — may the child's years increase!
Bless Him, saying, 'Live long!'"

ইহা বলি হাথে ধরি, প্রণতি মিনতি করি,
শচী আর মিশ্র পুরন্দর ।
হাসি বোলে মুরারি, এনা পুত্র তোহারি,
দেব-দেব-দেব বিশ্বম্ভর ॥ ৩৯৭ ॥

*ihā bali hāthe dhari, praṇati minati kari,*
*śacī āra miśra purandara |*
*hāsi bole murāri, enā putra tohāri,*
*deba-deba-deba biśbambhara || 397 ||*

*Word for word:* iha bali — saying this; hathe dhari — holding the hands; pranati minati kari — bowing and entreating; shachi ara mishra purandara — Shachi and Mishra Purandara; hasi bole murari — smiling, Murari says; ena putra tohari — this son of yours; deva-deva-deva — God of the god of gods; vishvambhara — Vishvambhara

**397a.** Saying this, holding his hands, bowing and entreating,
[stand] Shachi and Mishra Purandara;
and Murari, smiling, says: "This son of yours,
Vishvambhara, is the God of the god of gods.

বালক লালিহ কাছে, ইহা ত জানিবে পাছে,
তোর সম নাহি ভাগ্যবান্ ।
সম্বরি রাখিহ মনে, এই মোর বচনে,
বিশ্বম্ভর সেই ভগবান্ ॥ ৩৯৮ ॥

*bālaka lāliha kāche, ihā ta jānibe pāche,*
*tora sama nāhi bhāgyabān |*
*sambari rākhiha mane, ei mora bacane,*
*biśbambhara sei bhagabān || 398 ||*

*Word for word:* balaka laliha kachhe — cherish the boy near you; iha ta janibe pachhe — this you will know later; tora sama nahi bhagyavan — none is as fortunate as you; sambari rakhiha mane — keep it guarded in your heart; ei mora vachane — these words of mine; vishvambhara sei bhagavan — Vishvambhara is that very Bhagavan

**398a.** Cherish the boy, keep Him close to you — later you will understand this;
no one is as fortunate as you.
Keep these words of mine treasured in your heart, guarding the secret:
Vishvambhara is that very Bhagavan."

ইহা বলি গুপ্তবেজা, না করিল আন-চর্চা,
চলি গেলা হরিষ-অন্তর ।
আনন্দে ভরল হিয়া, গোরাপদ দেখিয়া,
গেলা যথা আচার্যের ঘর ॥ ৩৯৯ ॥

*ihā bali guptabejā, nā karila āna-carcā,*
*cali gelā hariṣa-antara |*
*ānande bharala hiẏā, gorāpada dekhiẏā,*
*gelā yathā ācāryera ghara || 399 ||*

*Word for word:* iha bali — saying this; guptabeja — Gupta the vaidya; na karila ana-charcha — spoke of nothing else; chali gela harisha-antara — went away with a joyful heart; anande bharala hiya — the heart filled with bliss; gorapada dekhiya — having seen Gora's feet; gela yatha acharyera ghara — went to the house of the Acharya

**399a.** Saying this, Gupta the vaidya spoke of nothing else
and went away with a joyful heart;
his heart overflowing with bliss, having seen Gora's feet,
he went to the house of the Acharya.

অদ্বৈত-আচার্য নাম, সেই সর্বগুণধাম,
সেই সর্বজন-শিক্ষাগুরু ।
পড়িয়া চরণতলে, মুরারি বিনতি করে,
তুমি সর্বভক্ত-কল্পতরু ॥ ৪০০ ॥

*adbaita-ācārya nāma, sei sarbaguṇadhāma,*
*sei sarbajana-śikṣāguru |*
*paṛiẏā caraṇatale, murāri binati kare,*
*tumi sarbabhakta-kalpataru || 400 ||*

*Word for word:* advaita-acharya nama — His name is Advaita Acharya; sei sarvaguna-dhama — He is the abode of all virtues; sei sarvajana-shiksha-guru — He is the teacher of all people; padiya charanatale — falling at the feet; murari vinati kare — Murari humbly says; tumi sarvabhakta-kalpataru — you are the wish-fulfilling tree of all devotees

**400a.** His name is Advaita Acharya: He is the abode of all virtues,
He is the teacher of all people.
Falling at His feet, Murari humbly says:
"You are the wish-fulfilling tree for all devotees.

দেখিলাঙ অদ্ভুত, মিশ্র-পুরন্দর-সুত,
নিমাই পণ্ডিত বিশ্বম্ভর ।
বাল্যক্রীড়া করে রঙ্গে, সকল শিশুর সঙ্গে,
চরিত্র দেখিলুঁ লোকোত্তর ॥ ৪০১ ॥

*dekhilāṅa adbhuta, miśra-purandara-suta,*
*nimāi paṇḍita biśbambhara |*
*bālyakrīṛā kare raṅge, sakala śiśura saṅge,*
*caritra dekhiluṁ lokottara || 401 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhilanga adbhuta — I have seen a wonder; mishra-purandara-suta — the son of Mishra Purandara; nimai pandita vishvambhara — Nimai Pandita Vishvambhara; balya-krida kare range — merrily plays childhood games; sakala shishura sange — with all the boys; charitra dekhilun lokottara — I have seen deeds beyond the human

**401b.** I have seen a wonder: the son of Mishra Purandara,
Nimai Pandita Vishvambhara,
merrily plays His childhood games with all the boys —
I have seen deeds beyond the human."

ইহা শুনি দ্বিজমণি, হুহুঙ্কার করে ধ্বনি,
পুলকে ভরল সব অঙ্গ ।
রহস্য রহস্য এই, তোমারে নিভৃতে কই,
সেই ব্রহ্ম রসিক শ্রীঅঙ্গ ॥ ৪০২ ॥

*ihā śuni dbijamaṇi, huhuṅkāra kare dhbani,*
*pulake bharala saba aṅga |*
*rahasya rahasya ei, tomāre nibhṛte kai,*
*sei brahma rasika śrīaṅga || 402 ||*

*Word for word:* iha shuni — hearing this; dvijamani — the jewel of the twice-born; huhunkara kare dhvani — thunders "hum-hum"; pulake bharala saba anga — the whole body filled with thrills; rahasya rahasya ei — this is a secret, a secret; tomare nibhrite kai — I tell you in private; sei brahma — He is that Brahman; rasika — the relisher of rasa; shri-anga — of beautiful form

**402.** Hearing this, the jewel of the twice-born thundered "hum-hum";
His whole body filled with thrills of ecstasy:
"This is a secret, a secret — I tell you in private:
He is that very Brahman, the Relisher of rasa, in a beautiful form."[^13-4]

ইহা বলি কোলাকুলি, দুজনে আনন্দে ভুলি,
বেকত না করে বিশোয়াস ।
অখিল-ভুবনপতি, কৃপায়ে আইলা ক্ষিতি,
গুণ গায় এ লোচনদাস ॥ ৪০৩ ॥

*ihā bali kolākuli, dujane ānande bhuli,*
*bekata nā kare biśoẏāsa |*
*akhila-bhubanapati, kṛpāẏe āilā kṣiti,*
*guṇa gāẏa e locanadāsa || 403 ||*

*Word for word:* iha bali — saying this; kolakuli — embraced; dujane anande bhuli — both forgetting themselves in joy; bekata na kare vishoyasa — do not disclose their conviction; akhila-bhuvanapati — the Lord of all the worlds; kripaye aila kshiti — came to earth out of mercy; guna gaya e lochanadasa — this Lochana Dasa sings His glories

**403.** Saying this, they embraced, both forgetting themselves in joy,
but they do not disclose their conviction [to others].
The Lord of all the worlds has come to earth out of mercy —
His glories are sung by this Lochana Dasa.

*Raga bhatiyari; disha (numbered as a couplet in the edition):*

হরি হরি বোল চারিদিগ্ ভরি শুনি ।
হাতে তালি জয় জয় নাচে দ্বিজমণি ॥ ৪০৪ ॥

*hari hari bola cāridig bhari śuni |*
*hāte tāli jaẏa jaẏa nāce dbijamaṇi || 404 ||*

*Word for word:* hari hari bola — the cry "Hari, Hari"; charidig bhari shuni — is heard filling the four directions; hate tali — clapping hands; jaya jaya — "jaya, jaya"; nache dvijamani — the jewel of the twice-born dances

**404.** The cry "Hari! Hari!" is heard, filling all the directions;
clapping His hands, [crying] "Jaya, jaya!", the jewel of the twice-born dances.

বয়স্য বালক সব করি একমেলা ।
হরিগুণ-কীর্তন ভাল পাতিয়াছে খেলা ॥ ৪০৫ ॥

*baẏasya bālaka saba kari ekamelā |*
*hariguṇa-kīrtana bhāla pātiẏāche khelā || 405 ||*

*Word for word:* vayasya balaka saba — all the boys of His age; kari ekamela — gathering together; hariguna-kirtana — kirtana of Hari's glories; bhala patiyachhe khela — has started a fine game

**405.** Gathering together all the boys of His age,
He has started a fine game — a kirtana of Hari's glories.

চৌদিকে বালক বেঢ়ি হরি হরি বোলে ।
আনন্দে বিভোর প্রভু ভূমে গড়ি বুলে ॥ ৪০৬ ॥

*caudike bālaka beṛhi hari hari bole |*
*ānande bibhora prabhu bhūme gaṛi bule || 406 ||*

*Word for word:* chaudike balaka bedhi — the boys surrounding on all sides; hari hari bole — cry "Hari, Hari"; anande vibhora prabhu — the Lord overwhelmed with joy; bhume gadi bule — rolls on the ground

**406.** Surrounding Him on all sides, the boys cry "Hari, Hari!"
and the Lord, overwhelmed with joy, rolls on the ground.

বোল বোল বলি ডাকে মেঘগম্ভীর-স্বরে ।
আইস আইস বলিয়া বালক কোলে করে ॥ ৪০৭ ॥

*bola bola bali ḍāke meghagambhīra-sbare |*
*āisa āisa baliẏā bālaka kole kare || 407 ||*

*Word for word:* bola bola bali dake — calls, "Sing, sing!"; meghagambhira-svare — in a voice deep as thunder; aisa aisa baliya — saying "come, come"; balaka kole kare — embraces the boys

**407.** "Sing, sing!" He calls in a voice deep as thunder,
and saying, "Come here, come!", He embraces the boys.

শ্রীঅঙ্গ-পরশে বালক পাশরে আপনা ।
ফাঁফরে পড়িয়া দেখি বালকের কান্দনা ॥ ৪০৮ ॥

*śrīaṅga-paraśe bālaka pāśare āpanā |*
*phāṁphare paṛiẏā dekhi bālakera kāndanā || 408 ||*

*Word for word:* shri-anga-parashe — at the touch of the divine body; balaka pasare apana — the boy forgets himself; phanphare padiya — overwhelmed; dekhi balakera kandana — see the boy's weeping

**408.** At the touch of His divine body a boy forgets himself —
see how the boy, overwhelmed, is weeping!

আপাদমস্তকে পুলক অশ্রুধারা গলে ।
করতালি দিয়া বালক হরি হরি বোলে ॥ ৪০৯ ॥

*āpādamastake pulaka aśrudhārā gale |*
*karatāli diẏā bālaka hari hari bole || 409 ||*

*Word for word:* apada-mastake pulaka — thrills from foot to head; ashrudhara gale — streams of tears flow; karatali diya — clapping hands; balaka hari hari bole — the boy cries "Hari, Hari"

**409.** From head to foot — thrills of ecstasy; streams of tears flow;
clapping his hands, the boy cries "Hari, Hari!"

চৌদিকে বালক বেঢ়ি মাঝে গোরাসিংহ ।
মধুময় কমলে যেন বেঢ়িল মত্ত ভৃঙ্গ ॥ ৪১০ ॥

*caudike bālaka beṛhi mājhe gorāsiṃha |*
*madhumaẏa kamale yena beṛhila matta bhṛṅga || 410 ||*

*Word for word:* chaudike balaka bedhi — boys surrounding on all sides; majhe gorasimha — in the middle the lion Gora; madhumaya kamale — a honey-filled lotus; yena bedhila matta bhringa — as if intoxicated bees had encircled

**410.** The boys surround Him on all sides, and in the middle is the lion Gora,
as if intoxicated bees had encircled a honey-filled lotus.

হেনকালে সেই পথে দুই চারি পণ্ডিত ।
বিশ্বম্ভর খেলেন দেখিল আচম্বিত ॥ ৪১১ ॥

*henakāle sei pathe dui cāri paṇḍita |*
*biśbambhara khelena dekhila ācambita || 411 ||*

*Word for word:* henakale — at that time; sei pathe — on that road; dui chari pandita — a few pandits; vishvambhara khelena — Vishvambhara playing; dekhila achambita — suddenly saw

**411.** At that time a few pandits were passing along that road
and suddenly saw Vishvambhara's game.

অপরূপ দেখি গোরা-বালকের খেলা ।
বনফুল গাঁথিয়া সভার গলে মালা ॥ ৪১২ ॥

*aparūpa dekhi gorā-bālakera khelā |*
*banaphula gāṁthiẏā sabhāra gale mālā || 412 ||*

*Word for word:* aparupa dekhi — they see the wonderful; gora-balakera khela — game of the boy Gora; vanaphula ganthiya — strung of wildflowers; sabhara gale mala — garlands on everyone's neck

**412.** They see the wonderful game of the boy Gora:
on everyone's neck are garlands strung of wildflowers;

হরি হরি বোলে মুখে করে করতালি ।
আনন্দে নাচিয়া বুলে মাঝে গোরাহরি ॥ ৪১৩ ॥

*hari hari bole mukhe kare karatāli |*
*ānande nāciẏā bule mājhe gorāhari || 413 ||*

*Word for word:* hari hari bole mukhe — with their mouths cry "Hari, Hari"; kare karatali — clap hands; anande nachiya bule — dances about in joy; majhe gorahari — in the middle Gorahari

**413.** with their mouths they cry "Hari, Hari!" and clap their hands,
and in the middle Gorahari dances about in joy.

আপনা পাশরি পণ্ডিত সভে আইল মেলে ।
করতালি দিয়া তারা হরি হরি বোলে ॥ ৪১৪ ॥

*āpanā pāśari paṇḍita sabhe āila mele |*
*karatāli diẏā tārā hari hari bole || 414 ||*

*Word for word:* apana pasari — forgetting themselves; pandita sabhe aila mele — all the pandits joined; karatali diya — clapping hands; tara hari hari bole — they cry "Hari, Hari"

**414.** Forgetting themselves, all the pandits joined them,
and, clapping their hands, they too cried "Hari, Hari!"

যে বা আসে যায় পথে দেখি হয় ভোলা ।
কাঁখেতে কলসী করি চাহে নারীগুলা ॥ ৪১৫ ॥

*ye bā āse yāẏa pathe dekhi haẏa bholā |*
*kāṁkhete kalasī kari cāhe nārīgulā || 415 ||*

*Word for word:* ye ba ase yaya pathe — whoever comes or goes along the road; dekhi haya bhola — is entranced at the sight; kankhete kalasi kari — with water-pots on their hips; chahe narigula — the women gaze

**415.** Whoever comes or goes along the road is entranced at the sight;
women with water-pots on their hips stand and gaze.

হরি হরি বোল শুনি জয় জয় নাদ ।
শুনিঞা ধাইল কেহো দেখিবারে সাধ ॥ ৪১৬ ॥

*hari hari bola śuni jaẏa jaẏa nāda |*
*śuniñā dhāila keho dekhibāre sādha || 416 ||*

*Word for word:* hari hari bola shuni — hearing "Hari, Hari"; jaya jaya nada — shouts of "jaya, jaya"; shuniya dhaila keho — hearing, some ran; dekhibare sadha — eager to see

**416.** Hearing the cries of "Hari, Hari!" and the shouts of "Jaya, jaya!",
some came running, eager to see.

এ বোল শুনিঞা শচী আইলা আচম্বিতে ।
দেখিল আপন পুত্র নিমাই আর পণ্ডিতে ॥ ৪১৭ ॥

*e bola śuniñā śacī āilā ācambite |*
*dekhila āpana putra nimāi āra paṇḍite || 417 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuniya — hearing these cries; shachi aila achambite — Shachi suddenly came; dekhila apana putra nimai — saw her own son Nimai; ara pandite — and the pandits

**417.** Hearing these cries, Shachi suddenly came
and saw her own son Nimai and the pandits.

পুত্র পুত্র বলি শচী নিমাই কৈল কোলে ।
সভারে দেখিয়া সে নিষ্ঠুর বাণী বোলে ॥ ৪১৮ ॥

*putra putra bali śacī nimāi kaila kole |*
*sabhāre dekhiẏā se niṣṭhura bāṇī bole || 418 ||*

*Word for word:* putra putra bali — saying "son, son"; shachi nimai kaila kole — Shachi took Nimai in her arms; sabhare dekhiya — looking at all; se nishthura vani bole — she speaks harsh words

**418.** Crying "My son, my son!", Shachi took Nimai in her arms,
and, looking at them all, she speaks harsh words:

এমত বেভার সব পণ্ডিত-সভায় ।
পর-পুত পাগল করি উন্মত্ত নাচায় ॥ ৪১৯ ॥

*emata bebhāra saba paṇḍita-sabhāẏa |*
*para-puta pāgala kari unmatta nācāẏa || 419 ||*

*Word for word:* emata bebhara — such conduct; saba pandita-sabhaya — of the whole assembly of pandits; para-puta pagala kari — driving someone else's son mad; unmatta nachaya — make him dance like a madman

**419.** "Fine conduct for a whole assembly of pandits!
You have driven someone else's son mad and make him dance like a lunatic!"

কর্কশ কথায় সভার হইল চেতন ।
কি কৈল কি কৈল বলি গণে মনে মন ॥ ৪২০ ॥

*karkaśa kathāẏa sabhāra haila cetana |*
*ki kaila ki kaila bali gaṇe mane mana || 420 ||*

*Word for word:* karkasha kathaya — at the harsh words; sabhara haila chetana — all came to their senses; ki kaila ki kaila bali — saying "what have we done, what have we done"; gane mane mana — each reckons within himself

**420.** At her harsh words they all came to their senses:
"What have we done, what have we done?" each thinks to himself.

বিশ্বম্ভরে লঞা গেলা বিশ্বম্ভরের মাতা ।
আনন্দে লোচন কহে গোরাগুণগাথা ॥ ৪২১ ॥

*biśbambhare lañā gelā biśbambharera mātā |*
*ānande locana kahe gorāguṇagāthā || 421 ||*

*Word for word:* vishvambhare lana gela — took Vishvambhara away; vishvambharera mata — Vishvambhara's mother; anande lochana kahe — in joy Lochana tells; goraguna-gatha — the glories of Gora

**421.** Vishvambhara's mother took Vishvambhara away;
in joy Lochana tells the glories of Gora.

*Raga sindhura; disha: "A spotless moon has risen in Nadia!"*

এইখানে এক কথা কহিব এখন ।
মুরারিতে দামোদরে যে হৈল কথন ॥ ৪২২ ॥

*eikhāne eka kathā kahiba ekhana |*
*murārite dāmodare ye haila kathana || 422 ||*

*Word for word:* eikhane — here; eka katha kahiba ekhana — I shall now tell a story; murarite damodare — between Murari and Damodara; ye haila kathana — the conversation that took place

**422.** Now here I shall tell a story —
the conversation that took place between Murari and Damodara.[^13-5]

মুরারিকে পুছিলা পণ্ডিত দামোদর ।
এক নিবেদঙ চির বেদনা অন্তর ॥ ৪২৩ ॥

*murārike puchilā paṇḍita dāmodara |*
*eka nibedaṅa cira bedanā antara || 423 ||*

*Word for word:* murarike puchhila — asked Murari; pandita damodara — Damodara Pandita; eka nivedanga — I submit one [request]; chira vedana antara — a long-standing pain of the heart

**423.** Damodara Pandita asked Murari:
"I make one request — it is a long-standing pain in my heart.

কহ কহ গুপ্তবেজা পুছোঁ তোর ঠাঞি ।
কতি গেলা বিশ্বরূপ ঠাকুরের ভাই ॥ ৪২৪ ॥

*kaha kaha guptabejā puchoṁ tora ṭhāñi |*
*kati gelā biśbarūpa ṭhākurera bhāi || 424 ||*

*Word for word:* kaha kaha — tell, tell; guptabeja — Gupta the vaidya; puchhon tora thani — I ask you; kati gela — where did he go; vishvarupa — Vishvarupa; thakurera bhai — the Thakura's brother

**424.** Tell me, tell me, Gupta the vaidya, I ask you:
where did Vishvarupa, the Thakura's brother, go?

তাহার চরিত্র কিছু পুছোঁ মো সাদরে ।
কহয়ে মুরারি বড় হরিষ অন্তরে ॥ ৪২৫ ॥

*tāhāra caritra kichu puchoṁ mo sādare |*
*kahaẏe murāri baṛa hariṣa antare || 425 ||*

*Word for word:* tahara charitra kichhu — something of his life; puchhon mo sadare — I ask with love; kahaye murari — Murari says; bada harisha antare — with great joy in his heart

**425.** With love I ask you about his life."
And Murari, with great joy in his heart, replies:

শুন শুন দামোদর পণ্ডিত-প্রধান ।
যে জানোঁ মো কহোঁ কিছু তোর বিদ্যমান ॥ ৪২৬ ॥

*śuna śuna dāmodara paṇḍita-pradhāna |*
*ye jānoṁ mo kahoṁ kichu tora bidyamāna || 426 ||*

*Word for word:* shuna shuna — listen, listen; damodara pandita-pradhana — Damodara, foremost of pandits; ye janon mo — what I know; kahon kichhu — I shall tell; tora vidyamana — in your presence

**426.** "Listen, listen, Damodara, foremost of pandits:
what I know I shall tell you.

বিশ্বম্ভর-জ্যেষ্ঠ বিশ্বরূপ গুণধাম ।
কি কহিব তার গুণ-চরিত্র-বাখান ॥ ৪২৭ ॥

*biśbambhara-jyeṣṭha biśbarūpa guṇadhāma |*
*ki kahiba tāra guṇa-caritra-bākhāna || 427 ||*

*Word for word:* vishvambhara-jyeshtha — Vishvambhara's elder brother; vishvarupa gunadhama — Vishvarupa, abode of virtues; ki kahiba — what shall I say; tara guna-charitra-vakhana — the description of his virtues and deeds

**427.** Vishvambhara's elder brother, Vishvarupa, was an abode of virtues;[^13-6]
how can I describe his virtues and deeds!

অল্পকালে সর্বশাস্ত্র জানয় সকল ।
ধর্মে তৎপর বুদ্ধি সংসারে বিরল ॥ ৪২৮ ॥

*alpakāle sarbaśāstra jānaẏa sakala |*
*dharme tatpara buddhi saṃsāre birala || 428 ||*

*Word for word:* alpakale — in a short time; sarvashastra janaya sakala — knew all the shastras; dharme tatpara buddhi — mind devoted to dharma; samsare virala — averse to worldly life

**428.** In a short time he mastered all the shastras;
his mind was devoted to dharma and averse to worldly life.

স্বচ্ছন্দ-হৃদয় দ্বিজ-দেব-গুরু-ভক্ত ।
পিতা-মাতার সেবা করে অতি অনুরক্ত ॥ ৪২৯ ॥

*sbacchanda-hṛdaẏa dbija-deba-guru-bhakta |*
*pitā-mātāra sebā kare ati anurakta || 429 ||*

*Word for word:* svachchhanda-hridaya — of pure (open) heart; dvija-deva-guru-bhakta — devoted to brahmanas, gods and guru; pita-matara seva kare — serves father and mother; ati anurakta — with great love

**429.** Pure of heart, devoted to brahmanas, gods and guru,
he served his father and mother with great love.

বেদান্ত-সিদ্ধান্ত জানে সর্বধর্ম-মর্ম ।
বিষ্ণুভক্তি বিনু সে না করে কোন কর্ম ॥ ৪৩০ ॥

*bedānta-siddhānta jāne sarbadharma-marma |*
*biṣṇubhakti binu se nā kare kona karma || 430 ||*

*Word for word:* vedanta-siddhanta jane — knows the conclusions of Vedanta; sarvadharma-marma — the essence of every dharma; vishnubhakti vinu — without devotion to Vishnu; se na kare kona karma — he does no act at all

**430.** He knew the conclusions of Vedanta, the essence of every dharma;
without devotion to Vishnu he did no act at all.

সর্বলোক-প্রিয় সে পরম মহাসিদ্ধি ।
অন্তরে বৈরাগ্য তত্ত্বজ্ঞানে নিষ্ঠ বুদ্ধি ॥ ৪৩১ ॥

*sarbaloka-priẏa se parama mahāsiddhi |*
*antare bairāgya tattbajñāne niṣṭha buddhi || 431 ||*

*Word for word:* sarvaloka-priya se — he is beloved by all; parama mahasiddhi — of supreme perfection; antare vairagya — detachment at heart; tattvajnane nishtha buddhi — mind fixed in the knowledge of truth

**431.** Beloved by all, he had attained the highest perfection;
detached at heart, his mind was fixed in the knowledge of truth.

সমাধ্যায়ি-সনে কথা পুথি বামহাতে ।
জগন্নাথ পিতায়ে দেখিলা রাজপথে ॥ ৪৩২ ॥

*samādhyāẏi-sane kathā puthi bāmahāte |*
*jagannātha pitāẏe dekhilā rājapathe || 432 ||*

*Word for word:* samadhyayi-sane katha — talking with fellow students; puthi vamahate — a book in the left hand; jagannatha pitaye — the father Jagannatha; dekhila rajapathe — saw on the main road

**432.** One day his father Jagannatha saw him on the main road,
talking with his fellow students, a book in his left hand.

ষোড়শ বরিষ পুত্র ভেল বয়ঃক্রম ।
বিবাহের যোগ্য রূপ-যৌবন-সম্পন্ন ॥ ৪৩৩ ॥

*ṣoṛaśa bariṣa putra bhela baẏaḥkrama |*
*bibāhera yogya rūpa-yaubana-sampanna || 433 ||*

*Word for word:* shodasha barisha — sixteen years; putra bhela vayahkrama — became the son's age; vivahera yogya — fit for marriage; rupa-yauvana-sampanna — endowed with beauty and youth

**433.** The son had reached the age of sixteen;
he was fit for marriage, endowed with beauty and youth.

এই মনঃকথা পিতা হৃদয়ে করিল ।
বিশ্বরূপ-যোগ্য কন্যা মনে বিচারিল ॥ ৪৩৪ ॥

*ei manaḥkathā pitā hṛdaẏe karila |*
*biśbarūpa-yogya kanyā mane bicārila || 434 ||*

*Word for word:* ei manahkatha — this wish; pita hridaye karila — the father harboured in his heart; vishvarupa-yogya kanya — brides worthy of Vishvarupa; mane vicharila — considered in his mind

**434.** The father harboured this wish in his heart
and began to consider brides worthy of Vishvarupa.

চিন্তিতে চিন্তিতে দ্বিজ আইলা নিজঘর ।
বিশ্বরূপ-বিভা দিব চিন্তিত অন্তর ॥ ৪৩৫ ॥

*cintite cintite dbija āilā nijaghara |*
*biśbarūpa-bibhā diba cintita antara || 435 ||*

*Word for word:* chintite chintite — thinking and thinking; dvija aila nijaghara — the brahmana came home; vishvarupa-vibha diba — "I will get Vishvarupa married"; chintita antara — preoccupied heart

**435.** Deep in thought, the brahmana came home,
his heart full of one thought: 'I will get Vishvarupa married.'

কথোক্ষণে বিশ্বরূপ দ্বিজ আইলা ঘর ।
সুবিস্মিত পিতা দেখি বুঝিল অন্তর ॥ ৪৩৬ ॥

*kathokṣaṇe biśbarūpa dbija āilā ghara |*
*subismita pitā dekhi bujhila antara || 436 ||*

*Word for word:* kathokshane — after a while; vishvarupa dvija aila ghara — the brahmana Vishvarupa came home; suvismita pita dekhi — seeing his father lost in thought (lit. "much amazed"); bujhila antara — understood his heart

**436.** Soon the brahmana Vishvarupa also came home,
and, seeing his father lost in thought, he understood what was in his heart.

তবে সেইমতে বিশ্বরূপ দ্বিজবর্য ।
সুবিস্মিত পিতা দেখি বুঝিলেন কার্য ॥ ৪৩৭ ॥

*tabe seimate biśbarūpa dbijabarya |*
*subismita pitā dekhi bujhilena kārya || 437 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe seimate — so; vishvarupa dvijavarya — Vishvarupa, the best of brahmanas; suvismita pita dekhi — seeing his father lost in thought; bujhilena karya — understood the matter

**437.** So the best of brahmanas, Vishvarupa,
seeing his father lost in thought, understood the matter.

অন্তরে জানিল মোর বিবাহের তরে ।
চিন্তিত হইলা দোঁহে কার্য করিবারে ॥ ৪৩৮ ॥

*antare jānila mora bibāhera tare |*
*cintita hailā doṁhe kārya karibāre || 438 ||*

*Word for word:* antare janila — understood in his heart; mora vivahera tare — for my marriage; chintita haila donhe — both have become anxious; karya karibare — to accomplish the matter

**438.** He understood in his heart: 'It is for my marriage —
they are both anxious how to arrange it.

বিবাহ করিব আমি নহে ত উচিত ।
নহে বা জননী দুঃখ পাবে বিপরীত ॥ ৪৩৯ ॥

*bibāha kariba āmi nahe ta ucita |*
*nahe bā jananī duḥkha pābe biparīta || 439 ||*

*Word for word:* vivaha kariba ami — for me to marry; nahe ta uchita — is not proper; nahe ba — or else; janani duhkha pave — mother will suffer grief; viparita — contrary [to her wish]

**439.** For me to marry is not proper;
and if I do not, mother will grieve: it will go against her wish.'

এই মনে অনুমানি রাত্রি-সুপ্রভাতে ।
বাহির হইয়া গেলা পুথি বামহাতে ॥ ৪৪০ ॥

*ei mane anumāni rātri-suprabhāte |*
*bāhira haiẏā gelā puthi bāmahāte || 440 ||*

*Word for word:* ei mane anumani — reasoning thus; ratri-suprabhate — at daybreak; bahira haiya gela — went out; puthi vamahate — with a book in his left hand

**440.** Having reasoned thus, at daybreak
he went out of the house with a book in his left hand,

গঙ্গাজল-সন্তরণ করি পার হৈলা ।
গত-মাত্র মহাশয় সন্ন্যাস করিলা ॥ ৪৪১ ॥

*gaṅgājala-santaraṇa kari pāra hailā |*
*gata-mātra mahāśaẏa sannyāsa karilā || 441 ||*

*Word for word:* gangajala-santarana kari — swimming across the Ganga's waters; para haila — crossed over; gata-matra — as soon as he had gone; mahashaya — the great soul; sannyasa karila — took sannyasa

**441.** swam across the waters of the Ganga to the other bank,
and, as soon as he had gone, the great soul took sannyasa.

*Raga pathamanjari*

তৃতীয়-প্রহর বেলা, কেনে পুত্র না আইলা,
পিতা মাতা চিন্তিত-হৃদয় ।
জগন্নাথ খোঁজ করে, চাহে প্রতি ঘরে ঘরে,
না পাইল আপন তনয় ॥ ৪৪২ ॥

*tṛtīẏa-prahara belā, kene putra nā āilā,*
*pitā mātā cintita-hṛdaẏa |*
*jagannātha khoṁja kare, cāhe prati ghare ghare,*
*nā pāila āpana tanaẏa || 442 ||*

*Word for word:* tritiya-prahara vela — the third watch of the day; kene putra na aila — why has the son not come; pita mata chintita-hridaya — father and mother anxious at heart; jagannatha khoja kare — Jagannatha searches; chahe prati ghare ghare — looks into every house; na paila apana tanaya — did not find his son

**442.** The third watch of the day has come — why has our son not returned?
The hearts of father and mother are full of anxiety.
Jagannatha searches, looks into house after house,
and did not find his son.

জনে জনে কানাকানি, কার্য হৈল জানাজানি,
বিশ্বরূপ-সন্ন্যাসকরণ ।
তো-কাণি মো-কাণি কথা, শুনি জগন্নাথ পিতা,
আচম্বিতে হরিল চেতন ॥ ৪৪৩ ॥

*jane jane kānākāni, kārya haila jānājāni,*
*biśbarūpa-sannyāsakaraṇa |*
*to-kāṇi mo-kāṇi kathā, śuni jagannātha pitā,*
*ācambite harila cetana || 443 ||*

*Word for word:* jane jane kanakani — people whisper to one another; karya haila janajani — the matter became known; vishvarupa-sannyasa-karana — Vishvarupa's taking sannyasa; to-kani mo-kani katha — talk passed from ear to ear; shuni jagannatha pita — hearing, the father Jagannatha; achambite harila chetana — suddenly lost consciousness

**443.** People whisper to one another, and the matter became known:
Vishvarupa had taken sannyasa.
Hearing the news passed from ear to ear,
the father Jagannatha suddenly lost consciousness.

তবে শচীদেবী শুনি, মূর্ছিত পড়িলা ভূমি,
অন্ধকার হৈল ত্রিজগত ।
বিশ্বরূপ বলি ডাকে, আইস পুত্র দেখি তোকে,
কি লাগিয়া হইলা বিরক্ত ॥ ৪৪৪ ॥

*tabe śacīdebī śuni, mūrchita paṛilā bhūmi,*
*andhakāra haila trijagata |*
*biśbarūpa bali ḍāke, āisa putra dekhi toke,*
*ki lāgiẏā hailā birakta || 444 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe shachidevi shuni — then Shachi-devi, hearing; murchhita padila bhumi — fell senseless to the ground; andhakara haila trijagata — the three worlds became dark; vishvarupa bali dake — calls "Vishvarupa!"; aisa putra dekhi toke — come, son, let me see you; ki lagiya haila virakta — why have you renounced

**444.** Then Shachi-devi too, hearing it, fell senseless to the ground —
the three worlds became dark.
She calls, "Vishvarupa! Come, my son, let me see you!
Why have you renounced the world?

সে হেন সুন্দর গা, সে হেন সুন্দর পা,
কেমনে হাঁটিয়া যাবে পথে ।
প্রহরেক ভোখ তুমি, তিলেক সহিতে নার,
আখটি করিবে আর কাথে ॥ ৪৪৫ ॥

*se hena sundara gā, se hena sundara pā,*
*kemane hāṁṭiẏā yābe pathe |*
*prahareka bhokha tumi, tileka sahite nāra,*
*ākhaṭi karibe āra kāthe || 445 ||*

*Word for word:* se hena sundara ga — such a beautiful body; se hena sundara pa — such beautiful feet; kemane hantiya yabe pathe — how will you walk along the roads; praharaka bhokha tumi — the hunger of one watch you; tileka sahite nara — could not bear even a moment; akhati karibe ara kathe — with whom will you now be fussy

**445.** Such a beautiful body, such beautiful feet —
how will you walk along the roads?
You could not bear the hunger of a single watch —
with whom will you now be fussy?

পড়িবারে যাও পুতে, সোয়াস্থ না পাঙ চিতে,
বেলি চাহোঁ তখনে তখন ।
স্নান করিবারে যাও, তথা স্থির নাহি পাঙ,
বিশ্বরূপ আসিবে এখন ॥ ৪৪৬ ॥

*paṛibāre yāo pute, soẏāstha nā pāṅa cite,*
*beli cāhoṁ takhane takhana |*
*snāna karibāre yāo, tathā sthira nāhi pāṅa,*
*biśbarūpa āsibe ekhana || 446 ||*

*Word for word:* padibare yao pute — when you go to study, son; soyastha na panga chite — I find no ease in my heart; beli chahon takhane takhana — I look at the time again and again; snana karibare yao — when you go to bathe; tatha sthira nahi panga — then too I cannot keep still; vishvarupa asibe ekhana — "Vishvarupa will come now"

**446.** When you went to study, son, my heart found no rest —
I kept looking at the time again and again;
when you went to bathe, even then I could not keep still:
'Vishvarupa will come any moment now.'

তুমি মা বলিয়া ডাক, সেই ধন লাখো লাখ,
মুখ চাঞা পাশরোঁ আপনা ।
না জানি কি দুঃখ পাঞা, মোর মুখে আগি দিয়া,
সন্ন্যাস করিলি দীনপনা ॥ ৪৪৭ ॥

*tumi mā baliẏā ḍāka, sei dhana lākho lākha,*
*mukha cāñā pāśaroṁ āpanā |*
*nā jāni ki duḥkha pāñā, mora mukhe āgi diẏā,*
*sannyāsa karili dīnapanā || 447 ||*

*Word for word:* tumi ma baliya daka — that you call "mother"; sei dhana lakho lakha — that is wealth of hundreds of thousands; mukha chana — looking at the face; pasaron apana — I forget myself; na jani ki duhkha pana — I know not what grief befell you; mora mukhe agi diya — putting fire in my mouth; sannyasa karili dinapana — you took sannyasa, a life of poverty

**447.** When you called me 'Mother', it was wealth of hundreds of thousands to me —
looking at your face I forgot myself.
I do not know what grief befell you that, putting fire into my mouth,[^13-7]
you took sannyasa, a life of poverty.

কতি গেলা তার পিতা, যাউ বিশ্বরূপ যথা,
ধরিয়া আনহ পুত্র ঘরে ।
যে বলুক সে বলুক লোকে, পুত্র আনি দেহ মোকে,
পুনঃ উপবীত দিমু তারে ॥ ৪৪৮ ॥

*kati gelā tāra pitā, yāu biśbarūpa yathā,*
*dhariẏā ānaha putra ghare |*
*ye baluka se baluka loke, putra āni deha moke,*
*punaḥ upabīta dimu tāre || 448 ||*

*Word for word:* kati gela tara pita — where are you, his father; yau vishvarupa yatha — go where Vishvarupa is; dhariya anaha putra ghare — seize and bring the son home; ye baluka se baluka loke — let people say what they will; putra ani deha moke — bring the son and give him to me; punah upavita dimu tare — I shall invest him with the sacred thread again

**448.** Where are you, his father? Go to where Vishvarupa is,
seize our son and bring him home!
Let people say what they will — bring my son and give him to me:
I will invest him with the sacred thread again."

জগন্নাথ বোলে বাণী, শুন দেবি শচীরাণী,
স্থির কর আপন অন্তর ।
শোক না করিহ আর, মিথ্যা সব সংসার,
বিশ্বরূপ সুপুরুষবর ॥ ৪৪৯ ॥

*jagannātha bole bāṇī, śuna debi śacīrāṇī,*
*sthira kara āpana antara |*
*śoka nā kariha āra, mithyā saba saṃsāra,*
*biśbarūpa supuruṣabara || 449 ||*

*Word for word:* jagannatha bole vani — Jagannatha speaks; shuna devi shachirani — listen, goddess Shachi-rani; sthira kara apana antara — calm your heart; shoka na kariha ara — grieve no more; mithya saba samsara — all worldly life is vain; vishvarupa supurushavara — Vishvarupa is the best of worthy men

**449.** Jagannatha replies: "Listen, goddess Shachi-rani,
calm your heart.
Grieve no more: all worldly life is vanity;[^13-8]
and Vishvarupa is the best of worthy men.

আমার বংশের ভাগ্য, বিশ্বরূপ পুত্র যোগ্য,
আকুমার করিল সন্ন্যাস ।
এই আশীর্বাদ কর, সেই পথে হউক স্থির,
সন্ন্যাস করুক অনায়াস ॥ ৪৫০ ॥

*āmāra baṃśera bhāgya, biśbarūpa putra yogya,*
*ākumāra karila sannyāsa |*
*ei āśīrbāda kara, sei pathe hauka sthira,*
*sannyāsa karuka anāẏāsa || 450 ||*

*Word for word:* amara vamshera bhagya — the fortune of our line; vishvarupa putra yogya — Vishvarupa, a worthy son; akumara karila sannyasa — took sannyasa without marrying; ei ashirvada kara — give this blessing; sei pathe hauka sthira — may he be steady on that path; sannyasa karuka anayasa — may he keep sannyasa without hardship

**450.** It is the good fortune of our line: Vishvarupa, a worthy son,
has taken sannyasa without ever marrying.
Give him this blessing: may he be steady on that path
and keep his sannyasa without hardship.

সম্পদে বিপদ যেন, না মানিহ ইহা শুন,
শোক না করিহ অকারণ ।
একটি সন্ন্যাস করে, কোটি কুল নিস্তারে,
বিশ্বরূপ পুরুষরতন ॥ ৪৫১ ॥

*sampade bipada yena, nā māniha ihā śuna,*
*śoka nā kariha akāraṇa |*
*ekaṭi sannyāsa kare, koṭi kula nistāre,*
*biśbarūpa puruṣaratana || 451 ||*

*Word for word:* sampade vipada yena — as misfortune amid good fortune; na maniha iha shuna — do not regard this, listen; shoka na kariha akarana — do not grieve without cause; ekati sannyasa kare — if one takes sannyasa; koti kula nistare — millions of generations are delivered; vishvarupa purusharatana — Vishvarupa is a jewel among men

**451.** Listen: do not regard this as misfortune in the midst of good fortune;
do not grieve without cause.
If one takes sannyasa, millions of generations of the family are delivered —
Vishvarupa is a jewel among men."

শুনি জগন্নাথ-বাণী, পুনঃ কহে শচীরাণী,
কি কহিলে কহ মহাশয় ।
একটি সন্ন্যাস করে, কোটি কুল নিস্তারে,
ভাল কৈল আমার তনয় ॥ ৪৫২ ॥

*śuni jagannātha-bāṇī, punaḥ kahe śacīrāṇī,*
*ki kahile kaha mahāśaẏa |*
*ekaṭi sannyāsa kare, koṭi kula nistāre,*
*bhāla kaila āmāra tanaẏa || 452 ||*

*Word for word:* shuni jagannatha-vani — hearing Jagannatha's words; punah kahe shachirani — Shachi-rani speaks again; ki kahile kaha mahashaya — what did you say, tell me, my lord; ekati sannyasa kare koti kula nistare — "if one takes sannyasa, millions of generations are delivered"; bhala kaila amara tanaya — my son has done well

**452.** Hearing Jagannatha's words, Shachi-rani speaks again:
"What did you say? Tell me again, my lord.
'If one takes sannyasa, millions of generations are delivered'?
Then my son has done well."

এইমতে দুইজনে, হরিষ-বিষাদ মনে,
গোঙাইলা কথোক সময় ।
কি কহিব সে মহিমা, ভাগ্যপথে নাহি সীমা,
বিশ্বম্ভর পাইল তনয় ॥ ৪৫৩ ॥

*eimate duijane, hariṣa-biṣāda mane,*
*goṅāilā kathoka samaẏa |*
*ki kahiba se mahimā, bhāgyapathe nāhi sīmā,*
*biśbambhara pāila tanaẏa || 453 ||*

*Word for word:* eimate duijane — thus the two; harisha-vishada mane — with joy and sorrow in their minds; gonaila kathoka samaya — passed some time; ki kahiba se mahima — what shall I say of that glory; bhagyapathe nahi sima — there is no limit to their fortune; vishvambhara paila tanaya — obtained Vishvambhara as their son

**453.** Thus the two of them, with joy and sorrow in their hearts,
passed some time.
What can I say of that glory? There is no limit to their fortune:
they obtained Vishvambhara as their son.[^13-9]

কহিল মুরারিগুপ্ত, দামোদর পণ্ডিত,
শুন বিশ্বরূপের সন্ন্যাস ।
পুনরপি পুছে কথা, বিশ্বম্ভর-গুণগাথা,
কহে এই এ লোচনদাস ॥ ৪৫৪ ॥

*kahila murārigupta, dāmodara paṇḍita,*
*śuna biśbarūpera sannyāsa |*
*punarapi puche kathā, biśbambhara-guṇagāthā,*
*kahe ei e locanadāsa || 454 ||*

*Word for word:* kahila murari-gupta — Murari Gupta told; damodara pandita — Damodara Pandita; shuna vishvarupera sannyasa — hear of Vishvarupa's sannyasa; punarapi puchhe katha — again he asks for the story; vishvambhara-guna-gatha — the song of Vishvambhara's glories; kahe ei e lochanadasa — says this Lochana Dasa

**454.** So Murari Gupta told, and Damodara Pandita heard,
of Vishvarupa's sannyasa.
Again he asks for the story — the song of Vishvambhara's glories —
says this Lochana Dasa.

বিশ্বম্ভর হেনকালে, বসিয়া মায়ের কোলে,
নেহারয়ে বাপের বয়ান ।
কতি গেলা মোর ভ্রাতা, শুন শুন পিতা মাতা,
আমি তোর করিব পালন ॥ ৪৫৫ ॥

*biśbambhara henakāle, basiẏā māẏera kole,*
*nehāraẏe bāpera baẏāna |*
*kati gelā mora bhrātā, śuna śuna pitā mātā,*
*āmi tora kariba pālana || 455 ||*

*Word for word:* vishvambhara henakale — at that time Vishvambhara; vasiya mayera kole — sitting on His mother's lap; neharaye bapera bayana — gazes at His father's face; kati gela mora bhrata — wherever My brother has gone; shuna shuna pita mata — listen, listen, father and mother; ami tora kariba palana — I will take care of you

**455.** At that time Vishvambhara, sitting on His mother's lap,
gazes into His father's face:
"Wherever My brother has gone — listen, listen, father and mother:
I will take care of you."

এহেন শুনিঞা বাণী, জগন্নাথ শচীরাণী,
দোঁহে মেলি পুত্র কৈল কোলে ।
দেখি বিশ্বম্ভর-মুখ, পাশরিল যত দুঃখ,
এ কথা লোচনদাস বোলে ॥ ৪৫৬ ॥

*ehena śuniñā bāṇī, jagannātha śacīrāṇī,*
*doṁhe meli putra kaila kole |*
*dekhi biśbambhara-mukha, pāśarila yata duḥkha,*
*e kathā locanadāsa bole || 456 ||*

*Word for word:* ehena shuniya vani — hearing such words; jagannatha shachirani — Jagannatha and Shachi-rani; donhe meli putra kaila kole — both together embraced their son; dekhi vishvambhara-mukha — seeing Vishvambhara's face; pasarila yata duhkha — forgot all sorrows; e katha lochanadasa bole — so says Lochana Dasa

**456.** Hearing such words, Jagannatha and Shachi-rani
both together embraced their son;
looking at Vishvambhara's face, they forgot all their sorrows —
so says Lochana Dasa.

*Thus ends the description of the Balya-lila.*

[^13-1]: The numbering of Bhaktisiddhanta's edition goes astray here: after 399 it prints 400, 401, 401 again, then the count returns to 393 and runs 393–403, after which it continues 404, 405… (and so on through the edition). Apparently the compositor was correcting the jump 330 → 340 of portion 12. To keep the edition's numbers, on which all further numbering depends, we retain the printed numbers and distinguish the repeats by a letter: the second "401" is 401a, the repeated series 393–401 is 393a–400a and 401b. The sequence of the couplets (confirmed by the 1983 and 1903 editions) is unchanged.
[^13-2]: Murari, an elder and respected man, prostrated himself before a child; by popular belief, an elder's bow to a younger one brings misfortune on the younger and shortens his life. Hence the parents' alarm and their plea that he bless Nimai with long life.
[^13-3]: Murari Gupta was a vaidya (physician) by caste; the parents respectfully call him a "shudra-muni", a sage who is not a brahmana.
[^13-4]: "Brahman, the Relisher of rasa" is Brahman as the Person who enjoys rasa (cf. Taittiriya Upanishad 2.7: "He, verily, is rasa"), that is, Krishna Himself. Advaita at once discloses to Murari that Nimai is the Lord Himself, but bids him keep it secret.
[^13-5]: Murari Gupta and Damodara Pandita are the narrator and his interlocutor in Murari Gupta's Sanskrit biography (Sri Krishna-chaitanya-charitamrita); Lochana Dasa, who relies on that work, adopts its frame. The story of Vishvarupa is in Murari 1.07.1–10.
[^13-6]: In the Gaudiya Vaishnava understanding Vishvarupa is Sankarshana (in Murari, "a portion of Baladeva", 1.07.3). On taking sannyasa he received the name Shankararanya, and he left this world at Pandharpur (Chaitanya-charitamrita, Madhya 9.299–300).
[^13-7]: At a cremation it is the son who places fire in the mouth of the dead (mukhagni); Shachi says bitterly that by leaving, her son has as good as performed her funeral rite while she lives.
[^13-8]: That is, attachment to home and family is worthless; this is not a claim that the world is illusory, but a statement of the vanity of worldly life (samsara) beside renunciation for God's sake.
[^13-9]: In A this couplet was lost in the OCR (its number is restored from the neighbouring ones); the text follows the 1903 edition; the 1983 edition ends the stanza: "whose son is Gorachand".

---

# Adi-khanda, part 6 (portion 14)

*The beginning of the Pauganda-lila: Vishvambhara begins to learn His letters; the chudakarana rite; a game on the sandy bank of the Ganga following the tracks of birds; Jagannatha Mishra's anger and Shachi's intercession; Jagannatha's dream: a brahmana reveals to him that his son is the Lord Himself*

## Pauganda-lila (The Boyhood Pastimes)

> *Summary by Srila Bhaktisiddhanta Sarasvati.* When Gaurasundara, having heard Murari expound the scripture of yoga, began to mock him by imitating his gestures and manners, Murari in anger spoke harsh words to Him. In return, Sriman Mahaprabhu, to show the worthlessness of yoga and what becomes of the yogi, urinated into Murari's plate during his midday meal and instructed him in the supremacy of devotion to Krishna. Then the author, having described how Sriman Mahaprabhu enacted the pastime of sankirtana with the boys of His age, the sannyasa of Vishvarupa as told in a conversation between Murari and Damodara, the grief of Shachi and Jagannatha and so on, proceeds to describe Gaurasundara's Pauganda-lila. In due time the chudakarana and other rites of Gaurahari were duly performed. As prescribed, at an auspicious moment chalk was placed in His hand;[^14-1] He […][^14-2] Mishra Purandara, learning [in a dream] that [his son] is Bhagavan, was enlightened; but when this mood of his […], he became absorbed once more in his parental love (vatsalya). At the appointed time Gaurahari's upanayana rite was performed according to rule. Then the teaching on the avataras of the four yugas is set out. At the end of the Dvapara-yuga, Bhagavan Himself, Sri Krishna, the son of the king of Vraja, appears. In the Kali-yuga, assuming the feelings and the lustre of Srimati Radha, He descends in a hidden way in the form of Sri Gaurasundara to preach the dharma of the age — the sankirtana of Hari's name. Intoxicated with prema, He gave prema away, offering it at the door of every living being. During His life as a householder, by forbidding His mother to eat grains on the day of Ekadashi, He taught the living beings of the world. When Jagannatha Mishra fell ill, He instructed about the impermanence of human life and comforted His mother in many ways. When Jagannatha Mishra passed from this world, Shachi-devi mourned her husband; Gaurahari too mourned His father. After that He began His studies […].[^14-3]

*Raga dhanashi*

এইমতে আর দিনে মিশ্র পুরন্দর ।
চিন্তিতে লাগিলা মনে দেখি বিশ্বম্ভর ॥ ৪৫৭ ॥

*eimate āra dine miśra purandara |*
*cintite lāgilā mane dekhi biśbambhara || 457 ||*

*Word for word:* eimate — thus; ara dine — on another day; mishra purandara — Mishra Purandara; chintite lagila mane — began to reflect in his mind; dekhi vishvambhara — looking at Vishvambhara

**457.** Thus one day Mishra Purandara,
looking at Vishvambhara, began to reflect.

শুভদিন শুভক্ষণ তিথি সুনক্ষত্র ।
হাথে খড়ি দিল তার সময় বিচিত্র ॥ ৪৫৮ ॥

*śubhadina śubhakṣaṇa tithi sunakṣatra |*
*hāthe khaṛi dila tāra samaẏa bicitra || 458 ||*

*Word for word:* shubhadina shubhakshana — auspicious day, auspicious moment; tithi sunakshatra — [good] tithi and nakshatra; hathe khadi dila tara — placed chalk in His hand; samaya vichitra — a wonderful occasion

**458.** On an auspicious day, at an auspicious moment, under a good tithi and nakshatra,
he placed chalk in His hand[^14-1] — a wonderful occasion it was.

দিনে দিনে পড়ে সেই জগতের গুরু ।
দেখি শচী-জগন্নাথ আপনা পাশরু ॥ ৪৫৯ ॥

*dine dine paṛe sei jagatera guru |*
*dekhi śacī-jagannātha āpanā pāśaru || 459 ||*

*Word for word:* dine dine pade — day by day studies; sei jagatera guru — He, the Guru of the world; dekhi — seeing; shachi-jagannatha apana pasaru — Shachi and Jagannatha forget themselves

**459.** Day by day He studies, the Guru of the world;
seeing this, Shachi and Jagannatha forget themselves.

কি মধুর করি প্রভু ক খ গ ঘ বোলে ।
দেখি শচী জগন্নাথ সব দুখ ভোলে ॥ ৪৫৯+১ ॥

*ki madhura kari prabhu ka kha ga gha bole |*
*dekhi śacī jagannātha saba dukha bhole || 459+1 ||*

*Word for word:* ki madhura kari — how sweetly; prabhu — the Lord; ka kha ga gha bole — says "ka, kha, ga, gha"; dekhi — seeing [this]; shachi jagannatha — Shachi and Jagannatha; saba dukha bhole — forget all sorrow

**459+1.** How sweetly the Lord says "ka, kha, ga, gha"![^14-4]
Seeing this, Shachi and Jagannatha forget every sorrow.

দিন দুই তিনে সে লিখিল সব ফলা ।
নিরন্তর লিখেন কৃষ্ণের নামমালা ॥ ৪৫৯+২ ॥

*dina dui tine se likhila saba phalā |*
*nirantara likhena kṛṣṇera nāmamālā || 459+2 ||*

*Word for word:* dina dui tine — in two or three days; se — He; likhila — wrote (learned to write); saba phala — all the phala signs (all the letters with their signs); nirantara — unceasingly; likhena — writes; krishnera namamala — the garland of Krishna's names

**459+2.** In two or three days He learned to write all the letters with all their signs;
unceasingly He writes out garlands of Krishna's names:

রামকৃষ্ণ গোবিন্দ গোপাল বনমালী ।
অহর্নিশ লিখেন পড়েন কুতূহলী ॥ ৪৫৯+৩ ॥

*rāmakṛṣṇa gobinda gopāla banamālī |*
*aharniśa likhena paṛena kutūhalī || 459+3 ||*

*Word for word:* rama krishna govinda gopala vanamali — "Rama, Krishna, Govinda, Gopala, Vanamali"; aharnisha — day and night; likhena padena — writes and reads; kutuhali — with delight

**459+3.** "Rama, Krishna, Govinda, Gopala, Vanamali" —
day and night He writes and reads them with delight.

এইমতে খেলা-লীলায় কথোদিন গেল ।
জগন্নাথ শচী দোঁহে যুকতি করিল ॥ ৪৬০ ॥

*eimate khelā-līlāẏa kathodina gela |*
*jagannātha śacī doṁhe yukati karila || 460 ||*

*Word for word:* eimate — thus; khela-lilaya — in play; kathodina gela — some days passed; jagannatha shachi donhe — Jagannatha and Shachi both; yukati karila — took counsel

**460.** Thus some days passed in play,
and Jagannatha and Shachi both took counsel together.

বিশ্বম্ভর-চূড়াকর্ম করি মনে মনে ।
ইষ্ট-কুটুম্ব যত আনিল তখনে ॥ ৪৬১ ॥

*biśbambhara-cūṛākarma kari mane mane |*
*iṣṭa-kuṭumba yata ānila takhane || 461 ||*

*Word for word:* vishvambhara-chudakarma — Vishvambhara's chudakarana; kari mane mane — resolving in their minds; ishta-kutumba yata — all friends and kinsfolk; anila takhane — invited then

**461.** Having resolved in their minds on Vishvambhara's chudakarana,[^14-5]
they then invited all their friends and kinsfolk.

চর্চিল সে শুভক্ষণ তিথি শুভদিনে ।
করিব ত চূড়াকর্ম দঢ়াইল মনে ॥ ৪৬২ ॥

*carcila se śubhakṣaṇa tithi śubhadine |*
*kariba ta cūṛākarma daṛhāila mane || 462 ||*

*Word for word:* charchila se — they considered; shubhakshana tithi shubhadine — the auspicious moment, tithi and auspicious day; kariba ta chudakarma — "we shall perform the chudakarana"; dadhaila mane — made firm in their minds

**462.** Having considered the auspicious moment, tithi and day,
they made their decision firm: "We shall perform the chudakarana."

নদীয়ানগরে ঘরে ঘরে আনন্দিত ।
ব্রাহ্মণ-সজ্জন আনি লোকে যে পূজিত ॥ ৪৬৩ ॥

*nadīẏānagare ghare ghare ānandita |*
*brāhmaṇa-sajjana āni loke ye pūjita || 463 ||*

*Word for word:* nadiya-nagare — in the town of Nadia; ghare ghare anandita — every house rejoiced; brahmana-sajjana ani — inviting brahmanas and worthy men; loke ye pujita — honoured by people

**463.** In the town of Nadia every house rejoiced;
they invited brahmanas and worthy men honoured by all.

ব্রাহ্মণেতে বেদ পড়ে গায়নে গায় গীত ।
করিল সে যজ্ঞবিধি যে ছিল উচিত ॥ ৪৬৪ ॥

*brāhmaṇete beda paṛe gāẏane gāẏa gīta |*
*karila se yajñabidhi ye chila ucita || 464 ||*

*Word for word:* brahmanete veda pade — the brahmanas recite the Vedas; gayane gaya gita — singers sing songs; karila se yajna-vidhi — performed the sacrificial rite; ye chhila uchita — as was proper

**464.** The brahmanas recite the Vedas, the singers sing songs;
the sacrificial rite was performed as was proper.

জয় জয় দেই যত কুলবধূজন ।
সভাকারে দিল গন্ধ গুবাক চন্দন ॥ ৪৬৫ ॥

*jaẏa jaẏa dei yata kulabadhūjana |*
*sabhākāre dila gandha gubāka candana || 465 ||*

*Word for word:* jaya jaya dei — raise "jaya, jaya"; yata kulavadhujana — all the respectable women; sabhakare dila — gave to everyone; gandha guvaka chandana — perfume, betel nut, sandal

**465.** All the respectable women raise the cry "Jaya, jaya!";
to everyone were given perfumes, betel nut and sandal.

নানা বাদ্যভাণ্ড বাজে আনন্দ অপার ।
শঙ্খ দুন্দুভি বাজে ভেউর কাহাল ॥ ৪৬৬ ॥

*nānā bādyabhāṇḍa bāje ānanda apāra |*
*śaṅkha dundubhi bāje bheura kāhāla || 466 ||*

*Word for word:* nana vadyabhanda baje — all kinds of instruments sound; ananda apara — boundless joy; shankha dundubhi baje — conches and dundubhis sound; bheura kahala — bheur and kahal horns

**466.** All kinds of instruments sound — the joy is boundless:
conches, dundubhis, bheur and kahal horns resound;

মৃদঙ্গ পটহ বাজে কাংস্য করতাল ।
সানাই-শবদ শুনি বড়ই রসাল ॥ ৪৬৭ ॥

*mṛdaṅga paṭaha bāje kāṃsya karatāla |*
*sānāi-śabada śuni baṛai rasāla || 467 ||*

*Word for word:* mridanga pataha baje — mridangas and pataha drums sound; kamsya karatala — bronze cymbals; sanai-shabada shuni — hearing the sound of the sanai; badai rasala — most sweet

**467.** mridangas, pataha drums and bronze cymbals resound;
the sound of the sanai is sweetness itself to hear.

চতুর্দিকে হরিধ্বনি ঝাঁপয়ে গগন ।
চূড়াকর্ম কর্ণবেধ করিল তখন ॥ ৪৬৮ ॥

*caturdike haridhbani jhāṁpaẏe gagana |*
*cūṛākarma karṇabedha karila takhana || 468 ||*

*Word for word:* chaturdike haridhvani — on all sides cries of "Hari"; jhanpaye gagana — cover the sky; chudakarma karnavedha — the chudakarana and ear-piercing; karila takhana — were performed then

**468.** On all sides cries of "Hari!" fill the sky;
then the chudakarana and the ear-piercing were performed.

আনন্দিত হৈল সব নদীয়ানগরী ।
বিশ্বম্ভর-মুখ দেখি আপনা পাশরি ॥ ৪৬৯ ॥

*ānandita haila saba nadīẏānagarī |*
*biśbambhara-mukha dekhi āpanā pāśari || 469 ||*

*Word for word:* anandita haila — rejoiced; saba nadiya-nagari — the whole town of Nadia; vishvambhara-mukha dekhi — seeing Vishvambhara's face; apana pasari — forgetting themselves

**469.** The whole town of Nadia rejoiced:
seeing Vishvambhara's face, people forget themselves.

হাটে বাটে ঘাটে যেই যথা তথা যায় ।
দোঁহে দোঁহা মেলি গোরাচাঁদের গুণ গায় ॥ ৪৭০ ॥

*hāṭe bāṭe ghāṭe yei yathā tathā yāẏa |*
*doṁhe doṁhā meli gorācāṁdera guṇa gāẏa || 470 ||*

*Word for word:* hate bate ghate — in the market, on the road, at the ghat; yei yatha tatha yaya — whoever goes anywhere; donhe donha meli — two meeting each other; gorachandera guna gaya — sing Gorachand's glories

**470.** In the market, on the road, at the ghat — wherever anyone goes,
when two meet, they sing of Gorachand's glories.

পর-পুত্র দেখি হেন করয়ে হৃদয় ।
শচী-জগন্নাথ-ভাগ্য এ হেন তনয় ॥ ৪৭১ ॥

*para-putra dekhi hena karaẏe hṛdaẏa |*
*śacī-jagannātha-bhāgya e hena tanaẏa || 471 ||*

*Word for word:* para-putra dekhi — seeing another's son; hena karaye hridaya — thus they feel in their hearts; shachi-jagannatha-bhagya — the fortune of Shachi and Jagannatha; e hena tanaya — such a son

**471.** Seeing another's son, this is what they feel in their hearts:
"It is Shachi and Jagannatha's good fortune — such a son!

নবদ্বীপের ভাগ্য আর সংসারের ভাগ্য ।
ও রূপ দেখিলে হয় নয়ানের শ্লাঘ্য ॥ ৪৭২ ॥

*nabadbīpera bhāgya āra saṃsārera bhāgya |*
*o rūpa dekhile haẏa naẏānera ślāghya || 472 ||*

*Word for word:* navadvipera bhagya — the fortune of Navadvipa; ara samsarera bhagya — and the fortune of the world; o rupa dekhile — on seeing that form; haya nayanera shlaghya — the eyes become praiseworthy

**472.** It is the good fortune of Navadvipa and the good fortune of the world;
whoever sees that form — his eyes are worthy of praise."

এ বোল শুনিয়া সর্বজনের উল্লাস ।
আনন্দ-হৃদয়ে কহে এ লোচনদাস ॥ ৪৭২+১ ॥

*e bola śuniẏā sarbajanera ullāsa |*
*ānanda-hṛdaẏe kahe e locanadāsa || 472+1 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola suniya — hearing these words; sarvajanera ullasa — the rejoicing of all people; ananda-hridaye — with bliss in the heart; kahe e lochanadasa — this Lochana Dasa tells

**472+1.** Hearing such words, everyone rejoices;
with bliss in his heart Lochana Dasa tells this.[^14-6]

আর একদিনে গঙ্গা-বালুকার তটে ।
বালক সহিতে ক্রীড়া করে গঙ্গাঘাটে ॥ ৪৭৩ ॥

*āra ekadine gaṅgā-bālukāra taṭe |*
*bālaka sahite krīṛā kare gaṅgāghāṭe || 473 ||*

*Word for word:* ara ekadine — on another day; ganga-valukara tate — on the sandy bank of the Ganga; balaka sahite krida kare — plays with the boys; gangaghate — at the Ganga ghat

**473.** On another day, on the sandy bank of the Ganga,
He is playing with the boys at the ghat.

বালুকায় পক্ষিগণ-পদ অনুসারি ।
গমন করিলা পক্ষি-পদচিহ্ন ধরি ॥ ৪৭৪ ॥

*bālukāẏa pakṣigaṇa-pada anusāri |*
*gamana karilā pakṣi-padacihna dhari || 474 ||*

*Word for word:* valukaya — on the sand; pakshigana-pada anusari — following the tracks of birds; gamana karila — walked; pakshi-padachihna dhari — keeping to the birds' footprints

**474.** Following the tracks of birds on the sand,
He walked, stepping exactly in the birds' footprints.

ইহা বলি মহাপ্রভু শ্রীগৌরচন্দ্র ।
বালক-সহিতে ক্রীড়া করিল নির্বন্ধ ॥ ৪৭৫ ॥

*ihā bali mahāprabhu śrīgauracandra |*
*bālaka-sahite krīṛā karila nirbandha || 475 ||*

*Word for word:* iha bali — saying this; mahaprabhu shri-gaurachandra — Mahaprabhu Sri Gaurachandra; balaka-sahite — with the boys; krida karila nirbandha — set a rule for the game

**475.** Saying this,[^14-7] Mahaprabhu Sri Gaurachandra
set a rule for the game with the boys:

এই পদচিহ্ন যেই বালক ডিঙ্গায় ।
সেই ততক্ষণে খেলা পরাজয় পায় ॥ ৪৭৬ ॥

*ei padacihna yei bālaka ḍiṅgāẏa |*
*sei tatakṣaṇe khelā parājaẏa pāẏa || 476 ||*

*Word for word:* ei padachihna — these footprints; yei balaka dingaya — whichever boy steps over; sei tatakshane — he at once; khela parajaya paya — loses the game

**476.** "Whichever boy steps beyond these footprints
loses the game at once.

যে জনা ত আগে ধাঞা পারে ধরিবার ।
সেই জন খেলা জিনে কান্ধে চড়ে তার ॥ ৪৭৭ ॥

*ye janā ta āge dhāñā pāre dharibāra |*
*sei jana khelā jine kāndhe caṛe tāra || 477 ||*

*Word for word:* ye jana ta age dhana — whoever, running ahead; pare dharibara — can catch; sei jana khela jine — he wins the game; kandhe chade tara — rides on the other's shoulders

**477.** Whoever can run ahead and catch [another]
wins the game and rides on his shoulders.

তার কান্ধে চড়ি তার পিঠে মারে ছাট ।
কান্ধে করি লঞা যায় সঙ্কেতের ঘাট ॥ ৪৭৮ ॥

*tāra kāndhe caṛi tāra piṭhe māre chāṭa |*
*kāndhe kari lañā yāẏa saṅketera ghāṭa || 478 ||*

*Word for word:* tara kandhe chadi — riding on his shoulders; tara pithe mare chhata — whips his back with a switch; kandhe kari lana yaya — [the other] carries him on his shoulders; sanketera ghata — to the agreed ghat

**478.** Riding on his shoulders, he whips his back with a switch,
and the other carries him on his shoulders to the agreed ghat."

ইহা বলি শিশুসনে বালুকায় ধায় ।
মহাপরিশ্রমে ঘর্ম নিকলিছে গায় ॥ ৪৭৯ ॥

*ihā bali śiśusane bālukāẏa dhāẏa |*
*mahāpariśrame gharma nikaliche gāẏa || 479 ||*

*Word for word:* iha bali — saying this; shishusane — with the children; valukaya dhaya — runs over the sand; mahaparishrame — from great exertion; gharma nikalichhe gaya — sweat streams from His body

**479.** Saying this, He runs over the sand with the children;
