from great exertion sweat streams down His body.

হেনকালে জগন্নাথ মিশ্র পুরন্দর ।
স্নান করিবারে গেলা জাহ্নবীর তীর ॥ ৪৮০ ॥

*henakāle jagannātha miśra purandara |*
*snāna karibāre gelā jāhnabīra tīra || 480 ||*

*Word for word:* henakale — at that time; jagannatha mishra purandara — Jagannatha Mishra Purandara; snana karibare — to bathe; gela jahnavira tira — went to the bank of the Jahnavi

**480.** At that time Jagannatha Mishra Purandara
went to the bank of the Jahnavi to bathe.

দেখিয়া পুত্রের খেলা ক্রোধ উপজিল ।
পরিশ্রম দেখি হিয়া পুড়িতে লাগিল ॥ ৪৮১ ॥

*dekhiẏā putrera khelā krodha upajila |*
*pariśrama dekhi hiẏā puṛite lāgila || 481 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhiya putrera khela — seeing his son's game; krodha upajila — anger arose; parishrama dekhi — seeing the exhaustion; hiya pudite lagila — his heart began to burn

**481.** Seeing his son's game, he grew angry;
seeing Him so worn out, the father's heart began to burn:

সুবর্ণ-পদ্ম যেন আতপেতে ম্লান ।
মধু নিকলয়ে যেন বদনের ঘাম ॥ ৪৮২ ॥

*subarṇa-padma yena ātapete mlāna |*
*madhu nikalaẏe yena badanera ghāma || 482 ||*

*Word for word:* suvarna-padma yena — as if a golden lotus; atapete mlana — wilted in the heat; madhu nikalaye yena — as if honey oozes; vadanera ghama — the sweat on the face

**482.** it was as if a golden lotus had wilted in the heat,
and the sweat on His face was like honey oozing out.

ডাকিতে ডাকিতে মিশ্র যায় পাছে পাছে ।
পিতা দেখি বিশ্বম্ভর পাইল বড় লাজে ॥ ৪৮৩ ॥

*ḍākite ḍākite miśra yāẏa pāche pāche |*
*pitā dekhi biśbambhara pāila baṛa lāje || 483 ||*

*Word for word:* dakite dakite — calling and calling; mishra yaya pachhe pachhe — Mishra follows behind; pita dekhi — seeing His father; vishvambhara paila bada laje — Vishvambhara was greatly abashed

**483.** Calling out again and again, Mishra follows Him;
seeing His father, Vishvambhara was greatly abashed.

লাজে মুখ নাহি তুলে অন্তরে তরাস ।
আপনি পণ্ডিত গেলা গোরাচাঁদের পাশ ॥ ৪৮৪ ॥

*lāje mukha nāhi tule antare tarāsa |*
*āpani paṇḍita gelā gorācāṁdera pāśa || 484 ||*

*Word for word:* laje mukha nahi tule — out of shame does not raise His face; antare tarasa — fear within; apani pandita — the pandit himself; gela gorachandera pasha — went to Gorachand

**484.** Out of shame He does not raise His face, fear in His heart;
the pandit himself went up to Gorachand,

করে ধরি লঞা আইলা আপন কুমার ।
সকল বালক গেলা ঘর আপনার ॥ ৪৮৫ ॥

*kare dhari lañā āilā āpana kumāra |*
*sakala bālaka gelā ghara āpanāra || 485 ||*

*Word for word:* kare dhari — taking by the hand; lana aila apana kumara — brought his son away; sakala balaka — all the boys; gela ghara apanara — went to their homes

**485.** took Him by the hand and led his son away;
all the boys went off to their homes.

জগন্নাথ গঙ্গাস্নান করি আইলা ঘর ।
ঘরে আসি গোরাচাঁদে গঞ্জিলা বিস্তর ॥ ৪৮৬ ॥

*jagannātha gaṅgāsnāna kari āilā ghara |*
*ghare āsi gorācāṁde gañjilā bistara || 486 ||*

*Word for word:* jagannatha gangasnana kari — Jagannatha, having bathed in the Ganga; aila ghara — came home; ghare asi — coming home; gorachande ganjila vistara — scolded Gorachand at length

**486.** Having bathed in the Ganga, Jagannatha came home
and, on coming home, scolded Gorachand at length:

পাঠ সাঠ গেল তোর অধমের হেন ।
কুবুদ্ধি হইয়া কেনে বুল অনুক্ষণ ॥ ৪৮৭ ॥

*pāṭha sāṭha gela tora adhamera hena |*
*kubuddhi haiẏā kene bula anukṣaṇa || 487 ||*

*Word for word:* patha-satha gela tora — all your studies are ruined; adhamera hena — like a good-for-nothing's; kubuddhi haiya — being foolish; kene bula anukshana — why do you roam about all the time

**487.** "All Your studies are ruined, as with some good-for-nothing!
Why, with Your foolish mind, do You roam about all the time?

ব্রাহ্মণকুমার হঞা নাহিক আচার ।
ইহার উচিত ফল দিতেছি তোমার ॥ ৪৮৮ ॥

*brāhmaṇakumāra hañā nāhika ācāra |*
*ihāra ucita phala ditechi tomāra || 488 ||*

*Word for word:* brahmana-kumara hana — being a brahmana's son; nahika achara — there is no proper conduct; ihara uchita phala — the fitting fruit of this; ditechhi tomara — I am giving you

**488.** You are a brahmana's son, yet You have no proper conduct —
I am giving You now the fruit You deserve."

ইহা বলি জগন্নাথ হাথে ছাট ধরি ।
তর্জন করিতে শচী তার হাথে ধরি ॥ ৪৮৯ ॥

*ihā bali jagannātha hāthe chāṭa dhari |*
*tarjana karite śacī tāra hāthe dhari || 489 ||*

*Word for word:* iha bali — saying this; jagannatha hathe chhata dhari — Jagannatha, taking a switch in hand; tarjana karite — as he threatened; shachi tara hathe dhari — Shachi caught his hand

**489.** Saying this, Jagannatha took a switch in his hand;
as he threatened, Shachi caught hold of his hand:

না মারিহ পুত্র মোর না খেলিবে আর ।
সর্বদা পড়িবে কাছে থাকিয়া তোমার ॥ ৪৯০ ॥

*nā māriha putra mora nā khelibe āra |*
*sarbadā paṛibe kāche thākiẏā tomāra || 490 ||*

*Word for word:* na mariha putra mora — do not beat my son; na khelibe ara — He will not play any more; sarvada padibe — He will always study; kachhe thakiya tomara — staying near you

**490.** "Do not beat my son! He will not play any more;
He will always study, sitting beside you."

বিশ্বম্ভর সান্ধাইলা জননীর কোলে ।
না খেলিব না খেলিব ধীরে ধীরে বোলে ॥ ৪৯১ ॥

*biśbambhara sāndhāilā jananīra kole |*
*nā kheliba nā kheliba dhīre dhīre bole || 491 ||*

*Word for word:* vishvambhara sandhaila — Vishvambhara slipped into; jananira kole — His mother's lap; na kheliba na kheliba — "I won't play, I won't play"; dhire dhire bole — says very softly

**491.** Vishvambhara hid in His mother's lap
and says very softly, "I won't play, I won't play."

জগন্নাথে পাছে করি পুত্র আগোরিয়া ।
না মারিহ পুত্র মোর মৈল ডরাইয়া ॥ ৪৯২ ॥

*jagannāthe pāche kari putra āgoriẏā |*
*nā māriha putra mora maila ḍarāiẏā || 492 ||*

*Word for word:* jagannathe pachhe kari — pushing Jagannatha back; putra agoriya — shielding the son; na mariha putra mora — do not beat my son; maila daraiya — He is dying of fright

**492.** Pushing Jagannatha back and shielding her son,
[Shachi says:] "Do not beat my son — He is dying of fright!"

ইহা বলি শচীদেবী পুত্র করি কোলে ।
বয়ান মুছিল অঙ্গ-বসন-অঞ্চলে ॥ ৪৯৩ ॥

*ihā bali śacīdebī putra kari kole |*
*baẏāna muchila aṅga-basana-añcale || 493 ||*

*Word for word:* iha bali — saying this; shachidevi putra kari kole — Shachi-devi, taking her son on her lap; bayana muchhila — wiped His face; anga-vasana-anchale — with the end of her garment

**493.** Saying this, Shachi-devi took her son on her lap
and wiped His face with the end of her sari.

না পড়ুক পুত্র মোর হউক মুরুখ ।
মুরুখ হইয়া শত বরিষ জীউক ॥ ৪৯৪ ॥

*nā paṛuka putra mora hauka murukha |*
*murukha haiẏā śata bariṣa jīuka || 494 ||*

*Word for word:* na paduka putra mora — let my son not study; hauka murukha — let Him be a dunce; murukha haiya — being a dunce; shata barisha jiuka — may He live a hundred years

**494.** "Let my son not study, let Him be a dunce —
as long as, a dunce, He lives a hundred years!"

শুনিঞা শচীর বাণী মিশ্র পুরন্দর ।
কহিতে লাগিল কিছু সক্রোধ উত্তর ॥ ৪৯৫ ॥

*śuniñā śacīra bāṇī miśra purandara |*
*kahite lāgila kichu sakrodha uttara || 495 ||*

*Word for word:* shuniya shachira vani — hearing Shachi's words; mishra purandara — Mishra Purandara; kahite lagila kichhu — began to speak; sakrodha uttara — an angry reply

**495.** Hearing Shachi's words, Mishra Purandara
began to answer her in anger:

মুরুখ হইলে পুত্র জীবেক কেমনে ।
কেমনে ব্রাহ্মণ ইহায় কন্যা দিবে দানে ॥ ৪৯৬ ॥

*murukha haile putra jībeka kemane |*
*kemane brāhmaṇa ihāẏa kanyā dibe dāne || 496 ||*

*Word for word:* murukha haile putra — if the son is a dunce; jiveka kemane — how will he live; kemane brahmana — how will a brahmana; ihaya kanya dibe dane — give him a daughter in marriage

**496.** "If our son is a dunce, how will He make a living?
What brahmana will give Him a daughter in marriage?"

তবে জগন্নাথ দেখে পুত্রের বয়ান ।
পিতা-পানে চাহে পুত্র তরাস-নয়ান ॥ ৪৯৭ ॥

*tabe jagannātha dekhe putrera baẏāna |*
*pitā-pāne cāhe putra tarāsa-naẏāna || 497 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe jagannatha dekhe — then Jagannatha sees; putrera bayana — his son's face; pita-pane chahe putra — the son looks at his father; tarasa-nayana — with frightened eyes

**497.** Then Jagannatha looked at his son's face:
the son looks at his father with frightened eyes.

অন্তরে পোড়য়ে মিশ্র বাহিরে কঠিন ।
ফেলিল হাথের ছাট প্রেম-পরবীণ ॥ ৪৯৮ ॥

*antare poṛaẏe miśra bāhire kaṭhina |*
*phelila hāthera chāṭa prema-parabīṇa || 498 ||*

*Word for word:* antare podaye mishra — Mishra burns within; bahire kathina — outwardly stern; phelila hathera chhata — threw away the switch from his hand; prema-paravina — overcome by love

**498.** Mishra's heart burns, though outwardly he is stern —
and, overcome by love, he threw away the switch.

সজল নয়ানে পুত্র লঞা কৈল কোলে ।
পুত্রেরে বুঝায় মিশ্র সুমধুর বোলে ॥ ৪৯৯ ॥

*sajala naẏāne putra lañā kaila kole |*
*putrere bujhāẏa miśra sumadhura bole || 499 ||*

*Word for word:* sajala nayane — with tearful eyes; putra lana kaila kole — took his son on his lap; putrere bujhaya mishra — Mishra persuades the son; sumadhura bole — with sweet words

**499.** With tears in his eyes he took his son on his lap
and gently persuades Him with sweet words:

পড়িলে শুনিলে বাপা লোকে বোলে ভাল ।
আমি পাটধড়া দিব কদলক আর ॥ ৫০০ ॥

*paṛile śunile bāpā loke bole bhāla |*
*āmi pāṭadhaṛā diba kadalaka āra || 500 ||*

*Word for word:* padile shunile — if one studies and listens; bapa — my boy; loke bole bhala — people speak well; ami patadhada diba — I will give a silk dhoti; kadalaka ara — and bananas

**500.** "Of one who studies and listens to his lessons, my boy, people speak well;
and I will give You a silk dhoti and bananas."

এইমতে আনন্দে সানন্দে দিন গেলা ।
সন্ধ্যা সমাপিয়া মিশ্র শয়ন করিলা ॥ ৫০১ ॥

*eimate ānande sānande dina gelā |*
*sandhyā samāpiẏā miśra śaẏana karilā || 501 ||*

*Word for word:* eimate — thus; anande sanande — in joy and gladness; dina gela — the day passed; sandhya samapiya — having finished the evening rites; mishra shayana karila — Mishra went to bed

**501.** Thus in joy and gladness the day went by;
having finished his evening rites, Mishra went to bed.

নিদ্রাগত হৈল রাত্রি তৃতীয় প্রহর ।
স্বপন দেখিয়া মিশ্র হইলা ফাঁফর ॥ ৫০২ ॥

*nidrāgata haila rātri tṛtīẏa prahara |*
*sbapana dekhiẏā miśra hailā phāṁphara || 502 ||*

*Word for word:* nidragata haila — fell asleep; ratri tritiya prahara — in the third watch of the night; svapana dekhiya — seeing a dream; mishra haila phanphara — Mishra became perturbed

**502.** He fell asleep, and in the third watch of the night
Mishra had a dream and was thrown into turmoil.

রাত্রি সুপ্রভাতে উঠি ডাকিল সভারে ।
স্বপ্ন এক দেখিয়াছি কহি সভাকারে ॥ ৫০৩ ॥

*rātri suprabhāte uṭhi ḍākila sabhāre |*
*sbapna eka dekhiẏāchi kahi sabhākāre || 503 ||*

*Word for word:* ratri suprabhate uthi — rising at daybreak; dakila sabhare — called everyone; svapna eka dekhiyachhi — I have seen a dream; kahi sabhakare — I tell everyone

**503.** Rising at daybreak, he called everyone:
"I have seen a dream — I will tell you all.

দেখিল ত এক দ্বিজ পুরুষ বিশাল ।
দিনকর-কিরণ বরণ উজিয়ার ॥ ৫০৪ ॥

*dekhila ta eka dbija puruṣa biśāla |*
*dinakara-kiraṇa baraṇa ujiẏāra || 504 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhila ta — I saw; eka dvija purusha vishala — a brahmana of majestic stature; dinakara-kirana barana — coloured like the sun's rays; ujiyara — radiant

**504.** I saw a brahmana of majestic stature,
radiant like the rays of the sun.

রত্ন-অলঙ্কারে সে ভূষিত দিব্যদেহ ।
নিরখি না পারি ঝলমল করে গেহ ॥ ৫০৫ ॥

*ratna-alaṅkāre se bhūṣita dibyadeha |*
*nirakhi nā pāri jhalamala kare geha || 505 ||*

*Word for word:* ratna-alankare — with jewelled ornaments; se bhushita divyadeha — his divine body adorned; nirakhi na pari — I cannot look; jhalamala kare geha — the house blazes

**505.** His divine body was adorned with jewels;
I could not look at him — the whole house was ablaze.

বলিল আমারে মেঘগম্ভীর-বচনে ।
বিশ্বম্ভর নিজপুত্র করি মান কেনে ॥ ৫০৬ ॥

*balila āmāre meghagambhīra-bacane |*
*biśbambhara nijaputra kari māna kene || 506 ||*

*Word for word:* balila amare — he said to me; meghagambhira-vachane — in a voice deep as thunder; vishvambhara nijaputra — Vishvambhara as your own son; kari mana kene — why do you regard

**506.** In a voice deep as thunder he said to me:
'Why do you regard Vishvambhara as your son?

আমি দেব নারায়ণ ইহা নাহি জান ।
কেবল আপন সুত করি কেনে মান ॥ ৫০৭ ॥

*āmi deba nārāẏaṇa ihā nāhi jāna |*
*kebala āpana suta kari kene māna || 507 ||*

*Word for word:* ami deva narayana — I am God, Narayana; iha nahi jana — this you do not know; kevala apana suta — merely as your son; kari kene mana — why do you regard

**507.** I am God, Narayana — and you do not know it;
why do you regard [Me] merely as your son?[^14-8]

পশু না জানয়ে স্পর্শমণির পরশ ।
পুত্রজ্ঞানে জান মোরে এ বড় সহজ ॥ ৫০৮ ॥

*paśu nā jānaẏe sparśamaṇira paraśa |*
*putrajñāne jāna more e baṛa sahaja || 508 ||*

*Word for word:* pashu na janaye — a beast does not know; sparshamanira parasha — the touch of the philosopher's stone; putrajnane jana more — you know Me as your son; e bada sahaja — this is only natural

**508.** A beast does not know the touch of the philosopher's stone;
you take Me for your son — but for you that is only natural.[^14-9]

সর্বশাস্ত্র জানি আমি সর্বদেব-গুরু ।
আমা পড়াইবারে কেনে হাথে ছাট ধরু ॥ ৫০৯ ॥

*sarbaśāstra jāni āmi sarbadeba-guru |*
*āmā paṛāibāre kene hāthe chāṭa dharu || 509 ||*

*Word for word:* sarvashastra jani ami — I know all the shastras; sarvadeva-guru — the Guru of all the gods; ama padaibare — to teach Me; kene hathe chhata dharu — why do you take a switch in hand

**509.** I know all the shastras, I am the Guru of all the gods;
why then do you take a switch in hand to teach Me?'

এহেন স্বপন আজি দেখিয়াছি আমি ।
সেই অবধি মোর হিয়া করয়ে কি জানি ॥ ৫১০ ॥

*ehena sbapana āji dekhiẏāchi āmi |*
*sei abadhi mora hiẏā karaẏe ki jāni || 510 ||*

*Word for word:* ehena svapana aji — such a dream today; dekhiyachhi ami — I have seen; sei avadhi — since then; mora hiya karaye ki jani — my heart does I know not what

**510.** Such a dream I have seen today,
and ever since, I do not know what is happening in my heart."

শচী অতি হৃষ্টমন আর সর্বজন ।
সভে নিরখয়ে বিশ্বম্ভরের বদন ॥ ৫১১ ॥

*śacī ati hṛṣṭamana āra sarbajana |*
*sabhe nirakhaẏe biśbambharera badana || 511 ||*

*Word for word:* shachi ati hrishtamana — Shachi was overjoyed; ara sarvajana — and all the people; sabhe nirakhaye — all gaze; vishvambharera vadana — at Vishvambhara's face

**511.** Shachi was overjoyed, and so were all the people;
all gaze at Vishvambhara's face.

শচী-জগন্নাথ কোলে করে হিয়া ভরি ।
আমার তনয় বিশ্বম্ভর গৌরহরি ॥ ৫১২ ॥

*śacī-jagannātha kole kare hiẏā bhari |*
*āmāra tanaẏa biśbambhara gaurahari || 512 ||*

*Word for word:* shachi-jagannatha kole kare — Shachi and Jagannatha embrace; hiya bhari — to their heart's content; amara tanaya — our son; vishvambhara gaurahari — Vishvambhara Gaurahari

**512.** Shachi and Jagannatha embrace Him, pressing Him to their hearts:
"Our son is Vishvambhara Gaurahari!

অনন্ত মহিমা যার বেদে নাহি জানে ।
শিব-সনকাদি যারে নাহি পায় ধেয়ানে ॥ ৫১৩ ॥

*ananta mahimā yāra bede nāhi jāne |*
*śiba-sanakādi yāre nāhi pāẏa dheẏāne || 513 ||*

*Word for word:* ananta mahima yara — whose boundless glory; vede nahi jane — the Vedas do not know; shiva-sanakadi — Shiva, Sanaka and the others; yare nahi paya dheyane — whom they do not attain in meditation

**513.** He whose boundless glory the Vedas do not know,
whom Shiva, Sanaka and the others do not attain in meditation —

হেন মহা-মহত্ত্ব মহিমা জানে কেবা ।
মোর পুত্র হইয়া জনমে গৌর দেবা ॥ ৫১৪ ॥

*hena mahā-mahattba mahimā jāne kebā |*
*mora putra haiẏā janame gaura debā || 514 ||*

*Word for word:* hena maha-mahattva — of such a Greatest One; mahima jane keba — who knows the greatness; mora putra haiya — becoming my son; janame gaura deva — Lord Gaura (Gaura-deva) is born

**514.** who can know the greatness of this Greatest One?
Lord Gaura has been born as my son!"

বলিতে বলিতে স্নেহ বাৎসল্য হইল ।
ঐশ্বর্য যতেক ভাব সব দূরে গেল ॥ ৫১৫ ॥

*balite balite sneha bātsalya haila |*
*aiśbarya yateka bhāba saba dūre gela || 515 ||*

*Word for word:* balite balite — even as they spoke; sneha vatsalya haila — tenderness, parental love arose; aishvarya yateka bhava — every feeling of majesty; saba dure gela — all went far away

**515.** But even as they spoke, tender parental love (vatsalya) awoke in them,
and every feeling of His majesty withdrew.[^14-10]

স্বপন শুনিয়া সর্বজনের উল্লাস ।
গোরাগুণ গায় সুখে এ লোচনদাস ॥ ৫১৬ ॥

*sbapana śuniẏā sarbajanera ullāsa |*
*gorāguṇa gāẏa sukhe e locanadāsa || 516 ||*

*Word for word:* svapana shuniya — hearing of the dream; sarvajanera ullasa — all people rejoice; goraguna gaya sukhe — joyfully sings Gora's glories; e lochanadasa — this Lochana Dasa

**516.** Hearing of the dream, all the people rejoice —
the glories of Gora are joyfully sung by this Lochana Dasa.

[^14-1]: "Hate khadi", "chalk in the hand": the rite of beginning to learn letters (vidyarambha), when the child first traces letters with chalk.
[^14-2]: Here in the OCR of the summary the lines are overlaid by text from a neighbouring page (vv. 416–418), and part of the sentence is lost; in substance it concerns the games with the boys, the father's anger (vv. 473–500) and Jagannatha's dream (vv. 501–516).
[^14-3]: The name or word before "began His studies" is unreadable in the OCR.
[^14-4]: Vv. 459+1 – 459+3 are found only in the 1983 edition (absent from Bhaktisiddhanta's edition); the 1903 edition does not have them. "Ka, kha, ga, gha" are the first letters of the Bengali alphabet; "with all their signs" is literally "all the phalas", the signs for conjunct consonants.
[^14-5]: Chudakarana is the samskara of the first cutting of the hair, leaving a lock (shikha) on the crown.
[^14-6]: V. 472+1 is found only in the 1983 edition (absent from Bhaktisiddhanta's edition); the 1903 edition does not have it, but gives in a footnote, from one manuscript, a different signature: "Meditating on the lotus feet of Narahari, Lochana joyfully sings of Chaitanya."
[^14-7]: That is, announcing this game; the 1983 edition has "thus".
[^14-8]: In the dream the brahmana speaks in the person of the Lord Himself. In Murari (1.07.14–16) the brahmana speaks to Jagannatha about his son, and Mishra replies that even if his son is Narayana, it is a father's duty to correct Him.
[^14-9]: So A ("e bada sahaja"). The 1983 edition reads "e bada sahasa": "this is great audacity".
[^14-10]: Cf. the Bhagavata (10.8.43–45): Yashoda, having seen the universe in Krishna's mouth, is at once covered again by His yogamaya and sees in Him only her son. The parental love (vatsalya) of Shachi and Jagannatha does not admit the thought of the Lord's majesty, and He Himself by His own will hides it for the sake of their love.

---

# Adi-khanda, part 7 (portion 15)

*Pauganda-lila (continued): Vishvambhara's upanayana; during the rite He is overcome by the ecstasy of prema, and the astonished pandits reason about the avataras for a special purpose and the yuga-avataras, about Krishna in the Dvapara and Gaura in the Kali, about Radha and the dharma of service, and conclude that Vishvambhara is the Lord Himself*

*Raga varadi; disha: "Gorachand is my life!"*

এইমতে আনন্দে সানন্দে দিন যায় ।
নদীয়ানগর সুখসাগরে ভাসায় ॥ ৫১৭ ॥

*eimate ānande sānande dina yāẏa |*
*nadīẏānagara sukhasāgare bhāsāẏa || 517 ||*

*Word for word:* eimate — thus; anande sanande — in joy and gladness; dina yaya — the days pass; nadiya-nagara — the town of Nadia; sukhasagare bhasaya — floats in an ocean of happiness

**517.** Thus in joy and gladness the days pass;
the town of Nadia floats in an ocean of happiness.

তিলেকের যত সুখ কে কহিতে পারে ।
শচী-জগন্নাথ-ভাগ্য ব্রহ্মাণ্ডে না ধরে ॥ ৫১৮ ॥

*tilekera yata sukha ke kahite pāre |*
*śacī-jagannātha-bhāgya brahmāṇḍe nā dhare || 518 ||*

*Word for word:* tilekera yata sukha — the happiness of a moment; ke kahite pare — who can tell; shachi-jagannatha-bhagya — the fortune of Shachi and Jagannatha; brahmande na dhare — the universe cannot contain

**518.** Who can tell the happiness of a single moment!
The good fortune of Shachi and Jagannatha cannot be contained in the universe.

একদিন বয়স্যের সঙ্গে আচম্বিত ।
জগন্নাথ দেখিল তনয় সুচরিত ॥ ৫১৯ ॥

*ekadina baẏasyera saṅge ācambita |*
*jagannātha dekhila tanaẏa sucarita || 519 ||*

*Word for word:* ekadina — one day; vayasyera sange — among companions; achambita — suddenly; jagannatha dekhila — Jagannatha saw; tanaya sucharita — his well-mannered son

**519.** One day Jagannatha suddenly saw
his well-mannered son among His companions.

নবম বরিষ পুত্র যোগ্য সুসময় ।
উপবীত দিব বলি চিন্তিল হৃদয় ॥ ৫২০ ॥

*nabama bariṣa putra yogya susamaẏa |*
*upabīta diba bali cintila hṛdaẏa || 520 ||*

*Word for word:* navama barisha putra — the son in his ninth year; yogya susamaya — a fitting, auspicious time; upavita diba bali — "I shall give the sacred thread"; chintila hridaya — he thought in his heart

**520.** The son is in His ninth year — a fitting and auspicious time;
"I shall give Him the sacred thread," he thought in his heart.

ঘরে আসি শচী-সনে যুকতি করিল ।
দৈবজ্ঞ আনিঞা শুভদিন যে রচিল ॥ ৫২১ ॥

*ghare āsi śacī-sane yukati karila |*
*daibajña āniñā śubhadina ye racila || 521 ||*

*Word for word:* ghare asi — coming home; shachi-sane yukati karila — took counsel with Shachi; daivajna anina — calling an astrologer; shubhadina ye rachila — fixed an auspicious day

**521.** Coming home, he took counsel with Shachi,
called an astrologer and fixed an auspicious day.

ইষ্ট-কুটুম্ব আনি নিবেদিল কথা ।
আজ্ঞা কর দিব বিশ্বম্ভরের পইতা ॥ ৫২২ ॥

*iṣṭa-kuṭumba āni nibedila kathā |*
*ājñā kara diba biśbambharera paitā || 522 ||*

*Word for word:* ishta-kutumba ani — gathering friends and kinsfolk; nivedila katha — announced; ajna kara — give leave; diba vishvambharera paita — I shall invest Vishvambhara with the sacred thread

**522.** Gathering friends and kinsfolk, he announced to them:
"Give me leave to invest Vishvambhara with the sacred thread."

মিশ্র আচার্য আনি খ্যাত যে পণ্ডিত ।
যজ্ঞকর্ম জানে যেই জানয়ে বেদরীত ॥ ৫২৩ ॥

*miśra ācārya āni khyāta ye paṇḍita |*
*yajñakarma jāne yei jānaẏe bedarīta || 523 ||*

*Word for word:* mishra acharya ani — Mishra, engaging as acharya; khyata ye pandita — a famous pandit; yajna-karma jane yei — who knows the rites of sacrifice; janaye veda-rita — knows the Vedic ordinances

**523.** Mishra engaged as acharya a famous pandit
who knows the rites of sacrifice and knows the Vedic ordinances.

গুবাক চন্দন মালা ব্রাহ্মণেরে দিল ।
শত শত কুলবধূ সিন্দুর পরিল ॥ ৫২৪ ॥

*gubāka candana mālā brāhmaṇere dila |*
*śata śata kulabadhū sindura parila || 524 ||*

*Word for word:* guvaka chandana mala — betel nuts, sandal, garlands; brahmanere dila — gave to the brahmanas; shata shata kulavadhu — hundreds of respectable women; sindura parila — put on sindura

**524.** To the brahmanas were given betel nuts, sandal and garlands;
hundreds of respectable women put on sindura.

খদিকা কদলক আর তৈল হরিদ্রা ।
প্রত্যেকে সভারে দিল শচী সুচরিতা ॥ ৫২৫ ॥

*khadikā kadalaka āra taila haridrā |*
*pratyeke sabhāre dila śacī sucaritā || 525 ||*

*Word for word:* khadika — puffed rice (khai); kadalaka — bananas; ara taila haridra — and oil and turmeric; pratyeke sabhare dila — gave to each and every one; shachi sucharita — virtuous Shachi

**525.** Puffed rice, bananas, oil and turmeric
the virtuous Shachi gave to each and every one.

শঙ্খ-শবদ হুলাহুলি জয় জয় ।
গন্ধ-অধিবাস করে গোধূলি সময় ॥ ৫২৬ ॥

*śaṅkha-śabada hulāhuli jaẏa jaẏa |*
*gandha-adhibāsa kare godhūli samaẏa || 526 ||*

*Word for word:* shankha-shabada — the sound of conches; hulahuli jaya jaya — women's ululation, "jaya, jaya"; gandha-adhivasa kare — they perform the anointing with fragrance (adhivasa); godhuli samaya — at the hour of dusk

**526.** Conches sound, the women's cries of "Jaya, jaya!" ring out;
at the hour of dusk they perform the rite of anointing with fragrances (adhivasa).[^15-1]

ব্রাহ্মণে বেদ পড়ে ভাটে রায়বার ।
আশীর্বাদ দিঞা কৈল যে বিধি আচার ॥ ৫২৭ ॥

*brāhmaṇe beda paṛe bhāṭe rāẏabāra |*
*āśīrbāda diñā kaila ye bidhi ācāra || 527 ||*

*Word for word:* brahmane veda pade — the brahmanas recite the Vedas; bhate rayabara — the bards their eulogies; ashirvada dina — giving blessings; kaila ye vidhi achara — did according to rule and custom

**527.** The brahmanas recite the Vedas, the bhat bards their eulogies;
giving blessings, they did all according to rule and custom.

রাত্রি সুপ্রভাতে উঠি মিশ্র পুরন্দর ।
নান্দীমুখ শ্রাদ্ধবিধি করিল সুন্দর ॥ ৫২৮ ॥

*rātri suprabhāte uṭhi miśra purandara |*
*nāndīmukha śrāddhabidhi karila sundara || 528 ||*

*Word for word:* ratri suprabhate uthi — rising at daybreak; mishra purandara — Mishra Purandara; nandimukha shraddha-vidhi — the rite of nandimukha-shraddha; karila sundara — performed beautifully

**528.** Rising at daybreak, Mishra Purandara
performed the nandimukha-shraddha beautifully.[^15-2]

ব্রাহ্মণ পূজিল পাদ্য আচমন দিয়া ।
যজ্ঞকর্ম আরম্ভিল সময় বুঝিয়া ॥ ৫২৯ ॥

*brāhmaṇa pūjila pādya ācamana diẏā |*
*yajñakarma ārambhila samaẏa bujhiẏā || 529 ||*

*Word for word:* brahmana pujila — honoured the brahmanas; padya achamana diya — offering water for the feet and for sipping; yajna-karma arambhila — began the sacrificial rite; samaya bujhiya — judging the time

**529.** Having honoured the brahmanas with water for the feet and for sipping,
judging the time had come, he began the sacrificial rite.

এথা শচীদেবী যত আইহ সুইহ লঞা ।
পুত্র-মহোৎসবে বুলে কৌতুক করিয়া ॥ ৫৩০ ॥

*ethā śacīdebī yata āiha suiha lañā |*
*putra-mahotsabe bule kautuka kariẏā || 530 ||*

*Word for word:* etha — here, meanwhile; shachidevi — Shachi-devi; yata aiha suiha lana — with all the married women; putra-mahotsave — at her son's festival; bule kautuka kariya — goes about making merry

**530.** Here, meanwhile, Shachi-devi with all the married women
goes about making merry at her son's festival.

নাগরীর গণ যত গৌরাঙ্গ বেঢ়িল ।
শ্রীঅঙ্গ মাজনা করিবার মন কৈল ॥ ৫৩০+১ ॥

*nāgarīra gaṇa yata gaurāṅga beṛhila |*
*śrīaṅga mājanā karibāra mana kaila || 530+1 ||*

*Word for word:* nagarira gana yata — all the nagaris, as many as there were; gauranga bedhila — surrounded Gauranga; sri-anga majana karibara — to anoint (rub) the holy body; mana kaila — wished

**530+1.** All the nagaris, as many as there were, surrounded Gauranga[^15-3]
and wished to anoint His holy body.

তৈল হরিদ্রা বিশ্বম্ভর-অঙ্গে দিল ।
গন্ধ-আমলকী দিয়া মস্তক মাজিল ॥ ৫৩১ ॥

*taila haridrā biśbambhara-aṅge dila |*
*gandha-āmalakī diẏā mastaka mājila || 531 ||*

*Word for word:* taila haridra — oil and turmeric; vishvambhara-ange dila — applied to Vishvambhara's body; gandha-amalaki diya — with fragrant amalaki; mastaka majila — washed His head

**531.** They anointed Vishvambhara's body with oil and turmeric,
washed His head with fragrant amalaki

অভিষেক করাইলা সুরনদী-জলে ।
আপনা পাশরে শচী আনন্দ-হিল্লোলে ॥ ৫৩২ ॥

*abhiṣeka karāilā suranadī-jale |*
*āpanā pāśare śacī ānanda-hillole || 532 ||*

*Word for word:* abhisheka karaila — bathed Him ceremonially; suranadi-jale — with water of the heavenly river; apana pasare shachi — Shachi forgets herself; ananda-hillole — in waves of joy

**532.** and bathed Him with water of the heavenly river;
Shachi forgets herself in waves of joy.

শঙ্খ দুন্দুভি বাজে ভেউর কাহাল ।
মৃদঙ্গ পটহ বাজে কাংস্য করতাল ॥ ৫৩৩ ॥

*śaṅkha dundubhi bāje bheura kāhāla |*
*mṛdaṅga paṭaha bāje kāṃsya karatāla || 533 ||*

*Word for word:* shankha dundubhi baje — conches and dundubhis sound; bheura kahala — bheur and kahal horns; mridanga pataha baje — mridangas and patahas sound; kamsya karatala — bronze cymbals

**533.** Conches, dundubhis, bheur and kahal horns resound;
mridangas, patahas and bronze cymbals resound.

ঢাকের দুড়দুড়ি শুনি যোজনেক পথে ।
শুনিঞা জুড়ায় হিয়া সাহিনী-শবদে ॥ ৫৩৪ ॥

*ḍhākera duṛaduṛi śuni yojaneka pathe |*
*śuniñā juṛāẏa hiẏā sāhinī-śabade || 534 ||*

*Word for word:* dhakera duduri — the rumble of the dhak drums; shuni yojaneka pathe — is heard a yojana away; shuniya juraya hiya — hearing, the heart is soothed; sahini-shabade — by the sound of the sahini (sanai)

**534.** The rumble of the dhak drums is heard a yojana away;
at the sound of the sahini the heart is gladdened.

বীণা বেণু কপিলাস বংশীর নিসান ।
রবাব উপাঙ্গ পাখোয়াজ একতান ॥ ৫৩৫ ॥

*bīṇā beṇu kapilāsa baṃśīra nisāna |*
*rabāba upāṅga pākhoẏāja ekatāna || 535 ||*

*Word for word:* vina venu — vinas, flutes; kapilasa — kapilasa horns; vamshira nisana — pipes, nisan drums; rababa upanga pakhoyaja — rababs, upangas, pakhoyajes; ekatana — in unison

**535.** Vinas, flutes, kapilasa horns, pipes, nisan drums,
rababs, upangas and pakhoyajes play in unison.

নর্তক নাচয়ে গীত গাএ ত গায়ন ।
শুভক্ষণ করি কৈল মস্তকমুণ্ডন ॥ ৫৩৬ ॥

*nartaka nācaẏe gīta gāe ta gāẏana |*
*śubhakṣaṇa kari kaila mastakamuṇḍana || 536 ||*

*Word for word:* nartaka nachaye — dancers dance; gita gae ta gayana — singers sing songs; shubhakshana kari — at an auspicious moment; kaila mastaka-mundana — shaved His head

**536.** Dancers dance, singers sing songs;
at an auspicious moment His head was shaved.

প্রতি অঙ্গে অলঙ্কার ভূষণ করিল ।
গন্ধ মাল্য চন্দনেতে সুবেশ রচিল ॥ ৫৩৭ ॥

*prati aṅge alaṅkāra bhūṣaṇa karila |*
*gandha mālya candanete subeśa racila || 537 ||*

*Word for word:* prati ange — on every limb; alankara bhushana karila — put ornaments; gandha malya chandanete — with perfumes, garlands and sandal; suvesha rachila — dressed Him beautifully

**537.** Every limb of His was adorned with ornaments,
and He was dressed in perfumes, garlands and sandal.

যজ্ঞস্থানে লঞা আইলা শচীর নন্দনে ।
যথা বেদধ্বনি করে ব্রাহ্মণের গণে ॥ ৫৩৮ ॥

*yajñasthāne lañā āilā śacīra nandane |*
*yathā bedadhbani kare brāhmaṇera gaṇe || 538 ||*

*Word for word:* yajnasthane lana aila — brought to the place of sacrifice; shachira nandane — Shachi's son; yatha vedadhvani kare — where chant the Vedas; brahmanera gane — the host of brahmanas

**538.** Shachi's son was brought to the place of sacrifice,
where the host of brahmanas chant the Vedas.

রক্তবস্ত্র উপবীত পরাইল অঙ্গে ।
রূপ দেখি ভুলি গেলা আপনে অনঙ্গে ॥ ৫৩৯ ॥

*raktabastra upabīta parāila aṅge |*
*rūpa dekhi bhuli gelā āpane anaṅge || 539 ||*

*Word for word:* raktavastra upavita — red garments and the sacred thread; paraila ange — put on His body; rupa dekhi — seeing the beauty; bhuli gela apane anange — Ananga himself was entranced

**539.** They clothed Him in red garments and the sacred thread;
seeing His beauty, Ananga (Kamadeva) himself was entranced.

বিশ্বম্ভর-কর্ণে মন্ত্র কহে তার বাপ ।
দণ্ড করে দেখি ডরে ডরাইল পাপ ॥ ৫৪০ ॥

*biśbambhara-karṇe mantra kahe tāra bāpa |*
*daṇḍa kare dekhi ḍare ḍarāila pāpa || 540 ||*

*Word for word:* vishvambhara-karne — into Vishvambhara's ear; mantra kahe tara bapa — His father speaks the mantra; danda kare dekhi — seeing the staff in His hand; dare daraila papa — sin trembled with fear

**540.** His father speaks the mantra into Vishvambhara's ear;
seeing the staff in His hand, sin itself trembled with fear.

ভিক্ষা মাগয়ে প্রভু আশ্রম-আচার ।
সন্ন্যাস-আশ্রম সর্ব-আশ্রমের সার ॥ ৫৪১ ॥

*bhikṣā māgaẏe prabhu āśrama-ācāra |*
*sannyāsa-āśrama sarba-āśramera sāra || 541 ||*

*Word for word:* bhiksha magaye prabhu — the Lord begs alms; ashrama-achara — the custom of the ashrama; sannyasa-ashrama — the sannyasa ashrama; sarva-ashramera sara — the essence of all ashramas

**541.** The Lord begs alms — such is the custom of this ashrama;
the sannyasa ashrama is the essence of all ashramas.

যুগধর্মে সন্ন্যাস করিব মনে ছিল ।
মুণ্ডনের কালে সেই মনেতে পড়িল ॥ ৫৪২ ॥

*yugadharme sannyāsa kariba mane chila |*
*muṇḍanera kāle sei manete paṛila || 542 ||*

*Word for word:* yugadharme — for the dharma of the age; sannyasa kariba — I shall take sannyasa; mane chhila — was in His mind; mundanera kale — at the time of the shaving; sei manete padila — that came to His mind

**542.** It was in His mind: "For the dharma of the age I shall take sannyasa,"
and at the time His head was shaved, He remembered it.[^15-4]

এমন হইব বলি হইল আবেশ ।
কলি-সর্বজনে ভ্রমি ঘুচাইব ক্লেশ ॥ ৫৪৩ ॥

*emana haiba bali haila ābeśa |*
*kali-sarbajane bhrami ghucāiba kleśa || 543 ||*

*Word for word:* emana haiba bali — saying "so I shall be"; haila avesha — ecstasy arose; kali-sarvajane — of all the people of Kali; bhrami — wandering; ghuchaiba klesha — I shall dispel the sufferings

**543.** "So I shall do," and ecstasy seized Him:
"Wandering, I shall dispel the sufferings of all the people of Kali!"

পুলকিত সর্ব অঙ্গ আপাদ-মস্তক ।
কদম্ব-কেশর জিনি একটি পুলক ॥ ৫৪৪ ॥

*pulakita sarba aṅga āpāda-mastaka |*
*kadamba-keśara jini ekaṭi pulaka || 544 ||*

*Word for word:* pulakita sarva anga — the whole body thrills; apada-mastaka — from foot to head; kadamba-keshara jini — surpassing the kadamba filament; ekati pulaka — each single bristling hair

**544.** His whole body thrills from head to foot;
each single bristling hair surpasses the filaments of the kadamba.

করুণ অরুণ দুই দীঘল লোচন ।
বাল-দিনকর যেন অঙ্গের কিরণ ॥ ৫৪৫ ॥

*karuṇa aruṇa dui dīghala locana |*
*bāla-dinakara yena aṅgera kiraṇa || 545 ||*

*Word for word:* karuna aruna — compassionate, reddish; dui dighala lochana — two long eyes; bala-dinakara yena — like the rising sun; angera kirana — the radiance of the body

**545.** His two long eyes are compassionate and reddish;
the radiance of His body is like the rising sun.

প্রেমারম্ভে মহাদম্ভ হুঙ্কার গর্জন ।
চমক লাগিল দেখি সকল ব্রাহ্মণ ॥ ৫৪৬ ॥

*premārambhe mahādambha huṅkāra garjana |*
*camaka lāgila dekhi sakala brāhmaṇa || 546 ||*

*Word for word:* premarambhe — at the onset of prema; mahadambha — great and proud; hunkara garjana — roaring and thundering; chamaka lagila — were astounded; dekhi sakala brahmana — seeing, all the brahmanas

**546.** At the onset of prema — a great, proud, thundering roar;
seeing this, all the brahmanas were astounded.

সুদর্শন-আদি যত পণ্ডিত প্রধান ।
একত্র হইয়া সভে করে অনুমান ॥ ৫৪৭ ॥

*sudarśana-ādi yata paṇḍita pradhāna |*
*ekatra haiẏā sabhe kare anumāna || 547 ||*

*Word for word:* sudarshana-adi — Sudarshana and others; yata pandita pradhana — the leading pandits; ekatra haiya — gathering together; sabhe kare anumana — all reason

**547.** Sudarshana[^15-5] and the other leading pandits,
gathering together, reason among themselves:

সকল পণ্ডিত মিলি করয়ে বিচার ।
মানুষ না হয় এই শচীর কুমার ॥ ৫৪৮ ॥

*sakala paṇḍita mili karaẏe bicāra |*
*mānuṣa nā haẏa ei śacīra kumāra || 548 ||*

*Word for word:* sakala pandita mili — all the pandits meeting; karaye vichara — deliberate; manusha na haya — is not a human being; ei shachira kumara — this son of Shachi

**548.** all the pandits, meeting together, deliberate:
"This son of Shachi is not a human being.

কোন দেবতার তেজ জানিল নিশ্চয় ।
এ তেজ গোবিন্দ বিনু আর কারু নয় ॥ ৫৪৯ ॥

*kona debatāra teja jānila niścaẏa |*
*e teja gobinda binu āra kāru naẏa || 549 ||*

*Word for word:* kona devatara teja — the effulgence of some god; janila nishchaya — they understood for certain; e teja — this effulgence; govinda vinu — apart from Govinda; ara karu naya — belongs to no one else

**549.** This is the effulgence of some god," they understood with certainty;
"such effulgence can belong to none but Govinda.

আমরা কি জানি প্রভুর চরিত্র আচার ।
অনুমান করি সভে বুদ্ধির বিচার ॥ ৫৫০ ॥

*āmarā ki jāni prabhura caritra ācāra |*
*anumāna kari sabhe buddhira bicāra || 550 ||*

*Word for word:* amara ki jani — what do we know; prabhura charitra achara — of the Lord's deeds and conduct; anumana kari sabhe — we all conjecture; buddhira vichara — by the reasoning of the intellect

**550.** What do we know of the Lord's deeds and conduct?
We only conjecture by the reasoning of our intellect."

একজন বোলে শুন আমার বচন ।
না বুঝিয়ে এই দৃঢ় প্রভুর আচরণ ॥ ৫৫১ ॥

*ekajana bole śuna āmāra bacana |*
*nā bujhiẏe ei dṛṛha prabhura ācaraṇa || 551 ||*

*Word for word:* ekajana bole — one said; shuna amara vachana — hear my words; na bujhiye — we do not understand; ei dridha — this is certain; prabhura acharana — the Lord's conduct

**551.** One said: "Listen to my words:
the Lord's deeds we do not understand — that is certain.

যে কিছু কহিয়ে শুন আপনার মর্ম ।
লোক নিস্তারিতে প্রভু যুগে যুগে জন্ম ॥ ৫৫২ ॥

*ye kichu kahiẏe śuna āpanāra marma |*
*loka nistārite prabhu yuge yuge janma || 552 ||*

*Word for word:* ye kichhu kahiye shuna — hear what I say; apanara marma — my own understanding; loka nistarite — to deliver the people; prabhu yuge yuge janma — the Lord is born age after age

**552.** Listen to what I say, as I myself understand it:
to deliver the people, the Lord takes birth age after age.

কত কত অবতার কার্য-অনুসারে ।
যুগের স্বভাবে সবে চারি অবতারে ॥ ৫৫৩ ॥

*kata kata abatāra kārya-anusāre |*
*yugera sbabhābe sabe cāri abatāre || 553 ||*

*Word for word:* kata kata avatara — many avataras; karya-anusare — according to purpose; yugera svabhave — by the nature of the yugas; sabe chari avatare — only four avataras

**553.** There are many avataras, according to the purpose for which they come;
but according to the nature of the yugas there are only four avataras.[^15-6]

ধর্মসংস্থাপন আর অধর্ম-বিনাশে ।
সাধুজন-পরিত্রাণ-হেতু পরকাশে ॥ ৫৫৪ ॥

*dharmasaṃsthāpana āra adharma-bināśe |*
*sādhujana-paritrāṇa-hetu parakāśe || 554 ||*

*Word for word:* dharma-samsthapana — to establish dharma; ara adharma-vinashe — and to destroy adharma; sadhujana-paritrana-hetu — for the deliverance of the righteous; parakashe — He appears

**554.** To establish dharma, to destroy adharma
and to deliver the righteous, He appears.

অসুর-সংহার হেতু আদি যত আর ।
কার্য-অবতার বলি এ নাম তাহার ॥ ৫৫৫ ॥

*asura-saṃhāra hetu ādi yata āra |*
*kārya-abatāra bali e nāma tāhāra || 555 ||*

*Word for word:* asura-samhara hetu adi — for slaying asuras and the like; yata ara — all the others; karya-avatara bali — called karya-avataras; e nama tahara — such is their name

**555.** Those who come to slay the asuras and the like
are called avataras for a special purpose (karya-avataras).

শ্রীরাম-আদি যত অবতার লেখি ।
কার্য-অবতার তার কার্যে পাই সাক্ষী ॥ ৫৫৬ ॥

*śrīrāma-ādi yata abatāra lekhi |*
*kārya-abatāra tāra kārye pāi sākṣī || 556 ||*

*Word for word:* shrirama-adi — beginning with Sri Rama; yata avatara lekhi — all the avataras written of; karya-avatara — are karya-avataras; tara karye pai sakshi — in their deeds we find the witness

**556.** All the avataras that are written of, beginning with Sri Rama,
are karya-avataras: their deeds bear witness to it.

ত্রেতাযুগে রক্তবর্ণ যজ্ঞ তার ধর্ম ।
দূর্বাদলশ্যাম প্রভু রাক্ষস-ক্ষয় কর্ম ॥ ৫৫৭ ॥

*tretāyuge raktabarṇa yajña tāra dharma |*
*dūrbādalaśyāma prabhu rākṣasa-kṣaẏa karma || 557 ||*

*Word for word:* tretayuge — in the Treta-yuga; raktavarna — red in colour; yajna tara dharma — its dharma is sacrifice; durvadala-shyama prabhu — the Lord dark as durva grass; rakshasa-kshaya karma — the task of destroying the rakshasas

**557.** In the Treta-yuga [the yuga-avatara] is red, its dharma is sacrifice;
the Lord, dark as a blade of durva grass, [came] to destroy the rakshasas.

সকল ত্রেতায় সে না হয় রঘুনাথ ।
রাবণ বধিতে খেলা বানরের সাথ ॥ ৫৫৮ ॥

*sakala tretāẏa se nā haẏa raghunātha |*
*rābaṇa badhite khelā bānarera sātha || 558 ||*

*Word for word:* sakala tretaya — in every Treta; se na haya raghunatha — Raghunatha does not appear; ravana vadhite — to slay Ravana; khela vanarera satha — playing with the monkeys

**558.** Not in every Treta does Raghunatha appear
to play with the monkeys in order to slay Ravana.

চৌদ্দ চৌযুগ সে রাবণের পরমাই ।
কত কত ত্রেতা গেল লেখা কর ভাই ॥ ৫৫৯ ॥

*caudda cauyuga se rābaṇera paramāi |*
*kata kata tretā gela lekhā kara bhāi || 559 ||*

*Word for word:* chaudda chauyuga — fourteen chatur-yugas; se ravanera paramai — is Ravana's lifespan; kata kata treta gela — how many Tretas went by; lekha kara bhai — count, brothers

**559.** Ravana's lifespan is fourteen chatur-yugas;
count, brothers, how many Tretas went by!

এতেকে বোলিয়ে সব ত্রেতা এক নহে ।
কার্য-অনুসারে বলি যখন যে হয়ে ॥ ৫৬০ ॥

*eteke boliẏe saba tretā eka nahe |*
*kārya-anusāre bali yakhana ye haẏe || 560 ||*

*Word for word:* eteke boliye — therefore I say; saba treta eka nahe — not all Tretas are the same; karya-anusare bali — I say: according to purpose; yakhana ye haye — depending on what happens when

**560.** That is why I say: not all Tretas are the same —
[the avataras come] according to purpose, depending on what happens when.

সত্যে শ্বেত তপোধর্ম হংস-নাম জানি ।
নৃসিংহাদি অবতার কার্য অনুমানি ॥ ৫৬১ ॥

*satye śbeta tapodharma haṃsa-nāma jāni |*
*nṛsiṃhādi abatāra kārya anumāni || 561 ||*

*Word for word:* satye shveta — in the Satya white; tapo-dharma — the dharma is austerity; hamsa-nama jani — I know the name Hamsa; nrisimhadi avatara — Nrisimha and the other avataras; karya anumani — I consider [avataras for a] purpose

**561.** In the Satya-yuga [the avatara] is white, the dharma is austerity, the name Hamsa;
Nrisimha and the others I consider karya-avataras.

যুগ-অনুরূপ বর্ণ ধর্মসংস্থাপন ।
যুগ-অবতার বলি জানিয়ে সে জন ॥ ৫৬২ ॥

*yuga-anurūpa barṇa dharmasaṃsthāpana |*
*yuga-abatāra bali jāniẏe se jana || 562 ||*

*Word for word:* yuga-anurupa varna — a colour befitting the yuga; dharma-samsthapana — establishing dharma; yuga-avatara bali — as the yuga-avatara; janiye se jana — I know him

**562.** He who, with a colour befitting the yuga, establishes [its] dharma —
him I know as the avatara of the yuga (yuga-avatara).

দ্বাপরে কৃষ্ণের কথা শুন একমনে ।
একলা ঠাকুর সেই নাহি অন্যজনে ॥ ৫৬৩ ॥

*dbāpare kṛṣṇera kathā śuna ekamane |*
*ekalā ṭhākura sei nāhi anyajane || 563 ||*

*Word for word:* dvapare krishnera katha — about Krishna in the Dvapara; shuna ekamane — listen attentively; ekala thakura sei — He alone is the Lord; nahi anyajane — there is no other

**563.** Listen attentively about Krishna in the Dvapara:
He alone is the Lord, and no one else.

কার্য-অবতার কিবা যুগ-অবতার ।
সর্বকলা-পূর্ণ সেই নন্দের কুমার ॥ ৫৬৪ ॥

*kārya-abatāra kibā yuga-abatāra |*
*sarbakalā-pūrṇa sei nandera kumāra || 564 ||*

*Word for word:* karya-avatara kiva yuga-avatara — whether karya-avatara or yuga-avatara; sarvakala-purna — full of all parts; sei nandera kumara — He, Nanda's son

**564.** Whether karya-avatara or yuga-avatara —
the son of Nanda is full of all the parts (kalas).

পূর্ণ পূর্ণব্রহ্ম যারে বোলে সর্বজনে ।
গোপিকা-লম্পট সেই জানিহ বৃন্দাবনে ॥ ৫৬৫ ॥

*pūrṇa pūrṇabrahma yāre bole sarbajane |*
*gopikā-lampaṭa sei jāniha bṛndābane || 565 ||*

*Word for word:* purna purnabrahma — the full, complete Brahman; yare bole sarvajane — whom all call; gopika-lampata — avid for the gopis; sei janiha vrindavane — know Him in Vrindavana

**565.** Him all call the full, complete Brahman;
know that in Vrindavana He is the One who longs for the gopis' love.[^15-7]

অবতার-শিরোমণি কৃষ্ণ-অবতার ।
দ্বাপর-ভিতরে এই দ্বাপর যে সার ॥ ৫৬৬ ॥

*abatāra-śiromaṇi kṛṣṇa-abatāra |*
*dbāpara-bhitare ei dbāpara ye sāra || 566 ||*

*Word for word:* avatara-shiromani — the crown of avataras; krishna-avatara — Krishna's avatara; dvapara-bhitare — among the Dvaparas; ei dvapara ye sara — this Dvapara is the best

**566.** The avatara of Krishna is the crown of all avataras;
among the Dvaparas this Dvapara is the best.

আর দ্বাপরে আছে অবতার দুই ।
কার্য-অবতার কিবা যুগাবতার এই ॥ ৫৬৭ ॥

*āra dbāpare āche abatāra dui |*
*kārya-abatāra kibā yugābatāra ei || 567 ||*

*Word for word:* ara dvapare — in other Dvaparas; achhe avatara dui — there are two [kinds of] avataras; karya-avatara kiva — either karya-avatara; yugavatara ei — or this yuga-avatara

**567.** In other Dvaparas there are two [kinds of] avataras:
either a karya-avatara or a yuga-avatara.

যেই দ্বাপরে হয় কৃষ্ণ-অবতার ।
সেই কলিযুগে গৌরচান্দের প্রচার ॥ ৫৬৮ ॥

*yei dbāpare haẏa kṛṣṇa-abatāra |*
*sei kaliyuge gauracāndera pracāra || 568 ||*

*Word for word:* yei dvapare — in the Dvapara in which; haya krishna-avatara — Krishna descends; sei kaliyuge — in that Kali-yuga; gaurachandera prachara — Gaurachand is manifest

**568.** In the Kali-yuga that follows the Dvapara in which Krishna descends,
Gaurachand appears.[^15-8]

যেন কৃষ্ণ-অবতার তেন গৌরচন্দ্র ।
এই দুই যুগ সব যুগের স্বতন্ত্র ॥ ৫৬৯ ॥

*yena kṛṣṇa-abatāra tena gauracandra |*
*ei dui yuga saba yugera sbatantra || 569 ||*

*Word for word:* yena krishna-avatara — as is the Krishna-avatara; tena gaurachandra — so is Gaurachandra; ei dui yuga — these two yugas; saba yugera svatantra — are distinct from all yugas

**569.** As is the Krishna-avatara, so is Gaurachandra;
these two yugas are distinct from all the yugas.

সব দ্বাপরে নাহি কৃষ্ণের বিহার ।
সব কলিযুগে নাহি গোরা-অবতার ॥ ৫৭০ ॥

*saba dbāpare nāhi kṛṣṇera bihāra |*
*saba kaliyuge nāhi gorā-abatāra || 570 ||*

*Word for word:* saba dvapare nahi — not in every Dvapara; krishnera vihara — are Krishna's pastimes; saba kaliyuge nahi — not in every Kali-yuga; gora-avatara — is Gora's descent

**570.** Not in every Dvapara are there Krishna's pastimes,
not in every Kali-yuga does Gora descend.

কতেক দ্বাপর কলি সত্য ত্রেতা যায় ।
অংশ-অবতার প্রভু হয় তা-সভায় ॥ ৫৭১ ॥

*kateka dbāpara kali satya tretā yāẏa |*
*aṃśa-abatāra prabhu haẏa tā-sabhāẏa || 571 ||*

*Word for word:* kateka dvapara kali satya treta yaya — many Dvaparas, Kalis, Satyas, Tretas pass; amsha-avatara prabhu haya — the Lord appears as partial avataras; ta-sabhaya — in all of them

**571.** Many Dvaparas, Kalis, Satyas and Tretas pass —
in all of them the Lord appears as partial avataras.

এই দ্বাপরে আর এই কলিযুগে ।
কৃষ্ণ কৃষ্ণচৈতন্য মিলে বড় ভাগে ॥ ৫৭২ ॥

*ei dbāpare āra ei kaliyuge |*
*kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇacaitanya mile baṛa bhāge || 572 ||*

*Word for word:* ei dvapare — in this Dvapara; ara ei kaliyuge — and in this Kali-yuga; krishna krishnachaitanya — Krishna and Krishna Chaitanya; mile bada bhage — are met by great fortune

**572.** In this Dvapara and in this Kali-yuga,
by great fortune, one meets Krishna and Krishna Chaitanya.

ব্রহ্মার দিবসে অবতার একবার ।
দ্বাপরেতে কলিযুগে করেন বিহার ॥ ৫৭৩ ॥

*brahmāra dibase abatāra ekabāra |*
*dbāparete kaliyuge karena bihāra || 573 ||*

*Word for word:* brahmara divase — in a day of Brahma; avatara ekabara — the descent occurs once; dvaparete kaliyuge — in the Dvapara and Kali-yuga; karena vihara — He sports

**573.** In one day of Brahma He descends once
and sports in the Dvapara and in the Kali-yuga.

বৈবস্বত-মন্বন্তরে শ্যাম গৌর হঞা ।
দ্বাপরের পূজা কৈলা কীর্তন করিয়া ॥ ৫৭৪ ॥

*baibasbata-manbantare śyāma gaura hañā |*
*dbāparera pūjā kailā kīrtana kariẏā || 574 ||*

*Word for word:* vaivasvata-manvantare — in the Vaivasvata manvantara; shyama gaura hana — becoming dark and golden; dvaparera puja kaila — performed the worship (dharma) of the Dvapara; kirtana kariya — [and] doing kirtana

**574.** In the manvantara of Vaivasvata, becoming dark and golden,
He performed the worship (service), [the dharma] of the Dvapara, and [in the Kali] kirtana.

ধন্য ধন্য কলিযুগ যুগের উপরি ।
সঙ্কীর্তন-যজ্ঞে সভে হৈলা অধিকারী ॥ ৫৭৫ ॥

*dhanya dhanya kaliyuga yugera upari |*
*saṅkīrtana-yajñe sabhe hailā adhikārī || 575 ||*

*Word for word:* dhanya dhanya kaliyuga — blessed is the Kali-yuga; yugera upari — above all yugas; sankirtana-yajne — in the sacrifice of sankirtana; sabhe haila adhikari — all became qualified

**575.** Blessed, blessed is the Kali-yuga — above all the yugas:
in the sacrifice of sankirtana all became qualified to take part.

আরে আরে দয়াল ঠাকুর গৌরচন্দ্র ।
সঙ্কীর্তনে পার কৈল পঙ্গু জড় অন্ধ ॥ ৫৭৬ ॥

*āre āre daẏāla ṭhākura gauracandra |*
*saṅkīrtane pāra kaila paṅgu jaṛa andha || 576 ||*

*Word for word:* are are — O, O; dayala thakura gaurachandra — merciful Lord Gaurachandra; sankirtane — by sankirtana; para kaila — carried across; pangu jada andha — the lame, the dull, the blind

**576.** O, O merciful Lord Gaurachandra!
By sankirtana He carried across [the ocean of the world] the lame, the dull and the blind.

আমার বচনে যদি না যাহ প্রতীত ।
যে কিছু পুছিয়ে তাহা কহ সমুচিত ॥ ৫৭৭ ॥

*āmāra bacane yadi nā yāha pratīta |*
*ye kichu puchiẏe tāhā kaha samucita || 577 ||*

*Word for word:* amara vachane — in my words; yadi na yaha pratita — if you do not trust; ye kichhu puchhiye — what I shall ask; taha kaha samuchita — answer that properly

**577.** If you do not trust my words,
then answer properly what I shall ask.

যে যুগে যাহার যেই আছে বর্ণ-ধর্ম ।
যুগ-অবতারে প্রভু করে সেই কর্ম ॥ ৫৭৮ ॥

*ye yuge yāhāra yei āche barṇa-dharma |*
*yuga-abatāre prabhu kare sei karma || 578 ||*

*Word for word:* ye yuge — in whichever yuga; yahara yei achhe varna-dharma — whatever colour and dharma belong to it; yuga-avatare — as the yuga-avatara; prabhu kare sei karma — the Lord does that work

**578.** Whatever colour and dharma belong to a yuga,
that work the Lord performs as the avatara of the yuga.

দ্বাপরে ঠাকুর কৃষ্ণ যুগ-অবতার ।
যুগধর্ম-আচরণে কি কৈল আচার ॥ ৫৭৯ ॥

*dbāpare ṭhākura kṛṣṇa yuga-abatāra |*
*yugadharma-ācaraṇe ki kaila ācāra || 579 ||*

*Word for word:* dvapare — in the Dvapara; thakura krishna yuga-avatara — the Lord Krishna was the yuga-avatara; yugadharma-acharane — in practising the dharma of the age; ki kaila achara — what did He do

**579.** In the Dvapara the Lord Krishna was the avatara of the yuga:
how then did He carry out the dharma of the age?

দ্বাপরে পরিচর্যা-ধর্ম শাস্ত্রে কহে ।
কোথা ধর্মসংস্থাপন কৈল প্রভু তাহে ॥ ৫৮০ ॥

*dbāpare paricaryā-dharma śāstre kahe |*
*kothā dharmasaṃsthāpana kaila prabhu tāhe || 580 ||*

*Word for word:* dvapare — in the Dvapara; paricharya-dharma — the dharma is service; shastre kahe — the shastras say; kotha dharma-samsthapana — where the establishing of dharma; kaila prabhu tahe — did the Lord accomplish in it

**580.** The shastras say that in the Dvapara the dharma is service (paricharya);
where did the Lord establish this dharma?

অবজ্ঞা না করহ বোলোঁ এক বোল ।
যুক্তিপর কহোঁ কথা না ঠেলিহ মোর ॥ ৫৮১ ॥

*abajñā nā karaha boloṁ eka bola |*
*yuktipara kahoṁ kathā nā ṭheliha mora || 581 ||*

*Word for word:* avajna na karaha — if you will not disdain; bolon eka bola — I shall say one word; yuktipara kahon katha — I speak with reason; na theliha mora — do not reject mine

**581.** If you will not disdain it, I shall say one thing;
I speak with reason — do not reject my words.

আপনে ঠাকুর সেই স্বতন্ত্র ঈশ্বর ।
কার্য কিবা যুগধর্ম সব তাঁর ভার ॥ ৫৮২ ॥

*āpane ṭhākura sei sbatantra īśbara |*
*kārya kibā yugadharma saba tāṁra bhāra || 582 ||*

*Word for word:* apane thakura sei — He Himself is the Lord; svatantra ishvara — the independent Ishvara; karya kiva yugadharma — whether special purpose or dharma of the age; saba tanra bhara — all is His charge

**582.** He Himself is the Lord, the independent Ishvara;
both the special purpose and the dharma of the age are all in His hands.

যুগধর্মসংস্থাপন কৈল যেবা কার্য ।
সকল করিল প্রভু বুঝিতে আশ্চর্য ॥ ৫৮৩ ॥

*yugadharmasaṃsthāpana kaila yebā kārya |*
*sakala karila prabhu bujhite āścarya || 583 ||*

*Word for word:* yugadharma-samsthapana — the establishment of the dharma of the age; kaila yeba karya — and whatever purpose; sakala karila prabhu — the Lord accomplished all; bujhite ashcharya — wonderful to understand

**583.** The establishment of the dharma of the age and every special purpose —
all this the Lord accomplished; it is wonderful to comprehend!

রাধাকৃষ্ণ-অবতার করিতে বিহার ।
আপনে স্বতন্ত্র রাধা প্রকৃতি-আকার ॥ ৫৮৪ ॥

*rādhākṛṣṇa-abatāra karite bihāra |*
*āpane sbatantra rādhā prakṛti-ākāra || 584 ||*

*Word for word:* radhakrishna-avatara — the descent of Radha-Krishna; karite vihara — to sport; apane svatantra — He Himself independent; radha prakriti-akara — Radha in the form of prakriti

**584.** To sport by descending as Radha-Krishna,
He Himself is the independent [Lord], and Radha is in the form of [His] prakriti.[^15-9]

প্রকৃতি পুরুষ যেন দোঁহে আত্মা তনু ।
দোঁহে এক তনু কার্য বুঝি হৈলা ভিনু ॥ ৫৮৫ ॥

*prakṛti puruṣa yena doṁhe ātmā tanu |*
*doṁhe eka tanu kārya bujhi hailā bhinu || 585 ||*

*Word for word:* prakriti purusha yena — like prakriti and purusha; donhe atma tanu — the two are soul and body; donhe eka tanu — both are one body; karya bujhi — understanding the purpose; haila bhinu — became separate

**585.** Like prakriti and purusha, They are soul and body;
both are one body, but, understanding the purpose [of the pastimes], They became two.

রাধা-নাম ধরে কৃষ্ণ-আরাধনা-কাজ ।
পরিচর্যা করে লঞা গোপিকা-সমাজ ॥ ৫৮৬ ॥

*rādhā-nāma dhare kṛṣṇa-ārādhanā-kāja |*
*paricaryā kare lañā gopikā-samāja || 586 ||*

*Word for word:* radha-nama dhare — bears the name Radha; krishna-aradhana-kaja — [Her] task is the worship of Krishna; paricharya kare — She serves; lana gopika-samaja — together with the society of gopis

**586.** She bears the name Radha because Her task is the worship (aradhana) of Krishna;
She serves Him together with the society of the gopis.

প্রেমভক্তি করে গোপী শত শত শাখা ।
প্রকৃতি-স্বরূপ সেই একলা রাধিকা ॥ ৫৮৭ ॥

*premabhakti kare gopī śata śata śākhā |*
*prakṛti-sbarūpa sei ekalā rādhikā || 587 ||*

*Word for word:* premabhakti kare gopi — the gopis serve with loving devotion; shata shata shakha — hundreds upon hundreds of branches; prakriti-svarupa — the essence of prakriti; sei ekala radhika — is Radhika alone

**587.** The gopis, hundreds upon hundreds of branches, serve with prema and devotion;
but the very essence of [His] prakriti is Radhika alone.

করণ সমর্পয়ে দেহ দেহের স্বভাব ।
নিত্য নূতন তায় বাঢ়ে অনুরাগ ॥ ৫৮৮ ॥

*karaṇa samarpaẏe deha dehera sbabhāba |*
*nitya nūtana tāẏa bāṛhe anurāga || 588 ||*

*Word for word:* karana — the senses; samarpaye — She offers; deha — the body; dehera svabhava — the nature of the body; nitya nutana — ever new; taya badhe anuraga — in this anuraga (love) grows

**588.** She offers [Him] Her senses, Her body, the very nature of Her body;
and in this Her ever-new love (anuraga) grows.

এই পরিচর্যা-ধর্ম না বুঝিল কেহ ।
এই কথা কহে যত ভাগবত সেহ ॥ ৫৮৯ ॥

*ei paricaryā-dharma nā bujhila keha |*
*ei kathā kahe yata bhāgabata seha || 589 ||*

*Word for word:* ei paricharya-dharma — this dharma of service; na bujhila keha — no one understood; ei katha kahe — so say; yata bhagavata seha — all the bhagavatas (devotees; or: the Bhagavata)

**589.** No one understood this dharma of service;
so say all the bhagavatas.[^15-10]

আর আর দ্বাপরযুগে অংশে করে কর্ম ।
ধর্মসংস্থাপন করে না বুঝয়ে মর্ম ॥ ৫৯০ ॥

*āra āra dbāparayuge aṃśe kare karma |*
*dharmasaṃsthāpana kare nā bujhaẏe marma || 590 ||*

*Word for word:* ara ara dvaparayuge — in other Dvapara-yugas; amshe kare karma — He acts through a portion; dharma-samsthapana kare — establishes dharma; na bujhaye marma — [people] do not grasp its essence

**590.** In other Dvapara-yugas He acts through a portion
and establishes dharma, [but people] do not grasp its essence.

ধর্ম বলি দান ব্রত তপোধর্ম কহি ।
ধর্ম করি সমর্পণ করে সভে তাহি ॥ ৫৯১ ॥

*dharma bali dāna brata tapodharma kahi |*
*dharma kari samarpaṇa kare sabhe tāhi || 591 ||*

*Word for word:* dharma bali — calling it dharma; dana vrata tapadharma kahi — they speak of charity, vows, austerity; dharma kari — doing dharma; samarpana kare sabhe tahi — all offer it to Him

**591.** Charity, vows and austerity are called dharma,
and all, having performed dharma, offer [its fruit] to Him.

এই ত কারণে প্রভু প্রকাশিল নিজ ।
তবু না বুঝিল কেহ ধর্মাধর্ম-বীজ ॥ ৫৯২ ॥

*ei ta kāraṇe prabhu prakāśila nija |*
*tabu nā bujhila keha dharmādharma-bīja || 592 ||*

*Word for word:* ei ta karane — for this very reason; prabhu prakashila nija — the Lord revealed Himself; tabu na bujhila keha — still no one understood; dharmadharma-bija — the seed of dharma and adharma

**592.** That is why the Lord revealed Himself in person;
and still no one understood the root of dharma and adharma.

কলিযুগে গৌরদেহ প্রকাশে আপনা ।
যুগ-অবতার-কার্য প্রকাশয়ে প্রেমা ॥ ৫৯৩ ॥

*kaliyuge gauradeha prakāśe āpanā |*
*yuga-abatāra-kārya prakāśaẏe premā || 593 ||*

*Word for word:* kaliyuge — in the Kali-yuga; gauradeha prakashe apana — reveals Himself in a golden body; yuga-avatara-karya — [as] the work of the yuga-avatara; prakashaye prema — reveals prema

**593.** In the Kali-yuga He reveals Himself in a golden body
and, doing the work of the yuga-avatara, reveals prema.

রাধার বরণে অঙ্গ গৌর অঙ্গ হঞা ।
রাধিকার ভাব রস অন্তরে করিয়া ॥ ৫৯৪ ॥

*rādhāra baraṇe aṅga gaura aṅga hañā |*
*rādhikāra bhāba rasa antare kariẏā || 594 ||*

*Word for word:* radhara barane anga — a body of Radha's complexion; gaura anga hana — becoming golden-limbed; radhikara bhava rasa — Radhika's feelings and rasa; antare kariya — holding within

**594.** His body has Radha's complexion — He became golden,
holding within His heart Radhika's feelings and rasa.

সেই ভাবে কান্দে এই রসিক-শেখর ।
বিকশিত পুলক-কদম্ব কলেবর ॥ ৫৯৫ ॥

*sei bhābe kānde ei rasika-śekhara |*
*bikaśita pulaka-kadamba kalebara || 595 ||*

*Word for word:* sei bhave — in that mood; kande ei rasika-shekhara — this crown of rasikas weeps; vikashita pulaka-kadamba — like a blossoming kadamba, thrilling; kalevara — the body

**595.** In that mood He weeps, the crown of the relishers of rasa;
His body is like a blossoming kadamba, all thrilling.

সেই প্রেমে গরগর মাতোয়াল হঞা ।
হুঙ্কার গর্জন করে কান্দিয়া কান্দিয়া ॥ ৫৯৬ ॥

*sei preme garagara mātoẏāla hañā |*
*huṅkāra garjana kare kāndiẏā kāndiẏā || 596 ||*

*Word for word:* sei preme — with that prema; garagara — brimming; matoyala hana — intoxicated; hunkara garjana kare — roars and thunders; kandiya kandiya — weeping and weeping

**596.** Intoxicated with that prema, brimming over with it,
He roars and thunders, weeping and weeping.

সেই গর্জন শুনি অচেতন কলিকাল ।
চেতন পাইয়া সভে আনন্দ বিশাল ॥ ৫৯৭ ॥

*sei garjana śuni acetana kalikāla |*
*cetana pāiẏā sabhe ānanda biśāla || 597 ||*

*Word for word:* sei garjana shuni — hearing that roar; achetana kalikala — the senseless age of Kali; chetana paiya sabhe — all regained consciousness; ananda vishala — the joy was vast

**597.** Hearing that roar, the age of Kali that lay senseless —
all regained consciousness, and the joy was immense.

তেঞি রাধাকৃষ্ণ বলি নাচে কান্দে হাসে ।
অন্ধকার দূরে গেল পাইল প্রকাশে ॥ ৫৯৮ ॥

*teñi rādhākṛṣṇa bali nāce kānde hāse |*
*andhakāra dūre gela pāila prakāśe || 598 ||*

*Word for word:* teni — therefore; radhakrishna bali — crying "Radha-Krishna"; nache kande hase — they dance, weep, laugh; andhakara dure gela — the darkness went away; paila prakashe — they gained light

**598.** Therefore, crying "Radha-Krishna", they dance, weep and laugh;
the darkness went away and they found light.

দ্বাপরে উপজে কৃষ্ণ গৌরময় তনু ।
কলি অচেতন লোক করাইল চেতন ॥ ৫৯৯ ॥

*dbāpare upaje kṛṣṇa gauramaẏa tanu |*
*kali acetana loka karāila cetana || 599 ||*

*Word for word:* dvapare upaje krishna — Krishna, born in the Dvapara; gauramaya tanu — in a golden body; kali achetana loka — the senseless people of Kali; karaila chetana — awakened

**599.** Krishna, born in the Dvapara, [now] in a golden body
awakened the senseless people of the Kali.

প্রেম প্রকাশয়ে প্রভু করি দীনভাব ।
আপনা বিলায় আপে মানে নিজ লাভ ॥ ৬০০ ॥

*prema prakāśaẏe prabhu kari dīnabhāba |*
*āpanā bilāẏa āpe māne nija lābha || 600 ||*

*Word for word:* prema prakashaye prabhu — the Lord reveals prema; kari dinabhava — assuming humility; apana vilaya ape — gives Himself away Himself; mane nija labha — counts it His gain

**600.** The Lord reveals prema, assuming a humble guise;
He gives Himself away and counts it His own gain.

এহেন ঠাকুর কোন্ কৈল ঠাকুরাল ।
না ভজিলে প্রেম দেয় নাহিক বিচার ॥ ৬০১ ॥

*ehena ṭhākura kon kaila ṭhākurāla |*
*nā bhajile prema deẏa nāhika bicāra || 601 ||*

*Word for word:* ehena thakura — such lordship; kon kaila thakurala — what lord ever showed; na bhajile — even to those who do not worship; prema deya — He gives prema; nahika vichara — without discrimination

**601.** What lord ever showed such lordship?
He gives prema even to those who do not worship Him — without discrimination.

এতেক বোলিয়ে যুগ-অবতার এই ।
এই পূর্ণ অবতার প্রকাশিল সেই ॥ ৬০২ ॥

*eteka boliẏe yuga-abatāra ei |*
*ei pūrṇa abatāra prakāśila sei || 602 ||*

*Word for word:* eteka boliye — therefore I say; yuga-avatara ei — this is the yuga-avatara; ei purna avatara — this full avatara; prakashila sei — He manifested

**602.** That is why I say: this is the avatara of the yuga;
and He also manifested this full avatara.

আর কলিযুগে নারায়ণ-অবতার ।
শ্রীকৃষ্ণ দ্বাপরযুগে নাম সে তাহার ॥ ৬০৩ ॥

*āra kaliyuge nārāẏaṇa-abatāra |*
*śrīkṛṣṇa dbāparayuge nāma se tāhāra || 603 ||*

*Word for word:* ara kaliyuge — in other Kali-yugas; narayana-avatara — an avatara of Narayana; shrikrishna — Sri Krishna; dvaparayuge — [as] in the Dvapara-yuga; nama se tahara — such is His name

**603.** In other Kali-yugas, however, there is an avatara of Narayana;
His name is Krishna, as in the Dvapara-yuga.[^15-11]

শুকপক্ষ-পাখা জিনি বরণ যাহার ।
ইন্দ্রনীলমণি-দ্যুতি কহে টীকাকার ॥ ৬০৪ ॥

*śukapakṣa-pākhā jini baraṇa yāhāra |*
*indranīlamaṇi-dyuti kahe ṭīkākāra || 604 ||*

*Word for word:* shukapaksha-pakha jini — surpassing a parrot's wing; barana yahara — whose colour; indranila-mani-dyuti — the lustre of sapphire; kahe tikakara — says the commentator

**604.** His colour surpasses a parrot's wing —
"the lustre of sapphire", says the commentator.

এই কলিযুগে গৌরচন্দ্র পূর্ণব্রহ্ম ।
অংশ প্রবেশিল ইথে কহিল এ মর্ম ॥ ৬০৫ ॥

*ei kaliyuge gauracandra pūrṇabrahma |*
*aṃśa prabeśila ithe kahila e marma || 605 ||*

*Word for word:* ei kaliyuge — in this Kali-yuga; gaurachandra purnabrahma — Gaurachandra is the full Brahman; amsha praveshila ithe — the portion entered into Him; kahila e marma — I have told this essence

**605.** In this Kali-yuga Gaurachandra is the full Brahman,
and the portion [— the yuga-avatara —] entered into Him: this is the essence I have told.[^15-12]

পূর্ণ পূর্ণ অবতার চৈতন্য গোসাঞি ।
এহেন করুণানিধি আর কেহ নাঞি ॥ ৬০৬ ॥

*pūrṇa pūrṇa abatāra caitanya gosāñi |*
*ehena karuṇānidhi āra keha nāñi || 606 ||*

*Word for word:* purna purna avatara — the fullest of full avataras; chaitanya gosani — Chaitanya Gosani; ehena karunanidhi — such an ocean of compassion; ara keha nani — there is no one else

**606.** Chaitanya Gosani is the fullest of full avataras;
there is no one else who is such an ocean of compassion.

কার্য-অবতার যুগ-অবতারে এক ।
যুগ-অনুরূপ তেঞি গৌর পরতেখ ॥ ৬০৭ ॥

*kārya-abatāra yuga-abatāre eka |*
*yuga-anurūpa teñi gaura paratekha || 607 ||*

*Word for word:* karya-avatara yuga-avatare eka — karya-avatara and yuga-avatara are one; yuga-anurupa — in accordance with the yuga; teni — therefore; gaura paratekha — Gaura is manifest before the eyes

**607.** Karya-avatara and yuga-avatara are one in Him;
therefore, in accordance with the yuga, Gaura is manifest before our eyes.

কলি পীত সঙ্কীর্তন-ধর্ম শাস্ত্রে কহে ।
এই বিশ্বম্ভর প্রভু কভু আন নহে ॥ ৬০৮ ॥

*kali pīta saṅkīrtana-dharma śāstre kahe |*
*ei biśbambhara prabhu kabhu āna nahe || 608 ||*

*Word for word:* kali pita — in the Kali, golden; sankirtana-dharma — the dharma is sankirtana; shastre kahe — the shastras say; ei vishvambhara prabhu — this is the Lord Vishvambhara; kabhu ana nahe — none other

**608.** The shastras say: in the Kali [the avatara] is golden, the dharma is sankirtana;[^15-13]
this is the Lord Vishvambhara, and no one else."

বিচারি পণ্ডিত সব দঢ়াইল হিয়া ।
আপনা সম্বরে প্রভু সে কাল বুঝিয়া ॥ ৬০৯ ॥

*bicāri paṇḍita saba daṛhāila hiẏā |*
*āpanā sambare prabhu se kāla bujhiẏā || 609 ||*

*Word for word:* vichari — having reflected; pandita saba dadhaila hiya — all the pandits became firm at heart; apana sambare prabhu — the Lord restrains Himself; se kala bujhiya — understanding the time

**609.** Having reflected, all the pandits became firm in heart;
and the Lord, understanding the time, restrained Himself.

সব সম্বরিল প্রভু তিলেকে তখন ।
বিশ্বম্ভর গৌরহরি উঠিল বচন ॥ ৬১০ ॥

*saba sambarila prabhu tileke takhana |*
*biśbambhara gaurahari uṭhila bacana || 610 ||*

*Word for word:* saba sambarila prabhu — the Lord withdrew everything; tileke takhana — then in a moment; vishvambhara gaurahari — Vishvambhara Gaurahari; uthila vachana — speech arose (He spoke)

**610.** Then in a moment the Lord withdrew it all,
and Vishvambhara Gaurahari spoke [as usual].

সব লোক কাণাকাণি অপরূপ কথা ।
সাতে পাঁচে অনুমানি যায় যথা তথা ॥ ৬১১ ॥

*saba loka kāṇākāṇi aparūpa kathā |*
*sāte pāṁce anumāni yāẏa yathā tathā || 611 ||*

*Word for word:* saba loka kanakani — all the people whisper; aparupa katha — about the wondrous event; sate panche anumani — guessing this way and that; yaya yatha tatha — go here and there

**611.** All the people whisper to one another about the wondrous event;
guessing this way and that, they go off here and there.

আশ্চর্য থাকিল কারো সন্দেহ হৃদয় ।
কি দেখিল বিশ্বম্ভর-চরিত্র-আশয় ॥ ৬১২ ॥

*āścarya thākila kāro sandeha hṛdaẏa |*
*ki dekhila biśbambhara-caritra-āśaẏa || 612 ||*

*Word for word:* ashcharya thakila karo — some remained amazed; sandeha hridaya — with doubt in their hearts; ki dekhila — what have we seen; vishvambhara-charitra-ashaya — the intent behind Vishvambhara's deeds

**612.** Some remained in amazement, with doubt in their hearts:
"What have we seen? What lies behind Vishvambhara's deeds?"

লোকমুখে যে শুনিল বিশ্বম্ভর-কথা ।
সাক্ষাৎ দেখিল এই জগত-করতা ॥ ৬১৩ ॥

*lokamukhe ye śunila biśbambhara-kathā |*
*sākṣāt dekhila ei jagata-karatā || 613 ||*

*Word for word:* lokamukhe ye shunila — what they had heard from people; vishvambhara-katha — about Vishvambhara; sakshat dekhila — they saw directly; ei jagata-karata — this is the Creator of the world

**613.** What they had heard from people about Vishvambhara
they saw with their own eyes: He is the Creator of the world.

আনন্দে ভরল পুরী দেই জয় জয় ।
ধন্য গোরাগুণগাথা এ লোচনে গায় ॥ ৬১৪ ॥

*ānande bharala purī dei jaẏa jaẏa |*
*dhanya gorāguṇagāthā e locane gāẏa || 614 ||*

*Word for word:* anande bharala puri — the town overflowed with joy; dei jaya jaya — they cry "jaya, jaya"; dhanya goraguna-gatha — the blessed song of Gora's glories; e lochane gaya — this Lochana sings

**614.** The town overflowed with joy, all cry "Jaya, jaya!";
the blessed song of Gora's glories is sung by this Lochana.

[^15-1]: Adhivasa is a preparatory rite on the eve of a samskara, with anointing with fragrances and the distribution of auspicious gifts.
[^15-2]: The nandimukha-shraddha is an offering to the ancestors performed before a samskara (upanayana, wedding and the like).
[^15-3]: V. 530+1 is found only in the 1983 edition (absent from Bhaktisiddhanta's edition); the 1903 edition gives its first line in a footnote as a variant of v. 531. On Lochana Dasa's nagari-bhava see en/09, note 9.
[^15-4]: At the upanayana the brahmachari student receives a staff and begs alms like a sannyasi; Lochana Dasa sees in this a foreshadowing of the sannyasa the Lord will take in 1510.
[^15-5]: Sudarshana Pandita was one of the Lord's teachers in Navadvipa (in Murari, 1.09.1).
[^15-6]: Lochana Dasa's division: "karya-avataras" (avataras for a special purpose — slaying asuras and the like; in the Chaitanya-charitamrita the lila-avataras correspond to them) and "yuga-avataras", who establish the dharma of their age in the colour proper to the yuga (cf. Bhagavata 11.5.20–32).
[^15-7]: Literally "gopika-lampata", "avid for the gopis". In the Gaudiya Vaishnava understanding this is Krishna's transcendental love for the gopis, His internal energy, which has nothing in common with worldly lust.
[^15-8]: Cf. Chaitanya-charitamrita (Adi 3.6–10): Krishna descends once in a day of Brahma, at the end of the Dvapara of the twenty-eighth chatur-yuga of the Vaivasvata manvantara, and in the Kali following it appears as Sri Chaitanya. Verses 573–574 say the same.
[^15-9]: "Prakriti" here is not material nature but the Lord's internal energy (hladini-shakti), personified by Radha; Radha and Krishna are one soul in two bodies (cf. Chaitanya-charitamrita, Adi 4.55–56, 4.96–98).
[^15-10]: "Bhagavatas" are the Lord's devotees; the reading "so says the Bhagavata" is also possible.
[^15-11]: That is, in ordinary Kali-yugas the yuga-avatara is "krishna-varna", dark in colour (cf. Bhagavata 11.5.32 and Sridhara Svami's comment: "shining like sapphire"). The line is corrupt in A; the reading of the 1983 edition is adopted; its exact sense is unclear.
[^15-12]: Cf. Chaitanya-charitamrita (Adi 4.8–12): the dharma of the age is established by a portion of the Lord, the yuga-avatara; but when Krishna Himself descends, all the avataras, the yuga-avatara included, enter into Him.
[^15-13]: "Pita" means yellow, golden; cf. Bhagavata (10.8.13): Garga Muni speaks of the three former colours of the avataras — white, red and yellow (pita) — and the Gaudiya Vaishnavas see in "yellow" an indication of Gauranga.

---

# Adi-khanda, part 8 (portion 16)

*Pauganda-lila (continued): Vishvambhara tells His mother not to eat grains on Ekadashi and for a moment becomes motionless after saying "I am going"; the conversation of Damodara and Murari Gupta on how the Lord abides in the body of His devotee; the illness and departure of Jagannatha Mishra on the bank of the Ganga, the grief of Shachi and of the Lord, the funeral rites*

*Raga shri; disha: "O, what do we see! Glory, glory to Gauranga!" Refrain: "What nectar-bliss is the prema of my Gauranga! What a Gauranga is mine! Glory, glory!"*

আর একদিন প্রভু বসি নিজঘরে ।
আপন-অন্তর-কথা পরকাশ করে ॥ ৬১৫ ॥

*āra ekadina prabhu basi nijaghare |*
*āpana-antara-kathā parakāśa kare || 615 ||*

*Word for word:* ara ekadina — another day; prabhu — the Lord; basi nija-ghare — sitting in His house; apana-antara-katha — what was in His heart; parakasha kare — reveals

**615.** Another day the Lord, sitting in His house,
revealed what was in His heart.

নিজ তেজ-অমিয়া পূরিত সব দেহ ।
নিরখি না পারি ঝলমল করে গেহ ॥ ৬১৬ ॥

*nija teja-amiẏā pūrita saba deha |*
*nirakhi nā pāri jhalamala kare geha || 616 ||*

*Word for word:* nija teja-amiya — with the nectar of His own effulgence; purita saba deha — the whole body filled; nirakhi na pari — one cannot look; jhalamala kare geha — the house is ablaze

**616.** His whole body was filled with the nectar of His own effulgence;
one could not look at it — the house was all ablaze with light.

মায়েরে দেখিয়া বৈল শুন মোর বোল ।
এক মহাদোষ মুঞি দেখিয়াছি তোর ॥ ৬১৭ ॥

*māẏere dekhiẏā baila śuna mora bola |*
*eka mahādoṣa muñi dekhiẏāchi tora || 617 ||*

*Word for word:* mayere dekhiya — seeing His mother; baila — said; shuna mora bola — listen to My word; eka maha-dosha — one great fault; muni dekhiyachhi tora — I have noticed in you

**617.** Seeing His mother, He said: "Listen to what I say:
I have noticed one great fault in you.

একাদশী তিথি অন্ন না খাইহ আর ।
যতনে পালিহ তুমি এ বোল আমার ॥ ৬১৮ ॥

*ekādaśī tithi anna nā khāiha āra |*
*yatane pāliha tumi e bola āmāra || 618 ||*

*Word for word:* ekadashi tithi — on the lunar day of Ekadashi; anna — grain; na khaiha ara — do not eat any more; yatane paliha tumi — carefully keep; e bola amara — this word of Mine

**618.** Do not eat grains any more on the day of Ekadashi;[^16-1]
carefully keep this word of Mine."

মেঘ-গম্ভীর-নাদে কহিল মায়েরে ।
শুনি মাতা সবিস্মিতা সম্ভ্রম অন্তরে ॥ ৬১৯ ॥

*megha-gambhīra-nāde kahila māẏere |*
*śuni mātā sabismitā sambhrama antare || 619 ||*

*Word for word:* megha-gambhira-nade — in a voice deep as thunder; kahila mayere — said to His mother; shuni mata — hearing, the mother; savismita — amazed; sambhrama antare — with awe in her heart

**619.** In a voice deep as the rumbling of clouds He said this to His mother;
hearing it, the mother was amazed, and reverent awe filled her heart.

সঙ্কোচ-সম্ভ্রমে প্রেমে ভরিল শরীরে ।
পালিব তোমার আজ্ঞা বোলে ধীরে ধীরে ॥ ৬২০ ॥

*saṅkoca-sambhrame preme bharila śarīre |*
*pāliba tomāra ājñā bole dhīre dhīre || 620 ||*

*Word for word:* sankocha-sambhrame preme — with shyness, awe and love; bharila sharire — the body filled; paliba tomara ajna — I shall keep Your command; bole dhire dhire — she says softly

**620.** Her body filled with shyness, awe and love;
"I shall keep Your command," she said very softly.

শুনিঞা মায়ের বোল সন্তোষ-হৃদয় ।
ধর্ম শিখাইল সেই অন্তর-সদয় ॥ ৬২১ ॥

*śuniñā māẏera bola santoṣa-hṛdaẏa |*
*dharma śikhāila sei antara-sadaẏa || 621 ||*

*Word for word:* shunina mayera bola — hearing His mother's words; santosha-hridaya — with gladdened heart; dharma shikhaila — taught dharma; sei antara-sadaya — He who is kind at heart

**621.** Hearing His mother's words, He, kind at heart,
with a gladdened heart taught her dharma.

সেইকালে এক দ্বিজ আসি আচম্বিত ।
আনি দিল গুয়া-পান অতি শুদ্ধচিত ॥ ৬২২ ॥

*seikāle eka dbija āsi ācambita |*
*āni dila guẏā-pāna ati śuddhacita || 622 ||*

*Word for word:* sei kale — at that time; eka dvija asi — a brahmana coming; achambita — suddenly; ani dila — brought; guya-pana — betel nut and leaf; ati shuddha-chita — with a pure heart

**622.** At that time a brahmana suddenly came
and with a pure heart brought Him betel leaf and nut.

হাসিয়া তখনে প্রভু গুবাক খাইল ।
ক্ষণেক-অন্তরে পুনঃ মায়েরে ডাকিল ॥ ৬২৩ ॥

*hāsiẏā takhane prabhu gubāka khāila |*
*kṣaṇeka-antare punaḥ māẏere ḍākila || 623 ||*

*Word for word:* hasiya — smiling; takhane — then; prabhu guvaka khaila — the Lord ate the betel nut; kshaneka-antare — after a moment; punah mayere dakila — again called His mother

**623.** Smiling, the Lord then ate the betel nut,
and a moment later called His mother again.

মায়েরে কহিল প্রভু আমি যাই দেহ ।
যতনে পালিহ তুমি নিজসুত এহ ॥ ৬২৪ ॥

*māẏere kahila prabhu āmi yāi deha |*
*yatane pāliha tumi nijasuta eha || 624 ||*

*Word for word:* mayere kahila prabhu — the Lord said to His mother; ami yai — I am going; deha — the body; yatane paliha tumi — guard it carefully; nija-suta eha — this is your own son

**624.** The Lord said to His mother: "I am going; [this] body —
guard it carefully: it is your own son."[^16-2]

ইহা বলি ক্ষণার্ধ নিশ্চেষ্ট হঞা রহি ।
দণ্ড-পরণাম করে লোটাইঞা মহী ॥ ৬২৫ ॥

*ihā bali kṣaṇārdha niśceṣṭa hañā rahi |*
*daṇḍa-paraṇāma kare loṭāiñā mahī || 625 ||*

*Word for word:* iha bali — saying this; kshanardha — for half a moment; nishcheshta hina rahi — remaining motionless; danda-paranama kare — prostrates like a stick; lotaina mahi — stretched on the ground

**625.** Saying this, He remained motionless for half a moment
and lay stretched on the ground like a stick.

নিঃশব্দে রহিলা পুন শচী তরাসিত ।
গঙ্গাজল মুখে দেই হৃদয় ত্বরিত ॥ ৬২৬ ॥

*niḥśabde rahilā puna śacī tarāsita |*
*gaṅgājala mukhe dei hṛdaẏa tbarita || 626 ||*

*Word for word:* nihshabde rahila puna — again remained silent; shachi tarasita — Shachi, terrified; gangajala mukhe dei — pours Ganga water into His mouth; hridaya tvarita — hastily (with a racing heart)

**626.** Again He lay silent; Shachi, terrified,
hastily pours Ganga water into His mouth.

ক্ষণেকে তখন প্রভু হইলা সম্বিত ।
সহজ-রূপের তেজে ঘর আলোকিত ॥ ৬২৭ ॥

*kṣaṇeke takhana prabhu hailā sambita |*
*sahaja-rūpera teje ghara ālokita || 627 ||*

*Word for word:* kshaneke takhana — then in a moment; prabhu haila samvita — the Lord came to Himself; sahaja-rupera teje — by the effulgence of His natural form; ghara alokita — the house was lit up

**627.** In a moment the Lord came to Himself,
and the house was lit up by the effulgence of His natural form.

মায়েরে কহিল প্রভু আমি যাই দেহ ।
এ কথা বিচার করিবারে আছে কেহ ॥ ৬২৮ ॥

*māẏere kahila prabhu āmi yāi deha |*
*e kathā bicāra karibāre āche keha || 628 ||*

*Word for word:* mayere kahila prabhu — the Lord said to His mother; ami yai deha — "I am going; the body…"; e katha — this matter; vichara karibare — to judge; achhe keha — is there anyone

**628.** The Lord said to His mother: "I am going; the body…" —
is there anyone who can judge this matter?

শ্রীমুরারি গুপ্ত বেজা প্রভুর অন্তরীণ ।
সর্বতত্ত্ববেত্তা সেই ভকতপ্রবীণ ॥ ৬২৯ ॥

*śrīmurāri gupta bejā prabhura antarīṇa |*
*sarbatattbabettā sei bhakataprabīṇa || 629 ||*

*Word for word:* sri-murari gupta beja — Sri Murari Gupta the vaidya; prabhura antarina — intimate with the Lord; sarva-tattva-vetta — knower of all truths; sei bhakata-pravina — he, a seasoned devotee

**629.** Sri Murari Gupta the vaidya, intimate with the Lord,
a knower of every truth, a seasoned devotee —

দামোদর পণ্ডিত পুছিল তার স্থানে ।
এ কথার তত্ত্ব মোরে কহ মহাজনে ॥ ৬৩০ ॥

*dāmodara paṇḍita puchila tāra sthāne |*
*e kathāra tattba more kaha mahājane || 630 ||*

*Word for word:* damodara pandita — Damodara Pandita; puchhila tara sthane — asked him; e kathara tattva — the truth of this; more kaha — tell me; mahajane — O great soul

**630.** Damodara Pandita asked him:
"Great soul, tell me the truth of this.

কিবা মায়া কৈল প্রভু কিবা কোন শক্তি ।
ইহার বিচার মোরে করি দেহ যুক্তি ॥ ৬৩১ ॥

*kibā māẏā kaila prabhu kibā kona śakti |*
*ihāra bicāra more kari deha yukti || 631 ||*

*Word for word:* kiba maya kaila prabhu — did the Lord display maya (yogamaya); kiba kona shakti — or some power; ihara vichara kari — considering this; more deha yukti — give me a reasoned answer

**631.** Did the Lord display [His] yogamaya,[^16-3] or some power?
Consider it and give me a reasoned answer."

মুরারি কহয়ে শুন শুন মহাশয় ।
আমি কি সকল জানি কৃষ্ণের আশয় ॥ ৬৩২ ॥

*murāri kahaẏe śuna śuna mahāśaẏa |*
*āmi ki sakala jāni kṛṣṇera āśaẏa || 632 ||*

*Word for word:* murari kahaye — Murari says; shuna shuna mahashaya — listen, listen, good sir; ami ki sakala jani — do I know all; krishnera ashaya — Krishna's intentions

**632.** Murari says: "Listen, listen, good sir:
do I know all the intentions of Krishna?

যে কিছু কহিয়ে নিজ বুদ্ধি-অনুমানে ।
যুক্তিসিদ্ধ হয় যদি রাখিহ পরাণে ॥ ৬৩৩ ॥

*ye kichu kahiẏe nija buddhi-anumāne |*
*yuktisiddha haẏa yadi rākhiha parāṇe || 633 ||*

*Word for word:* ye kichhu kahiye — whatever I say; nija buddhi-anumane — by my own reasoning; yukti-siddha haya yadi — if it proves well founded; rakhiha parane — keep it in your heart

**633.** I shall say something as my own reason suggests;
if it proves well founded, keep it in your heart.

শ্রবণ দর্শন ধ্যান আর সংকীর্তনে ।
হৃদয়ে প্রবেশে প্রভু নিজ ভক্তজনে ॥ ৬৩৪ ॥

*śrabaṇa darśana dhyāna āra saṃkīrtane |*
*hṛdaẏe prabeśe prabhu nija bhaktajane || 634 ||*

*Word for word:* shravana darshana dhyana ara sankirtane — through hearing, seeing, meditation and sankirtana; hridaye praveshe prabhu — the Lord enters the heart; nija bhakta-jane — of His devotees

**634.** When they hear [of Him], see, meditate and sing sankirtana,
the Lord enters the hearts of His devotees.

নিজ দেহ দেহ নহে নির্গুণ আকার ।
গুণে সে গুণের ভোগ আচার বিচার ॥ ৬৩৫ ॥

*nija deha deha nahe nirguṇa ākāra |*
*guṇe se guṇera bhoga ācāra bicāra || 635 ||*

*Word for word:* nija deha — His own body; deha nahe — is not a [material] body; nirguna akara — a form beyond the gunas; gune se gunera bhoga — the enjoyment of the gunas belongs to the gunas; achara vichara — conduct and deliberation

**635.** His own body is not a [material] body: it is a form beyond the gunas;[^16-4]
the enjoyment of the gunas, conduct and deliberation [belong to those] in the gunas.

এতেকে ভকত-দেহ দেহ করি মানে ।
স্বচ্ছন্দ-বিহার তঁহি সব আচরণে ॥ ৬৩৬ ॥

*eteke bhakata-deha deha kari māne |*
*sbacchanda-bihāra taṁhi saba ācaraṇe || 636 ||*

*Word for word:* eteke — therefore; bhakata-deha — the devotee's body; deha kari mane — regards as [His] body; svachchhanda-vihara — free play; tanhi — there; saba acharane — in all doings

**636.** Therefore He accepts the devotee's body as [His] body
and there freely plays in all His doings.

নিজপূজা-অধিক ভকতপূজা মানে ।
পূজার সংগ্রহ তাথে জানে মনে মনে ॥ ৬৩৭ ॥

*nijapūjā-adhika bhakatapūjā māne |*
*pūjāra saṃgraha tāthe jāne mane mane || 637 ||*

*Word for word:* nija-puja-adhika — above worship of Himself; bhakata-puja mane — He regards the worship of the devotee; pujara sangraha — the fullness of worship; tathe — in that; jane mane mane — He knows within Himself

**637.** He regards the worship of His devotee as greater than worship of Himself;
within Himself He knows that in this lies the fullness of all worship.

আপনে ঠাকুর সেই তদধীন জন ।
লোক-আচরণে মায়া বলি দুই জন ॥ ৬৩৮ ॥
