*āpane ṭhākura sei tadadhīna jana |*
*loka-ācaraṇe māẏā bali dui jana || 638 ||*

*Word for word:* apane thakura — the Lord Himself; sei tad-adhina jana — is that one who depends on Him (or: "and that one depends on Him"); loka-acharane — in worldly usage; maya — by maya; bali dui jana — they are called "two"

**638.** The Lord Himself is the very one who depends on Him;
only in worldly usage, by maya, are they spoken of as "two".[^16-5]

আপনা অধিক কেনে মানয়ে ভকত ।
এ কথা বুঝিতে নারে সকল জগত ॥ ৬৩৯ ॥

*āpanā adhika kene mānaẏe bhakata |*
*e kathā bujhite nāre sakala jagata || 639 ||*

*Word for word:* apana adhika — greater than Himself; kene manaye bhakata — why He regards the devotee; e katha — this; bujhite nare — cannot understand; sakala jagata — the whole world

**639.** Why He regards the devotee as greater than Himself —
this the whole world cannot understand.

রসময় বিগ্রহ লাবণ্যময় দেহ ।
সকল সম্পদ তনু নিরমিল তেঁহ ॥ ৬৪০ ॥

*rasamaẏa bigraha lābaṇyamaẏa deha |*
*sakala sampada tanu niramila teṁha || 640 ||*

*Word for word:* rasamaya vigraha — a form full of rasa; lavanyamaya deha — a body full of beauty; sakala sampada tanu — a body of every splendour; niramila tenha — He manifested (lit. "made")

**640.** A form full of rasa, a body full of beauty,
a body endowed with every splendour — so He has manifested Himself.

বিলাস-বিনোদ-লীলা বিনে নাহি আর ।
নির্গুণ বলিয়া গালি দেই কোন্ ছার ॥ ৬৪১ ॥

*bilāsa-binoda-līlā bine nāhi āra |*
*nirguṇa baliẏā gāli dei kon chāra || 641 ||*

*Word for word:* vilasa-vinoda-lila — play, sport and lila; bine nahi ara — apart from these there is nothing; nirguna baliya — calling Him "without qualities"; gali dei — reviles; kon chhara — what wretch

**641.** He has nothing but play, sport and lila;
what wretch reviles Him by calling Him "without qualities"?

মায়ার কারণে আপে না হয় বেকত ।
ভক্তদেহে বিনোদ করয়ে অবিরত ॥ ৬৪২ ॥

*māẏāra kāraṇe āpe nā haẏa bekata |*
*bhaktadehe binoda karaẏe abirata || 642 ||*

*Word for word:* mayara karane — by [His] maya (yogamaya); ape na haya bekata — He does not openly manifest Himself; bhakta-dehe — in the devotee's body; vinoda karaye — He plays; avirata — unceasingly

**642.** By His maya He does not openly manifest Himself[^16-6]
and plays unceasingly in the body of His devotee.

ভক্তের ভোজন নিদ্রা শয়ন বিলাস ।
তাহাতেই কৃষ্ণসুখ হয়ে ত প্রকাশ ॥ ৬৪৩ ॥

*bhaktera bhojana nidrā śaẏana bilāsa |*
*tāhātei kṛṣṇasukha haẏe ta prakāśa || 643 ||*

*Word for word:* bhaktera — of the devotee; bhojana nidra shayana vilasa — eating, sleeping, resting, enjoyment; tahatei — in these very things; krishna-sukha — Krishna's happiness; haye ta prakasha — becomes manifest

**643.** The devotee's eating, sleeping, resting and enjoyment —
in these very things Krishna's happiness becomes manifest.

ভক্তজন আর-জন আচরণ এক ।
দেহের স্বভাবে এক দেখে পরতেখ ॥ ৬৪৪ ॥

*bhaktajana āra-jana ācaraṇa eka |*
*dehera sbabhābe eka dekhe paratekha || 644 ||*

*Word for word:* bhakta-jana ara-jana — devotees and other people; acharana eka — conduct is the same; dehera svabhave — by the nature of the body; eka dekhe — they look the same; paratekha — to the eye

**644.** The conduct of devotees and of other people is the same;
by the nature of the body they look the same to the eye.

পরতেখ দেখি যার মানুষ-গেয়ানে ।
কোথা কৃষ্ণ মানুষ সে দেখিয়ে নয়ানে ॥ ৬৪৫ ॥

*paratekha dekhi yāra mānuṣa-geẏāne |*
*kothā kṛṣṇa mānuṣa se dekhiẏe naẏāne || 645 ||*

*Word for word:* paratekha dekhi — seeing with the eyes; yara manusha-geyane — those who take [them] for men; kotha krishna — "where is Krishna?"; manusha se dekhiye nayane — "with my eyes I see a man"

**645.** Those who, seeing with their eyes, take [them] for men
[say]: 'Where is Krishna? With my eyes I see a man.

কৃষ্ণ সর্বেশ্বরেশ্বর নির্গুণ ব্রহ্ম ।
মানুষ-শরীরে করে প্রাকৃতের কর্ম ॥ ৬৪৬ ॥

*kṛṣṇa sarbeśbareśbara nirguṇa brahma |*
*mānuṣa-śarīre kare prākṛtera karma || 646 ||*

*Word for word:* krishna — Krishna; sarveshvareshvara — Lord of all lords; nirguna brahma — the Brahman beyond the gunas; manusha-sharire — in a human body; kare prakritera karma — does mundane deeds

**646.** Krishna, the Lord of all lords, the Brahman beyond the gunas —
can He be doing mundane deeds in a human body?'

ইহা বলি নাহি মানে যে অধম জন ।
ভক্তদেহে প্রভুদেহ জানয়ে উত্তম ॥ ৬৪৭ ॥

*ihā bali nāhi māne ye adhama jana |*
*bhaktadehe prabhudeha jānaẏe uttama || 647 ||*

*Word for word:* iha bali — saying this; nahi mane — does not accept; ye adhama jana — the low man; bhakta-dehe — in the devotee's body; prabhu-deha — the Lord's body; janaye uttama — the elevated one knows

**647.** Saying this, the low man does not accept [it];
but the elevated one knows the Lord's body in the devotee's body.[^16-7]

এই অনুমান-কথা মোর চিত্তে লয় ।
আপনে বুঝিয়া চিত্তে কর যে যুয়ায় ॥ ৬৪৮ ॥

*ei anumāna-kathā mora citte laẏa |*
*āpane bujhiẏā citte kara ye yuẏāẏa || 648 ||*

*Word for word:* ei anumana-katha — this reasoning; mora chitte laya — is what I think; apane bujhiya — understanding yourself; chitte kara — decide in your heart; ye yuyaya — what is right

**648.** Such is my reasoning, this is how I think;
understand for yourself and decide in your heart what is right.

সদা কৃষ্ণময় তনু বৈষ্ণব জানিয়ে ।
শ্রীবেদ-পুরাণ-ভাগবতেতে শুনিয়ে ॥ ৬৪৯ ॥

*sadā kṛṣṇamaẏa tanu baiṣṇaba jāniẏe |*
*śrībeda-purāṇa-bhāgabatete śuniẏe || 649 ||*

*Word for word:* sada krishnamaya tanu — a body always full of Krishna; vaishnava — the Vaishnava's; janiye — know; sri-veda-purana-bhagavatete — in the Vedas, Puranas and Bhagavata; shuniye — we hear

**649.** Know that a Vaishnava's body is always full of Krishna;
so we hear in the Vedas, the Puranas and the Bhagavata.

যার পদপাংশুতে পবিত্র সর্বজন ।
গঙ্গা-আদি করি তীর্থ সভার পাবন ॥ ৬৫০ ॥

*yāra padapāṃśute pabitra sarbajana |*
*gaṅgā-ādi kari tīrtha sabhāra pābana || 650 ||*

*Word for word:* yara pada-pamshute — by the dust of whose feet; pavitra sarvajana — all people are purified; ganga-adi kari tirtha — the Ganga and other holy places; sabhara pavana — the purifier of all

**650.** By the dust of his feet all people are purified;
he purifies even the Ganga and all the other holy places.

হেন জনার দেহে যে অধম করে বাদ ।
না বুঝিয়া সেই জন করে অপরাধ ॥ ৬৫১ ॥

*hena janāra dehe ye adhama kare bāda |*
*nā bujhiẏā sei jana kare aparādha || 651 ||*

*Word for word:* hena janara dehe — about the body of such a person; ye adhama kare vada — the low man who disputes; na bujhiya — not understanding; sei jana kare aparadha — he commits an offence

**651.** The low man who disputes about the body of such a person
commits an offence out of incomprehension."

এইমত দামোদর-মুরারি-গুপতে ।
নিবড়িল কথা দোঁহে হরষিত-চিতে ॥ ৬৫২ ॥

*eimata dāmodara-murāri-gupate |*
*nibaṛila kathā doṁhe haraṣita-cite || 652 ||*

*Word for word:* eimata — thus; damodara-murari-gupate — Damodara and Murari Gupta; nibadila katha — concluded the talk; donhe — both; harashita-chite — with gladdened hearts

**652.** Thus Damodara and Murari Gupta
concluded their talk, both with gladdened hearts.

আপনার দেহ প্রভু দেহ নাহি গণে ।
ভকত-জনার দেহ নিজ করি মানে ॥ ৬৫৩ ॥

*āpanāra deha prabhu deha nāhi gaṇe |*
*bhakata-janāra deha nija kari māne || 653 ||*

*Word for word:* apanara deha — His own body; prabhu — the Lord; deha nahi gane — does not count as a body; bhakata-janara deha — the devotee's body; nija kari mane — regards as His own

**653.** The Lord does not count His own body as a body,
but regards the body of His devotee as His own.

এতেক বিচারি গেল সেই দুইজনে ।
শুনি আনন্দিত কহে এ দাস লোচনে ॥ ৬৫৪ ॥

*eteka bicāri gela sei duijane |*
*śuni ānandita kahe e dāsa locane || 654 ||*

*Word for word:* eteka vichari — having reasoned thus; gela sei dui-jane — the two departed; shuni — hearing; anandita kahe — joyfully tells; e dasa lochane — this Lochana Dasa

**654.** Having reasoned thus, the two departed;
hearing of it, this Lochana Dasa speaks with joy.

*Raga vibhasa; disha: "Ah, ah!" Refrain: "Ah, ah, my life!"*

সর্বজন শুন আর অপরূপ কথা ।
যাহা শুনিলে ঘুচিবেক অন্তরের ব্যথা ॥ ৬৫৫ ॥

*sarbajana śuna āra aparūpa kathā |*
*yāhā śunile ghucibeka antarera byathā || 655 ||*

*Word for word:* sarvajana shuna — listen, everyone; ara aparupa katha — another wondrous account; yaha shunile — hearing which; ghuchibeka — will be dispelled; antarera vyatha — the pain in the heart

**655.** Listen, everyone, to another wondrous account;
when you hear it, the pain in your heart will be dispelled.

গুরুর আশ্রমে সব বেদতত্ত্ব জানি ।
ঘরেরে আইলা জগন্নাথ দ্বিজমণি ॥ ৬৫৬ ॥

*gurura āśrame saba bedatattba jāni |*
*gharere āilā jagannātha dbijamaṇi || 656 ||*

*Word for word:* gurura ashrame — in the teacher's ashrama; saba veda-tattva jani — having learned the whole essence of the Vedas; gharere aila — came home; jagannatha dvija-mani — Jagannatha, the jewel of brahmanas

**656.** Having learned the whole essence of the Vedas in his teacher's ashrama,
Jagannatha, the jewel of brahmanas, came home.[^16-8]

দৈবনির্বন্ধে তার জ্বর আইল দেহে ।
বিপরীত জ্বর দেখি তরাস উঠয়ে ॥ ৬৫৭ ॥

*daibanirbandhe tāra jbara āila dehe |*
*biparīta jbara dekhi tarāsa uṭhaẏe || 657 ||*

*Word for word:* daiva-nirbandhe — by providence; tara jvara aila dehe — a fever came upon his body; viparita jvara dekhi — seeing the grievous fever; tarasa uthaye — fear arises

**657.** By the will of providence a fever seized his body;
seeing the grievous fever, all were struck with fear.

শচীর কান্দনা অতি ব্যাকুল দেখিয়া ।
প্রবোধ করেন প্রভু তত্ত্ব বুঝাইয়া ॥ ৬৫৮ ॥

*śacīra kāndanā ati byākula dekhiẏā |*
*prabodha karena prabhu tattba bujhāiẏā || 658 ||*

*Word for word:* shachira kandana — Shachi's weeping; ati vyakula dekhiya — seeing her in great distress; prabodha karena prabhu — the Lord consoles; tattva bujhaiya — explaining the truth

**658.** Seeing Shachi weeping in utter distress,
the Lord consoles her, explaining the truth:

মরণ সভার মাতা আছয়ে নিশ্চয় ।
ব্রহ্মা রুদ্র সমুদ্র পর্বত হিমালয় ॥ ৬৫৯ ॥

*maraṇa sabhāra mātā āchaẏe niścaẏa |*
*brahmā rudra samudra parbata himālaẏa || 659 ||*

*Word for word:* marana sabhara — death for all; mata — mother; achhaye nishchaya — is certain; brahma rudra — Brahma, Rudra; samudra parvata himalaya — oceans, mountains, the Himalaya

**659.** "Mother, death is certain for all:
for Brahma and Rudra, the oceans, the mountains and the Himalaya,[^16-9]

ইন্দ্র বরুণ অগ্নি কালে সব নাশে ।
মরণ লাগিয়া কেনে পাইছ তরাসে ॥ ৬৬০ ॥

*indra baruṇa agni kāle saba nāśe |*
*maraṇa lāgiẏā kene pāicha tarāse || 660 ||*

*Word for word:* indra varuna agni — Indra, Varuna, Agni; kale saba nashe — time destroys all; marana lagiya — on account of death; kene paichha tarase — why are you afraid

**660.** Indra, Varuna, Agni — time destroys them all;
why are you so afraid of death?

তোর বন্ধুগণ যত আনহ এখন ।
সভে মিলি কৃষ্ণনাম করাহ স্মরণ ॥ ৬৬১ ॥

*tora bandhugaṇa yata ānaha ekhana |*
*sabhe mili kṛṣṇanāma karāha smaraṇa || 661 ||*

*Word for word:* tora bandhugana yata — all your kinsfolk and friends; anaha ekhana — bring now; sabhe mili — all together; krishna-nama karaha smarana — let them help remember Krishna's name

**661.** Call all your kinsfolk and friends now:
let them all together help [him] remember the name of Krishna."

বান্ধবের কার্য মৃত্যুকালে সত্য জানি ।
স্মরণ করায় প্রভু দেব যদুমণি ॥ ৬৬২ ॥

*bāndhabera kārya mṛtyukāle satya jāni |*
*smaraṇa karāẏa prabhu deba yadumaṇi || 662 ||*

*Word for word:* bandhavera karya — the duty of kin; mrityu-kale — at the time of death; satya jani — knowing it to be true; smarana karaya — has [him] helped to remember; prabhu deva yadumani — the Lord, the divine Jewel of the Yadus

**662.** Knowing that at the time of death this is truly the duty of kin,
the Lord, the divine Jewel of the Yadus, has [His father] helped to remember [Krishna].

শুনিঞা কুটুম্ব-বন্ধুজন সব আইলা ।
প্রভুর বাড়িতে আসি মিশ্রেরে বেড়িলা ॥ ৬৬৩ ॥

*śuniñā kuṭumba-bandhujana saba āilā |*
*prabhura bāṛite āsi miśrere beṛilā || 663 ||*

*Word for word:* shunina — hearing; kutumba-bandhu-jana saba aila — all kinsfolk and friends came; prabhura badite asi — coming to the Lord's house; mishrere bedila — surrounded Mishra

**663.** Hearing this, all the kinsfolk and friends came;
coming to the Lord's house, they surrounded Mishra.

পরিণত-বুদ্ধি যত বন্ধুগণ ছিলা ।
কাল প্রত্যাসন্ন দেখি যুকতি করিলা ॥ ৬৬৪ ॥

*pariṇata-buddhi yata bandhugaṇa chilā |*
*kāla pratyāsanna dekhi yukati karilā || 664 ||*

*Word for word:* parinata-buddhi — mature in judgement; yata bandhugana chhila — all the friends there were; kala pratyasanna dekhi — seeing the hour near; yukati karila — took counsel

**664.** Those friends who were mature in judgement,
seeing that the hour was near, took counsel.

বিশ্বম্ভর বোলে মা গো কি কর বিলম্ব ।
এইক্ষণে চাহি যত ইষ্ট-কুটুম্ব ॥ ৬৬৫ ॥

*biśbambhara bole mā go ki kara bilamba |*
*eikṣaṇe cāhi yata iṣṭa-kuṭumba || 665 ||*

*Word for word:* vishvambhara bole — Vishvambhara says; ma go — mother; ki kara vilamba — why do you delay; ei-kshane chahi — at once are needed; yata ishta-kutumba — all near ones and kin

**665.** Vishvambhara says: "Mother, why do you delay?
All our near ones and kin are needed at once."

ইহা বলি মায়ে-পোয়ে ধরি নিল তারে ।
বন্ধুর সহিত গেলা জাহ্নবীর তীরে ॥ ৬৬৬ ॥

*ihā bali māẏe-poẏe dhari nila tāre |*
*bandhura sahita gelā jāhnabīra tīre || 666 ||*

*Word for word:* iha bali — saying this; maye-poye — mother and son; dhari nila tare — lifted him up; bandhura sahita — with the kinsfolk; gela jahnavira tire — went to the bank of the Jahnavi

**666.** Saying this, mother and son lifted him up
and with their kinsfolk went to the bank of the Jahnavi.

বাপের চরণ ধরি কান্দে বিশ্বম্ভর ।
সম্বরিতে নারে অশ্রু গদগদ-স্বর ॥ ৬৬৭ ॥

*bāpera caraṇa dhari kānde biśbambhara |*
*sambarite nāre aśru gadagada-sbara || 667 ||*

*Word for word:* bapera charana dhari — clasping His father's feet; kande vishvambhara — Vishvambhara weeps; samvarite nare ashru — cannot hold back tears; gadagada-svara — with faltering voice

**667.** Clasping His father's feet, Vishvambhara weeps;
He cannot hold back His tears, His voice falters:

আমারে এড়িয়া বাপ কোথা যাহ তুমি ।
বাপ বলি আর ডাক নাহি দিব আমি ॥ ৬৬৮ ॥

*āmāre eṛiẏā bāpa kothā yāha tumi |*
*bāpa bali āra ḍāka nāhi diba āmi || 668 ||*

*Word for word:* amare ediya — leaving Me; bapa — father; kotha yaha tumi — where are you going; bapa bali — "Father!"; ara daka nahi diba ami — I shall call no more

**668.** "Leaving Me, father, where are you going?
Never again shall I call anyone 'Father!'

আজি হৈতে শূন্য হৈল এ ঘর আমার ।
আর না দেখিব বাপ চরণ তোমার ॥ ৬৬৯ ॥

*āji haite śūnya haila e ghara āmāra |*
*āra nā dekhiba bāpa caraṇa tomāra || 669 ||*

*Word for word:* aji haite — from today; shunya haila — has become empty; e ghara amara — this house of Mine; ara na dekhiba — I shall see no more; bapa — father; charana tomara — your feet

**669.** From today this house of Mine is empty;
never again shall I see your feet, father.

আজি দশদিক শূন্য আন্ধিয়ার ঘোরে ।
না পঢ়াবে যতন করি ধরি নিজ করে ॥ ৬৭০ ॥

*āji daśadika śūnya āndhiẏāra ghore |*
*nā paṛhābe yatana kari dhari nija kare || 670 ||*

*Word for word:* aji dashadika shunya — today the ten directions are empty; andhiyara ghore — in pitch darkness; na padhabe — will not teach; yatana kari — lovingly; dhari nija kare — holding by the hand

**670.** Today all ten directions are empty, all is pitch dark:
no one will teach Me so lovingly, holding Me by the hand."

এছন অমিঞা-বাণী শুনি জগন্নাথ ।
সকরুণ-কণ্ঠে নিঃসরে নাহি বাত ॥ ৬৭১ ॥

*echana amiñā-bāṇī śuni jagannātha |*
*sakaruṇa-kaṇṭhe niḥsare nāhi bāta || 671 ||*

*Word for word:* echhana amina-vani — such nectarean words; shuni jagannatha — hearing, Jagannatha; sakaruna-kanthe — with grief in his throat; nihsare nahi bata — no word comes out

**671.** Hearing such nectarean words,
Jagannatha in his anguish cannot utter a word.

গদগদ-স্বরে বোলে শুন বিশ্বম্ভর ।
কহিল না হয় মোর যে ছিল অন্তর ॥ ৬৭২ ॥

*gadagada-sbare bole śuna biśbambhara |*
*kahila nā haẏa mora ye chila antara || 672 ||*

*Word for word:* gadagada-svare bole — says in a faltering voice; shuna vishvambhara — listen, Vishvambhara; kahila na haya — cannot be told; mora ye chhila antara — what was in my heart

**672.** In a faltering voice he says: "Listen, Vishvambhara:
what was in my heart cannot be told.

রঘুনাথ-চরণে সঁপিনু মুঞি তোমা ।
তুমি পাছে কোন কালে পাসরিবে আমা ॥ ৬৭৩ ॥

*raghunātha-caraṇe saṁpinu muñi tomā |*
*tumi pāche kona kāle pāsaribe āmā || 673 ||*

*Word for word:* raghunatha-charane — to the feet of Raghunatha; sampinu muni toma — I have entrusted You; tumi pachhe — lest You; kona kale — at any time; pasaribe ama — forget me

**673.** I have entrusted You to the feet of Raghunatha;[^16-10]
only may You never at any time forget me."

ইহা বলি হরি হরি করয়ে স্মরণ ।
গঙ্গাজলে নামাইল সকল ব্রাহ্মণ ॥ ৬৭৪ ॥

*ihā bali hari hari karaẏe smaraṇa |*
*gaṅgājale nāmāila sakala brāhmaṇa || 674 ||*

*Word for word:* iha bali — saying this; hari hari karaye smarana — remembers: "Hari, Hari!"; gangajale namaila — lowered into the Ganga's water; sakala brahmana — all the brahmanas

**674.** Saying this, he gives himself to remembrance: "Hari, Hari!"
All the brahmanas lowered him into the water of the Ganga.[^16-11]

গলায় তুলিয়া দিল তুলসীর দাম ।
চতুর্দিগে বন্ধুগণে লয় হরিনাম ॥ ৬৭৫ ॥

*galāẏa tuliẏā dila tulasīra dāma |*
*caturdige bandhugaṇe laẏa harināma || 675 ||*

*Word for word:* galaya tuliya dila — placed around the neck; tulasira dama — a garland of tulasi; chaturdige — on all sides; bandhugane laya harinama — kinsfolk and friends chant Hari's name

**675.** They placed a garland of tulasi around his neck;
on all sides kinsfolk and friends chant the name of Hari.

চতুর্দিকে হয় হরিগুণ-সংকীর্তন ।
হেনকালে দ্বিজোত্তমের বৈকুণ্ঠে গমন ॥ ৬৭৬ ॥

*caturdike haẏa hariguṇa-saṃkīrtana |*
*henakāle dbijottamera baikuṇṭhe gamana || 676 ||*

*Word for word:* chaturdike — on all sides; haya hariguna-sankirtana — there is sankirtana of Hari's qualities; hena-kale — at that moment; dvijottamera — of the best of brahmanas; vaikunthe gamana — going to Vaikuntha

**676.** On all sides resounds the sankirtana of Hari's qualities;
and at that moment the best of brahmanas went to Vaikuntha.[^16-12]

বৈকুণ্ঠে চলিলা দ্বিজ রথ-আরোহণে ।
ধরণী বিদার দেই শচীর ক্রন্দনে ॥ ৬৭৭ ॥

*baikuṇṭhe calilā dbija ratha-ārohaṇe |*
*dharaṇī bidāra dei śacīra krandane || 677 ||*

*Word for word:* vaikunthe chalila — departed for Vaikuntha; dvija — the brahmana; ratha-arohane — mounting a chariot; dharani vidara dei — the earth is rent; shachira krandane — at Shachi's wailing

**677.** Mounting a chariot, the brahmana departed for Vaikuntha;
at Shachi's wailing the earth is rent asunder.

পতির চরণ ধরি কান্দে লোটাইয়া ।
মো যাঙ আমারে লহ সংহতি করিয়া ॥ ৬৭৮ ॥

*patira caraṇa dhari kānde loṭāiẏā |*
*mo yāṅa āmāre laha saṃhati kariẏā || 678 ||*

*Word for word:* patira charana dhari — clasping her husband's feet; kande lotaiya — weeps, rolling on the ground; mo yanga — I shall go; amare laha — take me; samhati kariya — with you

**678.** Clasping her husband's feet, she weeps, rolling on the ground:
"I shall go! Take me with you!

এতকাল ধরি তোর সেবা কৈলুঁ মুঞি ।
বৈকুণ্ঠে চলিলা তুমি আমি রহিলাম ভুঞি ॥ ৬৭৯ ॥

*etakāla dhari tora sebā kailuṁ muñi |*
*baikuṇṭhe calilā tumi āmi rahilāma bhuñi || 679 ||*

*Word for word:* eta-kala dhari — for so long; tora seva kailun muni — I served you; vaikunthe chalila tumi — you went to Vaikuntha; ami rahilama bhuni — I remained on the earth

**679.** For so long I served you;
you have gone to Vaikuntha, and I am left on the earth.

শয়নে ভোজনে মুঞি সেবা কৈলুঁ তোর ।
আজি দশদিক শূন্য অন্ধকার ঘোর ॥ ৬৮০ ॥

*śaẏane bhojane muñi sebā kailuṁ tora |*
*āji daśadika śūnya andhakāra ghora || 680 ||*

*Word for word:* shayane bhojane — at rest and at meals; muni seva kailun tora — I served you; aji dashadika shunya — today the ten directions are empty; andhakara ghora — pitch darkness

**680.** I served you at your rest and at your meals;
today all ten directions are empty, all is pitch dark.

অনাথিনী হৈলুঁ তোর ছোট পুত্র লঞা ।
নিমাই থাকিবে কোথা কার মুখ চাঞা ॥ ৬৮১ ॥

*anāthinī hailuṁ tora choṭa putra lañā |*
*nimāi thākibe kothā kāra mukha cāñā || 681 ||*

*Word for word:* anathini hailun — I am left forsaken; tora chhota putra lana — with your younger son; nimai thakibe kotha — where will Nimai live; kara mukha chana — looking to whose face

**681.** I am left forsaken with your younger son;
where will Nimai live, to whose face will He look?

জগত-দুর্লভ তোর তনয় নিমাঞি ।
সব পাসরিয়া যাহ আমার গোসাঞি ॥ ৬৮২ ॥

*jagata-durlabha tora tanaẏa nimāñi |*
*saba pāsariẏā yāha āmāra gosāñi || 682 ||*

*Word for word:* jagata-durlabha — rare in the world; tora tanaya nimani — your son Nimai; saba pasariya — forgetting everything; yaha — you go; amara gosani — my lord

**682.** Your son Nimai, rare in all the world —
forgetting it all, you are going, my lord!"

মায়ের কান্দনা দেখি বাপের মরণ ।
কান্দয়ে শচীর সুত ঝরয়ে নয়ন ॥ ৬৮৩ ॥

*māẏera kāndanā dekhi bāpera maraṇa |*
*kāndaẏe śacīra suta jharaẏe naẏana || 683 ||*

*Word for word:* mayera kandana dekhi — seeing His mother's weeping; bapera marana — His father's death; kandaye shachira suta — Shachi's son weeps; jharaye nayana — tears stream from His eyes

**683.** Seeing His mother's weeping and His father's death,
Shachi's son weeps, tears streaming from His eyes.

গজমতি-হার যেন গাঁথিল সূতায় ।
নয়ানে গলয়ে জল বিশাল হিয়ায় ॥ ৬৮৪ ॥

*gajamati-hāra yena gāṁthila sūtāẏa |*
*naẏāne galaẏe jala biśāla hiẏāẏa || 684 ||*

*Word for word:* gajamati-hara yena — like a pearl necklace; ganthila sutaya — strung on a thread; nayane galaye jala — tears flow from the eyes; vishala hiyaya — onto the broad chest

**684.** Like a pearl necklace strung on a thread,
the tears flow from His eyes onto His broad chest.

ভক্তজন বন্ধুজন হাহাকার করে ।
প্রভুর কান্দনায় কান্দে সকল সংসারে ॥ ৬৮৫ ॥

*bhaktajana bandhujana hāhākāra kare |*
*prabhura kāndanāẏa kānde sakala saṃsāre || 685 ||*

*Word for word:* bhakta-jana bandhu-jana — devotees and friends; hahakara kare — cry "alas!"; prabhura kandanaya — at the Lord's weeping; kande sakala samsare — the whole world weeps

**685.** Devotees and friends cry out, "Alas, alas!";
at the Lord's weeping the whole world weeps.

শান্ত করাইল সভে মধুর-বচনে ।
সৃষ্টি নষ্ট হয় প্রভু তোমার ক্রন্দনে ॥ ৬৮৬ ॥

*śānta karāila sabhe madhura-bacane |*
*sṛṣṭi naṣṭa haẏa prabhu tomāra krandane || 686 ||*

*Word for word:* shanta karaila sabhe — all soothed; madhura-bachane — with sweet words; srishti nashta haya — creation perishes; prabhu — O Lord; tomara krandane — by Your weeping

**686.** All soothed [Him] with sweet words:
"Lord, at Your weeping creation perishes!"

নারীগণে প্রবোধ করিল শচীদেবী ।
বিশ্বম্ভর দেখি শচী সব পাসরিবি ॥ ৬৮৭ ॥

*nārīgaṇe prabodha karila śacīdebī |*
*biśbambhara dekhi śacī saba pāsaribi || 687 ||*

*Word for word:* narigane prabodha karila — the women consoled; shachidevi — Shachi-devi; vishvambhara dekhi — looking at Vishvambhara; shachi — Shachi; saba pasaribi — you will forget everything

**687.** The women consoled Shachi-devi:
"Looking at Vishvambhara, Shachi, you will forget everything."

আপনে সুধীর প্রভু সব সম্বরিয়া ।
কাল-যথোচিত কর্ম করিল সৎক্রিয়া ॥ ৬৮৮ ॥

*āpane sudhīra prabhu saba sambariẏā |*
*kāla-yathocita karma karila satkriẏā || 688 ||*

*Word for word:* apane sudhira prabhu — the Lord, steadfast Himself; saba samvariya — restraining everything; kala-yathochita karma — the acts befitting the time; karila sat-kriya — performed the rites

**688.** The Lord, steadfast Himself, restraining everything within,
performed the rites befitting the time.

তবে বেদবিধি-মতে যে ছিল উচিত ।
করিল বাপের কর্ম কুটুম্ব-বেষ্টিত ॥ ৬৮৯ ॥

*tabe bedabidhi-mate ye chila ucita |*
*karila bāpera karma kuṭumba-beṣṭita || 689 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe — then; veda-vidhi-mate — according to Vedic injunction; ye chhila uchita — as was proper; karila bapera karma — performed his father's rites; kutumba-veshtita — surrounded by kinsfolk

**689.** Then, surrounded by His kinsfolk, He performed His father's rites
as the Vedic injunctions prescribe.

পিতৃবৎসল প্রভু পিতৃযজ্ঞ কৈল ।
ক্রমে ক্রমে যথাবিধি ব্রাহ্মণ পূজিল ॥ ৬৯০ ॥

*pitṛbatsala prabhu pitṛyajña kaila |*
*krame krame yathābidhi brāhmaṇa pūjila || 690 ||*

*Word for word:* pitri-vatsala prabhu — the Lord, loving His father; pitri-yajna kaila — performed the offering to the ancestors; krame krame — in due order; yathavidhi — according to rule; brahmana pujila — honoured the brahmanas

**690.** The Lord, loving His father, performed the offering to the ancestors
and, in due order and according to rule, honoured the brahmanas.

তোয়াধার অন্ন ভোজনাদি দ্রব্য যত ।
ব্রাহ্মণেরে দিলা প্রভু পিতৃভকত ॥ ৬৯১ ॥

*toẏādhāra anna bhojanādi drabya yata |*
*brāhmaṇere dilā prabhu pitṛbhakata || 691 ||*

*Word for word:* toyadhara — water vessels; anna — rice; bhojana-adi dravya yata — food and all other gifts; brahmanere dila prabhu — the Lord gave to the brahmanas; pitri-bhakata — devoted to His father

**691.** Water vessels, rice, food and all other gifts
the Lord, devoted to His father, gave to the brahmanas.

জগন্নাথ-বৈকুণ্ঠগমন এই কথা ।
আপনে সে দ্বিজোত্তম বিশ্বম্ভর-পিতা ॥ ৬৯২ ॥

*jagannātha-baikuṇṭhagamana ei kathā |*
*āpane se dbijottama biśbambhara-pitā || 692 ||*

*Word for word:* jagannatha-vaikuntha-gamana — Jagannatha's going to Vaikuntha; ei katha — this is the account; apane — Himself; se dvijottama — that best of brahmanas; vishvambhara-pita — the father of Vishvambhara

**692.** This is the account of Jagannatha's going to Vaikuntha —
of that best of brahmanas who was the father of Vishvambhara Himself.

শ্রদ্ধাবন্ত জন যদি এই কথা শুনে ।
বৈকুণ্ঠে চলয়ে সেই গঙ্গায় মরণে ॥ ৬৯৩ ॥

*śraddhābanta jana yadi ei kathā śune |*
*baikuṇṭhe calaẏe sei gaṅgāẏa maraṇe || 693 ||*

*Word for word:* shraddhavanta jana — a person with faith; yadi ei katha shune — if he hears this account; vaikunthe chalaye sei — he goes to Vaikuntha; gangaya marane — [as] by death at the Ganga

**693.** If a person hears this account with faith,
he goes to Vaikuntha, as one who dies at the Ganga.

গোরাচাঁদ দেখি শচী ছাড়য়ে নিশ্বাস ।
পিতৃশূন্য পুত্র পাছে পায়েন তরাস ॥ ৬৯৪ ॥

*gorācāṁda dekhi śacī chāṛaẏe niśbāsa |*
*pitṛśūnya putra pāche pāẏena tarāsa || 694 ||*

*Word for word:* gorachanda dekhi — looking at Gorachand; shachi chhadaye nishvasa — Shachi sighs; pitri-shunya putra — the fatherless son; pachhe payena tarasa — lest He fall into despair

**694.** Looking at Gorachand, Shachi sighs:
"May the fatherless son not fall into despair!

বিদ্যারসে চিত্ত যদি ডুবয়ে ইহার ।
তবে মনঃসুখে পুত্র গোঙায় আমার ॥ ৬৯৫ ॥

*bidyārase citta yadi ḍubaẏe ihāra |*
*tabe manaḥsukhe putra goṅāẏa āmāra || 695 ||*

*Word for word:* vidya-rase — in the taste of learning; chitta yadi dubaye ihara — if His heart is immersed; tabe — then; manah-sukhe — happily; putra gongaya amara — my son will pass His days

**695.** If His heart becomes immersed in the taste of learning,
then my son will pass His days happily."

হেন অদ্ভুত কথা শুন সর্বজন ।
চৈতন্যচরিত্র কিছু কহয়ে লোচন ॥ ৬৯৬ ॥

*hena adbhuta kathā śuna sarbajana |*
*caitanyacaritra kichu kahaẏe locana || 696 ||*

*Word for word:* hena adbhuta katha — this wondrous account; shuna sarvajana — listen, everyone; chaitanya-charitra kichhu — something of Chaitanya's deeds; kahaye lochana — Lochana tells

**696.** Listen, everyone, to this wondrous account:
Lochana tells something of the deeds of Chaitanya.

[^16-1]: Ekadashi is the eleventh day of each lunar fortnight, a day of fasting; "anna" means grain (rice and the like). Bhaktisiddhanta's summary (en/14) stresses that by forbidding His mother to eat grain on Ekadashi the Lord taught the whole world. In Murari — 1.07.18–20.
[^16-2]: In Murari (1.07.21) the Lord says: "I am going. Guard the body of your son, which will for half a moment become motionless." The conversation of Damodara and Murari (vv. 629–653) interprets exactly these words.
[^16-3]: Literally "maya". In Murari (1.07.24, 27) the same question concerns the Lord's "yogamaya": when said of the Lord, maya is His internal power, yogamaya.
[^16-4]: "Nirguna" here means beyond the material gunas, not "devoid of form and qualities": in vv. 640–641 Lochana Dasa expressly condemns those who call the Lord "nirguna" in an impersonal sense. In v. 640 "niramila" literally means "made": the Lord Himself manifests His eternal form.
[^16-5]: The line also admits the reading: "He Himself is the Lord, and that one (the devotee) depends on Him." From the sense of the whole argument (vv. 624, 653), Lochana Dasa is explaining the words "I am going; the body is your son": in Gaura the Lord Himself plays the part of His own devotee, and that people see "two" here is the working of His maya (yogamaya). The eternal distinction between the Lord and the devotee (vv. 637, 639) is not denied by this.
[^16-6]: Here maya is the power by which the Lord conceals Himself, that is, yogamaya.
[^16-7]: The reasoning of vv. 634–653 follows Murari (1.08.1–7): the Lord enters the heart of the devotee and regards the devotee's body as His own. In the Gaudiya Vaishnava understanding (Bhaktisiddhanta), the Lord's body is not different from Himself and is not material, and Mahaprabhu is Krishna Himself who has assumed the form and feeling of His own devotee (bhakta-rupa); what is said of the "devotee's body" therefore does not mean that in Gaura the Lord uses a separate, human body.
[^16-8]: The subject of the line is Jagannatha Mishra; cf. Murari (1.08.13): the Lord's father too studied Vedanta and other scriptures.
[^16-9]: According to the Puranas, Brahma and Rudra, who govern the universe, are also not eternal in these offices: at the end of Brahma's life the universe is dissolved.
[^16-10]: Raghunatha ("Lord of the Raghu dynasty") is Sri Ramachandra; Jagannatha says the same words in Murari (1.08.17).
[^16-11]: The custom of antarjali: the dying person is carried to the bank of the Ganga and immersed waist-deep in its water so that he may leave the body remembering Hari.
[^16-12]: Jagannatha Mishra is an eternal associate of the Lord (in the Gaura-ganoddesha-dipika — Nanda Maharaja and Vasudeva); his departure is not an ordinary death, and Lochana Dasa speaks of it as leaving for Vaikuntha on a chariot.

---

# Adi-khanda, part 9 (portion 17)

*Pauganda-lila (conclusion): Shachi entrusts her son to the pandits; studies under Vishnu Pandita, Sudarshana and Gangadasa; the first meeting with Vallabhacharya's daughter on the way to the Ganga; Vanamali Acharya's matchmaking — Shachi's refusal, the matchmaker's lament, his meeting with the Lord and Shachi's consent; Vallabhacharya gladly agrees to give his daughter*

*Raga dhanashi; disha: "Ah, ah!"*

একদিন শচী করে ধরি গৌরহরি ।
পঢ়িতে গৌরাঙ্গ দিল নিয়োজিত করি ॥ ৬৯৭ ॥

*ekadina śacī kare dhari gaurahari |*
*paṛhite gaurāṅga dila niẏojita kari || 697 ||*

*Word for word:* ekadina — one day; shachi — Shachi; kare dhari gaurahari — taking Gaurahari by the hand; padhite — to study; gauranga dila niyojita kari — put Gauranga

**697.** One day Shachi, taking Gaurahari by the hand,
put Gauranga to His studies.

সকল পণ্ডিত-স্থানে পুত্র সমর্পিয়া ।
বোলয়ে কাতরে দেবী বিনয় করিয়া ॥ ৬৯৮ ॥

*sakala paṇḍita-sthāne putra samarpiẏā |*
*bolaẏe kātare debī binaẏa kariẏā || 698 ||*

*Word for word:* sakala pandita-sthane — to all the pandits; putra samarpiya — entrusting her son; bolaye katare — speaks plaintively; devi — the goddess; vinaya kariya — humbly

**698.** Entrusting her son to all the pandits,
the goddess speaks humbly and plaintively:

পঢ়াইও মোর পুত্রে তোমরা ঠাকুর ।
রাখিবে আপন কাছে না রাখিবে দূর ॥ ৬৯৯ ॥

*paṛhāio mora putre tomarā ṭhākura |*
*rākhibe āpana kāche nā rākhibe dūra || 699 ||*

*Word for word:* padhaio — teach; mora putre — my son; tomara thakura — you, good sirs; rakhibe apana kachhe — keep near you; na rakhibe dura — do not keep at a distance

**699.** "Teach my son, good sirs;
keep Him close to you, do not keep Him at a distance.

পিতৃশূন্য পুত্র মোর পীরিতি করিবে ।
আপন তনয় হেন ইহারে জানিবে ॥ ৭০০ ॥

*pitṛśūnya putra mora pīriti karibe |*
*āpana tanaẏa hena ihāre jānibe || 700 ||*

*Word for word:* pitri-shunya putra mora — my fatherless son; piriti karibe — show Him affection; apana tanaya hena — like your own son; ihare janibe — regard Him

**700.** My son has lost His father — be kind to Him;
regard Him as your own son."

শুনিঞা পণ্ডিত সব সঙ্কোচ অন্তরে ।
কহিতে লাগিলা কিছু বিনয়-উত্তরে ॥ ৭০১ ॥

*śuniñā paṇḍita saba saṅkoca antare |*
*kahite lāgilā kichu binaẏa-uttare || 701 ||*

*Word for word:* shunina — hearing; pandita saba — all the pandits; sankocha antare — abashed at heart; kahite lagila kichhu — began to say; vinaya-uttare — in humble reply

**701.** Hearing this, all the pandits, abashed at heart,
began to answer humbly:

মো সভার ভাগ্য এতদিনে সে জানিল ।
কোটি-সরস্বতী-কান্ত আমরা পাইল ॥ ৭০২ ॥

*mo sabhāra bhāgya etadine se jānila |*
*koṭi-sarasbatī-kānta āmarā pāila || 702 ||*

*Word for word:* mo sabhara bhagya — our fortune; etadine se janila — today we have come to know; koti-sarasvati-kanta — the Lord of millions of Sarasvatis; amara paila — we have obtained

**702.** "Today we have come to know our good fortune:
we have obtained the Lord of millions of Sarasvatis.[^17-1]

অখিলে পঢ়াইবে ইহঁ নিজ-প্রেম-নাম ।
সর্বলোক-গুরু ইহঁ সভার প্রধান ॥ ৭০৩ ॥

*akhile paṛhāibe ihaṁ nija-prema-nāma |*
*sarbaloka-guru ihaṁ sabhāra pradhāna || 703 ||*

*Word for word:* akhile padhaibe — will teach the whole world; ihan — He; nija-prema-nama — His own prema and name; sarvaloka-guru ihan — He is the teacher of all people; sabhara pradhana — the foremost of all

**703.** He will teach the whole world His own prema and His name;
He is the teacher of all people, the foremost of all.

আমরাহ পঢ়ব ইহাঁর সন্নিধানে ।
নিশ্চয় জানিহ মাতা কহিল বচনে ॥ ৭০৪ ॥

*āmarāha paṛhaba ihāṁra sannidhāne |*
*niścaẏa jāniha mātā kahila bacane || 704 ||*

*Word for word:* amarah padhaba — it is we who shall study; ihanra sannidhane — in His presence; nishchaya janiha — know for certain; mata — mother; kahila bachane — we have said (it) in words

**704.** It is we who shall learn in His presence —
know this for certain, mother; we have told you the truth."

শুনি শচীদেবী বৈল বিনয়-বচনে ।
পুত্র সমর্পিয়া আইলা আপন-ভবনে ॥ ৭০৫ ॥

*śuni śacīdebī baila binaẏa-bacane |*
*putra samarpiẏā āilā āpana-bhabane || 705 ||*

*Word for word:* shuni — hearing; shachidevi baila — Shachi-devi spoke; vinaya-bachane — with humble words; putra samarpiya — entrusting her son; aila apana-bhavane — came back home

**705.** Hearing this, Shachi-devi answered with humble words
and, having entrusted her son, returned to her home.

তবে আর কথোদিনে প্রভু বিশ্বম্ভর ।
পঢ়িবারে গেলা বিষ্ণুপণ্ডিতের ঘর ॥ ৭০৬ ॥

*tabe āra kathodine prabhu biśbambhara |*
*paṛhibāre gelā biṣṇupaṇḍitera ghara || 706 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe ara kathodine — then after some more days; prabhu vishvambhara — the Lord Vishvambhara; padhibare gela — went to study; vishnu-panditera ghara — at the house of Vishnu Pandita

**706.** Then, after a few more days, the Lord Vishvambhara
went to study at the house of Vishnu Pandita.

সুদর্শন আর গঙ্গাদাস যে পণ্ডিতে ।
পঢ়িলা জগত-গুরু তা সভার হিতে ॥ ৭০৭ ॥

*sudarśana āra gaṅgādāsa ye paṇḍite |*
*paṛhilā jagata-guru tā sabhāra hite || 707 ||*

*Word for word:* sudarshana ara gangadasa ye pandite — under Sudarshana and the pandit Gangadasa; padhila — studied; jagata-guru — the Teacher of the world; ta sabhara hite — for their good

**707.** Under Sudarshana and the pandit Gangadasa
the Teacher of the world studied — for their own good.

লোক আচরয়ে মায়া-মানুষ-বিগ্রহ ।
পঢ়য়ে পঢ়ায় বিদ্যা লোক-অনুগ্রহ ॥ ৭০৮ ॥

*loka ācaraẏe māẏā-mānuṣa-bigraha |*
*paṛhaẏe paṛhāẏa bidyā loka-anugraha || 708 ||*

*Word for word:* loka acharaye — behaves like people; maya-manusha-vigraha — He who by yogamaya has a human form; padhaye padhaya vidya — studies and teaches knowledge; loka-anugraha — out of kindness to people

**708.** He who by His yogamaya has manifested a human form[^17-2] behaves like people;
out of kindness to people He studies and teaches knowledge.

পণ্ডিত শ্রীসুদর্শন আর একদিনে ।
পরিহাস করে প্রভু সতীর্থের সনে ॥ ৭০৯ ॥

*paṇḍita śrīsudarśana āra ekadine |*
*parihāsa kare prabhu satīrthera sane || 709 ||*

*Word for word:* pandita sri-sudarshana — [at] Pandita Sri Sudarshana's; ara ekadine — one day; parihasa kare prabhu — the Lord jokes; satirthera sane — with fellow students

**709.** One day, at the school of Pandita Sri Sudarshana,
the Lord jokes with His fellow students.

বঙ্গজের কথা কহে বড়ই রসাল ।
অতি মনোহর হাসি অমিয়া-মিশাল ॥ ৭১০ ॥

*baṅgajera kathā kahe baṛai rasāla |*
*ati manohara hāsi amiẏā-miśāla || 710 ||*

*Word for word:* bangajera katha kahe — speaks the speech of the East Bengalis; badai rasala — most amusingly; ati manohara hasi — most charming laughter; amiya-mishala — mixed with nectar

**710.** He talks in the speech of the East Bengalis — most amusingly;[^17-3]
His laughter, full of nectar, captivates the heart.

এইমতে রঙ্গে-ঢঙ্গে কথোদিন গেল ।
বনমালী-আচার্য দেখিব মনে কৈল ॥ ৭১১ ॥

*eimate raṅge-ḍhaṅge kathodina gela |*
*banamālī-ācārya dekhiba mane kaila || 711 ||*

*Word for word:* eimate — thus; range-dhange — in merry pranks; kathodina gela — some days passed; vanamali-acharya dekhiba — "I shall see Vanamali Acharya"; mane kaila — He decided

**711.** Thus some days passed in merry pranks;
He decided to visit Vanamali Acharya.

তারে দেখিবারে তার আশ্রমেতে গেলা ।
দেখিয়া প্রণতি করি সম্ভ্রমে উঠিলা ॥ ৭১২ ॥

*tāre dekhibāre tāra āśramete gelā |*
*dekhiẏā praṇati kari sambhrame uṭhilā || 712 ||*

*Word for word:* tare dekhibare — to see him; tara ashramete gela — went to his house; dekhiya — seeing; pranati kari — bowing; sambhrame uthila — rose in reverence

**712.** To see him He went to his house;
seeing [Him], he rose in reverence and bowed.

করে ধরি তার সনে চলি যায় পথে ।
কৌতুক-রহস্য-কথা কহিতে কহিতে ॥ ৭১৩ ॥

*kare dhari tāra sane cali yāẏa pathe |*
*kautuka-rahasya-kathā kahite kahite || 713 ||*

*Word for word:* kare dhari — taking by the hand; tara sane — with him; chali yaya pathe — walks along the road; kautuka-rahasya-katha — amusing and confidential talk; kahite kahite — talking

**713.** Taking him by the hand, He walks with him along the road,
talking of amusing and confidential things.

হেনকালে বল্লভ সে আচার্যের কন্যা ।
রূপে গুণে শীলে সেই ত্রিজগত-ধন্যা ॥ ৭১৪ ॥

*henakāle ballabha se ācāryera kanyā |*
*rūpe guṇe śīle sei trijagata-dhanyā || 714 ||*

*Word for word:* hena-kale — at that time; vallabha se acharyera kanya — the daughter of Vallabha Acharya; rupe gune shile — in beauty, virtue, character; sei trijagata-dhanya — famed in the three worlds

**714.** At that time the daughter of Vallabha Acharya,
famed in the three worlds for beauty, virtue and character,

গঙ্গাস্নানে যায় সেই সখীর সহিতে ।
বিশ্বম্ভর হরি তারে দেখে আচম্বিতে ॥ ৭১৫ ॥

*gaṅgāsnāne yāẏa sei sakhīra sahite |*
*biśbambhara hari tāre dekhe ācambite || 715 ||*

*Word for word:* ganga-snane yaya — goes to bathe in the Ganga; sei sakhira sahite — she with her friends; vishvambhara hari — Vishvambhara Hari; tare dekhe achambite — suddenly sees her

**715.** is going with her friends to bathe in the Ganga;
Vishvambhara Hari suddenly sees her.

একদৃষ্টে চাহে প্রভু সস্মিত আনন ।
দেখিয়া জানিল তার জন্মের কারণ ॥ ৭১৬ ॥

*ekadṛṣṭe cāhe prabhu sasmita ānana |*
*dekhiẏā jānila tāra janmera kāraṇa || 716 ||*

*Word for word:* eka-drishte chahe prabhu — the Lord gazes steadily; sasmita anana — with a smiling face; dekhiya — seeing; janila — knew; tara janmera karana — the reason of her birth

**716.** The Lord gazes at her steadily with a smiling face
and, seeing her, knew why she had been born.[^17-4]

লক্ষ্মী ঠাকুরাণী তাহা ইঙ্গিতে বুঝিল ।
প্রভু-পাদপদ্ম দেবী শিরে করি নিল ॥ ৭১৭ ॥

*lakṣmī ṭhākurāṇī tāhā iṅgite bujhila |*
*prabhu-pādapadma debī śire kari nila || 717 ||*

*Word for word:* lakshmi thakurani — Lakshmi Thakurani; taha ingite bujhila — understood it from the sign; prabhu-padapadma — the Lord's lotus feet; devi — the goddess; shire kari nila — took upon her head

**717.** Lakshmi Thakurani understood this from the sign,
and the goddess took the lotus feet of the Lord upon her head.[^17-5]

আচার্য সে বনমালী বড়ই চতুর ।
বুঝিল অন্তর-কথা হৃদয়-অঙ্কুর ॥ ৭১৮ ॥

*ācārya se banamālī baṛai catura |*
*bujhila antara-kathā hṛdaẏa-aṅkura || 718 ||*

*Word for word:* acharya se vanamali — Acharya Vanamali; badai chatura — very shrewd; bujhila antara-katha — understood what was in their hearts; hridaya-ankura — the sprout of the heart

**718.** Acharya Vanamali was very shrewd:
he understood what was in their hearts — the sprouting feeling.

আরদিন বনমালী আচার্য আপনে ।
আনন্দ-হৃদয়ে গেলা শচীর ভবনে ॥ ৭১৯ ॥

*āradina banamālī ācārya āpane |*
*ānanda-hṛdaẏe gelā śacīra bhabane || 719 ||*

*Word for word:* aradina — the next day; vanamali acharya apane — Vanamali Acharya himself; ananda-hridaye — with joy in his heart; gela shachira bhavane — went to Shachi's house

**719.** The next day Vanamali Acharya himself,
with joy in his heart, went to Shachi's house.

হাসিয়া প্রণাম কৈল শচীর চরণে ।
প্রণতি করিয়া বৈল মধুর-বচনে ॥ ৭২০ ॥

*hāsiẏā praṇāma kaila śacīra caraṇe |*
*praṇati kariẏā baila madhura-bacane || 720 ||*

*Word for word:* hasiya — smiling; pranama kaila shachira charane — bowed at Shachi's feet; pranati kariya — bowing; baila madhura-bachane — spoke with sweet words

**720.** Smiling, he bowed at Shachi's feet
and, bowing, spoke with sweet words:

তোমার পুত্রের যোগ্য আছে এক কন্যা ।
রূপে গুণে শীলে সেই ত্রিজগতে ধন্যা ॥ ৭২১ ॥

*tomāra putrera yogya āche eka kanyā |*
*rūpe guṇe śīle sei trijagate dhanyā || 721 ||*

*Word for word:* tomara putrera yogya — worthy of your son; achhe eka kanya — there is a girl; rupe gune shile — in beauty, virtue, character; sei trijagate dhanya — she is famed in the three worlds

**721.** "There is a girl worthy of your son:
for beauty, virtue and character she is famed in the three worlds.

বল্লভ-আচার্য-কন্যা অতি সুচরিতা ।
যদি ইচ্ছা থাকে কহ হৃদয়ের কথা ॥ ৭২২ ॥

*ballabha-ācārya-kanyā ati sucaritā |*
*yadi icchā thāke kaha hṛdaẏera kathā || 722 ||*

*Word for word:* vallabha-acharya-kanya — Vallabha Acharya's daughter; ati sucharita — very well-mannered; yadi ichchha thake — if there is the wish; kaha hridayera katha — tell what is in your heart

**722.** She is the daughter of Vallabha Acharya, most well-mannered;
if you have the wish, tell me what is in your heart."

তবে শচীদেবী শুনি আচার্য-বচন ।
এ অতি বালক মোর পঢ়ুক এখন ॥ ৭২৩ ॥

*tabe śacīdebī śuni ācārya-bacana |*
*e ati bālaka mora paṛhuka ekhana || 723 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe shachidevi — then Shachi-devi; shuni acharya-bachana — hearing the Acharya's words; e ati balaka mora — He is still a mere boy; padhuka ekhana — let Him study now

**723.** Hearing the Acharya's words, Shachi-devi [said]:
"He is still just a boy; let Him study now.

পিতৃশূন্য পুত্র মোর পঢ়ুক কথোদিন ।
তাহাতে করহ যত্ন হউক প্রবীণ ॥ ৭২৪ ॥

*pitṛśūnya putra mora paṛhuka kathodina |*
*tāhāte karaha yatna hauka prabīṇa || 724 ||*

*Word for word:* pitri-shunya putra mora — my fatherless son; padhuka kathodina — let Him study some days; tahate karaha yatna — take care of that; hauka pravina — may He become accomplished

**724.** My son has lost His father — let Him study for some more days;
see to that instead, so that He may become accomplished."

শুনিঞা আচার্য তবে সন্তোষ না পাইল ।
বিরস-বদন হঞা ঘরেতে চলিল ॥ ৭২৫ ॥

*śuniñā ācārya tabe santoṣa nā pāila |*
*birasa-badana hañā gharete calila || 725 ||*

*Word for word:* shunina — hearing; acharya tabe — the Acharya then; santosha na paila — was not pleased; virasa-badana hina — with a downcast face; gharete chalila — set out for home

**725.** Hearing this, the Acharya was not pleased;
with a downcast face he set out for home.

কান্দিতে কান্দিতে চলে ব্যাকুল অন্তরে ।
হা হা গোরাচাঁদ বলি ডাকে উচ্চৈঃস্বরে ॥ ৭২৬ ॥

*kāndite kāndite cale byākula antare |*
*hā hā gorācāṁda bali ḍāke uccaiḥsbare || 726 ||*

*Word for word:* kandite kandite chale — goes weeping and weeping; vyakula antare — distressed at heart; ha ha gorachanda bali — crying "O, O Gorachand!"; dake uchchaihsvare — calls aloud

**726.** He goes weeping and weeping, distressed at heart,
calling aloud: "O, O Gorachand!

মোর ভাগ্যে না করিলে পতিতপাবন ।
বাঞ্ছাকল্পতরু নাম ধর কি কারণ ॥ ৭২৭ ॥

*mora bhāgye nā karile patitapābana |*
*bāñchākalpataru nāma dhara ki kāraṇa || 727 ||*

*Word for word:* mora bhagye — for my lot; na karile — You did not do; patita-pavana — O Purifier of the fallen; vanchha-kalpataru nama — the name "Wish-fulfilling Tree"; dhara ki karana — why do You bear

**727.** You did not do it for my lot, O Purifier of the fallen —
why then do You bear the name 'Wish-fulfilling Tree'?

মোর বাঞ্ছা পূর্ণ যদি না কৈলে আপনে ।
বাঞ্ছাকল্পতরু নাম ধরিবে কেমনে ॥ ৭২৮ ॥

*mora bāñchā pūrṇa yadi nā kaile āpane |*
*bāñchākalpataru nāma dharibe kemane || 728 ||*

*Word for word:* mora vanchha — my desire; purna yadi na kaile apane — if You Yourself did not fulfil; vanchha-kalpataru nama — the name "Wish-fulfilling Tree"; dharibe kemane — how will You bear

**728.** If You Yourself have not fulfilled my desire,
how will You bear the name 'Wish-fulfilling Tree'?

জয় জয় দ্রৌপদীর লজ্জা-ভয়-হারী ।
জয় গজরাজকে কুম্ভীর-মুখে তারি ॥ ৭২৯ ॥

*jaẏa jaẏa draupadīra lajjā-bhaẏa-hārī |*
*jaẏa gajarājake kumbhīra-mukhe tāri || 729 ||*

*Word for word:* jaya jaya — glory, glory; draupadira lajja-bhaya-hari — to Him who took away Draupadi's shame and fear; jaya — glory; gajarajake kumbhira-mukhe tari — to Him who saved the king of elephants from the crocodile's jaws

**729.** Glory, glory to You who took away Draupadi's shame and fear!
Glory to You who saved the king of elephants from the crocodile's jaws!

জয় অজামিল-গণিকার ত্রাণদাতা ।
আমারে যে ত্রাণ কর অখিলের পিতা ॥ ৭৩০ ॥

*jaẏa ajāmila-gaṇikāra trāṇadātā |*
*āmāre ye trāṇa kara akhilera pitā || 730 ||*

*Word for word:* jaya — glory; ajamila-ganikara trana-data — to the giver of deliverance to Ajamila and the courtesan; amare ye trana kara — deliver me too; akhilera pita — Father of all

**730.** Glory to You who gave deliverance to Ajamila and the courtesan![^17-6]
Deliver me too, Father of all the world!"

এথা গুরুগৃহে প্রভু জানিল অন্তরে ।
আচার্য শোকেতে যত হঞাছে কাতরে ॥ ৭৩১ ॥

*ethā gurugṛhe prabhu jānila antare |*
*ācārya śokete yata hañāche kātare || 731 ||*

*Word for word:* etha — meanwhile; guru-grihe — at the teacher's house; prabhu janila antare — the Lord knew in His heart; acharya shokete — the Acharya in grief; yata hinachhe katare — how stricken he was

**731.** Meanwhile, at His teacher's house, the Lord knew in His heart
how stricken with grief the Acharya was.

আস্তে-ব্যস্তে পুস্তক সম্বরি ভগবান্ ।
গুরু সম্ভাষিয়া প্রভু করিলা পয়ান ॥ ৭৩২ ॥

*āste-byaste pustaka sambari bhagabān |*
*guru sambhāṣiẏā prabhu karilā paẏāna || 732 ||*

*Word for word:* aste-vyaste — hastily; pustaka samvari — gathering His books; bhagavan — Bhagavan; guru sambhashiya — taking leave of His teacher; prabhu karila payana — the Lord set out

**732.** Hastily gathering His books, Bhagavan,
taking leave of His teacher, the Lord set out.

মাতল কুঞ্জর যেন গমন সুন্দর ।
গৌরতনু অলঙ্কারে করে ঝলমল ॥ ৭৩৩ ॥

*mātala kuñjara yena gamana sundara |*
*gauratanu alaṅkāre kare jhalamala || 733 ||*

*Word for word:* matala kunjara yena — like an intoxicated elephant; gamana sundara — a beautiful gait; gaura-tanu — the golden body; alankare kare jhalamala — sparkles with ornaments

**733.** His gait was beautiful, like that of an intoxicated elephant;
His golden body sparkled with ornaments.

চাঁচর কেশের বেশ অখিল-মোহন ।
অধর বান্ধুলী-ফুল মুকুতা দশন ॥ ৭৩৪ ॥

*cāṁcara keśera beśa akhila-mohana |*
*adhara bāndhulī-phula mukutā daśana || 734 ||*

*Word for word:* chanchara keshera besha — the arrangement of curling locks; akhila-mohana — enchants the world; adhara bandhuli-phula — lips are bandhuli flowers; mukuta dashana — teeth are pearls

**734.** His curling locks enchant the whole world;
His lips are bandhuli flowers, His teeth pearls.

চন্দনে চর্চিত মনোহর অঙ্গশোভা ।
তনু সূক্ষ্ম বসন পিন্ধন মনোলোভা ॥ ৭৩৫ ॥

*candane carcita manohara aṅgaśobhā |*
*tanu sūkṣma basana pindhana manolobhā || 735 ||*

*Word for word:* chandane charchita — anointed with sandal; manohara anga-shobha — beautiful limbs; tanu sukshma basana pindhana — fine garments worn on the body; mano-lobha — captivating the heart

**735.** His limbs, anointed with sandal, are beautiful;
on His body fine garments that captivate the heart.

কত কোটি কামের নৃপতি গৌরহরি ।
কুলবতী-কলঙ্ক-বিথার দেহধারী ॥ ৭৩৬ ॥

*kata koṭi kāmera nṛpati gaurahari |*
*kulabatī-kalaṅka-bithāra dehadhārī || 736 ||*

*Word for word:* kata koti kamera nripati — king of many millions of Kamadevas; gaurahari — Gaurahari; kulavati-kalanka-vithara — spreading disgrace among chaste wives; deha-dhari — bearing [such] a body

**736.** Gaurahari is the king of many millions of Kamadevas,
and His body throws chaste wives into turmoil.[^17-7]

আচার্য লাগিয়া প্রভুর ত্বরিতে গমন ।
বাঞ্ছাকল্পতরু নাম বলি এ কারণ ॥ ৭৩৭ ॥

*ācārya lāgiẏā prabhura tbarite gamana |*
*bāñchākalpataru nāma bali e kāraṇa || 737 ||*

*Word for word:* acharya lagiya — for the Acharya's sake; prabhura tvarite gamana — the Lord hastened; vanchha-kalpataru nama — the name "Wish-fulfilling Tree"; bali e karana — is said for this reason

**737.** The Lord hastened for the Acharya's sake —
that is why He is called the "Wish-fulfilling Tree".

আচার্য কান্দিয়া তবে আইসে পথে পথে ।
হা হা গোরাচাঁদ বলি ধায় ঊর্ধ্বহাথে ॥ ৭৩৮ ॥

*ācārya kāndiẏā tabe āise pathe pathe |*
*hā hā gorācāṁda bali dhāẏa ūrdhbahāthe || 738 ||*

*Word for word:* acharya kandiya — the Acharya weeping; tabe — then; aise pathe pathe — comes from road to road; ha ha gorachanda bali — crying "O, O Gorachand!"; dhaya urdhva-hathe — runs with arms raised

**738.** And the Acharya goes weeping from road to road
and runs with arms raised, crying: "O, O Gorachand!"

হেনকালে মহাপ্রভু গুরুগৃহ হৈতে ।
আসিতে হইল দেখা আচার্য-সহিতে ॥ ৭৩৯ ॥

*henakāle mahāprabhu gurugṛha haite |*
*āsite haila dekhā ācārya-sahite || 739 ||*

*Word for word:* hena-kale — just then; mahaprabhu guru-griha haite — Mahaprabhu from His teacher's house; asite — coming; haila dekha acharya-sahite — met the Acharya

**739.** Just then Mahaprabhu, coming back from His teacher's house,
met the Acharya.

পড়িলা আচার্য পায় দণ্ডবত হঞা ।
তুলিলেন মহাপ্রভু হাসিয়া হাসিয়া ॥ ৭৪০ ॥

*paṛilā ācārya pāẏa daṇḍabata hañā |*
*tulilena mahāprabhu hāsiẏā hāsiẏā || 740 ||*

*Word for word:* padila acharya paya — the Acharya fell at His feet; dandavata hina — stretched out like a stick; tulilena mahaprabhu — Mahaprabhu raised him; hasiya hasiya — smiling and smiling

**740.** The Acharya fell at His feet, stretched out like a stick,
and Mahaprabhu, smiling and smiling, raised him up.

নমস্কার করি কৈল গাঢ় আলিঙ্গন ।
কোথা গিয়াছিলা বৈল মধুর বচন ॥ ৭৪১ ॥

*namaskāra kari kaila gāṛha āliṅgana |*
*kothā giẏāchilā baila madhura bacana || 741 ||*

*Word for word:* namaskara kari — greeting; kaila gadha alingana — embraced tightly; kotha giyachhila — "where had you gone?"; baila madhura bachana — said sweetly

**741.** Greeting him, He embraced him tightly
and asked sweetly: "Where have you been?"

আচার্য কহয়ে শুন শুন বিশ্বম্ভর ।
আমি গিয়াছিলাম এই ঘরেরে তোমার ॥ ৭৪২ ॥

*ācārya kahaẏe śuna śuna biśbambhara |*
*āmi giẏāchilāma ei gharere tomāra || 742 ||*

*Word for word:* acharya kahaye — the Acharya says; shuna shuna vishvambhara — listen, listen, Vishvambhara; ami giyachhilama — I went; ei gharere tomara — to this house of Yours

**742.** The Acharya says: "Listen, listen, Vishvambhara:
I went to Your house.

তোমার জননী দেবী অতি সুচরিতা ।
গোচর করিলুঁ চিত্তে যে আছিল কথা ॥ ৭৪৩ ॥

*tomāra jananī debī ati sucaritā |*
*gocara kariluṁ citte ye āchila kathā || 743 ||*

*Word for word:* tomara janani devi — to Your mother, the goddess; ati sucharita — very well-mannered; gochara karilun — I made known; chitte ye achhila katha — what was in my heart

**743.** To Your mother, the goddess, so well-mannered,
I made known what was in my heart:

তোমার বিভার যোগ্যা আছে এক কন্যা ।
বল্লভ-আচার্য-কন্যা সর্বগুণে ধন্যা ॥ ৭৪৪ ॥

*tomāra bibhāra yogyā āche eka kanyā |*
*ballabha-ācārya-kanyā sarbaguṇe dhanyā || 744 ||*

*Word for word:* tomara vibhara yogya — worthy of marriage with You; achhe eka kanya — there is a girl; vallabha-acharya-kanya — Vallabha Acharya's daughter; sarvagune dhanya — renowned for every virtue

**744.** there is a girl worthy to be Your bride —
the daughter of Vallabha Acharya, renowned for every virtue.

এ কথা তোমার মাতা শুনি শ্রদ্ধাহীন ।
ঘরেরে চলিলাঙ আমি অন্তর-মলিন ॥ ৭৪৫ ॥

*e kathā tomāra mātā śuni śraddhāhīna |*
*gharere calilāṅa āmi antara-malina || 745 ||*

*Word for word:* e katha — these words; tomara mata shuni — Your mother, hearing; shraddhahina — without regard; gharere chalilanga ami — I am going home; antara-malina — with a heavy heart

**745.** Your mother paid no heed to these words,
and I am going home with a heavy heart."

কিছু না বলিলা প্রভু শুনিঞা বচন ।
মুচকি হাসিয়া ঘরে করিলা গমন ॥ ৭৪৬ ॥

*kichu nā balilā prabhu śuniñā bacana |*
*mucaki hāsiẏā ghare karilā gamana || 746 ||*

*Word for word:* kichhu na balila prabhu — the Lord said nothing; shunina bachana — hearing the words; muchaki hasiya — smiling playfully; ghare karila gamana — went home

**746.** Hearing this, the Lord said nothing,
but with a playful smile went home.

সে চাতুরী লাবণ্য মধুর মন্দ হাসি ।
হেরিয়া আচার্য মনে হঞা অভিলাষী ॥ ৭৪৭ ॥

*se cāturī lābaṇya madhura manda hāsi |*
*heriẏā ācārya mane hañā abhilāṣī || 747 ||*

*Word for word:* se chaturi — that playfulness (lit. "cleverness"); lavanya — beauty; madhura manda hasi — soft sweet smile; heriya — seeing; acharya mane hina abhilashi — the Acharya became hopeful at heart

**747.** Seeing that playfulness, that beauty, that soft, sweet smile,
the Acharya was filled with hope:

জানিলেন মোর কার্য অবশ্য হইব ।
অন্তরে জানিল প্রভু বিবাহ করিব ॥ ৭৪৮ ॥

*jānilena mora kārya abaśya haiba |*
*antare jānila prabhu bibāha kariba || 748 ||*

*Word for word:* janilena — he understood; mora karya — my business; avashya haiba — will surely succeed; antare janila — knew in his heart; prabhu vibaha kariba — the Lord will marry

**748.** "My business will surely succeed," he understood;
he understood in his heart that the Lord would marry.

ঘরেরে আইলা আচার্য আনন্দিত হঞা ।
প্রভুর চরিত্র সব হৃদয়ে ভাবিয়া ॥ ৭৪৯ ॥

*gharere āilā ācārya ānandita hañā |*
*prabhura caritra saba hṛdaẏe bhābiẏā || 749 ||*

*Word for word:* gharere aila — came home; acharya anandita hina — the Acharya, rejoicing; prabhura charitra saba — all the Lord's doings; hridaye bhaviya — pondering in his heart

**749.** The Acharya came home rejoicing,
pondering in his heart all that the Lord had done.

ঘরে গিয়া জননীরে বৈল বিশ্বম্ভর ।
বনমালী-আচার্যেরে কি দিলা উত্তর ॥ ৭৫০ ॥

*ghare giẏā jananīre baila biśbambhara |*
*banamālī-ācāryere ki dilā uttara || 750 ||*

*Word for word:* ghare giya — going home; jananire baila vishvambhara — Vishvambhara said to His mother; vanamali-acharyere — to Vanamali Acharya; ki dila uttara — what answer did you give

**750.** Coming home, Vishvambhara said to His mother:
"What answer did you give Vanamali Acharya?

বিমনা দেখিল আমি তারে পথে যাইতে ।
সম্ভাষে না পাইনু সুখ আচার্য-সহিতে ॥ ৭৫১ ॥

*bimanā dekhila āmi tāre pathe yāite |*
*sambhāṣe nā pāinu sukha ācārya-sahite || 751 ||*

*Word for word:* vimana dekhila ami tare — I saw him downcast; pathe yaite — going along the road; sambhashe na painu sukha — I found no joy in talking; acharya-sahite — with the Acharya

**751.** I saw him going along the road downcast;
talking with the Acharya gave Me no joy.

তার অসন্তোষ কেনে করিয়াছ তুমি ।
বিমনা দেখিয়া তারে দুঃখ পাইলুঁ আমি ॥ ৭৫২ ॥

*tāra asantoṣa kene kariẏācha tumi |*
*bimanā dekhiẏā tāre duḥkha pāiluṁ āmi || 752 ||*

*Word for word:* tara asantosha — his displeasure; kene kariyachha tumi — why have you caused; vimana dekhiya tare — seeing him downcast; duhkha pailun ami — I was saddened

**752.** Why have you displeased him?
Seeing him downcast, I was saddened."

শুনিয়া পুত্রের বাণী শচী সুচতুরা ।
ইঙ্গিত জানিঞা হৈল হৃদয়-সত্বরা ॥ ৭৫৩ ॥

*śuniẏā putrera bāṇī śacī sucaturā |*
*iṅgita jāniñā haila hṛdaẏa-satbarā || 753 ||*

*Word for word:* shuniya putrera vani — hearing her son's words; shachi suchatura — the very shrewd Shachi; ingita janina — understanding the hint; haila hridaya-satvara — became eager at heart

**753.** Hearing her son's words, the very shrewd Shachi
understood the hint and made haste.

ত্বরায় মানুষ গেল আচার্য আনিবারে ।
সংবাদ শুনিয়া তেঁহো আইলা সত্বরে ॥ ৭৫৪ ॥

*tbarāẏa mānuṣa gela ācārya ānibāre |*
*saṃbāda śuniẏā teṁho āilā satbare || 754 ||*

*Word for word:* tvaraya — at once; manusha gela — a man went; acharya anibare — to fetch the Acharya; samvada shuniya — hearing the news; tenho aila satvare — he came quickly

**754.** At once a man went to fetch the Acharya;
hearing the news, he came quickly.

আনন্দে পূরিত তনু গদগদ হঞা ।
শচী-কাছে উপনীত প্রণত হইয়া ॥ ৭৫৫ ॥

*ānande pūrita tanu gadagada hañā |*
*śacī-kāche upanīta praṇata haiẏā || 755 ||*

*Word for word:* anande purita tanu — body filled with joy; gadagada hina — choked with emotion; shachi-kachhe upanita — came before Shachi; pranata haiya — bowing

**755.** His whole body filled with joy, his voice choked with emotion,
he came before Shachi and bowed.

দণ্ডবত করি লৈল চরণের ধূলি ।
কি কারণে আজ্ঞা মোরে করিলা ঈশ্বরী ॥ ৭৫৬ ॥

*daṇḍabata kari laila caraṇera dhūli |*
*ki kāraṇe ājñā more karilā īśbarī || 756 ||*

*Word for word:* dandavata kari — prostrating; laila charanera dhuli — took the dust of her feet; ki karane — for what reason; ajna more karila — have you summoned me; ishvari — O mistress

**756.** Prostrating himself, he took the dust of her feet:
"Why have you called me, mistress?"

শুনি শচীদেবী তবে আচার্য-বচন ।
আদর করিয়া তারে কৈল তখন ॥ ৭৫৬+১ ॥

*śuni śacīdebī tabe ācārya-bacana |*
*ādara kariẏā tāre kaila takhana || 756+1 ||*

*Word for word:* shuni — hearing; shachidevi — Shachi-devi; tabe — then; acharya-vachana — the Acharya's words; adara kariya — with respect; tare — to him; kaila takhana — said then

**756+1.** Hearing the Acharya's words, Shachi-devi
then spoke to him with respect:[^17-8]

পূর্বে যে কহিলা তার করহ উদ্যোগ ।
বিশ্বম্ভরে বিভা দিব সভার সন্তোষ ॥ ৭৫৭ ॥

*pūrbe ye kahilā tāra karaha udyoga |*
*biśbambhare bibhā diba sabhāra santoṣa || 757 ||*

*Word for word:* purve ye kahila — what you said before; tara karaha udyoga — arrange it; vishvambhare vibha diba — I shall marry Vishvambhara; sabhara santosha — to everyone's joy

**757.** "What you spoke of before — arrange it;
I shall marry Vishvambhara, to everyone's joy.

আমার অধিক স্নেহ তোর বিশ্বম্ভরে ।
আপনে করিবি সব কি বলিব তোরে ॥ ৭৫৮ ॥

*āmāra adhika sneha tora biśbambhare |*
*āpane karibi saba ki baliba tore || 758 ||*

*Word for word:* amara adhika sneha — affection greater than mine; tora vishvambhare — you have for Vishvambhara; apane karibi saba — you will do everything yourself; ki baliba tore — what should I tell you

**758.** You love my Vishvambhara more than I do;
you will do everything yourself — what should I tell you?

বিশ্বম্ভর-বিবাহ-নিমিত্তে যে কহিলে ।
আপনে উদ্যোগ কর কহিল তোমারে ॥ ৭৫৯ ॥

*biśbambhara-bibāha-nimitte ye kahile |*
*āpane udyoga kara kahila tomāre || 759 ||*

*Word for word:* vishvambhara-vibaha-nimitte — for Vishvambhara's marriage; ye kahile — what you said; apane udyoga kara — undertake it yourself; kahila tomare — I tell you

**759.** What you spoke of for Vishvambhara's marriage —
undertake it yourself, I tell you."

ইহা শুনি বনমালী আচার্য-উত্তম ।
পালিব তোমার আজ্ঞা বলিল বচন ॥ ৭৬০ ॥

*ihā śuni banamālī ācārya-uttama |*
*pāliba tomāra ājñā balila bacana || 760 ||*

*Word for word:* iha shuni — hearing this; vanamali acharya-uttama — Vanamali, the excellent Acharya; paliba tomara ajna — I shall carry out your command; balila bachana — said

**760.** Hearing this, Vanamali, the excellent Acharya,
said: "I shall carry out your command."

ইহা বলি বল্লভ-আচার্য-বাড়ী গেলা ।
বল্লভ-আচার্য অতি সম্ভ্রমে উঠিলা ॥ ৭৬১ ॥

*ihā bali ballabha-ācārya-bāṛī gelā |*
*ballabha-ācārya ati sambhrame uṭhilā || 761 ||*

*Word for word:* iha bali — saying this; vallabha-acharya-badi gela — went to Vallabha Acharya's house; vallabha-acharya — Vallabha Acharya; ati sambhrame uthila — rose with great respect

**761.** Saying this, he went to the house of Vallabha Acharya;
Vallabha Acharya rose to meet him with great respect,

বসিতে আসন দিল বিনয় করিয়া ।
নিজ ভাগ্য মানি কিছু কহিল হাসিয়া ॥ ৭৬২ ॥

*basite āsana dila binaẏa kariẏā |*
*nija bhāgya māni kichu kahila hāsiẏā || 762 ||*

*Word for word:* basite asana dila — offered a seat; vinaya kariya — humbly; nija bhagya mani — counting it his good fortune; kichhu kahila hasiya — said smiling

**762.** humbly offered him a seat
and, counting it his good fortune, said with a smile:

বলিল আমার ভাগ্যে তোর আগমন ।
আর কিবা কার্য থাকে কহ ত এখন ॥ ৭৬৩ ॥

*balila āmāra bhāgye tora āgamana |*
*āra kibā kārya thāke kaha ta ekhana || 763 ||*

*Word for word:* balila — said; amara bhagye — by my good fortune; tora agamana — your coming; ara kiba karya thake — if there is other business; kaha ta ekhana — tell me now

**763.** "By my good fortune you have come to me;
and if there is some other business — tell me now."

বল্লভ-মিশ্রের কথা শুনিঞা আচার্য ।
প্রবন্ধ করিয়া কহে হৃদয়ের কার্য ॥ ৭৬৪ ॥

*ballabha-miśrera kathā śuniñā ācārya |*
*prabandha kariẏā kahe hṛdaẏera kārya || 764 ||*

*Word for word:* vallabha-mishrera katha — Vallabha Mishra's words; shunina acharya — hearing, the Acharya; prabandha kariya — at length; kahe hridayera karya — tells the business of his heart

**764.** Hearing the words of Vallabha Mishra, the Acharya
set out at length the business of his heart:

সর্বকাল আমারে করহ তুমি স্নেহ ।
স্নেহবশ হঞা আমি আইনু তোর গেহ ॥ ৭৬৫ ॥

*sarbakāla āmāre karaha tumi sneha |*
*snehabaśa hañā āmi āinu tora geha || 765 ||*

*Word for word:* sarvakala — always; amare karaha tumi sneha — you show me affection; sneha-basha hina — out of affection; ami ainu tora geha — I have come to your house

**765.** "You are always kind to me;
out of affection for you I have come to your house.

মিশ্রপুরন্দর-সুত শ্রীবিশ্বম্ভর ।
কুলে শীলে গুণে সেই সর্বাঙ্গে সুন্দর ॥ ৭৬৬ ॥

*miśrapurandara-suta śrībiśbambhara |*
*kule śīle guṇe sei sarbāṅge sundara || 766 ||*

*Word for word:* mishra-purandara-suta — the son of Mishra Purandara; sri-vishvambhara — Sri Vishvambhara; kule shile gune — in lineage, character, virtues; sei sarvange sundara — He is beautiful in every way

**766.** The son of Mishra Purandara, Sri Vishvambhara, —
in lineage, character and virtues He is beautiful in every way.

আমি কি কহিতে পারি তার গুণ-কথা ।
একত্র সকল-গুণে গড়িল বিধাতা ॥ ৭৬৭ ॥

*āmi ki kahite pāri tāra guṇa-kathā |*
*ekatra sakala-guṇe gaṛila bidhātā || 767 ||*

*Word for word:* ami ki kahite pari — can I describe; tara guna-katha — His virtues; ekatra sakala-gune — all virtues together; gadila vidhata — the Creator has fashioned

**767.** Can I describe His virtues?
The Creator has gathered all virtues together in one.

কি কহিব তার গুণ গায় সর্বলোকে ।
শুনিবে তাহার গুণ সর্বলোক-মুখে ॥ ৭৬৮ ॥

*ki kahiba tāra guṇa gāẏa sarbaloke |*
*śunibe tāhāra guṇa sarbaloka-mukhe || 768 ||*

*Word for word:* ki kahiba tara guna — what shall I say of His virtues; gaya sarvaloke — all people sing them; shunibe tahara guna — you will hear of His virtues; sarvaloka-mukhe — from the mouths of all

**768.** What shall I say of His virtues — all people sing them;
you will hear of them from the mouths of all.

তোমার কন্যার যোগ্য বর বিশ্বম্ভর ।
কহিল সকল যদি মনে লয় তোর ॥ ৭৬৯ ॥

*tomāra kanyāra yogya bara biśbambhara |*
*kahila sakala yadi mane laẏa tora || 769 ||*

*Word for word:* tomara kanyara yogya bara — a bridegroom worthy of your daughter; vishvambhara — Vishvambhara; kahila sakala — I have said everything; yadi mane laya tora — if it pleases you

**769.** Vishvambhara is a bridegroom worthy of your daughter;
I have said everything — if it pleases your heart."

এ কথা শুনিঞা মিশ্র মনে অনুমানি ।
এ কথা আমার ভাগ্যে কহিলে যে তুমি ॥ ৭৭০ ॥

*e kathā śuniñā miśra mane anumāni |*
*e kathā āmāra bhāgye kahile ye tumi || 770 ||*

*Word for word:* e katha shunina — hearing this; mishra mane anumani — Mishra, reflecting; e katha — these words; amara bhagye — by my good fortune; kahile ye tumi — you have spoken

**770.** Hearing this, Mishra reflected and said:
"By my good fortune you have spoken these words to me.

আমি ধনহীন কিছু দিবারে না পারি ।
কন্যা একমাত্র মোর আছয়ে সুন্দরী ॥ ৭৭১ ॥

*āmi dhanahīna kichu dibāre nā pāri |*
*kanyā ekamātra mora āchaẏe sundarī || 771 ||*

*Word for word:* ami dhanahina — I am poor; kichhu dibare na pari — I cannot give anything; kanya ekamatra mora — my only daughter; achhaye sundari — is a beauty

**771.** I am poor, I cannot give anything [as dowry];
I have only one daughter — a beauty.

ইহা জানি আজ্ঞা যবে করহ আপনে ।
কন্যা দিব বিশ্বম্ভর জামাতা-রতনে ॥ ৭৭২ ॥

*ihā jāni ājñā yabe karaha āpane |*
*kanyā diba biśbambhara jāmātā-ratane || 772 ||*

*Word for word:* iha jani — knowing this; ajna yabe karaha apane — if you yourself direct; kanya diba — I shall give my daughter; vishvambhara jamata-ratane — to Vishvambhara, the jewel of a son-in-law

**772.** Knowing this, if you yourself so direct,
I shall give my daughter to Vishvambhara, a jewel of a son-in-law.

দেব-ঋষি-পিতৃলোকে করিব আনন্দে ।
যবে মোর কন্যা বিভা দিব গৌরচন্দ্রে ॥ ৭৭৩ ॥

*deba-ṛṣi-pitṛloke kariba ānande |*
*yabe mora kanyā bibhā diba gauracandre || 773 ||*

*Word for word:* deva-rishi-pitri-loke — the gods, rishis and ancestors; kariba anande — I shall gladden; yabe — when; mora kanya vibha diba — I give my daughter in marriage; gaurachandre — to Gaurachandra

**773.** I shall gladden the gods, the rishis and the ancestors
when I give my daughter in marriage to Gaurachandra.

অনেক তপের ফলে হয় হেন কর্ম ।
ততোধিক বন্ধু নাহি কহিল এ মর্ম ॥ ৭৭৪ ॥

*aneka tapera phale haẏa hena karma |*
*tatodhika bandhu nāhi kahila e marma || 774 ||*

*Word for word:* aneka tapera phale — as the fruit of much austerity; haya hena karma — such a thing comes about; tatodhika bandhu nahi — there is no greater friend; kahila e marma — I have told the heart of it

**774.** Such a thing comes only as the fruit of much austerity;
there is no greater friend than you — I have told you my heart.

এই মনঃকথা মোর রজনী-দিবস ।
প্রকট বদনে কহি নাহিক সাহস ॥ ৭৭৫ ॥

*ei manaḥkathā mora rajanī-dibasa |*
*prakaṭa badane kahi nāhika sāhasa || 775 ||*

*Word for word:* ei manah-katha mora — this wish of my heart; rajani-divasa — night and day; prakata badane kahi — to say it aloud; nahika sahasa — I had no courage

**775.** This has been my heart's wish day and night,
but I did not dare to say it aloud."

এইমতে দুইজনে কথা নিবড়িল ।
আচার্য শচীর স্থানে সব নিবেদিল ॥ ৭৭৬ ॥

*eimate duijane kathā nibaṛila |*
*ācārya śacīra sthāne saba nibedila || 776 ||*

*Word for word:* eimate — thus; dui-jane katha nibadila — the two came to an agreement; acharya — the Acharya; shachira sthane saba nivedila — reported everything to Shachi

**776.** Thus the two came to an agreement,
and the Acharya reported everything to Shachi.

শুনিঞা সে শচীদেবী বড় তুষ্ট হৈল ।
বনমালী আচার্যেরে আশীর্বাদ কৈল ॥ ৭৭৭ ॥

*śuniñā se śacīdebī baṛa tuṣṭa haila |*
*banamālī ācāryere āśīrbāda kaila || 777 ||*

*Word for word:* shunina — hearing; se shachidevi — Shachi-devi; bada tushta haila — was very pleased; vanamali acharyere — Vanamali Acharya; ashirvada kaila — blessed

**777.** Hearing it, Shachi-devi was very pleased
and blessed Vanamali Acharya.

ইষ্ট-কুটুম্ব আনি নিবেদিল কথা ।
আনন্দে ভরল তনু অতি হরষিতা ॥ ৭৭৮ ॥

*iṣṭa-kuṭumba āni nibedila kathā |*
*ānande bharala tanu ati haraṣitā || 778 ||*

*Word for word:* ishta-kutumba ani — calling friends and kinsfolk; nivedila katha — announced it; anande bharala tanu — her body filled with joy; ati harashita — greatly rejoicing

**778.** Calling her friends and kinsfolk, she made it known to them;
her whole body filled with joy, she rejoiced.

কুটুম্ব সোদর যত সভে আজ্ঞা দিল ।
বিচার করিয়া সভে ভাল ভাল বৈল ॥ ৭৭৯ ॥

*kuṭumba sodara yata sabhe ājñā dila |*
*bicāra kariẏā sabhe bhāla bhāla baila || 779 ||*

*Word for word:* kutumba sodara yata — all the kinsfolk and brothers; sabhe ajna dila — all gave consent; vichara kariya — having considered; sabhe bhala bhala baila — all said "good, good"

**779.** All the kinsfolk and brothers gave their consent;
having considered it, all said: "Good, good."

*Here ends the Pauganda-lila.*

[^17-1]: Sarasvati is the goddess of learning and speech; the Lord is the Master of all knowledge (cf. Murari 1.08.12: "husband of Sarasvati").
[^17-2]: Literally "maya-manusha-vigraha", "a human form by maya": said of the Lord, maya is His yogamaya; so also in Murari (1.09.3).
[^17-3]: Literally "the speech of the bangajas" — natives of East Bengal (cf. Murari 1.09.4). The Lord's forefathers came from Shrihatta, and He loved to mimic the East Bengali accent in jest.
[^17-4]: Vallabhacharya's daughter is Lakshmipriya, Lakshmi herself, who appeared in order to become the Lord's consort; Bhaktisiddhanta in his summary (en/18) calls her Lakshmi-devi. Cf. Murari 1.09.7.
[^17-5]: That is, she bowed to His feet in her mind. The 1983 edition reads: "took upon her head the dust of the Lord's lotus feet".
[^17-6]: Draupadi, wife of the Pandavas, whom Krishna saved from disgrace in the assembly of the Kauravas; the king of elephants is Gajendra (Bhagavata, Canto 8); Ajamila (Bhagavata, Canto 6) was saved by uttering the name of Narayana; the courtesan is probably Pingala (Bhagavata 11.8).
[^17-7]: Literally "a body that spreads disgrace among chaste wives", that is, so beautiful that they lose their composure: a motif of Lochana Dasa's nagari-bhava (see en/09, note 9).
[^17-8]: V. 756+1 is found only in the 1983 edition (absent from Bhaktisiddhanta's edition); the 1903 edition does not have it.

# Adi-khanda, part 10 (portion 18)

*The beginning of the Kaishora-lila: preparations for Vishvambhara's wedding; the adhivasa of bridegroom and bride; the women of Nadia go to fetch water for the rite; the wedding morning — the nandimukha-shraddha, the tears of Shachi and of the Lord for His departed father; the bridegroom's attire and the wedding procession, the rejoicing of Nadia*

## Kaishora-lila (The Pastimes of Youth): the Wedding

> *Summary by Srila Bhaktisiddhanta Sarasvati.* One day, as Gaurasundara, having finished His lessons, was returning home from His teacher's house, He met Vanamali Acharya on the way. Talking with the Acharya, Gaurahari understood that he had gone to His mother Shachi-devi to arrange His marriage, but, not having received the hoped-for answer from Shachi-devi, was returning home with a saddened heart. Without saying a word to the Acharya on the way, Gaurahari went home and by a hint let Mother Shachi know His wish; then Mother Shachi again summoned the matchmaker Vanamali Acharya and told him to arrange her son's marriage. Receiving Mother Shachi's command, Vanamali Acharya came to the house of Vallabhacharya and settled the marriage of Gaurahari with his daughter Lakshmi-devi. When the marriage had been agreed upon, Shachi-devi called her relatives and neighbours and announced her son's wedding, and all were immersed in an ocean of supreme bliss. Meanwhile Shachi-devi set about making all kinds of preparations in the house for her son's wedding. Before long the day of the adhivasa arrived. The respectable ladies, following ancient popular custom, duly performed the anointing of the body with turmeric, the fetching of water[^18-1] and other rites; the Vedic rites too were performed as prescribed. In Vallabhacharya's house all these rites were likewise duly performed. Then on the wedding day Gaurahari, with great pomp, in a festive procession and with many companions, arrived at the house of Vallabhacharya, and the Acharya, according to ancient custom, received his son-in-law by offering Him water for His feet and arghya. Then the Acharya brought his daughter Lakshmi-devi to the wedding pavilion and gave her to Gaurahari. And after completing the rites of kushandika,[^18-2] the feeding of brahmanas and so on, he sent his daughter to his son-in-law's house.

*Raga varadi; disha: "Dvijachand is my life!"*

তবে শচী নিজসুত-বদন চাহিয়া ।
মধুর-বচনে কিছু কহে ত হাসিয়া ॥ ১ ॥

*tabe śacī nijasuta-badana cāhiẏā |*
*madhura-bacane kichu kahe ta hāsiẏā || 1 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe — then; shachi — Shachi; nija-suta-badana chahiya — looking at her son's face; madhura-bachane — with sweet words; kichhu kahe ta hasiya — speaks smiling

**1.** Then Shachi, looking at her son's face,
says to Him sweet words with a smile:

শুন শুন বিশ্বম্ভর মোর সোণার সুত ।
বল্লভ-আচার্য-কন্যা অতি অদভুত ॥ ২ ॥

*śuna śuna biśbambhara mora soṇāra suta |*
*ballabha-ācārya-kanyā ati adabhuta || 2 ||*

*Word for word:* shuna shuna — listen, listen; vishvambhara — Vishvambhara; mora sonara suta — my golden son; vallabha-acharya-kanya — Vallabha Acharya's daughter; ati adabhuta — simply wonderful

**2.** "Listen, listen, Vishvambhara, my golden son:
the daughter of Vallabha Acharya is simply wonderful.

তোর বিবাহের যোগ্য মোর মনে লয় ।
হেন পুত্রবধূ মোর কত ভাগ্যে হয় ॥ ৩ ॥

*tora bibāhera yogya mora mane laẏa |*
*hena putrabadhū mora kata bhāgye haẏa || 3 ||*

*Word for word:* tora vibahera yogya — worthy of marriage with You; mora mane laya — so I feel; hena putra-badhu mora — such a daughter-in-law for me; kata bhagye haya — by what good fortune

**3.** I feel she is worthy to be Your wife;
what good fortune to have such a daughter-in-law!

বিচার করিয়া কর বিচিত্র সময় ।
দ্রব্য আহরণ কর যে উচিত হয় ॥ ৪ ॥

*bicāra kariẏā kara bicitra samaẏa |*
*drabya āharaṇa kara ye ucita haẏa || 4 ||*

*Word for word:* vichara kariya — considering; kara vichitra samaya — fix a splendid time; dravya aharana kara — gather the things; ye uchita haya — that are proper

**4.** Consider it and fix a splendid time;
gather all that is proper."

শুনিঞা মায়ের বাণী বিশ্বম্ভর রায় ।
করিল সকল দ্রব্য যতেক যুয়ায় ॥ ৫ ॥

*śuniñā māẏera bāṇī biśbambhara rāẏa |*
*karila sakala drabya yateka yuẏāẏa || 5 ||*

*Word for word:* shunina mayera vani — hearing His mother's words; vishvambhara raya — Vishvambhara Raya; karila sakala dravya — got ready everything; yateka yuyaya — that was needed

**5.** Hearing His mother's words, Vishvambhara Raya
got ready all that was needed.

দৈবজ্ঞ আনিল আর উত্তম পণ্ডিত ।
করিল ত শুভক্ষণ সময় অঙ্কিত ॥ ৬ ॥

*daibajña ānila āra uttama paṇḍita |*
*karila ta śubhakṣaṇa samaẏa aṅkita || 6 ||*

*Word for word:* daivajna anila — called an astrologer; ara uttama pandita — and an excellent pandit; karila ta — they fixed; shubha-kshana samaya ankita — the auspicious moment and time

**6.** He called an astrologer and an excellent pandit,
and they fixed the auspicious moment and time.

সেই শুভদিন শুভসময় হইল ।
ব্রাহ্মণ-সজ্জন সব আনন্দে আইল ॥ ৭ ॥

*sei śubhadina śubhasamaẏa haila |*
*brāhmaṇa-sajjana saba ānande āila || 7 ||*

*Word for word:* sei shubhadina — that auspicious day; shubha-samaya haila — the auspicious time came; brahmana-sajjana saba — brahmanas and all good people; anande aila — came joyfully

**7.** That auspicious day, that auspicious time arrived;
brahmanas and all good people came joyfully.

আনন্দে ভরল সব নদীয়া-নগরী ।
উথলিল প্রেমসিন্ধু আপনা পাসরি ॥ ৮ ॥

*ānande bharala saba nadīẏā-nagarī |*
*uthalila premasindhu āpanā pāsari || 8 ||*

*Word for word:* anande bharala — was filled with joy; saba nadiya-nagari — the whole town of Nadia; uthalila prema-sindhu — the ocean of prema surged; apana pasari — forgetting themselves

**8.** The whole town of Nadia was filled with joy;
the ocean of prema surged, and all forgot themselves.

আইহ-সুহ লঞা শচী করে শুভকার্য ।
প্রভু-অধিবাস করে সকল আচার্য ॥ ৯ ॥

*āiha-suha lañā śacī kare śubhakārya |*
*prabhu-adhibāsa kare sakala ācārya || 9 ||*

*Word for word:* aiha-suha lana — with the married women; shachi kare shubha-karya — Shachi performs the auspicious rites; prabhu-adhivasa kare — perform the Lord's adhivasa; sakala acharya — all the acharyas

**9.** Gathering the married women,[^18-3] Shachi performs the auspicious rites;
all the acharyas perform the Lord's adhivasa.

চতুর্দিকে বেদধ্বনি করয়ে ব্রাহ্মণ ।
শঙ্খ মৃদঙ্গ বাজে মঙ্গল লক্ষণ ॥ ১০ ॥

*caturdike bedadhbani karaẏe brāhmaṇa |*
*śaṅkha mṛdaṅga bāje maṅgala lakṣaṇa || 10 ||*

*Word for word:* chaturdike — on all sides; veda-dhvani karaye brahmana — brahmanas recite the Vedas; shankha mridanga baje — conchs and mridangas sound; mangala lakshana — auspicious signs

**10.** On all sides the brahmanas recite the Vedas;
conchs and mridangas sound — auspicious signs.

দীপ-মালা-পতাকা-ভূষিত দিগন্তরে ।
সুগন্ধি-চন্দন মালা অতি মনোহরে ॥ ১১ ॥

*dīpa-mālā-patākā-bhūṣita digantare |*
*sugandhi-candana mālā ati manohare || 11 ||*

*Word for word:* dipa-mala-pataka-bhushita — adorned with rows of lamps and flags; digantare — the quarters; sugandhi-chandana mala — fragrant sandal, garlands; ati manohare — most beautiful

**11.** All the quarters are adorned with rows of lamps and flags;
fragrant sandal, garlands — everything is beautiful.

সকল ব্রাহ্মণে প্রভুর কৈল অধিবাস ।
কোটি-কামরূপ দেহ কৈল পরকাশ ॥ ১২ ॥

*sakala brāhmaṇe prabhura kaila adhibāsa |*
*koṭi-kāmarūpa deha kaila parakāśa || 12 ||*

*Word for word:* sakala brahmane — all the brahmanas; prabhura kaila adhivasa — performed the Lord's adhivasa; koti-kama-rupa deha — a body beautiful as millions of Kamas; kaila parakasha — He revealed

**12.** All the brahmanas performed the Lord's adhivasa,
and He revealed a body as beautiful as millions of Kamadevas.

ঝলমল করে অঙ্গ-ছটা আলোকিত ।
দেখিয়া ব্রাহ্মণ সব ভেল চমকিত ॥ ১৩ ॥

*jhalamala kare aṅga-chaṭā ālokita |*
*dekhiẏā brāhmaṇa saba bhela camakita || 13 ||*

*Word for word:* jhalamala kare — sparkles; anga-chhata alokita — all lit by the radiance of His body; dekhiya — seeing; brahmana saba — all the brahmanas; bhela chamakita — were amazed

**13.** His body sparkles, all is lit by its radiance;
seeing it, all the brahmanas were amazed.

সুগন্ধি-চন্দন মালা ব্রাহ্মণেরে দিল ।
ঘন ঘন তাম্বূল-দানে বড় তুষ্ট কৈল ॥ ১৪ ॥

*sugandhi-candana mālā brāhmaṇere dila |*
*ghana ghana tāmbūla-dāne baṛa tuṣṭa kaila || 14 ||*

*Word for word:* sugandhi-chandana mala — fragrant sandal, garlands; brahmanere dila — were given to the brahmanas; ghana ghana tambula-dane — with repeated gifts of betel; bada tushta kaila — pleased them greatly

**14.** The brahmanas were given fragrant sandal and garlands
and, with gift after gift of betel, were greatly pleased.

কন্যা অধিবাস করে বল্লভ-আচার্য ।
সুমঙ্গল কর্ম কৈল লঞা দ্বিজবর্য ॥ ১৫ ॥

*kanyā adhibāsa kare ballabha-ācārya |*
*sumaṅgala karma kaila lañā dbijabarya || 15 ||*

*Word for word:* kanya adhivasa kare — performs the bride's adhivasa; vallabha-acharya — Vallabha Acharya; sumangala karma kaila — performed the auspicious rites; lana dvijavarya — with the best of brahmanas

**15.** Vallabha Acharya performs the bride's adhivasa;
with the best of brahmanas he performed the auspicious rites.

অন্যোন্যে সৌরভ্য গন্ধ-মাল্য-চন্দন ।
অধিবাসে ভূষা কৈল জামাতা-রতন ॥ ১৬ ॥

*anyonye saurabhya gandha-mālya-candana |*
*adhibāse bhūṣā kaila jāmātā-ratana || 16 ||*

*Word for word:* anyonye — mutually; saurabhya gandha-malya-chandana — fragrant scents, garlands, sandal; adhivase — at the adhivasa; bhusha kaila — adorned; jamata-ratana — the jewel of a son-in-law

**16.** Exchanging fragrant garlands, sandal and scents,
at the adhivasa they adorned the jewel of a son-in-law.

অধিবাস-সমাধান রজনীর শেষে ।
পানী সাহিব বলি আইল উল্লাসে ॥ ১৭ ॥

*adhibāsa-samādhāna rajanīra śeṣe |*
*pānī sāhiba bali āila ullāse || 17 ||*
