*Word for word:* adhivasa-samadhana — the completion of the adhivasa; rajanira sheshe — at the end of the night; pani sahiba bali — saying "we shall fetch the water" (for the rite); aila ullase — came rejoicing

**17.** When the adhivasa was finished towards the end of the night,
[the women] came rejoicing, saying: "Let us go for the water!"[^18-4]

নানা বাদ্য এককালে হইল তরঙ্গ ।
কুলবতী সভাকার ব্রত কৈল ভঙ্গ ॥ ১৮ ॥

*nānā bādya ekakāle haila taraṅga |*
*kulabatī sabhākāra brata kaila bhaṅga || 18 ||*

*Word for word:* nana vadya — all kinds of instruments; eka-kale — at once; haila taranga — rose in waves; kulavati sabhakara — of all the respectable wives; vrata kaila bhanga — broke the vows

**18.** All at once, in waves, all kinds of instruments sounded,
and all the respectable wives forgot their vows.

যুবতী উমতী হৈল নদীয়া-নগরে ।
গৌরাঙ্গ-বিবাহ-রস-সমুদ্র-হিল্লোলে ॥ ১৯ ॥

*yubatī umatī haila nadīẏā-nagare |*
*gaurāṅga-bibāha-rasa-samudra-hillole || 19 ||*

*Word for word:* yuvati — the young women; umati haila — lost their senses; nadiya-nagare — in the town of Nadia; gauranga-vibaha-rasa-samudra-hillole — in the waves of the ocean of rasa of Gauranga's wedding

**19.** The young women in the town of Nadia lost their senses
in the waves of the ocean of rasa of Gauranga's wedding.[^18-5]

যূথে যূথে নাগরী চলিল বিপ্রবধূ ।
অবনী-মণ্ডলেরে মণ্ডিত যেন বিধু ॥ ২০ ॥

*yūthe yūthe nāgarī calila biprabadhū |*
*abanī-maṇḍalere maṇḍita yena bidhu || 20 ||*

*Word for word:* yuthe yuthe — in throngs; nagari chalila — the nagaris went; vipra-badhu — wives of brahmanas; avani-mandalere mandita — adorning the circle of the earth; yena vidhu — like moons

**20.** In throngs go the nagaris — wives of brahmanas —
like moons adorning the circle of the earth.

কুরঙ্গ-নয়নী চারু কুঞ্জর-গামিনী ।
ঝলমল অঙ্গতেজ মদন-দাপুনী ॥ ২১ ॥

*kuraṅga-naẏanī cāru kuñjara-gāminī |*
*jhalamala aṅgateja madana-dāpunī || 21 ||*

*Word for word:* kuranga-nayani — doe-eyed; charu kunjara-gamini — with the lovely gait of a she-elephant; jhalamala anga-teja — their bodies' radiance sparkles; madana-dapuni — humbling Madana's pride

**21.** Eyes like a doe's, gait like a she-elephant's,
the radiance of their bodies sparkles, humbling Madana's pride.

কেশ-বেশ-বসন-ভূষণ অনুপাম ।
হেরিলে হরিতে পারে মুনির পরাণ ॥ ২২ ॥

*keśa-beśa-basana-bhūṣaṇa anupāma |*
*herile harite pāre munira parāṇa || 22 ||*

*Word for word:* kesha-besha-basana-bhushana — hair, dress, garments, ornaments; anupama — matchless; herile — on seeing; harite pare — can steal; munira parana — a sage's heart

**22.** Their hair, dress, garments and ornaments are matchless:
one glance at them would steal even a sage's heart.

হাসিতে দামিনী কাঁপে বচনে অমিয়া ।
হাস-পরিহাসে চলে ঢুলিয়া ঢুলিয়া ॥ ২৩ ॥

*hāsite dāminī kāṁpe bacane amiẏā |*
*hāsa-parihāse cale ḍhuliẏā ḍhuliẏā || 23 ||*

*Word for word:* hasite — in the smile; damini kanpe — lightning trembles; bachane amiya — nectar in speech; hasa-parihase — laughing and jesting; chale dhuliya dhuliya — they go swaying

**23.** In their smiles lightning trembles, in their speech is nectar;
laughing and jesting, they go swaying along.

গাইছে গৌরাঙ্গগুণ মধুর-আলাপে ।
স্বর-পঞ্চ-ধ্বনিতে অনঙ্গ-অঙ্গ কাঁপে ॥ ২৪ ॥

*gāiche gaurāṅgaguṇa madhura-ālāpe |*
*sbara-pañca-dhbanite anaṅga-aṅga kāṁpe || 24 ||*

*Word for word:* gaichhe gauranga-guna — they sing Gauranga's virtues; madhura-alape — in sweet melodies; svara-pancha-dhvanite — at the sound of the fifth note; ananga-anga kanpe — Ananga's body trembles

**24.** They sing of Gauranga's virtues in sweet melodies;
at the sound of the fifth note Ananga's body trembles.

নাসায় বেশর শোভে মুকুতা-হিল্লোলে ।
নক্ষত্র পড়িছে যেন অরুণ-মণ্ডলে ॥ ২৫ ॥

*nāsāẏa beśara śobhe mukutā-hillole |*
*nakṣatra paṛiche yena aruṇa-maṇḍale || 25 ||*

*Word for word:* nasaya beshara shobhe — nose-rings shine; mukuta-hillole — with swaying pearls; nakshatra padichhe — stars are falling; yena — as if; aruna-mandale — onto the red disc [of dawn]

**25.** In their noses pearl-rings sway —
as if stars were falling onto the red disc [of dawn].

শচীর মন্দিরে আইলা কুলবধূগণ ।
সভাকারে দিলা গন্ধ গুবাক চন্দন ॥ ২৬ ॥

*śacīra mandire āilā kulabadhūgaṇa |*
*sabhākāre dilā gandha gubāka candana || 26 ||*

*Word for word:* shachira mandire — to Shachi's house; aila kulabadhu-gana — the respectable wives came; sabhakare dila — to all were given; gandha guvaka chandana — scents, betel nuts and sandal

**26.** The respectable wives came to Shachi's house;
all were given scents, betel nuts and sandal.

চলিলা নাগরী সভে পানী সাহিবারে ।
মঙ্গল আনন্দরস প্রতি ঘরে ঘরে ॥ ২৭ ॥

*calilā nāgarī sabhe pānī sāhibāre |*
*maṅgala ānandarasa prati ghare ghare || 27 ||*

*Word for word:* chalila nagari sabhe — all the nagaris went; pani sahibare — to fetch the water; mangala ananda-rasa — auspicious joy; prati ghare ghare — in every house

**27.** All the nagaris went for the water;
in every house there is auspicious joy.

*Sung in raga tudi*

সচন্দ্রিম রজনী চন্দ্রমুখী বালা ।
সুস্বর সঙ্গীত গো গাইব গোরালীলা ॥ ২৮ ॥

*sacandrima rajanī candramukhī bālā |*
*susbara saṅgīta go gāiba gorālīlā || 28 ||*

*Word for word:* sachandrima rajani — a moonlit night; chandramukhi bala — moon-faced maidens; susvara sangita — with sweet voices; go — friends; gaiba gora-lila — we shall sing Gora's lilas

**28.** A moonlit night, moon-faced maidens;
with sweet voices, friends, we shall sing of Gora's lilas.

*Refrain: "Who, who will go in front, friends, who will sing of Gora's virtues, friends? Let us go for the water! The heart surges — who can hold it back?"*

কেহ পট্টবিলাসিনী কেহ পীতবাসে ।
ঢুলিতে ঢুলিতে যায় গোরা-অঙ্গের বাতাসে ॥ ২৯ ॥

*keha paṭṭabilāsinī keha pītabāse |*
*ḍhulite ḍhulite yāẏa gorā-aṅgera bātāse || 29 ||*

*Word for word:* keha pattavilasini — one in silken dress; keha pita-vase — another in yellow garments; dhulite dhulite yaya — they go swaying; gora-angera batase — [fanned by] the breeze from Gora's body

**29.** One in silken dress, another in yellow garments;
swaying, they go [fanned by] the breeze from Gora's body.

শচী আগে আগে করি যাব পাছে পাছে ।
আসিতে যাইতে গো দাঁড়াব গোরা-কাছে ॥ ৩০ ॥

*śacī āge āge kari yāba pāche pāche |*
*āsite yāite go dāṁṛāba gorā-kāche || 30 ||*

*Word for word:* shachi age age kari — putting Shachi in front; yaba pachhe pachhe — we shall go behind; asite yaite — coming and going; go — friends; dandaba gora-kachhe — we shall stand near Gora

**30.** "Let Shachi go in front, and we shall go behind her;
coming and going, friends, we shall stand near Gora.

সুগন্ধি-চন্দন মালা ঢাকি লহ করে ।
গোরা-অঙ্গ পরশ করিব সেহি ছলে ॥ ৩১ ॥

*sugandhi-candana mālā ḍhāki laha kare |*
*gorā-aṅga paraśa kariba sehi chale || 31 ||*

*Word for word:* sugandhi-chandana mala — fragrant sandal and garlands; dhaki laha kare — take in your hands, covered; gora-anga parasha kariba — I shall touch Gora's body; sehi chhale — on that pretext

**31.** Take fragrant sandal and garlands in your hands, covered:
on that pretext I shall touch Gora's body.

কর্পূর তাম্বূল লেহ যত্ন করি হাথে ।
করে কর ধরি গোরার দিব হাথে হাথে ॥ ৩২ ॥

*karpūra tāmbūla leha yatna kari hāthe |*
*kare kara dhari gorāra diba hāthe hāthe || 32 ||*

*Word for word:* karpura tambula — camphor and betel; leha yatna kari hathe — take carefully in your hands; kare kara dhari — hand in hand; gorara diba hathe hathe — I shall place right into Gora's hand

**32.** Take camphor and betel carefully in your hands;
hand in hand, I shall place them right into Gora's hand."

আইহ-সুহ মিলিয়া কৌতুক-রঙ্গ-রসে ।
পানী সাহিল গুণ গায় এ লোচনদাসে ॥ ৩৩ ॥

*āiha-suha miliẏā kautuka-raṅga-rase |*
*pānī sāhila guṇa gāẏa e locanadāse || 33 ||*

*Word for word:* aiha-suha miliya — the married women together; kautuka-ranga-rase — in play and merriment; pani sahila — fetched the water; guna gaya — sings the virtues; e lochana-dase — this Lochana Dasa

**33.** The married women, gathered together in play and merriment,
brought the water — so sings this Lochana Dasa of [the Lord's] virtues.

*Raga bhatiyari*

আনন্দে সানন্দে রাত্রি সুপ্রভাতে ।
যথাবিধি কর্ম কৈল হরষিত-চিতে ॥ ৩৪ ॥

*ānande sānande rātri suprabhāte |*
*yathābidhi karma kaila haraṣita-cite || 34 ||*

*Word for word:* anande sanande — in joy and gladness; ratri — the night [passed]; suprabhate — at the bright dawn; yathavidhi karma kaila — performed the rites by rule; harashita-chite — with joyful hearts

**34.** In joy and gladness the night passed; at the bright dawn
with joyful hearts they performed the rites according to rule.

স্নান-দান কর্ম কৈল যে ছিল উচিত ।
দেবপূজা পিতৃপূজা করিল বিহিত ॥ ৩৫ ॥

*snāna-dāna karma kaila ye chila ucita |*
*debapūjā pitṛpūjā karila bihita || 35 ||*

*Word for word:* snana-dana karma kaila — performed bathing and gift-giving; ye chhila uchita — as was proper; deva-puja pitri-puja — worship of gods and ancestors; karila vihita — performed as prescribed

**35.** They performed the bathing and the giving of gifts, as was proper;
as prescribed, they worshipped the gods and the ancestors.

নান্দীমুখ-শ্রাদ্ধ কৈল যে বেদবিধান ।
সর্ব সম্পূর্ণ ভোজ্য ব্রাহ্মণেরে দান ॥ ৩৬ ॥

*nāndīmukha-śrāddha kaila ye bedabidhāna |*
*sarba sampūrṇa bhojya brāhmaṇere dāna || 36 ||*

*Word for word:* nandimukha-shraddha kaila — performed the nandimukha-shraddha; ye veda-vidhana — as the Vedas ordain; sarva sampurna bhojya — abundant food; brahmanere dana — given to the brahmanas

**36.** They performed the nandimukha-shraddha as the Vedas ordain;
abundant food was given to the brahmanas.

নর্তকেরে দিল দ্রব্য আর ভাটগণে ।
সভার সন্তোষ কৈল নানা দ্রব্যদানে ॥ ৩৭ ॥

*nartakere dila drabya āra bhāṭagaṇe |*
*sabhāra santoṣa kaila nānā drabyadāne || 37 ||*

*Word for word:* nartakere dila dravya — gifts were given to dancers; ara bhatagane — and to the bards; sabhara santosha kaila — all were pleased; nana dravya-dane — with gifts of every kind

**37.** To dancers and to the bards gifts were given;
with gifts of every kind all were pleased.

দ্রব্যকে অধিক মানে মধুর বচনে ।
দেখিয়া যুড়ায় হিয়া চন্দ্রিম-বদনে ॥ ৩৮ ॥

*drabyake adhika māne madhura bacane |*
*dekhiẏā yuṛāẏa hiẏā candrima-badane || 38 ||*

*Word for word:* dravyake adhika mane — they value more than the gifts; madhura bachane — the sweet words; dekhiya — seeing; yudaya hiya — the heart is refreshed; chandrima-badane — the moonlike face

**38.** But they valued [the Lord's] sweet words more than the gifts:
seeing His moonlike face, the heart is refreshed.

প্রবোধ করিল যার যেই অনুমান ।
বিবাহ-উচিত প্রভু করে পুনঃ স্নান ॥ ৩৯ ॥

*prabodha karila yāra yei anumāna |*
*bibāha-ucita prabhu kare punaḥ snāna || 39 ||*

*Word for word:* prabodha karila — satisfied; yara yei anumana — each according to his hope; vibaha-uchita — as befits the wedding; prabhu kare punah snana — the Lord bathes again

**39.** He satisfied each one as he had hoped;
then the Lord bathes again, as befits the wedding.

নাপিতে নাপিত-ক্রিয়া করিল সেকালে ।
শ্রীঅঙ্গ-মার্জনা করে কুলবধূ মেলে ॥ ৪০ ॥

*nāpite nāpita-kriẏā karila sekāle |*
*śrīaṅga-mārjanā kare kulabadhū mele || 40 ||*

*Word for word:* napite — the barber; napita-kriya karila — did his work; se-kale — then; sri-anga-marjana kare — anoint the divine body; kulabadhu mele — the respectable wives together

**40.** Then the barber did his work,
and the respectable wives together anoint His divine body.

সুধাকরময় গোরা রূপের পাথার ।
ডুবিল তরুণীর মন না জানে সাঁতার ॥ ৪০+১ ॥

*sudhākaramaẏa gorā rūpera pāthāra |*
*ḍubila taruṇīra mana nā jāne sāṁtāra || 40+1 ||*

*Word for word:* sudhakaramaya — made of moon-nectar; gora — Gora; rupera pathara — an ocean of beauty; dubila — sank; tarunira mana — the minds (hearts) of the young women; na jane santara — know not how to swim

**40+1.** Gora is an ocean of beauty woven of moonlit nectar;
the hearts of the young women sank in it — they do not know how to swim.[^18-6]

পরশে অবশ অঙ্গ হইল সবাকার ।
গদগদ বচন নয়নে জলধার ॥ ৪০+২ ॥

*paraśe abaśa aṅga haila sabākāra |*
*gadagada bacana naẏane jaladhāra || 40+2 ||*

*Word for word:* parashe — at the touch; avasha anga haila — the body grew faint; sabakara — of all; gadgada vachana — faltering speech; nayane jaladhara — streams of tears from the eyes

**40+2.** At touching Him the bodies of all grew faint;
their speech falters, streams of tears flow from their eyes.

হেরইতে পহু-মুখ কি ভাব উঠিল ।
মরমে মদন-জ্বরে ঢলিয়া পড়িল ॥ ৪০+৩ ॥

*heraite pahu-mukha ki bhāba uṭhila |*
*marame madana-jbare ḍhaliẏā paṛila || 40+3 ||*

*Word for word:* heraite — on beholding; pahu-mukha — the Lord's face; ki bhava uthila — what feeling arose; marame — deep in the heart; madana-jvare — with the fever of Madana; dhaliya padila — sank down powerless

**40+3.** On beholding the Lord's face — what feeling rose in them! —
burning deep in their hearts with the fever of Madana, they sank down powerless.

কেহো বাহু ধরি রহে অথির হইয়া ।
কেহো রহে উদ্বর্তন শ্রীঅঙ্গে লেপিয়া ॥ ৪০+৪ ॥

*keho bāhu dhari rahe athira haiẏā |*
*keho rahe udbartana śrīaṅge lepiẏā || 40+4 ||*

*Word for word:* keho — one; bahu dhari — holding [His] arm; rahe athira haiya — stands trembling; keho rahe — another stays; udvartana — fragrant paste; sri-ange lepiya — rubbing [it] on the divine body

**40+4.** One, holding His arm, stands all atremble;
another stays still, rubbing His divine body with fragrant paste.

কেহো বুকে পদযুগ ধরিয়া আনন্দে ।
ভুজলতা দিয়া সে বান্ধিল পরবন্ধে ॥ ৪০+৫ ॥

*keho buke padayuga dhariẏā ānande |*
*bhujalatā diẏā se bāndhila parabandhe || 40+5 ||*

*Word for word:* keho — one; buke — to the breast; padayuga dhariya — clasping the two feet; anande — in bliss; bhujalata diya — with the creepers of her arms; se bandhila — she bound; parabandhe — fast

**40+5.** One in bliss pressed His two feet to her breast
and bound them fast with the creepers of her arms.

কেহো চিত্রার্পিত হৈয়া নেহারে গৌরাঙ্গ ।
কেহো জল দেই শিরে মদন-তরঙ্গে ॥ ৪০+৬ ॥

*keho citrārpita haiẏā nehāre gaurāṅga |*
*keho jala dei śire madana-taraṅge || 40+6 ||*

*Word for word:* keho — one; chitrarpita haiya — as if painted in a picture; nehare gauranga — gazes at Gauranga; keho — another; jala dei shire — pours water on the head; madana-tarange — in the waves of Madana

**40+6.** One, as if painted in a picture, gazes fixedly at Gauranga;
another, in the waves of Madana, pours water on His head.

উন্মত্ত হইয়া কেহো হাসে ঘনে ঘনে ।
সতীত্ব নাশিল হেরি গৌরাঙ্গ-বদনে ॥ ৪০+৭ ॥

*unmatta haiẏā keho hāse ghane ghane |*
*satītba nāśila heri gaurāṅga-badane || 40+7 ||*

*Word for word:* unmatta haiya — as if mad; keho hase — one laughs; ghane ghane — again and again; satitva nashila — lost [the duty of] a faithful wife; heri — seeing; gauranga-vadane — Gauranga's face

**40+7.** One, as if mad, laughs again and again:
seeing Gauranga's face, they forgot even the duty of a faithful wife.

অভিষেক কৈল প্রভুর সুরনদী-জলে ।
দেখি সর্বজন ভাসে আনন্দ-হিল্লোলে ॥ ৪০+৮ ॥

*abhiṣeka kaila prabhura suranadī-jale |*
*dekhi sarbajana bhāse ānanda-hillole || 40+8 ||*

*Word for word:* abhisheka kaila — bathed; prabhura — the Lord; suranadi-jale — with the water of the celestial river; dekhi — seeing; sarvajana — all people; bhase — float; ananda-hillole — on waves of bliss

**40+8.** They bathed the Lord with the water of the celestial river;
seeing this, all the people rocked on waves of bliss.

স্নান সমাধিয়া যবে বসিলা আসনে ।
বেঢ়িল নাগরীগণ শচীর নন্দনে ॥ ৪০+৯ ॥

*snāna samādhiẏā yabe basilā āsane |*
*beṛhila nāgarīgaṇa śacīra nandane || 40+9 ||*

*Word for word:* snana samadhiya — having completed the bath; yabe basila asane — when He sat on the seat; bedhila — surrounded; nagari-gana — the nagaris; shachira nandane — the son of Shachi

**40+9.** When, His bath completed, He sat down on His seat,
the nagaris surrounded the son of Shachi.

নানাবিধ বাদ্য বাজে সুমধুর ধ্বনি ।
চতুর্দিকে হুলাহুলি জয় জয় শুনি ॥ ৪১ ॥

*nānābidha bādya bāje sumadhura dhbani |*
*caturdike hulāhuli jaẏa jaẏa śuni || 41 ||*

*Word for word:* nanavidha vadya baje — all kinds of instruments sound; sumadhura dhvani — sweet tones; chaturdike — on all sides; hulahuli — "ulu-ulu" cries; jaya jaya shuni — "Jaya, jaya!" is heard

**41.** All kinds of instruments sound with sweet tones;
on all sides the cries of "ulu-ulu" and "Jaya, jaya!" are heard.

তবে শচীদেবী লই আইহ-সুহ যত ।
আদরে পূজয়ে যার যেই সমুচিত ॥ ৪২ ॥

*tabe śacīdebī lai āiha-suha yata |*
*ādare pūjaẏe yāra yei samucita || 42 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe shachidevi — then Shachi-devi; lai aiha-suha yata — taking all the married women; adare pujaye — lovingly honours; yara yei samuchita — each as befits her

**42.** Then Shachi-devi, taking with her all the married women,
lovingly honours each as befits her.

সভারে পূজিলা গৃহাগত বন্ধু যত ।
বলিল সভারে শচী হৃদয় বেকত ॥ ৪৩ ॥

*sabhāre pūjilā gṛhāgata bandhu yata |*
*balila sabhāre śacī hṛdaẏa bekata || 43 ||*

*Word for word:* sabhare pujila — honoured all; griha-agata bandhu yata — all the kin who had come to the house; balila sabhare shachi — Shachi said to all; hridaya bekata — opening her heart

**43.** She honoured all the kinsfolk who had come to the house
and spoke to all, opening her heart:

পতিহীন মুঞি ছার পুত্র পিতৃহীন ।
তো সভার পূজা কি করিব আমি দীন ॥ ৪৪ ॥

*patihīna muñi chāra putra pitṛhīna |*
*to sabhāra pūjā ki kariba āmi dīna || 44 ||*

*Word for word:* patihina muni chhara — I, wretched, without a husband; putra pitrihina — my son fatherless; to sabhara puja — honouring you; ki kariba ami dina — how shall I, poor one, do it

**44.** "I, wretched one, have lost my husband, my son is fatherless;
how can I, poor as I am, honour you?"[^18-7]

এ বোল বলিতে শচী গদগদ-ভাষ ।
ভিজিল আঁখির জলে হৃদয়ের বাস ॥ ৪৫ ॥

*e bola balite śacī gadagada-bhāṣa |*
*bhijila āṁkhira jale hṛdaẏera bāsa || 45 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola balite — saying this; shachi gadagada-bhasha — Shachi's speech faltered; bhijila ankhira jale — was soaked with the tears of her eyes; hridayera basa — the garment over her breast

**45.** As she said this, Shachi's voice faltered;
tears from her eyes soaked the garment over her breast.

এছন কাতর-বাণী শচী যবে বৈল ।
শুনি বিশ্বম্ভর পহুঁ হেট মাথা কৈল ॥ ৪৬ ॥

*echana kātara-bāṇī śacī yabe baila |*
*śuni biśbambhara pahuṁ heṭa māthā kaila || 46 ||*

*Word for word:* echhana katara-vani — such grieving words; shachi yabe baila — when Shachi spoke; shuni — hearing; vishvambhara pahun — the Lord Vishvambhara; heta matha kaila — bowed His head

**46.** When Shachi spoke these grieving words,
the Lord Vishvambhara, hearing them, bowed His head.

চিন্তিতে লাগিলা মোর পিতা গেলা কোথা ।
পুড়িতে লাগিল হিয়া পাইল বড় ব্যথা ॥ ৪৭ ॥

*cintite lāgilā mora pitā gelā kothā |*
*puṛite lāgila hiẏā pāila baṛa byathā || 47 ||*

*Word for word:* chintite lagila — He began to think; mora pita gela kotha — where has My father gone; pudite lagila hiya — His heart began to burn; paila bada vyatha — He felt great pain

**47.** He began to think: "Where has My father gone?"
His heart began to burn; He felt great pain.

মুকুতা-গাঁথনী যেন চক্ষে পড়ে পানী ।
দেখিয়া ত্রস্ত হৈলা দেবী শচীরাণী ॥ ৪৮ ॥

*mukutā-gāṁthanī yena cakṣe paṛe pānī |*
*dekhiẏā trasta hailā debī śacīrāṇī || 48 ||*

*Word for word:* mukuta-ganthani yena — like a string of pearls; chakshe pade pani — tears fall from the eyes; dekhiya — seeing; trasta haila — was alarmed; devi shachirani — the goddess Shachi-rani

**48.** Tears fall from His eyes like a string of pearls;
seeing this, the goddess Shachi-rani was alarmed.

আর যত কুলবধূ তার পাশে ছিল ।
প্রভুর কান্দনা দেখি কান্দিতে লাগিল ॥ ৪৯ ॥

*āra yata kulabadhū tāra pāśe chila |*
*prabhura kāndanā dekhi kāndite lāgila || 49 ||*

*Word for word:* ara yata kulabadhu — and all the respectable wives; tara pashe chhila — who were beside her; prabhura kandana dekhi — seeing the Lord weep; kandite lagila — began to weep

**49.** And all the respectable wives who were beside her,
seeing the Lord's tears, began to weep.

কেনে কেনে বাপ হেরি নিরস-বদন ।
এহেন মঙ্গলকার্যে করহ ক্রন্দন ॥ ৫০ ॥

*kene kene bāpa heri nirasa-badana |*
*ehena maṅgalakārye karaha krandana || 50 ||*

*Word for word:* kene kene — why, why; bapa — child; heri nirasa-badana — do I see Your face so sad; ehena mangala-karye — at such an auspicious event; karaha krandana — You weep

**50.** "Why, why, child, do I see Your face so sad?
At such an auspicious time — and You weep?

সকল সংসারে মোর তুমি মাত্র ধন ।
তুমি বিমরিষ প্রাণ ছাড়িব এখন ॥ ৫১ ॥

*sakala saṃsāre mora tumi mātra dhana |*
*tumi bimariṣa prāṇa chāṛiba ekhana || 51 ||*

*Word for word:* sakala samsare — in all the world; mora tumi matra dhana — You are my only wealth; tumi vimarisha — [if] You are dejected; prana chhadiba ekhana — I shall give up my life now

**51.** In all the world You are my only wealth;
if You are dejected, I shall give up my life this very moment."

শুনিঞা মায়ের বাণী প্রভু বিশ্বম্ভর ।
বাপের হুতাশে কণ্ঠ গদগদ-স্বর ॥ ৫২ ॥

*śuniñā māẏera bāṇī prabhu biśbambhara |*
*bāpera hutāśe kaṇṭha gadagada-sbara || 52 ||*

*Word for word:* shunina mayera vani — hearing His mother's words; prabhu vishvambhara — the Lord Vishvambhara; bapera hutashe — in grief for His father; kantha gadagada-svara — with faltering voice

**52.** Hearing His mother's words, the Lord Vishvambhara,
grieving for His father, speaks in a faltering voice.

প্রাতঃকালে শশী যেন মলিন-বদন ।
নবীন-মেঘের যেন গম্ভীর গর্জন ॥ ৫৩ ॥

*prātaḥkāle śaśī yena malina-badana |*
*nabīna-meghera yena gambhīra garjana || 53 ||*

*Word for word:* pratah-kale shashi yena — like the moon at dawn; malina-badana — with pale face; navina-meghera yena — as of a fresh cloud; gambhira garjana — deep thunder

**53.** His face was pale, like the moon at dawn;
[His voice] like the deep thunder of a fresh cloud.

মায়েরে কহিল প্রভু শুন মোর কথা ।
কি লাগিয়া এতদূর তোর মন-ব্যথা ॥ ৫৪ ॥

*māẏere kahila prabhu śuna mora kathā |*
*ki lāgiẏā etadūra tora mana-byathā || 54 ||*

*Word for word:* mayere kahila prabhu — the Lord said to His mother; shuna mora katha — listen to My words; ki lagiya — why; etadura — so great; tora mana-vyatha — the pain in your heart

**54.** The Lord said to His mother: "Listen to what I say:
why is there such pain in your heart?

কোন্ ধন নাহি তোর কিবা পাইলে দুঃখ ।
দীন একাকিনী হেন কহ অতি রূখ ॥ ৫৫ ॥

*kon dhana nāhi tora kibā pāile duḥkha |*
*dīna ekākinī hena kaha ati rūkha || 55 ||*

*Word for word:* kon dhana nahi tora — what wealth do you lack; kiba paile duhkha — what sorrow has befallen you; dina ekakini hena — as if poor and alone; kaha ati rukha — you speak so bitterly

**55.** What wealth do you lack? What sorrow has befallen you?
You speak so bitterly, as if you were poor and alone.

পিতা-অদর্শন মোর স্মরাইলে তুমি ।
যেমন করিছে হিয়া কি কহিব আমি ॥ ৫৬ ॥

*pitā-adarśana mora smarāile tumi |*
*yemana kariche hiẏā ki kahiba āmi || 56 ||*

*Word for word:* pita-adarshana mora — My no longer seeing My father; smaraile tumi — you have reminded Me of; yemana karichhe hiya — how My heart feels; ki kahiba ami — how can I tell

**56.** You have reminded Me that I no longer see My father —
and how My heart feels, how can I tell?

একজনে দুবার দেহ গুবাক চন্দন ।
নানা দ্রব্য দেহ তোমার যত লয় মন ॥ ৫৭ ॥

*ekajane dubāra deha gubāka candana |*
*nānā drabya deha tomāra yata laẏa mana || 57 ||*

*Word for word:* eka-jane dubara deha — give each one twice; guvaka chandana — betel and sandal; nana dravya deha — give all kinds of gifts; tomara yata laya mana — as much as your heart wishes

**57.** Give each person betel and sandal twice over,
give all kinds of gifts — as much as your heart desires.

সর্বাঙ্গে লেপহ সভার গন্ধ-চন্দনে ।
যথেষ্ট করিয়া দেহ চিন্তা নাহি মনে ॥ ৫৮ ॥

*sarbāṅge lepaha sabhāra gandha-candane |*
*yatheṣṭa kariẏā deha cintā nāhi mane || 58 ||*

*Word for word:* sarvange lepaha sabhara — anoint everyone's whole body; gandha-chandane — with fragrant sandal; yatheshta kariya deha — give abundantly; chinta nahi mane — have no worry

**58.** Anoint everyone's whole body with fragrant sandal;
give abundantly, have no worry in your mind.

পৃথিবীতে কেহ যাহা নাহি করে লোকে ।
ইঙ্গিতে করিব তাহা কহিল তোমাকে ॥ ৫৯ ॥

*pṛthibīte keha yāhā nāhi kare loke |*
*iṅgite kariba tāhā kahila tomāke || 59 ||*

*Word for word:* prithivite keha yaha — what no one on earth; nahi kare loke — does for people; ingite kariba taha — I shall do by a mere sign; kahila tomake — I tell you

**59.** What no one on earth does for people,
I shall accomplish by a mere sign — I tell you."[^18-8]

এ বোল শুনিঞা শচী কহে ধীরে ধীরে ।
মধুর-বচনে শান্ত করি বিশ্বম্ভরে ॥ ৬০ ॥

*e bola śuniñā śacī kahe dhīre dhīre |*
*madhura-bacane śānta kari biśbambhare || 60 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shunina — hearing these words; shachi kahe dhire dhire — Shachi speaks softly; madhura-bachane — with sweet words; shanta kari vishvambhare — calming Vishvambhara

**60.** Hearing these words, Shachi spoke very softly
and with sweet words calmed Vishvambhara.

যেন রূপে আদেশ করিল বিশ্বম্ভর ।
তেন রূপে তুষিল সে ব্রাহ্মণ-সকল ॥ ৬১ ॥

*yena rūpe ādeśa karila biśbambhara |*
*tena rūpe tuṣila se brāhmaṇa-sakala || 61 ||*

*Word for word:* yena rupe — just as; adesha karila vishvambhara — Vishvambhara directed; tena rupe — so; tushila se — she satisfied; brahmana-sakala — all the brahmanas

**61.** Just as Vishvambhara had directed,
so she satisfied all the brahmanas.

হেনকালে বল্লভ-আচার্য নিজঘরে ।
ব্রাহ্মণ-সহিতে দেব-পিতৃপূজা করে ॥ ৬২ ॥

*henakāle ballabha-ācārya nijaghare |*
*brāhmaṇa-sahite deba-pitṛpūjā kare || 62 ||*

*Word for word:* hena-kale — meanwhile; vallabha-acharya nija-ghare — Vallabha Acharya in his house; brahmana-sahite — with brahmanas; deva-pitri-puja kare — worships gods and ancestors

**62.** Meanwhile Vallabha Acharya in his own house
worships the gods and ancestors together with brahmanas.

আপন কন্যারে নানা আভরণ দিল ।
গন্ধ-চন্দন-মাল্যে সুবেশ করিল ॥ ৬৩ ॥

*āpana kanyāre nānā ābharaṇa dila |*
*gandha-candana-mālye subeśa karila || 63 ||*

*Word for word:* apana kanyare — to his daughter; nana abharana dila — gave all kinds of ornaments; gandha-chandana-malye — with scents, sandal, garlands; subesha karila — adorned her

**63.** To his daughter he gave all kinds of ornaments
and adorned her with scents, sandal and garlands.

শুভক্ষণ নিকট বুঝিয়া দ্বিজবর ।
ব্রাহ্মণ পাঠাঞা দিল আনিবারে বর ॥ ৬৪ ॥

*śubhakṣaṇa nikaṭa bujhiẏā dbijabara |*
*brāhmaṇa pāṭhāñā dila ānibāre bara || 64 ||*

*Word for word:* shubha-kshana nikata bujhiya — seeing the auspicious moment near; dvijabara — the best of brahmanas; brahmana pathana dila — sent a brahmana; anibare bara — to fetch the bridegroom

**64.** Seeing that the auspicious moment was near, the best of brahmanas
sent a brahmana to fetch the bridegroom.

এথা বিশ্বম্ভর পহুঁ বয়স্যের সঙ্গে ।
অতি অদভুত বেশ করেন শ্রীঅঙ্গে ॥ ৬৫ ॥

*ethā biśbambhara pahuṁ baẏasyera saṅge |*
*ati adabhuta beśa karena śrīaṅge || 65 ||*

*Word for word:* etha — here; vishvambhara pahun — the Lord Vishvambhara; vayasyera sange — with His friends; ati adabhuta besha — wonderful attire; karena sri-ange — puts on His divine body

**65.** Here, meanwhile, the Lord Vishvambhara, with His friends,
arrays His divine body in wonderful attire.

গন্ধ-চন্দনে অঙ্গ করিল লেপন ।
ললাটে তিলক যেন চাঁদের কিরণ ॥ ৬৬ ॥

*gandha-candane aṅga karila lepana |*
*lalāṭe tilaka yena cāṁdera kiraṇa || 66 ||*

*Word for word:* gandha-chandane — with scents and sandal; anga karila lepana — anointed the body; lalate tilaka — tilaka on the forehead; yena chandera kirana — like a moonbeam

**66.** His body was anointed with scents and sandal;
on His forehead a tilaka like a moonbeam.

মকর-কুণ্ডল গণ্ডে করে ঝলমল ।
মুকুতার হার শোভে হৃদয়-উপর ॥ ৬৭ ॥

*makara-kuṇḍala gaṇḍe kare jhalamala |*
*mukutāra hāra śobhe hṛdaẏa-upara || 67 ||*

*Word for word:* makara-kundala — makara earrings; gande kare jhalamala — sparkle on the cheeks; mukutara hara — pearl necklace; shobhe hridaya-upara — shines on the chest

**67.** On His cheeks sparkle makara-shaped earrings;
on His chest shines a pearl necklace.

কাজরে উজোর রাতা কমল-নয়ান ।
ভুরুযুগ যেন দুই কামের কামান ॥ ৬৮ ॥

*kājare ujora rātā kamala-naẏāna |*
*bhuruyuga yena dui kāmera kāmāna || 68 ||*

*Word for word:* kajare ujora — brightened with kajal; rata kamala-nayana — red lotus eyes; bhuru-yuga — the pair of brows; yena dui kamera kamana — like the two bows of Kama

**68.** His red lotus eyes are brightly lined with kajal;
His two brows are like the two bows of Kama.

অঙ্গদ কঙ্কণ দিব্য রতন-অঙ্গুরী ।
ঝলমল দিব্য তেজ চাহিতে না পারি ॥ ৬৯ ॥

*aṅgada kaṅkaṇa dibya ratana-aṅgurī |*
*jhalamala dibya teja cāhite nā pāri || 69 ||*

*Word for word:* angada kankana — armlets and bracelets; divya ratana-anguri — divine jewelled rings; jhalamala divya teja — a divine radiance sparkles; chahite na pari — one cannot look

**69.** Armlets, bracelets, divine rings set with jewels;
a divine radiance sparkles — one cannot look at it.

দিব্যমালা পরিধান রক্তপ্রান্ত বাস ।
গন্ধে মহ-মহ করে অঙ্গের বাতাস ॥ ৭০ ॥

*dibyamālā paridhāna raktaprānta bāsa |*
*gandhe maha-maha kare aṅgera bātāsa || 70 ||*

*Word for word:* divya-mala — a divine garland; paridhana rakta-pranta basa — wearing a red-bordered cloth; gandhe maha-maha kare — is laden with fragrance; angera batasa — the breeze from the body

**70.** He wears a divine garland and a cloth with a red border;
the breeze from His body is laden with fragrance.

স্বর্ণ-দর্পণ করে যেন পূর্ণচন্দ্র ।
হেরি লোক নিজ হিয়া না হয় স্বতন্ত্র ॥ ৭১ ॥

*sbarṇa-darpaṇa kare yena pūrṇacandra |*
*heri loka nija hiẏā nā haẏa sbatantra || 71 ||*

*Word for word:* svarna-darpana kare — a golden mirror in the hand; yena purnachandra — like the full moon; heri loka — seeing [Him], people; nija hiya na haya svatantra — are no longer masters of their hearts

**71.** In His hand a golden mirror, like the full moon;
seeing Him, people are no longer masters of their hearts.

বধূগণ বিকল হইল রূপ দেখি ।
রূপ দেখি নারী না নিয়ড় করে আঁখি ॥ ৭২ ॥

*badhūgaṇa bikala haila rūpa dekhi |*
*rūpa dekhi nārī nā niẏaṛa kare āṁkhi || 72 ||*

*Word for word:* badhu-gana — the young wives; vikala haila — lost composure; rupa dekhi — seeing the beauty; nari — the women; na niyada kare ankhi — cannot take their eyes away

**72.** The young wives lost their composure seeing His beauty;
seeing His beauty, the women cannot take their eyes away.

অথির নারীগণ শিথিল বসন ।
মথিল ভুজঙ্গকুল খগেন্দ্র যেমন ॥ ৭২+১ ॥

*athira nārīgaṇa śithila basana |*
*mathila bhujaṅgakula khagendra yemana || 72+1 ||*

*Word for word:* athira nari-gana — the women restless; shithila vasana — garments loosened; mathila — crushed (churned); bhujanga-kula — the race of serpents; khagendra yemana — as the king of birds (Garuda)

**72+1.** The women are restless, their garments loosened:
He crushed [their hearts] as the king of birds crushes the race of serpents.[^18-9]

চিত্ত হরিয়া নিল সভার একই কালে ।
মন-মীন ধরিয়া রাখিল রূপ-জালে ॥ ৭২+২ ॥

*citta hariẏā nila sabhāra ekai kāle |*
*mana-mīna dhariẏā rākhila rūpa-jāle || 72+2 ||*

*Word for word:* chitta hariya nila — stole the hearts; sabhara — of all; eki kale — at one moment; mana-mina dhariya — catching the fish of the mind; rakhila — holds [it]; rupa-jale — in the net of beauty

**72+2.** At one and the same moment He stole the hearts of all,
caught the fish of their minds and holds it in the net of His beauty.

হরিণীনয়নীগণ গৌরাঙ্গ দেখিয়া ।
বলিতে না পারে সে ধরিতে নারে হিয়া ॥ ৭২+৩ ॥

*hariṇīnaẏanīgaṇa gaurāṅga dekhiẏā |*
*balite nā pāre se dharite nāre hiẏā || 72+3 ||*

*Word for word:* harini-nayani-gana — the doe-eyed women; gauranga dekhiya — seeing Gauranga; balite na pare se — cannot speak; dharite nare hiya — cannot hold back the heart

**72+3.** The doe-eyed women, gazing at Gauranga,
cannot utter a word, nor hold back their hearts.

ভুরুভঙ্গি-আকর্ষণে রঙ্গিণীর গণ ।
দোলমান হৃদয় করয়ে অনুক্ষণ ॥ ৭২+৪ ॥

*bhurubhaṅgi-ākarṣaṇe raṅgiṇīra gaṇa |*
*dolamāna hṛdaẏa karaẏe anukṣaṇa || 72+4 ||*

*Word for word:* bhurubhangi-akarshane — drawn by the play of the brows; ranginira gana — the playful women; dolamana hridaya karaye — the heart sways; anukshana — every moment

**72+4.** Drawn by the play of His brows, the playful women
feel their hearts swaying every moment.

সে হাস্য-মাধুরী যার পশিল হিয়ায় ।
মরমে মরিল সেই মদন-ব্যথায় ॥ ৭২+৫ ॥

*se hāsya-mādhurī yāra paśila hiẏāẏa |*
*marame marila sei madana-byathāẏa || 72+5 ||*

*Word for word:* se hasya-madhuri — that sweetness of the smile; yara pashila hiyaya — into whose heart entered; marame — deep within; marila sei — she swoons (lit. "died"); madana-vyathaya — from the pain of Madana

**72+5.** She into whose heart the sweetness of His smile has entered
swoons deep within from the pain of Madana.

সে ভুজ-বিলাস-রস পরশ লাগিয়া ।
মানিনীর মানগণ চলে লুকাইয়া ॥ ৭২+৬ ॥

*se bhuja-bilāsa-rasa paraśa lāgiẏā |*
*māninīra mānagaṇa cale lukāiẏā || 72+6 ||*

*Word for word:* se bhuja-vilasa-rasa — the rasa of the play of those arms; parasha lagiya — for the touch; maninira mana-gana — the pride of the proud beauties; chale lukaiya — goes into hiding

**72+6.** Longing to touch the rasa of the play of His arms,
the pride of the proud beauties slinks away into hiding.

মায়ে নমস্করি প্রভু চলে শুভক্ষণে ।
উঠিল মঙ্গলধ্বনি জয় হরিনামে ॥ ৭৩ ॥

*māẏe namaskari prabhu cale śubhakṣaṇe |*
*uṭhila maṅgaladhbani jaẏa harināme || 73 ||*

*Word for word:* maye namaskari — bowing to His mother; prabhu chale shubha-kshane — the Lord sets out at the auspicious moment; uthila mangala-dhvani — auspicious cries arose; jaya hariname — "Jaya!" and Hari's name

**73.** Bowing to His mother, the Lord sets out at the auspicious moment;
auspicious cries arose — "Jaya!" and the name of Hari.

দিব্য-যানে চড়ে প্রভু বয়স্য-বেষ্টিত ।
সম্মুখে নাটুয়া নাচে গায়নে গায় গীত ॥ ৭৪ ॥

*dibya-yāne caṛe prabhu baẏasya-beṣṭita |*
*sammukhe nāṭuẏā nāce gāẏane gāẏa gīta || 74 ||*

*Word for word:* divya-yane chade prabhu — the Lord mounts a divine palanquin; vayasya-veshtita — surrounded by friends; sammukhe natuya nache — in front dancers dance; gayane gaya gita — singers sing songs

**74.** The Lord mounts a divine palanquin, surrounded by His friends;
in front dancers dance and singers sing songs.[^18-10]

ব্রাহ্মণেতে বেদ পঢ়ে ভাটে রায়বার ।
শিঙ্গা বরগো বাজে ভেউর কাহাল ॥ ৭৫ ॥

*brāhmaṇete beda paṛhe bhāṭe rāẏabāra |*
*śiṅgā barago bāje bheura kāhāla || 75 ||*

*Word for word:* brahmanete veda padhe — brahmanas recite the Vedas; bhate rayabara — bards their panegyrics; shinga bargo baje — shinga and bargo horns sound; bheura kahala — bheur and kahal

**75.** Brahmanas recite the Vedas, bards their panegyrics;
shinga and bargo horns sound, bheur and kahal horns.

দামামা দগড় বাজে পটাহ মৃদঙ্গ ।
দোসরি মোহরি বাজে শুনিতে আনন্দ ॥ ৭৬ ॥

*dāmāmā dagaṛa bāje paṭāha mṛdaṅga |*
*dosari mohari bāje śunite ānanda || 76 ||*

*Word for word:* damama dagada baje — damama and dagar kettledrums sound; pataha mridanga — patahas and mridangas; dosari mohari baje — dosari and mohari pipes play; shunite ananda — a joy to hear

**76.** Damama and dagar kettledrums sound, pataha drums and mridangas;
dosari and mohari pipes play — a joy to hear.[^18-11]

হরি-হরিবোল শুনি জয়জয়-নাদ ।
আনন্দে নদীয়ার লোক ভেল উন্মাদ ॥ ৭৭ ॥

*hari-haribola śuni jaẏajaẏa-nāda |*
*ānande nadīẏāra loka bhela unmāda || 77 ||*

*Word for word:* hari-haribola shuni — hearing "Hari, Haribol!"; jayajaya-nada — the cries of "Jaya, jaya!"; anande — with joy; nadiyara loka — the people of Nadia; bhela unmada — went mad

**77.** Hearing "Hari, Haribol!" and the cries of "Jaya, jaya!",
the people of Nadia went mad with joy.

ঠেলাঠেলি ধায় লোক পথ নাহি পায় ।
চমক লাগিল নাগরিকের সভায় ॥ ৭৮ ॥

*ṭhelāṭheli dhāẏa loka patha nāhi pāẏa |*
*camaka lāgila nāgarikera sabhāẏa || 78 ||*

*Word for word:* thelatheli dhaya loka — people run jostling; patha nahi paya — find no way; chamaka lagila — a thrill ran through; nagarikera sabhaya — the assembly of townsfolk

**78.** People run, jostling one another, unable to find a way;
a thrill ran through the assembly of townsfolk.

কেহ কেশ নাহি বান্ধে না সম্বরে বাস ।
দেখিবারে ধাওয়াধাই ঘন বহে শ্বাস ॥ ৭৯ ॥

*keha keśa nāhi bāndhe nā sambare bāsa |*
*dekhibāre dhāoẏādhāi ghana bahe śbāsa || 79 ||*

*Word for word:* keha kesha nahi bandhe — some do not tie their hair; na samvare basa — do not adjust their clothes; dekhibare dhaoyadhai — run headlong to see; ghana bahe shvasa — breathing hard

**79.** Some do not tie up their hair, do not adjust their clothes —
they run headlong to see, breathing hard.

কাণাকাণি সানাসানি নাহি আর লাজ ।
ডাকাডাকি ধায় সব নদীয়া-সমাজ ॥ ৮০ ॥

*kāṇākāṇi sānāsāni nāhi āra lāja |*
*ḍākāḍāki dhāẏa saba nadīẏā-samāja || 80 ||*

*Word for word:* kanakani — whispering; sanasani — exchanging glances; nahi ara laja — with no more shame; dakadaki — calling to one another; dhaya saba nadiya-samaja — all the people of Nadia run

**80.** Whispering, exchanging glances, with no more shame,
calling to one another, all the people of Nadia run.

গরবী গরব সব দূরে তেয়াগিয়া ।
গৌরাঙ্গ দেখিতে ধায় উলসিত হঞা ॥ ৮১ ॥

*garabī garaba saba dūre teẏāgiẏā |*
*gaurāṅga dekhite dhāẏa ulasita hañā || 81 ||*

*Word for word:* garabi — the proud ones; garaba saba dure teyagiya — casting off all pride; gauranga dekhite dhaya — run to see Gauranga; ulasita hina — joyfully

**81.** The proud ones, casting all their pride far away,
run joyfully to see Gauranga.

পথ বিপথ কেহো না মানে রঙ্গিণী ।
অনঙ্গ-তরঙ্গে সব ধাইল রমণী ॥ ৮১+১ ॥

*patha bipatha keho nā māne raṅgiṇī |*
*anaṅga-taraṅge saba dhāila ramaṇī || 81+1 ||*

*Word for word:* patha vipatha — road and roadless ground; keho na mane — none heeds; rangini — the playful [women]; ananga-tarange — on the waves of Ananga; saba dhaila ramani — all the women ran

**81+1.** The playful women heed neither road nor roadless ground:
on the waves of Ananga all the women run.[^18-12]

অন্তরীক্ষে দেবগণ দিব্য-যানে চাহে ।
গোরা-অঙ্গ দেখিবারে অনুরাগে ধায়ে ॥ ৮২ ॥

*antarīkṣe debagaṇa dibya-yāne cāhe |*
*gorā-aṅga dekhibāre anurāge dhāẏe || 82 ||*

*Word for word:* antarikshe — in the sky; deva-gana — the gods; divya-yane chahe — look from divine chariots; gora-anga dekhibare — to see Gora's body; anurage dhaye — press forward with love

**82.** In the sky the gods on divine chariots look down
and with love press forward to see Gora's body.

সুরবধূগণ বিশ্বম্ভর-মুখ চাহে ।
চতুর্দিকে দিব্য নারী মঙ্গল গায়ে ॥ ৮৩ ॥

*surabadhūgaṇa biśbambhara-mukha cāhe |*
*caturdike dibya nārī maṅgala gāẏe || 83 ||*

*Word for word:* sura-badhu-gana — the wives of the gods; vishvambhara-mukha chahe — gaze at Vishvambhara's face; chaturdike — on all sides; divya nari — celestial women; mangala gaye — sing auspicious songs

**83.** The wives of the gods gaze at Vishvambhara's face;
on all sides celestial women sing auspicious songs.

*Raga bihagara; refrain: "On all sides cries of 'Jaya, jaya!' are heard — the wedding of Gauranga-chand! The respectable wives together raise the 'ulu-ulu': sing auspicious songs with joy!"*

কেশ বেশ কর, পাটশাড়ী পর,
কাজর দেহ নয়ানে ।
শ্রীবিশ্বম্ভর-বিহা, সবজন মেলি,
সাজিয়া করল পয়ানে ॥ ৮৪ ॥

*keśa beśa kara, pāṭaśāṛī para,*
*kājara deha naẏāne |*
*śrībiśbambhara-bihā, sabajana meli,*
*sājiẏā karala paẏāne || 84 ||*

*Word for word:* kesha besha kara — do up your hair; patashadi para — put on silk saris; kajara deha nayane — put kajal on your eyes; sri-vishvambhara-biha — to Sri Vishvambhara's wedding; sabajana meli — all gathering; sajiya karala payane — dressed up, they set out

**84.** "Do up your hair, put on silk saris,
put kajal on your eyes!"
To the wedding of Sri Vishvambhara, all gathering together,
dressed up, they set out.

হার কেয়ূর, কঙ্কণ কিঙ্কিণী,
নূপুর পরহ না ঝাট ।
অলকা নিকটে, সিন্দূর ললাটে,
চন্দন-বিন্দু তার হেঠ ॥ ৮৫ ॥

*hāra keẏūra, kaṅkaṇa kiṅkiṇī,*
*nūpura paraha nā jhāṭa |*
*alakā nikaṭe, sindūra lalāṭe,*
*candana-bindu tāra heṭha || 85 ||*

*Word for word:* hara keyura — necklaces, armlets; kankana kinkini — bracelets, belts with bells; nupura — anklets; paraha na jhata — put on quickly; alaka nikate — near the locks; sindura lalate — sindura on the forehead; chandana-bindu tara hetha — a dot of sandal beneath it

**85.** "Necklaces, armlets, bracelets, belts with little bells,
anklets — put them on quickly!"
Sindura on the forehead close to the locks,
and below it a dot of sandal.

তাম্বূল অধরে, তাম্বূল বাম করে,
লীলায় ঢুলি ঢুলি যায় ।
দেখি বিশ্বম্ভর, যেন পাঁচশর,
ধৈরয ধরিতে না পায় ॥ ৮৬ ॥

*tāmbūla adhare, tāmbūla bāma kare,*
*līlāẏa ḍhuli ḍhuli yāẏa |*
*dekhi biśbambhara, yena pāṁcaśara,*
*dhairaya dharite nā pāẏa || 86 ||*

*Word for word:* tambula adhare — betel on the lips; tambula bama kare — betel in the left hand; lilaya dhuli dhuli yaya — they go playfully swaying; dekhi vishvambhara — seeing Vishvambhara; yena panchashara — like the Five-arrowed One (Kama); dhairaya dharite na paya — cannot keep composure

**86.** Betel on their lips, betel in the left hand,
they go playfully swaying;
seeing Vishvambhara, like the Five-arrowed One,[^18-13]
they cannot keep their composure.

তাম্বূল-চর্বণে, হাসিয়া বয়ানে,
কুন্দ-দশন বিকসি ।
বান্ধুলি-অধরে, দশন-মধুকরে,
পাশে মধুলোভে বসি ॥ ৮৬+১ ॥

*tāmbūla-carbaṇe, hāsiẏā baẏāne,*
*kunda-daśana bikasi |*
*bāndhuli-adhare, daśana-madhukare,*
*pāśe madhulobhe basi || 86+1 ||*

*Word for word:* tambula-charvane — chewing betel; hasiya bayane — with smiling faces; kunda-dashana vikasi — the kunda-bud teeth open; bandhuli-adhare — by the bandhuli-red lips; dashana-madhukare — the bee-like teeth; pashe — close by; madhu-lobhe basi — sit, greedy for honey

**86+1.** Chewing betel, smiling,
their teeth open like buds of kunda jasmine;
by lips red as bandhuli flowers the bee-like teeth
sit close, greedy for honey.[^18-14]

নাগরী সারি সারি, চলিলা কুতূহলী,
মরাল-গমন সুঠাম ।
মদনরস সব, বিথার অন্তরে,
থির বিশাল নয়ান ॥ ৮৬+২ ॥

*nāgarī sāri sāri, calilā kutūhalī,*
*marāla-gamana suṭhāma |*
*madanarasa saba, bithāra antare,*
*thira biśāla naẏāna || 86+2 ||*

*Word for word:* nagari sari sari — the nagaris in rows; chalila kutuhali — went eagerly; marala-gamana sutham — with the graceful gait of swans; madana-rasa saba — all the rasa of Madana; vithara antare — spreads in the heart; thira vishala nayana — the wide eyes fixed

**86+2.** In rows upon rows the nagaris
went eagerly with the graceful gait of swans;
all the rasa of Madana spreads through their hearts,
their wide eyes stay fixed.

নানা বাদ্য বাজে, শত শঙ্খ গাজে,
মৃদঙ্গ পটাহ কাহাল ।
আনন্দে দুন্দুভি, বাজয়ে ডিণ্ডিমি,
মুহরি বাজয়ে রসাল ॥ ৮৭ ॥

*nānā bādya bāje, śata śaṅkha gāje,*
*mṛdaṅga paṭāha kāhāla |*
*ānande dundubhi, bājaẏe ḍiṇḍimi,*
*muhari bājaẏe rasāla || 87 ||*

*Word for word:* nana vadya baje — all kinds of instruments sound; shata shankha gaje — hundreds of conchs resound; mridanga pataha kahala — mridangas, patahas, kahals; anande dundubhi — joyfully the dundubhis; bajaye dindimi — the dindimas sound; muhari bajaye rasala — the muharis play sweetly

**87.** All kinds of instruments sound, hundreds of conchs resound,
mridangas, pataha drums and kahal horns;
joyfully the dundubhis sound and the dindima drums,
sweetly the muhari pipes play.

বীণার বিলাস, বেণু মন্দভাষ,
রবাব উপাঙ্গ পাখোয়াজে ।
নদীয়া-নগরে, আনন্দ ঘরে ঘরে,
মঙ্গল-বাধাই বাজে ॥ ৮৮ ॥

*bīṇāra bilāsa, beṇu mandabhāṣa,*
*rabāba upāṅga pākhoẏāje |*
*nadīẏā-nagare, ānanda ghare ghare,*
*maṅgala-bādhāi bāje || 88 ||*

*Word for word:* vinara vilasa — the play of vinas; venu mandabhasha — flutes softly speak; rababa upanga pakhoyaje — rababs, upangas, pakhoyajs; nadiya-nagare — in the town of Nadia; ananda ghare ghare — joy in every house; mangala-badhai baje — auspicious wedding music plays

**88.** The vinas play, the flutes softly speak,
rababs, upangas, pakhoyajs;
in the town of Nadia there is joy in every house,
auspicious wedding music plays.

গৌরচন্দ্র-মুখ, দেখি সব লোক,
আনন্দ নদীয়া-সমাজ ।
কোটি কাম জিনি, সে রূপ বাখানি,
নিরখি না রহে লাজ ॥ ৮৯ ॥

*gauracandra-mukha, dekhi saba loka,*
*ānanda nadīẏā-samāja |*
*koṭi kāma jini, se rūpa bākhāni,*
*nirakhi nā rahe lāja || 89 ||*

*Word for word:* gaurachandra-mukha — Gaurachandra's face; dekhi saba loka — all people see; ananda nadiya-samaja — the people of Nadia rejoice; koti kama jini — surpassing millions of Kamas; se rupa bakhani — praising that beauty; nirakhi na rahe laja — gazing, they lose all shame

**89.** All the people gaze at Gaurachandra's face,
all the people of Nadia rejoice;
praising that beauty which surpasses millions of Kamadevas,
they gaze at Him, forgetting all shame.

ফুয়ল কবরী, চীর না সম্বরি,
ধায়ে উনমত-বেশ ।
পাসরি পতি-সুত, বদন সুবেকত,
হিয়া-পরি ফেলে কেশ ॥ ৯০ ॥

*phuẏala kabarī, cīra nā sambari,*
*dhāẏe unamata-beśa |*
*pāsari pati-suta, badana subekata,*
*hiẏā-pari phele keśa || 90 ||*

*Word for word:* phuyala kabari — braids loosened; chira na samvari — not adjusting their clothes; dhaye unamata-besha — they run in a frenzy; pasari pati-suta — forgetting husbands and sons; badana subekata — faces uncovered; hiya-pari phele kesha — hair falling on their breasts

**90.** Braids come loose, garments go unadjusted —
they run in a frenzy;
forgetting husbands and sons, faces uncovered,
their hair falling over their breasts.

ধনি ধনি ধনি, কহয়ে রমণী,
আন না শুনিয়ে বাণী ।
চৌদিকে হাটে-বাটে, নাগরীর ঠাটে,
দেখিতে করল উঠানি ॥ ৯১ ॥

*dhani dhani dhani, kahaẏe ramaṇī,*
*āna nā śuniẏe bāṇī |*
*caudike hāṭe-bāṭe, nāgarīra ṭhāṭe,*
*dekhite karala uṭhāni || 91 ||*

*Word for word:* dhani dhani dhani — "Blessed, blessed, blessed!"; kahaye ramani — say the women; ana na shuniye vani — no other word is heard; chaudike hate-bate — on all sides in markets and roads; nagarira thate — in crowds of nagaris; dekhite karala uthani — rose up to see

**91.** "Blessed, blessed, blessed!" say the women,
no other word is heard;
on all sides, in markets and roads, crowds of nagaris
rose up to see.

কেহ বীণা বায়, কেহ গীত গায়,
কেহ ধায় উল্লাসে ।
চৌদিকে জয় জয়, মঙ্গল বিজয়,
কহয়ে লোচনদাসে ॥ ৯২ ॥

*keha bīṇā bāẏa, keha gīta gāẏa,*
*keha dhāẏa ullāse |*
*caudike jaẏa jaẏa, maṅgala bijaẏa,*
*kahaẏe locanadāse || 92 ||*

*Word for word:* keha vina baya — some play the vina; keha gita gaya — some sing songs; keha dhaya ullase — some run in delight; chaudike jaya jaya — on all sides "Jaya, jaya!"; mangala vijaya — the auspicious triumph; kahaye lochana-dase — says Lochana Dasa

**92.** Some play the vina, some sing songs,
some run in delight;
on all sides "Jaya, jaya!", the auspicious triumph —
so says Lochana Dasa.

[^18-1]: The fetching of water (jal-saha; in Lochana Dasa "pani sahi"): on the morning of the wedding the married women go singing to the Ganga to fetch water for the bridegroom's bath (below, vv. 17–33).
[^18-2]: Kushandika is the rite at the sacred fire that concludes the wedding (in Lochana Dasa, on the day after the wedding).
[^18-3]: "Aiho-suho" are married women whose husbands are living: only they take part in the auspicious wedding rites.
[^18-4]: "Pani sahi" — see note 1.
[^18-5]: Here and below (vv. 18–33, 72, 78–81, 84–92) is a favourite motif of Lochana Dasa: the women of Nadia, forgetting shame, are drawn to Gaura (nagari-bhava; see en/09, note 9). Still more such lines are in the 1983 edition (vv. 40+1 – 40+9, 72+1 – 72+6, 81+1, 86+1 – 86+2); they are absent in A.
[^18-6]: Vv. 40+1 – 40+9 are found only in the 1983 edition (absent from Bhaktisiddhanta's edition); the 1903 edition has them in brackets (except v. 40+8) — the way that editor marks lines found in only some manuscripts. This is Lochana Dasa's motif of nagari-bhava (see note 5 and en/09, note 9). "Madana" (Kamadeva) here is an image of the hearts' attraction to Gaura; for a Gaudiya Vaishnava the Lord is the transcendental (aprakrita) Madana, and such attraction to Him, as in the gopis, is not worldly passion; Bhaktisiddhanta, however, does not accept worship of Gaura in the mood of "Gaura-nagari". "Forgot even the duty of a faithful wife" (v. 40+7) — like the gopis, who left family dharma for Krishna's sake.
[^18-7]: By custom a widow takes no part in the auspicious wedding rites and cannot honour the guests as before; hence Shachi's grief. Cf. Murari 1.10.5–12.
[^18-8]: That is, the Lord, encouraging His mother, promises to do for the guests by His mere sign more than people can; cf. Murari (1.10.11): "I have the power to do what is beyond mortals, and yet I follow the customs of the world."
[^18-9]: Vv. 72+1 – 72+6 are found only in the 1983 edition (absent from Bhaktisiddhanta's edition); the 1903 edition has them in brackets (together with v. 72). The king of birds is Garuda, the enemy of serpents.
[^18-10]: In the 1983 edition there are two couplets instead of this one (a different redaction): "The Lord mounts a divine palanquin, surrounded by His friends; seeing this, all the people rejoice at heart. The Lord sets out with His friends; in front a dancer dances, singers sing." A and the 1903 edition have one couplet; we follow A.
[^18-11]: Shinga is a horn; bargo, a wind instrument; damama and dagar, large kettledrums; dosari and mohari (muhari), pipes like the shahnai. For bheur, kahal and the others see the glossary.
[^18-12]: V. 81+1 is found only in the 1983 edition (absent from Bhaktisiddhanta's edition); the 1903 edition has it in brackets (together with v. 81). Ananga ("the Bodiless") is Kamadeva.
[^18-13]: The Five-arrowed One is Kamadeva, the god of love, armed with five flower-arrows.
[^18-14]: Stanzas 86+1 – 86+2 are found only in the 1983 edition (absent from Bhaktisiddhanta's edition); the 1903 edition has them in brackets. Bandhuli (bandhuka) is a bright red flower, a usual simile for lips.

---

# Adi-khanda, part 11 (portion 19)

*Kaishora-lila, the wedding (conclusion): the Lord at Vallabhacharya's house; the welcoming of the bridegroom; the bride is brought to the Lord, their first sight of each other; Vallabha honours his son-in-law and gives Him his daughter; the night in the bridal chamber; the kushandika, Vallabha's parting words; the return home with Lakshmi, Shachi receives the couple; a song of the Lord's strolls with His friends (1983 edition only)*

*Raga bhatiyari; disha: "Behold, my heart, the wonder: the Darling of Navadvipa, dear as life!" (murchha)*

হেনমতে বল্লভ-আচার্য-বাটী গিয়া ।
জয় জয় শব্দ হৈল আকাশ জুড়িয়া ॥ ৯৩ ॥

*henamate ballabha-ācārya-bāṭī giẏā |*
*jaẏa jaẏa śabda haila ākāśa juṛiẏā || 93 ||*

*Word for word:* henamate — thus; vallabha-acharya-bati giya — coming to Vallabha Acharya's house; jaya jaya shabda haila — cries of "Jaya, jaya!" arose; akasha judiya — filling the sky

**93.** Thus [the Lord] arrived at Vallabha Acharya's house;
cries of "Jaya, jaya!" filled the sky.

শত শত দীপ জ্বলে উজ্জ্বল পৃথিবী ।
ঝলমল করে তাহে গোরা-অঙ্গের ছবি ॥ ৯৪ ॥

*śata śata dīpa jbale ujjbala pṛthibī |*
*jhalamala kare tāhe gorā-aṅgera chabi || 94 ||*

*Word for word:* shata shata dipa jvale — hundreds upon hundreds of lamps burn; ujjvala prithivi — the earth is lit; jhalamala kare — shines; tahe — in that [light]; gora-angera chhabi — the beauty of Gora's body

**94.** Hundreds upon hundreds of lamps are burning, the whole earth is lit,
and in their light the beauty of Gora's body shines.

তবে ত বল্লভমিশ্র পাদ্য অর্ঘ্য দিয়া ।
ঘরেরে আনিল বর মঙ্গল করিয়া ॥ ৯৫ ॥

*tabe ta ballabhamiśra pādya arghya diẏā |*
*gharere ānila bara maṅgala kariẏā || 95 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe ta — then; vallabha-mishra — Vallabha Mishra; padya arghya diya — offering water for the feet and arghya; gharere anila bara — brought the bridegroom into the house; mangala kariya — performing auspicious rites

**95.** Then Vallabha Mishra, offering water for the feet and arghya,
brought the bridegroom into the house with auspicious rites.

তবে সেই মহাপ্রভু ছোড়লাতে গিয়া ।
দাঁড়াইলা পীঠোপরি উলসিত হঞা ॥ ৯৬ ॥

*tabe sei mahāprabhu choṛalāte giẏā |*
*dāṁṛāilā pīṭhopari ulasita hañā || 96 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe sei mahaprabhu — then Mahaprabhu; chhodlate giya — going onto the wedding platform (chhorla); dandaila pithopari — stood on the seat; ulasita hana — joyful

**96.** Then Mahaprabhu, going up onto the wedding platform,[^19-1]
joyfully stood upon the seat.

পূর্ণিমার পূর্ণচন্দ্র জিনিঞা বদন ।
তাহাতে মধুর হাসি অমিয়া-মিলন ॥ ৯৭ ॥

*pūrṇimāra pūrṇacandra jiniñā badana |*
*tāhāte madhura hāsi amiẏā-milana || 97 ||*

*Word for word:* purnimara purnachandra — the full moon of the full-moon night; jinina badana — a face surpassing; tahate madhura hasi — on it a sweet smile; amiya-milana — blended with nectar

**97.** His face surpasses the full moon on the night of the full moon,
and on it is a sweet smile, as if blended with nectar.

তপত-কাঞ্চন যেন অঙ্গের কিরণ ।
মেরু পর্বত যেন দেহের গঠন ॥ ৯৮ ॥

*tapata-kāñcana yena aṅgera kiraṇa |*
*meru parbata yena dehera gaṭhana || 98 ||*

*Word for word:* tapata-kanchana yena — like molten gold; angera kirana — the radiance of the body; meru parvata yena — like Mount Meru; dehera gathana — the build of the body

**98.** The radiance of His body is like molten gold,
the build of His body like Mount Meru.

অঙ্গদ কঙ্কণ ভুজে রতন-অঙ্গুরি ।
অরুণ-কমল করতল ঝলমলি ॥ ৯৯ ॥

*aṅgada kaṅkaṇa bhuje ratana-aṅguri |*
*aruṇa-kamala karatala jhalamali || 99 ||*

*Word for word:* angada kankana bhuje — armlets and bracelets on the arms; ratana-anguri — jewelled rings; aruna-kamala — [like] red lotuses; karatala jhalamali — the palms sparkle

**99.** On His arms are armlets and bracelets, rings set with jewels;
His palms sparkle like red lotuses.

সুদিব্য মালতীমালা দোলে গোরা-অঙ্গে ।
সুমেরু উপরে যেন গঙ্গার তরঙ্গে ॥ ১০০ ॥

*sudibya mālatīmālā dole gorā-aṅge |*
*sumeru upare yena gaṅgāra taraṅge || 100 ||*

*Word for word:* sudivya malati-mala — a splendid malati garland; dole gora-ange — swings on Gora's body; sumeru upare — upon Sumeru; yena gangara tarange — like the waves of the Ganga

**100.** A splendid garland of malati jasmine swings on Gora's body —
like the waves of the Ganga upon the summit of Sumeru.

মুকুটের নিকটে ললাট ভাল সাজে ।
কাম-কোটি কাতর দেখিয়া রহে লাজে ॥ ১০১ ॥

*mukuṭera nikaṭe lalāṭa bhāla sāje |*
*kāma-koṭi kātara dekhiẏā rahe lāje || 101 ||*

*Word for word:* mukutera nikate — beneath the crown; lalata bhala saje — the forehead is beautifully adorned; kama-koti katara — millions of Kamas, abashed; dekhiya rahe laje — seeing it, stand ashamed

**101.** Beneath His crown His forehead is beautifully adorned;
millions of Kamas, seeing it, stand abashed and ashamed.

শ্রবণে কুণ্ডল দোলে কি দিব তুলনা ।
দূর কৈল মানিনীর মানের বাসনা ॥ ১০২ ॥

*śrabaṇe kuṇḍala dole ki diba tulanā |*
*dūra kaila māninīra mānera bāsanā || 102 ||*

*Word for word:* shravane kundala dole — earrings swing at the ears; ki diba tulana — what comparison can I give; dura kaila — removed; maninira manera basana — proud beauties' desire for pride

**102.** Earrings swing at His ears — to what can I compare them?
They have taken from proud beauties all desire for pride.

হেনমতে মহাপ্রভু ছোড়লাতে আছে ।
বর উরথিতে তথা আইওগণ কাছে ॥ ১০৩ ॥

*henamate mahāprabhu choṛalāte āche |*
*bara urathite tathā āiogaṇa kāche || 103 ||*

*Word for word:* henamate — thus; mahaprabhu chhodlate achhe — Mahaprabhu is on the platform; bara urathite — to welcome the bridegroom (bar-urati); tatha aiogana kachhe — there the married women [came] near

**103.** While Mahaprabhu stood thus on the platform,
the married women came there for the welcoming of the bridegroom.[^19-2]

করিল বিচিত্র বেশ পরে দিব্যবাস ।
হাথেতে উজ্জ্বল দীপ অন্তরে উল্লাস ॥ ১০৪ ॥

*karila bicitra beśa pare dibyabāsa |*
*hāthete ujjbala dīpa antare ullāsa || 104 ||*

*Word for word:* karila vichitra besha — dressed splendidly; pare divya-basa — put on divine garments; hathete ujjvala dipa — bright lamps in their hands; antare ullasa — joy in their hearts

**104.** They had put on splendid attire and garments;
in their hands were bright lamps, in their hearts jubilation.

আইওগণ আগে পাছে কন্যার জননী ।
বর উরখিতে ধনী চলিলা আপুনি ॥ ১০৫ ॥

*āiogaṇa āge pāche kanyāra jananī |*
*bara urakhite dhanī calilā āpuni || 105 ||*

*Word for word:* aiogana age pachhe — the married women before and behind; kanyara janani — the bride's mother; bara urakhite — to welcome the bridegroom; dhani chalila apuni — the lady went herself

**105.** Before and behind went the married women, and with them the bride's mother:
the noble lady herself went to welcome the bridegroom.

সাত প্রদক্ষিণ করি সাত-দীপ-হাথে ।
চরণে ঢালিল দধি হরষিত-চিতে ॥ ১০৬ ॥

*sāta pradakṣiṇa kari sāta-dīpa-hāthe |*
*caraṇe ḍhālila dadhi haraṣita-cite || 106 ||*

*Word for word:* sata pradakshina kari — circling seven times; sata-dipa-hathe — with seven lamps in hand; charane dhalila dadhi — poured curd on the feet; harashita-chite — with a joyful heart

**106.** Circling [Him] seven times with seven lamps in her hands,
with a joyful heart she poured curd upon His feet.

বর উরখিয়া ধনী চলিলা আলয় ।
শুভক্ষণ হৈল সেই গোধূলি-সময় ॥ ১০৭ ॥

*bara urakhiẏā dhanī calilā ālaẏa |*
*śubhakṣaṇa haila sei godhūli-samaẏa || 107 ||*

*Word for word:* bara urakhiya — having welcomed the bridegroom; dhani chalila alaya — the lady went into the house; shubha-kshana haila — the auspicious moment came; sei godhuli-samaya — that hour of dusk

**107.** Having welcomed the bridegroom, the lady went into the house;
the auspicious moment came — the hour of dusk.[^19-3]

তবে সেই বল্লভ-আচার্য দ্বিজবর ।
কন্যা আনিবারে আজ্ঞা করিল সত্বর ॥ ১০৮ ॥

*tabe sei ballabha-ācārya dbijabara |*
*kanyā ānibāre ājñā karila satbara || 108 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe sei — then; vallabha-acharya dvijabara — Vallabha Acharya, best of brahmanas; kanya anibare — to bring the daughter; ajna karila satvara — quickly ordered

**108.** Then Vallabha Acharya, the best of brahmanas,
quickly ordered his daughter to be brought.

সুগঠিত সিংহাসন-মাঝে রূপবতী ।
অঙ্গের ছটায় ঝলমল করে ক্ষিতি ॥ ১০৯ ॥

*sugaṭhita siṃhāsana-mājhe rūpabatī |*
*aṅgera chaṭāẏa jhalamala kare kṣiti || 109 ||*

*Word for word:* sugathita simhasana-majhe — on a finely made seat; rupavati — the beautiful maiden; angera chhataya — by the radiance of her body; jhalamala kare kshiti — the earth shines

**109.** The beautiful maiden [sat] on a finely made seat;
the radiance of her body lit up the earth.

রতনপ্রদীপ জ্বলে তার চারি পাশে ।
বদন জিতল পূর্ণচন্দ্র-পরকাশে ॥ ১১০ ॥

*ratanapradīpa jbale tāra cāri pāśe |*
*badana jitala pūrṇacandra-parakāśe || 110 ||*

*Word for word:* ratana-pradipa jvale — jewelled lamps burn; tara chari pashe — all around her; badana jitala — her face surpassed; purnachandra-parakashe — the splendour of the full moon

**110.** Jewelled lamps are burning all around her;
her face surpassed the splendour of the full moon.

সর্ব অঙ্গে অলঙ্কার রতন-কাঞ্চনে ।
অন্ধকার দূরে গেল তাহার কিরণে ॥ ১১১ ॥

*sarba aṅge alaṅkāra ratana-kāñcane |*
*andhakāra dūre gela tāhāra kiraṇe || 111 ||*

*Word for word:* sarva ange alankara — ornaments on all her body; ratana-kanchane — of jewels and gold; andhakara dure gela — the darkness went far away; tahara kirane — by their radiance

**111.** On all her body were ornaments of jewels and gold;
their radiance drove the darkness away.

প্রভু প্রদক্ষিণ করি ফিরে সাতবার ।
করজোড় করি শিরে করে নমস্কার ॥ ১১২ ॥

*prabhu pradakṣiṇa kari phire sātabāra |*
*karajoṛa kari śire kare namaskāra || 112 ||*

*Word for word:* prabhu pradakshina kari — circling the Lord; phire satabara — goes round seven times; karajoda kari shire — joining her palms at her head; kare namaskara — bows

**112.** Circling the Lord seven times,
[the bride], joining her palms at her head, bows to Him.

অন্তঃপট ঘুচাইল দোঁহে দোঁহা দেখি ।
দোঁহে দোঁহা দেখি দোঁহার নাচয়ে দু আঁখি ॥ ১১৩ ॥

*antaḥpaṭa ghucāila doṁhe doṁhā dekhi |*
*doṁhe doṁhā dekhi doṁhāra nācaẏe du āṁkhi || 113 ||*

*Word for word:* antahpata ghuchaila — the screening cloth was removed; donhe donha dekhi — the two saw each other; donhe donha dekhi — seeing each other; donhara nachaye du ankhi — the eyes of both dance

**113.** The cloth that screened them was removed, and they saw each other;
they gaze at each other — and the eyes of both are dancing.

চন্দ্র রোহিণী যেন একত্র মিলন ।
অন্যোন্যে করয়ে দোঁহে কুসুমের রণ ॥ ১১৪ ॥

*candra rohiṇī yena ekatra milana |*
*anyonye karaẏe doṁhe kusumera raṇa || 114 ||*

*Word for word:* chandra rohini yena — like the Moon and Rohini; ekatra milana — meeting together; anyonye karaye donhe — the two wage with each other; kusumera rana — a duel of flowers

**114.** As if the Moon and Rohini had met together:[^19-4]
the two shower each other with flowers, as if in a duel.

যেন হরপার্বতী দোঁহে হৈলা মেলা ।
ছামুনি নাড়িল দোঁহে আনন্দে বিভোলা ॥ ১১৫ ॥

*yena harapārbatī doṁhe hailā melā |*
*chāmuni nāṛila doṁhe ānande bibholā || 115 ||*

*Word for word:* yena hara-parvati — like Hara and Parvati; donhe haila mela — the two met; chhamuni nadila donhe — both waved the chhamuni; anande vibhola — beside themselves with bliss

**115.** Like Hara and Parvati — so the two met;
both, beside themselves with bliss, waved the chhamuni.[^19-5]

চতুর্দিকে জয়ধ্বনি হরি হরি নাদ ।
নাচয়ে সকল লোক হরিষে উন্মাদ ॥ ১১৬ ॥

*caturdike jaẏadhbani hari hari nāda |*
*nācaẏe sakala loka hariṣe unmāda || 116 ||*

*Word for word:* chaturdike — on all sides; jaya-dhvani — cries of "Jaya!"; hari hari nada — shouts of "Hari, Hari!"; nachaye sakala loka — all the people dance; harishe unmada — mad with joy

**116.** On all sides are cries of "Jaya!" and shouts of "Hari, Hari!";
all the people dance, mad with joy.

তবে সে কমলাপতি বিশ্বম্ভর পহুঁ ।
একত্রে বসিলা বামপাশে করি বহু ॥ ১১৭ ॥

*tabe se kamalāpati biśbambhara pahuṁ |*
*ekatre basilā bāmapāśe kari bahu || 117 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe se — then; kamalapati — the Lord of Kamala; vishvambhara pahun — Lord Vishvambhara; ekatre basila — sat together; vama-pashe kari bahu — placing the bride at His left

**117.** Then the Lord of Kamala, Lord Vishvambhara,
sat down, seating the bride at His left.

লজ্জা-নম্রমুখী সে বসিলা পহুঁ-কাছে ।
জামাতা পূজয়ে মিশ্র যে বিধান আছে ॥ ১১৮ ॥

*lajjā-namramukhī se basilā pahuṁ-kāche |*
*jāmātā pūjaẏe miśra ye bidhāna āche || 118 ||*

*Word for word:* lajja-namra-mukhi se — she, her face bowed in shyness; basila pahun-kachhe — sat near the Lord; jamata pujaye mishra — Mishra honours his son-in-law; ye vidhana achhe — as is prescribed

**118.** Her face bowed in shyness, she sat beside the Lord;
and Mishra honours his son-in-law according to all the rules.

যার পাদপদ্মে ব্রহ্মা পাদ্য নিবেদিয়া ।
সৃষ্টির করতা হৈল প্রসাদ পাইয়া ॥ ১১৯ ॥

*yāra pādapadme brahmā pādya nibediẏā |*
*sṛṣṭira karatā haila prasāda pāiẏā || 119 ||*

*Word for word:* yara pada-padme — to whose lotus feet; brahma padya nivediya — Brahma, offering water for the feet; srishtira karata haila — became the creator of the world; prasada paiya — obtaining grace

**119.** He to whose lotus feet Brahma offered water
and by whose grace became the creator of the world;[^19-6]

যে পদ হইতে গঙ্গা আইলা মহীতলে ।
সর্বলোক মুক্তিপদ পাইল সেকালে ॥ ১২০ ॥

*ye pada haite gaṅgā āilā mahītale |*
*sarbaloka muktipada pāila sekāle || 120 ||*

*Word for word:* ye pada haite — from which foot; ganga aila mahitale — the Ganga came down to earth; sarva-loka — all the worlds; mukti-pada paila — attained liberation; sekale — at that time

**120.** He from whose foot the Ganga came down to the earth,[^19-7]
and at that time all the worlds attained liberation;

যাহারে ত্রিপাদ-ভূমি উৎসর্গিল বলি ।
তাহার মস্তকে দিলা পাদপদ্ম-ধূলি ॥ ১২১ ॥

*yāhāre tripāda-bhūmi utsargila bali |*
*tāhāra mastake dilā pādapadma-dhūli || 121 ||*

*Word for word:* yahare — to whom; tripada-bhumi utsargila bali — Bali gave three steps of land; tahara mastake — on his head; dila pada-padma-dhuli — placed the dust of the lotus feet

**121.** He to whom Bali gave three steps of land
and on whose head He placed the dust of His lotus feet;

যে পদ জপিয়া যোগী হৈলা মহেশ্বর ।
যেই পদ আনন্দে কমলা-দেবী সেবে ॥ ১২২ ॥

*ye pada japiẏā yogī hailā maheśbara |*
*yei pada ānande kamalā-debī sebe || 122 ||*

*Word for word:* ye pada japiya — by repeating [the name of] which foot; yogi haila maheshvara — the yogi became Maheshvara; yei pada — that foot; anande kamala-devi seve — the goddess Kamala serves with joy

**122.** That foot by repeating [the name of] which the yogi became Maheshvara,
that foot which the goddess Kamala serves with joy;

তাহা হইতে বিষ্ণু যার অংশ অবতার ।
যার অংশ আদিবরাহ পৃথিবী-উদ্ধার ॥ ১২৩ ॥

*tāhā haite biṣṇu yāra aṃśa abatāra |*
*yāra aṃśa ādibarāha pṛthibī-uddhāra || 123 ||*

*Word for word:* taha haite — from Him; vishnu — Vishnu; yara amsha avatara — His partial avatara; yara amsha — whose portion; adi-varaha — Adi-Varaha; prithivi-uddhara — the raiser of the earth

**123.** He from whom comes Vishnu, His partial avatara;
whose portion is Adi-Varaha, who raised up the earth;

যার অংশ মৎস্য-কূর্ম-বরাহ-নৃসিংহাদি ।
হিরণ্যকশিপু-বামন-ম্লেচ্ছ প্রভৃতি ॥ ১২৪ ॥

*yāra aṃśa matsya-kūrma-barāha-nṛsiṃhādi |*
*hiraṇyakaśipu-bāmana-mleccha prabhṛti || 124 ||*

*Word for word:* yara amsha — whose portions; matsya-kurma-varaha-nrisimha-adi — Matsya, Kurma, Varaha, Nrisimha and others; hiranyakashipu — [the Slayer of] Hiranyakashipu; vamana — Vamana; mleccha — [the Chastiser of] the mlecchas; prabhriti — and the rest

**124.** whose portions are Matsya, Kurma, Varaha, Nrisimha and the others,
[the Slayer of] Hiranyakashipu, Vamana, [the Chastiser of] the mlecchas and the rest;

পরশুরাম-ভৃগুরাম-বৌদ্ধ-ব্যাসমুনি ।
অষ্টাদশ পুরাণ যাহার মুখে শুনি ॥ ১২৫ ॥

*paraśurāma-bhṛgurāma-bauddha-byāsamuni |*
*aṣṭādaśa purāṇa yāhāra mukhe śuni || 125 ||*

*Word for word:* parashurama — Parashurama; bhrigurama — Bhrigurama; bauddha — Buddha; vyasa-muni — the sage Vyasa; ashtadasha purana — the eighteen Puranas; yahara mukhe shuni — heard from whose lips

**125.** Parashurama, Bhrigurama, Buddha, the sage Vyasa,
from whose lips the eighteen Puranas are heard[^19-8] —

এই শুন গুণগাথা দশ অবতার ।
যুগে যুগে অবতার জীব তরাবার ॥ ১২৬ ॥

*ei śuna guṇagāthā daśa abatāra |*
*yuge yuge abatāra jība tarābāra || 126 ||*

*Word for word:* ei shuna guna-gatha — hear this song of virtues; dasha avatara — of the ten avataras; yuge yuge avatara — descending age after age; jiva tarabara — to deliver the souls

**126.** hear now this song of the virtues of the ten avataras,
who descend age after age to deliver the souls —

সে প্রভু হইলা বল্লভাচার্যের জামাতা ।
ত্রিভুবনে যাহার ভাগ্যের নাহি কথা ॥ ১২৭ ॥

*se prabhu hailā ballabhācāryera jāmātā |*
*tribhubane yāhāra bhāgyera nāhi kathā || 127 ||*

*Word for word:* se prabhu haila — that Lord became; vallabhacharyera jamata — Vallabhacharya's son-in-law; tribhuvane — in the three worlds; yahara bhagyera nahi katha — there are no words for his fortune

**127.** that Lord became Vallabhacharya's son-in-law;
in all the three worlds there are no words for his good fortune.

গৌরাঙ্গের গুণগাথা অমৃতের খণ্ড ।
যে কথা শুনিলে ঘুচে অন্তর-পাষণ্ড ॥ ১২৮ ॥

*gaurāṅgera guṇagāthā amṛtera khaṇḍa |*
*ye kathā śunile ghuce antara-pāṣaṇḍa || 128 ||*

*Word for word:* gaurangera guna-gatha — the song of Gauranga's virtues; amritera khanda — a morsel of nectar; ye katha shunile — when one hears this account; ghuche antara-pashanda — godlessness leaves the heart

**128.** The song of Gauranga's virtues is a morsel of nectar:
whoever hears it, from his heart godlessness departs.

হেন সে পদারবিন্দে পাদ্য দেই মিশ্র ।
যার আরাধনে ঘুচে সংসার-তমিস্র ॥ ১২৯ ॥

*hena se padārabinde pādya dei miśra |*
*yāra ārādhane ghuce saṃsāra-tamisra || 129 ||*

*Word for word:* hena se padaravinde — to such lotus feet; padya dei mishra — Mishra offers water; yara aradhane — by whose worship; ghuche samsara-tamisra — the darkness of samsara is dispelled

**129.** To such lotus feet Mishra offers water —
feet whose worship dispels the darkness of samsara.

মহেন্দ্র যাহারে দিল নৃপ-সিংহাসন ।
হেন জনে দেই মিশ্র বিষ্টর-আসন ॥ ১৩০ ॥

*mahendra yāhāre dila nṛpa-siṃhāsana |*
*hena jane dei miśra biṣṭara-āsana || 130 ||*

*Word for word:* mahendra yahare dila — to whom great Indra gave; nripa-simhasana — the royal throne; hena jane — to such a Person; dei mishra — Mishra gives; vishtara-asana — a seat of grass (vishtara)

**130.** To Him to whom great Indra yielded his royal throne,[^19-9]
Mishra gives a seat — a mat of grass.

যে প্রভু বসন পরে দিব্য-পীতবাস ।
তাহারে বসন দেই শুনিতে তরাস ॥ ১৩১ ॥

*ye prabhu basana pare dibya-pītabāsa |*
*tāhāre basana dei śunite tarāsa || 131 ||*

*Word for word:* ye prabhu basana pare — the Lord who wears as garment; divya-pita-basa — divine yellow cloth; tahare basana dei — to Him he gives a garment; shunite tarasa — fearful to hear

**131.** To the Lord who is clad in divine yellow garments
he gives a garment — it is fearful even to hear!

এই মনে ক্রমে ক্রমে যে বিধি আছিল ।
যজ্ঞ আদি যত কর্ম সব নিবড়িল ॥ ১৩২ ॥

*ei mane krame krame ye bidhi āchila |*
*yajña ādi yata karma saba nibaṛila || 132 ||*

*Word for word:* ei mane — thus; krame krame — in due order; ye vidhi achhila — what was prescribed; yajna adi yata karma — the sacrifice and all the rites; saba nibadila — all was completed

**132.** Thus, in due order, all that was prescribed —
the sacrifice and all the other rites — was completed.

বল্লভ আচার্য হেন নাহি ভাগ্যবান্ ।
আপনে বৈকুণ্ঠনাথ লৈল কন্যাদান ॥ ১৩৩ ॥

*ballabha ācārya hena nāhi bhāgyabān |*
*āpane baikuṇṭhanātha laila kanyādāna || 133 ||*

*Word for word:* vallabha acharya hena — like Vallabha Acharya; nahi bhagyavan — there is none so fortunate; apane — Himself; vaikuntha-natha — the Lord of Vaikuntha; laila kanya-dana — accepted the gift of the daughter

**133.** No one is as fortunate as Vallabha Acharya:
the Lord of Vaikuntha Himself accepted his daughter as a gift.

কি কহিব বল্লভমিশ্রের ভাগ্যরাশি ।
যার ঘরে কৈলা প্রভু এ পঞ্চ-গরাসি ॥ ১৩৪ ॥

*ki kahiba ballabhamiśrera bhāgyarāśi |*
*yāra ghare kailā prabhu e pañca-garāsi || 134 ||*

*Word for word:* ki kahiba — what shall I say; vallabha-mishrera bhagya-rashi — of Vallabha Mishra's heap of fortune; yara ghare — in whose house; kaila prabhu — the Lord performed; e pancha-garasi — this rite of the five mouthfuls

**134.** What can I say of the boundless good fortune of Vallabha Mishra,
in whose house the Lord performed the rite of the five mouthfuls![^19-10]

কন্যা-বরে একগৃহে ভোজন করিল ।
শত শত কুলবধূ বাসরে মিলিল ॥ ১৩৫ ॥

*kanyā-bare ekagṛhe bhojana karila |*
*śata śata kulabadhū bāsare milila || 135 ||*

*Word for word:* kanya-bare — bride and bridegroom; eka-grihe — in one room; bhojana karila — took their meal; shata shata kula-badhu — hundreds upon hundreds of noble wives; basare milila — gathered in the bridal chamber

**135.** Bride and bridegroom took their meal in one room;
hundreds upon hundreds of wives of noble families gathered in the bridal chamber.[^19-11]

যূথে যূথে তরুণী আইল প্রভু-কাছে ।
বেঢ়িয়া রহিল বিশ্বম্ভর আগে পাছে ॥ ১৩৬ ॥

*yūthe yūthe taruṇī āila prabhu-kāche |*
*beṛhiẏā rahila biśbambhara āge pāche || 136 ||*

*Word for word:* yuthe yuthe taruni — young women in throngs; aila prabhu-kachhe — came to the Lord; bedhiya rahila — surrounded; vishvambhara age pachhe — Vishvambhara in front and behind

**136.** In throngs the young women came to the Lord
and surrounded Vishvambhara in front and behind.

সে চন্দ্রবদন-হাস্য উদয় দেখিয়া ।
লজ্জা-তিমির সভার গেল পলাইয়া ॥ ১৩৭ ॥

*se candrabadana-hāsya udaẏa dekhiẏā |*
*lajjā-timira sabhāra gela palāiẏā || 137 ||*

*Word for word:* se chandra-badana-hasya — of the smile on that moonlike face; udaya dekhiya — seeing the rising; lajja-timira — the darkness of shyness; sabhara — of all; gela palaiya — fled away

**137.** Seeing the rising of the smile on His moonlike face,
the darkness of everyone's shyness fled away.

বসিলা সুন্দরী সব প্রভুর সমীপে ।
সে অঙ্গ-বাতাসে রঙ্গিণীর অঙ্গ কাঁপে ॥ ১৩৭+১ ॥

*basilā sundarī saba prabhura samīpe |*
*se aṅga-bātāse raṅgiṇīra aṅga kāṁpe || 137+1 ||*

*Word for word:* basila sundari saba — all the beauties sat; prabhura samipe — near the Lord; se anga-batase — at the breeze of that body; ranginira anga kape — the bodies of the playful women tremble

**137+1.** All the beauties sat down near the Lord;[^19-12]
at the breeze from His body the bodies of the playful women tremble.

বসন বচন সব স্খলিত হইল ।
নয়ান আলস-যুত কাহারো হইল ॥ ১৩৭+২ ॥

*basana bacana saba skhalita haila |*
*naẏāna ālasa-yuta kāhāro haila || 137+2 ||*

*Word for word:* vasana vachana saba — the garments and speech of all; skhalita haila — began to slip; nayana alasa-yuta — eyes heavy with languor; kaharo haila — became in some

**137+2.** The garments and the speech of all began to slip,
and the eyes of some grew heavy with languor.

কেহ অঙ্গ-পরশে অনঙ্গ-রঙ্গ-ভরে ।
ঢুলিয়া পড়িলা বিশ্বম্ভরের উপরে ॥ ১৩৭+৩ ॥

*keha aṅga-paraśe anaṅga-raṅga-bhare |*
*ḍhuliẏā paṛilā biśbambharera upare || 137+3 ||*

*Word for word:* keha — one; anga-parashe — touching [His] body; ananga-ranga-bhare — overcome by Ananga's play; dhuliya padila — sank down; vishvambharera upare — upon Vishvambhara

**137+3.** One, touching His body, in the waves of Ananga's play
sank down powerless upon Vishvambhara.

কেহো অনিমিষে থির-নয়নে নিরীখে ।
চকোর চাঁদের লাগি যেন রহে সুখে ॥ ১৩৭+৪ ॥

*keho animiṣe thira-naẏane nirīkhe |*
*cakora cāṁdera lāgi yena rahe sukhe || 137+4 ||*

*Word for word:* keho — another; animishe — unblinking; thira-nayane nirikhe — gazes with fixed eyes; chakora — the chakora bird; chandera lagi — for the moon; yena rahe sukhe — as if remains blissful

**137+4.** Another, unblinking, gazes at Him with a fixed look —
as the chakora is blissful gazing at the moon.

নয়ন-পঙ্কজে সবে গোরা-মুখ পূজে ।
নিজদেহ-পরশ লাগিয়া কেহো যাচে ॥ ১৩৭+৫ ॥

*naẏana-paṅkaje sabe gorā-mukha pūje |*
*nijadeha-paraśa lāgiẏā keho yāce || 137+5 ||*

*Word for word:* nayana-pankaje — with the lotuses of the eyes; sabe — all; gora-mukha puje — worship Gora's face; nijadeha-parasha lagiya — for a touch upon herself; keho yache — one begs

**137+5.** With the lotuses of their eyes all worship Gora's face;
one begs for His touch upon herself.

পরাধীন রঙ্ক যেন মহাধন পাইয়া ।
সম্বরিতে নাহি ঠাঁই ছাড়িতে নারে মায়া ॥ ১৩৭+৬ ॥

*parādhīna raṅka yena mahādhana pāiẏā |*
*sambarite nāhi ṭhāṁi chāṛite nāre māẏā || 137+6 ||*

*Word for word:* paradhina ranka — a dependent pauper; yena — as if; mahadhana paiya — finding great wealth; sambarite nahi thai — has nowhere to hide it; chhadite nare — cannot let go; maya — out of attachment

**137+6.** Like a dependent pauper who has found great wealth —
there is nowhere to hide it, yet out of attachment he cannot let it go.

নাম-বিপর্যয় কেহ করে বাসরঘরে ।
বিশ্বম্ভর-গুণে ভোরা পরিহাস করে ॥ ১৩৮ ॥

*nāma-biparyaẏa keha kare bāsaraghare |*
*biśbambhara-guṇe bhorā parihāsa kare || 138 ||*

*Word for word:* nama-viparyaya — the changing of names (a game); keha kare — some start; basara-ghare — in the bridal chamber; vishvambhara-gune bhora — enraptured by Vishvambhara's virtues; parihasa kare — they jest

**138.** In the bridal chamber some start the game of changing names;
enraptured by Vishvambhara's virtues, they jest.

কেহ বোলে বিশ্বম্ভর শুন মোর বোল ।
গুয়াখানি দেহ লক্ষ্মী নিদে হৈল ভোর ॥ ১৩৯ ॥

*keha bole biśbambhara śuna mora bola |*
*guẏākhāni deha lakṣmī nide haila bhora || 139 ||*

*Word for word:* keha bole — one says; vishvambhara shuna mora bola — Vishvambhara, listen to me; guyakhani deha — give a betel nut; lakshmi nide haila bhora — Lakshmi is overcome with sleep

**139.** One says: "Vishvambhara, listen to me:
give a betel nut — Lakshmi is overcome with sleep.

আপনে তুলিয়া দেহ লখিমী-বদনে ।
দেখুক সকল সখী হরষিত-মনে ॥ ১৪০ ॥

*āpane tuliẏā deha lakhimī-badane |*
*dekhuka sakala sakhī haraṣita-mane || 140 ||*

*Word for word:* apane tuliya deha — put it Yourself; lakhimi-badane — into Lakshmi's mouth; dekhuka sakala sakhi — let all the friends see; harashita-mane — with delight

**140.** Put it into Lakshmi's mouth Yourself —
let all her friends watch with delight!"

বিশ্বম্ভর-কেশ কেহ আউলাইয়া বান্ধে ।
বন্ধন-আকূতি তার পরশের সাধে ॥ ১৪০+১ ॥

*biśbambhara-keśa keha āulāiẏā bāndhe |*
*bandhana-ākūti tāra paraśera sādhe || 140+1 ||*

*Word for word:* vishvambhara-kesha — Vishvambhara's hair; keha — one; aulaiya bandhe — loosening, binds; bandhana-akuti tara — her eagerness to bind; parashera sadhe — from longing for the touch

**140+1.** One loosens Vishvambhara's hair and binds it again —
her eagerness to bind it comes from her longing to touch [Him].[^19-13]

কেহো গুয়াখানি দেয় গোরাচাঁদের মুখে ।
হিয়া দরদর তার পায় বড় সুখে ॥ ১৪০+২ ॥

*keho guẏākhāni deẏa gorācāṁdera mukhe |*
*hiẏā daradara tāra pāẏa baṛa sukhe || 140+2 ||*

*Word for word:* keho — another; guyakhani deya — gives a betel nut; gorachandera mukhe — into Gorachand's mouth; hiya daradara tara — her heart trembles; paya bada sukhe — feels great bliss

**140+2.** Another puts a betel nut into Gorachand's mouth —
her heart trembles, she feels great bliss.

অঙ্গ ঢলি পড়ে কেহো হিয়া উতরোল ।
লক্ষ্মীরে তুলিয়া দেয় গোরাচাঁদের কোল ॥ ১৪০+৩ ॥

*aṅga ḍhali paṛe keho hiẏā utarola |*
*lakṣmīre tuliẏā deẏa gorācāṁdera kola || 140+3 ||*

*Word for word:* anga dhali pade — sways and sinks; keho — another; hiya utarola — her heart in tumult; lakshmire tuliya — lifting Lakshmi; deya gorachandera kola — places on Gorachand's lap

**140+3.** Another, swaying faint, her heart in a tumult,
lifts Lakshmi and places her on Gorachand's lap.

কেহ বোলে হেন ভাগ্যবতী কে বা আছে ।
বিশ্বম্ভর হেন পতি মিলিয়াছে কাছে ॥ ১৪১ ॥

*keha bole hena bhāgyabatī ke bā āche |*
*biśbambhara hena pati miliẏāche kāche || 141 ||*

*Word for word:* keha bole — another says; hena bhagyavati ke va achhe — who is so fortunate; vishvambhara hena pati — a husband like Vishvambhara; miliyachhe kachhe — has come to her

**141.** Another says: "Is anyone more fortunate than she?
She has gained a husband like Vishvambhara!

কোন্ তপ কৈল কোন্ কৈল ব্রত-দান ।
দেব-আরাধনে কিবা সাধিল ধেয়ান ॥ ১৪২ ॥

*kon tapa kaila kon kaila brata-dāna |*
*deba-ārādhane kibā sādhila dheẏāna || 142 ||*

*Word for word:* kon tapa kaila — what austerity did she perform; kon kaila vrata-dana — what vows and gifts; deva-aradhane — in the worship of the gods; kiva sadhila dheyana — what meditation did she perfect

**142.** What austerity did she perform, what vows, what gifts?
What meditation did she perfect in the worship of the gods?

কোন্ সতী পতিব্রতা আছে পৃথিবীতে ।
বিশ্বম্ভর-রূপ দেখি স্থির করু চিতে ॥ ১৪৩ ॥

*kon satī patibratā āche pṛthibīte |*
*biśbambhara-rūpa dekhi sthira karu cite || 143 ||*

*Word for word:* kon sati pati-vrata — what chaste, faithful wife; achhe prithivite — is there on earth; vishvambhara-rupa dekhi — seeing Vishvambhara's beauty; sthira karu chite — could keep her heart steady

**143.** What faithful, chaste wife on earth
could keep her heart steady on seeing Vishvambhara's beauty?

মদন-সদন জিনি বদন সুন্দর ।
মানিনীর মানস-রতন-বর-চোর ॥ ১৪৪ ॥

*madana-sadana jini badana sundara |*
*māninīra mānasa-ratana-bara-cora || 144 ||*

*Word for word:* madana-sadana jini — surpassing Madana's abode; badana sundara — the beautiful face; maninira manasa-ratana — of the jewel of a proud beauty's heart; bara-chora — the great thief

**144.** His beautiful face surpasses Madana's abode;
He is the thief of the finest jewel — a proud beauty's heart.

ভুজদণ্ড অখণ্ড যে কামদণ্ড জিনি ।
সাধ করে নিজবুকে ধরিতে রমণী ॥ ১৪৫ ॥

*bhujadaṇḍa akhaṇḍa ye kāmadaṇḍa jini |*
*sādha kare nijabuke dharite ramaṇī || 145 ||*

*Word for word:* bhujadanda akhanda — the mighty arms; ye kamadanda jini — surpassing the staff of Kama; sadha kare — long; nija-buke dharite — to clasp to their breasts; ramani — women

**145.** His mighty arms surpass the staff of Kama:
women long to clasp them to their breasts.

লখিমী এ সব অঙ্গ বিলাস করিব ।
আমরা ইহার কবে পরশ পাইব ॥ ১৪৬ ॥

*lakhimī e saba aṅga bilāsa kariba |*
*āmarā ihāra kabe paraśa pāiba || 146 ||*

*Word for word:* lakhimi — Lakshmi; e saba anga — all this body; vilasa kariba — will enjoy; amara — we; ihara kabe parasha paiba — when shall we gain His touch

**146.** Lakshmi will delight in all this body —
but when shall we be blessed with His touch?

এই আমাদের আশা হ'ব ইহার দাসী ।
ক'বে সে সেবিব মোরা শ্রীগৌরাঙ্গ-শশী ॥ ১৪৭ ॥

*ei āmādera āśā ha'ba ihāra dāsī |*
*ka'be se sebiba morā śrīgaurāṅga-śaśī || 147 ||*
