*Word for word:* ei amadera asha — this is our hope; haba ihara dasi — we shall become His maidservants; kabe se sebiba mora — when shall we serve; sri-gauranga-shashi — Sri Gauranga, the moon

**147.** This is our hope: to become His maidservants;
when shall we serve Sri Gauranga, who is like the moon?"[^19-14]

*Raga varadi; disha: "My life, O Gorachand, are haya!"*

এই মনে রঙ্গে-ঢঙ্গে প্রভাত হইল ।
প্রাতঃক্রিয়া কৈল প্রভু যে বিধি আছিল ॥ ১৪৮ ॥

*ei mane raṅge-ḍhaṅge prabhāta haila |*
*prātaḥkriẏā kaila prabhu ye bidhi āchila || 148 ||*

*Word for word:* ei mane — thus; range-dhange — in amusement and merriment; prabhata haila — morning came; pratah-kriya kaila prabhu — the Lord performed the morning rites; ye vidhi achhila — as was prescribed

**148.** Thus, in amusement and merriment, morning came;
the Lord performed the morning rites as prescribed.

বিবাহের পর দিনে কুশণ্ডিকা-কর্ম ।
ব্রাহ্মণ ভোজন করে ব্রাহ্মণের ধর্ম ॥ ১৪৯ ॥

*bibāhera para dine kuśaṇḍikā-karma |*
*brāhmaṇa bhojana kare brāhmaṇera dharma || 149 ||*

*Word for word:* vibahera para dine — on the day after the wedding; kushandika-karma — the rite of kushandika; brahmana bhojana kare — brahmanas are fed; brahmanera dharma — as befits brahmanas

**149.** On the day after the wedding came the rite of kushandika;
brahmanas are fed, as befits brahmanas.

সকল করিল প্রভু সে দিন তথায় ।
আর দিনে ঘর যাব কহিল কথায় ॥ ১৫০ ॥

*sakala karila prabhu se dina tathāẏa |*
*āra dine ghara yāba kahila kathāẏa || 150 ||*

*Word for word:* sakala karila prabhu — the Lord did all this; se dina tathaya — that day there; ara dine ghara yaba — tomorrow I shall go home; kahila kathaya — He said

**150.** The Lord performed all this there that day
and said: "Tomorrow I shall go home."

ঘরেরে চলিল প্রভু আনন্দিত মনে ।
পরিজনে পূজা করে রজত-কাঞ্চনে ॥ ১৫১ ॥

*gharere calila prabhu ānandita mane |*
*parijane pūjā kare rajata-kāñcane || 151 ||*

*Word for word:* gharere chalila prabhu — the Lord set out for home; anandita mane — with a joyful heart; parijane puja kare — the family honour [Him]; rajata-kanchane — with silver and gold

**151.** The Lord set out for home with a joyful heart;
the family honour Him with silver and gold.

একাসনে বৈসে প্রভু লক্ষ্মী বামপাশে ।
চৌদিগে বেঢ়িল নারীগণ তার কাছে ॥ ১৫২ ॥

*ekāsane baise prabhu lakṣmī bāmapāśe |*
*caudige beṛhila nārīgaṇa tāra kāche || 152 ||*

*Word for word:* ekasane baise prabhu — the Lord sits on one seat; lakshmi vama-pashe — Lakshmi at His left; chaudige bedhila — all around surrounded; narigana tara kachhe — the women near them

**152.** The Lord sits on one seat with Lakshmi at His left;
all around, the women surrounded them.

বল্লভমিশ্রের হিয়া হরিষ-বিষাদ ।
যাত্রাকালে করে কন্যা-বরে আশীর্বাদ ॥ ১৫৩ ॥

*ballabhamiśrera hiẏā hariṣa-biṣāda |*
*yātrākāle kare kanyā-bare āśīrbāda || 153 ||*

*Word for word:* vallabha-mishrera hiya — in Vallabha Mishra's heart; harisha-vishada — joy and sorrow; yatra-kale — at the departure; kare kanya-bare ashirvada — he blesses bride and bridegroom

**153.** In Vallabha Mishra's heart are joy and sorrow;
at the departure he blesses bride and bridegroom.

দূর্বা ধান্য গন্ধ মাল্য গুবাক চন্দন ।
জামাতারে দিয়া কিছু করে নিবেদন ॥ ১৫৪ ॥

*dūrbā dhānya gandha mālya gubāka candana |*
*jāmātāre diẏā kichu kare nibedana || 154 ||*

*Word for word:* durva dhanya gandha malya gubaka chandana — durva grass, rice, scents, garlands, betel nuts, sandal; jamatare diya — giving to his son-in-law; kichhu kare nivedana — makes this submission

**154.** Offering durva grass, rice, scents, garlands, betel nuts and sandal,
he speaks to his son-in-law these words:

ধনহীন আমি ছার নাহি করি ভাগ্য ।
কি দিব তোমারে দান কিবা তোর যোগ্য ॥ ১৫৫ ॥

*dhanahīna āmi chāra nāhi kari bhāgya |*
*ki diba tomāre dāna kibā tora yogya || 155 ||*

*Word for word:* dhana-hina ami chhara — I am poor and wretched; nahi kari bhagya — I have no fortune; ki diba tomare dana — what gift shall I give You; kiva tora yogya — what is worthy of You

**155.** "I am poor and wretched, I have no good fortune;
what gift can I give You — what is worthy of You?

কেবল আপনগুণে কৈলে অনুগ্রহ ।
ধন্য করাইলে করি কন্যা-পরিগ্রহ ॥ ১৫৬ ॥

*kebala āpanaguṇe kaile anugraha |*
*dhanya karāile kari kanyā-parigraha || 156 ||*

*Word for word:* kebala apana-gune — only by Your own goodness; kaile anugraha — You showed grace; dhanya karaile — You made [me] blessed; kari kanya-parigraha — by accepting my daughter

**156.** Only by Your own goodness have You shown me grace:
by accepting my daughter You have made me blessed.

তোরে কি বলিব প্রভু কি আছে যোগ্যতা ।
আপনার নিজগুণে আমার জামাতা ॥ ১৫৭ ॥

*tore ki baliba prabhu ki āche yogyatā |*
*āpanāra nijaguṇe āmāra jāmātā || 157 ||*

*Word for word:* tore ki baliba prabhu — what shall I say to You, Lord; ki achhe yogyata — what worth is there [in me]; apanara nija-gune — by Your own goodness; amara jamata — [You are] my son-in-law

**157.** What can I say to You, Lord — what worth have I?
Only by Your own goodness have You become my son-in-law.

তোমার অভয় পাদপদ্মেতে শরণ ।
লভিলে না দিবে দুঃখ আমারে শমন ॥ ১৫৮ ॥

*tomāra abhaẏa pādapadmete śaraṇa |*
*labhile nā dibe duḥkha āmāre śamana || 158 ||*

*Word for word:* tomara abhaya pada-padmete sharana — refuge at Your fearless lotus feet; labhile — having obtained; na dibe duhkha amare shamana — Yama will not give me pain

**158.** Having found refuge at Your lotus feet, which grant fearlessness,
I shall no longer suffer at the hands of Yama.

দেব-পিতৃগণ মোরে প্রসন্ন হইল ।
যখনে তোমারে নিজ কন্যা সমর্পিল ॥ ১৫৯ ॥

*deba-pitṛgaṇa more prasanna haila |*
*yakhane tomāre nija kanyā samarpila || 159 ||*

*Word for word:* deva-pitrigana — the gods and ancestors; more prasanna haila — became pleased with me; yakhane — when; tomare nija kanya samarpila — I gave You my daughter

**159.** The gods and the ancestors are pleased with me
since I gave You my daughter.

যে পদ ধেয়ানে পূজে ব্রহ্মা-শিব-আদি ।
সে পদ পূজিল বিদ্যমানে যথাবিধি ॥ ১৬০ ॥

*ye pada dheẏāne pūje brahmā-śiba-ādi |*
*se pada pūjila bidyamāne yathābidhi || 160 ||*

*Word for word:* ye pada dheyane puje — the feet which in meditation are worshipped by; brahma-shiva-adi — Brahma, Shiva and others; se pada pujila — those feet I worshipped; vidyamane — in person; yatha-vidhi — as prescribed

**160.** The feet which Brahma, Shiva and others worship in meditation —
those feet I have worshipped in person, as prescribed.

আর কিছু নিবেদিয়ে শুন বিশ্বম্ভর ।
এ বোল বলিতে কণ্ঠে গদগদস্বর ॥ ১৬১ ॥

*āra kichu nibediẏe śuna biśbambhara |*
*e bola balite kaṇṭhe gadagadasbara || 161 ||*

*Word for word:* ara kichhu nivediye — I submit something more; shuna vishvambhara — listen, Vishvambhara; e bola balite — saying this; kanthe gadgada-svara — his voice faltered

**161.** I shall say something more — listen, Vishvambhara."
As he said this, his voice faltered.

ছলছল করে আঁখি করুণার জলে ।
লক্ষ্মী-কর ধরি দিল বিশ্বম্ভর-করে ॥ ১৬২ ॥

*chalachala kare āṁkhi karuṇāra jale |*
*lakṣmī-kara dhari dila biśbambhara-kare || 162 ||*

*Word for word:* chhalachhala kare ankhi — the eyes brimmed; karunara jale — with tears of tenderness; lakshmi-kara dhari — taking Lakshmi's hand; dila vishvambhara-kare — placed it in Vishvambhara's hand

**162.** His eyes brimmed with tears of tenderness;
taking Lakshmi's hand, he placed it in Vishvambhara's hand.

আজি হৈতে লক্ষ্মী তোরে কৈলুঁ সমর্পণ ।
জানিঞা করিবে ইহার ভরণ-পালন ॥ ১৬৩ ॥

*āji haite lakṣmī tore kailuṁ samarpaṇa |*
*jāniñā karibe ihāra bharaṇa-pālana || 163 ||*

*Word for word:* aji haite — from this day; lakshmi tore kailun samarpana — I entrust Lakshmi to You; janina — knowing; karibe ihara bharana-palana — You will care for and protect her

**163.** "From this day I entrust Lakshmi to You;
knowing [all this], care for her and protect her.

মোর ঘরে ছিলা লক্ষ্মী ঘরের ঈশ্বরী ।
আজি হৈতে তোর দাসী কুলের বহুড়ী ॥ ১৬৪ ॥

*mora ghare chilā lakṣmī gharera īśbarī |*
*āji haite tora dāsī kulera bahuṛī || 164 ||*

*Word for word:* mora ghare chhila lakshmi — in my house Lakshmi was; gharera ishvari — the mistress of the house; aji haite — from this day; tora dasi — Your maidservant; kulera bahudi — the daughter-in-law of the family

**164.** In my house Lakshmi was the mistress of the house;
from this day she is Your maidservant, the daughter-in-law of Your family.

মোর ঘরে ছিল এই স্বচ্ছন্দ-আচারে ।
আখটি করিয়া মায়ে করিত আহারে ॥ ১৬৫ ॥

*mora ghare chila ei sbacchanda-ācāre |*
*ākhaṭi kariẏā māẏe karita āhāre || 165 ||*

*Word for word:* mora ghare chhila ei — in my house she lived; svachchhanda-achare — as she pleased; akhati kariya — being stubborn; maye karita ahare — [made] her mother feed her

**165.** In my house she lived as she pleased:
she would be stubborn until her mother fed her [herself].

মোর ঘরে আছিল এ মা-বাপের কোলে ।
যথা তথা হৈতে আইলে ধরেসিয়া গলে ॥ ১৬৬ ॥

*mora ghare āchila e mā-bāpera kole |*
*yathā tathā haite āile dharesiẏā gale || 166 ||*

*Word for word:* mora ghare achhila e — in my house she grew; ma-bapera kole — in her mother's and father's arms; yatha tatha haite aile — when we came from anywhere; dharesiya gale — she hung on our necks

**166.** In my house she grew up in her mother's and father's arms;
wherever we came back from, she would throw her arms round our necks.

সভার দুলালী লক্ষ্মী আমি অপুত্রকা ।
ঘরমধ্যে সবে মোর এইটি বালিকা ॥ ১৬৭ ॥

*sabhāra dulālī lakṣmī āmi aputrakā |*
*gharamadhye sabe mora eiṭi bālikā || 167 ||*

*Word for word:* sabhara dulali lakshmi — Lakshmi is everyone's darling; ami aputraka — I am sonless; ghara-madhye — in the house; sabe mora eiti balika — I have only this little girl

**167.** Lakshmi is everyone's darling; I have no son —
in all my house I have only this one little girl.

আমি কি বলিব এই তোর নিজজন ।
মোহে মুগ্ধ হঞা বলি যতেক বচন ॥ ১৬৮ ॥

*āmi ki baliba ei tora nijajana |*
*mohe mugdha hañā bali yateka bacana || 168 ||*

*Word for word:* ami ki baliba — what shall I say; ei tora nija-jana — she is Your own; mohe mugdha hana — bewildered by attachment; bali yateka bachana — I speak all these words

**168.** But what am I saying — she is Your own.
All that I say I say blinded by attachment.

এই যে বলিল সেই আমি মূঢ়মতি ।
কি করিব মোর মায়া তুমি যার পতি ॥ ১৬৯ ॥

*ei ye balila sei āmi mūṛhamati |*
*ki kariba mora māẏā tumi yāra pati || 169 ||*

*Word for word:* ei ye balila — all this I said; sei ami mudha-mati — I, foolish-minded; ki kariba mora maya — what can my attachment do; tumi yara pati — [when] You are her husband

**169.** All this I have said out of my foolishness:
what does my attachment matter, when You are her husband?[^19-15]

ত্রিভুবনে নাহি লক্ষ্মীসম ভাগ্যবতী ।
আমি যত বলি সেই এ মোহ-পিরীতি ॥ ১৭০ ॥

*tribhubane nāhi lakṣmīsama bhāgyabatī |*
*āmi yata bali sei e moha-pirīti || 170 ||*

*Word for word:* tribhuvane — in the three worlds; nahi lakshmi-sama bhagyavati — none as fortunate as Lakshmi; ami yata bali — all that I say; sei e moha-piriti — is from attachment and love

**170.** In the three worlds no one is as fortunate as Lakshmi;
all that I say comes only from love and attachment."

এতেক বলিয়া মিশ্র কৈল সম্বরণ ।
ঢলঢল সকরুণ অরুণ-নয়ন ॥ ১৭১ ॥

*eteka baliẏā miśra kaila sambaraṇa |*
*ḍhalaḍhala sakaruṇa aruṇa-naẏana || 171 ||*

*Word for word:* eteka baliya — having said this; mishra kaila samvarana — Mishra fell silent; dhaladhala — brimming; sakaruna — sorrowful; aruna-nayana — reddened eyes

**171.** Having said this, Mishra fell silent;
his reddened eyes were brimming with tears of sorrow.

চলিলা সে বিশ্বম্ভর নিজপ্রিয়া বামে ।
লক্ষ্মীর সহিত চড়ে মনুষ্যের যানে ॥ ১৭২ ॥

*calilā se biśbambhara nijapriẏā bāme |*
*lakṣmīra sahita caṛe manuṣyera yāne || 172 ||*

*Word for word:* chalila se vishvambhara — Vishvambhara set out; nija-priya vame — with His beloved at His left; lakshmira sahita — with Lakshmi; chade manushyera yane — mounts the palanquin (carried by men)

**172.** And Vishvambhara set out, with His beloved at His left:
together with Lakshmi He mounted the palanquin.[^19-16]

শঙ্খ-দুন্দুভি বাজে জয়-জয়-রোল ।
নানাবিধ বাদ্য বাজে আনন্দ-হিল্লোল ॥ ১৭৩ ॥

*śaṅkha-dundubhi bāje jaẏa-jaẏa-rola |*
*nānābidha bādya bāje ānanda-hillola || 173 ||*

*Word for word:* shankha-dundubhi baje — conchs and dundubhis sound; jaya-jaya-rola — cries of "Jaya, jaya!"; nanavidha vadya baje — all kinds of instruments play; ananda-hillola — waves of joy

**173.** Conchs and dundubhis sound, cries of "Jaya, jaya!" resound;
all kinds of instruments play, joy spreads in waves.

ব্রাহ্মণেতে বেদ পড়ে ভাটে রায়বার ।
সম্মুখে নাটুয়া নাচে আনন্দ অপার ॥ ১৭৪ ॥

*brāhmaṇete beda paṛe bhāṭe rāẏabāra |*
*sammukhe nāṭuẏā nāce ānanda apāra || 174 ||*

*Word for word:* brahmanete veda pade — brahmanas recite the Vedas; bhate rayabara — bards [sing] praise songs; sammukhe natuya nache — in front dancers dance; ananda apara — boundless joy

**174.** Brahmanas recite the Vedas, bhat bards sing songs of praise;
in front the dancers dance — the joy is boundless.

বয়স্য-বেষ্টিত প্রভু চলি যায় পথে ।
অন্তরীক্ষে দেবগণ চলে দিব্যরথে ॥ ১৭৫ ॥

*baẏasya-beṣṭita prabhu cali yāẏa pathe |*
*antarīkṣe debagaṇa cale dibyarathe || 175 ||*

*Word for word:* vayasya-veshtita prabhu — the Lord surrounded by friends; chali yaya pathe — goes along the road; antarikshe devagana — in the sky the gods; chale divya-rathe — move in divine chariots

**175.** Surrounded by His friends, the Lord travels along the road;
in the sky the gods follow in divine chariots.

এথা শচী আনন্দিত আইহ-সুহ লৈয়া ।
পুত্র-মহোৎসবে বুলে কৌতুক করিয়া ॥ ১৭৬ ॥

*ethā śacī ānandita āiha-suha laiẏā |*
*putra-mahotsabe bule kautuka kariẏā || 176 ||*

*Word for word:* etha shachi anandita — here Shachi, joyful; aiha-suha laiya — with the married women; putra-mahotsave — at her son's festival; bule kautuka kariya — goes about merrily

**176.** Meanwhile Shachi, joyful, gathering the married women,
bustles about merrily at her son's festival.

সশাখ মঙ্গলঘট পাতিল দুয়ারে ।
নারিকেল-ফল দিল তাহার উপরে ॥ ১৭৭ ॥

*saśākha maṅgalaghaṭa pātila duẏāre |*
*nārikela-phala dila tāhāra upare || 177 ||*

*Word for word:* sashakha mangala-ghata — the auspicious pitcher with sprigs; patila duyare — set at the door; narikela-phala dila — placed a coconut; tahara upare — on top of it

**177.** At the door she set an auspicious pitcher with sprigs of leaves
and placed a coconut on top of it.

নির্মঞ্ছন-সজ্জ আর ঘৃত-বাতি জ্বলে ।
ঘরেরে আইলা প্রভু সেই শুভকালে ॥ ১৭৮ ॥

*nirmañchana-sajja āra ghṛta-bāti jbale |*
*gharere āilā prabhu sei śubhakāle || 178 ||*

*Word for word:* nirmanchhana-sajja — the things for the nirmanchhana; ara ghrita-bati jvale — and ghee lamps burn; gharere aila prabhu — the Lord came home; sei shubha-kale — at that auspicious hour

**178.** All is ready for the nirmanchhana, lamps of ghee are burning;
at that auspicious hour the Lord arrived home.

বিশ্বম্ভর-নির্মঞ্ছন করে নারীগণ ।
জয় জয় হুলাহুলি সুগীত নাচন ॥ ১৭৯ ॥

*biśbambhara-nirmañchana kare nārīgaṇa |*
*jaẏa jaẏa hulāhuli sugīta nācana || 179 ||*

*Word for word:* vishvambhara-nirmanchhana — Vishvambhara's nirmanchhana; kare narigana — the women perform; jaya jaya — "Jaya, jaya!"; hulahuli — "ulu-ulu" cries; sugita nachana — fine songs and dancing

**179.** The women perform Vishvambhara's nirmanchhana;[^19-17]
cries of "Jaya, jaya!", "ulu-ulu", fine songs and dancing.

নানাবিধ বাদ্য বাজে আনন্দ অপার ।
সর্বসুখময় হৈল শচীর আগার ॥ ১৮০ ॥

*nānābidha bādya bāje ānanda apāra |*
*sarbasukhamaẏa haila śacīra āgāra || 180 ||*

*Word for word:* nanavidha vadya baje — all kinds of instruments play; ananda apara — boundless joy; sarva-sukhamaya haila — became full of every happiness; shachira agara — Shachi's house

**180.** All kinds of instruments play, the joy is boundless;
Shachi's house was filled with every happiness.

উঠিল মঙ্গলধ্বনি আনন্দ বিশেষ ।
লক্ষ্মী-কর ধরি নিজগৃহে পরবেশ ॥ ১৮১ ॥

*uṭhila maṅgaladhbani ānanda biśeṣa |*
*lakṣmī-kara dhari nijagṛhe parabeśa || 181 ||*

*Word for word:* uthila mangala-dhvani — auspicious cries arose; ananda vishesha — special joy; lakshmi-kara dhari — taking Lakshmi's hand; nija-grihe paravesha — entered His home

**181.** Auspicious cries arose, the joy was great;
taking Lakshmi by the hand, [the Lord] entered His home.

পুত্র আর বধূ কোলে করে শচীদেবী ।
দূর্বা-ধান্য দিয়া বোলে হও চিরজীবী ॥ ১৮২ ॥

*putra āra badhū kole kare śacīdebī |*
*dūrbā-dhānya diẏā bole hao cirajībī || 182 ||*

*Word for word:* putra ara badhu — her son and daughter-in-law; kole kare shachidevi — Shachi-devi embraces; durva-dhanya diya — giving durva grass and rice; bole hao chirajivi — says: "Live long!"

**182.** Shachi-devi embraces her son and daughter-in-law;
showering them with durva grass and rice, she says: "Live long!"

পুত্রমুখে চুম্ব দেই বধূপানে চাঞা ।
বধূমুখে চুম্ব দেই পুত্র নিরখিয়া ॥ ১৮৩ ॥

*putramukhe cumba dei badhūpāne cāñā |*
*badhūmukhe cumba dei putra nirakhiẏā || 183 ||*

*Word for word:* putra-mukhe chumba dei — she kisses her son's face; badhu-pane chana — looking at the daughter-in-law; badhu-mukhe chumba dei — she kisses the daughter-in-law's face; putra nirakhiya — gazing at her son

**183.** She kisses her son's face, looking at her daughter-in-law,
and kisses her daughter-in-law's face, gazing at her son.

সর্বসুখময় হৈল শচীর আবাস ।
গোরাগুণ গায় সুখে এ লোচনদাস ॥ ১৮৪ ॥

*sarbasukhamaẏa haila śacīra ābāsa |*
*gorāguṇa gāẏa sukhe e locanadāsa || 184 ||*

*Word for word:* sarva-sukhamaya haila — became full of every happiness; shachira avasa — Shachi's dwelling; gora-guna gaya sukhe — joyfully sings Gora's virtues; e lochana-dasa — this Lochana Dasa

**184.** Shachi's dwelling was filled with every happiness;
joyfully Lochana Dasa sings of Gora's virtues.[^19-18]

*Raga sindhura*

এইমতে নিজ-বান্ধব-সহিত,
সুখে নিবসয়ে পহুঁ ।
শচীর অন্তরে, আনন্দ-পাথার,
দেখি গোরাচান্দ বহু ॥ ১৮৪+১ ॥

*eimate nija-bāndhaba-sahita,*
*sukhe nibasaẏe pahuṁ |*
*śacīra antare, ānanda-pāthāra,*
*dekhi gorācānda bahu || 184+1 ||*

*Word for word:* eimate — thus; nija-bandhava-sahita — with His own friends and kin; sukhe nivasaye pahun — the Lord dwells happily; shachira antare — in Shachi's heart; ananda-pathara — an ocean of bliss; dekhi — seeing; gorachanda bahu — Gorachand [and His] bride

**184+1.** Thus the Lord lives happily
with His friends and kinsmen;
in Shachi's heart is an ocean of bliss
as she sees Gorachand with His bride.[^19-19]

নদীয়া-বিনোদ গোরা,
কেলি-কুতূহলে ভোরা ।
কামের কামান, ভুরু-নিরমাণ,
বাণ কটাক্ষ তারা ॥ ১৮৪+২ ॥

*nadīẏā-binoda gorā,*
*keli-kutūhale bhorā |*
*kāmera kāmāna, bhuru-niramāṇa,*
*bāṇa kaṭākṣa tārā || 184+2 ||*

*Word for word:* nadiya-vinoda gora — Gora, the delight of Nadia; keli-kutuhale bhora — absorbed in the joy of play; kamera kamana — Kama's bow; bhuru-niramana — fashioned of the brows; bana — the arrows; kataksha tara — the glances of the pupils

**184+2.** Gora, the delight of Nadia,
absorbed in the joy of play;
His brows are Kama's bow,
the arrows are the glances of His eyes.

বয়স্যের সঙ্গ, রহস্য-বিলাস,
লীলা-রসময় তনু ।
বিনি মেঘে মহী, এ থির বিজুরী,
তেজল কুসুম-ধনু ॥ ১৮৪+৩ ॥

*baẏasyera saṅga, rahasya-bilāsa,*
*līlā-rasamaẏa tanu |*
*bini meghe mahī, e thira bijurī,*
*tejala kusuma-dhanu || 184+3 ||*

*Word for word:* bayasyera sanga — the company of friends; rahasya-vilasa — jests and sport; lila-rasamaya tanu — a body full of the rasa of lila; vini meghe mahi — on earth without a cloud; e thira bijuri — this steady lightning; tejala kusuma-dhanu — has thrown down the flower-bow

**184+3.** Among His friends, in jests and sport,
His body full of the rasa of lila;
on earth, without a cloud, a steady lightning:
[Kama] has thrown down his flower-bow.

বয়স্য-অংসে, কর অবলম্বি,
পুঁথি করি বাম হাতে ।
দিবসের অন্তে, সব যূথে যূথে,
সুরধুনী-তট-পথে ॥ ১৮৪+৪ ॥

*baẏasya-aṃse, kara abalambi,*
*puṁthi kari bāma hāte |*
*dibasera ante, saba yūthe yūthe,*
*suradhunī-taṭa-pathe || 184+4 ||*

*Word for word:* bayasya-amse — on a friend's shoulder; kara avalambi — resting the hand; punthi kari bama hate — holding a book in the left hand; divasera ante — at the close of day; saba yuthe yuthe — all in groups; suradhuni-tata-pathe — on the way to the bank of the celestial river

**184+4.** Resting His hand on a friend's shoulder,
a book in His left hand,
at the close of day [He goes]
to the bank of the celestial river.

সুগন্ধি চন্দন, অঙ্গে বিলেপন,
বিনোদ বিনোদ ফোঁটা ।
তাহার সৌরভে, ভ্রমর ভুলে,
ধাওল যুবতী-ঘটা ॥ ১৮৪+৫ ॥

*sugandhi candana, aṅge bilepana,*
*binoda binoda phoṁṭā |*
*tāhāra saurabhe, bhramara bhule,*
*dhāola yubatī-ghaṭā || 184+5 ||*

*Word for word:* sugandhi chandana — fragrant sandal; ange vilepana — anointing the body; vinoda vinoda phonta — a most charming tilaka; tahara saurabhe — at its fragrance; bhramara bhule — the bees are bewildered; dhaola yuvati-ghata — crowds of young women ran

**184+5.** His body anointed with fragrant sandal,
on His brow a most charming tilaka;
at its fragrance the bees are bewildered,
and the young women came running in crowds.

চাঁচর কেশ, বেশের মাধুরী,
হেরিয়া কে ধরে চিত ।
কাছার শোভায়, লোভায় যুবতী,
না মানে গুরুর ভীত ॥ ১৮৪+৬ ॥

*cāṁcara keśa, beśera mādhurī,*
*heriẏā ke dhare cita |*
*kāchāra śobhāẏa, lobhāẏa yubatī,*
*nā māne gurura bhīta || 184+6 ||*

*Word for word:* chanchara kesha — curling hair; beshera madhuri — the sweetness of the attire; heriya — seeing; ke dhare chita — who can hold the heart; kachhara shobhaya — by the beauty of the dress; lobhaya yuvati — the young women are allured; na mane gurura bhita — heed not the fear of elders

**184+6.** His curling hair, the sweetness of His attire —
who, seeing it, can hold back her heart?
Allured by the beauty of His dress, the young women
do not heed the fear of their elders.

নদীয়া-নগরে, নাগর-আগরে,
রসের সাগর সভে ।
গৌরচন্দ্র-লীলা, দেখিয়া ভুলিলা,
দম্ভ চূর গেল তবে ॥ ১৮৪+৭ ॥

*nadīẏā-nagare, nāgara-āgare,*
*rasera sāgara sabhe |*
*gauracandra-līlā, dekhiẏā bhulilā,*
*dambha cūra gela tabe || 184+7 ||*

*Word for word:* nadiya-nagare — in the town of Nadia; nagara-agare — [He] the foremost of nagaras; rasera sagara sabhe — all in an ocean of rasa; gaurachandra-lila — Gaurachandra's lila; dekhiya bhulila — seeing, lost their senses; dambha chura gela tabe — then the pride was ground to dust

**184+7.** In the town of Nadia, where He is the foremost of nagaras,
all are sunk in an ocean of rasa;
seeing Gaurachandra's lila, all lost their senses,
and their pride was ground to dust.

নাগরীর গুণ, আছয়ে বাখান,
বঙ্কিম-আঁখি-কটাক্ষে ।
লাজের মন্দিরে, আগুনি ভেজায়া,
লোভে পড়ে লাখে লাখে ॥ ১৮৪+৮ ॥

*nāgarīra guṇa, āchaẏe bākhāna,*
*baṅkima-āṁkhi-kaṭākṣe |*
*lājera mandire, āguni bhejāẏā,*
*lobhe paṛe lākhe lākhe || 184+8 ||*

*Word for word:* nagarira guna — the nagaris [His] qualities; achhaye bakhana — praise; bankima-ankhi-katakshe — with sidelong glances of curving eyes; lajera mandire — the temple of shame; aguni bhejaya — setting on fire; lobhe pade — fall in longing; lakhe lakhe — by hundreds of thousands

**184+8.** The nagaris praise His qualities
with sidelong glances of curving eyes;
setting fire to the temple of shame,
they fall [to Him] by hundreds of thousands in longing.

নদীয়া-সুন্দরী, আপনা পাসরি,
রহল হিয়া-ধেয়ানে ।
লোচনদাস বলে, সে সুখ-হিল্লোলে,
এই কর অনুমানে ॥ ১৮৪+৯ ॥

*nadīẏā-sundarī, āpanā pāsari,*
*rahala hiẏā-dheẏāne |*
*locanadāsa bale, se sukha-hillole,*
*ei kara anumāne || 184+9 ||*

*Word for word:* nadiya-sundari — the beauties of Nadia; apana pasari — forgetting themselves; rahala hiya-dheyane — remain in meditation in the heart; lochanadasa bale — Lochana Dasa says; se sukha-hillole — in those waves of happiness; ei kara anumane — imagine this

**184+9.** The beauties of Nadia, forgetting themselves,
remain absorbed in meditation [on Him] in their hearts.
Lochana Dasa says: in those waves of happiness —
just imagine this.

[^19-1]: "Chhorla" — the raised wedding platform (under a canopy) where the bridegroom stands and the rite is performed.
[^19-2]: "Bar-urati" (in Lochana Dasa, "bara urathite") — the rite of welcoming the bridegroom: the married women, led by the bride's mother, circle him with lamps and bless him.
[^19-3]: Godhuli — "the hour of cow-dust", dusk, when the herds come home; in Bengal an auspicious time for a wedding.
[^19-4]: Rohini — the beloved consort of the Moon god; cf. Murari 1.10.22.
[^19-5]: The meaning of "chhamuni" is unclear (perhaps the covering that hides the faces of bride and groom until the rite of seeing each other); the 1983 edition reads "they left the chhamuni".
[^19-6]: When the Lord as Vamana-Trivikrama strode up to Brahma's abode, Brahma washed His foot; cf. Murari 1.10.24.
[^19-7]: Vv. 120–128 are in A but absent from the 1983 edition; the 1903 edition gives them in a note as an additional reading of one manuscript.
[^19-8]: Lochana Dasa's list of avataras is free: "Hiranyakashipu" apparently stands for the avatara who slew him (Nrisimha), "the mlecchas" for Kalki, who chastises them; Bhrigurama is another name of Parashurama (perhaps Rama of the Raghus was meant); Vyasa is a shaktyavesha-avatara. The sense is clear: all the avataras are portions of Him who appeared as Gauranga; so too the Gaudiya Vaishnava tradition teaches (Gaura is Krishna Himself, the source of all avataras).
[^19-9]: Indra, king of the gods, honours the Lord as his master; cf. Murari 1.10.25.
[^19-10]: "Pancha-grasi" — the rite of the five mouthfuls: in the bride's house the bridegroom eats five handfuls of food.
[^19-11]: Basara — the room where the newly-weds spend the wedding night while the women keep them awake with jests and songs.
[^19-12]: Vv. 137+1 – 137+6 are found only in the 1983 edition (absent from Bhaktisiddhanta's edition); the 1903 edition has them, partly in brackets. On the nagari-bhava see en/09, note 9; cf. en/18, note 6: Lochana Dasa depicts the attraction of the women of Nadia to Gaura in the language of love poetry, but for a Gaudiya Vaishnava this is not worldly passion but attraction to the Lord, the transcendental Madana. The chakora is a bird which, by poetic tradition, feeds on moonbeams.
[^19-13]: Vv. 140+1 – 140+3 are found only in the 1983 edition (absent from Bhaktisiddhanta's edition); the 1903 edition has them.
[^19-14]: Vv. 136–147 — again Lochana Dasa's motif of nagari-bhava (see en/09, note 9). Still more such lines are in the 1983 edition (vv. 137+1 – 137+6, 140+1 – 140+3).
[^19-15]: Here "maya" is Vallabha's own fatherly attachment: before such a husband as the Lord it counts for nothing.
[^19-16]: Lit. "a vehicle carried by men".
[^19-17]: Nirmanchhana — a rite in which women wave lamps and auspicious articles around the bridegroom to ward off all that is inauspicious.
[^19-18]: Cf. Murari 1.10.27, 1.11.1–2.
[^19-19]: The song in raga sindhura (vv. 184+1 – 184+9) is found only in the 1983 edition (absent from Bhaktisiddhanta's edition, where the new section begins at once); the 1903 edition has it. The 1983 edition marks stanza 184+2 as the refrain (dhruva). Vv. 184+4 and 184+6 are partly corrupt in both editions and are translated by sense. "The foremost of nagaras" (184+7) and the stanzas on the nagaris are Lochana Dasa's motif of nagari-bhava (see en/09, note 9).

---

# Adi-khanda, part 12 (portion 20)

*Banga-vijaya: the Ganga, loving the Lord, rises to touch His feet; a brahmana devoted to the Ganga recognizes Him as Bhagavan and tells how the Ganga was born from the Lord, who melted at Shiva's singing; the Lord journeys to East Bengal, sanctifies the Padmavati and gives the name of Hari to all; Lakshmi serves Shachi in Navadvipa*

## Kaishora-lila (The Pastimes of Youth): Banga-vijaya — the Lord in East Bengal

> *Summary by Srila Bhaktisiddhanta Sarasvati.* One day, when Sri Sri Mahaprabhu went at sunset to see the Ganga, Ganga-devi, seeing her beloved Lord, surged up in love and tenderly began to touch His feet again and again. The acharyas, mishras, bhattas and other brahmana pandits who at that time, having finished their evening prayers on the bank of the Ganga, were praising the Ganga, were astonished to see the water suddenly rise and fell to pondering; and then a certain brahmana devoted to the Ganga, by her grace, came to know that the Lord is Bhagavan Himself. In explaining the cause of this rising of the water the author relates a Puranic story: once the devarshi Narada, together with Mahadeva and Ganesha, was singing the glories of Sri Hari, and at that time Bhagavan Sri Hari Himself appeared there. The perspiration that then came out on His divine body as He heard the kirtana about Himself is the Ganga, Brahman in liquid form. […] Then Bhagavan Gaurahari wished to go to East Bengal […]; having shown boundless mercy to the people of East Bengal, He returned to Navadvipa, but before that Lakshmi-devi, bitten by the serpent of separation from the Lord, disappeared from this world. Therefore Shachi-devi […]; and Gaurahari, consoling His mother, […].[^20-1]

*Raga shri;[^20-2] disha: "How wondrous — behold: the Darling of Navadvipa, dear as life — are haya!"*

আর দিনে এক কথা শুন সর্বজন ।
বিশ্বম্ভর-গুণগাথা নিতুই নূতন ॥ ১ ॥

*āra dine eka kathā śuna sarbajana |*
*biśbambhara-guṇagāthā nitui nūtana || 1 ||*

*Word for word:* ara dine eka katha — another story; shuna sarvajana — listen, everyone; vishvambhara-guna-gatha — the song of Vishvambhara's virtues; nitui nutana — ever new

**1.** Listen, everyone, to another story:
the song of Vishvambhara's virtues is ever new.

গঙ্গা দেখিবারে গেলা বয়স্যের মেলা ।
দিন-অবসানে সন্ধ্যা হৈল রম্য বেলা ॥ ২ ॥

*gaṅgā dekhibāre gelā baẏasyera melā |*
*dina-abasāne sandhyā haila ramya belā || 2 ||*

*Word for word:* ganga dekhibare gela — went to see the Ganga; vayasyera mela — with a band of friends; dina-avasane — at the end of the day; sandhya haila ramya bela — the lovely evening hour came

**2.** [He] went with His friends to see the Ganga;
the day was ending, the lovely evening hour had come.

গঙ্গার দুকূলে যত ব্রাহ্মণ-সজ্জন ।
গঙ্গা নমস্করি নিতি করয়ে স্তবন ॥ ৩ ॥

*gaṅgāra dukūle yata brāhmaṇa-sajjana |*
*gaṅgā namaskari niti karaẏe stabana || 3 ||*

*Word for word:* gangara dukule — on both banks of the Ganga; yata brahmana-sajjana — all the brahmanas and good people; ganga namaskari — bowing to the Ganga; niti karaye stavana — offer praises as daily

**3.** On both banks of the Ganga all the brahmanas and good people,
bowing to the Ganga, were offering her praises as every day.

কাখে কুম্ভ করি যায় পুরনারীগণ ।
নিরিখয়ে গঙ্গাদেবী বেকত-বদন ॥ ৪ ॥

*kākhe kumbha kari yāẏa puranārīgaṇa |*
*nirikhaẏe gaṅgādebī bekata-badana || 4 ||*

*Word for word:* kakhe kumbha kari — with pitchers on their hips; yaya puranarigana — the townswomen go; nirikhaye gangadevi — gaze at the goddess Ganga; bekata-badana — with faces unveiled

**4.** With pitchers on their hips the townswomen go
and, faces unveiled, gaze at the goddess Ganga.

মিশ্র আচার্য ভট্ট পণ্ডিত অপার ।
কত কত ধর্মশীল উত্তম-আচার ॥ ৫ ॥

*miśra ācārya bhaṭṭa paṇḍita apāra |*
*kata kata dharmaśīla uttama-ācāra || 5 ||*

*Word for word:* mishra acharya bhatta pandita apara — countless mishras, acharyas, bhattas, pandits; kata kata dharmashila — so many pious people; uttama-achara — of excellent conduct

**5.** Countless mishras, acharyas, bhattas and pandits,
so many pious people of excellent conduct —

সর্বজন দাণ্ডাইয়া দেখে গঙ্গাকূলে ।
গঙ্গার নির্মল জল শোভে নানা ফুলে ॥ ৬ ॥

*sarbajana dāṇḍāiẏā dekhe gaṅgākūle |*
*gaṅgāra nirmala jala śobhe nānā phule || 6 ||*

*Word for word:* sarvajana dandaiya — all, standing; dekhe ganga-kule — gaze on the bank of the Ganga; gangara nirmala jala — the pure water of the Ganga; shobhe nana phule — is adorned with many flowers

**6.** all stand on the bank of the Ganga and gaze at her:
the pure waters of the Ganga are adorned with many flowers.

গন্ধ চন্দন মাল্য দিব্য কদলক ।
যুবক যুবতী বৃদ্ধ পূজয়ে বালক ॥ ৭ ॥

*gandha candana mālya dibya kadalaka |*
*yubaka yubatī bṛddha pūjaẏe bālaka || 7 ||*

*Word for word:* gandha chandana malya — with scents, sandal, garlands; divya kadalaka — fine bananas; yuvaka yuvati vriddha — young men, young women, the old; pujaye balaka — and children worship

**7.** With scents, sandal, garlands and fine bananas
young men and women, the old and children worship her.

ত্রৈলোক্যপাবনী গঙ্গা বহে মহাবেগে ।
আপনা না ধরে গঙ্গা প্রভু-অনুরাগে ॥ ৮ ॥

*trailokyapābanī gaṅgā bahe mahābege |*
*āpanā nā dhare gaṅgā prabhu-anurāge || 8 ||*

*Word for word:* trailokya-pavani ganga — the Ganga, purifier of the three worlds; bahe mahavege — flows swiftly; apana na dhare ganga — the Ganga cannot contain herself; prabhu-anurage — in love for the Lord

**8.** The Ganga, purifier of the three worlds, flows swiftly:
in her love for the Lord the Ganga cannot contain herself.

উথলিল গঙ্গাদেবী বাঢ়িল সলিল ।
কুলু কুলু শব্দে পহুঁ-অঙ্গ পরশিল ॥ ৯ ॥

*uthalila gaṅgādebī bāṛhila salila |*
*kulu kulu śabde pahuṁ-aṅga paraśila || 9 ||*

*Word for word:* uthalila gangadevi — the goddess Ganga surged; badhila salila — the waters rose; kulu kulu shabde — with a murmur; pahun-anga parashila — touched the Lord's body

**9.** The goddess Ganga surged up, her waters rose,
and with a murmur she touched the Lord's body.

পুনঃ পরশের আশে বাঢ়ে গঙ্গাদেবী ।
সন্দেহ লাগিল লোকে মনে মনে ভাবি ॥ ১০ ॥

*punaḥ paraśera āśe bāṛhe gaṅgādebī |*
*sandeha lāgila loke mane mane bhābi || 10 ||*

*Word for word:* punah parashera ashe — longing to touch again; badhe gangadevi — the goddess Ganga rises; sandeha lagila loke — the people grew doubtful; mane mane bhavi — thinking to themselves

**10.** Longing to touch Him again, the goddess Ganga rises;
the people grew doubtful, thinking to themselves:

প্রতিদিন দেখি গঙ্গা যেমন তেমন ।
আজি অপরূপ তেজঃ শুনিয়ে গর্জন ॥ ১১ ॥

*pratidina dekhi gaṅgā yemana temana |*
*āji aparūpa tejaḥ śuniẏe garjana || 11 ||*

*Word for word:* pratidina dekhi ganga — every day we see the Ganga; yemana temana — always the same; aji aparupa tejah — today a wondrous force; shuniye garjana — a roaring is heard

**11.** "Every day we see the Ganga — she is always the same,
but today — a wondrous force, a roaring is heard.

মেঘ-বরিষণ নাহি বাঢ়য়ে সলিল ।
খরতর স্রোত বহে নীর উথলিল ॥ ১২ ॥

*megha-bariṣaṇa nāhi bāṛhaẏe salila |*
*kharatara srota bahe nīra uthalila || 12 ||*

*Word for word:* megha-varishana nahi — there is no rain; badhaye salila — the water rises; kharatara srota bahe — the current runs swifter; nira uthalila — the waters surge

**12.** There has been no rain, yet the water rises;
the current runs ever swifter, the waters surge."

এই মনে অনুমান করে সর্বজন ।
গঙ্গার ভকত এক আছয়ে ব্রাহ্মণ ॥ ১৩ ॥

*ei mane anumāna kare sarbajana |*
*gaṅgāra bhakata eka āchaẏe brāhmaṇa || 13 ||*

*Word for word:* ei mane — thus; anumana kare sarvajana — all the people conjecture; gangara bhakata eka — a devotee of the Ganga; achhaye brahmana — there was a brahmana

**13.** So all the people conjectured.
[But there] was a brahmana devoted to the Ganga.

গঙ্গার প্রসাদে তার অন্তর নির্মল ।
ভূত ভবিষ্যৎ বিপ্র জানয়ে সকল ॥ ১৪ ॥

*gaṅgāra prasāde tāra antara nirmala |*
*bhūta bhabiṣyat bipra jānaẏe sakala || 14 ||*

*Word for word:* gangara prasade — by the Ganga's grace; tara antara nirmala — his heart is pure; bhuta bhavishyat — past and future; vipra janaye sakala — the brahmana knows all

**14.** By the Ganga's grace his heart was pure,
and that brahmana knew everything — past and future.

গঙ্গা আরাধনা করে জপে হরিনাম ।
গঙ্গা গৌরাঙ্গ যেন দেখে এক ঠাম ॥ ১৪+১ ॥

*gaṅgā ārādhanā kare jape harināma |*
*gaṅgā gaurāṅga yena dekhe eka ṭhāma || 14+1 ||*

*Word for word:* ganga aradhana kare — worships the Ganga; jape harinama — chants the name of Hari; ganga gauranga — the Ganga and Gauranga; yena dekhe — that he may see; eka thama — in one place

**14+1.** He worships the Ganga and chants the name of Hari,
[longing] to see the Ganga and Gauranga in one place.[^20-3]

এই বাঞ্ছা সেই বিপ্র করিল হৃদয়ে ।
গঙ্গাতীরে কুটীর বান্ধিয়া সুখে রহে ॥ ১৪+২ ॥

*ei bāñchā sei bipra karila hṛdaẏe |*
*gaṅgātīre kuṭīra bāndhiẏā sukhe rahe || 14+2 ||*

*Word for word:* ei vanchha — this desire; sei vipra — that brahmana; karila hridaye — held in his heart; gangatire — on the bank of the Ganga; kutira bandhiya — building a hut; sukhe rahe — lives happily

**14+2.** With this desire in his heart that brahmana
built a hut on the bank of the Ganga and lived there happily.

গঙ্গা-মহোৎসব দেখি বাঢ়য়ে উল্লাস ।
চিন্তিতে চিন্তিতে তাহে ভেল পরকাশ ॥ ১৫ ॥

*gaṅgā-mahotsaba dekhi bāṛhaẏe ullāsa |*
*cintite cintite tāhe bhela parakāśa || 15 ||*

*Word for word:* ganga-mahotsava dekhi — seeing the Ganga's festival; badhaye ullasa — joy increases; chintite chintite — pondering and pondering; tahe bhela parakasha — it was revealed to him

**15.** Seeing the Ganga's festival, he grows ever more joyful;
he pondered and pondered — and it was revealed to him.

বিশ্বম্ভর মহাপ্রভু বয়স্যে বেষ্টিত ।
গঙ্গার সমীপে রহে দেখে আচম্বিত ॥ ১৬ ॥

*biśbambhara mahāprabhu baẏasye beṣṭita |*
*gaṅgāra samīpe rahe dekhe ācambita || 16 ||*

*Word for word:* vishvambhara mahaprabhu — Mahaprabhu Vishvambhara; vayasye veshtita — surrounded by friends; gangara samipe rahe — stands near the Ganga; dekhe achambita — [the brahmana] suddenly sees

**16.** Suddenly he sees: Mahaprabhu Vishvambhara,
surrounded by His friends, standing by the Ganga.

গঙ্গা নিরিখয়ে প্রভু বড় অনুরাগে ।
দ্বিগুণ হইল দেহ অঙ্গের পুলকে ॥ ১৭ ॥

*gaṅgā nirikhaẏe prabhu baṛa anurāge |*
*dbiguṇa haila deha aṅgera pulake || 17 ||*

*Word for word:* ganga nirikhaye prabhu — the Lord gazes at the Ganga; bada anurage — with great love; dviguna haila deha — the body grew twice its size; angera pulake — with the bristling of the hairs

**17.** The Lord gazes at the Ganga with great love;
His body grew twice its size, so did the hairs on His body stand on end.

করুণা-অরুণ ছলছল করে আঁখি ।
দেখিয়া পাইল বিপ্র অন্তরের সাক্ষী ॥ ১৮ ॥

*karuṇā-aruṇa chalachala kare āṁkhi |*
*dekhiẏā pāila bipra antarera sākṣī || 18 ||*

*Word for word:* karuna-aruna — reddened with tenderness; chhalachhala kare ankhi — the eyes brim with tears; dekhiya paila vipra — seeing it, the brahmana found; antarera sakshi — a witness for his heart

**18.** His eyes, reddened with tenderness, brim with tears;
seeing this, the brahmana found a witness [to what had been revealed] to his heart.

এই সেই ভগবান্ কভু নহে আন ।
চিন্তিতে চিন্তিতে গেলা প্রভু-বিদ্যমান ॥ ১৯ ॥

*ei sei bhagabān kabhu nahe āna |*
*cintite cintite gelā prabhu-bidyamāna || 19 ||*

*Word for word:* ei sei bhagavan — this is He, Bhagavan; kabhu nahe ana — none other; chintite chintite — so pondering; gela prabhu-vidyamana — went into the Lord's presence

**19.** "This is He — Bhagavan, and none other!"
So pondering, he went up to the Lord.

প্রভুর নিকটে গিয়া দাণ্ডাইয়া দেখে ।
অবশ হঞাছে প্রভু গঙ্গা-অনুরাগে ॥ ২০ ॥

*prabhura nikaṭe giẏā dāṇḍāiẏā dekhe |*
*abaśa hañāche prabhu gaṅgā-anurāge || 20 ||*

*Word for word:* prabhura nikate giya — going near the Lord; dandaiya dekhe — stands and sees; avasha hanachhe prabhu — the Lord is beside Himself; ganga-anurage — with the Ganga's love

**20.** Coming close to the Lord, he stands and sees:
the Lord is beside Himself with the Ganga's love.

গঙ্গার হৃদয় প্রভু জানে মনে মনে ।
আগুসরি করে গঙ্গা কর-পরশনে ॥ ২১ ॥

*gaṅgāra hṛdaẏa prabhu jāne mane mane |*
*āgusari kare gaṅgā kara-paraśane || 21 ||*

*Word for word:* gangara hridaya — the Ganga's heart; prabhu jane mane mane — the Lord knows within; agusari kare ganga — the Ganga comes forward; kara-parashane — touching His hands

**21.** The Lord in His heart knows the Ganga's heart;
the Ganga comes forward and touches His hands.

কর-পরশনে গঙ্গার না পূরিল আশ ।
ঢেউ-ছলে করে গঙ্গা চরণ-সম্ভাষ ॥ ২২ ॥

*kara-paraśane gaṅgāra nā pūrila āśa |*
*ḍheu-chale kare gaṅgā caraṇa-sambhāṣa || 22 ||*

*Word for word:* kara-parashane — by the touch of the hands; gangara na purila asha — the Ganga's desire was not fulfilled; dheu-chhale — under the guise of waves; kare ganga charana-sambhasha — the Ganga greets His feet

**22.** But touching His hands did not fulfil the Ganga's desire:
under the guise of waves the Ganga clings to His feet.

মূর্তিমতী হৈয়া গঙ্গা প্রভু-কাছে রহে ।
করজোড় করিয়া চরণ-পদ্ম চাহে ॥ ২২+১ ॥

*mūrtimatī haiẏā gaṅgā prabhu-kāche rahe |*
*karajoṛa kariẏā caraṇa-padma cāhe || 22+1 ||*

*Word for word:* murtimati haiya — taking a visible form; ganga — the Ganga; prabhu-kachhe rahe — stands near the Lord; karajoda kariya — with joined palms; charana-padma chahe — gazes at the lotus feet

**22+1.** Taking a visible form, the Ganga stands near the Lord;[^20-4]
with joined palms she gazes at His lotus feet.

দেখিয়া ব্রাহ্মণ পুলকিত সব অঙ্গ ।
দেখহ সকল লোক গঙ্গা গৌরাঙ্গ ॥ ২২+২ ॥

*dekhiẏā brāhmaṇa pulakita saba aṅga |*
*dekhaha sakala loka gaṅgā gaurāṅga || 22+2 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhiya — seeing; brahmana — the brahmana; pulakita saba anga — thrilled in all his limbs; dekhaha — look; sakala loka — all people; ganga gauranga — the Ganga [and] Gauranga

**22+2.** Seeing this, the brahmana thrilled all over:
"Look, all you people: the Ganga and Gauranga!"

প্রভু পরশিল গঙ্গা চরণ-কমলে ।
কৃতার্থ হইয়া গঙ্গা গেলা নিজ জলে ॥ ২২+৩ ॥

*prabhu paraśila gaṅgā caraṇa-kamale |*
*kṛtārtha haiẏā gaṅgā gelā nija jale || 22+3 ||*

*Word for word:* prabhu — the Lord's; parashila ganga — the Ganga touched; charana-kamale — the lotus feet; kritartha haiya — her desire fulfilled; ganga gela — the Ganga went; nija jale — into her own waters

**22+3.** The Ganga touched the Lord's lotus feet
and, her desire fulfilled, went back into her own waters.

গৌরাঙ্গ-নিকটে গঙ্গা কেহো না জানিল ।
ব্রাহ্মণ অভীষ্ট-ভরে নয়ানে দেখিল ॥ ২২+৪ ॥

*gaurāṅga-nikaṭe gaṅgā keho nā jānila |*
*brāhmaṇa abhīṣṭa-bhare naẏāne dekhila || 22+4 ||*

*Word for word:* gauranga-nikate — near Gauranga; ganga — the Ganga; keho na janila — no one knew; brahmana — the brahmana; abhishta-bhare — in the fullness of his desire; nayane dekhila — saw with his eyes

**22+4.** No one knew that the Ganga had been near Gauranga;
but the brahmana, attaining his desire, saw it with his own eyes.

সুরধুনী-অনুরাগ পাইয়া গৌরহরি ।
পুলকিত সব অঙ্গ কাঁপে থরথরি ॥ ২২+৫ ॥

*suradhunī-anurāga pāiẏā gaurahari |*
*pulakita saba aṅga kāṁpe tharathari || 22+5 ||*

*Word for word:* suradhuni-anuraga — the love of the celestial river; paiya — receiving; gaurahari — Gaurahari; pulakita saba anga — thrilled in all His limbs; kape tharathari — trembles

**22+5.** Receiving the love of the celestial river, Gaurahari
thrilled all over and trembled.

আবেশ হইয়া প্রভু বোলে হরিবোল ।
অবশ হইয়া নিজজনে দেই কোল ॥ ২৩ ॥

*ābeśa haiẏā prabhu bole haribola |*
*abaśa haiẏā nijajane dei kola || 23 ||*

*Word for word:* avesha haiya prabhu — the Lord in ecstasy; bole haribola — cries "Haribol!"; avasha haiya — losing control; nijajane dei kola — embraces His own

**23.** In ecstasy the Lord cries "Haribol!"
and, losing control of Himself, embraces His companions.

অরুণ-বরণ ভেল প্রেমার আরম্ভ ।
কদম্ব-কেশর জিনি পুলক-কদম্ব ॥ ২৪ ॥

*aruṇa-baraṇa bhela premāra ārambha |*
*kadamba-keśara jini pulaka-kadamba || 24 ||*

*Word for word:* aruna-barana bhela — became crimson; premara arambha — the beginning of prema; kadamba-keshara jini — like kadamba filaments; pulaka-kadamba — a mass of bristling hairs

**24.** He turned crimson — thus prema begins;
the hairs on His body stood up like the filaments of kadamba flowers.

প্রভু-অনুরাগে গঙ্গা হিয়ামাঝে রহে ।
শত শত ধারা আঁখি-সাগরেতে বহে ॥ ২৫ ॥

*prabhu-anurāge gaṅgā hiẏāmājhe rahe |*
*śata śata dhārā āṁkhi-sāgarete bahe || 25 ||*

*Word for word:* prabhu-anurage — in love for the Lord; ganga hiya-majhe rahe — the Ganga abides in [His] heart; shata shata dhara — hundreds of streams; ankhi-sagarete bahe — flow from the ocean of His eyes

**25.** In her love for the Lord the Ganga abides in His heart:
hundreds of streams flow from the ocean of His eyes.

লোমে লোমে বহে নীর লোকে বোলে ঘর্ম ।
উথলিল প্রেমসিন্ধু দ্রবময় ব্রহ্ম ॥ ২৬ ॥

*lome lome bahe nīra loke bole gharma |*
*uthalila premasindhu drabamaẏa brahma || 26 ||*

*Word for word:* lome lome bahe nira — water flows from every pore; loke bole gharma — people say "sweat"; uthalila prema-sindhu — the ocean of prema surged; drava-maya brahma — Brahman in liquid form

**26.** Moisture flows from every pore — people say, "It is sweat";
[but this] is the ocean of prema surging — Brahman in liquid form.

চৌদিকে সকল লোক হরি হরি বোলে ।
উথলিল প্রেমসিন্ধু আনন্দ-হিল্লোলে ॥ ২৭ ॥

*caudike sakala loka hari hari bole |*
*uthalila premasindhu ānanda-hillole || 27 ||*

*Word for word:* chaudike sakala loka — on all sides all the people; hari hari bole — cry "Hari, Hari!"; uthalila prema-sindhu — the ocean of prema surged; ananda-hillole — in waves of bliss

**27.** On all sides all the people cry "Hari, Hari!";
the ocean of prema surged in waves of bliss.

চমৎকৃত হৈল সব নদীয়া-সমাজ ।
গঙ্গার ভকত বিপ্র জানিলেক কাজ ॥ ২৮ ॥

*camatkṛta haila saba nadīẏā-samāja |*
*gaṅgāra bhakata bipra jānileka kāja || 28 ||*

*Word for word:* chamatkrita haila — were astonished; saba nadiya-samaja — all the people of Nadia; gangara bhakata vipra — the brahmana devoted to the Ganga; janileka kaja — understood the matter

**28.** All the people of Nadia were astonished;
the brahmana devoted to the Ganga understood the matter.

সেই ভগবান্ প্রভু বিশ্বম্ভর দেব ।
ইহা দেখি বাঢ়ে গঙ্গা এই অনুভব ॥ ২৯ ॥

*sei bhagabān prabhu biśbambhara deba |*
*ihā dekhi bāṛhe gaṅgā ei anubhaba || 29 ||*

*Word for word:* sei bhagavan — Bhagavan Himself; prabhu vishvambhara deva — Lord Vishvambharadeva; iha dekhi — seeing Him; badhe ganga — the Ganga rises; ei anubhava — so he realized

**29.** "This Lord, Vishvambharadeva, is Bhagavan Himself:
seeing Him, the Ganga rises" — so he realized.

চরণে পড়িয়া বিপ্র করয়ে আর্তনাদ ।
এতদিনে গঙ্গা মোরে কৈল পরসাদ ॥ ৩০ ॥

*caraṇe paṛiẏā bipra karaẏe ārtanāda |*
*etadine gaṅgā more kaila parasāda || 30 ||*

*Word for word:* charane padiya vipra — the brahmana, falling at His feet; karaye artanada — cries aloud; etadine — at last; ganga more kaila parasada — the Ganga has shown me grace

**30.** Falling at His feet, the brahmana cries aloud:
"At last the Ganga has shown me her grace!

যোগীন্দ্র মুনীন্দ্র যাহা না পায় ধেয়ানে ।
হেন মহাপ্রভু আজি দেখিল নয়ানে ॥ ৩১ ॥

*yogīndra munīndra yāhā nā pāẏa dheẏāne |*
*hena mahāprabhu āji dekhila naẏāne || 31 ||*

*Word for word:* yogindra munindra — the best of yogis and sages; yaha na paya dheyane — whom they do not attain in meditation; hena mahaprabhu — such a Mahaprabhu; aji dekhila nayane — today I saw with my eyes

**31.** He whom the best of yogis and sages cannot attain in meditation —
such a Mahaprabhu I have seen today with my own eyes!"

ভূমে গড়াগড়ি যায় কান্দে আর্তনাদে ।
আপনা পাশরে বিপ্র প্রেমার আনন্দে ॥ ৩২ ॥

*bhūme gaṛāgaṛi yāẏa kānde ārtanāde |*
*āpanā pāśare bipra premāra ānande || 32 ||*

*Word for word:* bhume gadagadi yaya — rolls on the ground; kande artanade — weeps crying out; apana pashare vipra — the brahmana forgot himself; premara anande — in the bliss of prema

**32.** He rolls on the ground, weeping and crying out;
the brahmana forgot himself in the bliss of prema.

চতুর্দিগে সর্বজন দাণ্ডাইয়া রহে ।
বেকত-বদনে বিপ্র পূর্বকথা কহে ॥ ৩৩ ॥

*caturdige sarbajana dāṇḍāiẏā rahe |*
*bekata-badane bipra pūrbakathā kahe || 33 ||*

*Word for word:* chaturdige sarvajana — all the people around; dandaiya rahe — stand; bekata-badane — openly; vipra purva-katha kahe — the brahmana tells the ancient story

**33.** All the people stand around;
and the brahmana openly tells the ancient story.

অবশ ব্রাহ্মণ দেখি চলিলা ঠাকুর ।
নিজঘরে গেলা হিয়া আনন্দ প্রচুর ॥ ৩৪ ॥

*abaśa brāhmaṇa dekhi calilā ṭhākura |*
*nijaghare gelā hiẏā ānanda pracura || 34 ||*

*Word for word:* avasha brahmana dekhi — seeing the brahmana beside himself; chalila thakura — Thakura left; nija-ghare gela — went to His home; hiya ananda prachura — His heart full of bliss

**34.** Seeing the brahmana beside himself, Thakura[^20-5] went away
to His home, His heart full of bliss.

আদিকথা কহে বিপ্র শুনে সর্বজন ।
যেমনে হইল গঙ্গাদেবীর জনম ॥ ৩৫ ॥

*ādikathā kahe bipra śune sarbajana |*
*yemane haila gaṅgādebīra janama || 35 ||*

*Word for word:* adi-katha kahe vipra — the brahmana tells the original story; shune sarvajana — all listen; yemane haila — how there came about; gangadevira janama — the birth of the goddess Ganga

**35.** The brahmana tells the original story, and all listen —
how the goddess Ganga was born

এখনে বা গঙ্গাদেবী বাঢ়ে যে কারণে ।
সকল কহিয়ে সভে শুন সাবধানে ॥ ৩৬ ॥

*ekhane bā gaṅgādebī bāṛhe ye kāraṇe |*
*sakala kahiẏe sabhe śuna sābadhāne || 36 ||*

*Word for word:* ekhane va — and now; gangadevi badhe — the goddess Ganga rises; ye karane — for what reason; sakala kahiye — I shall tell all; sabhe shuna savadhane — all listen attentively

**36.** and for what reason the goddess Ganga rises now:
"I shall tell you all — listen attentively.

পূর্বে এককালে মহামহেশ ঠাকুর ।
কৃষ্ণগুণ গায় মহা আনন্দ প্রচুর ॥ ৩৭ ॥

*pūrbe ekakāle mahāmaheśa ṭhākura |*
*kṛṣṇaguṇa gāẏa mahā ānanda pracura || 37 ||*

*Word for word:* purve ekakale — once long ago; maha-mahesha thakura — the great Mahesha Thakura; krishna-guna gaya — sang Krishna's virtues; maha ananda prachura — in great, abundant bliss

**37.** Once the great Mahesha Thakura[^20-6]
was singing of Krishna's virtues in great, abundant bliss.

নারদ ঠাকুর গায় গণেশ বাদক ।
পুলকে পূরিল অঙ্গ আপাদ-মস্তক ॥ ৩৮ ॥

*nārada ṭhākura gāẏa gaṇeśa bādaka |*
*pulake pūrila aṅga āpāda-mastaka || 38 ||*

*Word for word:* narada thakura gaya — Narada Thakura sings; ganesha vadaka — Ganesha the drummer; pulake purila anga — their bodies filled with bristling hairs; apada-mastaka — from feet to head

**38.** Narada Thakura sang, and Ganesha played the drum;
the hairs of their bodies stood on end from head to foot.

সঙ্গীত-সুতান তিনে গায় একমেলে ।
ব্রহ্মাণ্ড ভেদিল শব্দব্রহ্মের হিল্লোলে ॥ ৩৯ ॥

*saṅgīta-sutāna tine gāẏa ekamele |*
*brahmāṇḍa bhedila śabdabrahmera hillole || 39 ||*

*Word for word:* sangita-sutana — a beautiful melody; tine gaya ekamele — the three sing together; brahmanda bhedila — pierced the universe; shabda-brahmera hillole — the waves of sound-Brahman

**39.** All three sang a beautiful melody together;
the waves of sound-Brahman[^20-7] pierced the universe.

একে সে মহেশ আরে কৃষ্ণের আবেশ ।
নারদের বীণা তাহে বাদক গণেশ ॥ ৪০ ॥

*eke se maheśa āre kṛṣṇera ābeśa |*
*nāradera bīṇā tāhe bādaka gaṇeśa || 40 ||*

*Word for word:* eke se mahesha — first, Mahesha himself; are krishnera avesha — and besides in ecstasy for Krishna; naradera vina — Narada's vina; tahe vadaka ganesha — and Ganesha as drummer

**40.** First, it was Mahesha himself, and in the ecstasy of love for Krishna besides;
Narada had his vina, and Ganesha was on the drum as well!

অথির হইয়া প্রভু আইলা সেই ঠাঞি ।
মহেশ নারদ মিলি যথা গুণ গাই ॥ ৪১ ॥

*athira haiẏā prabhu āilā sei ṭhāñi |*
*maheśa nārada mili yathā guṇa gāi || 41 ||*

*Word for word:* athira haiya prabhu — the Lord, unable to stay still; aila sei thani — came to that place; mahesha narada mili — Mahesha and Narada together; yatha guna gai — where they sang His virtues

**41.** The Lord, unable to restrain Himself, came to the place
where Mahesha and Narada were singing His virtues together.

কহিল না গাও গুণ শুন হে মহেশ ।
তো সভার গান-তত্ত্ব না বুঝি বিশেষ ॥ ৪২ ॥

*kahila nā gāo guṇa śuna he maheśa |*
*to sabhāra gāna-tattba nā bujhi biśeṣa || 42 ||*

*Word for word:* kahila — He said; na gao guna — do not sing the virtues; shuna he mahesha — listen, O Mahesha; to sabhara gana-tattva — the essence of your singing; na bujhi vishesha — I do not well understand

**42.** He said: 'Do not sing My virtues, listen, Mahesha:
I do not well understand the essence of your singing.

তোমার সঙ্গীত-গানে নাহি রহে দেহ ।
আউলায় শরীর-বন্ধ দ্রবময় নেহ ॥ ৪৩ ॥

*tomāra saṅgīta-gāne nāhi rahe deha |*
*āulāẏa śarīra-bandha drabamaẏa neha || 43 ||*

*Word for word:* tomara sangita-gane — at your singing; nahi rahe deha — I do not remain in the body; aulaya sharira-bandha — the bonds of the body loosen; drava-maya neha — it becomes liquid

**43.** At your singing I cannot remain in My body:
the bonds of the body loosen, and it becomes liquid.'

শুনিঞা ঠাকুর-বাণী হাসয়ে মহেশ ।
গাইয়া দেখিব তত্ত্ব ইহার বিশেষ ॥ ৪৪ ॥

*śuniñā ṭhākura-bāṇī hāsaẏe maheśa |*
*gāiẏā dekhiba tattba ihāra biśeṣa || 44 ||*

*Word for word:* shunina thakura-vani — hearing Thakura's words; hasaye mahesha — Mahesha smiles; gaiya dekhiba — I shall sing and see; tattva ihara vishesha — the essence of this

**44.** Hearing Thakura's words, Mahesha smiles:
'I shall sing and see what the essence of this is.'

ইহা বলি গায় গুণ অধিক উল্লাস ।
ব্রহ্মাণ্ড ভরিল শব্দে এ ভূমি আকাশ ॥ ৪৫ ॥

*ihā bali gāẏa guṇa adhika ullāsa |*
*brahmāṇḍa bharila śabde e bhūmi ākāśa || 45 ||*

*Word for word:* iha bali — so saying; gaya guna — sings the virtues; adhika ullasa — with greater delight; brahmanda bharila shabde — the sound filled the universe; e bhumi akasha — this earth and sky

**45.** So saying, he sings His virtues with still greater delight;
the sound filled the universe — this earth and the sky.

দ্রবিলা শরীর প্রভু ক্ষীণ হৈল তনু ।
তরাসে মহেশ কৈল গান-সম্বরণ ॥ ৪৬ ॥

*drabilā śarīra prabhu kṣīṇa haila tanu |*
*tarāse maheśa kaila gāna-sambaraṇa || 46 ||*

*Word for word:* drabila sharira prabhu — the Lord's body melted; kshina haila tanu — His form grew thin; tarase mahesha — in alarm Mahesha; kaila gana-samvarana — stopped his singing

**46.** The Lord's body melted, His form grew thin;[^20-8]
in alarm Mahesha stopped his singing.

সম্বরণ কৈল গান থির হৈল মতি ।
সেই সে কারুণ্য-জল লোকে আছে খ্যাতি ॥ ৪৭ ॥

*sambaraṇa kaila gāna thira haila mati |*
*sei se kāruṇya-jala loke āche khyāti || 47 ||*

*Word for word:* samvarana kaila gana — when he stopped the singing; thira haila mati — the mind grew calm; sei se karunya-jala — that is the water of mercy; loke achhe khyati — famed in the world

**47.** When he stopped singing, [the Lord's] mind grew calm;
this is that water of mercy famed in the world.

সেই দ্রবব্রহ্ম-নাম করুণার জল ।
তীর্থরূপী জনার্দন ঘোষয়ে সকল ॥ ৪৮ ॥

*sei drababrahma-nāma karuṇāra jala |*
*tīrtharūpī janārdana ghoṣaẏe sakala || 48 ||*

*Word for word:* sei drava-brahma-nama — called Brahman in liquid form; karunara jala — the water of mercy; tirtha-rupi janardana — Janardana in the form of a holy place; ghoshaye sakala — all proclaim

**48.** This water of mercy is called Brahman in liquid form;
all proclaim it to be Janardana in the form of a holy place.[^20-9]

দুর্লভ দুর্লভ এই সংসার-ভিতর ।
কমণ্ডলু ভরি ব্রহ্মা রাখিল সে জল ॥ ৪৯ ॥

*durlabha durlabha ei saṃsāra-bhitara |*
*kamaṇḍalu bhari brahmā rākhila se jala || 49 ||*

*Word for word:* durlabha durlabha — very, very rare; ei samsara-bhitara — in this world; kamandalu bhari — filling his kamandalu; brahma rakhila se jala — Brahma kept that water

**49.** It is very, very rare in this world:
Brahma filled his kamandalu with it and kept it.

আছিলত বলিরাজ প্রভুর ভকত ।
তারে অনুগ্রহ লাগি ভৈ গেল বেকত ॥ ৫০ ॥

*āchilata balirāja prabhura bhakata |*
*tāre anugraha lāgi bhai gela bekata || 50 ||*

*Word for word:* achhilata bali-raja — there was King Bali; prabhura bhakata — a devotee of the Lord; tare anugraha lagi — to show him grace; bhai gela bekata — [the Lord] appeared

**50.** King Bali was a devotee of the Lord;
to show him grace, the Lord appeared [as Vamana].

ত্রিপাদ থুইতে প্রভু মাগিল পৃথিবী ।
ত্রিভুবন জোড়ে প্রভুর দ্বিপাদ-পদবী ॥ ৫১ ॥

*tripāda thuite prabhu māgila pṛthibī |*
*tribhubana joṛe prabhura dbipāda-padabī || 51 ||*

*Word for word:* tripada thuite — to place three steps; prabhu magila prithivi — the Lord asked for land; tribhuvana jode — cover the three worlds; prabhura dvipada-padavi — the Lord's two steps

**51.** The Lord asked for land on which to set three steps:
with two steps He covered the three worlds,

আর পাদ দিল বলির মাথার উপর ।
এছন কৃপালু প্রভু নাহি হয় আর ॥ ৫২ ॥

*āra pāda dila balira māthāra upara |*
*echana kṛpālu prabhu nāhi haẏa āra || 52 ||*

*Word for word:* ara pada dila — the other foot He placed; balira mathara upara — on Bali's head; echhana kripalu prabhu — so merciful a Lord; nahi haya ara — there is no other

**52.** and the third foot He placed on Bali's head.
There is no other Lord so merciful!

আর অপরূপ শুন ত্রিপাদ-মহিমা ।
ত্রিজগতে ধন্য হৈল যাহার করুণা ॥ ৫৩ ॥

*āra aparūpa śuna tripāda-mahimā |*
*trijagate dhanya haila yāhāra karuṇā || 53 ||*

*Word for word:* ara aparupa shuna — hear another wonder; tripada-mahima — the glory of the third step; trijagate dhanya haila — the three worlds were blessed; yahara karuna — by whose mercy

**53.** Hear also another wonder — the glory of the third step,
whose mercy blessed the three worlds:

ব্রহ্মাণ্ড ভেদিল সেই পদনখ-আগে ।
সেই পদে পাদ্য ব্রহ্মা দিল অনুরাগে ॥ ৫৪ ॥

*brahmāṇḍa bhedila sei padanakha-āge |*
*sei pade pādya brahmā dila anurāge || 54 ||*

*Word for word:* brahmanda bhedila — the shell of the universe was pierced; sei pada-nakha-age — by the tip of that foot's nail; sei pade — to that foot; padya brahma dila — Brahma offered water for washing; anurage — lovingly

**54.** with the tip of that foot's toenail the shell of the universe was pierced,
and to that foot Brahma lovingly offered water for washing.[^20-10]

প্রভু-পাদাম্বুজ-জল পূজয়ে মস্তকে ।
ত্রিপাদ-সম্ভবা গঙ্গা তেঞি বোলে লোকে ॥ ৫৫ ॥

*prabhu-pādāmbuja-jala pūjaẏe mastake |*
*tripāda-sambhabā gaṅgā teñi bole loke || 55 ||*

*Word for word:* prabhu-padambuja-jala — the water from the Lord's lotus feet; pujaye mastake — they honour on their heads; tripada-sambhava ganga — the Ganga born of the third step; teni bole loke — therefore people say

**55.** The water from the Lord's lotus feet [people] reverently place on their heads;
that is why the Ganga is called 'born of the third step'.

হেনই ঠাকুর মহাপ্রভু বিশ্বম্ভর ।
দেখহ সকল লোক নয়ান-গোচর ॥ ৫৬ ॥

*henai ṭhākura mahāprabhu biśbambhara |*
*dekhaha sakala loka naẏāna-gocara || 56 ||*

*Word for word:* henai thakura — such is Thakura; mahaprabhu vishvambhara — Mahaprabhu Vishvambhara; dekhaha sakala loka — behold, all people; nayana-gochara — before your eyes

**56.** Such is Thakura — Mahaprabhu Vishvambhara:
behold, all of you, here He is before your eyes!

দেখি গঙ্গাদেবী পূর্ব-সোঙরণ হৈল ।
প্রেম-অনুরাগে গঙ্গা বাঢ়িতে লাগিল ॥ ৫৭ ॥

*dekhi gaṅgādebī pūrba-soṅaraṇa haila |*
*prema-anurāge gaṅgā bāṛhite lāgila || 57 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhi gangadevi — seeing, the goddess Ganga; purva-songarana haila — remembered the past; prema-anurage — in love and tenderness; ganga badhite lagila — the Ganga began to rise

**57.** Seeing Him, the goddess Ganga remembered the past
and in love and tenderness began to rise.

গঙ্গাপানে চাহে প্রভু অনুরাগ-দিঠে ।
অমৃত-অধিক গোরা-অঙ্গ লাগে মিঠে ॥ ৫৮ ॥

*gaṅgāpāne cāhe prabhu anurāga-diṭhe |*
*amṛta-adhika gorā-aṅga lāge miṭhe || 58 ||*

*Word for word:* ganga-pane chahe prabhu — the Lord looks at the Ganga; anuraga-dithe — with a loving gaze; amrita-adhika — more than nectar; gora-anga lage mithe — Gora's body tastes sweet

**58.** The Lord looks at the Ganga with a loving gaze,
and Gora's body is sweeter to her than nectar.

চরণ-পরশে পুনঃ তরঙ্গের ছলে ।
অনুভবে জানি মো কহিল সভারে ॥ ৫৯ ॥

*caraṇa-paraśe punaḥ taraṅgera chale |*
*anubhabe jāni mo kahila sabhāre || 59 ||*

*Word for word:* charana-parashe punah — again touches the feet; tarangera chhale — under the guise of waves; anubhave jani — knowing by realization; mo kahila sabhare — I have told all

**59.** Under the guise of waves she touches His feet again;
I have realized this by inner experience and told you all."

শুনিঞা সকল লোকের বাঢ়ল উল্লাস ।
গোরাগুণ গায় সুখে এ লোচনদাস ॥ ৬০ ॥

*śuniñā sakala lokera bāṛhala ullāsa |*
*gorāguṇa gāẏa sukhe e locanadāsa || 60 ||*

*Word for word:* shunina — hearing; sakala lokera badhala ullasa — all the people's joy increased; gora-guna gaya sukhe — joyfully sings Gora's virtues; e lochana-dasa — this Lochana Dasa

**60.** Hearing this, all the people rejoiced;
joyfully Lochana Dasa sings of Gora's virtues.

*Raga dhanashi; disha: "Are, the sweetness of my Gora's lotus feet! The bees, His devotees, fly up, circle and fall [upon them]. Are are haya!" (murchha). "Listen to this wondrous tale, the song of Gora's virtues — a name auspicious to the ear!"*

এইমতে কতদিন গোঙাইলা সুখে ।
বান্ধব-সহিতে প্রভু আনন্দ-কৌতুকে ॥ ৬১ ॥

*eimate katadina goṅāilā sukhe |*
*bāndhaba-sahite prabhu ānanda-kautuke || 61 ||*

*Word for word:* eimate — thus; kata dina gongaila sukhe — spent some days happily; bandhava-sahite prabhu — the Lord with His friends; ananda-kautuke — in joy and play

**61.** Thus [the Lord] spent some days in happiness,
in joy and play together with His friends.

একদিন মনে মনে কৈল আচম্বিত ।
পূর্বদেশে যাব আমি সর্বলোক-হিত ॥ ৬২ ॥

*ekadina mane mane kaila ācambita |*
*pūrbadeśe yāba āmi sarbaloka-hita || 62 ||*

*Word for word:* ekadina — one day; mane mane kaila achambita — suddenly resolved within; purva-deshe yaba ami — I shall go to the eastern land; sarvaloka-hita — for the good of all people

**62.** One day He suddenly resolved within Himself:
"I shall go to the eastern country — for the good of all people.

পাণ্ডব-বর্জিত দেশ সর্বলোকে গায় ।
গঙ্গা হৈয়া গঙ্গা নহে এই সাক্ষী তায় ॥ ৬৩ ॥

*pāṇḍaba-barjita deśa sarbaloke gāẏa |*
*gaṅgā haiẏā gaṅgā nahe ei sākṣī tāẏa || 63 ||*

*Word for word:* pandava-varjita desha — the land the Pandavas avoided; sarvaloke gaya — everyone says; ganga haiya ganga nahe — being the Ganga, not the Ganga; ei sakshi taya — this is the proof of it

**63.** Everyone says it is the land the Pandavas avoided;[^20-11]
[the Padma there] is the Ganga and yet not the Ganga: this is the proof of it.

আমার পরশে পদ্মাবতী হৈব ধন্য ।
সর্বলোক আমা বহি না জানিব অন্য ॥ ৬৪ ॥

*āmāra paraśe padmābatī haiba dhanya |*
*sarbaloka āmā bahi nā jāniba anya || 64 ||*

*Word for word:* amara parashe — by My touch; padmavati haiba dhanya — the Padmavati will be blessed; sarvaloka — all people; ama bahi na janiba anya — will know none but Me

**64.** By My touch the Padmavati will become blessed;
all the people will know no one but Me."

হেন যুকতি প্রভু করি অনুমানে ।
মায়েরে কহিল যাব ধন উপার্জনে ॥ ৬৫ ॥

*hena yukati prabhu kari anumāne |*
*māẏere kahila yāba dhana upārjane || 65 ||*

*Word for word:* hena yukati — such a plan; prabhu kari anumane — the Lord, considering; mayere kahila — told His mother; yaba dhana uparjane — I shall go to earn money

**65.** Having thus reasoned within Himself,
the Lord told His mother: "I shall go to earn money."

যাত্রা করি যায় প্রভু সঙ্গে নিজজন ।
ছটফট করে শচী-মায়ের পরাণ ॥ ৬৬ ॥

*yātrā kari yāẏa prabhu saṅge nijajana |*
*chaṭaphaṭa kare śacī-māẏera parāṇa || 66 ||*

*Word for word:* yatra kari yaya prabhu — the Lord sets out on the journey; sange nijajana — with His own; chhataphata kare — is tossed about; shachi-mayera parana — Mother Shachi's heart

**66.** The Lord sets out on the journey together with His own;
Mother Shachi's heart is tossed with anxiety.

কাতর হৃদয়ে শচী কহয়ে পুত্রেরে ।
শুন নিবেদন বাপু কহিয়ে তোমারে ॥ ৬৭ ॥

*kātara hṛdaẏe śacī kahaẏe putrere |*
*śuna nibedana bāpu kahiẏe tomāre || 67 ||*

*Word for word:* katara hridaye — with an aching heart; shachi kahaye putrere — Shachi says to her son; shuna nivedana bapu — hear my plea, child; kahiye tomare — I tell You

**67.** With an aching heart Shachi says to her son:
"Listen, my child, to what I tell You.

ধন উপার্জনে দূরদেশে যাবে তুমি ।
তোমা না দেখিলে কেমনে জীব আমি ॥ ৬৮ ॥

*dhana upārjane dūradeśe yābe tumi |*
*tomā nā dekhile kemane jība āmi || 68 ||*

*Word for word:* dhana uparjane — to earn money; dura-deshe yabe tumi — You will go to a distant land; toma na dekhile — not seeing You; kemane jiba ami — how shall I live

**68.** You are going to a distant land to earn money —
how shall I live without seeing You?

জল বিনু যেন মীন না ধরে পরাণ ।
তোমা বিনু আমার তেমন সমাধান ॥ ৬৯ ॥

*jala binu yena mīna nā dhare parāṇa |*
*tomā binu āmāra temana samādhāna || 69 ||*

*Word for word:* jala vinu — without water; yena mina — as a fish; na dhare parana — cannot keep its life; toma vinu amara — without You for me; temana samadhana — so it will be

**69.** As a fish without water cannot live,
so it is with me without You.

তোমার মুখচন্দ্র মনেতে ভাবিয়া ।
মরি যাব বাপ হের তোমা না দেখিয়া ॥ ৭০ ॥

*tomāra mukhacandra manete bhābiẏā |*
*mari yāba bāpa hera tomā nā dekhiẏā || 70 ||*

*Word for word:* tomara mukha-chandra — Your moonlike face; manete bhaviya — thinking of; mari yaba bapa hera — I shall die, my child; toma na dekhiya — not seeing You

**70.** Thinking of Your moonlike face,
I shall die, my child, not seeing You."

মায়ের বচন শুনি প্রভু দামোদর ।
বিনয় করিয়া কৈল প্রবোধ-উত্তর ॥ ৭১ ॥

*māẏera bacana śuni prabhu dāmodara |*
*binaẏa kariẏā kaila prabodha-uttara || 71 ||*

*Word for word:* mayera bachana shuni — hearing His mother's words; prabhu damodara — Lord Damodara; vinaya kariya — humbly; kaila prabodha-uttara — gave a consoling answer

**71.** Hearing His mother's words, Lord Damodara[^20-12]
humbly answered her, consoling her:

আমার বিচ্ছেদে ডর না ভাবিহ তুমি ।
নিকটে তোমার ঠাঞি আসিব যে আমি ॥ ৭২ ॥

*āmāra bicchede ḍara nā bhābiha tumi |*
*nikaṭe tomāra ṭhāñi āsiba ye āmi || 72 ||*

*Word for word:* amara vichchhede — of separation from Me; dara na bhaviha tumi — do not fear; nikate — soon; tomara thani asiba ye ami — I shall come back to you

**72.** "Do not fear separation from Me:
I shall soon come back to you."

লক্ষ্মীরে কহিল প্রভু হাসিয়া উত্তর ।
মাতার সেবায় তুমি হইবে তৎপর ॥ ৭৩ ॥

*lakṣmīre kahila prabhu hāsiẏā uttara |*
*mātāra sebāẏa tumi haibe tatpara || 73 ||*

*Word for word:* lakshmire kahila prabhu — to Lakshmi the Lord said; hasiya uttara — smiling in reply; matara sevaya — in serving My mother; tumi haibe tatpara — be diligent

**73.** To Lakshmi the Lord said with a smile:
"Be diligent in serving My mother."

মায়ে যত কৈল কিছু না শুনিল পহুঁ ।
শুভযাত্রা করি যায় হাসি লহু লহু ॥ ৭৪ ॥

*māẏe yata kaila kichu nā śunila pahuṁ |*
*śubhayātrā kari yāẏa hāsi lahu lahu || 74 ||*

*Word for word:* maye yata kaila — whatever His mother said; kichhu na shunila pahun — the Lord heeded nothing; shubha-yatra kari — setting out auspiciously; yaya hasi lahu lahu — goes softly smiling

**74.** Whatever His mother said, the Lord paid no heed:
setting out on the auspicious journey, He goes, softly smiling.

চলিল সে মহাপ্রভু সঙ্গে নিজজন ।
কৌতুকে ভ্রময়ে প্রভু আনন্দিত মন ॥ ৭৫ ॥

*calila se mahāprabhu saṅge nijajana |*
*kautuke bhramaẏe prabhu ānandita mana || 75 ||*

*Word for word:* chalila se mahaprabhu — Mahaprabhu set out; sange nijajana — with His own; kautuke bhramaye prabhu — the Lord travels merrily; anandita mana — with a joyful heart

**75.** Mahaprabhu set out with His companions
and travels about, merry, with a joyful heart.

যেখানে সেখানে যায় প্রভু বিশ্বম্ভর ।
দেখি সেখানের লোক হয়ে ত ফাঁফর ॥ ৭৬ ॥

*yekhāne sekhāne yāẏa prabhu biśbambhara |*
*dekhi sekhānera loka haẏe ta phāṁphara || 76 ||*

*Word for word:* yekhane sekhane yaya — wherever goes; prabhu vishvambhara — Lord Vishvambhara; dekhi sekhanera loka — the people there, seeing [Him]; haye ta phaphara — are bewildered

**76.** Wherever Lord Vishvambhara went,
the people there, seeing Him, lost their heads.

সে রূপ দেখিতে কারো না লেউটে আঁখি ।
কেহ বোলে এই রূপ অহর্নিশি দেখি ॥ ৭৭ ॥

*se rūpa dekhite kāro nā leuṭe āṁkhi |*
*keha bole ei rūpa aharniśi dekhi || 77 ||*

*Word for word:* se rupa dekhite — seeing that beauty; karo na leute ankhi — no one's eyes turn away; keha bole — some say; ei rupa aharnishi dekhi — may we see this beauty day and night

**77.** Seeing His beauty, no one can take their eyes away;
some say: "If only we could see this beauty day and night!"

পুরনারীগণ বোলে দেখিয়া বদন ।
সফল জনম আজি সফল নয়ন ॥ ৭৮ ॥

*puranārīgaṇa bole dekhiẏā badana |*
*saphala janama āji saphala naẏana || 78 ||*

*Word for word:* puranarigana bole — the townswomen say; dekhiya badana — seeing His face; saphala janama aji — today our birth is fruitful; saphala nayana — our eyes are fruitful

**78.** The women, seeing His face, say:
"Today our birth is fruitful, our eyes are fruitful!

কোন্ ভাগ্যবতী মায়ে ধরিল উদরে ।
কভু নাহি দেখি হেন সুন্দর শরীরে ॥ ৭৯ ॥

*kon bhāgyabatī māẏe dharila udare |*
*kabhu nāhi dekhi hena sundara śarīre || 79 ||*

*Word for word:* kon bhagyavati maye — what fortunate mother; dharila udare — bore in her womb; kabhu nahi dekhi — never have we seen; hena sundara sharire — so beautiful a body

**79.** What fortunate mother bore Him in her womb?
Never have we seen so beautiful a body!

হরগৌরী আরাধিল কোন্ ভাগ্যবতী ।
হেন রূপে হেন গুণে মিলিয়াছে পতি ॥ ৮০ ॥

*haragaurī ārādhila kon bhāgyabatī |*
*hena rūpe hena guṇe miliẏāche pati || 80 ||*

*Word for word:* hara-gauri aradhila — worshipped Hara and Gauri; kon bhagyavati — what fortunate woman; hena rupe hena gune — of such beauty, such virtues; miliyachhe pati — has gained a husband

**80.** What fortunate woman, having worshipped Hara and Gauri,
has gained a husband of such beauty, such virtues?

নবীন-কাঞ্চন জিনি অঙ্গের কিরণ ।
সুমেরু-পর্বত জিনি দেহের গঠন ॥ ৮১ ॥

*nabīna-kāñcana jini aṅgera kiraṇa |*
*sumeru-parbata jini dehera gaṭhana || 81 ||*

*Word for word:* navina-kanchana jini — surpassing new gold; angera kirana — the radiance of the body; sumeru-parvata jini — surpassing Mount Sumeru; dehera gathana — the build of the body

**81.** The radiance of His body surpasses new gold,
the build of His body Mount Sumeru.

সহজ-রূপের নাহি ভুবনে তুলনা ।
যজ্ঞসূত্র অতিশয় তাহাতে শোভনা ॥ ৮২ ॥

*sahaja-rūpera nāhi bhubane tulanā |*
*yajñasūtra atiśaẏa tāhāte śobhanā || 82 ||*

*Word for word:* sahaja-rupera — of the natural beauty; nahi bhuvane tulana — no equal in the world; yajna-sutra — the sacred thread; atishaya tahate shobhana — is exceedingly lovely on it

**82.** His natural beauty has no equal in the world,
and the sacred thread makes it lovelier still.

মরি যাই হেরিয়া সুন্দর মুখের হাসি ।
প্রেমবতী-হৃদয়ে রহল তেঞো পশি ॥ ৮৩ ॥

*mari yāi heriẏā sundara mukhera hāsi |*
*premabatī-hṛdaẏe rahala teño paśi || 83 ||*

*Word for word:* mari yai heriya — one could die seeing; sundara mukhera hasi — the smile on the beautiful face; premavati-hridaye — in the hearts of loving women; rahala teno pashi — He entered and remained

**83.** One could die seeing the smile on His beautiful face!"
He entered and remained in the hearts of the loving women.

কোন্ ভাগ্যবতী কৃষ্ণের রসতত্ত্ব-জ্ঞাতা ।
অনুমানি কহে সেই নির্যাস-বারতা ॥ ৮৪ ॥

*kon bhāgyabatī kṛṣṇera rasatattba-jñātā |*
*anumāni kahe sei niryāsa-bāratā || 84 ||*

*Word for word:* kon bhagyavati — a fortunate woman; krishnera rasa-tattva-jnata — knowing the truth of Krishna's rasa; anumani kahe — guessing, speaks; sei niryasa-barata — the very essence

**84.** One fortunate woman who knew the truth of Krishna's rasa,
guessing, spoke the very essence:[^20-13]

দীঘল সুন্দর আঁখি পুণ্ডরীক জিনি ।
অপরূপ তাহে চারু সুতরল চাহনি ॥ ৮৫ ॥

*dīghala sundara āṁkhi puṇḍarīka jini |*
*aparūpa tāhe cāru sutarala cāhani || 85 ||*

*Word for word:* dighala sundara ankhi — long beautiful eyes; pundarika jini — surpassing lotuses; aparupa tahe — and in them a wondrous; charu sutarala chahani — lovely tremulous glance

**85.** "Long, beautiful eyes surpassing lotuses,
and in them a wondrous, lovely, tremulous glance.

দেখি যেন রাধার বল্লভ হেন ঠাম ।
রাধার বরণ অঙ্গ দেখি বিদ্যমান ॥ ৮৬ ॥

*dekhi yena rādhāra ballabha hena ṭhāma |*
*rādhāra baraṇa aṅga dekhi bidyamāna || 86 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhi yena — it seems to me; radhara vallabha — Radha's Beloved; hena thama — in such a form; radhara barana anga — a body of Radha's complexion; dekhi vidyamana — I see before me

**86.** It seems to me this is Radha's Beloved in such a form —
I see before me a body of Radha's complexion."[^20-14]

সকল যুবতী মেলি কহিতে লাগিলা ।
শুনি বিশ্বম্ভর প্রভু উলটি চলিলা ॥ ৮৬+১ ॥

*sakala yubatī meli kahite lāgilā |*
*śuni biśbambhara prabhu ulaṭi calilā || 86+1 ||*

*Word for word:* sakala yuvati meli — all the young women together; kahite lagila — began to speak; shuni — hearing; vishvambhara prabhu — Lord Vishvambhara; ulati chalila — turned back

**86+1.** Thus all the young women spoke together;
hearing them, Lord Vishvambhara turned back.[^20-15]

সরস নয়ানে প্রভু চাহিলা সবারে ।
প্রেমে গরগর তারা আপনা পাসরে ॥ ৮৬+২ ॥

*sarasa naẏāne prabhu cāhilā sabāre |*
*preme garagara tārā āpanā pāsare || 86+2 ||*

*Word for word:* sarasa nayane — with eyes full of rasa; prabhu chahila sabare — the Lord looked at all; preme garagara — overwhelmed with prema; tara apana pasare — they forget themselves

**86+2.** With eyes full of rasa the Lord looked at them all,
and they, overwhelmed with prema, forgot themselves.

পদ্মাবতী-স্নান কৈল যে আছিল বিধি ।
চরণ-পরশে গঙ্গাসম ভেল নদী ॥ ৮৭ ॥

*padmābatī-snāna kaila ye āchila bidhi |*
*caraṇa-paraśe gaṅgāsama bhela nadī || 87 ||*

*Word for word:* padmavati-snana kaila — bathed in the Padmavati; ye achhila vidhi — as prescribed; charana-parashe — by the touch of His feet; ganga-sama bhela nadi — the river became like the Ganga

**87.** [The Lord] bathed in the Padmavati as prescribed:
by the touch of His feet the river became like the Ganga.

পদ্মাবতী মহাবেগা পুলিন-সংযুতা ।
কুম্ভীর-কচ্ছপ-মীনে অতি সুশোভিতা ॥ ৮৮ ॥

*padmābatī mahābegā pulina-saṃyutā |*
*kumbhīra-kacchapa-mīne ati suśobhitā || 88 ||*

*Word for word:* padmavati mahavega — the swift Padmavati; pulina-samyuta — with sandbanks; kumbhira-kachchhapa-mine — with crocodiles, tortoises, fish; ati sushobhita — very beautiful

**88.** The swift Padmavati with her sandbanks
is beautiful with crocodiles, tortoises and fish.

ব্রাহ্মণ-সজ্জন সব বৈসে তার তটে ।
দিব্য পুরুষ-নারী স্নান করে ঘাটে ॥ ৮৯ ॥

*brāhmaṇa-sajjana saba baise tāra taṭe |*
*dibya puruṣa-nārī snāna kare ghāṭe || 89 ||*

*Word for word:* brahmana-sajjana saba — all brahmanas and good people; baise tara tate — live on her banks; divya purusha-nari — noble men and women; snana kare ghate — bathe at the ghats

**89.** On her banks live brahmanas and good people;
noble men and women bathe at her ghats.

বিশ্বম্ভর-স্নানে পূতা ভেল পদ্মাবতী ।
সর্বলোক-পাপ হরে স্নান করি তথি ॥ ৯০ ॥

*biśbambhara-snāne pūtā bhela padmābatī |*
*sarbaloka-pāpa hare snāna kari tathi || 90 ||*

*Word for word:* vishvambhara-snane — by Vishvambhara's bath; puta bhela padmavati — the Padmavati was purified; sarvaloka-papa hare — takes away the sins of all; snana kari tathi — who bathe in her

**90.** By Vishvambhara's bath the Padmavati was purified:
she takes away the sins of all who bathe in her.

প্রেমভক্তি হয় কৃষ্ণ-চরণারবিন্দে ।
স্নান করে কভু যদি বৈষ্ণব না নিন্দে ॥ ৯১ ॥

*premabhakti haẏa kṛṣṇa-caraṇārabinde |*
*snāna kare kabhu yadi baiṣṇaba nā ninde || 91 ||*

*Word for word:* prema-bhakti haya — prema-bhakti arises; krishna-charanaravinde — for Krishna's lotus feet; snana kare — [in one who] bathes; kabhu yadi vaishnava na ninde — if only he never blasphemes the Vaishnavas

**91.** Prema-bhakti for Krishna's lotus feet arises
in whoever bathes in her, if only he does not blaspheme the Vaishnavas.

সেই পদ্মাবতী-তটবাসী যত জন ।
গৌরচন্দ্র দেখি শ্লাঘ্য করিল নয়ন ॥ ৯২ ॥

*sei padmābatī-taṭabāsī yata jana |*
*gauracandra dekhi ślāghya karila naẏana || 92 ||*

*Word for word:* sei padmavati-tata-basi — dwelling on the banks of the Padmavati; yata jana — all the people; gaurachandra dekhi — seeing Gaurachandra; shlaghya karila nayana — made their eyes blessed

**92.** All who lived on the banks of the Padmavati,
seeing Gaurachandra, made their eyes blessed.

সেই পদ্মাবতী-তীরে ভ্রমে গৌরহরি ।
সে দেশ ভকত হৈল শ্রীচরণ ধরি ॥ ৯৩ ॥

*sei padmābatī-tīre bhrame gaurahari |*
*se deśa bhakata haila śrīcaraṇa dhari || 93 ||*

*Word for word:* sei padmavati-tire — on the banks of the Padmavati; bhrame gaurahari — Gaurahari wanders; se desha bhakata haila — that land became devoted; shri-charana dhari — clasping His feet

**93.** Gaurahari wanders along the banks of the Padmavati;
that land, clasping His feet, became devoted.

শীতল চরণ পাঞা ধরণী শীতল ।
পুলকিত হৈলা দেবী গেল অমঙ্গল ॥ ৯৪ ॥

*śītala caraṇa pāñā dharaṇī śītala |*
*pulakita hailā debī gela amaṅgala || 94 ||*

*Word for word:* shitala charana pana — receiving the cool feet; dharani shitala — the earth became cool; pulakita haila devi — the goddess thrilled; gela amangala — the inauspicious departed

**94.** Receiving His cool feet, the earth became cool;
the goddess thrilled with joy — all that was inauspicious departed.

সে দেশ তারিল আগে বহু যত্ন করি ।
পাণ্ডব-বর্জিত দেশ দূর কৈল হরি ॥ ৯৫ ॥

*se deśa tārila āge bahu yatna kari |*
*pāṇḍaba-barjita deśa dūra kaila hari || 95 ||*

*Word for word:* se desha tarila age — first He delivered that land; bahu yatna kari — with great care; pandava-varjita desha — [the name] "land the Pandavas avoided"; dura kaila hari — Hari removed

**95.** Hari first of all delivered that land with great care:
He removed [the stigma] of the land the Pandavas avoided.

চণ্ডাল পতিত কিবা সজ্জন দুর্জন ।
সভারে যাচিয়া প্রভু দিল হরিনাম ॥ ৯৬ ॥

*caṇḍāla patita kibā sajjana durjana |*
*sabhāre yāciẏā prabhu dila harināma || 96 ||*

*Word for word:* chandala patita — chandalas, the fallen; kiva sajjana durjana — good or wicked; sabhare yachiya — entreating all; prabhu dila hari-nama — the Lord gave the name of Hari

**96.** Chandalas and the fallen, the good and the wicked —
the Lord, Himself entreating them, gave all the name of Hari.

শুচি বা অশুচি কিবা আচার বিচার ।
না মানিল সভারে করিল ভবপার ॥ ৯৭ ॥

*śuci bā aśuci kibā ācāra bicāra |*
*nā mānila sabhāre karila bhabapāra || 97 ||*

*Word for word:* shuchi va ashuchi — clean or unclean; kiva achara vichara — what customs, what rules; na manila — He did not regard; sabhare karila bhava-para — carried all across the ocean of existence

**97.** Clean or unclean, what customs, what rules —
He did not regard them and carried all across the ocean of existence.

নাম-সংকীর্তন প্রভু নৌকা সাজাইয়া ।
পার কৈল সব জীবে আপনি যাচিয়া ॥ ৯৮ ॥

*nāma-saṃkīrtana prabhu naukā sājāiẏā |*
*pāra kaila saba jībe āpani yāciẏā || 98 ||*

*Word for word:* nama-sankirtana — of the sankirtana of the name; prabhu nauka sajaiya — the Lord, fitting out the boat; para kaila saba jive — carried all souls across; apani yachiya — Himself entreating

**98.** Fitting out the boat of the sankirtana of the name,
the Lord, Himself entreating, carried all souls across.

যে জন পলায় তারে ধরি কোলে করি ।
কাণ্ডারীর রূপে পার করে গৌরহরি ॥ ৯৯ ॥

*ye jana palāẏa tāre dhari kole kari |*
*kāṇḍārīra rūpe pāra kare gaurahari || 99 ||*

*Word for word:* ye jana palaya — whoever runs away; tare dhari kole kari — catching and embracing him; kandarira rupe — as the helmsman; para kare gaurahari — Gaurahari carries across

**99.** And whoever runs away — Gaurahari catches and embraces him
and, as the helmsman, carries him to the other shore.

এহেন করুণা নাহি শুনি কোন যুগে ।
কোন্ অবতারে কোথা কে বা পাপ মাগে ॥ ১০০ ॥

*ehena karuṇā nāhi śuni kona yuge |*
*kon abatāre kothā ke bā pāpa māge || 100 ||*

*Word for word:* ehena karuna — such mercy; nahi shuni kona yuge — is not heard of in any age; kon avatare kotha — in what avatara, where; ke va papa mage — who begged for sins

**100.** Never, in any age, has such mercy been heard of:
in what avatara, where, did anyone beg for sins?[^20-16]

সভারে পবিত্র কৈল সম-ভাব করি ।
রাধাকৃষ্ণ-প্রেমের করিল অধিকারী ॥ ১০১ ॥

*sabhāre pabitra kaila sama-bhāba kari |*
*rādhākṛṣṇa-premera karila adhikārī || 101 ||*

*Word for word:* sabhare pavitra kaila — purified all; sama-bhava kari — being equally disposed; radha-krishna-premera — of prema for Radha and Krishna; karila adhikari — made them fit

**101.** He purified all, equally disposed towards all,
and made them fit for prema for Radha and Krishna.

বিদ্যাদান কৈল প্রভু অশেষ-বিশেষে ।
পণ্ডিত হইল সভে দিন পক্ষ মাসে ॥ ১০২ ॥

*bidyādāna kaila prabhu aśeṣa-biśeṣe |*
*paṇḍita haila sabhe dina pakṣa māse || 102 ||*

*Word for word:* vidya-dana kaila prabhu — the Lord gave knowledge; ashesha-visheshe — endlessly and generously; pandita haila sabhe — all became pandits; dina paksha mase — in days, fortnights, months
