**102.** The Lord gave knowledge generously, without end:
all became pandits in days, fortnights, months.

দয়ার সাগর প্রভু সর্বলোকপতি ।
করুণা প্রকাশি লোকে শুদ্ধ কৈল মতি ॥ ১০৩ ॥

*daẏāra sāgara prabhu sarbalokapati |*
*karuṇā prakāśi loke śuddha kaila mati || 103 ||*

*Word for word:* dayara sagara prabhu — the Lord, ocean of mercy; sarvaloka-pati — master of all worlds; karuna prakashi — revealing mercy; loke shuddha kaila mati — purified people's minds

**103.** The Lord, the ocean of mercy, master of all the worlds,
revealing His mercy, purified people's minds.

এইমতে আছে প্রভু সজ্জন-সমাজে ।
এথা লক্ষ্মী শচীদেবী নবদ্বীপে আছে ॥ ১০৪ ॥

*eimate āche prabhu sajjana-samāje |*
*ethā lakṣmī śacīdebī nabadbīpe āche || 104 ||*

*Word for word:* eimate achhe prabhu — thus the Lord stays; sajjana-samaje — in the company of good people; etha — here; lakshmi shachidevi — Lakshmi and Shachi-devi; navadvipe achhe — are in Navadvipa

**104.** Thus the Lord stays in the company of good people,
while here in Navadvipa are Lakshmi and Shachi-devi.

পতিব্রতা লক্ষ্মীদেবী পতিগত-প্রাণ ।
আনন্দে শচীর সেবা করয়ে বিধান ॥ ১০৫ ॥

*patibratā lakṣmīdebī patigata-prāṇa |*
*ānande śacīra sebā karaẏe bidhāna || 105 ||*

*Word for word:* pativrata lakshmidevi — faithful Lakshmi-devi; patigata-prana — whose life is her husband; anande — joyfully; shachira seva karaye vidhana — serves Shachi as is proper

**105.** Faithful Lakshmi-devi, for whom her husband is her very life,
serves Shachi joyfully, as is proper.

দেবতার সজ্জ করে গৃহ-সম্মার্জন ।
ধূপ দীপ নৈবেদ্য গন্ধ মাল্য চন্দন ॥ ১০৬ ॥

*debatāra sajja kare gṛha-sammārjana |*
*dhūpa dīpa naibedya gandha mālya candana || 106 ||*

*Word for word:* devatara sajja kare — prepares [the room] of the Deities; griha-sammarjana — sweeps and cleans the house; dhupa dipa naivedya — incense, lamps, offerings; gandha malya chandana — scents, garlands, sandal

**106.** She tidies the Deities' room, sweeps and cleans the house,
[prepares] incense, lamps, offerings, scents, garlands and sandal.

সকল সংস্করি দেই দেবতার ঘরে ।
বধূর শীলতায় শচী আপনা পাশরে ॥ ১০৭ ॥

*sakala saṃskari dei debatāra ghare |*
*badhūra śīlatāẏa śacī āpanā pāśare || 107 ||*

*Word for word:* sakala samskari — preparing everything; dei devatara ghare — places it in the Deities' room; badhura shilataya — by the daughter-in-law's good nature; shachi apana pashare — Shachi forgets herself

**107.** Having prepared everything, she takes it to the Deities' room;
her daughter-in-law's good nature makes Shachi forget herself.

বশ ভেল শচীদেবী বধূর চরিতে ।
পুলকিত বধূ শচীমাতার পিরীতে ॥ ১০৮ ॥

*baśa bhela śacīdebī badhūra carite |*
*pulakita badhū śacīmātāra pirīte || 108 ||*

*Word for word:* basha bhela shachidevi — Shachi-devi was won over; badhura charite — by her daughter-in-law's conduct; pulakita badhu — the daughter-in-law thrills; shachi-matara pirite — at Mother Shachi's love

**108.** Shachi-devi is won over by her daughter-in-law's conduct,
and the daughter-in-law thrills with joy at Mother Shachi's love.

[^20-1]: The end of the summary (on the journey to East Bengal and Lakshmi's departure) is almost illegible in the scan of the edition; it is translated from the surviving words, and gaps are marked […].
[^20-2]: The name of the raga is illegible in the scan of A; raga shri follows the 1903 edition (the 1983 edition has pathamanjari). In the 1983 edition this section is the "Fifth Chapter".
[^20-3]: Vv. 14+1 – 14+2 are found only in the 1983 edition (absent from Bhaktisiddhanta's edition); the 1903 edition does not have them.
[^20-4]: Vv. 22+1 – 22+5 are found only in the 1983 edition (absent from Bhaktisiddhanta's edition); the 1903 edition gives vv. 22+1 – 22+2 in a footnote as the additional reading of one manuscript, and does not have vv. 22+3 – 22+5.
[^20-5]: Thakura ("master") — here the Lord Himself.
[^20-6]: Mahesha — Shiva; Lochana Dasa respectfully calls him, like Narada, "Thakura".
[^20-7]: Shabda-brahman — Brahman as sound, transcendental sound.
[^20-8]: This is the Puranic story of how Vishnu melted on hearing Shiva's song, and so the Ganga was born. The Lord's body is spiritual, and His "melting" is a manifestation of His love for His devotees' singing, not any loss to Him: Bhaktisiddhanta in his summary understands it as the perspiration that appeared on the Lord's body in ecstasy at the kirtana about Him — that moisture is the Ganga.
[^20-9]: I.e. the Ganga is the Lord Himself (Janardana) in the form of sacred water.
[^20-10]: When the Lord as Vamana-Trivikrama strode upward, the nail of His foot pierced the shell of the universe, and the waters of the Causal Ocean — the Ganga — poured in; Brahma washed that foot (Bhagavata 5.17.1, 8.21.1–4). Cf. en/19, vv. 119–120.
[^20-11]: East Bengal was traditionally "the land the Pandavas avoided" (pandava-varjita): in their wanderings the Pandavas did not visit it, and it was held to be impure. The river Padma (Padmavati) is a branch of the Ganga, but the Ganga's sanctity was not acknowledged for it: "the Ganga and yet not the Ganga".
[^20-12]: Damodara — a name of Krishna; cf. v. 86.
[^20-13]: Here (vv. 76–86, 86+1 – 86+2) is again Lochana Dasa's motif of nagari-bhava (see en/09, note 9); cf. Murari 1.11.6–10.
[^20-14]: I.e. Gaura is Krishna Himself, Radha's Beloved, who has taken on Radha's complexion and mood; so too the Gaudiya Vaishnava tradition understands Him (cf. Chaitanya-charitamrita, Adi 1.5).
[^20-15]: Vv. 86+1 – 86+2 are found only in the 1983 edition (absent from Bhaktisiddhanta's edition); the 1903 edition has them, without brackets.
[^20-16]: I.e. the Lord Himself begged people to give Him their sins and take the name of Hari.

---

# Adi-khanda, part 13 (portion 21)

*The end of the Banga-vijaya: the serpent of separation bites Lakshmi, and she departs from this world; Shachi's lament; the Lord returns from East Bengal and consoles His mother with the story of the cursed apsara. The beginning of the second wedding: Shachi seeks the daughter of Sanatana Pandita for her son; the Lord's jest with the astrologer and Sanatana's grief; the Lord dispels his grief*

*Raga vibhasa*

এইমতে আছে শচী লক্ষ্মীর সহিত ।
দৈবের নির্বন্ধ তাহা না যায় খণ্ডিত ॥ ১০৯ ॥

*eimate āche śacī lakṣmīra sahita |*
*daibera nirbandha tāhā nā yāẏa khaṇḍita || 109 ||*

*Word for word:* eimate achhe shachi — thus Shachi lived; lakshmira sahita — with Lakshmi; daivera nirbandha — what destiny ordains; taha na yaya khandita — that cannot be undone

**109.** Thus Shachi lived together with Lakshmi;
but what destiny has ordained cannot be undone.

প্রভু না দেখিয়া লক্ষ্মী কাতর-অন্তর ।
প্রভুর বিরহ তার স্ফুরে নিরন্তর ॥ ১১০ ॥

*prabhu nā dekhiẏā lakṣmī kātara-antara |*
*prabhura biraha tāra sphure nirantara || 110 ||*

*Word for word:* prabhu na dekhiya — not seeing the Lord; lakshmi katara-antara — Lakshmi is sick at heart; prabhura viraha — separation from the Lord; tara sphure nirantara — is ever present in her

**110.** Not seeing the Lord, Lakshmi pined at heart:
separation from the Lord was ever present within her.

বিরহ হৈল মূর্তি সর্পের আকার ।
লক্ষ্মী ঠাকুরাণী তাহা জানিল অন্তর ॥ ১১১ ॥

*biraha haila mūrti sarpera ākāra |*
*lakṣmī ṭhākurāṇī tāhā jānila antara || 111 ||*

*Word for word:* viraha haila murti — separation took form; sarpera akara — in the shape of a serpent; lakshmi thakurani — Lakshmi Thakurani; taha janila antara — knew it in her heart

**111.** Separation took the form of a serpent —
Lakshmi Thakurani knew it in her heart.[^21-1]

দংশিলেক মহাসর্প লক্ষ্মীর চরণে ।
অস্তব্যস্ত হইয়া শচী গুণে মনে মনে ॥ ১১২ ॥

*daṃśileka mahāsarpa lakṣmīra caraṇe |*
*astabyasta haiẏā śacī guṇe mane mane || 112 ||*

*Word for word:* damshileka maha-sarpa — a huge serpent bit; lakshmira charane — Lakshmi on the foot; astavyasta haiya shachi — Shachi, in dismay; gune mane mane — ponders within

**112.** A huge serpent bit Lakshmi on the foot;
in dismay Shachi ponders within herself.

দংশন-জ্বালায় লক্ষ্মী করে ছটফট ।
দেখি শচীদেবী পাইল পরম সঙ্কট ॥ ১১৩ ॥

*daṃśana-jbālāẏa lakṣmī kare chaṭaphaṭa |*
*dekhi śacīdebī pāila parama saṅkaṭa || 113 ||*

*Word for word:* damshana-jvalaya — from the burning of the bite; lakshmi kare chhataphata — Lakshmi writhes; dekhi shachidevi — seeing this, Shachi-devi; paila parama sankata — fell into great distress

**113.** From the burning pain of the bite Lakshmi writhes;
seeing this, Shachi-devi fell into great distress.

ডাকিয়া আনিল ওঝা জানে নানা মন্ত্র ।
জিজ্ঞাসা করিল নানা ঔষধের তন্ত্র ॥ ১১৪ ॥

*ḍākiẏā ānila ojhā jāne nānā mantra |*
*jijñāsā karila nānā auṣadhera tantra || 114 ||*

*Word for word:* dakiya anila ojha — she called a snake-charmer; jane nana mantra — who knows many mantras; jijnasa karila — inquired; nana aushadhera tantra — about many remedies

**114.** She called a snake-charmer who knew many mantras
and inquired about many remedies.

অনেক যতন কৈল না লেউটে বিষ ।
বড় ভয় পাইলা শচী হইল বিমরিষ ॥ ১১৫ ॥

*aneka yatana kaila nā leuṭe biṣa |*
*baṛa bhaẏa pāilā śacī haila bimariṣa || 115 ||*

*Word for word:* aneka yatana kaila — they tried hard; na leute visha — the poison does not recede; bada bhaya paila shachi — Shachi was greatly afraid; haila vimarisha — fell into despair

**115.** They tried hard, but the poison does not recede;
Shachi was greatly afraid and fell into despair.

প্রাপ্তিকাল দেখি সভে ছাড়িল যতন ।
গঙ্গাজলে নামাইল শ্রীহরি-স্মরণ ॥ ১১৬ ॥

*prāptikāla dekhi sabhe chāṛila yatana |*
*gaṅgājale nāmāila śrīhari-smaraṇa || 116 ||*

*Word for word:* prapti-kala dekhi — seeing that her time had come; sabhe chhadila yatana — all gave up their efforts; ganga-jale namaila — they brought her down into the Ganga water; shrihari-smarana — remembering Sri Hari

**116.** Seeing that her time had come, all gave up their efforts
and, remembering Sri Hari, carried her into the waters of the Ganga.

গলায় তুলিয়া দিল তুলসীর দাম ।
চৌদিগে সকল লোক লয় হরিনাম ॥ ১১৭ ॥

*galāẏa tuliẏā dila tulasīra dāma |*
*caudige sakala loka laẏa harināma || 117 ||*

*Word for word:* galaya tuliya dila — placed round her neck; tulasira dama — a garland of tulasi; chaudige sakala loka — on all sides all the people; laya hari-nama — chant the name of Hari

**117.** They placed a garland of tulasi round her neck;
on all sides all the people chant the name of Hari.

লক্ষ্মী গেলা প্রভু-স্থানে না জানিল লোক ।
পরম অদ্ভুত সভে দেখে পরতেখ ॥ ১১৮ ॥

*lakṣmī gelā prabhu-sthāne nā jānila loka |*
*parama adbhuta sabhe dekhe paratekha || 118 ||*

*Word for word:* lakshmi gela prabhu-sthane — Lakshmi went to the Lord's place; na janila loka — people did not know; parama adbhuta — a supreme wonder; sabhe dekhe paratekha — all see with their own eyes

**118.** Lakshmi went to the Lord — the people did not understand it,
but all beheld with their own eyes a supreme wonder:

আকাশের পথে রথ আনিল গন্ধর্ব ।
হরি বলি দেহ ছাড়ি লক্ষ্মী গেলা স্বর্গ ॥ ১১৯ ॥

*ākāśera pathe ratha ānila gandharba |*
*hari bali deha chāṛi lakṣmī gelā sbarga || 119 ||*

*Word for word:* akashera pathe — along the path of the sky; ratha anila gandharva — the gandharvas brought a chariot; hari bali — saying "Hari"; deha chhadi — leaving the body; lakshmi gela svarga — Lakshmi went to heaven

**119.** the gandharvas brought a chariot along the path of the sky,
and Lakshmi, saying "Hari", left her body and went to heaven.

লক্ষ্মী-অংশ কোন শক্তি বৈকুণ্ঠ চলিল ।
দেখিয়া সকল লোক পরম বিহ্বল ॥ ১২০ ॥

*lakṣmī-aṃśa kona śakti baikuṇṭha calila |*
*dekhiẏā sakala loka parama bihbala || 120 ||*

*Word for word:* lakshmi-amsha — a portion of Lakshmi; kona shakti — a certain shakti; vaikuntha chalila — went to Vaikuntha; dekhiya sakala loka — seeing this, all the people; parama vihvala — were overwhelmed

**120.** A certain shakti, a portion of Lakshmi, went to Vaikuntha;
seeing this, all the people were overwhelmed.

ইন্দ্রপুরী গেলা লক্ষ্মী আপন আলয় ।
পরম লখিমী-দ্যুতি সর্ব লক্ষ্মীময় ॥ ১২১ ॥

*indrapurī gelā lakṣmī āpana ālaẏa |*
*parama lakhimī-dyuti sarba lakṣmīmaẏa || 121 ||*

*Word for word:* indrapuri gela lakshmi — Lakshmi went to Indra's city; apana alaya — her own abode; parama lakhimi-dyuti — with the supreme radiance of Lakshmi; sarva lakshmi-maya — wholly Lakshmi

**121.** Lakshmi went to Indra's city, her own abode,[^21-2]
shining with the supreme radiance of Lakshmi, wholly Lakshmi.

তবে শচীদেবী এথা কান্দয়ে দুঃখিতা ।
গুণ বিনাইয়া কান্দে স্ত্রীগণ-বেষ্টিতা ॥ ১২২ ॥

*tabe śacīdebī ethā kāndaẏe duḥkhitā |*
*guṇa bināiẏā kānde strīgaṇa-beṣṭitā || 122 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe shachidevi etha — then here Shachi-devi; kandaye duhkhita — weeps in grief; guna vinaiya kande — weeps recounting the virtues; strigana-veshtita — surrounded by women

**122.** Meanwhile here Shachi-devi weeps in grief;
surrounded by the women, she weeps, recounting [her daughter-in-law's] virtues.

নয়নে গলয়ে জল ভিজে হিয়াবাস ।
শিরে কর হানি ছাড়ে তপত নিঃশ্বাস ॥ ১২৩ ॥

*naẏane galaẏe jala bhije hiẏābāsa |*
*śire kara hāni chāṛe tapata niḥśbāsa || 123 ||*

*Word for word:* nayane galaye jala — tears stream from her eyes; bhije hiya-basa — the cloth on her breast is soaked; shire kara hani — striking her head with her hand; chhade tapata nihshvasa — heaves hot sighs

**123.** Tears stream from her eyes, the cloth on her breast is soaked;
striking her head, she heaves hot, heavy sighs:

সর্বগুণে শীলে বধূ লক্ষ্মী লক্ষ্মীসমা ।
নদীয়া-নগরে নাহি দিবারে উপমা ॥ ১২৪ ॥

*sarbaguṇe śīle badhū lakṣmī lakṣmīsamā |*
*nadīẏā-nagare nāhi dibāre upamā || 124 ||*

*Word for word:* sarva-gune shile — in every virtue and in nature; badhu lakshmi — my daughter-in-law Lakshmi; lakshmi-sama — was like Lakshmi; nadiya-nagare — in the town of Nadia; nahi dibare upama — there is no comparison

**124.** "My daughter-in-law Lakshmi was like Lakshmi in every virtue and in nature;
in all Nadia there is none to compare with her.

কেমনে ঘরেরে যাব একেশ্বরী আমি ।
কিলাগিয়া মোরে দয়া পাশরিলে তুমি ॥ ১২৫ ॥

*kemane gharere yāba ekeśbarī āmi |*
*kilāgiẏā more daẏā pāśarile tumi || 125 ||*

*Word for word:* kemane gharere yaba — how shall I go home; ekeshvari ami — I alone; kilagiya — why; more daya pasharile tumi — have you forgotten your love for me

**125.** How shall I go home alone?
Why have you forgotten your love for me?

দেব-আরাধন-সজ্জ থাকিল পড়িয়া ।
আমার শুশ্রূষা কেনে গেলা ত ছাড়িয়া ॥ ১২৬ ॥

*deba-ārādhana-sajja thākila paṛiẏā |*
*āmāra śuśrūṣā kene gelā ta chāṛiẏā || 126 ||*

*Word for word:* deva-aradhana-sajja — the things for the worship of the Deities; thakila padiya — lie there; amara shushrusha — your service to me; kene gela ta chhadiya — why did you go, leaving

**126.** All that was prepared for the worship of the Deities lies there —
why have you gone, leaving your service to me?

আজি হৈতে শূন্য হৈল মোর গৃহবাস ।
বিভা কৈলা বিশ্বম্ভর না গেলা ত পাশ ॥ ১২৭ ॥

*āji haite śūnya haila mora gṛhabāsa |*
*bibhā kailā biśbambhara nā gelā ta pāśa || 127 ||*

*Word for word:* aji haite — from this day; shunya haila mora griha-basa — my home is empty; vibha kaila vishvambhara — Vishvambhara married; na gela ta pasha — [yet you] never stayed at His side

**127.** From this day my home is empty;
Vishvambhara married you, but you never stayed at His side.[^21-3]

আরে রে পাপিষ্ঠ সর্প কোথা তুই ছিলি ।
আমারে না খাইলি কেনে জীত বধূ খালি ॥ ১২৮ ॥

*āre re pāpiṣṭha sarpa kothā tui chili |*
*āmāre nā khāili kene jīta badhū khāli || 128 ||*

*Word for word:* are re papishtha sarpa — O wicked serpent; kotha tui chhili — where were you; amare na khaili kene — why did you not devour me; jita badhu khali — you devoured my living daughter-in-law

**128.** O wicked serpent, where were you hiding?
Why did you not devour me, but devoured my daughter-in-law, so full of life?

মোর সেবা করিবারে বধূ নিয়োজিয়া ।
বিদেশে চলিল পুত্র নিশ্চিন্ত হইয়া ॥ ১২৯ ॥

*mora sebā karibāre badhū niẏojiẏā |*
*bideśe calila putra niścinta haiẏā || 129 ||*

*Word for word:* mora seva karibare — to serve me; badhu niyojiya — appointing the daughter-in-law; videshe chalila putra — my son went abroad; nishchinta haiya — free of care

**129.** Having appointed my daughter-in-law to serve me,
my son went to foreign lands without a care.

কেমনে বা পুত্রমুখ চাহিব অভাগী ।
কি করিব প্রাণ পোড়ে বহুকে না দেখি ॥ ১৩০ ॥

*kemane bā putramukha cāhiba abhāgī |*
*ki kariba prāṇa poṛe bahuke nā dekhi || 130 ||*

*Word for word:* kemane va — how indeed; putra-mukha chahiba — shall I look at my son's face; abhagi — unfortunate one; ki kariba — what shall I do; prana pode — my heart burns; bahuke na dekhi — not seeing my daughter-in-law

**130.** How shall I, unfortunate one, look at my son's face?
What shall I do? My heart burns, not seeing my daughter-in-law."

এতেক বিলাপ দেখি যত বন্ধুগণ ।
সভে বোলে শচীদেবি কর সম্বরণ ॥ ১৩১ ॥

*eteka bilāpa dekhi yata bandhugaṇa |*
*sabhe bole śacīdebi kara sambaraṇa || 131 ||*

*Word for word:* eteka vilapa dekhi — seeing such lamentation; yata bandhugana — all the relatives and friends; sabhe bole — all say; shachidevi kara samvarana — Shachi-devi, compose yourself

**131.** Seeing such lamentation, all the relatives and friends
say: "Shachi-devi, compose yourself!

যার যে নির্বন্ধ আছে ঘুচাইবে কেহ ।
সকল সংসার মিথ্যা এই সব দেহ ॥ ১৩২ ॥

*yāra ye nirbandha āche ghucāibe keha |*
*sakala saṃsāra mithyā ei saba deha || 132 ||*

*Word for word:* yara ye nirbandha achhe — what is ordained for anyone; ghuchaibe keha — who will undo; sakala samsara mithya — the whole world is deceptive; ei saba deha — [and] all these bodies

**132.** Who can change what is ordained for anyone?
This whole world is deceptive, and deceptive are all these bodies.[^21-4]

তোমারে কে বুঝাইব তুমি সব জান ।
জানিঞা শুনিঞা কেনে প্রবোধ না মান ॥ ১৩৩ ॥

*tomāre ke bujhāiba tumi saba jāna |*
*jāniñā śuniñā kene prabodha nā māna || 133 ||*

*Word for word:* tomare ke bujhaiba — who will instruct you; tumi saba jana — you know all; janina shunina — knowing and hearing; kene prabodha na mana — why do you not accept consolation

**133.** Who is to instruct you — you know everything;
knowing and hearing all this, why do you not accept consolation?

শরীর ধরিয়া কেহো মৃত্যু না এড়ায় ।
ব্রহ্মাদি দেবতা যত তারা মৃত্যু পায় ॥ ১৩৪ ॥

*śarīra dhariẏā keho mṛtyu nā eṛāẏa |*
*brahmādi debatā yata tārā mṛtyu pāẏa || 134 ||*

*Word for word:* sharira dhariya — having taken a body; keho mrityu na edaya — no one escapes death; brahmadi devata yata — Brahma and all the gods; tara mrityu paya — they too die

**134.** Having taken a body, no one escapes death:
even Brahma and all the other gods die.

কেহো আগে কেহো পাছে মরণ সভার ।
জনম মরণ মাত্র সভার ব্যভার ॥ ১৩৫ ॥

*keho āge keho pāche maraṇa sabhāra |*
*janama maraṇa mātra sabhāra byabhāra || 135 ||*

*Word for word:* keho age keho pachhe — some sooner, some later; marana sabhara — death for all; janama marana matra — only birth and death; sabhara byabhara — is the lot of all

**135.** Some sooner, some later — death awaits all;
birth and death are the lot of all.

সত্য এক বস্তু কৃষ্ণ বেদে মাত্র জানি ।
হেন কৃষ্ণ যে না ভজে সেই মূঢ়-খনি ॥ ১৩৬ ॥

*satya eka bastu kṛṣṇa bede mātra jāni |*
*hena kṛṣṇa ye nā bhaje sei mūṛha-khani || 136 ||*

*Word for word:* satya eka vastu krishna — the one true Reality is Krishna; vede matra jani — we know it from the Vedas; hena krishna ye na bhaje — whoever does not worship such a Krishna; sei mudha-khani — is a mine of folly

**136.** The one true Reality is Krishna — this we know from the Vedas;
whoever does not worship such a Krishna is a mine of folly."

ইহা বলি প্রবোধিয়া সব বন্ধুজন ।
হরি বলি সভে মিলি সম্বরে ক্রন্দন ॥ ১৩৭ ॥

*ihā bali prabodhiẏā saba bandhujana |*
*hari bali sabhe mili sambare krandana || 137 ||*

*Word for word:* iha bali — saying this; prabodhiya — having consoled her; saba bandhujana — all the relatives; hari bali — saying "Hari"; sabhe mili — all together; samvare krandana — restrain their weeping

**137.** Saying this, all the relatives consoled her,
and all together, saying "Hari", restrain their weeping.

তবে সব জন মিলি যে বিধি আছিল ।
করিয়া সৎক্রিয়া সভে ঘরেরে চলিল ॥ ১৩৮ ॥

*tabe saba jana mili ye bidhi āchila |*
*kariẏā satkriẏā sabhe gharere calila || 138 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe saba jana mili — then all together; ye vidhi achhila — as was prescribed; kariya sat-kriya — performing the funeral rites; sabhe gharere chalila — all went home

**138.** Then all together, having performed the funeral rites
as prescribed, went to their homes.

কান্দিতে কান্দিতে শচী নিজঘর গেলা ।
প্রবোধ করিল তারে বন্ধুগণ মেলা ॥ ১৩৯ ॥

*kāndite kāndite śacī nijaghara gelā |*
*prabodha karila tāre bandhugaṇa melā || 139 ||*

*Word for word:* kandite kandite — weeping and weeping; shachi nija-ghara gela — Shachi went to her home; prabodha karila tare — consoled her; bandhugana mela — the gathered relatives

**139.** Shachi, weeping and weeping, went to her own home;
gathering together, relatives and friends consoled her.

তবে তথা কথোদিন রহি বিশ্বম্ভর ।
ঘরেরে চলিলা প্রভু আনন্দ-অন্তর ॥ ১৪০ ॥

*tabe tathā kathodina rahi biśbambhara |*
*gharere calilā prabhu ānanda-antara || 140 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe tatha — then there; katho-dina rahi — staying some days; vishvambhara — Vishvambhara; gharere chalila prabhu — the Lord set out for home; ananda-antara — with a joyful heart

**140.** And Vishvambhara, having stayed there a few more days,
set out for home with a joyful heart.

রজত কাঞ্চন বস্ত্র মুকুতা প্রবাল ।
সকল-বৈষ্ণব-পূজা করিল অপার ॥ ১৪১ ॥

*rajata kāñcana bastra mukutā prabāla |*
*sakala-baiṣṇaba-pūjā karila apāra || 141 ||*

*Word for word:* rajata kanchana vastra mukuta pravala — with silver, gold, cloth, pearls, coral; sakala-vaishnava — all the Vaishnavas; puja karila apara — honoured [Him] without measure

**141.** With silver, gold, cloth, pearls and coral
all the Vaishnavas honoured Him without measure.

ঘরেরে আইলা প্রভু নানা ধন লঞা ।
মাতৃস্থানে দিল ধন হরষিত হঞা ॥ ১৪২ ॥

*gharere āilā prabhu nānā dhana lañā |*
*mātṛsthāne dila dhana haraṣita hañā || 142 ||*

*Word for word:* gharere aila prabhu — the Lord came home; nana dhana lana — with many riches; matri-sthane dila dhana — gave the wealth to His mother; harashita hana — joyfully

**142.** The Lord came home with many riches
and joyfully gave them to His mother.

নমস্কার করি প্রভু নেহারে বদন ।
বিরসবদন শচী না কহে বচন ॥ ১৪৩ ॥

*namaskāra kari prabhu nehāre badana |*
*birasabadana śacī nā kahe bacana || 143 ||*

*Word for word:* namaskara kari prabhu — bowing, the Lord; nehare badana — looks at her face; virasa-badana shachi — Shachi with a downcast face; na kahe bachana — says not a word

**143.** Bowing, the Lord looks at her face:
Shachi, her face downcast, does not say a word.

পুনরপি পদধূলি লয় বিশ্বম্ভর ।
মলিনবদন দেখি কহিল উত্তর ॥ ১৪৪ ॥

*punarapi padadhūli laẏa biśbambhara |*
*malinabadana dekhi kahila uttara || 144 ||*

*Word for word:* punarapi pada-dhuli laya — again takes the dust of her feet; vishvambhara — Vishvambhara; malina-badana dekhi — seeing the sad face; kahila uttara — spoke

**144.** Vishvambhara again takes the dust of her feet;
seeing her sad face, He spoke.

যে কিছু আনিল ধন মায়ে নিবেদিয়া ।
ধীরি ধীরি কহে প্রভু বিস্মিত হইয়া ॥ ১৪৫ ॥

*ye kichu ānila dhana māẏe nibediẏā |*
*dhīri dhīri kahe prabhu bismita haiẏā || 145 ||*

*Word for word:* ye kichhu anila dhana — whatever wealth He had brought; maye nivediya — offering to His mother; dhiri dhiri kahe prabhu — the Lord says very softly; vismita haiya — astonished

**145.** Having given His mother all the wealth He had brought,
the Lord, astonished, says very softly:

কেনে হেন দেখি তোমার মলিনবদন ।
তোমারে মলিন দেখি পোড়ে মোর মন ॥ ১৪৬ ॥

*kene hena dekhi tomāra malinabadana |*
*tomāre malina dekhi poṛe mora mana || 146 ||*

*Word for word:* kene hena dekhi — why do I see thus; tomara malina-badana — your sad face; tomare malina dekhi — seeing you sad; pode mora mana — My heart burns

**146.** "Why do I see your face so sad?
Seeing you sad, My heart burns."

এ বোল শুনিঞা শচী গদগদ-ভাষ ।
বহয়ে আঁখির নীর ভিজে হিয়াবাস ॥ ১৪৭ ॥

*e bola śuniñā śacī gadagada-bhāṣa |*
*bahaẏe āṁkhira nīra bhije hiẏābāsa || 147 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shunina — hearing this; shachi gadgada-bhasha — Shachi, her voice choking; bahaye ankhira nira — tears flow from her eyes; bhije hiya-basa — the cloth on her breast is soaked

**147.** Hearing this, Shachi, her voice choking,
began to weep, and her tears soaked the cloth on her breast.

কহিতে না পারে কিছু সকরুণ কণ্ঠ ।
কহিল আমার বধূ গেলা ত বৈকুণ্ঠ ॥ ১৪৮ ॥

*kahite nā pāre kichu sakaruṇa kaṇṭha |*
*kahila āmāra badhū gelā ta baikuṇṭha || 148 ||*

*Word for word:* kahite na pare kichhu — she can say nothing; sakaruna kantha — her voice full of grief; kahila — she said; amara badhu gela ta vaikuntha — my daughter-in-law has gone to Vaikuntha

**148.** She can say nothing — her voice is full of grief;
at last she said: "My daughter-in-law has gone to Vaikuntha."

এ বোল শুনিঞা প্রভু বিরস-অন্তর ।
ছলছল করে আঁখি করুণার জল ॥ ১৪৯ ॥

*e bola śuniñā prabhu birasa-antara |*
*chalachala kare āṁkhi karuṇāra jala || 149 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shunina — hearing this; prabhu virasa-antara — the Lord grew sad at heart; chhalachhala kare ankhi — His eyes brimmed; karunara jala — with tears of tenderness

**149.** Hearing this, the Lord grew sad at heart;
His eyes filled with tears of tenderness.

মায়েরে কহিল প্রভু শুনহ বচন ।
পূর্বকথা কহি তার জন্মের কারণ ॥ ১৫০ ॥

*māẏere kahila prabhu śunaha bacana |*
*pūrbakathā kahi tāra janmera kāraṇa || 150 ||*

*Word for word:* mayere kahila prabhu — the Lord said to His mother; shunaha bachana — listen to My words; purva-katha kahi — I shall tell the earlier story; tara janmera karana — the reason for her birth

**150.** The Lord said to His mother: "Listen to My words:
I shall tell you the earlier story — why she was born.

ইন্দ্রের অপ্সরা নৃত্য করে এককালে ।
দৈবের নির্বন্ধ পদস্খলন হৈল তারে ॥ ১৫১ ॥

*indrera apsarā nṛtya kare ekakāle |*
*daibera nirbandha padaskhalana haila tāre || 151 ||*

*Word for word:* indrera apsara — an apsara of Indra; nritya kare ekakale — was once dancing; daivera nirbandha — by the decree of destiny; pada-skhalana haila tare — she missed a step

**151.** Once an apsara of Indra was dancing,
and by the will of destiny she missed a step.

তালভঙ্গ হৈল শাপ দিল সুরেশ্বরে ।
পৃথিবীতে জন্ম গিয়া মনুষ্যের ঘরে ॥ ১৫২ ॥

*tālabhaṅga haila śāpa dila sureśbare |*
*pṛthibīte janma giẏā manuṣyera ghare || 152 ||*

*Word for word:* tala-bhanga haila — the rhythm broke; shapa dila sureshvare — the lord of the gods cursed; prithivite janma giya — go and be born on earth; manushyera ghare — in a human home

**152.** The rhythm was broken, and the lord of the gods cursed her:
'Be born on earth in a human home.'

শাপ দিয়া পুনঃ দয়া ভেল দেবরাজে ।
দুঃখ না পাইবা তুমি হৈব বড় কাজে ॥ ১৫৩ ॥

*śāpa diẏā punaḥ daẏā bhela debarāje |*
*duḥkha nā pāibā tumi haiba baṛa kāje || 153 ||*

*Word for word:* shapa diya — having cursed; punah daya bhela devaraje — the king of the gods again felt pity; duhkha na paiba tumi — you will not suffer; haiba bada kaje — a great task awaits you

**153.** Having cursed her, the king of the gods again took pity:
'You will not suffer — a great task awaits you.

পৃথিবীতে অবতার হইবে ঈশ্বর ।
তার বধূ হৈবা তুমি এই দিল বর ॥ ১৫৪ ॥

*pṛthibīte abatāra haibe īśbara |*
*tāra badhū haibā tumi ei dila bara || 154 ||*

*Word for word:* prithivite avatara haibe ishvara — on earth the Ishvara will appear as an avatara; tara badhu haiba tumi — you will become His wife; ei dila bara — this boon he gave

**154.** On earth the Ishvara will appear as an avatara,
and you will become His wife' — such was the boon he gave.

তবে ত আসিবে তুমি এই ইন্দ্রপুরী ।
কহিল সকল সেই ইন্দ্রের সুন্দরী ॥ ১৫৫ ॥

*tabe ta āsibe tumi ei indrapurī |*
*kahila sakala sei indrera sundarī || 155 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe ta asibe tumi — then you will return; ei indrapuri — to this city of Indra; kahila sakala — I have told all; sei indrera sundari — about that beauty of Indra

**155.** 'And then you will return here, to Indra's city.'
That is all about that beauty of Indra.[^21-5]

শোক না করিহ আর শুন মোর মাতা ।
নির্বন্ধ না ঘুচে যেই লিখিল বিধাতা ॥ ১৫৬ ॥

*śoka nā kariha āra śuna mora mātā |*
*nirbandha nā ghuce yei likhila bidhātā || 156 ||*

*Word for word:* shoka na kariha ara — grieve no more; shuna mora mata — listen, My mother; nirbandha na ghuche — the decree is not undone; yei likhila vidhata — which the Creator wrote

**156.** Grieve no more, listen, My mother:
what the Creator has written cannot be changed."

পুত্রের বচন শচী শুনি সাবধানে ।
না করিল শোক কিছু না করিলা মনে ॥ ১৫৭ ॥

*putrera bacana śacī śuni sābadhāne |*
*nā karila śoka kichu nā karilā mane || 157 ||*

*Word for word:* putrera bachana — her son's words; shachi shuni savadhane — Shachi heard attentively; na karila shoka — she grieved no more; kichhu na karila mane — kept nothing in her mind

**157.** Shachi listened attentively to her son's words,
ceased grieving and thought of it no more.

প্রবোধ পাইয়া শচী করে অন্য-চিন্তা ।
ভক্তগণসঙ্গে বসি কহে নিজকথা ॥ ১৫৮ ॥

*prabodha pāiẏā śacī kare anya-cintā |*
*bhaktagaṇasaṅge basi kahe nijakathā || 158 ||*

*Word for word:* prabodha paiya — consoled; shachi kare anya-chinta — Shachi turns to other thoughts; bhaktagana-sange basi — sitting with the devotees; kahe nija-katha — speaks of her affairs

**158.** Consoled, Shachi turned to other thoughts;
sitting with the devotees, she speaks of her affairs.

এ বোল বলিয়া বিশ্বম্ভর পাইল চিন্তা ।
আপনা সঙ্গোপন করে কহে নানা কথা ॥ ১৫৯ ॥

*e bola baliẏā biśbambhara pāila cintā |*
*āpanā saṅgopana kare kahe nānā kathā || 159 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola baliya — having said this; vishvambhara paila chinta — Vishvambhara became thoughtful; apana sangopana kare — concealing Himself; kahe nana katha — speaks of various things

**159.** Having said this, Vishvambhara became thoughtful;
concealing Himself, He speaks of various things.[^21-6]

কহয়ে লোচনদাস শুনহ বিচিত্র ।
লক্ষ্মী-স্বর্গ-আরোহণ গৌরাঙ্গ-চরিত্র ॥ ১৬০ ॥

*kahaẏe locanadāsa śunaha bicitra |*
*lakṣmī-sbarga-ārohaṇa gaurāṅga-caritra || 160 ||*

*Word for word:* kahaye lochana-dasa — says Lochana Dasa; shunaha vichitra — listen to the wonderful; lakshmi-svarga-arohana — Lakshmi's ascent to heaven; gauranga-charitra — deed of Gauranga

**160.** Says Lochana Dasa: listen to this wonderful
deed of Gauranga — Lakshmi's ascent to heaven.

## Kaishora-lila (The Pastimes of Youth): the Lord's Second Wedding

> *Summary by Srila Bhaktisiddhanta Sarasvati.* When some days had passed after Lakshmi-devi's ascent to heaven, Mother Shachi grew anxious to have Nimai married again and sent the brahmana Kashinatha to the house of Sanatana Pandita to settle a match with his daughter. When Kashinatha Mishra, coming to Sanatana Pandita's house, conveyed Shachi-devi's words, Sanatana Pandita with the greatest joy agreed to give his daughter to Vishvambhara. An astrologer was called and the day and hour of the wedding were fixed; on the eve of the wedding the respectable ladies and the brahmanas duly performed the popular and the Vedic rites. As before, the anointing with turmeric and the other rites were duly performed. On the wedding day everything was done with great pomp, just as the previous time. After the wedding Sanatana Mishra sent his daughter with his son-in-law to His house.[^21-7]

*Raga gandhara;[^21-8] disha: "Moon of the twice-born line, jewel-like Gora! Nadia rejoices, 'Hari' resounds, cries rise up. O-ki ho re, Gauranga, jaya, jaya!"*

হেনমতে নবদ্বীপে প্রভু বিশ্বম্ভর ।
আনন্দে গোঙায় দিন শচীর কোঙর ॥ ১ ॥

*henamate nabadbīpe prabhu biśbambhara |*
*ānande goṅāẏa dina śacīra koṅara || 1 ||*

*Word for word:* henamate — thus; navadvipe — in Navadvipa; prabhu vishvambhara — Lord Vishvambhara; anande gongaya dina — joyfully spends His days; shachira kongara — the son of Shachi

**1.** Thus Lord Vishvambhara, the son of Shachi,
joyfully spent His days in Navadvipa.

সুখে নিবসয়ে বন্ধু-বান্ধব-সহিতে ।
শচীর হৃদয়ে দুঃখ ভেল আচম্বিতে ॥ ২ ॥

*sukhe nibasaẏe bandhu-bāndhaba-sahite |*
*śacīra hṛdaẏe duḥkha bhela ācambite || 2 ||*

*Word for word:* sukhe nivasaye — lives happily; bandhu-bandhava-sahite — with relatives and friends; shachira hridaye — in Shachi's heart; duhkha bhela achambite — sorrow suddenly arose

**2.** He lived happily with His relatives and friends,
but in Shachi's heart sorrow suddenly arose.

বধূ-শূন্য গৃহ দেখি বড় পাইল চিন্তা ।
বিশ্বম্ভরে বিভা দিব এই মনঃকথা ॥ ৩ ॥

*badhū-śūnya gṛha dekhi baṛa pāila cintā |*
*biśbambhare bibhā diba ei manaḥkathā || 3 ||*

*Word for word:* badhu-shunya griha dekhi — seeing the house without a daughter-in-law; bada paila chinta — grew very anxious; vishvambhare vibha diba — I shall get Vishvambhara married; ei manah-katha — this was her thought

**3.** Seeing the house without a daughter-in-law, she grew very anxious:
"I shall get Vishvambhara married" — so she resolved within.

মনে অনুমান করি করিল নিশ্চয় ।
আছে একখানি কন্যা যদি ভাগ্যে হয় ॥ ৪ ॥

*mane anumāna kari karila niścaẏa |*
*āche ekakhāni kanyā yadi bhāgye haẏa || 4 ||*

*Word for word:* mane anumana kari — having considered; karila nishchaya — she decided; achhe eka-khani kanya — there is a certain maiden; yadi bhagye haya — if fortune allows

**4.** Having considered, she came to a decision:
"There is a certain maiden — if only fortune favours us."

কাশীনাথ-নামে দ্বিজ দেখিল সম্মুখে ।
অন্তর কহিল শচী নিভৃতে তাহাকে ॥ ৫ ॥

*kāśīnātha-nāme dbija dekhila sammukhe |*
*antara kahila śacī nibhṛte tāhāke || 5 ||*

*Word for word:* kashinatha-name dvija — a brahmana named Kashinatha; dekhila sammukhe — she saw before her; antara kahila shachi — Shachi told her heart; nibhrite tahake — to him in private

**5.** Seeing before her a brahmana named Kashinatha,
Shachi in private opened her heart to him:

সনাতন-পণ্ডিতের ঘর যাহ তুমি ।
প্রবন্ধ করিয়া কহ যে কহিয়ে আমি ॥ ৬ ॥

*sanātana-paṇḍitera ghara yāha tumi |*
*prabandha kariẏā kaha ye kahiẏe āmi || 6 ||*

*Word for word:* sanatana-panditera ghara — to Sanatana Pandita's house; yaha tumi — go; prabandha kariya kaha — tell him fully; ye kahiye ami — what I say

**6.** "Go to the house of Sanatana Pandita
and tell him fully what I say:

সর্বগুণে শীলে এই আমার তনয় ।
তার কন্যার যোগ্য বর যদি মনে লয় ॥ ৭ ॥

*sarbaguṇe śīle ei āmāra tanaẏa |*
*tāra kanyāra yogya bara yadi mane laẏa || 7 ||*

*Word for word:* sarva-gune shile — with every virtue and good nature; ei amara tanaya — is my son; tara kanyara yogya bara — a worthy groom for his daughter; yadi mane laya — if it pleases him

**7.** my son is endowed with every virtue and good nature;
if it pleases him, He is a worthy bridegroom for his daughter."

এতেক বচন শচী দ্বিজেরে কহিল ।
শুনি কাশীনাথ দ্বিজ সত্বরে চলিলা ॥ ৮ ॥

*eteka bacana śacī dbijere kahila |*
*śuni kāśīnātha dbija satbare calilā || 8 ||*

*Word for word:* eteka bachana — these words; shachi dvijere kahila — Shachi said to the brahmana; shuni kashinatha dvija — hearing, the brahmana Kashinatha; satvare chalila — set out quickly

**8.** So Shachi spoke to the brahmana,
and, having heard, the brahmana Kashinatha set out quickly.

পণ্ডিত সনাতন আছে নিজঘরে ।
কাশীনাথ দ্বিজোত্তম গেলা তথাকারে ॥ ৯ ॥

*paṇḍita sanātana āche nijaghare |*
*kāśīnātha dbijottama gelā tathākāre || 9 ||*

*Word for word:* pandita sanatana — Pandita Sanatana; achhe nija-ghare — is in his house; kashinatha dvijottama — Kashinatha, the best of brahmanas; gela tathakare — went there

**9.** Pandita Sanatana was in his house;
there came Kashinatha, the best of brahmanas.

আইস আইস বলি দিল আসন বসিতে ।
কি কাজে আইলা কহে হাসিতে হাসিতে ॥ ১০ ॥

*āisa āisa bali dila āsana basite |*
*ki kāje āilā kahe hāsite hāsite || 10 ||*

*Word for word:* aisa aisa bali — saying "Come, come!"; dila asana vasite — offered a seat; ki kaje aila — on what business have you come; kahe hasite hasite — he says smiling

**10.** "Come in, come in!" said [Sanatana], and offered him a seat;
"On what business have you come?" he asks with a smile.

কাশীনাথ কহে শুন শুন হে পণ্ডিত ।
কহিব সকল কথা যে হয় উচিত ॥ ১১ ॥

*kāśīnātha kahe śuna śuna he paṇḍita |*
*kahiba sakala kathā ye haẏa ucita || 11 ||*

*Word for word:* kashinatha kahe — Kashinatha says; shuna shuna he pandita — listen, listen, O pandit; kahiba sakala katha — I shall tell everything; ye haya uchita — as is proper

**11.** Kashinatha says: "Listen, listen, pandit:
I shall tell you everything, as is proper.

তুমি সর্বশাস্ত্র জান ধন্য পৃথিবীতে ।
কি আছয়ে যত গুণ তোর অবিদিতে ॥ ১২ ॥

*tumi sarbaśāstra jāna dhanya pṛthibīte |*
*ki āchaẏe yata guṇa tora abidite || 12 ||*

*Word for word:* tumi sarva-shastra jana — you know all the shastras; dhanya prithivite — renowned on earth; ki achhaye yata guna — what virtue is there; tora avidite — unknown to you

**12.** You know all the shastras, you are renowned on earth;
what virtue is there unknown to you?

পরম ধার্মিক তুমি বিষ্ণুপরায়ণ ।
নিজধর্মপরায়ণ বলিয়ে ব্রাহ্মণ ॥ ১৩ ॥

*parama dhārmika tumi biṣṇuparāẏaṇa |*
*nijadharmaparāẏaṇa baliẏe brāhmaṇa || 13 ||*

*Word for word:* parama dharmika tumi — you are supremely righteous; vishnu-parayana — devoted to Vishnu; nija-dharma-parayana — faithful to your own dharma; baliye brahmana — a brahmana, I say

**13.** You are supremely righteous, devoted to Vishnu;
you are a brahmana faithful to his own dharma.

এছন জানিঞা শচী বিশ্বম্ভর-মাতা ।
ডাকিয়া কহিল মোরে অন্তরের কথা ॥ ১৪ ॥

*echana jāniñā śacī biśbambhara-mātā |*
*ḍākiẏā kahila more antarera kathā || 14 ||*

*Word for word:* echhana janina — knowing this; shachi vishvambhara-mata — Shachi, Vishvambhara's mother; dakiya kahila more — called and told me; antarera katha — what is in her heart

**14.** Knowing this, Shachi, Vishvambhara's mother,
called me and told me what is in her heart.

পাঠাইয়া দিল মোরে তোমা-বরাবর ।
অবধান করি শুন যে কহি উত্তর ॥ ১৫ ॥

*pāṭhāiẏā dila more tomā-barābara |*
*abadhāna kari śuna ye kahi uttara || 15 ||*

*Word for word:* pathaiya dila more — she sent me; toma-barabara — straight to you; avadhana kari shuna — listen attentively; ye kahi uttara — to what I say

**15.** She has sent me straight to you;
listen attentively to what I say.

আপন বলিয়া তোরে কহি নিজমর্ম ।
আপনে বুঝিয়া কর যে যুয়ায় কর্ম ॥ ১৬ ॥

*āpana baliẏā tore kahi nijamarma |*
*āpane bujhiẏā kara ye yuẏāẏa karma || 16 ||*

*Word for word:* apana baliya — regarding you as her own; tore kahi nija-marma — I tell you her heart; apane bujhiya kara — judge for yourself and do; ye yuyaya karma — what is fitting

**16.** Regarding you as her own, I tell you her heart;
judge for yourself and do what is fitting:

তোমার কন্যার যোগ্য বর বিশ্বম্ভর ।
কহিল সকল কথা যে দেহ উত্তর ॥ ১৭ ॥

*tomāra kanyāra yogya bara biśbambhara |*
*kahila sakala kathā ye deha uttara || 17 ||*

*Word for word:* tomara kanyara yogya bara — a worthy groom for your daughter; vishvambhara — Vishvambhara; kahila sakala katha — I have said all; ye deha uttara — give your answer

**17.** Vishvambhara is a worthy bridegroom for your daughter.
I have said everything — give your answer."

শুনি সনাতন মিশ্র মনে অনুমানি ।
বন্ধুর সহিত কথা দঢ়াইল বাণী ॥ ১৮ ॥

*śuni sanātana miśra mane anumāni |*
*bandhura sahita kathā daṛhāila bāṇī || 18 ||*

*Word for word:* shuni sanatana mishra — hearing, Sanatana Mishra; mane anumani — reflecting; bandhura sahita katha — conferring with relatives; dadhaila vani — confirmed his word

**18.** Hearing this, Sanatana Mishra reflected
and with his relatives settled on his word.

কাশীনাথ-পণ্ডিতেরে কহে সনাতন ।
আপন অন্তর কহি শুন মহাজন ॥ ১৯ ॥

*kāśīnātha-paṇḍitere kahe sanātana |*
*āpana antara kahi śuna mahājana || 19 ||*

*Word for word:* kashinatha-panditere — to Kashinatha Pandita; kahe sanatana — says Sanatana; apana antara kahi — I tell my heart; shuna mahajana — listen, honoured sir

**19.** Sanatana says to Kashinatha Pandita:
"I shall open my heart to you, listen, honoured sir.

এই মনঃকথা মোর রজনী দিবস ।
প্রকট-বদনে কহি নাহিক সাহস ॥ ২০ ॥

*ei manaḥkathā mora rajanī dibasa |*
*prakaṭa-badane kahi nāhika sāhasa || 20 ||*

*Word for word:* ei manah-katha mora — this thought of mine; rajani divasa — night and day; prakata-badane kahi — to say openly; nahika sahasa — I had no courage

**20.** This is what I have been thinking day and night,
but I did not dare to say it openly.

আজি শুভদিন প্রসন্ন ভেল বিধি ।
জামাতা হইব বিশ্বম্ভর গুণনিধি ॥ ২১ ॥

*āji śubhadina prasanna bhela bidhi |*
*jāmātā haiba biśbambhara guṇanidhi || 21 ||*

*Word for word:* aji shubha-dina — today is an auspicious day; prasanna bhela vidhi — destiny is favourable; jamata haiba — will become my son-in-law; vishvambhara guna-nidhi — Vishvambhara, treasure of virtues

**21.** Today is an auspicious day — destiny favours me:
Vishvambhara, the treasure-house of virtues, will become my son-in-law.

আপনার ভাগ্যতত্ত্ব জানিল মো তবে ।
আপনে সে শচীদেবী আজ্ঞা কৈল যবে ॥ ২২ ॥

*āpanāra bhāgyatattba jānila mo tabe |*
*āpane se śacīdebī ājñā kaila yabe || 22 ||*

*Word for word:* apanara bhagya-tattva — the truth of my fortune; janila mo tabe — I understood then; apane se shachidevi — Shachi-devi herself; ajna kaila yabe — when she commanded

**22.** Then indeed I understood how great my good fortune is,
when Shachi-devi herself gave the command.

মোর ভাগ্য-সম ভাগ্য কাহার হইব ।
পরব্রহ্ম শ্রীগোবিন্দে কন্যা সমর্পিব ॥ ২৩ ॥

*mora bhāgya-sama bhāgya kāhāra haiba |*
*parabrahma śrīgobinde kanyā samarpiba || 23 ||*

*Word for word:* mora bhagya-sama bhagya — fortune equal to mine; kahara haiba — whose will it be; parabrahma shri-govinde — to the Parabrahman Sri Govinda; kanya samarpiba — I shall give my daughter

**23.** Whose fortune can equal mine?
I shall give my daughter to the Parabrahman, Sri Govinda!

সদা যার পাদপদ্ম পূজে ব্রহ্মা-শিব ।
সে চরণে কন্যা দিয়া আমিহ অর্চিব ॥ ২৪ ॥

*sadā yāra pādapadma pūje brahmā-śiba |*
*se caraṇe kanyā diẏā āmiha arciba || 24 ||*

*Word for word:* sada yara pada-padma — whose lotus feet always; puje brahma-shiva — Brahma and Shiva worship; se charane kanya diya — giving my daughter to those feet; amiha archiba — I too shall worship

**24.** The feet that Brahma and Shiva ever worship —
giving my daughter to them, I too shall worship them."

আগুসরি কাশীনাথ চলে দ্বিজোত্তমে ।
কহিল কহিও শচীদেবীর চরণে ॥ ২৫ ॥

*āgusari kāśīnātha cale dbijottame |*
*kahila kahio śacīdebīra caraṇe || 25 ||*

*Word for word:* agusari — setting forth; kashinatha chale dvijottame — Kashinatha, best of brahmanas, goes; kahila — [Sanatana] said; kahio shachidevira charane — tell at the feet of Shachi-devi

**25.** As Kashinatha, the best of brahmanas, set out,
[Sanatana] said: "Convey this at the feet of Shachi-devi:

সময়-নির্ণয় করি পাঠাব ব্রাহ্মণ ।
শুভকার্য-অনুবন্ধে করিহ যতন ॥ ২৬ ॥

*samaẏa-nirṇaẏa kari pāṭhāba brāhmaṇa |*
*śubhakārya-anubandhe kariha yatana || 26 ||*

*Word for word:* samaya-nirnaya kari — having fixed the time; pathaba brahmana — I shall send a brahmana; shubha-karya-anubandhe — for the preparations of the auspicious event; kariha yatana — take care

**26.** 'Having fixed the time, I shall send a brahmana;
see to the preparations for the auspicious event.'"

পণ্ডিত শ্রীসনাতন কহিল উত্তর ।
কাশীনাথ দ্বিজোত্তম চলিলা সত্বর ॥ ২৭ ॥

*paṇḍita śrīsanātana kahila uttara |*
*kāśīnātha dbijottama calilā satbara || 27 ||*

*Word for word:* pandita shri-sanatana — Pandita Sri Sanatana; kahila uttara — gave this answer; kashinatha dvijottama — Kashinatha, best of brahmanas; chalila satvara — went off quickly

**27.** So Pandita Sri Sanatana replied,
and Kashinatha, the best of brahmanas, went off quickly.

শচীর চরণে আসি কৈল পরণাম ।
কহিল সকল কথা তার বিদ্যমান ॥ ২৮ ॥

*śacīra caraṇe āsi kaila paraṇāma |*
*kahila sakala kathā tāra bidyamāna || 28 ||*

*Word for word:* shachira charane asi — coming to Shachi's feet; kaila paranama — he bowed; kahila sakala katha — told everything; tara vidyamana — in her presence

**28.** Coming, he bowed at Shachi's feet
and in her presence related everything.

অতি হরষিতা শচী উত্তর পাইয়া ।
পুত্র-বিবাহের কার্য করেন হাসিয়া ॥ ২৯ ॥

*ati haraṣitā śacī uttara pāiẏā |*
*putra-bibāhera kārya karena hāsiẏā || 29 ||*

*Word for word:* ati harashita shachi — Shachi, overjoyed; uttara paiya — receiving the answer; putra-vibahera karya — the work of her son's wedding; karena hasiya — does smiling

**29.** Receiving the answer, Shachi was overjoyed
and, smiling, began the preparations for her son's wedding.

নানাদ্রব্য আহরণ করে শচী ধন্যা ।
কোন কোন ছলে দেখিবারে যায় কন্যা ॥ ৩০ ॥

*nānādrabya āharaṇa kare śacī dhanyā |*
*kona kona chale dekhibāre yāẏa kanyā || 30 ||*

*Word for word:* nana-dravya aharana kare — gathers many things; shachi dhanya — blessed Shachi; kona kona chhale — on one pretext or another; dekhibare yaya kanya — goes to see the maiden

**30.** Blessed Shachi gathers all kinds of things,
and on one pretext or another goes to see the maiden.

তবে সেই সনাতন পণ্ডিত-উত্তম ।
কথোদিন রহি তথা পাঠাইল ব্রাহ্মণ ॥ ৩১ ॥

*tabe sei sanātana paṇḍita-uttama |*
*kathodina rahi tathā pāṭhāila brāhmaṇa || 31 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe sei sanatana — then Sanatana; pandita-uttama — the excellent pandit; kathodina rahi — after some days; tatha pathaila brahmana — sent a brahmana there

**31.** And Sanatana, the excellent pandit,
after waiting some days, sent a brahmana:

শচীর চরণে মোর বলিহ বচন ।
গোচরিহ পুরুবে যে কহিল ব্রাহ্মণ ॥ ৩২ ॥

*śacīra caraṇe mora baliha bacana |*
*gocariha purube ye kahila brāhmaṇa || 32 ||*

*Word for word:* shachira charane — at Shachi's feet; mora baliha bachana — convey my words; gochariha — remind her; purube ye kahila brahmana — of what the brahmana said before

**32.** "Convey my words at Shachi's feet;
remind her of what the brahmana said before.

মোর ভাগ্যে আজ্ঞা যদি করে সেই কথা ।
সত্বরে আসিহ কার্য করি যেন এথা ॥ ৩৩ ॥

*mora bhāgye ājñā yadi kare sei kathā |*
*satbare āsiha kārya kari yena ethā || 33 ||*

*Word for word:* mora bhagye — to my good fortune; ajna yadi kare sei katha — if she gives her word; satvare asiha — come back quickly; karya kari yena etha — so that we may do the work here

**33.** If, to my good fortune, she gives her word,
come back quickly, so that we may set to work here.

পরব্রহ্ম শ্রীগোবিন্দ শ্রীশচীনন্দন ।
কন্যা দিয়া সংসারে হইব বিমোচন ॥ ৩৪ ॥

*parabrahma śrīgobinda śrīśacīnandana |*
*kanyā diẏā saṃsāre haiba bimocana || 34 ||*

*Word for word:* parabrahma shri-govinda — the Parabrahman Sri Govinda; shri-shachinandana — is Sri Shachinandana; kanya diya — by giving my daughter; samsare haiba vimochana — I shall be freed from samsara

**34.** Sri Shachinandana is the Parabrahman, Sri Govinda:
by giving my daughter to Him I shall be freed from samsara."

শুনিঞা চলিলা বিপ্র শচীর ভবনে ।
সকল কহিল গিয়া শচীর চরণে ॥ ৩৫ ॥

*śuniñā calilā bipra śacīra bhabane |*
*sakala kahila giẏā śacīra caraṇe || 35 ||*

*Word for word:* shunina — hearing; chalila vipra — the brahmana went; shachira bhavane — to Shachi's house; sakala kahila giya — coming, told everything; shachira charane — at Shachi's feet

**35.** Hearing this, the brahmana went to Shachi's house
and, arriving, related everything at Shachi's feet:

পণ্ডিত শ্রীসনাতন পাঠাইল মোরে ।
নিজ মর্ম নিবেদন করিতে তোমারে ॥ ৩৬ ॥

*paṇḍita śrīsanātana pāṭhāila more |*
*nija marma nibedana karite tomāre || 36 ||*

*Word for word:* pandita shri-sanatana — Pandita Sri Sanatana; pathaila more — has sent me; nija marma nivedana karite — to make known his heart; tomare — to you

**36.** "Pandita Sri Sanatana has sent me
to open his heart to you:

তার ভাগ্যে আজ্ঞা যদি কর তুমি ধন্যা ।
তোর পুত্র বিশ্বম্ভরে দেই নিজকন্যা ॥ ৩৭ ॥

*tāra bhāgye ājñā yadi kara tumi dhanyā |*
*tora putra biśbambhare dei nijakanyā || 37 ||*

*Word for word:* tara bhagye — to his good fortune; ajna yadi kara tumi dhanya — if you, blessed one, permit; tora putra vishvambhare — to your son Vishvambhara; dei nija-kanya — he gives his daughter

**37.** if, to his good fortune, you, blessed lady, permit it,
he will give his daughter to your son Vishvambhara."

ভাল ভাল বলি শচী অতি হৃষ্টচিত্ত ।
আমার সম্মত কার্য করহ ত্বরিত ॥ ৩৮ ॥

*bhāla bhāla bali śacī ati hṛṣṭacitta |*
*āmāra sammata kārya karaha tbarita || 38 ||*

*Word for word:* bhala bhala bali — saying "Good, good!"; shachi ati hrishta-chitta — Shachi in great joy; amara sammata — I consent; karya karaha tvarita — do the work quickly

**38.** "Good, good!" said Shachi in great joy.
"I agree; do everything quickly."

এ বোল শুনিঞা দ্বিজ অতি হৃষ্টমনে ।
কহিতে লাগিল কিছু মধুর-বচনে ॥ ৩৯ ॥

*e bola śuniñā dbija ati hṛṣṭamane |*
*kahite lāgila kichu madhura-bacane || 39 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shunina — hearing this; dvija ati hrishta-mane — the brahmana, very glad; kahite lagila kichhu — began to say something; madhura-bachane — in sweet words

**39.** Hearing this, the brahmana in great joy
began to speak sweet words:

বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া বিশ্বম্ভর-হেন পতি পাব ।
বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া-নাম তার যথার্থ হইব ॥ ৪০ ॥

*biṣṇupriẏā biśbambhara-hena pati pāba |*
*biṣṇupriẏā-nāma tāra yathārtha haiba || 40 ||*

*Word for word:* vishnupriya — Vishnupriya; vishvambhara-hena pati paba — will gain a husband like Vishvambhara; vishnupriya-nama tara — her name Vishnupriya; yathartha haiba — will become true

**40.** "Vishnupriya will gain a husband like Vishvambhara —
and the name Vishnupriya ('beloved of Vishnu') will be true for her.

শ্রীকৃষ্ণেরে পতি যেন পাইল রুক্মিণী ।
এছন হইব সেই হিয়া অনুমানি ॥ ৪১ ॥

*śrīkṛṣṇere pati yena pāila rukmiṇī |*
*echana haiba sei hiẏā anumāni || 41 ||*

*Word for word:* shri-krishnere pati — Sri Krishna as husband; yena paila rukmini — as Rukmini gained; echhana haiba sei — so will it be with her; hiya anumani — my heart surmises

**41.** As Rukmini gained Sri Krishna as her husband,
so it will be with her — so my heart tells me."[^21-9]

এ বোল শুনিঞা শচী অতি হরষিতা ।
ব্রাহ্মণ কহিল গিয়া পণ্ডিতেরে কথা ॥ ৪২ ॥

*e bola śuniñā śacī ati haraṣitā |*
*brāhmaṇa kahila giẏā paṇḍitere kathā || 42 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shunina — hearing this; shachi ati harashita — Shachi was overjoyed; brahmana kahila giya — the brahmana went and told; panditere katha — the matter to the pandit

**42.** Hearing this, Shachi was overjoyed,
and the brahmana went and told everything to the pandit.

পণ্ডিত শ্রীসনাতন বড় তুষ্ট হৈলা ।
বিবাহ-উচিত দ্রব্য করিতে লাগিলা ॥ ৪৩ ॥

*paṇḍita śrīsanātana baṛa tuṣṭa hailā |*
*bibāha-ucita drabya karite lāgilā || 43 ||*

*Word for word:* pandita shri-sanatana — Pandita Sri Sanatana; bada tushta haila — was very pleased; vibaha-uchita dravya — the things proper for a wedding; karite lagila — began to prepare

**43.** Pandita Sri Sanatana was very pleased
and began to prepare all that is needed for a wedding.

নানাদ্রব্য অলঙ্কার করে মহামতি ।
অধিবাস করিবারে করিল যুগতি ॥ ৪৪ ॥

*nānādrabya alaṅkāra kare mahāmati |*
*adhibāsa karibāre karila yugati || 44 ||*

*Word for word:* nana-dravya alankara — many things and ornaments; kare mahamati — the wise one has made; adhivasa karibare — to perform the adhivasa; karila yugati — he planned

**44.** The wise [pandit] has all kinds of things and ornaments made;
he planned to perform the adhivasa.

গণক আনিঞা বলে বচন বিনয় ।
বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া-বিভা দিব করহ সময় ॥ ৪৫ ॥

*gaṇaka āniñā bale bacana binaẏa |*
*biṣṇupriẏā-bibhā diba karaha samaẏa || 45 ||*

*Word for word:* ganaka anina — calling an astrologer; bale bachana vinaya — speaks humbly; vishnupriya-vibha diba — I shall give Vishnupriya in marriage; karaha samaya — fix the time

**45.** Calling an astrologer, he says humbly:
"I am giving Vishnupriya in marriage — fix the time."

গণক কহিল শুন শুন হে পণ্ডিত ।
আজিতে দেখিল বিশ্বম্ভর আচম্বিত ॥ ৪৬ ॥

*gaṇaka kahila śuna śuna he paṇḍita |*
*ājite dekhila biśbambhara ācambita || 46 ||*

*Word for word:* ganaka kahila — the astrologer said; shuna shuna he pandita — listen, listen, O pandit; ajite dekhila — today I saw; vishvambhara achambita — Vishvambhara unexpectedly

**46.** The astrologer said: "Listen, listen, pandit:
today I unexpectedly met Vishvambhara.

তারে দেখি আনন্দিত হৈল মোর মন ।
কৌতুকে তাহারে আমি যে কৈল বচন ॥ ৪৭ ॥

*tāre dekhi ānandita haila mora mana |*
*kautuke tāhāre āmi ye kaila bacana || 47 ||*

*Word for word:* tare dekhi — seeing Him; anandita haila mora mana — my heart rejoiced; kautuke tahare ami — I in jest to Him; ye kaila bachana — spoke these words

**47.** Seeing Him, my heart rejoiced,
and I said to Him in jest:

কালি শুভ অধিবাস হইব তোমার ।
বিবাহ হইব শুন বচন আমার ॥ ৪৮ ॥

*kāli śubha adhibāsa haiba tomāra |*
*bibāha haiba śuna bacana āmāra || 48 ||*

*Word for word:* kali shubha adhivasa — tomorrow the auspicious adhivasa; haiba tomara — will be Yours; vibaha haiba — there will be a wedding; shuna bachana amara — hear my words

**48.** 'Tomorrow is Your auspicious adhivasa,
there will be a wedding — hear what I say.'

এ বোল শুনিঞা তেঁহো কহিল উত্তর ।
কহ কোথা কার বিভা কে বা কন্যা বর ॥ ৪৯ ॥

*e bola śuniñā teṁho kahila uttara |*
*kaha kothā kāra bibhā ke bā kanyā bara || 49 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shunina — hearing this; tenho kahila uttara — He answered; kaha kotha — tell, where; kara vibha — whose wedding; ke va kanya bara — who is bride, who is groom

**49.** Hearing this, He answered:
'Tell Me, where, whose wedding, who is the bride, who the groom?

আমার সাক্ষাতে কথা কহিলি কখন ।
বুঝিয়া কার্যের গতি কর আচরণ ॥ ৫০ ॥

*āmāra sākṣāte kathā kahili kakhana |*
*bujhiẏā kāryera gati kara ācaraṇa || 50 ||*

*Word for word:* amara sakshate — with Me; katha kahili kakhana — when was it spoken of; bujhiya karyera gati — understanding the course of the matter; kara acharana — act [accordingly]

**50.** When was this ever spoken of with Me?'
Understand how matters stand and act accordingly."[^21-10]

গণকের মুখে এত শুনিঞা বচন ।
ধৈর্য অবলম্বি কিছু না কৈল তখন ॥ ৫১ ॥

*gaṇakera mukhe eta śuniñā bacana |*
*dhairya abalambi kichu nā kaila takhana || 51 ||*

*Word for word:* ganakera mukhe — from the astrologer's mouth; eta shunina bachana — hearing such words; dhairya avalambi — taking courage; kichhu na kaila takhana — said nothing then

**51.** Hearing such words from the astrologer,
[Sanatana] took courage and said nothing at the time.

সনাতন পণ্ডিত সে চরিত্র উদার ।
বন্ধুগণ লঞা করে অনুমান সার ॥ ৫২ ॥

*sanātana paṇḍita se caritra udāra |*
*bandhugaṇa lañā kare anumāna sāra || 52 ||*

*Word for word:* sanatana pandita se — Sanatana Pandita; charitra udara — of noble character; bandhugana lana — with his relatives; kare anumana sara — considers the essential point

**52.** Sanatana Pandita, a man of noble character,
considered the main point with his relatives:

নানা দ্রব্য কৈল নানা কৈল অলঙ্কার ।
কাহারে কি দোষ দিব করম আমার ॥ ৫৩ ॥

*nānā drabya kaila nānā kaila alaṅkāra |*
*kāhāre ki doṣa diba karama āmāra || 53 ||*

*Word for word:* nana dravya kaila — I prepared many things; nana kaila alankara — had many ornaments made; kahare ki dosha diba — whom shall I blame; karama amara — it is my karma

**53.** "I have prepared all kinds of things, had all kinds of ornaments made;
whom shall I blame? It is my karma.

আমি কোন কিছু অপরাধ নাহি করি ।
অকারণে আদর ছাড়িলা গৌরহরি ॥ ৫৪ ॥

*āmi kona kichu aparādha nāhi kari |*
*akāraṇe ādara chāṛilā gaurahari || 54 ||*

*Word for word:* ami kona kichhu — I any; aparadha nahi kari — offence have not committed; akarane — without reason; adara chhadila gaurahari — Gaurahari rejected [my] affection

**54.** I have committed no offence,
yet Gaurahari has without reason rejected [my] love."[^21-11]

গৌরাঙ্গ-সম্বন্ধ-সুখ-ধন হারাইয়া ।
হাহা গৌরচন্দ্র বলি ভূমিতে পড়িয়া ॥ ৫৪+১ ॥

*gaurāṅga-sambandha-sukha-dhana hārāiẏā |*
*hāhā gauracandra bali bhūmite paṛiẏā || 54+1 ||*

*Word for word:* gauranga-sambandha-sukha-dhana — the treasure of the joy of kinship with Gauranga; haraiya — having lost; haha gaurachandra bali — crying "Alas, alas, Gaurachandra!"; bhumite padiya — falling to the ground

**54+1.** Having lost the treasure — the joy of kinship with Gauranga —[^21-12]
he cried "Alas, alas, Gaurachandra!" and fell to the ground.

ফুকারি ফুকারি কান্দে বলে হরি হরি ।
তোমা না দেখিয়া বিশ্বম্ভর আমি মরি ॥ ৫৪+২ ॥

*phukāri phukāri kānde bale hari hari |*
*tomā nā dekhiẏā biśbambhara āmi mari || 54+2 ||*

*Word for word:* phukari phukari kande — weeps aloud; bale hari hari — cries "Hari, Hari!"; toma na dekhiya — not seeing You; vishvambhara — O Vishvambhara; ami mari — I die

**54+2.** He weeps aloud, crying: "Hari, Hari!
Not seeing You, Vishvambhara, I am dying!

জয় পতিতের পরিত্রাণ বিশ্বম্ভর ।
রাখিলে ভীষ্মক-বাঞ্ছা বিদর্ভ-নগরে ॥ ৫৪+৩ ॥

*jaẏa patitera paritrāṇa biśbambhara |*
*rākhile bhīṣmaka-bāñchā bidarbha-nagare || 54+3 ||*

*Word for word:* jaya — glory; patitera paritrana — the deliverer of the fallen; vishvambhara — to Vishvambhara; rakhile — You kept (fulfilled); bhishmaka-vanchha — Bhishmaka's desire; vidarbha-nagare — in the city of Vidarbha

**54+3.** Glory to Vishvambhara, the deliverer of the fallen!
You fulfilled Bhishmaka's desire in the city of Vidarbha.

জয় রুক্মিণীর বাঞ্ছা-রক্ষক মুরারি ।
আনিলে সে নরক-কুমারী যতেক সুন্দরী ॥ ৫৪+৪ ॥

*jaẏa rukmiṇīra bāñchā-rakṣaka murāri |*
*ānile se naraka-kumārī yateka sundarī || 54+4 ||*

*Word for word:* jaya — glory; rukminira vanchha-rakshaka — the guardian of Rukmini's desire; murari — Murari; anile — You brought; se naraka-kumari — those maidens of Naraka; yateka sundari — all the beautiful

**54+4.** Glory to Murari, the guardian of Rukmini's desire!
You brought to Yourself all the beautiful princesses [held captive by] Naraka,

তা সভা করিলা বিভা জানি তার মর্ম ।
মোর কন্যা বিভা কর তুমি সত্য-ধর্ম ॥ ৫৪+৫ ॥

*tā sabhā karilā bibhā jāni tāra marma |*
*mora kanyā bibhā kara tumi satya-dharma || 54+5 ||*

*Word for word:* ta sabha — them all; karila bibha — You married; jani tara marma — knowing their hearts; mora kanya — my daughter; bibha kara — marry; tumi satya-dharma — You are the true dharma

**54+5.** and, knowing their hearts, You married them all.
Marry my daughter too — You are the true dharma!

মোরে ঘৃণা না করিবে পতিত বলিয়া ।
কত কত পতিতেরে লয়্যা তারিলা ॥ ৫৪+৬ ॥

*more ghṛṇā nā karibe patita baliẏā |*
*kata kata patitere laẏyā tārilā || 54+6 ||*

*Word for word:* more — me; ghrina na karibe — do not despise; patita baliya — as one fallen; kata kata patitere — so many fallen ones; laya tarila — taking up, You saved

**54+6.** Do not spurn me in contempt as one fallen:
how many, many fallen ones You have taken up and saved!

জয় বিশ্বম্ভর জগজন-ত্রাণদাতা ।
জয় সর্বেশ্বরেশ্বর বিধির বিধাতা ॥ ৫৪+৭ ॥

*jaẏa biśbambhara jagajana-trāṇadātā |*
*jaẏa sarbeśbareśbara bidhira bidhātā || 54+7 ||*

*Word for word:* jaya — glory; vishvambhara — to Vishvambhara; jagajana-trana-data — the saviour of the people of the world; jaya — glory; sarveshvareshvara — the Lord of all lords; vidhira vidhata — the Creator of the creator

**54+7.** Glory to Vishvambhara, the saviour of the people of the world!
Glory to the Lord of all lords, the Creator of the creator!

মুই সে অধমাধম মতি অতি মন্দ ।
কভু না পাইল তোর ভজনের গন্ধ ॥ ৫৪+৮ ॥

*mui se adhamādhama mati ati manda |*
*kabhu nā pāila tora bhajanera gandha || 54+8 ||*

*Word for word:* mui se — but I; adhamadhama — the lowest of the low; mati ati manda — of very dull mind; kabhu na paila — never obtained; tora bhajanera gandha — the scent of worship of You

**54+8.** But I am the lowest of the low, my mind is very dull:
never have I known even the scent of worship of You."

অন্তরে জন্মিল দুঃখ করিল উদ্গার ।
সন্তপ্ত হৃদয়ে কহে ব্রাহ্মণী তাহার ॥ ৫৫ ॥

*antare janmila duḥkha karila udgāra |*
*santapta hṛdaẏe kahe brāhmaṇī tāhāra || 55 ||*

*Word for word:* antare janmila duhkha — sorrow arose in his heart; karila udgara — he gave voice to it; santapta hridaye — with a burning heart; kahe brahmani tahara — his brahmana wife speaks

**55.** Sorrow arose in his heart, and he gave voice to it;
and his brahmana wife, her heart aflame, speaks —

কুলজা সুলজ্জা কুলবতী পতিব্রতা ।
সর্বগুণশীলা সেই বিষ্ণুর ভকতা ॥ ৫৬ ॥

*kulajā sulajjā kulabatī patibratā |*
*sarbaguṇaśīlā sei biṣṇura bhakatā || 56 ||*

*Word for word:* kulaja sulajja kulavati pativrata — of noble birth, modest, well-bred, faithful to her husband; sarva-guna-shila — of every virtue and good nature; sei vishnura bhakata — she is devoted to Vishnu

**56.** she was of noble birth, modest, well-bred, faithful to her husband,
endowed with every virtue and good nature, devoted to Vishnu —

স্বামি-দুঃখ দেখিয়া পাইল বড় দুঃখ ।
লজ্জা পরিহরি কহে স্বামীর সম্মুখ ॥ ৫৭ ॥

*sbāmi-duḥkha dekhiẏā pāila baṛa duḥkha |*
*lajjā parihari kahe sbāmīra sammukha || 57 ||*

*Word for word:* svami-duhkha dekhiya — seeing her husband's grief; paila bada duhkha — was much grieved; lajja parihari — setting aside shyness; kahe svamira sammukha — speaks before her husband

**57.** seeing her husband's grief, she herself was much grieved
and, setting aside her shyness, speaks before her husband:

আপনে যে বিশ্বম্ভর না করিল কাজ ।
তোমারে কি দোষ দিবে নদীয়া-সমাজ ॥ ৫৮ ॥

*āpane ye biśbambhara nā karila kāja |*
*tomāre ki doṣa dibe nadīẏā-samāja || 58 ||*

*Word for word:* apane ye vishvambhara — if Vishvambhara Himself; na karila kaja — did not do the deed; tomare ki dosha dibe — what blame will lay on you; nadiya-samaja — the people of Nadia

**58.** "If Vishvambhara Himself did not wish this match,
what blame can the people of Nadia lay on you?

আপনে যে না করিলা বিশ্বম্ভর হরি ।
তোমার শকতি কিবা করিবারে পারি ॥ ৫৯ ॥

*āpane ye nā karilā biśbambhara hari |*
*tomāra śakati kibā karibāre pāri || 59 ||*

*Word for word:* apane ye na karila — if Himself did not do; vishvambhara hari — Vishvambhara Hari; tomara shakati — by your power; kiva karibare pari — what can be done

**59.** If Vishvambhara Hari Himself did not wish it,
what can you do by your own power?

স্বতন্ত্র পুরুষ সেই সভার ঈশ্বর ।
ব্রহ্মা-রুদ্র-ইন্দ্র-আদি যাহার কিঙ্কর ॥ ৬০ ॥

*sbatantra puruṣa sei sabhāra īśbara |*
*brahmā-rudra-indra-ādi yāhāra kiṅkara || 60 ||*

*Word for word:* svatantra purusha sei — He is the independent Person; sabhara ishvara — the Lord of all; brahma-rudra-indra-adi — Brahma, Rudra, Indra and others; yahara kinkara — are His servants

**60.** He is the independent Person, the Lord of all,
whose servants are Brahma, Rudra, Indra and the rest.

সে জন কেমতে হইব তোমার জামাতা ।
শান্ত কর মন স্মর কৃষ্ণের বারতা ॥ ৬১ ॥

*se jana kemate haiba tomāra jāmātā |*
*śānta kara mana smara kṛṣṇera bāratā || 61 ||*

*Word for word:* se jana kemate haiba — how can such a Person become; tomara jamata — your son-in-law; shanta kara mana — calm your mind; smara krishnera barata — remember the message of Krishna

**61.** How can He become your son-in-law?
Calm your mind, remember Krishna.

শক্তি-সম্ভবে নাহি দুঃখ অকারণ ।
বলিতে ডরাঙ দুঃখ ঘুচাহ এখন ॥ ৬২ ॥

*śakti-sambhabe nāhi duḥkha akāraṇa |*
*balite ḍarāṅa duḥkha ghucāha ekhana || 62 ||*

*Word for word:* shakti-sambhave nahi — it is not within our power; duhkha akarana — grief is pointless; balite darana — I am afraid to say it; duhkha ghuchaha ekhana — cast off grief now

**62.** It is not in our power — there is no point in grieving;
I am afraid to say it, but cast off your grief now."

এতেক বচন যবে তার প্রিয়া কৈল ।
পণ্ডিত শ্রীসনাতন দুঃখ সম্বরিল ॥ ৬৩ ॥

*eteka bacana yabe tāra priẏā kaila |*
*paṇḍita śrīsanātana duḥkha sambarila || 63 ||*

*Word for word:* eteka bachana — these words; yabe tara priya kaila — when his beloved spoke; pandita shri-sanatana — Pandita Sri Sanatana; duhkha samvarila — restrained his grief

**63.** When his beloved spoke these words to him,
Pandita Sri Sanatana restrained his grief.

বান্ধব-সহিত এই যুক্তি নিবড়িল ।
আমার কি দোষ বিশ্বম্ভর না করিল ॥ ৬৪ ॥

*bāndhaba-sahita ei yukti nibaṛila |*
*āmāra ki doṣa biśbambhara nā karila || 64 ||*

*Word for word:* bandhava-sahita — with relatives; ei yukti nibadila — came to this conclusion; amara ki dosha — what is my fault; vishvambhara na karila — Vishvambhara did not do it

**64.** Together with his relatives he came to this conclusion:
"What is my fault? Vishvambhara did not wish it."

ইহা বলি কারে কিছু না বলিল বাণী ।
অন্তর-দুঃখিত হৈল ব্রাহ্মণ-ব্রাহ্মণী ॥ ৬৫ ॥

*ihā bali kāre kichu nā balila bāṇī |*
*antara-duḥkhita haila brāhmaṇa-brāhmaṇī || 65 ||*

*Word for word:* iha bali — saying this; kare kichhu na balila vani — he said nothing more to anyone; antara-duhkhita haila — grieved at heart; brahmana-brahmani — the brahmana and his wife

**65.** Having said this, he spoke no more to anyone;
the brahmana and his wife grieved at heart.

অন্তরে চিন্তিত পুনঃ খেদ উপজিল ।
হাহা বিশ্বম্ভর দেব মোরে লজ্জা দিল ॥ ৬৬ ॥

*antare cintita punaḥ kheda upajila |*
*hāhā biśbambhara deba more lajjā dila || 66 ||*

*Word for word:* antare chintita — brooding within; punah kheda upajila — sorrow arose again; haha vishvambhara deva — alas, Vishvambhara-deva; more lajja dila — has put me to shame

**66.** He brooded within, and again sorrow arose:
"Alas, Vishvambhara-deva has put me to shame!

জয় জয় দ্রৌপদীর লজ্জা-ভয়-হারী ।
জয় জয় গজকে কুম্ভীর-মুখে তারি ॥ ৬৭ ॥

*jaẏa jaẏa draupadīra lajjā-bhaẏa-hārī |*
*jaẏa jaẏa gajake kumbhīra-mukhe tāri || 67 ||*

*Word for word:* jaya jaya — glory, glory; draupadira lajja-bhaya-hari — to Him who took away Draupadi's shame and fear; gajake kumbhira-mukhe tari — who saved the elephant from the crocodile's jaws

**67.** Glory, glory to You who took away Draupadi's shame and fear!
Glory, glory to You who saved the elephant from the crocodile's jaws![^21-13]

পাণ্ডবের পরিত্রাণ রুক্মিণী-জীবন ।
জয় জয় অহল্যা-দুষ্কৃতি-বিমোচন ॥ ৬৮ ॥

*pāṇḍabera paritrāṇa rukmiṇī-jībana |*
*jaẏa jaẏa ahalyā-duṣkṛti-bimocana || 68 ||*

*Word for word:* pandavera paritrana — saviour of the Pandavas; rukmini-jivana — life of Rukmini; jaya jaya — glory, glory; ahalya-dushkriti-vimochana — who freed Ahalya from her sin

**68.** Saviour of the Pandavas, life of Rukmini!
Glory, glory to You who freed Ahalya from her sin!"

এইমত বহু স্তব কৈল বিপ্রবর ।
জানিল গৌরাঙ্গ প্রভু জগৎ-ঈশ্বর ॥ ৬৯ ॥

*eimata bahu staba kaila biprabara |*
*jānila gaurāṅga prabhu jagat-īśbara || 69 ||*

*Word for word:* eimata bahu stava — thus many prayers; kaila viprabara — offered the best of brahmanas; janila gauranga prabhu — Lord Gauranga knew; jagat-ishvara — the Lord of the world

**69.** Thus the best of brahmanas offered many prayers,
and Lord Gauranga, the Lord of the world, came to know of it.

তবে ত সকল কথা শুনি বিশ্বম্ভর ।
কেনে হেন কৈল দুঃখ ভাবিল অন্তর ॥ ৭০ ॥

*tabe ta sakala kathā śuni biśbambhara |*
*kene hena kaila duḥkha bhābila antara || 70 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe ta sakala katha shuni — then, hearing everything; vishvambhara — Vishvambhara; kene hena kaila duhkha — why do they grieve so; bhavila antara — thought in His heart

**70.** Hearing all about it, Vishvambhara
thought in His heart: "Why are they grieving so?

আমার ভকত দোঁহে দুঃখ পাইল চিতে ।
কৌতুকে কহিল কথা হাসিতে হাসিতে ॥ ৭১ ॥

*āmāra bhakata doṁhe duḥkha pāila cite |*
*kautuke kahila kathā hāsite hāsite || 71 ||*

*Word for word:* amara bhakata donhe — two of My devotees; duhkha paila chite — grieved at heart; kautuke kahila katha — I said it in jest; hasite hasite — laughing

**71.** Two of My devotees have become sad at heart,
and yet I said it in jest, laughing."

প্রিয় একজন ছিল বয়স্যের মাঝে ।
নিভৃতে কহিল তারে যত মনে আছে ॥ ৭২ ॥

*priẏa ekajana chila baẏasyera mājhe |*
*nibhṛte kahila tāre yata mane āche || 72 ||*

*Word for word:* priya eka-jana — one dear [friend]; chhila vayasyera majhe — was among His friends; nibhrite kahila tare — in private He told him; yata mane achhe — all that was in His mind

**72.** Among His friends there was one dear friend;
in private He told him all that was in His mind:

কোন কথাচ্ছলে যাহ পণ্ডিতের ঘর ।
আমি নাহি জানি হেন কহিও উত্তর ॥ ৭৩ ॥

*kona kathācchale yāha paṇḍitera ghara |*
*āmi nāhi jāni hena kahio uttara || 73 ||*

*Word for word:* kona kathachchhale — on some pretext; yaha panditera ghara — go to the pandit's house; ami nahi jani — [as if] I do not know; hena kahio uttara — speak thus

**73.** "On some pretext go to the pandit's house
and speak as though I knew nothing of it:

কৌতুক-রভসে আমি গণকে কহিল ।
না বুঝিয়া কার্য কেনে অবহেলা কৈল ॥ ৭৪ ॥

*kautuka-rabhase āmi gaṇake kahila |*
*nā bujhiẏā kārya kene abahelā kaila || 74 ||*

*Word for word:* kautuka-rabhase — in merry jest; ami ganake kahila — I said to the astrologer; na bujhiya — without understanding; karya kene avahela kaila — why did you neglect the matter

**74.** 'It was in jest that I said this to the astrologer —
why then, without understanding, did [you] give up the matter?

কার্য-অবহেলা তাহে নাহিক অধিক ।
সে দোঁহার চিত্তে দুঃখ এ নহে উচিত ॥ ৭৫ ॥

*kārya-abahelā tāhe nāhika adhika |*
*se doṁhāra citte duḥkha e nahe ucita || 75 ||*

*Word for word:* karya-avahela — neglecting the matter; tahe nahika adhika — there is no reason at all; se donhara chitte duhkha — grief in the hearts of the two; e nahe uchita — this is not right

**75.** There is no reason at all to give up the matter;
it is not right that the two of them should grieve.

মায়ে যে বলিল তাহে কি আছয়ে কথা ।
তাহার উপরে আর কে করে অন্যথা ॥ ৭৬ ॥

*māẏe ye balila tāhe ki āchaẏe kathā |*
*tāhāra upare āra ke kare anyathā || 76 ||*

*Word for word:* maye ye balila — what the mother said; tahe ki achhaye katha — what more is there to say; tahara upare — against that; ara ke kare anyatha — who would act otherwise

**76.** What His mother has said — what more is there to discuss?
Who would go against her word?

মিছা কার্যক্ষতি মিছা দুঃখ ভাব চিতে ।
করহ বিভার কার্য যে হয় উচিতে ॥ ৭৭ ॥

*michā kāryakṣati michā duḥkha bhāba cite |*
*karaha bibhāra kārya ye haẏa ucite || 77 ||*

*Word for word:* michha karya-kshati — the matter suffers for nothing; michha duhkha bhava chite — you grieve at heart for nothing; karaha vibhara karya — do the work of the wedding; ye haya uchite — as is proper

**77.** The matter suffers for nothing, you grieve for nothing;
do all that is proper for the wedding.'"

এতেক শিখাঞা প্রভু ব্রাহ্মণ পাঠাইল ।
সনাতন পণ্ডিতেরে সকল কহিল ॥ ৭৮ ॥

*eteka śikhāñā prabhu brāhmaṇa pāṭhāila |*
*sanātana paṇḍitere sakala kahila || 78 ||*

*Word for word:* eteka shikhana — having so instructed; prabhu brahmana pathaila — the Lord sent the brahmana; sanatana panditere — to Sanatana Pandita; sakala kahila — he related everything

**78.** Having so instructed him, the Lord sent the brahmana,
and he related everything to Sanatana Pandita.

[^21-1]: Cf. en/17, note 4: Lakshmipriya is Lakshmi herself. Lochana Dasa presents the serpent's bite as separation from the Lord that has taken the form of a serpent — and so does Bhaktisiddhanta in his summary: "bitten by the serpent of separation". Her departure is not a mundane death: she goes to the Lord (v. 118). Cf. Murari 1.11.21–28.
[^21-2]: The 1983 edition has it the other way round: a portion of Lakshmi went to heaven (svarga), and Lakshmi herself to Vaikuntha, "her own abode". In A Indra's city is called her abode in agreement with the Lord's story of the apsara (vv. 151–155). Gaudiya Vaishnavas, following Murari (1.12.17) and Vrindavana Dasa, see in Lakshmipriya Lakshmi herself, who went to the feet of her Lord; the story of the apsara is the words with which the Lord consoled His mother while concealing Himself (cf. v. 159).
[^21-3]: The 1983 edition: "having married, Vishvambhara went to foreign lands".
[^21-4]: "Mithya" ("deceptive, false") here refers to the transience of worldly life and of bodies, not to the unreality of the world in the Mayavada sense; the one eternal Reality is Krishna (v. 136).
[^21-5]: Cf. Murari 1.12.13–17, where the Lord tells the same story "concealing everything with words strong to hide His own self" and adds: "Or else it was the Mistress of the world herself, in the form of Lakshmi, who went to the lotus feet of her Lord". See note 2.
[^21-6]: I.e. without revealing His divinity. V. 158 is absent in the 1983 edition.
[^21-7]: Bhaktisiddhanta's summary does not include the episode with the astrologer (vv. 45–78); in the scan this summary is damaged in places and is translated from the surviving text.
[^21-8]: The name of the raga is illegible in the scan of A; raga gandhara follows the 1983 edition (where this is the "Sixth Chapter").
[^21-9]: Gaudiya Vaishnavas honour Vishnupriya as the embodiment of Bhu-shakti, the Lord's energy. Cf. Murari 1.13.13–15.
[^21-10]: The Lord's jest: He pretends to know nothing of the wedding. Cf. Murari 1.13.18–21. The second line is the astrologer's advice to Sanatana.
[^21-11]: Cf. Murari 1.13.22–30.
[^21-12]: Vv. 54+1 – 54+8 are found only in the 1983 edition (absent from Bhaktisiddhanta's edition); the 1903 edition gives them in a footnote as the additional reading of one manuscript. Bhishmaka is the king of Vidarbha, Rukmini's father; Rukmini longed to become Krishna's wife, and He carried her away (Bhagavata 10.52–54). Naraka (Bhaumasura) held sixteen thousand princesses captive; Krishna, having slain him, freed them and married them (10.59).
[^21-13]: On Draupadi, Gajendra and the others see en/17, note 6. Ahalya — the wife of the sage Gautama, freed from a curse by the touch of Rama's foot.

---

# Adi-khanda, part 14 (portion 22)

*The second wedding (conclusion): the adhivasa of the Lord and of Vishnupriya; the wedding morning; the bridegroom's attire and the bride's beauty; the wedding procession and the excitement of the women of Nadia; the welcoming of the bridegroom, the exchange of glances and the giving away of the bride in Sanatana's house; the wedding night, the kushandika, Sanatana's farewell; Shachi welcomes the couple home*

*Raga ramakeli; disha: "Hari, Rama, Narayana — Shachi's darling, golden Gora!"*

তবে ত পণ্ডিত অতি হরষিত মনে ।
আনন্দে করয়ে শুভদিন শুভক্ষণে ॥ ৭৯ ॥

*tabe ta paṇḍita ati haraṣita mane |*
*ānande karaẏe śubhadina śubhakṣaṇe || 79 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe ta — then; pandita — the pandit; ati harashita mane — with great joy in his heart; anande — happily; karaye — fixes; shubha-dina shubha-kshane — an auspicious day and an auspicious moment

**79.** Then the pandit, with great joy in his heart,
happily fixes an auspicious day and an auspicious moment.

এথা প্রভু বিশ্বম্ভর এছন জানিঞা ।
শুভদিন করে ঘরে গণক আনিঞা ॥ ৮০ ॥

*ethā prabhu biśbambhara echana jāniñā |*
*śubhadina kare ghare gaṇaka āniñā || 80 ||*

*Word for word:* etha — here; prabhu vishvambhara — the Lord Vishvambhara; echhana janina — learning of this; shubha-dina kare — fixes the auspicious day; ghare — at home; ganaka anina — calling an astrologer

**80.** And here the Lord Vishvambhara, learning of it,
called an astrologer to His house and fixes the auspicious day.

চর্চিয়া করিল দিন সময় বিচিত্র ।
শুভকাল শুভলগ্ন তিথি সুনক্ষত্র ॥ ৮১ ॥

*carciẏā karila dina samaẏa bicitra |*
*śubhakāla śubhalagna tithi sunakṣatra || 81 ||*

*Word for word:* charchiya — after deliberation; karila dina — they fixed the day; samaya vichitra — a wonderful time; shubha-kala — auspicious hour; shubha-lagna — auspicious lagna; tithi — lunar day; su-nakshatra — favourable nakshatra

**81.** After deliberation they fixed the day, a wonderful time:
an auspicious hour, an auspicious lagna, tithi and a favourable nakshatra[^22-1].

অধিবাস-কালে সাধু ব্রাহ্মণ সজ্জন ।
মিলিয়া করিল প্রভুর শুভ প্রয়োজন ॥ ৮২ ॥

*adhibāsa-kāle sādhu brāhmaṇa sajjana |*
*miliẏā karila prabhura śubha praẏojana || 82 ||*

*Word for word:* adhivasa-kale — at the time of the adhivasa; sadhu — holy men; brahmana — brahmanas; sajjana — good people; miliya — gathering; karila — arranged; prabhura — for the Lord; shubha prayojana — what the auspicious rite required

**82.** At the time of the adhivasa, holy men, brahmanas and good people
gathered and arranged for the Lord all that the auspicious rite required.

আনন্দিত শচীদেবী আইহ-সুহ লঞা ।
পুত্র-মহোৎসব করে নানা দ্রব্য দিয়া ॥ ৮৩ ॥

*ānandita śacīdebī āiha-suha lañā |*
*putra-mahotsaba kare nānā drabya diẏā || 83 ||*

*Word for word:* anandita shachidevi — joyful Shachi-devi; aiha-suha lana — gathering the married women; putra-mahotsava kare — celebrates her son's festival; nana dravya diya — giving all kinds of gifts

**83.** Joyful Shachi-devi, gathering the married women,
celebrates her son's festival, giving all kinds of gifts:

তৈল হরিদ্রা আর ললাটে সিন্দুর ।
খদি কদলক আর সন্দেশ তাম্বূল ॥ ৮৪ ॥

*taila haridrā āra lalāṭe sindura |*
*khadi kadalaka āra sandeśa tāmbūla || 84 ||*

*Word for word:* taila — oil; haridra — turmeric; ara — and; lalate sindura — sindura on the forehead; khadi — puffed rice; kadalaka — bananas; sandesha — sweets; tambula — betel

**84.** oil, turmeric and sindura for the forehead,
puffed rice, bananas, sweets and betel.

আনন্দে মঙ্গল গায় যত আইহগণ ।
প্রভু-অধিবাস করে যতেক ব্রাহ্মণ ॥ ৮৫ ॥

*ānande maṅgala gāẏa yata āihagaṇa |*
*prabhu-adhibāsa kare yateka brāhmaṇa || 85 ||*

*Word for word:* anande — joyfully; mangala gaya — sing auspicious songs; yata aiha-gana — all the married women; prabhu-adhivasa kare — perform the Lord's adhivasa; yateka brahmana — all the brahmanas

**85.** Joyfully all the married women sing auspicious songs;
all the brahmanas perform the Lord's adhivasa.

ধূপ দীপ পতাকা শোভিত দিগন্তরে ।
স্বস্তিবাচন-পূর্ব দেবপূজা করে ॥ ৮৬ ॥

*dhūpa dīpa patākā śobhita digantare |*
*sbastibācana-pūrba debapūjā kare || 86 ||*

*Word for word:* dhupa — incense; dipa — lamps; pataka — banners; shobhita digantare — the quarters are adorned; svastivachana-purva — after the svastivachana blessings; deva-puja kare — they worship the gods

**86.** All the quarters are adorned with incense, lamps and banners;
after the svastivachana blessings they worship the gods.

ব্রাহ্মণেতে বেদ পড়ে বাজে শুভশঙ্খ ।
নানাবিধ বাদ্য বাজে পটহ মৃদঙ্গ ॥ ৮৭ ॥

*brāhmaṇete beda paṛe bāje śubhaśaṅkha |*
*nānābidha bādya bāje paṭaha mṛdaṅga || 87 ||*

*Word for word:* brahmanete veda pade — the brahmanas recite the Vedas; baje shubha-shankha — auspicious conches sound; nanavidha vadya baje — all kinds of instruments play; pataha mridanga — patahas and mridangas

**87.** The brahmanas recite the Vedas, auspicious conches sound,
all kinds of instruments play — pataha drums and mridangas.

চৌদিকেতে কুলবধূ দেই জয় জয় ।
প্রভু-অধিবাস হৈল উত্তম সময় ॥ ৮৮ ॥

*caudikete kulabadhū dei jaẏa jaẏa |*
*prabhu-adhibāsa haila uttama samaẏa || 88 ||*

*Word for word:* chaudikete — on all sides; kulavadhu — wives of noble families; dei jaya jaya — cry "Jaya, jaya!"; prabhu-adhivasa haila — the Lord's adhivasa took place; uttama samaya — at an excellent hour

**88.** On all sides the wives of noble families cry "Jaya, jaya!";
the Lord's adhivasa fell at an excellent hour.

গন্ধ-চন্দন-মাল্যে পূজিল ব্রাহ্মণ ।
কর্পূর তাম্বূল আর ভূরি বিভূষণ ॥ ৮৯ ॥

*gandha-candana-mālye pūjila brāhmaṇa |*
*karpūra tāmbūla āra bhūri bibhūṣaṇa || 89 ||*

*Word for word:* gandha-chandana-malye — with scents, sandal and garlands; pujila brahmana — the brahmanas were honoured; karpura — camphor; tambula — betel; ara — and; bhuri vibhushana — many ornaments

**89.** The brahmanas were honoured with scents, sandal and garlands,
with camphor, betel and many ornaments.

হেনকালে পণ্ডিত শ্রীযুত সনাতন ।
অতিশ্রদ্ধাযুত সেই উলসিত-মন ॥ ৯০ ॥

*henakāle paṇḍita śrīyuta sanātana |*
*atiśraddhāyuta sei ulasita-mana || 90 ||*

*Word for word:* henakale — at this time; pandita shriyuta sanatana — the venerable pandit Sanatana; ati-shraddha-yuta — full of reverence; sei ulasita-mana — his heart rejoicing

**90.** At this time the venerable pandit Sanatana,
full of reverence, his heart rejoicing,

ব্রাহ্মণ পাঠাইল আর বিপ্রসাধ্বীগণ ।
জামাতার অধিবাস করিবার মন ॥ ৯১ ॥

*brāhmaṇa pāṭhāila āra biprasādhbīgaṇa |*
*jāmātāra adhibāsa karibāra mana || 91 ||*

*Word for word:* brahmana pathaila — sent brahmanas; ara vipra-sadhvi-gana — and virtuous brahmana wives; jamatara adhivasa — the son-in-law's adhivasa; karibara mana — wishing to perform

**91.** sent brahmanas and virtuous brahmana wives,
wishing to perform the adhivasa of his son-in-law,

আপনে আপন-কন্যা-অধিবাস করে ।
ঝলমল করে অঙ্গ রত্ন-অলঙ্কারে ॥ ৯২ ॥

*āpane āpana-kanyā-adhibāsa kare |*
*jhalamala kare aṅga ratna-alaṅkāre || 92 ||*

*Word for word:* apane — himself; apana-kanya-adhivasa kare — performs the adhivasa of his own daughter; jhalamala kare anga — [her] body glitters; ratna-alankare — with jewelled ornaments
