*Word for word:* eta bujhaiya — having explained thus; prabhu jagatera guru — the Lord, the Teacher of the world; chalila pathete — went on His way; prabhu vanchha-kalpataru — the Lord, the Wish-fulfilling Tree

**28.** Having explained all this, the Lord, the Teacher of the world,
the Lord who is the Wish-fulfilling Tree, went on His way.

তবে সেই চিরনামে আছে এক নদী ।
স্নানদান কৈল প্রভু যে আছিল বিধি ॥ ২৯ ॥

*tabe sei ciranāme āche eka nadī |*
*snānadāna kaila prabhu ye āchila bidhi || 29 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe — then; sei chira-name — named Chira; achhe eka nadi — there is a river; snana-dana kaila prabhu — the Lord bathed and gave gifts; ye achhila vidhi — as was prescribed

**29.** Then — a river named Chira;
there the Lord bathed and gave gifts as prescribed[^23-4].

দেবপূজা পিতৃপূজা করি হরষিতে ।
মন্দারে উঠিলা প্রভু দেবতা দেখিতে ॥ ৩০ ॥

*debapūjā pitṛpūjā kari haraṣite |*
*mandāre uṭhilā prabhu debatā dekhite || 30 ||*

*Word for word:* deva-puja pitri-puja — worship of gods and ancestors; kari harashite — joyfully performing; mandare uthila prabhu — the Lord climbed Mandara; devata dekhite — to see the Deity

**30.** Joyfully performing the worship of the gods and the ancestors,
the Lord climbed Mandara to see the Deity.

দেবতা দেখিয়া প্রভু নামিলা সত্বর ।
পর্বত-নিকটে বাসা ব্রাহ্মণের ঘর ॥ ৩১ ॥

*debatā dekhiẏā prabhu nāmilā satbara |*
*parbata-nikaṭe bāsā brāhmaṇera ghara || 31 ||*

*Word for word:* devata dekhiya — having seen the Deity; prabhu namila satvara — the Lord quickly descended; parvata-nikate — near the mountain; basa — lodging; brahmanera ghara — in a brahmana's house

**31.** Having seen the Deity, the Lord quickly came down;
at the foot of the mountain He stayed in a brahmana's house.

হেনকালে বিশ্বম্ভর-সঙ্গের ব্রাহ্মণ ।
সে-দেশের বিপ্র দেখি দোষে তার মন ॥ ৩২ ॥

*henakāle biśbambhara-saṅgera brāhmaṇa |*
*se-deśera bipra dekhi doṣe tāra mana || 32 ||*

*Word for word:* henakale — then; vishvambhara-sangera brahmana — the brahmanas accompanying Vishvambhara; se-deshera vipra dekhi — seeing the brahmanas of that land; doshe tara mana — their minds find fault

**32.** Then the brahmanas accompanying Vishvambhara,
seeing the brahmanas of that land, found fault with them in their minds.

দেশ-আচরণ তারা করে যথাবিধি ।
দেখিয়া ব্রাহ্মণে তার নাহি বিপ্রবুদ্ধি ॥ ৩৩ ॥

*deśa-ācaraṇa tārā kare yathābidhi |*
*dekhiẏā brāhmaṇe tāra nāhi biprabuddhi || 33 ||*

*Word for word:* desha-acharana — the customs of their land; tara kare yathavidhi — they follow as is their rule; dekhiya — seeing [this]; brahmane — in those brahmanas; tara nahi vipra-buddhi — they did not see brahmanas

**33.** These followed the customs of their land as was their way;
seeing this, [the Lord's companions] did not regard them as brahmanas[^23-5].

ব্রাহ্মণে অবজ্ঞা দেখি প্রভু বিশ্বম্ভর ।
প্রকাশিব দ্বিজভক্তি করিলা অন্তর ॥ ৩৪ ॥

*brāhmaṇe abajñā dekhi prabhu biśbambhara |*
*prakāśiba dbijabhakti karilā antara || 34 ||*

*Word for word:* brahmane avajna dekhi — seeing disregard for brahmanas; prabhu vishvambhara — the Lord Vishvambhara; prakashiba dvija-bhakti — I shall show reverence for brahmanas; karila antara — resolved in His heart

**34.** Seeing this disregard for brahmanas, the Lord Vishvambhara
resolved to show reverence for brahmanas.

আচম্বিতে প্রভুদেহে আইল মহাজ্বর ।
জ্বর দেখি ত্রাস পাইল সভার অন্তর ॥ ৩৫ ॥

*ācambite prabhudehe āila mahājbara |*
*jbara dekhi trāsa pāila sabhāra antara || 35 ||*

*Word for word:* achambite — suddenly; prabhu-dehe aila maha-jvara — a high fever came upon the Lord's body; jvara dekhi — seeing the fever; trasa paila sabhara antara — all were frightened at heart

**35.** Suddenly a high fever seized the Lord's body;
seeing the fever, all were frightened at heart[^23-6].

বলিলা ঠাকুর শুন শুন সর্বজন ।
দেব-পিতৃকার্যে বিঘ্ন ভেল কি-কারণ ॥ ৩৬ ॥

*balilā ṭhākura śuna śuna sarbajana |*
*deba-pitṛkārye bighna bhela ki-kāraṇa || 36 ||*

*Word for word:* balila thakura — the Thakura said; shuna shuna sarvajana — listen, listen, all of you; deva-pitri-karye — to the rite for gods and ancestors; vighna bhela — an obstacle arose; ki-karana — for what reason

**36.** The Thakura said: "Listen, listen, all of you:
for what reason has an obstacle arisen to the rite for the gods and the ancestors?

না জানি কি মোর দোষে সঙ্গিগণ-দোষে ।
শ্রেয়ঃকার্যে বিঘ্ন হয় বড় অসন্তোষে ॥ ৩৭ ॥

*nā jāni ki mora doṣe saṅgigaṇa-doṣe |*
*śreẏaḥkārye bighna haẏa baṛa asantoṣe || 37 ||*

*Word for word:* na jani — I do not know; ki mora doshe — whether through My fault; sangi-gana-doshe — or through the fault of My companions; shreyah-karye vighna haya — an obstacle arises to the auspicious work; bada asantoshe — to great displeasure

**37.** I do not know — through My fault or through the fault of My companions —
an obstacle has arisen to the auspicious work, and this grieves Me greatly.

সর্ববিঘ্ন-নিবারণ আছয়ে উপায় ।
বিপ্রপাদোদক মোরে দেহ ত জুড়ায় ॥ ৩৮ ॥

*sarbabighna-nibāraṇa āchaẏe upāẏa |*
*biprapādodaka more deha ta juṛāẏa || 38 ||*

*Word for word:* sarva-vighna-nivarana — removing all obstacles; achhaye upaya — there is a remedy; vipra-padodaka — the water of a brahmana's feet; more deha ta — give Me; judaya — it brings relief

**38.** There is a remedy that removes all obstacles:
give Me the water that has washed a brahmana's feet — it will bring relief.

বিপ্রপাদোদক খাইলে সর্বপাপ হরে ।
এখনে ঘুচিব জ্বর কি করিতে পারে ॥ ৩৯ ॥

*biprapādodaka khāile sarbapāpa hare |*
*ekhane ghuciba jbara ki karite pāre || 39 ||*

*Word for word:* vipra-padodaka khaile — when the water of a brahmana's feet is drunk; sarva-papa hare — it destroys all sins; ekhane ghuchiba jvara — the fever will go at once; ki karite pare — what can it do

**39.** The water of a brahmana's feet, when drunk, destroys all sins —
the fever will go at once: what can it do?"

সেইখানে সেইদেশী আছিল ব্রাহ্মণ ।
আপনে উঠিয়া তার পাখালে চরণ ॥ ৪০ ॥

*seikhāne seideśī āchila brāhmaṇa |*
*āpane uṭhiẏā tāra pākhāle caraṇa || 40 ||*

*Word for word:* seikhane — there; sei-deshi achhila brahmana — there was a local brahmana; apane uthiya — rising Himself; tara pakhale charana — washed his feet

**40.** A local brahmana was there;
[the Lord] rose Himself and washed his feet.

বিপ্রপাদোদক-পান কৈল বিশ্বম্ভর ।
প্রকাশিল দ্বিজভক্তি পলাইল জ্বর ॥ ৪১ ॥

*biprapādodaka-pāna kaila biśbambhara |*
*prakāśila dbijabhakti palāila jbara || 41 ||*

*Word for word:* vipra-padodaka-pana kaila — drank the water of the brahmana's feet; vishvambhara — Vishvambhara; prakashila dvija-bhakti — showed reverence for brahmanas; palaila jvara — the fever fled

**41.** Vishvambhara drank the water of the brahmana's feet,
showed reverence for brahmanas — and the fever fled.

সঙ্কোচে সে দ্বিজবর বোলে চাটুবাণী ।
আমার অন্তর-দোষে দুঃখ পাইলে তুমি ॥ ৪২ ॥

*saṅkoce se dbijabara bole cāṭubāṇī |*
*āmāra antara-doṣe duḥkha pāile tumi || 42 ||*

*Word for word:* sankoche — abashed; se dvijavara — that best of brahmanas; bole chatu-vani — speaks humble words; amara antara-doshe — because of the fault in my heart; duhkha paile tumi — You suffered pain

**42.** Then the abashed best of brahmanas speaks humble words:
"Because of the fault in my heart You have suffered pain.

কুৎসিত আচার দেখি মোর মন দোষে ।
মোর মন-দোষে তুমি পাইলে অসন্তোষে ॥ ৪৩ ॥

*kutsita ācāra dekhi mora mana doṣe |*
*mora mana-doṣe tumi pāile asantoṣe || 43 ||*

*Word for word:* kutsita achara dekhi — seeing [their] customs as bad; mora mana doshe — my mind found fault; mora mana-doshe — because of my mind's fault; tumi paile asantoshe — You were displeased

**43.** Seeing [their] customs as bad, my mind found fault [with them];
because of the fault in my mind You were displeased.

এখনে ব্রাহ্মণভক্তি প্রকাশিলে তুমি ।
অপরাধ কৈলু দেব ক্ষমিবে আপনি ॥ ৪৪ ॥

*ekhane brāhmaṇabhakti prakāśile tumi |*
*aparādha kailu deba kṣamibe āpani || 44 ||*

*Word for word:* ekhane — now; brahmana-bhakti prakashile tumi — You have shown reverence for brahmanas; aparadha kailu — I committed an offence; deva — Lord; kshamibe apani — please forgive

**44.** Now You have shown reverence for brahmanas;
I have committed an offence — You, Lord, forgive me.

তুমি সে ব্রহ্মণ্য দ্বিজভক্তি-অধিকারী ।
ভৃগুমুনি-পদচিহ্ন নিজবক্ষে ধরি ॥ ৪৫ ॥

*tumi se brahmaṇya dbijabhakti-adhikārī |*
*bhṛgumuni-padacihna nijabakṣe dhari || 45 ||*

*Word for word:* tumi se brahmanya — You are Brahmanya; dvija-bhakti-adhikari — the guardian of reverence for brahmanas; bhrigu-muni-pada-chihna — the mark of the sage Bhrigu's foot; nija-vakshe dhari — bearing on Your chest

**45.** You are Brahmanya, You are the guardian of reverence for brahmanas,
bearing on Your chest the mark of the sage Bhrigu's foot[^23-7].

নিজভক্তি-মহিমা প্রকাশ নিজমুখে ।
জগতের নিস্তার করহ এইরূপে ॥ ৪৬ ॥

*nijabhakti-mahimā prakāśa nijamukhe |*
*jagatera nistāra karaha eirūpe || 46 ||*

*Word for word:* nija-bhakti-mahima — the glory of devotion to You; prakasha nija-mukhe — You reveal with Your own lips; jagatera nistara karaha — You deliver the world; ei-rupe — in this way

**46.** With Your own lips You reveal the glory of devotion to You
and thus deliver the world.

জয় বিশ্বম্ভরপ্রিয় জয় দ্বিজরাজ ।
তোমায় সেবিলে সিদ্ধ হয় সব কাজ ॥ ৪৭ ॥

*jaẏa biśbambharapriẏa jaẏa dbijarāja |*
*tomāẏa sebile siddha haẏa saba kāja || 47 ||*

*Word for word:* jaya vishvambhara-priya — glory, beloved Vishvambhara; jaya dvijaraja — glory, king of brahmanas; tomaya sevile — by serving You; siddha haya saba kaja — every undertaking succeeds

**47.** Glory to You, beloved Vishvambhara! Glory to You, king of brahmanas!
For one who serves You every undertaking succeeds.

নম দ্বিজবল্লভ দয়ালু গৌরহরি ।
নম ধর্মসংস্থাপন সর্ব অধিকারী ॥ ৪৮ ॥

*nama dbijaballabha daẏālu gaurahari |*
*nama dharmasaṃsthāpana sarba adhikārī || 48 ||*

*Word for word:* nama — obeisance; dvija-vallabha — lover of brahmanas; dayalu gaurahari — merciful Gaurahari; nama — obeisance; dharma-samsthapana — establisher of dharma; sarva adhikari — Lord of all

**48.** Obeisance to You, merciful Gaurahari, lover of brahmanas!
Obeisance to You, establisher of dharma, Lord of all!"

সঙ্গীর এতেক বাক্য শুনি বিশ্বম্ভর ।
ক্ষমা কৈলা সভাকার দোষ বহুতর ॥ ৪৯ ॥

*saṅgīra eteka bākya śuni biśbambhara |*
*kṣamā kailā sabhākāra doṣa bahutara || 49 ||*

*Word for word:* sangira eteka vakya — such words of the companion; shuni vishvambhara — hearing, Vishvambhara; kshama kaila — forgave; sabhakara dosha bahutara — the many faults of all

**49.** Hearing such words from His companion, Vishvambhara
forgave all of them their many faults.

ইহারা পূজয়ে মধুসূদন ঠাকুর ।
এ সকল ত্যজ্য নহে না ভাবিহ দূর ॥ ৫০ ॥

*ihārā pūjaẏe madhusūdana ṭhākura |*
*e sakala tyajya nahe nā bhābiha dūra || 50 ||*

*Word for word:* ihara pujaye — they worship; madhusudana thakura — Thakura Madhusudana; e sakala tyajya nahe — these are not to be rejected; na bhaviha dura — do not consider them outsiders

**50.** "They worship Thakura Madhusudana;
they are not to be rejected — do not regard them as outsiders.

কৃষ্ণ না ভজিলে দ্বিজ নহে কদাচিত ।
পুরাণে প্রমাণ এই শিক্ষা আছে নীত ॥ ৫১ ॥

*kṛṣṇa nā bhajile dbija nahe kadācita |*
*purāṇe pramāṇa ei śikṣā āche nīta || 51 ||*

*Word for word:* krishna na bhajile — one who does not worship Krishna; dvija nahe kadachita — is never twice-born; purane pramana — the proof is in the Puranas; ei shiksha achhe nita — this teaching is established

**51.** One who does not worship Krishna is never twice-born —
this teaching is confirmed by the Puranas."

*Thus [it is said][^23-8]:*

চণ্ডালোঽপি মুনেঃ শ্রেষ্ঠো বিষ্ণুভক্তিপরায়ণঃ ।
বিষ্ণুভক্তিবিহীনস্তু দ্বিজোঽপি শ্বপচাধমঃ ॥ ৫২ ॥

*caṇḍālo'pi muneḥ śreṣṭho biṣṇubhaktiparāẏaṇaḥ |*
*biṣṇubhaktibihīnastu dbijo'pi śbapacādhamaḥ || 52 ||*

*Word for word:* chandalah api — even a chandala; muneh shreshthah — better than a sage; vishnu-bhakti-parayanah — devoted to Vishnu; vishnu-bhakti-vihinah tu — but devoid of devotion to Vishnu; dvijah api — even a twice-born; shvapacha-adhamah — lower than a dog-eater

**52.** "Even a chandala devoted to Vishnu is better than a sage;
but a twice-born devoid of devotion to Vishnu is lower than a dog-eater."

ইহা বলি সঙ্গের ব্রাহ্মণে তুষ্ট হইয়া ।
দোষ ক্ষমাইলা তারে প্রসন্ন হইয়া ॥ ৫৩ ॥

*ihā bali saṅgera brāhmaṇe tuṣṭa haiẏā |*
*doṣa kṣamāilā tāre prasanna haiẏā || 53 ||*

*Word for word:* iha bali — saying this; sangera brahmane — with the brahmana companions; tushta haiya — pleased; dosha kshamaila tare — forgave them their fault; prasanna haiya — graciously

**53.** Saying this, He was pleased with His brahmana companions
and graciously forgave them their fault.

এইমতে প্রভু দ্বিজভক্তি প্রকাশিয়া ।
পুনঃপুনা-নদীতীর্থে উত্তরিলা গিয়া ॥ ৫৪ ॥

*eimate prabhu dbijabhakti prakāśiẏā |*
*punaḥpunā-nadītīrthe uttarilā giẏā || 54 ||*

*Word for word:* eimate — thus; prabhu dvija-bhakti prakashiya — the Lord, having shown reverence for brahmanas; punahpuna-nadi-tirthe — at the holy place on the river Punahpuna; uttarila giya — arrived

**54.** Having thus shown reverence for brahmanas,
[the Lord] came to the holy place on the river Punahpuna.

স্নান-দেবার্চন তথি করিলা তখন ।
পিতৃকার্য সমাধিয়া করিলা গমন ॥ ৫৫ ॥

*snāna-debārcana tathi karilā takhana |*
*pitṛkārya samādhiẏā karilā gamana || 55 ||*

*Word for word:* snana-devarchana — bath and worship of the Deity; tathi karila takhana — He performed there then; pitri-karya samadhiya — completing the rites for the ancestors; karila gamana — went on

**55.** Performing there His bath and the worship of the Deity,
and completing the rites for the ancestors, He went on.

তবে ত উত্তম তীর্থ রাজগিরি নাম ।
ব্রহ্মকুণ্ডে গিয়া প্রভু কৈল স্নানদান ॥ ৫৬ ॥

*tabe ta uttama tīrtha rājagiri nāma |*
*brahmakuṇḍe giẏā prabhu kaila snānadāna || 56 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe ta — then; uttama tirtha — an excellent holy place; rajagiri nama — named Rajagiri; brahma-kunde giya — coming to the Brahma-kunda; prabhu kaila snana-dana — the Lord bathed and gave gifts

**56.** Then — the excellent holy place called Rajagiri:
coming to the Brahma-kunda, the Lord bathed and gave gifts[^23-9].

দেবপূজা পিতৃপূজা কৈলা সেই ঠায় ।
বিষ্ণুপদ দেখিবারে চলিলা ত্বরায় ॥ ৫৭ ॥

*debapūjā pitṛpūjā kailā sei ṭhāẏa |*
*biṣṇupada dekhibāre calilā tbarāẏa || 57 ||*

*Word for word:* deva-puja pitri-puja — worship of gods and ancestors; kaila sei thaya — He performed there; vishnupada dekhibare — to see the Vishnupada; chalila tvaraya — He hastened

**57.** Having performed there the worship of the gods and the ancestors,
He hastened to see the Vishnupada.

যাইতে দেখিল পথে এক ন্যাসিবর ।
মহাভাগবত নাম পুরী যে ঈশ্বর ॥ ৫৮ ॥

*yāite dekhila pathe eka nyāsibara |*
*mahābhāgabata nāma purī ye īśbara || 58 ||*

*Word for word:* yaite — going; dekhila pathe — saw on the road; eka nyasivara — the best of sannyasis; mahabhagavata — a maha-bhagavata; nama puri ye ishvara — named Ishvara Puri

**58.** On the way He saw the best of sannyasis,
a maha-bhagavata named Ishvara Puri.

প্রণাম করিয়া তারে বৈল বিশ্বম্ভর ।
বড় ভাগ্যে দেখিল এ চরণযুগল ॥ ৫৯ ॥

*praṇāma kariẏā tāre baila biśbambhara |*
*baṛa bhāgye dekhila e caraṇayugala || 59 ||*

*Word for word:* pranama kariya tare — bowing to him; baila vishvambhara — Vishvambhara said; bada bhagye — by great fortune; dekhila e charana-yugala — I have seen these two feet

**59.** Bowing to him, Vishvambhara said:
"By great good fortune I have seen these two feet!"

চরণে পড়িয়া বোলে বচন কাতর ।
করুণ অরুণ আঁখি করে ছলছল ॥ ৬০ ॥

*caraṇe paṛiẏā bole bacana kātara |*
*karuṇa aruṇa āṁkhi kare chalachala || 60 ||*

*Word for word:* charane padiya — falling at his feet; bole vachana katara — speaks plaintive words; karuna aruna ankhi — eyes full of entreaty and reddened; kare chhalachhala — brim with tears

**60.** Falling at his feet, He speaks plaintive words;
His eyes, reddened and full of entreaty, fill with tears:

কেমনে তরিব এই সংসার-সাগরে ।
কৃষ্ণপাদাম্বুজ-ভক্তি দেহ ত আমারে ॥ ৬১ ॥

*kemane tariba ei saṃsāra-sāgare |*
*kṛṣṇapādāmbuja-bhakti deha ta āmāre || 61 ||*

*Word for word:* kemane tariba — how shall I cross; ei samsara-sagare — this ocean of samsara; krishna-padambuja-bhakti — devotion to Krishna's lotus feet; deha ta amare — grant Me

**61.** "How shall I cross this ocean of samsara?
Grant Me devotion to Krishna's lotus feet.

কৃষ্ণদীক্ষা বিনু দেহ অকারণ দেখি ।
পুরাণে এ সব বাক্য সাধুমুখে সাক্ষী ॥ ৬২ ॥

*kṛṣṇadīkṣā binu deha akāraṇa dekhi |*
*purāṇe e saba bākya sādhumukhe sākṣī || 62 ||*

*Word for word:* krishna-diksha vinu — without Krishna initiation; deha akarana dekhi — the body, I see, is useless; purane e saba vakya — all these words in the Puranas; sadhu-mukhe sakshi — and the lips of saints bear witness

**62.** Without initiation into the Krishna mantra the body, I see, is useless:
the words of the Puranas and the lips of the saints all bear witness to this"[^23-10].

এছন শুনিঞা বাণী পুরী যে ঈশ্বর ।
নিভৃতে কহিলা তারে মহামন্ত্রবর ॥ ৬৩ ॥

*echana śuniñā bāṇī purī ye īśbara |*
*nibhṛte kahilā tāre mahāmantrabara || 63 ||*

*Word for word:* echhana shunina vani — hearing such words; puri ye ishvara — Ishvara Puri; nibhrite kahila tare — in private imparted to Him; mahamantra-vara — the great, best of mantras

**63.** Hearing such words, Ishvara Puri
in private imparted to Him the great, the best of mantras.

গোপীনাথ-মহামন্ত্র পায় বিশ্বম্ভর ।
পুলকিত সব অঙ্গ হরিষ অন্তর ॥ ৬৪ ॥

*gopīnātha-mahāmantra pāẏa biśbambhara |*
*pulakita saba aṅga hariṣa antara || 64 ||*

*Word for word:* gopinatha-mahamantra — the great mantra of Gopinatha; paya vishvambhara — Vishvambhara received; pulakita saba anga — His whole body thrilled; harisha antara — His heart rejoiced

**64.** Vishvambhara received the great mantra of Gopinatha[^23-11],
His whole body thrilled, His heart rejoiced.

নয়নে গলয়ে নীর পুলকিত অঙ্গ ।
রাধা রাধা বলি সুখ বাড়িল তরঙ্গ ॥ ৬৫ ॥

*naẏane galaẏe nīra pulakita aṅga |*
*rādhā rādhā bali sukha bāṛila taraṅga || 65 ||*

*Word for word:* nayane galaye nira — tears flow from the eyes; pulakita anga — the body thrills; radha radha bali — repeating "Radha, Radha"; sukha badila taranga — waves of happiness rose

**65.** Tears flow from His eyes, His body trembles;
repeating "Radha, Radha!", He stirs up waves of happiness.

ব্রজের যতেক ভাব সব মনে হৈল ।
বিশেষে মাধুর্যরসে মন ডুবাইল ॥ ৬৬ ॥

*brajera yateka bhāba saba mane haila |*
*biśeṣe mādhuryarase mana ḍubāila || 66 ||*

*Word for word:* vrajera yateka bhava — all the moods of Vraja; saba mane haila — arose in His mind; vishese — above all; madhurya-rase — in madhurya-rasa; mana dubaila — His mind plunged

**66.** All the moods of Vraja awoke in His mind,
and above all His mind plunged into madhurya-rasa.

রাধাভাবে অবশ হইয়া কলেবর ।
কৃষ্ণ কৃষ্ণ বলি ডাকে অতি উচ্চস্বর ॥ ৬৭ ॥

*rādhābhābe abaśa haiẏā kalebara |*
*kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa bali ḍāke ati uccasbara || 67 ||*

*Word for word:* radha-bhave — by the mood of Radha; avasha haiya kalevara — the body being overwhelmed; krishna krishna bali — "Krishna, Krishna!"; dake ati uchchasvara — calls very loudly

**67.** His whole body overcome by the mood of Radha,
He calls in a loud voice: "Krishna, Krishna!"

বৃন্দাবন গোবর্ধন বলি ডাকে হাসে ।
কালিন্দী যমুনা বলি গর্জে উল্লাসে ॥ ৬৮ ॥

*bṛndābana gobardhana bali ḍāke hāse |*
*kālindī yamunā bali garje ullāse || 68 ||*

*Word for word:* vrindavana govardhana bali — calling "Vrindavana, Govardhana!"; dake hase — calls and laughs; kalindi yamuna bali — crying "Kalindi, Yamuna!"; garje ullase — shouts in delight

**68.** Calling "Vrindavana, Govardhana!", He laughs;
crying "Kalindi, Yamuna!", He shouts in delight.

ক্ষণে ডাকে বলরাম শ্রীদাম সুদাম ।
ক্ষণে নন্দ যশোদা বলিয়া করে নাম ॥ ৬৯ ॥

*kṣaṇe ḍāke balarāma śrīdāma sudāma |*
*kṣaṇe nanda yaśodā baliẏā kare nāma || 69 ||*

*Word for word:* kshane dake — now calls; balarama shridama sudama — Balarama, Shridama, Sudama; kshane — now; nanda yashoda baliya kare nama — calls the names of Nanda and Yashoda

**69.** Now He calls Balarama, Shridama, Sudama,
now He calls out the names of Nanda and Yashoda.

ধবলী সাঙলী বলি গরজে গম্ভীর ।
ক্ষণে সখী বলি প্রভু পড়য়ে অস্থির ॥ ৭০ ॥

*dhabalī sāṅalī bali garaje gambhīra |*
*kṣaṇe sakhī bali prabhu paṛaẏe asthira || 70 ||*

*Word for word:* dhavali shangali bali — "Dhavali, Shangali!" (names of cows); garaje gambhira — He calls in a deep voice; kshane sakhi bali — now, crying "Friend!"; prabhu padaye asthira — the Lord falls down in agitation

**70.** "Dhavali, Shangali!" — He calls in a deep voice;
now, crying "Friend!", the Lord falls down in agitation.

ক্ষণে দাস্যভাবে তৃণ দশনে ধরিয়া ।
ক্ষণে অহঙ্কার করে আমি সে বলিয়া ॥ ৭১ ॥

*kṣaṇe dāsyabhābe tṛṇa daśane dhariẏā |*
*kṣaṇe ahaṅkāra kare āmi se baliẏā || 71 ||*

*Word for word:* kshane dasya-bhave — now in the mood of a servant; trina dashane dhariya — holding a straw between the teeth; kshane ahankara kare — now proudly; ami se bali — saying "It is I"

**71.** Now in the mood of a servant He takes a straw between His teeth,
now proudly says: "It is I!

ধরিলুঁ পর্বত আমি মারিলুঁ অঘাসুর ।
মারিলুঁ পূতনা-আদি যতেক অসুর ॥ ৭২ ॥

*dhariluṁ parbata āmi māriluṁ aghāsura |*
*māriluṁ pūtanā-ādi yateka asura || 72 ||*

*Word for word:* dharilun parvata ami — I held up the mountain; marilun aghasura — I killed Aghasura; marilun putana-adi — I killed Putana and the others; yateka asura — all the asuras

**72.** I held up the mountain, I killed Aghasura,
I killed Putana and all the other asuras!"

ক্ষণে যে ত্রিভঙ্গ হঞা বংশীমুখে রহে ।
ক্ষণে চমকিত হঞা চৌদিগে ত চাহে ॥ ৭৩ ॥

*kṣaṇe ye tribhaṅga hañā baṃśīmukhe rahe |*
*kṣaṇe camakita hañā caudige ta cāhe || 73 ||*

*Word for word:* kshane ye tribhanga hana — now, standing in the threefold-bending pose; vamshi-mukhe rahe — stays with the flute at His lips; kshane chamakita hana — now, startled; chaudige ta chahe — looks around in all directions

**73.** Now, standing in the threefold-bending pose, He holds a flute to His lips,
now, startled, He looks around in all directions[^23-12].

নয়নে গলয়ে নীর গদগদ ভাষ ।
মধুর বচনে করে গুরুর সম্ভাষ ॥ ৭৪ ॥

*naẏane galaẏe nīra gadagada bhāṣa |*
*madhura bacane kare gurura sambhāṣa || 74 ||*

*Word for word:* nayane galaye nira — tears flow from the eyes; gadagada bhasha — the voice falters; madhura vachane — with sweet words; kare gurura sambhasha — He addresses the guru

**74.** Tears flow from His eyes, His voice falters;
with sweet words He addresses the guru:

তোমার প্রসাদে মুঞি হইনু কৃতার্থ ।
আজি হৈতে দেহ ধরা ভৈ গেল যথার্থ ॥ ৭৫ ॥

*tomāra prasāde muñi hainu kṛtārtha |*
*āji haite deha dharā bhai gela yathārtha || 75 ||*

*Word for word:* tomara prasade — by your mercy; muni hainu kritartha — I have attained the goal; aji haite — from this day; deha dhara — embodiment; bhai gela yathartha — has become meaningful

**75.** "By your mercy I have attained the goal:
from this day My embodiment has become meaningful."

ইহা শুনি ঈশ্বরপুরী নিজ-সুখে ।
ত্রিভঙ্গ মুরলী-মুখ দেখয়ে প্রভুকে ॥ ৭৫+১ ॥

*ihā śuni īśbarapurī nija-sukhe |*
*tribhaṅga muralī-mukha dekhaẏe prabhuke || 75+1 ||*

*Word for word:* iha shuni — hearing this; ishvarapuri — Ishvara Puri; nija-sukhe — in his own bliss; tribhanga — in the threefold-bent pose; murali-mukha — with the flute at the lips; dekhaye prabhuke — sees the Lord

**75+1.** Hearing this, Ishvara Puri, in his own bliss,
sees the Lord standing in the threefold-bent pose, with the flute at His lips[^23-13].

মাধবেন্দ্রপুরীর কথা হৈল স্মরণ ।
জানিলা সে কৃষ্ণচন্দ্র প্রকট এখন ॥ ৭৫+২ ॥

*mādhabendrapurīra kathā haila smaraṇa |*
*jānilā se kṛṣṇacandra prakaṭa ekhana || 75+2 ||*

*Word for word:* madhavendrapurira katha — the words of Madhavendra Puri; haila smarana — came to mind; janila se — he understood; krishnachandra — Krishnachandra; prakata ekhana — has now appeared

**75+2.** He remembered the words of Madhavendra Puri
and understood: Krishnachandra has now appeared.

গুরুভক্তি প্রকাশিয়া চলিলা ত প্রভু ।
ফল্গুনামা নদী দেখি হাসে লহু লহু ॥ ৭৬ ॥

*gurubhakti prakāśiẏā calilā ta prabhu |*
*phalgunāmā nadī dekhi hāse lahu lahu || 76 ||*

*Word for word:* guru-bhakti prakashiya — having shown devotion to the guru; chalila ta prabhu — the Lord went on; phalgu-nama nadi dekhi — seeing the river named Phalgu; hase lahu lahu — gently smiled

**76.** Having [thus] shown devotion to the guru, the Lord went on;
seeing the river named Phalgu, He gently smiled.

পূর্বস্মরণ হইল হরিষ-বিষাদে ।
সীতা সঙরিয়া হইল পরম প্রমাদে ॥ ৭৭ ॥

*pūrbasmaraṇa haila hariṣa-biṣāde |*
*sītā saṅariẏā haila parama pramāde || 77 ||*

*Word for word:* purva-smarana haila — He remembered the past; harisha-vishade — in joy and sorrow; sita sanariya — remembering Sita; haila parama pramade — fell into great agitation

**77.** He remembered the past — in joy and sorrow;
remembering Sita, He fell into great agitation[^23-14].

দেবপূজা পিতৃপূজা কৈল স্নানদান ।
প্রেতশিলায় পিণ্ডদান করিল বিধান ॥ ৭৮ ॥

*debapūjā pitṛpūjā kaila snānadāna |*
*pretaśilāẏa piṇḍadāna karila bidhāna || 78 ||*

*Word for word:* deva-puja pitri-puja — worship of gods and ancestors; kaila snana-dana — He bathed and gave gifts; pretashilaya pinda-dana — the offering of pinda on the Pretashila; karila vidhana — He duly performed

**78.** He worshipped the gods and the ancestors, bathed and gave gifts,
and duly offered pinda on the Pretashila.

ব্রাহ্মণেরে দিল ধন পিতার উদ্দেশে ।
উদীচী করিয়া কৈল দক্ষিণ-মানসে ॥ ৭৯ ॥

*brāhmaṇere dila dhana pitāra uddeśe |*
*udīcī kariẏā kaila dakṣiṇa-mānase || 79 ||*

*Word for word:* brahmanere dila dhana — gave wealth to the brahmanas; pitara uddeshe — for His father; udichi kariya — performing [the rite at] Udichi; kaila dakshina-manase — performed it at Dakshina-manasa

**79.** For His father He gave wealth to the brahmanas;
having performed [the rite at] Udichi, He performed it at Dakshina-manasa.

উত্তর-মানস করি জিহ্বালোল তীর্থ ।
দেব পিতৃ-পূজা করি বিলাইল অর্থ ॥ ৮০ ॥

*uttara-mānasa kari jihbālola tīrtha |*
*deba pitṛ-pūjā kari bilāila artha || 80 ||*

*Word for word:* uttara-manasa kari — performing at Uttara-manasa; jihvalola tirtha — [and at] the holy place Jihvalola; deva pitri-puja kari — worshipping gods and ancestors; bilaila artha — He distributed wealth

**80.** Performing [the rite] at Uttara-manasa and at the holy place Jihvalola,
worshipping the gods and the ancestors, He distributed wealth[^23-15].

তবে গয়া উত্তরিলা অতি হৃষ্টমনে ।
দেখিতে বাড়িল আর্তি বিষ্ণুর চরণে ॥ ৮১ ॥

*tabe gaẏā uttarilā ati hṛṣṭamane |*
*dekhite bāṛila ārti biṣṇura caraṇe || 81 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe — then; gaya uttarila — He arrived in Gaya; ati hrishta-mane — with great joy in His heart; dekhite badila arti — the longing to see grew; vishnura charane — the foot of Vishnu

**81.** Then with great joy in His heart He arrived in Gaya;
His longing to see the foot of Vishnu grew.

ষোড়শ বেদিকায় প্রভু পিণ্ডদান করে ।
উৎকণ্ঠা বাড়িল বিষ্ণুপদ দেখিবারে ॥ ৮২ ॥

*ṣoṛaśa bedikāẏa prabhu piṇḍadāna kare |*
*utkaṇṭhā bāṛila biṣṇupada dekhibāre || 82 ||*

*Word for word:* shodasha vedikaya — at the Sixteen Altars; prabhu pinda-dana kare — the Lord offers pindas; utkantha badila — eagerness grew; vishnupada dekhibare — to see the Vishnupada

**82.** The Lord offers pindas at the Sixteen Altars;
His eagerness to see the Vishnupada grew.

সর্বকার্য সমাপিয়া চলিলা ত্বরিতে ।
বিষ্ণুপদ দেখিবারে হরষিত চিতে ॥ ৮৩ ॥

*sarbakārya samāpiẏā calilā tbarite |*
*biṣṇupada dekhibāre haraṣita cite || 83 ||*

*Word for word:* sarva-karya samapiya — having finished all the rites; chalila tvarite — He went quickly; vishnupada dekhibare — to see the Vishnupada; harashita chite — with a joyful heart

**83.** Having finished all the rites, He went quickly,
with a joyful heart, to see the Vishnupada.

বিষ্ণুপদ-চিহ্ন আমি দেখিব নয়নে ।
হরিষে অন্তর-কথা কহে মনে মনে ॥ ৮৪ ॥

*biṣṇupada-cihna āmi dekhiba naẏane |*
*hariṣe antara-kathā kahe mane mane || 84 ||*

*Word for word:* vishnupada-chihna — the marks of Vishnu's foot; ami dekhiba nayane — I shall see with My eyes; harishe — joyfully; antara-katha — what is in His heart; kahe mane mane — He says to Himself

**84.** "With My own eyes I shall see the marks of Vishnu's foot!" —
joyfully He says to Himself what is in His heart.

এত ভাবি উত্তরিলা বিষ্ণুপদে আসি ।
পরম-আনন্দে দণ্ডবত করি বসি ॥ ৮৫ ॥

*eta bhābi uttarilā biṣṇupade āsi |*
*parama-ānande daṇḍabata kari basi || 85 ||*

*Word for word:* eta bhavi — thinking so; uttarila vishnupade asi — He came to the Vishnupada; parama-anande — in supreme bliss; dandavata kari — bowing down; basi — He sat

**85.** Thinking so, He came to the Vishnupada
and in supreme bliss, having bowed down, sat.

বোলয়ে গৌরাঙ্গ শুন শুন সর্বজন ।
কেমন করয়ে বিষ্ণুপদ দেখি মন ॥ ৮৬ ॥

*bolaẏe gaurāṅga śuna śuna sarbajana |*
*kemana karaẏe biṣṇupada dekhi mana || 86 ||*

*Word for word:* bolaye gauranga — Gauranga says; shuna shuna sarvajana — listen, listen, all of you; kemana karaye — how does it become; vishnupada dekhi — on seeing the Vishnupada; mana — the heart

**86.** Gauranga says: "Listen, listen, all of you:
what happens in the heart when one sees the Vishnupada?

বিষ্ণুপদ-চিহ্ন আমি দেখিলুঁ নয়নে ।
দেখিয়া ত প্রেমোদয় না হইল কেনে ॥ ৮৭ ॥

*biṣṇupada-cihna āmi dekhiluṁ naẏane |*
*dekhiẏā ta premodaẏa nā haila kene || 87 ||*

*Word for word:* vishnupada-chihna — the marks of Vishnu's foot; ami dekhilun nayane — I have seen with My eyes; dekhiya ta — having seen them; premodaya na haila kene — why has prema not arisen

**87.** I have seen with My own eyes the marks of Vishnu's foot —
why then, having seen them, has prema not arisen?"[^23-16]

ইহা বলি মহাপ্রভু পাখালে বিষ্ণুপদ ।
অভিষেক করি কৈল হিয়ার প্রসাদ ॥ ৮৮ ॥

*ihā bali mahāprabhu pākhāle biṣṇupada |*
*abhiṣeka kari kaila hiẏāra prasāda || 88 ||*

*Word for word:* iha bali — saying this; mahaprabhu pakhale vishnupada — Mahaprabhu washed the Vishnupada; abhisheka kari — performing abhisheka; kaila hiyara prasada — His heart was gladdened

**88.** Saying this, Mahaprabhu washed the Vishnupada,
performed abhisheka — and His heart was filled with joy.

ভক্তি প্রকাশিয়া প্রভু বিশ্বম্ভর হরি ।
প্রকাশ করয়ে গোরা প্রেম-অধিকারী ॥ ৮৯ ॥

*bhakti prakāśiẏā prabhu biśbambhara hari |*
*prakāśa karaẏe gorā prema-adhikārī || 89 ||*

*Word for word:* bhakti prakashiya — showing bhakti; prabhu vishvambhara hari — the Lord Vishvambhara Hari; prakasha karaye — manifests; gora — Gora; prema-adhikari — the possessor of prema

**89.** Showing bhakti, the Lord Vishvambhara Hari —
Gora, the possessor of prema — manifests [it]:

কম্প পুলক ভেল প্রেমার আরম্ভ ।
নয়নে গলয়ে ধারা ক্ষণে হয় স্তম্ভ ॥ ৯০ ॥

*kampa pulaka bhela premāra ārambha |*
*naẏane galaẏe dhārā kṣaṇe haẏa stambha || 90 ||*

*Word for word:* kampa pulaka — trembling, hair on end; bhela premara arambha — prema began; nayane galaye dhara — streams flow from the eyes; kshane haya stambha — at times He is stunned

**90.** prema began — trembling, hair standing on end,
streams flow from His eyes, at times He becomes stunned.

বিভোল হইলা প্রভু পাদাব্জ দেখিয়া ।
প্রেম-মহামহোৎসবে বুলয়ে নাচিয়া ॥ ৯১ ॥

*bibhola hailā prabhu pādābja dekhiẏā |*
*prema-mahāmahotsabe bulaẏe nāciẏā || 91 ||*

*Word for word:* bibhola haila prabhu — the Lord lost Himself; padabja dekhiya — seeing the lotus foot; prema-maha-mahotsave — in a great festival of prema; bulaye nachiya — moves about dancing

**91.** Seeing the lotus foot, the Lord lost Himself
and in a great festival of prema moves about, dancing.

গয়াশিরে পিণ্ডদান পাদাব্জ-উপর ।
আনন্দে নাচয়ে সঙ্গে ব্রাহ্মণ সকল ॥ ৯২ ॥

*gaẏāśire piṇḍadāna pādābja-upara |*
*ānande nācaẏe saṅge brāhmaṇa sakala || 92 ||*

*Word for word:* gaya-shire — on the head of Gaya; pinda-dana — the offering of pinda; padabja-upara — on the lotus foot; anande nachaye sange — in joy dance together [with Him]; brahmana sakala — all the brahmanas

**92.** He offered pinda on the head of Gaya, on the lotus foot;
in joy all the brahmanas dance together [with Him].

আর দিনে মনঃকথা দঢ়াইল চিতে ।
মধুপুরী-যাত্রা প্রভু কৈল আচম্বিতে ॥ ৯৩ ॥

*āra dine manaḥkathā daṛhāila cite |*
*madhupurī-yātrā prabhu kaila ācambite || 93 ||*

*Word for word:* ara dine — on the next day; manah-katha — the secret desire; dadhaila chite — took firm hold in His heart; madhupuri-yatra — the journey to Madhupuri; prabhu kaila achambite — the Lord suddenly undertook

**93.** On the next day the secret desire took firm hold in His heart:
the Lord suddenly set out for Madhupuri.

সঙ্গের ব্রাহ্মণগণে কহিল বচন ।
বৃন্দাবন-দরশনে করহ গমন ॥ ৯৪ ॥

*saṅgera brāhmaṇagaṇe kahila bacana |*
*bṛndābana-daraśane karaha gamana || 94 ||*

*Word for word:* sangera brahmana-gane — to the brahmana companions; kahila vachana — He said; vrindavana-darashane — to see Vrindavana; karaha gamana — let us go

**94.** He said to His brahmana companions:
"Let us go to see Vrindavana."

শুনিয়া সঙ্গতিগণ কুণ্ঠিত হইলা ।
যাইতে নারিব ব্যয় অল্প হইলা ॥ ৯৫ ॥

*śuniẏā saṅgatigaṇa kuṇṭhita hailā |*
*yāite nāriba byaẏa alpa hailā || 95 ||*

*Word for word:* shuniya — hearing; sangati-gana — the companions; kunthita haila — were dismayed; yaite nariba — we cannot go; vyaya alpa haila — our means are small

**95.** Hearing this, the companions were dismayed:
"We cannot go — our means are small."

প্রভু কহে ভক্ষ্য-সঙ্গে মনুষ্যের জন্ম ।
না বুঝি বিকল হঞা করে কত কর্ম ॥ ৯৬ ॥

*prabhu kahe bhakṣya-saṅge manuṣyera janma |*
*nā bujhi bikala hañā kare kata karma || 96 ||*

*Word for word:* prabhu kahe — the Lord says; bhakshya-sange — together with the care for food; manushyera janma — the birth of man; na bujhi — not understanding; vikala hana — anxiously; kare kata karma — performs so many works

**96.** The Lord says: "From birth man is bound by the care for food;
not understanding [life's goal], he anxiously performs many works.

সার্থক মনুষ্য-জন্ম কৃষ্ণ যদি ভজে ।
না ভজিলে কৃষ্ণ দুঃখ-সাগরেতে মজে ॥ ৯৭ ॥

*sārthaka manuṣya-janma kṛṣṇa yadi bhaje |*
*nā bhajile kṛṣṇa duḥkha-sāgarete maje || 97 ||*

*Word for word:* sarthaka manushya-janma — human birth is meaningful; krishna yadi bhaje — if one worships Krishna; na bhajile krishna — not worshipping Krishna; duhkha-sagarete maje — one sinks in an ocean of suffering

**97.** Human birth becomes meaningful if one worships Krishna;
but not worshipping Krishna, one sinks in an ocean of suffering."

এইমত বুঝাইয়া প্রভু গৌরহরি ।
গয়া হৈতে বৃন্দাবন প্রভু যাত্রা করি ॥ ৯৮ ॥

*eimata bujhāiẏā prabhu gaurahari |*
*gaẏā haite bṛndābana prabhu yātrā kari || 98 ||*

*Word for word:* eimata bujhaiya — having explained thus; prabhu gaurahari — the Lord Gaurahari; gaya haite vrindavana — from Gaya to Vrindavana; prabhu yatra kari — the Lord set out

**98.** Having explained all this, the Lord Gaurahari
set out from Gaya for Vrindavana.

সঙ্গিগণ সঙ্গে করি চলিলা আপনি ।
হেনকালে উঠি গেল আকাশেতে বাণী ॥ ৯৯ ॥

*saṅgigaṇa saṅge kari calilā āpani |*
*henakāle uṭhi gela ākāśete bāṇī || 99 ||*

*Word for word:* sangi-gana sange kari — together with the companions; chalila apani — He Himself set out; henakale — then; uthi gela akashete vani — a voice rose in the sky

**99.** He Himself set out together with His companions;
and then a voice rang out from the sky,

নূতন মেঘের যেন গভীর গর্জন ।
বিশ্বম্ভর সম্বোধিয়া কহিল বচন ॥ ১০০ ॥

*nūtana meghera yena gabhīra garjana |*
*biśbambhara sambodhiẏā kahila bacana || 100 ||*

*Word for word:* nutana meghera — of a fresh cloud; yena gabhira garjana — like the deep thunder; vishvambhara sambodhiya — addressing Vishvambhara; kahila vachana — it said

**100.** like the deep thunder of a fresh cloud;
addressing Vishvambhara, it said:

শুন শুন মহাপ্রভু অহে বিশ্বম্ভর ।
না যাইবে বৃন্দাবন যাহ নিজ ঘর ॥ ১০১ ॥

*śuna śuna mahāprabhu ahe biśbambhara |*
*nā yāibe bṛndābana yāha nija ghara || 101 ||*

*Word for word:* shuna shuna mahaprabhu — listen, listen, Mahaprabhu; ahe vishvambhara — O Vishvambhara; na yaibe vrindavana — do not go to Vrindavana; yaha nija ghara — go to Your home

**101.** "Listen, listen, Mahaprabhu, O Vishvambhara:
do not go to Vrindavana — go home.

সন্ন্যাস করিয়া তীর্থ করিবে পর্যটন ।
সময়ের বশ হঞা যাবে বৃন্দাবন ॥ ১০২ ॥

*sannyāsa kariẏā tīrtha karibe paryaṭana |*
*samaẏera baśa hañā yābe bṛndābana || 102 ||*

*Word for word:* sannyasa kariya — having taken sannyasa; tirtha karibe paryatana — You will travel to the holy places; samayera vasha hana — in due time; yabe vrindavana — You will go to Vrindavana

**102.** Having taken sannyasa, You will travel to the holy places
and in due time You will go to Vrindavana"[^23-17].

এইমত দৈববাণী শুনি নিজ কর্ণে ।
গমন-নিরোধ কৈল সঙ্গের ব্রাহ্মণে ॥ ১০৩ ॥

*eimata daibabāṇī śuni nija karṇe |*
*gamana-nirodha kaila saṅgera brāhmaṇe || 103 ||*

*Word for word:* eimata daiva-vani — such a heavenly voice; shuni nija karne — hearing with their own ears; gamana-nirodha kaila — held [Him] back from going; sangera brahmane — the brahmana companions

**103.** Hearing such a heavenly voice with their own ears,
the brahmana companions held Him back from going.

লেউটিয়া মহাপ্রভু ঘরেতে চলিলা ।
ক্রমে ক্রমে পদব্রজে নদীয়া আইলা ॥ ১০৪ ॥

*leuṭiẏā mahāprabhu gharete calilā |*
*krame krame padabraje nadīẏā āilā || 104 ||*

*Word for word:* leutiya — turning back; mahaprabhu gharete chalila — Mahaprabhu went home; krame krame — little by little; padavraje — on foot; nadiya aila — came to Nadia

**104.** Turning back, Mahaprabhu went home
and little by little, on foot, came to Nadia.

নমস্কার করি শচী-মায়ের চরণে ।
ঘরেরে বিদায় দিলা যত সঙ্গিগণে ॥ ১০৫ ॥

*namaskāra kari śacī-māẏera caraṇe |*
*gharere bidāẏa dilā yata saṅgigaṇe || 105 ||*

*Word for word:* namaskara kari — bowing; shachi-mayera charane — at the feet of mother Shachi; gharere bidaya dila — sent home; yata sangi-gane — all the companions

**105.** Bowing at the feet of His mother Shachi,
He sent all His companions to their homes.

পুত্র কোলে করি শচী আনন্দিত মনে ।
হরিষে প্রেমার নীর ঝরে দুনয়নে ॥ ১০৬ ॥

*putra kole kari śacī ānandita mane |*
*hariṣe premāra nīra jhare dunaẏane || 106 ||*

*Word for word:* putra kole kari — embracing her son; shachi anandita mane — Shachi with joy in her heart; harishe — for joy; premara nira — tears of love; jhare dunayane — stream from both eyes

**106.** Shachi, with joy in her heart, embraced her son;
tears of love and joy stream from both her eyes.

পুলকিত সব অঙ্গ কম্প কলেবর ।
আনন্দে পাইল সব নদীয়া নগর ॥ ১০৭ ॥

*pulakita saba aṅga kampa kalebara |*
*ānande pāila saba nadīẏā nagara || 107 ||*

*Word for word:* pulakita saba anga — the whole body thrills; kampa kalevara — the body trembles; anande paila — received joy; saba nadiya nagara — the whole town of Nadia

**107.** Her whole body thrills, her body trembles;
the whole town of Nadia received joy.

বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া-হিয়া মাঝে আনন্দ-হিল্লোল ।
ধরিতে না পারে অঙ্গ সুখের নাহি ওর ॥ ১০৮ ॥

*biṣṇupriẏā-hiẏā mājhe ānanda-hillola |*
*dharite nā pāre aṅga sukhera nāhi ora || 108 ||*

*Word for word:* vishnupriya-hiya majhe — in Vishnupriya's heart; ananda-hillola — waves of joy; dharite na pare anga — she cannot contain herself; sukhera nahi ora — her happiness has no limit

**108.** In Vishnupriya's heart there are waves of joy:
she cannot contain herself, her happiness has no limit.

আনন্দে আইলা প্রভু আপন আবাস ।
গোরাগুণ গায় সুখে এ লোচনদাস ॥ ১০৯ ॥

*ānande āilā prabhu āpana ābāsa |*
*gorāguṇa gāẏa sukhe e locanadāsa || 109 ||*

*Word for word:* anande aila prabhu — joyfully the Lord came; apana avasa — to His own abode; gora-guna gaya — sings Gora's glories; sukhe — happily; e lochanadasa — this Lochana Dasa

**109.** With joy the Lord came to His own abode —
happily this Lochana Dasa sings the glories of Gora.

*Raga varadi; disha: "Dvijachand!..." (murchha)*

নবদ্বীপ-চরিত্র সে অপরূপ কথা ।
অমিয় মাখিল গোরাচাঁদ-গুণগাথা ॥ ১১০ ॥

*nabadbīpa-caritra se aparūpa kathā |*
*amiẏa mākhila gorācāṁda-guṇagāthā || 110 ||*

*Word for word:* navadvipa-charitra — the deeds in Navadvipa; se aparupa katha — are a wondrous tale; amiya makhila — steeped in nectar; gorachanda-guna-gatha — the song of Gorachand's glories

**110.** The deeds [of the Lord] in Navadvipa are a wondrous tale:
the account of Gorachand's glories is steeped in nectar.

লোকবেদ-অগোচর নদীয়া-চরিত ।
শ্রবণ-মঙ্গল হয় সভার পিরীত ॥ ১১১ ॥

*lokabeda-agocara nadīẏā-carita |*
*śrabaṇa-maṅgala haẏa sabhāra pirīta || 111 ||*

*Word for word:* loka-veda-agochara — beyond the reach of the world and the Vedas; nadiya-charita — the deeds in Nadia; shravana-mangala haya — hearing them is auspicious; sabhara pirita — beloved of all

**111.** The deeds in Nadia are beyond the reach of the world and of the Vedas;
hearing them is auspicious — all love them.

শিব শুক নারদ এ লখিমী অনন্ত ।
যেই সুখে আপনাকে মানে ভাগ্যবন্ত ॥ ১১২ ॥

*śiba śuka nārada e lakhimī ananta |*
*yei sukhe āpanāke māne bhāgyabanta || 112 ||*

*Word for word:* shiva shuka narada — Shiva, Shuka, Narada; e lakhimi ananta — and Lakshmi, Ananta; yei sukhe — in this joy; apanake mane bhagyavanta — consider themselves fortunate

**112.** Shiva, Shuka, Narada, Lakshmi, Ananta,
tasting this joy, consider themselves fortunate.

আমি ছার কি বলিব অতি বুদ্ধিহীন ।
ভালমন্দ নাহি জ্ঞান নাহি নিশা দিন ॥ ১১৩ ॥

*āmi chāra ki baliba ati buddhihīna |*
*bhālamanda nāhi jñāna nāhi niśā dina || 113 ||*

*Word for word:* ami chhara — I, wretched; ki baliba — what shall I say; ati buddhi-hina — utterly without understanding; bhala-manda nahi jnana — no knowledge of good or bad; nahi nisha dina — nor of night and day

**113.** What can I say, wretched and utterly without understanding?
I know neither good nor bad, neither day nor night.

পশুর চরিতে মোর আচরণ একে ।
তাহাতে অধম বলি লিখিয়ে আমাকে ॥ ১১৪ ॥

*paśura carite mora ācaraṇa eke |*
*tāhāte adhama bali likhiẏe āmāke || 114 ||*

*Word for word:* pashura charite — like the conduct of a beast; mora acharana eke — my conduct is the same; tahate — therefore; adhama bali — as the lowest; likhiye amake — I write of myself

**114.** My conduct is like that of a beast,
therefore I write of myself that I am the lowest.

সব অবতার-সার গোরা-অবতার ।
তাহাতে নদীয়াপুরে প্রেমার প্রচার ॥ ১১৫ ॥

*saba abatāra-sāra gorā-abatāra |*
*tāhāte nadīẏāpure premāra pracāra || 115 ||*

*Word for word:* saba avatara-sara — the essence of all avataras; gora-avatara — the avatara of Gora; tahate — in it; nadiya-pure — in Nadia; premara prachara — the preaching of prema

**115.** The essence of all avataras is the avatara of Gora,
and in it — the preaching of prema in Nadia.

প্রণতি করিয়া বোলোঁ বৈষ্ণব-চরণে ।
কৃপা কর গোরাগুণ গাঙ মো-বদনে ॥ ১১৬ ॥

*praṇati kariẏā boloṁ baiṣṇaba-caraṇe |*
*kṛpā kara gorāguṇa gāṅa mo-badane || 116 ||*

*Word for word:* pranati kariya — bowing down; bolon vaishnava-charane — I beseech the feet of the Vaishnavas; kripa kara — be merciful; gora-guna — Gora's glories; gaun mo-vadane — may my lips sing

**116.** Bowing down, I beseech the feet of the Vaishnavas:
be merciful — let my lips sing the glories of Gora.

অধম বলিয়া ঘৃণা না করিহ মোরে ।
পতিতের ত্রাণ লোকে বোলে তো সভারে ॥ ১১৭ ॥

*adhama baliẏā ghṛṇā nā kariha more |*
*patitera trāṇa loke bole to sabhāre || 117 ||*

*Word for word:* adhama baliya — because I am low; ghrina na kariha more — do not despise me; patitera trana — the deliverance of the fallen; loke bole to sabhare — people call all of you

**117.** Do not despise me because I am low:
people say that you are the deliverance of the fallen.

নিজগুণে দয়া করি কর পরসাদ ।
গোরাগুণ গাঙ মুখে বড় লাগে সাধ ॥ ১১৮ ॥

*nijaguṇe daẏā kari kara parasāda |*
*gorāguṇa gāṅa mukhe baṛa lāge sādha || 118 ||*

*Word for word:* nijagune — out of your own goodness; daya kari — taking pity; kara parasada — show me mercy; gora-guna gaun mukhe — to sing Gora's glories with my lips; bada lage sadha — I long so much

**118.** Out of your own goodness show me mercy:
I long so much to sing with my lips the glories of Gora.

গোরাপদ-কমলে মো করি পরণতি ।
তিলেক করুণা-দিঠে কর অবগতি ॥ ১১৯ ॥

*gorāpada-kamale mo kari paraṇati |*
*tileka karuṇā-diṭhe kara abagati || 119 ||*

*Word for word:* gora-pada-kamale — to the lotus feet of Gora; mo kari paranati — I bow down; tileka — even for a moment; karuna-dithe — with a merciful glance; kara avagati — look upon me

**119.** I bow down to the lotus feet of Gora:
cast on me, even for a moment, a merciful glance.

শ্রীনরহরিদাস ঠাকুর আমার ।
এই তো ভরসা গুণ বলি যে তোমার ॥ ১২০ ॥

*śrīnaraharidāsa ṭhākura āmāra |*
*ei to bharasā guṇa bali ye tomāra || 120 ||*

*Word for word:* shri-narahari-dasa thakura — Sri Narahari Dasa Thakura; amara — is mine; ei to bharasa — this is my reliance; guna bali ye tomara — in speaking of Your glories

**120.** Sri Narahari Dasa Thakura is my [master]:
on this alone I rely in speaking of Your glories[^23-18].

নহে বা অধমাধম মুঞি পাপী ছার ।
তোর গুণ কহিবারে কিবা অধিকার ॥ ১২১ ॥

*nahe bā adhamādhama muñi pāpī chāra |*
*tora guṇa kahibāre kibā adhikāra || 121 ||*

*Word for word:* nahe va — otherwise; adhamadhama muni — I, lowest of the low; papi chhara — sinful, wretched; tora guna kahibare — to tell Your glories; kiba adhikara — what right

**121.** Otherwise — I, lowest of the low, sinful, wretched —
what right have I to speak of Your glories?

অধিকারী নহোঁ মুঞি কর পরসাদ ।
তোর গুণ কহিবারে বড় লাগে সাধ ॥ ১২২ ॥

*adhikārī nahoṁ muñi kara parasāda |*
*tora guṇa kahibāre baṛa lāge sādha || 122 ||*

*Word for word:* adhikari nahon muni — I am not worthy; kara parasada — show mercy; tora guna kahibare — to tell Your glories; bada lage sadha — I long so much

**122.** I am not worthy — show me mercy:
I long so much to speak of Your glories.

যে হউ সে হউ কথা কহিব অবশ্য ।
সাবধানে শুন কথা নদীয়া-রহস্য ॥ ১২৩ ॥

*ye hau se hau kathā kahiba abaśya |*
*sābadhāne śuna kathā nadīẏā-rahasya || 123 ||*

*Word for word:* ye hau se hau — come what may; katha kahiba avashya — I shall certainly tell; savadhane shuna — listen attentively; katha nadiya-rahasya — the tale, the secret of Nadia

**123.** Come what may, I shall certainly tell it:
listen attentively to the secret of Nadia.

জানি বা না জানি কহি বড় প্রতি-আশে ।
আদিখণ্ড সায় কহে এ লোচনদাসে ॥ ১২৪ ॥

*jāni bā nā jāni kahi baṛa prati-āśe |*
*ādikhaṇḍa sāẏa kahe e locanadāse || 124 ||*

*Word for word:* jani va na jani — knowing or not knowing; kahi bada prati-ashe — I speak with great hope; adikhanda saya — the Adi-khanda is ended; kahe e lochanadase — says this Lochana Dasa

**124.** Knowing or not knowing, I speak with great hope:
"The Adi-khanda is ended," says this Lochana Dasa.

*Thus ends the Adi-khanda of the Sri Chaitanya-mangala, composed by Sri Lochana Dasa Thakura.*

[^23-1]: Cf. Murari 1.15–1.16. In Lochana Dasa's text the Lord meets Ishvara Puri already on the way to the Vishnupada (vv. 57–58), before the rites at the Phalgu and in Gaya itself.
[^23-2]: Gaya — a holy city in Bihar where pindas are offered to the ancestors. In performing the shraddha the Lord, as on other occasions, "instructs the people" by His own example (cf. Murari 1.15.6).
[^23-3]: V. 13+1 is found only in the 1983 edition (absent from Bhaktisiddhanta's edition); the 1903 edition does not have it. Shachi asks to share in the blessing of the Gaya-shraddha performed by her son.
[^23-4]: In Murari (1.15.8) the river is called Chorandhayaka. Mandara — a holy mountain in Bihar where Madhusudana is worshipped (cf. v. 50).
[^23-5]: The Lord's companions from Bengal found fault with the local brahmanas, whose customs differed from those of Bengal; cf. Murari 1.15.12: these brahmanas had taken refuge in Madhusudana.
[^23-6]: The Lord is not subject to illness: Bhaktisiddhanta in his summary says that He "enacted the lila of being cured" in order to teach reverence for brahmanas; cf. Murari 1.15.9–13. The 1903 edition gives in its notes several more couplets from individual manuscripts (among them the Lord recalls how once in His childhood His mother gave Him the water of a brahmana's feet); A and B do not have them.
[^23-7]: Brahmanya — "kind to brahmanas", a name of the Lord. The sage Bhrigu, testing the gods, struck Vishnu on the chest with his foot, and the Lord bears the mark of his foot as a sign of respect for brahmanas (cf. Bhagavata 10.89). The 1903 edition gives vv. 45–47 only in a note as an additional reading of the printed edition.
[^23-8]: The 1983 edition: "Thus in the Padma Purana". Bhaktisiddhanta's prose rendering of the shloka (anvaya and translation) is not translated.
[^23-9]: Punahpuna (modern Punpun) — a holy river on the way to Gaya; Rajagiri (Rajagriha, modern Rajgir) with the pond Brahma-kunda — an ancient holy place in Bihar. Cf. Murari 1.15.13–14.
[^23-10]: The Lord, Himself the Teacher of the world, speaks as a seeking disciple, teaching people that everyone needs initiation from a genuine guru; according to Bhaktisiddhanta's summary He asked for the mantra in order to show mercy to Ishvara Puri. Cf. Murari 1.15.16–19.
[^23-11]: That is, the mantra of Krishna, the Lord of the gopis. In Murari (1.15.18) and in Vrindavana Dasa (Chaitanya-bhagavata, Adi 17) it is the ten-syllable mantra.
[^23-12]: After the initiation the moods of Vraja manifest in the Lord: the mood of Radha (vv. 65–67, 70), His own mood as Krishna (vv. 71–73), the mood of a servant (v. 71). Gaudiya Vaishnavas see in Gaura Krishna Himself, who has taken the mood and the radiance of Radha.
[^23-13]: Vv. 75+1 – 75+2 are found only in the 1983 edition (absent from Bhaktisiddhanta's edition); the 1903 edition gives them in a note as the additional reading of another printed edition. Madhavendra Puri is Ishvara Puri's guru, the root of the tree of prema (Chaitanya-charitamrita, Adi 9.10–11); apparently his words about Krishna's imminent appearance are meant.
[^23-14]: The Lord remembered His lila as Rama. According to the tradition of Gaya, Sita, having offered pinda to Dasharatha in Rama's absence, called the Phalgu to witness, but the river lied, and Sita cursed it to flow beneath the sand.
[^23-15]: The Pretashila, Udichi, Dakshina-manasa, Uttara-manasa, Jihvalola and the Sixteen Altars (v. 82) are holy places of Gaya where the shraddha is performed; cf. Murari 1.16.1–4.
[^23-16]: Cf. Murari 1.16.6–7. The Lord, as a devotee, laments a seeming lack of love — thus He teaches humility; at once prema awakens in Him (vv. 88–91).
[^23-17]: Cf. Murari 1.16.8–10. The heavenly voice foretells the Lord's sannyasa and His journey to Vrindavana.
[^23-18]: Narahari Sarakara Thakura of Shrikhanda is Lochana Dasa's guru. "Your" (vv. 120–122) apparently refers to Gaura (cf. v. 119).

# Madhya-khanda, part 1 (portion 24)

*The beginning of the Madhya-khanda: the Lord teaches His students that true knowledge is devotion to Krishna; in the mood of Radha He weeps in separation, and by His word Shachi attains prema; prema in the house of Shuklambara; the Lord's associates gather; the sound of the flute and the mood of Gandharvika; the heavenly voice: "You are Ishvara Himself"; the mood of the Boar in Murari's house, the talk about the Vedas, the instruction to worship Radha and Krishna, Murari sees Rama; the explanation of the verse on the holy name*

## Prema-dana-lila (The Lord bestows prema)

> *Summary by Srila Bhaktisiddhanta Sarasvati.* The author, having praised the good fortune of those who were Sriman Mahaprabhu's students in His lila of teaching, describes the lila of the Lord's mercy to mother Shachi. One day, when Sriman Mahaprabhu was resting in His house, He suddenly, Himself absorbed in the mood of Srimati Radhika in separation [when Krishna had gone] to Mathura, began to weep, crying: "O Krishna, O Krishna!" Hearing the weeping, Shachi-devi came there and begged Gaurasundara for prema, and Gaurasundara bestowed prema on her. Then in the house of Shuklambara Brahmachari He enacted the lila of the great manifestation of prema. Bereft of all outward awareness, He wept all the time, crying "O Krishna!"; and hearing someone sing the name of Krishna, He fainted in bliss. Moment by moment the eight sattvika-bhavas arose all over His body, and anubhavas such as dancing, singing and rolling on the ground appeared. Gaurasundara, though Bhagavan Himself, accepted the mood of a devotee and revealed the glory of bhakti and of the devotees — therefore He is the crown jewel of all avataras.
>
> When Sriman Mahaprabhu began the lila of preaching prema, the devotees headed by Gadadhara and devotees from various lands and countries all gathered together. By Gaurahari's mercy all were maddened with prema. One day the Lord was walking with Srivasa Pandita and his brothers, and suddenly, hearing the sound of Krishna's flute, He attained the state that Srimati Gandharvika had attained and, like a madman, began to display loud laughter, weeping, silence, humility and other anubhavas. Then a heavenly voice resounded: "O Vishvambhara! You are Bhagavan Himself, descended to the earth to preach prema." When in Murari's house the Lord manifested the form of the Boar, Murari praised Him and begged the Lord for prema; the Lord told him to worship the son of the king of Vraja, served by the cowherd men and women. When Murari wished to see the form of Ramachandra, the Lord showed him that form and glorified the greatness of the name of Krishna. Further are described the coming of Brahma and the other gods to Gaura with prayers for prema, their attaining prema by Gaura's mercy and their dancing with cries of "O Radha, O Govinda!", the mercy to Shuklambara Brahmachari, the garland from the Lord's body given to Gadadhara, the wondrous beauty of the pair Gaura and Gadadhara, and so on[^24-1].

*Raga karuna-shri*

জয় নরহরি-গদাধর-প্রাণনাথ ।
কৃপা করি কর প্রভু শুভ দৃষ্টিপাত ॥ ১ ॥

*jaẏa narahari-gadādhara-prāṇanātha |*
*kṛpā kari kara prabhu śubha dṛṣṭipāta || 1 ||*

*Word for word:* jaya — glory; narahari-gadadhara-prananatha — to the Lord of the life of Narahari and Gadadhara; kripa kari — mercifully; kara prabhu — cast, Lord; shubha drishtipata — an auspicious glance

**1.** Glory to You, Lord of the life of Narahari and Gadadhara!
Be merciful, Lord — cast on us Your auspicious glance.

আদিখণ্ড সায় মধ্যখণ্ডের আরম্ভ ।
যা শুনিলে প্রেমধন পাবে অবিলম্ব ॥ ২ ॥

*ādikhaṇḍa sāẏa madhyakhaṇḍera ārambha |*
*yā śunile premadhana pābe abilamba || 2 ||*

*Word for word:* adikhanda saya — the Adi-khanda is ended; madhyakhandera arambha — the beginning of the Madhya-khanda; ya shunile — by hearing which; prema-dhana — the treasure of prema; pabe avilamba — one will obtain at once

**2.** The Adi-khanda is ended — the beginning of the Madhya-khanda:
whoever hears it will at once obtain the treasure of prema.

মধ্যখণ্ড-কথা কহি অমৃতের সার ।
নদিয়া-বিহার যাথে প্রেমার প্রচার ॥ ৩ ॥

*madhyakhaṇḍa-kathā kahi amṛtera sāra |*
*nadiẏā-bihāra yāthe premāra pracāra || 3 ||*

*Word for word:* madhyakhanda-katha kahi — I tell the story of the Madhya-khanda; amritera sara — the essence of nectar; nadiya-vihara — the pastimes in Nadia; yathe — in which; premara prachara — the preaching of prema

**3.** I tell the story of the Madhya-khanda — the essence of nectar,
where are the pastimes in Nadia and the preaching of prema,

জগাই-মাধাই পাপী যাহে উদ্ধারিলা ।
ব্রহ্মার দুর্লভ প্রেম যারে তারে দিলা ॥ ৪ ॥

*jagāi-mādhāi pāpī yāhe uddhārilā |*
*brahmāra durlabha prema yāre tāre dilā || 4 ||*

*Word for word:* jagai-madhai papi — the sinners Jagai and Madhai; yahe uddharila — where He delivered; brahmara durlabha prema — prema rare for Brahma; yare tare dila — was given to one and all

**4.** where the sinners Jagai and Madhai were delivered,
where prema, rare even for Brahma, was given to one and all,

হরিনাম-সঙ্কীর্তন যাহাতে প্রকাশ ।
পতিত-উদ্ধার-হেতু যাহাতে সন্ন্যাস ॥ ৫ ॥

*harināma-saṅkīrtana yāhāte prakāśa |*
*patita-uddhāra-hetu yāhāte sannyāsa || 5 ||*

*Word for word:* harinama-sankirtana — the sankirtana of the name of Hari; yahate prakasha — in which is manifested; patita-uddhara-hetu — for the deliverance of the fallen; yahate sannyasa — in which is sannyasa

**5.** where the sankirtana of the name of Hari was manifested,
where — for the deliverance of the fallen — sannyasa.

কহিব এ সব কথা অমৃতের খণ্ড ।
যা শুনিলে ঘুচে জীবের অন্তর-পাষণ্ড ॥ ৬ ॥

*kahiba e saba kathā amṛtera khaṇḍa |*
*yā śunile ghuce jībera antara-pāṣaṇḍa || 6 ||*

*Word for word:* kahiba e saba katha — I shall tell all this; amritera khanda — morsels of nectar; ya shunile — by hearing which; ghuche jivera antara-pashanda — the godlessness in the soul's heart vanishes

**6.** I shall tell all this — morsels of nectar:
whoever hears it, from his heart godlessness will vanish.

নদিয়া আসিয়া প্রভু আনন্দিত-চিতে ।
সুখে নিবসয়ে বন্ধু-বান্ধব-সহিতে ॥ ৭ ॥

*nadiẏā āsiẏā prabhu ānandita-cite |*
*sukhe nibasaẏe bandhu-bāndhaba-sahite || 7 ||*

*Word for word:* nadiya asiya — having come to Nadia; prabhu anandita-chite — the Lord with a joyful heart; sukhe nivasaye — lives happily; bandhu-bandhava-sahite — with relatives and friends

**7.** Having returned to Nadia, the Lord with a joyful heart
lives happily together with His relatives and friends.

নবদ্বীপবাসী যত ব্রাহ্মণকুমার ।
সৎকুলসম্ভব তারা অতি শুদ্ধাচার ॥ ৮ ॥

*nabadbīpabāsī yata brāhmaṇakumāra |*
*satkulasambhaba tārā ati śuddhācāra || 8 ||*

*Word for word:* navadvipa-vasi — living in Navadvipa; yata brahmana-kumara — all the brahmana youths; sat-kula-sambhava tara — born of good families; ati shuddhachara — very pure in conduct

**8.** All the brahmana youths living in Navadvipa
are born in good families and very pure in conduct.

বড় সুকৃতী তারা ধন্য তিনলোকে ।
আপনে ঠাকুর বিদ্যাদান দিল যাকে ॥ ৯ ॥

*baṛa sukṛtī tārā dhanya tinaloke |*
*āpane ṭhākura bidyādāna dila yāke || 9 ||*

*Word for word:* bada sukriti tara — great is their merit; dhanya tina-loke — blessed in the three worlds; apane thakura — the Thakura Himself; vidya-dana dila yake — to whom He gave knowledge

**9.** Great is their fortune, they are blessed in the three worlds:
the Thakura Himself bestowed knowledge on them.

সব শিষ্যগণে একদিন গৌরহরি ।
বলিল সভারে প্রভু অনুগ্রহ করি ॥ ১০ ॥

*saba śiṣyagaṇe ekadina gaurahari |*
*balila sabhāre prabhu anugraha kari || 10 ||*

*Word for word:* saba shishya-gane — to all the students; ekadina gaurahari — one day Gaurahari; balila sabhare prabhu — the Lord said to all; anugraha kari — showing favour

**10.** One day Gaurahari, the Lord, showing His favour,
said to all His students:

পড় এক সত্য বস্তু কৃষ্ণের চরণ ।
সেই বিদ্যা যাথে হরিভক্তির লক্ষণ ॥ ১১ ॥

*paṛa eka satya bastu kṛṣṇera caraṇa |*
*sei bidyā yāthe haribhaktira lakṣaṇa || 11 ||*

*Word for word:* pada — study; eka satya vastu — the one true reality; krishnera charana — the feet of Krishna; sei vidya — that is knowledge; yathe haribhaktira lakshana — in which is the mark of devotion to Hari

**11.** "Study the one true reality — the feet of Krishna:
that is knowledge in which there is the mark of devotion to Hari.

তাহা বিনু অবিদ্যা সকল শাস্ত্রে কহে ।
রাধাকৃষ্ণ-ভক্তি বিনে কেহো সঙ্গী নহে ॥ ১২ ॥

*tāhā binu abidyā sakala śāstre kahe |*
*rādhākṛṣṇa-bhakti bine keho saṅgī nahe || 12 ||*

*Word for word:* taha vinu — without it; avidya sakala — all is ignorance; shastre kahe — say the shastras; radha-krishna-bhakti vine — without devotion to Radha and Krishna; keho sangi nahe — no one is a companion

**12.** Without it, say the shastras, all is ignorance;
without devotion to Radha and Krishna no one is our companion.

বিদ্যা-কুল-ধন-মদে কৃষ্ণ নাহি পায় ।
ভক্তিতে সে অনায়াসে পাই যদুরায় ॥ ১৩ ॥

*bidyā-kula-dhana-made kṛṣṇa nāhi pāẏa |*
*bhaktite se anāẏāse pāi yadurāẏa || 13 ||*

*Word for word:* vidya-kula-dhana-made — by pride of learning, birth and wealth; krishna nahi paya — Krishna is not attained; bhaktite se — but by devotion; anayase — easily; pai yaduraya — one attains the Lord of the Yadus

**13.** By pride of learning, birth and wealth Krishna is not attained,
but by devotion one easily attains the Lord of the Yadus.

ভক্তিরসে বশ কৃষ্ণ দেখহ বিচারি ।
এত কহি শ্লোক পড়ে শাস্ত্র-অনুসারি ॥ ১৪ ॥

*bhaktirase baśa kṛṣṇa dekhaha bicāri |*
*eta kahi śloka paṛe śāstra-anusāri || 14 ||*

*Word for word:* bhakti-rase — by the rasa of devotion; vasha krishna — Krishna is subdued; dekhaha vichari — consider; eta kahi — saying this; shloka pade — He recites a shloka; shastra-anusari — following the shastras

**14.** Consider: Krishna is subdued by the rasa of devotion" —
saying this, He recites a shloka in accordance with the shastras.

*Thus in the Padyavali (the words of a southern poet):*

ব্যাধস্যাচরণং ধ্রুবস্য চ বয়ো বিদ্যা গজেন্দ্রস্য কা
কুব্জায়াঃ কিমু নাম রূপমধিকং কিং তৎ সুদাম্নো ধনম্ ।
বংশঃ কো বিদুরস্য যাদবপতেরুগ্রস্য কিং পৌরুষং
ভক্ত্যা তুষ্যতি কেবলং ন চ গুণৈর্ভক্তিপ্রিয়ো মাধবঃ ॥ ১৫ ॥

*byādhasyācaraṇaṃ dhrubasya ca baẏo bidyā gajendrasya kā*
*kubjāẏāḥ kimu nāma rūpamadhikaṃ kiṃ tat sudāmno dhanam |*
*baṃśaḥ ko bidurasya yādabapaterugrasya kiṃ pauruṣaṃ*
*bhaktyā tuṣyati kebalaṃ na ca guṇairbhaktipriẏo mādhabaḥ || 15 ||*

*Word for word:* vyadhasya acharanam — the conduct of the hunter; dhruvasya cha vayah — and the age of Dhruva; vidya gajendrasya ka — what the learning of Gajendra; kubjayah kimu nama rupam adhikam — what the name and beauty of Kubja; kim tat sudamnah dhanam — what the wealth of Sudama; vamshah kah vidurasya — what the lineage of Vidura; yadava-pateh ugrasya kim paurusham — what the prowess of Ugrasena, lord of the Yadavas; bhaktya tushyati kevalam — is pleased by devotion alone; na cha gunaih — not by qualities; bhakti-priyah madhavah — Madhava, who loves devotion

**15.** "What was the conduct of the hunter, what the age of Dhruva, what the learning of Gajendra, what the name and beauty of Kubja, what the wealth of Sudama,
what the lineage of Vidura, what the prowess of Ugrasena, lord of the Yadavas? Madhava, who loves devotion, is pleased by devotion alone, not by qualities"[^24-2].

এইমতে শিষ্যগণে পড়ায় ঠাকুর ।
প্রকাশিব নিজপ্রেম আনন্দ প্রচুর ॥ ১৬ ॥

*eimate śiṣyagaṇe paṛāẏa ṭhākura |*
*prakāśiba nijaprema ānanda pracura || 16 ||*

*Word for word:* eimate — thus; shishya-gane padaya thakura — the Thakura teaches His students; prakashiba nija-prema — I shall reveal My prema; ananda prachura — abundant bliss

**16.** Thus the Thakura taught His students,
[intending] to reveal His prema — abundant bliss.

একদিন নিজগৃহে আছয়ে শুইয়া ।
কৃষ্ণপ্রেমানন্দে কান্দে বিহ্বল হইয়া ॥ ১৭ ॥

*ekadina nijagṛhe āchaẏe śuiẏā |*
*kṛṣṇapremānande kānde bihbala haiẏā || 17 ||*

*Word for word:* ekadina — one day; nija-grihe achhaye shuiya — lying in His house; krishna-premanande — in the bliss of love for Krishna; kande vihvala haiya — He weeps, overwhelmed

**17.** One day, lying in His house,
He weeps, overwhelmed by the bliss of love for Krishna.

রাধাভাবে ব্যাকুল হইয়া প্রভু ডাকে ।
মাথুর-বিরহে হাথ মারে নিজবুকে ॥ ১৮ ॥

*rādhābhābe byākula haiẏā prabhu ḍāke |*
*māthura-birahe hātha māre nijabuke || 18 ||*

*Word for word:* radha-bhave — in the mood of Radha; vyakula haiya — agitated; prabhu dake — the Lord calls out; mathura-virahe — in the separation of Mathura; hatha mare nija-buke — beats His own breast with His hand

**18.** Agitated by the mood of Radha, the Lord calls out
and in separation from [Krishna gone to] Mathura beats His breast with His hand:

আরে রে অক্রূর মোর কৃষ্ণ লঞা গেলি ।
ইহা বলি কান্দে প্রভু করিয়া বিকুলি ॥ ১৯ ॥

*āre re akrūra mora kṛṣṇa lañā geli |*
*ihā bali kānde prabhu kariẏā bikuli || 19 ||*

*Word for word:* are re akrura — ah, Akrura; mora krishna lana geli — you have taken my Krishna away; iha bali — saying this; kande prabhu — the Lord weeps; kariya vikuli — lamenting

**19.** "Ah, Akrura! You have carried off my Krishna!" —
saying this, the Lord weeps and laments.

কুবুজা কুৎসিতমতি কৃষ্ণ নিল মোর ।
শঠরতি লম্পট যুবতী-মন-চোর ॥ ২০ ॥

*kubujā kutsitamati kṛṣṇa nila mora |*
*śaṭharati lampaṭa yubatī-mana-cora || 20 ||*

*Word for word:* kubuja kutsita-mati — Kubja of base mind; krishna nila mora — has taken my Krishna; shatha-rati — the cheat in love; lampata — the rake; yuvati-mana-chora — the thief of young women's hearts

**20.** "Kubja, with her base mind, has taken my Krishna —
the cheat in love, the rake, the thief of young women's hearts!"[^24-3]

ইহা বলি কান্দে প্রভু গরজে হুঙ্কার ।
পুলকে আকুল অঙ্গ ভাব চমৎকার ॥ ২১ ॥

*ihā bali kānde prabhu garaje huṅkāra |*
*pulake ākula aṅga bhāba camatkāra || 21 ||*

*Word for word:* iha bali — saying this; kande prabhu — the Lord weeps; garaje hunkara — cries aloud; pulake akula anga — His body thrills with hair on end; bhava chamatkara — a wondrous bhava

**21.** Saying this, the Lord weeps and cries aloud;
His body thrills, His hair stands on end — a wondrous bhava.

বিস্মিত হইয়া শচী বিশ্বম্ভরে পুছে ।
কি লাগিয়া কান্দ বাপ দুঃখ তোর কিসে ॥ ২২ ॥

*bismita haiẏā śacī biśbambhare puche |*
*ki lāgiẏā kānda bāpa duḥkha tora kise || 22 ||*

*Word for word:* vismita haiya — astonished; shachi vishvambhare puchhe — Shachi asks Vishvambhara; ki lagiya kanda — why do You weep; bapa — my son; duhkha tora kise — what is Your sorrow

**22.** Astonished, Shachi asks Vishvambhara:
"Why are You weeping, my son? What is Your sorrow?"

মায়ের বচন শুনি না দিয়া উত্তর ।
রোদন করয়ে প্রভু আনন্দে বিভোর ॥ ২৩ ॥

*māẏera bacana śuni nā diẏā uttara |*
*rodana karaẏe prabhu ānande bibhora || 23 ||*

*Word for word:* mayera vachana shuni — hearing His mother's words; na diya uttara — giving no answer; rodana karaye prabhu — the Lord weeps; anande bibhora — beside Himself with bliss

**23.** Hearing His mother's words, the Lord gave no answer
and weeps, beside Himself with bliss.

তবে সেই শচীদেবী মনে মনে গণে ।
কৃষ্ণ-অনুগ্রহ প্রেম জানিল লক্ষণে ॥ ২৪ ॥

*tabe sei śacīdebī mane mane gaṇe |*
*kṛṣṇa-anugraha prema jānila lakṣaṇe || 24 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe sei shachidevi — then Shachi-devi; mane mane gane — reflects within herself; krishna-anugraha prema — prema, Krishna's grace; janila lakshane — she understood by the signs

**24.** Then Shachi-devi, reflecting within herself,
understood by the signs: this is prema — Krishna's grace.

বড় ভাগ্যবতী শচী সর্বতত্ত্ব জানে ।
পুত্রের সম্মুখে কহে মধুর বচনে ॥ ২৫ ॥

*baṛa bhāgyabatī śacī sarbatattba jāne |*
*putrera sammukhe kahe madhura bacane || 25 ||*

*Word for word:* bada bhagyavati shachi — most fortunate is Shachi; sarva-tattva jane — she knows all truth; putrera sammukhe — before her son; kahe madhura vachane — speaks sweet words

**25.** Great is Shachi's fortune — she knows the whole truth;
before her son she speaks sweet words:

শুন শুন আরে বাপ মোর সোণার সুত ।
জগত-দুর্লভ তোর দেখোঁ অদ্ভুত ॥ ২৬ ॥

*śuna śuna āre bāpa mora soṇāra suta |*
*jagata-durlabha tora dekhoṁ adbhuta || 26 ||*

*Word for word:* shuna shuna are bapa — listen, listen, my son; mora sonara suta — my golden son; jagata-durlabha — rare in the world; tora dekhon adbhuta — I see in You something wondrous

**26.** "Listen, listen, my son, my golden son:
I see in You a wondrous [treasure], rare in the world.

যথা তথা যাও তুমি পাও যে বা ধন ।
আনিঞা আমার ঠাঞি কর সমর্পণ ॥ ২৭ ॥

*yathā tathā yāo tumi pāo ye bā dhana |*
*āniñā āmāra ṭhāñi kara samarpaṇa || 27 ||*

*Word for word:* yatha tatha yao tumi — wherever You go; pao ye ba dhana — whatever wealth You obtain; anina amara thani — bringing it to me; kara samarpana — You hand it over

**27.** Wherever You went, whatever wealth You obtained,
You brought it and gave it to me.

গয়াতে পাইলে কৃষ্ণপ্রেম হেন ধন ।
দেবতা-দুর্লভ বস্তু অমূল্য রতন ॥ ২৮ ॥

*gaẏāte pāile kṛṣṇaprema hena dhana |*
*debatā-durlabha bastu amūlya ratana || 28 ||*

*Word for word:* gayate paile — in Gaya You obtained; krishna-prema hena dhana — such wealth, love for Krishna; devata-durlabha vastu — a thing rare for the gods; amulya ratana — a priceless jewel

**28.** In Gaya You obtained such wealth — love for Krishna,
a thing rare even for the gods, a priceless jewel.

আমা প্রতি কভু যদি দয়া থাকে চিতে ।
দেহ কৃষ্ণপ্রেমধন এই চাহিতে ॥ ২৯ ॥

*āmā prati kabhu yadi daẏā thāke cite |*
*deha kṛṣṇapremadhana ei cāhite || 29 ||*

*Word for word:* ama prati — towards me; kabhu yadi daya thake chite — if there is any compassion in Your heart; deha krishna-prema-dhana — give the wealth of love for Krishna; ei chahite — this I ask

**29.** If there is any compassion for me in Your heart,
give me the wealth of love for Krishna — this I ask."

এতেক বচন যদি শচীদেবী বৈল ।
হৃদয় দরবে প্রভু চাহিতে লাগিল ॥ ৩০ ॥

*eteka bacana yadi śacīdebī baila |*
*hṛdaẏa darabe prabhu cāhite lāgila || 30 ||*

*Word for word:* eteka vachana yadi — when such words; shachidevi baila — Shachi-devi spoke; hridaya darabe — the heart melted; prabhu chahite lagila — the Lord looked [at her]

**30.** When Shachi-devi spoke such words,
the Lord's heart melted, and He looked [at her]:

বৈষ্ণব-প্রসাদে প্রেম পাবে মাতা তুমি ।
নিশ্চয় জানিহ কথা কহিলাম আমি ॥ ৩১ ॥

*baiṣṇaba-prasāde prema pābe mātā tumi |*
*niścaẏa jāniha kathā kahilāma āmi || 31 ||*

*Word for word:* vaishnava-prasade — by the mercy of the Vaishnavas; prema pabe mata tumi — you will obtain prema, mother; nishchaya janiha katha — know it for certain; kahilama ami — I tell you

**31.** "By the mercy of the Vaishnavas you will obtain prema, mother —
know it for certain: I am telling you.

বৈষ্ণব-গোসাঞি প্রেম দিতে নিতে পারে ।
তাহা বিনা প্রেম আর কেহো দিতে নারে ॥ ৩১+১ ॥

*baiṣṇaba-gosāñi prema dite nite pāre |*
*tāhā binā prema āra keho dite nāre || 31+1 ||*

*Word for word:* vaishnava-gosani — the Vaishnava gosanis; prema — prema; dite nite pare — can give and take away; taha vina — apart from them; prema ara keho — prema no one else; dite nare — can give

**31+1.** The Vaishnava gosanis can give prema and take it away;
apart from them no one else can give prema"[^24-4].

এ বোল শুনিঞা শচী অতি হৃষ্টচিত ।
তখনে পাইল প্রেমভক্তি আচম্বিত ॥ ৩২ ॥

*e bola śuniñā śacī ati hṛṣṭacita |*
*takhane pāila premabhakti ācambita || 32 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shunina — hearing these words; shachi ati hrishta-chita — Shachi was overjoyed; takhane paila — at once obtained; prema-bhakti — prema-bhakti; achambita — unexpectedly

**32.** Hearing these words, Shachi was overjoyed
and at once, unexpectedly, obtained prema-bhakti.

পুলকিত সব অঙ্গ কম্প কলেবর ।
নয়নে গলয়ে অশ্রুধারা নিরন্তর ॥ ৩৩ ॥

*pulakita saba aṅga kampa kalebara |*
*naẏane galaẏe aśrudhārā nirantara || 33 ||*

*Word for word:* pulakita saba anga — the whole body thrills; kampa kalevara — the body trembles; nayane galaye — from the eyes flow; ashru-dhara nirantara — streams of tears ceaselessly

**33.** Her whole body thrills, her body trembles,
streams of tears flow ceaselessly from her eyes.

কৃষ্ণ কৃষ্ণ বলি ডাকে হৃদয়-উল্লাস ।
কহয়ে লোচন গোরা-প্রথম-প্রকাশ ॥ ৩৪ ॥

*kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa bali ḍāke hṛdaẏa-ullāsa |*
*kahaẏe locana gorā-prathama-prakāśa || 34 ||*

*Word for word:* krishna krishna bali dake — she calls "Krishna, Krishna!"; hridaya-ullasa — her heart rejoicing; kahaye lochana — Lochana tells; gora-prathama-prakasha — of Gora's first manifestation

**34.** "Krishna, Krishna!" she calls, her heart rejoicing. —
Thus Lochana tells of Gora's first manifestation.

*Raga shri*

তবে বিশ্বম্ভর পহুঁ প্রেমে গরগর ।
আছয়ে ব্রাহ্মণ ব্রহ্মচারী শুক্লাম্বর ॥ ৩৫ ॥

*tabe biśbambhara pahuṁ preme garagara |*
*āchaẏe brāhmaṇa brahmacārī śuklāmbara || 35 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe — then; vishvambhara pahun — the Lord Vishvambhara; preme garagara — overwhelmed with love; achhaye brahmana — there was a brahmana; brahmachari shuklambara — the brahmachari Shuklambara

**35.** Then the Lord Vishvambhara, overwhelmed with love, —
[in Navadvipa] there lived a brahmana, the brahmachari Shuklambara, —

তার ঘরে কান্দে প্রভু প্রেমায় বিভোর ।
নয়নে গলয়ে অশ্রুধারা নিরন্তর ॥ ৩৬ ॥

*tāra ghare kānde prabhu premāẏa bibhora |*
*naẏane galaẏe aśrudhārā nirantara || 36 ||*

*Word for word:* tara ghare — in his house; kande prabhu — the Lord weeps; premaya bibhora — lost in prema; nayane galaye ashru-dhara nirantara — streams of tears flow ceaselessly from the eyes

**36.** in his house the Lord weeps, lost in prema;
streams of tears flow ceaselessly from His eyes.

নাসিকায় বহে শ্লেষ্মা অতি নিরন্তর ।
নিরবধি ফেলে তাহা বিপ্র শুক্লাম্বর ॥ ৩৭ ॥

*nāsikāẏa bahe śleṣmā ati nirantara |*
*nirabadhi phele tāhā bipra śuklāmbara || 37 ||*

*Word for word:* nasikaya bahe shleshma — mucus flows from the nose; ati nirantara — ceaselessly; niravadhi phele taha — keeps wiping it away; vipra shuklambara — the brahmana Shuklambara

**37.** Mucus flows ceaselessly from His nose,
and the brahmana Shuklambara keeps wiping it away.

ভূমেতে লুটাঞা কান্দে রজনী দিবস ।
সন্ধ্যার সময়ে প্রশ্ন করয়ে বিবশ ॥ ৩৮ ॥

*bhūmete luṭāñā kānde rajanī dibasa |*
*sandhyāra samaẏe praśna karaẏe bibaśa || 38 ||*

*Word for word:* bhumete lutana — rolling on the ground; kande rajani divasa — He weeps night and day; sandhyara samaye — at dusk; prashna karaye vivasha — beside Himself, He asks

**38.** Rolling on the ground, He weeps day and night;
at dusk, beside Himself, He asks [the time]:

দিবসে পুছয়ে প্রভু কত রাত্রি যায় ।
সব-জন কহে দিবা রাত্রি নাহি হয় ॥ ৩৯ ॥

*dibase puchaẏe prabhu kata rātri yāẏa |*
*saba-jana kahe dibā rātri nāhi haẏa || 39 ||*

*Word for word:* divase puchhaye prabhu — in the daytime the Lord asks; kata ratri yaya — how much of the night has passed; saba-jana kahe — all say; diva — it is day; ratri nahi haya — it is not night

**39.** in the daytime the Lord asks: "How much of the night has passed?"
All say: "It is day now, not night."

তবে সেইমত প্রভু প্রেমাতে বিবশ ।
রোদন করয়ে পুনঃ আনন্দে অবশ ॥ ৪০ ॥

*tabe seimata prabhu premāte bibaśa |*
*rodana karaẏe punaḥ ānande abaśa || 40 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe seimata — thus; prabhu premate vivasha — the Lord overpowered by prema; rodana karaye punah — weeps again; anande avasha — helpless with bliss

**40.** Thus the Lord, overpowered by prema,
weeps again, helpless with bliss.

প্রহরেক রাত্রি গেলে দিন বলি পুছে ।
দিন নাহি হয় কহে কাছে যত আছে ॥ ৪১ ॥

*prahareka rātri gele dina bali puche |*
*dina nāhi haẏa kahe kāche yata āche || 41 ||*

*Word for word:* prahareka ratri gele — when a watch of the night has passed; dina bali puchhe — He asks, [thinking it] day; dina nahi haya — it is not day; kahe kachhe yata achhe — say all who are near

**41.** When a watch of the night has passed, He asks, [thinking it] day;
"It is not yet day," say all who are near.

প্রেমায় বিভোর নাহি জানে দিবা-রাতি ।
কারো মুখে কৃষ্ণনাম শুনি পড়ে ক্ষিতি ॥ ৪২ ॥

*premāẏa bibhora nāhi jāne dibā-rāti |*
*kāro mukhe kṛṣṇanāma śuni paṛe kṣiti || 42 ||*

*Word for word:* premaya bibhora — lost in prema; nahi jane diva-rati — He does not know day from night; karo mukhe — from anyone's lips; krishna-nama shuni — hearing the name of Krishna; pade kshiti — He falls to the ground

**42.** Lost in prema, He does not know day from night;
hearing the name of Krishna from anyone's lips, He falls to the ground.

কৃষ্ণ-গুণ-নাম-গীত কেহ যদি গায় ।
শুনিঞা তখনি কান্দে ভূমেতে লুটায় ॥ ৪৩ ॥

*kṛṣṇa-guṇa-nāma-gīta keha yadi gāẏa |*
*śuniñā takhani kānde bhūmete luṭāẏa || 43 ||*

*Word for word:* krishna-guna-nama-gita — a song of Krishna's qualities and names; keha yadi gaya — if anyone sings; shunina takhani — hearing it, at once; kande — He weeps; bhumete lutaya — rolls on the ground

**43.** If anyone sings a song of Krishna's names and qualities,
He, hearing it, at once weeps, rolling on the ground.

ক্ষণে দণ্ডবত করি করে পরণাম ।
ক্ষণে উচ্চস্বর করি গায় কৃষ্ণনাম ॥ ৪৪ ॥

*kṣaṇe daṇḍabata kari kare paraṇāma |*
*kṣaṇe uccasbara kari gāẏa kṛṣṇanāma || 44 ||*

*Word for word:* kshane dandavata kari — now prostrating Himself; kare paranama — bows down; kshane uchchasvara kari — now in a loud voice; gaya krishna-nama — sings the name of Krishna

**44.** Now He prostrates Himself and bows down,
now He sings the name of Krishna in a loud voice.

সকরুণ কণ্ঠ ক্ষণে কম্প কলেবর ।
পুলকিত অঙ্গ জিনি কদম্ব-কেশর ॥ ৪৫ ॥

*sakaruṇa kaṇṭha kṣaṇe kampa kalebara |*
*pulakita aṅga jini kadamba-keśara || 45 ||*

*Word for word:* sakaruna kantha — the voice full of entreaty; kshane — at times; kampa kalevara — the body trembles; pulakita anga — the hair on the body stands on end; jini kadamba-keshara — like kadamba filaments

**45.** Now His voice is full of entreaty, now His body trembles,
His hair stands on end like the filaments of the kadamba.

নিরন্তর পরবশ ক্ষণেক প্রবোধে ।
সেইক্ষণে স্নান-দান জন-অনুরোধে ॥ ৪৬ ॥

*nirantara parabaśa kṣaṇeka prabodhe |*
*seikṣaṇe snāna-dāna jana-anurodhe || 46 ||*

*Word for word:* nirantara paravasha — all the time beside Himself; kshaneka prabodhe — comes to His senses for a moment; sei-kshane — at that time; snana-dana — bathing and giving gifts; jana-anurodhe — at people's request

**46.** All the time He is beside Himself and only for a moment comes to His senses —
then, at people's request, He bathes and gives gifts.

সেইকালে পূজা করে অন্ন-নিবেদন ।
ভোজন করয়ে মহাপ্রসাদ তখন ॥ ৪৭ ॥

*seikāle pūjā kare anna-nibedana |*
*bhojana karaẏe mahāprasāda takhana || 47 ||*

*Word for word:* seikale — at that time; puja kare — He performs worship; anna-nivedana — offers food; bhojana karaye — partakes; mahaprasada takhana — of mahaprasada then

**47.** Then too He performs worship, offers food [to the Deity]
and partakes of mahaprasada.

হেনমতে আনন্দে-কৌতুকে দিন যায় ।
সকল রজনী নিজসুখে নাচে গায় ॥ ৪৮ ॥

*henamate ānande-kautuke dina yāẏa |*
*sakala rajanī nijasukhe nāce gāẏa || 48 ||*

*Word for word:* henamate — thus; anande-kautuke — in joy and delight; dina yaya — the day passes; sakala rajani — all night; nija-sukhe — in His own happiness; nache gaya — dances and sings

**48.** Thus in joy and delight the day passes,
and all night long He, happy, dances and sings.

হেনমতে কৌতুকে সে রজনী-দিবস ।
লোকশিক্ষা করে প্রভু ভুঞ্জে প্রেমরস ॥ ৪৯ ॥

*henamate kautuke se rajanī-dibasa |*
*lokaśikṣā kare prabhu bhuñje premarasa || 49 ||*

*Word for word:* henamate kautuke — thus in delight; se rajani-divasa — night and day; loka-shiksha kare prabhu — the Lord teaches the people; bhunje prema-rasa — tastes the rasa of prema

**49.** Thus in delight — day and night:
the Lord teaches the people and tastes the rasa of prema.

আপনে আপন-রস করে আস্বাদন ।
মুখ্য এই হেতু কথা শুন সর্বজন ॥ ৫০ ॥

*āpane āpana-rasa kare āsbādana |*
*mukhya ei hetu kathā śuna sarbajana || 50 ||*

*Word for word:* apane — Himself; apana-rasa — His own rasa; kare asvadana — He tastes; mukhya ei hetu — this is the chief reason; katha shuna sarvajana — listen, all of you

**50.** He Himself tastes His own rasa —
this is the chief reason; listen, all of you.

জীব-উদ্ধারণ-হেতু গৌণ করি মানি ।
এইহেতু অবতার বলি শিরোমণি ॥ ৫১ ॥

*jība-uddhāraṇa-hetu gauṇa kari māni |*
*eihetu abatāra bali śiromaṇi || 51 ||*

*Word for word:* jiva-uddharana-hetu — the deliverance of souls as a reason; gauna kari mani — I regard as secondary; ei-hetu — therefore; avatara bali shiromani — He is called the crown jewel of avataras

**51.** The deliverance of souls I consider a secondary reason;
that is why He is called the crown jewel of avataras[^24-5].

সব অবতারাবলি দেহেতে প্রকাশ ।
সব অবতার-সঙ্গী সঙ্গে সব দাস ॥ ৫২ ॥

*saba abatārābali dehete prakāśa |*
*saba abatāra-saṅgī saṅge saba dāsa || 52 ||*

*Word for word:* saba avataravali — the whole series of avataras; dehete prakasha — is manifest in the body; saba avatara-sangi — the associates of all avataras; sange — with Him; saba dasa — all servants

**52.** In His body the whole series of avataras is manifest;
the associates of all the avataras are with Him, all [His] servants.

নবদ্বীপে উদয় করিল গৌরচন্দ্র ।
দূর কৈল জগজন-হৃদয়ের অন্ধ ॥ ৫৩ ॥

*nabadbīpe udaẏa karila gauracandra |*
*dūra kaila jagajana-hṛdaẏera andha || 53 ||*

*Word for word:* navadvipe udaya karila — rose in Navadvipa; gaurachandra — Gaurachandra; dura kaila — dispelled; jagajana-hridayera andha — the blindness of the hearts of the world's people

**53.** Gaurachandra has risen in Navadvipa
and dispelled the blindness in the hearts of the people of the world.

করুণা-কিরণে কলিযুগ হৈল আলা ।
ঘুচিল সকল লোকের হৃদয়ের জ্বালা ॥ ৫৪ ॥

*karuṇā-kiraṇe kaliyuga haila ālā |*
*ghucila sakala lokera hṛdaẏera jbālā || 54 ||*

*Word for word:* karuna-kirane — by the rays of compassion; kaliyuga haila ala — the age of Kali was lit up; ghuchila — was quenched; sakala lokera hridayera jvala — the burning in the hearts of all people

**54.** By the rays of His compassion the age of Kali was lit up,
