the burning in the hearts of all people was quenched.

ভকত-চকোর সব আসিয়া মিলিলা ।
প্রেমামৃত-পান করি সভাই ভুলিলা ॥ ৫৫ ॥

*bhakata-cakora saba āsiẏā mililā |*
*premāmṛta-pāna kari sabhāi bhulilā || 55 ||*

*Word for word:* bhakata-chakora saba — all the chakora-devotees; asiya milila — came and gathered; premamrita-pana kari — drinking the nectar of prema; sabhai bhulila — all lost themselves

**55.** All the chakora-devotees came and gathered together;
drinking the nectar of prema, all lost themselves.

মিলিলেন গদাধর-পণ্ডিত গোসাঞি ।
নরহরি মিলিয়া রহিলা তার ঠাঞি ॥ ৫৬ ॥

*mililena gadādhara-paṇḍita gosāñi |*
*narahari miliẏā rahilā tāra ṭhāñi || 56 ||*

*Word for word:* mililena — came; gadadhara-pandita gosani — Gadadhara Pandita Gosani; narahari miliya — Narahari, coming; rahila tara thani — remained with him

**56.** Gadadhara Pandita Gosani came,
and Narahari came and remained with him.

শ্রীনিবাস মুরারি মুকুন্দ বক্রেশ্বর ।
শ্রীধর-পণ্ডিত নবদ্বীপে যার ঘর ॥ ৫৭ ॥

*śrīnibāsa murāri mukunda bakreśbara |*
*śrīdhara-paṇḍita nabadbīpe yāra ghara || 57 ||*

*Word for word:* shrinivasa murari mukunda vakreshvara — Srinivasa, Murari, Mukunda, Vakreshvara; shridhara-pandita — Shridhara Pandita; navadvipe yara ghara — whose home is in Navadvipa

**57.** Srinivasa, Murari, Mukunda, Vakreshvara,
Shridhara Pandita, whose home is in Navadvipa,

শ্রীমান্ সঞ্জয় পণ্ডিত ধনঞ্জয় ।
শুক্লাম্বর নীলাম্বর-আদি মহাশয় ॥ ৫৮ ॥

*śrīmān sañjaẏa paṇḍita dhanañjaẏa |*
*śuklāmbara nīlāmbara-ādi mahāśaẏa || 58 ||*

*Word for word:* shriman — Shriman; sanjaya — Sanjaya; pandita dhananjaya — Pandita Dhananjaya; shuklambara — Shuklambara; nilambara-adi — Nilambara and others; mahashaya — great souls

**58.** Shriman, Sanjaya, Pandita Dhananjaya,
Shuklambara, Nilambara and other great souls,

শ্রীরামপণ্ডিত আর মহেশপণ্ডিত ।
হরিদাস নন্দন-আচার্য সুচরিত ॥ ৫৯ ॥

*śrīrāmapaṇḍita āra maheśapaṇḍita |*
*haridāsa nandana-ācārya sucarita || 59 ||*

*Word for word:* shrirama-pandita — Sri Rama Pandita; ara mahesha-pandita — and Mahesha Pandita; haridasa — Haridasa; nandana-acharya — Nandana Acharya; sucharita — the righteous

**59.** Sri Rama Pandita and Mahesha Pandita,
Haridasa, Nandana Acharya — the righteous,

রুদ্রপণ্ডিত আর পণ্ডিত দামোদর ।
অনেক মিলিলা সে গৌরাঙ্গ-অনুচর ॥ ৬০ ॥

*rudrapaṇḍita āra paṇḍita dāmodara |*
*aneka mililā se gaurāṅga-anucara || 60 ||*

*Word for word:* rudra-pandita — Rudra Pandita; ara pandita damodara — and Pandita Damodara; aneka milila — many gathered; se gauranga-anuchara — the followers of Gauranga

**60.** Rudra Pandita and Pandita Damodara —
many followers of Gauranga gathered.

নামক্রমে লিখন না হয় তা-সভার ।
সম্বরণ নহে গ্রন্থ হয় ত অপার ॥ ৬১ ॥

*nāmakrame likhana nā haẏa tā-sabhāra |*
*sambaraṇa nahe grantha haẏa ta apāra || 61 ||*

*Word for word:* nama-krame — by name in order; likhana na haya — it is impossible to write; ta-sabhara — of them all; sambarana nahe — it could not be finished; grantha haya ta apara — the book would be endless

**61.** It is impossible to list them all by name:
the book could not be finished — it would become endless.

নানাদেশে যতেক আছিলা ভক্তগণ ।
সভেই মিলিলা আসি প্রভুর চরণ ॥ ৬২ ॥

*nānādeśe yateka āchilā bhaktagaṇa |*
*sabhei mililā āsi prabhura caraṇa || 62 ||*

*Word for word:* nanadeshe — in various lands; yateka achhila bhakta-gana — all the devotees who were; sabhei milila asi — all came and gathered; prabhura charana — at the Lord's feet

**62.** All the devotees who lived in various lands
came and gathered at the Lord's feet.

মহাপ্রেমে উন্মত্ত হইলা ভক্তগণ ।
মাতাইলা সর্বলোকে দিয়া প্রেমধন ॥ ৬৩ ॥

*mahāpreme unmatta hailā bhaktagaṇa |*
*mātāilā sarbaloke diẏā premadhana || 63 ||*

*Word for word:* maha-preme — with great prema; unmatta haila bhakta-gana — the devotees were maddened; mataila sarvaloke — they intoxicated all people; diya prema-dhana — giving the wealth of prema

**63.** The devotees were maddened with great prema
and intoxicated all the people, giving them the wealth of prema.

সমভাবে সব-জীবে করুণা করিয়া ।
ভক্তসঙ্গে বুলে গোরা প্রেমবিনোদিয়া ॥ ৬৪ ॥

*samabhābe saba-jībe karuṇā kariẏā |*
*bhaktasaṅge bule gorā premabinodiẏā || 64 ||*

*Word for word:* samabhave — equally; saba-jive karuna kariya — showing compassion to all beings; bhakta-sange — with the devotees; bule gora — Gora goes about; prema-vinodiya — delighting in prema

**64.** Equally compassionate to all living beings,
Gora goes about with the devotees, delighting in prema.

তবে সেই বিশ্বম্ভর আর একদিনে ।
শ্রীবাসপণ্ডিত আর তার ভ্রাতৃগণে ॥ ৬৫ ॥

*tabe sei biśbambhara āra ekadine |*
*śrībāsapaṇḍita āra tāra bhrātṛgaṇe || 65 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe sei vishvambhara — then Vishvambhara; ara ekadine — one day; shrivasa-pandita — Srivasa Pandita; ara tara bhratri-gane — and his brothers

**65.** And then one day Vishvambhara,
with Srivasa Pandita and his brothers —

এ-সব-সহিতে প্রভু পথে চলি যায় ।
শুনয়ে বংশীর ধ্বনি না জানি কে গায় ॥ ৬৬ ॥

*e-saba-sahite prabhu pathe cali yāẏa |*
*śunaẏe baṃśīra dhbani nā jāni ke gāẏa || 66 ||*

*Word for word:* e-saba-sahite — with all of them; prabhu pathe chali yaya — the Lord walks along the road; shunaye vamshira dhvani — He hears the sound of a flute; na jani ke gaya — no one knows who plays

**66.** with all of them the Lord walks along the road
and hears the sound of a flute — no one knows who is playing.

গান্ধর্বার ভাবে বংশীধ্বনি যে শুনিঞা ।
কান্দিয়া কান্দিয়া বুলে ডাকিয়া ডাকিয়া ॥ ৬৭ ॥

*gāndharbāra bhābe baṃśīdhbani ye śuniñā |*
*kāndiẏā kāndiẏā bule ḍākiẏā ḍākiẏā || 67 ||*

*Word for word:* gandharvara bhave — in the mood of Gandharva (Radha); vamshi-dhvani ye shunina — hearing the sound of the flute; kandiya kandiya — weeping and weeping; bule — He wanders; dakiya dakiya — calling and calling

**67.** In the mood of Gandharvika, hearing the sound of the flute,
He wanders, weeping and weeping, calling and calling[^24-6].

বিভোর হইয়া ভূমে দণ্ডবত করে ।
রোদন করয়ে নানাবিধ প্রেমভরে ॥ ৬৮ ॥

*bibhora haiẏā bhūme daṇḍabata kare |*
*rodana karaẏe nānābidha premabhare || 68 ||*

*Word for word:* bibhora haiya — beside Himself; bhume dandavata kare — He prostrates Himself on the ground; rodana karaye nanavidha — weeps in many ways; prema-bhare — overflowing with prema

**68.** Beside Himself, He prostrates Himself on the ground
and weeps in many ways, overflowing with prema.

অবশ হইল প্রভু নির্ভর-আবেশে ।
নিজজনে আশীর্বাদ করে অট্ট হাসে ॥ ৬৯ ॥

*abaśa haila prabhu nirbhara-ābeśe |*
*nijajane āśīrbāda kare aṭṭa hāse || 69 ||*

*Word for word:* avasha haila prabhu — the Lord became senseless; nirbhara-aveshe — wholly in the grip of bhava; nija-jane ashirvada kare — blesses His own; atta hase — laughs aloud

**69.** The Lord is senseless, wholly in the grip of bhava;
He blesses His own and laughs aloud.

শিষ্যগণ-সঙ্গে ক্ষণে অলৌকিক কহে ।
ক্ষণে উনমাদ ক্ষণে নিঃশব্দে রহে ॥ ৭০ ॥

*śiṣyagaṇa-saṅge kṣaṇe alaukika kahe |*
*kṣaṇe unamāda kṣaṇe niḥśabde rahe || 70 ||*

*Word for word:* shishya-gana-sange — to the students; kshane alaukika kahe — at times says unearthly things; kshane unamada — now in frenzy; kshane nihshabde rahe — now remains silent

**70.** To His students He at times says unearthly things;
now He is in a frenzy, now He keeps silent.

শ্রীবাসপণ্ডিত আর রাম নারায়ণ ।
মুকুন্দ-সহিত গেলা শ্রীবাস-ভবন ॥ ৭১ ॥

*śrībāsapaṇḍita āra rāma nārāẏaṇa |*
*mukunda-sahita gelā śrībāsa-bhabana || 71 ||*

*Word for word:* shrivasa-pandita — Srivasa Pandita; ara rama narayana — and Rama, Narayana; mukunda-sahita — with Mukunda; gela shrivasa-bhavana — went to Srivasa's house

**71.** Srivasa Pandita, Rama and Narayana,
together with Mukunda, came [with Him] to Srivasa's house.

চৌদিকে বেঢ়িয়া ভক্ত মাঝে গৌরহরি ।
মদে মাতোয়াল যেন কিশোর-কিশোরী ॥ ৭২ ॥

*caudike beṛhiẏā bhakta mājhe gaurahari |*
*made mātoẏāla yena kiśora-kiśorī || 72 ||*

*Word for word:* chaudike bedhiya bhakta — the devotees all around; majhe gaurahari — Gaurahari in the midst; made matoyala — intoxicated; yena kishora-kishori — like Kishora and Kishori

**72.** All around are the devotees, and in the midst is Gaurahari,
intoxicated like the Youthful Couple[^24-7].

ক্ষণে উঠে ক্ষণে পড়ে ভূমিতে লোটায় ।
হরি হরি বলি ডাকে কান্দে উচ্চরায় ॥ ৭৩ ॥

*kṣaṇe uṭhe kṣaṇe paṛe bhūmite loṭāẏa |*
*hari hari bali ḍāke kānde uccarāẏa || 73 ||*

*Word for word:* kshane uthe — now rises; kshane pade — now falls; bhumite lotaya — rolls on the ground; hari hari bali dake — cries "Hari, Hari!"; kande uchcharaya — weeps aloud

**73.** Now He rises, now falls and rolls on the ground,
cries "Hari, Hari!" and weeps aloud.

রাত্রিদিনে প্রেমানন্দে পুলকিত তনু ।
আন-পরসঙ্গ নাহি কৃষ্ণকথা বিনু ॥ ৭৪ ॥

*rātridine premānande pulakita tanu |*
*āna-parasaṅga nāhi kṛṣṇakathā binu || 74 ||*

*Word for word:* ratri-dine — night and day; premanande — with the bliss of prema; pulakita tanu — the body thrills; ana-parasanga nahi — there is no other talk; krishna-katha vinu — but talk of Krishna

**74.** Day and night His body thrills with the bliss of prema;
there is no other talk than talk of Krishna.

এককালে নিজঘরে আছে প্রেমে ভোরা ।
রোদন করয়ে আঁখে সাত-পাঁচ-ধারা ॥ ৭৫ ॥

*ekakāle nijaghare āche preme bhorā |*
*rodana karaẏe āṁkhe sāta-pāṁca-dhārā || 75 ||*

*Word for word:* eka-kale — once; nija-ghare achhe — at His home; preme bhora — absorbed in prema; rodana karaye — weeps; ankhe — from the eyes; sata-pancha-dhara — in seven or five streams

**75.** Once, when He was at home, absorbed in prema,
tears flowed from His eyes in seven or five streams:

কি করিব কোথা যাব কেমন উপায় ।
শ্রীকৃষ্ণে আমার মতি কোন মতে হয় ॥ ৭৬ ॥

*ki kariba kothā yāba kemana upāẏa |*
*śrīkṛṣṇe āmāra mati kona mate haẏa || 76 ||*

*Word for word:* ki kariba — what shall I do; kotha yaba — where shall I go; kemana upaya — what means; shri-krishne amara mati — that My mind towards Sri Krishna; kona mate haya — may somehow turn

**76.** "What shall I do? Where shall I go? What means shall I find
so that My mind may somehow turn to Sri Krishna?"

ইহা বলি রোদন করয়ে আর্তনাদে ।
কাতর বচন শুনি সর্বলোক কান্দে ॥ ৭৭ ॥

*ihā bali rodana karaẏe ārtanāde |*
*kātara bacana śuni sarbaloka kānde || 77 ||*

*Word for word:* iha bali — saying this; rodana karaye artanade — He sobs with anguished cries; katara vachana shuni — hearing the plaintive words; sarvaloka kande — all the people weep

**77.** Saying this, He sobs with anguished cries;
hearing His plaintive words, all the people weep.

হেনকালে দৈববাণী উঠিল সাদরে ।
আপনে ঈশ্বর তুমি শুন বিশ্বম্ভরে ॥ ৭৮ ॥

*henakāle daibabāṇī uṭhila sādare |*
*āpane īśbara tumi śuna biśbambhare || 78 ||*

*Word for word:* henakale — then; daiva-vani uthila — a heavenly voice arose; sadare — tenderly; apane ishvara tumi — You are Ishvara Himself; shuna vishvambhare — listen, Vishvambhara

**78.** Then a heavenly voice resounded tenderly:
"You are Ishvara Himself; listen, Vishvambhara!

প্রেম প্রকাশিতে মহী কৈলে অবতার ।
নিজ-করুণায় প্রেমা করিবে প্রচার ॥ ৭৯ ॥

*prema prakāśite mahī kaile abatāra |*
*nija-karuṇāẏa premā karibe pracāra || 79 ||*

*Word for word:* prema prakashite — to reveal prema; mahi kaile avatara — You descended to the earth; nija-karunaya — by Your own mercy; prema karibe prachara — You will preach prema

**79.** You have descended to the earth to reveal prema;
by Your own mercy You will preach prema.

ধর্মসংস্থাপন ক্ষিতি করিবে কীর্তন ।
খেদ না করিহ কর কৃষ্ণসঙ্কীর্তন ॥ ৮০ ॥

*dharmasaṃsthāpana kṣiti karibe kīrtana |*
*kheda nā kariha kara kṛṣṇasaṅkīrtana || 80 ||*

*Word for word:* dharma-samsthapana kshiti — establishing dharma on earth; karibe kirtana — You will perform kirtana; kheda na kariha — do not grieve; kara krishna-sankirtana — perform the kirtana of Krishna

**80.** You will establish dharma on earth and perform kirtana;
do not grieve — perform the kirtana of Krishna.

তোমার প্রসাদে কলি নিস্তারিব লোক ।
নিজ-প্রেম দিয়া সব ঘুচাইব শোক ॥ ৮১ ॥

*tomāra prasāde kali nistāriba loka |*
*nija-prema diẏā saba ghucāiba śoka || 81 ||*

*Word for word:* tomara prasade — by Your mercy; kali — in Kali; nistariba loka — people will be delivered; nija-prema diya — giving Your prema; saba ghuchaiba shoka — You will dispel all sorrows

**81.** By Your mercy in Kali the people will be delivered;
giving them Your prema, You will dispel all their sorrows.

সংশয় নাহিক ইথে শুনহ বচন ।
খেদ দূর করি কর নিজ-সঙ্কীর্তন ॥ ৮২ ॥

*saṃśaẏa nāhika ithe śunaha bacana |*
*kheda dūra kari kara nija-saṅkīrtana || 82 ||*

*Word for word:* samshaya nahika ithe — there is no doubt in this; shunaha vachana — listen to these words; kheda dura kari — casting off grief; kara nija-sankirtana — perform Your sankirtana

**82.** There is no doubt in this — listen to these words:
cast off Your grief and perform Your sankirtana."

এতেক বচন যবে দৈবমুখে শুনি ।
অন্তর হরিষ কিছু না কহিল বাণী ॥ ৮৩ ॥

*eteka bacana yabe daibamukhe śuni |*
*antara hariṣa kichu nā kahila bāṇī || 83 ||*

*Word for word:* eteka vachana — these words; yabe daiva-mukhe shuni — when He heard from the lips of the gods; antara harisha — His heart rejoiced; kichhu na kahila vani — He said not a word

**83.** When He heard these words from the lips of the gods,
His heart rejoiced, but He did not say a word[^24-8].

তার-পর-দিনে শুন অপরূপ কথা ।
অমিয়া-মাখিল বিশ্বম্ভর-গুণগাথা ॥ ৮৪ ॥

*tāra-para-dine śuna aparūpa kathā |*
*amiẏā-mākhila biśbambhara-guṇagāthā || 84 ||*

*Word for word:* tara-para-dine — on the next day; shuna aparupa katha — hear a wondrous tale; amiya-makhila — steeped in nectar; vishvambhara-guna-gatha — the account of Vishvambhara's glories

**84.** On the next day — listen to a wondrous tale,
the nectar-steeped account of Vishvambhara's glories.

মুরারিগুপ্তের ঘর গেলা একদিন ।
পুলকিত সব অঙ্গ আবেশের চিন ॥ ৮৫ ॥

*murāriguptera ghara gelā ekadina |*
*pulakita saba aṅga ābeśera cina || 85 ||*

*Word for word:* murari-guptera ghara — to Murari Gupta's house; gela ekadina — He came one day; pulakita saba anga — His whole body thrills; aveshera china — signs of bhava

**85.** One day He came to the house of Murari Gupta;
His whole body thrills — signs of bhava.

দেবতার ঘরমধ্যে প্রবেশ করিল ।
আবেশে বিভোল কিছু কহিতে লাগিল ॥ ৮৬ ॥

*debatāra gharamadhye prabeśa karila |*
*ābeśe bibhola kichu kahite lāgila || 86 ||*

*Word for word:* devatara ghara-madhye — into the shrine; pravesha karila — He entered; aveshe bibhola — beside Himself in bhava; kichhu kahite lagila — began to say something

**86.** He entered the shrine
and, beside Himself in bhava, began to say something.

প্রেম-নীর-ধারা বহে নয়ান-সাগরে ।
সুরধুনী-ধারা যেন সুমেরু-শিখরে ॥ ৮৭ ॥

*prema-nīra-dhārā bahe naẏāna-sāgare |*
*suradhunī-dhārā yena sumeru-śikhare || 87 ||*

*Word for word:* prema-nira-dhara — streams of tears of love; bahe nayana-sagare — flow from the oceans of the eyes; suradhuni-dhara — the streams of the heavenly Ganga; yena sumeru-shikhare — as on the peak of Sumeru

**87.** From the oceans of His eyes flow streams of tears of love,
like the heavenly Ganga from the peak of Sumeru.

কহে সব লোক হের দেখ অপরূপ ।
পর্বত-আকার এক বরাহ সম্মুখ ॥ ৮৮ ॥

*kahe saba loka hera dekha aparūpa |*
*parbata-ākāra eka barāha sammukha || 88 ||*

*Word for word:* kahe saba loka — He says to all; hera dekha aparupa — look, a wonder; parvata-akara — as large as a mountain; eka baraha sammukha — a boar before Me

**88.** He says to all: "Look — a wonder:
before Me is a boar as large as a mountain!

মহাবেগে আইসে হের দেখহ বরাহে ।
দন্ত সারি আইসে মোরে মারিবারে চাহে ॥ ৮৯ ॥

*mahābege āise hera dekhaha barāhe |*
*danta sāri āise more māribāre cāhe || 89 ||*

*Word for word:* maha-vege aise — at great speed he comes; hera dekhaha barahe — look, the boar; danta sari aise — baring his tusks he comes; more maribare chahe — he wants to kill Me

**89.** At great speed he rushes on — look, the boar!
Baring his tusks, he rushes on, he wants to kill Me.

দুই দন্ত সারি মোরে মারিবে শূকর ।
ইহা বলি প্রবেশিলা দেবতার ঘর ॥ ৯০ ॥

*dui danta sāri more māribe śūkara |*
*ihā bali prabeśilā debatāra ghara || 90 ||*

*Word for word:* dui danta sari — baring two tusks; more maribe shukara — the boar will kill Me; iha bali — saying this; praveshila devatara ghara — He entered the shrine

**90.** Baring his two tusks, this boar will kill Me!" —
saying this, He entered the shrine.

বরাহ-আবেশ পুনঃ হইল তখন ।
কর-চরণেতে মহী করে পর্যটন ॥ ৯১ ॥

*barāha-ābeśa punaḥ haila takhana |*
*kara-caraṇete mahī kare paryaṭana || 91 ||*

*Word for word:* baraha-avesha — the mood of the Boar; punah haila takhana — then came again; kara-charanete — on hands and feet; mahi kare paryatana — He moves about the ground

**91.** Then the mood of the Boar again took hold of Him:
on hands and feet He moves about the ground.

বর্তুল আকার রাঙ্গা-বরণ লোচন ।
মহা পরাক্রম মহা হুঙ্কার-গর্জন ॥ ৯২ ॥

*bartula ākāra rāṅgā-baraṇa locana |*
*mahā parākrama mahā huṅkāra-garjana || 92 ||*

*Word for word:* vartula akara — a round form; ranga-varana lochana — eyes of red colour; maha parakrama — great might; maha hunkara-garjana — a loud roar and bellowing

**92.** His form is round, His eyes are red,
great might, a loud roar and bellowing.

সেইখানে ছিল এক পিত্তলের পাত্র ।
ঊর্ধ্বমুখে দশনে ধরিল ক্ষণমাত্র ॥ ৯৩ ॥

*seikhāne chila eka pittalera pātra |*
*ūrdhbamukhe daśane dharila kṣaṇamātra || 93 ||*

*Word for word:* seikhane chhila — there was there; eka pittalera patra — a brass vessel; urdhva-mukhe — with upturned snout; dashane dharila — He seized with His teeth; kshana-matra — for a moment

**93.** A brass vessel stood there;
raising His snout, He seized it for a moment in His teeth.

পিত্তলের পাত্র ছাড়ি বিকশে বয়ান ।
মুরারিকে পুছে নিজ-স্বরূপ-আখ্যান ॥ ৯৪ ॥

*pittalera pātra chāṛi bikaśe baẏāna |*
*murārike puche nija-sbarūpa-ākhyāna || 94 ||*

*Word for word:* pittalera patra chhadi — letting go of the brass vessel; vikashe bayana — opening His mouth; murarike puchhe — asks Murari; nija-svarupa-akhyana — to declare His own true nature

**94.** Letting go of the brass vessel and opening His mouth,
He asks Murari to declare His true nature.

বেদ-উদ্ধারণ-রূপ ধরি ভগবান্ ।
বসিয়া কহয়ে প্রভু পুরুষ-প্রধান ॥ ৯৫ ॥

*beda-uddhāraṇa-rūpa dhari bhagabān |*
*basiẏā kahaẏe prabhu puruṣa-pradhāna || 95 ||*

*Word for word:* veda-uddharana-rupa dhari — bearing the form of the rescuer of the Vedas; bhagavan — Bhagavan; basiya kahaye — sitting, says; prabhu purusha-pradhana — the Lord, the Supreme Person

**95.** In the form [of the Boar] who rescued the Vedas, Bhagavan,
the Lord, the Supreme Person, sitting down, says:

কহ ত স্বরূপ মোর কি জানহ তুমি ।
মুরারি কহয়ে প্রভু কি জানিয়ে আমি ॥ ৯৬ ॥

*kaha ta sbarūpa mora ki jānaha tumi |*
*murāri kahaẏe prabhu ki jāniẏe āmi || 96 ||*

*Word for word:* kaha ta — tell; svarupa mora — of My svarupa; ki janaha tumi — what you know; murari kahaye — Murari says; prabhu ki janiye ami — Lord, what do I know

**96.** "Tell Me, what do you know of My svarupa?"
Murari says: "Lord, what do I know?"

দণ্ডবত করি ভূমে পড়িলা মুরারি ।
শম্ভু না জানয়ে প্রভু চরিত্র তোমারি ॥ ৯৭ ॥

*daṇḍabata kari bhūme paṛilā murāri |*
*śambhu nā jānaẏe prabhu caritra tomāri || 97 ||*

*Word for word:* dandavata kari — prostrating; bhume padila murari — Murari fell to the ground; shambhu na janaye — [even] Shambhu does not know; prabhu — Lord; charitra tomari — Your deeds

**97.** Prostrate on the ground, Murari [said]:
"[Even] Shambhu does not know Your deeds, Lord."

ইহা বলি পড়িল গীতার এক শ্লোক ।
প্রাকৃত-প্রবন্ধে কহি শুন সর্বলোক ॥ ৯৮ ॥

*ihā bali paṛila gītāra eka śloka |*
*prākṛta-prabandhe kahi śuna sarbaloka || 98 ||*

*Word for word:* iha bali — saying this; padila gitara eka shloka — he recited a shloka of the Gita; prakrita-prabandhe kahi — I render it in plain speech; shuna sarvaloka — listen, all

**98.** Saying this, he recited a shloka of the Gita;
I shall render it in plain speech — listen, all.

*Thus in the Srimad Bhagavad-gita (10.15):*

স্বয়মেবাত্মনাত্মানং বেত্থ ত্বং পুরুষোত্তম ।
ভূতভাবন ভূতেশ দেবদেব জগৎপতে ॥ ৯৯ ॥

*sbaẏamebātmanātmānaṃ bettha tbaṃ puruṣottama |*
*bhūtabhābana bhūteśa debadeba jagatpate || 99 ||*

*Word for word:* svayam eva atmana atmanam — Yourself by Yourself; vettha tvam — You know; purushottama — O Supreme Person; bhuta-bhavana — Source of beings; bhutesha — Lord of beings; deva-deva — God of gods; jagat-pate — Lord of the world

**99.** "You alone know Yourself by Yourself, O Supreme Person,
Source of beings, Lord of beings, God of gods, Lord of the world!"

আপনে আপনা তুমি জান মহাপ্রভু ।
তোমা বহি তোমারে না জানে আর কেহু ॥ ১০০ ॥

*āpane āpanā tumi jāna mahāprabhu |*
*tomā bahi tomāre nā jāne āra kehu || 100 ||*

*Word for word:* apane apana tumi jana — You Yourself know Yourself; mahaprabhu — Mahaprabhu; toma bahi — apart from You; tomare na jane — does not know You; ara kehu — anyone else

**100.** "You Yourself know Yourself, Mahaprabhu:
apart from You no one knows You."

তবে সেই পুনরপি কহে গৌরহরি ।
বেদের শকতি আমা কি জানিতে পারি ॥ ১০১ ॥

*tabe sei punarapi kahe gaurahari |*
*bedera śakati āmā ki jānite pāri || 101 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe — then; punarapi kahe gaurahari — Gaurahari speaks again; vedera shakati — the power of the Vedas; ama ki janite pari — can it know Me

**101.** Then Gaurahari speaks again:
"Have the Vedas the power to know Me?"

মুরারি কহয়ে পুনঃ কাতর বচন ।
তোর তত্ত্ব নাহি জানে সহস্রবদন ॥ ১০২ ॥

*murāri kahaẏe punaḥ kātara bacana |*
*tora tattba nāhi jāne sahasrabadana || 102 ||*

*Word for word:* murari kahaye punah — Murari speaks again; katara vachana — plaintive words; tora tattva nahi jane — does not know Your truth; sahasra-vadana — the Thousand-mouthed One

**102.** Murari again speaks plaintively:
"Even the Thousand-mouthed One does not know Your truth.

বেদে কি জানিব তোর আচরণ-তত্ত্ব ।
কেহো নাহি জানে প্রভু তোমার মহত্ত্ব ॥ ১০৩ ॥

*bede ki jāniba tora ācaraṇa-tattba |*
*keho nāhi jāne prabhu tomāra mahattba || 103 ||*

*Word for word:* vede ki janiba — how could the Vedas know; tora acharana-tattva — the truth of Your deeds; keho nahi jane — no one knows; prabhu — Lord; tomara mahattva — Your greatness

**103.** How could the Vedas know the truth of Your deeds?
No one knows Your greatness, Lord."

ইহা শুনি পুনঃ কহে গৌর ভগবান্ ।
আমারে বিড়ম্বে বেদ শুনহ আখ্যান ॥ ১০৪ ॥

*ihā śuni punaḥ kahe gaura bhagabān |*
*āmāre biṛambe beda śunaha ākhyāna || 104 ||*

*Word for word:* iha shuni — hearing this; punah kahe — speaks again; gaura bhagavan — Gaura Bhagavan; amare vidambe veda — the Vedas mock Me; shunaha akhyana — listen to the account

**104.** Hearing this, Gaura Bhagavan speaks again:
"The Vedas mock Me — listen to the account."

*Thus in the Shvetashvatara Upanishad (3.19):*

অপাণিপাদো জবনো গ্রহীতা
পশ্যত্যচক্ষুঃ স শৃণোত্যকর্ণঃ ।
স বেত্তি বেদ্যং ন চ তস্যাস্তি বেত্তা
তমাহুরগ্র্যং পুরুষং পুরাণম্ ॥ ১০৫ ॥

*apāṇipādo jabano grahītā*
*paśyatyacakṣuḥ sa śṛṇotyakarṇaḥ |*
*sa betti bedyaṃ na ca tasyāsti bettā*
*tamāhuragryaṃ puruṣaṃ purāṇam || 105 ||*

*Word for word:* apani-padah — without hands and feet; javanah — swift; grahita — grasping; pashyati achakshuh — without eyes He sees; sah shrinoti akarnah — He hears without ears; sah vetti vedyam — He knows what is to be known; na cha tasya asti vetta — but there is none who knows Him; tam ahuh — they call Him; agryam purusham puranam — the first, primeval Person

**105.** "Without hands and feet, He is swift and grasps; without eyes, He sees; without ears, He hears.
He knows all that is to be known, but none knows Him; they call Him the first, primeval Person."

বেদে কহে আমি কর-চরণ-শূন্য ।
হেন বিড়ম্বনা মোরে নাহি করে অন্য ॥ ১০৬ ॥

*bede kahe āmi kara-caraṇa-śūnya |*
*hena biṛambanā more nāhi kare anya || 106 ||*

*Word for word:* vede kahe — the Vedas say; ami kara-charana-shunya — I am without hands and feet; hena vidambana — such mockery; more nahi kare anya — no one else makes of Me

**106.** "The Vedas say: 'I have no hands and feet' —
no one else mocks Me like this."

ইহা বলি হাসে প্রভু প্রসন্ন-বদন ।
নাহি জানে বেদ আমা কহিল কথন ॥ ১০৭ ॥

*ihā bali hāse prabhu prasanna-badana |*
*nāhi jāne beda āmā kahila kathana || 107 ||*

*Word for word:* iha bali — saying this; hase prabhu — the Lord laughs; prasanna-vadana — with a serene face; nahi jane veda ama — the Vedas do not know Me; kahila kathana — He said

**107.** Saying this, the Lord laughs, His face serene:
"The Vedas do not know Me" — so He said[^24-9].

তবে ত কহিল বৈদ্য করি পরণাম ।
করুণা করহ প্রভু দেহ প্রেমদান ॥ ১০৮ ॥

*tabe ta kahila baidya kari paraṇāma |*
*karuṇā karaha prabhu deha premadāna || 108 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe ta — then; kahila vaidya — the vaidya said; kari paranama — bowing down; karuna karaha prabhu — be merciful, Lord; deha prema-dana — grant the gift of prema

**108.** Then the vaidya [Murari], bowing down, said:
"Be merciful, Lord, grant me prema."

ঠাকুর কহিল পুনঃ শুনহ মুরারি ।
আমারে পিরীতি কর এই প্রেমা তোরি ॥ ১০৯ ॥

*ṭhākura kahila punaḥ śunaha murāri |*
*āmāre pirīti kara ei premā tori || 109 ||*

*Word for word:* thakura kahila punah — the Thakura said again; shunaha murari — listen, Murari; amare piriti kara — love Me; ei prema tori — that is your prema

**109.** The Thakura said again: "Listen, Murari:
love Me — that is your prema.

ভজিবে পরমব্রহ্ম নরাকৃতি তনু ।
ইন্দ্রনীল-বরণ ত্রিভঙ্গ করে বেণু ॥ ১১০ ॥

*bhajibe paramabrahma narākṛti tanu |*
*indranīla-baraṇa tribhaṅga kare beṇu || 110 ||*

*Word for word:* bhajibe paramabrahma — worship the Parabrahman; nara-akriti tanu — whose body has human form; indranila-varana — sapphire-coloured; tribhanga — bending in three places; kare venu — flute in hand

**110.** Worship the Parabrahman in human form:
the colour of sapphire, bending in three places, a flute in His hand, —

নবগোরোচনা-গর্ভ-গর্বভঙ্গ-দ্যুতি ।
বৃষভানুসুতা নাম মূল যে প্রকৃতি ॥ ১১১ ॥

*nabagorocanā-garbha-garbabhaṅga-dyuti |*
*bṛṣabhānusutā nāma mūla ye prakṛti || 111 ||*

*Word for word:* nava-gorochana-garbha-garva-bhanga-dyuti — whose radiance humbles the pride of fresh gorochana; vrishabhanu-suta nama — by name the daughter of Vrishabhanu; mula ye prakriti — the original prakriti

**111.** [and Her] whose radiance humbles the pride of fresh gorochana,
by name the daughter of Vrishabhanu, the original prakriti[^24-10].

নব ব্রজাঙ্গনা কত বল্লবী-বল্লভে ।
সমর্পিবে নিজতনু নন্দসুত-পাশে ॥ ১১২ ॥

*naba brajāṅganā kata ballabī-ballabhe |*
*samarpibe nijatanu nandasuta-pāśe || 112 ||*

*Word for word:* nava vrajangana kata — many young beauties of Vraja; vallavi-vallabhe — to the Beloved of the cowherd girls; samarpibe nija-tanu — give themselves; nanda-suta-pashe — at the side of Nanda's son

**112.** Many young beauties of Vraja give themselves
to the Beloved of the cowherd girls, the son of Nanda, [staying] by His side.

চিন্তামণি-ভূমি রত্ন-মন্দির সুন্দর ।
কল্পবৃক্ষ রত্নবেদী আসন উপর ॥ ১১৩ ॥

*cintāmaṇi-bhūmi ratna-mandira sundara |*
*kalpabṛkṣa ratnabedī āsana upara || 113 ||*

*Word for word:* chintamani-bhumi — ground of chintamani; ratna-mandira sundara — a beautiful temple of jewels; kalpavriksha — a wish-fulfilling tree; ratna-vedi — a jewelled altar; asana upara — a seat upon it

**113.** The ground [there] is chintamani, a beautiful temple of jewels,
a wish-fulfilling tree, an altar, and on it a seat.

কামধেনুগণ তথা অচিন্ত্য-প্রভাব ।
অভীষ্ট করয়ে পূর্ণ করয়ে যে ধ্যান ॥ ১১৪ ॥

*kāmadhenugaṇa tathā acintya-prabhāba |*
*abhīṣṭa karaẏe pūrṇa karaẏe ye dhyāna || 114 ||*

*Word for word:* kamadhenu-gana tatha — there are kamadhenu cows; achintya-prabhava — of inconceivable power; abhishta karaye purna — they fulfil the desire; karaye ye dhyana — of one who meditates

**114.** There are kamadhenu cows of inconceivable power:
they fulfil the desire of one who meditates [on this].

তার অঙ্গছটা নিরাকার ব্রহ্ম বলি ।
জানিবে এ সব তত্ত্ব কৃষ্ণের মাধুরী ॥ ১১৫ ॥

*tāra aṅgachaṭā nirākāra brahma bali |*
*jānibe e saba tattba kṛṣṇera mādhurī || 115 ||*

*Word for word:* tara anga-chhata — the radiance of His body; nirakara brahma bali — is called the formless Brahman; janibe e saba tattva — know all this truth; krishnera madhuri — [as] the sweetness of Krishna

**115.** The radiance of His body is called the formless Brahman.
Know: all this truth is the sweetness of Krishna"[^24-11].

এইমতে সব-ভক্তে বলিল ঠাকুর ।
শুনিঞা সভার হিয়া আনন্দ প্রচুর ॥ ১১৬ ॥

*eimate saba-bhakte balila ṭhākura |*
*śuniñā sabhāra hiẏā ānanda pracura || 116 ||*

*Word for word:* eimate — thus; saba-bhakte balila thakura — the Thakura spoke to all the devotees; shunina — hearing; sabhara hiya — the hearts of all; ananda prachura — [were filled with] great joy

**116.** Thus the Thakura spoke to all the devotees;
hearing it, the hearts of all were filled with great joy.

শুনিঞা মুরারি কহে প্রভুর চরণে ।
রঘুনাথ-রূপ প্রভু দেখিব নয়নে ॥ ১১৭ ॥

*śuniñā murāri kahe prabhura caraṇe |*
*raghunātha-rūpa prabhu dekhiba naẏane || 117 ||*

*Word for word:* shunina murari kahe — hearing this, Murari says; prabhura charane — at the Lord's feet; raghunatha-rupa — the form of Raghunatha; prabhu — Lord; dekhiba nayane — let me see with my eyes

**117.** Hearing this, Murari says at the Lord's feet:
"Lord, [let] me see with my eyes the form of Raghunatha."

এতেক কহিতে মাত্র দেখে সেইক্ষণে ।
দূর্বাদলশ্যাম রাম জানকী-জীবনে ॥ ১১৮ ॥

*eteka kahite mātra dekhe seikṣaṇe |*
*dūrbādalaśyāma rāma jānakī-jībane || 118 ||*

*Word for word:* eteka kahite matra — as soon as he said this; dekhe sei-kshane — that very moment he sees; durvadala-shyama rama — Rama, dark as durva grass; janaki-jivane — the life of Janaki

**118.** As soon as he said this, that very moment he sees:
Rama, dark as durva grass, the life of Janaki,

লক্ষ্মণ ভরত আর শত্রুঘ্নাদি যত ।
দেখিয়া মুরারি হৈল আনন্দে পূরিত ॥ ১১৯ ॥

*lakṣmaṇa bharata āra śatrughnādi yata |*
*dekhiẏā murāri haila ānande pūrita || 119 ||*

*Word for word:* lakshmana bharata — Lakshmana, Bharata; ara shatrughnadi yata — and Shatrughna and all the others; dekhiya — seeing; murari haila anande purita — Murari was filled with bliss

**119.** Lakshmana, Bharata, Shatrughna and all the rest.
Seeing this, Murari was filled with bliss.

বাহ্য দূরে গেল ভূমে পড়ি গড়ি যায় ।
পদ্মহস্ত দিয়া প্রভু শান্ত কৈল তায় ॥ ১২০ ॥

*bāhya dūre gela bhūme paṛi gaṛi yāẏa |*
*padmahasta diẏā prabhu śānta kaila tāẏa || 120 ||*

*Word for word:* bahya dure gela — outer consciousness left [him]; bhume padi gadi yaya — falling to the ground he rolls; padma-hasta diya — placing His lotus hand; prabhu shanta kaila taya — the Lord calmed him

**120.** Losing consciousness, he fell to the ground and rolls about;
the Lord, placing [on him] His lotus hand, calmed him.

বর দিল প্রেমে পরিপূর্ণ হও তুমি ।
তুমি হনুমান্ সেই রামচন্দ্র আমি ॥ ১২১ ॥

*bara dila preme paripūrṇa hao tumi |*
*tumi hanumān sei rāmacandra āmi || 121 ||*

*Word for word:* bara dila — He gave a blessing; preme paripurna hao tumi — be full of prema; tumi hanuman — you are Hanuman; sei ramachandra ami — I am that Ramachandra

**121.** He gave him a blessing: "Be full of prema:
you are Hanuman, and I am that same Ramachandra"[^24-12].

এ বোল বলিয়া প্রভু চলিলা মন্দিরে ।
আর দিনে শ্রীনিবাস-পণ্ডিতের ঘরে ॥ ১২২ ॥

*e bola baliẏā prabhu calilā mandire |*
*āra dine śrīnibāsa-paṇḍitera ghare || 122 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola baliya — saying this; prabhu chalila mandire — the Lord went home; ara dine — on another day; shrinivasa-panditera ghare — in the house of Srinivasa Pandita

**122.** Saying this, the Lord went home.
On another day in the house of Srinivasa Pandita,

সব নিজগণ যত সংহতি করিয়া ।
বসিয়া কহয়ে নিজ-প্রেম প্রকাশিয়া ॥ ১২৩ ॥

*saba nijagaṇa yata saṃhati kariẏā |*
*basiẏā kahaẏe nija-prema prakāśiẏā || 123 ||*

*Word for word:* saba nija-gana yata — all His associates; samhati kariya — gathering; basiya kahaye — sitting, He speaks; nija-prema prakashiya — revealing His prema

**123.** gathering all His associates,
He sat and speaks, revealing His prema.

হরি হরি বলি ডাকে অন্তরে কৌতুক ।
নিজজনে কহে শুন শুন অপরূপ ॥ ১২৪ ॥

*hari hari bali ḍāke antare kautuka |*
*nijajane kahe śuna śuna aparūpa || 124 ||*

*Word for word:* hari hari bali dake — He calls "Hari, Hari!"; antare kautuka — with delight in His heart; nija-jane kahe — He says to His own; shuna shuna aparupa — listen, listen to a wonder

**124.** Calling "Hari, Hari!", with delight in His heart,
He says to His own: "Listen, listen to a wonder:

সেই রাধাকৃষ্ণ পাবে কলিতে যেমতে ।
সে কথা কহিএ তোরে শুন একচিতে ॥ ১২৫ ॥

*sei rādhākṛṣṇa pābe kalite yemate |*
*se kathā kahie tore śuna ekacite || 125 ||*

*Word for word:* sei radha-krishna pabe — one will attain Radha and Krishna; kalite yemate — how in Kali; se katha kahiye tore — this I tell you; shuna eka-chite — listen with undivided mind

**125.** how in Kali one attains Radha and Krishna —
this I shall tell you; listen with undivided attention."

ইহা বলি নারদীয় পড়িল এক শ্লোক ।
ইহার মর্ম-ব্যাখ্যা নাহি জানে লোক ॥ ১২৬ ॥

*ihā bali nāradīẏa paṛila eka śloka |*
*ihāra marma-byākhyā nāhi jāne loka || 126 ||*

*Word for word:* iha bali — saying this; naradiya padila eka shloka — He recited a shloka from the Naradiya; ihara marma-vyakhya — its inner explanation; nahi jane loka — people do not know

**126.** Saying this, He recited a shloka from the Naradiya;
its hidden meaning people do not know.

*Thus in the Brihan-naradiya Purana (38.126):*

হরের্নাম হরের্নাম হরের্নামৈব কেবলম্ ।
কলৌ নাস্ত্যেব নাস্ত্যেব নাস্ত্যেব গতিরন্যথা ॥ ১২৭ ॥

*harernāma harernāma harernāmaiba kebalam |*
*kalau nāstyeba nāstyeba nāstyeba gatiranyathā || 127 ||*

*Word for word:* hareh nama — the name of Hari; hareh nama — the name of Hari; hareh nama eva kevalam — only the name of Hari; kalau — in Kali; nasti eva nasti eva nasti eva — there is no, no, no; gatih anyatha — other way

**127.** "The name of Hari, the name of Hari, only the name of Hari!
In Kali there is no, no, no other way."

নামরূপী নাম এক আদি যে পুরুষ ।
কলৌ মূর্তিমন্ত আছে না জানে মুরুখ ॥ ১২৮ ॥

*nāmarūpī nāma eka ādi ye puruṣa |*
*kalau mūrtimanta āche nā jāne murukha || 128 ||*

*Word for word:* nama-rupi — the Name is [His] form; nama eka adi ye purusha — the Name is the one original Person; kalau murtimanta achhe — in Kali He is present embodied; na jane murukha — the fool does not know

**128.** "The Name is [the Lord's] form: the Name is the one original Person;
in Kali He is present embodied — the fool does not know this.

নামরূপী ভগবান্ জানিবে কেবল ।
দ্বিধা ঘুচাইতে ব্যাস বোলে তিনবার ॥ ১২৯ ॥

*nāmarūpī bhagabān jānibe kebala |*
*dbidhā ghucāite byāsa bole tinabāra || 129 ||*

*Word for word:* nama-rupi bhagavan — Bhagavan in the form of the Name; janibe kevala — know [this as] "kevala" ("only"); dvidha ghuchaite — to dispel doubt; vyasa bole tinabara — Vyasa says three times

**129.** Know: 'only' means Bhagavan in the form of the Name;
to dispel doubt Vyasa says it three times.

তিনবার বহি আর আছে একবার ।
দুরাশয় পাপী লোক সব বুঝাবার ॥ ১৩০ ॥

*tinabāra bahi āra āche ekabāra |*
*durāśaẏa pāpī loka saba bujhābāra || 130 ||*

*Word for word:* tinabara bahi — besides the three times; ara achhe ekabara — there is once more; durashaya papi loka saba — all ill-intentioned sinful people; bujhabara — to make understand

**130.** Besides the three times there is one more ['only'],
to bring all ill-intentioned sinners to understanding.

হরিনাম-মাত্রে হয় কৈবল্য তাহার ।
কেবল কৈবল্য অর্থ জানিবে বিচার ॥ ১৩১ ॥

*harināma-mātre haẏa kaibalya tāhāra |*
*kebala kaibalya artha jānibe bicāra || 131 ||*

*Word for word:* harinama-matre — by the name of Hari alone; haya kaivalya tahara — one attains kaivalya; kevala kaivalya artha — "kevala" means "kaivalya"; janibe vichara — understand by reflection

**131.** By the name of Hari alone one attains kaivalya:
consider — 'kevala' means 'kaivalya'.

নামমাত্র নামাভাস স্পষ্টার্থ ইহার ।
কৈবল্য সে মুখ্য হয় শাস্ত্রপরচার ॥ ১৩২ ॥

*nāmamātra nāmābhāsa spaṣṭārtha ihāra |*
*kaibalya se mukhya haẏa śāstraparacāra || 132 ||*

*Word for word:* nama-matra — "by the Name alone"; namabhasa — namabhasa; spashtartha ihara — its plain sense; kaivalya se mukhya haya — kaivalya is the chief [fruit]; shastra-parachara — as the shastras proclaim

**132.** The plain sense of this: 'by the Name alone' is namabhasa;
its chief [fruit] is kaivalya, as the shastras proclaim.

নামাভাসে মোক্ষ হয় সত্য শাস্ত্রবাণী ।
নামোদয়ে প্রেমানন্দ পুরাণে বাখানি ॥ ১৩৩ ॥

*nāmābhāse mokṣa haẏa satya śāstrabāṇī |*
*nāmodaẏe premānanda purāṇe bākhāni || 133 ||*

*Word for word:* namabhase moksha haya — by namabhasa comes liberation; satya shastra-vani — true is the word of scripture; namodaye — with the rising of the Name; premananda — the bliss of prema; purane bakhani — as the Puranas explain

**133.** Namabhasa gives liberation — true is the word of the shastras;
but when the Name rises [in the heart] — the bliss of prema, as the Puranas explain.

ইহা বহি আন দেব মানে যেই জন ।
তার গতি নাহি তিনবার এ বচন ॥ ১৩৪ ॥

*ihā bahi āna deba māne yei jana |*
*tāra gati nāhi tinabāra e bacana || 134 ||*

*Word for word:* iha bahi — besides this; ana deva mane — honours another god; yei jana — whoever; tara gati nahi — has no way; tinabara e vachana — [that is] the threefold word

**134.** Whoever, besides this, honours another god
has no way — that is [the sense of] the threefold word.

গো-গোপী-গোপাল-সঙ্গে ধ্যান হরিনাম ।
জানিবে এ সব অর্থ বেদের প্রমাণ ॥ ১৩৫ ॥

*go-gopī-gopāla-saṅge dhyāna harināma |*
*jānibe e saba artha bedera pramāṇa || 135 ||*

*Word for word:* go-gopi-gopala-sange — with the cows, gopis and cowherd boys; dhyana harinama — meditating, chant the name of Hari; janibe e saba artha — know all this meaning; vedera pramana — as confirmed by the Vedas

**135.** Chant the name of Hari, meditating [on the Lord] with the cows, the gopis and the cowherd boys;
know that all this meaning is confirmed by the Vedas"[^24-13].

এতেক বলিল গোরা বরাহ-আবেশে ।
নামসঙ্কীর্তন করে নাচে প্রেমাবেশে ॥ ১৩৬ ॥

*eteka balila gorā barāha-ābeśe |*
*nāmasaṅkīrtana kare nāce premābeśe || 136 ||*

*Word for word:* eteka balila gora — so spoke Gora; baraha-aveshe — in the mood of the Boar; nama-sankirtana kare — performs sankirtana of the Name; nache premaveshe — dances, overwhelmed by prema

**136.** So spoke Gora in the mood of the Boar;
He performs sankirtana of the Name and dances, overwhelmed by prema[^24-14].

যে শুনয়ে গোরাগুণ নদিয়া-বিহার ।
অবিলম্বে কৃষ্ণপ্রেম উপজে তাহার ॥ ১৩৭ ॥

*ye śunaẏe gorāguṇa nadiẏā-bihāra |*
*abilambe kṛṣṇaprema upaje tāhāra || 137 ||*

*Word for word:* ye shunaye — whoever hears; gora-guna — Gora's glories; nadiya-vihara — the pastimes in Nadia; avilambe — at once; krishna-prema upaje tahara — love for Krishna arises in him

**137.** Whoever hears of Gora's glories and His pastimes in Nadia —
in him love for Krishna at once arises.

দশনে ধরিয়া তৃণ কহয়ে লোচন ।
গৌরপদ বিনু মোর অন্য নাহি ধন ॥ ১৩৮ ॥

*daśane dhariẏā tṛṇa kahaẏe locana |*
*gaurapada binu mora anya nāhi dhana || 138 ||*

*Word for word:* dashane dhariya trina — holding a straw between his teeth; kahaye lochana — Lochana says; gaura-pada vinu — but for the feet of Gaura; mora anya nahi dhana — I have no other wealth

**138.** Holding a straw between his teeth, Lochana says:
I have no other wealth than the feet of Gaura.

[^24-1]: The summary covers the whole section; its end (the coming of the gods, the mercy to Shuklambara, Gadadhara) is in the next portion. Cf. Murari 2.1–2.3.
[^24-2]: A shloka from Rupa Gosvami's Padyavali. The hunter, Dhruva, Gajendra, Kubja, Sudama, Vidura, Ugrasena — devotees whom the Lord accepted for their devotion, not for their qualities. Bhaktisiddhanta's prose renderings of the shlokas (anvaya and translation) are not translated here or below.
[^24-3]: The Lord speaks in the mood of Radha separated from Krishna, whom Akrura has taken away to Mathura (cf. Bhaktisiddhanta's summary). The reproaches to Krishna ("cheat", "rake") are the language of the gopis' love in separation, not blasphemy.
[^24-4]: V. 31+1 is found only in the 1983 edition (absent from Bhaktisiddhanta's edition); the 1903 edition does not have it. Cf. Murari 2.1.9–18; in Vrindavana Dasa too (Chaitanya-bhagavata, Madhya 22) Shachi obtains prema only by the mercy of a Vaishnava (Advaita).
[^24-5]: Vv. 50–51 anticipate the teaching of Krishnadasa Kaviraja (Chaitanya-charitamrita, Adi 4): the chief reason for Gaura's appearance is the tasting of His own rasa (Radha's love), while the deliverance of souls is a secondary reason.
[^24-6]: Gandharvika — a name of Radha. Hearing the flute, the Lord experiences what Radha experienced (so in Bhaktisiddhanta's summary). Cf. Murari 2.2.1–6.
[^24-7]: Lit. "like Kishora and Kishori" — the youthful Krishna and Radha. Gaudiya Vaishnavas see in Gaura both of Them in one form.
[^24-8]: Cf. Murari 2.2.7–10, where the voice from above likewise calls the Lord Bhagavan, descended to give people prema.
[^24-9]: Cf. Murari 2.2.11–24. The Upanishadic verse denies the Lord material hands and feet, but not a spiritual form: that is why He is "swift" and "grasps". The Lord jokingly calls it "mockery" when these words are taken as a denial of all form: the Vedas cannot describe Him directly (vv. 101–107). So also in Gaudiya Vaishnava theology: the Lord is a person with a spiritual body, and the impersonal Brahman is the radiance of His body (v. 115).
[^24-10]: "The original prakriti" (mula-prakriti) here means the Lord's original energy (shakti): Radha is the source of all His shaktis, not material nature.
[^24-11]: Cf. the Brahma-samhita (5.29, 5.40): Krishna's abode with ground of chintamani stones, wish-fulfilling trees and surabhi cows; the impersonal Brahman is the radiance of His body. In Bhaktisiddhanta's summary: the Lord told Murari to worship the son of the king of Vraja, served by the cowherd men and women.
[^24-12]: In the Rama lila Murari Gupta is Hanuman. Cf. Murari 2.7.13–18, where the Lord names him Ramadasa.
[^24-13]: Vv. 128–135 are an explanation of the verse "harer nama", following Murari (2.2.29–33). According to Lochana Dasa, the word "kevalam" ("only") points to kaivalya — liberation; but liberation is given already by namabhasa (the "shadow of the Name"), whereas the pure Name bestows prema (v. 133); so too Gaudiya Vaishnavas, following Haridasa Thakura (Chaitanya-charitamrita, Antya 3), teach that liberation is only a by-product of namabhasa. Krishnadasa Kaviraja (Adi 17.21–25) explains differently: the threefold "name of Hari" is for emphasis, and "kevala" excludes knowledge, yoga, austerity and karma.
[^24-14]: Cf. Murari 2.2.34.

---

# Madhya-khanda, part 2 (portion 25)

*The gods come to the Lord and receive prema; mercy to Shuklambara and Gadadhara; the dance in Srivasa's house — Vrindavana in Navadvipa; the Lord disperses the clouds over the kirtana; the section "Mercy to Mukunda": a song of Gaura's dance*

*Raga dhanashi*

নবদ্বীপে নিতুই পূর্ণিমাচাঁদ গোরা ।
প্রকাশয়ে নিজ-প্রেম-অমিয়ার ধারা ॥ ১৩৯ ॥

*nabadbīpe nitui pūrṇimācāṁda gorā |*
*prakāśaẏe nija-prema-amiẏāra dhārā || 139 ||*

*Word for word:* navadvipe — in Navadvipa; nitui — ever; purnima-chanda gora — Gora, the full moon; prakashaye — reveals, pours out; nija-prema-amiyara dhara — streams of the nectar of His own prema

**139.** In Navadvipa Gora is the ever-full moon:
He pours out streams of the nectar of His own prema.

পিবই চরণামৃত ভকত-চকোরা ।
অবাধ করুণা প্রেমা প্রকাশয়ে গোরা ॥ ১৪০ ॥

*pibai caraṇāmṛta bhakata-cakorā |*
*abādha karuṇā premā prakāśaẏe gorā || 140 ||*

*Word for word:* pibai — drink; charanamrita — the nectar of the feet; bhakata-chakora — the devotee-chakoras; abadha karuna — boundless compassion; prema — prema; prakashaye gora — Gora reveals

**140.** The devotee-chakoras drink the nectar of His feet;
boundless compassion — prema — Gora reveals.

আর এক-দিনে কথা শুন অপরূপ ।
নিজঘরে বসি' তেজঃ কোটি-কাম-রূপ ॥ ১৪১ ॥

*āra eka-dine kathā śuna aparūpa |*
*nijaghare basi' tejaḥ koṭi-kāma-rūpa || 141 ||*

*Word for word:* ara eka-dine — on another day; katha shuna aparupa — hear a wonderful story; nija-ghare basi — sitting in His own house; tejah — radiance; koti-kama-rupa — the beauty of millions of Kamadevas

**141.** Hear a wonderful story of yet another day.
He sits in His own house, radiant as millions of Kamadevas:

সিংহগ্রীব কম্বুকণ্ঠ কমললোচন ।
কহয়ে প্রকট ঘন গম্ভীর বচন ॥ ১৪২ ॥

*siṃhagrība kambukaṇṭha kamalalocana |*
*kahaẏe prakaṭa ghana gambhīra bacana || 142 ||*

*Word for word:* simha-griva — lion-necked; kambu-kantha — with a conch-like throat; kamala-lochana — lotus-eyed; kahaye prakata — speaks aloud; ghana gambhira bachana — words deep as thunder

**142.** a neck like a lion's, a throat like a conch, lotus eyes;
and aloud He speaks words deep as thunder:

এ ঘরে কি দেখি চারি-পাঁচ-ছয়-মুখ ।
দেখিতে বাঢ়য়ে মোর অন্তর-কৌতুক ॥ ১৪৩ ॥

*e ghare ki dekhi cāri-pāṁca-chaẏa-mukha |*
*dekhite bāṛhaẏe mora antara-kautuka || 143 ||*

*Word for word:* e ghare — in this house; ki dekhi — what do I see; chari-pancha-chhaya-mukha — four-, five-, six-faced ones; dekhite — on seeing; badhaye — grows; mora antara-kautuka — the wonder of My heart

**143.** "What do I see in this house — four-, five-, six-faced ones?
At the sight of them wonder grows in My heart."

শ্রীনিবাস-পণ্ডিত আছিল প্রভু-কাছে ।
শুনিঞা উত্তর দিল যে বিধান আছে ॥ ১৪৪ ॥

*śrīnibāsa-paṇḍita āchila prabhu-kāche |*
*śuniñā uttara dila ye bidhāna āche || 144 ||*

*Word for word:* shrinibasa-pandita — Srinivasa Pandita; achhila prabhu-kachhe — was near the Lord; shunina — having heard; uttara dila — gave an answer; ye vidhana achhe — as the matter stands

**144.** Srinivasa Pandita was beside the Lord;
hearing this, he answered as the matter stood:

তোমা দেখিবারে সব দেব-আগমন ।
ব্রহ্মা-আদি চারি পাঁচ ছয় যে বদন ॥ ১৪৫ ॥

*tomā dekhibāre saba deba-āgamana |*
*brahmā-ādi cāri pāṁca chaẏa ye badana || 145 ||*

*Word for word:* toma dekhibare — to see You; saba deva-agamana — the coming of all the gods; brahma-adi — Brahma and others; chari pancha chhaya ye badana — those with four, five, six faces

**145.** "All the gods have come to see You —
Brahma and the others, the four-, five- and six-faced.

প্রেমার সমুদ্র তুমি দেহ প্রেমধন ।
তোরে প্রেমধন মাগে সব দেবগণ ॥ ১৪৬ ॥

*premāra samudra tumi deha premadhana |*
*tore premadhana māge saba debagaṇa || 146 ||*

*Word for word:* premara samudra tumi — You are the ocean of prema; deha premadhana — give the treasure of prema; tore — of You; premadhana mage — beg the treasure of prema; saba deva-gana — all the gods

**146.** You are an ocean of prema: give [them] the treasure of prema!
All the gods are begging You for the treasure of prema"[^25-1].

তবে সেই মহাপ্রভু বসি' দিব্যাসনে ।
এক ভক্ত-অঙ্গে অঙ্গ পদ আর জনে ॥ ১৪৭ ॥

*tabe sei mahāprabhu basi' dibyāsane |*
*eka bhakta-aṅge aṅga pada āra jane || 147 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe sei mahaprabhu — then Mahaprabhu; basi divyasane — sitting on a divine seat; eka bhakta-ange anga — His body on one devotee's body; pada ara jane — His feet on another

**147.** Then Mahaprabhu sat on a divine seat,
leaning His body on one devotee and [placing] His feet on another[^25-2].

শ্রীনিবাস-আদি করি যত ভক্তজন ।
চরণে পড়িয়া তারা করয়ে রোদন ॥ ১৪৮ ॥

*śrīnibāsa-ādi kari yata bhaktajana |*
*caraṇe paṛiẏā tārā karaẏe rodana || 148 ||*

*Word for word:* shrinibasa-adi kari — Srinivasa and the rest; yata bhakta-jana — all the devotees; charane padiya — falling at the feet; tara karaye rodana — they weep

**148.** Srinivasa and all the other devotees
fell at His feet and weep:

বর মাগোঁ তোর পদাম্বুজ-মধু-প্রেমা ।
দেহ ত আমারে প্রভু করুণার সীমা ॥ ১৪৯ ॥

*bara māgoṁ tora padāmbuja-madhu-premā |*
*deha ta āmāre prabhu karuṇāra sīmā || 149 ||*

*Word for word:* bara mago — I beg a boon; tora padambuja-madhu-prema — the honey-prema of Your lotus feet; deha ta amare — do give me; prabhu — Lord; karunara sima — limit of compassion

**149.** "I beg a boon — the honey-prema of Your lotus feet:
give it to me, Lord, O utmost limit of compassion!"

তবে বিশ্বম্ভর প্রভু বোলে মেঘনাদে ।
লেহ ত সভারে দিল প্রেম-পরসাদে ॥ ১৫০ ॥

*tabe biśbambhara prabhu bole meghanāde |*
*leha ta sabhāre dila prema-parasāde || 150 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe vishvambhara prabhu — then Lord Vishvambhara; bole megha-nade — speaks with the sound of thunder; leha ta — take it; sabhare dila — gave to all; prema-parasade — the grace of prema

**150.** Then Lord Vishvambhara speaks in a voice like thunder:
"Take it!" — and gave to all the grace of prema.

তৎকাল হইল প্রেম সব দেবতার ।
ভাবময় শরীর হইল চমৎকার ॥ ১৫১ ॥

*tatkāla haila prema saba debatāra |*
*bhābamaẏa śarīra haila camatkāra || 151 ||*

*Word for word:* tat-kala — at once; haila prema — prema arose; saba devatara — in all the gods; bhavamaya sharira — bodies full of bhava; haila chamatkara — became wondrous

**151.** At once prema awoke in all the gods:
their bodies, filled with bhava, became wondrous.

হা রাধাগোবিন্দ বলি' নাচে দেবগণ ।
দেখিয়া বৈষ্ণব সব হরষিত মন ॥ ১৫২ ॥

*hā rādhāgobinda bali' nāce debagaṇa |*
*dekhiẏā baiṣṇaba saba haraṣita mana || 152 ||*

*Word for word:* ha radha-govinda bali — crying "O Radha-Govinda!"; nache deva-gana — the gods dance; dekhiya — seeing; vaishnava saba — all the Vaishnavas; harashita mana — are glad at heart

**152.** Crying "O Radha-Govinda!", the gods dance;
seeing it, all the Vaishnavas rejoice at heart.

দেবগণ নাচে দেবীগণ করি' সঙ্গে ।
অশ্রু পুলক স্বেদ প্রেমার তরঙ্গে ॥ ১৫৩ ॥

*debagaṇa nāce debīgaṇa kari' saṅge |*
*aśru pulaka sbeda premāra taraṅge || 153 ||*

*Word for word:* deva-gana nache — the gods dance; devi-gana kari sange — with the goddesses; ashru pulaka sveda — tears, thrill, sweat; premara tarange — in the waves of prema

**153.** The gods dance, and the goddesses with them:
tears, thrill, sweat — in waves of prema.

ক্ষণে ভূমে গড়ি যায় চরণে পড়িয়া ।
ক্ষণে উভরায়ে নাচে হরিবোল বলিয়া ॥ ১৫৪ ॥

*kṣaṇe bhūme gaṛi yāẏa caraṇe paṛiẏā |*
*kṣaṇe ubharāẏe nāce haribola baliẏā || 154 ||*

*Word for word:* kshane — now; bhume gadi yaya — they roll on the ground; charane padiya — falling at the feet; kshane — now; ubharaye nache — they dance crying aloud; haribola baliya — saying "Haribol!"

**154.** Now they roll on the ground, falling at His feet,
now they dance, loudly crying "Haribol!",

ক্ষণে স্তব করে গৌরগোবিন্দ বলিয়া ।
ক্ষণে দণ্ডবৎ করে চরণে পড়িয়া ॥ ১৫৫ ॥

*kṣaṇe staba kare gauragobinda baliẏā |*
*kṣaṇe daṇḍabat kare caraṇe paṛiẏā || 155 ||*

*Word for word:* kshane stava kare — now they offer praise; gaura-govinda baliya — calling "Gaura-Govinda!"; kshane dandavat kare — now they prostrate; charane padiya — falling at the feet

**155.** now they offer praise, calling "Gaura-Govinda!",
now they prostrate themselves, falling at His feet.

ক্ষণে পদ মস্তকে ধরিয়া দেবগণ ।
বর মাগে তোর পদে রহু মোর মন ॥ ১৫৬ ॥

*kṣaṇe pada mastake dhariẏā debagaṇa |*
*bara māge tora pade rahu mora mana || 156 ||*

*Word for word:* kshane pada mastake dhariya — now holding [His] feet on their heads; deva-gana — the gods; bara mage — beg a boon; tora pade — at Your feet; rahu mora mana — may my mind remain

**156.** Now, placing His feet on their heads, the gods
beg a boon: "May my mind abide at Your feet!"

তথাস্তু বলিয়া প্রভু বোলে বার বার ।
প্রেমধন পরিপূর্ণ হউ তো-সভার ॥ ১৫৭ ॥

*tathāstu baliẏā prabhu bole bāra bāra |*
*premadhana paripūrṇa hau to-sabhāra || 157 ||*

*Word for word:* tathastu baliya — saying "so be it"; prabhu bole bara bara — the Lord says again and again; premadhana paripurna — full of the treasure of prema; hau to-sabhara — may you all be

**157.** "So be it," the Lord replies, and says again and again:
"May you all be filled with the treasure of prema!"

দেবগণ প্রেম পাই' গেলা নিজস্থান ।
দেখিয়া সকল ভক্ত আনন্দিতমন ॥ ১৫৮ ॥

*debagaṇa prema pāi' gelā nijasthāna |*
*dekhiẏā sakala bhakta ānanditamana || 158 ||*

*Word for word:* deva-gana prema pai — the gods, having obtained prema; gela nija-sthana — went to their own abodes; dekhiya — seeing; sakala bhakta — all the devotees; anandita-mana — were joyful at heart

**158.** Having received prema, the gods went to their own abodes;
seeing it, all the devotees rejoiced at heart.

এতেক করুণা কৈল ভক্তবৎসল ।
করুণা-প্রকাশ দেখি' বোলে শুক্লাম্বর ॥ ১৫৯ ॥

*eteka karuṇā kaila bhaktabatsala |*
*karuṇā-prakāśa dekhi' bole śuklāmbara || 159 ||*

*Word for word:* eteka karuna kaila — such mercy showed; bhakta-vatsala — the Lover of His devotees; karuna-prakasha dekhi — seeing the display of mercy; bole shuklambara — Shuklambara speaks

**159.** Such mercy did the Lover of His devotees show.
Seeing this display of mercy, Shuklambara speaks.

শুক্লাম্বর ব্রহ্মচারী বড়ই পবিত্র ।
তীর্থপূত-কলেবর মধুরচরিত্র ॥ ১৬০ ॥

*śuklāmbara brahmacārī baṛai pabitra |*
*tīrthapūta-kalebara madhuracaritra || 160 ||*

*Word for word:* shuklambara brahmachari — Shuklambara Brahmachari; badai pavitra — very pure; tirtha-puta-kalebara — his body hallowed by holy places; madhura-charitra — of sweet nature

**160.** Shuklambara Brahmachari is most pure:
his body is hallowed by holy places, his nature is gentle.

প্রভু-আগে কহে কথা নাহি করে ভয় ।
প্রেম-লোভে কহে কথা যত মনে লয় ॥ ১৬১ ॥

*prabhu-āge kahe kathā nāhi kare bhaẏa |*
*prema-lobhe kahe kathā yata mane laẏa || 161 ||*

*Word for word:* prabhu-age — before the Lord; kahe katha — he speaks; nahi kare bhaya — without fear; prema-lobhe — in longing for prema; kahe katha — he says; yata mane laya — all that comes to mind

**161.** Before the Lord he speaks without fear;
longing for prema, he says all that is in his heart:

শুন শুন অহে প্রভু গৌর ভগবান্ ।
এতদিনে হৈল মোর প্রসন্ন-নয়ান ॥ ১৬২ ॥

*śuna śuna ahe prabhu gaura bhagabān |*
*etadine haila mora prasanna-naẏāna || 162 ||*

*Word for word:* shuna shuna — hear, hear; ahe prabhu — O Lord; gaura bhagavan — Gaura Bhagavan; eta-dine — at last (after so many days); haila mora prasanna-nayana — my eyes have become glad

**162.** "Hear, hear, O Lord, Gaura Bhagavan:
at last today my eyes have found their joy.

নানা-তীর্থ-পর্যটন করিয়াছি আমি ।
অনেক যন্ত্রণা দুঃখ কিছুই না জানি ॥ ১৬৩ ॥

*nānā-tīrtha-paryaṭana kariẏāchi āmi |*
*aneka yantraṇā duḥkha kichui nā jāni || 163 ||*

*Word for word:* nana-tirtha-paryatana — travel to many holy places; kariyachhi ami — I have made; aneka jantrana duhkha — much torment and hardship; kichhui na jani — I know nothing

**163.** I have travelled to many holy places,
[suffered] many torments and hardships — and have understood nothing.

মধুপুরী দ্বারাবতী কৈলুঁ পর্যটন ।
দুঃখিত হঞাছি আমি দেহ প্রেমধন ॥ ১৬৪ ॥

*madhupurī dbārābatī kailuṁ paryaṭana |*
*duḥkhita hañāchi āmi deha premadhana || 164 ||*

*Word for word:* madhupuri — Madhupuri (Mathura); dvaravati — Dvaravati (Dvaraka); kailun paryatana — I have travelled to; duhkhita hanachhi ami — I am unhappy; deha premadhana — give the treasure of prema

**164.** I have travelled to Madhupuri and Dvaravati,
and still I am unhappy: give me the treasure of prema!"

এ বোল শুনিঞা প্রভু কহিল উত্তর ।
মোর এক বোল তুমি শুন শুক্লাম্বর ॥ ১৬৫ ॥

*e bola śuniñā prabhu kahila uttara |*
*mora eka bola tumi śuna śuklāmbara || 165 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shunina — hearing these words; prabhu kahila uttara — the Lord answered; mora eka bola — one word of Mine; tumi shuna — you hear; shuklambara — Shuklambara

**165.** Hearing these words, the Lord answered:
"Hear one word of Mine, Shuklambara:

সে বনে কতেক আছে শৃগাল-কুক্কুর ।
আমার কি হৈল তাথে কহিল ঠাকুর ॥ ১৬৬ ॥

*se bane kateka āche śṛgāla-kukkura |*
*āmāra ki haila tāthe kahila ṭhākura || 166 ||*

*Word for word:* se bane — in those forests; kateka achhe — ever so many live; shrigala-kukkura — jackals and dogs; amara ki haila tathe — what is that to Me; kahila thakura — said the Thakura

**166.** in those forests live ever so many jackals and dogs —
what is that to Me?" said the Thakura[^25-3].

হৃদয়ে যাবত কৃষ্ণ উদয় না করে ।
তাবত তীর্থের অনুগ্রহ নাহি তারে ॥ ১৬৭ ॥

*hṛdaẏe yābata kṛṣṇa udaẏa nā kare |*
*tābata tīrthera anugraha nāhi tāre || 167 ||*

*Word for word:* hridaye — in the heart; yabata krishna udaya na kare — as long as Krishna does not rise; tabata — so long; tirthera anugraha — the grace of the holy places; nahi tare — he has not

**167.** "As long as Krishna does not rise in the heart,
so long one has no grace from the holy places.

কৃষ্ণপ্রেম বিনু ধর্ম কেহো কিছু নহে ।
পড়িয়া দেখহ ইহা শাস্ত্রে সব কহে ॥ ১৬৮ ॥

*kṛṣṇaprema binu dharma keho kichu nahe |*
*paṛiẏā dekhaha ihā śāstre saba kahe || 168 ||*

*Word for word:* krishna-prema vinu — without love for Krishna; dharma keho kichhu nahe — no dharma is anything; padiya dekhaha — read and see; iha shastre saba kahe — the shastras all say this

**168.** Without love for Krishna any dharma is nothing;
read and see: the shastras all say this."

*Thus [it is said]:*

মীনঃ স্নানপরঃ ফণী পবনভুঙ্ মেষোঽপি পর্ণাশনঃ
শশ্বদ্ভ্রাম্যতি চক্রিগৌরপি বকো ধ্যানে সদা তিষ্ঠতি ।
গর্তে তিষ্ঠতি মূষিকোঽপি গহনে সিংহঃ সদা বর্ততে
কিং তেষাং ফলমস্তি হন্ত তপসা সদ্ভাবসিদ্ধিং বিনা ॥ ১৬৯ ॥

*mīnaḥ snānaparaḥ phaṇī pabanabhuṅ meṣo'pi parṇāśanaḥ*
*śaśbadbhrāmyati cakrigaurapi bako dhyāne sadā tiṣṭhati |*
*garte tiṣṭhati mūṣiko'pi gahane siṃhaḥ sadā bartate*
*kiṃ teṣāṃ phalamasti hanta tapasā sadbhābasiddhiṃ binā || 169 ||*

*Word for word:* minah snana-parah — the fish is intent on bathing; phani pavana-bhuk — the snake lives on air; meshah api parnashanah — the ram too eats leaves; shashvat bhramyati — ever goes round; chakri-gauh api — the oil-presser's ox too; bakah dhyane sada tishthati — the heron always stands in meditation; garte tishthati mushikah api — the mouse too lives in a hole; gahane simhah sada vartate — the lion always dwells in the thicket; kim tesham phalam asti — what fruit do they have; hanta — alas; tapasa — from austerity; sad-bhava-siddhim vina — without perfection in true feeling

**169.** "The fish is always bathing, the snake lives on air, the ram eats leaves, the oil-presser's ox is ever going round, the heron always stands in meditation,
the mouse lives in a hole, the lion always dwells in the thicket — but alas! what fruit do they have from austerity without perfection in true feeling?"[^25-4]

*Thus in the Narada-pancharatra (1.2.6):*

আরাধিতো যদি হরিস্তপসা ততঃ কিং
নারাধিতো যদি হরিস্তপসা ততঃ কিম্ ।
অন্তর্বহির্যদি হরিস্তপসা ততঃ কিং
নান্তর্বহির্যদি হরিস্তপসা ততঃ কিম্ ॥ ১৭০ ॥

*ārādhito yadi haristapasā tataḥ kiṃ*
*nārādhito yadi haristapasā tataḥ kim |*
*antarbahiryadi haristapasā tataḥ kiṃ*
*nāntarbahiryadi haristapasā tataḥ kim || 170 ||*

*Word for word:* aradhitah yadi harih — if Hari is worshipped; tapasa tatah kim — what then of austerity; na aradhitah yadi harih — if Hari is not worshipped; tapasa tatah kim — what then of austerity; antah bahih yadi harih — if Hari is within and without; na antah bahih yadi harih — if Hari is not within and without

**170.** "If Hari is worshipped, what need of austerity? If Hari is not worshipped, what use is austerity?
If Hari is within and without, what need of austerity? If Hari is not within and without, what use is austerity?"

এ বোল শুনিঞা বিপ্র ভূমেতে পড়িল ।
কাতর হইয়া কান্দে আরতি বাঢ়িল ॥ ১৭১ ॥

*e bola śuniñā bipra bhūmete paṛila |*
*kātara haiẏā kānde ārati bāṛhila || 171 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shunina — hearing these words; vipra bhumete padila — the brahmana fell to the ground; katara haiya kande — distraught, he weeps; arati badhila — his longing grew

**171.** Hearing these words, the brahmana fell to the ground;
distraught, he weeps, and his longing grows.

অনুগত-আর্তি প্রভু সহিবারে নারে ।
করুণ অরুণ ভেল গৌর-কলেবরে ॥ ১৭২ ॥

*anugata-ārti prabhu sahibāre nāre |*
*karuṇa aruṇa bhela gaura-kalebare || 172 ||*

*Word for word:* anugata-arti — the distress of one devoted; prabhu sahibare nare — the Lord cannot bear; karuna aruna bhela — flushed red with compassion; gaura-kalebare — Gaura's body

**172.** The Lord cannot bear the distress of one devoted to Him:
Gaura's body flushed red with compassion.

প্রেম দিল প্রেম দিল ডাকে আর্তনাদে ।
শুক্লাম্বর বিপ্র পাইল প্রেম-পরসাদে ॥ ১৭৩ ॥

*prema dila prema dila ḍāke ārtanāde |*
*śuklāmbara bipra pāila prema-parasāde || 173 ||*

*Word for word:* prema dila prema dila — I have given prema, given prema; dake arta-nade — He cries with a loud voice; shuklambara vipra — the brahmana Shuklambara; paila prema-parasade — obtained the grace of prema

**173.** "I have given prema, given prema!" He cries aloud,
and the brahmana Shuklambara obtained the grace of prema.

তৎকালে পাইল প্রেম কম্পকলেবর ।
পুলকিত ভেল অঙ্গ নয়নেতে জল ॥ ১৭৪ ॥

*tatkāle pāila prema kampakalebara |*
*pulakita bhela aṅga naẏanete jala || 174 ||*

*Word for word:* tat-kale — at once; paila prema — he obtained prema; kampa-kalebara — his body trembles; pulakita bhela anga — his limbs thrilled; nayanete jala — tears in his eyes

**174.** At once he obtained prema: his body trembles,
his whole body thrills, there are tears in his eyes.

হরষিত হৈয়া তবে কৃষ্ণনাম লয় ।
সকল রজনী ভেল কৃষ্ণরসময় ॥ ১৭৪+১ ॥

*haraṣita haiẏā tabe kṛṣṇanāma laẏa |*
*sakala rajanī bhela kṛṣṇarasamaẏa || 174+1 ||*

*Word for word:* harashita haiya — rejoicing; tabe — then; krishna-nama laya — repeats the name of Krishna; sakala rajani — the whole night; bhela — became; krishna-rasa-maya — full of the rasa of Krishna

**174+1.** Rejoicing, he repeats the name of Krishna;
the whole night passed in the rasa of Krishna[^25-5].

হরিষে করয়ে গুণ-নাম-সংকীর্তন ।
দেখিয়া সকল লোক অতি হৃষ্টমন ॥ ১৭৫ ॥

*hariṣe karaẏe guṇa-nāma-saṃkīrtana |*
*dekhiẏā sakala loka ati hṛṣṭamana || 175 ||*

*Word for word:* harishe — rejoicing; karaye guna-nama-sankirtana — performs sankirtana of qualities and names; dekhiya — seeing; sakala loka — all the people; ati hrishta-mana — were very glad

**175.** Rejoicing, he performs sankirtana of [the Lord's] qualities and names;
seeing it, all the people were very glad.

পণ্ডিত শ্রীগদাধর সর্বগুণধাম ।
প্রভু-কাছে থাকে নিরন্তর লয় নাম ॥ ১৭৬ ॥

*paṇḍita śrīgadādhara sarbaguṇadhāma |*
*prabhu-kāche thāke nirantara laẏa nāma || 176 ||*

*Word for word:* pandita shri-gadadhara — Pandita Sri Gadadhara; sarva-guna-dhama — the abode of all virtues; prabhu-kachhe thake — stays with the Lord; nirantara laya nama — constantly repeats the Name

**176.** Pandita Sri Gadadhara — the abode of all virtues —
stays constantly with the Lord and repeats the Name.

রজনী শুতিয়া ছিলা প্রভুর সংহতি ।
পরিতোষে বৈল প্রভু দেখিয়া আরতি ॥ ১৭৭ ॥

*rajanī śutiẏā chilā prabhura saṃhati |*
*paritoṣe baila prabhu dekhiẏā ārati || 177 ||*

*Word for word:* rajani — at night; shutiya chhila — he lay sleeping; prabhura samhati — with the Lord; paritoshe — pleased; baila prabhu — the Lord said; dekhiya arati — seeing his longing

**177.** One night he slept beside the Lord;
seeing his longing, the Lord, pleased, said:

পাইবে দুর্লভ প্রেম রজনী-প্রভাতে ।
মনোরথ সিদ্ধি হৈব বৈষ্ণব-প্রসাদে ॥ ১৭৮ ॥

*pāibe durlabha prema rajanī-prabhāte |*
*manoratha siddhi haiba baiṣṇaba-prasāde || 178 ||*

*Word for word:* paibe — you will obtain; durlabha prema — rare prema; rajani-prabhate — at the dawn of the night; manaratha siddhi haiba — your desire will be fulfilled; vaishnava-prasade — by the grace of the Vaishnavas

**178.** "You will obtain rare prema at the dawn of this night:
by the grace of the Vaishnavas your desire will be fulfilled"[^25-6].

ইহা বলি' অঙ্গমালা দিলা তার গলে ।
প্রভাতে আইলা সভে প্রভু দেখিবারে ॥ ১৭৯ ॥

*ihā bali' aṅgamālā dilā tāra gale |*
*prabhāte āilā sabhe prabhu dekhibāre || 179 ||*

*Word for word:* iha bali — saying this; anga-mala — the garland from [His] body; dila tara gale — He put on his neck; prabhate — in the morning; aila sabhe — all came; prabhu dekhibare — to see the Lord

**179.** Saying this, He put the garland from His own body round his neck.
In the morning all came to see the Lord.

সভারে কহিল প্রভু রজনী-চরিত ।
কথাছলে প্রেম পাইল গদাধর-পণ্ডিত ॥ ১৮০ ॥

*sabhāre kahila prabhu rajanī-carita |*
*kathāchale prema pāila gadādhara-paṇḍita || 180 ||*

*Word for word:* sabhare kahila prabhu — the Lord told everyone; rajani-charita — the events of the night; katha-chhale — in the course of the talk; prema paila — obtained prema; gadadhara-pandita — Gadadhara Pandita

**180.** The Lord told everyone what had happened in the night —
and in the course of that talk Gadadhara Pandita obtained prema.

অতি হৃষ্টমনে স্নান করি' গঙ্গাজলে ।
প্রেমায় অবশ তনু টলমল করে ॥ ১৮১ ॥

*ati hṛṣṭamane snāna kari' gaṅgājale |*
*premāẏa abaśa tanu ṭalamala kare || 181 ||*

*Word for word:* ati hrishta-mane — with great joy at heart; snana kari gangajale — bathing in the waters of the Ganga; premaya avasha tanu — his body helpless with prema; talamala kare — sways

**181.** With great joy at heart he bathed in the waters of the Ganga;
his body, helpless with prema, sways.

জগন্নাথদেব-পূজা করিল বিধানে ।
পুনঃ পূজা করে নিজ-প্রভু-বিদ্যমানে ॥ ১৮২ ॥

*jagannāthadeba-pūjā karila bidhāne |*
*punaḥ pūjā kare nija-prabhu-bidyamāne || 182 ||*

*Word for word:* jagannatha-deva-puja — the worship of Jagannatha-deva; karila vidhane — he performed according to the rules; punah puja kare — again he worships; nija-prabhu-vidyamane — in the presence of his own Lord

**182.** He performed the worship of Jagannatha-deva according to the rules,
and worships again — before his own Lord:

সুগন্ধি চন্দন অঙ্গে করিল লেপন ।
দিব্যমালা গলে দিয়া করয়ে স্তবন ॥ ১৮৩ ॥

*sugandhi candana aṅge karila lepana |*
*dibyamālā gale diẏā karaẏe stabana || 183 ||*

*Word for word:* sugandhi chandana — fragrant sandal paste; ange karila lepana — he smeared on the body; divya-mala gale diya — putting a divine garland on the neck; karaye stavana — offers praise

**183.** he anointed His body with fragrant sandal paste,
put a divine garland round His neck and offers praise.

এইমত প্রতিদিন করে পরিচর্যা ।
শয়নমন্দিরে করে শয়নের শয্যা ॥ ১৮৪ ॥

*eimata pratidina kare paricaryā |*
*śaẏanamandire kare śaẏanera śayyā || 184 ||*

*Word for word:* eimata — thus; pratidina kare paricharya — every day he serves; shayana-mandire — in the bedchamber; kare shayanera shayya — he prepares the bed for sleep

**184.** So every day he serves [the Lord]:
in the bedchamber he prepares His bed

চরণ-নিকটে নিতি করয়ে শয়ন ।
নিরন্তর শ্রদ্ধাভক্তি-পর তার মন ॥ ১৮৫ ॥

*caraṇa-nikaṭe niti karaẏe śaẏana |*
*nirantara śraddhābhakti-para tāra mana || 185 ||*

*Word for word:* charana-nikate — near the feet; niti karaye shayana — daily he sleeps; nirantara — always; shraddha-bhakti-para — full of faith and devotion; tara mana — his heart

**185.** and every night sleeps at His feet;
his heart is always full of faith and devotion[^25-7].

প্রভুর সম্মুখে কহে অমৃতবচন ।
শুনি' বিশ্বম্ভর প্রভু আনন্দিতমন ॥ ১৮৬ ॥

*prabhura sammukhe kahe amṛtabacana |*
*śuni' biśbambhara prabhu ānanditamana || 186 ||*

*Word for word:* prabhura sammukhe — before the Lord; kahe amrita-bachana — he speaks nectarean words; shuni — hearing; vishvambhara prabhu — Lord Vishvambhara; anandita-mana — is joyful at heart

**186.** Before the Lord he speaks nectarean words;
hearing them, Lord Vishvambhara rejoices at heart.

তাহার অমৃত-বাণী সিঞ্চিল অন্তর ।
নাচিবারে যায় প্রভু ধরি' তার কর ॥ ১৮৭ ॥

*tāhāra amṛta-bāṇī siñcila antara |*
*nācibāre yāẏa prabhu dhari' tāra kara || 187 ||*

*Word for word:* tahara amrita-vani — his nectarean speech; sinchila antara — sprinkled the heart; nachibare yaya prabhu — the Lord goes to dance; dhari tara kara — holding his hand

**187.** His nectarean speech sprinkled [the Lord's] heart:
the Lord, taking him by the hand, goes to dance.

নরহরি-ভুজে আর ভুজ আরোপিয়া ।
শ্রীবাসের ঘরে নাচে রাস-বিনোদিয়া ॥ ১৮৮ ॥

*narahari-bhuje āra bhuja āropiẏā |*
*śrībāsera ghare nāce rāsa-binodiẏā || 188 ||*

*Word for word:* narahari-bhuje — on Narahari's arm; ara bhuja aropiya — placing His other arm; shrivasera ghare — in Srivasa's house; nache — dances; rasa-vinodiya — the Charmer of the rasa

**188.** Placing His other arm on Narahari's arm,
the Charmer of the rasa dances in Srivasa's house.

গৌরদেহে শ্যাম তনু দেখে ভক্তগণ ।
গদাধর রাধারূপ হইলা তখন ॥ ১৮৯ ॥

*gauradehe śyāma tanu dekhe bhaktagaṇa |*
*gadādhara rādhārūpa hailā takhana || 189 ||*

*Word for word:* gaura-dehe — in Gaura's body; shyama tanu — a dark form; dekhe bhakta-gana — the devotees see; gadadhara — Gadadhara; radha-rupa haila takhana — then took the form of Radha

**189.** In Gaura's body the devotees see a dark form,
and Gadadhara then took the form of Radha.

মধুমতী নরহরি হৈলা সেইকালে ।
দেখিয়া বৈষ্ণব সব হরিহরি বোলে ॥ ১৯০ ॥

*madhumatī narahari hailā seikāle |*
*dekhiẏā baiṣṇaba saba harihari bole || 190 ||*

*Word for word:* madhumati — Madhumati; narahari haila — Narahari became; sei-kale — at that moment; dekhiya — seeing; vaishnava saba — all the Vaishnavas; hari-hari bole — cry "Hari, Hari!"

**190.** Narahari at that moment became Madhumati;
seeing this, all the Vaishnavas cry "Hari, Hari!"

বৃন্দাবন প্রকাশ হইল সেইস্থানে ।
গো-গোপী-গোপাল-সঙ্গে শচীর নন্দনে ॥ ১৯১ ॥

*bṛndābana prakāśa haila seisthāne |*
*go-gopī-gopāla-saṅge śacīra nandane || 191 ||*

*Word for word:* vrindavana prakasha haila — Vrindavana appeared; sei-sthane — in that place; go-gopi-gopala-sange — with the cows, gopis and cowherd boys; shachira nandane — the son of Shachi

**191.** In that place Vrindavana appeared:
the son of Shachi — with the cows, the gopis and the cowherd boys.

পূর্বে সখা সখীগণ যেরূপে আছিলা ।
রস-আস্বাদনে প্রভু-সঙ্গে ভক্ত হৈলা ॥ ১৯২ ॥

*pūrbe sakhā sakhīgaṇa yerūpe āchilā |*
*rasa-āsbādane prabhu-saṅge bhakta hailā || 192 ||*

*Word for word:* purve — formerly; sakha sakhi-gana — the friends and girl-friends; ye-rupe achhila — as they were; rasa-asvadane — in tasting rasa; prabhu-sange — with the Lord; bhakta haila — the devotees became

**192.** As the friends and girl-friends had been before,
so the devotees became beside the Lord, tasting rasa.

অভিনব-কামদেব শ্রীরঘুনন্দন ।
অপ্রাকৃত মদন বলিয়া যে গণন ॥ ১৯৩ ॥

*abhinaba-kāmadeba śrīraghunandana |*
*aprākṛta madana baliẏā ye gaṇana || 193 ||*

*Word for word:* abhinava-kamadeva — a new Kamadeva; shri-raghunandana — Sri Raghunandana; aprakrita madana — the transcendental Madana; baliya ye ganana — so he is reckoned

**193.** Sri Raghunandana is a new Kamadeva:
he is called the transcendental Madana.

তারা সব পূর্বদেহ ধরি' প্রভু-কাছে ।
আবরণ-ক্রমে তারা প্রভু বেড়ি' নাচে ॥ ১৯৪ ॥

*tārā saba pūrbadeha dhari' prabhu-kāche |*
*ābaraṇa-krame tārā prabhu beṛi' nāce || 194 ||*

*Word for word:* tara saba — all of them; purva-deha dhari — taking their former bodies; prabhu-kachhe — beside the Lord; avarana-krame — in the order of the enclosures; tara prabhu bedi nache — they dance around the Lord

**194.** All of them, taking their former bodies, beside the Lord
dance round the Lord, circle within circle.

দেখি' অন্য-অবতার-সঙ্গী সব কান্দে ।
নবদ্বীপে উদয় করিল ব্রজচান্দে ॥ ১৯৫ ॥

*dekhi' anya-abatāra-saṅgī saba kānde |*
*nabadbīpe udaẏa karila brajacānde || 195 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhi — seeing; anya-avatara-sangi — the associates of other avataras; saba kande — all weep; navadvipe — in Navadvipa; udaya karila — has risen; vraja-chande — the Moon of Vraja

**195.** Seeing this, all the associates of other avataras weep:
in Navadvipa the Moon of Vraja has risen!

ক্ষণে গৌরলীলা গদাধর করি' সঙ্গে ।
ক্ষণে শ্যামলীলা রাধা-রাসরস-রঙ্গে ॥ ১৯৬ ॥

*kṣaṇe gauralīlā gadādhara kari' saṅge |*
*kṣaṇe śyāmalīlā rādhā-rāsarasa-raṅge || 196 ||*

*Word for word:* kshane — now; gaura-lila — Gaura's lila; gadadhara kari sange — with Gadadhara; kshane — now; shyama-lila — Shyama's lila; radha-rasa-rasa-range — in the joy of the rasa of the rasa dance with Radha

**196.** Now it is Gaura's lila with Gadadhara,
now Shyama's lila, the joy of the rasa of the rasa dance with Radha[^25-8].

চমৎকার লীলা দেখি' সব ভক্তগণ ।
হরিহরি জয় জয় বোলে ঘনে ঘন ॥ ১৯৭ ॥

*camatkāra līlā dekhi' saba bhaktagaṇa |*
*harihari jaẏa jaẏa bole ghane ghana || 197 ||*

*Word for word:* chamatkara lila dekhi — seeing the wondrous lila; saba bhakta-gana — all the devotees; hari-hari jaya jaya — "Hari, Hari! Jaya, jaya!"; bole ghane ghana — cry again and again

**197.** Seeing the wondrous lila, all the devotees
cry again and again: "Hari, Hari! Jaya, jaya!"

দিন-অবসানে সন্ধ্যা রম্য দিগন্তর ।
আচম্বিতে মেঘারম্ভ গগন-মণ্ডল ॥ ১৯৮ ॥

*dina-abasāne sandhyā ramya digantara |*
*ācambite meghārambha gagana-maṇḍala || 198 ||*

*Word for word:* dina-avasane — at the end of the day; sandhya — evening; ramya digantara — lovely quarters; achambite — suddenly; megharambha — clouds gathered; gagana-mandala — the vault of the sky

**198.** The day ended; it was evening, the quarters were lovely —
and suddenly clouds covered the vault of the sky.

ঘন ঘন গরজয়ে গম্ভীর-নিনাদে ।
দেখিয়া বৈষ্ণবগণ গণিল প্রমাদে ॥ ১৯৯ ॥

*ghana ghana garajaẏe gambhīra-nināde |*
*dekhiẏā baiṣṇabagaṇa gaṇila pramāde || 199 ||*

*Word for word:* ghana ghana — again and again; garajaye — it thunders; gambhira-ninade — with a deep roar; dekhiya — seeing; vaishnava-gana — the Vaishnavas; ganila pramade — took it for a calamity

**199.** Again and again the thunder rolls;
seeing this, the Vaishnavas took it for a calamity.

বিঘ্ন উপসন্ন দেখি' সভেই দুঃখিত ।
কেমনে ঘুচয়ে বিঘ্ন চিন্তাপর-চিত ॥ ২০০ ॥

*bighna upasanna dekhi' sabhei duḥkhita |*
*kemane ghucaẏe bighna cintāpara-cita || 200 ||*

*Word for word:* vighna upasanna dekhi — seeing a hindrance arrived; sabhei duhkhita — all are dejected; kemane ghuchaye vighna — how can the hindrance be removed; chintapara-chita — with anxious hearts

**200.** Seeing that a hindrance had come, all were dejected;
anxiously they think: "How can the hindrance be removed?"

মেঘগণ প্রেম-পরসাদ নিতে আইলা ।
গৌরলীলা দেখি' প্রেমে গর্জিতে লাগিলা ॥ ২০১ ॥

*meghagaṇa prema-parasāda nite āilā |*
*gauralīlā dekhi' preme garjite lāgilā || 201 ||*

*Word for word:* megha-gana — the clouds; prema-parasada nite aila — came to receive the grace of prema; gaura-lila dekhi — seeing Gaura's lila; preme garjite lagila — began to thunder with love

**201.** [But] the clouds had come to receive the grace of prema:
seeing Gaura's lila, they thundered with love.

তবে মহাপ্রভু সে মন্দিরা করি' করে ।
নাম-গুণ-সংকীর্তন করে উচ্চস্বরে ॥ ২০২ ॥

*tabe mahāprabhu se mandirā kari' kare |*
*nāma-guṇa-saṃkīrtana kare uccasbare || 202 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe mahaprabhu se — then Mahaprabhu; mandira kari kare — taking the mandiras in His hands; nama-guna-sankirtana — the sankirtana of names and qualities; kare uchcha-svare — performs aloud

**202.** Then Mahaprabhu took the mandira cymbals in His hands
and loudly sings the sankirtana of names and qualities.

দেবলোক কৃতার্থ করিব হেন মনে ।
ঊর্ধ্বমুখে চাহে প্রভু আকাশের পানে ॥ ২০৩ ॥

*debaloka kṛtārtha kariba hena mane |*
*ūrdhbamukhe cāhe prabhu ākāśera pāne || 203 ||*

*Word for word:* deva-loka — the heavenly world; kritartha kariba — I shall fulfil; hena mane — so thinking; urdhva-mukhe — with upturned face; chahe prabhu — the Lord gazes; akashera pane — at the sky

**203.** Wishing to fulfil [the desires of] the heavenly world,
the Lord raised His face and gazes at the sky.

দূরে গেল মেঘগণ প্রকাশ আকাশ ।
হরিষে বৈষ্ণবগণের বাড়িল উল্লাস ॥ ২০৪ ॥

*dūre gela meghagaṇa prakāśa ākāśa |*
*hariṣe baiṣṇabagaṇera bāṛila ullāsa || 204 ||*

*Word for word:* dure gela megha-gana — the clouds went far away; prakasha akasha — the sky cleared; harishe — in joy; vaishnava-ganera — of the Vaishnavas; badila ullasa — the jubilation increased

**204.** The clouds went far away, the sky cleared,
and the jubilation of the Vaishnavas increased.

নিরমল ভেল শশি-রঞ্জিত রজনী ।
অনুগত গুণ গায় নাচয়ে আপনি ॥ ২০৫ ॥

*niramala bhela śaśi-rañjita rajanī |*
*anugata guṇa gāẏa nācaẏe āpani || 205 ||*

*Word for word:* niramala bhela — became clear; shashi-ranjita rajani — the night tinged by the moon; anugata — the followers; guna gaya — sing the qualities; nachaye apani — He Himself dances

**205.** The night became clear, tinged by the moon;
the devotees sing His qualities, and He Himself dances.

মেঘগণ নিজরূপ ধরি' প্রভু-কাছে ।
নাচিয়া বুলয়ে তারা ভক্ত-পাছে পাছে ॥ ২০৬ ॥

*meghagaṇa nijarūpa dhari' prabhu-kāche |*
*nāciẏā bulaẏe tārā bhakta-pāche pāche || 206 ||*

*Word for word:* megha-gana — the clouds; nija-rupa dhari — taking their own form; prabhu-kachhe — beside the Lord; nachiya bulaye tara — they go about dancing; bhakta-pachhe pachhe — behind the devotees

**206.** The clouds, taking their own form, beside the Lord
dance, following the devotees.

সেই প্রেম বিচার না করে গৌরহরি ।
মেঘে কি বলিব দিল ত্রিজগৎ ভরি' ॥ ২০৭ ॥

*sei prema bicāra nā kare gaurahari |*
*meghe ki baliba dila trijagat bhari' || 207 ||*

*Word for word:* sei prema — [in giving] this prema; vichara na kare — makes no distinction; gaurahari — Gaurahari; meghe ki baliba — what to speak of the clouds; dila trijagat bhari — He gave it, filling the three worlds

**207.** In giving this prema Gaurahari makes no distinction:
what to speak of clouds — He filled the three worlds with it!

আপনে ঠাকুর নাচে ভক্তগণ-সনে ।
সভার আবেশে নাচে শচীর নন্দনে ॥ ২০৮ ॥

*āpane ṭhākura nāce bhaktagaṇa-sane |*
*sabhāra ābeśe nāce śacīra nandane || 208 ||*

*Word for word:* apane thakura — the Thakura Himself; nache bhakta-gana-sane — dances with the devotees; sabhara aveshe — in the ecstasy of all; nache shachira nandane — the son of Shachi dances

**208.** The Thakura Himself dances with the devotees:
amid the ecstasy of all dances the son of Shachi.

প্রেমার আবেশে নাচে মহানটরাজে ।
পদাম্বুজে মুখর মঞ্জীর ঘন বাজে ॥ ২০৯ ॥

*premāra ābeśe nāce mahānaṭarāje |*
*padāmbuje mukhara mañjīra ghana bāje || 209 ||*

*Word for word:* premara aveshe — in the ecstasy of prema; nache maha-nataraje — the great King of dancers dances; padambuje — on the lotus feet; mukhara manjira — the ringing anklets; ghana baje — sound loudly

**209.** In the ecstasy of prema the great King of dancers dances;
on His lotus feet the anklets ring loudly.

বিপ্রসাধ্বীগণ জয় জয় দেই সুখে ।
আকাশেতে দেবগণ দেখয়ে কৌতুকে ॥ ২১০ ॥

*biprasādhbīgaṇa jaẏa jaẏa dei sukhe |*
*ākāśete debagaṇa dekhaẏe kautuke || 210 ||*

*Word for word:* vipra-sadhvi-gana — the virtuous wives of the brahmanas; jaya jaya dei sukhe — joyfully cry "Jaya, jaya!"; akashete deva-gana — the gods in the sky; dekhaye kautuke — watch the festival

**210.** The virtuous wives of the brahmanas joyfully cry "Jaya, jaya!";
from the sky the gods watch the festival[^25-9].

প্রেমায়ে বিভোল সব নাচে ভক্তগণ ।
না জানি কি কৈল তপঃ কতেক জনম ॥ ২১১ ॥

*premāẏe bibhola saba nāce bhaktagaṇa |*
*nā jāni ki kaila tapaḥ kateka janama || 211 ||*

*Word for word:* premaye vibhola — intoxicated with prema; saba nache bhakta-gana — all the devotees dance; na jani — who knows; ki kaila tapah — what austerities they did; kateka janama — for how many births

**211.** All the devotees dance, intoxicated with prema:
who knows what austerities they performed — for how many births —

তাহার কারণে নাচে ঠাকুরের সনে ।
আমোদ করয়ে তারা প্রেম হেন ধনে ॥ ২১২ ॥

*tāhāra kāraṇe nāce ṭhākurera sane |*
*āmoda karaẏe tārā prema hena dhane || 212 ||*

*Word for word:* tahara karane — for that reason; nache thakurera sane — they dance with the Thakura; amoda karaye tara — they make merry; prema hena dhane — with such a treasure as prema

**212.** that for them they dance with the Thakura
and make merry with such a treasure as prema?

করুণায় ছাইল প্রভু এ ভূমি আকাশ ।
শুনি' আনন্দিত কহে এ লোচনদাস ॥ ২১৩ ॥

*karuṇāẏa chāila prabhu e bhūmi ākāśa |*
*śuni' ānandita kahe e locanadāsa || 213 ||*

*Word for word:* karunaya chhaila prabhu — with compassion the Lord covered; e bhumi akasha — this earth and sky; shuni — hearing; anandita kahe — joyfully says; e lochanadasa — Lochana Dasa

**213.** With His compassion the Lord covered both earth and sky.
Hearing of it, Lochana Dasa speaks in joy.

## Mercy to Mukunda

> *Summary by Srila Bhaktisiddhanta Sarasvati.* The author, having described the wondrous beauty and loveliness of Sriman Mahaprabhu, glorifies the lila of planting the mango tree. One day Sriman Mahaprabhu, before the devotees, planted a mango stone; before their eyes it at once sprouted, gradually became a tree and blossomed; mangoes appeared on the tree and at once ripened; the devotees offered them to Bhagavan and all together honoured the prasada. Afterwards they saw that none of it was there any more — everything had vanished.
