একাঙ্গুলি মধু জিহ্বা লিহায় যতনে ॥ ৪৪ ॥

*durgandha lāgiẏā tāhā nā cāhe naẏane |*
*ekāṅguli madhu jihbā lihāẏa yatane || 44 ||*

*Word for word:* durgandha lagiya — because of the stench; taha na chahe nayane — one does not look at them; ekanguli madhu — the one honeyed finger; jihva lihaya yatane — one carefully licks with the tongue

**44.** Because of the stench one does not even want to look at them,
but the finger with honey one carefully licks with the tongue.

এক অব্যয় সেই ভগবান্ মাত্র ।
ইহা বহি' মুক্ত হইবারে নাহি পাত্র ॥ ৪৫ ॥

*eka abyaẏa sei bhagabān mātra |*
*ihā bahi' mukta haibāre nāhi pātra || 45 ||*

*Word for word:* eka avyaya — the One, the Imperishable; sei bhagavan matra — is Bhagavan alone; iha bahi — apart from Him; mukta haibare — to be liberated; nahi patra — there is no means

**45.** The One, the Imperishable is Bhagavan alone;
apart from Him there is nothing by which to be liberated."

এইমতে জ্ঞানযোগ কহে নানাবিধি ।
ক্ষণেক রহিলা নিঃশবদে গুণনিধি ॥ ৪৬ ॥

*eimate jñānayoga kahe nānābidhi |*
*kṣaṇeka rahilā niḥśabade guṇanidhi || 46 ||*

*Word for word:* eimate — thus; jnana-yoga kahe nana-vidhi — sets forth the path of knowledge in many ways; kshaneka rahila nihshabade — for a moment fell silent; guna-nidhi — the Ocean of virtues

**46.** Thus in many ways He set forth the path of knowledge (jnana-yoga)
and for a moment fell silent — the Ocean of virtues.

দয়া করি' পুনঃ কহে সর্বতত্ত্বসার ।
শ্রীকৃষ্ণভকতি বিনে কিছু নাহি আর ॥ ৪৭ ॥

*daẏā kari' punaḥ kahe sarbatattbasāra |*
*śrīkṛṣṇabhakati bine kichu nāhi āra || 47 ||*

*Word for word:* daya kari — out of mercy; punah kahe — again He says; sarva-tattva-sara — the essence of all truths; shri-krishna-bhakati vine — without devotion to Sri Krishna; kichhu nahi ara — there is nothing else

**47.** Then, out of mercy, He again speaks the essence of all truths:
"Without devotion to Sri Krishna there is nothing else."

জ্ঞানগম্য কৃষ্ণ ইহা বুঝাইল সভারে ।
কৃষ্ণ-পাদাম্বুজে প্রেমভক্তি সর্বসারে ॥ ৪৮ ॥

*jñānagamya kṛṣṇa ihā bujhāila sabhāre |*
*kṛṣṇa-pādāmbuje premabhakti sarbasāre || 48 ||*

*Word for word:* jnana-gamya krishna — Krishna is reached through knowledge; iha bujhaila sabhare — this He explained to all; krishna-padambuje prema-bhakti — prema-bhakti for Krishna's lotus feet; sarva-sare — the essence of all

**48.** He explained to all: "Krishna is reached through knowledge,
[but] prema-bhakti for Krishna's lotus feet is the essence of all.

এই জ্ঞান হইলে হয় কৃষ্ণে দৃঢ়মতি ।
মতি দৃঢ়া হৈলে হয় ভক্তি অহৈতুকী ॥ ৪৯ ॥

*ei jñāna haile haẏa kṛṣṇe dṛṛhamati |*
*mati dṛṛhā haile haẏa bhakti ahaitukī || 49 ||*

*Word for word:* ei jnana haile — when this knowledge comes; haya krishne dridha-mati — the mind is fixed firmly on Krishna; mati dridha haile — when the mind is firm; haya bhakti ahaituki — causeless bhakti arises

**49.** When this knowledge comes, the mind turns firmly to Krishna;
when the mind is firm, causeless bhakti arises"[^27-2].

কৃষ্ণ-পাদাম্বুজ-ধ্যান করিল তখন ।
হরিহরি বলি' পাদাম্বুজ-সঙরণ ॥ ৫০ ॥

*kṛṣṇa-pādāmbuja-dhyāna karila takhana |*
*harihari bali' pādāmbuja-saṅaraṇa || 50 ||*

*Word for word:* krishna-padambuja-dhyana — meditation on Krishna's lotus feet; karila takhana — then He did; hari-hari bali — crying "Hari, Hari!"; padambuja-sanarana — remembrance of the lotus feet

**50.** Then He became absorbed in meditation on Krishna's lotus feet
and, crying "Hari, Hari!", remembered His lotus feet:

রাধা-সঙ্গে চিদানন্দ শ্যাম ত্রিভঙ্গী ।
মদন-মোহন নটবর বহুরঙ্গী ॥ ৫১ ॥

*rādhā-saṅge cidānanda śyāma tribhaṅgī |*
*madana-mohana naṭabara bahuraṅgī || 51 ||*

*Word for word:* radha-sange — with Radha; chid-ananda — consciousness and bliss; shyama tribhangi — dark, thrice-bent; madana-mohana — enchanter of Kamadeva; natavara — the best of dancers; bahu-rangi — of many sports

**51.** together with Radha — dark, thrice-bent, [the embodiment of] consciousness and bliss,
the enchanter of Kamadeva, the best of dancers, of many sports,

বৃন্দাবন-মাঝে নব-রতন-মন্দিরে ।
বল্লবসুন্দরী সব বেড়ি' মনোহরে ॥ ৫২ ॥

*bṛndābana-mājhe naba-ratana-mandire |*
*ballabasundarī saba beṛi' manohare || 52 ||*

*Word for word:* vrindavana-majhe — in Vrindavana; nava-ratana-mandire — in a new temple of jewels; ballava-sundari saba — all the beautiful cowherd girls; bedi — surrounding; manohare — the Captivating One

**52.** in Vrindavana, in a new temple of jewels,
captivating, surrounded by the beautiful cowherd girls.

কোকিল ময়ূর সারী শুক অলিকুলে ।
প্রফুল্লিত বৃন্দাবন শোভে নানাফুলে ॥ ৫৩ ॥

*kokila maẏūra sārī śuka alikule |*
*praphullita bṛndābana śobhe nānāphule || 53 ||*

*Word for word:* kokila mayura sari shuka — cuckoos, peacocks, sarikas, parrots; alikule — swarms of bees; praphullita vrindavana — Vrindavana in bloom; shobhe nana-phule — is adorned with many flowers

**53.** Cuckoos, peacocks, sarikas, parrots, swarms of bees;
Vrindavana in full bloom is adorned with many flowers.

চিন্তামণি-ভূমি কল্পতরুগণ যত ।
কামধেনুগণ যেন সুরভিগণযুত ॥ ৫৪ ॥

*cintāmaṇi-bhūmi kalpatarugaṇa yata |*
*kāmadhenugaṇa yena surabhigaṇayuta || 54 ||*

*Word for word:* chintamani-bhumi — ground of chintamani; kalpa-taru-gana yata — all the wish-fulfilling trees; kamadhenu-gana — the kamadhenu cows; yena surabhi-gana-yuta — like herds of surabhis

**54.** The ground is chintamani, everywhere wish-fulfilling trees,
the kamadhenu cows like herds of surabhis.

যমুনা-বেষ্টিত মনোহর অতি শোভা ।
সে রস-লাবণ্য দেখি' লক্ষ্মী মনোলোভা ॥ ৫৫ ॥

*yamunā-beṣṭita manohara ati śobhā |*
*se rasa-lābaṇya dekhi' lakṣmī manolobhā || 55 ||*

*Word for word:* yamuna-veshtita — girdled by the Yamuna; manohara ati shobha — captivating, most beautiful; se rasa-lavanya dekhi — seeing that rasa and loveliness; lakshmi mano-lobha — Lakshmi longs at heart

**55.** Girdled by the Yamuna, captivating, full of beauty —
seeing that rasa and loveliness, Lakshmi is filled with longing[^27-3].

উঠিল প্রেমের ধারা বহে দুনয়ানে ।
পুলকিত কলেবর অরুণ নয়ানে ॥ ৫৬ ॥

*uṭhila premera dhārā bahe dunaẏāne |*
*pulakita kalebara aruṇa naẏāne || 56 ||*

*Word for word:* uthila premera dhara — a stream of prema rose; bahe dunayane — flows from both eyes; pulakita kalebara — the body thrills; aruna nayane — the eyes red

**56.** A stream of prema rose and flows from both His eyes,
His body thrills, His eyes are red.

ক্ষণে হাসে ক্ষণে কান্দে ক্ষণে নাচে গায় ।
কহিল সবারে প্রভু গদগদ-ভাষায় ॥ ৫৭ ॥

*kṣaṇe hāse kṣaṇe kānde kṣaṇe nāce gāẏa |*
*kahila sabāre prabhu gadagada-bhāṣāẏa || 57 ||*

*Word for word:* kshane hase — now He laughs; kshane kande — now weeps; kshane nache gaya — now dances and sings; kahila sabare prabhu — the Lord said to all; gadgada-bhashaya — in a faltering voice

**57.** Now He laughs, now weeps, now dances and sings;
in a faltering voice the Lord said to all:

ঐছন আমার যেই যেই ভক্তগণ ।
নিজগুণে পবিত্র করয়ে ত্রিভুবন ॥ ৫৮ ॥

*aichana āmāra yei yei bhaktagaṇa |*
*nijaguṇe pabitra karaẏe tribhubana || 58 ||*

*Word for word:* aichhana — such are; amara yei yei bhakta-gana — all My devotees; nija-gune — by their virtues; pavitra karaye tribhuvana — purify the three worlds

**58.** "Such are all My devotees:
by their virtues they purify the three worlds."

ইহা বলি' হৃষ্ট হঞা নিজভক্ত-সনে ।
নাচায় সভারে প্রভু নাচয়ে আপনে ॥ ৫৯ ॥

*ihā bali' hṛṣṭa hañā nijabhakta-sane |*
*nācāẏa sabhāre prabhu nācaẏe āpane || 59 ||*

*Word for word:* iha bali — saying this; hrishta hana — joyful; nija-bhakta-sane — with His devotees; nachaya sabhare prabhu — the Lord makes all dance; nachaye apane — dances Himself

**59.** Saying this, the Lord, joyful, with His devotees
makes them all dance and dances Himself.

এইমতে সুখে নিবসয়ে নবদ্বীপে ।
নিজভক্তগণ মেলি' গঙ্গার সমীপে ॥ ৬০ ॥

*eimate sukhe nibasaẏe nabadbīpe |*
*nijabhaktagaṇa meli' gaṅgāra samīpe || 60 ||*

*Word for word:* eimate — thus; sukhe nivasaye navadvipe — He lives happily in Navadvipa; nija-bhakta-gana meli — together with His devotees; gangara samipe — near the Ganga

**60.** Thus He lives happily in Navadvipa
together with His devotees, by the Ganga.

অদ্বৈত-আচার্য-গোসাঞি তবে আর দিনে ।
নবদ্বীপে আইলা বিশ্বম্ভর-দরশনে ॥ ৬১ ॥

*adbaita-ācārya-gosāñi tabe āra dine |*
*nabadbīpe āilā biśbambhara-daraśane || 61 ||*

*Word for word:* advaita-acharya-gosani — Advaita Acharya Gosani; tabe ara dine — then on another day; navadvipe aila — came to Navadvipa; vishvambhara-darashane — to see Vishvambhara

**61.** And then on another day Advaita Acharya Gosani
came to Navadvipa to see Vishvambhara.

গিয়াছিলা মহাপ্রভু শ্রীনিবাস-ঘরে ।
আগমন চাহি' আচার্য স্নানপূজা করে ॥ ৬২ ॥

*giẏāchilā mahāprabhu śrīnibāsa-ghare |*
*āgamana cāhi' ācārya snānapūjā kare || 62 ||*

*Word for word:* giyachhila mahaprabhu — Mahaprabhu had gone; shrinibasa-ghare — to Srinivasa's house; agamana chahi — intending to come; acharya snana-puja kare — the Acharya performs bath and worship

**62.** Mahaprabhu had gone to Srinivasa's house;
the Acharya, about to come [to Him], performs His bath and worship.

শ্রীনিবাস-ঘরে প্রভু আনন্দিত মনে ।
দণ্ডাগ্রে পুষ্প দিয়া কহিল বচনে ॥ ৬৩ ॥

*śrīnibāsa-ghare prabhu ānandita mane |*
*daṇḍāgre puṣpa diẏā kahila bacane || 63 ||*

*Word for word:* shrinibasa-ghare — in Srinivasa's house; prabhu anandita mane — the Lord with a joyful heart; dandagre pushpa diya — placing a flower on the tip of a staff; kahila bachane — said

**63.** In Srinivasa's house the Lord, with a joyful heart,
placing a flower on the tip of a staff, said:

গদাপূজা কৈল এই দুষ্ট নাশিবারে ।
আমার ভকত-হিংসা যেই যেই করে ॥ ৬৪ ॥

*gadāpūjā kaila ei duṣṭa nāśibāre |*
*āmāra bhakata-hiṃsā yei yei kare || 64 ||*

*Word for word:* gada-puja kaila — I have worshipped the club; ei dushta nashibare — to destroy these wicked ones; amara bhakata-himsa — harm to My devotees; yei yei kare — all who do

**64.** "I have worshipped the club to destroy these wicked ones —
all who do harm to My devotees.

ইহাতে নাশিব আমি সেই সেই জন ।
সভা-বিদ্যমানে প্রভু কহিল বচন ॥ ৬৫ ॥

*ihāte nāśiba āmi sei sei jana |*
*sabhā-bidyamāne prabhu kahila bacana || 65 ||*

*Word for word:* ihate — with this; nashiba ami — I shall destroy; sei sei jana — all such people; sabha-vidyamane — in the presence of all; prabhu kahila bachana — the Lord said

**65.** With it I shall destroy all such people" —
so the Lord spoke in the presence of all.

মোর ভক্তদ্বেষী এক আছে দুষ্টজন ।
কুষ্ঠব্যাধি হইবে তার অনেক জনম ॥ ৬৬ ॥

*mora bhaktadbeṣī eka āche duṣṭajana |*
*kuṣṭhabyādhi haibe tāra aneka janama || 66 ||*

*Word for word:* mora bhakta-dveshi — a hater of My devotees; eka achhe dushta-jana — there is one wicked man; kushtha-vyadhi haibe tara — he will have leprosy; aneka janama — for many births

**66.** "There is one wicked man, a hater of My devotees:
he will suffer leprosy for many births.

পৈশাচ-নরকে বাস করাইব আমি ।
বিড়্ভুজ শূকর সেই হইবে আপনি ॥ ৬৭ ॥

*paiśāca-narake bāsa karāiba āmi |*
*biṛbhuja śūkara sei haibe āpani || 67 ||*

*Word for word:* paishacha-narake — in the hell of the pishachas; basa karaiba ami — I shall make him dwell; vid-bhuja shukara — a filth-eating hog; sei haibe apani — he himself will become

**67.** I shall make him dwell in the hell of the pishachas;
he himself will become a hog that eats filth.

তাহার শিষ্যের আমি করাইব দণ্ড ।
আমার গদায় সব নাশিব পাষণ্ড ॥ ৬৮ ॥

*tāhāra śiṣyera āmi karāiba daṇḍa |*
*āmāra gadāẏa saba nāśiba pāṣaṇḍa || 68 ||*

*Word for word:* tahara shishyera — his disciples; ami karaiba danda — I shall punish; amara gadaya — with My club; saba nashiba pashanda — I shall destroy all the godless

**68.** I shall punish his disciples too;
with My club I shall destroy all the godless[^27-4].

বনেরে যাইব বলি' ছিল মোর মন ।
এথাই আমার সেই হৈল মহাবন ॥ ৬৯ ॥

*banere yāiba bali' chila mora mana |*
*ethāi āmāra sei haila mahābana || 69 ||*

*Word for word:* banere yaiba bali — "I will go to the forest"; chhila mora mana — so I had thought; ethai — right here; amara sei haila mahabana — has become that great forest for Me

**69.** I had thought to go to the forest —
but here for Me is that great forest:

ব্যাঘ্রসদৃশ কেহো কেহো বা পাষাণ ।
বৃক্ষের সদৃশ কেহো তৃণের সমান ॥ ৭০ ॥

*byāghrasadṛśa keho keho bā pāṣāṇa |*
*bṛkṣera sadṛśa keho tṛṇera samāna || 70 ||*

*Word for word:* vyaghra-sadrisha keho — some are like tigers; keho ba pashana — others like stones; vrikshera sadrisha keho — some like trees; trinera samana — [others] like grass

**70.** some are like tigers, others like stones,
some are like trees, others like grass,

পশুর সমান করি' গণি কোন জন ।
এতেক বলিয়ে মোরে এই মহাবন ॥ ৭১ ॥

*paśura samāna kari' gaṇi kona jana |*
*eteka baliẏe more ei mahābana || 71 ||*

*Word for word:* pashura samana kari — as cattle; gani kona jana — some I count; eteka baliye — therefore I say; more ei mahabana — this is a great forest for Me

**71.** and some I count as cattle —
that is why I say: this is a great forest for Me[^27-5].

অদ্বৈত-আচার্য এথা আইল ইহা শুনি ।
এথা না আইলা তথা যাইব আপনি ॥ ৭২ ॥

*adbaita-ācārya ethā āila ihā śuni |*
*ethā nā āilā tathā yāiba āpani || 72 ||*

*Word for word:* advaita-acharya etha aila — Advaita Acharya has come here; iha shuni — so I hear; etha na aila — [if] He does not come here; tatha yaiba apani — I shall go there Myself

**72.** I have heard that Advaita Acharya has come here;
if He does not come here, I shall go there Myself."

হেনই সময়ে আচার্য আইলা আচম্বিত ।
প্রভুর সম্মুখে গিয়া হৈলা উপনীত ॥ ৭৩ ॥

*henai samaẏe ācārya āilā ācambita |*
*prabhura sammukhe giẏā hailā upanīta || 73 ||*

*Word for word:* henai samaye — at that very time; acharya aila achambita — the Acharya suddenly came; prabhura sammukhe giya — going before the Lord; haila upanita — he presented himself

**73.** At that very moment the Acharya suddenly came
and appeared before the Lord.

পাদাম্বুজ-সন্নিকটে উপায়ন দিয়া ।
দণ্ডপরণাম করে ভূমিতে পড়িয়া ॥ ৭৪ ॥

*pādāmbuja-sannikaṭe upāẏana diẏā |*
*daṇḍaparaṇāma kare bhūmite paṛiẏā || 74 ||*

*Word for word:* padambuja-sannikate — near the lotus feet; upayana diya — placing gifts; danda-paranama kare — prostrates; bhumite padiya — falling to the ground

**74.** Placing gifts near the lotus feet,
He fell to the ground and prostrated Himself.

তার কর ধরি' প্রভু বোলয়ে বচন ।
এথা আগমন মোর তোমার কারণ ॥ ৭৫ ॥

*tāra kara dhari' prabhu bolaẏe bacana |*
*ethā āgamana mora tomāra kāraṇa || 75 ||*

*Word for word:* tara kara dhari — taking His hand; prabhu bolaye bachana — the Lord says; etha agamana mora — My coming here; tomara karana — is for Your sake

**75.** Taking His hand, the Lord says:
"I have come here for Your sake.

মোর পাদপদ্ম নিজ মস্তকে ধরিয়া ।
তুলসী-মঞ্জরী দিয়া পূজিলে কান্দিয়া ॥ ৭৬ ॥

*mora pādapadma nija mastake dhariẏā |*
*tulasī-mañjarī diẏā pūjile kāndiẏā || 76 ||*

*Word for word:* mora pada-padma — My lotus feet; nija mastake dhariya — holding on Your head; tulasi-manjari diya — offering tulasi buds; pujile kandiya — You worshipped, weeping

**76.** You held My lotus feet on Your head
and, weeping, worshipped them, offering tulasi buds.

ভাগবতচিত্ত তুমি হুঙ্কারে আনিলা ।
তোমার পীরিতি লাগি' মোরে সভে পাইলা ॥ ৭৭ ॥

*bhāgabatacitta tumi huṅkāre ānilā |*
*tomāra pīriti lāgi' more sabhe pāilā || 77 ||*

*Word for word:* bhagavata-chitta tumi — You, whose heart is a bhagavata's; hunkare anila — brought [Me] by loud calls; tomara piriti lagi — because of Your love; more sabhe paila — all have obtained Me

**77.** You, whose heart is that of a bhagavata, brought [Me] with Your loud calls:
thanks to Your love all have obtained Me"[^27-6].

ইহা বলি' মহাপ্রভু খট্টায় বসিলা ।
নাচহ বলিয়া আচার্যেরে আজ্ঞা দিলা ॥ ৭৮ ॥

*ihā bali' mahāprabhu khaṭṭāẏa basilā |*
*nācaha baliẏā ācāryere ājñā dilā || 78 ||*

*Word for word:* iha bali — saying this; mahaprabhu khattaya basila — Mahaprabhu sat on a couch; nachaha baliya — saying "dance"; acharyere ajna dila — gave the order to the Acharya

**78.** Saying this, Mahaprabhu sat on a couch
and ordered the Acharya: "Dance!"

তবে সেই অদ্বৈত-আচার্য দ্বিজবর ।
দশ-অবতার-গীতে নাচিলা বিস্তর ॥ ৭৯ ॥

*tabe sei adbaita-ācārya dbijabara |*
*daśa-abatāra-gīte nācilā bistara || 79 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe sei advaita-acharya — then Advaita Acharya; dvija-vara — the best of brahmanas; dasha-avatara-gite — to songs of the ten avataras; nachila vistara — danced at length

**79.** Then Advaita Acharya, the best of brahmanas,
danced long to songs of the ten avataras.

শ্রীবাসপণ্ডিত-আদি যত ভক্তগণ ।
আনন্দে বিভোর করে গুণসংকীর্তন ॥ ৮০ ॥

*śrībāsapaṇḍita-ādi yata bhaktagaṇa |*
*ānande bibhora kare guṇasaṃkīrtana || 80 ||*

*Word for word:* shrivasa-pandita-adi — Srivasa Pandita and others; yata bhakta-gana — all the devotees; anande vibhora — beside themselves with joy; kare guna-sankirtana — sing the sankirtana of qualities

**80.** Srivasa Pandita and all the other devotees,
beside themselves with joy, sing the sankirtana of His qualities.

তা দেখিয়া মহাপ্রভু গৌর ভগবান্ ।
হৃষ্ট হইয়া বৈল তারে প্রসন্নবয়ান ॥ ৮১ ॥

*tā dekhiẏā mahāprabhu gaura bhagabān |*
*hṛṣṭa haiẏā baila tāre prasannabaẏāna || 81 ||*

*Word for word:* ta dekhiya — seeing this; mahaprabhu gaura bhagavan — Mahaprabhu Gaura Bhagavan; hrishta haiya — pleased; baila tare — said to Him; prasanna-bayana — with a serene face

**81.** Seeing this, Mahaprabhu Gaura Bhagavan,
pleased, said to Him with a serene face:

এ তোর বালক সব প্রেম মাগে মোরে ।
দিব প্রেমভক্তিদান কহিল তোমারে ॥ ৮২ ॥

*e tora bālaka saba prema māge more |*
*diba premabhaktidāna kahila tomāre || 82 ||*

*Word for word:* e tora balaka saba — all these children of Yours; prema mage more — beg Me for prema; diba prema-bhakti-dana — I shall give the gift of prema-bhakti; kahila tomare — I tell You

**82.** "All these children of Yours beg Me for prema;
I shall give them the gift of prema-bhakti — I tell You"[^27-7].

এ বোল শুনিঞা তুষ্ট হইলা আচার্য ।
অন্তরে জানিল মোর সিদ্ধ হৈল কার্য ॥ ৮৩ ॥

*e bola śuniñā tuṣṭa hailā ācārya |*
*antare jānila mora siddha haila kārya || 83 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shunina — hearing these words; tushta haila acharya — the Acharya was pleased; antare janila — He knew at heart; mora siddha haila karya — my work is accomplished

**83.** Hearing these words, the Acharya rejoiced;
in His heart He knew: "My work is accomplished."

আচার্য কহয়ে প্রভু শুনহ বচন ।
এই-সব জন তোর পদপরায়ণ ॥ ৮৪ ॥

*ācārya kahaẏe prabhu śunaha bacana |*
*ei-saba jana tora padaparāẏaṇa || 84 ||*

*Word for word:* acharya kahaye — the Acharya says; prabhu shunaha bachana — Lord, hear my words; ei-saba jana — all these people; tora pada-parayana — are devoted to Your feet

**84.** The Acharya says: "Lord, hear me:
all these people are devoted to Your feet.

ভকতবৎসল তুমি করুণাসাগর ।
প্রেমধন দিয়া নিজ ভক্ত রক্ষা কর ॥ ৮৫ ॥

*bhakatabatsala tumi karuṇāsāgara |*
*premadhana diẏā nija bhakta rakṣā kara || 85 ||*

*Word for word:* bhakata-vatsala tumi — You love Your devotees; karuna-sagara — ocean of compassion; premadhana diya — giving the treasure of prema; nija bhakta raksha kara — protect Your devotees

**85.** You love Your devotees, You are an ocean of compassion:
giving them the treasure of prema, protect Your devotees."

তবে সেই সব জন প্রভু-পাশে গিয়া ।
বসিলা আসন করি' ঠাকুর বেড়িয়া ॥ ৮৬ ॥

*tabe sei saba jana prabhu-pāśe giẏā |*
*basilā āsana kari' ṭhākura beṛiẏā || 86 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe sei saba jana — then all of them; prabhu-pashe giya — going to the Lord; basila asana kari — sat down; thakura bediya — around the Thakura

**86.** Then all of them came to the Lord
and sat down around the Thakura.

সচন্দ্রিকা রজনী শোভিত দিগন্তর ।
আচার্য দেখিয়া পুনঃ কহিল উত্তর ॥ ৮৭ ॥

*sacandrikā rajanī śobhita digantara |*
*ācārya dekhiẏā punaḥ kahila uttara || 87 ||*

*Word for word:* sachandrika rajani — a moonlit night; shobhita digantara — the quarters shining; acharya dekhiya — looking at the Acharya; punah kahila uttara — He spoke again

**87.** The night was moonlit, the quarters shone;
looking at the Acharya, [the Lord] spoke again:

কমলাক্ষ তুমি মোর পরম ভকত ।
তোমার লাগিয়া আইনু হৈনু বেকত ॥ ৮৮ ॥

*kamalākṣa tumi mora parama bhakata |*
*tomāra lāgiẏā āinu hainu bekata || 88 ||*

*Word for word:* kamalaksha — Kamalaksha; tumi mora parama bhakata — You are My greatest devotee; tomara lagiya ainu — for Your sake I came; hainu bekata — I became manifest

**88.** "Kamalaksha, You are My greatest devotee:
for Your sake I have come, for Your sake I have appeared.

মোর গুণ-নৃত্য-গীতে হও তুমি সুখী ।
সর্বজন ভক্তিপর হউ ইহা দেখি' ॥ ৮৯ ॥

*mora guṇa-nṛtya-gīte hao tumi sukhī |*
*sarbajana bhaktipara hau ihā dekhi' || 89 ||*

*Word for word:* mora guna-nritya-gite — in songs of My qualities and dance; hao tumi sukhi — be happy; sarvajana bhakti-para hau — may all become devoted; iha dekhi — seeing this

**89.** Be happy singing My qualities and dancing;
may all people become devotees, seeing this."

এ বোল শুনিঞা সেই শ্রীবাসপণ্ডিত ।
কহয়ে ঠাকুর-আগে পরসন্ন চিত ॥ ৯০ ॥

*e bola śuniñā sei śrībāsapaṇḍita |*
*kahaẏe ṭhākura-āge parasanna cita || 90 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shunina — hearing these words; sei shrivasa-pandita — Srivasa Pandita; kahaye thakura-age — speaks before the Thakura; parasanna chita — with a serene heart

**90.** Hearing these words, Srivasa Pandita,
with a serene heart, speaks before the Thakura:

এক নিবেদন করোঁ শুন মোর বোল ।
কহিতে ডরাঙ পুনঃ চিত উতরোল ॥ ৯১ ॥

*eka nibedana karoṁ śuna mora bola |*
*kahite ḍarāṅa punaḥ cita utarola || 91 ||*

*Word for word:* eka nivedana karon — I have one request; shuna mora bola — hear my words; kahite darana — I am afraid to speak; punah chita utarola — yet my heart is restless

**91.** "I wish to ask something — hear me;
I am afraid to speak, yet my heart is restless.

একটি সন্দেহ পুছোঁ হৃদয়ের কার্য ।
তোমার কি ভক্ত এই অদ্বৈত আচার্য ॥ ৯২ ॥

*ekaṭi sandeha puchoṁ hṛdaẏera kārya |*
*tomāra ki bhakta ei adbaita ācārya || 92 ||*

*Word for word:* ekati sandeha — one doubt; puchhon — I ask; hridayera karya — what is in my heart; tomara ki bhakta — is he Your devotee; ei advaita acharya — this Advaita Acharya

**92.** I have one doubt, and that is what I ask:
is this Advaita Acharya really Your devotee?"

ইহা শুনি' ক্রোধমুখ গৌর ভগবান্ ।
ভর্ৎসিতে লাগিলা ক্রোধে অরুণনয়ান ॥ ৯৩ ॥

*ihā śuni' krodhamukha gaura bhagabān |*
*bhartsite lāgilā krodhe aruṇanaẏāna || 93 ||*

*Word for word:* iha shuni — hearing this; krodha-mukha — with an angry face; gaura bhagavan — Gaura Bhagavan; bhartsite lagila — began to rebuke; krodhe aruna-nayana — His eyes red with anger

**93.** Hearing this, Gaura Bhagavan, His face angry,
His eyes red with anger, began to rebuke him:

উদ্ধব অক্রূর মোর প্রিয় দুইজন ।
আচার্য বাসহ তুমি তা-সভাকে ন্যূন ॥ ৯৪ ॥

*uddhaba akrūra mora priẏa duijana |*
*ācārya bāsaha tumi tā-sabhāke nyūna || 94 ||*

*Word for word:* uddhava akrura — Uddhava and Akrura; mora priya dui-jana — two dear ones of Mine; acharya basaha tumi — the Acharya you consider; ta-sabhake nyuna — lower than they

**94.** "Uddhava and Akrura are two dear ones of Mine —
and you think the Acharya lower than they?

ভারতবরষে এই আচার্য সমান ।
আমার ভকত আছে হেন কোন জন ॥ ৯৫ ॥

*bhāratabaraṣe ei ācārya samāna |*
*āmāra bhakata āche hena kona jana || 95 ||*

*Word for word:* bharata-varashe — in Bharata-varsha; ei acharya samana — equal to this Acharya; amara bhakata achhe — is there a devotee of Mine; hena kona jana — any such person

**95.** Is there in Bharata-varsha
a single devotee of Mine equal to the Acharya?

এতেক বলিয়ে তুমি অজ্ঞান ব্রাহ্মণ ।
আচার্য সমান মোর ভক্ত নাহি আন ॥ ৯৬ ॥

*eteka baliẏe tumi ajñāna brāhmaṇa |*
*ācārya samāna mora bhakta nāhi āna || 96 ||*

*Word for word:* eteka baliye — since you say so; tumi ajnana brahmana — you are an ignorant brahmana; acharya samana — equal to the Acharya; mora bhakta nahi ana — I have no other devotee

**96.** Since you speak so, you are an ignorant brahmana:
I have no other devotee equal to the Acharya.

বৈষ্ণবের রাজা সেই মোর আত্মা বলি ।
জগতের কর্তা তারিবারে আইলা কলি ॥ ৯৭ ॥

*baiṣṇabera rājā sei mora ātmā bali |*
*jagatera kartā tāribāre āilā kali || 97 ||*

*Word for word:* vaishnavera raja sei — He is the king of the Vaishnavas; mora atma bali — I call Him My soul; jagatera karta — the creator of the world; taribare aila kali — has come to deliver Kali

**97.** He is the king of the Vaishnavas, I call Him My own soul;
the creator of the world has come to deliver [the people of] Kali.

শাস্ত্রে মহাবিষ্ণু বলি' করে নিরূপণ ।
সে জন অদ্বৈত ভক্ত-অবতার জান ॥ ৯৮ ॥

*śāstre mahābiṣṇu bali' kare nirūpaṇa |*
*se jana adbaita bhakta-abatāra jāna || 98 ||*

*Word for word:* shastre — the shastras; mahavishnu bali — as Maha-Vishnu; kare nirupana — describe; se jana advaita — that Advaita; bhakta-avatara jana — know as the avatara in the form of a devotee

**98.** The shastras describe Him as Maha-Vishnu;
know that this Advaita is the avatara in the form of a devotee.

এতেক কহিয়ে আমি সুদৃঢ় বচন ।
আচার্যের স্তুতি ভক্তি কর সর্বক্ষণ ॥ ৯৯ ॥

*eteka kahiẏe āmi sudṛṛha bacana |*
*ācāryera stuti bhakti kara sarbakṣaṇa || 99 ||*

*Word for word:* eteka kahiye ami — therefore I say; sudridha bachana — firm words; acharyera stuti bhakti — praise of and devotion to the Acharya; kara sarvakshana — show always

**99.** Therefore I tell you firmly:
always glorify the Acharya and be devoted to Him"[^27-8].

এ বোল শুনিঞা বিপ্র অন্তরে তরাস ।
নিঃশবদে রহে বিপ্র মুখে নাহি ভাষ ॥ ১০০ ॥

*e bola śuniñā bipra antare tarāsa |*
*niḥśabade rahe bipra mukhe nāhi bhāṣa || 100 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shunina — hearing this; vipra antare tarasa — the brahmana was frightened at heart; nihshabade rahe vipra — the brahmana fell silent; mukhe nahi bhasha — no word in his mouth

**100.** Hearing this, the brahmana was frightened at heart;
the brahmana fell silent, unable to utter a word.

তবে সেই গৌরহরি বোলে পুনর্বার ।
অধ্যাত্ম-চরচা তোরা না করিবি আর ॥ ১০১ ॥

*tabe sei gaurahari bole punarbāra |*
*adhyātma-caracā torā nā karibi āra || 101 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe sei gaurahari — then Gaurahari; bole punarbara — says again; adhyatma-characha — speculation about the Self; tora na karibi ara — you will no longer engage in

**101.** Then Gaurahari says again:
"You will no longer speculate about the Self.

যদি বা অধ্যাত্মবাদে দেখি শুনি তোমা ।
তবে পুনঃ তো-সভারে নাহি দিব প্রেমা ॥ ১০২ ॥

*yadi bā adhyātmabāde dekhi śuni tomā |*
*tabe punaḥ to-sabhāre nāhi diba premā || 102 ||*

*Word for word:* yadi ba — if ever; adhyatma-bade — in talk of the Self; dekhi shuni toma — I see or hear you; tabe punah — then again; to-sabhare nahi diba prema — I shall not give you prema

**102.** If I see or hear you speculating about the Self,
I shall no longer give you prema.

জ্ঞান-কর্ম উপেখিলে কৃষ্ণপ্রেমা হয় ।
ইহা জানি' জ্ঞানকর্ম না কর আশ্রয় ॥ ১০৩ ॥

*jñāna-karma upekhile kṛṣṇapremā haẏa |*
*ihā jāni' jñānakarma nā kara āśraẏa || 103 ||*

*Word for word:* jnana-karma upekhile — if one disregards knowledge and karma; krishna-prema haya — love for Krishna comes; iha jani — knowing this; jnana-karma na kara ashraya — do not take refuge in knowledge and karma

**103.** For one who disregards knowledge and karma, love for Krishna comes;
knowing this, do not take refuge in knowledge and karma."

এ বোল শুনিঞা কহে শ্রীবাসপণ্ডিত ।
এই বর দেহ তাহা পাসরউ চিত ॥ ১০৪ ॥

*e bola śuniñā kahe śrībāsapaṇḍita |*
*ei bara deha tāhā pāsarau cita || 104 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shunina — hearing this; kahe shrivasa-pandita — Srivasa Pandita says; ei bara deha — give this boon; taha pasarau chita — may my heart forget it

**104.** Hearing this, Srivasa Pandita says:
"Give me this boon: let my heart forget it."

মুরারি কহিল আমি অধ্যাত্ম না জানি ।
প্রভু কহে কমলাক্ষ হৈতে জান তুমি ॥ ১০৫ ॥

*murāri kahila āmi adhyātma nā jāni |*
*prabhu kahe kamalākṣa haite jāna tumi || 105 ||*

*Word for word:* murari kahila — Murari said; ami adhyatma na jani — I do not know the doctrine of the Self; prabhu kahe — the Lord says; kamalaksha haite — from Kamalaksha; jana tumi — you know it

**105.** Murari said: "I do not know the doctrine of the Self."
The Lord says: "You know it — from Kamalaksha![^27-9]

শুদ্ধচিত্তে কৃষ্ণচন্দ্রে কর দৃঢ় ভক্তি ।
ভক্তিরস-নিকটে চেটিকা হয় মুক্তি ॥ ১০৬ ॥

*śuddhacitte kṛṣṇacandre kara dṛṛha bhakti |*
*bhaktirasa-nikaṭe ceṭikā haẏa mukti || 106 ||*

*Word for word:* shuddha-chitte — with a pure heart; krishnachandre kara dridha bhakti — have firm devotion to Krishnachandra; bhakti-rasa-nikate — before the rasa of bhakti; chetika haya mukti — liberation is a maidservant

**106.** With a pure heart be firmly devoted to Krishnachandra:
before the rasa of bhakti, liberation is a maidservant."

এ বোল শুনিঞা সভে আনন্দিত মন ।
অন্তরে করিল আজ্ঞা করিব পালন ॥ ১০৭ ॥

*e bola śuniñā sabhe ānandita mana |*
*antare karila ājñā kariba pālana || 107 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shunina — hearing these words; sabhe anandita mana — all were glad at heart; antare karila — in their hearts resolved; ajna kariba palana — we shall carry out the order

**107.** Hearing these words, all rejoiced
and in their hearts accepted the order: "We shall carry it out."

হরি-হর-পাদাম্বুজ-মধুমত্ত তারা ।
আনন্দে নাচয়ে তারা দেবতার পারা ॥ ১০৮ ॥

*hari-hara-pādāmbuja-madhumatta tārā |*
*ānande nācaẏe tārā debatāra pārā || 108 ||*

*Word for word:* hari-hara-padambuja — of the lotus feet of Hari-Hara; madhu-matta tara — intoxicated with the honey; anande nachaye tara — they dance in joy; devatara para — like gods

**108.** Intoxicated with the honey of the lotus feet of Hari-Hara,
they dance in joy like gods[^27-10].

হেন অপরূপ কথা নদীয়া-বিহার ।
কহিল লোচন গোরা-প্রেমার প্রচার ॥ ১০৯ ॥

*hena aparūpa kathā nadīẏā-bihāra |*
*kahila locana gorā-premāra pracāra || 109 ||*

*Word for word:* hena aparupa katha — such a wondrous story; nadiya-vihara — of the pastimes in Nadia; kahila lochana — Lochana has told; gora-premara prachara — Gora's preaching of prema

**109.** Such is the wondrous story of the pastimes in Nadia:
Lochana has told how Gora preached prema.

*Raga sindhura*

অরুণ-কমল-আঁখি, তারক ভ্রমর-পাখী,
ডুবুডুবু করুণা-মকরন্দ ।
বদন পূর্ণিমার চান্দে, ছটায় পরাণ কান্দে,
তাহে কত প্রেমার আরম্ভ ॥ ১১০ ॥

*aruṇa-kamala-āṁkhi, tāraka bhramara-pākhī,*
*ḍubuḍubu karuṇā-makaranda |*
*badana pūrṇimāra cānde, chaṭāẏa parāṇa kānde,*
*tāhe kata premāra ārambha || 110 ||*

*Word for word:* aruna-kamala-ankhi — eyes like red lotuses; taraka bhramara-pakhi — the pupils are bees; dubudubu karuna-makaranda — drowning in the nectar of compassion; badana purnimara chande — the face a full moon; chhataya parana kande — at its radiance the heart weeps; tahe kata premara arambha — how many beginnings of prema in it

**110.** His eyes are red lotuses, the pupils bees
drowning in the nectar of compassion.
His face is the full moon: at its radiance the heart weeps;
how many beginnings of prema are in it!

*Refrain: "The town of Nadia rejoices: swaying under the weight of prema, the moon, Shachi's darling, dances. They cry 'Jaya, jaya!' and auspicious words; seeing Him, all are amazed — the King of dancers, the enchanter of Madana!"*

পুলক ভরিল গায়, ঘর্ম বিন্দু-বিন্দু তায়,
লোমচক্রে সোনার কদম্ব ।
প্রেমার আরম্ভে তনু, যেন প্রাতঃকালের ভানু,
আধবাণী রাখে কম্বুকণ্ঠ ॥ ১১১ ॥

*pulaka bharila gāẏa, gharma bindu-bindu tāẏa,*
*lomacakre sonāra kadamba |*
*premāra ārambhe tanu, yena prātaḥkālera bhānu,*
*ādhabāṇī rākhe kambukaṇṭha || 111 ||*

*Word for word:* pulaka bharila gaya — the body full of thrill; gharma bindu-bindu taya — drops of sweat on it; loma-chakre sonara kadamba — the bristling hairs a golden kadamba; premara arambhe tanu — at the onset of prema the body; yena pratah-kalera bhanu — like the morning sun; adha-vani rakhe kambu-kantha — the conch-throat holds back half-words

**111.** His body is full of thrill, with drops of sweat upon it;
the hairs on end — like a golden kadamba.
At the onset of prema His body is like the morning sun;
His conch-like throat holds back half-spoken words.

শ্রীপাদপদুম-গন্ধে, বেড়ি' দশ নখ-চান্দে,
উপরে কনক-বঙ্ক রাজে ।
যখন ভাতিয়া চলে, বিজুরী ঝলমল করে,
চমকিত অমর-সমাজে ॥ ১১২ ॥

*śrīpādapaduma-gandhe, beṛi' daśa nakha-cānde,*
*upare kanaka-baṅka rāje |*
*yakhana bhātiẏā cale, bijurī jhalamala kare,*
*camakita amara-samāje || 112 ||*

*Word for word:* shri-pada-paduma-gandhe — in the fragrance of the lotus feet; bedi dasha nakha-chande — ringed by ten nail-moons; upare kanaka-banka raje — above shine golden anklets; yakhana bhatiya chale — when He walks shining; bijuri jhalamala kare — lightning flashes; chamakita amara-samaje — the assembly of gods is astonished

**112.** In the fragrance of His lotus feet, ringed by ten moons of nails,
above them shine golden anklets.
When He walks, shining, lightning flashes;
the assembly of the gods is astonished.

সপ্তদ্বীপা মহী-মাঝে, তাহে নবদ্বীপ সাজে,
তাহে নব প্রেমার প্রকাশ ।
তাহে নব গৌরহরি, হরি-গুণকীর্তন করি',
আনন্দিত এ ভূমি-আকাশ ॥ ১১৩ ॥

*saptadbīpā mahī-mājhe, tāhe nabadbīpa sāje,*
*tāhe naba premāra prakāśa |*
*tāhe naba gaurahari, hari-guṇakīrtana kari',*
*ānandita e bhūmi-ākāśa || 113 ||*

*Word for word:* saptadvipa mahi-majhe — in the midst of the earth of seven continents; tahe navadvipa saje — Navadvipa is adorned; tahe nava premara prakasha — in it a new manifestation of prema; tahe nava gaurahari — there the new Gaurahari; hari-guna-kirtana kari — singing Hari's qualities; anandita e bhumi-akasha — earth and sky rejoice

**113.** In the midst of the earth of seven continents Navadvipa is adorned,
and in it a new manifestation of prema;
there the new Gaurahari sings the kirtana of Hari's qualities —
earth and sky rejoice.

সিংহের শাবক যেন, গম্ভীর গর্জন ঘন,
হুঙ্কার-হিল্লোল প্রেম-সিন্ধু ।
হরিহরি-বোল বোলে, জগত পড়িল ভোলে,
দু-কূল খাইল কুলবধূ ॥ ১১৪ ॥

*siṃhera śābaka yena, gambhīra garjana ghana,*
*huṅkāra-hillola prema-sindhu |*
*harihari-bola bole, jagata paṛila bhole,*
*du-kūla khāila kulabadhū || 114 ||*

*Word for word:* simhera shabaka yena — like a lion cub; gambhira garjana ghana — roaring deeply again and again; hunkara-hillola prema-sindhu — "hum!", the waves of the ocean of prema; hari-hari-bola bole — He cries "Hari, Hari!"; jagata padila bhole — the world fell into rapture; du-kula khaila kula-badhu — the wives of noble houses lost both houses

**114.** Like a lion cub, He roars deeply again and again;
"hum!" — the waves of the ocean of prema.
He cries "Hari, Hari!" — and the world fell into rapture,
and the wives of noble houses forgot the honour of both houses[^27-11].

অঙ্গের ছটায় যেন, দিনকর দীপ হেন,
তাহে লীলা-বেশের বিলাস ।
কোটি কুসুমধনু, জিনিঞা বিনোদ তনু,
তাহে করে প্রেমার প্রকাশ ॥ ১১৫ ॥

*aṅgera chaṭāẏa yena, dinakara dīpa hena,*
*tāhe līlā-beśera bilāsa |*
*koṭi kusumadhanu, jiniñā binoda tanu,*
*tāhe kare premāra prakāśa || 115 ||*

*Word for word:* angera chhataya — by the radiance of His body; yena dinakara dipa hena — the sun is like a lamp; tahe lila-beshera vilasa — in it the play of lila and attire; koti kusuma-dhanu — millions of flower-bowed Kamadevas; jinina vinoda tanu — surpassing, the charming body; tahe kare premara prakasha — in it He reveals prema

**115.** By the radiance of His body the sun is like a lamp;
in it is the play of lila and attire.
His charming body surpasses millions of flower-bowed Kamadevas;
in it He reveals prema.

লাখ লাখ পূর্ণিমার চান্দে, জিনিঞা বদন-ছান্দে,
তাহে চারু চন্দন-চন্দ্রিমা ।
নয়ান-অঞ্চল চলে, ঝরি' অমিয়া ঝরে,
জনম-মুগধে পায় প্রেমা ॥ ১১৬ ॥

*lākha lākha pūrṇimāra cānde, jiniñā badana-chānde,*
*tāhe cāru candana-candrimā |*
*naẏāna-añcala cale, jhari' amiẏā jhare,*
*janama-mugadhe pāẏa premā || 116 ||*

*Word for word:* lakha lakha purnimara chande — hundreds of thousands of full moons; jinina badana-chhande — surpassing by the form of His face; tahe charu chandana-chandrima — on it lovely moon-marks of sandal; nayana-anchala chale — when the corners of the eyes move; jhari amiya jhare — nectar streams; janama-mugdhe paya prema — even those deluded from birth obtain prema

**116.** The form of His face surpasses hundreds of thousands of full moons,
and on it are lovely moon-marks of sandal.
When the corners of His eyes move, nectar streams forth:
even those deluded from birth obtain prema.

মাতিল-কুঞ্জর-গতি, ভাবে গরগর অতি,
ক্ষণে হাসে চমকিয়া চায় ।
কামিনী-মোহন বেশ, হেরিয়া ভুলিল দেশ,
মদন-বেদন হেরি' পায় ॥ ১১৭ ॥

*mātila-kuñjara-gati, bhābe garagara ati,*
*kṣaṇe hāse camakiẏā cāẏa |*
*kāminī-mohana beśa, heriẏā bhulila deśa,*
*madana-bedana heri' pāẏa || 117 ||*

*Word for word:* matila-kunjara-gati — the gait of an intoxicated elephant; bhave garagara ati — wholly overwhelmed by bhava; kshane hase — now He laughs; chamakiya chaya — starts and looks around; kamini-mohana besha — an appearance enchanting women; heriya bhulila desha — seeing it, the land lost its head; madana-bedana heri paya — seeing, they feel the pain of love

**117.** His gait is that of an intoxicated elephant, He is wholly in the grip of bhava;
now He laughs, now starts and looks around.
His appearance enchants women; seeing Him, the whole land lost its head,
seeing [Him], they feel the pain of love.

কি দিব উপমা তার, করুণাবিগ্রহ-সার,
হেনরূপে মোর গোরারায় ।
প্রেমায় নদীয়া-লোকে, নাহি নিশি-দিশি তাকে,
আনন্দে লোচনদাসে গায় ॥ ১১৮ ॥

*ki diba upamā tāra, karuṇābigraha-sāra,*
*henarūpe mora gorārāẏa |*
*premāẏa nadīẏā-loke, nāhi niśi-diśi tāke,*
*ānande locanadāse gāẏa || 118 ||*

*Word for word:* ki diba upama tara — what comparison can I give Him; karuna-vigraha-sara — the essence of compassion embodied; hena-rupe mora goraraya — such is my Gora-raya; premaya nadiya-loke — in prema the people of Nadia; nahi nishi-dishi take — know neither night nor day; anande lochanadase gaya — joyfully sings Lochana Dasa

**118.** To what shall I compare Him — the essence of compassion embodied?
Such is my Gora-raya.
In prema the people of Nadia know neither night nor day;
joyfully sings Lochana Dasa.

[^27-1]: Vv. 36–46 (as in Murari, 2.5.20–28) set out the path of knowledge (jnana-yoga) as those seeking liberation understand it; the Lord expounds it in order then to place bhakti above everything (vv. 47–49) and to forbid speculation about the Self (vv. 101–106). In v. 42 the 1983 edition has "without bhakti" instead of "without liberation". According to the teaching of the Gaudiya Vaishnavas (and of Bhaktisiddhanta), Krishna is reached by bhakti alone ("bhaktyaham ekaya grahyah", Bhagavata 11.14.21), and liberation is not a precondition but a by-product of devotion.
[^27-2]: "Knowledge" here is the understanding that Krishna is Bhagavan Himself; it leads to firm faith and to causeless, uninterrupted bhakti (cf. Bhagavata 1.2.7). Cf. Murari 2.5.29–30.
[^27-3]: Cf. the Brahma-samhita (5.29, 5.56) and en/24, note 11. On Lakshmi's longing for the rasa of Vraja see Chaitanya-charitamrita, Madhya 9. Vv. 56–58 — cf. Murari 2.5.30–33.
[^27-4]: Cf. Murari 2.6.1–6. The hater of devotees is perhaps the brahmana Gopala Chapala, struck with leprosy for offending Srivasa (Chaitanya-charitamrita, Adi 17).
[^27-5]: Cf. Murari 2.6.7–9. "To go to the forest" hints at the coming sannyasa.
[^27-6]: According to Gaudiya Vaishnava tradition, the Lord descended in answer to the loud calls (hunkaras) and worship of Advaita, who offered tulasi leaves and Ganga water to the Shalagrama (Chaitanya-charitamrita, Adi 3). Cf. Murari 2.6.10–13.
[^27-7]: The "children" are Advaita's sons (Achyutananda and others) or His disciples. Cf. Murari 2.6.14–15.
[^27-8]: Cf. Murari 2.6.16–22. So too in Gaudiya Vaishnava theology: Advaita is Maha-Vishnu, who has taken the form of a devotee (bhakta-avatara); Chaitanya-charitamrita, Adi 6. Kamalaksha is Advaita's worldly name.
[^27-9]: That is, "you heard it from Advaita". According to the Chaitanya-bhagavata (Madhya 19), Advaita for a time deliberately preached the doctrine of the Self (the Yoga-vasishtha) so as to provoke the Lord's punishment. Cf. Murari 2.6.23–26.
[^27-10]: "Hari-Hara" — so also in Murari (2.6.27); probably Hari is Gaura, and Hara is Advaita, revered as one with Sadashiva.
[^27-11]: That is, they cast aside the honour of both their fathers' and their husbands' houses — an image from the songs of the gopis; cf. Lochana Dasa's "nagari-bhava" (en/09, note 9).

---

# Madhya-khanda, part 5 (portion 28)

*The section "Meeting Nityananda": the name of Srivasa; Murari's Raghuvira-ashtaka and the name "Ramadasa"; service to Srivasa is worship of the Lord; the search for Nityananda and the meeting in the house of Nandana Acharya; the glory of Nityananda; Shachi accepts Nityananda as her son; in Srivasa's house the Lord reveals to Nityananda His six-armed, four-armed and two-armed forms*

## Meeting Nityananda

> *Summary by Srila Bhaktisiddhanta Sarasvati.* One day Sriman Mahaprabhu asked Srivasa Pandita the meaning of his name and Himself revealed its sense: "Srivasa is the abode (avasa) of devotion (shri)." Then, when at the Lord's command Murari recited the Raghuvira-ashtaka, Sriman Mahaprabhu wrote the name "Ramadasa" on his forehead and showed him the form of Rama whom he worshipped. Having instructed Sri Rama Pandita to serve his brother Srivasa, a supreme devotee (parama-bhagavata), Sriman Mahaprabhu sent the devotees to look for Sriman Nityananda Prabhu. [Learning] that Sriman Nityananda Prabhu was staying in the house of Nandana Acharya, Mahaprabhu came there with His associates and met Him; before everyone He glorified the greatness of Nityananda Prabhu and [explained] the way to prema-bhakti for Krishna. When Sriman Nityananda Prabhu was taking His meal in the house of Srivasa Pandita, Sriman Mahaprabhu revealed to Him His six-armed, four-armed and two-armed forms[^28-1].

*Raga — any (yatha-raga); disha: "Ah, my life — Gorachand!"*

তবে নিজঘরে প্রভু বসি' দিব্যাসনে ।
চৌদিগে বেঢ়িয়া আছে নিজভক্তজনে ॥ ১ ॥

*tabe nijaghare prabhu basi' dibyāsane |*
*caudige beṛhiẏā āche nijabhaktajane || 1 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe — then; nija-ghare — in His own house; prabhu — the Lord; basi — sitting; divya-asane — on a divine seat; chaudige — all around; bedhiya achhe — are surrounding; nija-bhakta-jane — His own devotees

**1.** Then the Lord was sitting at home on a divine seat,
and around Him were His devotees.

শ্রীবাস দেখিয়া প্রভু কৈল এক উক্তি ।
তোমার নামের তুমি কি জান ব্যুৎপত্তি ॥ ২ ॥

*śrībāsa dekhiẏā prabhu kaila eka ukti |*
*tomāra nāmera tumi ki jāna byutpatti || 2 ||*

*Word for word:* shrivasa dekhiya — seeing Srivasa; prabhu kaila eka ukti — the Lord made a remark; tomara namera — of your name; tumi ki jana — do you know; vyutpatti — the derivation

**2.** Seeing Srivasa, the Lord said:
"Do you know how your name is formed?

শ্রী-ভকতির তুমি কেবল আবাস ।
এতেক বলিয়ে তোর নাম সে শ্রীবাস ॥ ৩ ॥

*śrī-bhakatira tumi kebala ābāsa |*
*eteka baliẏe tora nāma se śrībāsa || 3 ||*

*Word for word:* shri-bhakatira — of Shri, that is, of devotion; tumi kevala avasa — you are the very abode; eteka baliye — therefore I say; tora nama se shrivasa — your name is Srivasa

**3.** You are the very abode (avasa) of Shri — of devotion;
that is why I say: your name is Srivasa."[^28-2]

তবে ত কহিল প্রভু দেখি' গোপীনাথ ।
আমার ভকত তুমি বুল মোর সাথ ॥ ৪ ॥

*tabe ta kahila prabhu dekhi' gopīnātha |*
*āmāra bhakata tumi bula mora sātha || 4 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe ta kahila prabhu — then the Lord said; dekhi gopinatha — seeing Gopinatha; amara bhakata tumi — you are My devotee; bula mora satha — go about with Me

**4.** Then, seeing Gopinatha, the Lord said:
"You are My devotee — go about with Me."[^28-3]

মুরারি দেখিয়া প্রভু বোলে পুনর্বার ।
পঢ়হ আপন শ্লোক শুনিব তোমার ॥ ৫ ॥

*murāri dekhiẏā prabhu bole punarbāra |*
*paṛhaha āpana śloka śuniba tomāra || 5 ||*

*Word for word:* murari dekhiya — seeing Murari; prabhu bole punarvara — the Lord says again; padhaha apana shloka — recite your own verses; shuniba tomara — I shall hear you

**5.** Seeing Murari, the Lord says again:
"Recite your verses — I shall listen to you."

এ বোল শুনিঞা সেই মুরারি চতুর ।
পঢ়য়ে কবিত্ব নিজ শুনয়ে ঠাকুর ॥ ৬ ॥

*e bola śuniñā sei murāri catura |*
*paṛhaẏe kabitba nija śunaẏe ṭhākura || 6 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuninya — hearing these words; sei murari chatura — that skilful Murari; padhaye kavitva nija — recites his own poetry; shunaye thakura — the Thakura listens

**6.** Hearing these words, the skilful Murari
recites his own poetry, and the Thakura listens.

*So in the Sri Chaitanya-charita composed by Sri Murari Gupta, second prakrama, seventh sarga:*

রাজৎকিরীটমণিদীধিতিদীপিতাশম্
উদ্যদ্বৃহস্পতিকবিপ্রতিমে বহন্তম্ ।
দ্বে কুণ্ডলেঽঙ্করহিতেন্দুসমানবক্ত্রং
রামং জগত্ত্রয়গুরুং সততং ভজামি ॥ ৭ ॥

*rājatkirīṭamaṇidīdhitidīpitāśam*
*udyadbṛhaspatikabipratime bahantam |*
*dbe kuṇḍale'ṅkarahitendusamānabaktraṃ*
*rāmaṃ jagattraẏaguruṃ satataṃ bhajāmi || 7 ||*

*Word for word:* rajat-kirita-mani-didhiti-dipita-asham — who lights up the quarters with the rays of the gems of His gleaming crown; udyat-brihaspati-kavi-pratime — resembling the rising Brihaspati and Kavi; dve kundale — two earrings; vahantam — wearing; anka-rahita-indu-samana-vaktram — whose face is like a spotless moon; ramam — Rama; jagat-traya-gurum — the teacher of the three worlds; satatam — ever; bhajami — I worship

**7.** "The rays of the gems of His gleaming crown light up the quarters; He wears earrings like the rising Brihaspati and Kavi; His face is like a spotless moon. Rama, the teacher of the three worlds, I worship ever.

উদ্যদ্বিভাকরমরীচিবিবোধিতাব্জ-
নেত্রং সুবিম্বদশনচ্ছদচারুনাসম্ ।
শুভ্রাংশুরশ্মিপরিনির্জিতচারুহাসং
রামং জগত্ত্রয়গুরুং সততং ভজামি ॥ ৮ ॥

*udyadbibhākaramarīcibibodhitābja-*
*netraṃ subimbadaśanacchadacārunāsam |*
*śubhrāṃśuraśmiparinirjitacāruhāsaṃ*
*rāmaṃ jagattraẏaguruṃ satataṃ bhajāmi || 8 ||*

*Word for word:* udyat-vibhakara-marichi-vibodhita-abja-netram — with eyes like lotuses awakened by the rays of the rising sun; su-bimba-dashana-chchhada-charu-nasam — with lips like ripe bimba fruit and a lovely nose; shubhramshu-rashmi-parinirjita-charu-hasam — whose lovely smile outshines the moonbeams; ramam — Rama; jagat-traya-gurum — the teacher of the three worlds; satatam bhajami — I ever worship

**8.** His eyes are like lotuses awakened by the rays of the rising sun; His lips are like ripe bimba fruit, His nose is lovely; His charming smile outshines the moonbeams. Rama, the teacher of the three worlds, I worship ever."[^28-4]

এইমতে রঘুবীরাষ্টক শ্লোক শুনি' ।
মুরারি-মস্তকে পদ দিল ত আপনি ॥ ৯ ॥

*eimate raghubīrāṣṭaka śloka śuni' |*
*murāri-mastake pada dila ta āpani || 9 ||*

*Word for word:* eimate — thus; raghuviraashtaka shloka shuni — hearing the verses of the Raghuvira-ashtaka; murari-mastake — on Murari's head; pada dila ta apani — Himself placed His foot

**9.** Having thus heard the verses of the Raghuvira-ashtaka,
[the Lord] Himself placed His foot on Murari's head.

'রামদাস' বলি' নাম লিখিলা কপালে ।
মোর পরসাদে তুমি 'রামদাস' হৈলে ॥ ১০ ॥

*'rāmadāsa' bali' nāma likhilā kapāle |*
*mora parasāde tumi 'rāmadāsa' haile || 10 ||*

*Word for word:* ramadasa bali — saying "Ramadasa"; nama likhila kapale — wrote the name on his forehead; mora parasade — by My grace; tumi ramadasa haile — you have become Ramadasa

**10.** He wrote the name "Ramadasa" on his forehead:
"By My grace you have become Ramadasa.

রঘুনাথ বিনে তুমি তিলেক না জীয় ।
মুঞি তোর রঘুনাথ জানিহ নিশ্চয় ॥ ১১ ॥

*raghunātha bine tumi tileka nā jīẏa |*
*muñi tora raghunātha jāniha niścaẏa || 11 ||*

*Word for word:* raghunatha vine — without Raghunatha; tumi tileka na jiya — you do not live even a moment; munyi tora raghunatha — I am your Raghunatha; janiha nishchaya — know for certain

**11.** Without Raghunatha you do not live even a moment;
know for certain: I am your Raghunatha."[^28-5]

ইহা বলি' রামরূপ দেখাইল তারে ।
জানকী-সহিত সাঙ্গোপাঙ্গ সব মেলে ॥ ১২ ॥

*ihā bali' rāmarūpa dekhāila tāre |*
*jānakī-sahita sāṅgopāṅga saba mele || 12 ||*

*Word for word:* iha bali — saying this; rama-rupa dekhaila tare — showed him the form of Rama; janaki-sahita — together with Janaki (Sita); sangopanga saba mele — with all His associates and attendants

**12.** Saying this, He showed him the form of Rama —
with Janaki, with all His associates and attendants.

স্তব করে মুরারি পড়িয়া পদতলে ।
জয় জয় রঘুবীর শচীর কোঙরে ॥ ১৩ ॥

*staba kare murāri paṛiẏā padatale |*
*jaẏa jaẏa raghubīra śacīra koṅare || 13 ||*

*Word for word:* stava kare murari — Murari offers praise; padiya padatale — falling at His feet; jaya jaya raghuvira — glory, glory to Raghuvira; shachira kongare — to Shachi's son

**13.** Falling at His feet, Murari offers praise:
"Glory, glory to Raghuvira, the son of Shachi!"

বারবার উঠে পড়ে লোটাঞা ধরণী ।
বহুবিধ স্তব করে অনুনয়-বাণী ॥ ১৪ ॥

*bārabāra uṭhe paṛe loṭāñā dharaṇī |*
*bahubidha staba kare anunaẏa-bāṇī || 14 ||*

*Word for word:* barabara uthe pade — again and again rises and falls; lotanya dharani — rolling on the ground; bahuvidha stava kare — offers many kinds of praise; anunaya-vani — humble entreaties

**14.** Again and again he rises and falls, rolling on the ground,
offering many kinds of praise and humble entreaties.

মুরারিকে কৃপা করি' বলিলা বচন ।
আমার ভকতি বিনু না জানিহ আন ॥ ১৫ ॥

*murārike kṛpā kari' balilā bacana |*
*āmāra bhakati binu nā jāniha āna || 15 ||*

*Word for word:* murarike — to Murari; kripa kari — mercifully; balila bachana — spoke words; amara bhakati vinu — apart from devotion to Me; na janiha ana — know nothing else

**15.** The Lord mercifully said to Murari:
"Know nothing but devotion to Me.

যদি তোর ইষ্ট আমি হই রঘুনাথ ।
তথাপিহ রস আস্বাদিহ রাধানাথ ॥ ১৬ ॥

*yadi tora iṣṭa āmi hai raghunātha |*
*tathāpiha rasa āsbādiha rādhānātha || 16 ||*

*Word for word:* yadi tora ishta ami hai raghunatha — though your chosen Deity is I, Raghunatha; tathapiha — still; rasa asvadiha — taste the rasa; radhanatha — of the Lord of Radha

**16.** Though your chosen Deity is I, Raghunatha,
still, taste the rasa of the Lord of Radha.

সংকীর্তন-ধর্মে রাধাকৃষ্ণ গাও যাইয়া ।
করিবে আমাতে ভক্তি শুন মন দিয়া ॥ ১৭ ॥

*saṃkīrtana-dharme rādhākṛṣṇa gāo yāiẏā |*
*karibe āmāte bhakti śuna mana diẏā || 17 ||*

*Word for word:* sankirtana-dharme — by the dharma of sankirtana; radhakrishna gao yaiya — go and sing of Radha and Krishna; karibe amate bhakti — you will render devotion to Me; shuna mana diya — listen attentively

**17.** Go and sing of Radha and Krishna, following the dharma of sankirtana —
thus you will render devotion to Me; listen attentively."[^28-6]

ইহা বলি' শ্লোক এক পঢ়িলেক নিজ ।
মোর এক শ্লোক শুন শ্রীনিবাস দ্বিজ ॥ ১৮ ॥

*ihā bali' śloka eka paṛhileka nija |*
*mora eka śloka śuna śrīnibāsa dbija || 18 ||*

*Word for word:* iha bali — saying this; shloka eka padhileka nija — Himself recited a verse; mora eka shloka — one verse of Mine; shuna shrinivasa dvija — hear, brahmana Srinivasa

**18.** Saying this, He Himself recited a verse:
"Hear one verse of Mine, brahmana Srinivasa."

*So [in the Srimad-Bhagavata (11.14.20)]:*

ন সাধয়তি মাং যোগো ন সাংখ্যং ধর্ম উদ্ধব ।
ন স্বাধ্যায়স্তপস্ত্যাগো যথা ভক্তির্মমোর্জিতা ॥ ১৯ ॥

*na sādhaẏati māṃ yogo na sāṃkhyaṃ dharma uddhaba |*
*na sbādhyāẏastapastyāgo yathā bhaktirmamorjitā || 19 ||*

*Word for word:* na sadhayati mam — do not win Me over; yogah — yoga; na sankhyam — nor Sankhya; dharmah — dharma; uddhava — O Uddhava; na svadhyayah — nor Vedic study; tapah — austerity; tyagah — renunciation; yatha — as; bhaktih mama urjita — mighty devotion to Me

**19.** "Neither yoga nor Sankhya nor dharma, O Uddhava, neither Vedic study nor austerity nor renunciation win Me over as does mighty devotion to Me."

পঢ়িয়া কহিল শুন সব নিজজন ।
তোমরা করিহ এইমত আচরণ ॥ ২০ ॥

*paṛhiẏā kahila śuna saba nijajana |*
*tomarā kariha eimata ācaraṇa || 20 ||*

*Word for word:* padhiya kahila — having recited, He said; shuna saba nijajana — hear, all My own; tomara kariha — you should practise; eimata acharana — such conduct

**20.** Having recited it, He said: "Hear, all My own:
act in this way.

শ্রীনিবাস-পণ্ডিতের কথা অনুসরি' ।
করিহ আমাতে ভক্তি সুখ পাবে বড় ॥ ২১ ॥

*śrīnibāsa-paṇḍitera kathā anusari' |*
*kariha āmāte bhakti sukha pābe baṛa || 21 ||*

*Word for word:* shrinivasa-panditera katha anusari — following the words of Srinivasa Pandita; kariha amate bhakti — render devotion to Me; sukha pabe bada — you will find great happiness

**21.** Following the words of Srinivasa Pandita,
render devotion to Me — you will find great happiness.

শ্রীরাম-পণ্ডিত শুন আমার বচন ।
তোমার জ্যেষ্ঠের সেবা আমার অর্চন ॥ ২২ ॥

*śrīrāma-paṇḍita śuna āmāra bacana |*
*tomāra jyeṣṭhera sebā āmāra arcana || 22 ||*

*Word for word:* shrirama-pandita — Sri Rama Pandita; shuna amara bachana — hear My words; tomara jyeshthera seva — service to your elder brother; amara archana — is worship of Me

**22.** Sri Rama Pandita, hear My words:
service to your elder brother is worship of Me.

এতেক জানিঞা কর শ্রীবাসের সেবা ।
ইহা হৈতে পাবে তুমি মোর পদ-প্রভা ॥ ২৩ ॥

*eteka jāniñā kara śrībāsera sebā |*
*ihā haite pābe tumi mora pada-prabhā || 23 ||*

*Word for word:* eteka janinya — knowing this; kara shrivasera seva — serve Srivasa; iha haite — through this; pabe tumi — you will attain; mora pada-prabha — the radiance of My feet

**23.** Knowing this, serve Srivasa:
through this you will attain the radiance of My feet."[^28-7]

এতেক কহিল প্রভু ভকতবৎসল ।
করুণ-অরুণ আঁখি করে ছলছল ॥ ২৪ ॥

*eteka kahila prabhu bhakatabatsala |*
*karuṇa-aruṇa āṁkhi kare chalachala || 24 ||*

*Word for word:* eteka kahila — thus spoke; prabhu bhakatavatsala — the Lord, affectionate to His devotees; karuna-aruna ankhi — His eyes, reddened with compassion; kare chhalachhala — brim with tears

**24.** So spoke the Lord, affectionate to His devotees;
His eyes, reddened with compassion, brimmed with tears.

তবে সেই শ্রীনিবাস-পণ্ডিত চতুর ।
নিবেদন কৈল দুগ্ধ ভুঞ্জয়ে ঠাকুর ॥ ২৫ ॥

*tabe sei śrīnibāsa-paṇḍita catura |*
*nibedana kaila dugdha bhuñjaẏe ṭhākura || 25 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe — then; sei shrinivasa-pandita chatura — the skilful Srinivasa Pandita; nivedana kaila dugdha — offered milk; bhunjaye thakura — the Thakura partakes

**25.** Then the skilful Srinivasa Pandita
offered milk, and the Thakura partakes of it.

গন্ধ চন্দন মালা সুবাসিত পূগ ।
ধূপ দীপ নিবেদন করিল সম্মুখ ॥ ২৬ ॥

*gandha candana mālā subāsita pūga |*
*dhūpa dīpa nibedana karila sammukha || 26 ||*

*Word for word:* gandha chandana mala — scents, sandal, garlands; suvasita puga — fragrant betel nut; dhupa dipa — incense and lamps; nivedana karila sammukha — offered before Him

**26.** Scents, sandal, garlands, fragrant betel,
incense and lamps he offered before Him.

গ্রহণ করিল প্রভু আনন্দিত মনে ।
অবশেষ দিল যত নিজভক্তজনে ॥ ২৭ ॥

*grahaṇa karila prabhu ānandita mane |*
*abaśeṣa dila yata nijabhaktajane || 27 ||*

*Word for word:* grahana karila prabhu — the Lord accepted; anandita mane — with a joyful heart; avashesha dila — gave the remnants; yata nija-bhakta-jane — to all His devotees

**27.** The Lord joyfully accepted [the offerings]
and gave the remnants to all His devotees.[^28-8]

এইমতে কৌতুকে সকল নিশা গেল ।
প্রভাতে উঠিয়া প্রভু ঘরেরে চলিল ॥ ২৮ ॥

*eimate kautuke sakala niśā gela |*
*prabhāte uṭhiẏā prabhu gharere calila || 28 ||*

*Word for word:* eimate — thus; kautuke — in joyous play; sakala nisha gela — the whole night passed; prabhate uthiya — rising at dawn; prabhu gharere chalila — the Lord went home

**28.** Thus in joyous play the whole night passed;
at dawn the Lord rose and went home.

স্নান-দেবার্চনা সভে কৈলা নিজঘরে ।
পুনরপি গেলা পাদাম্বুজ দেখিবারে ॥ ২৯ ॥

*snāna-debārcanā sabhe kailā nijaghare |*
*punarapi gelā pādāmbuja dekhibāre || 29 ||*

*Word for word:* snana-devarchana — bathing and worship of the Deity; sabhe kaila nijaghare — all performed in their own homes; punarapi gela — again they went; padambuja dekhibare — to see [His] lotus feet

**29.** All performed their bathing and worship of the Deity in their own homes
and came again to see His lotus feet.

হাসিয়া কহিল প্রভু শুন অদ্ভুত ।
আইলা শ্রীপাদ নিত্যানন্দ অবধূত ॥ ৩০ ॥

*hāsiẏā kahila prabhu śuna adbhuta |*
*āilā śrīpāda nityānanda abadhūta || 30 ||*

*Word for word:* hasiya kahila prabhu — laughing, the Lord said; shuna adbhuta — hear a wonder; aila shripada — Shripada has come; nityananda avadhuta — Nityananda the Avadhuta

**30.** Laughing, the Lord said: "Hear a wonderful thing:
Shripada Nityananda Avadhuta has come!

তাঁহার মহিমা-তত্ত্ব কে কহিতে জানে ।
বড় পুণ্য-ভাগ্যে আজি দেখিব চরণে ॥ ৩১ ॥

*tāṁhāra mahimā-tattba ke kahite jāne |*
*baṛa puṇya-bhāgye āji dekhiba caraṇe || 31 ||*

*Word for word:* tanhara mahima-tattva — the truth of His glory; ke kahite jane — who knows how to tell; bada punya-bhagye — by great merit and fortune; aji dekhiba charane — today I shall see [His] feet

**31.** Who knows how to tell the truth of His glory?
By great merit and fortune I shall see His feet today.

হের রাম নারায়ণ মুরারি মুকুন্দ ।
সত্বরে জানহ কোথা আছে নিত্যানন্দ ॥ ৩২ ॥

*hera rāma nārāẏaṇa murāri mukunda |*
*satbare jānaha kothā āche nityānanda || 32 ||*

*Word for word:* hera — ho; rama narayana murari mukunda — Rama, Narayana, Murari, Mukunda; satvare janaha — quickly find out; kotha achhe nityananda — where Nityananda is

**32.** Ho, Rama, Narayana, Murari, Mukunda,
quickly find out where Nityananda is."[^28-9]

হেনরূপে মহাপ্রভু আজ্ঞা যবে কৈল ।
সত্বরে চলিয়া গ্রাম-দক্ষিণে চাহিল ॥ ৩৩ ॥

*henarūpe mahāprabhu ājñā yabe kaila |*
*satbare caliẏā grāma-dakṣiṇe cāhila || 33 ||*

*Word for word:* henarupe — thus; mahaprabhu ajna yabe kaila — when Mahaprabhu gave the order; satvare chaliya — going quickly; grama-dakshine chahila — they searched south of the village

**33.** When Mahaprabhu gave this order,
they set off at once and searched south of the village.

বিচার করিয়া লাগ না পাইল তার ।
পাদাম্বুজ-সন্নিকটে আইলা আরবার ॥ ৩৪ ॥

*bicāra kariẏā lāga nā pāila tāra |*
*pādāmbuja-sannikaṭe āilā ārabāra || 34 ||*

*Word for word:* vichara kariya — having searched; laga na paila tara — they found no trace of Him; padambuja-sannikate — near the lotus feet; aila aravara — they came back

**34.** They searched but found no trace of Him
and came back again to His lotus feet.

করজোড় করি' কহে ঠাকুরের আগে ।
বিচার করিয়া প্রভু না পাইল লাগে ॥ ৩৫ ॥

*karajoṛa kari' kahe ṭhākurera āge |*
*bicāra kariẏā prabhu nā pāila lāge || 35 ||*

*Word for word:* karajoda kari — with joined palms; kahe thakurera age — they say before the Thakura; vichara kariya — having searched; prabhu — O Lord; na paila lage — we found no trace

**35.** With joined palms they say before the Thakura:
"Lord, we searched but found no trace of Him."

পুনরপি কহে প্রভু শুন সর্বজন ।
বিচার করহ সভে আপন-আশ্রম ॥ ৩৬ ॥

*punarapi kahe prabhu śuna sarbajana |*
*bicāra karaha sabhe āpana-āśrama || 36 ||*

*Word for word:* punarapi kahe prabhu — again the Lord says; shuna sarvajana — hear, all; vichara karaha sabhe — all of you consider (go); apana-ashrama — [to] your own dwelling

**36.** Again the Lord says: "Hear, all of you:
now go, each of you, to your own dwelling."[^28-10]

প্রভুর আজ্ঞায় সভে চলিলা সত্বর ।
একে একে সভে গেলা আপনার ঘর ॥ ৩৭ ॥

*prabhura ājñāẏa sabhe calilā satbara |*
*eke eke sabhe gelā āpanāra ghara || 37 ||*

*Word for word:* prabhura ajnaya — at the Lord's command; sabhe chalila satvara — all set off at once; eke eke — one by one; sabhe gela apanara ghara — all went to their own homes

**37.** At the Lord's command all set off at once
and one by one went to their own homes.

সন্ধ্যাকালে সন্ধ্যা করি' একত্র হইয়া ।
প্রভু-বিদ্যমানে সভে মিলিলা আসিয়া ॥ ৩৮ ॥

*sandhyākāle sandhyā kari' ekatra haiẏā |*
*prabhu-bidyamāne sabhe mililā āsiẏā || 38 ||*

*Word for word:* sandhya-kale — in the evening; sandhya kari — having performed the evening prayers; ekatra haiya — gathering together; prabhu-vidyamane — into the Lord's presence; sabhe milila asiya — all came and assembled

**38.** In the evening, having performed the evening prayers, they gathered together
and all came together to the Lord.

পথে যাইতে 'মুরারি' বলিয়া ডাকে পহুঁ ।
না দেখিলে অবধূত বলি' হাসে লহু ॥ ৩৯ ॥

*pathe yāite 'murāri' baliẏā ḍāke pahuṁ |*
*nā dekhile abadhūta bali' hāse lahu || 39 ||*

*Word for word:* pathe yaite — going along the road; murari baliya — saying "Murari!"; dake pahu — the Lord calls; na dekhile avadhuta — you did not see the Avadhuta; bali hase lahu — He says, laughing gently

**39.** Going along the road, the Lord calls: "Murari!" —
"You did not see the Avadhuta," He says, and laughs gently.

নন্দন-আচার্য-ঘরে আছে মহাশয় ।
আমিহ যাইব তথা কহিল নিশ্চয় ॥ ৪০ ॥

*nandana-ācārya-ghare āche mahāśaẏa |*
*āmiha yāiba tathā kahila niścaẏa || 40 ||*

*Word for word:* nandana-acharya-ghare — in the house of Nandana Acharya; achhe mahashaya — the great soul is staying; amiha yaiba tatha — I too shall go there; kahila nishchaya — He said firmly

**40.** "The great soul is staying in the house of Nandana Acharya;
I too shall go there," He said firmly.

এ বোল শুনিঞা সভে হরষিত হঞা ।
চলিলা ঠাকুর-সঙ্গে জয় জয় দিয়া ॥ ৪১ ॥

*e bola śuniñā sabhe haraṣita hañā |*
*calilā ṭhākura-saṅge jaẏa jaẏa diẏā || 41 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuninya — hearing these words; sabhe harashita hanya — all, rejoicing; chalila thakura-sange — went with the Thakura; jaya jaya diya — crying "Jaya, jaya!"

**41.** Hearing these words, all rejoiced
and went with the Thakura, crying: "Jaya, jaya!"

পথে যাইতে ঘন ঘন হরি হরি বোলে ।
গণ্ড পুলকিত কণ্ঠ গদগদ রোলে ॥ ৪২ ॥

*pathe yāite ghana ghana hari hari bole |*
*gaṇḍa pulakita kaṇṭha gadagada role || 42 ||*

*Word for word:* pathe yaite — going along the road; ghana ghana — again and again; hari hari bole — cries "Hari, Hari!"; ganda pulakita — His cheeks thrill; kantha gadagada role — His voice falters

**42.** Going along the road, again and again He cries: "Hari, Hari!";
His cheeks thrill, His voice falters.

নয়নে গলয়ে নীর সাত-পাঁচ-ধারা ।
চলিতে না পারে প্রেমে সোণার কিশোরা ॥ ৪৩ ॥

*naẏane galaẏe nīra sāta-pāṁca-dhārā |*
*calite nā pāre preme soṇāra kiśorā || 43 ||*

*Word for word:* nayane galaye nira — tears stream from His eyes; sata-pancha-dhara — in many streams; chalite na pare — cannot walk; preme — from prema; sonara kishora — the golden Youth

**43.** Tears stream from His eyes in many streams;
from prema the golden Youth cannot walk.

ক্ষণে সিংহ-পরাক্রমে পদ চারি যায় ।
মত্ত করিবর যেন উলটি' না চায় ॥ ৪৪ ॥

*kṣaṇe siṃha-parākrame pada cāri yāẏa |*
*matta karibara yena ulaṭi' nā cāẏa || 44 ||*

*Word for word:* kshane — at moments; simha-parakrame — with a lion's prowess; pada chari yaya — goes four steps; matta karivara yena — like a maddened elephant; ulati na chaya — does not look back

**44.** Now with a lion's prowess He goes four steps —
like a maddened elephant that does not look back;

নব-জলধরে যেন গম্ভীর নিনাদ ।
ঘন ঘন হুহুঙ্কার আনন্দ-উন্মাদ ॥ ৪৫ ॥

*naba-jaladhare yena gambhīra nināda |*
*ghana ghana huhuṅkāra ānanda-unmāda || 45 ||*

*Word for word:* nava-jaladhare yena — as of a new raincloud; gambhira ninada — a deep rumble; ghana ghana huhunkara — again and again the roar "hum!"; ananda-unmada — intoxication of bliss

**45.** now, like the deep rumble of a new raincloud,
again and again He roars "hum!", intoxicated with bliss.

এইমনে আনন্দে সানন্দে চলি' যায় ।
দেখিল ত অবধূত নিত্যানন্দরায় ॥ ৪৬ ॥

*eimane ānande sānande cali' yāẏa |*
*dekhila ta abadhūta nityānandarāẏa || 46 ||*

*Word for word:* eimane — thus; anande sanande — in joy and delight; chali yaya — He goes on; dekhila ta — He saw; avadhuta nityananda-raya — the Avadhuta Nityananda-raya

**46.** So in joy and delight He goes on,
and He saw the Avadhuta Nityananda-raya.

আরক্ত গৌরাঙ্গ-কান্তি পরম সুন্দর ।
ঝলমল অলঙ্কারে অঙ্গ মনোহর ॥ ৪৭ ॥

*ārakta gaurāṅga-kānti parama sundara |*
*jhalamala alaṅkāre aṅga manohara || 47 ||*

*Word for word:* arakta gauranga-kanti — a golden body with a reddish glow; parama sundara — supremely beautiful; jhalamala alankare — with glittering ornaments; anga manohara — His body is enchanting

**47.** His body is golden with a reddish glow, supremely beautiful;
an enchanting body in glittering ornaments.

কটিতটে পীতবাস বিরাজিত শোভা ।
শিরে লটপটি পাগ চম্পকের আভা ॥ ৪৮ ॥

*kaṭitaṭe pītabāsa birājita śobhā |*
*śire laṭapaṭi pāga campakera ābhā || 48 ||*

*Word for word:* katitate — on His hips; pita-vasa — yellow cloth; virajita shobha — shines beautifully; shire — on His head; latapati paga — a loosely tied turban; champakera abha — of champaka hue

**48.** Yellow cloth shines on His hips,
on His head a loosely tied turban of champaka hue.

চলিতে নূপুর পদে ঝনঝনি শুনি ।
কুরঙ্গ-নয়নী-চিত্ত-তরল-সন্ধানী ॥ ৪৯ ॥

*calite nūpura pade jhanajhani śuni |*
*kuraṅga-naẏanī-citta-tarala-sandhānī || 49 ||*

*Word for word:* chalite — as He walks; nupura pade — the anklets on His feet; jhanajhani shuni — are heard jingling; kuranga-nayani-chitta-tarala-sandhani — setting the hearts of doe-eyed women aquiver

**49.** As He walks, the bells on His feet are heard jingling,
setting the hearts of doe-eyed women aquiver.

হাসিতে বিজুরী যেন খসিয়া পড়িছে ।
কামিনী আপন লাজ তাহাতেই দিছে ॥ ৫০ ॥

*hāsite bijurī yena khasiẏā paṛiche |*
*kāminī āpana lāja tāhātei diche || 50 ||*

*Word for word:* hasite — when He laughs; bijuri yena — as if lightning; khasiya padichhe — is falling down; kamini — women; apana laja — their own modesty; tahatei dichhe — give up to it then and there

**50.** When He laughs, it is as if lightning were falling from the sky:
women give up their modesty to it then and there.

মেঘ জিনি' গরজে গম্ভীর শব্দ শুনি ।
কলি-মত্ত-হাথীর দমন সিংহধ্বনি ॥ ৫১ ॥

*megha jini' garaje gambhīra śabda śuni |*
*kali-matta-hāthīra damana siṃhadhbani || 51 ||*

*Word for word:* megha jini — surpassing the clouds; garaje — He thunders; gambhira shabda shuni — a deep sound is heard; kali-matta-hathira — of the maddened elephant of Kali; damana simha-dhvani — a lion's roar that tames

**51.** His roar is heard, deeper than thunder —
a lion's roar that tames the maddened elephant of Kali.

মাতল-কুঞ্জর যেন গমন সুন্দর ।
প্রসন্ন-বদনে প্রেমধারা নিরন্তর ॥ ৫২ ॥

*mātala-kuñjara yena gamana sundara |*
*prasanna-badane premadhārā nirantara || 52 ||*

*Word for word:* matala-kunjara yena — like a maddened elephant's; gamana sundara — a beautiful gait; prasanna-vadane — on His serene face; prema-dhara nirantara — ceaseless streams of prema

**52.** His gait is beautiful, like a maddened elephant's;
on His serene face are ceaseless streams of prema.

পুলকে আকুল তনু প্রেমে ডগমগি ।
কম্প-স্বেদ-আদি ভাবে রস-অনুরাগী ॥ ৫৩ ॥

*pulake ākula tanu preme ḍagamagi |*
*kampa-sbeda-ādi bhābe rasa-anurāgī || 53 ||*

*Word for word:* pulake akula tanu — His body overcome with thrills; preme dagamagi — brimming with prema; kampa-sveda-adi bhave — in the bhavas of trembling, perspiration and others; rasa-anuragi — attached to rasa

**53.** His body is overcome with thrills, brimming with prema;
in the bhavas of trembling, perspiration and others He is attached to rasa.

কলিদর্প-দমন কনক-দণ্ড করে ।
রাতা-উতপল করতল মনোহরে ॥ ৫৪ ॥

*kalidarpa-damana kanaka-daṇḍa kare |*
*rātā-utapala karatala manohare || 54 ||*

*Word for word:* kali-darpa-damana — subduing the pride of Kali; kanaka-danda kare — a golden staff in His hand; rata-utapala — red lotuses; karatala manohare — His charming palms

**54.** In His hand is a golden staff that subdues the pride of Kali;
His charming palms are like red lotuses.

অঙ্গদ কঙ্কণ হার কেয়ূর কিঙ্কিণী ।
গণ্ডযুগে কুণ্ডল যেমন দিনমণি ॥ ৫৫ ॥

*aṅgada kaṅkaṇa hāra keẏūra kiṅkiṇī |*
*gaṇḍayuge kuṇḍala yemana dinamaṇi || 55 ||*

*Word for word:* angada kankana hara keyura kinkini — armlets, bracelets, necklace, upper-arm bands, belt of bells; ganda-yuge kundala — earrings by His cheeks; yemana dina-mani — like the sun

**55.** Armlets, bracelets, necklace, upper-arm bands, a belt of bells;
by His cheeks earrings shine like the sun.[^28-11]

পড়িতে পড়িতে উঠে বলিয়া 'সাম্ভাল' ।
সভাকে পুছয়ে কাহাঁ কানাঞি গোয়াল ॥ ৫৬ ॥

*paṛite paṛite uṭhe baliẏā 'sāmbhāla' |*
*sabhāke puchaẏe kāhāṁ kānāñi goẏāla || 56 ||*

*Word for word:* padite padite — falling again and again; uthe — He rises; baliya sambhala — crying "Steady!"; sabhake puchhaye — asks everyone; kaha kananyi goyala — where is Kanai the cowherd

**56.** Falling again and again, He rises crying: "Steady!"
and asks everyone: "Where is Kanai the cowherd?"

অলৌকিক বাল্যভাবে ক্ষণে কান্দে হাসে ।
'মধু দেহ' বলি' ক্ষণে রেবতী প্রশংসে ॥ ৫৭ ॥

*alaukika bālyabhābe kṣaṇe kānde hāse |*
*'madhu deha' bali' kṣaṇe rebatī praśaṃse || 57 ||*

*Word for word:* alaukika balya-bhave — in an unearthly childlike mood; kshane kande hase — now weeps, now laughs; madhu deha bali — crying "Give honey!"; kshane revati prashamse — now praises Revati

**57.** In an unearthly childlike mood He now weeps, now laughs;
now He cries: "Give Me honey!" — now praises Revati.[^28-12]

ক্ষণে যুগপদ করি' লাফে লাফে যায় ।
এক বোলে আর করে বুঝনে না যায় ॥ ৫৮ ॥

*kṣaṇe yugapada kari' lāphe lāphe yāẏa |*
*eka bole āra kare bujhane nā yāẏa || 58 ||*

*Word for word:* kshane — at times; yugapada kari — with feet together; laphe laphe yaya — goes by leaps; eka bole — says one thing; ara kare — does another; bujhane na yaya — cannot be understood

**58.** Now, with feet together, He goes by leaps;
He says one thing and does another — there is no understanding it.

অঙ্গের সৌরভে যত যুবতীর গণ ।
কুলবতী-মদ তারা ছাড়িলা তখন ॥ ৫৯ ॥

*aṅgera saurabhe yata yubatīra gaṇa |*
*kulabatī-mada tārā chāṛilā takhana || 59 ||*

*Word for word:* angera saurabhe — by the fragrance of His body; yata yuvatira gana — all the young women; kulavati-mada — the pride of noble wives; tara chhadila takhana — they then gave up

**59.** By the fragrance of His body all the young women
then gave up the pride of noble wives.[^28-13]

ভূমিতে পড়িয়া প্রভু পরণাম করে ।
করিল মঙ্গল-স্তুতি মধুর-অক্ষরে ॥ ৬০ ॥

*bhūmite paṛiẏā prabhu paraṇāma kare |*
*karila maṅgala-stuti madhura-akṣare || 60 ||*

*Word for word:* bhumite padiya — falling to the ground; prabhu paranama kare — the Lord bows down; karila mangala-stuti — offered auspicious praise; madhura-akshare — in sweet words

**60.** The Lord, falling to the ground, bowed down to Him
and offered auspicious praise in sweet words.[^28-14]

পড়িলেন প্রভুপদে নিত্যানন্দরায় ।
দোঁহার চরণ ধরিবারে দোঁহে চায় ॥ ৬১ ॥

*paṛilena prabhupade nityānandarāẏa |*
*doṁhāra caraṇa dharibāre doṁhe cāẏa || 61 ||*

*Word for word:* padilena prabhu-pade — fell at the Lord's feet; nityananda-raya — Nityananda-raya; donhara charana — each other's feet; dharibare donhe chaya — both seek to clasp

**61.** Nityananda-raya fell at the Lord's feet:
each seeks to clasp the other's feet.

দোঁহে আলিঙ্গন করে কান্দিয়া কান্দিয়া ।
কতি ছিলা বলি' হাসে মুখ চাহিয়া ॥ ৬২ ॥

*doṁhe āliṅgana kare kāndiẏā kāndiẏā |*
*kati chilā bali' hāse mukha cāhiẏā || 62 ||*

*Word for word:* donhe alingana kare — both embrace; kandiya kandiya — weeping and weeping; kati chhila bali — saying "Where have You been?"; hase mukha chahiya — they laugh, gazing at [each other's] faces

**62.** Both embrace, weeping and weeping,
and, gazing into each other's faces, laugh: "Where have You been?"

সকল অবনী আমি ফিরিয়া আইনু ।
কোথাহ তোমার লাগি মুঞি না পাইনু ॥ ৬৩ ॥

*sakala abanī āmi phiriẏā āinu |*
*kothāha tomāra lāgi muñi nā pāinu || 63 ||*

*Word for word:* sakala avani — the whole earth; ami phiriya ainu — I have wandered through; kothaha — nowhere; tomara lagi — any trace of You; munyi na painu — did I find

**63.** "I have wandered through the whole earth,
but nowhere did I find any trace of You.

শুনিলাম গৌড়দেশে নবদ্বীপপুরে ।
লুকাঞা আছে তথা নন্দের কুমারে ॥ ৬৪ ॥

*śunilāma gauṛadeśe nabadbīpapure |*
*lukāñā āche tathā nandera kumāre || 64 ||*

*Word for word:* shunilama — I heard; gauda-deshe navadvipa-pure — in the land of Gauda, in the town of Navadvipa; lukanya achhe tatha — there is hiding; nandera kumare — the son of Nanda

**64.** I heard that in the land of Gauda, in the town of Navadvipa,
the son of Nanda is hiding.

চোর ধরিবারে মুঞি আইলাম এথা ।
ধরিলাম চোর আজি পলাইবা কোথা ॥ ৬৫ ॥

*cora dharibāre muñi āilāma ethā |*
*dharilāma cora āji palāibā kothā || 65 ||*

*Word for word:* chora dharibare — to catch the thief; munyi ailama etha — I have come here; dharilama chora — I have caught the thief; aji palaiba kotha — where will You flee now

**65.** To catch the thief I have come here —
I have caught the thief! Where will You flee now?"[^28-15]

ইহা বলি' নিত্যানন্দ হাসে কান্দে নাচে ।
গৌরাঙ্গ আনন্দে নাচে নিত্যানন্দ-কাছে ॥ ৬৬ ॥

*ihā bali' nityānanda hāse kānde nāce |*
*gaurāṅga ānande nāce nityānanda-kāche || 66 ||*

*Word for word:* iha bali — saying this; nityananda hase kande nache — Nityananda laughs, weeps, dances; gauranga anande nache — Gauranga dances in joy; nityananda-kachhe — beside Nityananda

**66.** Saying this, Nityananda laughs, weeps and dances,
and Gauranga dances in joy beside Nityananda.

কলিদর্প-দমন পাইনু নিত্যানন্দ ।
তারিনু পতিত পঙ্গু জড় আদি অন্ধ ॥ ৬৭ ॥

*kalidarpa-damana pāinu nityānanda |*
*tārinu patita paṅgu jaṛa ādi andha || 67 ||*

*Word for word:* kali-darpa-damana — the tamer of Kali's pride; painu nityananda — I have found Nityananda; tarinu — I have [as good as] delivered; patita pangu jada adi andha — the fallen, the lame, the dull and the blind

**67.** "I have found Nityananda, the tamer of Kali's pride —
now the fallen, the lame, the dull and the blind are as good as delivered by Me!

নিত্যানন্দ-প্রতাপে পবিত্র ত্রিভুবন ।
না জানে পাষণ্ডী দুরাচার মূঢ় জন ॥ ৬৮ ॥

*nityānanda-pratāpe pabitra tribhubana |*
*nā jāne pāṣaṇḍī durācāra mūṛha jana || 68 ||*

*Word for word:* nityananda-pratape — by the might of Nityananda; pavitra tribhuvana — the three worlds are purified; na jane — they do not know; pashandi durachara mudha jana — the godless, the wicked, the foolish

**68.** By the might of Nityananda the three worlds are purified,
yet the godless, the wicked and the foolish do not know it.

সভাই পড়িবে পাছে নিত্যানন্দ-ফান্দে ।
এই কথা কহিলেন প্রভু গোরাচান্দে ॥ ৬৯ ॥

*sabhāi paṛibe pāche nityānanda-phānde |*
*ei kathā kahilena prabhu gorācānde || 69 ||*

*Word for word:* sabhai — all; padibe pachhe — will later fall; nityananda-phande — into Nityananda's net; ei katha kahilena — thus spoke; prabhu gorachande — the Lord Gorachand

**69.** But they too will all fall later into Nityananda's net" —
so spoke the Lord Gorachand.

ভূমিতে লুটাইয়া প্রভু পরণাম করে ।
কহিল বিনয়-কথা মঙ্গল-অক্ষরে ॥ ৬৯+১ ॥

*bhūmite luṭāiẏā prabhu paraṇāma kare |*
*kahila binaẏa-kathā maṅgala-akṣare || 69+1 ||*

*Word for word:* bhumite lutaiya — prostrating on the ground; prabhu parnama kare — the Lord bows down; kahila vinaya-katha — spoke humble words; mangala-akshare — in auspicious syllables

**69+1.** Prostrating Himself on the ground, the Lord bows down [to Him]
and speaks humble words in auspicious syllables[^28-16].

হরিগুণ-সংকীর্তন করয়ে আনন্দে ।
আপনে নাচয়ে সঙ্গে নাচে নিত্যানন্দে ॥ ৭০ ॥

*hariguṇa-saṃkīrtana karaẏe ānande |*
*āpane nācaẏe saṅge nāce nityānande || 70 ||*

*Word for word:* hari-guna-sankirtana — sankirtana of Hari's qualities; karaye anande — He performs joyfully; apane nachaye — He Himself dances; sange nache nityanande — with Him dances Nityananda

**70.** Joyfully He sings the sankirtana of Hari's qualities:
He Himself dances, and with Him dances Nityananda.

নৃত্য সম্বরিয়া সে বসিলা দুইজনে ।
আনন্দিত সর্বজন দেখয়ে নয়নে ॥ ৭১ ॥

*nṛtya sambariẏā se basilā duijane |*
*ānandita sarbajana dekhaẏe naẏane || 71 ||*

*Word for word:* nritya samvariya — ending the dance; se basila duijane — the two sat down; anandita sarvajana — everyone, delighted; dekhaye nayane — beholds them

**71.** Ending the dance, the two sat down,
and everyone gazed at Them in joy.

তবে নিত্যানন্দ-পদ-অরবিন্দ-ধূলি ।
আপনে আনিঞা দিল ভক্ত-শিরোপরি ॥ ৭২ ॥

*tabe nityānanda-pada-arabinda-dhūli |*
*āpane āniñā dila bhakta-śiropari || 72 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe — then; nityananda-pada-aravinda-dhuli — the dust of Nityananda's lotus feet; apane aninya — Himself taking; dila bhakta-shiropari — He placed on the devotees' heads

**72.** Then [the Lord] Himself took the dust of Nityananda's lotus feet
and placed it on the devotees' heads.

নিত্যানন্দ-পদধূলি পাঞা ভক্তগণ ।
প্রেমে গরগর চিত্ত ঝরয়ে নয়ন ॥ ৭৩ ॥

*nityānanda-padadhūli pāñā bhaktagaṇa |*
*preme garagara citta jharaẏe naẏana || 73 ||*

*Word for word:* nityananda-pada-dhuli panya — receiving the dust of Nityananda's feet; bhaktagana — the devotees; preme garagara chitta — their hearts overflowing with prema; jharaye nayana — their eyes stream

**73.** Receiving the dust of Nityananda's feet, the devotees —
their hearts overflowing with prema, tears streaming from their eyes.

এইমতে কৌতুকে আছিলা কথোক্ষণ ।
ঘরেরে চলিলা প্রভু শচীর নন্দন ॥ ৭৪ ॥

*eimate kautuke āchilā kathokṣaṇa |*
*gharere calilā prabhu śacīra nandana || 74 ||*

*Word for word:* eimate — thus; kautuke — in joy; achhila kathokshana — they stayed a while; gharere chalila — went home; prabhu shachira nandana — the Lord, Shachi's son

**74.** So they stayed there a while in joy,
and the Lord, Shachi's son, went home.

পথে যাইতে কহে নিত্যানন্দের মহিমা ।
ত্রিজগতে দিতে নাঞি ইহার উপমা ॥ ৭৫ ॥

*pathe yāite kahe nityānandera mahimā |*
*trijagate dite nāñi ihāra upamā || 75 ||*

*Word for word:* pathe yaite — going along the road; kahe nityanandera mahima — He tells of Nityananda's glory; trijagate — in the three worlds; dite nanyi ihara upama — there is no comparison to give for Him

**75.** Going along the road, He tells of Nityananda's glory:
"In all the three worlds there is none to compare with Him.

শুন শুন সর্বজন আমার বচন ।
কৃষ্ণ-প্রেমভক্তি এই নহে সাধারণ ॥ ৭৬ ॥

*śuna śuna sarbajana āmāra bacana |*
*kṛṣṇa-premabhakti ei nahe sādhāraṇa || 76 ||*

*Word for word:* shuna shuna sarvajana — hear, hear, all; amara bachana — My words; krishna-prema-bhakti ei — this prema-bhakti for Krishna; nahe sadharana — is not ordinary

**76.** Hear, hear, all of you, My words:
this prema-bhakti of His for Krishna is not ordinary.

আগে জ্ঞান হয় তবে উপজে ভকতি ।
তবে সে জনমে সর্বভোগে বিরকতি ॥ ৭৭ ॥

*āge jñāna haẏa tabe upaje bhakati |*
*tabe se janame sarbabhoge birakati || 77 ||*

*Word for word:* age — first; jnana haya — there is knowledge; tabe upaje bhakati — then devotion arises; tabe se janame — then is born; sarva-bhoge virakati — detachment from all enjoyments

**77.** First there is knowledge, then devotion arises,
and then comes detachment from all enjoyments.

এইমনে ক্রমে ক্রমে বাঢ়ে অনুদিন ।
কৃষ্ণ-অনুরাগ বাঢ়ে হয় পরবীণ ॥ ৭৮ ॥

*eimane krame krame bāṛhe anudina |*
*kṛṣṇa-anurāga bāṛhe haẏa parabīṇa || 78 ||*

*Word for word:* eimane — thus; krame krame — step by step; badhe anudina — it grows day by day; krishna-anuraga badhe — attachment to Krishna grows; haya paravina — one becomes mature

**78.** So step by step it grows day by day;
attachment to Krishna grows, and one becomes mature."[^28-17]

আর দিনে মহাপ্রভু আপনার ঘরে ।
আমন্ত্রণ দিল নিত্যানন্দ ন্যাসিবরে ॥ ৭৯ ॥

*āra dine mahāprabhu āpanāra ghare |*
*āmantraṇa dila nityānanda nyāsibare || 79 ||*

*Word for word:* ara dine — on another day; mahaprabhu apanara ghare — Mahaprabhu, to His own house; amantrana dila — invited; nityananda nyasivare — Nityananda, the best of sannyasis

**79.** On another day Mahaprabhu
invited Nityananda, the best of sannyasis, to His own house.

ভিক্ষা-অনন্তরে অঙ্গে লেপিল চন্দনে ।
দিব্য মালা নিবেদিল পূজার বিধানে ॥ ৮০ ॥

*bhikṣā-anantare aṅge lepila candane |*
*dibya mālā nibedila pūjāra bidhāne || 80 ||*

*Word for word:* bhiksha-anantare — after the meal; ange lepila chandane — anointed His body with sandal; divya mala nivedila — offered a divine garland; pujara vidhane — according to the rules of worship

**80.** After the meal He anointed His body with sandal
and, according to the rules of worship, offered Him a divine garland.[^28-18]

তাঁহার কৌপীন লৈয়া খণ্ড খণ্ড করি' ।
চিরিয়া বান্ধিল প্রভু ভক্ত-শিরোপরি ॥ ৮০+১ ॥

*tāṁhāra kaupīna laiẏā khaṇḍa khaṇḍa kari' |*
*ciriẏā bāndhila prabhu bhakta-śiropari || 80+1 ||*

*Word for word:* tahara kaupina laiya — taking His kaupina; khanda khanda kari — tearing it into pieces; chiriya — rending; bandhila prabhu — the Lord tied; bhakta-shiropari — on the heads of the devotees

**80+1.** Taking His kaupina, the Lord tore it into pieces
