and tied [them] on the heads of the devotees[^28-19].

তাঁহার চরণোদক ভক্তে পিয়াইল ।
অবধূত দেখি' সবার আনন্দ বাড়িল ॥ ৮০+২ ॥

*tāṁhāra caraṇodaka bhakte piẏāila |*
*abadhūta dekhi' sabāra ānanda bāṛila || 80+2 ||*

*Word for word:* tahara charanodaka — the water of His feet; bhakte piyaila — gave the devotees to drink; avadhuta dekhi — seeing the Avadhuta; sabara ananda badila — everyone's joy increased

**80+2.** He gave the devotees the water of His feet to drink;
seeing the Avadhuta, everyone's joy increased.

নাচে গায় সে করে হুঙ্কার গর্জন ।
প্রেমে পরিপূর্ণ দেখে অনন্ত ভুবন ॥ ৮০+৩ ॥

*nāce gāẏa se kare huṅkāra garjana |*
*preme paripūrṇa dekhe ananta bhubana || 80+3 ||*

*Word for word:* nache gaya — dances, sings; se kare hunkara garjana — He roars and thunders; preme paripurna — filled with prema; dekhe ananta bhuvana — sees the endless worlds

**80+3.** He dances and sings, He roars and thunders,
and sees the endless worlds filled with prema.

নিত্যানন্দ মহাপ্রভু পরম উল্লাসে ।
গৌরচন্দ্র-মুখ হেরি' অট্ট অট্ট হাসে ॥ ৮০+৪ ॥

*nityānanda mahāprabhu parama ullāse |*
*gauracandra-mukha heri' aṭṭa aṭṭa hāse || 80+4 ||*

*Word for word:* nityananda mahaprabhu — Nityananda Mahaprabhu; parama ullase — in supreme delight; gaurachandra-mukha heri — looking at Gaurachandra's face; atta atta hase — laughs aloud

**80+4.** Nityananda Mahaprabhu, in supreme delight,
looking at Gaurachandra's face, laughs aloud.

পদতালে ধরণী সে থির নাহি হয় ।
ভূমিকম্প হেন সবে মানিল নিশ্চয় ॥ ৮০+৫ ॥

*padatāle dharaṇī se thira nāhi haẏa |*
*bhūmikampa hena sabe mānila niścaẏa || 80+5 ||*

*Word for word:* padatale — by the stamping of the feet; dharani se thira nahi haya — the earth does not stay still; bhumikampa hena — as if an earthquake; sabe manila nishchaya — all were sure

**80+5.** Under the stamping of His feet the earth cannot stay still:
everyone took it for an earthquake.

নাচে গৌরচন্দ্র প্রভু সবার ঠাকুর ।
ক্ষণে ক্ষণে বাড়ে প্রেম-হিল্লোল প্রচুর ॥ ৮০+৬ ॥

*nāce gauracandra prabhu sabāra ṭhākura |*
*kṣaṇe kṣaṇe bāṛe prema-hillola pracura || 80+6 ||*

*Word for word:* nache — dances; gaurachandra prabhu — Gaurachandra Prabhu; sabara thakura — the Master of all; kshane kshane — moment by moment; bade — swell; prema-hillola prachura — abundant waves of prema

**80+6.** Gaurachandra Prabhu, the Master of all, dances;
moment by moment the abundant waves of prema swell.

দেখিয়া ত শচীদেবী আনন্দিত চিত ।
নিত্যানন্দ দেখি' বিশ্বরূপ পরতীত ॥ ৮০+৭ ॥

*dekhiẏā ta śacīdebī ānandita cita |*
*nityānanda dekhi' biśbarūpa paratīta || 80+7 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhiya ta — seeing this; shachidevi — Shachi-devi; anandita chita — rejoiced at heart; nityananda dekhi — looking at Nityananda; vishvarupa paratita — recognized Vishvarupa

**80+7.** Seeing this, Shachi-devi rejoiced at heart:
looking at Nityananda, she recognized Vishvarupa [in Him].

বধূ-সঙ্গে গৃহে করে পরম মঙ্গল ।
হুলাহুলি জয়ধ্বনি করে সুমঙ্গল ॥ ৮০+৮ ॥

*badhū-saṅge gṛhe kare parama maṅgala |*
*hulāhuli jaẏadhbani kare sumaṅgala || 80+8 ||*

*Word for word:* vadhu-sange — with her daughter-in-law; grihe — in the house; kare parama mangala — holds a great festivity; hulahuli — cries of "ulu-ulu"; jaya-dhvani — cries of "Jaya!"; kare sumangala — raises auspicious

**80+8.** Together with her daughter-in-law she holds a great festivity in the house:
auspicious cries of "ulu-ulu" and "Jaya!"

নিত্যানন্দে দেখি' আজ বিশ্বরূপ-ঠান ।
একদিঠে চাহে দেবী হরষিত-পরাণ ॥ ৮০+৯ ॥

*nityānande dekhi' āja biśbarūpa-ṭhāna |*
*ekadiṭhe cāhe debī haraṣita-parāṇa || 80+9 ||*

*Word for word:* nityanande dekhi — seeing in Nityananda; aja — today; vishvarupa-thana — the likeness of Vishvarupa; ekadithe chahe devi — the goddess gazes fixedly; harashita-parana — her heart rejoicing

**80+9.** Seeing Vishvarupa in Nityananda today,
the goddess gazes [at Him] fixedly, her heart rejoicing.

গৌরচন্দ্র কহে কথা শুন বাপ মোর ।
বিশ্বরূপ সেই পুত্র সহোদর তোর ॥ ৮০+১০ ॥

*gauracandra kahe kathā śuna bāpa mora |*
*biśbarūpa sei putra sahodara tora || 80+10 ||*

*Word for word:* gaurachandra kahe katha — Gaurachandra says; shuna bapa mora — listen, dear one (lit. "my father", an endearment); vishvarupa sei putra — Vishvarupa, that very son; sahodara tora — your own (lit. "uterine")

**80+10.** Gaurachandra says: "Listen, dear one:
this is Vishvarupa — that very son, your own [son].

নিত্যানন্দ নাম ধরি' আইলা নবদ্বীপে ।
মোর বাপ বিশ্বম্ভর রাখহ সমীপে ॥ ৮০+১১ ॥

*nityānanda nāma dhari' āilā nabadbīpe |*
*mora bāpa biśbambhara rākhaha samīpe || 80+11 ||*

*Word for word:* nityananda nama dhari — taking the name Nityananda; aila navadvipe — came to Navadvipa; mora bapa vishvambhara — my dear Vishvambhara; rakhaha samipe — keep near you

**80+11.** Under the name of Nityananda He has come to Navadvipa;
keep Him by you, [like] your dear Vishvambhara."

কহিতেই দেবী তবে আনন্দ-পাথারে ।
ডুবি' নিত্যানন্দে চাহে কোলে করিবারে ॥ ৮০+১২ ॥

*kahitei debī tabe ānanda-pāthāre |*
*ḍubi' nityānande cāhe kole karibāre || 80+12 ||*

*Word for word:* kahitei — as soon as He said; devi tabe — the goddess then; ananda-pathare dubi — plunged in an ocean of bliss; nityanande chahe — wants Nityananda; kole karibare — to take on her lap

**80+12.** As soon as He said this, the goddess, plunged in an ocean of bliss,
wants to take Nityananda on her lap.

আইস বাপ বিশ্বরূপ চুম্বি' মুখ তার ।
হরিষে না জানি চিত কি করে মোর ॥ ৮০+১৩ ॥

*āisa bāpa biśbarūpa cumbi' mukha tāra |*
*hariṣe nā jāni cita ki kare mora || 80+13 ||*

*Word for word:* aisa bapa vishvarupa — come, my son Vishvarupa; chumbi mukha tara — kissing His face; harishe — for joy; na jani — I know not; chita ki kare mora — what my heart is doing

**80+13.** "Come, my son Vishvarupa!" — and she kisses His face.
"For joy I know not what is happening to my heart!"

কহে গৌরচন্দ্র মাগো না হও উতরোল ।
রাখহ গোপতে কথা শুন মোর বোল ॥ ৮০+১৪ ॥

*kahe gauracandra māgo nā hao utarola |*
*rākhaha gopate kathā śuna mora bola || 80+14 ||*

*Word for word:* kahe gaurachandra — Gaurachandra says; mago — mother; na hao utarola — do not be agitated; rakhaha gopate katha — keep this secret; shuna mora bola — listen to My word

**80+14.** Gaurachandra says: "Mother, do not be agitated;
keep this secret — listen to My word."

নিত্যানন্দ মহাপ্রভু আইর চরণে ।
দণ্ডবৎ পরণাম করয়ে যতনে ॥ ৮০+১৫ ॥

*nityānanda mahāprabhu āira caraṇe |*
*daṇḍabat paraṇāma karaẏe yatane || 80+15 ||*

*Word for word:* nityananda mahaprabhu — Nityananda Mahaprabhu; aira charane — at the feet of Ai (Shachi); dandavat parnama karaye — prostrates Himself; yatane — with care

**80+15.** Nityananda Mahaprabhu at the feet of Ai (mother Shachi)
prostrates Himself with care.

চরণের ধূলি লয় দু'হাতে করিয়া ।
আইর সন্তোষে নাচে হরিষ হইয়া ॥ ৮০+১৬ ॥

*caraṇera dhūli laẏa du'hāte kariẏā |*
*āira santoṣe nāce hariṣa haiẏā || 80+16 ||*

*Word for word:* charanera dhuli laya — takes the dust of the feet; du-hate kariya — with both hands; aira santoshe — to Ai's delight; nache — dances; harisha haiya — rejoicing

**80+16.** With both hands He takes the dust of her feet
and, rejoicing, dances to Ai's delight.

কতক্ষণে হইলেন স্থির সবে মিলি' ।
নিত্যানন্দ মহাপ্রভু মহাকুতূহলী ॥ ৮০+১৭ ॥

*katakṣaṇe hailena sthira sabe mili' |*
*nityānanda mahāprabhu mahākutūhalī || 80+17 ||*

*Word for word:* katakshane — after a while; hailena sthira — grew calm; sabe mili — all together; nityananda mahaprabhu — Nityananda Mahaprabhu; maha-kutuhali — full of great merriment

**80+17.** After a while all together grew calm;
Nityananda Mahaprabhu [was] full of great merriment.

নিত্যানন্দ দেখি' শচীর জুড়াইল নয়ান ।
পিরীতি-পাগল হঞা নেহারে বয়ান ॥ ৮১ ॥

*nityānanda dekhi' śacīra juṛāila naẏāna |*
*pirīti-pāgala hañā nehāre baẏāna || 81 ||*

*Word for word:* nityananda dekhi — seeing Nityananda; shachira judaila nayana — Shachi's eyes were soothed; piriti-pagala hanya — beside herself with love; nehare bayana — she gazes at [His] face

**81.** Seeing Nityananda, Shachi's eyes were soothed;
beside herself with love, she gazes at His face.

প্রভু বোলে নিজপুত্র বলিয়া জানিবে ।
আমারে অধিক করি' ইহারে পালিবে ॥ ৮২ ॥

*prabhu bole nijaputra baliẏā jānibe |*
*āmāre adhika kari' ihāre pālibe || 82 ||*

*Word for word:* prabhu bole — the Lord says; nija-putra baliya janibe — know [Him] as your own son; amare adhika kari — more than Me; ihare palibe — care for Him

**82.** The Lord says: "Know Him as your own son
and care for Him more than for Me."

পুত্রভাবে শচী নিত্যানন্দ-মুখ চাহে ।
মোর পুত্র তুমি হৈলা শচীদেবী কহে ॥ ৮৩ ॥

*putrabhābe śacī nityānanda-mukha cāhe |*
*mora putra tumi hailā śacīdebī kahe || 83 ||*

*Word for word:* putra-bhave — in the mood of a son; shachi nityananda-mukha chahe — Shachi gazes at Nityananda's face; mora putra tumi haila — you have become my son; shachidevi kahe — says Shachi-devi

**83.** As on a son, Shachi gazes at Nityananda's face.
"You have become my son," says Shachi-devi.

মোর বিশ্বম্ভরে কৃপা করিবে আপনে ।
আজি হৈতে তোরা দুই আমার নন্দনে ॥ ৮৪ ॥

*mora biśbambhare kṛpā karibe āpane |*
*āji haite torā dui āmāra nandane || 84 ||*

*Word for word:* mora vishvambhare — to my Vishvambhara; kripa karibe apane — be kind yourself; aji haite — from today; tora dui — you two; amara nandane — are my sons

**84.** "Be kind yourself to my Vishvambhara:
from today you two are my sons."

বলিতে বলিতে শচীর অশ্রু নেত্রে ঝরে ।
পুত্রভাবে শচী নিত্যানন্দ কোলে করে ॥ ৮৫ ॥

*balite balite śacīra aśru netre jhare |*
*putrabhābe śacī nityānanda kole kare || 85 ||*

*Word for word:* balite balite — as she speaks; shachira ashru netre jhare — tears stream from Shachi's eyes; putra-bhave — as a son; shachi nityananda kole kare — Shachi takes Nityananda in her arms

**85.** As she speaks, tears stream from Shachi's eyes,
and Shachi takes Nityananda in her arms as a son.

নিত্যানন্দ মাতৃভাবে শচীর চরণে ।
দণ্ডবৎ করি' বোলে মধুর বচনে ॥ ৮৬ ॥

*nityānanda mātṛbhābe śacīra caraṇe |*
*daṇḍabat kari' bole madhura bacane || 86 ||*

*Word for word:* nityananda matri-bhave — Nityananda, in the mood of a son to his mother; shachira charane — at Shachi's feet; dandavat kari — prostrating; bole madhura bachane — speaks in sweet words

**86.** Nityananda, seeing her as His mother, prostrated Himself
at Shachi's feet and speaks in sweet words:

যে কহিলে মাতা তুমি সব সত্য হয় ।
তব পুত্র হই আমি জানিহ নিশ্চয় ॥ ৮৭ ॥

*ye kahile mātā tumi saba satya haẏa |*
*taba putra hai āmi jāniha niścaẏa || 87 ||*

*Word for word:* ye kahile mata tumi — what you have said, mother; saba satya haya — is all true; tava putra hai ami — I am your son; janiha nishchaya — know for certain

**87.** "All that you have said, mother, is true:
I am your son — know it for certain.

পুত্র-অপরাধ কিছু না লইবে মাতা ।
তব পুত্র বটি মুঞি জানিবে সর্বথা ॥ ৮৮ ॥

*putra-aparādha kichu nā laibe mātā |*
*taba putra baṭi muñi jānibe sarbathā || 88 ||*

*Word for word:* putra-aparadha kichhu — any offences of your son; na laibe mata — do not hold against me, mother; tava putra bati munyi — I am truly your son; janibe sarvatha — know it in every way

**88.** Do not hold your son's offences against Him, mother:
know it in every way — I am truly your son."

নিত্যানন্দের মাতৃভাব পাঞা শচীরাণী ।
নয়নে গলয়ে জল গদগদ বাণী ॥ ৮৯ ॥

*nityānandera mātṛbhāba pāñā śacīrāṇī |*
*naẏane galaẏe jala gadagada bāṇī || 89 ||*

*Word for word:* nityanandera matri-bhava panya — receiving Nityananda's love for her as mother; shachirani — queen Shachi; nayane galaye jala — tears flow from her eyes; gadagada vani — her voice falters

**89.** Receiving Nityananda's love as a son, queen Shachi —
tears flow from her eyes, her voice falters.

এইমতে স্নেহরসে সভে গরগর ।
দুই পুত্র দেখি' শচীর জুড়াইল অন্তর ॥ ৯০ ॥

*eimate sneharase sabhe garagara |*
*dui putra dekhi' śacīra juṛāila antara || 90 ||*

*Word for word:* eimate — thus; sneha-rase — in the rasa of affection; sabhe garagara — all overflow; dui putra dekhi — seeing her two sons; shachira judaila antara — Shachi's heart was soothed

**90.** Thus all overflow with the rasa of affection;
seeing her two sons, Shachi was comforted at heart.[^28-20]

আর দিন শ্রীবাস-পণ্ডিত ভিক্ষা দিল ।
তাঁহার আশ্রমে অবধূত ভিক্ষা কৈল ॥ ৯১ ॥

*āra dina śrībāsa-paṇḍita bhikṣā dila |*
*tāṁhāra āśrame abadhūta bhikṣā kaila || 91 ||*

*Word for word:* ara dina — on another day; shrivasa-pandita bhiksha dila — Srivasa Pandita offered a meal; tanhara ashrame — in his house; avadhuta bhiksha kaila — the Avadhuta took the meal

**91.** On another day Srivasa Pandita offered a meal,
and the Avadhuta took the meal in his house.

অনেক সন্তোষ পাইল পণ্ডিতের ঠাঞি ।
ভিক্ষা করি' সেই দিন রহিলা তথাই ॥ ৯২ ॥

*aneka santoṣa pāila paṇḍitera ṭhāñi |*
*bhikṣā kari' sei dina rahilā tathāi || 92 ||*

*Word for word:* aneka santosha paila — found great satisfaction; panditera thanyi — with the Pandita; bhiksha kari — having taken the meal; sei dina rahila tathai — that day He stayed there

**92.** He found great satisfaction with the Pandita
and, having taken the meal, stayed there that day.

সেইক্ষণে মহাপ্রভু গৌর ভগবান্ ।
শ্রীবাস-ভবনে গেলা প্রসন্ন-বয়ান ॥ ৯৩ ॥

*seikṣaṇe mahāprabhu gaura bhagabān |*
*śrībāsa-bhabane gelā prasanna-baẏāna || 93 ||*

*Word for word:* seikshane — at that moment; mahaprabhu gaura bhagavan — Mahaprabhu Gaura Bhagavan; shrivasa-bhavane gela — went to Srivasa's house; prasanna-bayana — with a serene face

**93.** At that very moment Mahaprabhu Gaura Bhagavan
came with a serene face to Srivasa's house.

দেবালয়ে প্রবেশিয়া বৈসে দিব্যাসনে ।
কহিল আমারে এই দেখহ নয়নে ॥ ৯৪ ॥

*debālaẏe prabeśiẏā baise dibyāsane |*
*kahila āmāre ei dekhaha naẏane || 94 ||*

*Word for word:* devalaye praveshiya — entering the shrine room; baise divya-asane — sits on a divine seat; kahila — He said; amare ei dekhaha nayane — behold Me now with Your eyes

**94.** Entering the shrine room, He sits on a divine seat
and said: "Behold Me now with Your eyes."

এ বোল শুনিঞা নিত্যানন্দ ন্যাসিবর ।
সাদরে নিরিখে বিশ্বম্ভর-কলেবর ॥ ৯৫ ॥

*e bola śuniñā nityānanda nyāsibara |*
*sādare nirikhe biśbambhara-kalebara || 95 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuninya — hearing these words; nityananda nyasivara — Nityananda, the best of sannyasis; sadare nirikhe — lovingly gazes at; vishvambhara-kalevara — the form of Vishvambhara

**95.** Hearing these words, Nityananda, the best of sannyasis,
lovingly gazes at the form of Vishvambhara.

তত্ত্ব না জানিল কিছু বিশেষ তাহার ।
কি কাজ কহিল প্রভু ইঙ্গিত-আকার ॥ ৯৬ ॥

*tattba nā jānila kichu biśeṣa tāhāra |*
*ki kāja kahila prabhu iṅgita-ākāra || 96 ||*

*Word for word:* tattva na janila — He did not grasp the truth; kichhu vishesha tahara — of any special [meaning] in it; ki kaja kahila prabhu — what purpose the Lord spoke of; ingita-akara — by a hint

**96.** But He did not grasp any special meaning in this —
what purpose the Lord had hinted at.

তবে পুনরপি মহাপ্রভু বিশ্বম্ভর ।
নিজজন দেখি' কিছু কহিল উত্তর ॥ ৯৭ ॥

*tabe punarapi mahāprabhu biśbambhara |*
*nijajana dekhi' kichu kahila uttara || 97 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe punarapi — then again; mahaprabhu vishvambhara — Mahaprabhu Vishvambhara; nijajana dekhi — looking at His own; kichhu kahila uttara — said something in reply

**97.** Then Mahaprabhu Vishvambhara again,
looking at His own, said to them in reply:

সর্বজন হও এই মন্দির-বাহিরে ।
মন্দির বাহির হৈলা আজ্ঞা পালিবারে ॥ ৯৮ ॥

*sarbajana hao ei mandira-bāhire |*
*mandira bāhira hailā ājñā pālibāre || 98 ||*

*Word for word:* sarvajana hao — all of you go; ei mandira-bahire — out of this room; mandira bahira haila — they went out of the room; ajna palibare — to obey the command

**98.** "All of you, go out of this room" —
and they went out of the room, obeying the command.

অবশেষ কথা কিবা কহে আপনার ।
নিভৃতে কহয়ে মর্ম কে জানিবে তার ॥ ৯৯ ॥

*abaśeṣa kathā kibā kahe āpanāra |*
*nibhṛte kahaẏe marma ke jānibe tāra || 99 ||*

*Word for word:* avashesha katha — the remaining words; kiba kahe apanara — what He says of Himself; nibhrite kahaye — He speaks in private; marma — the inner meaning; ke janibe tara — who will know it

**99.** What He says of Himself in the remaining words —
the inner meaning spoken in private — who will know?

কহিল আমারে এই দেখহ আপনে ।
আমার কারণে তুমি কৈলে পরিশ্রমে ॥ ১০০ ॥

*kahila āmāre ei dekhaha āpane |*
*āmāra kāraṇe tumi kaile pariśrame || 100 ||*

*Word for word:* kahila — He said; amare ei dekhaha apane — behold Me now Yourself; amara karane — for My sake; tumi kaile parishrame — You have toiled

**100.** He said: "Behold Me now Yourself:
for My sake You have toiled so much."

ষড়্ভুজ শরীর প্রভু দেখাইল আগে ।
তবে চতুর্ভুজ রূপ দুই ভুজ তবে ॥ ১০১ ॥

*ṣaṛbhuja śarīra prabhu dekhāila āge |*
*tabe caturbhuja rūpa dui bhuja tabe || 101 ||*

*Word for word:* shadbhuja sharira — the six-armed body; prabhu dekhaila age — the Lord showed first; tabe chaturbhuja rupa — then the four-armed form; dui bhuja tabe — then two-armed

**101.** First the Lord showed His six-armed form,
then the four-armed form, and then the two-armed.

দেখিয়া ঐছন রূপ অতি অদ্ভুত ।
পূর্ব সঙরিলা নিত্যানন্দ অবধূত ॥ ১০২ ॥

*dekhiẏā aichana rūpa ati adbhuta |*
*pūrba saṅarilā nityānanda abadhūta || 102 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhiya aichhana rupa — seeing such a form; ati adbhuta — most wonderful; purva sangarila — remembered the past; nityananda avadhuta — Nityananda Avadhuta

**102.** Seeing such a form, the greatest of wonders,
Nityananda Avadhuta remembered the past.[^28-21]

দেখিল আমার প্রভু প্রকাশ হইলা ।
এক অঙ্গে তিন অবতার দেখাইলা ॥ ১০৩ ॥

*dekhila āmāra prabhu prakāśa hailā |*
*eka aṅge tina abatāra dekhāilā || 103 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhila — He saw; amara prabhu prakasha haila — my Lord revealed Himself; eka ange — in one body; tina avatara dekhaila — He showed three avataras

**103.** He saw: my Lord revealed Himself
and in one body showed three avataras.

রাম কৃষ্ণ গৌরাঙ্গ দেখিল দিব্য তনু ।
পশ্চাৎ দেখিল নব-কিশোর রাধাকানু ॥ ১০৪ ॥

*rāma kṛṣṇa gaurāṅga dekhila dibya tanu |*
*paścāt dekhila naba-kiśora rādhākānu || 104 ||*

*Word for word:* rama krishna gauranga — Rama, Krishna, Gauranga; dekhila divya tanu — He saw in divine bodies; pashchat dekhila — afterwards He saw; nava-kishora radhakanu — the youthful Radha and Kanu

**104.** He saw the divine forms of Rama, Krishna and Gauranga,
and afterwards saw the youthful pair — Radha and Kanu.[^28-22]

হরিষে নাচয়ে প্রভু আনন্দ অপার ।
দিগ্বিদিগ্ নাহি জানে প্রেমের পাথার ॥ ১০৫ ॥

*hariṣe nācaẏe prabhu ānanda apāra |*
*digbidig nāhi jāne premera pāthāra || 105 ||*

*Word for word:* harishe nachaye prabhu — in delight Prabhu dances; ananda apara — boundless bliss; digvidig nahi jane — He knows no directions; premera pathara — an ocean of prema

**105.** In delight Prabhu dances, His bliss boundless;
He knows no directions — an ocean of prema.

হেন অদ্ভুত কথা শুন সর্বজন ।
গোরা-গুণগাথা কহে এ দাস লোচন ॥ ১০৬ ॥

*hena adbhuta kathā śuna sarbajana |*
*gorā-guṇagāthā kahe e dāsa locana || 106 ||*

*Word for word:* hena adbhuta katha — such a wondrous story; shuna sarvajana — hear, all; gora-guna-gatha — the song of Gora's qualities; kahe e dasa lochana — tells this servant Lochana

**106.** Hear, all of you, this wondrous story:
this servant Lochana tells the song of Gora's qualities.

*Raga — any (yatha-raga); refrain: "Hari, Rama, Narayana — golden Gora, Shachi's darling! At the festival of Nityananda's joy the enraptured devotees dance"*

পরম অদ্ভুত কথা লোকে অবিদিত ।
শুনহ ভকত সব হৈয়া একচিত ॥ ১০৬+১ ॥

*parama adbhuta kathā loke abidita |*
*śunaha bhakata saba haiẏā ekacita || 106+1 ||*

*Word for word:* parama adbhuta katha — a supremely wondrous story; loke avidita — unknown to people; shunaha bhakata saba — hear, all you devotees; haiya ekachita — with one-pointed mind

**106+1.** A supremely wondrous story, unknown to people —
hear it, all you devotees, with one-pointed mind[^28-23].

ষড়্‌ভুজ দেখয়ে নিত্যানন্দ সুবিলাসী ।
বাঢ়ে নিত্যানন্দ-সুখ অমিয়ার রাশি ॥ ১০৬+২ ॥

*ṣaṛ‌bhuja dekhaẏe nityānanda subilāsī |*
*bāṛhe nityānanda-sukha amiẏāra rāśi || 106+2 ||*

*Word for word:* shad-bhuja dekhaye — sees the six-armed [form]; nityananda suvilasi — Nityananda, graceful in play; badhe nityananda-sukha — Nityananda's happiness grows; amiyara rashi — a heap of nectar

**106+2.** Nityananda, so graceful in His play, sees the six-armed [form];
Nityananda's happiness grows — a heap of nectar.

ঊর্ধ্ব দুই হস্তে দেখে ধনু আর শর ।
মধ্য দুই হস্তে বক্ষে মুরলী অধর ॥ ১০৬+৩ ॥

*ūrdhba dui haste dekhe dhanu āra śara |*
*madhya dui haste bakṣe muralī adhara || 106+3 ||*

*Word for word:* urdhva dui haste — in the two upper hands; dekhe — sees; dhanu ara shara — bow and arrows; madhya dui haste — in the two middle hands; vakshe — at the breast; murali adhara — the flute at the lips

**106+3.** In the two upper hands He sees bow and arrows;
in the two middle ones — the flute, [raised] at the breast to the lips.

অধো হস্তদ্বয়ে শোভে কমণ্ডলু দণ্ড ।
মালসাট মারে দেখি' পরম প্রচণ্ড ॥ ১০৬+৪ ॥

*adho hastadbaẏe śobhe kamaṇḍalu daṇḍa |*
*mālasāṭa māre dekhi' parama pracaṇḍa || 106+4 ||*

*Word for word:* adho hasta-dvaye — in the two lower hands; shobhe — shine; kamandalu danda — waterpot and staff; malasata mare — slaps His arms (as a wrestler challenging); dekhi — seeing; parama prachanda — very fiercely

**106+4.** In the two lower hands shine the waterpot and the staff.
Seeing this, [Nityananda] fiercely slaps His arms[^28-24].

রাম কৃষ্ণ গৌরাঙ্গ মাধুরী মনোহর ।
কিশোর-শেখর রসময় কলেবর ॥ ১০৬+৫ ॥

*rāma kṛṣṇa gaurāṅga mādhurī manohara |*
*kiśora-śekhara rasamaẏa kalebara || 106+5 ||*

*Word for word:* rama krishna gauranga — Rama, Krishna, Gauranga; madhuri manohara — captivating sweetness; kishora-shekhara — crown of youths; rasamaya kalebara — a body full of rasa

**106+5.** The captivating sweetness of Rama, Krishna and Gauranga;
the crown of youths — a body full of rasa.

দেখি' নিত্যানন্দ প্রভু সন্তোষ-অন্তর ।
লীলাবেশে হৈলা গৌর-রসে গরগর ॥ ১০৬+৬ ॥

*dekhi' nityānanda prabhu santoṣa-antara |*
*līlābeśe hailā gaura-rase garagara || 106+6 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhi — seeing; nityananda prabhu — Nityananda Prabhu; santosha-antara — glad at heart; lilaveshe — in the mood of the lila; haila gaura-rase garagara — overflowed with the rasa of Gaura

**106+6.** Seeing this, Nityananda Prabhu, His heart glad,
entering the mood of the lila, overflowed with the rasa of Gaura.

তবে গভীর গরজে ঘন ঘন ।
মত্ত বলদেব যেন অঙ্গের গঠন ॥ ১০৬+৭ ॥

*tabe gabhīra garaje ghana ghana |*
*matta baladeba yena aṅgera gaṭhana || 106+7 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe — then; gabhira garaje — roars deeply; ghana ghana — again and again; matta baladeva yena — just like the intoxicated Baladeva; angera gathana — in the build of His body

**106+7.** Then again and again He gives a deep roar;
in the build of His body He is just like the intoxicated Baladeva.

সে রূপ দেখিতে কামদেব মুরছায় ।
তুলনা দিবারে কিবা আছয়ে ধরায় ॥ ১০৬+৮ ॥

*se rūpa dekhite kāmadeba murachāẏa |*
*tulanā dibāre kibā āchaẏe dharāẏa || 106+8 ||*

*Word for word:* se rupa dekhite — at the sight of that form; kamadeva murachhaya — Kamadeva swoons; tulana dibare — to compare; kiba achhaye dharaya — what is there on earth

**106+8.** At the sight of that form Kamadeva swoons:
what on earth could be compared to it?

জিনিয়া রাতুল পদ্ম চরণযুগল ।
ভক্ত-ভ্রমর লোভে মহাকুতূহল ॥ ১০৬+৯ ॥

*jiniẏā rātula padma caraṇayugala |*
*bhakta-bhramara lobhe mahākutūhala || 106+9 ||*

*Word for word:* jiniya ratula padma — outshining red lotuses; charana-yugala — the pair of feet; bhakta-bhramara — bee-like devotees; lobhe — crave; maha-kutuhala — in great excitement

**106+9.** The pair of feet outshines red lotuses:
the bee-like devotees crave them in great excitement.

কনক-নূপুর তাহে শোভে মনোহরে ।
দশচন্দ্র বিরাজিত অঙ্গুলি-উপরে ॥ ১০৬+১০ ॥

*kanaka-nūpura tāhe śobhe manohare |*
*daśacandra birājita aṅguli-upare || 106+10 ||*

*Word for word:* kanaka-nupura — golden anklets; tahe shobhe manohare — shine captivatingly on them; dasha-chandra virajita — ten moons (the nails) are resplendent; anguli-upare — on the toes

**106+10.** On them golden anklets shine captivatingly;
on the toes ten moons are resplendent.

উলট-কদলী উরু সুন্দর নিতম্ব ।
নীল ধটী পরিপাটি রভস-তরঙ্গ ॥ ১০৬+১১ ॥

*ulaṭa-kadalī uru sundara nitamba |*
*nīla dhaṭī paripāṭi rabhasa-taraṅga || 106+11 ||*

*Word for word:* ulata-kadali uru — thighs like inverted plantain trunks; sundara nitamba — beautiful hips; nila dhati — a blue dhoti; paripati — neatly tied; rabhasa-taranga — waves of merriment

**106+11.** Thighs like inverted plantain trunks, beautiful hips;
a blue dhoti neatly tied — waves of merriment.

ত্রিবলী-বলিত চারু নাভি সুগভীর ।
রসিক-নাগরী-চিত দেখিয়া অধীর ॥ ১০৬+১২ ॥

*tribalī-balita cāru nābhi sugabhīra |*
*rasika-nāgarī-cita dekhiẏā adhīra || 106+12 ||*

*Word for word:* tribali-balita — marked with three folds; charu nabhi sugabhira — a lovely deep navel; rasika-nagari-chita — the hearts of the discerning nagaris; dekhiya adhira — seeing, lose composure

**106+12.** Three folds [on the belly], a lovely deep navel:
seeing this, the hearts of the discerning nagaris lose their composure[^28-25].

পরিসর উচ্চ বক্ষে মুকুতার দাম ।
গজমোতি-হার হেরি' মুরছায় কাম ॥ ১০৬+১৩ ॥

*parisara ucca bakṣe mukutāra dāma |*
*gajamoti-hāra heri' murachāẏa kāma || 106+13 ||*

*Word for word:* parisara uchcha vakshe — on the broad, high chest; mukutara dama — strings of pearls; gajamoti-hara heri — seeing the necklace of "elephant pearls"; murachhaya kama — Kama swoons

**106+13.** On the broad, high chest — strings of pearls;
at the sight of the necklace of "elephant pearls" Kama swoons.

কম্বু কণ্ঠ গণ্ডস্থল কনক-দর্পণ ।
লাজ ধৈর্য ছাড়ে হেরি' কুলবতীগণ ॥ ১০৬+১৪ ॥

*kambu kaṇṭha gaṇḍasthala kanaka-darpaṇa |*
*lāja dhairya chāṛe heri' kulabatīgaṇa || 106+14 ||*

*Word for word:* kambu kantha — the neck a conch; gandasthala kanaka-darpana — the cheeks golden mirrors; laja dhairya chhade — abandon shame and restraint; heri — seeing; kulavati-gana — wives of good families

**106+14.** The neck a conch, the cheeks golden mirrors;
seeing this, wives of good families abandon shame and restraint.

কর্ণে সুকুণ্ডল যেন সূর্যের মণ্ডল ।
পদ্মিনীর গণ হেরি' প্রফুল্লিত জলে ॥ ১০৬+১৫ ॥

*karṇe sukuṇḍala yena sūryera maṇḍala |*
*padminīra gaṇa heri' praphullita jale || 106+15 ||*

*Word for word:* karne sukundala — beautiful earrings in the ears; yena suryera mandala — like the disc of the sun; padminira gana — the lotuses; heri — seeing; praphullita jale — open in the water

**106+15.** In the ears — beautiful earrings like discs of the sun:
seeing them, the lotuses in the water open.

শিরোপরি পাগড়ী শোভয়ে লটপটি ।
মধুভরে টলে রাঙ্গা উতপল-দিঠি ॥ ১০৬+১৬ ॥

*śiropari pāgaṛī śobhaẏe laṭapaṭi |*
*madhubhare ṭale rāṅgā utapala-diṭhi || 106+16 ||*

*Word for word:* shiropari — on the head; pagadi shobhaye latapati — a turban is loosely tied; madhu-bhare — heavy with honey; tale — sways; ranga utapala-dithi — gaze like red lotuses

**106+16.** On His head a turban is loosely tied;
heavy with honey, His gaze — red lotuses — sways[^28-26].

শ্রীদাম সুদাম দাম বসুদাম ভাইয়া ।
বারুণী বারুণী ডাকে মহামত্ত হৈয়া ॥ ১০৬+১৭ ॥

*śrīdāma sudāma dāma basudāma bhāiẏā |*
*bāruṇī bāruṇī ḍāke mahāmatta haiẏā || 106+17 ||*

*Word for word:* shridama sudama dama vasudama — Shridama, Sudama, Dama, Vasudama; bhaiya — brothers; varuni varuni — varuni, varuni; dake — calls; maha-matta haiya — greatly intoxicated

**106+17.** "Shridama, Sudama, Dama, Vasudama, brothers!
Varuni, varuni!" — He calls, greatly intoxicated.

চন্দনে চর্চিত চারু ললাটে তিলক ।
ভুরুযুগ জিনিলেক কামের ধনুক ॥ ১০৬+১৮ ॥

*candane carcita cāru lalāṭe tilaka |*
*bhuruyuga jinileka kāmera dhanuka || 106+18 ||*

*Word for word:* chandane charchita — drawn with sandal; charu lalate tilaka — a lovely tilaka on the forehead; bhuru-yuga — the pair of brows; jinileka — has surpassed; kamera dhanuka — Kama's bow

**106+18.** On the forehead a lovely tilaka of sandal paste;
the pair of brows has surpassed Kama's bow.

কোটি চন্দ্র নিছনিয়ে সে চন্দ্রবদন ।
প্রেমধারা নয়নে সে সুধা-বরিষণ ॥ ১০৬+১৯ ॥

*koṭi candra nichaniẏe se candrabadana |*
*premadhārā naẏane se sudhā-bariṣaṇa || 106+19 ||*

*Word for word:* koti chandra — millions of moons; nichhaniye — are offered up; se chandra-vadana — for that moon-like face; premadhara nayane — streams of prema from the eyes; se sudha-varishana — that is a shower of nectar

**106+19.** Millions of moons are offered up for that moon-like face;
streams of prema from the eyes — a shower of nectar.

লৌহদণ্ড শ্রীহস্তে সে পাষণ্ড দলিতে ।
শ্রীহল মুষল যেন শত্রু বিনাশিতে ॥ ১০৬+২০ ॥

*lauhadaṇḍa śrīhaste se pāṣaṇḍa dalite |*
*śrīhala muṣala yena śatru bināśite || 106+20 ||*

*Word for word:* lauhadanda shrihaste — an iron staff in the holy hand; se pashanda dalite — to crush the godless; shri-hala mushala — the holy plough and club; yena — like; shatru vinashite — to destroy enemies

**106+20.** In His holy hand an iron staff to crush the godless,
like the holy plough and club to destroy enemies.

কোন ক্ষণে ধবলী শ্যামলী বলি' ডাকে ।
ভাই কানাই মধু আন আমার নিকটে ॥ ১০৬+২১ ॥

*kona kṣaṇe dhabalī śyāmalī bali' ḍāke |*
*bhāi kānāi madhu āna āmāra nikaṭe || 106+21 ||*

*Word for word:* kona kshane — now; dhavali shyamali bali dake — calls out "Dhavali! Shyamali!" (names of cows); bhai kanai — brother Kanai; madhu ana — bring honey; amara nikate — to Me

**106+21.** Now He calls: "Dhavali! Shyamali!" —
"Brother Kanai, bring Me honey!"

হরি হরি বলে ক্ষণে মেঘের শবদে ।
ভাইয়া ভাইয়া বলে ক্ষণে পরম উন্মাদে ॥ ১০৬+২২ ॥

*hari hari bale kṣaṇe meghera śabade |*
*bhāiẏā bhāiẏā bale kṣaṇe parama unmāde || 106+22 ||*

*Word for word:* hari hari bale kshane — now says "Hari, Hari"; meghera shabade — with the voice of thunder; bhaiya bhaiya bale kshane — now calls "brother, brother"; parama unmade — in supreme madness

**106+22.** Now with a voice of thunder He says "Hari, Hari!" —
now in supreme madness [of prema] He calls, "Brother, brother!"

ক্ষণে ভক্তিরস-সুখে লীলা-অনুসারে ।
পরস্পর দোঁহে মেলি' প্রণাম করে ॥ ১০৬+২৩ ॥

*kṣaṇe bhaktirasa-sukhe līlā-anusāre |*
*paraspara doṁhe meli' praṇāma kare || 106+23 ||*

*Word for word:* kshane — now; bhakti-rasa-sukhe — in the happiness of the rasa of bhakti; lila-anusare — in keeping with the lila; paraspara donhe meli — the two together, to each other; pranama kare — bow

**106+23.** Now, in the happiness of the rasa of bhakti, in keeping with the lila,
the two of Them bow to each other.

পড়িলেন প্রভুপদে নিত্যানন্দ রায় ।
গৌরচন্দ্র প্রেমানন্দ দেহ ত আমায় ॥ ১০৬+২৪ ॥

*paṛilena prabhupade nityānanda rāẏa |*
*gauracandra premānanda deha ta āmāẏa || 106+24 ||*

*Word for word:* padilena prabhu-pade — fell at the Lord's feet; nityananda raya — Nityananda Raya; gaurachandra — O Gaurachandra; premananda deha ta amaya — grant me the bliss of prema

**106+24.** Nityananda Raya fell at the Lord's feet:
"Gaurachandra, grant me the bliss of prema!"

নিত্যানন্দ-পদে পড়ে শ্রীগৌরাঙ্গ রায় ।
দোঁহার চরণ দোঁহে ধরিবারে চায় ॥ ১০৬+২৫ ॥

*nityānanda-pade paṛe śrīgaurāṅga rāẏa |*
*doṁhāra caraṇa doṁhe dharibāre cāẏa || 106+25 ||*

*Word for word:* nityananda-pade pade — falls at Nityananda's feet; shri-gauranga raya — Sri Gauranga Raya; donhara charana donhe — the two, each other's feet; dharibare chaya — seek to clasp

**106+25.** At Nityananda's feet falls Sri Gauranga Raya;
each of the Two seeks to clasp the other's feet.

গদগদ বলে গোরা দাদা রে বলাই ।
আমারে ছাড়িয়া ভাই চলে কোন্ ঠাঁই ॥ ১০৬+২৬ ॥

*gadagada bale gorā dādā re balāi |*
*āmāre chāṛiẏā bhāi cale kon ṭhāṁi || 106+26 ||*

*Word for word:* gadagada bale gora — Gora says in a choked voice; dada re balai — elder brother Balai; amare chhadiya — leaving Me; bhai — brother; chale kon thani — where did You go

**106+26.** In a choked voice Gora says: "Elder brother Balai!
Leaving Me, where did You go, brother?

এই বেশে কোন্ দেশে কতেক ভ্রমিলে ।
পাচনী গুঞ্জার মালা কোথা বা রাখিলে ॥ ১০৬+২৭ ॥

*ei beśe kon deśe kateka bhramile |*
*pācanī guñjāra mālā kothā bā rākhile || 106+27 ||*

*Word for word:* ei beshe — in this guise; kon deshe — through what lands; kateka bhramile — wandered so long; pachani — the herdsman's stick; gunjara mala — the gunja garland; kotha ba rakhile — where have You left

**106+27.** In this guise, through what lands have You wandered so long?
Where have You left the herdsman's stick and the gunja garland?

কিবা ছিলাম কিবা হৈলাম কি করিল ধাতা ।
কোথা নন্দ পিতা কোথা যশোমতী মাতা ॥ ১০৬+২৮ ॥

*kibā chilāma kibā hailāma ki karila dhātā |*
*kothā nanda pitā kothā yaśomatī mātā || 106+28 ||*

*Word for word:* kiba chhilama — what We were; kiba hailama — what We have become; ki karila dhata — what has the Creator done; kotha nanda pita — where is father Nanda; kotha yashomati mata — where is mother Yashomati

**106+28.** What We were, what We have become — what has the Creator done!
Where is father Nanda, where is mother Yashomati?

কালিন্দীর তীরে তীরে চরাইতাম গাই ।
তাহা কিছু পড়ে মনে দাদা রে বলাই ॥ ১০৬+২৯ ॥

*kālindīra tīre tīre carāitāma gāi |*
*tāhā kichu paṛe mane dādā re balāi || 106+29 ||*

*Word for word:* kalindira tire tire — along the banks of the Kalindi; charaitama gai — We grazed the cows; taha kichhu pade mane — do You remember any of it; dada re balai — elder brother Balai

**106+29.** Along the banks of the Kalindi We grazed the cows —
do You remember anything of it, elder brother Balai?"

হেনমতে দুই প্রভুর হইল মিলন ।
আনন্দেতে গুণ গায় এ দাস লোচন ॥ ১০৬+৩০ ॥

*henamate dui prabhura haila milana |*
*ānandete guṇa gāẏa e dāsa locana || 106+30 ||*

*Word for word:* henamate — thus; dui prabhura haila milana — the two Lords met; anandete — in bliss; guna gaya — sings of the glories; e dasa lochana — this servant Lochana

**106+30.** Thus the two Lords met;
in bliss this servant Lochana sings of [Their] glories.

[^28-1]: The summary covers the whole section (vv. 1–106). Some places in the OCR of the edition are illegible and have been restored by sense (in square brackets). The section as a whole follows Murari Gupta (2.7–2.8).
[^28-2]: So also in Murari (2.7.7): "Shri is devotion, and you are its abode."
[^28-3]: Gopinatha is a brahmana of Navadvipa, an associate of the Lord; in Murari (2.7.8): "You are known as My servant."
[^28-4]: Vv. 7–8 are the first two stanzas of Murari Gupta's Ramashtaka (eight verses on Rama) (Murari 2.7.10–11); Brihaspati and Kavi (Shukra) are the planets Jupiter and Venus. Murari is a devotee of Rama, in Gaudiya Vaishnava tradition Hanuman (en/24, note 12). Bhaktisiddhanta's anvaya and translation of the verses are not translated here or below.
[^28-5]: Cf. Murari 2.7.18. Ramadasa means "servant of Rama".
[^28-6]: This instruction is not in Murari. In the Chaitanya-charitamrita (Madhya 15.137–157) the Lord, testing Murari, advises him to worship Krishna, and then glorifies his unshakeable fidelity to Rama. Cf. also en/24, where the Lord instructs Murari to worship Radha and Krishna.
[^28-7]: The verse is Bhagavata 11.14.20; vv. 18–23 — cf. Murari 2.7.19–23. Sri Rama Pandita is the younger brother of Srivasa (Srinivasa).
[^28-8]: Cf. Murari 2.7.25–27; in Murari the remnants of the meal are received also by Narayani, Srivasa's niece, the future mother of Vrindavana Dasa.
[^28-9]: Cf. Murari 2.8.1–9. Shripada is a respectful address to a sannyasi; an Avadhuta is a wandering renunciant who stands above external rules. Rama is Sri Rama Pandita; Mukunda is Mukunda Datta. According to the Chaitanya-bhagavata (Madhya-khanda), Nityananda came to Navadvipa after many years of pilgrimage and stayed in the house of Nandana Acharya.
[^28-10]: Literally "consider, all, your own dwelling"; so in A and in the 1983 edition. We understand it from v. 37 and from Murari (2.8.6–7), where the Lord says the Avadhuta can be found in the evening and sends everyone home.
[^28-11]: Vv. 47–55 describe Nityananda. According to Gaudiya Vaishnava theology Nityananda is Balarama Himself, Krishna's elder brother (cf. Murari 2.9.12); His staff, roar and gait "subdue Kali" — that is, His mercy breaks the power of the age of Kali. The yellow cloth is Lochana Dasa's; in Murari (2.9.12) Balarama wears blue.
[^28-12]: Nityananda is in the mood of Balarama: Kanai is Krishna, His younger brother; Revati is Balarama's consort; "honey" (madhu) is the intoxicating honey-wine (varuni) that Balarama drinks (cf. Murari 2.9.12, 2.14). This intoxication is the ecstasy of prema, not worldly drunkenness; the Avadhuta's strange behaviour (vv. 56–58) is likewise a manifestation of prema.
[^28-13]: An image from the songs of the gopis, as in Lochana Dasa's descriptions of Gaura (cf. en/09, note 9, on "nagari-bhava"): the beauty of the Lord and His associates draws souls away from worldly attachments; it is not worldly passion.
[^28-14]: Cf. Murari 2.8.10–13: the Lord bows to Nityananda with devotion. Thus the Lord honours Nityananda as His elder brother (Balarama) and shows how to honour a Vaishnava.
[^28-15]: Nityananda had wandered for many years through the holy places in search of Krishna, and found Him "hiding" in Navadvipa in the form of Gaura. The "thief" is Krishna, the Stealer of butter and of hearts.
[^28-16]: V. 69+1 is found only in the 1983 edition (the 1903 edition lacks it); it nearly repeats v. 60.
[^28-17]: Vv. 75–78 — cf. Murari 2.8.15–16. "Knowledge" here is the knowledge of Krishna as Bhagavan Himself (cf. en/27, note 2); according to Gaudiya Vaishnava teaching, devotion itself brings both knowledge and detachment (Bhagavata 1.2.7; 11.2.42).
[^28-18]: Cf. Murari 2.8.18–19.
[^28-19]: Vv. 80+1 — 80+17 are found only in the 1983 edition (absent from Bhaktisiddhanta's edition); the 1903 edition gives vv. 80+1 — 80+16 in a footnote as an additional reading. By distributing pieces of the Avadhuta's kaupina to the devotees and giving them the water of His feet to drink, the Lord teaches them to honour Nityananda as the supreme guru (cf. the Chaitanya-bhagavata, Madhya-khanda, where the Lord likewise has the devotees tie pieces of Nityananda's kaupina on their heads). Shachi recognizes in Nityananda her elder son Vishvarupa: according to Gaudiya Vaishnava understanding, Nityananda is Balarama Himself and Vishvarupa an expansion of Sankarshana, and tradition holds that Vishvarupa, on leaving this world, entered into Nityananda; cf. also the Chaitanya-bhagavata, where Shachi sees Nityananda and Nimai in a dream as Balarama and Krishna. Vv. 80+10 — 80+11 are not quite clear in either edition (lit. "listen, my father" — an endearment; "Vishvarupa — that son, your uterine…"; "keep my dear Vishvambhara near you"); they are translated by sense.
[^28-20]: Vv. 81–90 are not in Murari. Nityananda, according to Gaudiya Vaishnava theology, is Balarama, and Vishvarupa too is an expansion of Sankarshana; hence Shachi naturally loves Nityananda as her son.
[^28-21]: Vv. 91–102 — cf. Murari 2.8.20–29. "The past" is His former pastimes with Krishna as Balarama (in Murari, 2.8.29, the Lord says: "You are My brother who sported in Vrindavana!"). In Murari Nityananda tells no one of what He saw.
[^28-22]: The six-armed form unites Rama (bow and arrows), Krishna (flute) and Gaura the sannyasi (staff and waterpot); by tradition, the Lord also revealed the same form to Sarvabhauma (en/45, vv. 243–245 and note 22; according to the Chaitanya-charitamrita, Madhya 6, Sarvabhauma sees a four-armed and then a two-armed form). The vision of Radha and Krishna in Gaura: according to Gaudiya Vaishnava theology, Gaura is Radha and Krishna in one body (cf. Chaitanya-charitamrita, Adi 4; Madhya 8, Ramananda Raya's vision).
[^28-23]: The song of vv. 106+1 — 106+30 is found only in the 1983 edition (absent from Bhaktisiddhanta's edition, where a new section begins at once); the 1903 edition gives it in a footnote as an additional reading. Nityananda sees the six-armed form (see note 22) and then abides in the bhava of Balarama: He calls the cowherd boys and cows of Vraja and asks Kanai (Krishna) for honey. This bhava is His own: according to Gaudiya Vaishnava understanding, Nityananda is Balarama Himself (the comparison "just like the intoxicated Baladeva" in v. 106+7 is poetic). In vv. 106+26 — 106+29 the Lord recalls with Him the pastimes in Vraja, as Krishna with His elder brother.
[^28-24]: Slapping one's arms (malasat) is the gesture of a wrestler challenging to a fight; this is Balarama's heroic mood.
[^28-25]: Vv. 106+12 — 106+14 are Lochana Dasa's nagari-bhava motif, here transferred to Nityananda (see en/09, note 9); the subject is the Lord's beauty that captivates hearts, not worldly passion.
[^28-26]: Honey (madhu) and varuni (106+17) are the intoxicating drink Balarama loves; Nityananda's "intoxication" is the ecstasy of prema, not worldly intoxication (cf. note 12).

---

# Madhya-khanda, part 6 (portion 29)

*The section "Meeting with Advaita and Haridasa": the Lord weeps after seeing Krishna in a dream; Nityananda beholds the Lord's forms; Nityananda at Advaita's; Advaita worships the Lord in Srivasa's house; the arrival of Haridasa; Nityananda's kaupina; the Lord vanishes with Srivasa and returns; the greatness of prema*

## Meeting with Advaita and Haridasa

> *Summary by Srila Bhaktisiddhanta Sarasvati.* One night, in the third watch, Sriman Mahaprabhu suddenly began to weep; Shachi-devi in alarm asked the reason for His weeping, and Mahaprabhu told His mother how He had seen Krishna in a dream. Sriman Nityananda Prabhu [beheld] the six-armed and other forms of Mahaprabhu; then at Mahaprabhu's command the devotees took Him to Advaita's [house], and there They spent two days in great bliss. [When] Murari [told the Lord] of Nityananda Prabhu's manifestations of prema, [the Lord laughed]. When Advaita [Prabhu], seeing Sriman Mahaprabhu in the house of Srivasa Pandita, worshipped Him, the Vaishnavas [danced in bliss]. [Thakura] Haridasa came [and met the Lord]. When Nityananda Prabhu [was taking leave] of Sriman Mahaprabhu, Mahaprabhu took Nityananda's kaupina [and distributed it] to the devotees, [and they tied it] on their heads. [When the Lord disappeared,] the devotees lamented, and when He returned, they were seized with boundless bliss.[^29-1]

*Raga turi; refrain: "Gora has remembered the past — that is why Gora weeps!"*[^29-2]

আর অপরূপ কথা কহিব এখন ।
না দেখিল না শুনিল গোরা-আচরণ ॥ ১ ॥

*āra aparūpa kathā kahiba ekhana |*
*nā dekhila nā śunila gorā-ācaraṇa || 1 ||*

*Word for word:* ara aparupa katha — another wondrous story; kahiba ekhana — I shall tell now; na dekhila na shunila — such as none has seen or heard; gora-acharana — Gora's conduct

**1.** Now I shall tell another wondrous story —
of such deeds of Gora as none has seen or heard.

সকল লোকের নাথ ক্ষিতি-অবতার ।
ভাগ্য করি' না মানহ ইহা আপনার ॥ ২ ॥

*sakala lokera nātha kṣiti-abatāra |*
*bhāgya kari' nā mānaha ihā āpanāra || 2 ||*

*Word for word:* sakala lokera natha — the Lord of all worlds; kshiti-avatara — has descended on earth; bhagya kari — as good fortune; na manaha — you do not regard; iha apanara — this as your own

**2.** The Lord of all worlds has descended on earth —
why do you not count this your good fortune?

চাতুরী না ঘুচে ছার পাষণ্ডি-হিয়ায় ।
জড়িত অন্তর তার এ বিষ্ণুমায়ায় ॥ ৩ ॥

*cāturī nā ghuce chāra pāṣaṇḍi-hiẏāẏa |*
*jaṛita antara tāra e biṣṇumāẏāẏa || 3 ||*

*Word for word:* chaturi na ghuche — cunning does not leave; chhara pashandi-hiyaya — the vile hearts of the godless; jadita antara tara — their hearts are entangled; e vishnu-mayaya — in this maya of Vishnu

**3.** Cunning does not leave the vile hearts of the godless:
their hearts are entangled in this maya of Vishnu.[^29-3]

নির্মল হইবে যবে শুনে গোরাগুণ ।
ভবব্যাধি নাশিবারে এই সে কারণ ॥ ৪ ॥

*nirmala haibe yabe śune gorāguṇa |*
*bhababyādhi nāśibāre ei se kāraṇa || 4 ||*

*Word for word:* nirmala haibe — they will become pure; yabe shune gora-guna — when they hear of Gora's qualities; bhava-vyadhi nashibare — to destroy the disease of worldly existence; ei se karana — this is the means

**4.** They will become pure when they hear of Gora's qualities:
this is the means that cures the disease of worldly existence.

একদিন রাত্রি যায় তৃতীয় প্রহর ।
আচম্বিতে রোদন করয়ে বিশ্বম্ভর ॥ ৫ ॥

*ekadina rātri yāẏa tṛtīẏa prahara |*
*ācambite rodana karaẏe biśbambhara || 5 ||*

*Word for word:* ekadina — one day; ratri yaya tritiya prahara — the third watch of the night was passing; achambite — suddenly; rodana karaye vishvambhara — Vishvambhara weeps

**5.** One day, as the third watch of the night was passing,
Vishvambhara suddenly began to weep.

বিস্মিত হইয়া শচী পুছেন পুত্রেরে ।
কি কারণে কান্দ বাপ কহ না আমারে ॥ ৬ ॥

*bismita haiẏā śacī puchena putrere |*
*ki kāraṇe kānda bāpa kaha nā āmāre || 6 ||*

*Word for word:* vismita haiya — astonished; shachi puchhena putrere — Shachi asks her son; ki karane kanda bapa — why do you weep, child; kaha na amare — do tell me

**6.** Astonished, Shachi asks her son:
"Why are you weeping, child? Tell me.

তোমার কান্দনা শুনি' পোড়য়ে শরীর ।
ধরিতে না পারি হিয়া বুকে বাজে তীর ॥ ৭ ॥

*tomāra kāndanā śuni' poṛaẏe śarīra |*
*dharite nā pāri hiẏā buke bāje tīra || 7 ||*

*Word for word:* tomara kandana shuni — hearing your weeping; podaye sharira — my body burns; dharite na pari hiya — I cannot hold my heart; buke baje tira — an arrow strikes my breast

**7.** Hearing your weeping, I burn all over;
I cannot hold my heart — an arrow pierces my breast."

শুনিঞা মায়ের বাণী নিঃশব্দে রহে ।
শয্যায় বসিয়া যে দেখিল স্বপ্ন কহে ॥ ৮ ॥

*śuniñā māẏera bāṇī niḥśabde rahe |*
*śayyāẏa basiẏā ye dekhila sbapna kahe || 8 ||*

*Word for word:* shuninya mayera vani — hearing his mother's words; nihshabde rahe — He remains silent; shayyaya basiya — sitting on the bed; ye dekhila svapna kahe — He tells the dream He saw

**8.** Hearing His mother's words, He is silent,
and then, sitting up on the bed, tells the dream He saw:

নবীন নীরদ-কান্তি দেখিলুঁ পুরুষে ।
ময়ূরপাখার চূড়া অদ্ভুত ময়ূখে ॥ ৯ ॥

*nabīna nīrada-kānti dekhiluṁ puruṣe |*
*maẏūrapākhāra cūṛā adbhuta maẏūkhe || 9 ||*

*Word for word:* navina nirada-kanti — with the lustre of a fresh raincloud; dekhilun purushe — I saw a Person; mayura-pakhara chuda — a crest of peacock feathers; adbhuta mayukhe — of wondrous radiance

**9.** "I saw a Person shining like a fresh raincloud,
with a crest of peacock feathers, wondrously radiant;

কঙ্কণ কেয়ূর হার চরণে নূপুর ।
ললাটে চন্দন-চাঁদ কিরণ প্রচুর ॥ ১০ ॥

*kaṅkaṇa keẏūra hāra caraṇe nūpura |*
*lalāṭe candana-cāṁda kiraṇa pracura || 10 ||*

*Word for word:* kankana keyura hara — bracelets, armlets, necklace; charane nupura — anklets on His feet; lalate chandana-chanda — a moon of sandal on His forehead; kirana prachura — richly shining

**10.** bracelets, armlets, a necklace, bells on His feet,
on His forehead a moon of sandal, richly shining;

পীতবস্ত্র-পরিধান বংশী বামকরে ।
দেখিলুঁ সুন্দর এক হরিষ-অন্তরে ॥ ১১ ॥

*pītabastra-paridhāna baṃśī bāmakare |*
*dekhiluṁ sundara eka hariṣa-antare || 11 ||*

*Word for word:* pita-vastra-paridhana — clad in yellow; bamshi vama-kare — a flute in His left hand; dekhilun sundara eka — I saw a Beautiful One; harisha-antare — with a joyful heart

**11.** clad in yellow, with a flute in His left hand —
such a Beautiful One I saw, and My heart rejoiced."

রোদন করয়ে আঁখি গলে অশ্রুধার ।
না কহিও কেহো যেন না শুনয়ে আর ॥ ১২ ॥

*rodana karaẏe āṁkhi gale aśrudhāra |*
*nā kahio keho yena nā śunaẏe āra || 12 ||*

*Word for word:* rodana karaye — He weeps; ankhi gale ashru-dhara — streams of tears flow from His eyes; na kahio — do not tell; keho yena na shunaye ara — let no one else hear

**12.** He weeps, streams of tears flow from His eyes:
"Do not tell anyone, so that no one else may hear."

ঐছন বচন শুনি' শচী আনন্দিতা ।
বিশ্বম্ভর-মুখোদিত অমৃতের কথা ॥ ১৩ ॥

*aichana bacana śuni' śacī ānanditā |*
*biśbambhara-mukhodita amṛtera kathā || 13 ||*

*Word for word:* aichhana bachana shuni — hearing such words; shachi anandita — Shachi rejoiced; vishvambhara-mukhodita — risen from Vishvambhara's lips; amritera katha — nectarean words

**13.** Hearing such words, the nectarean speech
risen from Vishvambhara's lips, Shachi rejoiced.

বিশ্বম্ভর পুলকে পূরিত সব দেহ ।
ঝলমল করে অঙ্গ-ছটায় সব গেহ ॥ ১৪ ॥

*biśbambhara pulake pūrita saba deha |*
*jhalamala kare aṅga-chaṭāẏa saba geha || 14 ||*

*Word for word:* vishvambhara — Vishvambhara's; pulake purita saba deha — whole body is filled with thrills; jhalamala kare — glitters; anga-chhataya — with the radiance of His body; saba geha — the whole house

**14.** Vishvambhara's whole body is filled with thrills,
and the whole house glitters with the radiance of His body.[^29-4]

হেনকালে নিত্যানন্দ অবধূত রায় ।
শ্রীনিবাস-ঘর হৈতে মিলিলা তথায় ॥ ১৫ ॥

*henakāle nityānanda abadhūta rāẏa |*
*śrīnibāsa-ghara haite mililā tathāẏa || 15 ||*

*Word for word:* henakale — at that time; nityananda avadhuta raya — Nityananda the Avadhuta-raya; shrinivasa-ghara haite — from Srinivasa's house; milila tathaya — arrived there

**15.** At that time Nityananda the Avadhuta-raya
came there from Srinivasa's house.

আসিয়া দেখিল প্রভুর সুন্দর শরীর ।
তেজোময় মহাবাহু এ নাভি গভীর ॥ ১৬ ॥

*āsiẏā dekhila prabhura sundara śarīra |*
*tejomaẏa mahābāhu e nābhi gabhīra || 16 ||*

*Word for word:* asiya dekhila — coming, He saw; prabhura sundara sharira — the Lord's beautiful body; tejomaya mahabahu — radiant, mighty-armed; e nabhi gabhira — with a deep navel

**16.** Coming, He saw the Lord's beautiful body:
radiant, mighty-armed, with a deep navel;

দক্ষিণ করেতে গদা বামকরে বেণু ।
করতলে পদ্ম বামকরতলে ধনু ॥ ১৭ ॥

*dakṣiṇa karete gadā bāmakare beṇu |*
*karatale padma bāmakaratale dhanu || 17 ||*

*Word for word:* dakshina karete gada — a club in His right hand; vama-kare venu — a flute in His left hand; karatale padma — a lotus in His palm; vama-karatale dhanu — a bow in His left palm

**17.** in His right hand a club, in His left hand a flute,
in His palm a lotus, in His left palm a bow;

তপতকাঞ্চন-কান্তি হৃদয়ে কৌস্তুভ ।
মকর-কুণ্ডল দুই শোভে গণ্ডযুগ ॥ ১৮ ॥

*tapatakāñcana-kānti hṛdaẏe kaustubha |*
*makara-kuṇḍala dui śobhe gaṇḍayuga || 18 ||*

*Word for word:* tapata-kanchana-kanti — the lustre of molten gold; hridaye kaustubha — the Kaustubha on His breast; makara-kundala dui — two makara-shaped earrings; shobhe ganda-yuga — adorn His cheeks

**18.** His lustre like molten gold, the Kaustubha on His breast,
two makara-shaped earrings adorning His cheeks;

মরকত-দ্যুতি হার শোভয়ে গলায় ।
অদ্ভুত বেশ দেখি' অবধূত রায় ॥ ১৯ ॥

*marakata-dyuti hāra śobhaẏe galāẏa |*
*adbhuta beśa dekhi' abadhūta rāẏa || 19 ||*

*Word for word:* marakata-dyuti hara — a necklace with the lustre of emerald; shobhaye galaya — adorns His neck; adbhuta vesha dekhi — seeing the wondrous attire; avadhuta raya — the Avadhuta-raya

**19.** a necklace with the lustre of emerald adorning His neck —
such wondrous attire the Avadhuta-raya beholds.

চতুর্ভুজ দেখি' ধনু মুরলিকা নাই ।
সেইমত রূপ সব বর চারি বাই ॥ ২০ ॥

*caturbhuja dekhi' dhanu muralikā nāi |*
*seimata rūpa saba bara cāri bāi || 20 ||*

*Word for word:* chaturbhuja dekhi — He sees Him four-armed; dhanu muralika nai — without bow and flute; seimata rupa saba — the form all the same; vara chari bai — with four excellent arms

**20.** Then He sees Him four-armed — without the bow and flute:
the form all the same, with four excellent arms.

ক্ষণেক অন্তরে দেখে দ্বিভুজ-আকার ।
লোক-অনুগ্রহ-রূপ চরিত্র তাহার ॥ ২১ ॥

*kṣaṇeka antare dekhe dbibhuja-ākāra |*
*loka-anugraha-rūpa caritra tāhāra || 21 ||*

*Word for word:* kshaneka antare — a moment later; dekhe dvibhuja-akara — He sees the two-armed form; loka-anugraha-rupa — a form of grace to the world; charitra tahara — and His deeds

**21.** A moment later He sees Him two-armed —
in a form and deeds gracious to the world.[^29-5]

এ রূপ দেখিয়া সেই অবধূত রায় ।
নিজজনে আলিঙ্গন দিয়া নাচে গায় ॥ ২২ ॥

*e rūpa dekhiẏā sei abadhūta rāẏa |*
*nijajane āliṅgana diẏā nāce gāẏa || 22 ||*

*Word for word:* e rupa dekhiya — seeing this form; sei avadhuta raya — the Avadhuta-raya; nijajane alingana diya — embracing His own; nache gaya — dances and sings

**22.** Seeing this form, the Avadhuta-raya
embraces His own, dances and sings.

আবেশে নাচেন সেই বিবশ হইয়া ।
প্রেম-মহাজলনিধি প্রবেশ করিয়া ॥ ২৩ ॥

*ābeśe nācena sei bibaśa haiẏā |*
*prema-mahājalanidhi prabeśa kariẏā || 23 ||*

*Word for word:* aveshe nachena — He dances in rapture; sei vibasha haiya — beside Himself; prema-maha-jalanidhi — into the great ocean of prema; pravesha kariya — plunging

**23.** In rapture He dances, beside Himself,
plunged into the great ocean of prema.

শ্রীনিবাস নারায়ণ রাম মুরারি ।
ইহা সঙ্গে তোমরা চলহ জনা চারি ॥ ২৪ ॥

*śrīnibāsa nārāẏaṇa rāma murāri |*
*ihā saṅge tomarā calaha janā cāri || 24 ||*

*Word for word:* shrinivasa narayana rama murari — Srinivasa, Narayana, Rama, Murari; iha sange — with Him; tomara chalaha — you go; jana chari — the four of you

**24.** [The Lord said:] "Srinivasa, Narayana, Rama, Murari,
go, the four of you, with Him.

অদ্বৈত-আচার্য-বাড়ী যাব অবধূত ।
ইহা জানাইহ ইহো বড় অদ্ভুত ॥ ২৫ ॥

*adbaita-ācārya-bāṛī yāba abadhūta |*
*ihā jānāiha iho baṛa adbhuta || 25 ||*

*Word for word:* advaita-acharya-badi — to the house of Advaita Acharya; yaba avadhuta — the Avadhuta will go; iha janaiha — announce this; iho bada adbhuta — He is a great wonder

**25.** The Avadhuta will go to the house of Advaita Acharya —
let Him know of it: He is a great wonder."

হেনমতে মহাপ্রভু আজ্ঞা যবে কৈল ।
শুনি' সর্বজন-হিয়া আনন্দিত হৈল ॥ ২৬ ॥

*henamate mahāprabhu ājñā yabe kaila |*
*śuni' sarbajana-hiẏā ānandita haila || 26 ||*

*Word for word:* henamate — thus; mahaprabhu ajna yabe kaila — when Mahaprabhu gave the command; shuni — hearing; sarvajana-hiya — the hearts of all; anandita haila — rejoiced

**26.** When Mahaprabhu gave this command,
the hearts of all who heard it rejoiced.

নিত্যানন্দ-সঙ্গে সভে চলিলা সত্বর ।
আনন্দ-হৃদয়ে গেলা আচার্যের ঘর ॥ ২৭ ॥

*nityānanda-saṅge sabhe calilā satbara |*
*ānanda-hṛdaẏe gelā ācāryera ghara || 27 ||*

*Word for word:* nityananda-sange — with Nityananda; sabhe chalila satvara — all set off quickly; ananda-hridaye — with joyful hearts; gela acharyera ghara — went to the Acharya's house

**27.** All set off quickly with Nityananda
and with joyful hearts came to the Acharya's house.

পরণাম করি' কথা কহিল সকল ।
শুনিঞা আচার্য সুখে নাচয়ে বিহ্বল ॥ ২৮ ॥

*paraṇāma kari' kathā kahila sakala |*
*śuniñā ācārya sukhe nācaẏe bihbala || 28 ||*

*Word for word:* paranama kari — bowing down; katha kahila sakala — they told everything; shuninya acharya — hearing, the Acharya; sukhe nachaye vihvala — dances in bliss, overwhelmed

**28.** Bowing down, they told everything;
hearing it, the Acharya dances in bliss, beside Himself.

দোঁহে দোঁহা আলিঙ্গন করয়ে আনন্দে ।
আচার্য নাচয়ে সুখে নাচে নিত্যানন্দে ॥ ২৯ ॥

*doṁhe doṁhā āliṅgana karaẏe ānande |*
*ācārya nācaẏe sukhe nāce nityānande || 29 ||*

*Word for word:* donhe donha alingana karaye — they embrace each other; anande — in joy; acharya nachaye sukhe — the Acharya dances happily; nache nityanande — Nityananda dances

**29.** Both joyfully embrace each other:
the Acharya dances happily, Nityananda dances.

আনন্দ-সমুদ্রে সুখে ডুবিলা নির্ভরে ।
ঘন ঘন হুহুঙ্কার উঠয়ে হিল্লোলে ॥ ৩০ ॥

*ānanda-samudre sukhe ḍubilā nirbhare |*
*ghana ghana huhuṅkāra uṭhaẏe hillole || 30 ||*

*Word for word:* ananda-samudre — in the ocean of bliss; sukhe dubila nirbhare — they sank wholly in happiness; ghana ghana huhunkara — again and again the roar "hum!"; uthaye hillole — rises in waves

**30.** Happily They sank wholly into the ocean of bliss:
again and again roars of "hum!" rise up in waves.

দোঁহে গুপ্তকথা কহে গৌরাঙ্গ-চরিত ।
কহিতে শুনিতে দোঁহে উনমত-চিত ॥ ৩১ ॥

*doṁhe guptakathā kahe gaurāṅga-carita |*
*kahite śunite doṁhe unamata-cita || 31 ||*

*Word for word:* donhe gupta-katha kahe — both speak confidentially; gauranga-charita — of Gauranga's deeds; kahite shunite — telling and hearing; donhe unamata-chita — both are enraptured at heart

**31.** Both speak confidentially of Gauranga's deeds;
telling and hearing, both are enraptured at heart.

এইমত আনন্দে আছিলা দিন দুই ।
আনন্দে বৈষ্ণব সব গোরাগুণ গাই ॥ ৩২ ॥

*eimata ānande āchilā dina dui |*
*ānande baiṣṇaba saba gorāguṇa gāi || 32 ||*

*Word for word:* eimata — thus; anande achhila dina dui — they spent two days in joy; anande vaishnava saba — all the Vaishnavas joyfully; gora-guna gai — singing of Gora's qualities

**32.** So they spent two days in joy;
all the Vaishnavas joyfully sang of Gora's qualities.

অদ্বৈত-চরণে পুনঃ নিবেদন করি' ।
চলিলা সত্বরে দেখিবারে গৌরহরি ॥ ৩৩ ॥

*adbaita-caraṇe punaḥ nibedana kari' |*
*calilā satbare dekhibāre gaurahari || 33 ||*

*Word for word:* advaita-charane — at Advaita's feet; punah nivedana kari — again submitting [their request]; chalila satvare — they set off quickly; dekhibare gaurahari — to see Gaurahari

**33.** Again respectfully asking leave at Advaita's feet,
they hurried to see Gaurahari.

প্রভুর সম্মুখে আসি' পরণাম করি' ।
করজোড় করি' সব কহয়ে মুরারি ॥ ৩৪ ॥

*prabhura sammukhe āsi' paraṇāma kari' |*
*karajoṛa kari' saba kahaẏe murāri || 34 ||*

*Word for word:* prabhura sammukhe asi — coming before the Lord; paranama kari — bowing down; karajoda kari — with joined palms; saba kahaye murari — Murari tells everything

**34.** Coming before the Lord and bowing down,
with joined palms Murari tells everything:

আচার্যের ঘরে যত হৈল রহস্য ।
শুনি' আনন্দিত প্রভু উপজিল হাস্য ॥ ৩৫ ॥

*ācāryera ghare yata haila rahasya |*
*śuni' ānandita prabhu upajila hāsya || 35 ||*

*Word for word:* acharyera ghare — in the Acharya's house; yata haila rahasya — all the confidential play that took place; shuni — hearing; anandita prabhu — the Lord was delighted; upajila hasya — laughter arose

**35.** all the confidential play that took place in the Acharya's house;
hearing it, the Lord was delighted and laughed.[^29-6]

তার-পর-দিনে পুনঃ আপনে আচার্য ।
পাদাম্বুজ দেখিতে আইলা দ্বিজবর্য ॥ ৩৬ ॥

*tāra-para-dine punaḥ āpane ācārya |*
*pādāmbuja dekhite āilā dbijabarya || 36 ||*

*Word for word:* tara-para-dine — the next day; punah apane acharya — the Acharya Himself; padambuja dekhite — to see the lotus feet; aila dvijavarya — came, the best of brahmanas

**36.** The next day the Acharya Himself, the best of brahmanas,
came to see His lotus feet.

শ্রীনিবাস-পণ্ডিতের ঘরে মহাপ্রভু ।
দেবতার ঘর মধ্যে বসি' হাসে লহু ॥ ৩৭ ॥

*śrīnibāsa-paṇḍitera ghare mahāprabhu |*
*debatāra ghara madhye basi' hāse lahu || 37 ||*

*Word for word:* shrinivasa-panditera ghare — in Srinivasa Pandita's house; mahaprabhu — Mahaprabhu; devatara ghara madhye — in the shrine room; basi hase lahu — sitting, smiles gently

**37.** In the house of Srinivasa Pandita Mahaprabhu
sits in the shrine room, smiling gently.

দিব্যাসনে পহুঁ বসিয়াছে মহাসুখে ।
ঝলমল করে ঘর অঙ্গের ছটাকে ॥ ৩৮ ॥

*dibyāsane pahuṁ basiẏāche mahāsukhe |*
*jhalamala kare ghara aṅgera chaṭāke || 38 ||*

*Word for word:* divya-asane — on a divine seat; pahu basiyachhe — the Lord is seated; maha-sukhe — in great joy; jhalamala kare ghara — the room glitters; angera chhatake — with the radiance of His body

**38.** The Lord sits in great joy on a divine seat;
the room glitters with the radiance of His body.

তপত-কাঞ্চন যেন শ্রীঅঙ্গের ছবি ।
প্রেমার অরুণ যেন প্রভাতের রবি ॥ ৩৯ ॥

*tapata-kāñcana yena śrīaṅgera chabi |*
*premāra aruṇa yena prabhātera rabi || 39 ||*

*Word for word:* tapata-kanchana yena — like molten gold; shri-angera chhavi — the beauty of His holy body; premara aruna — ruddy with prema; yena prabhatera ravi — like the morning sun

**39.** The beauty of His holy body is like molten gold,
ruddy with prema, like the morning sun.

দিব্য অলঙ্কার মালা সুগন্ধি চন্দন ।
পূর্ণিমার চন্দ্র জিনি' সুন্দর বদন ॥ ৪০ ॥

*dibya alaṅkāra mālā sugandhi candana |*
*pūrṇimāra candra jini' sundara badana || 40 ||*

*Word for word:* divya alankara mala — divine ornaments, garlands; sugandhi chandana — fragrant sandal; purnimara chandra jini — surpassing the full moon; sundara vadana — His beautiful face

**40.** Divine ornaments, garlands, fragrant sandal;
His beautiful face surpasses the full moon.

গদাধর নরহরি দুইদিগে রহে ।
শ্রীরঘুনন্দন যে শ্রীমুখচন্দ্র চাহে ॥ ৪১ ॥

*gadādhara narahari duidige rahe |*
*śrīraghunandana ye śrīmukhacandra cāhe || 41 ||*

*Word for word:* gadadhara narahari — Gadadhara and Narahari; duidige rahe — stand on both sides; shri-raghunandana — Sri Raghunandana; ye shri-mukha-chandra chahe — gazes at the moon of His face

**41.** Gadadhara and Narahari stand on both sides,
and Sri Raghunandana gazes at the moon of His face.[^29-7]

চৌদিগে বেঢ়িয়া ভক্তগণ তার পাশে ।
নক্ষত্র বেঢ়িল যেন দ্বিজরাজ হাসে ॥ ৪২ ॥

*caudige beṛhiẏā bhaktagaṇa tāra pāśe |*
*nakṣatra beṛhila yena dbijarāja hāse || 42 ||*

*Word for word:* chaudige bedhiya — surrounding on all sides; bhaktagana tara pashe — the devotees beside Him; nakshatra bedhila yena — as if surrounded by stars; dvijaraja hase — the moon shines

**42.** All around Him are the devotees,
like the shining moon in a ring of stars.

নিত্যানন্দ বসিয়া সম্মুখে প্রেমানন্দে ।
বদন হেরিয়া ঘন ঘন হাসে কান্দে ॥ ৪৩ ॥

*nityānanda basiẏā sammukhe premānande |*
*badana heriẏā ghana ghana hāse kānde || 43 ||*

*Word for word:* nityananda basiya sammukhe — Nityananda, sitting before Him; premanande — in the bliss of prema; vadana heriya — gazing at [His] face; ghana ghana hase kande — again and again laughs and weeps

**43.** Nityananda, sitting before Him in the bliss of prema,
gazes at His face and again and again laughs and weeps.

হেনই সময়ে দেখি' আচার্য দ্বিজচাঁদ ।
ঘন ঘন হুহুঙ্কার ছাড়ে সিংহনাদ ॥ ৪৪ ॥

*henai samaẏe dekhi' ācārya dbijacāṁda |*
*ghana ghana huhuṅkāra chāṛe siṃhanāda || 44 ||*

*Word for word:* henai samaye — at that very time; dekhi — seeing [Him]; acharya dvija-chanda — the Acharya, moon among brahmanas; ghana ghana huhunkara — again and again "hum!"; chhade simhanada — lets out a lion's roar

**44.** At that very time, seeing [Him], the Acharya, the moon among brahmanas,
again and again roars "hum!" and lets out a lion's roar.

পুলকে ভরিল অঙ্গ আপাদ-মস্তক ।
ব্রহ্মাণ্ডে না ধরে তার অন্তর-কৌতুক ॥ ৪৫ ॥

*pulake bharila aṅga āpāda-mastaka |*
*brahmāṇḍe nā dhare tāra antara-kautuka || 45 ||*

*Word for word:* pulake bharila anga — His body filled with thrills; apada-mastaka — from feet to head; brahmande na dhare — the universe cannot contain; tara antara-kautuka — the joy of His heart

**45.** His body from feet to head filled with thrills;
the universe cannot contain the joy of His heart.

নিবেদন কৈল দ্বিজ নানা উপায়ন ।
পাদাম্বুজে দিল নব্য দিব্য যে বসন ॥ ৪৬ ॥

*nibedana kaila dbija nānā upāẏana |*
*pādāmbuje dila nabya dibya ye basana || 46 ||*

*Word for word:* nivedana kaila dvija — the brahmana offered; nana upayana — various gifts; padambuje dila — placed at the lotus feet; navya divya ye basana — new divine garments

**46.** The brahmana offered various gifts
and laid new divine garments at His lotus feet.

তুলসী-মঞ্জরী দিয়া পূজিল চরণ ।
সুগন্ধি মালতীর মালা সুগন্ধি চন্দন ॥ ৪৭ ॥

*tulasī-mañjarī diẏā pūjila caraṇa |*
*sugandhi mālatīra mālā sugandhi candana || 47 ||*

*Word for word:* tulasi-manjari diya — with tulasi blossoms; pujila charana — He worshipped the feet; sugandhi malatira mala — with a fragrant garland of malati; sugandhi chandana — with fragrant sandal

**47.** With tulasi blossoms He worshipped His feet,
with a fragrant garland of malati and with fragrant sandal.

দণ্ড-পরণাম করে ভূমিতে পড়িয়া ।
আপনে সে মহাপ্রভু তুলিলা ধরিয়া ॥ ৪৮ ॥

*daṇḍa-paraṇāma kare bhūmite paṛiẏā |*
*āpane se mahāprabhu tulilā dhariẏā || 48 ||*

*Word for word:* danda-paranama kare — He prostrates like a rod; bhumite padiya — falling on the ground; apane se mahaprabhu — Mahaprabhu Himself; tulila dhariya — lifted Him up, taking hold of Him

**48.** He prostrates, falling on the ground like a rod —
and Mahaprabhu Himself lifted Him up.

পূজা পরিগ্রহ করি' গৌর ভগবান্ ।
অবশেষ দিল নিজ ভক্তগণে দান ॥ ৪৯ ॥

*pūjā parigraha kari' gaura bhagabān |*
*abaśeṣa dila nija bhaktagaṇe dāna || 49 ||*

*Word for word:* puja parigraha kari — accepting the worship; gaura bhagavan — Gaura Bhagavan; avashesha dila — gave the remnants; nija bhaktagane dana — as a gift to His devotees

**49.** Accepting the worship, Gaura Bhagavan
gave the remnants as a gift to His devotees.

সেই বস্ত্র অলঙ্কার শোভয়ে শ্রীঅঙ্গে ।
হরি হরি বলি' নাচে তা সভার সঙ্গে ॥ ৫০ ॥

*sei bastra alaṅkāra śobhaẏe śrīaṅge |*
*hari hari bali' nāce tā sabhāra saṅge || 50 ||*

*Word for word:* sei vastra alankara — those garments and ornaments; shobhaye shri-ange — adorn His holy body; hari hari bali — crying "Hari, Hari!"; nache ta sabhara sange — He dances with them all

**50.** Those garments and ornaments adorn His holy body;
crying "Hari, Hari!", He dances with them all.

অদ্বৈত-আচার্য আর নিত্যানন্দরায় ।
শ্রীনিবাস মুরারি মুকুন্দ গুণ গায় ॥ ৫১ ॥

*adbaita-ācārya āra nityānandarāẏa |*
*śrīnibāsa murāri mukunda guṇa gāẏa || 51 ||*

*Word for word:* advaita-acharya ara nityananda-raya — Advaita Acharya and Nityananda-raya; shrinivasa murari mukunda — Srinivasa, Murari, Mukunda; guna gaya — sing His qualities

**51.** Advaita Acharya and Nityananda-raya,
Srinivasa, Murari, Mukunda sing His qualities.

সকল বৈষ্ণব মেলি' আনন্দ-উল্লাসে ।
আপনা পাসরে সভে রসের আবেশে ॥ ৫২ ॥

*sakala baiṣṇaba meli' ānanda-ullāse |*
*āpanā pāsare sabhe rasera ābeśe || 52 ||*

*Word for word:* sakala vaishnava meli — all the Vaishnavas together; ananda-ullase — in joyful exultation; apana pasare sabhe — all forget themselves; rasera aveshe — absorbed in rasa

**52.** All the Vaishnavas together in joyful exultation
forget themselves, absorbed in rasa.

সভে সভা পরশংসে বলে ধন্য ধন্য ।
তুচ্ছ করি' মানে সুখ কৈবল্য নির্বাণ ॥ ৫৩ ॥

*sabhe sabhā paraśaṃse bale dhanya dhanya |*
*tuccha kari' māne sukha kaibalya nirbāṇa || 53 ||*

*Word for word:* sabhe sabha parashamse — all praise one another; bale dhanya dhanya — saying "Blessed, blessed!"; tuchchha kari mane — they deem insignificant; sukha kaivalya nirvana — the happiness of kaivalya and nirvana

**53.** All praise one another: "Blessed, blessed!" —
and deem the happiness of kaivalya and nirvana insignificant.

দিবানিশি না জানয়ে প্রেমানন্দ-সুখে ।
নিয়ত বিহ্বল তারা অন্তর-কৌতুকে ॥ ৫৪ ॥

*dibāniśi nā jānaẏe premānanda-sukhe |*
*niẏata bihbala tārā antara-kautuke || 54 ||*

*Word for word:* divanishi na janaye — they know neither day nor night; premananda-sukhe — in the happiness of prema's bliss; niyata vihvala tara — they are ever overwhelmed; antara-kautuke — with inner joy

**54.** In the happiness of prema's bliss they know neither day nor night,
ever overwhelmed with inner joy.

সূর্যোদয়ে নৃত্যারম্ভ হয়ে ত রজনী ।
সন্ধ্যায় নাচয়ে সে অবধি দিনমণি ॥ ৫৫ ॥

*sūryodaẏe nṛtyārambha haẏe ta rajanī |*
*sandhyāẏa nācaẏe se abadhi dinamaṇi || 55 ||*

*Word for word:* suryodaye nrityarambha — the dance begins at sunrise; haye ta rajani — and night comes; sandhyaya nachaye — they dance from evening; se avadhi dina-mani — until the [next] sun

**55.** The dance begins at sunrise and lasts into the night;
from evening they dance until the next dawn.[^29-8]

হেনমনে রাত্রিদিনে প্রেমানন্দে ভোরা ।
নৃত্য-অবসানে সভে আজ্ঞা দিল গোরা ॥ ৫৬ ॥

*henamane rātridine premānande bhorā |*
*nṛtya-abasāne sabhe ājñā dila gorā || 56 ||*

*Word for word:* henamane — thus; ratridine — night and day; premanande bhora — immersed in the bliss of prema; nritya-avasane — at the end of the dance; sabhe ajna dila gora — Gora commanded all

**56.** So night and day they are immersed in the bliss of prema.
When the dance ended, Gora commanded all:

স্নান দেবার্চনা সভে কর নিজ ঘরে ।
পুনরপি আইস সভে ভোজন-অন্তরে ॥ ৫৭ ॥

*snāna debārcanā sabhe kara nija ghare |*
*punarapi āisa sabhe bhojana-antare || 57 ||*

*Word for word:* snana devarchana — bathing and worship of the Deity; sabhe kara nija ghare — all perform in your own homes; punarapi aisa sabhe — come again, all; bhojana-antare — after the meal

**57.** "Bathe and worship the Deity, all of you, in your own homes,
and after your meal come again."

সেইমত সর্বজন ক্রিয়া সমাধিয়া ।
পাদাম্বুজ-সন্নিকটে মিলিলা আসিয়া ॥ ৫৮ ॥

*seimata sarbajana kriẏā samādhiẏā |*
*pādāmbuja-sannikaṭe mililā āsiẏā || 58 ||*

*Word for word:* seimata sarvajana — so all; kriya samadhiya — having completed their rites; padambuja-sannikate — near the lotus feet; milila asiya — came and assembled

**58.** So all, having completed their rites,
came and assembled at His lotus feet.

হেনই সময়ে মহাশয় হরিদাস ।
কৃষ্ণনামে নিরন্তর অন্তর-উল্লাস ॥ ৫৯ ॥

*henai samaẏe mahāśaẏa haridāsa |*
*kṛṣṇanāme nirantara antara-ullāsa || 59 ||*

*Word for word:* henai samaye — at that very time; mahashaya haridasa — the great-souled Haridasa; krishna-name — in the name of Krishna; nirantara antara-ullasa — ceaseless inner exultation

**59.** At that very time the great-souled Haridasa,
whose heart ceaselessly exults in the name of Krishna —

কৃষ্ণ-পাদাম্বুজ-মধুময় মত্ত ভৃঙ্গ ।
রসের আবেশে হয় তরুণিম সিংহ ॥ ৬০ ॥

*kṛṣṇa-pādāmbuja-madhumaẏa matta bhṛṅga |*
*rasera ābeśe haẏa taruṇima siṃha || 60 ||*

*Word for word:* krishna-padambuja-madhumaya — with the honey of Krishna's lotus feet; matta bhringa — an intoxicated bee; rasera aveshe — in absorption in rasa; haya tarunima simha — he becomes a young lion

**60.** a bee intoxicated with the honey of Krishna's lotus feet,
who in absorption in rasa becomes a young lion —

আচম্বিতে নবদ্বীপে মিলিলা আসিয়া ।
আইস আইস বলি' প্রভু সম্ভাষে হাসিয়া ॥ ৬১ ॥

*ācambite nabadbīpe mililā āsiẏā |*
*āisa āisa bali' prabhu sambhāṣe hāsiẏā || 61 ||*

*Word for word:* achambite — suddenly; navadvipe milila asiya — arrived in Navadvipa; aisa aisa bali — saying "Come, come!"; prabhu sambhashe hasiya — the Lord greets him, laughing

**61.** suddenly arrived in Navadvipa.
"Come, come!" the Lord greets him, laughing.

নির্ভর-প্রেমায় কৈল গাঢ় আলিঙ্গন ।
আদেশিলা মহাপ্রভু বসিতে আসন ॥ ৬২ ॥

*nirbhara-premāẏa kaila gāṛha āliṅgana |*
*ādeśilā mahāprabhu basite āsana || 62 ||*

*Word for word:* nirbhara-premaya — with full love; kaila gadha alingana — embraced him tightly; adeshila mahaprabhu — Mahaprabhu bade; basite asana — to sit on a seat

**62.** With full love He embraced him tightly,
and Mahaprabhu bade him sit down.

চতুর সে হরিদাস পরণাম করে ।
আপনে ঠাকুর তার কর ধরি' তোলে ॥ ৬৩ ॥

*catura se haridāsa paraṇāma kare |*
*āpane ṭhākura tāra kara dhari' tole || 63 ||*

*Word for word:* chatura se haridasa — the wise Haridasa; paranama kare — bows down; apane thakura — the Thakura Himself; tara kara dhari tole — taking his hand, raises him

**63.** The wise Haridasa bows down,
and the Thakura Himself, taking his hand, raises him.

সুগন্ধি চন্দন অঙ্গে লেপিল তাহার ।
অঙ্গের প্রসাদী মালা দিল আপনার ॥ ৬৪ ॥

*sugandhi candana aṅge lepila tāhāra |*
*aṅgera prasādī mālā dila āpanāra || 64 ||*

*Word for word:* sugandhi chandana — with fragrant sandal; ange lepila tahara — anointed his body; angera prasadi mala — the prasada garland from His own body; dila apanara — He gave His own

**64.** He anointed his body with fragrant sandal
and gave him His own prasada garland from His body.

ভোজন করিতে আজ্ঞা দিলেন ঠাকুর ।
ভোজন করিল মহাপ্রসাদ প্রচুর ॥ ৬৫ ॥

*bhojana karite ājñā dilena ṭhākura |*
*bhojana karila mahāprasāda pracura || 65 ||*

*Word for word:* bhojana karite — to eat; ajna dilena thakura — the Thakura bade; bhojana karila — he ate; mahaprasada prachura — abundant mahaprasada

**65.** The Thakura bade him eat,
and he partook of abundant mahaprasada.[^29-9]

এইমতে হরিনাম-গুণ-সংকীর্তন ।
বিলসয়ে মহাপ্রভু আনন্দিত মন ॥ ৬৬ ॥

*eimate harināma-guṇa-saṃkīrtana |*
*bilasaẏe mahāprabhu ānandita mana || 66 ||*

*Word for word:* eimate — thus; hari-nama-guna-sankirtana — in the sankirtana of Hari's name and qualities; vilasaye mahaprabhu — Mahaprabhu delights; anandita mana — with a joyful heart

**66.** So Mahaprabhu with a joyful heart
delights in the sankirtana of Hari's name and qualities,

হরিদাস অদ্বৈত-আচার্য নিত্যানন্দ ।
শ্রীনিবাস-আদি যত নিজজনবৃন্দ ॥ ৬৭ ॥

*haridāsa adbaita-ācārya nityānanda |*
*śrīnibāsa-ādi yata nijajanabṛnda || 67 ||*

*Word for word:* haridasa advaita-acharya nityananda — Haridasa, Advaita Acharya, Nityananda; shrinivasa-adi — Srinivasa and others; yata nijajana-vrinda — all His own

**67.** [with Him] Haridasa, Advaita Acharya, Nityananda,
Srinivasa and all the rest of His own.

প্রেমানন্দ-কৌতুকে গোঙাইল দিনরাতি ।
আচার্যে বিদায় দিল ঘর যাহ আজি ॥ ৬৮ ॥

*premānanda-kautuke goṅāila dinarāti |*
*ācārye bidāẏa dila ghara yāha āji || 68 ||*

*Word for word:* premananda-kautuke — in joyful play of prema's bliss; gongaila dinarati — they passed days and nights; acharye vidaya dila — He bade the Acharya farewell; ghara yaha aji — go home today

**68.** Days and nights they passed in joyful play of prema's bliss.
[At last the Lord] dismissed the Acharya: "Go home today."

আজ্ঞা পাই' অদ্বৈত-আচার্য ঘর গেলা ।
যে দেখিল যে শুনিল সেই সুখে ভোলা ॥ ৬৯ ॥

*ājñā pāi' adbaita-ācārya ghara gelā |*
*ye dekhila ye śunila sei sukhe bholā || 69 ||*

*Word for word:* ajna pai — receiving the command; advaita-acharya ghara gela — Advaita Acharya went home; ye dekhila ye shunila — what He had seen and heard; sei sukhe bhola — lost in that happiness

**69.** Receiving the command, Advaita Acharya went home,
lost in happiness at all He had seen and heard.

তবে সেই নিত্যানন্দ অবধূতরায় ।
প্রভু-বিদ্যমানে তেঁহো হইলা বিদায় ॥ ৭০ ॥

*tabe sei nityānanda abadhūtarāẏa |*
*prabhu-bidyamāne teṁho hailā bidāẏa || 70 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe — then; sei nityananda avadhuta-raya — Nityananda the Avadhuta-raya; prabhu-vidyamane — before the Lord; tenho haila vidaya — took His leave

**70.** Then Nityananda the Avadhuta-raya
took leave of the Lord.

তার সঙ্গে অনুব্রজি' চলিলা ঠাকুর ।
প্রেমে পালটিতে নারে গেলা বহুদূর ॥ ৭১ ॥

*tāra saṅge anubraji' calilā ṭhākura |*
*preme pālaṭite nāre gelā bahudūra || 71 ||*

*Word for word:* tara sange — with Him; anuvraji chalila thakura — the Thakura went along to see Him off; preme palatite nare — from love cannot turn back; gela bahudura — went far

**71.** The Thakura went along to see Him off;
from love He cannot turn back and went far.

ছাড়িয়া যাইতে নারে অবধূতরায় ।
অনেক যতনে তেঁহো করিলা বিদায় ॥ ৭২ ॥

*chāṛiẏā yāite nāre abadhūtarāẏa |*
*aneka yatane teṁho karilā bidāẏa || 72 ||*

*Word for word:* chhadiya yaite nare — cannot leave [Him] and go; avadhuta-raya — the Avadhuta-raya; aneka yatane — with great effort; tenho karila vidaya — He took leave

**72.** The Avadhuta-raya cannot bring Himself to leave [Him] and go;
with great effort He took His leave.

বিদায়-সময়ে প্রভু কহে এক বাণী ।
এ সভারে দেহ ত কৌপীন একখানি ॥ ৭৩ ॥

*bidāẏa-samaẏe prabhu kahe eka bāṇī |*
*e sabhāre deha ta kaupīna ekakhāni || 73 ||*

*Word for word:* vidaya-samaye — at the time of parting; prabhu kahe eka vani — the Lord speaks a word; e sabhare — to all these; deha ta kaupina ekakhani — give one kaupina

**73.** At the parting the Lord says:
"Give them all one kaupina."

প্রভুর বচনে সে ঠাকুর অবধূত ।
সভাকারে দিলেন কৌপীন অদ্ভুত ॥ ৭৪ ॥

*prabhura bacane se ṭhākura abadhūta |*
*sabhākāre dilena kaupīna adbhuta || 74 ||*

*Word for word:* prabhura bachane — at the Lord's word; se thakura avadhuta — the Thakura Avadhuta; sabhakare dilena — gave for all; kaupina adbhuta — a wondrous kaupina

**74.** At the Lord's word the Thakura Avadhuta
gave them all a wondrous kaupina.

আপনে কৌপীন প্রভু নিল ত হাসিয়া ।
নিজভক্তজনে দিল সভারে বাঁটিয়া ॥ ৭৫ ॥

*āpane kaupīna prabhu nila ta hāsiẏā |*
*nijabhaktajane dila sabhāre bāṁṭiẏā || 75 ||*

*Word for word:* apane kaupina prabhu — the Lord Himself the kaupina; nila ta hasiya — took, laughing; nija-bhakta-jane — to His devotees; dila sabhare bantiya — dividing it, gave to all

**75.** The Lord Himself, laughing, took the kaupina,
divided it and gave it to all His devotees.

কৌপীন-প্রসাদ তারা পাইয়া কৌতুকে ।
আনন্দ করিয়া সভে বান্ধিল মস্তকে ॥ ৭৬ ॥

*kaupīna-prasāda tārā pāiẏā kautuke |*
*ānanda kariẏā sabhe bāndhila mastake || 76 ||*

*Word for word:* kaupina-prasada — the kaupina as prasada; tara paiya kautuke — receiving it joyfully; ananda kariya — rejoicing; sabhe bandhila mastake — all tied it on their heads

**76.** Receiving this kaupina joyfully as grace,
all, rejoicing, tied it on their heads.[^29-10]

নিত্যানন্দ-পাদাম্বুজে লইয়া বিদায় ।
প্রভুর সংহতি তারা নিজ ঘরে যায় ॥ ৭৭ ॥

*nityānanda-pādāmbuje laiẏā bidāẏa |*
*prabhura saṃhati tārā nija ghare yāẏa || 77 ||*

*Word for word:* nityananda-padambuje — at Nityananda's lotus feet; laiya vidaya — taking leave; prabhura samhati — together with the Lord; tara nija ghare yaya — they go home

**77.** Taking leave at Nityananda's lotus feet,
they go home together with the Lord.

ঘরেরে আইলা সভে দুঃখিত-হৃদয় ।
বাষ্প-ছলছল আঁখি বসিলা আলয় ॥ ৭৮ ॥

*gharere āilā sabhe duḥkhita-hṛdaẏa |*
*bāṣpa-chalachala āṁkhi basilā ālaẏa || 78 ||*

*Word for word:* gharere aila sabhe — all came home; duhkhita-hridaya — with sorrowful hearts; bashpa-chhalachhala ankhi — eyes brimming with tears; basila alaya — they sat in the house

**78.** All came home with sorrowful hearts
and sit in their houses, their eyes brimming with tears.

কথোক্ষণে সভে স্নান-দেবার্চন করি' ।
সন্ধ্যাকালে আইলা দেখিবারে গৌরহরি ॥ ৭৯ ॥

*kathokṣaṇe sabhe snāna-debārcana kari' |*
*sandhyākāle āilā dekhibāre gaurahari || 79 ||*

*Word for word:* kathokshane — after a while; sabhe snana-devarchana kari — all, having bathed and worshipped the Deity; sandhya-kale aila — came in the evening; dekhibare gaurahari — to see Gaurahari

**79.** After a while, having bathed and worshipped the Deity,
in the evening all came to see Gaurahari.

নিত্যানন্দ আইলা আচার্য-গোসাঞির স্থানে ।
হরিষে গোরা-কথা কহে রাতিদিনে ॥ ৮০ ॥

*nityānanda āilā ācārya-gosāñira sthāne |*
*hariṣe gorā-kathā kahe rātidine || 80 ||*

*Word for word:* nityananda aila — Nityananda came; acharya-gosanyira sthane — to Acharya Gosani; harishe — joyfully; gora-katha kahe ratidine — speaks of Gora day and night

**80.** And Nityananda went to Acharya Gosani
and joyfully speaks of Gora day and night.

তার-পর-দিনে এক কথা শুন সভে ।
শ্রীকৃষ্ণ-চরণে প্রেমভক্তি পাবে তবে ॥ ৮১ ॥

*tāra-para-dine eka kathā śuna sabhe |*
*śrīkṛṣṇa-caraṇe premabhakti pābe tabe || 81 ||*

*Word for word:* tara-para-dine — on the next day; eka katha shuna sabhe — hear, all, a story; shri-krishna-charane — at Sri Krishna's feet; prema-bhakti pabe tabe — then you will attain prema-bhakti

**81.** Hear, all of you, the story of the next day —
then you will attain prema-bhakti at the feet of Sri Krishna.

লোক-বেদ-অগোচর অপরূপ কথা ।
অমৃতের সার এই গোরা-গুণগাথা ॥ ৮২ ॥

*loka-beda-agocara aparūpa kathā |*
*amṛtera sāra ei gorā-guṇagāthā || 82 ||*

*Word for word:* loka-veda-agochara — beyond the reach of the world and the Vedas; aparupa katha — a wondrous story; amritera sara — the essence of nectar; ei gora-guna-gatha — this song of Gora's qualities

**82.** It is a wondrous story, beyond the reach of the world and the Vedas;
this song of Gora's qualities is the essence of nectar.

দেখি' নিজজন প্রভু আলিঙ্গন দিয়া ।
আপনার গুণ শুনি' বুলয়ে নাচিয়া ॥ ৮৩ ॥

*dekhi' nijajana prabhu āliṅgana diẏā |*
*āpanāra guṇa śuni' bulaẏe nāciẏā || 83 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhi nijajana — seeing His own; prabhu alingana diya — the Lord, embracing [them]; apanara guna shuni — hearing of His own qualities; bulaye nachiya — moves about dancing

**83.** Seeing His own, the Lord embraces them
and, hearing of His own qualities, moves about dancing.

চতুর্দিগে সর্বজন সুখে নাচে গায় ।
আনন্দে বিভোর মাঝে নাচে গোরারায় ॥ ৮৪ ॥

*caturdige sarbajana sukhe nāce gāẏa |*
*ānande bibhora mājhe nāce gorārāẏa || 84 ||*

*Word for word:* chaturdige sarvajana — all around, everyone; sukhe nache gaya — happily dance and sing; anande vibhora — absorbed in bliss; majhe nache goraraya — in the middle dances Gora-raya

**84.** All around, everyone happily dances and sings,
and in the middle, absorbed in bliss, Gora-raya dances.

আচম্বিতে শ্রীনিবাস কর ধরি' করে ।
কতি গেলা নাহি জানি প্রভু বিশ্বম্ভরে ॥ ৮৫ ॥

*ācambite śrīnibāsa kara dhari' kare |*
*kati gelā nāhi jāni prabhu biśbambhare || 85 ||*
