*Word for word:* achambite — suddenly; shrinivasa kara dhari kare — taking Srinivasa's hand in His hand; kati gela nahi jani — where He went, no one knows; prabhu vishvambhare — the Lord Vishvambhara

**85.** Suddenly the Lord Vishvambhara, taking Srinivasa by the hand,
went off — no one knows where.

চতুর্দিগে সর্বজন নাচিতে গাইতে ।
মধ্যে মহাপ্রভু নাই না পাই দেখিতে ॥ ৮৬ ॥

*caturdige sarbajana nācite gāite |*
*madhye mahāprabhu nāi nā pāi dekhite || 86 ||*

*Word for word:* chaturdige sarvajana — all around, everyone; nachite gaite — dancing and singing; madhye mahaprabhu nai — Mahaprabhu is not in the middle; na pai dekhite — they cannot see Him

**86.** All around, everyone is dancing and singing,
but Mahaprabhu is not in the middle — He cannot be seen.

সর্বজন উপজিল অন্তরে তরাস ।
কান্দয়ে সকল লোক গণয়ে হতাশ ॥ ৮৭ ॥

*sarbajana upajila antare tarāsa |*
*kāndaẏe sakala loka gaṇaẏe hatāśa || 87 ||*

*Word for word:* sarvajana upajila — in all arose; antare tarasa — fear in the heart; kandaye sakala loka — all the people weep; ganaye hatasha — they reckon [all] lost

**87.** Fear arose in everyone's heart;
all the people weep, reckoning all lost.

ভূমিতে লোটাঞা কান্দে স্থির নাহি বান্ধে ।
নদীয়ার লোক সব গুণ ঝুরি' কান্দে ॥ ৮৮ ॥

*bhūmite loṭāñā kānde sthira nāhi bāndhe |*
*nadīẏāra loka saba guṇa jhuri' kānde || 88 ||*

*Word for word:* bhumite lotanya kande — rolling on the ground they weep; sthira nahi bandhe — they find no calm; nadiyara loka saba — all the people of Nadia; guna jhuri kande — weep, recalling [His] qualities

**88.** Rolling on the ground they weep and find no calm;
all the people of Nadia weep, recalling His qualities.

ধাওয়াধাই সর্বলোক চাহে ঘরে ঘরে ।
আঁখি মেলিবারে নারে নয়নের জলে ॥ ৮৯ ॥

*dhāoẏādhāi sarbaloka cāhe ghare ghare |*
*āṁkhi melibāre nāre naẏanera jale || 89 ||*

*Word for word:* dhaoyadhai sarvaloka — everyone running about; chahe ghare ghare — searches from house to house; ankhi melibare nare — cannot open their eyes; nayanera jale — for the tears

**89.** Everyone runs about searching from house to house,
unable to open their eyes for the tears.

বিষ খাই' সর্বজন মরিব আমরা ।
কি লাগিয়া কতি গেলা আমার প্রভু গোরা ॥ ৯০ ॥

*biṣa khāi' sarbajana mariba āmarā |*
*ki lāgiẏā kati gelā āmāra prabhu gorā || 90 ||*

*Word for word:* visha khai — taking poison; sarvajana mariba amara — we shall all die; ki lagiya — why; kati gela — where has He gone; amara prabhu gora — our Lord Gora

**90.** "We shall take poison and all die!
Why, where has our Lord Gora gone?"

এতেক বিলাপ করে সব নিজজন ।
শুনিঞা ধাইল শচী হঞা অচেতন ॥ ৯১ ॥

*eteka bilāpa kare saba nijajana |*
*śuniñā dhāila śacī hañā acetana || 91 ||*

*Word for word:* eteka vilapa kare — thus lament; saba nijajana — all His own; shuninya dhaila shachi — hearing, Shachi ran; hanya achetana — beside herself

**91.** So lament all His own.
Hearing it, Shachi ran [there], beside herself.

বসন সম্বরে নাহি নাহি বান্ধে চুলি ।
বুকে কর হানি' ধায় উন্মত্ত পাগলী ॥ ৯২ ॥

*basana sambare nāhi nāhi bāndhe culi |*
*buke kara hāni' dhāẏa unmatta pāgalī || 92 ||*

*Word for word:* basana samvare nahi — she does not arrange her clothes; nahi bandhe chuli — does not tie her hair; buke kara hani — beating her breast; dhaya unmatta pagali — runs like a madwoman

**92.** Without arranging her clothes, without tying her hair,
beating her breast, she runs, frantic with grief.

বাপ বাপ ডাক ডাকে বলি' বিশ্বম্ভর ।
ঘরেরে আইস বেলা দ্বিতীয় প্রহর ॥ ৯৩ ॥

*bāpa bāpa ḍāka ḍāke bali' biśbambhara |*
*gharere āisa belā dbitīẏa prahara || 93 ||*

*Word for word:* bapa bapa — "child, child!"; daka dake — she calls aloud; bali vishvambhara — calling Vishvambhara; gharere aisa — come home; bela dvitiya prahara — the time is the second watch

**93.** "Child, child!" she calls aloud to Vishvambhara. —
"Come home: it is already the second watch of the day!

কুলের প্রদীপ মোর নদীয়ার চান্দ ।
নয়ানের তারা মোর কেবা কৈল আন্ধ ॥ ৯৪ ॥

*kulera pradīpa mora nadīẏāra cānda |*
*naẏānera tārā mora kebā kaila āndha || 94 ||*

*Word for word:* kulera pradipa mora — the lamp of my family; nadiyara chanda — the moon of Nadia; nayanera tara mora — the pupils of my eyes; keba kaila andha — who has blinded

**94.** Lamp of my family, moon of Nadia,
pupil of my eyes — who has blinded me?"

সর্বজন-আরতি দেখিয়া বিপরীত ।
ভকতবৎসল প্রভু আইলা আচম্বিত ॥ ৯৫ ॥

*sarbajana-ārati dekhiẏā biparīta |*
*bhakatabatsala prabhu āilā ācambita || 95 ||*

*Word for word:* sarvajana-arati — the anguish of all; dekhiya viparita — seeing it so extreme; bhakatavatsala prabhu — the Lord, affectionate to His devotees; aila achambita — suddenly came

**95.** Seeing the extreme anguish of all,
the Lord, affectionate to His devotees, suddenly came.

ঘোর অন্ধকারে যেন সূর্যের উদয় ।
প্রকাশ করিল প্রভু বৈষ্ণব-হৃদয় ॥ ৯৬ ॥

*ghora andhakāre yena sūryera udaẏa |*
*prakāśa karila prabhu baiṣṇaba-hṛdaẏa || 96 ||*

*Word for word:* ghora andhakare — in pitch darkness; yena suryera udaya — like the rising of the sun; prakasha karila prabhu — the Lord illumined; vaishnava-hridaya — the hearts of the Vaishnavas

**96.** As the sun rises in pitch darkness,
so the Lord illumined the hearts of the Vaishnavas.

চরণে পড়িয়া কেহ কান্দে আর্তনাদে ।
শ্রীমুখ দেখিয়া কেহো নাচে উনমাদে ॥ ৯৭ ॥

*caraṇe paṛiẏā keha kānde ārtanāde |*
*śrīmukha dekhiẏā keho nāce unamāde || 97 ||*

*Word for word:* charane padiya — falling at His feet; keha kande artanade — some weep with cries of anguish; shri-mukha dekhiya — seeing His holy face; keho nache unamade — some dance in rapture

**97.** Some, falling at His feet, weep with cries of anguish;
some, seeing His holy face, dance in rapture.

কেহো বোলে মহাপ্রভু তোর পদ বিনে ।
অন্ধকার দশদিগ না দেখি নয়নে ॥ ৯৮ ॥

*keho bole mahāprabhu tora pada bine |*
*andhakāra daśadiga nā dekhi naẏane || 98 ||*

*Word for word:* keho bole — some say; mahaprabhu — O Mahaprabhu; tora pada vine — without Your feet; andhakara dashadiga — darkness in all ten directions; na dekhi nayane — we see nothing with our eyes

**98.** Some say: "Mahaprabhu, without Your feet
there is darkness in all ten directions — we see nothing with our eyes."

উন্মতি পাগলী শচী পুত্র কোলে করে ।
লক্ষ লক্ষ চুম্ব দেই বদন-কমলে ॥ ৯৯ ॥

*unmati pāgalī śacī putra kole kare |*
*lakṣa lakṣa cumba dei badana-kamale || 99 ||*

*Word for word:* unmati pagali shachi — Shachi, like one mad; putra kole kare — takes her son in her arms; laksha laksha chumba dei — gives hundreds of thousands of kisses; vadana-kamale — to [His] lotus face

**99.** Shachi, beside herself with love, takes her son in her arms
and showers His lotus face with hundreds of thousands of kisses:

আন্ধলের লড়ি মোর দু-আঁখির তারা ।
এ দেহের আত্মা তোমা বহি নাহি মোরা ॥ ১০০ ॥

*āndhalera laṛi mora du-āṁkhira tārā |*
*e dehera ātmā tomā bahi nāhi morā || 100 ||*

*Word for word:* andhalera ladi mora — my staff, the blind woman's; du-ankhira tara — the pupils of both my eyes; e dehera atma — the soul of this body; toma vahi nahi mora — apart from you I have none

**100.** "You are my staff — the blind woman's — the pupil of both my eyes,
the soul of this body; apart from you I have no one.

শূন্য হইয়াছিল মোর সকল সংসার ।
গোরাচান্দ-উদয়ে ঘুচিল অন্ধকার ॥ ১০১ ॥

*śūnya haiẏāchila mora sakala saṃsāra |*
*gorācānda-udaẏe ghucila andhakāra || 101 ||*

*Word for word:* shunya haiyachhila — had become empty; mora sakala samsara — my whole world; gorachanda-udaye — at the rising of Gorachand; ghuchila andhakara — the darkness vanished

**101.** My whole world had become empty —
with the rising of Gorachand the darkness vanished."[^29-11]

মুরারি মুকুন্দদত্ত আর হরিদাস ।
বিনয় করিয়া কহে শুন শ্রীনিবাস ॥ ১০২ ॥

*murāri mukundadatta āra haridāsa |*
*binaẏa kariẏā kahe śuna śrīnibāsa || 102 ||*

*Word for word:* murari mukunda-datta ara haridasa — Murari, Mukunda Datta and Haridasa; vinaya kariya kahe — humbly say; shuna shrinivasa — hear, Srinivasa

**102.** Murari, Mukunda Datta and Haridasa
humbly say: "Hear, Srinivasa:

তোমা বহি নাহিক প্রভুর প্রিয়দাস ।
তোমার প্রসাদে এই চরণ-প্রকাশ ॥ ১০৩ ॥

*tomā bahi nāhika prabhura priẏadāsa |*
*tomāra prasāde ei caraṇa-prakāśa || 103 ||*

*Word for word:* toma vahi — apart from you; nahika prabhura priyadasa — the Lord has no dear servant; tomara prasade — by your grace; ei charana-prakasha — these feet have appeared

**103.** the Lord has no servant dearer than you;
by your grace these feet have appeared [to us].

আমি-সব তোমারে বা কি কহিতে জানি ।
আপন বলিয়া দয়া করিবে আপনি ॥ ১০৪ ॥

*āmi-saba tomāre bā ki kahite jāni |*
*āpana baliẏā daẏā karibe āpani || 104 ||*

*Word for word:* ami-saba — all of us; tomare ba ki kahite jani — what can we say to you; apana baliya — considering [us] your own; daya karibe apani — be kind yourself

**104.** What can all of us say to you?
Considering [us] your own, be kind to us yourself."[^29-12]

ইহা বলি' সভে মেলি' হরিগুণ গায় ।
পীরিতি-পাগল হঞা নাচে গোরারায় ॥ ১০৫ ॥

*ihā bali' sabhe meli' hariguṇa gāẏa |*
*pīriti-pāgala hañā nāce gorārāẏa || 105 ||*

*Word for word:* iha bali — saying this; sabhe meli — all together; hari-guna gaya — sing Hari's qualities; piriti-pagala hanya — intoxicated with love; nache goraraya — Gora-raya dances

**105.** Saying this, all together sing Hari's qualities,
and Gora-raya, intoxicated with love, dances.

হেন অদ্ভুত কথা শুন সর্বজন ।
নবদ্বীপে পরচার পীরিতি-রতন ॥ ১০৬ ॥

*hena adbhuta kathā śuna sarbajana |*
*nabadbīpe paracāra pīriti-ratana || 106 ||*

*Word for word:* hena adbhuta katha — such a wondrous story; shuna sarvajana — hear, all; navadvipe parachara — proclaimed in Navadvipa; piriti-ratana — the jewel of love

**106.** Hear, all of you, this wondrous story:
in Navadvipa the jewel of love has been proclaimed.

ত্রিজগতে দুর্লভ প্রভুর প্রেমভক্তি ।
হেনজন কেবা আছে লভিবারে শক্তি ॥ ১০৭ ॥

*trijagate durlabha prabhura premabhakti |*
*henajana kebā āche labhibāre śakti || 107 ||*

*Word for word:* trijagate durlabha — rare in the three worlds; prabhura prema-bhakti — the Lord's prema-bhakti; henajana keba achhe — who is there; labhibare shakti — with the power to attain it

**107.** The Lord's prema-bhakti is rare in the three worlds —
who has the power to attain it?

লখিমী অনন্ত কিবা শিব সনাতন ।
যে প্রেমভক্তির কেহো না জানে মরম ॥ ১০৮ ॥

*lakhimī ananta kibā śiba sanātana |*
*ye premabhaktira keho nā jāne marama || 108 ||*

*Word for word:* lakhimi ananta — Lakshmi, Ananta; kiba shiva sanatana — or Shiva, Sanatana; ye prema-bhaktira — of this prema-bhakti; keho na jane marama — none knows the inner essence

**108.** Lakshmi, Ananta, Shiva or Sanatana —
none of them knows the inner essence of this prema-bhakti.[^29-13]

হেন প্রেমভক্তি প্রভু করে পরকাশ ।
আনন্দ-হৃদয়ে কহে এ লোচনদাস ॥ ১০৯ ॥

*hena premabhakti prabhu kare parakāśa |*
*ānanda-hṛdaẏe kahe e locanadāsa || 109 ||*

*Word for word:* hena prema-bhakti — such prema-bhakti; prabhu kare parakasha — the Lord reveals; ananda-hridaye — with a joyful heart; kahe e lochanadasa — says this Lochana Dasa

**109.** Such prema-bhakti the Lord reveals —
so says with a joyful heart this Lochana Dasa.

[^29-1]: The summary covers the whole section (vv. 1–109). In the OCR of the edition it is almost illegible (lines of two columns are mixed); it has been restored from the surviving words and from the table of contents in Bhaktisiddhanta's preface (the fifth chapter of the Madhya-khanda); what is restored by sense is in square brackets. The section as a whole follows Murari Gupta (2.9–2.10).
[^29-2]: The raga is given only in the 1983 edition. The refrain is read after the 1903 edition (in the OCR of Bhaktisiddhanta's edition it is garbled); it refers to the Lord's weeping in vv. 5–12: Gora remembers His former pastimes — the pastimes of Krishna.
[^29-3]: Vishnu-maya here is the Lord's external energy, which by His will keeps the godless away from Him (cf. en/26, note 17); the Lord Himself is never subject to maya.
[^29-4]: Vv. 5–14 — cf. Murari 2.9.2–6, where the Lord sees the Boy Krishna in a dream. The request to tell no one: the Lord conceals His intimate bhava.
[^29-5]: Vv. 15–23 — cf. Murari 2.9.6–11: Nityananda sees the form of Hari with club, discus, conch, flute, bow and lotus, then the four-armed and two-armed forms. The translation of the second line of v. 20 is tentative.
[^29-6]: Vv. 24–35 — cf. Murari 2.9.13–16. Advaita lived in Shantipura, on the bank of the Ganga. Rama is Sri Rama Pandita; Narayana is an associate of the Lord in Navadvipa.
[^29-7]: Gadadhara is Radha (en/25, note 8). Narahari Sarakara is Lochana Dasa's guru, and Raghunandana his nephew, both of Shrikhanda; only Lochana Dasa mentions their presence in this scene. In Murari (2.9.17–18) Advaita sees the Lord on the seat of honour in Srivasa's shrine room.
[^29-8]: Vv. 44–55 — cf. Murari 2.9.17–22. Kaivalya and nirvana are liberation as merging into Brahman; for the devotees it is insignificant beside prema.
[^29-9]: Vv. 59–65 — cf. Murari 2.10.2–5. Haridasa Thakura is the great devotee of the holy name; the Lord Himself feeds him mahaprasada.
[^29-10]: Vv. 68–76 — cf. Murari 2.10.6–9. The kaupina is a renunciant's loincloth; the Lord gave the pieces of Nityananda's kaupina to the devotees as a holy relic.
[^29-11]: Vv. 83–101 — cf. Murari 2.10.10–13: the Lord carries Srivasa away from the circle of dancers and, seeing the devotees' alarm, appears again of Himself. Shachi's lament is only in Lochana Dasa.
[^29-12]: The devotees ascribe the Lord's return to the grace of Srivasa, whom He had taken with Him: thus the Lord's mercy comes through His devotee.
[^29-13]: Ananta (Shesha) is an expansion of the Lord; Sanatana is one of the four Kumaras (possibly also an epithet of Shiva, "the eternal Shiva"). Cf. Chaitanya-charitamrita, Madhya 8–9: even Lakshmi did not attain the rasa of the gopis; the prema that Gaura bestowed is the highest treasure, rare even for the greatest.

# Madhya-khanda, part 7 (portion 30)

*The section "Pastimes with the Devotees and the Deliverance of Jagai and Madhai": the devotees place on their heads the water of Nityananda's feet; Haridasa in the form of Brahma; the arrival of Advaita; the Lord speaks of the reasons for His descent; He bids the devotees give the holy name from house to house; the sins of Jagai and Madhai; sankirtana through the town; the brothers wound Nityananda; the Lord summons Sudarshana, and Nityananda pleads for the offenders*

## Pastimes with the Devotees and the Deliverance of Jagai and Madhai

> *Summary by Srila Bhaktisiddhanta Sarasvati.* One day, when Sriman Mahaprabhu was sporting in the bliss of prema with the devotees headed by Srivasa, Haridasa, Murari and Mukunda, Sriman Nityananda Prabhu came there. At Sriman Mahaprabhu's command the devotees placed on their heads the water of Sriman Nityananda Prabhu's feet and [began] to dance in the bliss of prema. When Haridasa and Sriman Advaita Prabhu came there, [Haridasa] offered Him praise; then Sriman Mahaprabhu rose together with the devotees and showed him due honour, fed him and told him of preaching prema without distinction between the worthy and the unworthy, and commanded His devotees to go from door to door and distribute the holy name and prema. But when the devotees refused, [fearing] two great sinful brahmanas named Jagai and Madhai, Sriman Mahaprabhu Himself glorified before the devotees the greatness of the holy name — for example, the deliverance of the great sinner Ajamila by namabhasa, [the name uttered while intending another,] — and, to deliver these two sons of brahmanas, expressed His wish to go round the town Himself with the devotees, performing kirtana with mridangas and karatalas. Delighted at Sriman Mahaprabhu's words, the devotees all gathered together and began kirtana; all around resounded with the holy name. Hearing the kirtana, Jagai and Madhai in great anger began to abuse Sriman Mahaprabhu in every way; [Sriman Mahaprabhu and] Nityananda by Their own will [paid no heed] and [looked on them with mercy]. At last they struck Sri Nityananda on the head with a shard of a pot. Sriman Mahaprabhu, unable to bear [the insult and pain] of His own [devotee], summoned Sudarshana to destroy those two. Sri Nityananda Prabhu forgave Jagai and Madhai all their offences and begged for their lives, [and Mahaprabhu] cast a merciful glance on them. [By the grace] of Sri Nityananda, Jagai and Madhai were delivered and became great devotees. Then the author glorified the compassion of Nityananda and Mahaprabhu.[^30-1]

*Raga dhanashi; refrain: "What a wonder in the midst of Nadia! Golden Gauranga dances — a great wonder!"*

হেনরূপে নবদ্বীপে বিহরে ঠাকুর ।
আপনা পাসরি' প্রেম প্রকাশে প্রচুর ॥ ১ ॥

*henarūpe nabadbīpe bihare ṭhākura |*
*āpanā pāsari' prema prakāśe pracura || 1 ||*

*Word for word:* henarupe — thus; navadvipe vihare thakura — the Thakura sports in Navadvipa; apana pasari — forgetting Himself; prema prakashe prachura — reveals prema abundantly

**1.** Thus the Thakura sports in Navadvipa:
forgetting Himself, He reveals prema abundantly.

স্বতন্ত্র হইয়া হয়ে ভকত-অধীন ।
সভারে যাচয়ে প্রেমা যেন মহাদীন ॥ ২ ॥

*sbatantra haiẏā haẏe bhakata-adhīna |*
*sabhāre yācaẏe premā yena mahādīna || 2 ||*

*Word for word:* svatantra haiya — though independent; haye bhakata-adhina — He becomes subject to His devotees; sabhare yachaye prema — He offers prema to all unasked; yena mahadina — as if most humble

**2.** Independent as He is, He becomes subject to His devotees
and, as if most humble, begs everyone to take prema.

আচম্বিতে একদিন ধন্য রম্য বেলে ।
নিজজন-সঙ্গে ক্রীড়া করে সন্ধ্যাকালে ॥ ২+১ ॥

*ācambite ekadina dhanya ramya bele |*
*nijajana-saṅge krīṛā kare sandhyākāle || 2+1 ||*

*Word for word:* achambite — suddenly; ekadina — one day; dhanya ramya bele — at a blessed, lovely hour; nijajana-sange — with His own people; krida kare — plays; sandhya-kale — in the evening

**2+1.** Suddenly one day, at a blessed and lovely hour,
He was playing with His own people in the evening[^30-2].

সবার অঙ্গের বস্তর নিলা ত কাড়িয়া ।
আনন্দে হাসয়ে সবে বিনয় করিয়া ॥ ২+২ ॥

*sabāra aṅgera bastara nilā ta kāṛiẏā |*
*ānande hāsaẏe sabe binaẏa kariẏā || 2+2 ||*

*Word for word:* sabara angera bastara — the clothes from everyone's bodies; nila ta kadiya — snatched away; anande hasaye sabe — all laugh for joy; vinaya kariya — humbly beseeching

**2+2.** He snatched away everyone's clothes,
and all, laughing for joy, humbly beseech [Him].

সব জন লজ্জায় অবশ ভেল তনু ।
করে আচ্ছাদয়ে অঙ্গ চাটু করে পুনু ॥ ২+৩ ॥

*saba jana lajjāẏa abaśa bhela tanu |*
*kare ācchādaẏe aṅga cāṭu kare punu || 2+3 ||*

*Word for word:* saba jana — everyone; lajjaya — for shame; avasha bhela tanu — the body went weak; kare achchhadaye anga — cover the body with the hands; chatu kare punu — coax again and again

**2+3.** For shame everyone's limbs went weak;
covering themselves with their hands, they coax [Him] again and again:

বস্ত্র দেহ বস্ত্র দেহ ত্রিজগত-রায় ।
এমন করিতে প্রভু তোরে না জুয়ায় ॥ ২+৪ ॥

*bastra deha bastra deha trijagata-rāẏa |*
*emana karite prabhu tore nā juẏāẏa || 2+4 ||*

*Word for word:* bastra deha — give the clothes; trijagata-raya — Lord of the three worlds; emana karite — to act so; prabhu — Lord; tore na juyaya — does not befit You

**2+4.** "Give the clothes, give the clothes, Lord of the three worlds!
It does not befit You, Lord, to act like this!"

এ বোল শুনিয়া প্রভুর অধিক উল্লাস ।
ক্ষণেক অন্তরে সব জনে দিল বাস ॥ ২+৫ ॥

*e bola śuniẏā prabhura adhika ullāsa |*
*kṣaṇeka antare saba jane dila bāsa || 2+5 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuniya — hearing these words; prabhura adhika ullasa — the Lord's delight increased; kshaneka antare — a moment later; saba jane dila basa — gave everyone their clothes

**2+5.** Hearing these words, the Lord grew merrier still
and a moment later gave everyone back their clothes.

এইমতে বিহরে রসিক-শিরোমণি ।
সর্বজনে রসদাতা সর্বরস জানি' ॥ ২+৬ ॥

*eimate bihare rasika-śiromaṇi |*
*sarbajane rasadātā sarbarasa jāni' || 2+6 ||*

*Word for word:* eimate vihare — thus plays; rasika-shiromani — the crown-jewel of connoisseurs of rasa; sarvajane rasa-data — giver of rasa to all; sarva-rasa jani — knowing every rasa

**2+6.** Thus plays the crown-jewel of connoisseurs of rasa,
the giver of rasa to all, who knows every rasa.

বস্ত্র দিয়া তুষ্ট কৈলা সব নিজজনে ।
আপনে নাচয়ে সুখে নাচে ভৃত্যগণে ॥ ২+৭ ॥

*bastra diẏā tuṣṭa kailā saba nijajane |*
*āpane nācaẏe sukhe nāce bhṛtyagaṇe || 2+7 ||*

*Word for word:* bastra diya — giving the clothes; tushta kaila — gladdened; saba nijajane — all His own people; apane nachaye sukhe — He Himself dances joyfully; nache bhritya-gane — the servants dance

**2+7.** Giving back the clothes, He gladdened all His own people;
He Himself dances joyfully, and His servants dance.

লীলাগতি চলে প্রভু লোক-অলক্ষিত ।
তার নিজজন জানে তাহার ইঙ্গিত ॥ ৩ ॥

*līlāgati cale prabhu loka-alakṣita |*
*tāra nijajana jāne tāhāra iṅgita || 3 ||*

*Word for word:* lila-gati chale prabhu — the Lord moves in His lila; loka-alakshita — unnoticed by people; tara nijajana jane — His own know; tahara ingita — His hints

**3.** The Lord moves in His lila unnoticed by people;
only His own understand His hints.

শ্রীনিবাস হরিদাস মুরারি মুকুন্দ ।
ইঙ্গিত বুঝিয়া গায় বাঢ়ে প্রেমানন্দ ॥ ৪ ॥

*śrīnibāsa haridāsa murāri mukunda |*
*iṅgita bujhiẏā gāẏa bāṛhe premānanda || 4 ||*

*Word for word:* shrinivasa haridasa murari mukunda — Srinivasa, Haridasa, Murari, Mukunda; ingita bujhiya — understanding the hint; gaya — sing; badhe premananda — the bliss of prema grows

**4.** Srinivasa, Haridasa, Murari, Mukunda,
understanding His hint, sing, and the bliss of prema grows.

আনন্দে বিহ্বল নিজগণে নাচে গায় ।
হেনকালে আইলা পুনঃ অবধূতরায় ॥ ৫ ॥

*ānande bihbala nijagaṇe nāce gāẏa |*
*henakāle āilā punaḥ abadhūtarāẏa || 5 ||*

*Word for word:* anande vihvala — overwhelmed with joy; nijagane nache gaya — His associates dance and sing; henakale — at that time; aila punah avadhuta-raya — the Avadhuta-raya came again

**5.** Overwhelmed with joy, His associates dance and sing;
at that time the Avadhuta-raya came again.

অবধূত আইলা বলি' পড়ে জয় জয় ।
আনন্দে সকল লোক সুমঙ্গল গায় ॥ ৬ ॥

*abadhūta āilā bali' paṛe jaẏa jaẏa |*
*ānande sakala loka sumaṅgala gāẏa || 6 ||*

*Word for word:* avadhuta aila bali — saying "The Avadhuta has come!"; pade jaya jaya — "Jaya, jaya!" rings out; anande sakala loka — all the people joyfully; sumangala gaya — sing auspicious songs

**6.** "The Avadhuta has come!" — "Jaya, jaya!" rings out,
and all the people joyfully sing auspicious songs.

মত্ত করিবর যেন গমন মন্থর ।
হরি হরি ধ্বনি শুনি' অবশ অন্তর ॥ ৭ ॥

*matta karibara yena gamana manthara |*
*hari hari dhbani śuni' abaśa antara || 7 ||*

*Word for word:* matta karivara yena — like a maddened elephant; gamana manthara — His gait is slow; hari hari dhvani shuni — hearing the cry "Hari, Hari!"; avasha antara — His heart is helpless

**7.** His gait is slow, like a maddened elephant's;
hearing the cry "Hari, Hari!", He is not master of Himself.

পথ আগুলিয়া চলে অঙ্গ হেলাইয়া ।
পদ দুই গিয়া রহে চৌদিগে চাহিয়া ॥ ৮ ॥

*patha āguliẏā cale aṅga helāiẏā |*
*pada dui giẏā rahe caudige cāhiẏā || 8 ||*

*Word for word:* patha aguliya — blocking the road; chale anga helaiya — He walks swaying His body; pada dui giya — after two steps; rahe chaudige chahiya — stops, looking all around

**8.** Swaying, He walks, blocking the road;
after two steps He stops and looks all around.

পুলকিত সব অঙ্গ আপাদ-মস্তক ।
কদম্ব-কেশর জিনি' একটি পুলক ॥ ৯ ॥

*pulakita saba aṅga āpāda-mastaka |*
*kadamba-keśara jini' ekaṭi pulaka || 9 ||*

*Word for word:* pulakita saba anga — His whole body thrilled; apada-mastaka — from feet to head; kadamba-keshara jini — surpassing kadamba filaments; ekati pulaka — each single thrill

**9.** His whole body thrills from feet to head:
each hair standing on end surpasses the kadamba's filaments.

বক্র-গ্রীবায় দু-ভিত নেহালে রাঙ্গা আঁখি ।
ক্ষণে উনমাদে ধায় উচ্চনাদে ডাকি' ॥ ১০ ॥

*bakra-grībāẏa du-bhita nehāle rāṅgā āṁkhi |*
*kṣaṇe unamāde dhāẏa uccanāde ḍāki' || 10 ||*

*Word for word:* vakra-grivaya — with bent neck; du-bhita nehale — looks to both sides; ranga ankhi — with red eyes; kshane unamade dhaya — at times runs in rapture; uchchanade daki — calling loudly

**10.** With bent neck He looks to both sides with red eyes;
at times He runs in rapture, calling loudly.

এইমত শত শত লোক পাছে ধায় ।
আনন্দে বিভোর গেলা যথা গোরারায় ॥ ১১ ॥

*eimata śata śata loka pāche dhāẏa |*
*ānande bibhora gelā yathā gorārāẏa || 11 ||*

*Word for word:* eimata — thus; shata shata loka — hundreds of people; pachhe dhaya — run behind; anande vibhora — absorbed in bliss; gela yatha goraraya — He went to where Gora-raya was

**11.** So, with hundreds of people running behind Him,
absorbed in bliss He came to where Gora-raya was.

নিত্যানন্দ দেখি' প্রভু গৌরাঙ্গসুন্দর ।
দুঁহু আলিঙ্গন করে প্রেমে গরগর ॥ ১২ ॥

*nityānanda dekhi' prabhu gaurāṅgasundara |*
*duṁhu āliṅgana kare preme garagara || 12 ||*

*Word for word:* nityananda dekhi — seeing Nityananda; prabhu gauranga-sundara — the Lord Gaurasundara; dunhu alingana kare — the two embrace; preme garagara — overflowing with prema

**12.** Seeing Nityananda, the Lord Gaurasundara [embraces Him]:
the two embrace, overflowing with prema.

দোঁহার নয়নে ঝরে প্রেমানন্দ-নীর ।
আনন্দে বিভোর দোঁহে অথির-শরীর ॥ ১৩ ॥

*doṁhāra naẏane jhare premānanda-nīra |*
*ānande bibhora doṁhe athira-śarīra || 13 ||*

*Word for word:* donhara nayane — from the eyes of both; jhare premananda-nira — tears of prema's bliss flow; anande vibhora donhe — both absorbed in bliss; athira-sharira — their bodies unsteady

**13.** Tears of prema's bliss flow from the eyes of both;
both are absorbed in bliss, Their bodies unsteady.

আনন্দে নাচয়ে দুঁহে সঙ্গে নিজজন ।
কৃষ্ণ-বলরাম-সঙ্গে যেন শিশুগণ ॥ ১৪ ॥

*ānande nācaẏe duṁhe saṅge nijajana |*
*kṛṣṇa-balarāma-saṅge yena śiśugaṇa || 14 ||*

*Word for word:* anande nachaye dunhe — both dance joyfully; sange nijajana — with Them Their own; krishna-balarama-sange — with Krishna and Balarama; yena shishugana — like the [cowherd] boys

**14.** Both dance in joy, and with Them Their own,
like the cowherd boys with Krishna and Balarama.

নৃত্য-অবসানে প্রভু কহিল সভারে ।
নিত্যানন্দ-পাদ-প্রক্ষালন করিবারে ॥ ১৫ ॥

*nṛtya-abasāne prabhu kahila sabhāre |*
*nityānanda-pāda-prakṣālana karibāre || 15 ||*

*Word for word:* nritya-avasane — at the end of the dance; prabhu kahila sabhare — the Lord told all; nityananda-pada-prakshalana — the washing of Nityananda's feet; karibare — to perform

**15.** When the dance ended, the Lord told everyone
to wash Nityananda's feet:

নিত্যানন্দ-পাদোদক লহ শিরোপরি ।
পাইবে পরম প্রেমা আনন্দ-লহরী ॥ ১৬ ॥

*nityānanda-pādodaka laha śiropari |*
*pāibe parama premā ānanda-laharī || 16 ||*

*Word for word:* nityananda-padodaka — the water of Nityananda's feet; laha shiropari — place on your heads; paibe parama prema — you will attain supreme prema; ananda-lahari — waves of bliss

**16.** "Place on your heads the water of Nityananda's feet —
you will attain supreme prema, waves of bliss."

হেনমতে মহাপ্রভু আজ্ঞা যবে কৈল ।
শুনিঞা সভার হিয়া আনন্দ বাঢ়িল ॥ ১৭ ॥

*henamate mahāprabhu ājñā yabe kaila |*
*śuniñā sabhāra hiẏā ānanda bāṛhila || 17 ||*

*Word for word:* henamate — thus; mahaprabhu ajna yabe kaila — when Mahaprabhu commanded; shuninya — hearing; sabhara hiya — in all hearts; ananda badhila — joy grew

**17.** When Mahaprabhu gave this command,
the joy in the hearts of all who heard it grew.

একে চাহে আরে পায় প্রভু-আজ্ঞাবাণী ।
মস্তকে ধরিল পাদ-প্রক্ষালন-পানী ॥ ১৮ ॥

*eke cāhe āre pāẏa prabhu-ājñābāṇī |*
*mastake dharila pāda-prakṣālana-pānī || 18 ||*

*Word for word:* eke chahe are paya — seeking one thing, they found more; prabhu-ajna-vani — the Lord's command; mastake dharila — placed on their heads; pada-prakshalana-pani — the water that washed the feet

**18.** They longed for one thing and received more — the Lord's command;
they placed on their heads the water that had washed [His] feet.

তবে অবধূত প্রভু প্রভু-আজ্ঞা শুনি' ।
রক্তিম-নয়ানে ছলছল করে পানী ॥ ১৯ ॥

*tabe abadhūta prabhu prabhu-ājñā śuni' |*
*raktima-naẏāne chalachala kare pānī || 19 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe — then; avadhuta prabhu — Avadhuta Prabhu; prabhu-ajna shuni — hearing the Lord's command; raktima-nayane — in His reddened eyes; chhalachhala kare pani — tears brimmed

**19.** Then Avadhuta Prabhu, hearing the Lord's command —
tears brimmed in His reddened eyes.

উঠিয়া আনন্দে সর্বজন করি' কোলে ।
উথলিল প্রেমসিন্ধু আনন্দ-হিল্লোলে ॥ ২০ ॥

*uṭhiẏā ānande sarbajana kari' kole |*
*uthalila premasindhu ānanda-hillole || 20 ||*

*Word for word:* uthiya — rising; anande sarvajana kari kole — joyfully embracing everyone; uthalila premasindhu — the ocean of prema surged; ananda-hillole — in waves of bliss

**20.** Rising, He joyfully embraces everyone:
the ocean of prema surged in waves of bliss.

প্রেমায় বিহ্বল সভে করয়ে ক্রন্দন ।
হৃদয়ে ধরয়ে অবধূতের চরণ ॥ ২১ ॥

*premāẏa bihbala sabhe karaẏe krandana |*
*hṛdaẏe dharaẏe abadhūtera caraṇa || 21 ||*

*Word for word:* premaya vihvala — overwhelmed by prema; sabhe karaye krandana — all weep; hridaye dharaye — clasp to their hearts; avadhutera charana — the Avadhuta's feet

**21.** Overwhelmed by prema, all weep
and clasp the Avadhuta's feet to their hearts.

প্রেম-মহামহোৎসব বাঢ়িল অপার ।
অন্তরে ঝলমল করে বাহ্যেতে বিকার ॥ ২২ ॥

*prema-mahāmahotsaba bāṛhila apāra |*
*antare jhalamala kare bāhyete bikāra || 22 ||*

*Word for word:* prema-mahamahotsava — the great festival of prema; badhila apara — grew boundlessly; antare jhalamala kare — within it shines; bahyete vikara — outwardly, transformations [of ecstasy]

**22.** The great festival of prema grew boundlessly:
within — radiance, without — the transformations of ecstasy.

ঐছন দেখিয়া প্রভু গৌর ভগবান্ ।
অন্তর-সন্তোষে চাহে প্রসন্ন-বয়ান ॥ ২৩ ॥

*aichana dekhiẏā prabhu gaura bhagabān |*
*antara-santoṣe cāhe prasanna-baẏāna || 23 ||*

*Word for word:* aichhana dekhiya — seeing this; prabhu gaura bhagavan — the Lord Gaura Bhagavan; antara-santoshe — with inner satisfaction; chahe prasanna-bayana — gazes with serene face

**23.** Seeing this, the Lord Gaura Bhagavan
looks on with a serene face, rejoicing at heart.[^30-3]

সর্বজন স্তব করে বেঢ়ি' চারিপাশে ।
হেনকালে আচম্বিতে আইলা হরিদাসে ॥ ২৪ ॥

*sarbajana staba kare beṛhi' cāripāśe |*
*henakāle ācambite āilā haridāse || 24 ||*

*Word for word:* sarvajana stava kare — all offer praise; bedhi charipashe — surrounding [Him] on all sides; henakale achambite — at that time suddenly; aila haridase — Haridasa came

**24.** All, surrounding [Him] on every side, offer praise;
at that time Haridasa suddenly came:

শুদ্ধ স্ফটিকের মালা ধরিয়া গলায় ।
হেমমণি-মুখর মঞ্জীর রাঙ্গা পায় ॥ ২৫ ॥

*śuddha sphaṭikera mālā dhariẏā galāẏa |*
*hemamaṇi-mukhara mañjīra rāṅgā pāẏa || 25 ||*

*Word for word:* shuddha sphatikera mala — a necklace of pure crystal; dhariya galaya — wearing on his neck; hemamani-mukhara manjira — tinkling golden anklets; ranga paya — on his red feet

**25.** on his neck a necklace of pure crystal,
golden bells tinkling on his red feet;

পুলকিত সব অঙ্গ সজল-নয়ন ।
প্রেমে টলমল তনু হুঙ্কার-গর্জন ॥ ২৬ ॥

*pulakita saba aṅga sajala-naẏana |*
*preme ṭalamala tanu huṅkāra-garjana || 26 ||*

*Word for word:* pulakita saba anga — his whole body thrilled; sajala-nayana — eyes full of tears; preme talamala tanu — his body swaying with prema; hunkara-garjana — roars of "hum!" and thundering

**26.** his whole body thrilled, his eyes full of tears,
his body swaying with prema, he roars "hum!" and calls aloud.

নির্ভর-প্রেমায় নাচে প্রভুর সম্মুখে ।
ব্রহ্মাণ্ডে না ধরে তার প্রেমানন্দ-সুখে ॥ ২৭ ॥

*nirbhara-premāẏa nāce prabhura sammukhe |*
*brahmāṇḍe nā dhare tāra premānanda-sukhe || 27 ||*

*Word for word:* nirbhara-premaya — in the fullness of prema; nache prabhura sammukhe — he dances before the Lord; brahmande na dhare — the universe cannot contain; tara premananda-sukhe — his happiness in prema's bliss

**27.** In the fullness of prema he dances before the Lord —
the universe cannot contain his happiness in prema's bliss.

পাদ্য অর্ঘ্য আচমনীয় গৃহ-ব্যবহারে ।
আদেশিল আপনে ভোজন করিবারে ॥ ২৮ ॥

*pādya arghya ācamanīẏa gṛha-byabahāre |*
*ādeśila āpane bhojana karibāre || 28 ||*

*Word for word:* padya arghya achamaniya — water for the feet, arghya, water for sipping; griha-vyavahare — by the custom of hospitality; adeshila apane — He Himself bade; bhojana karibare — to take food

**28.** [The Lord], by the custom of hospitality [offering] water for the feet, arghya and water for sipping,
Himself bade [him] take food.[^30-4]

হেনকালে অদ্বৈত-আচার্য আচম্বিত ।
প্রভুর নিকটে আসি' হৈল উপনীত ॥ ২৯ ॥

*henakāle adbaita-ācārya ācambita |*
*prabhura nikaṭe āsi' haila upanīta || 29 ||*

*Word for word:* henakale — at that time; advaita-acharya achambita — suddenly Advaita Acharya; prabhura nikate asi — coming near the Lord; haila upanita — arrived

**29.** At that time Advaita Acharya suddenly
came to the Lord.

ঠাকুর উঠিয়া কৈল বন্দন তাঁহার ।
সর্বজন উঠিয়া করিল নমস্কার ॥ ৩০ ॥

*ṭhākura uṭhiẏā kaila bandana tāṁhāra |*
*sarbajana uṭhiẏā karila namaskāra || 30 ||*

*Word for word:* thakura uthiya — the Thakura, rising; kaila bandana tanhara — honoured Him; sarvajana uthiya — all, rising; karila namaskara — bowed

**30.** The Thakura rose and honoured Him,
and all, rising, bowed to Him.

নাচিতে নাচিতে ব্রহ্মা মূর্তিমান্ হঞা ।
দণ্ডবৎ করে প্রভুর চরণে পড়িয়া ॥ ৩১ ॥

*nācite nācite brahmā mūrtimān hañā |*
*daṇḍabat kare prabhura caraṇe paṛiẏā || 31 ||*

*Word for word:* nachite nachite — dancing and dancing; brahma murtiman hanya — Brahma becoming manifest; dandavat kare — prostrates; prabhura charane padiya — falling at the Lord's feet

**31.** Dancing and dancing, [Haridasa], in whom Brahma manifested,
falls at the Lord's feet and prostrates;

চতুর্মুখে স্তব করে বেদ উচ্চারিয়া ।
শান্ত হও বলি' প্রভু তোলে কোলে লঞা ॥ ৩২ ॥

*caturmukhe staba kare beda uccāriẏā |*
*śānta hao bali' prabhu tole kole lañā || 32 ||*

*Word for word:* chaturmukhe — with four mouths; stava kare — offers praise; veda uchchariya — reciting the Vedas; shanta hao bali — saying "Be calm!"; prabhu tole kole lanya — the Lord lifts him into His arms

**32.** with four mouths, reciting the Vedas, he offers praise.
"Be calm!" says the Lord, lifts him up and embraces him.

শান্ত হঞা হরিদাস নাচে কান্দে হাসে ।
দিগ্বিদিগ্ নাহি প্রেমানন্দে ভাসে ॥ ৩৩ ॥

*śānta hañā haridāsa nāce kānde hāse |*
*digbidig nāhi premānande bhāse || 33 ||*

*Word for word:* shanta hanya — becoming calm; haridasa nache kande hase — Haridasa dances, weeps, laughs; digvidig nahi — knowing no directions; premanande bhase — floats in prema's bliss

**33.** Becoming calm, Haridasa dances, weeps and laughs,
knowing no directions, floating in prema's bliss.[^30-5]

সম্ভ্রম পাইল তবে আচার্য-গোসাঞি ।
আজ্ঞা শিরে করি' অন্ন ভুঞ্জিলা তথাই ॥ ৩৪ ॥

*sambhrama pāila tabe ācārya-gosāñi |*
*ājñā śire kari' anna bhuñjilā tathāi || 34 ||*

*Word for word:* sambhrama paila — was filled with reverent awe; tabe acharya-gosanyi — then Acharya Gosani; ajna shire kari — taking the command on his head; anna bhunjila tathai — ate there

**34.** Then Acharya Gosani was filled with reverent awe
and, taking the command on his head, ate there.

হেনমতে সব নিজজন-সঙ্গে পহুঁ ।
নিভৃতে বসিয়া ঘরে হাসে লহু লহু ॥ ৩৫ ॥

*henamate saba nijajana-saṅge pahuṁ |*
*nibhṛte basiẏā ghare hāse lahu lahu || 35 ||*

*Word for word:* henamate — thus; saba nijajana-sange — with all His own; pahu — the Lord; nibhrite basiya ghare — sitting secluded in the house; hase lahu lahu — smiles gently

**35.** So the Lord with all His own
sits secluded in the house, smiling gently.

নিজজন-সঙ্গে পহুঁ নিজকথা কহে ।
যে কারণে কৈল প্রভু পৃথিবী-বিজয়ে ॥ ৩৬ ॥

*nijajana-saṅge pahuṁ nijakathā kahe |*
*ye kāraṇe kaila prabhu pṛthibī-bijaẏe || 36 ||*

*Word for word:* nijajana-sange — with His own; pahu nija-katha kahe — the Lord speaks of Himself; ye karane — for what reason; kaila prabhu prithivi-vijaye — the Lord came to the earth

**36.** Among His own the Lord speaks of Himself —
of the reasons for which He came to the earth:

নিজ-ভাব-আস্বাদন অধর্ম-বিনাশ ।
ধর্ম-সংস্থাপন নাম-কীর্তন-প্রকাশ ॥ ৩৭ ॥

*nija-bhāba-āsbādana adharma-bināśa |*
*dharma-saṃsthāpana nāma-kīrtana-prakāśa || 37 ||*

*Word for word:* nija-bhava-asvadana — tasting His own bhava; adharma-vinasha — destruction of irreligion; dharma-samsthapana — establishment of dharma; nama-kirtana-prakasha — manifestation of the kirtana of the name

**37.** "To taste My own bhava, to destroy irreligion,
to establish dharma and to reveal the kirtana of the name.

দেশে দেশে প্রকাশ করিব ঘরে ঘরে ।
ব্রজভাব দাস্য-সখ্য-বাৎসল্য-শৃঙ্গারে ॥ ৩৮ ॥

*deśe deśe prakāśa kariba ghare ghare |*
*brajabhāba dāsya-sakhya-bātsalya-śṛṅgāre || 38 ||*

*Word for word:* deshe deshe — in every land; prakasha kariba ghare ghare — I will reveal in every home; vraja-bhava — the bhava of Vraja; dasya-sakhya-vatsalya-shringare — in servitude, friendship, parental love and amorous love

**38.** In every land, in every home, I will reveal
the bhava of Vraja — servitude, friendship, parental love and amorous love.

ভুঞ্জাব অধিক রাধাকৃষ্ণ-প্রেমধন ।
আপনি ভুঞ্জিমু ভুঞ্জাইমু ত্রিভুবন ॥ ৩৯ ॥

*bhuñjāba adhika rādhākṛṣṇa-premadhana |*
*āpani bhuñjimu bhuñjāimu tribhubana || 39 ||*

*Word for word:* bhunjaba adhika — I will give to taste above all; radhakrishna-premadhana — the treasure of prema for Radha and Krishna; apani bhunjimu — I Myself will taste; bhunjaimu tribhuvana — I will make the three worlds taste

**39.** Above all I will give to taste the treasure of prema for Radha and Krishna:
I Myself will taste it and make the three worlds taste it.

সুরাসুরগণে দিমু এই প্রেমধন ।
চণ্ডাল যবন মূর্খ স্ত্রী বালক জন ॥ ৪০ ॥

*surāsuragaṇe dimu ei premadhana |*
*caṇḍāla yabana mūrkha strī bālaka jana || 40 ||*

*Word for word:* surasura-gane — to gods and asuras; dimu ei premadhana — I will give this treasure of prema; chandala yavana murkha — to chandalas, yavanas, the ignorant; stri balaka jana — to women and children

**40.** To gods and asuras I will give this treasure of prema,
to chandalas, yavanas, the ignorant, women and children.

বৃন্দাবন-সুখ আমি নদীয়া আনিঞা ।
দেশে দেশে ভুঞ্জাইব তো-সভারে লঞা ॥ ৪১ ॥

*bṛndābana-sukha āmi nadīẏā āniñā |*
*deśe deśe bhuñjāiba to-sabhāre lañā || 41 ||*

*Word for word:* vrindavana-sukha — the happiness of Vrindavana; ami nadiya aninya — I, bringing to Nadia; deshe deshe bhunjaiba — will give to taste in every land; to-sabhare lanya — together with all of you

**41.** Bringing the happiness of Vrindavana to Nadia,
together with all of you I will give it to taste in every land."[^30-6]

অতি অপরূপ কথা নদীয়া-বিহার ।
একত্র এ সব কথা করিব প্রচার ॥ ৪২ ॥

*ati aparūpa kathā nadīẏā-bihāra |*
*ekatra e saba kathā kariba pracāra || 42 ||*

*Word for word:* ati aparupa katha — a most wondrous story; nadiya-vihara — the pastimes in Nadia; ekatra — together; e saba katha — all these stories; kariba prachara — I shall proclaim

**42.** A most wondrous story — the pastimes in Nadia;
all these stories I shall proclaim together.

গদাধর নরহরি বৈসে দুইপাশে ।
শ্রীরঘুনন্দন পদ-নিকটে বিলাসে ॥ ৪৩ ॥

*gadādhara narahari baise duipāśe |*
*śrīraghunandana pada-nikaṭe bilāse || 43 ||*

*Word for word:* gadadhara narahari — Gadadhara and Narahari; baise duipashe — sit on both sides; shri-raghunandana — Sri Raghunandana; pada-nikate vilase — delights near [His] feet

**43.** Gadadhara and Narahari sit on both sides,
Sri Raghunandana delights near His feet;

অদ্বৈত-আচার্য আর নিত্যানন্দরায় ।
আপনে ঠাকুর নিজগুণগাথা গায় ॥ ৪৪ ॥

*adbaita-ācārya āra nityānandarāẏa |*
*āpane ṭhākura nijaguṇagāthā gāẏa || 44 ||*

*Word for word:* advaita-acharya ara nityananda-raya — Advaita Acharya and Nityananda-raya; apane thakura — the Thakura Himself; nija-guna-gatha gaya — sings the song of His own qualities

**44.** Advaita Acharya and Nityananda-raya —
and the Thakura Himself sings the song of His own qualities;

মুরারি মুকুন্দদত্ত আর শ্রীনিবাস ।
হরিদাস-আদি যত প্রেমার আবাস ॥ ৪৫ ॥

*murāri mukundadatta āra śrīnibāsa |*
*haridāsa-ādi yata premāra ābāsa || 45 ||*

*Word for word:* murari mukunda-datta ara shrinivasa — Murari, Mukunda Datta and Srinivasa; haridasa-adi — Haridasa and others; yata premara avasa — all abodes of prema

**45.** Murari, Mukunda Datta and Srinivasa,
Haridasa and the rest — all abodes of prema;

শুক্লাম্বর বক্রেশ্বর শ্রীমান্ সঞ্জয় ।
শ্রীধর-পণ্ডিত-আদি যত মহাশয় ॥ ৪৬ ॥

*śuklāmbara bakreśbara śrīmān sañjaẏa |*
*śrīdhara-paṇḍita-ādi yata mahāśaẏa || 46 ||*

*Word for word:* shuklambara vakreshvara shriman sanjaya — Shuklambara, Vakreshvara, Shriman, Sanjaya; shridhara-pandita-adi — Shridhara Pandita and others; yata mahashaya — all the great souls

**46.** Shuklambara, Vakreshvara, Shriman, Sanjaya,
Shridhara Pandita and the other great souls.[^30-7]

একজন মহিমা কহিতে জানে কেবা ।
আপনি অবনী অবতরে গৌরদেবা ॥ ৪৭ ॥

*ekajana mahimā kahite jāne kebā |*
*āpani abanī abatare gauradebā || 47 ||*

*Word for word:* ekajana mahima — the glory of even one; kahite jane keba — who knows how to tell; apani avani — Himself to the earth; avatare gauradeva — Gauradeva descends

**47.** Who can tell the glory of even one of them?
Gauradeva Himself has descended to the earth!

উপমা দিবারে নাহি নদীয়া-প্রকাশ ।
আনন্দ-হৃদয়ে কহে এ লোচনদাস ॥ ৪৮ ॥

*upamā dibāre nāhi nadīẏā-prakāśa |*
*ānanda-hṛdaẏe kahe e locanadāsa || 48 ||*

*Word for word:* upama dibare nahi — there is no comparison for; nadiya-prakasha — the manifestation in Nadia; ananda-hridaye — with a joyful heart; kahe e lochanadasa — says this Lochana Dasa

**48.** The manifestation in Nadia has no comparison —
so says with a joyful heart this Lochana Dasa.

*Raga gurjari; disha: "Gorachand is my life!" (with vocables); refrain: "Hari, Rama, Narayana — golden Gora, Shachi's darling!"*

কহিব অপূর্ব কথা শুন সর্বজন ।
শুনিলে সকল পাপ হয় বিমোচন ॥ ৪৯ ॥

*kahiba apūrba kathā śuna sarbajana |*
*śunile sakala pāpa haẏa bimocana || 49 ||*

*Word for word:* kahiba apurva katha — I shall tell an unprecedented story; shuna sarvajana — hear, all; shunile — on hearing it; sakala papa haya vimochana — all sins are removed

**49.** I shall tell an unprecedented story — hear, all:
whoever hears it is freed from all sins.

নবদ্বীপে গৌরচন্দ্র আপন আবাসে ।
শিষ্যগণ-সঙ্গে আছে বিনোদ-বিলাসে ॥ ৫০ ॥

*nabadbīpe gauracandra āpana ābāse |*
*śiṣyagaṇa-saṅge āche binoda-bilāse || 50 ||*

*Word for word:* navadvipe — in Navadvipa; gaurachandra apana avase — Gaurachandra in His own home; shishyagana-sange — with His disciples; achhe vinoda-vilase — is in joyful play

**50.** In Navadvipa, in His own home,
Gaurachandra is in joyful play with His disciples.

নিজভক্তগণ সব করি' এক মেলি ।
নিজগুণ-সংকীর্তনে প্রেমানন্দে ভুলি' ॥ ৫১ ॥

*nijabhaktagaṇa saba kari' eka meli |*
*nijaguṇa-saṃkīrtane premānande bhuli' || 51 ||*

*Word for word:* nija-bhaktagana saba — all His devotees; kari eka meli — gathering together; nija-guna-sankirtane — in the sankirtana of His own qualities; premanande bhuli — lost in prema's bliss

**51.** Gathering all His devotees together,
He was lost in prema's bliss in the sankirtana of His own qualities.

হাসিয়া কহিল প্রভু ভক্ত সভাকারে ।
এই মোর হরিনাম দেহ ঘরে ঘরে ॥ ৫২ ॥

*hāsiẏā kahila prabhu bhakta sabhākāre |*
*ei mora harināma deha ghare ghare || 52 ||*

*Word for word:* hasiya kahila prabhu — laughing, the Lord said; bhakta sabhakare — to all the devotees; ei mora harinama — this name of Hari of Mine; deha ghare ghare — give in every home

**52.** Laughing, the Lord said to all the devotees:
"Give this name of Hari of Mine in every home.

নবদ্বীপে বাল বৃদ্ধ বৈসে যত জন ।
চণ্ডাল দুর্গত আর সজ্জন দুর্জন ॥ ৫৩ ॥

*nabadbīpe bāla bṛddha baise yata jana |*
*caṇḍāla durgata āra sajjana durjana || 53 ||*

*Word for word:* navadvipe — in Navadvipa; bala vriddha — children and old people; baise yata jana — all who live; chandala durgata — chandalas, the wretched; ara sajjana durjana — and the good and the wicked

**53.** All who live in Navadvipa — children and old people,
chandalas and the wretched, the good and the wicked —

সভারে শিখাও হরিনাম গ্রন্থি করি' ।
অনায়াসে সর্বলোক যাউ ভব তরি' ॥ ৫৪ ॥

*sabhāre śikhāo harināma granthi kari' |*
*anāẏāse sarbaloka yāu bhaba tari' || 54 ||*

*Word for word:* sabhare shikhao — teach everyone; harinama granthi kari — the name of Hari, tying [it] in a knot; anayase sarvaloka — let all people easily; yau bhava tari — cross the ocean of existence

**54.** teach them all the name of Hari, tying it fast,
so that all people may easily cross the ocean of existence."[^30-8]

শুনিঞা সকল ভক্ত কহিল প্রভুরে ।
না পারিব হরিনাম দিতে ঘরে ঘরে ॥ ৫৫ ॥

*śuniñā sakala bhakta kahila prabhure |*
*nā pāriba harināma dite ghare ghare || 55 ||*

*Word for word:* shuninya — hearing; sakala bhakta kahila prabhure — all the devotees said to the Lord; na pariba — we cannot; harinama dite ghare ghare — give the name of Hari in every home

**55.** Hearing this, all the devotees said to the Lord:
"We cannot give the name of Hari in every home.

সেই নবদ্বীপে এক আছয়ে দুরন্ত ।
অতি দুরাচার সেই পাপে নাহি অন্ত ॥ ৫৬ ॥

*sei nabadbīpe eka āchaẏe duranta |*
*ati durācāra sei pāpe nāhi anta || 56 ||*

*Word for word:* sei navadvipe — in that Navadvipa; eka achhaye duranta — there is one calamity; ati durachara sei — most wicked; pape nahi anta — their sins have no end

**56.** In this Navadvipa there is one calamity:
most wicked [men], whose sins have no end —

মহাপাপী ব্রাহ্মণ সে আছে দুই ভাই ।
নবদ্বীপের ঠাকুর সে জগাই মাধাই ॥ ৫৭ ॥

*mahāpāpī brāhmaṇa se āche dui bhāi |*
*nabadbīpera ṭhākura se jagāi mādhāi || 57 ||*

*Word for word:* mahapapi brahmana — greatly sinful brahmanas; se achhe dui bhai — there are two brothers; navadvipera thakura — the masters of Navadvipa; se jagai madhai — they are Jagai and Madhai

**57.** two brothers, greatly sinful brahmanas,
the masters of Navadvipa, Jagai and Madhai.[^30-9]

ব্রাহ্মণী যবনী গুর্বঙ্গনা নাহি এড়ে ।
সুরাপান পাইলে সকল কর্ম ছাড়ে ॥ ৫৮ ॥

*brāhmaṇī yabanī gurbaṅganā nāhi eṛe |*
*surāpāna pāile sakala karma chāṛe || 58 ||*

*Word for word:* brahmani yavani gurvangana — brahmana women, yavana women, the guru's wife; nahi ede — they spare none; surapana paile — getting liquor; sakala karma chhade — they abandon all duties

**58.** They spare neither brahmana women, nor Muslim women, nor the wives of gurus;
getting liquor, they abandon all duties.

দেব-গুরু-ব্রাহ্মণের হিংসা নিরন্তর ।
বাহির হইলে বিনা বধে না যায় ঘর ॥ ৫৯ ॥

*deba-guru-brāhmaṇera hiṃsā nirantara |*
*bāhira haile binā badhe nā yāẏa ghara || 59 ||*

*Word for word:* deva-guru-brahmanera — to gods, gurus and brahmanas; himsa nirantara — constant violence; bahira haile — when they go out; vina vadhe na yaya ghara — they do not return home without a killing

**59.** They constantly do violence to gods, gurus and brahmanas;
when they go out, they do not return home without a killing.

ব্রহ্মবধ গোবধ স্ত্রীবধ শত শত ।
লিখিতে না পারি পাপ করিয়াছে কত ॥ ৬০ ॥

*brahmabadha gobadha strībadha śata śata |*
*likhite nā pāri pāpa kariẏāche kata || 60 ||*

*Word for word:* brahma-vadha go-vadha stri-vadha — killing of brahmanas, cows, women; shata shata — by hundreds; likhite na pari — I cannot write; papa kariyachhe kata — how many sins they have committed

**60.** Killings of brahmanas, cows, women — by hundreds;
I cannot write how many sins they have committed.

গঙ্গাকূলে বৈসে গঙ্গাস্নান নাহি করে ।
দেবতা পূজয়ে নাহি আজন্ম-ভিতরে ॥ ৬১ ॥

*gaṅgākūle baise gaṅgāsnāna nāhi kare |*
*debatā pūjaẏe nāhi ājanma-bhitare || 61 ||*

*Word for word:* ganga-kule baise — they live on the bank of the Ganga; gangasnana nahi kare — do not bathe in the Ganga; devata pujaye nahi — do not worship the gods; ajanma-bhitare — in all their lives

**61.** They live on the bank of the Ganga, yet do not bathe in the Ganga;
never in their lives have they worshipped the gods.

নিরন্তর স্বজন-বান্ধবে করে দণ্ড ।
কৃষ্ণগুণ-সংকীর্তনে পরম পাষণ্ড ॥ ৬২ ॥

*nirantara sbajana-bāndhabe kare daṇḍa |*
*kṛṣṇaguṇa-saṃkīrtane parama pāṣaṇḍa || 62 ||*

*Word for word:* nirantara — constantly; svajana-bandhave kare danda — they punish their own kin and friends; krishna-guna-sankirtane — towards the sankirtana of Krishna's qualities; parama pashanda — utter atheists

**62.** They constantly punish their own kin and friends;
towards the sankirtana of Krishna's qualities they are utter atheists.

সহস্র কায়স্থ যদি শত জন্ম লেখে ।
তথাপি তাহার পাপ অন্ত নাহি দেখে ॥ ৬২+১ ॥

*sahasra kāẏastha yadi śata janma lekhe |*
*tathāpi tāhāra pāpa anta nāhi dekhe || 62+1 ||*

*Word for word:* sahasra kayastha — a thousand scribes; yadi shata janma lekhe — if they write for a hundred births; tathapi — even then; tahara papa anta nahi dekhe — they would not see the end of their sins

**62+1.** Even if a thousand scribes were to write [them] down for a hundred births,
they would still not see the end of their sins"[^30-10].

একদিন আছে প্রভু নিজজন-মেলে ।
কথার প্রসঙ্গে তার কথা হেনকালে ॥ ৬৩ ॥

*ekadina āche prabhu nijajana-mele |*
*kathāra prasaṅge tāra kathā henakāle || 63 ||*

*Word for word:* ekadina achhe prabhu — one day the Lord was; nijajana-mele — among His own; kathara prasange — in the course of conversation; tara katha henakale — then talk of them [arose]

**63.** One day, when the Lord was among His own,
in the course of conversation talk of them arose.

কহিল সকল লোক প্রভু-বিদ্যমানে ।
শুনিঞা রুষিলা প্রভু গুণে মনে মনে ॥ ৬৪ ॥

*kahila sakala loka prabhu-bidyamāne |*
*śuniñā ruṣilā prabhu guṇe mane mane || 64 ||*

*Word for word:* kahila sakala loka — everyone told; prabhu-vidyamane — before the Lord; shuninya rushila prabhu — hearing, the Lord grew angry; gune mane mane — pondering within

**64.** Everyone told [of them] before the Lord;
hearing it, the Lord grew angry, pondering within.

অরুণ বরণ ভেল রাঙ্গা দুই আঁখি ।
যে কহিলে তোমরা অন্তরে পাই সাক্ষী ॥ ৬৫ ॥

*aruṇa baraṇa bhela rāṅgā dui āṁkhi |*
*ye kahile tomarā antare pāi sākṣī || 65 ||*

*Word for word:* aruna varana bhela — His colour turned red; ranga dui ankhi — both eyes red; ye kahile tomara — what you have said; antare pai sakshi — I find witness to it within

**65.** His face turned red, both eyes reddened:
"What you have said, My heart too bears witness to.

অজামিল-নামে পাপী আছিল ব্রাহ্মণ ।
মরিবার বেলে নাম লৈল নারায়ণ ॥ ৬৬ ॥

*ajāmila-nāme pāpī āchila brāhmaṇa |*
*maribāra bele nāma laila nārāẏaṇa || 66 ||*

*Word for word:* ajamila-name — named Ajamila; papi achhila brahmana — there was a sinful brahmana; maribara bele — at the time of death; nama laila narayana — he uttered the name "Narayana"

**66.** There was a sinful brahmana named Ajamila;
at the hour of death he uttered the name "Narayana".

পুত্রস্নেহে নারায়ণ নাম লৈল সেহ ।
বৈকুণ্ঠ পাইল দ্বিজ পাঞা দিব্যদেহ ॥ ৬৭ ॥

*putrasnehe nārāẏaṇa nāma laila seha |*
*baikuṇṭha pāila dbija pāñā dibyadeha || 67 ||*

*Word for word:* putra-snehe — out of love for his son; narayana nama laila seha — he uttered the name "Narayana"; vaikuntha paila dvija — the brahmana attained Vaikuntha; panya divya-deha — receiving a divine body

**67.** Out of love for his son he uttered the name "Narayana" —
and the brahmana, receiving a divine body, attained Vaikuntha.[^30-11]

তাহার অধিক পাপী জগাই মাধাই ।
উহার নিস্তার হবে কেমন উপায় ॥ ৬৮ ॥

*tāhāra adhika pāpī jagāi mādhāi |*
*uhāra nistāra habe kemana upāẏa || 68 ||*

*Word for word:* tahara adhika papi — more sinful than he; jagai madhai — Jagai and Madhai; uhara nistara habe — their deliverance will be; kemana upaya — by what means

**68.** Jagai and Madhai are more sinful than he:
by what means will they be delivered?

তাহার লাগিয়া মোর অন্তর কাতর ।
যে কিছু কহিয়ে সভে শুনহ উত্তর ॥ ৬৯ ॥

*tāhāra lāgiẏā mora antara kātara |*
*ye kichu kahiẏe sabhe śunaha uttara || 69 ||*

*Word for word:* tahara lagiya — for their sake; mora antara katara — My heart is pained; ye kichhu kahiye — whatever I say; sabhe shunaha uttara — all hear the answer

**69.** For their sake My heart is pained;
all of you, hear what I say in answer.

হরিনাম-সংকীর্তন কলিযুগ-ধর্ম ।
নামগুণ-সংকীর্তনে সাধিব সব কর্ম ॥ ৭০ ॥

*harināma-saṃkīrtana kaliyuga-dharma |*
*nāmaguṇa-saṃkīrtane sādhiba saba karma || 70 ||*

*Word for word:* harinama-sankirtana — the sankirtana of Hari's name; kaliyuga-dharma — is the dharma of the age of Kali; nama-guna-sankirtane — by the sankirtana of the name and qualities; sadhiba saba karma — I will accomplish the whole task

**70.** The sankirtana of Hari's name is the dharma of the age of Kali:
by the sankirtana of the name and qualities I will accomplish the whole task.

আনহ যেখানে যেই আছে বন্ধুজন ।
মিলিয়া সকল লোক কর সংকীর্তন ॥ ৭১ ॥

*ānaha yekhāne yei āche bandhujana |*
*miliẏā sakala loka kara saṃkīrtana || 71 ||*

*Word for word:* anaha — bring; yekhane yei achhe — wherever any are; bandhujana — friends; miliya sakala loka — gathering, all people; kara sankirtana — perform sankirtana

**71.** Bring your friends, wherever they may be;
gathering all together, perform sankirtana.

গায়ন বায়ন লঞা মৃদঙ্গ করতাল ।
উচ্চস্বরে কর নাম-কীর্তন রসাল ॥ ৭২ ॥

*gāẏana bāẏana lañā mṛdaṅga karatāla |*
*uccasbare kara nāma-kīrtana rasāla || 72 ||*

*Word for word:* gayana vayana lanya — taking singers and players; mridanga karatala — mridangas and karatalas; uchchasvare — with loud voices; kara nama-kirtana rasala — perform sweet kirtana of the name

**72.** Taking singers and players, mridangas and karatalas,
sing aloud the sweet kirtana of the name.

নগরে বেঢ়াব আমি কীর্তন করিয়া ।
আইল সকল লোক এ বোল শুনিঞা ॥ ৭৩ ॥

*nagare beṛhāba āmi kīrtana kariẏā |*
*āila sakala loka e bola śuniñā || 73 ||*

*Word for word:* nagare bedhaba ami — I will go round the town; kirtana kariya — performing kirtana; aila sakala loka — all came; e bola shuninya — hearing these words

**73.** I will go round the town performing kirtana."
Hearing these words, all came:

অদ্বৈত-আচার্য আর তাঁর নিজজন ।
অবধূত নিত্যানন্দ প্রসন্ন-বদন ॥ ৭৪ ॥

*adbaita-ācārya āra tāṁra nijajana |*
*abadhūta nityānanda prasanna-badana || 74 ||*

*Word for word:* advaita-acharya ara tanra nijajana — Advaita Acharya and His people; avadhuta nityananda — the Avadhuta Nityananda; prasanna-vadana — with a serene face

**74.** Advaita Acharya and His people,
the Avadhuta Nityananda with a serene face,

হরিদাস শ্রীনিবাস মিলি' চারি ভাই ।
মুরারি মুকুন্দদত্ত পণ্ডিত গদাই ॥ ৭৫ ॥

*haridāsa śrīnibāsa mili' cāri bhāi |*
*murāri mukundadatta paṇḍita gadāi || 75 ||*

*Word for word:* haridasa — Haridasa; shrinivasa mili chari bhai — Srinivasa with his four brothers; murari mukunda-datta — Murari, Mukunda Datta; pandita gadai — Pandita Gadai (Gadadhara)

**75.** Haridasa, Srinivasa with his four brothers,
Murari, Mukunda Datta, Pandita Gadai,

শ্রীচন্দ্রশেখরাচার্য আর শুক্লাম্বর ।
সর্বজন মিলি' আইলা ঠাকুরের ঘর ॥ ৭৬ ॥

*śrīcandraśekharācārya āra śuklāmbara |*
*sarbajana mili' āilā ṭhākurera ghara || 76 ||*

*Word for word:* shri-chandrashekhara-acharya — Sri Chandrashekhara Acharya; ara shuklambara — and Shuklambara; sarvajana mili — all together; aila thakurera ghara — came to the Thakura's house

**76.** Sri Chandrashekhara Acharya and Shuklambara —
all together came to the Thakura's house.

যেখানে আছিল ভক্তগণ যত যত ।
প্রভুর আজ্ঞায় সভে হৈ গেল একত্র ॥ ৭৭ ॥

*yekhāne āchila bhaktagaṇa yata yata |*
*prabhura ājñāẏa sabhe hai gela ekatra || 77 ||*

*Word for word:* yekhane achhila — wherever they were; bhaktagana yata yata — all the devotees; prabhura ajnaya — at the Lord's command; sabhe hai gela ekatra — all came together

**77.** All the devotees, wherever they were,
at the Lord's command gathered together.

একত্র হইয়া সভে সংকীর্তন করি' ।
বিজয় করিলা প্রভু বিশ্বম্ভর হরি ॥ ৭৮ ॥

*ekatra haiẏā sabhe saṃkīrtana kari' |*
*bijaẏa karilā prabhu biśbambhara hari || 78 ||*

*Word for word:* ekatra haiya sabhe — all gathering together; sankirtana kari — performing sankirtana; vijaya karila — set forth; prabhu vishvambhara hari — the Lord Vishvambhara Hari

**78.** When all had gathered and sankirtana began,
the Lord Vishvambhara Hari set forth.

নদিয়া-নগরে ভেল আনন্দ-হিল্লোল ।
গগনে উঠিয়া লাগে হরি হরি বোল ॥ ৭৯ ॥

*nadiẏā-nagare bhela ānanda-hillola |*
*gagane uṭhiẏā lāge hari hari bola || 79 ||*

*Word for word:* nadiya-nagare — in the town of Nadia; bhela ananda-hillola — waves of bliss arose; gagane uthiya lage — rising, reaches the sky; hari hari bola — the cry "Hari, Hari!"

**79.** In the town of Nadia waves of bliss arose;
the cry "Hari, Hari!" rises to the sky.

নিজঘরে শুতিয়াছে জগাই মাধাই ।
নিজমদে মত্ত নিদ্রা যায় দুই ভাই ॥ ৮০ ॥

*nijaghare śutiẏāche jagāi mādhāi |*
*nijamade matta nidrā yāẏa dui bhāi || 80 ||*

*Word for word:* nijaghare shutiyachhe — lie in their house; jagai madhai — Jagai and Madhai; nija-made matta — drunk on their liquor; nidra yaya dui bhai — the two brothers sleep

**80.** Meanwhile Jagai and Madhai lie in their house:
drunk on their liquor, both brothers sleep.

সেই পথে কীর্তন করিয়া প্রভু যায় ।
নদিয়ার লোক সব দেখিবারে ধায় ॥ ৮১ ॥

*sei pathe kīrtana kariẏā prabhu yāẏa |*
*nadiẏāra loka saba dekhibāre dhāẏa || 81 ||*

*Word for word:* sei pathe — along that road; kirtana kariya prabhu yaya — the Lord goes performing kirtana; nadiyara loka saba — all the people of Nadia; dekhibare dhaya — run to see

**81.** Along that very road the Lord goes performing kirtana,
and all the people of Nadia run to see.

করতাল-মৃদঙ্গাদি কীর্তনের রোলে ।
চতুর্দিগে শুনি মাত্র হরি হরি বোলে ॥ ৮২ ॥

*karatāla-mṛdaṅgādi kīrtanera role |*
*caturdige śuni mātra hari hari bole || 82 ||*

*Word for word:* karatala-mridangadi — karatalas, mridangas and the rest; kirtanera role — in the roar of kirtana; chaturdige shuni matra — on all sides one hears only; hari hari bole — "Hari, Hari!"

**82.** In the roar of the kirtana — karatalas, mridangas and the rest —
on all sides one hears only "Hari, Hari!".

জাগিল সে দুই ভাই কীর্তনের রোলে ।
মুখ তুলি' চাহে ক্রোধে ধর্ ধর্ বোলে ॥ ৮৩ ॥

*jāgila se dui bhāi kīrtanera role |*
*mukha tuli' cāhe krodhe dhar dhar bole || 83 ||*

*Word for word:* jagila se dui bhai — the two brothers awoke; kirtanera role — at the roar of the kirtana; mukha tuli chahe — raising their heads they look; krodhe dhar dhar bole — angrily shout "Seize, seize!"

**83.** At the roar of the kirtana the two brothers awoke;
raising their heads they look and angrily shout: "Seize, seize!"

রাঙ্গা দু-নয়ন করি' চাহে ক্রোধ-দিঠি ।
কি না ধ্বনি শুনি কর্ণে মাইল যেন জাঠি ॥ ৮৪ ॥

*rāṅgā du-naẏana kari' cāhe krodha-diṭhi |*
*ki nā dhbani śuni karṇe māila yena jāṭhi || 84 ||*

*Word for word:* ranga du-nayana kari — with both eyes reddened; chahe krodha-dithi — they glare in anger; ki na dhvani shuni — what noise is this we hear; karne maila yena jathi — as if a spear struck our ears

**84.** With reddened eyes they glare in anger:
"What noise is this we hear? As if a spear had struck our ears!

হৃদয়ের শেল যেন একটি শবদ ।
জীতে সাধ থাকে যদি হউ নিঃশবদ ॥ ৮৫ ॥

*hṛdaẏera śela yena ekaṭi śabada |*
*jīte sādha thāke yadi hau niḥśabada || 85 ||*

*Word for word:* hridayera shela yena — like a spear in the heart; ekati shabada — every single sound; jite sadha thake yadi — if they wish to live; hau nihshabada — let them be silent

**85.** Every sound is like a spear in the heart.
If they value their lives, let them be silent!"

তাহার কাছের লোক কহে তার আগে ।
সম্বরণ কর গোসাঞি ক্রোধ কর কাকে ॥ ৮৬ ॥

*tāhāra kāchera loka kahe tāra āge |*
*sambaraṇa kara gosāñi krodha kara kāke || 86 ||*

*Word for word:* tahara kachhera loka — their attendants; kahe tara age — say before them; samvarana kara gosanyi — restrain yourselves, masters; krodha kara kake — at whom are you angry

**86.** Their attendants say to them:
"Restrain yourselves, masters — with whom are you angry?

আজ্ঞা পাইলে যাব এখন নিষেধ করিব ।
কাহার শকতি আর এ পথে আসিব ॥ ৮৭ ॥

*ājñā pāile yāba ekhana niṣedha kariba |*
*kāhāra śakati āra e pathe āsiba || 87 ||*

*Word for word:* ajna paile — if ordered; yaba ekhana — we will go now; nishedha kariba — we will forbid them; kahara shakati — who would dare; ara e pathe asiba — to come this way again

**87.** Give the order and we will go at once and forbid them;
who would then dare to come this way again?

জগন্নাথ-সুত দ্বিজ নিমাই-পণ্ডিত ।
কীর্তন করয়ে সব-ব্রাহ্মণ-বেষ্টিত ॥ ৮৮ ॥

*jagannātha-suta dbija nimāi-paṇḍita |*
*kīrtana karaẏe saba-brāhmaṇa-beṣṭita || 88 ||*

*Word for word:* jagannatha-suta dvija — the brahmana son of Jagannatha; nimai-pandita — Nimai Pandita; kirtana karaye — performs kirtana; saba-brahmana-veshtita — surrounded by brahmanas

**88.** It is Jagannatha's son, the brahmana Nimai Pandita,
performing kirtana surrounded by brahmanas."

নিষেধ করহ তারা যাউ অন্যপথে ।
নিঃশবদে রহু যদি সাধ থাকে জীতে ॥ ৮৯ ॥

*niṣedha karaha tārā yāu anyapathe |*
*niḥśabade rahu yadi sādha thāke jīte || 89 ||*

*Word for word:* nishedha karaha — forbid them; tara yau anyapathe — let them go another way; nihshabade rahu — let them be silent; yadi sadha thake jite — if they wish to live

**89.** "Forbid them: let them go another way!
Let them be silent if they value their lives.

মিছা গোল করি' বুলে নাহি চিনে মূল ।
মোর হাথে হারাইবে জাতি প্রাণ কুল ॥ ৯০ ॥

*michā gola kari' bule nāhi cine mūla |*
*mora hāthe hārāibe jāti prāṇa kula || 90 ||*

*Word for word:* michha gola kari bule — they go about making a pointless din; nahi chine mula — they do not know the root; mora hathe — at my hand; haraibe jati prana kula — they will lose caste, life and family

**90.** They go about making a pointless din, not knowing the root of things —
at my hand they will lose caste, life and family!"

ইহা বলি' পাঠাইল আপনার দূত ।
কহিল ঠাকুর-আগে শুনে শচীসুত ॥ ৯১ ॥

*ihā bali' pāṭhāila āpanāra dūta |*
*kahila ṭhākura-āge śune śacīsuta || 91 ||*

*Word for word:* iha bali — saying this; pathaila apanara duta — they sent their messenger; kahila thakura-age — [he] spoke before the Thakura; shune shachisuta — Shachi's son listens

**91.** Saying this, they sent their messenger,
and he gave [their message] to the Thakura; Shachi's son listens —

অধিক করয়ে হরিনাম-সংকীর্তন ।
বাহু তুলি' হরি হরি বোলে ঘনে ঘন ॥ ৯২ ॥

*adhika karaẏe harināma-saṃkīrtana |*
*bāhu tuli' hari hari bole ghane ghana || 92 ||*

*Word for word:* adhika karaye — [He] performs all the more; harinama-sankirtana — the sankirtana of Hari's name; bahu tuli — raising His arms; hari hari bole ghane ghana — cries "Hari, Hari!" again and again

**92.** and sings the sankirtana of Hari's name all the louder:
raising His arms, again and again He cries "Hari, Hari!".

দ্বিগুণ করিয়া প্রেম বাঢ়ায় উল্লাস ।
হরি হরি বোল-ধ্বনি পরশে আকাশ ॥ ৯৩ ॥

*dbiguṇa kariẏā prema bāṛhāẏa ullāsa |*
*hari hari bola-dhbani paraśe ākāśa || 93 ||*

*Word for word:* dviguna kariya prema — doubling the prema; badhaya ullasa — He increases the exultation; hari hari bola-dhvani — the cry "Hari, Hari!"; parashe akasha — touches the sky

**93.** Doubling the prema, He increases the exultation:
the cry "Hari, Hari!" touches the sky.

পাপিষ্ঠ হৃদয় তাহা সহিবারে নারে ।
চলিলা সে দুই ভাই বাহির-দুয়ারে ॥ ৯৪ ॥

*pāpiṣṭha hṛdaẏa tāhā sahibāre nāre |*
*calilā se dui bhāi bāhira-duẏāre || 94 ||*

*Word for word:* papishtha hridaya — the sinful hearts; taha sahibare nare — cannot bear it; chalila se dui bhai — the two brothers went; bahira-duyare — to the outer gate

**94.** The sinful hearts cannot bear it:
the two brothers went out to the outer gate.

ক্রোধে রাঙ্গা আঁখি তার অরুণ-বদন ।
পড়িতে পড়িতে যায় অঙ্গের বসন ॥ ৯৫ ॥

*krodhe rāṅgā āṁkhi tāra aruṇa-badana |*
*paṛite paṛite yāẏa aṅgera basana || 95 ||*

*Word for word:* krodhe ranga ankhi — eyes red with anger; tara aruna-vadana — their faces crimson; padite padite — falling and falling; yaya angera vasana — their clothes slip off

**95.** Their eyes red with anger, their faces crimson,
their clothes slipping again and again from their bodies.

টলবল করি' যায় ক্রোধে অচেতন ।
থাক্ থাক্ করি' বোলে তর্জন গর্জন ॥ ৯৬ ॥

*ṭalabala kari' yāẏa krodhe acetana |*
*thāk thāk kari' bole tarjana garjana || 96 ||*

*Word for word:* talabala kari yaya — they go staggering; krodhe achetana — blind with anger; thak thak kari bole — shout "Stop, stop!"; tarjana garjana — with threats and roars

**96.** Staggering, blind with anger, they go
and with threats and roars shout: "Stop, stop!"

রাঙ্গা দুনয়ন করি' বলে ক্রোধভরে ।
নাশিব বৈষ্ণব সব নদীয়া নগরে ॥ ৯৬+১ ॥

*rāṅgā dunaẏana kari' bale krodhabhare |*
*nāśiba baiṣṇaba saba nadīẏā nagare || 96+1 ||*

*Word for word:* ranga dunayana kari — reddening both eyes; bale krodha-bhare — shout in anger; nashiba — we will destroy; vaishnava saba — all the Vaishnavas; nadiya nagare — in the town of Nadia

**96+1.** Their eyes red, they shout in anger:
"We will destroy all the Vaishnavas in the town of Nadia!"[^30-12]

সম্মুখে দাঁড়াঞা তারা চারিপানে চায় ।
আপনা চিনিয়া যাহ বড় ডাকে কয় ॥ ৯৭ ॥

*sammukhe dāṁṛāñā tārā cāripāne cāẏa |*
*āpanā ciniẏā yāha baṛa ḍāke kaẏa || 97 ||*

*Word for word:* sammukhe dandanya — standing in front; tara charipane chaya — they look all around; apana chiniya yaha — know your place and go; bada dake kaya — they shout loudly

**97.** Standing in front, they look all around
and shout loudly: "Know your place — get out!

আরে রে বামনা তোর জীতে লাগে শনি ।
ইহা বলি' দুর্বাক্য-বচনে পাড়ে গালি ॥ ৯৮ ॥

*āre re bāmanā tora jīte lāge śani |*
*ihā bali' durbākya-bacane pāṛe gāli || 98 ||*

*Word for word:* are re bamana — hey you, wretched brahmana; tora jite lage shani — Shani hangs over your life; iha bali — saying this; durvakya-bachane pade gali — they hurl foul abuse

**98.** Hey you, wretched brahmana, Shani hangs over your life!" —
and with these words they hurl foul abuse.[^30-13]

ক্রোধ দেখি' নদিয়ার লোক তরাসিত ।
চারিপানে চাহি' সভে হৈলা ভীতাভীত ॥ ৯৯ ॥

*krodha dekhi' nadiẏāra loka tarāsita |*
*cāripāne cāhi' sabhe hailā bhītābhīta || 99 ||*

*Word for word:* krodha dekhi — seeing the anger; nadiyara loka tarasita — the people of Nadia are terrified; charipane chahi — looking around; sabhe haila bhitabhita — all were frightened

**99.** Seeing their anger, the people of Nadia were frightened:
looking around, all were terrified.

তর্জিয়া গর্জিয়া তবে দুই ভাই চলে ।
বাহু তুলি' ভক্তগণ হরি হরি বলে ॥ ৯৯+১ ॥

*tarjiẏā garjiẏā tabe dui bhāi cale |*
*bāhu tuli' bhaktagaṇa hari hari bale || 99+1 ||*

*Word for word:* tarjiya garjiya — threatening and roaring; tabe dui bhai chale — then the two brothers move on; bahu tuli — raising their arms; bhakta-gana hari hari bale — the devotees cry "Hari, Hari"

**99+1.** Threatening and roaring, the brothers moved on,
while the devotees, raising their arms, cry: "Hari, Hari!"[^30-14]

অদ্বৈত-আচার্য-গোসাঞি আর নিত্যানন্দ ।
হরিদাস শ্রীনিবাস মুরারি মুকুন্দ ॥ ১০০ ॥

*adbaita-ācārya-gosāñi āra nityānanda |*
*haridāsa śrīnibāsa murāri mukunda || 100 ||*

*Word for word:* advaita-acharya-gosanyi ara nityananda — Advaita Acharya Gosani and Nityananda; haridasa shrinivasa murari mukunda — Haridasa, Srinivasa, Murari, Mukunda

**100.** Advaita Acharya Gosani and Nityananda,
Haridasa, Srinivasa, Murari, Mukunda —

আপনে ঠাকুর সেই বিশ্বম্ভর-রায় ।
নিজগণ সঙ্গে করি' হরিগুণ গায় ॥ ১০১ ॥

*āpane ṭhākura sei biśbambhara-rāẏa |*
*nijagaṇa saṅge kari' hariguṇa gāẏa || 101 ||*

*Word for word:* apane thakura — the Thakura Himself; sei vishvambhara-raya — Vishvambhara-raya; nijagana sange kari — with His associates; hari-guna gaya — sings Hari's qualities

**101.** and the Thakura Himself, Vishvambhara-raya,
together with His associates, sings Hari's qualities.

দ্বিগুণ করিয়া গায় বাঢ়ায় উল্লাস ।
হরি হরি বোল ধ্বনি পরশে আকাশ ॥ ১০১+১ ॥

*dbiguṇa kariẏā gāẏa bāṛhāẏa ullāsa |*
*hari hari bola dhbani paraśe ākāśa || 101+1 ||*

*Word for word:* dviguna kariya gaya — sing twice as strongly; badhaya ullasa — increase the jubilation; hari hari bola dhvani — the cry "Hari, Hari"; parashe akasha — touches the sky

**101+1.** They sing with redoubled strength, increasing the jubilation:
the cry "Hari, Hari!" touches the sky[^30-15].

হরিগুণ গায় সুখে নাহি অবসাদ ।
জগাই মাধাই ক্রোধে করে পরমাদ ॥ ১০২ ॥

*hariguṇa gāẏa sukhe nāhi abasāda |*
*jagāi mādhāi krodhe kare paramāda || 102 ||*

*Word for word:* hari-guna gaya sukhe — happily they sing Hari's qualities; nahi avasada — without weariness; jagai madhai — Jagai and Madhai; krodhe kare paramada — in anger make mischief

**102.** Happily, without weariness, they sing Hari's qualities,
while Jagai and Madhai in anger make mischief.

হরিনাম দুই ভাই সহিবারে নারে ।
বেগেতে ধাইল তারা ভক্ত মারিবারে ॥ ১০২+১ ॥

*harināma dui bhāi sahibāre nāre |*
*begete dhāila tārā bhakta māribāre || 102+1 ||*

*Word for word:* hari-nama — the name of Hari; dui bhai sahibare nare — the two brothers cannot bear; begete dhaila tara — they rushed headlong; bhakta maribare — to beat the devotees

**102+1.** The two brothers cannot bear the name of Hari:
they rushed headlong to beat the devotees[^30-16].

দীন-দয়ার্দ্র-চিত্ত নিত্যানন্দ রায় ।
অশ্রুপূর্ণ লোচনেতে দোঁহা পানে চায় ॥ ১০২+২ ॥

*dīna-daẏārdra-citta nityānanda rāẏa |*
*aśrupūrṇa locanete doṁhā pāne cāẏa || 102+2 ||*

*Word for word:* dina-dayardra-chitta — whose heart melts with compassion for the wretched; nityananda raya — Nityananda Raya; ashrupurna lochanete — with eyes full of tears; donha pane chaya — looks at the two

**102+2.** Nityananda Raya, whose heart melts with compassion for the wretched,
looks at the two of them with eyes full of tears.

সে করুণ আঁখি দেখি' পাপী না গলিল ।
তবে ত সম্মুখে নিতাই গৌর দাঁড়াইল ॥ ১০২+৩ ॥

*se karuṇa āṁkhi dekhi' pāpī nā galila |*
*tabe ta sammukhe nitāi gaura dāṁṛāila || 102+3 ||*

*Word for word:* se karuna ankhi dekhi — seeing those compassionate eyes; papi na galila — the sinners did not soften; tabe ta sammukhe — then before [them]; nitai gaura dandaila — Nitai and Gaura stood

**102+3.** But even seeing those compassionate eyes the sinners did not soften;
then Nitai and Gaura stood before them.

দেখি' জগাইর মন গেল দরবিয়া ।
দাঁড়ায়ে রহিল জগা স্তম্ভিত হৈয়া ॥ ১০২+৪ ॥

*dekhi' jagāira mana gela darabiẏā |*
*dāṁṛāẏe rahila jagā stambhita haiẏā || 102+4 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhi — seeing; jagaira mana gela daraviya — Jagai's heart melted; dandaye rahila jaga — Jagai stood still; stambhita haiya — stupefied

**102+4.** At the sight [of Them] Jagai's heart melted:
Jagai stood rooted to the spot.

ক্রোধে দুই ভাই ধায় করে করি' দণ্ড ।
সম্মুখে পাইল ভাঙ্গা কুম্ভ একখণ্ড ॥ ১০৩ ॥

*krodhe dui bhāi dhāẏa kare kari' daṇḍa |*
*sammukhe pāila bhāṅgā kumbha ekakhaṇḍa || 103 ||*

*Word for word:* krodhe dui bhai dhaya — in anger both brothers run; kare kari danda — with sticks in hand; sammukhe paila — in front they found; bhanga kumbha ekakhanda — a shard of a broken pot

**103.** In anger both brothers run with sticks in their hands
and find before them a shard of a broken pot.

কলসীর কাণা সে ফেলিয়া মারে ক্রোধে ।
নির্ভরে বাজিল নিত্যানন্দের মস্তকে ॥ ১০৪ ॥

*kalasīra kāṇā se pheliẏā māre krodhe |*
*nirbhare bājila nityānandera mastake || 104 ||*

*Word for word:* kalasira kana — the rim of the [broken] pot; se pheliya mare krodhe — they hurl in anger; nirbhare bajila — it struck hard; nityanandera mastake — on Nityananda's head

**104.** In anger they hurl that rim of the pot —
and it struck Nityananda's head with full force.

নির্ভরে বাজিল কাণা রক্ত পড়ে ধারে ।
দেখি' সর্ব নিজজন হাহাকার করে ॥ ১০৫ ॥

*nirbhare bājila kāṇā rakta paṛe dhāre |*
*dekhi' sarba nijajana hāhākāra kare || 105 ||*

*Word for word:* nirbhare bajila kana — the shard struck hard; rakta pade dhare — blood flows in a stream; dekhi sarva nijajana — seeing it, all His own; hahakara kare — cry out in dismay

**105.** The shard struck with full force, blood flows in a stream;
seeing it, all [the Lord's] own cry out in dismay.[^30-17]

ফাটিল মুটকী শিরে ব্যথা নাহি গণে ।
গৌর বলি' নাচে নিতাই হরষিত মনে ॥ ১০৫+১ ॥

*phāṭila muṭakī śire byathā nāhi gaṇe |*
*gaura bali' nāce nitāi haraṣita mane || 105+1 ||*

*Word for word:* phatila mutaki shire — the shard split His head; byatha nahi gane — takes no note of the pain; gaura bali — crying "Gaura"; nache nitai — Nitai dances; harashita mane — with a rejoicing heart

**105+1.** His head is split by the shard, but He takes no note of the pain:
crying "Gaura!", Nitai dances with a rejoicing heart[^30-18].

মারিলি কলসীর কাণা সহিবারে পারি ।
তোদের দুর্গতি আমি সহিবারে নারি ॥ ১০৫+২ ॥

*mārili kalasīra kāṇā sahibāre pāri |*
*todera durgati āmi sahibāre nāri || 105+2 ||*

*Word for word:* marili — you struck; kalasira kana — with the rim of a pot; sahibare pari — I can bear; todera durgati — your evil plight; ami sahibare nari — I cannot bear

**105+2.** "You struck me with the rim of a pot — that I can bear,
but your evil plight I cannot bear.

মারিলি মারিলি ভাল তাহে ক্ষতি নাই ।
সুমধুর হরিনাম মুখে বল ভাই ॥ ১০৫+৩ ॥

*mārili mārili bhāla tāhe kṣati nāi |*
*sumadhura harināma mukhe bala bhāi || 105+3 ||*

*Word for word:* marili marili bhala — you struck, well and good; tahe kshati nai — no harm in that; sumadhura hari-nama — the sweetest name of Hari; mukhe bala bhai — utter with your lips, brothers

**105+3.** You struck me — well and good, no harm in that;
only utter with your lips the sweetest name of Hari, brothers!"

নিত্যানন্দ-সর্ব-অঙ্গে রক্ত পড়ে ধারে ।
পরমানন্দে নিত্যানন্দ গৌরাঙ্গ নেহারে ॥ ১০৫+৪ ॥

*nityānanda-sarba-aṅge rakta paṛe dhāre |*
*paramānande nityānanda gaurāṅga nehāre || 105+4 ||*

*Word for word:* nityananda-sarva-ange — over all Nityananda's body; rakta pade dhare — blood streams; paramanande — in supreme bliss; nityananda gauranga nehare — Nityananda gazes at Gauranga

**105+4.** Blood streams over all of Nityananda's body,
and Nityananda in supreme bliss gazes at Gauranga.

প্রেমভরে মহাপ্রভু নিতাই কোলে নিল ।
আপন বসন দিয়া রক্ত মুছাইল ॥ ১০৫+৫ ॥

*premabhare mahāprabhu nitāi kole nila |*
*āpana basana diẏā rakta muchāila || 105+5 ||*

*Word for word:* prema-bhare — overflowing with love; mahaprabhu nitai kole nila — Mahaprabhu embraced Nitai; apana basana diya — with His own cloth; rakta muchhaila — wiped away the blood

**105+5.** Overflowing with love, Mahaprabhu embraced Nitai
and wiped away the blood with His own cloth.

দেখিয়া ঠাকুর চিত্তে বড় পাইল দুখ ।
ডাকিয়া কহিল সেই পাপিষ্ঠ-সম্মুখ ॥ ১০৬ ॥

*dekhiẏā ṭhākura citte baṛa pāila dukha |*
*ḍākiẏā kahila sei pāpiṣṭha-sammukha || 106 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhiya thakura — seeing it, the Thakura; chitte bada paila dukha — felt great sorrow at heart; dakiya kahila — called out; sei papishtha-sammukha — before those sinners

**106.** Seeing it, the Thakura was deeply grieved at heart
and called out, [standing] before those sinners:

তোমরা দোঁহার অধিক দুরাচার নাহি ।
পাপ বলি' যার নাম সঞ্চারয়ে মহী ॥ ১০৭ ॥

*tomarā doṁhāra adhika durācāra nāhi |*
*pāpa bali' yāra nāma sañcāraẏe mahī || 107 ||*

*Word for word:* tomara donhara adhika — more than you two; durachara nahi — there are none so wicked; papa bali — as "sin"; yara nama sancharaye mahi — whose name the earth spreads

**107.** "There are none more wicked than you two:
the earth spreads your names as the very name of sin.

সকল করিলা মাত্র নাহি কর এক ।
এখনে করিলে সেই দেখ পরতেক ॥ ১০৮ ॥

*sakala karilā mātra nāhi kara eka |*
*ekhane karile sei dekha parateka || 108 ||*

*Word for word:* sakala karila — you have done everything; matra nahi kara eka — only one thing you had not done; ekhane karile sei — now you have done that too; dekha parateka — see it plainly

**108.** You had done everything but one thing —
and now you have done that too; see it plainly!"[^30-19]

ইহা বলি' মহাপ্রভু নিত্যানন্দ-কাছে ।
আপন বসন তাঁর শিরে বান্ধিয়াছে ॥ ১০৯ ॥

*ihā bali' mahāprabhu nityānanda-kāche |*
*āpana basana tāṁra śire bāndhiẏāche || 109 ||*

*Word for word:* iha bali — saying this; mahaprabhu nityananda-kachhe — Mahaprabhu, [going] to Nityananda; apana vasana — with His own cloth; tanra shire bandhiyachhe — bound His head

**109.** Saying this, Mahaprabhu went to Nityananda
and bound His head with His own cloth.

নিত্যানন্দ-শ্রীপাদের জানেন মহত্ত্ব ।
ভূমিতে পড়য়ে পাছে তাঁহার রকত ॥ ১১০ ॥

*nityānanda-śrīpādera jānena mahattba |*
*bhūmite paṛaẏe pāche tāṁhāra rakata || 110 ||*

*Word for word:* nityananda-shripadera — of Nityananda Shripada; janena mahattva — He knows the greatness; bhumite padaye pachhe — lest it fall on the ground; tanhara rakata — His blood

**110.** He knows the greatness of Nityananda Shripada:
lest His blood fall on the ground —

পৃথিবীর অমঙ্গল জানি পাছে হয় ।
মস্তকে বান্ধিল বস্ত্র প্রভু এই ভয় ॥ ১১১ ॥

*pṛthibīra amaṅgala jāni pāche haẏa |*
*mastake bāndhila bastra prabhu ei bhaẏa || 111 ||*

*Word for word:* prithivira amangala — misfortune to the earth; jani pachhe haya — knowing it might come; mastake bandhila vastra — bound the cloth on the head; prabhu ei bhaya — the Lord, fearing this

**111.** knowing that misfortune would then befall the earth —
the Lord, fearing this, bound His head with the cloth.[^30-20]

তখনে সে মহাপ্রভুর ক্রোধ উপজিল ।
সুদর্শন চক্র বলি' স্মরণ করিল ॥ ১১১+১ ॥

*takhane se mahāprabhura krodha upajila |*
*sudarśana cakra bali' smaraṇa karila || 111+1 ||*

*Word for word:* takhane — then; se mahaprabhura krodha upajila — anger arose in Mahaprabhu; sudarshana chakra bali — saying "Sudarshana-chakra"; smarana karila — called to mind

**111+1.** Then anger arose in Mahaprabhu,
and He called [His disc] to mind, crying: "Sudarshana-chakra!"[^30-21]

সুদর্শন বলি' প্রভু ডাকে বার বার ।
শুনিয়া মুরারি গুপ্ত ছাড়য়ে হুঙ্কার ॥ ১১১+২ ॥

*sudarśana bali' prabhu ḍāke bāra bāra |*
*śuniẏā murāri gupta chāṛaẏe huṅkāra || 111+2 ||*

*Word for word:* sudarshana bali — crying "Sudarshana"; prabhu dake bara bara — the Lord calls again and again; shuniya — hearing; murari gupta chhadaye hunkara — Murari Gupta gives a roar

**111+2.** "Sudarshana!" — the Lord calls again and again;
hearing this, Murari Gupta gives a thunderous roar

শুনিয়া কহয়ে শুন প্রভু বিশ্বম্ভর ।
আজ্ঞা পাঙ এ দুই পাঠাঙ যম-ঘর ॥ ১১১+৩ ॥

*śuniẏā kahaẏe śuna prabhu biśbambhara |*
*ājñā pāṅa e dui pāṭhāṅa yama-ghara || 111+3 ||*

*Word for word:* shuniya kahaye — hearing, he says; shuna prabhu vishvambhara — listen, Lord Vishvambhara; ajna pana — let me get the order; e dui pathana yama-ghara — I send these two to the abode of Yama

**111+3.** and says: "Listen, Lord Vishvambhara:
give me the order — I will send these two to the abode of Yama!"

শুনি' নিত্যানন্দ ধরেন মুরারির হাতে ।
হেনকালে সুদর্শন আইলা সাক্ষাতে ॥ ১১১+৪ ॥

*śuni' nityānanda dharena murārira hāte |*
*henakāle sudarśana āilā sākṣāte || 111+4 ||*

*Word for word:* shuni — hearing; nityananda dharena murarira hate — Nityananda holds Murari by the hand; henakale — at that moment; sudarshana aila sakshate — Sudarshana appeared in person

**111+4.** Hearing this, Nityananda holds Murari back by the hand —
and at that moment Sudarshana appeared in person.

ক্রোধ করি' সুদর্শনে ডাকে গৌরহরি ।
দাণ্ডাইলা সুদর্শন করযোড় করি' ॥ ১১২ ॥

*krodha kari' sudarśane ḍāke gaurahari |*
*dāṇḍāilā sudarśana karayoṛa kari' || 112 ||*

*Word for word:* krodha kari — in anger; sudarshane dake gaurahari — Gaurahari summons Sudarshana; dandaila sudarshana — Sudarshana stood forth; karajoda kari — with joined palms

**112.** In anger Gaurahari summons Sudarshana,
and Sudarshana stood [before Him] with joined palms:

কি কারণে আজ্ঞা মোরে করিলা ঈশ্বর ।
জয় জয় মহাপ্রভু শচীর কোঙর ॥ ১১৩ ॥

*ki kāraṇe ājñā more karilā īśbara |*
*jaẏa jaẏa mahāprabhu śacīra koṅara || 113 ||*

*Word for word:* ki karane — for what reason; ajna more karila ishvara — has the Ishvara summoned me; jaya jaya mahaprabhu — glory, glory to Mahaprabhu; shachira kongara — the son of Shachi

**113.** "Why, O Ishvara, have You summoned me?
Glory, glory to Mahaprabhu, the son of Shachi!"

প্রভু বোলে জগাই-মাধাইরে সংহার ।
নিত্যানন্দ মারি' ব্যথা দিলেক অন্তর ॥ ১১৪ ॥

*prabhu bole jagāi-mādhāire saṃhāra |*
*nityānanda māri' byathā dileka antara || 114 ||*

*Word for word:* prabhu bole — the Lord says; jagai-madhaire samhara — destroy Jagai and Madhai; nityananda mari — striking Nityananda; vyatha dileka antara — they have pained [My] heart

**114.** The Lord says: "Destroy Jagai and Madhai:
by striking Nityananda they have wounded My heart."
