শুনি' সুদর্শন অতি প্রলয় হইয়া ।
জগাই মাধাই-পাশে চলিলা ধাইয়া ॥ ১১৫ ॥

*śuni' sudarśana ati pralaẏa haiẏā |*
*jagāi mādhāi-pāśe calilā dhāiẏā || 115 ||*

*Word for word:* shuni sudarshana — hearing, Sudarshana; ati pralaya haiya — terrible as the world's dissolution; jagai madhai-pashe — towards Jagai and Madhai; chalila dhaiya — rushed

**115.** Hearing this, Sudarshana, terrible as the world's dissolution,
rushed towards Jagai and Madhai.

দেখিলেন জগাই মাধাই সুদর্শন ।
কাঁপিতে লাগিল অঙ্গ তরাসিত মন ॥ ১১৬ ॥

*dekhilena jagāi mādhāi sudarśana |*
*kāṁpite lāgila aṅga tarāsita mana || 116 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhilena jagai madhai — Jagai and Madhai saw; sudarshana — Sudarshana; kapite lagila anga — their bodies began to tremble; tarasita mana — their minds terrified

**116.** Jagai and Madhai saw Sudarshana:
their bodies began to tremble, their minds were seized with fear.

সুদর্শন দেখি' নিত্যানন্দ প্রভু হাসে ।
কি করিলা ভগবান্ এ বড় প্রকাশে ॥ ১১৭ ॥

*sudarśana dekhi' nityānanda prabhu hāse |*
*ki karilā bhagabān e baṛa prakāśe || 117 ||*

*Word for word:* sudarshana dekhi — seeing Sudarshana; nityananda prabhu hase — Nityananda Prabhu laughs; ki karila bhagavan — what has Bhagavan done; e bada prakashe — with this great manifestation

**117.** Seeing Sudarshana, Nityananda Prabhu laughs:
"What has Bhagavan done — what a great manifestation!"

দয়ার সাগর মোর নিত্যানন্দ রায় ।
না মারিহ বলি' সুদর্শনে নিবারয় ॥ ১১৭+১ ॥

*daẏāra sāgara mora nityānanda rāẏa |*
*nā māriha bali' sudarśane nibāraẏa || 117+1 ||*

*Word for word:* dayara sagara — an ocean of mercy; mora nityananda raya — my Nityananda Raya; na mariha bali — saying "do not kill"; sudarshane nivaraya — holds Sudarshana back

**117+1.** My Nityananda Raya is an ocean of mercy:
"Do not kill!" He says, and holds Sudarshana back[^30-22].

করুণাতে উদ্ধার করিলা ত্রিভুবন ।
দীনহীন পতিত পামর দুষ্টজন ॥ ১১৮ ॥

*karuṇāte uddhāra karilā tribhubana |*
*dīnahīna patita pāmara duṣṭajana || 118 ||*

*Word for word:* karunate — out of compassion; uddhara karila tribhuvana — You have delivered the three worlds; dinahina — the poor and lowly; patita pamara dushtajana — the fallen, the vile, the wicked

**118.** "In Your compassion You have delivered the three worlds —
the poor and lowly, the fallen, the vile and the wicked.

জগাই মাধাই তারি' দীনবন্ধু হও ।
পতিতপাবন-নামের গরিমা রাখহ ॥ ১১৯ ॥

*jagāi mādhāi tāri' dīnabandhu hao |*
*patitapābana-nāmera garimā rākhaha || 119 ||*

*Word for word:* jagai madhai tari — delivering Jagai and Madhai; dinabandhu hao — be the Friend of the wretched; patitapavana-namera — of the name "Purifier of the fallen"; garima rakhaha — keep the glory

**119.** Deliver Jagai and Madhai — be the Friend of the wretched,
keep the glory of the name 'Purifier of the fallen'."

ইহা বলি' নিত্যানন্দ চরণে পড়িয়া ।
কহিলেন প্রভু-পদে বিনয় করিয়া ॥ ১২০ ॥

*ihā bali' nityānanda caraṇe paṛiẏā |*
*kahilena prabhu-pade binaẏa kariẏā || 120 ||*

*Word for word:* iha bali — saying this; nityananda charane padiya — Nityananda, falling at the feet; kahilena prabhu-pade — spoke at the Lord's feet; vinaya kariya — humbly

**120.** Saying this, Nityananda fell at His feet
and spoke humbly at the Lord's feet:

এ দুই পতিত প্রভু মোরে কর দান ।
পতিতপাবন-নাম থাকুক ব্যাখ্যান ॥ ১২১ ॥

*e dui patita prabhu more kara dāna |*
*patitapābana-nāma thākuka byākhyāna || 121 ||*

*Word for word:* e dui patita — these two fallen ones; prabhu more kara dana — Lord, give to me; patitapavana-nama — the name "Purifier of the fallen"; thakuka vyakhyana — let it remain renowned

**121.** "Lord, give these two fallen ones to me:
let the name 'Purifier of the fallen' be renowned.

আর আর যুগে দৈত্য করিলে সংহার ।
সশরীরে এই দুই করহ উদ্ধার ॥ ১২২ ॥

*āra āra yuge daitya karile saṃhāra |*
*saśarīre ei dui karaha uddhāra || 122 ||*

*Word for word:* ara ara yuge — in other ages; daitya karile samhara — You destroyed the demons; sasharire — in their very bodies; ei dui karaha uddhara — deliver these two

**122.** In other ages You destroyed the demons —
deliver these two in their very bodies[^30-23].

করজোড়ি' প্রভুরে বোলয়ে নিত্যানন্দ ।
নাহি লো নিস্তার কলি-পাষণ্ড দুরন্ত ॥ ১২২+১ ॥

*karajoṛi' prabhure bolaẏe nityānanda |*
*nāhi lo nistāra kali-pāṣaṇḍa duranta || 122+1 ||*

*Word for word:* karajodi — with joined palms; prabhure bolaye nityananda — Nityananda says to the Lord; nahi lo nistara — there is no deliverance; kali-pashanda duranta — the godless of Kali are untamable

**122+1.** With joined palms Nityananda says to the Lord:
"[Otherwise] there is no deliverance: the godless of the Kali age are untamable[^30-24].

সংকীর্তন-আরম্ভে সে তোমার অবতার ।
কেমনে করিবে কলি-জীবের নিস্তার ॥ ১২২+২ ॥

*saṃkīrtana-ārambhe se tomāra abatāra |*
*kemane karibe kali-jībera nistāra || 122+2 ||*

*Word for word:* sankirtana-arambhe — to begin sankirtana; se tomara avatara — is Your descent; kemane karibe — how will You accomplish; kali-jivera nistara — the deliverance of the souls of Kali

**122+2.** You descended to begin sankirtana —
how [else] will You deliver the souls of the Kali age?"

শুনি' নিত্যানন্দ-বাণী প্রভু দয়াময় ।
ধন্য ধন্য নিত্যানন্দ রোহিণী-তনয় ॥ ১২৩ ॥

*śuni' nityānanda-bāṇī prabhu daẏāmaẏa |*
*dhanya dhanya nityānanda rohiṇī-tanaẏa || 123 ||*

*Word for word:* shuni nityananda-vani — hearing Nityananda's words; prabhu dayamaya — the merciful Lord [says]; dhanya dhanya nityananda — blessed, blessed is Nityananda; rohini-tanaya — the son of Rohini

**123.** Hearing Nityananda's words, the merciful Lord [says]:
"Blessed, blessed is Nityananda, the son of Rohini!"[^30-25]

প্রভু বলে নিত্যানন্দ পতিতপাবন ।
তোমারে ভজিলে জীব পায় প্রেমধন ॥ ১২৩+১ ॥

*prabhu bale nityānanda patitapābana |*
*tomāre bhajile jība pāẏa premadhana || 123+1 ||*

*Word for word:* prabhu bale — the Lord says; nityananda patita-pavana — Nityananda, Purifier of the fallen; tomare bhajile — worshipping You; jiva paya prema-dhana — living beings obtain the treasure of prema

**123+1.** The Lord says: "Nityananda, You are the Purifier of the fallen:
worshipping You, living beings obtain the treasure of prema[^30-26].

তোমা হৈতে হবে কলি-জীবের নিস্তার ।
তোমা বহি কৃপার সমুদ্র নাহি আর ॥ ১২৩+২ ॥

*tomā haite habe kali-jībera nistāra |*
*tomā bahi kṛpāra samudra nāhi āra || 123+2 ||*

*Word for word:* toma haite — through You; habe kali-jivera nistara — will come the deliverance of the souls of Kali; toma bahi — apart from You; kripara samudra nahi ara — there is no other ocean of mercy

**123+2.** Through You will come the deliverance of the souls of Kali;
apart from You there is no [other] ocean of mercy.

তোর বশ মুঞি হও সর্বশাস্ত্রে কহে ।
যে তুমি কহিলে তাহা করিব নিশ্চয়ে ॥ ১২৪ ॥

*tora baśa muñi hao sarbaśāstre kahe |*
*ye tumi kahile tāhā kariba niścaẏe || 124 ||*

*Word for word:* tora basha munyi hao — I am under Your control; sarva-shastre kahe — all the scriptures say; ye tumi kahile — what You have said; taha kariba nishchaye — I will surely do

**124.** All the scriptures say that I am under Your control:
what You have said I will surely do.

একবার নিত্যানন্দ বোলে জন্ম ধরি' ।
সে জন পবিত্র হৈল সে লোক আমারি ॥ ১২৫ ॥

*ekabāra nityānanda bole janma dhari' |*
*se jana pabitra haila se loka āmāri || 125 ||*

*Word for word:* ekabara — even once; nityananda bole — says "Nityananda"; janma dhari — having taken birth; se jana pavitra haila — that person is purified; se loka amari — that person is Mine

**125.** Whoever, having taken birth, even once says 'Nityananda'
is purified — that person is Mine."

ঘরে গেলা মহাপ্রভু নিজজন লঞা ।
জগাই মাধাই রহে বিস্মিত হইয়া ॥ ১২৬ ॥

*ghare gelā mahāprabhu nijajana lañā |*
*jagāi mādhāi rahe bismita haiẏā || 126 ||*

*Word for word:* ghare gela mahaprabhu — Mahaprabhu went home; nijajana lanya — with His own; jagai madhai rahe — Jagai and Madhai remained; vismita haiya — astonished

**126.** Mahaprabhu went home with His own,
and Jagai and Madhai remained, astonished.

[^30-1]: The summary covers the whole section (vv. 1–169); this portion contains vv. 1–126, the rest is in the next. In the OCR of the edition many places are garbled or illegible (part of the summary ended up among the verses); what is restored by sense is in square brackets. Cf. Murari 2.10 and 2.13; Chaitanya-bhagavata, Madhya 13; Chaitanya-charitamrita, Adi 17.
[^30-2]: Vv. 2+1 — 2+7 are found only in the 1983 edition (absent from Bhaktisiddhanta's edition); the 1903 edition has them in the main text. Cf. Murari 2.10.16–17, where this play is understood as a repetition of Krishna's play with the gopis' garments; here it is the Lord's playful sport with His intimates, in which He, "who knows every rasa", gives them joy.
[^30-3]: Vv. 5–23 — cf. Murari 2.10.18–21. Nityananda's swaying gait, red eyes and loud cries are signs of His intoxication with prema (cf. en/28, note 12). The washing of His feet at the Lord's command teaches honour to the Vaishnava: the water of a devotee's feet purifies and bestows prema.
[^30-4]: In the 1983 edition this couplet stands after Advaita's arrival (vv. 29–30), and the honours and the meal refer to Him (cf. v. 34); in Bhaktisiddhanta's edition it comes before His arrival, so that they may also be referred to Haridasa (cf. Murari 2.10.4, where the Lord feeds Haridasa mahaprasada). We keep the order of the edition.
[^30-5]: According to Gaudiya Vaishnava tradition, Brahma and Prahlada are united in Haridasa Thakura (Gaura-ganoddesha-dipika); here Brahma manifests in him and praises the Lord with four mouths. Cf. Murari 2.10.24.
[^30-6]: Vv. 36–41 — the reasons for the Lord's descent: to taste His own bhava and to establish the dharma of the age, the sankirtana of the name (cf. Chaitanya-charitamrita, Adi 3–4, where the inner reason is to taste Radha's love, and the outer one to spread the holy name and the prema of Vraja). Cf. Gita 4.8 on "destroying irreligion and establishing dharma".
[^30-7]: Vv. 43–46 — a list of associates; the presence of Narahari and Raghunandana, as above (en/29, note 7), is mentioned only by Lochana Dasa.
[^30-8]: "Tying it fast" — literally "making a knot (granthi)": perhaps counting the names on knots of a string is also meant.
[^30-9]: "Masters (thakuras) of Navadvipa" — according to the Chaitanya-bhagavata (Madhya 13), Jagai and Madhai, brothers of a noble brahmana family, were the town's keepers of order (kotwals) and were sunk in vice.
[^30-10]: V. 62+1 is found only in the 1983 edition; the 1903 edition gives it in a footnote as an additional reading of one printed book. Kayasthas are the caste of scribes. Cf. en/31, v. 148+1.
[^30-11]: The story of Ajamila is Bhagavata 6.1–2: the dying sinner called his son named Narayana, and even such an utterance of the name — namabhasa, the "shadow of the name", the name directed to another — saved him. Bhaktisiddhanta's summary stresses precisely this.
[^30-12]: V. 96+1 is found only in the 1983 edition (the 1903 edition lacks it).
[^30-13]: Shani is Saturn, the planet-deity who brings misfortune; "Shani hangs over your life" is a threat: "you are done for".
[^30-14]: V. 99+1 is found only in the 1983 edition (the 1903 edition lacks it).
[^30-15]: V. 101+1 is found only in the 1983 edition (the 1903 edition lacks it); it nearly repeats v. 93.
[^30-16]: Vv. 102+1 — 102+4 are found only in the 1983 edition (the 1903 edition lacks them). In the 1983 edition v. 103 also differs: "Madhai runs in anger with a stick in his hand", so that Madhai alone throws the shard, while Jagai, touched by Nityananda's gaze, stands rooted to the spot (see note 17).
[^30-17]: In Bhaktisiddhanta's edition both brothers throw the shard. According to the Chaitanya-bhagavata (Madhya 13), only Madhai struck Nityananda, while Jagai held him back from a second blow and was the first to receive mercy; the 1983 edition is close to this (vv. 102+1 — 102+4 and its reading of v. 103), and there, moreover, Nityananda, heedless of the pain, asks the brothers to sing the name of Hari (vv. 105+1 — 105+5). In Murari (2.13) the Lord promises to deliver Jagai and Madhai at Srivasa's request.
[^30-18]: Vv. 105+1 — 105+5 are found only in the 1983 edition (the 1903 edition lacks them). Nityananda grieves not over His wound but over the evil plight of the offenders — an image of His unparalleled mercy (see note 23).
[^30-19]: That is, they have offended a saint — Nityananda, a sannyasi and a Vaishnava; offence to a Vaishnava (vaishnava-aparadha) is the gravest of sins.
[^30-20]: Nityananda is Balarama, the Lord Himself (Sankarshana, the source of Ananta-Shesha); to spill His blood on the earth is a great offence that threatens the world with calamity.
[^30-21]: Vv. 111+1 — 111+4 are found only in the 1983 edition (the 1903 edition lacks them). Murari Gupta, according to Gaudiya Vaishnava tradition, is Hanuman (en/24, note 12) — hence his warlike roar.
[^30-22]: V. 117+1 is found only in the 1983 edition (the 1903 edition lacks it); these are the author's words inserted into Nityananda's speech.
[^30-23]: The Lord's anger at the offenders of His devotee is also a manifestation of His love; and in the age of Kali the Lord takes up no weapons, but delivers by the holy name and prema (Chaitanya-charitamrita, Adi 3, 17). Nityananda's intercession for His offenders is an image of His unparalleled mercy: according to Gaudiya Vaishnava teaching, Nityananda's grace makes no distinction between the worthy and the unworthy (Chaitanya-charitamrita, Adi 5).
[^30-24]: Vv. 122+1 — 122+2 are found only in the 1983 edition (the 1903 edition lacks them).
[^30-25]: The son of Rohini is Balarama; thus Lochana Dasa directly calls Nityananda Balarama, as does the whole Gaudiya Vaishnava tradition.
[^30-26]: Vv. 123+1 — 123+2 are found only in the 1983 edition (the 1903 edition lacks them). In the 1983 edition v. 123 itself also differs: "Hearing Nityananda's words, Lord Gaurachandra began to weep, embracing Nityananda"; and the words "Blessed, blessed is Nityananda, the son of Rohini" stand there after v. 125 as the author's exclamation: "Blessed, blessed is Gaurachandra, the merciful Lord; blessed, blessed is Nityananda, the son of Rohini!" According to Gaudiya Vaishnava teaching, it is by Nityananda's mercy that one obtains Gaura's mercy (Chaitanya-charitamrita, Adi 5, 8).

---

# Madhya-khanda, part 8 (portion 31)

*The section "Pastimes with the Devotees and the Deliverance of Jagai and Madhai" (end): the repentance of Jagai and Madhai; the Lord takes their sins upon Himself and embraces them. The section "Wondrous Pastimes of Mahaprabhu in the Bhava of Bhagavan": the poor brahmana Vanamali and his son see Krishna in Vrindavana in the Lord — the "new Creator"; the bhava of Nrisimha in Srivasa's house; the singer of Shiva and the Lord in Shiva's bhava on his shoulders*

মহাপ্রভুর দরশন সংকীর্তন-শব্দে ।
বিস্মিত হইয়া রহে চাহে এক স্তব্ধে ॥ ১২৭ ॥

*mahāprabhura daraśana saṃkīrtana-śabde |*
*bismita haiẏā rahe cāhe eka stabdhe || 127 ||*

*Word for word:* mahaprabhura darashana — the sight of Mahaprabhu; sankirtana-shabde — by the sound of sankirtana; vismita haiya rahe — they remain astonished; chahe eka stabdhe — they stare, stunned

**127.** At the sight of Mahaprabhu and the sound of the sankirtana
they stand astonished, staring motionless [after Him].[^31-1]

মনে মনে অনুমান করয়ে অন্তর ।
বিচার করয়ে মহাপ্রভুর উত্তর ॥ ১২৮ ॥

*mane mane anumāna karaẏe antara |*
*bicāra karaẏe mahāprabhura uttara || 128 ||*

*Word for word:* mane mane — within themselves; anumana karaye antara — they reflect in their hearts; vichara karaye — they ponder; mahaprabhura uttara — Mahaprabhu's words (reply)

**128.** Within themselves they reflect in their hearts,
pondering Mahaprabhu's words:

হেন পাপ কৈলুঁ যাহা মৃগে নাহি করে ।
যাহা নাহি করে তাহা সন্ন্যাসিরে মারে ॥ ১২৯ ॥

*hena pāpa kailuṁ yāhā mṛge nāhi kare |*
*yāhā nāhi kare tāhā sannyāsire māre || 129 ||*

*Word for word:* hena papa kailun — we have committed such a sin; yaha mrige nahi kare — as not even a beast commits; yaha nahi kare — what [even it] does not do; taha sannyasire mare — that: to strike a sannyasi

**129.** "We have committed a sin such as not even a beast would commit:
what not even it would do — we struck a sannyasi!"[^31-2]

গুণিতে গুণিতে তার অন্তর নির্মল ।
দেখ দেখ মহাপ্রভুর করুণার বল ॥ ১৩০ ॥

*guṇite guṇite tāra antara nirmala |*
*dekha dekha mahāprabhura karuṇāra bala || 130 ||*

*Word for word:* gunite gunite — as they kept pondering; tara antara nirmala — their hearts became pure; dekha dekha — see, see; mahaprabhura karunara bala — the power of Mahaprabhu's mercy

**130.** Reflecting thus, they became pure in heart —
see, see the power of Mahaprabhu's mercy!

কাতর হইয়া দোঁহে ধায় ঊর্ধ্বমুখে ।
চমক লাগিল দেখি' নদিয়ার লোকে ॥ ১৩১ ॥

*kātara haiẏā doṁhe dhāẏa ūrdhbamukhe |*
*camaka lāgila dekhi' nadiẏāra loke || 131 ||*

*Word for word:* katara haiya — in anguish; donhe dhaya — both run; urdhva-mukhe — with faces upturned; chamaka lagila — were amazed; dekhi — seeing; nadiyara loke — the people of Nadia

**131.** In the anguish of repentance both run with faces raised [to the sky],
and the people of Nadia, seeing it, were amazed.

মহাপ্রভুর দ্বারে গিয়া হৈল উপনীত ।
ঠাকুর ঠাকুর বলি' ডাকে বিপরীত ॥ ১৩২ ॥

*mahāprabhura dbāre giẏā haila upanīta |*
*ṭhākura ṭhākura bali' ḍāke biparīta || 132 ||*

*Word for word:* mahaprabhura dvare giya — going to Mahaprabhu's door; haila upanita — they arrived; thakura thakura bali — saying "Thakura, Thakura"; dake viparita — they call out wildly

**132.** Coming to Mahaprabhu's door,
they cry out wildly: "Thakura! Thakura!"

নিজজন মেলি' প্রভু বসিয়াছে ঘরে ।
কে মোরে ডাকয়ে দেখ বাহির-দুয়ারে ॥ ১৩৩ ॥

*nijajana meli' prabhu basiẏāche ghare |*
*ke more ḍākaẏe dekha bāhira-duẏāre || 133 ||*

*Word for word:* nijajana meli — together with His own; prabhu basiyachhe ghare — the Lord was sitting at home; ke more dakaye — who is calling Me; dekha bahira-duyare — look at the outer door

**133.** The Lord, sitting at home among His own, [says]:
"Who is calling Me? Look at the outer door.

এখনে আমার ঠাঞি আনহ মুরারি ।
আজ্ঞা পাঞা দোঁহারে আনিলা কোলে করি' ॥ ১৩৪ ॥

*ekhane āmāra ṭhāñi ānaha murāri |*
*ājñā pāñā doṁhāre ānilā kole kari' || 134 ||*

*Word for word:* ekhane — now; amara thanni anaha — bring to Me; murari — Murari; ajna panna — receiving the command; donhare anila kole kari — he brought both, embracing them

**134.** Murari, bring them to Me at once."
Receiving the command, [Murari] embraced them both and brought them.

প্রভুকে দেখিয়া তারা অতি আর্তনাদে ।
চরণে পড়িয়া ভূমি দুই ভাই কান্দে ॥ ১৩৫ ॥

*prabhuke dekhiẏā tārā ati ārtanāde |*
*caraṇe paṛiẏā bhūmi dui bhāi kānde || 135 ||*

*Word for word:* prabhuke dekhiya — seeing the Lord; tara ati arta-nade — they with a cry of anguish; charane padiya bhumi — falling at His feet on the ground; dui bhai kande — the two brothers weep

**135.** Seeing the Lord, with a cry of anguish
they fell at [His] feet on the ground — both brothers weep:

পতিতপাবন তুমি করুণার সিন্ধু ।
সর্বলোকনাথ যে বিশেষে দীনবন্ধু ॥ ১৩৬ ॥

*patitapābana tumi karuṇāra sindhu |*
*sarbalokanātha ye biśeṣe dīnabandhu || 136 ||*

*Word for word:* patita-pavana tumi — You are the Purifier of the fallen; karunara sindhu — the ocean of mercy; sarva-loka-natha — the Lord of all worlds; ye visheshe dina-bandhu — and above all the Friend of the wretched

**136.** "You are the Purifier of the fallen, the ocean of mercy,
the Lord of all the worlds and above all the Friend of the wretched!"

করুণাসাগর প্রভু সদয়হৃদয় ।
আর্তজন-আর্তি দেখি' তখনি দ্রবয় ॥ ১৩৭ ॥

*karuṇāsāgara prabhu sadaẏahṛdaẏa |*
*ārtajana-ārti dekhi' takhani drabaẏa || 137 ||*

*Word for word:* karuna-sagara prabhu — the Lord, the ocean of mercy; sadaya-hridaya — compassionate of heart; artajana-arti dekhi — seeing the suffering of the afflicted; takhani dravaya — melts at once

**137.** The Lord is an ocean of mercy, His heart full of compassion:
seeing the suffering of the afflicted, He melts at once.

তুলিয়া পুছিল শুন জগাই মাধাই ।
কি কারণে কান্দ কেনে আইলা মোর ঠাঞি ॥ ১৩৮ ॥

*tuliẏā puchila śuna jagāi mādhāi |*
*ki kāraṇe kānda kene āilā mora ṭhāñi || 138 ||*

*Word for word:* tuliya — raising them; puchhila — He asked; shuna jagai madhai — listen, Jagai and Madhai; ki karane kanda — why do you weep; kene aila mora thanni — why have you come to Me

**138.** Raising them, He asked: "Listen, Jagai and Madhai,
why do you weep? Why have you come to Me?

নবদ্বীপে একাগ্র ঠাকুর দুইজন ।
চতুর হইয়া কেনে কান্দহ এখন ॥ ১৩৯ ॥

*nabadbīpe ekāgra ṭhākura duijana |*
*catura haiẏā kene kāndaha ekhana || 139 ||*

*Word for word:* navadvipe — in Navadvipa; ekagra thakura duijana — you two are the foremost masters; chatura haiya — being clever; kene kandaha ekhana — why do you weep now

**139.** You two are the foremost masters of Navadvipa,
clever men — why then do you weep now?"

এ বোল শুনিয়া বোলে জগাই মাধাই ।
তোমার কৃপায় মোরা আইনু তোর ঠাঞি ॥ ১৪০ ॥

*e bola śuniẏā bole jagāi mādhāi |*
*tomāra kṛpāẏa morā āinu tora ṭhāñi || 140 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuniya — hearing these words; bole jagai madhai — Jagai and Madhai say; tomara kripaya — by Your mercy; mora ainu tora thanni — we have come to You

**140.** Hearing this, Jagai and Madhai say:
"By Your mercy we have come to You.

গোবধ স্ত্রীবধ পাপ করিয়াছি কত ।
লেখা-জোখা নাহি নরবধ কৈলুঁ কত ॥ ১৪১ ॥

*gobadha strībadha pāpa kariẏāchi kata |*
*lekhā-jokhā nāhi narabadha kailuṁ kata || 141 ||*

*Word for word:* go-vadha stri-vadha papa — sins of killing cows and women; kariyachhi kata — how many we have committed; lekha-jokha nahi — beyond count and measure; nara-vadha kailun kata — how many men we have killed

**141.** How many sins we have committed — the killing of cows and women!
Beyond all count and measure — how many men we have killed!

ধিক যাউ আমার নদিয়ার ঠাকুরাল ।
গুরুহত্যা ব্রহ্মহত্যায় এ দেহ আমার ॥ ১৪২ ॥

*dhika yāu āmāra nadiẏāra ṭhākurāla |*
*guruhatyā brahmahatyāẏa e deha āmāra || 142 ||*

*Word for word:* dhik yau — shame on; amara nadiyara thakurala — our lordship over Nadia; guru-hatya brahma-hatyaya — with the killing of gurus and brahmanas; e deha amara — this body of ours [is stained]

**142.** Shame on our lordship over Nadia!
This body of ours [is stained] with the killing of gurus and the killing of brahmanas.

ব্রাহ্মণী যবনী গুর্বঙ্গনা নাহি এড়ি ।
চণ্ডালিনী-আদি করি' কাহুকে না ছাড়ি ॥ ১৪৩ ॥

*brāhmaṇī yabanī gurbaṅganā nāhi eṛi |*
*caṇḍālinī-ādi kari' kāhuke nā chāṛi || 143 ||*

*Word for word:* brahmani yavani gurv-angana — brahmana women, Muslim women, wives of gurus; nahi edi — we do not leave alone; chandalini-adi kari — chandala women and others; kahuke na chhadi — we spare no one

**143.** Brahmana women, Muslim women, the wives of gurus we did not leave alone;
chandala women and others — we spared no one.

হিংসা বহি নাহি করি জগতের লোকে ।
দেবকর্ম পিতৃকর্ম নাহি বাসে মোকে ॥ ১৪৪ ॥

*hiṃsā bahi nāhi kari jagatera loke |*
*debakarma pitṛkarma nāhi bāse moke || 144 ||*

*Word for word:* himsa bahi nahi kari — we do nothing but harm; jagatera loke — to the people of the world; deva-karma pitri-karma — rites for gods and ancestors; nahi base moke — do not please us

**144.** To the people of the world we have done nothing but harm;
rites for the gods and the ancestors are not to our liking.

তোর ঠাঞি আমি ছার আর কিবা বলি ।
যত পাপ কৈলুঁ তত শিরে নাহি চুলি ॥ ১৪৫ ॥

*tora ṭhāñi āmi chāra āra kibā bali |*
*yata pāpa kailuṁ tata śire nāhi culi || 145 ||*

*Word for word:* tora thanni — to You; ami chhara — we worthless ones; ara kiba bali — what more can we say; yata papa kailun — as many sins as we committed; tata shire nahi chuli — so many hairs there are not on the head

**145.** What more can we, worthless as we are, say to You?
There are not as many hairs on our heads as the sins we have committed.

অজামিলনামে পাপী বোলে সর্বজন ।
আমারে অধিক নহে কহিল বচন ॥ ১৪৬ ॥

*ajāmilanāme pāpī bole sarbajana |*
*āmāre adhika nahe kahila bacana || 146 ||*

*Word for word:* ajamila-name papi — of a sinner named Ajamila; bole sarvajana — all people speak; amare adhika nahe — [he] is not greater than us; kahila vachana — they said

**146.** All people speak of a sinner named Ajamila,
but he is no greater sinner than we," they said. —

পুত্রস্নেহে নারায়ণ নাম লৈল সেহ ।
বৈকুণ্ঠে চলিলা দ্বিজ পাইয়া দিব্যদেহ ॥ ১৪৬+১ ॥

*putrasnehe nārāẏaṇa nāma laila seha |*
*baikuṇṭhe calilā dbija pāiẏā dibyadeha || 146+1 ||*

*Word for word:* putra-snehe — out of love for his son; narayana nama laila seha — he uttered the name "Narayana"; vaikunthe chalila dvija — the brahmana went to Vaikuntha; paiya divya-deha — obtaining a divine body

**146+1.** "Out of love for his son he uttered the name 'Narayana',
and the brahmana, obtaining a divine body, went to Vaikuntha[^31-3].

নিস্তার করিল তারে নাম নারায়ণে ।
আমা নিস্তারিতে নারে আসিয়া আপনে ॥ ১৪৭ ॥

*nistāra karila tāre nāma nārāẏaṇe |*
*āmā nistārite nāre āsiẏā āpane || 147 ||*

*Word for word:* nistara karila tare — delivered him; nama narayane — the name "Narayana"; ama nistarite nare — cannot deliver us; asiya apane — [even] coming Himself

**147.** The name 'Narayana' delivered him,
but [Narayana Himself], coming in person, cannot deliver us.[^31-4]

আমার নিস্তার নাহি মো জান আপনা ।
আমারে কি গুণে তুমি করিবে করুণা ॥ ১৪৮ ॥

*āmāra nistāra nāhi mo jāna āpanā |*
*āmāre ki guṇe tumi karibe karuṇā || 148 ||*

*Word for word:* amara nistara nahi — there is no deliverance for us; mo jana apana — You Yourself know; amare ki gune — for what merit to us; tumi karibe karuna — will You show mercy

**148.** For us there is no deliverance — You Yourself know it:
for what merit will You show us mercy?

সহস্র কায়স্থ যদি শত জন্মে গণে ।
তবু আমা-দোঁহার পাপ না হয় গণনে ॥ ১৪৮+১ ॥

*sahasra kāẏastha yadi śata janme gaṇe |*
*tabu āmā-doṁhāra pāpa nā haẏa gaṇane || 148+1 ||*

*Word for word:* sahasra kayastha — a thousand scribes; yadi shata janme gane — if they count for a hundred births; tabu — still; ama-donhara papa — the sins of us two; na haya ganane — cannot be counted

**148+1.** Even if a thousand scribes were to count for a hundred births,
still the sins of us two could not be counted"[^31-5].

এতেক কাতর বাণী শুনিঞা ঠাকুর ।
অকৈতব শুনি' দয়া বাঢ়িল প্রচুর ॥ ১৪৯ ॥

*eteka kātara bāṇī śuniñā ṭhākura |*
*akaitaba śuni' daẏā bāṛhila pracura || 149 ||*

*Word for word:* eteka katara vani — such anguished words; shuninna thakura — hearing, the Thakura; akaitava shuni — hearing [them] free of pretence; daya badhila prachura — compassion grew abundantly

**149.** Hearing such anguished words
and seeing that they were without pretence, the Thakura was filled with boundless compassion.

আর্তজনার আর্তি দেখি' ঠাকুরের আর্তি ।
করুণাবিগ্রহ আরে দয়াময় মূর্তি ॥ ১৫০ ॥

*ārtajanāra ārti dekhi' ṭhākurera ārti |*
*karuṇābigraha āre daẏāmaẏa mūrti || 150 ||*

*Word for word:* artajanara arti dekhi — seeing the suffering of the afflicted; thakurera arti — the Thakura's suffering; karuna-vigraha — mercy embodied; are dayamaya murti — oh, the form full of compassion

**150.** Seeing the suffering of the afflicted, the Thakura Himself suffers —
compassion embodied, oh, the very form of mercy!

করুণাসাগর করে করুণা প্রকাশ ।
করে ধরি' লঞা গেলা জাহ্নবীর পাশ ॥ ১৫১ ॥

*karuṇāsāgara kare karuṇā prakāśa |*
*kare dhari' lañā gelā jāhnabīra pāśa || 151 ||*

*Word for word:* karuna-sagara — the ocean of mercy; kare karuna prakasha — reveals mercy; kare dhari — taking by the hand; lanna gela jahnavira pasha — led them to the Jahnavi

**151.** The ocean of mercy reveals His mercy:
taking them by the hand, He led them to the Jahnavi.

ধাইল নদিয়ার লোক দেখিতে কৌতুক ।
প্রেম প্রকাশয়ে প্রভু অতি অপরূপ ॥ ১৫২ ॥

*dhāila nadiẏāra loka dekhite kautuka |*
*prema prakāśaẏe prabhu ati aparūpa || 152 ||*

*Word for word:* dhaila nadiyara loka — the people of Nadia ran; dekhite kautuka — to see the wonder; prema prakashaye prabhu — the Lord reveals prema; ati aparupa — most wondrously

**152.** The people of Nadia ran to see the wonder:
the Lord reveals prema — a sight unheard of!

ব্রাহ্মণ-সজ্জন সব দাণ্ডাইয়া চাহে ।
সভা-বিদ্যমানে প্রভু দয়াবাণী কহে ॥ ১৫৩ ॥

*brāhmaṇa-sajjana saba dāṇḍāiẏā cāhe |*
*sabhā-bidyamāne prabhu daẏābāṇī kahe || 153 ||*

*Word for word:* brahmana-sajjana saba — all the brahmanas and good people; dandaiya chahe — stand and watch; sabha-vidyamane — in the presence of all; prabhu daya-vani kahe — the Lord speaks words of mercy

**153.** The brahmanas and good people all stand and watch;
before them all the Lord speaks words of mercy:

তোর পাপ-পরিগ্রহ করিব ত আমি ।
আপনে আপন পাপ উৎসর্গহ তুমি ॥ ১৫৪ ॥

*tora pāpa-parigraha kariba ta āmi |*
*āpane āpana pāpa utsargaha tumi || 154 ||*

*Word for word:* tora papa-parigraha kariba ta ami — I shall accept your sins; apane apana papa — your own sins yourselves; utsargaha tumi — you dedicate [as a gift]

**154.** "I shall take your sins upon Myself —
and you yourselves give Me your sins."

ইহা বলি' হাথ পাতে তুলসীর তরে ।
তুলসী না দেই তারা দুই ভাই ডরে ॥ ১৫৫ ॥

*ihā bali' hātha pāte tulasīra tare |*
*tulasī nā dei tārā dui bhāi ḍare || 155 ||*

*Word for word:* iha bali — saying this; hatha pate — He holds out His hand; tulasira tare — for the tulasi; tulasi na dei — do not give the tulasi; tara dui bhai dare — they, the two brothers, out of fear

**155.** Saying this, He holds out His hand for the tulasi,[^31-6]
but the two brothers in fear do not give the tulasi.

দয়া করি' পুনঃ কহে গৌর ভগবান্ ।
জগাই মাধাই তোরা পাপ দে রে দান ॥ ১৫৬ ॥

*daẏā kari' punaḥ kahe gaura bhagabān |*
*jagāi mādhāi torā pāpa de re dāna || 156 ||*

*Word for word:* daya kari — in mercy; punah kahe — again says; gaura bhagavan — Gaura Bhagavan; jagai madhai — Jagai and Madhai; tora papa de re dana — give your sins as a gift

**156.** In His mercy Gaura Bhagavan speaks again:
"Jagai and Madhai, give Me your sins as a gift!"

জগাই মাধাই বোলে শুন প্রভু তুমি ।
আমার যতেক পাপ লিখিতে না জানি ॥ ১৫৭ ॥

*jagāi mādhāi bole śuna prabhu tumi |*
*āmāra yateka pāpa likhite nā jāni || 157 ||*

*Word for word:* jagai madhai bole — Jagai and Madhai say; shuna prabhu tumi — listen, Lord; amara yateka papa — however many our sins; likhite na jani — cannot be written down

**157.** Jagai and Madhai say: "Listen, Lord:
our sins are so many that they cannot even be written down.

আমি মহা-অধমাধম পাপাশয় পাপ ।
তোরে পাপ দিতে হিয়া ভয়ে মোর কাঁপ ॥ ১৫৮ ॥

*āmi mahā-adhamādhama pāpāśaẏa pāpa |*
*tore pāpa dite hiẏā bhaẏe mora kāṁpa || 158 ||*

*Word for word:* ami maha-adhamadhama — we are the very lowest of the low; papashaya papa — a storehouse of sins, sin itself; tore papa dite — to give You our sins; hiya bhaye mora kampa — our hearts tremble with fear

**158.** We are the lowest of the low, a storehouse of sins, sin itself;
to give You our sins — our hearts tremble with fear."

এ বোল শুনিঞা আঁখি করে ছলছল ।
মেঘের গম্ভীর-নাদে বোলে হরিবোল ॥ ১৫৯ ॥

*e bola śuniñā āṁkhi kare chalachala |*
*meghera gambhīra-nāde bole haribola || 159 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuninna — hearing these words; ankhi kare chhalachhala — His eyes brimmed with tears; meghera gambhira-nade — with a voice deep as a cloud's thunder; bole hari-bola — He cries "Hari bol"

**159.** Hearing this, His eyes filled with tears,
and in a voice deep as thunder from a cloud He cried: "Hari bol!"

পুনরপি পাপদান চাহি' কর পাতে ।
জগাই মাধাই সে তুলসী দিল হাথে ॥ ১৬০ ॥

*punarapi pāpadāna cāhi' kara pāte |*
*jagāi mādhāi se tulasī dila hāthe || 160 ||*

*Word for word:* punarapi — again; papa-dana chahi — asking for the gift of sins; kara pate — He holds out His hand; jagai madhai — Jagai and Madhai; se tulasi dila hathe — placed the tulasi in His hand

**160.** Again, asking for the gift of their sins, He holds out His hand —
and Jagai and Madhai placed the tulasi in His hand.

চৌদিগে ভেল ধ্বনি হরি হরি বোল ।
জগাই মাধাই ধরি' প্রভু দেই কোল ॥ ১৬১ ॥

*caudige bhela dhbani hari hari bola |*
*jagāi mādhāi dhari' prabhu dei kola || 161 ||*

*Word for word:* chaudige bhela dhvani — on all sides rose the cry; hari hari bola — "Hari, Hari bol"; jagai madhai dhari — taking hold of Jagai and Madhai; prabhu dei kola — the Lord embraces

**161.** On all sides rose the cry: "Hari, Hari bol!"
The Lord embraced Jagai and Madhai.

নিস্তারিলা দুই ভাই জগাই মাধাই ।
এহেন পাতকী প্রভু পরশিতে পাই ॥ ১৬২ ॥

*nistārilā dui bhāi jagāi mādhāi |*
*ehena pātakī prabhu paraśite pāi || 162 ||*

*Word for word:* nistarila — He delivered; dui bhai jagai madhai — the two brothers Jagai and Madhai; ehena pataki — such sinners; prabhu parashite pai — obtained the touch of the Lord

**162.** He delivered the two brothers, Jagai and Madhai —
such sinners were granted the touch of the Lord!

প্রেমে গদগদ স্বর আধ-আধ বোলে ।
বসন ভিজিয়া গেল নয়ানের জলে ॥ ১৬৩ ॥

*preme gadagada sbara ādha-ādha bole |*
*basana bhijiẏā gela naẏānera jale || 163 ||*

*Word for word:* preme gadgada svara — voices choked with prema; adha-adha bole — they speak brokenly; basana bhijiya gela — their clothes became soaked; nayanera jale — with tears

**163.** Their voices choke with prema, their speech is broken,
their clothes are soaked with tears.

পুলকে ভরিল তনু কম্প কলেবরে ।
চরণে পড়িয়া ভূমে কহয়ে কাতরে ॥ ১৬৪ ॥

*pulake bharila tanu kampa kalebare |*
*caraṇe paṛiẏā bhūme kahaẏe kātare || 164 ||*

*Word for word:* pulake bharila tanu — their bodies were filled with thrill; kampa kalebare — trembling in their frames; charane padiya bhume — falling at His feet on the ground; kahaye katare — they speak in anguish

**164.** Their bodies thrill, their whole frames tremble;
falling at [the Lord's] feet on the ground, they speak in anguish:

এহেন ঠাকুর আর আছে কোন জন ।
দয়ার সাগর মহাপতিতপাবন ॥ ১৬৫ ॥

*ehena ṭhākura āra āche kona jana |*
*daẏāra sāgara mahāpatitapābana || 165 ||*

*Word for word:* ehena thakura — such a Thakura; ara achhe kona jana — is there anyone else; dayara sagara — an ocean of mercy; maha-patita-pavana — the great Purifier of the fallen

**165.** "Is there anywhere another such Thakura —
an ocean of mercy, the great Purifier of the fallen!"

জগাই-মাধাই হেন পাতকী নিস্তারে ।
শ্রীঅঙ্গ-পরশে তারা নাচে প্রেমভরে ॥ ১৬৬ ॥

*jagāi-mādhāi hena pātakī nistāre |*
*śrīaṅga-paraśe tārā nāce premabhare || 166 ||*

*Word for word:* jagai-madhai hena pataki — such sinners as Jagai and Madhai; nistare — He delivers; shri-anga-parashe — by the touch of His divine body; tara nache prema-bhare — they dance full of prema

**166.** He delivers such sinners as Jagai and Madhai:
by the touch of His divine body they dance, overflowing with prema.

জগাই-মাধাই-পাপ-পরিগ্রহ করি' ।
আপনে নাচয়ে প্রভু বিশ্বম্ভর হরি ॥ ১৬৭ ॥

*jagāi-mādhāi-pāpa-parigraha kari' |*
*āpane nācaẏe prabhu biśbambhara hari || 167 ||*

*Word for word:* jagai-madhai-papa-parigraha kari — having accepted the sins of Jagai and Madhai; apane nachaye — Himself dances; prabhu vishvambhara hari — the Lord Vishvambhara Hari

**167.** Having taken upon Himself the sins of Jagai and Madhai,
the Lord Vishvambhara Hari Himself dances.[^31-7]

এ হেন করুণানিধি কে আছে ঠাকুর ।
দোষ না দেখয়ে স্নেহ করে এতদূর ॥ ১৬৮ ॥

*e hena karuṇānidhi ke āche ṭhākura |*
*doṣa nā dekhaẏe sneha kare etadūra || 168 ||*

*Word for word:* e hena karuna-nidhi — such a treasury of mercy; ke achhe thakura — what other Thakura is there; dosha na dekhaye — He sees no fault; sneha kare etadura — He loves to such an extent

**168.** Where else is such a Thakura, a treasury of mercy,
who sees no fault and loves so boundlessly?

জীবের উদ্ধার করি' নাচয়ে উল্লাসে ।
এ বড় ভরসা বান্ধে এ লোচন দাসে ॥ ১৬৯ ॥

*jībera uddhāra kari' nācaẏe ullāse |*
*e baṛa bharasā bāndhe e locana dāse || 169 ||*

*Word for word:* jivera uddhara kari — delivering souls; nachaye ullase — He dances with joy; e bada bharasa — this great hope; bandhe e lochana dase — this Lochana Dasa holds firmly

**169.** He delivers souls and dances with joy —
on this Lochana Dasa firmly sets his hope.

## Wondrous Pastimes of Mahaprabhu in the Bhava of Bhagavan

> *Summary by Srila Bhaktisiddhanta Sarasvati.* One day, while Sriman Mahaprabhu was joyfully sporting with the devotees, a poor brahmana named Vanamali, a native of East Bengal, came there with his son, and Sriman Mahaprabhu cast a merciful glance upon them. At this they suddenly became mad with the bliss of prema, and when the sankirtana began, they saw Sriman Mahaprabhu right there in the form of Shyamasundara and fainted with supreme bliss; on regaining consciousness they praised Sriman Mahaprabhu, the Giver of prema, and called Him the "new Creator", since, freeing [people] from Vedic rites, He bestows prema on all living beings. Then one day in Srivasa's house, while listening to the hymn "The Thousand Names of Vishnu", [the Lord] suddenly roared in the bhava of Nrisimha; and when everyone in fear began to flee in all directions, He restrained His bhava of Nrisimha. On another day, when a worshipper of Shiva began to sing of Shiva's qualities, Gaurasundara, greatly pleased at hearing the qualities of the [great] devotee Shiva sung, climbed onto his shoulders and danced in the bhava of Shiva. On yet another day, when a brahmana woman touched Sriman Mahaprabhu's feet, Sriman Mahaprabhu, deeply grieved, leapt into the Ganga; the devotees drew Him out onto the bank and satisfied Sriman Mahaprabhu with all kinds of prayers and praises. Then Sriman Mahaprabhu taught that everyone who has obtained the rare human body must serve Hari, and that without serving Hari there is no meaning in human birth; [then are described] the embrace [of Murari], [his] humble words, the manifestation [by the Lord] of His divine form, the bathing [of the Lord] with Ganga water by Srivasa Pandita, the cleaning of the temple together with the devotees headed by Advaita Acharya, and so on; [at the end] the author, singing Gaura's qualities, instructs everyone to serve Gaura.[^31-8]

*Raga dhanashi; refrain: "O Lord, Dvijachand! To deliver the world He lays many snares"*

গদাধর গৌরাঙ্গ নরহরি জয় জয় ।
শুনিলে গৌরাঙ্গ-গুণ প্রেম লভ্য হয় ॥ ১ ॥

*gadādhara gaurāṅga narahari jaẏa jaẏa |*
*śunile gaurāṅga-guṇa prema labhya haẏa || 1 ||*

*Word for word:* gadadhara gauranga narahari — Gadadhara, Gauranga, Narahari; jaya jaya — glory, glory; shunile gauranga-guna — on hearing Gauranga's qualities; prema labhya haya — prema is obtained

**1.** Glory, glory to Gadadhara, Gauranga and Narahari!
Whoever hears of Gauranga's qualities obtains prema.

আর-দিনে আর অপরূপ কথা শুন ।
নবদ্বীপে প্রকাশ পরম মহাধন ॥ ২ ॥

*āra-dine āra aparūpa kathā śuna |*
*nabadbīpe prakāśa parama mahādhana || 2 ||*

*Word for word:* ara-dine — on another day; ara aparupa katha shuna — hear another wondrous story; navadvipe prakasha — in Navadvipa was revealed; parama maha-dhana — the supreme great treasure

**2.** Hear another wondrous story of another day:
in Navadvipa the supreme, great treasure was revealed.

নিজগৃহে বান্ধব সহিতে আছে পহুঁ ।
প্রকাশয়ে বদনকমলে কথা লহু ॥ ৩ ॥

*nijagṛhe bāndhaba sahite āche pahuṁ |*
*prakāśaẏe badanakamale kathā lahu || 3 ||*

*Word for word:* nijagrihe — in His own house; bandhava sahite — with His kinsmen; achhe pahu — the Lord stays; prakashaye — He utters; vadana-kamale — from His lotus mouth; katha lahu — words softly

**3.** The Lord stays at home with His own
and softly lets fall words from His lotus mouth.

অমিয়ানদীর ধারা বহে অনিবার ।
সিনাইল ভকত বেকত মাতোয়ার ॥ ৪ ॥

*amiẏānadīra dhārā bahe anibāra |*
*sināila bhakata bekata mātoẏāra || 4 ||*

*Word for word:* amiya-nadira dhara — the stream of a river of nectar; bahe anibara — flows unceasingly; sinaila bhakata — the bathed devotees; bekata matoyara — are manifestly intoxicated

**4.** A stream of a river of nectar flows unceasingly;
bathed in it, the devotees are manifestly intoxicated.

এইমনে আছে পহুঁ আনন্দ-কৌতুকে ।
আচম্বিতে আইল তথা এক ভিক্ষুকে ॥ ৫ ॥

*eimane āche pahuṁ ānanda-kautuke |*
*ācambite āila tathā eka bhikṣuke || 5 ||*

*Word for word:* ei-mane — thus; achhe pahu — the Lord abides; ananda-kautuke — in joyful play; achambite — suddenly; aila tatha — came there; eka bhikshuke — a beggar

**5.** Thus the Lord abides in joyful play —
and suddenly a beggar came there,

বনমালী নাম তার পুত্র এক সঙ্গে ।
বিপ্রকুলে জন্ম বৈসে পূর্বদেশ বঙ্গে ॥ ৬ ॥

*banamālī nāma tāra putra eka saṅge |*
*biprakule janma baise pūrbadeśa baṅge || 6 ||*

*Word for word:* vanamali nama tara — his name was Vanamali; putra eka sange — with him one son; vipra-kule janma — born in a brahmana family; baise purva-desha bange — he lives in the eastern land, Banga

**6.** named Vanamali, and with him his son;
born in a brahmana family, he lives in the east, in Banga.[^31-9]

দারিদ্র্য-জ্বালায় দগ্ধ আইল এই দেশে ।
গৌরচন্দ্র দেখি' বিপ্র পাইল সন্তোষে ॥ ৬+১ ॥

*dāridrya-jbālāẏa dagdha āila ei deśe |*
*gauracandra dekhi' bipra pāila santoṣe || 6+1 ||*

*Word for word:* daridrya-jvalaya dagdha — scorched by the fire of poverty; aila ei deshe — came to these parts; gaurachandra dekhi — seeing Gaurachandra; vipra paila santoshe — the brahmana was filled with gladness

**6+1.** Scorched by the fire of poverty, he had come to these parts,
and, seeing Gaurachandra, the brahmana was filled with gladness[^31-10].

দেখিল ত বিশ্বম্ভর ভকতবেষ্টিত ।
পুত্রের সহিত বিপ্র ভেল আনন্দিত ॥ ৭ ॥

*dekhila ta biśbambhara bhakatabeṣṭita |*
*putrera sahita bipra bhela ānandita || 7 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhila ta — he saw; vishvambhara bhakata-veshtita — Vishvambhara surrounded by devotees; putrera sahita vipra — the brahmana with his son; bhela anandita — became joyful

**7.** He saw Vishvambhara surrounded by devotees —
and the brahmana and his son were filled with joy.

পুত্রের সহিত বিপ্র অনুমান করে ।
কহিতে না পারে কণ্ঠ গদগদ স্বরে ॥ ৮ ॥

*putrera sahita bipra anumāna kare |*
*kahite nā pāre kaṇṭha gadagada sbare || 8 ||*

*Word for word:* putrera sahita vipra — the brahmana with his son; anumana kare — reflects; kahite na pare — cannot speak; kantha gadgada svare — his throat choked in voice

**8.** The brahmana and his son reflect [within];
he cannot speak — his voice chokes in his throat.

ভালই হইল আমি ভৈগেলুঁ দরিদ্র ।
দরিদ্র লাগিয়া আইনু ভৈগেলুঁ পবিত্র ॥ ৯ ॥

*bhālai haila āmi bhaigeluṁ daridra |*
*daridra lāgiẏā āinu bhaigeluṁ pabitra || 9 ||*

*Word for word:* bhalai haila — it turned out well; ami bhaigelun daridra — that I became poor; daridra lagiya ainu — because of poverty I came; bhaigelun pavitra — I became pure

**9.** "It is well that I became poor:
because of poverty I came [here] — and was purified.

নিশ্চয় জানিলুঁ বিশ্বম্ভর ভগবান্ ।
অনুভবে জানিলুঁ এ কভু নহে আন ॥ ১০ ॥

*niścaẏa jāniluṁ biśbambhara bhagabān |*
*anubhabe jāniluṁ e kabhu nahe āna || 10 ||*

*Word for word:* nishchaya janilun — I know for certain; vishvambhara bhagavan — Vishvambhara is Bhagavan; anubhave janilun — I realized by experience; e kabhu nahe ana — He is never anyone else

**10.** I know for certain: Vishvambhara is Bhagavan;
I have realized in my heart that He is no one else.

জনম সফল আজি ভেল হেন বাসি ।
দেখিলুঁ মো বিশ্বম্ভর গৌর গুণরাশি ॥ ১১ ॥

*janama saphala āji bhela hena bāsi |*
*dekhiluṁ mo biśbambhara gaura guṇarāśi || 11 ||*

*Word for word:* janama saphala aji bhela — my birth today has borne fruit; hena basi — so I feel; dekhilun mo — I have seen; vishvambhara gaura guna-rashi — Vishvambhara, golden, a mine of virtues

**11.** Today, I feel, my birth has been fulfilled:
I have seen Vishvambhara, the golden one, a mine of virtues.

দেখিতে নয়ান হিয়া জুড়াইল আমার ।
নিভাইল দুরন্ত দারিদ্র্য-জ্বালা ছার ॥ ১২ ॥

*dekhite naẏāna hiẏā juṛāila āmāra |*
*nibhāila duranta dāridrya-jbālā chāra || 12 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhite — on seeing; nayana hiya judaila amara — my eyes and heart were soothed; nibhaila — was quenched; duranta daridrya-jvala chhara — the wretched unbearable fire of poverty

**12.** As soon as I saw Him, my eyes and heart were soothed,
the wretched, unbearable fire of poverty was quenched.

অমিয়-আহারে যেন সন্তোষ অন্তর ।
গৌরচন্দ্র দেখিয়া সিঞ্চিত কলেবর ॥ ১৩ ॥

*amiẏa-āhāre yena santoṣa antara |*
*gauracandra dekhiẏā siñcita kalebara || 13 ||*

*Word for word:* amiya-ahare — on eating nectar; yena santosha antara — as the heart is content; gaurachandra dekhiya — seeing Gaurachandra; sinchita kalebara — the body is bathed

**13.** As the heart is content on tasting nectar,
so at the sight of Gaurachandra my whole body is [as if] bathed."

তবে গৌর ভগবান্ দেখিয়া তাহারে ।
করুণনয়ানে চাহে ব্রাহ্মণ-দোঁহারে ॥ ১৪ ॥

*tabe gaura bhagabān dekhiẏā tāhāre |*
*karuṇanaẏāne cāhe brāhmaṇa-doṁhāre || 14 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe — then; gaura bhagavan — Gaura Bhagavan; dekhiya tahare — seeing him; karuna-nayane chahe — looks with merciful eyes; brahmana-donhare — on the two brahmanas

**14.** Then Gaura Bhagavan, seeing him,
looked with merciful eyes upon the two brahmanas.

সুখে হরিগুণ গায় সে দোঁহার সনে ।
প্রভুর প্রসাদে তারা পাইল প্রেমধনে ॥ ১৫ ॥

*sukhe hariguṇa gāẏa se doṁhāra sane |*
*prabhura prasāde tārā pāila premadhane || 15 ||*

*Word for word:* sukhe — joyfully; hari-guna gaya — sings Hari's qualities; se donhara sane — He together with the two; prabhura prasade — by the Lord's grace; tara paila prema-dhane — they obtained the treasure of prema

**15.** Joyfully He sings of Hari's qualities with the two,
and by the Lord's grace they obtained the treasure of prema.

আনন্দে নাচয়ে বিপ্র নাচে তার পুত্র ।
তিলেকে ঘুচিল তার এ সংসারসূত্র ॥ ১৬ ॥

*ānande nācaẏe bipra nāce tāra putra |*
*tileke ghucila tāra e saṃsārasūtra || 16 ||*

*Word for word:* anande nachaye vipra — the brahmana dances in joy; nache tara putra — his son dances; tileke — in a moment; ghuchila tara — was removed for him; e samsara-sutra — this thread of samsara

**16.** In joy the brahmana dances, his son dances;
in a moment the thread of samsara was cut for him.

হেন মহাপ্রভু গোরা করুণার সিন্ধু ।
ইহার অধিক আর নাহি দীনবন্ধু ॥ ১৭ ॥

*hena mahāprabhu gorā karuṇāra sindhu |*
*ihāra adhika āra nāhi dīnabandhu || 17 ||*

*Word for word:* hena mahaprabhu gora — such is Mahaprabhu Gora; karunara sindhu — the ocean of mercy; ihara adhika — greater than He; ara nahi dina-bandhu — there is no other Friend of the wretched

**17.** Such is Mahaprabhu Gora, the ocean of mercy:
there is no greater Friend of the wretched than He.

তার-পর-দিন প্রভু সংকীর্তন-মাঝে ।
নাচয়ে ঠাকুর বিশ্বম্ভর নটরাজে ॥ ১৮ ॥

*tāra-para-dina prabhu saṃkīrtana-mājhe |*
*nācaẏe ṭhākura biśbambhara naṭarāje || 18 ||*

*Word for word:* tara-para-dina — on the next day; prabhu sankirtana-majhe — the Lord in the midst of sankirtana; nachaye thakura vishvambhara — the Thakura Vishvambhara dances; nataraje — the king of dancers

**18.** The next day, in the midst of the sankirtana,
the Thakura Vishvambhara, king of dancers, dances.

হেনকালে সে দুই ব্রাহ্মণ আচম্বিত ।
দেখিল বালক এক চিত চমকিত ॥ ১৯ ॥

*henakāle se dui brāhmaṇa ācambita |*
*dekhila bālaka eka cita camakita || 19 ||*

*Word for word:* henakale — at that time; se dui brahmana — those two brahmanas; achambita — suddenly; dekhila balaka eka — saw a boy; chita chamakita — their hearts were startled

**19.** Then those two brahmanas suddenly
saw a certain boy — and their hearts were startled:

গৌরশরীরে প্রভু ভেল শ্যামতনু ।
কটি পীতধটী শোভে করে বর-বেণু ॥ ২০ ॥

*gauraśarīre prabhu bhela śyāmatanu |*
*kaṭi pītadhaṭī śobhe kare bara-beṇu || 20 ||*

*Word for word:* gaura-sharire — in the golden body; prabhu bhela shyama-tanu — the Lord became dark of body; kati pita-dhati shobhe — a yellow cloth shines on the hips; kare vara-venu — in the hand a splendid flute

**20.** the Lord in His golden body had become dark,
a yellow cloth shines on His hips, in His hand a splendid flute,

ময়ূর-পাখার চূড়া ঘন উড়ে বায় ।
সেইরূপ দেখি' যত অনুগত গায় ॥ ২১ ॥

*maẏūra-pākhāra cūṛā ghana uṛe bāẏa |*
*seirūpa dekhi' yata anugata gāẏa || 21 ||*

*Word for word:* mayura-pakhara chuda — the crest of peacock feathers; ghana ude baya — flutters in the wind; sei-rupa dekhi — seeing that form; yata anugata gaya — all the followers sing

**21.** a crest of peacock feathers flutters in the wind.
[Seeing] that form, all [His] companions sing.

রাধাসঙ্গে বৃন্দাবনে বিপিনের মাঝে ।
দেখিলেন শ্যামতনু নটবররাজে ॥ ২২ ॥

*rādhāsaṅge bṛndābane bipinera mājhe |*
*dekhilena śyāmatanu naṭabararāje || 22 ||*

*Word for word:* radha-sange — with Radha; vrindavane vipinera majhe — in Vrindavana in the depth of the forest; dekhilena shyama-tanu — they saw the Dark One; natavara-raje — the king of dancers

**22.** In Vrindavana, in the depths of the forest, beside Radha,
they saw the Dark One, the king of dancers.

যমুনা তথাই দেখে গোবর্ধন গিরি ।
বহুলা ভাণ্ডীর মধুবন আদি করি' ॥ ২৩ ॥

*yamunā tathāi dekhe gobardhana giri |*
*bahulā bhāṇḍīra madhubana ādi kari' || 23 ||*

*Word for word:* yamuna tathai dekhe — there too they see the Yamuna; govardhana giri — Mount Govardhana; bahula bhandira madhuvana — Bahula, Bhandira, Madhuvana; adi kari — and others

**23.** There too they see the Yamuna, Mount Govardhana,
Bahula, Bhandira, Madhuvana and the other [forests];

গো গোপী গোপাল দেখে আর বনতাল ।
নবদ্বীপে দেখিলেন মদনগোপাল ॥ ২৪ ॥

*go gopī gopāla dekhe āra banatāla |*
*nabadbīpe dekhilena madanagopāla || 24 ||*

*Word for word:* go gopi gopala dekhe — they see the cows, gopis, cowherds; ara bana-tala — and Talavana (the palm forest); navadvipe dekhilena — in Navadvipa they saw; madana-gopala — Madana-Gopala

**24.** they see the cows, the gopis, the cowherd boys and Talavana —
in Navadvipa they saw Madana-Gopala.[^31-11]

দেখিয়া মূর্চ্ছিত হৈয়া পড়িল ব্রাহ্মণ ।
পুলকে আকুল অঙ্গ সজল নয়ন ॥ ২৫ ॥

*dekhiẏā mūrcchita haiẏā paṛila brāhmaṇa |*
*pulake ākula aṅga sajala naẏana || 25 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhiya — seeing this; murchchhita haiya padila brahmana — the brahmana fell unconscious; pulake akula anga — his body agitated with thrill; sajala nayana — eyes full of tears

**25.** Seeing this, the brahmana fell unconscious:
his body thrilling, his eyes in tears.

ঘন ঘন হুহুঙ্কার মারে মালসাট ।
এই কৃষ্ণ কৃষ্ণ বলি' পাতিলেক হাট ॥ ২৬ ॥

*ghana ghana huhuṅkāra māre mālasāṭa |*
*ei kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa bali' pātileka hāṭa || 26 ||*

*Word for word:* ghana ghana huhunkara — again and again "hum!"; mare malasata — he slaps himself like a wrestler; ei krishna krishna bali — crying "here is Krishna, Krishna"; patileka hata — set up a market (drew a crowd)

**26.** Again and again he cries "hum!", slaps himself like a wrestler,
shouts "Here is Krishna, Krishna!" — and a crowd gathered round.[^31-12]

দেখিয়া ঠাকুর পুনঃ নৃত্য সম্বরিল ।
ধর ধর বলি' পুনঃ ব্রাহ্মণে ধরিল ॥ ২৭ ॥

*dekhiẏā ṭhākura punaḥ nṛtya sambarila |*
*dhara dhara bali' punaḥ brāhmaṇe dharila || 27 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhiya — seeing this; thakura punah — the Thakura again; nritya sambarila — stopped the dance; dhara dhara bali — crying "hold, hold"; punah brahmane dharila — again caught hold of the brahmana

**27.** Seeing this, the Thakura again stopped dancing
and, crying "Hold him, hold him!", again caught hold of the brahmana.

শুন সবজন এই গোরা-গুণগাথা ।
করুণা প্রকাশে এই নবীন বিধাতা ॥ ২৮ ॥

*śuna sabajana ei gorā-guṇagāthā |*
*karuṇā prakāśe ei nabīna bidhātā || 28 ||*

*Word for word:* shuna sabajana — hear, all people; ei gora-guna-gatha — this song of Gora's qualities; karuna prakashe — reveals mercy; ei navina vidhata — this new Creator

**28.** Hear, all of you, this song of Gora's qualities:
this new Creator reveals mercy.

কর্মবন্ধ ঘুচাইয়া প্রেমধন দেই ।
এছন ঠাকুর আর আছে কোন ঠাঁই ॥ ২৯ ॥

*karmabandha ghucāiẏā premadhana dei |*
*echana ṭhākura āra āche kona ṭhāṁi || 29 ||*

*Word for word:* karma-bandha ghuchaiya — removing the bonds of karma; prema-dhana dei — He gives the treasure of prema; echhana thakura — such a Thakura; ara achhe kona thani — where else is there

**29.** Removing the bonds of karma, He gives the treasure of prema —
where else is there such a Thakura?

সংসারের বহি সৃজে আপন সংসার ।
স্ববিষয়া প্রেমভক্তি বিষয়ের পার ॥ ৩০ ॥

*saṃsārera bahi sṛje āpana saṃsāra |*
*sbabiṣaẏā premabhakti biṣaẏera pāra || 30 ||*

*Word for word:* samsarera bahi — outside samsara; srije apana samsara — He creates His own world; sva-vishaya prema-bhakti — prema-bhakti whose object is Himself; vishayera para — beyond sense objects

**30.** Beyond samsara He creates His own world —
prema-bhakti directed to Himself, beyond the objects of the senses.[^31-13]

দিব্য মালা চন্দন প্রসাদ পরে নিতি ।
মমতা নাহিক সব জনেরে পিরীতি ॥ ৩১ ॥

*dibya mālā candana prasāda pare niti |*
*mamatā nāhika saba janere pirīti || 31 ||*

*Word for word:* divya mala chandana prasada — divine garlands, sandal paste, prasada; pare niti — He wears daily; mamata nahika — there is no attachment; saba janere piriti — love for all

**31.** Every day He wears divine garlands, sandal paste, prasada,
[yet] there is no attachment in Him — only love for all.

নিঃসঙ্গ হইয়া সঙ্গ বিনে নাহি জীয়ে ।
অকর্ম হইয়া কর্ম করয়ে বিধিয়ে ॥ ৩২ ॥

*niḥsaṅga haiẏā saṅga bine nāhi jīẏe |*
*akarma haiẏā karma karaẏe bidhiẏe || 32 ||*

*Word for word:* nihsanga haiya — though unattached; sanga vine nahi jiye — He does not live without company; akarma haiya — though beyond karma; karma karaye vidhiye — He performs acts according to injunction

**32.** Unattached, He cannot live without the company [of devotees];
beyond karma, He performs acts according to injunction.

বেদের বিচার বিধি যে আছে উচিত ।
সকল করয়ে সেই কার্যে বিপরীত ॥ ৩৩ ॥

*bedera bicāra bidhi ye āche ucita |*
*sakala karaẏe sei kārye biparīta || 33 ||*

*Word for word:* vedera vichara vidhi — the Vedic rulings and injunctions; ye achhe uchita — which are proper; sakala karaye sei — all that He performs; karye viparita — in effect the opposite

**33.** All that is proper according to the Vedic injunctions
He performs in full — yet in effect the result is the opposite.

এছন প্রকাশে নিজ প্রেমভক্তিধন ।
এতেকে বলিয়ে নব বিধাতা রতন ॥ ৩৪ ॥

*echana prakāśe nija premabhaktidhana |*
*eteke baliẏe naba bidhātā ratana || 34 ||*

*Word for word:* echhana prakashe — thus He reveals; nija prema-bhakti-dhana — His own treasure of prema-bhakti; eteke baliye — therefore I call; nava vidhata ratana — the new Creator, a jewel

**34.** Thus He reveals His treasure of prema-bhakti;
therefore I call Him: "The new Creator, a jewel."

এ হেন করুণাসিন্ধু মোর গোরারায় ।
অনায়াসে সব জন পর-ধন পায় ॥ ৩৫ ॥

*e hena karuṇāsindhu mora gorārāẏa |*
*anāẏāse saba jana para-dhana pāẏa || 35 ||*

*Word for word:* e hena karuna-sindhu — such an ocean of mercy; mora gora-raya — my Gora-raya; anayase — without effort; saba jana para-dhana paya — all people obtain the supreme treasure

**35.** Such is my Gora-raya, the ocean of mercy:
all without effort obtain the supreme treasure.

এছন ঠাকুর আর নাহি প্রেমদাতা ।
কহয়ে লোচন ভজ নবীন বিধাতা ॥ ৩৬ ॥

*echana ṭhākura āra nāhi premadātā |*
*kahaẏe locana bhaja nabīna bidhātā || 36 ||*

*Word for word:* echhana thakura — such a Thakura; ara nahi prema-data — there is no other Giver of prema; kahaye lochana — says Lochana; bhaja navina vidhata — worship the new Creator

**36.** There is no other such Thakura, the Giver of prema —
says Lochana: worship the new Creator!

*Refrain: "Whoever has once seen Gora's beauty cannot forget it — he pines away all his life"*

তবে আর-এক-দিন শুন অপরূপ ।
শ্রীবাসপণ্ডিত-ঘরে আনন্দ-কৌতুক ॥ ৩৭ ॥

*tabe āra-eka-dina śuna aparūpa |*
*śrībāsapaṇḍita-ghare ānanda-kautuka || 37 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe ara-eka-dina — then on another day; shuna aparupa — hear of a wonder; shrivasa-pandita-ghare — in the house of Srivasa Pandita; ananda-kautuka — a joyful festivity

**37.** And then one more day — hear of a wonder —
a joyful festival in the house of Srivasa Pandita.

পিতৃকর্ম করে সেই শ্রীবাসপণ্ডিত ।
শুনয়ে সহস্রনাম অতি শুদ্ধচিত ॥ ৩৮ ॥

*pitṛkarma kare sei śrībāsapaṇḍita |*
*śunaẏe sahasranāma ati śuddhacita || 38 ||*

*Word for word:* pitri-karma kare — performs the rite for the ancestors; sei shrivasa-pandita — that Srivasa Pandita; shunaye sahasra-nama — listens to the "Thousand Names"; ati shuddha-chita — with a most pure heart

**38.** That Srivasa Pandita performs the rite for the ancestors
and with a most pure heart listens to the "Thousand Names".

হেনকালে সেই ঠাঞি গেলা গৌরহরি ।
শুনয়ে সহস্রনাম মনোরথ পূরি' ॥ ৩৯ ॥

*henakāle sei ṭhāñi gelā gaurahari |*
*śunaẏe sahasranāma manoratha pūri' || 39 ||*

*Word for word:* henakale — at that time; sei thanni gela gaurahari — Gaurahari went there; shunaye sahasra-nama — listens to the "Thousand Names"; manoratha puri — fulfilling His heart's desire

**39.** At that time Gaurahari came there
and, fulfilling His heart's desire, listens to the "Thousand Names".

শুনিতে শুনিতে ভেল নৃসিংহ-আবেশ ।
ক্রোধে রাঙ্গা দু-নয়ান ঊর্ধ্ব ভেল কেশ ॥ ৪০ ॥

*śunite śunite bhela nṛsiṃha-ābeśa |*
*krodhe rāṅgā du-naẏāna ūrdhba bhela keśa || 40 ||*

*Word for word:* shunite shunite — as He listened; bhela nrisimha-avesha — the bhava of Nrisimha arose; krodhe ranga du-nayana — both eyes red with anger; urdhva bhela kesha — the hair stood on end

**40.** As He listened, the bhava of Nrisimha arose in Him:[^31-14]
His two eyes reddened with anger, His hair stood on end.

পুলকিত সব অঙ্গ অরুণ বরণ ।
ঘন ঘন হুহুঙ্কার সিংহের গর্জন ॥ ৪১ ॥

*pulakita saba aṅga aruṇa baraṇa |*
*ghana ghana huhuṅkāra siṃhera garjana || 41 ||*

*Word for word:* pulakita saba anga — the whole body thrilling; aruna barana — of crimson hue; ghana ghana huhunkara — again and again "hum!"; simhera garjana — a lion's roar

**41.** His whole body thrilling, His colour crimson,
again and again a fierce "hum!", a lion's roar.

আচম্বিতে গদা লঞা ধাইল সত্বর ।
দেখিয়া সকল লোক কাঁপিলা অন্তর ॥ ৪২ ॥

*ācambite gadā lañā dhāila satbara |*
*dekhiẏā sakala loka kāṁpilā antara || 42 ||*

*Word for word:* achambite — suddenly; gada lanna — taking a club; dhaila satvara — He rushed swiftly; dekhiya sakala loka — seeing this, all the people; kanpila antara — trembled at heart

**42.** Suddenly He seized a club and rushed [forward] —
seeing this, all the people trembled at heart.

পলায় সকল লোক না বান্ধয়ে কেশ ।
সহিতে না পারে প্রভুর ক্রোধ-আবেশ ॥ ৪৩ ॥

*palāẏa sakala loka nā bāndhaẏe keśa |*
*sahite nā pāre prabhura krodha-ābeśa || 43 ||*

*Word for word:* palaya sakala loka — all the people flee; na bandhaye kesha — without tying their hair; sahite na pare — they cannot bear; prabhura krodha-avesha — the Lord's wrathful bhava

**43.** Everyone flees without even tying up their hair:
they cannot bear the Lord's wrathful bhava.

পলায়নপর লোক দেখি' নরহরি ।
ক্ষণেকে ছাড়িল গদা আবেশ সম্বরি' ॥ ৪৪ ॥

*palāẏanapara loka dekhi' narahari |*
*kṣaṇeke chāṛila gadā ābeśa sambari' || 44 ||*

*Word for word:* palayana-para loka dekhi — seeing the people in flight; narahari — Nrihari (the Man-Lion, the Lord); kshaneke chhadila gada — in a moment dropped the club; avesha sambari — restraining the bhava

**44.** Seeing the people take to flight, Nrihari[^31-15]
in a moment threw down the club, restraining His bhava.

সর্ব-অবতার-বীজ শচীর নন্দন ।
যখনে যে পড়ে মনে হয় ত তেমন ॥ ৪৫ ॥

*sarba-abatāra-bīja śacīra nandana |*
*yakhane ye paṛe mane haẏa ta temana || 45 ||*

*Word for word:* sarva-avatara-bija — the seed of all avataras; shachira nandana — the son of Shachi; yakhane ye pade mane — whenever someone comes to mind; haya ta temana — so He becomes

**45.** The son of Shachi is the seed of all avataras:
whoever comes to His mind, that He becomes.[^31-16]

ভাব সম্বরিয়া প্রভু বসিলা আসনে ।
বিস্মিত হইয়া কিছু বলিলা বচনে ॥ ৪৬ ॥

*bhāba sambariẏā prabhu basilā āsane |*
*bismita haiẏā kichu balilā bacane || 46 ||*

*Word for word:* bhava sambariya — restraining His bhava; prabhu basila asane — the Lord sat on His seat; vismita haiya — astonished; kichhu balila vachane — spoke some words

**46.** Restraining His bhava, the Lord sat down on His seat
and, astonished, spoke:

না জানি কি অপরাধ ভৈগেল আমার ।
কিবা চিতে অনুমান ভেল তো-সবার ॥ ৪৭ ॥

*nā jāni ki aparādha bhaigela āmāra |*
*kibā cite anumāna bhela to-sabāra || 47 ||*

*Word for word:* na jani — I do not know; ki aparadha bhaigela amara — what offence of Mine occurred; kiba chite anumana — or what thought in the heart; bhela to-sabara — arose in all of you

**47.** "I do not know — have I committed some offence?
Or is something on your minds?"

এ বোল শুনিঞা সভে বলিল বচন ।
কি তোমার অপরাধ কি কহ কথন ॥ ৪৮ ॥

*e bola śuniñā sabhe balila bacana |*
*ki tomāra aparādha ki kaha kathana || 48 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuninna — hearing this; sabhe balila vachana — all said; ki tomara aparadha — what offence of Yours; ki kaha kathana — what are You saying

**48.** Hearing this, all said:
"What offence of Yours? What are You saying?"

শ্রীবাস কহিল তোমা দেখিল যে জন ।
তাহার হইল সব বন্ধ-বিমোচন ॥ ৪৯ ॥

*śrībāsa kahila tomā dekhila ye jana |*
*tāhāra haila saba bandha-bimocana || 49 ||*

*Word for word:* shrivasa kahila — Srivasa said; toma dekhila ye jana — whoever has seen You; tahara haila — for him there came; saba bandha-vimochana — release from all bonds

**49.** Srivasa said: "Whoever has seen You [thus]
has been released from all bonds."

তার-পর-দিনে কথা শুন সব জন ।
আচম্বিতে আইল এক শিবের গায়ন ॥ ৫০ ॥

*tāra-para-dine kathā śuna saba jana |*
*ācambite āila eka śibera gāẏana || 50 ||*

*Word for word:* tara-para-dine — on the following day; katha shuna saba jana — hear the story, all; achambite aila — there suddenly came; eka shivera gayana — a singer of Shiva

**50.** The next day — hear this story, all of you —
there suddenly came a singer who sang of Shiva.

নমস্কার করি' গৌরহরির চরণে ।
মহেশের গুণ গায় আনন্দিত-মনে ॥ ৫১ ॥

*namaskāra kari' gauraharira caraṇe |*
*maheśera guṇa gāẏa ānandita-mane || 51 ||*

*Word for word:* namaskara kari — bowing; gauraharira charane — at the feet of Gaurahari; maheshera guna gaya — sings the qualities of Mahesha; anandita-mane — with a joyful mind

**51.** Bowing at the feet of Gaurahari,
he sings of Mahesha's qualities with a joyful heart.

শিব শিব বলি' ডাকে পরম উল্লাসে ।
শিবের ভকতি তার দেহে পরকাশে ॥ ৫২ ॥

*śiba śiba bali' ḍāke parama ullāse |*
*śibera bhakati tāra dehe parakāśe || 52 ||*

*Word for word:* shiva shiva bali dake — calls "Shiva, Shiva"; parama ullase — in great ecstasy; shivera bhakati — devotion to Shiva; tara dehe parakashe — shows in his body

**52.** In great ecstasy he calls out: "Shiva! Shiva!" —
devotion to Shiva shows itself in his body.

শুনি' আনন্দিত মন ভৈগেল ঠাকুর ।
শিবগুণ শুনি' সুখ বাঢ়িল প্রচুর ॥ ৫৩ ॥

*śuni' ānandita mana bhaigela ṭhākura |*
*śibaguṇa śuni' sukha bāṛhila pracura || 53 ||*

*Word for word:* shuni — hearing; anandita mana bhaigela thakura — the Thakura became joyful at heart; shiva-guna shuni — hearing Shiva's qualities; sukha badhila prachura — happiness grew abundantly

**53.** Hearing him, the Thakura rejoiced at heart:
at the song of Shiva's qualities His happiness grew abundantly.

শিবের আবেশে নৃত্য করয়ে তখন ।
আপনা পাসরে সুখে শিবের গায়ন ॥ ৫৪ ॥

*śibera ābeśe nṛtya karaẏe takhana |*
*āpanā pāsare sukhe śibera gāẏana || 54 ||*

*Word for word:* shivera aveshe — in the bhava of Shiva; nritya karaye takhana — then [He] dances; apana pasare — forgets himself; sukhe shivera gayana — in happiness the singer of Shiva

**54.** Then, in the bhava of Shiva, the dancing began;
the singer of Shiva forgets himself in happiness.

তার সম ভাগ্যবান নাহি কোন জন ।
আপনে ঠাকুর কৈল স্কন্ধে আরোহণ ॥ ৫৫ ॥

*tāra sama bhāgyabāna nāhi kona jana |*
*āpane ṭhākura kaila skandhe ārohaṇa || 55 ||*

*Word for word:* tara sama bhagyavana — as fortunate as he; nahi kona jana — there is no one; apane thakura — the Thakura Himself; kaila skandhe arohana — climbed onto his shoulders

**55.** There is no one more fortunate than he:
the Thakura Himself climbed onto his shoulders.

স্কন্ধে করি' আনন্দে সে নাচয়ে গায়ন ।
আবেশে হইল প্রভুর রকত লোচন ॥ ৫৬ ॥

*skandhe kari' ānande se nācaẏe gāẏana |*
*ābeśe haila prabhura rakata locana || 56 ||*

*Word for word:* skandhe kari — carrying on his shoulders; anande se nachaye gayana — the singer dances in joy; aveshe — in His bhava; haila prabhura rakata lochana — the Lord's eyes became red

**56.** Carrying [the Lord] on his shoulders, the singer dances in joy,
and the Lord's eyes turned red in His bhava.

শিবের আবেশে কহে শিবের কথন ।
খটক ডম্বরু মুখে শিঙ্গার গর্জন ॥ ৫৭ ॥

*śibera ābeśe kahe śibera kathana |*
*khaṭaka ḍambaru mukhe śiṅgāra garjana || 57 ||*

*Word for word:* shivera aveshe — in the bhava of Shiva; kahe shivera kathana — He speaks Shiva's words; khataka dambaru — the rattle of the damaru; mukhe shingara garjana — with the mouth the blare of a horn

**57.** In the bhava of Shiva He speaks Shiva's words:
the damaru rattles, with His mouth He sounds a horn.

রাম কৃষ্ণ বলিয়া সে ডাকে কাঁদে হাসে ।
ক্ষণেকে কান্দয়ে গোরা শিবের আবেশে ॥ ৫৮ ॥

*rāma kṛṣṇa baliẏā se ḍāke kāṁde hāse |*
*kṣaṇeke kāndaẏe gorā śibera ābeśe || 58 ||*

*Word for word:* rama krishna baliya — saying "Rama, Krishna"; se dake kande hase — He calls, weeps and laughs; kshaneke kandaye gora — now Gora weeps; shivera aveshe — in the bhava of Shiva

**58.** "Rama! Krishna!" He calls, weeping and laughing;
now Gora weeps in the bhava of Shiva.[^31-17]

শ্রীবাসপণ্ডিত সেই সব তত্ত্ব জানে ।
শিবস্তব পড়ে সেই সাবধান মনে ॥ ৫৯ ॥

*śrībāsapaṇḍita sei saba tattba jāne |*
*śibastaba paṛe sei sābadhāna mane || 59 ||*

*Word for word:* shrivasa-pandita — Srivasa Pandita; sei saba tattva jane — knows all this truth; shiva-stava pade — recites a hymn to Shiva; sei savadhana mane — he with attentive mind

**59.** Srivasa Pandita knows all this truth:
with attentive mind he recites a hymn to Shiva.

পঢ়য়ে মহিম্ন-স্তব শ্রীমুকুন্দ দত্ত ।
আনন্দে নাচয়ে তারা জানে সব তত্ত্ব ॥ ৬০ ॥

*paṛhaẏe mahimna-staba śrīmukunda datta |*
*ānande nācaẏe tārā jāne saba tattba || 60 ||*

*Word for word:* padhaye mahimna-stava — recites the "Mahimna-stava"; shri-mukunda datta — Sri Mukunda Datta; anande nachaye tara — they dance in joy; jane saba tattva — they know the whole truth

**60.** Sri Mukunda Datta recites the "Mahimna-stava";
they dance in joy — they know the whole truth.

গায়নের কান্ধ হৈতে নামিল ঠাকুর ।
হরিপরায়ণ হরি গায়েন প্রচুর ॥ ৬১ ॥

*gāẏanera kāndha haite nāmila ṭhākura |*
*hariparāẏaṇa hari gāẏena pracura || 61 ||*

*Word for word:* gayanera kandha haite — from the singer's shoulders; namila thakura — the Thakura came down; hari-parayana — devoted to Hari; hari gayena prachura — He sings of Hari abundantly

**61.** The Thakura came down from the singer's shoulders
and, devoted to Hari, sings abundantly of Hari.

আনন্দে নাচয়ে যেন মদে মাতোয়ার ।
হরিগুণ গায় সুখে আনন্দ-পাথার ॥ ৬২ ॥

*ānande nācaẏe yena made mātoẏāra |*
*hariguṇa gāẏa sukhe ānanda-pāthāra || 62 ||*

*Word for word:* anande nachaye — He dances in joy; yena made matoyara — as if drunk with wine; hari-guna gaya sukhe — happily sings Hari's qualities; ananda-pathara — an ocean of bliss

**62.** He dances in joy, as if drunk with wine,
and happily sings Hari's qualities — an ocean of bliss.

করুণাসমুদ্র করে করুণাপ্রকাশ ।
শুনিতে আনন্দে ভোরা এ লোচনদাস ॥ ৬৩ ॥

*karuṇāsamudra kare karuṇāprakāśa |*
*śunite ānande bhorā e locanadāsa || 63 ||*

*Word for word:* karuna-samudra — the ocean of mercy; kare karuna-prakasha — reveals mercy; shunite — on hearing; anande bhora — is lost in joy; e lochana-dasa — this Lochana Dasa

**63.** The ocean of mercy reveals mercy —
hearing this, Lochana Dasa is lost in joy.

[^31-1]: Vv. 127–169 are the end of the section (Bhaktisiddhanta's summary is at its beginning, en/30). Cf. Chaitanya-bhagavata, Madhya 13; Chaitanya-charitamrita, Adi 17. Murari (2.13) has only the Lord's promise to deliver Jagai and Madhai. In the 1983 edition the second line reads: "purified [in heart], they stand motionless".
[^31-2]: The sannyasi is Nityananda, the avadhuta. The first line in Bhaktisiddhanta's edition is not entirely clear; we read "মৃগে", "a beast". The 1983 edition has: "There is no sin we have not committed; and what we had not committed — [we have committed now]: we struck a sannyasi."
[^31-3]: V. 146+1 is found only in the 1983 edition (the 1903 edition lacks it); cf. en/30, v. 67.
[^31-4]: On Ajamila see en/30, note 11.
[^31-5]: V. 148+1 is found only in the 1983 edition (the 1903 edition lacks it); cf. en/30, v. 62+1.
[^31-6]: A ritual gift (dana) is handed over by placing a tulasi leaf in the recipient's hand; the Lord asks the brothers to give Him their sins as a ritual gift.
[^31-7]: Sin cannot touch the Lord: "the powerful are not stained [by what stains others], like the all-consuming fire" (Bhagavata 10.33.29–30). In accepting the sins of Jagai and Madhai the Lord shows His causeless mercy; cf. Chaitanya-bhagavata, Madhya 13, where the Lord likewise takes all their sins upon Himself, on condition that they sin no more.
[^31-8]: The summary covers the whole section (vv. 1–135); this portion contains vv. 1–63, the rest is in the next. The OCR of the summary is garbled in places; gaps are filled by sense and from the table of contents in the edition's preface (there: "the Lord's teaching on serving Hari, mercy to Murari, Murari's praise, the Lord's manifestation of His divine form, the bathing [of the Lord] by Srivasa, the author's singing of Gaura's qualities and his instruction to serve Gaura"). "The bhava of Bhagavan" — the Lord reveals His own divinity and His own forms (Krishna, Nrisimha and others); this is not "possession" by some other being (cf. v. 45). Cf. Murari 2.11–2.13.
[^31-9]: This is not Vanamali Acharya, the matchmaker of the Lord's first marriage (en/17). Banga is East Bengal.
[^31-10]: V. 6+1 is found only in the 1983 edition (the 1903 edition lacks it).
[^31-11]: Bahula, Bhandira, Madhuvana and Talavana are forests of Vraja; Madana-Gopala is Krishna who enchants even the god of love. In the Gaudiya Vaishnava understanding Gaura is Krishna Himself, who has covered His dark complexion with Radha's golden radiance (Chaitanya-charitamrita, Adi 4); here for a moment He reveals His original form to the brahmanas. Cf. Murari 2.11.3–6. The 1983 edition has "and their retinue (avarana)" instead of "and Talavana".
[^31-12]: Literally "he set up a market" — a Bengali idiom: he raised such a commotion that people came running.
[^31-13]: Vv. 28–36 explain why the Lord is called the "new Creator" (navina vidhata): the old Creator, Brahma, made the world of karma and rites, while Gaura, removing the bonds of karma, "creates His own world" — prema directed to Himself. Bhaktisiddhanta explains in his summary that, freeing [people] from Vedic rites, He bestows prema on all. This is no rejection of the Vedas: the highest aim of the Vedas is bhakti; the Lord Himself follows the injunctions to set an example, but gives what rites cannot give (vv. 32–33).
[^31-14]: Nrisimha (Narasimha) is the Man-Lion, the avatara who appeared for Prahlada's sake. The bhava of Nrisimha is the Lord's own, not an alien "possession": the Lord is the source of all avataras (v. 45). The "Thousand Names" is the Vishnu-sahasranama. Cf. Murari 2.11.6–12.
[^31-15]: The text has "Narahari" ("Man-Hari", i.e. Nrisimha) — here the Lord Himself in that bhava, not Narahari Sarakara. Cf. Murari 2.11.9 ("Nrihari").
[^31-16]: Krishna is the source of all avataras (Bhagavata 1.3.28; Chaitanya-charitamrita, Adi 2), and Gaura is Krishna Himself; therefore the forms of Nrisimha, Varaha and others that Gaura reveals are His own.
[^31-17]: Shiva is the greatest of Vaishnavas (Bhagavata 12.13.16). Rejoicing in the song about His devotee, the Lord takes on his bhava and, like Shiva, who eternally worships Rama, calls: "Rama! Krishna!" The damaru and the horn are Shiva's emblems; the "Mahimna-stava" is Pushpadanta's Shiva-mahimna-stotra. Cf. Murari 2.11.13–19.

---

# Madhya-khanda, part 9 (portion 32)

*The section "Wondrous Pastimes of Mahaprabhu in the Bhava of Bhagavan" (end): a brahmana takes the dust of the Lord's feet, and the Lord leaps into the Ganga; Nityananda brings Him out onto the bank; the Lord goes off to the northern bank and returns at the devotees' entreaties; in Srivasa's house — words on serving Krishna and on His departure; Murari, embraced by the Lord, recites the verse of Sudama; the Lord reveals His radiance, and Srivasa bathes Him; the Lord and the devotees clean the temple; Lochana Dasa calls on all to serve Gaura. The section "The Leper's Release from Sin and the Bhava of Baladeva": a leper who had offended Srivasa begs the Lord for deliverance; the Lord rejects him and delivers him only when Srivasa forgives*

*Refrain: "Who does not weep at the qualities of my Gauranga? He has bound the minds of all living beings with prema"*

আর অপরূপ শুন তার পরদিনে ।
বান্ধব সহিত প্রভু নৃত্য-অবসানে ॥ ৬৪ ॥

*āra aparūpa śuna tāra paradine |*
*bāndhaba sahita prabhu nṛtya-abasāne || 64 ||*

*Word for word:* ara aparupa shuna — hear another wonder; tara paradine — on the next day; bandhava sahita — with His kinsmen; prabhu nritya-avasane — at the end of the Lord's dance

**64.** Hear one more wonder — on the next day,
when the dancing with His own had ended,

ভূমিতে পড়িয়া প্রভু দণ্ডবৎ করে ।
আনন্দে সকল লোক হরি হরি বোলে ॥ ৬৫ ॥

*bhūmite paṛiẏā prabhu daṇḍabat kare |*
*ānande sakala loka hari hari bole || 65 ||*

*Word for word:* bhumite padiya — falling on the ground; prabhu dandavat kare — the Lord lies flat like a rod; anande sakala loka — all people in joy; hari hari bole — cry "Hari, Hari"

**65.** the Lord fell flat on the ground like a rod,
and all the people in joy cry: "Hari, Hari!"

হেনই সময় এক ব্রাহ্মণ আসিয়া ।
প্রভু-পদাম্বুজ-ধূলি লইল হাসিয়া ॥ ৬৬ ॥

*henai samaẏa eka brāhmaṇa āsiẏā |*
*prabhu-padāmbuja-dhūli laila hāsiẏā || 66 ||*

*Word for word:* henai samaya — at that very time; eka brahmana asiya — a brahmana coming; prabhu-padambuja-dhuli — the dust of the Lord's lotus feet; laila hasiya — took, smiling

**66.** At that very moment a certain brahmana came up[^32-1]
and, smiling, took the dust of the Lord's lotus feet.

দেখি' গৌর ভগবান্ সত্বরে উঠিলা ।
ব্রাহ্মণ-চরিত দেখি' দুঃখিত হইলা ॥ ৬৭ ॥

*dekhi' gaura bhagabān satbare uṭhilā |*
*brāhmaṇa-carita dekhi' duḥkhita hailā || 67 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhi — seeing; gaura bhagavan — Gaura Bhagavan; satvare uthila — rose quickly; brahmana-charita dekhi — seeing the brahmana's deed; duhkhita haila — became grieved

**67.** Seeing this, Gaura Bhagavan quickly rose:
seeing the brahmana's deed, He was grieved.

মহা-অনুতাপ করি' বিরস-বদন ।
অসন্তোষে নাসিকায় নিঃশ্বাস সঘন ॥ ৬৮ ॥

*mahā-anutāpa kari' birasa-badana |*
*asantoṣe nāsikāẏa niḥśbāsa saghana || 68 ||*

*Word for word:* maha-anutapa kari — in great remorse; virasa-vadana — with a downcast face; asantoshe — in displeasure; nasikaya nihshvasa saghana — breathing heavily through the nose

**68.** In great remorse, His face downcast,
in displeasure He breathes heavily and fast.

সত্বর উঠিয়া প্রভু ধাইল আচম্বিতে ।
জাহ্নবীর জলে ঝাঁপ দিলেন তুরিতে ॥ ৬৯ ॥

*satbara uṭhiẏā prabhu dhāila ācambite |*
*jāhnabīra jale jhāṁpa dilena turite || 69 ||*

*Word for word:* satvara uthiya — rising quickly; prabhu dhaila achambite — the Lord suddenly ran; jahnavira jale — into the waters of the Jahnavi; jhampa dilena turite — swiftly leapt

**69.** Quickly rising, the Lord suddenly ran
and swiftly leapt into the waters of the Jahnavi.

জলে মগ্ন হৈল প্রভু না পাই দেখিতে ।
সব নিজজন ঝাঁপ দিল পাছে তাথে ॥ ৭০ ॥

*jale magna haila prabhu nā pāi dekhite |*
*saba nijajana jhāṁpa dila pāche tāthe || 70 ||*

*Word for word:* jale magna haila prabhu — the Lord sank into the water; na pai dekhite — He cannot be seen; saba nijajana — all His own; jhampa dila pachhe tathe — leapt in after Him

**70.** The Lord sank under the water — He cannot be seen;
all His own leapt in after Him.

নদিয়ার লোক সব গণিল প্রমাদ ।
কান্দয়ে সকল লোক করয়ে বিষাদ ॥ ৭১ ॥

*nadiẏāra loka saba gaṇila pramāda |*
*kāndaẏe sakala loka karaẏe biṣāda || 71 ||*

*Word for word:* nadiyara loka saba — all the people of Nadia; ganila pramada — reckoned it a calamity; kandaye sakala loka — all the people weep; karaye vishada — they grieve

**71.** All the people of Nadia thought a calamity had happened:
all weep, all are in sorrow.

পুত্র পুত্র করি' ধায় শচী তার মাতা ।
ঝাঁপ দিতে চাহে বিশ্বম্ভর হরি যথা ॥ ৭২ ॥

*putra putra kari' dhāẏa śacī tāra mātā |*
*jhāṁpa dite cāhe biśbambhara hari yathā || 72 ||*

*Word for word:* putra putra kari — crying "son, son"; dhaya shachi tara mata — runs Shachi, His mother; jhampa dite chahe — wants to leap; vishvambhara hari yatha — where Vishvambhara Hari is

**72.** Crying "My son! My son!" runs Shachi, His mother,
wanting to leap in where Vishvambhara Hari is.

উন্মতী পাগলী শচী কান্দে উভরায় ।
হাকান্দ কান্দনা কান্দে ভূমিতে লোটায় ॥ ৭৩ ॥

*unmatī pāgalī śacī kānde ubharāẏa |*
*hākānda kāndanā kānde bhūmite loṭāẏa || 73 ||*

*Word for word:* unmati pagali shachi — Shachi, distraught and beside herself; kande ubharaya — wails aloud; hakanda kandana kande — sobs and sobs; bhumite lotaya — rolls on the ground

**73.** Shachi, distraught, wails aloud,
weeps and sobs, rolls on the ground.

এছন প্রমাদ দেখি' অবধূতরায় ।
প্রভুর উদ্দেশে ঝাঁপ দিলেন গঙ্গায় ॥ ৭৪ ॥

*echana pramāda dekhi' abadhūtarāẏa |*
*prabhura uddeśe jhāṁpa dilena gaṅgāẏa || 74 ||*

*Word for word:* echhana pramada dekhi — seeing such calamity; avadhuta-raya — the Avadhuta-raya; prabhura uddeshe — in search of the Lord; jhampa dilena gangaya — leapt into the Ganga

**74.** Seeing such calamity, the Avadhuta-raya
leapt into the Ganga in search of the Lord.

জলে মগ্ন হৈয়া প্রভুর ধরিলেন হাথে ।
ধরিয়া তুলিল গঙ্গাকূলে আচম্বিতে ॥ ৭৫ ॥

*jale magna haiẏā prabhura dharilena hāthe |*
*dhariẏā tulila gaṅgākūle ācambite || 75 ||*

*Word for word:* jale magna haiya — diving into the water; prabhura dharilena hathe — He caught the Lord by the hand; dhariya tulila — holding, He lifted [Him]; ganga-kule achambite — suddenly onto the bank of the Ganga

**75.** Diving into the water, He caught the Lord by the hand
and, holding Him, suddenly brought Him out onto the bank of the Ganga.

দেখিয়া সকল লোক অতি আনন্দিত ।
সব নিজজন কান্দে পাইয়া সম্বিত ॥ ৭৬ ॥

*dekhiẏā sakala loka ati ānandita |*
*saba nijajana kānde pāiẏā sambita || 76 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhiya sakala loka — seeing this, all the people; ati anandita — were overjoyed; saba nijajana kande — all His own weep; paiya samvita — regaining their senses

**76.** Seeing this, all the people were overjoyed;
all [the Lord's] own, coming to their senses, weep.

শচীদেবী কান্দে কোলে করি' বিশ্বম্ভর ।
শ্রীবাস মুরারি মুকুন্দ শুক্লাম্বর ॥ ৭৭ ॥

*śacīdebī kānde kole kari' biśbambhara |*
*śrībāsa murāri mukunda śuklāmbara || 77 ||*

*Word for word:* shachi-devi kande — Shachi-devi weeps; kole kari vishvambhara — holding Vishvambhara in her arms; shrivasa murari mukunda shuklambara — Srivasa, Murari, Mukunda, Shuklambara

**77.** Shachi-devi weeps, holding Vishvambhara in her arms;
[weep] Srivasa, Murari, Mukunda, Shuklambara,

গদাধর নরহরি কান্দে পদ ধরি' ।
বাসুদেব জগদানন্দ কান্দে মুখ হেরি' ॥ ৭৭+১ ॥

*gadādhara narahari kānde pada dhari' |*
*bāsudeba jagadānanda kānde mukha heri' || 77+1 ||*

*Word for word:* gadadhara narahari — Gadadhara and Narahari; kande pada dhari — weep, clasping the feet; vasudeva jagadananda — Vasudeva and Jagadananda; kande mukha heri — weep, gazing at the face

**77+1.** Gadadhara and Narahari weep, clasping [His] feet,
Vasudeva and Jagadananda weep, gazing at [His] face[^32-2],

হরিদাস-আদি যত যত নিজজন ।
গৌরমুখ দেখি' কান্দে তরাসিত মন ॥ ৭৮ ॥

*haridāsa-ādi yata yata nijajana |*
*gauramukha dekhi' kānde tarāsita mana || 78 ||*

*Word for word:* haridasa-adi — Haridasa and others; yata yata nijajana — all, all His own; gaura-mukha dekhi — looking at Gaura's face; kande tarasita mana — weep with frightened hearts

**78.** Haridasa and all, all His own —
they weep as they look at Gaura's face, still shaken with fear.

আর সব জন দুঃখ পাঞাছে বিস্তর ।
গৌরমুখ দেখি' সুখে সভে গেলা ঘর ॥ ৭৯ ॥

*āra saba jana duḥkha pāñāche bistara |*
*gauramukha dekhi' sukhe sabhe gelā ghara || 79 ||*

*Word for word:* ara saba jana — all the other people; duhkha pannachhe vistara — had suffered much grief; gaura-mukha dekhi — seeing Gaura's face; sukhe sabhe gela ghara — all went home happy

**79.** All the other people, who had grieved greatly,
