seeing Gaura's face, went home happy.

তবে সবজন মিলি' প্রভু বিশ্বম্ভর ।
মুরারিগুপ্তের ঘর গেলা ত সত্বর ॥ ৮০ ॥

*tabe sabajana mili' prabhu biśbambhara |*
*murāriguptera ghara gelā ta satbara || 80 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe — then; sabajana mili — together with all; prabhu vishvambhara — the Lord Vishvambhara; murari-guptera ghara — to the house of Murari Gupta; gela ta satvara — went quickly

**80.** Then the Lord Vishvambhara, with everyone,
quickly went to the house of Murari Gupta.

ক্ষণেক থাকিয়া প্রভু চলিলা তুরিতে ।
বিজয়-মিশ্রের ঘর গেলা আচম্বিতে ॥ ৮১ ॥

*kṣaṇeka thākiẏā prabhu calilā turite |*
*bijaẏa-miśrera ghara gelā ācambite || 81 ||*

*Word for word:* kshaneka thakiya — staying a little while; prabhu chalila turite — the Lord left quickly; vijaya-mishrera ghara — to the house of Vijaya Mishra; gela achambite — went unexpectedly

**81.** After staying there a little, the Lord swiftly left
and unexpectedly came to the house of Vijaya Mishra.[^32-3]

রজনী বঞ্চিয়া প্রভু উঠিলা প্রভাতে ।
গঙ্গার উত্তর-কূলে গেলা আচম্বিতে ॥ ৮২ ॥

*rajanī bañciẏā prabhu uṭhilā prabhāte |*
*gaṅgāra uttara-kūle gelā ācambite || 82 ||*

*Word for word:* rajani vanchiya — having spent the night; prabhu uthila prabhate — the Lord rose at dawn; gangara uttara-kule — to the northern bank of the Ganga; gela achambite — went unexpectedly

**82.** Having spent the night, the Lord rose at dawn
and unexpectedly went to the northern bank of the Ganga.

ভ্রমণ করয়ে তার না বুঝিয়ে মন ।
তরাস পাইলা সঙ্গে ছিলা যত জন ॥ ৮৩ ॥

*bhramaṇa karaẏe tāra nā bujhiẏe mana |*
*tarāsa pāilā saṅge chilā yata jana || 83 ||*

*Word for word:* bhramana karaye — He wanders; tara na bujhiye mana — His mind cannot be understood; tarasa paila — were frightened; sange chhila yata jana — all who were with Him

**83.** He wanders there — His mind is past understanding;
all who were with Him were frightened.

ব্রাহ্মণ-সজ্জন আর যত নিজজন ।
সভে মিলি' নিবেদিল বিনয়-বচন ॥ ৮৪ ॥

*brāhmaṇa-sajjana āra yata nijajana |*
*sabhe mili' nibedila binaẏa-bacana || 84 ||*

*Word for word:* brahmana-sajjana — brahmanas and good people; ara yata nijajana — and all His own; sabhe mili — all together; nivedila vinaya-vachana — submitted humble words

**84.** The brahmanas, the good people and all His own
together made a humble plea to Him:

প্রসন্ন হও প্রভু গৌরগুণনিধি ।
কাতরে কহয়ে এই সব অপরাধী ॥ ৮৫ ॥

*prasanna hao prabhu gauraguṇanidhi |*
*kātare kahaẏe ei saba aparādhī || 85 ||*

*Word for word:* prasanna hao — be gracious; prabhu gaura-guna-nidhi — Lord Gaura, treasury of virtues; katare kahaye — say in anguish; ei saba aparadhi — all these offenders

**85.** "Be gracious, Lord Gaura, treasury of virtues!" —
so all these offenders say in anguish. —

কৃপা কর মহাপ্রভু ছাড় অতি রোষ ।
এমন কতেক নিবে সেবকের দোষ ॥ ৮৬ ॥

*kṛpā kara mahāprabhu chāṛa ati roṣa |*
*emana kateka nibe sebakera doṣa || 86 ||*

*Word for word:* kripa kara mahaprabhu — have mercy, Mahaprabhu; chhada ati rosha — give up great anger; emana kateka nibe — how many such will You take [to heart]; sevakera dosha — faults of servants

**86.** "Have mercy, Mahaprabhu, give up Your great anger:
how many such faults of Your servants will You hold against them?

করুণাসাগর প্রভু করুণাবিগ্রহ ।
করুণায় অবতার লোক-অনুগ্রহ ॥ ৮৭ ॥

*karuṇāsāgara prabhu karuṇābigraha |*
*karuṇāẏa abatāra loka-anugraha || 87 ||*

*Word for word:* karuna-sagara prabhu — the Lord, the ocean of mercy; karuna-vigraha — mercy embodied; karunaya avatara — descended out of mercy; loka-anugraha — in grace to the people

**87.** The Lord is an ocean of mercy, mercy embodied;
You descended out of mercy, in grace towards the people.

এমন বিমুখ কেনে হও ত আপনে ।
আমরা কি জানি তোর চিত-আচরণে ॥ ৮৮ ॥

*emana bimukha kene hao ta āpane |*
*āmarā ki jāni tora cita-ācaraṇe || 88 ||*

*Word for word:* emana vimukha — so averse; kene hao ta apane — why have You Yourself become; amara ki jani — how can we know; tora chita-acharane — Your heart and ways

**88.** Why have You Yourself so turned away [from us]?
How can we know what is in Your heart, what Your ways are?

ঘরেরে আইস প্রভু ঘুচাহ প্রমাদ ।
নিজ অনুগত দেখি' করহ প্রসাদ ॥ ৮৯ ॥

*gharere āisa prabhu ghucāha pramāda |*
*nija anugata dekhi' karaha prasāda || 89 ||*

*Word for word:* gharere aisa prabhu — come home, Lord; ghuchaha pramada — remove this calamity; nija anugata dekhi — looking on Your followers; karaha prasada — show grace

**89.** Come home, Lord, avert this calamity;
look upon Your followers — be gracious!"

এতেক বিনয় যবে কৈল নিজজনে ।
সদয়-হৃদয় প্রভু দ্রবিলা তখনে ॥ ৯০ ॥

*eteka binaẏa yabe kaila nijajane |*
*sadaẏa-hṛdaẏa prabhu drabilā takhane || 90 ||*

*Word for word:* eteka vinaya — such humble entreaty; yabe kaila nijajane — when His own made; sadaya-hridaya prabhu — the Lord of compassionate heart; dravila takhane — then melted

**90.** When His own thus humbly pleaded,
the Lord's compassionate heart then melted.

ঘরেরে আইলা প্রভু আনন্দিত-মনে ।
নিজগুণ গায় নিজ-অনুগত-সনে ॥ ৯১ ॥

*gharere āilā prabhu ānandita-mane |*
*nijaguṇa gāẏa nija-anugata-sane || 91 ||*

*Word for word:* gharere aila prabhu — the Lord came home; anandita-mane — with a joyful heart; nija-guna gaya — sings His own qualities; nija-anugata-sane — with His followers

**91.** The Lord returned home with a joyful heart
and with His followers sings of His own qualities.

নদিয়া-নগরে ভেল আনন্দ-উল্লাস ।
গোরাগুণ গায় সুখে এ লোচনদাস ॥ ৯২ ॥

*nadiẏā-nagare bhela ānanda-ullāsa |*
*gorāguṇa gāẏa sukhe e locanadāsa || 92 ||*

*Word for word:* nadiya-nagare — in the town of Nadia; bhela ananda-ullasa — there arose jubilation; gora-guna gaya sukhe — happily sings Gora's qualities; e lochana-dasa — this Lochana Dasa

**92.** In the town of Nadia there arose jubilation —
Lochana Dasa happily sings of Gora's qualities.

*Raga varadi; disha: "Haya re haya, are haya!" (murchha); refrain: "I take upon myself all misfortunes of Gora's beauty! He has given away the treasure of prema, filling the world with it"*

শোক ছাড়ি' হৃষ্টমনে তবে গৌরহরি ।
নিজজন সঙ্গে গেলা শ্রীবাসের বাড়ী ॥ ৯৩ ॥

*śoka chāṛi' hṛṣṭamane tabe gaurahari |*
*nijajana saṅge gelā śrībāsera bāṛī || 93 ||*

*Word for word:* shoka chhadi — leaving grief; hrishta-mane — with a glad heart; tabe gaurahari — then Gaurahari; nijajana sange — with His own; gela shrivasera badi — went to Srivasa's house

**93.** Leaving grief behind, with a joyful heart Gaurahari
went with His own to Srivasa's house.

শ্রীনিবাস-হরিদাস-আদি যত জন ।
বসিয়া ঠাকুর কাছে নিরীখে বদন ॥ ৯৪ ॥

*śrīnibāsa-haridāsa-ādi yata jana |*
*basiẏā ṭhākura kāche nirīkhe badana || 94 ||*

*Word for word:* shrinivasa-haridasa-adi yata jana — Srinivasa, Haridasa and all the others; basiya thakura kachhe — sitting near the Thakura; nirikhe vadana — gaze at His face

**94.** Srinivasa, Haridasa and all the others
sit near the Thakura and gaze at His face.

হেনকালে মহাপ্রভু সভা-সন্নিধানে ।
কহয়ে অন্তর-কথা শুনে সর্বজনে ॥ ৯৫ ॥

*henakāle mahāprabhu sabhā-sannidhāne |*
*kahaẏe antara-kathā śune sarbajane || 95 ||*

*Word for word:* henakale — then; mahaprabhu sabha-sannidhane — Mahaprabhu before the assembly; kahaye antara-katha — speaks the words of His heart; shune sarvajane — all listen

**95.** Then Mahaprabhu, before the whole assembly,
speaks words from His heart, and all listen:

ধন জন যৌবন সকল অকারণ ।
না ভজিনু সত্যবস্তু কৃষ্ণের চরণ ॥ ৯৬ ॥

*dhana jana yaubana sakala akāraṇa |*
*nā bhajinu satyabastu kṛṣṇera caraṇa || 96 ||*

*Word for word:* dhana jana yauvana — wealth, kin, youth; sakala akarana — all is in vain; na bhajinu — I did not serve; satya-vastu krishnera charana — the true reality, Krishna's feet

**96.** "Wealth, kin, youth — all is in vain:
I have not served the true treasure — the feet of Krishna.

নিরন্তর দগধে সংসারে মোর হিয়া ।
না করিলুঁ কৃষ্ণকর্ম হেন দেহ পাঞা ॥ ৯৭ ॥

*nirantara dagadhe saṃsāre mora hiẏā |*
*nā kariluṁ kṛṣṇakarma hena deha pāñā || 97 ||*

*Word for word:* nirantara dagadhe — ceaselessly burns; samsare mora hiya — My heart in samsara; na karilun krishna-karma — I did no work for Krishna; hena deha panna — having obtained such a body

**97.** My heart burns ceaselessly in samsara:
having obtained such a body, I did no work for Krishna.

সংসারে দুর্লভ এই মানুষ-শরীর ।
কৃষ্ণ ভজিবারে কিবা পুরুষ নারীর ॥ ৯৮ ॥

*saṃsāre durlabha ei mānuṣa-śarīra |*
*kṛṣṇa bhajibāre kibā puruṣa nārīra || 98 ||*

*Word for word:* samsare durlabha — rare in the world; ei manusha-sharira — this human body; krishna bhajibare — for serving Krishna; kiba purusha narira — what matter man or woman

**98.** In this world the human body is rare;
and for serving Krishna, what does it matter — man or woman?

কৃষ্ণ না ভজিলে এই মিছা সব দেহ ।
পতি সুত পিতা মাতা মিছা সব গেহ ॥ ৯৯ ॥

*kṛṣṇa nā bhajile ei michā saba deha |*
*pati suta pitā mātā michā saba geha || 99 ||*

*Word for word:* krishna na bhajile — if one does not serve Krishna; ei michha saba deha — this whole body is vain; pati suta pita mata — husband, son, father, mother; michha saba geha — all is vain, and the home

**99.** If one does not serve Krishna, this whole body is in vain,
husband, son, father, mother — all is in vain, and the home.

মায়েরে ছাড়িয়া আমি যাব দিগন্তর ।
কহিল সভারে এই মরম-উত্তর ॥ ১০০ ॥

*māẏere chāṛiẏā āmi yāba digantara |*
*kahila sabhāre ei marama-uttara || 100 ||*

*Word for word:* mayere chhadiya — leaving My mother; ami yaba digantara — I shall go to distant lands; kahila sabhare — He told all; ei marama-uttara — this word from the heart

**100.** Leaving My mother, I shall go to distant lands" —
so He revealed to all His heart's word.[^32-4]

সব-লোকে বোলে আমি বিরুদ্ধ করিয়ে ।
মুরারি কহয়ে ইহা শুনিতে মরিয়ে ॥ ১০১ ॥

*saba-loke bole āmi biruddha kariẏe |*
*murāri kahaẏe ihā śunite mariẏe || 101 ||*

*Word for word:* saba-loke bole — all the people say; ami viruddha kariye — that I act wrongly; murari kahaye — Murari says; iha shunite mariye — on hearing this I die

**101.** "All the people say that I act wrongly."
Murari says: "To hear this is death to me.

কেহ না বোলয়ে ইহা শুন মহাপ্রভু ।
আমরা ত কারো মুখে নাহি শুনি কভু ॥ ১০২ ॥

*keha nā bolaẏe ihā śuna mahāprabhu |*
*āmarā ta kāro mukhe nāhi śuni kabhu || 102 ||*

*Word for word:* keha na bolaye iha — no one says this; shuna mahaprabhu — listen, Mahaprabhu; amara ta karo mukhe — we from anyone's lips; nahi shuni kabhu — have never heard

**102.** No one says so, listen, Mahaprabhu:
we have never heard it from anyone's lips."

এ বোল শুনিঞা সেই গৌর ভগবান্ ।
মুরারি ধরিয়া দিল আলিঙ্গন-দান ॥ ১০৩ ॥

*e bola śuniñā sei gaura bhagabān |*
*murāri dhariẏā dila āliṅgana-dāna || 103 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuninna — hearing this; sei gaura bhagavan — Gaura Bhagavan; murari dhariya — taking hold of Murari; dila alingana-dana — gave the gift of an embrace

**103.** Hearing this, Gaura Bhagavan
embraced Murari.

মুরারি করিয়া কোলে সান্ধাইলা ঘরে ।
প্রভু-আলিঙ্গনে বৈদ্য আপনা পাসরে ॥ ১০৪ ॥

*murāri kariẏā kole sāndhāilā ghare |*
*prabhu-āliṅgane baidya āpanā pāsare || 104 ||*

*Word for word:* murari kariya kole — holding Murari in His embrace; sandhaila ghare — He entered the house; prabhu-alingane — in the Lord's embrace; vaidya apana pasare — the vaidya forgot himself

**104.** Embracing Murari, He went [with him] into the house;
in the Lord's embrace the vaidya forgot himself.

পুলকিত সব অঙ্গ আপাদমস্তক ।
পড়িলা ত প্রাচীন আছিল এক শ্লোক ॥ ১০৫ ॥

*pulakita saba aṅga āpādamastaka |*
*paṛilā ta prācīna āchila eka śloka || 105 ||*

*Word for word:* pulakita saba anga — his whole body thrilled; apadamastaka — from foot to head; padila ta — he recited; prachina achhila eka shloka — an ancient verse there was

**105.** His whole body thrilled from head to foot;
he recited an ancient verse:

ক্বাহং দরিদ্রঃ পাপীয়ান্ ক্ব কৃষ্ণঃ শ্রীনিকেতনঃ ।
ব্রহ্মবন্ধুরিতি স্মাহং বাহুভ্যাং পরিরম্ভিতঃ ॥ ১০৬ ॥

*kbāhaṃ daridraḥ pāpīẏān kba kṛṣṇaḥ śrīniketanaḥ |*
*brahmabandhuriti smāhaṃ bāhubhyāṃ parirambhitaḥ || 106 ||*

*Word for word:* kva aham — where am I; daridrah — poor; papiyan — most sinful; kva krishnah — where is Krishna; shri-niketanah — the abode of Shri; brahma-bandhuh iti — [I,] a brahmana by birth only; sma aham — yet I; bahubhyam parirambhitah — was embraced with His arms

**106.** "Where am I — a poor man, most sinful — and where is Krishna, the abode of Shri!
Yet me, a brahmana only by birth, He embraced with His arms."[^32-5]

এ বোল শুনিঞা সে প্রকাশে ঠাকুরাল ।
কোটি রবি-কিরণ জিনিয়া উজিয়ার ॥ ১০৭ ॥

*e bola śuniñā se prakāśe ṭhākurāla |*
*koṭi rabi-kiraṇa jiniẏā ujiẏāra || 107 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuninna — hearing this; se prakashe thakurala — He revealed His lordship; koti ravi-kirana jiniya — surpassing the rays of millions of suns; ujiyara — radiance

**107.** Hearing this, He revealed His lordship —
a radiance surpassing the rays of millions of suns.

আসনে বসিয়া কহে বচন মধুর ।
এই আমি চিদানন্দ না ভাবিহ দূর ॥ ১০৮ ॥

*āsane basiẏā kahe bacana madhura |*
*ei āmi cidānanda nā bhābiha dūra || 108 ||*

*Word for word:* asane basiya — sitting on His seat; kahe vachana madhura — speaks sweet words; ei ami chidananda — here I am, consciousness and bliss; na bhaviha dura — do not think [Me] far

**108.** Sitting on His seat, He speaks sweet words:
"Here I am — consciousness and bliss; do not think I am far away."[^32-6]

এ বোল শুনিঞা সভে আনন্দে বিহ্বল ।
পুলকে ভরিল সভার সব কলেবর ॥ ১০৯ ॥

*e bola śuniñā sabhe ānande bihbala |*
*pulake bharila sabhāra saba kalebara || 109 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuninna — hearing this; sabhe anande vihvala — all were overwhelmed with bliss; pulake bharila — were filled with thrill; sabhara saba kalebara — the bodies of all

**109.** Hearing this, all were overwhelmed with bliss,
the bodies of all were filled with thrill.

শ্রীবাসপণ্ডিত সেই উত্তম-আচার ।
গঙ্গাজলে অভিষেক করয়ে তাহার ॥ ১১০ ॥

*śrībāsapaṇḍita sei uttama-ācāra |*
*gaṅgājale abhiṣeka karaẏe tāhāra || 110 ||*

*Word for word:* shrivasa-pandita sei — that Srivasa Pandita; uttama-achara — excellent in conduct; ganga-jale — with Ganga water; abhisheka karaye tahara — performs His bathing

**110.** Srivasa Pandita, excellent in conduct,
bathes Him with the water of the Ganga.

অভিষেক করি' পূজা করি' যথাবিধি ।
তাহার পূজায় তুষ্ট হৈলা গুণনিধি ॥ ১১১ ॥

*abhiṣeka kari' pūjā kari' yathābidhi |*
*tāhāra pūjāẏa tuṣṭa hailā guṇanidhi || 111 ||*

*Word for word:* abhisheka kari — performing the bathing; puja kari yathavidhi — worshipping according to rule; tahara pujaya — with his worship; tushta haila guna-nidhi — the Treasury of virtues was pleased

**111.** He performed the bathing and worship according to rule,
and the Treasury of virtues was pleased with his worship.

আনন্দে সকল লোক হরিগুণ গায় ।
ভকত-বদন হেরি' নাচে গোরারায় ॥ ১১২ ॥

*ānande sakala loka hariguṇa gāẏa |*
*bhakata-badana heri' nāce gorārāẏa || 112 ||*

*Word for word:* anande sakala loka — in joy all people; hari-guna gaya — sing Hari's qualities; bhakata-vadana heri — looking at the devotees' faces; nache gora-raya — Gora-raya dances

**112.** In joy all the people sing of Hari's qualities;
looking at the faces of the devotees, Gora-raya dances.

নরহরি-পাদপদ্ম ধরি' শিরোপরি ।
কহয়ে লোচনদাস গৌরাঙ্গ-মাধুরী ॥ ১১৩ ॥

*narahari-pādapadma dhari' śiropari |*
*kahaẏe locanadāsa gaurāṅga-mādhurī || 113 ||*

*Word for word:* narahari-pada-padma — the lotus feet of Narahari; dhari shiropari — holding on the head; kahaye lochana-dasa — Lochana Dasa speaks; gauranga-madhuri — of Gauranga's sweetness

**113.** Placing on his head the lotus feet of Narahari,
Lochana Dasa speaks of the sweetness of Gauranga.

তার-পর-দিনে কথা অপূর্ব-কথন ।
সাবধানে শুন সভে কহিব এখন ॥ ১১৪ ॥

*tāra-para-dine kathā apūrba-kathana |*
*sābadhāne śuna sabhe kahiba ekhana || 114 ||*

*Word for word:* tara-para-dine katha — the story of the following day; apurva-kathana — an unheard-of telling; savadhane shuna sabhe — all, listen attentively; kahiba ekhana — I shall tell now

**114.** Hear an unheard-of story of the following day:
listen attentively — I shall tell it now.

শিখায়ে সকল লোকে লোক-শিক্ষাগুরু ।
করুণাসাগর প্রেমভক্তি-কল্পতরু ॥ ১১৫ ॥

*śikhāẏe sakala loke loka-śikṣāguru |*
*karuṇāsāgara premabhakti-kalpataru || 115 ||*

*Word for word:* shikhaye sakala loke — teaches all people; loka-shiksha-guru — the Teacher of the world; karuna-sagara — the ocean of mercy; prema-bhakti-kalpataru — the wish-fulfilling tree of prema-bhakti

**115.** The Teacher of the world teaches all people —
the ocean of mercy, the wish-fulfilling tree of prema-bhakti.

নিজজন বুঝাবারে করে যত কার্য ।
সংহতি করিয়া আদি অদ্বৈত-আচার্য ॥ ১১৬ ॥

*nijajana bujhābāre kare yata kārya |*
*saṃhati kariẏā ādi adbaita-ācārya || 116 ||*

*Word for word:* nijajana bujhabare — to enlighten His own; kare yata karya — He does all His deeds; samhati kariya — taking along; adi advaita-acharya — Advaita Acharya and others

**116.** All He does is to enlighten His own.
Taking with Him Advaita Acharya and the others —

শ্রীনিবাস হরিদাস মুরারি মুকুন্দ ।
গদাধর শুক্লাম্বর রাম আদি অন্ত ॥ ১১৭ ॥

*śrīnibāsa haridāsa murāri mukunda |*
*gadādhara śuklāmbara rāma ādi anta || 117 ||*

*Word for word:* shrinivasa haridasa murari mukunda — Srinivasa, Haridasa, Murari, Mukunda; gadadhara shuklambara rama — Gadadhara, Shuklambara, Rama; adi anta — and the rest

**117.** Srinivasa, Haridasa, Murari, Mukunda,
Gadadhara, Shuklambara, Rama and the rest,

নরহরি রঘুনন্দন শ্রীমুকুন্দদাস ।
বাসুঘোষ জগদানন্দ আদি সর্বদাস ॥ ১১৮ ॥

*narahari raghunandana śrīmukundadāsa |*
*bāsughoṣa jagadānanda ādi sarbadāsa || 118 ||*

*Word for word:* narahari raghunandana shri-mukunda-dasa — Narahari, Raghunandana, Sri Mukunda Dasa; vasu-ghosha jagadananda — Vasu Ghosha, Jagadananda; adi sarva-dasa — and all the servants

**118.** Narahari, Raghunandana, Sri Mukunda Dasa,
Vasu Ghosha, Jagadananda and all the servants —

যতেক ভকত সব সংহতি করিয়া ।
দেবালয়ে যায় প্রভু আনন্দিত হইয়া ॥ ১১৯ ॥

*yateka bhakata saba saṃhati kariẏā |*
*debālaẏe yāẏa prabhu ānandita haiẏā || 119 ||*

*Word for word:* yateka bhakata saba — all the devotees; samhati kariya — taking along; devalaye yaya prabhu — the Lord goes to the temple; anandita haiya — joyfully

**119.** taking all the devotees with Him,
the Lord joyfully goes to the temple.[^32-7]

নেত-ধটী পরিধান কান্ধে ত কোদাল ।
করে সম্মার্জনী করি' সভার মিশাল ॥ ১২০ ॥

*neta-dhaṭī paridhāna kāndhe ta kodāla |*
*kare sammārjanī kari' sabhāra miśāla || 120 ||*

*Word for word:* neta-dhati paridhana — wearing a loincloth; kandhe ta kodala — a hoe on His shoulder; kare sammarjani kari — with a broom in hand; sabhara mishala — together with all

**120.** He wears a loincloth, a hoe on His shoulder,
a broom in His hand, and all are together with Him.

সঙ্গের যতেক জন ধরে সেই বেশ ।
হাথে ঝাঁটা কান্ধে কোদাল উভ বান্ধে কেশ ॥ ১২১ ॥

*saṅgera yateka jana dhare sei beśa |*
*hāthe jhāṁṭā kāndhe kodāla ubha bāndhe keśa || 121 ||*

*Word for word:* sangera yateka jana — all His companions; dhare sei besha — wear the same dress; hathe jhanta — brooms in hand; kandhe kodala — hoes on the shoulder; ubha bandhe kesha — tie their hair up high

**121.** All His companions wear the same dress:
brooms in their hands, hoes on their shoulders, their hair tied up high.

দেবালয়-মার্জনা করিতে যায় প্রভু ।
হেন অদ্ভুত কথা নাহি শুনি কভু ॥ ১২২ ॥

*debālaẏa-mārjanā karite yāẏa prabhu |*
*hena adbhuta kathā nāhi śuni kabhu || 122 ||*

*Word for word:* devalaya-marjana karite — to clean the temple; yaya prabhu — the Lord goes; hena adbhuta katha — such a wondrous story; nahi shuni kabhu — I have never heard

**122.** The Lord goes to clean the temple —
never have I heard such a wondrous story.

কৃষ্ণের হড্ডিপ হইয়া বুলে দ্বারে দ্বারে ।
সকল বৈষ্ণব মেলি' সম্মার্জনা করে ॥ ১২৩ ॥

*kṛṣṇera haḍḍipa haiẏā bule dbāre dbāre |*
*sakala baiṣṇaba meli' sammārjanā kare || 123 ||*

*Word for word:* krishnera haddipa haiya — becoming Krishna's sweeper; bule dvare dvare — He goes from door to door; sakala vaishnava meli — all the Vaishnavas together; sammarjana kare — sweep

**123.** Becoming Krishna's sweeper, He goes from door to door;
all the Vaishnavas together sweep.[^32-8]

এইমতে লোক-শিক্ষা করায়ে ঠাকুর ।
ভজহ সকল লোক যে হও চতুর ॥ ১২৪ ॥

*eimate loka-śikṣā karāẏe ṭhākura |*
*bhajaha sakala loka ye hao catura || 124 ||*

*Word for word:* ei-mate — thus; loka-shiksha karaye thakura — the Thakura teaches the people; bhajaha sakala loka — serve, all people; ye hao chatura — whoever is wise

**124.** Thus the Thakura teaches the people:
serve [Him], all people, whoever is wise!

প্রেমভক্তি-দাতা আর নাহি কোন জন ।
জানিঞা ভজহ শ্রীগৌরাঙ্গ-চরণ ॥ ১২৫ ॥

*premabhakti-dātā āra nāhi kona jana |*
*jāniñā bhajaha śrīgaurāṅga-caraṇa || 125 ||*

*Word for word:* prema-bhakti-data — Giver of prema-bhakti; ara nahi kona jana — there is no other; janinna — knowing this; bhajaha shri-gauranga-charana — serve the feet of Sri Gauranga

**125.** There is no other Giver of prema-bhakti —
knowing this, serve the feet of Sri Gauranga.

যুগে যুগে কত কত অবতার আছে ।
ভজিলে সে ভজে তার অনুরূপ আছে ॥ ১২৬ ॥

*yuge yuge kata kata abatāra āche |*
*bhajile se bhaje tāra anurūpa āche || 126 ||*

*Word for word:* yuge yuge — age after age; kata kata avatara achhe — there are so many avataras; bhajile se bhaje — they serve when served; tara anurupa achhe — in like measure

**126.** In age after age come so many avataras —
and they return service for service in like measure.

আর কেহো নাহি করে হেন ঠাকুরাল ।
ভক্তি বুঝাবারে করে কান্ধে ত কোদাল ॥ ১২৭ ॥

*āra keho nāhi kare hena ṭhākurāla |*
*bhakti bujhābāre kare kāndhe ta kodāla || 127 ||*

*Word for word:* ara keho nahi kare — no one else shows; hena thakurala — such lordship; bhakti bujhabare — to teach bhakti; kare kandhe ta kodala — He puts a hoe on His shoulder

**127.** No one else has shown such lordship:
to teach bhakti He puts a hoe on His shoulder.

না ভজিলে ভজে হেন জন কোন যুগে ।
ঘরে ঘরে বুলে কেবা নিজভক্তি মাগে ॥ ১২৮ ॥

*nā bhajile bhaje hena jana kona yuge |*
*ghare ghare bule kebā nijabhakti māge || 128 ||*

*Word for word:* na bhajile bhaje — who serves even when not served; hena jana kona yuge — such a one in what age; ghare ghare bule — goes from house to house; keba nija-bhakti mage — who begs [acceptance of] devotion to himself

**128.** In what age was there one who serves those who do not serve Him,
who goes from house to house begging [them to accept] devotion to Himself?

ভজিলে সে ভজে সেই বড়ই ঠাকুর ।
ভক্তে সে কহয়ে ইহা আনে কহে দূর ॥ ১২৯ ॥

*bhajile se bhaje sei baṛai ṭhākura |*
*bhakte se kahaẏe ihā āne kahe dūra || 129 ||*

*Word for word:* bhajile se bhaje — who serves in return when served; sei badai thakura — he is [already] a great lord; bhakte se kahaye iha — the devotees say this; ane kahe dura — others say: far away

**129.** "He who returns service for service is already a great lord" —
so say the devotees; and others say [God] is far away.[^32-9]

বিচার না করে পাত্রাপাত্র কোন দেশে ।
বৃন্দাবন-ধন দিয়া সভারে সন্তোষে ॥ ১৩০ ॥

*bicāra nā kare pātrāpātra kona deśe |*
*bṛndābana-dhana diẏā sabhāre santoṣe || 130 ||*

*Word for word:* vichara na kare — He does not consider; patrapatra — worthy and unworthy; kona deshe — in any land; vrindavana-dhana diya — giving the treasure of Vrindavana; sabhare santoshe — He gladdens all

**130.** Without considering who is worthy or unworthy, in any land,
He gives all the treasure of Vrindavana and gladdens all.

ধর্মাধর্ম-পর প্রেম যাচই সভারে ।
তারিল সভারে প্রভু শচীর কুমারে ॥ ১৩১ ॥

*dharmādharma-para prema yācai sabhāre |*
*tārila sabhāre prabhu śacīra kumāre || 131 ||*

*Word for word:* dharmadharma-para prema — prema beyond dharma and adharma; yachai sabhare — He offers to all; tarila sabhare — He delivered all; prabhu shachira kumare — the Lord, Shachi's son

**131.** Prema beyond dharma and adharma He offers to all —
the son of Shachi, the Lord, has delivered all.

ব্রহ্মা মহেশ্বর কিবা লখিমী অনন্ত ।
আপন বলিতে নারে এ হেন দুরন্ত ॥ ১৩২ ॥

*brahmā maheśbara kibā lakhimī ananta |*
*āpana balite nāre e hena duranta || 132 ||*

*Word for word:* brahma maheshvara kiba lakhimi ananta — Brahma, Maheshvara, or Lakshmi, Ananta; apana balite nare — cannot call it their own; e hena duranta — so hard is it to attain

**132.** Brahma, Maheshvara, Lakshmi and Ananta
cannot call it their own — so hard is it to obtain.

না ভজিলে নিজ বোলে নাহিক ঠাকুর ।
এই সে কারণে গোরাগুণে মন ঝুর ॥ ১৩৩ ॥

*nā bhajile nija bole nāhika ṭhākura |*
*ei se kāraṇe gorāguṇe mana jhura || 133 ||*

*Word for word:* na bhajile — those who do not serve; nija bole — who calls his own; nahika thakura — there is no lord; ei se karane — for this reason; gora-gune mana jhura — the heart pines for Gora's qualities

**133.** There is no [other] lord who calls his own those who do not serve him —
this is why my heart longs for Gora's qualities.

গৌরাঙ্গ-চরণ-গুণ-স্মরণ প্রবল ।
সংসার তারিতে সবে মাত্র এই বল ॥ ১৩৩+১ ॥

*gaurāṅga-caraṇa-guṇa-smaraṇa prabala |*
*saṃsāra tārite sabe mātra ei bala || 133+1 ||*

*Word for word:* gauranga-charana-guna-smarana — remembrance of the glories of Gauranga's feet; prabala — is mighty; samsara tarite — to carry across samsara; sabe — all; matra ei bala — this power alone

**133+1.** Mighty is the remembrance of the glories of Gauranga's feet:
this power alone carries everyone across samsara[^32-10].

গোরাগুণ ভজ ভাই না করিহ হেলা ।
সংসার তরিতে মাত্র সবে এই ভেলা ॥ ১৩৪ ॥

*gorāguṇa bhaja bhāi nā kariha helā |*
*saṃsāra tarite mātra sabe ei bhelā || 134 ||*

*Word for word:* gora-guna bhaja bhai — brothers, serve Gora's qualities; na kariha hela — do not neglect; samsara tarite — to cross samsara; matra sabe ei bhela — this alone is the raft

**134.** Brothers, serve Gora's qualities, do not neglect them:
to cross samsara, this alone is the raft.

এ হেন ঠাকুর কেহো না হইব আর ।
কহয়ে লোচন সবে গোরা-অবতার ॥ ১৩৫ ॥

*e hena ṭhākura keho nā haiba āra |*
*kahaẏe locana sabe gorā-abatāra || 135 ||*

*Word for word:* e hena thakura — such a Thakura; keho na haiba ara — no one will ever be again; kahaye lochana — says Lochana; sabe gora-avatara — only Gora's avatara

**135.** There will never be such a Thakura again —
says Lochana: Gora's avatara alone.

## The Leper's Release from Sin and the Bhava of Baladeva

> *Summary by Srila Bhaktisiddhanta Sarasvati.* One day, when Sriman Mahaprabhu was walking with the devotees, absorbed in prema, a brahmana afflicted with leprosy on that road appealed to Sriman Mahaprabhu for his deliverance. Sriman Mahaprabhu at first rejected him as an offender against a Vaishnava, then told him to beg Srivasa Pandita's forgiveness for his offence, and at last, freeing him from the offence against the Vaishnava, bestowed prema on him. A certain brahmana wished to see Gaurasundara's dancing, but the devotees of Gaura headed by Srivasa did not admit him, and his desire was not fulfilled; so one day, seeing Sriman Mahaprabhu bathing in the Ganga, he angrily cursed Him: "May Your worldly happiness be destroyed!" Sriman Mahaprabhu accepted the brahmana's curse with joy. Then the brahmana came to his senses and in fear began to praise Sriman Mahaprabhu, and Sriman Mahaprabhu consoled him, revealing that the brahmana's curse was what He Himself desired. Then are described wondrous pastimes: Sriman Mahaprabhu in the bhava of Balarama cries out "Give Me honey!"; with the devotees, performing kirtana, He goes to the house of Sri Advaita Acharya; the next day, when He has fainted in the bhava of Baladeva, Gadadhara comes and He restrains His bhava; the devotees headed by Acharyaratna arrive; Srivasa and the other devotees see Sriman Mahaprabhu in the form of Baladeva; He goes with the devotees to bathe in the Ganga, and so on.[^32-11]

*Refrain: "Hari, Rama, Narayana — Shachi's darling, golden Gora!"*

আর অপরূপ শুন গৌরাঙ্গ-চরিত ।
শুনিলে পাইবে ইথে বড়ই পিরীত ॥ ১ ॥

*āra aparūpa śuna gaurāṅga-carita |*
*śunile pāibe ithe baṛai pirīta || 1 ||*

*Word for word:* ara aparupa shuna — hear another wondrous; gauranga-charita — account of Gauranga's deeds; shunile paibe — on hearing you will gain; ithe badai pirita — by this great love

**1.** Hear another wondrous story of Gauranga's deeds:
hearing it, you will gain great love.

নিজজন-সনে পহুঁ পথে চলি' যায় ।
কৃষ্ণকথা-রসে অঙ্গ আবেশে দুলায় ॥ ২ ॥

*nijajana-sane pahuṁ pathe cali' yāẏa |*
*kṛṣṇakathā-rase aṅga ābeśe dulāẏa || 2 ||*

*Word for word:* nijajana-sane — with His own; pahu pathe chali yaya — the Lord walks along the road; krishna-katha-rase — in the taste of talk of Krishna; anga aveshe dulaya — His body sways in rapture

**2.** The Lord walks along the road with His own;
from the taste of talk of Krishna His body sways in rapture.

সেই পথে ছিল কুষ্ঠব্যাধি একজনে ।
বিনয় করিয়া কহে প্রভুর চরণে ॥ ৩ ॥

*sei pathe chila kuṣṭhabyādhi ekajane |*
*binaẏa kariẏā kahe prabhura caraṇe || 3 ||*

*Word for word:* sei pathe chhila — on that road was; kushtha-vyadhi ekajane — a leper; vinaya kariya — humbly; kahe prabhura charane — speaks to the Lord's feet

**3.** On that road there was a leper;
humbly he addresses the Lord's feet.

ভূমিতে পড়িয়া সেই পরণাম করে ।
কাতর হইয়া কিছু সবিনয়ে বোলে ॥ ৪ ॥

*bhūmite paṛiẏā sei paraṇāma kare |*
*kātara haiẏā kichu sabinaẏe bole || 4 ||*

*Word for word:* bhumite padiya — falling to the ground; sei paranama kare — he bows down; katara haiya — in anguish; kichhu savinaye bole — humbly speaks

**4.** Falling to the ground, he bows down
and in anguish humbly speaks:

সব লোকে বোলে প্রভু তুমি জনার্দন ।
তুমি সে পুরুষোত্তম তুমি সনাতন ॥ ৫ ॥

*saba loke bole prabhu tumi janārdana |*
*tumi se puruṣottama tumi sanātana || 5 ||*

*Word for word:* saba loke bole — all people say; prabhu tumi janardana — Lord, You are Janardana; tumi se purushottama — You are Purushottama; tumi sanatana — You are the Eternal

**5.** "All people say, Lord: You are Janardana,
You are Purushottama, You are the Eternal.

তুমি দেবদেবেশ্বর ত্রিজগদ্-বন্ধু ।
আমারে উদ্ধার কর করুণার সিন্ধু ॥ ৬ ॥

*tumi debadebeśbara trijagad-bandhu |*
*āmāre uddhāra kara karuṇāra sindhu || 6 ||*

*Word for word:* tumi deva-deveshvara — You are the Lord of the lords of gods; trijagad-bandhu — the Friend of the three worlds; amare uddhara kara — deliver me; karunara sindhu — ocean of mercy

**6.** You are the Lord of the lords of the gods, the Friend of the three worlds;
deliver me, O ocean of mercy!

পতিতপাবন শুনি' আইনু তোর ঠাঞি ।
তারহ আমারে তুমি সভার গোসাঞি ॥ ৭ ॥

*patitapābana śuni' āinu tora ṭhāñi |*
*tāraha āmāre tumi sabhāra gosāñi || 7 ||*

*Word for word:* patita-pavana shuni — hearing "Purifier of the fallen"; ainu tora thanni — I came to You; taraha amare — deliver me; tumi sabhara gosanni — You are the Master of all

**7.** Hearing that You are the Purifier of the fallen, I have come to You:
deliver me — You are the Master of all.

ওহে অকিঞ্চন-নাথ শচীর দুলাল ।
তারহ আমারে প্রভু গৌরাঙ্গ গোপাল ॥ ৮ ॥

*ohe akiñcana-nātha śacīra dulāla |*
*tāraha āmāre prabhu gaurāṅga gopāla || 8 ||*

*Word for word:* ohe akinchana-natha — O Lord of the destitute; shachira dulala — Shachi's darling; taraha amare — deliver me; prabhu gauranga gopala — Lord Gauranga-Gopala

**8.** O Lord of the destitute, Shachi's darling,
deliver me, Lord Gauranga-Gopala!

আমার অধিক পাপী নাহি ত্রিভুবনে ।
দুঃসহ এ কুষ্ঠব্যাধি কর পরিত্রাণে ॥ ৯ ॥

*āmāra adhika pāpī nāhi tribhubane |*
*duḥsaha e kuṣṭhabyādhi kara paritrāṇe || 9 ||*

*Word for word:* amara adhika papi — a greater sinner than I; nahi tribhuvane — there is not in the three worlds; duhsaha e kushtha-vyadhi — from this unbearable leprosy; kara paritrane — deliver

**9.** In the three worlds there is no greater sinner than I;
free [me] from this unbearable leprosy."

এ বোল শুনিঞা প্রভু রুষিলা অন্তর ।
ক্রোধদৃষ্ট্যে চাহে কুষ্ঠব্যাধির উপর ॥ ১০ ॥

*e bola śuniñā prabhu ruṣilā antara |*
*krodhadṛṣṭye cāhe kuṣṭhabyādhira upara || 10 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuninna — hearing this; prabhu rushila antara — the Lord grew angry at heart; krodha-drishtye chahe — looks wrathfully; kushtha-vyadhira upara — at the leper

**10.** Hearing this, the Lord grew angry at heart
and looked wrathfully at the leper.

ঠাকুর কহয়ে শুন পাপ দুরাচার ।
বৈষ্ণবের নিন্দা তুমি কৈলে কেনে ছার ॥ ১১ ॥

*ṭhākura kahaẏe śuna pāpa durācāra |*
*baiṣṇabera nindā tumi kaile kene chāra || 11 ||*

*Word for word:* thakura kahaye — the Thakura says; shuna papa durachara — listen, sinful wretch; vaishnavera ninda — blasphemy of a Vaishnava; tumi kaile kene chhara — why did you, worthless one, commit

**11.** The Thakura says: "Listen, sinful wretch:
why did you, worthless one, revile a Vaishnava?

সংসারে যতেক জীব সে-ই মোর মিত্র ।
বৈষ্ণবের দ্বেষ করে সে-ই মোর শত্রু ॥ ১২ ॥

*saṃsāre yateka jība se-i mora mitra |*
*baiṣṇabera dbeṣa kare se-i mora śatru || 12 ||*

*Word for word:* samsare yateka jiva — all living beings in the world; sei mora mitra — they are My friends; vaishnavera dvesha kare — whoever hates a Vaishnava; sei mora shatru — he is My enemy

**12.** All living beings in the world are My friends;
whoever hates a Vaishnava is My enemy.

আপন নিন্দায় আমি কভু নাহি দুঃখী ।
শ্রীবাসপণ্ডিত-নিন্দায় কেমনে হব সুখী ॥ ১৩ ॥

*āpana nindāẏa āmi kabhu nāhi duḥkhī |*
*śrībāsapaṇḍita-nindāẏa kemane haba sukhī || 13 ||*

*Word for word:* apana nindaya — at blasphemy of Myself; ami kabhu nahi duhkhi — I am never grieved; shrivasa-pandita-nindaya — at blasphemy of Srivasa Pandita; kemane haba sukhi — how can I be happy

**13.** At blasphemy against Myself I am never grieved,
but how can I be happy when Srivasa Pandita is reviled?

অকথ্য বচন তুমি কহিলি তাহারে ।
শতজন্ম ভুঞ্জিলেহ না ঘুচিব তোরে ॥ ১৪ ॥

*akathya bacana tumi kahili tāhāre |*
*śatajanma bhuñjileha nā ghuciba tore || 14 ||*

*Word for word:* akathya vachana — unspeakable words; tumi kahili tahare — you said to him; shata-janma bhunjileha — even if you suffer a hundred births; na ghuchiba tore — it will not leave you

**14.** You spoke unspeakable words to him:
even if you suffer a hundred births, [the sin] will not leave you.

বৈষ্ণবের অপরাধ করে যেই জন ।
তার পরিত্রাণ আমি না করি কখন ॥ ১৫ ॥

*baiṣṇabera aparādha kare yei jana |*
*tāra paritrāṇa āmi nā kari kakhana || 15 ||*

*Word for word:* vaishnavera aparadha — offence to a Vaishnava; kare yei jana — whoever commits; tara paritrana — his deliverance; ami na kari kakhana — I never effect

**15.** Whoever offends a Vaishnava,
him I never deliver.

বাহিরে পরাণ দেখ এই মোর দেহ ।
বৈষ্ণব অন্তরে প্রাণ নাহিক সন্দেহ ॥ ১৬ ॥

*bāhire parāṇa dekha ei mora deha |*
*baiṣṇaba antare prāṇa nāhika sandeha || 16 ||*

*Word for word:* bahire parana — the life outside; dekha ei mora deha — see, is this body of Mine; vaishnava antare prana — the Vaishnava is the life within; nahika sandeha — there is no doubt

**16.** See: this body of Mine is [My] life outside,
and the Vaishnava is [My] life within — there is no doubt.[^32-12]

বৈষ্ণবের সেবা করে মোরে করে দ্বেষ ।
তার পরিত্রাণ করি ঘুচাইয়ে ক্লেশ ॥ ১৭ ॥

*baiṣṇabera sebā kare more kare dbeṣa |*
*tāra paritrāṇa kari ghucāiẏe kleśa || 17 ||*

*Word for word:* vaishnavera seva kare — who serves a Vaishnava; more kare dvesha — [even if] he hates Me; tara paritrana kari — him I deliver; ghuchaiye klesha — removing his distress

**17.** Whoever serves the Vaishnava, even if he hates Me,
him I deliver, removing his distress.

বৈষ্ণবের হিংসা করে যেই মূঢ় জন ।
নরকে পড়য়ে তার নাহিক শরণ ॥ ১৮ ॥

*baiṣṇabera hiṃsā kare yei mūṛha jana |*
*narake paṛaẏe tāra nāhika śaraṇa || 18 ||*

*Word for word:* vaishnavera himsa kare — does harm to a Vaishnava; yei mudha jana — the fool who; narake padaye — falls into hell; tara nahika sharana — he has no refuge

**18.** The fool who does harm to a Vaishnava
falls into hell, and he has no refuge.

তুমি সে পাতকী মহাপামর দুরন্ত ।
কত কাল নরক ভুঞ্জিবি নাহি অন্ত ॥ ১৯ ॥

*tumi se pātakī mahāpāmara duranta |*
*kata kāla naraka bhuñjibi nāhi anta || 19 ||*

*Word for word:* tumi se pataki — you are a sinner; maha-pamara duranta — the greatest scoundrel, incorrigible; kata kala naraka bhunjibi — how long you will suffer hell; nahi anta — there is no end

**19.** You are a sinner, the greatest scoundrel, incorrigible:
how long you will suffer in hell — there is no end!"

এ বোল শুনিঞা কুষ্ঠব্যাধি পড়ি' কান্দে ।
আকুল হইয়া কান্দে স্থির নাহি বান্ধে ॥ ২০ ॥

*e bola śuniñā kuṣṭhabyādhi paṛi' kānde |*
*ākula haiẏā kānde sthira nāhi bāndhe || 20 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuninna — hearing this; kushtha-vyadhi padi kande — the leper falls and weeps; akula haiya kande — weeps distraught; sthira nahi bandhe — finds no calm

**20.** Hearing this, the leper falls down and weeps,
weeps in distress and finds no peace:

ভকত বুঝিয়া কৃপা আর অবতারে ।
এবে সে পামর প্রভু কলিতে ঘরে ঘরে ॥ ২১ ॥

*bhakata bujhiẏā kṛpā āra abatāre |*
*ebe se pāmara prabhu kalite ghare ghare || 21 ||*

*Word for word:* bhakata bujhiya — discerning the devotee; kripa ara avatare — mercy in other avataras; ebe se pamara — now the scoundrels; prabhu kalite ghare ghare — Lord, in Kali, in every home [You deliver]

**21.** "In other avataras You were merciful, discerning who was a devotee —
but now, Lord, in Kali [You deliver] scoundrels in every home.

যে তোমারে না ভজিবে তাহারে মারিবে ।
পতিতপাবন-নাম কেমনে ধরিবে ॥ ২২ ॥

*ye tomāre nā bhajibe tāhāre māribe |*
*patitapābana-nāma kemane dharibe || 22 ||*

*Word for word:* ye tomare na bhajibe — whoever will not serve You; tahare maribe — if You strike him down; patita-pavana-nama — the name "Purifier of the fallen"; kemane dharibe — how will You bear

**22.** If You strike down those who do not serve You,
how will You bear the name of Purifier of the fallen?

জয় বিশ্বম্ভর নাম সভার কল্যাণ ।
জয় মহাবাহু ধর্মসেতু-অধিষ্ঠান ॥ ২৩ ॥

*jaẏa biśbambhara nāma sabhāra kalyāṇa |*
*jaẏa mahābāhu dharmasetu-adhiṣṭhāna || 23 ||*

*Word for word:* jaya vishvambhara nama — glory [to You] named Vishvambhara; sabhara kalyana — the welfare of all; jaya mahabahu — glory, Mighty-armed; dharma-setu-adhishthana — the support of the bridge of dharma

**23.** Glory to You whose name, Vishvambhara, is the welfare of all!
Glory to You, Mighty-armed, the support of the bridge of dharma!

তোর সেতুবন্ধে লোক হয় ভব-পার ।
আমারে না ফেল প্রভু শচীর কুমার ॥ ২৪ ॥

*tora setubandhe loka haẏa bhaba-pāra |*
*āmāre nā phela prabhu śacīra kumāra || 24 ||*

*Word for word:* tora setu-bandhe — by Your bridge; loka haya bhava-para — people cross over existence; amare na phela — do not cast me away; prabhu shachira kumara — Lord, son of Shachi

**24.** By Your bridge people cross the ocean of existence —
do not cast me away, Lord, son of Shachi!"

দেখিয়া করুণা যদি হঞাছে হৃদয় ।
তথাপি বৈষ্ণববশ স্বতন্ত্রতা নয় ॥ ২৫ ॥

*dekhiẏā karuṇā yadi hañāche hṛdaẏa |*
*tathāpi baiṣṇababaśa sbatantratā naẏa || 25 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhiya — seeing [him]; karuna yadi hannachhe hridaya — though the heart had become merciful; tathapi — yet; vaishnava-basha — subject to the Vaishnavas; svatantrata naya — not independent

**25.** Though, seeing him, [the Lord] had softened at heart,
yet He is subject to the Vaishnavas — not independent.[^32-13]

ইহা জানি' গেলা প্রভু শ্রীবাস-আলয় ।
বসিয়া সকল কথা কহে মহাশয় ॥ ২৬ ॥

*ihā jāni' gelā prabhu śrībāsa-ālaẏa |*
*basiẏā sakala kathā kahe mahāśaẏa || 26 ||*

*Word for word:* iha jani — knowing this; gela prabhu shrivasa-alaya — the Lord went to Srivasa's house; basiya — sitting down; sakala katha kahe mahashaya — the Great Soul tells everything

**26.** Knowing this, the Lord went to Srivasa's house
and, sitting down, the Great Soul tells him everything:

পথেতে দেখিল কুষ্ঠব্যাধি একজন ।
অপরাধ ভুঞ্জিব সে অনেক জনম ॥ ২৭ ॥

*pathete dekhila kuṣṭhabyādhi ekajana |*
*aparādha bhuñjiba se aneka janama || 27 ||*

*Word for word:* pathete dekhila — on the road [I] saw; kushtha-vyadhi ekajana — a leper; aparadha bhunjiba se — he will suffer for his offence; aneka janama — many births

**27.** "On the road I saw a leper:
for his offence he will suffer many births.

তোর অপরাধে সে গলিত সর্বদেহ ।
তাহারে দেখিয়া মোর না উঠিল স্নেহ ॥ ২৮ ॥

*tora aparādhe se galita sarbadeha |*
*tāhāre dekhiẏā mora nā uṭhila sneha || 28 ||*

*Word for word:* tora aparadhe — for the offence against you; se galita sarva-deha — his whole body is rotting; tahare dekhiya — seeing him; mora na uthila sneha — no affection arose in Me

**28.** For his offence against you his whole body is rotting,
and seeing him, I felt no pity for him.

পরিত্রাণ কর বলি' ডাকে কুষ্ঠব্যাধি ।
কে করিবে পরিত্রাণ তোর অপরাধী ॥ ২৯ ॥

*paritrāṇa kara bali' ḍāke kuṣṭhabyādhi |*
*ke karibe paritrāṇa tora aparādhī || 29 ||*

*Word for word:* paritrana kara bali — saying "deliver me"; dake kushtha-vyadhi — the leper cries; ke karibe paritrana — who will deliver; tora aparadhi — one who offended you

**29.** 'Deliver me!' the leper cries;
but who will deliver one who has offended you?

যদি বা আপনে তুমি দয়া-দিঠে চায় ।
তবে সে নিস্তারে পাপী তোমার কৃপায় ॥ ৩০ ॥

*yadi bā āpane tumi daẏā-diṭhe cāẏa |*
*tabe se nistāre pāpī tomāra kṛpāẏa || 30 ||*

*Word for word:* yadi ba apane tumi — only if you yourself; daya-dithe chaya — look with a kind eye; tabe se nistare papi — then the sinner is delivered; tomara kripaya — by your mercy

**30.** Only if you yourself look on him with kindness
will the sinner be delivered by your mercy."

এ বোল শুনিঞা তবে শ্রীবাসপণ্ডিত ।
হাসিতে লাগিল প্রভুর শুনিঞা চরিত ॥ ৩১ ॥

*e bola śuniñā tabe śrībāsapaṇḍita |*
*hāsite lāgila prabhura śuniñā carita || 31 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuninna — hearing this; tabe shrivasa-pandita — then Srivasa Pandita; hasite lagila — began to laugh; prabhura shuninna charita — hearing of the Lord's conduct

**31.** Hearing this, Srivasa Pandita
began to laugh, hearing of the Lord's conduct:

মুঞি মহা-অধমাধম মোরে হেন বোল ।
মোর ছলে পাতকীর পরিত্রাণ কর ॥ ৩২ ॥

*muñi mahā-adhamādhama more hena bola |*
*mora chale pātakīra paritrāṇa kara || 32 ||*

*Word for word:* munni maha-adhamadhama — I am the lowest of the low; more hena bola — to me You say such things; mora chhale — using me as a pretext; patakira paritrana kara — You deliver the sinner

**32.** "I am the lowest of the low — and You say such things to me!
Using me as a pretext, You deliver the sinner.

মোর ঠাঞি তার দোষ ঘুচিল সর্বথা ।
প্রসন্ন হইলুঁ আমি ঘুচাও তার ব্যথা ॥ ৩৩ ॥

*mora ṭhāñi tāra doṣa ghucila sarbathā |*
*prasanna hailuṁ āmi ghucāo tāra byathā || 33 ||*

*Word for word:* mora thanni — towards me; tara dosha ghuchila sarvatha — his fault has entirely gone; prasanna hailun ami — I am pleased; ghuchao tara vyatha — remove his suffering

**33.** His fault towards me is entirely gone;
I am pleased — relieve him of his suffering."

এ বোল শুনিয়া প্রভু করে হরি-নাদ ।
নিস্তারিল কুষ্ঠব্যাধি হেন পরসাদ ॥ ৩৪ ॥

*e bola śuniẏā prabhu kare hari-nāda |*
*nistārila kuṣṭhabyādhi hena parasāda || 34 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuniya — hearing this; prabhu kare hari-nada — the Lord cries aloud "Hari"; nistarila kushtha-vyadhi — the leper was delivered; hena parasada — such was the grace

**34.** Hearing this, the Lord cried aloud "Hari!" —
and the leper was delivered: such [was] the grace.

তথা গঙ্গাতীরে সেইক্ষণে কুষ্ঠব্যাধি ।
পাইল শ্রীবাস-কৃপা পরম-ঔষধি ॥ ৩৫ ॥

*tathā gaṅgātīre seikṣaṇe kuṣṭhabyādhi |*
*pāila śrībāsa-kṛpā parama-auṣadhi || 35 ||*

*Word for word:* tatha gangatire — there on the bank of the Ganga; sei-kshane kushtha-vyadhi — that moment the leper; paila shrivasa-kripa — received Srivasa's mercy; parama-aushadhi — the supreme medicine

**35.** There, on the bank of the Ganga, that very moment the leper
received the supreme medicine — the mercy of Srivasa.[^32-14]

দিব্যদেহ সেইক্ষণে হইল তাহার ।
গৌরাঙ্গ বলিয়া ধায় আরতি-বিথার ॥ ৩৬ ॥

*dibyadeha seikṣaṇe haila tāhāra |*
*gaurāṅga baliẏā dhāẏa ārati-bithāra || 36 ||*

*Word for word:* divya-deha — a divine body; sei-kshane haila tahara — became his that moment; gauranga baliya dhaya — crying "Gauranga" he runs; arati-vithara — overwhelmed with longing

**36.** That very moment his body became divine;
crying "Gauranga!", he runs, overcome with longing:

মহাপ্রেমে মত্ত হৈয়া করয়ে হুঙ্কার ।
ক্ষণে মূর্ছা যায় ক্ষণে প্রলাপ অপার ॥ ৩৬+১ ॥

*mahāpreme matta haiẏā karaẏe huṅkāra |*
*kṣaṇe mūrchā yāẏa kṣaṇe pralāpa apāra || 36+1 ||*

*Word for word:* maha-preme matta haiya — intoxicated with great prema; karaye hunkara — gives thunderous cries; kshane murchha yaya — now swoons; kshane pralapa apara — now raves without end

**36+1.** Intoxicated with great prema, he gives thunderous cries:
now he swoons, now he raves without end[^32-15].

কোথা গেলা গৌরচন্দ্র অন্তরের চান্দ ।
এমন কে তারে ভবব্যাধি মহা-আন্ধ ॥ ৩৭ ॥

*kothā gelā gauracandra antarera cānda |*
*emana ke tāre bhababyādhi mahā-āndha || 37 ||*

*Word for word:* kotha gela gaurachandra — where has Gaurachandra gone; antarera chanda — the moon of my heart; emana ke tare — who else so delivers; bhava-vyadhi maha-andha — [from] the disease of existence, the great blindness

**37.** "Where has Gaurachandra gone, the moon of my heart?
Who else so frees one from the great blindness — the disease of existence?"

এথা গৌরচন্দ্র শ্রীনিবাস-ঘর হৈতে ।
কুষ্ঠব্যাধি দেখিবারে চলিলা তুরিতে ॥ ৩৮ ॥

*ethā gauracandra śrīnibāsa-ghara haite |*
*kuṣṭhabyādhi dekhibāre calilā turite || 38 ||*

*Word for word:* etha gaurachandra — meanwhile Gaurachandra; shrinivasa-ghara haite — from Srinivasa's house; kushtha-vyadhi dekhibare — to see the leper; chalila turite — set out quickly

**38.** Meanwhile Gaurachandra left Srinivasa's house
and hurried to see the leper.

পথে কুষ্ঠব্যাধি সনে হৈল দরশন ।
ধরিয়া পড়িলা ভূমি প্রভুর চরণ ॥ ৩৯ ॥

*pathe kuṣṭhabyādhi sane haila daraśana |*
*dhariẏā paṛilā bhūmi prabhura caraṇa || 39 ||*

*Word for word:* pathe — on the road; kushtha-vyadhi sane haila darashana — He met the leper; dhariya — clasping; padila bhumi — he fell on the ground; prabhura charana — the Lord's feet

**39.** On the road they met,
and [he], clasping the Lord's feet, fell to the ground.

তুলিয়া তাহারে প্রভু করিল আলিঙ্গনে ।
ব্রহ্মার দুর্লভ প্রেম দিলা সেইক্ষণে ॥ ৪০ ॥

*tuliẏā tāhāre prabhu karila āliṅgane |*
*brahmāra durlabha prema dilā seikṣaṇe || 40 ||*

*Word for word:* tuliya tahare — raising him; prabhu karila alingane — the Lord embraced him; brahmara durlabha prema — prema rare even for Brahma; dila sei-kshane — He gave that moment

**40.** Raising him, the Lord embraced him
and that very moment gave him prema, hard even for Brahma to obtain.

হাসে কান্দে নাচে গায় গড়াগড়ি যায় ।
গদাধর-বন্ধু বলি' নাচিয়া বেড়ায় ॥ ৪১ ॥

*hāse kānde nāce gāẏa gaṛāgaṛi yāẏa |*
*gadādhara-bandhu bali' nāciẏā beṛāẏa || 41 ||*

*Word for word:* hase kande nache gaya — he laughs, weeps, dances, sings; gadagadi yaya — rolls on the ground; gadadhara-bandhu bali — crying "Friend of Gadadhara"; nachiya bedaya — goes about dancing

**41.** He laughs, weeps, dances, sings, rolls on the ground,
whirls about in dance, crying: "Friend of Gadadhara!"[^32-16]

সব ভক্ত আনন্দিত হৈল তা দেখিয়া ।
চমৎকার হৈল দেখি' সকল নদিয়া ॥ ৪২ ॥

*saba bhakta ānandita haila tā dekhiẏā |*
*camatkāra haila dekhi' sakala nadiẏā || 42 ||*

*Word for word:* saba bhakta anandita haila — all the devotees rejoiced; ta dekhiya — seeing this; chamatkara haila — was amazed; dekhi sakala nadiya — seeing it, all Nadia

**42.** Seeing this, all the devotees rejoiced,
and all Nadia, seeing it, was amazed.

শুন সর্বজন বিশ্বম্ভরের চরিত ।
শুনিলে সে প্রেমভক্তি পাইবে তুরিত ॥ ৪৩ ॥

*śuna sarbajana biśbambharera carita |*
*śunile se premabhakti pāibe turita || 43 ||*

*Word for word:* shuna sarvajana — hear, all; vishvambharera charita — of Vishvambhara's deeds; shunile se — on hearing; prema-bhakti paibe turita — you will soon obtain prema-bhakti

**43.** Hear, all of you, of Vishvambhara's deeds:
hearing of them, you will soon obtain prema-bhakti.

তবে সেই মহাপ্রভু অন্তর-উল্লাস ।
নাচে সেই বিপ্র-দেহে প্রেমার প্রকাশ ॥ ৪৩+১ ॥

*tabe sei mahāprabhu antara-ullāsa |*
*nāce sei bipra-dehe premāra prakāśa || 43+1 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe sei mahaprabhu — then Mahaprabhu; antara-ullasa — rejoicing at heart; nache — dances; sei vipra-dehe — in the body of that brahmana; premara prakasha — the manifestation of prema

**43+1.** Then Mahaprabhu, rejoicing at heart,
dances — and prema became manifest in the brahmana's body[^32-17].

দেখিয়া ত মহাপ্রভু করে হরিনাদ ।
নিস্তারিল কুষ্ঠব্যাধি কৈল পরসাদ ॥ ৪৩+২ ॥

*dekhiẏā ta mahāprabhu kare harināda |*
*nistārila kuṣṭhabyādhi kaila parasāda || 43+2 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhiya ta — seeing this; mahaprabhu kare hari-nada — Mahaprabhu loudly cries "Hari"; nistarila kushthavyadhi — delivered the leper; kaila parasada — showed grace

**43+2.** Seeing this, Mahaprabhu loudly cries "Hari!":
He delivered the leper, He showed him grace.

অতি অপরূপ এই নদিয়া-প্রকাশ ।
শুনিতে আনন্দে ভোরা এ লোচনদাস ॥ ৪৪ ॥

*ati aparūpa ei nadiẏā-prakāśa |*
*śunite ānande bhorā e locanadāsa || 44 ||*

*Word for word:* ati aparupa — most wondrous; ei nadiya-prakasha — this manifestation in Nadia; shunite — on hearing; anande bhora — lost in joy; e lochana-dasa — this Lochana Dasa

**44.** Most wondrous is this manifestation in Nadia —
hearing of it, Lochana Dasa is lost in joy.

[^32-1]: The text has "a brahmana" (so also the 1983 edition); in Bhaktisiddhanta's summary (en/31, at the head of the section "Wondrous Pastimes of Mahaprabhu in the Bhava of Bhagavan") and in Murari (2.11.21) it is a brahmana woman. The Lord, playing the role of a devotee, grieves at having received an honour befitting the Lord. Vv. 64–79 — cf. Murari 2.11.19–25.
[^32-2]: V. 77+1 is found only in the 1983 edition; the 1903 edition gives it in a footnote as an additional reading (in another form: "Gadadhara and Narahari weep, holding the Lord; Vasudeva and Jagadananda weep, gazing at the Lord").
[^32-3]: Vv. 80–92 — cf. Murari 2.12.1–4. Vijaya is probably Vijaya Dasa, a devotee of Navadvipa and copyist of books.
[^32-4]: The Lord is already thinking of sannyasa. Vv. 93–102 — cf. Murari 2.12.5–8.
[^32-5]: Bhagavata 10.81.16 — the words of the poor brahmana Sudama whom Krishna embraced; Murari applies them to himself. In the edition the verse is followed by Bhaktisiddhanta's anvaya and translation: "Where am I, a sinful pauper, and where is Krishnachandra, full of all opulence! Only because I am the lowest of brahmanas did Bhagavan embrace me with both arms." Cf. Murari 2.12.9–11.
[^32-6]: Literally "I am Chidananda": the Lord's body is not material — it is consciousness and bliss (cf. Murari 2.12.13: "this body is the highest concentration of being and consciousness"). Vv. 107–111 — cf. Murari 2.12.12–15.
[^32-7]: Vv. 114–123 — cf. Murari 2.13 (the Lord and the devotees clean the temple). Narahari, Raghunandana and Mukunda Dasa in this list appear only in Lochana Dasa (cf. en/30, note 7); "Rama" is Sri Rama Pandita, Srivasa's brother.
[^32-8]: A haddipa is a sweeper of the lowest caste of scavengers. The Lord Himself takes on the lowliest service, teaching humility and service to the Deity; cf. the cleaning of the Gundicha temple (Chaitanya-charitamrita, Madhya 12).
[^32-9]: Vv. 126–133: the other avataras return service for service (cf. Gita 4.11: "as they surrender to Me, so I reciprocate"), while Gaura Himself goes from house to house offering prema even to those who do not serve Him.
[^32-10]: V. 133+1 is found only in the 1983 edition (the 1903 edition lacks it).
[^32-11]: The summary covers both this section (the leper, vv. 1–44; the brahmana's curse, vv. 45–69) and the pastimes in the bhava of Balarama, which in the text of the edition already form the next section. The OCR of the summary is garbled in places; gaps are filled from the table of contents in the edition's preface. Cf. Murari 2.13; Chaitanya-charitamrita, Adi 17. In the Chaitanya-charitamrita (Adi 17) this is the brahmana Gopala Chapala, who slandered Srivasa and was struck with leprosy; the Lord refused him and later told him to beg Srivasa's forgiveness.
[^32-12]: Vv. 11–19 speak of the gravity of offence against a Vaishnava (vaishnava-aparadha): the Lord does not forgive it Himself until the offended Vaishnava forgives. The words "the Vaishnava is My life within" convey the teaching that the devotee is dearer to the Lord than His own body (cf. Bhagavata 9.4.68: "the sadhus are My heart, and I am the heart of the sadhus").
[^32-13]: The Lord is the independent Master, but of His own will He submits to the love of His devotees (bhakta-adhina); therefore He places the Vaishnava's forgiveness above His own.
[^32-14]: In the 1983 edition this story is given in a different redaction (the 1903 edition agrees with Bhaktisiddhanta; we follow Bhaktisiddhanta's edition). Instead of vv. 20–24 it has: "Hearing this, the brahmana was filled with anguish and, falling to the ground, began to plead piteously: 'Glory, glory to Mahaprabhu, be merciful to me! The Vedas call You the Purifier of the fallen. If You bear the name Purifier of the fallen, You will surely deliver me. How many great sinners You have delivered — deliver me too, O lotus-eyed One! There is no sinner in the three worlds equal to me; I am suffering — free [me] from leprosy.'" V. 25 there reads: "Then compassion awoke in the Lord's heart, yet He is subject to the Vaishnavas, not independent." Instead of v. 34: "The Lord says: 'Srinivasa, listen to Me: take everyone and go to where the leper is.' Then all went there together joyfully and sprinkled him with the water of Srivasa's feet. As soon as the drops of that water touched his body, his body shone like gold and the disease vanished. Then his heart was filled with great bliss, and he joyfully began to dance, crying 'Hari, Hari!'" From v. 35 on the two redactions agree. The sense is the same: an offence against a Vaishnava is removed only by the mercy of the offended Vaishnava himself (the water of his feet).
[^32-15]: V. 36+1 is found only in the 1983 edition (the 1903 edition lacks it).
[^32-16]: "Friend of Gadadhara" — a name of Gaura, inseparable from Gadadhara Pandita (in the Gaudiya Vaishnava understanding, Radha; en/25, note 7).
[^32-17]: Vv. 43+1 — 43+2 are found only in the 1983 edition (the 1903 edition lacks them).

---

# Madhya-khanda, part 10 (portion 33)

*The section "The Leper's Release from Sin and the Bhava of Baladeva" (end): a brahmana who was not admitted to see the Lord's dancing curses Him — "Be outside samsara!" — and the Lord accepts the curse as a blessing. The section "Shachi's Grief over the Brahmana's Curse" (only in the 1983 edition): Shachi in despair, the Lord consoles her. The section "Mahaprabhu Distributes Prema in His Bhavas": the Lord in the bhava of Balarama demands honey; the vision of Halayudha and His words to Gadadhara; the fragrance of varuni and Balarama's divine companions; the Lord tells of Varaha and Halayudha and asks for His flute*

তবে আর-একদিন প্রভু নৃত্য করে ।
আছিল ত একজন ব্রাহ্মণ দুয়ারে ॥ ৪৫ ॥

*tabe āra-ekadina prabhu nṛtya kare |*
*āchila ta ekajana brāhmaṇa duẏāre || 45 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe ara-ekadina — then on another day; prabhu nritya kare — the Lord dances; achhila ta ekajana brahmana — there was a brahmana; duyare — at the door

**45.** Then on another day the Lord was dancing,
and at the door stood a brahmana.

হেনই সময়ে আইল আর এক ব্রাহ্মণ ।
গৌরচন্দ্র নৃত্য করে দেখিবারে মন ॥ ৪৬ ॥

*henai samaẏe āila āra eka brāhmaṇa |*
*gauracandra nṛtya kare dekhibāre mana || 46 ||*

*Word for word:* henai samaye — at that very time; aila ara eka brahmana — another brahmana came; gaurachandra nritya kare — [how] Gaurachandra dances; dekhibare mana — wishing to see

**46.** At that very time another brahmana came:
he wished to see Gaurachandra dance.

দ্বারেতে যে ছিল তারে না দিল যাইতে ।
দুঃখিত হইল বিপ্র না পাঞা দেখিতে ॥ ৪৭ ॥

*dbārete ye chila tāre nā dila yāite |*
*duḥkhita haila bipra nā pāñā dekhite || 47 ||*

*Word for word:* dvarete ye chhila — the one at the door; tare na dila yaite — did not let him go in; duhkhita haila vipra — the brahmana was grieved; na panna dekhite — not getting to see

**47.** The one who stood at the door did not let him in,
and the brahmana was grieved at not being able to see.[^33-1]

দুঃখিত হইয়া বিপ্র নিজ ঘরে গেল ।
আনন্দে নাচিল প্রভু কিছু না জানিল ॥ ৪৮ ॥

*duḥkhita haiẏā bipra nija ghare gela |*
*ānande nācila prabhu kichu nā jānila || 48 ||*

*Word for word:* duhkhita haiya — grieved; vipra nija ghare gela — the brahmana went home; anande nachila prabhu — the Lord danced in joy; kichhu na janila — knew nothing

**48.** Grieved, the brahmana went home;
the Lord danced in joy and knew nothing of it.

তার-পর-দিনে প্রভু-গঙ্গাস্নান-কালে ।
আচম্বিতে সেই দ্বিজ দেখিল প্রভুরে ॥ ৪৯ ॥

*tāra-para-dine prabhu-gaṅgāsnāna-kāle |*
*ācambite sei dbija dekhila prabhure || 49 ||*

*Word for word:* tara-para-dine — the next day; prabhu-ganga-snana-kale — at the time of the Lord's bath in the Ganga; achambite — suddenly; sei dvija dekhila prabhure — that brahmana saw the Lord

**49.** The next day, as the Lord was bathing in the Ganga,
that brahmana suddenly saw the Lord.

দেখিলেক গঙ্গাস্নানে প্রভু বিশ্বম্ভর ।
ক্রোধদৃষ্ট্যে চাহে বিপ্র কাঁপে কলেবর ॥ ৫০ ॥

*dekhileka gaṅgāsnāne prabhu biśbambhara |*
*krodhadṛṣṭye cāhe bipra kāṁpe kalebara || 50 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhileka — he saw; ganga-snane prabhu vishvambhara — the Lord Vishvambhara bathing in the Ganga; krodha-drishtye chahe vipra — the brahmana glares in anger; kanpe kalebara — his body trembles

**50.** He saw the Lord Vishvambhara bathing in the Ganga —
and the brahmana glares in anger, his whole body trembling.

প্রভুকে দেখিয়া বোলে সক্রোধ বচন ।
তোর ঘরে গেনু তোরে দেখিবারে মন ॥ ৫১ ॥

*prabhuke dekhiẏā bole sakrodha bacana |*
*tora ghare genu tore dekhibāre mana || 51 ||*

*Word for word:* prabhuke dekhiya — seeing the Lord; bole sakrodha vachana — speaks angry words; tora ghare genu — I went to Your house; tore dekhibare mana — wishing to see You

**51.** Seeing the Lord, he speaks angry words:
"I came to Your house wishing to see You.

তোর নৃত্য দেখিবারে বড় ছিল সাধ ।
পাপিষ্ঠ ব্রাহ্মণ এক তাতে দিল বাধ ॥ ৫২ ॥

*tora nṛtya dekhibāre baṛa chila sādha |*
*pāpiṣṭha brāhmaṇa eka tāte dila bādha || 52 ||*

*Word for word:* tora nritya dekhibare — to see Your dance; bada chhila sadha — there was great longing; papishtha brahmana eka — a sinful brahmana; tate dila badha — obstructed it

**52.** I greatly longed to see Your dancing,
but a sinful brahmana barred the way.

না দিল যাইতে মোরে বাহির-দুয়ারে ।
তেমনি বাহির তুমি হইবে সংসারে ॥ ৫৩ ॥

*nā dila yāite more bāhira-duẏāre |*
*temani bāhira tumi haibe saṃsāre || 53 ||*

*Word for word:* na dila yaite more — did not let me go in; bahira-duyare — [leaving me] outside the door; temani bahira tumi — so You outside; haibe samsare — will be of samsara

**53.** He did not let me in, [kept me] outside the door —
so You too shall be outside samsara!"

ইহা বলি' উপবীত ছিণ্ডিলেক ক্রোধে ।
ক্রোধে অচেতন বিপ্র নাহি পরবোধে ॥ ৫৪ ॥

*ihā bali' upabīta chiṇḍileka krodhe |*
*krodhe acetana bipra nāhi parabodhe || 54 ||*

*Word for word:* iha bali — saying this; upavita chhindileka krodhe — he tore his sacred thread in anger; krodhe achetana vipra — the brahmana, senseless with rage; nahi parabodhe — heeds no persuasion

**54.** Saying this, he tore his sacred thread in anger;
beside himself with rage, the brahmana heeds no persuasion.[^33-2]

দ্বারের বাহির কৈল আমি নাহি সহি ।
শাপ দিল হউ তুমি সংসারের বহি ॥ ৫৫ ॥

*dbārera bāhira kaila āmi nāhi sahi |*
*śāpa dila hau tumi saṃsārera bahi || 55 ||*

*Word for word:* dvarera bahira kaila — they put [me] outside the door; ami nahi sahi — I will not bear it; shapa dila — he cursed; hau tumi samsarera bahi — may You be outside samsara

**55.** "I was put outside the door — I will not bear it!" —
and he cursed: "May You be outside samsara!"

এ বোল শুনিঞা প্রভু হরিষ অন্তর ।
ব্রাহ্মণের শাপ মোরে বড় হৈল বর ॥ ৫৬ ॥

*e bola śuniñā prabhu hariṣa antara |*
*brāhmaṇera śāpa more baṛa haila bara || 56 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuninna — hearing this; prabhu harisha antara — the Lord rejoiced at heart; brahmanera shapa — the brahmana's curse; more bada haila bara — has become a great boon for Me

**56.** Hearing this, the Lord rejoiced at heart:
"The brahmana's curse has become a great blessing for Me!"

শাপ স্বীকার যবে কৈল ভগবান্ ।
শুনিঞা ব্রাহ্মণ ভয় পাইল বড় মন ॥ ৫৭ ॥

*śāpa sbīkāra yabe kaila bhagabān |*
*śuniñā brāhmaṇa bhaẏa pāila baṛa mana || 57 ||*

*Word for word:* shapa svikara — acceptance of the curse; yabe kaila bhagavan — when Bhagavan made; shuninna brahmana — hearing, the brahmana; bhaya paila bada mana — grew greatly afraid at heart

**57.** When Bhagavan accepted the curse,
the brahmana, hearing it, grew greatly afraid at heart:

আমি কি করিব প্রভু যে বোলাইলে তুমি ।
তুমি সর্ব-পরিপূর্ণ সর্ব-অন্তর্যামী ॥ ৫৮ ॥

*āmi ki kariba prabhu ye bolāile tumi |*
*tumi sarba-paripūrṇa sarba-antaryāmī || 58 ||*

*Word for word:* ami ki kariba prabhu — what could I do, Lord; ye bolaile tumi — You made me say it; tumi sarva-paripurna — You are all-perfect; sarva-antaryami — the Inner Witness of all

**58.** "What could I do, Lord? It is You who made me say it:
You are all-perfect, the Inner Witness of all.

কুতর্কের গণ সব নিস্তার করিবে ।
সন্ন্যাস করিয়া তা-সভারে প্রেম দিবে ॥ ৫৯ ॥

*kutarkera gaṇa saba nistāra karibe |*
*sannyāsa kariẏā tā-sabhāre prema dibe || 59 ||*

*Word for word:* kutarkera gana saba — all the crowd of disputants; nistara karibe — You will deliver; sannyasa kariya — taking sannyasa; ta-sabhare prema dibe — You will give them prema

**59.** You will deliver all who are given to idle argument:
taking sannyasa, You will give them prema.

সন্ন্যাসী বলিয়া গুরু তোমারে বলিবে ।
সেই নম্রভাবে প্রেম তা-সভারে দিবে ॥ ৬০ ॥

*sannyāsī baliẏā guru tomāre balibe |*
*sei namrabhābe prema tā-sabhāre dibe || 60 ||*

*Word for word:* sannyasi baliya — as a sannyasi; guru tomare balibe — they will call You guru; sei namra-bhave — through that humility; prema ta-sabhare dibe — You will give them prema

**60.** Seeing You a sannyasi, they will call You 'guru',
and through that humility You will give them prema.

পরম চতুরশিরোমণি গৌরহরি ।
বিলাইবে পূর্ব প্রেম-ভাণ্ডার উঘাড়ি' ॥ ৬১ ॥

*parama caturaśiromaṇi gaurahari |*
*bilāibe pūrba prema-bhāṇḍāra ughāṛi' || 61 ||*

*Word for word:* parama chatura-shiromani — the supreme crest-jewel of the wise; gaurahari — Gaurahari; vilaibe — will distribute; purva prema-bhandara ughadi — opening the storehouse of former prema

**61.** Gaurahari, the crest-jewel of the wise,
will open the storehouse of the prema of former times and distribute it.

তোমার প্রতিজ্ঞা এই ব্রহ্মাণ্ড ডুবাবে ।
দুর্জন সুজন সভা কারে না রাখিবে ॥ ৬২ ॥

*tomāra pratijñā ei brahmāṇḍa ḍubābe |*
*durjana sujana sabhā kāre nā rākhibe || 62 ||*

*Word for word:* tomara pratijna ei — this is Your vow; brahmanda dubabe — You will flood the universe; durjana sujana — the wicked and the good; sabha kare na rakhibe — You will leave out none

**62.** You have vowed to flood the universe [with prema] —
You will leave out no one, neither the wicked nor the good.

আমি সে বঞ্চিত হৈলুঁ তোর প্রেম-বানে ।
কি হইবে মোর গতি পতিতপাবনে ॥ ৬৩ ॥

*āmi se bañcita hailuṁ tora prema-bāne |*
*ki haibe mora gati patitapābane || 63 ||*

*Word for word:* ami se vanchita hailun — I alone was deprived; tora prema-bane — of the flood of Your prema; ki haibe mora gati — what will be my fate; patita-pavane — O Purifier of the fallen

**63.** I alone have been left out of the flood of Your prema:
what will become of me, O Purifier of the fallen?"[^33-3]

শুনি' প্রভু বোলে শাপ নহে মোর বর ।
মোর বাঞ্ছা পূর্ণ কৈলে নাহি তোর ডর ॥ ৬৪ ॥

*śuni' prabhu bole śāpa nahe mora bara |*
*mora bāñchā pūrṇa kaile nāhi tora ḍara || 64 ||*

*Word for word:* shuni — hearing; prabhu bole — the Lord says; shapa nahe — it is no curse; mora bara — a boon for Me; mora vanchha purna kaile — you fulfilled My desire; nahi tora dara — have no fear

**64.** Hearing this, the Lord says: "It is not a curse — it is a blessing for Me:
you have fulfilled My desire; do not fear."

শুনিঞা পড়িলা বিপ্র প্রভুর চরণে ।
তুলিয়া ত মহাপ্রভু কৈল আলিঙ্গনে ॥ ৬৫ ॥

*śuniñā paṛilā bipra prabhura caraṇe |*
*tuliẏā ta mahāprabhu kaila āliṅgane || 65 ||*

*Word for word:* shuninna — hearing; padila vipra — the brahmana fell; prabhura charane — at the Lord's feet; tuliya ta mahaprabhu — raising him, Mahaprabhu; kaila alingane — embraced him

**65.** Hearing this, the brahmana fell at the Lord's feet,
and Mahaprabhu, raising him, embraced him.

প্রভু-আলিঙ্গনে বিপ্র প্রেমায় আকুল ।
গরগর কৃষ্ণপ্রেমে হইল তরল ॥ ৬৬ ॥

*prabhu-āliṅgane bipra premāẏa ākula |*
*garagara kṛṣṇapreme haila tarala || 66 ||*

*Word for word:* prabhu-alingane — in the Lord's embrace; vipra premaya akula — the brahmana was overwhelmed with prema; garagara krishna-preme — brimming with prema for Krishna; haila tarala — he melted

**66.** In the Lord's embrace the brahmana is beside himself with prema:
overflowing with prema for Krishna, he melted.

বিপ্রের মানস পূর্ণ কৈল ভগবান্ ।
ব্রহ্মার দুর্লভ প্রেম তারে দিলা দান ॥ ৬৭ ॥

*biprera mānasa pūrṇa kaila bhagabān |*
*brahmāra durlabha prema tāre dilā dāna || 67 ||*

*Word for word:* viprera manasa — the brahmana's desire; purna kaila bhagavan — Bhagavan fulfilled; brahmara durlabha prema — prema rare even for Brahma; tare dila dana — He gave him as a gift

**67.** Bhagavan fulfilled the brahmana's desire —
He gave him prema, hard even for Brahma to obtain.

হেন চিত্র লীলা করে গৌরাঙ্গসুন্দর ।
বুঝিতে না পারে দুষ্ট-অন্তর পামর ॥ ৬৮ ॥

*hena citra līlā kare gaurāṅgasundara |*
*bujhite nā pāre duṣṭa-antara pāmara || 68 ||*

*Word for word:* hena chitra lila — such wondrous pastimes; kare gaurangasundara — Gaurangasundara performs; bujhite na pare — cannot understand; dushta-antara pamara — wicked-hearted scoundrels

**68.** Such wondrous pastimes Gaurangasundara performs —
scoundrels with wicked hearts cannot understand them.

ইহা বলি' মহাপ্রভু অন্তর উল্লাসে ।
গোরাগুণ গায় সুখে এ লোচনদাসে ॥ ৬৯ ॥

*ihā bali' mahāprabhu antara ullāse |*
*gorāguṇa gāẏa sukhe e locanadāse || 69 ||*

*Word for word:* iha bali — saying this; mahaprabhu antara ullase — Mahaprabhu rejoices at heart; gora-guna gaya sukhe — happily sings Gora's qualities; e lochana-dase — this Lochana Dasa

**69.** Thus Mahaprabhu rejoiced at heart —
and Lochana Dasa happily sings of Gora's qualities.

## Shachi's Grief over the Brahmana's Curse

*Raga — any (yatha-raga)*

প্রভুকে সে ব্রহ্মশাপ লোকমুখে শুনি' ।
আচম্বিতে কাঁপি' উঠে শচীর পরাণি ॥ ৬৯+১ ॥

*prabhuke se brahmaśāpa lokamukhe śuni' |*
*ācambite kāṁpi' uṭhe śacīra parāṇi || 69+1 ||*

*Word for word:* prabhuke se brahma-shapa — that brahmana's curse on the Lord; loka-mukhe shuni — hearing from people's lips; achambite — suddenly; kanpi uthe — trembles; shachira parani — Shachi's soul

**69+1.** Hearing from people's lips of the brahmana's curse on the Lord,
Shachi suddenly trembled to the depths of her soul[^33-4].

ধকধক প্রাণ পোড়ে বৃত্তান্ত না জানে ।
নিবারিতে নারে অশ্রু ভরে দু-নয়ানে ॥ ৬৯+২ ॥

*dhakadhaka prāṇa poṛe bṛttānta nā jāne |*
*nibārite nāre aśru bhare du-naẏāne || 69+2 ||*

*Word for word:* dhakadhaka prana pode — her heart pounds and burns; vrittanta na jane — she does not know what happened; nivarite nare — cannot hold back; ashru bhare du-nayane — tears fill both eyes

**69+2.** Her heart pounds and burns — she does not know what has happened;
she cannot hold back her tears — both eyes are full.

ব্যাকুল হৈয়া শচী পুছে সর্বজনে ।
প্রভুরে সে ব্রহ্মশাপ সবার বদনে ॥ ৬৯+৩ ॥

*byākula haiẏā śacī puche sarbajane |*
*prabhure se brahmaśāpa sabāra badane || 69+3 ||*

*Word for word:* vyakula haiya — in distress; shachi puchhe sarvajane — Shachi asks everyone; prabhure se brahma-shapa — the brahmana's curse on the Lord; sabara vadane — on everyone's lips

**69+3.** In distress Shachi asks everyone —
and on everyone's lips is the brahmana's curse on the Lord.

শুনিয়া মূর্ছিত হৈয়া পড়িলা তথায় ।
চেতন পাইয়া শচী কান্দে উভরায় ॥ ৬৯+৪ ॥

*śuniẏā mūrchita haiẏā paṛilā tathāẏa |*
*cetana pāiẏā śacī kānde ubharāẏa || 69+4 ||*

*Word for word:* shuniya — hearing; murchhita haiya padila tathaya — fell there senseless; chetana paiya — coming to herself; shachi kande ubharaya — Shachi weeps aloud

**69+4.** Hearing this, she fell there senseless;
coming to herself, Shachi weeps aloud.

কান্দিতে কান্দিতে আইলা আপনার ঘর ।
ক্ষণেক অন্তরে গৃহে আইলা বিশ্বম্ভর ॥ ৬৯+৫ ॥

*kāndite kāndite āilā āpanāra ghara |*
*kṣaṇeka antare gṛhe āilā biśbambhara || 69+5 ||*

*Word for word:* kandite kandite — weeping; aila apanara ghara — came to her home; kshaneka antare — a little later; grihe aila vishvambhara — Vishvambhara came home

**69+5.** Weeping, she returned home;
a little later Vishvambhara came home too.

গৌর-মুখ দেখি' মায়ের শোক উথলিল ।
কান্দিতে কান্দিতে শচী পুছিতে লাগিল ॥ ৬৯+৬ ॥

*gaura-mukha dekhi' māẏera śoka uthalila |*
*kāndite kāndite śacī puchite lāgila || 69+6 ||*

*Word for word:* gaura-mukha dekhi — seeing Gaura's face; mayera shoka uthalila — the mother's grief welled up; kandite kandite — weeping; shachi puchhite lagila — Shachi began to ask

**69+6.** Seeing Gaura's face, the mother's grief welled up,
and, weeping, Shachi began to ask:

শুন রে নিমাই বাপ কিবা কথা শুনি ।
তোমারে ব্রাহ্মণ নাকি দিল শাপবাণী ॥ ৬৯+৭ ॥

*śuna re nimāi bāpa kibā kathā śuni |*
*tomāre brāhmaṇa nāki dila śāpabāṇī || 69+7 ||*

*Word for word:* shuna re nimai bapa — listen, my son Nimai; kiba katha shuni — what do I hear; tomare brahmana naki — is it true that a brahmana to you; dila shapa-vani — pronounced a curse

**69+7.** "Listen, my son Nimai, what is this I hear?
They say a brahmana has pronounced a curse on you?

কোন্ অপরাধ তুমি কৈলে তার স্থান ।
কেমন ব্রাহ্মণ তার কি কঠিন প্রাণ ॥ ৬৯+৮ ॥

*kon aparādha tumi kaile tāra sthāna |*
*kemana brāhmaṇa tāra ki kaṭhina prāṇa || 69+8 ||*

*Word for word:* kon aparadha — what offence; tumi kaile tara sthana — did you commit against him; kemana brahmana — what sort of brahmana; tara ki kathina prana — how hard his heart

**69+8.** What offence did you commit against him?
What sort of brahmana is he — how hard his heart!

তোর মুখ দেখি' তার দয়া নাহি হৈল ।
আমার বধের ভাগী কোন্ জন হৈল ॥ ৬৯+৯ ॥

*tora mukha dekhi' tāra daẏā nāhi haila |*
*āmāra badhera bhāgī kon jana haila || 69+9 ||*

*Word for word:* tora mukha dekhi — looking at your face; tara daya nahi haila — he felt no pity; amara vadhera bhagi — guilty of my death; kon jana haila — who has become

**69+9.** Looking at your face, he felt no pity!
Who will be guilty of my death?

এ ঘরকরণ মোর সব তোমা লৈয়া ।
অভাগী শচীর প্রাণ যায় বিদরিয়া ॥ ৬৯+১০ ॥

*e gharakaraṇa mora saba tomā laiẏā |*
*abhāgī śacīra prāṇa yāẏa bidariẏā || 69+10 ||*

*Word for word:* e gharakarana mora saba — all this house and household of mine; toma laiya — is for you; abhagi shachira prana — unfortunate Shachi's heart; yaya vidariya — is breaking

**69+10.** All this house and household of mine is only for you;
the heart of unfortunate Shachi is breaking.

সবার দুলাল তুমি মোর আঁখি-তারা ।
বিধির বিপাকে পাছে তোমা হই হারা ॥ ৬৯+১১ ॥

*sabāra dulāla tumi mora āṁkhi-tārā |*
*bidhira bipāke pāche tomā hai hārā || 69+11 ||*

*Word for word:* sabara dulala tumi — you are everyone's darling; mora ankhi-tara — the apple of my eye; vidhira vipake — by an evil turn of fate; pachhe toma hai hara — lest I lose you

**69+11.** You are everyone's darling, the apple of my eye:
may I not lose you by some evil turn of fate!

অমিয়া-সিনান করি' দেখি তোর মুখ ।
দারুণ বচন শুনি' ফাটে মোর বুক ॥ ৬৯+১২ ॥

*amiẏā-sināna kari' dekhi tora mukha |*
*dāruṇa bacana śuni' phāṭe mora buka || 69+12 ||*

*Word for word:* amiya-sinana kari — as if bathing in nectar; dekhi tora mukha — I look at your face; daruna vachana shuni — hearing cruel words; phate mora buka — my breast bursts

**69+12.** Looking at your face, I bathe as if in nectar —
and hearing cruel words, my breast is bursting.

অভাগী শচীর ভাগ্যে না জানি কি হব ।
তোর অমঙ্গল হৈলে পরাণে মরিব ॥ ৬৯+১৩ ॥

*abhāgī śacīra bhāgye nā jāni ki haba |*
*tora amaṅgala haile parāṇe mariba || 69+13 ||*

*Word for word:* abhagi shachira bhagye — in unfortunate Shachi's lot; na jani ki haba — I know not what will be; tora amangala haile — if harm comes to you; parane mariba — I shall die

**69+13.** I know not what fate awaits unfortunate Shachi:
if harm comes to you, I shall die."

এ বোল শুনিয়া তবে গৌরাঙ্গ সুন্দর ।
মায়েরে কহয়ে কিছু প্রবোধ-উত্তর ॥ ৬৯+১৪ ॥

*e bola śuniẏā tabe gaurāṅga sundara |*
*māẏere kahaẏe kichu prabodha-uttara || 69+14 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuniya — hearing these words; tabe gauranga sundara — then beautiful Gauranga; mayere kahaye — says to His mother; kichhu prabodha-uttara — an answer in consolation

**69+14.** Hearing these words, beautiful Gauranga
gives His mother this answer in consolation:

শুন গো জননী তুমি আমার বচন ।
কি লাগিয়া রোদন করহ অকারণ ॥ ৬৯+১৫ ॥

*śuna go jananī tumi āmāra bacana |*
*ki lāgiẏā rodana karaha akāraṇa || 69+15 ||*

*Word for word:* shuna go janani — listen, mother; tumi amara vachana — you, My word; ki lagiya — why; rodana karaha akarana — do you weep for nothing

**69+15.** "Listen, mother, to My word:
why do you weep for nothing?

মোর অপরাধ নাহি ব্রাহ্মণের স্থানে ।
মোরে যে শাপিল বিপ্র সেহ অকারণে ॥ ৬৯+১৬ ॥

*mora aparādha nāhi brāhmaṇera sthāne |*
*more ye śāpila bipra seha akāraṇe || 69+16 ||*

*Word for word:* mora aparadha nahi — I have no offence; brahmanera sthane — against the brahmana; more ye shapila vipra — that the brahmana cursed Me; seha akarane — that too was without cause

**69+16.** I have committed no offence against the brahmana:
the brahmana cursed Me without cause.

বিনি অপরাধে শাপ লাগিবে বা কেনে ।
নিশ্চয় জানিহ মাতা এ সত্য বচনে ॥ ৬৯+১৭ ॥

*bini aparādhe śāpa lāgibe bā kene |*
*niścaẏa jāniha mātā e satya bacane || 69+17 ||*

*Word for word:* vini aparadhe — without an offence; shapa lagibe ba kene — how can a curse take effect; nishchaya janiha mata — know for certain, mother; e satya vachane — this is a true word

**69+17.** And how can a curse take effect without an offence?
Know for certain, mother: this is a true word"[^33-5].

ইহা বলি' গেলা প্রভু জাহ্নবীর তীর ।
সুরনদী স্নান করি' আইলা নিজ ঘর ॥ ৬৯+১৮ ॥

*ihā bali' gelā prabhu jāhnabīra tīra |*
*suranadī snāna kari' āilā nija ghara || 69+18 ||*

*Word for word:* iha bali — saying this; gela prabhu jahnavira tira — the Lord went to the bank of the Jahnavi; suranadi snana kari — bathing in the heavenly river; aila nija ghara — came home

**69+18.** Saying this, the Lord went to the bank of the Jahnavi
and, bathing in the heavenly river, came back home.

ঘরে আসি' মহাপ্রভু পরম সাদরে ।
কৃষ্ণ-পূজার্চনা করে হরিষ-অন্তরে ॥ ৬৯+১৯ ॥

*ghare āsi' mahāprabhu parama sādare |*
*kṛṣṇa-pūjārcanā kare hariṣa-antare || 69+19 ||*

*Word for word:* ghare asi — returning home; mahaprabhu parama sadare — Mahaprabhu with great reverence; krishna-pujarchana kare — performs the worship of Krishna; harisha-antare — with joy in His heart

**69+19.** Returning home, Mahaprabhu with great reverence
and joy in His heart performs the worship of Krishna.

পূজা করি' স্তব পাঠ পড়ি' কতক্ষণ ।
তুলসীরে জল দিলা প্রেমাবিষ্ট মন ॥ ৬৯+২০ ॥

*pūjā kari' staba pāṭha paṛi' katakṣaṇa |*
*tulasīre jala dilā premābiṣṭa mana || 69+20 ||*

*Word for word:* puja kari — having worshipped; stava patha padi katakshana — recited hymns for a while; tulasire jala dila — watered the tulasi; premavishta mana — absorbed in prema

**69+20.** Having worshipped, He recited hymns for a while
and, absorbed in prema, watered the tulasi.

প্রণাম করিয়া প্রভু কৈলা জলপান ।
সাদরে নিরীখে শচী পুত্রের বয়ান ॥ ৬৯+২১ ॥

*praṇāma kariẏā prabhu kailā jalapāna |*
*sādare nirīkhe śacī putrera baẏāna || 69+21 ||*

*Word for word:* pranama kariya — having bowed down; prabhu kaila jalapana — the Lord took refreshment; sadare nirikhe shachi — Shachi gazes tenderly; putrera bayana — at her son's face

**69+21.** Having bowed down, the Lord took refreshment,
and Shachi gazes tenderly at her son's face.

কোটি চান্দ জিনি' গোরার বদন-প্রকাশ ।
গৌরাঙ্গ-চরিত্র কহে এ লোচনদাস ॥ ৬৯+২২ ॥

*koṭi cānda jini' gorāra badana-prakāśa |*
*gaurāṅga-caritra kahe e locanadāsa || 69+22 ||*

*Word for word:* koti chanda jini — outshining millions of moons; gorara vadana-prakasha — the radiance of Gora's face; gauranga-charitra kahe — tells of Gauranga's deeds; e lochanadasa — this Lochana Dasa

**69+22.** The radiance of Gora's face outshines millions of moons;
of Gauranga's deeds this Lochana Dasa tells.

## Mahaprabhu Distributes Prema in His Bhavas

> *Summary by Srila Bhaktisiddhanta Sarasvati.* Sriman Mahaprabhu [one day] danced together [with the devotees] in the bhava of Varaha. Then, [saying] that Shiva, Shuka, Narada, Brahma and other sages worship God by song, that the best [dharma] of the Kali age is the sankirtana of the name, and that [Gaurahari] has descended to distribute this dharma at the door of every living being, Sriman Mahaprabhu ordered the devotees headed by Advaita Acharya [to preach it] and, singing with His own the stories of the gopis, in the bhava of a gopi He went with sankirtana to the house of Chandrashekhara Acharya; [Srivasa] Pandita was filled with the bhava of Narada. In His bhava Sriman Mahaprabhu glorified before all the greatness of Gadadhara Pandita and revealed that he is Radhika, [worshipped by] Brahma, Shiva, Narada and others. Then Thakura Haridasa [came], and all the Vaishnavas joined them in the sankirtana of the name and prema. [Dancing] in the bhava of a gopi, [the Lord] suddenly became filled with the bhava of His majesty; then the devotees saw Him in the form of Lakshmi and offered praise to Lakshmi. [In the bhava of Lakshmi the Lord] distributed the prema of service; at that time someone came and loudly called Sriman Mahaprabhu "Prabhu!" — and [the Lord, giving up] that bhava, in the bhava of Ishvara distributed prema to all.[^33-6]

*Raga vibhasa; disha: "Glory, glory to Gaurachand, risen in Nadia in the Kali age!" (murchha); refrain: "Hear the story of my Lord, whose qualities have lit up the three worlds! Hear the story of Gaurangachand!"*

আর কথা কহি শুন বড় অপরূপ ।
নদিয়া-নগরে নিত নূতন কৌতুক ॥ ১ ॥

*āra kathā kahi śuna baṛa aparūpa |*
*nadiẏā-nagare nita nūtana kautuka || 1 ||*

*Word for word:* ara katha kahi — I tell another story; shuna bada aparupa — listen, most wondrous; nadiya-nagare — in the town of Nadia; nita nutana kautuka — daily a new marvel

**1.** I shall tell another story — listen, it is most wondrous:
in the town of Nadia every day there is a new marvel.

নিজঘরে বৈসে প্রভু আনন্দিত মন ।
চৌদিগে বেড়িয়া বৈসে সব নিজজন ॥ ২ ॥

*nijaghare baise prabhu ānandita mana |*
*caudige beṛiẏā baise saba nijajana || 2 ||*

*Word for word:* nijaghare baise prabhu — the Lord sits in His house; anandita mana — joyful at heart; chaudige bediya baise — sit around Him; saba nijajana — all His own

**2.** The Lord sits in His house, joyful at heart,
and all His own sit around Him.

আচম্বিতে এক ধ্বনি উঠিল গগনে ।
মধু দেহ বলি' ডাকে এ মেঘ-নিঃস্বনে ॥ ৩ ॥

*ācambite eka dhbani uṭhila gagane |*
*madhu deha bali' ḍāke e megha-niḥsbane || 3 ||*

*Word for word:* achambite — suddenly; eka dhvani uthila gagane — a cry rose to the sky; madhu deha bali — saying "give honey"; dake e megha-nihsvane — He calls in a voice like a thundercloud

**3.** Suddenly a cry rose to the sky:
in a voice like a thundercloud He calls: "Give Me honey!"

সেইক্ষণে ধরে প্রভু হলায়ুধ-রূপ ।
নীলবসন শ্বেতপর্বত-স্বরূপ ॥ ৪ ॥

*seikṣaṇe dhare prabhu halāẏudha-rūpa |*
*nīlabasana śbetaparbata-sbarūpa || 4 ||*

*Word for word:* sei-kshane — at that moment; dhare prabhu halayudha-rupa — the Lord assumes the form of Halayudha; nila-vasana — clad in blue; shveta-parvata-svarupa — like a white mountain

**4.** At that very moment the Lord assumes the form of Halayudha —
clad in blue, like a white mountain,[^33-7]

সুন্দর চরণ আর পদ্মলোচনে ।
আশ্চর্য দেখিয়া সবে হৃষ্ট হৈলা মনে ॥ ৫ ॥

*sundara caraṇa āra padmalocane |*
*āścarya dekhiẏā sabe hṛṣṭa hailā mane || 5 ||*

*Word for word:* sundara charana — beautiful feet; ara padma-lochane — and lotus eyes; ashcharya dekhiya — seeing the marvel; sabe hrishta haila mane — all rejoiced at heart

**5.** with beautiful feet and lotus eyes;
