seeing this marvel, all rejoiced at heart.

সর্বজন-প্রেমদাতা প্রেম বিলসয় ।
আপন আবেশ ধরি' নাচে মহাশয় ॥ ৬ ॥

*sarbajana-premadātā prema bilasaẏa |*
*āpana ābeśa dhari' nāce mahāśaẏa || 6 ||*

*Word for word:* sarvajana-prema-data — the Giver of prema to all; prema vilasaya — enjoys prema; apana avesha dhari — holding to His own bhava; nache mahashaya — the Great Soul dances

**6.** The Giver of prema to all enjoys prema:
in His bhava the Great Soul dances.

হরিনাম গায় সব-নিজ-জন-সনে ।
সেইমনে গেলা অদ্বৈত-মুরারির স্থানে ॥ ৭ ॥

*harināma gāẏa saba-nija-jana-sane |*
*seimane gelā adbaita-murārira sthāne || 7 ||*

*Word for word:* hari-nama gaya — singing the name of Hari; saba-nija-jana-sane — with all His own; sei-mane — thus; gela advaita-murarira sthane — went to Advaita and Murari

**7.** Singing the name of Hari with all His own,
thus He went to Advaita and Murari.[^33-8]

তথা গিয়া কহে প্রভু গদগদ ভাষ ।
মধু দেহ দেহ বলি' অট্ট-অট্ট হাস ॥ ৮ ॥

*tathā giẏā kahe prabhu gadagada bhāṣa |*
*madhu deha deha bali' aṭṭa-aṭṭa hāsa || 8 ||*

*Word for word:* tatha giya — going there; kahe prabhu gadgada bhasha — the Lord speaks in a faltering voice; madhu deha deha bali — saying "give, give honey"; atta-atta hasa — laughs aloud

**8.** Going there, the Lord speaks in a faltering voice,
crying "Give, give Me honey!" — and laughs aloud.

দেহের বরণ যেন বাল-দিননাথ ।
মধু দেহ দেহ বলি' ঘন পাতে হাথ ॥ ৯ ॥

*dehera baraṇa yena bāla-dinanātha |*
*madhu deha deha bali' ghana pāte hātha || 9 ||*

*Word for word:* dehera barana — the colour of the body; yena bala-dinanatha — like the rising sun; madhu deha deha bali — saying "give, give honey"; ghana pate hatha — again and again holds out His hand

**9.** The colour of His body is like the rising sun;
"Give, give Me honey!" He says, holding out His hand.

তোয়পূর্ণ ভাজন ধরিয়া নিজকরে ।
মধুপান করি' তোলে রসের উদ্গারে ॥ ১০ ॥

*toẏapūrṇa bhājana dhariẏā nijakare |*
*madhupāna kari' tole rasera udgāre || 10 ||*

*Word for word:* toya-purna bhajana — a vessel full of water; dhariya nija-kare — taking in His hand; madhu-pana kari — drinking [it as] honey; tole rasera udgare — belches with relish

**10.** Taking in His hand a vessel full of water,
He drinks [it as] honey and belches with relish.[^33-9]

টলমল করি' নাচে প্রেমে মাতোয়াল ।
হেউ-হেউ করি' তোলে রসের উদ্গার ॥ ১১ ॥

*ṭalamala kari' nāce preme mātoẏāla |*
*heu-heu kari' tole rasera udgāra || 11 ||*

*Word for word:* talamala kari — reeling; nache preme matoyala — dances intoxicated with prema; heu-heu kari — going "heu-heu"; tole rasera udgara — belches with relish

**11.** Reeling, He dances, intoxicated with prema,
and belches with relish: "heu, heu!"

ক্ষণে পড়ে ক্ষণে উঠে ক্ষণে কান্দে হাসে ।
অধর মিটাই' ক্ষণে অট্ট-অট্ট হাসে ॥ ১২ ॥

*kṣaṇe paṛe kṣaṇe uṭhe kṣaṇe kānde hāse |*
*adhara miṭāi' kṣaṇe aṭṭa-aṭṭa hāse || 12 ||*

*Word for word:* kshane pade — now falls; kshane uthe — now rises; kshane kande hase — now weeps, now laughs; adhara mitai — smacking His lips; kshane atta-atta hase — now laughs aloud

**12.** Now He falls, now rises, now weeps, now laughs,
now, smacking His lips, laughs aloud.

দেখিয়া সকল লোক করয়ে স্তবন ।
হলধর বলি' কেহ ধরয়ে চরণ ॥ ১৩ ॥

*dekhiẏā sakala loka karaẏe stabana |*
*haladhara bali' keha dharaẏe caraṇa || 13 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhiya sakala loka — seeing this, all the people; karaye stavana — offer praise; haladhara bali — crying "Haladhara"; keha dharaye charana — some clasp His feet

**13.** Seeing this, all the people offer praise,
and some, crying "Haladhara!", clasp His feet.

তবে সেই মহাপ্রভু লীলা-বলরাম ।
কহয়ে অমৃত-কথা অতি অনুপাম ॥ ১৪ ॥

*tabe sei mahāprabhu līlā-balarāma |*
*kahaẏe amṛta-kathā ati anupāma || 14 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe sei mahaprabhu — then Mahaprabhu; lila-balarama — playing Balarama; kahaye amrita-katha — speaks nectarean words; ati anupama — incomparable

**14.** Then Mahaprabhu, playing Balarama,
speaks incomparable, nectarean words:

শ্রীকৃষ্ণ নহিয়ে আমি বোলে হব সুখী ।
অদ্ভুত সুপেয় মধু আনি' দেহ দেখি ॥ ১৫ ॥

*śrīkṛṣṇa nahiẏe āmi bole haba sukhī |*
*adbhuta supeẏa madhu āni' deha dekhi || 15 ||*

*Word for word:* shri-krishna nahiye ami — I am not Sri Krishna; bole haba sukhi — to be pleased by words; adbhuta supeya madhu — wonderful, sweet honey; ani deha dekhi — bring Me, come

**15.** "I am not Sri Krishna, to be pleased with words —
bring Me wonderful, sweet honey!"[^33-10]

সেইখানে এক দ্বিজ ছিল দাঁড়াইয়া ।
এই মল্ল বলি' ফেলে অঙ্গুলে ঠেলিয়া ॥ ১৬ ॥

*seikhāne eka dbija chila dāṁṛāiẏā |*
*ei malla bali' phele aṅgule ṭheliẏā || 16 ||*

*Word for word:* seikhane — there; eka dvija chhila dandaiya — a brahmana stood; ei malla bali — saying "here is a wrestler"; phele angule theliya — throws him down with a push of the finger

**16.** A brahmana was standing there;
"Here is a wrestler!" [the Lord] said, and pushed him with a finger.

অঙ্গুলি-ঠেলায় বিপ্র পড়ে বহুদূর ।
লজ্জা সে পাইল বিপ্র ফেলিল ঠাকুর ॥ ১৭ ॥

*aṅguli-ṭhelāẏa bipra paṛe bahudūra |*
*lajjā se pāila bipra phelila ṭhākura || 17 ||*

*Word for word:* anguli-thelaya — by the push of a finger; vipra pade bahudura — the brahmana falls far off; lajja se paila vipra — the brahmana felt ashamed; phelila thakura — the Thakura threw him

**17.** At the push of a finger the brahmana flew far off;
the brahmana was ashamed: the Thakura had thrown him down.

প্রভাতে আবেশ ভেল সায়াহ্ন সময় ।
লীলা-বলরাম ক্রীড়া করে মহাশয় ॥ ১৮ ॥

*prabhāte ābeśa bhela sāẏāhna samaẏa |*
*līlā-balarāma krīṛā kare mahāśaẏa || 18 ||*

*Word for word:* prabhate avesha bhela — the bhava began in the morning; sayahna samaya — [until] evening; lila-balarama — playing Balarama; krida kare mahashaya — the Great Soul sports

**18.** This bhava began in the morning [and lasted] until evening:
the Great Soul sports, playing Balarama.

নরহরি-পাদপদ্ম শিরের ভূষণ ।
ধন্য গোরাগুণ কহে এ দাস লোচন ॥ ১৯ ॥

*narahari-pādapadma śirera bhūṣaṇa |*
*dhanya gorāguṇa kahe e dāsa locana || 19 ||*

*Word for word:* narahari-pada-padma — the lotus feet of Narahari; shirera bhushana — the ornament of the head; dhanya gora-guna — Gora's blessed qualities; kahe e dasa lochana — this Lochana Dasa tells

**19.** The lotus feet of Narahari are the ornament of my head;
this Lochana Dasa sings of Gora's blessed qualities.

তার পরদিনে শুন অপরূপ আর ।
নাচয়ে ঠাকুর বলদেব-অনুকার ॥ ২০ ॥

*tāra paradine śuna aparūpa āra |*
*nācaẏe ṭhākura baladeba-anukāra || 20 ||*

*Word for word:* tara paradine — on the following day; shuna aparupa ara — hear another wonder; nachaye thakura — the Thakura dances; baladeva-anukara — imitating Baladeva

**20.** Hear one more wonder — on the following day
the Thakura dances, imitating Baladeva.

আচম্বিতে পরিতাপ করি' পাইল মোহ ।
বলরাম-স্মরণে নয়নে বহে লোহ ॥ ২১ ॥

*ācambite paritāpa kari' pāila moha |*
*balarāma-smaraṇe naẏane bahe loha || 21 ||*

*Word for word:* achambite — suddenly; paritapa kari — in grief; paila moha — He fainted; balarama-smarane — remembering Balarama; nayane bahe loha — tears flow from His eyes

**21.** Suddenly, in grief, He fainted;
remembering Balarama, He sheds tears.

ভূমিতে লোটায় মহাপ্রভু মুক্তকেশ ।
মুখে জল দেয় সব-জন পায় ক্লেশ ॥ ২২ ॥

*bhūmite loṭāẏa mahāprabhu muktakeśa |*
*mukhe jala deẏa saba-jana pāẏa kleśa || 22 ||*

*Word for word:* bhumite lotaya — rolls on the ground; mahaprabhu mukta-kesha — Mahaprabhu with loosened hair; mukhe jala deya — they put water on His face; saba-jana paya klesha — all are in distress

**22.** Mahaprabhu rolls on the ground with His hair loose;
they sprinkle water on His face — all are in distress.

ক্ষণেকে হইল সংজ্ঞা গদাধর দেখি' ।
কহিল কাতর-বাণী ইঙ্গিতে সে লখি' ॥ ২৩ ॥

*kṣaṇeke haila saṃjñā gadādhara dekhi' |*
*kahila kātara-bāṇī iṅgite se lakhi' || 23 ||*

*Word for word:* kshaneke haila samjna — in a moment He regained consciousness; gadadhara dekhi — seeing Gadadhara; kahila katara-vani — spoke anguished words; ingite se lakhi — perceiving the sign

**23.** In a moment, seeing Gadadhara, He came to Himself
and, understanding [his] silent sign, spoke anguished words:

তুমি সে আমার বন্ধু প্রাণসম জানি ।
তোর প্রেমে বশ আমি শুন দ্বিজমণি ॥ ২৪ ॥

*tumi se āmāra bandhu prāṇasama jāni |*
*tora preme baśa āmi śuna dbijamaṇi || 24 ||*

*Word for word:* tumi se amara bandhu — you are My friend; prana-sama jani — I know you are as dear as life; tora preme basha ami — I am subject to your love; shuna dvija-mani — listen, jewel of brahmanas

**24.** "You are My friend — I know you are as dear to Me as life;
I am conquered by your love, listen, jewel of brahmanas.

তোর নাথ মুঞি হঙ তুমি মোর প্রাণ ।
গদাইর গৌরাঙ্গ বোলে কর অবধান ॥ ২৫ ॥

*tora nātha muñi haṅa tumi mora prāṇa |*
*gadāira gaurāṅga bole kara abadhāna || 25 ||*

*Word for word:* tora natha munni hanga — I am your Lord; tumi mora prana — you are My life; gadaira gauranga bole — they say "Gadai's Gauranga"; kara avadhana — take heed

**25.** I am your Lord, you are My life;
[people] call Me 'Gadai's Gauranga' — mark this.

মোর যত ভাব তোতে নহে অগোচর ।
আমার অন্তরশক্তি তোর কলেবর ॥ ২৬ ॥

*mora yata bhāba tote nahe agocara |*
*āmāra antaraśakti tora kalebara || 26 ||*

*Word for word:* mora yata bhava — all My bhavas; tote nahe agochara — are not hidden from you; amara antara-shakti — My inner shakti; tora kalebara — is your body

**26.** None of My bhavas is hidden from you:
your body is My inner shakti.[^33-11]

রাত্রিদিন মোর সঙ্গ তিলেক না ছাড় ।
তোমা বিনে মোর কথা জানে কে বা দঢ় ॥ ২৭ ॥

*rātridina mora saṅga tileka nā chāṛa |*
*tomā bine mora kathā jāne ke bā daṛha || 27 ||*

*Word for word:* ratri-dina — night and day; mora sanga tileka na chhada — you do not leave My company for a moment; toma vine — apart from you; mora katha jane ke ba dadha — who firmly knows My affairs

**27.** Day and night you do not leave Me for a moment:
who but you truly knows My ways?

মোর প্রিয় বন্ধু যত বৈষ্ণব যে জন ।
আনহ সভারে আমি দেখিব এখন ॥ ২৮ ॥

*mora priẏa bandhu yata baiṣṇaba ye jana |*
*ānaha sabhāre āmi dekhiba ekhana || 28 ||*

*Word for word:* mora priya bandhu — My dear friends; yata vaishnava ye jana — all who are Vaishnavas; anaha sabhare — bring them all; ami dekhiba ekhana — I shall see them now

**28.** All My dear friends, the Vaishnavas —
bring them; I wish to see them now."

আজ্ঞা পাইয়া গদাধর-পণ্ডিত সভারে ।
আনিল আচার্যরত্ন-আদি যত আরে ॥ ২৯ ॥

*ājñā pāiẏā gadādhara-paṇḍita sabhāre |*
*ānila ācāryaratna-ādi yata āre || 29 ||*

*Word for word:* ajna paiya — receiving the command; gadadhara-pandita sabhare — Gadadhara Pandita, all; anila — brought; acharyaratna-adi yata are — Acharyaratna and all the others

**29.** Receiving the command, Gadadhara Pandita
brought them all — Acharyaratna and the others.[^33-12]

আসিয়া দেখিল যত মহোত্তম জন ।
বিভোর হইল সভে সজল-লোচন ॥ ৩০ ॥

*āsiẏā dekhila yata mahottama jana |*
*bibhora haila sabhe sajala-locana || 30 ||*

*Word for word:* asiya dekhila — coming, they saw; yata mahottama jana — all the great souls; vibhora haila sabhe — all were overwhelmed; sajala-lochana — with tearful eyes

**30.** Coming, all those great souls saw [Him] —
and all were overwhelmed, their eyes filled with tears.

কহিল আচার্যরত্ন মধুর বচন ।
কহ না আপনে বাপ ইহার কারণ ॥ ৩১ ॥

*kahila ācāryaratna madhura bacana |*
*kaha nā āpane bāpa ihāra kāraṇa || 31 ||*

*Word for word:* kahila acharyaratna — Acharyaratna said; madhura vachana — gentle words; kaha na apane bapa — tell us Yourself, dear child; ihara karana — the cause of this

**31.** Acharyaratna spoke gentle words:
"Tell us Yourself, dear child, what is the cause?"

শুনিঞা তাহার বাণী কহে বিশ্বম্ভর ।
কহিতে না পারে কণ্ঠ গদগদ স্বর ॥ ৩২ ॥

*śuniñā tāhāra bāṇī kahe biśbambhara |*
*kahite nā pāre kaṇṭha gadagada sbara || 32 ||*

*Word for word:* shuninna tahara vani — hearing his words; kahe vishvambhara — Vishvambhara speaks; kahite na pare — cannot speak; kantha gadgada svara — His throat choked in voice

**32.** Hearing his words, Vishvambhara speaks,
but cannot speak — His voice chokes in His throat.

অতি সুবিহ্বল কহে আধ-আধ বোলে ।
শ্বেতগিরি হলায়ুধ দেখিলুঁ মো কোলে ॥ ৩৩ ॥

*ati subihbala kahe ādha-ādha bole |*
*śbetagiri halāẏudha dekhiluṁ mo kole || 33 ||*

*Word for word:* ati suvihvala — greatly agitated; kahe adha-adha bole — He speaks in broken words; shveta-giri halayudha — Halayudha, a white mountain; dekhilun mo kole — I saw beside Me

**33.** In great agitation He speaks in broken words:
"I saw Halayudha, like a white mountain — beside Me.

সুবর্ণ-শোভিত সূর্যসম অঙ্গ-প্রভা ।
ঝলমল করে অতি অলঙ্কার-আভা ॥ ৩৪ ॥

*subarṇa-śobhita sūryasama aṅga-prabhā |*
*jhalamala kare ati alaṅkāra-ābhā || 34 ||*

*Word for word:* suvarna-shobhita — golden-bright; surya-sama anga-prabha — the radiance of His body like the sun; jhalamala kare — flashes brightly; ati alankara-abha — the brilliance of His ornaments

**34.** The radiance of His body, golden, is like the sun,
His ornaments flash brilliantly."

কহিতে কহিতে প্রভু সেই পুনর্বার ।
বলদেব দেখি' শ্বেতপর্বত-আকার ॥ ৩৫ ॥

*kahite kahite prabhu sei punarbāra |*
*baladeba dekhi' śbetaparbata-ākāra || 35 ||*

*Word for word:* kahite kahite — as He was speaking; prabhu sei punarbara — the Lord again; baladeva dekhi — saw Baladeva; shveta-parvata-akara — in the form of a white mountain

**35.** As He spoke, the Lord again
saw Baladeva, like a white mountain.

তবে সেই মহাপ্রভু বিশ্বম্ভর-রায় ।
সেইমতে তদাবেশে পুনঃ নাচে গায় ॥ ৩৬ ॥

*tabe sei mahāprabhu biśbambhara-rāẏa |*
*seimate tadābeśe punaḥ nāce gāẏa || 36 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe sei mahaprabhu — then Mahaprabhu; vishvambhara-raya — Vishvambhara-raya; sei-mate tad-aveshe — thus in that bhava; punah nache gaya — again dances and sings

**36.** Then Mahaprabhu Vishvambhara-raya
again, in that bhava, dances and sings.

সকল বৈষ্ণবজন আনন্দে বিহ্বল ।
বলরাম-প্রেমে সভে করে টলমল ॥ ৩৭ ॥

*sakala baiṣṇabajana ānande bihbala |*
*balarāma-preme sabhe kare ṭalamala || 37 ||*

*Word for word:* sakala vaishnava-jana — all the Vaishnavas; anande vihvala — overwhelmed with bliss; balarama-preme — in prema for Balarama; sabhe kare talamala — all reel

**37.** All the Vaishnavas are overwhelmed with bliss:
in prema for Balarama all of them reel.

আনন্দে ভরল সভার দিগ্-বিদিগে ।
দুইদিন ভেল প্রভুর আবেশ না ভাঙ্গে ॥ ৩৮ ॥

*ānande bharala sabhāra dig-bidige |*
*duidina bhela prabhura ābeśa nā bhāṅge || 38 ||*

*Word for word:* anande bharala — were filled with bliss; sabhara dig-vidige — all the quarters; dui-dina bhela — two days passed; prabhura avesha na bhange — the Lord's bhava did not break

**38.** Bliss filled all the quarters;
for two days the Lord's bhava did not break.

তবে তার-পর-দিনে নৃত্যের সময় ।
চৌদিগে বেড়িল সব ভক্ত মহাশয় ॥ ৩৯ ॥

*tabe tāra-para-dine nṛtyera samaẏa |*
*caudige beṛila saba bhakta mahāśaẏa || 39 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe tara-para-dine — then on the following day; nrityera samaya — at the time of dancing; chaudige bedila — surrounded on all sides; saba bhakta mahashaya — all the great devotees

**39.** Then on the following day, at the time of dancing,
all the great devotees surrounded Him on every side.

পদতল-ভারে মহী টলমল করে ।
ঢুলায় অরুণ আঁখি আধ-আধ বোলে ॥ ৪০ ॥

*padatala-bhāre mahī ṭalamala kare |*
*ḍhulāẏa aruṇa āṁkhi ādha-ādha bole || 40 ||*

*Word for word:* padatala-bhare — under the weight of His feet; mahi talamala kare — the earth shakes; dhulaya aruna ankhi — He rolls His red eyes; adha-adha bole — speaks brokenly

**40.** Under the weight of His feet the earth shakes;
He rolls His reddened eyes and speaks in broken words.

মত্ত করিবর যেন গমন মন্থর ।
চলিতে না পারে প্রেমে ভৈগেল নির্ভর ॥ ৪১ ॥

*matta karibara yena gamana manthara |*
*calite nā pāre preme bhaigela nirbhara || 41 ||*

*Word for word:* matta karivara yena — like an intoxicated elephant; gamana manthara — His gait is slow; chalite na pare — He cannot walk; preme bhaigela nirbhara — absorbed in prema

**41.** His gait is slow like that of an intoxicated elephant:
He cannot walk, absorbed in prema.

যেন পহুঁ আবেশ-অবশ তেন সঙ্গী ।
নাচয়ে বিহ্বল বলরাম-রঙ্গে রঙ্গী ॥ ৪২ ॥

*yena pahuṁ ābeśa-abaśa tena saṅgī |*
*nācaẏe bihbala balarāma-raṅge raṅgī || 42 ||*

*Word for word:* yena pahu avesha-avasha — as the Lord is overcome by His bhava; tena sangi — so are His companions; nachaye vihvala — He dances, beside Himself; balarama-range rangi — delighting in Balarama's play

**42.** As the Lord is given over to His bhava, so are His companions:
beside Himself, He dances, delighting in the play of Balarama.

নাচিতে গাইতে ভেল সায়াহ্ন-সময় ।
আচম্বিতে বয়ানে বারুণী-গন্ধ কয় ॥ ৪৩ ॥

*nācite gāite bhela sāẏāhna-samaẏa |*
*ācambite baẏāne bāruṇī-gandha kaẏa || 43 ||*

*Word for word:* nachite gaite — while dancing and singing; bhela sayahna-samaya — evening came; achambite bayane — suddenly from His mouth; baruni-gandha kaya — the fragrance of varuni spread

**43.** With dancing and singing evening came,
and suddenly from His mouth there wafted the fragrance of varuni.

বারুণীর দিব্যগন্ধে ভেল আমোদিত ।
চৌদিগে নেহারে লোক হৈয়া চমকিত ॥ ৪৪ ॥

*bāruṇīra dibyagandhe bhela āmodita |*
*caudige nehāre loka haiẏā camakita || 44 ||*

*Word for word:* barunira divya-gandhe — with the divine fragrance of varuni; bhela amodita — [all] became fragrant; chaudige nehare loka — people look all around; haiya chamakita — amazed

**44.** Everything was filled with the divine fragrance of varuni;
the people look about in amazement.

দশদিগ্ আমোদিত বারুণীর গন্ধে ।
মাতল ভকত অতি প্রেম-উন্মাদে ॥ ৪৫ ॥

*daśadig āmodita bāruṇīra gandhe |*
*mātala bhakata ati prema-unmāde || 45 ||*

*Word for word:* dasha-dig amodita — the ten directions are fragrant; barunira gandhe — with the scent of varuni; matala bhakata — the devotees became intoxicated; ati prema-unmade — in the great madness of prema

**45.** All ten directions are fragrant with the scent of varuni;
the devotees grew intoxicated in the madness of prema.[^33-13]

হেনকালে শ্রীরামপণ্ডিত দ্বিজবর্য ।
দেখিলেন শুন তার অনুভব-কার্য ॥ ৪৬ ॥

*henakāle śrīrāmapaṇḍita dbijabarya |*
*dekhilena śuna tāra anubhaba-kārya || 46 ||*

*Word for word:* henakale — at that time; shri-rama-pandita dvijavarya — Sri Rama Pandita, best of brahmanas; dekhilena — saw; shuna tara anubhava-karya — hear what he perceived

**46.** At that time Sri Rama Pandita, the best of brahmanas,
saw — hear what was revealed to him:

আচম্বিতে দিব্য দিব্য পুরুষ-রতন ।
সেইখানে দিব্য-বেশে হৈল উপসন্ন ॥ ৪৭ ॥

*ācambite dibya dibya puruṣa-ratana |*
*seikhāne dibya-beśe haila upasanna || 47 ||*

*Word for word:* achambite — suddenly; divya divya purusha-ratana — divine, divine jewels among men; seikhane — there; divya-beshe haila upasanna — appeared in divine dress

**47.** suddenly there appeared there
divine, divine jewels among men in divine dress:

কারো এক কর্ণে পদ্ম কমল-লোচন ।
এক কর্ণে কুণ্ডল নীলিম বসন ॥ ৪৮ ॥

*kāro eka karṇe padma kamala-locana |*
*eka karṇe kuṇḍala nīlima basana || 48 ||*

*Word for word:* karo eka karne padma — each with a lotus in one ear; kamala-lochana — lotus eyes; eka karne kundala — an earring in one ear; nilima vasana — blue garments

**48.** each had a lotus in one ear, lotus eyes,
an earring in the other ear, blue garments;

পীতবস্ত্র পাগড়ি বান্ধিয়া লটপটি ।
কহিতে না পারি রূপ-বেশ-পরিপাটি ॥ ৪৯ ॥

*pītabastra pāgaṛi bāndhiẏā laṭapaṭi |*
*kahite nā pāri rūpa-beśa-paripāṭi || 49 ||*

*Word for word:* pita-vastra pagadi — yellow cloth turbans; bandhiya latapati — tied loosely; kahite na pari — I cannot describe; rupa-besha-paripati — the elegance of form and dress

**49.** on their heads yellow turbans, loosely tied —
I cannot describe the beauty and elegance of their forms and dress.

বনমালী নাম এক ব্রাহ্মণ তথাই ।
কহিব তাহার কথা শুন সব ভাই ॥ ৫০ ॥

*banamālī nāma eka brāhmaṇa tathāi |*
*kahiba tāhāra kathā śuna saba bhāi || 50 ||*

*Word for word:* vanamali nama — named Vanamali; eka brahmana tathai — a brahmana was there; kahiba tahara katha — I shall tell of him; shuna saba bhai — listen, all brothers

**50.** There was a brahmana there named Vanamali —
I shall tell of him; listen, all brothers:

দেখিলেক কাঞ্চন-নির্মিত কলেবর ।
রত্ন-বিভূষিত যেন সুমেরু-শিখর ॥ ৫১ ॥

*dekhileka kāñcana-nirmita kalebara |*
*ratna-bibhūṣita yena sumeru-śikhara || 51 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhileka — he saw; kanchana-nirmita kalebara — a body made of gold; ratna-vibhushita — adorned with gems; yena sumeru-shikhara — like the peak of Sumeru

**51.** he saw a body made of gold,
adorned with gems like the peak of Sumeru.[^33-14]

দেখি' অতি হৃষ্ট মন তনু পুলকিত ।
দেখিয়া সকল লোক হৈল চমকিত ॥ ৫২ ॥

*dekhi' ati hṛṣṭa mana tanu pulakita |*
*dekhiẏā sakala loka haila camakita || 52 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhi — seeing; ati hrishta mana — his heart greatly rejoiced; tanu pulakita — his body thrilled; dekhiya sakala loka — seeing this, all the people; haila chamakita — were amazed

**52.** Seeing it, he rejoiced at heart, his body thrilled,
and all the people, seeing it, were amazed.

হলায়ুধ-বেশে নাচে তিন-লোক-নাথ ।
সকল ভকত মেলি' নাচে তার সাথ ॥ ৫৩ ॥

*halāẏudha-beśe nāce tina-loka-nātha |*
*sakala bhakata meli' nāce tāra sātha || 53 ||*

*Word for word:* halayudha-beshe — in the guise of Halayudha; nache tina-loka-natha — the Lord of the three worlds dances; sakala bhakata meli — all the devotees together; nache tara satha — dance with Him

**53.** In the form of Halayudha the Lord of the three worlds dances,
and all the devotees together dance with Him.

অন্তরীক্ষে দেবগণ হরষিত-মনে ।
সন্তোষ-হৃদয়ে গেল নিজ নিজ স্থানে ॥ ৫৪ ॥

*antarīkṣe debagaṇa haraṣita-mane |*
*santoṣa-hṛdaẏe gela nija nija sthāne || 54 ||*

*Word for word:* antarikshe devagana — the gods in the sky; harashita-mane — rejoicing at heart; santosha-hridaye — with contented hearts; gela nija nija sthane — went to their own abodes

**54.** The gods in the sky, rejoicing at heart,
went back content to their own abodes.

এইমনে গোঙাইয়া সব দিবানিশি ।
সুরনদী-স্নানে প্রভু যায় হাসি' হাসি' ॥ ৫৫ ॥

*eimane goṅāiẏā saba dibāniśi |*
*suranadī-snāne prabhu yāẏa hāsi' hāsi' || 55 ||*

*Word for word:* ei-mane — thus; gongaiya saba diva-nishi — having spent all the day and night; suranadi-snane — to bathe in the heavenly river; prabhu yaya hasi hasi — the Lord goes smiling

**55.** Thus, having spent the whole day and night,
the Lord, smiling, goes to bathe in the heavenly river.

সকল বৈষ্ণবগণ করি' এক-মেলে ।
করয়ে মজ্জন স্নান সুরনদী-জলে ॥ ৫৬ ॥

*sakala baiṣṇabagaṇa kari' eka-mele |*
*karaẏe majjana snāna suranadī-jale || 56 ||*

*Word for word:* sakala vaishnava-gana — all the Vaishnavas; kari eka-mele — gathering together; karaye majjana snana — dip and bathe; suranadi-jale — in the waters of the heavenly river

**56.** All the Vaishnavas together
dip and bathe in the waters of the heavenly river.

নিজজন-সঙ্গে পহুঁ হাস-পরিহাসে ।
কৌতুকে করয়ে ক্রীড়া তা-সভার রসে ॥ ৫৭ ॥

*nijajana-saṅge pahuṁ hāsa-parihāse |*
*kautuke karaẏe krīṛā tā-sabhāra rase || 57 ||*

*Word for word:* nijajana-sange — with His own; pahu hasa-parihase — the Lord laughs and jests; kautuke karaye krida — plays merrily; ta-sabhara rase — in delight of their company

**57.** The Lord laughs and jests with His own
and plays merrily, delighting in their company.

স্নান সমাপিয়া প্রভু উঠিল সত্বর ।
প্রভু নমস্করি' সভে গেলা নিজ ঘর ॥ ৫৮ ॥

*snāna samāpiẏā prabhu uṭhila satbara |*
*prabhu namaskari' sabhe gelā nija ghara || 58 ||*

*Word for word:* snana samapiya — finishing the bath; prabhu uthila satvara — the Lord quickly came out; prabhu namaskari — bowing to the Lord; sabhe gela nija ghara — all went to their homes

**58.** Finishing His bath, the Lord quickly came out [of the water];
all bowed to the Lord and went to their homes.

নিজালয় গিয়া প্রভু আছে মহাসুখে ।
প্রভাতে আইলা সভে প্রভুর সম্মুখে ॥ ৫৯ ॥

*nijālaẏa giẏā prabhu āche mahāsukhe |*
*prabhāte āilā sabhe prabhura sammukhe || 59 ||*

*Word for word:* nijalaya giya — going home; prabhu achhe maha-sukhe — the Lord remains in great happiness; prabhate aila sabhe — in the morning all came; prabhura sammukhe — before the Lord

**59.** The Lord, going home, remains in great happiness;
in the morning all came before the Lord.

কহিল ত মহাপ্রভু শুন এক বাণী ।
গদগদ কহিতে বেকত আধখানি ॥ ৬০ ॥

*kahila ta mahāprabhu śuna eka bāṇī |*
*gadagada kahite bekata ādhakhāni || 60 ||*

*Word for word:* kahila ta mahaprabhu — Mahaprabhu said; shuna eka vani — hear one word; gadgada kahite — speaking with a choked voice; bekata adhakhani — only half was distinct

**60.** And Mahaprabhu said: "Hear one word" —
but His voice choked, and only half was distinct:

বরাহ-ঠাকুর মোরে আলিঙ্গন দিল ।
হলায়ুধ মোর হিয়া প্রবেশ করিল ॥ ৬১ ॥

*barāha-ṭhākura more āliṅgana dila |*
*halāẏudha mora hiẏā prabeśa karila || 61 ||*

*Word for word:* baraha-thakura — Lord Varaha; more alingana dila — embraced Me; halayudha — Halayudha; mora hiya pravesha karila — entered My heart

**61.** "Lord Varaha embraced Me,
Halayudha entered My heart.

নয়ানে অঞ্জন মোর মুরলীবদন ।
কহিল অমৃত-কথা শুন নিজজন ॥ ৬২ ॥

*naẏāne añjana mora muralībadana |*
*kahila amṛta-kathā śuna nijajana || 62 ||*

*Word for word:* nayane anjana mora — the collyrium of My eyes; murali-vadana — He with the flute at His lips; kahila amrita-katha — He told a nectarean story; shuna nijajana — hear, His own

**62.** He who holds the flute to His lips has become the collyrium of My eyes."[^33-15]
Thus He told a nectarean story — hear, His own!

কহিল ত মহাপ্রভু শ্রীবাস দেখিয়া ।
মোর বাঁশী দেহ চাহে শ্রীহস্ত পাতিয়া ॥ ৬৩ ॥

*kahila ta mahāprabhu śrībāsa dekhiẏā |*
*mora bāṁśī deha cāhe śrīhasta pātiẏā || 63 ||*

*Word for word:* kahila ta mahaprabhu — Mahaprabhu said; shrivasa dekhiya — seeing Srivasa; mora banshi deha — give My flute; chahe shri-hasta patiya — He asks, holding out His divine hand

**63.** Seeing Srivasa, Mahaprabhu said:
"Give Me My flute!" — and holds out His divine hand.

তবে সেই শ্রীনিবাস-পণ্ডিত ঠাকুর ।
কহিল তাহারে তেঁহ ভক্ত সুচতুর ॥ ৬৪ ॥

*tabe sei śrīnibāsa-paṇḍita ṭhākura |*
*kahila tāhāre teṁha bhakta sucatura || 64 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe sei shrinivasa-pandita thakura — then Srinivasa Pandita Thakura; kahila tahare — answered Him; tenha bhakta suchatura — he, a clever devotee

**64.** Then Srinivasa Pandita Thakura,
a clever devotee, answered Him:

শুন শুন মহাপ্রভু এই তোর ঘরে ।
রাখিল ভীষ্মক-কন্যা মুরলী তোমারে ॥ ৬৫ ॥

*śuna śuna mahāprabhu ei tora ghare |*
*rākhila bhīṣmaka-kanyā muralī tomāre || 65 ||*

*Word for word:* shuna shuna mahaprabhu — listen, listen, Mahaprabhu; ei tora ghare — here in Your house; rakhila bhishmaka-kanya — Bhishmaka's daughter has kept; murali tomare — the flute for You

**65.** "Listen, listen, Mahaprabhu: here, in Your house,
the daughter of Bhishmaka keeps Your flute for You.[^33-16]

কপাট লাগিল রাত্রে ঘরের দুয়ারে ।
এখনি পাইবা বাঁশী কহিল তোমারে ॥ ৬৬ ॥

*kapāṭa lāgila rātre gharera duẏāre |*
*ekhani pāibā bāṁśī kahila tomāre || 66 ||*

*Word for word:* kapata lagila ratre — the door-leaves were shut at night; gharera duyare — at the doors of the house; ekhani paiba banshi — You will get the flute at once; kahila tomare — I tell You

**66.** At night the doors of the house were locked —
You will get the flute at once, I tell You."

এইমতে ক্ষণে ক্ষণে আনন্দ-কৌতুক ।
নদিয়া-বিহার এই বড় অপরূপ ॥ ৬৭ ॥

*eimate kṣaṇe kṣaṇe ānanda-kautuka |*
*nadiẏā-bihāra ei baṛa aparūpa || 67 ||*

*Word for word:* ei-mate — thus; kshane kshane — every moment; ananda-kautuka — joy and merriment; nadiya-vihara ei — these pastimes in Nadia; bada aparupa — most wondrous

**67.** Thus every moment there is joy and merriment:
most wondrous are these pastimes in Nadia.

যে জানে কৃষ্ণরস সে জানে মরম ।
নদিয়া-বিহার-কথা এই বড় ধন ॥ ৬৮ ॥

*ye jāne kṛṣṇarasa se jāne marama |*
*nadiẏā-bihāra-kathā ei baṛa dhana || 68 ||*

*Word for word:* ye jane krishna-rasa — whoever knows Krishna's rasa; se jane marama — knows the essence; nadiya-vihara-katha — the story of the pastimes in Nadia; ei bada dhana — is a great treasure

**68.** Whoever knows the rasa of Krishna knows their essence:
the story of the pastimes in Nadia is a great treasure.

যে না জানে তারে মুঞি করিয়ে মিনতি ।
হেলা না করিহ দেহ গোরাগুণে মতি ॥ ৬৯ ॥

*ye nā jāne tāre muñi kariẏe minati |*
*helā nā kariha deha gorāguṇe mati || 69 ||*

*Word for word:* ye na jane — those who do not know; tare munni kariye minati — I implore them; hela na kariha — do not neglect; deha gora-gune mati — turn your minds to Gora's qualities

**69.** And those who do not know — I implore them:
do not neglect it, turn your minds to Gora's qualities.

মন দিয়া চাহ ভাই কি আছে ইহাতে ।
ত্রিজগত-নাথ কৃষ্ণ লাগি' পাবে হাথে ॥ ৭০ ॥

*mana diẏā cāha bhāi ki āche ihāte |*
*trijagata-nātha kṛṣṇa lāgi' pābe hāthe || 70 ||*

*Word for word:* mana diya chaha bhai — look with your heart, brothers; ki achhe ihate — what is in this; trijagata-natha krishna — Krishna, Lord of the three worlds; lagi pabe hathe — you will get into your hands

**70.** Consider with your heart, brothers, what lies in this:
you will get into your hands Krishna, the Lord of the three worlds.

না ভজিলে নাহি নাহি নাহিক নিস্তার ।
এ লোচন দাস ইহা বোলে বারবার ॥ ৭১ ॥

*nā bhajile nāhi nāhi nāhika nistāra |*
*e locana dāsa ihā bole bārabāra || 71 ||*

*Word for word:* na bhajile — without serving; nahi nahi nahika nistara — there is no, no, no deliverance; e lochana dasa — this Lochana Dasa; iha bole barabara — says this again and again

**71.** Without serving [Him] there is no, no, no deliverance —
so says Lochana Dasa again and again.

[^33-1]: Vv. 45–69 — cf. Murari 2.13.18–23; Chaitanya-charitamrita, Adi 17. The kirtana in Srivasa's house was held behind closed doors, and outsiders were not admitted.
[^33-2]: Tearing the sacred thread is the sign of a curse pronounced by an angry brahmana.
[^33-3]: "Outside samsara" means one who has renounced the world, a sannyasi; the Lord Himself wished to take sannyasa, so the curse is a blessing for Him (cf. Murari 2.13.21–22). The brahmana, coming to his senses, himself foretells the Lord's sannyasa and its fruit: the disputants and logicians who did not honour Him as a householder will bow before the sannyasi and receive prema (Chaitanya-charitamrita, Adi 17).
[^33-4]: This section is not in Bhaktisiddhanta's edition (1922); it is translated from Haridasa Shastri's edition (1983), where it stands without a heading of its own (only with the indication "যথা রাগ" and a fresh numbering, vv. 1–22) right after the story of the brahmana's curse (vv. 45–69); the heading is ours. The 1903 edition lacks it. Shachi, full of maternal love (vatsalya), fears for her son as any mother would; the Lord consoles her.
[^33-5]: Consoling His mother, the Lord says that a curse without an offence will not take effect; but He Himself, as said above (vv. 56, 64), accepted this curse as a blessing, since it coincided with His wish to take sannyasa (see note 3). Then (vv. 69+19 — 69+20) the Lord, playing the role of a devotee, Himself worships Krishna and the tulasi, teaching this to others.
[^33-6]: This summary concerns pastimes told in the next portion (the bhava of Varaha, the sankirtana, the play in Chandrashekhara's house and so on); the pastimes in the bhava of Balarama with which the section begins (vv. 1–58) are already described in the summary of the previous section (en/32). The OCR of the summary is badly garbled; gaps are filled by sense and from the table of contents in the edition's preface ("the Lord's bhava of Varaha, the order to Advaita Acharya and other devotees about sankirtana and preaching, the singing of the gopis' qualities in the bhava of a gopi, the visit to Chandrashekhara's house, Srivasa's bhava of Narada, the glorification of Gadadhara and the revelation that he is Radhika, the arrival of Thakura Haridasa, the bliss of sankirtana, the Lord's bhava of majesty, the distribution of the prema of service in the form of Lakshmi, and finally the bhava of Ishvara").
[^33-7]: Halayudha ("armed with the plough"), Haladhara and Baladeva are Balarama. The form and bhava of Balarama that Gaura reveals are His own: Balarama is the first manifestation of Krishna Himself. Cf. Murari 2.14.
[^33-8]: So in Bhaktisiddhanta's edition ("অদ্বৈত-মুরারির স্থানে"; the OCR is not entirely clear); the 1983 edition has "to Advaita Acharya", Murari (2.14.4) the house of Murari; Bhaktisiddhanta's summary, the house of Advaita Acharya.
[^33-9]: Balarama loves the intoxicating drink varuni; the Lord in His bhava drinks water as honey (cf. Murari 2.14.5). This is not worldly intoxication but rapture in prema (cf. en/28, note 12).
[^33-10]: Cf. Murari 2.14.7: "I am not that Krishna whom it is enough to please with words."
[^33-11]: Gadadhara Pandita is, in the Gaudiya Vaishnava understanding, Sri Radha (en/25, note 7), the inner (antaranga) shakti of the Lord; hence all His bhavas are known to him. "Gadai's Gauranga" means "Gadadhara's Gauranga".
[^33-12]: Acharyaratna is Chandrashekhara Acharya. Vv. 20–38 — cf. Murari 2.14.10–15.
[^33-13]: Vv. 43–54 — cf. Murari 2.14.17–22. Balarama's divine varuni is no worldly wine; its fragrance is the sign of the presence of Balarama and His companions, whom Sri Rama Pandita, Srivasa's brother, sees.
[^33-14]: In Murari (2.14.20) Vanamali sees on the ground Balarama's golden club, Saunanda. Whether this is the same Vanamali as in en/31 (v. 6 of the section) is not stated.
[^33-15]: That is, the Lord ceaselessly beholds Krishna with the flute. Cf. Murari 2.15.1: the Lord tells of the vision of Varaha and Halayudha and asks for His flute.
[^33-16]: The daughter of Bhishmaka is Rukmini; thus Srivasa jokingly refers to the Lord's wife, Vishnupriya. (According to the Gaura-ganoddesha-dipika, Rukmini appeared in Gaura-lila as Lakshmipriya, and Vishnupriya is Bhu-shakti.)

---

# Madhya-khanda, part 11 (portion 34)

*The section "Mahaprabhu Distributes Prema in His Bhavas" (end): the Lord tells the devotees of the greatness of the sankirtana-yajna; the play in Chandrashekhara's house — the Lord in a gopi's dress, Srivasa in the bhava of Narada glorifies Gadadhara as Radha; the arrival of Haridasa and Advaita; the Lord in the bhava of Lakshmi and of the primal Shakti, Haridasa on Her lap; the bhava of Ishvara; Lochana Dasa's reflection on the hidden avatara*

তার-পর-দিনে প্রভু বসি' দিব্যাসনে ।
কহিতে লাগিলা কিছু সব ভক্তগণে ॥ ৭২ ॥

*tāra-para-dine prabhu basi' dibyāsane |*
*kahite lāgilā kichu saba bhaktagaṇe || 72 ||*

*Word for word:* tara-para-dine — on the next day; prabhu vasi divyasane — the Lord, seated on a divine seat; kahite lagila — began to say; kichhu saba bhakta-gane — something to all the devotees

**72.** The next day the Lord, seated on a divine seat,
began to speak to all the devotees:

মোর এই সংকীর্তন-যজ্ঞের মহিমা ।
সব শাস্ত্রে কহে ইহার মহিমা গরিমা ॥ ৭৩ ॥

*mora ei saṃkīrtana-yajñera mahimā |*
*saba śāstre kahe ihāra mahimā garimā || 73 ||*

*Word for word:* mora ei sankirtana-yajnera mahima — the greatness of this sankirtana-yajna of Mine; saba shastre kahe — all scriptures speak; ihara mahima garima — of its greatness and glory

**73.** "Such is the greatness of this sankirtana-yajna of Mine:[^34-1]
all the scriptures speak of its greatness and glory.

সর্বধর্মসার এই সংকীর্তন-ধর্ম ।
বিশেষ জানিবে কলিযুগে এই কর্ম ॥ ৭৪ ॥

*sarbadharmasāra ei saṃkīrtana-dharma |*
*biśeṣa jānibe kaliyuge ei karma || 74 ||*

*Word for word:* sarva-dharma-sara — the essence of all dharmas; ei sankirtana-dharma — is this dharma of sankirtana; vishesha janibe — know especially; kali-yuge ei karma — in the Kali age this is the work

**74.** This dharma of sankirtana is the essence of all dharmas;
know that in the Kali age this above all is the work to do.

পঞ্চম সে বেদ হৈতে প্রকাশ ইহার ।
শিব তেঞি পঞ্চমুখে গায় অনিবার ॥ ৭৫ ॥

*pañcama se beda haite prakāśa ihāra |*
*śiba teñi pañcamukhe gāẏa anibāra || 75 ||*

*Word for word:* panchama se veda haite — from that fifth Veda; prakasha ihara — is its manifestation; shiva teni — therefore Shiva; pancha-mukhe gaya anibara — sings with five mouths ceaselessly

**75.** It is revealed from the fifth Veda[^34-2] —
therefore Shiva sings [it] ceaselessly with his five mouths.

নারদ বীণায় গাই' বুলয়ে নাচিয়া ।
শুক-সনকাদি ভক্ত বুলয়ে গাইয়া ॥ ৭৬ ॥

*nārada bīṇāẏa gāi' bulaẏe nāciẏā |*
*śuka-sanakādi bhakta bulaẏe gāiẏā || 76 ||*

*Word for word:* narada vinaya gai — Narada, singing to the vina; bulaye nachiya — wanders dancing; shuka-sanakadi bhakta — the devotees Shuka, Sanaka and others; bulaye gaiya — wander singing

**76.** Narada wanders dancing, singing to his vina;
the devotees — Shuka, Sanaka and others — wander singing.

বৃন্দাবনে রাধাকৃষ্ণ এই বেদ লঞা ।
গোপী-সঙ্গে নাচি' বুলে প্রেমাবিষ্ট হঞা ॥ ৭৭ ॥

*bṛndābane rādhākṛṣṇa ei beda lañā |*
*gopī-saṅge nāci' bule premābiṣṭa hañā || 77 ||*

*Word for word:* vrindavane radha-krishna — in Vrindavana Radha and Krishna; ei veda laña — taking this Veda; gopi-sange nachi bule — dance about with the gopis; premavishta haña — absorbed in prema

**77.** In Vrindavana Radha and Krishna, taking up this Veda,
dance with the gopis, absorbed in prema.

নিত্য বৃন্দাবনে স্থিতি পঞ্চম জানিবে ।
তেঞি শিব গান করে মহাপ্রেমভাবে ॥ ৭৮ ॥

*nitya bṛndābane sthiti pañcama jānibe |*
*teñi śiba gāna kare mahāpremabhābe || 78 ||*

*Word for word:* nitya vrindavane sthiti — eternal abiding in Vrindavana; panchama janibe — of the fifth [Veda], know; teni shiva gana kare — therefore Shiva sings; maha-prema-bhave — in great prema

**78.** Know that the fifth [Veda] abides eternally in Vrindavana —
therefore Shiva sings in great prema.

তথাপি গাইয়া শিব ওর না পাইল ।
হেন বেদ কলিযুগে প্রকাশ হইল ॥ ৭৯ ॥

*tathāpi gāiẏā śiba ora nā pāila |*
*hena beda kaliyuge prakāśa haila || 79 ||*

*Word for word:* tathapi gaiya shiva — yet, though singing, Shiva; ora na paila — did not find the end; hena veda — such a Veda; kali-yuge prakasha haila — appeared in the Kali age

**79.** And yet, for all his singing, Shiva did not reach its end —
such a Veda has appeared in the Kali age.

গানে যেই করে সেই প্রবোধ হইয়া ।
গানরূপে বেদের উচ্চারে মহাদয়া ॥ ৮০ ॥

*gāne yei kare sei prabodha haiẏā |*
*gānarūpe bedera uccāre mahādaẏā || 80 ||*

*Word for word:* gane yei kare — whoever performs [it] in song; sei prabodha haiya — he becomes awakened; gana-rupe — in the form of song; vedera uchchare — in the utterance of the Veda; maha-daya — is great mercy

**80.** Whoever performs it in song is awakened:
the utterance of the Veda in the form of song is a great mercy.

সব-লোক-কর্ণ-গর্ত-কুণ্ড-পরিসর ।
জিহ্বা-স্রুব, ধ্বনি-রস-ঘৃত মনোহর ॥ ৮১ ॥

*saba-loka-karṇa-garta-kuṇḍa-parisara |*
*jihbā-sruba, dhbani-rasa-ghṛta manohara || 81 ||*

*Word for word:* saba-loka-karna-garta — the ear-hollows of all people; kunda-parisara — the expanse of the sacrificial pit; jihva-sruva — the tongue is the ladle; dhvani-rasa-ghrita — the rasa of sound is the ghee; manohara — charming

**81.** The hollows of everyone's ears are the expanse of the sacrificial pit,
the tongue is the ladle, the sweet rasa of the sound is the ghee.[^34-3]

অন্তরে প্রবিষ্ট হঞা ভাব-অগ্নি জ্বালে ।
অগ্নি-শিখা—পুলকাশ্রু, কম্প কলেবরে ॥ ৮২ ॥

*antare prabiṣṭa hañā bhāba-agni jbāle |*
*agni-śikhā—pulakāśru, kampa kalebare || 82 ||*

*Word for word:* antare pravishta haña — entering within; bhava-agni jvale — it kindles the fire of bhava; agni-shikha — the flames; pulakashru — thrill and tears; kampa kalebare — trembling of the body

**82.** Entering within, it kindles the fire of bhava;
its flames are thrill and tears, the trembling of the body.

সর্বপাপে মুক্ত হৈয়া সব জন নাচে ।
সালোক্যাদি মুক্তি তার ফিরে পাছে পাছে ॥ ৮৩ ॥

*sarbapāpe mukta haiẏā saba jana nāce |*
*sālokyādi mukti tāra phire pāche pāche || 83 ||*

*Word for word:* sarva-pape mukta haiya — freed from all sins; saba jana nache — all people dance; salokyadi mukti — the liberations, salokya and the rest; tara phire pachhe pachhe — wander after them

**83.** Freed from all sins, all the people dance;
the liberations — salokya and the rest — follow them about,

কদাচ না দেখে সেই নয়ানের কোণে ।
নাচিয়া বুলয়ে কৃষ্ণ-রস-আস্বাদনে ॥ ৮৪ ॥

*kadāca nā dekhe sei naẏānera koṇe |*
*nāciẏā bulaẏe kṛṣṇa-rasa-āsbādane || 84 ||*

*Word for word:* kadacha na dekhe — never look; sei nayanera kone — at those from the corner of the eye; nachiya bulaye — they wander dancing; krishna-rasa-asvadane — tasting Krishna's rasa

**84.** but they never glance at them even from the corner of their eyes:
they wander dancing, tasting the rasa of Krishna.[^34-4]

সে যজ্ঞ বেড়িয়া রহে বৈষ্ণব আচার্য ।
জানিবে কীর্তন-যজ্ঞ সর্বযজ্ঞ-আর্য ॥ ৮৫ ॥

*se yajña beṛiẏā rahe baiṣṇaba ācārya |*
*jānibe kīrtana-yajña sarbayajña-ārya || 85 ||*

*Word for word:* se yajna bediya rahe — surround that yajna; vaishnava acharya — the Vaishnava acharyas; janibe — know; kirtana-yajna — the yajna of kirtana; sarva-yajna-arya — is the noblest of all yajnas

**85.** The Vaishnava acharyas stand around this yajna;
know that the yajna of kirtana is the noblest of all yajnas.

ইহাতে জন্মিল এই প্রেম মহাধন ।
ইহার গৃহস্থ—নিত্যানন্দ-আবরণ ॥ ৮৬ ॥

*ihāte janmila ei prema mahādhana |*
*ihāra gṛhastha—nityānanda-ābaraṇa || 86 ||*

*Word for word:* ihate janmila — from it was born; ei prema maha-dhana — this great treasure, prema; ihara grihastha — its master (yajamana); nityananda-avarana — Nityananda with His circle

**86.** From it this great treasure, prema, was born;
the master of this [yajna] is Nityananda with His circle,

গদাধর-পণ্ডিত এই প্রেমের গৃহিণী ।
এই তত্ত্ব জানিবে সকল ভক্তমণি ॥ ৮৭ ॥

*gadādhara-paṇḍita ei premera gṛhiṇī |*
*ei tattba jānibe sakala bhaktamaṇi || 87 ||*

*Word for word:* gadadhara-pandita — Gadadhara Pandita; ei premera grihini — is the mistress of this prema; ei tattva janibe — know this truth; sakala bhakta-mani — all jewels among devotees

**87.** and the mistress of this prema is Gadadhara Pandita;[^34-5]
know this truth, all you jewels among devotees.

অদ্বৈত-আচার্য-গোসাঞি আমারে আনিঞা ।
সংকীর্তন-যজ্ঞ স্থাপে সুদৃঢ় হইয়া ॥ ৮৮ ॥

*adbaita-ācārya-gosāñi āmāre āniñā |*
*saṃkīrtana-yajña sthāpe sudṛṛha haiẏā || 88 ||*

*Word for word:* advaita-acharya-gosañi — Advaita Acharya Gosani; amare aniña — having brought Me; sankirtana-yajna sthape — establishes the sankirtana-yajna; sudridha haiya — firmly

**88.** Advaita Acharya Gosani, having brought Me down,
firmly establishes the sankirtana-yajna.[^34-6]

শ্রীনিবাস-নরহরি-আদি ভক্তগণ ।
তো-সভারে লঞা মোর যজ্ঞের স্থাপন ॥ ৮৯ ॥

*śrīnibāsa-narahari-ādi bhaktagaṇa |*
*to-sabhāre lañā mora yajñera sthāpana || 89 ||*

*Word for word:* shrinivasa-narahari-adi bhakta-gana — the devotees Srinivasa, Narahari and others; to-sabhare laña — with all of you; mora yajnera sthapana — is the establishment of My yajna

**89.** Srinivasa, Narahari and the other devotees —
with all of you I establish My yajna.

এই যজ্ঞ কলিকালে দেহ ঘরে ঘরে ।
তরুক সকল লোক পতিত পামরে ॥ ৯০ ॥

*ei yajña kalikāle deha ghare ghare |*
*taruka sakala loka patita pāmare || 90 ||*

*Word for word:* ei yajna — this yajna; kali-kale — in the Kali age; deha ghare ghare — give from house to house; taruka sakala loka — let all people be delivered; patita pamare — the fallen and the sinful

**90.** Carry this yajna in the Kali age from house to house —
let all the people, the fallen and the sinful, be delivered."

এ বোল শুনিঞা ভক্ত কান্দিয়া কান্দিয়া ।
প্রভুর চরণে পড়ে ঢলিয়া ঢলিয়া ॥ ৯১ ॥

*e bola śuniñā bhakta kāndiẏā kāndiẏā |*
*prabhura caraṇe paṛe ḍhaliẏā ḍhaliẏā || 91 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuniña — hearing these words; bhakta kandiya kandiya — the devotees, weeping and weeping; prabhura charane pade — fall at the Lord's feet; dhaliya dhaliya — swaying

**91.** Hearing this, the devotees, weeping and weeping,
fall at the Lord's feet, swaying.

সভারে করিলা কোলে গৌর ভগবান্ ।
শুনি আনন্দিত কথা এ লোচন গান ॥ ৯২ ॥

*sabhāre karilā kole gaura bhagabān |*
*śuni ānandita kathā e locana gāna || 92 ||*

*Word for word:* sabhare karila kole — embraced all; gaura bhagavan — Gaura Bhagavan; shuni anandita katha — hearing the joyful story; e lochana gana — this Lochana sings

**92.** Gaura Bhagavan embraced them all;
hearing this joyful story, this Lochana sings.

*Raga varadi; the tune "dhulakhela"*

আর অপরূপ কথা, শুন গোরা-গুণ-গাথা,
লোক-বেদ-অগোচর বাণী ।
আবেশের বশে করে, ভক্তিযোগ-পরচারে,
করুণাবিগ্রহ গুণমণি ॥ ৯৩ ॥

*āra aparūpa kathā, śuna gorā-guṇa-gāthā,*
*loka-beda-agocara bāṇī |*
*ābeśera baśe kare, bhaktiyoga-paracāre,*
*karuṇābigraha guṇamaṇi || 93 ||*

*Word for word:* ara aparupa katha — another wondrous story; shuna gora-guna-gatha — hear the song of Gora's qualities; loka-veda-agochara vani — words beyond the world and the Vedas; aveshera bashe kare — acts in the sway of His bhava; bhakti-yoga-parachare — to proclaim bhakti-yoga; karuna-vigraha guna-mani — mercy embodied, the jewel of qualities

**93.** Another wondrous story — hear the song of Gora's qualities,
words unknown to the world and to the Vedas.
In the sway of His bhava, to proclaim bhakti-yoga,
He acts — mercy embodied, the jewel of all qualities.

শুন কথা মন দিয়া, আন-কথা তেয়াগিয়া,
আর সব কহিবার বেলা ।
নিজজন সঙ্গে করি', শ্রীল বিশ্বম্ভর হরি,
শ্রীচন্দ্রশেখর-বাড়ী গেলা ॥ ৯৪ ॥

*śuna kathā mana diẏā, āna-kathā teẏāgiẏā,*
*āra saba kahibāra belā |*
*nijajana saṅge kari', śrīla biśbambhara hari,*
*śrīcandraśekhara-bāṛī gelā || 94 ||*

*Word for word:* shuna katha mana diya — hear the story attentively; ana-katha teyagiya — leaving other talk; ara saba kahibara bela — it is time to tell the rest; nija-jana sange kari — together with His own; shrila vishvambhara hari — Srila Vishvambhara Hari; shri-chandrashekhara-badi gela — went to Sri Chandrashekhara's house

**94.** Hear the story attentively, leaving other talk:
it is time to tell the rest as well.
Together with His own, Srila Vishvambhara Hari
went to the house of Sri Chandrashekhara.[^34-7]

কথা-পরসঙ্গে কথা, গোপিকার গুণগাথা,
কহিতে সে গদগদ ভাষ ।
অরুণ বয়ান ভেল, দুনয়ানে ঝরে নীর,
রসাবেশে রসের প্রকাশ ॥ ৯৫ ॥

*kathā-parasaṅge kathā, gopikāra guṇagāthā,*
*kahite se gadagada bhāṣa |*
*aruṇa baẏāna bhela, dunaẏāne jhare nīra,*
*rasābeśe rasera prakāśa || 95 ||*

*Word for word:* katha-parasange katha — in the course of talk the talk [turned]; gopikara guna-gatha — to the gopis' qualities; kahite se gadgada bhasha — speaking, His voice faltered; aruna bayana bhela — His face grew red; dunayane jhare nira — tears stream from His eyes; rasaveshe rasera prakasha — absorbed in rasa, He reveals rasa

**95.** In the course of talk the conversation turned to the qualities of the gopis —
and, speaking of them, His voice faltered;
His face grew red, tears streamed from His eyes —
immersed in rasa, He revealed rasa.

কমলা যাহার পদ, সেবা করে উনমত,
হেন প্রভু গোপিকার তরে ।
পরসঙ্গে হয় ভোরা, হেন ভক্তি কৈল তারা,
কথামাত্র সে আবেশ ধরে ॥ ৯৬ ॥

*kamalā yāhāra pada, sebā kare unamata,*
*hena prabhu gopikāra tare |*
*parasaṅge haẏa bhorā, hena bhakti kaila tārā,*
*kathāmātra se ābeśa dhare || 96 ||*

*Word for word:* kamala yahara pada — whose feet Kamala; seva kare unamata — serves in rapture; hena prabhu gopikara tare — such a Lord, for the gopis' sake; parasange haya bhora — is overwhelmed at the mention; hena bhakti kaila tara — such devotion they showed; katha-matra se avesha dhare — at mere words takes on that bhava

**96.** The Lord whose feet Kamala serves in rapture —
such a Lord, for the gopis' sake,
is overwhelmed at the mere mention [of them]: such was the devotion they showed!
At mere words He takes on their bhava.

তবে বিশ্বম্ভর হরি, গোপিকার বেশ ধরি',
শ্রীচন্দ্রশেখরাচার্য-ঘরে ।
নাচয়ে আনন্দে ভোলা, শ্রীবাস হেনই বেলা,
নারদ-আবেশ ভেল তারে ॥ ৯৭ ॥

*tabe biśbambhara hari, gopikāra beśa dhari',*
*śrīcandraśekharācārya-ghare |*
*nācaẏe ānande bholā, śrībāsa henai belā,*
*nārada-ābeśa bhela tāre || 97 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe vishvambhara hari — then Vishvambhara Hari; gopikara vesha dhari — putting on a gopi's dress; shri-chandrashekharacharya-ghare — in Sri Chandrashekhara Acharya's house; nachaye anande bhola — dances, lost in bliss; shrivasa henai bela — Srivasa at that very hour; narada-avesha bhela tare — the bhava of Narada came upon him

**97.** Then Vishvambhara Hari, putting on a gopi's dress,
in the house of Sri Chandrashekhara Acharya
dances, lost in bliss; and at that very hour
the bhava of Narada came upon Srivasa.[^34-8]

প্রভুরে প্রণাম করে, বিনয়-বচনে বোলে,
দাস করি' জানিহ আমারে ।
এমন কহিয়া বাণী, তবে সেই মহামুনি,
গদাধর-পণ্ডিতেরে বোলে ॥ ৯৮ ॥

*prabhure praṇāma kare, binaẏa-bacane bole,*
*dāsa kari' jāniha āmāre |*
*emana kahiẏā bāṇī, tabe sei mahāmuni,*
*gadādhara-paṇḍitere bole || 98 ||*

*Word for word:* prabhure pranama kare — bows to the Lord; vinaya-vachane bole — says humbly; dasa kari janiha amare — know me as a servant; emana kahiya vani — having spoken such words; tabe sei maha-muni — then that great sage; gadadhara-panditere bole — speaks to Gadadhara Pandita

**98.** He bows to the Lord and humbly says:
"Know me as Your servant."
Having spoken these words, that great sage
then addresses Gadadhara Pandita:

শুনহ গোপিকা তুমি, যে কিছু কহিয়ে আমি,
তোর পূর্বকথা কিছু জান ।
অপূর্ব কহিয়ে আমি, জগতে দুর্লভ তুমি,
তোর কথা শুন সাবধান ॥ ৯৯ ॥

*śunaha gopikā tumi, ye kichu kahiẏe āmi,*
*tora pūrbakathā kichu jāna |*
*apūrba kahiẏe āmi, jagate durlabha tumi,*
*tora kathā śuna sābadhāna || 99 ||*

*Word for word:* shunaha gopika tumi — listen, gopi; ye kichhu kahiye ami — to what I say; tora purva-katha kichhu jana — do you know anything of your past; apurva kahiye ami — I tell a wonder; jagate durlabha tumi — you are rare in the world; tora katha shuna savadhana — hear attentively about yourself

**99.** "Listen, gopi, to what I shall say:
do you know anything of your past?
I shall tell a wonder: you are rare in the world —
hear attentively about yourself.

শুন তো-সভার কথা, আমি কহি গুণগাথা,
গোকুলে জন্মিলা জনে জনে ।
ছাড়ি' নিজ পতিব্রত, সেবা কৈল অবিরত,
অভিমত পাঞা বৃন্দাবনে ॥ ১০০ ॥

*śuna to-sabhāra kathā, āmi kahi guṇagāthā,*
*gokule janmilā jane jane |*
*chāṛi' nija patibrata, sebā kaila abirata,*
*abhimata pāñā bṛndābane || 100 ||*

*Word for word:* shuna to-sabhara katha — hear about all of you; ami kahi guna-gatha — I tell your qualities; gokule janmila jane jane — you were born one by one in Gokula; chhadi nija pativrata — leaving your fidelity to husbands; seva kaila avirata — served unceasingly; abhimata pana vrindavane — attaining your desire in Vrindavana

**100.** Hear about all of you — I shall sing your qualities:
you were born, one and all, in Gokula;
leaving your fidelity to your husbands, you served [Krishna] unceasingly
and attained your heart's desire in Vrindavana.[^34-9]

প্রধান প্রকৃতি তুমি, কৃষ্ণশক্তি রাধা তুমি,
কি জানি তা কহিবারে আমি ॥ ১০১ ॥

*pradhāna prakṛti tumi, kṛṣṇaśakti rādhā tumi,*
*ki jāni tā kahibāre āmi || 101 ||*

*Word for word:* pradhana prakriti tumi — you are the first prakriti (shakti); krishna-shakti radha tumi — you are Radha, Krishna's shakti; ki jani — what do I know; ta kahibare ami — for me to tell of it

**101.** You are the first of prakritis, you are Radha, Krishna's shakti:[^34-10]
what do I know, that I could tell of it?

রমণীর শিরোমণি, কৃষ্ণপ্রেম-সোহাগিনী,
তোর তত্ত্ব কি বলিতে জানি ॥ ১০২ ॥

*ramaṇīra śiromaṇi, kṛṣṇaprema-sohāginī,*
*tora tattba ki balite jāni || 102 ||*

*Word for word:* ramanira shiromani — crown of women; krishna-prema-sohagini — favoured in Krishna's love; tora tattva — your truth; ki balite jani — how could I know to tell

**102.** Crown of all women, the favoured one in Krishna's love —
how could I tell your truth?

এঁছন করিলে ভক্তি, কেহো নহে সমযুক্তি,
পরম নিগূঢ় তিন-লোকে ।
ব্রহ্মা, মহেশ্বর দেবা, লখিমী অনন্ত কিবা,
তাকে অধিক পরসাদ তোকে ॥ ১০৩ ॥

*eṁchana karile bhakti, keho nahe samayukti,*
*parama nigūṛha tina-loke |*
*brahmā, maheśbara debā, lakhimī ananta kibā,*
*tāke adhika parasāda toke || 103 ||*

*Word for word:* enchhana karile bhakti — you showed such devotion; keho nahe sama-yukti — none is equal; parama nigudha tina-loke — the supreme secret in the three worlds; brahma maheshvara deva — Brahma, the god Maheshvara; lakhimi ananta kiba — Lakshmi, and even Ananta; take adhika parasada toke — more grace than to them — to you

**103.** You showed such devotion that none can equal [you];
it is the supreme secret of the three worlds.
Brahma, the god Maheshvara, Lakshmi and even Ananta
have less grace than you.

প্রহ্লাদ-নারদাদিক, সনাতন আদি শুক,
না জানয়ে তোর ভক্তি-লেশ ।
ত্রৈলোক্য-লখিমী-পতি, চাহে তোর পিরীতি,
স্ব-অঙ্গে ধরয়ে বর-বেশ ॥ ১০৪ ॥

*prahlāda-nāradādika, sanātana ādi śuka,*
*nā jānaẏe tora bhakti-leśa |*
*trailokya-lakhimī-pati, cāhe tora pirīti,*
*sba-aṅge dharaẏe bara-beśa || 104 ||*

*Word for word:* prahlada-naradadika — Prahlada, Narada and others; sanatana adi shuka — Sanatana, Shuka and the rest; na janaye tora bhakti-lesha — do not know a drop of your devotion; trailokya-lakhimi-pati — the Husband of the Lakshmi of the three worlds; chahe tora piriti — longs for your love; sva-ange dharaye bara-vesha — puts a lovely dress on His own body

**104.** Prahlada, Narada and others, Sanatana, Shuka and the rest
know not a drop of your devotion.
The Husband of the Lakshmi of the three worlds longs for your love —
and puts this lovely dress on His own body.[^34-11]

লখিমী যাহার দাসী, তোর প্রেম-প্রত্যাশী,
হৃদয়ে ধরয়ে অনুরাগ ।
সকল-ভুবন-পতি, ভুলাইলা সে পিরীতি,
ধনি ধনি তোহারি সোহাগ ॥ ১০৫ ॥

*lakhimī yāhāra dāsī, tora prema-pratyāśī,*
*hṛdaẏe dharaẏe anurāga |*
*sakala-bhubana-pati, bhulāilā se pirīti,*
*dhani dhani tohāri sohāga || 105 ||*

*Word for word:* lakhimi yahara dasi — He whose maidservant is Lakshmi; tora prema-pratyashi — hoping for your prema; hridaye dharaye anuraga — holds longing in His heart; sakala-bhuvana-pati — the Lord of all worlds; bhulaila se piriti — you enchanted with that love; dhani dhani tohari sohaga — blessed, blessed is your tenderness

**105.** He whose maidservant is Lakshmi, hoping for your prema,
holds in His heart a longing [for you];
the Lord of all the worlds you have enchanted with that love —
blessed, blessed is your tenderness!

তোরা সে জানিলি তত্ত্ব, প্রভু-মর্ম-মহত্ত্ব,
পিরীতি বান্ধিলি ভালমতে ।
উদ্ধব-অক্রূর-আদি, সভে তোর পদসেবী,
অনুগত না ছাড়িহ চিতে ॥ ১০৬ ॥

*torā se jānili tattba, prabhu-marma-mahattba,*
*pirīti bāndhili bhālamate |*
*uddhaba-akrūra-ādi, sabhe tora padasebī,*
*anugata nā chāṛiha cite || 106 ||*

*Word for word:* tora se janili tattva — you have known the truth; prabhu-marma-mahattva — the greatness of the Lord's inmost heart; piriti bandhili bhalamate — bound [Him] fast with love; uddhava-akrura-adi — Uddhava, Akrura and others; sabhe tora pada-sevi — all serve your feet; anugata na chhadiha chite — do not forsake your followers in your heart

**106.** You have known the truth — the greatness of the Lord's inmost heart —
and have bound [Him] fast with love.
Uddhava, Akrura and the rest — all serve your feet:
do not forsake in your heart those who follow you."

এতেক কহিল বাণী, শ্রীনিবাস দ্বিজমণি,
শুনি আনন্দিত সর্বজন ।
সকল বৈষ্ণব মিলি', সভে করে কোলাকুলি,
দেখি' বিশ্বম্ভর-চরণ ॥ ১০৭ ॥

*eteka kahila bāṇī, śrīnibāsa dbijamaṇi,*
*śuni ānandita sarbajana |*
*sakala baiṣṇaba mili', sabhe kare kolākuli,*
*dekhi' biśbambhara-caraṇa || 107 ||*

*Word for word:* eteka kahila vani — spoke such words; shrinivasa dvija-mani — Srinivasa, jewel of brahmanas; shuni anandita sarvajana — hearing, all rejoiced; sakala vaishnava mili — all the Vaishnavas together; sabhe kare kolakuli — embrace one another; dekhi vishvambhara-charana — gazing at Vishvambhara's feet

**107.** Such words spoke Srinivasa, the jewel of brahmanas;
hearing them, all rejoiced.
All the Vaishnavas together embrace one another,
gazing at Vishvambhara's feet.

নাচয়ে আনন্দে ভোরা, প্রেমে গরগর তারা,
হেনকালে আইলা হরিদাস ।
দণ্ড এক করি' করে, সম্মুখে দাণ্ডাইয়া বোলে,
গুণ গায় পরম উল্লাস ॥ ১০৮ ॥

*nācaẏe ānande bhorā, preme garagara tārā,*
*henakāle āilā haridāsa |*
*daṇḍa eka kari' kare, sammukhe dāṇḍāiẏā bole,*
*guṇa gāẏa parama ullāsa || 108 ||*

*Word for word:* nachaye anande bhora — they dance, lost in bliss; preme garagara tara — they overflow with prema; henakale aila haridasa — at that hour Haridasa came; danda eka kari kare — taking a staff in his hand; sammukhe dandaiya bole — standing in front, he says; guna gaya parama ullasa — sings the qualities in supreme delight

**108.** They dance, lost in bliss, overflowing with prema —
and at that hour Haridasa came.
Staff in hand, he stood in front and proclaims,
singing [the Lord's] qualities in supreme delight:[^34-12]

হরিগুণ-সংকীর্তন, কর ভাই অনুক্ষণ,
ইহা বলি' অট্ট অট্ট হাসে ।
হরিগুণ-গানে ভোরা, দুনয়ানে বহে ধারা,
আনন্দে ফিরয়ে চারিপাশে ॥ ১০৯ ॥

*hariguṇa-saṃkīrtana, kara bhāi anukṣaṇa,*
*ihā bali' aṭṭa aṭṭa hāse |*
*hariguṇa-gāne bhorā, dunaẏāne bahe dhārā,*
*ānande phiraẏe cāripāśe || 109 ||*

*Word for word:* hari-guna-sankirtana — the sankirtana of Hari's qualities; kara bhai anukshana — perform, brothers, without cease; iha bali atta atta hase — so saying, laughs aloud; hari-guna-gane bhora — lost in singing Hari's qualities; dunayane bahe dhara — streams flow from his eyes; anande phiraye charipashe — in joy turns to every side

**109.** "Brothers, perform the sankirtana of Hari's qualities without cease!" —
so saying, he laughs aloud.
Lost in singing Hari's qualities, he sheds streams from his eyes
and in joy turns round to every side.

শুনি হরিদাস-বাণী, সকল বৈষ্ণবমণি,
অমৃতে সিঞ্চিলা সব গা ।
হরষেতে নাচে গায়, মাঝে নাচে গোরারায়,
কান্দিয়া ধরয়ে রাঙ্গা পা ॥ ১১০ ॥

*śuni haridāsa-bāṇī, sakala baiṣṇabamaṇi,*
*amṛte siñcilā saba gā |*
*haraṣete nāce gāẏa, mājhe nāce gorārāẏa,*
*kāndiẏā dharaẏe rāṅgā pā || 110 ||*

*Word for word:* shuni haridasa-vani — hearing Haridasa's words; sakala vaishnava-mani — all the jewel-like Vaishnavas; amrite sinchila saba ga — [as if] their whole bodies were sprinkled with nectar; harashete nache gaya — in joy they dance and sing; majhe nache goraraya — in the midst dances Gora-raya; kandiya dharaye ranga pa — weeping, they clasp His reddish feet

**110.** Hearing Haridasa's words, all the jewel-like Vaishnavas —
as if their whole bodies were sprinkled with nectar:
in joy they dance and sing, in their midst dances Gora-raya,
and, weeping, they clasp His reddish feet.

তবে সর্বগুণধাম, অদ্বৈত-আচার্য নাম,
আইলা সব বৈষ্ণবের রাজা ।
রূপে আলোকিত মহী, সম্মুখে দাণ্ডায় চাহি',
প্রভু-অংশে জন্ম মহাতেজা ॥ ১১১ ॥

*tabe sarbaguṇadhāma, adbaita-ācārya nāma,*
*āilā saba baiṣṇabera rājā |*
*rūpe ālokita mahī, sammukhe dāṇḍāẏa cāhi',*
*prabhu-aṃśe janma mahātejā || 111 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe sarva-guna-dhama — then the abode of all virtues; advaita-acharya nama — named Advaita Acharya; aila saba vaishnavera raja — came, the king of all Vaishnavas; rupe alokita mahi — the earth lit by His beauty; sammukhe danday chahi — stands in front gazing; prabhu-amshe janma maha-teja — born of the Lord's portion, of great might

**111.** Then came the abode of all virtues, named Advaita Acharya,
the king of all the Vaishnavas;
His beauty lit up the earth; He stands in front and gazes —
born of the Lord's portion, of great might.[^34-13]

হরি হরি বলি' ডাকে, চমক লাগিল লোকে,
আনন্দে নাচয়ে প্রেমভরে ।
পুলকিত সব গা, আপাদ-মস্তক যা,
প্রেমবারি দুনয়ানে ঝরে ॥ ১১২ ॥

*hari hari bali' ḍāke, camaka lāgila loke,*
*ānande nācaẏe premabhare |*
*pulakita saba gā, āpāda-mastaka yā,*
*premabāri dunaẏāne jhare || 112 ||*

*Word for word:* hari hari bali dake — calls "Hari, Hari!"; chamaka lagila loke — the people start; anande nachaye premabhare — dances in joy, full of prema; pulakita saba ga — the whole body thrills; apada-mastaka ya — from feet to head; prema-bari dunayane jhare — tears of prema stream from His eyes

**112.** "Hari, Hari!" He calls, and the people start;
in joy He dances, filled with prema;
His whole body thrills from feet to head,
tears of prema stream from His eyes.

বিশ্বম্ভর-শ্রীচরণে, নেহারই ঘনে ঘনে,
হুঙ্কারে মারে মালসাট ।
সকল বৈষ্ণব মিলি', প্রেমের পসরা ডালি,
পসারিল অপরূপ হাট ॥ ১১৩ ॥

*biśbambhara-śrīcaraṇe, nehārai ghane ghane,*
*huṅkāre māre mālasāṭa |*
*sakala baiṣṇaba mili', premera pasarā ḍāli,*
*pasārila aparūpa hāṭa || 113 ||*

*Word for word:* vishvambhara-shri-charane — at Vishvambhara's holy feet; neharai ghane ghane — gazes again and again; hunkare mare malasata — roars and slaps His arms; sakala vaishnava mili — all the Vaishnavas together; premera pasara dali — baskets of the wares of prema; pasarila aparupa hata — spread out a wondrous market

**113.** Again and again He gazes at Vishvambhara's holy feet,
roars and slaps His arms like a wrestler;
all the Vaishnavas together, opening baskets of the wares of prema,
spread out a wondrous market.

সকল বৈষ্ণবগণে, অতি আনন্দিত মনে,
প্রেমের সাগরে দিল ডুব ।
সকল বৈষ্ণব মিলি', আপনে শ্রীগৌরহরি,
প্রকাশয়ে সংসারের সুখ ॥ ১১৪ ॥

*sakala baiṣṇabagaṇe, ati ānandita mane,*
*premera sāgare dila ḍuba |*
*sakala baiṣṇaba mili', āpane śrīgaurahari,*
*prakāśaẏe saṃsārera sukha || 114 ||*

*Word for word:* sakala vaishnava-gane — all the Vaishnavas; ati anandita mane — rejoicing at heart; premera sagare dila duba — plunged into the ocean of prema; sakala vaishnava mili — with all the Vaishnavas; apane shri-gaurahari — Sri Gaurahari Himself; prakashaye samsarera sukha — reveals happiness to the world

**114.** All the Vaishnavas, rejoicing at heart,
plunged into the ocean of prema;
with all the Vaishnavas Sri Gaurahari Himself
reveals happiness to the world.

এখনে কহিব শুন, সাবধানে সর্বজন,
গোপিকা-আবেশ-বশ প্রভু ।
হৃদয়ে কাঁচলি পরে, শঙ্খ-কঙ্কণ করে,
দুটি আঁখি রসে ডুবুডুবু ॥ ১১৫ ॥

*ekhane kahiba śuna, sābadhāne sarbajana,*
*gopikā-ābeśa-baśa prabhu |*
*hṛdaẏe kāṁcali pare, śaṅkha-kaṅkaṇa kare,*
*duṭi āṁkhi rase ḍubuḍubu || 115 ||*

*Word for word:* ekhane kahiba shuna — now I shall tell, listen; savadhane sarvajana — all, attentively; gopika-avesha-basha prabhu — the Lord in the sway of a gopi's bhava; hridaye kanchali pare — puts a bodice on His breast; shankha-kankana kare — conch bangles on His wrists; duti ankhi rase dubudubu — both eyes drowning in rasa

**115.** And now I shall tell — listen, all, attentively:
the Lord, in the sway of a gopi's bhava,
puts a bodice on His breast, conch-shell bangles on His wrists;
both His eyes are drowning in rasa.

পট্টবসন পরে, নূপুর চরণে ধরে,
মুঠে পাই ক্ষীণ মাঝাখানি ।
রূপে ত্রিজগত মোহে, উপমা দিবার কাহে,
গোপীবেশে ঠাকুর আপনি ॥ ১১৬ ॥

*paṭṭabasana pare, nūpura caraṇe dhare,*
*muṭhe pāi kṣīṇa mājhākhāni |*
*rūpe trijagata mohe, upamā dibāra kāhe,*
*gopībeśe ṭhākura āpani || 116 ||*

*Word for word:* patta-basana pare — wears silk; nupura charane dhare — anklets on the feet; muthe pai kshina majhakhani — a slender waist a fist could clasp; rupe trijagata mohe — the beauty charms the three worlds; upama dibara kahe — to what to compare; gopi-veshe thakura apani — the Thakura Himself in a gopi's dress

**116.** He wears silk, anklets on His feet,
His waist so slender a fist could clasp it;
His beauty charms the three worlds — to what can it be compared? —
the Thakura Himself in a gopi's dress.[^34-14]

অলৌকিক অঙ্গতেজে, বায়ু বহে মলয়জে,
তাহে নব মালতীর মালা ।
সুমেরু-শিখরে যেন, সুরধুনী-জল হেন,
গোরা-অঙ্গে বহে দুই ধারা ॥ ১১৭ ॥

*alaukika aṅgateje, bāẏu bahe malaẏaje,*
*tāhe naba mālatīra mālā |*
*sumeru-śikhare yena, suradhunī-jala hena,*
*gorā-aṅge bahe dui dhārā || 117 ||*

*Word for word:* alaukika anga-teje — from the unearthly radiance of His body; vayu bahe malayaje — a Malaya breeze blows; tahe nava malatira mala — on Him a garland of fresh malati; sumeru-shikhare yena — as on the peak of Sumeru; suradhuni-jala hena — the waters of the heavenly river; gora-ange bahe dui dhara — two streams flow on Gora's body

**117.** From the unearthly radiance of His body a Malaya breeze blows,
on Him is a garland of fresh malati;
like the waters of the heavenly river on the peak of Sumeru,
two streams [of tears] flow over Gora's body.

সকল বৈষ্ণব-মাঝে, নাচে মহানটরাজে,
রসের আবেশে ভাব ধরে ।
এমন করিতে পুন, লখিমী পড়িল মন,
সে আবেশে গেলা দেবঘরে ॥ ১১৮ ॥

*sakala baiṣṇaba-mājhe, nāce mahānaṭarāje,*
*rasera ābeśe bhāba dhare |*
*emana karite puna, lakhimī paṛila mana,*
*se ābeśe gelā debaghare || 118 ||*

*Word for word:* sakala vaishnava-majhe — amid all the Vaishnavas; nache mahanataraje — dances the great king of dancers; rasera aveshe bhava dhare — takes on bhavas in the rapture of rasa; emana karite puna — and as He did so; lakhimi padila mana — He thought of Lakshmi; se aveshe gela deva-ghare — in that bhava went into the Deity's chamber

**118.** Amid all the Vaishnavas dances the great king of dancers,
taking on bhavas in the rapture of rasa.
And as He danced thus, He thought of Lakshmi —
and in that bhava went into the Deity's chamber.

ঘরে সাম্ভাইয়া অতি, দিব্য চতুর্ভুজ-মূর্তি,
দেখি' দাণ্ডাইল তার কাছে ।
আধ-নয়ানে চায়, আধ-পদ চলি' যায়,
বসনে ঢাকিল আঁখি পাছে ॥ ১১৯ ॥

*ghare sāmbhāiẏā ati, dibya caturbhuja-mūrti,*
*dekhi' dāṇḍāila tāra kāche |*
*ādha-naẏāne cāẏa, ādha-pada cali' yāẏa,*
*basane ḍhākila āṁkhi pāche || 119 ||*

*Word for word:* ghare sambhaiya — entering the chamber; ati divya chaturbhuja-murti — the most divine four-armed Deity; dekhi dandaila tara kachhe — seeing, He stood beside It; adha-nayane chaya — looks with half-closed eyes; adha-pada chali yaya — walks with half-steps; basane dhakila ankhi pachhe — covered His eyes with His cloth

**119.** Entering the chamber and seeing the divine four-armed Deity,
He stood beside It;
He looks with half-closed eyes, walks with half-steps,
and has covered His eyes with the edge of His cloth.[^34-15]

তবে সব নিজজনে, পড়ি' তার শ্রীচরণে,
বিনয়-বচনে করে স্তুতি ।
শ্রীস্তব পঢ়ে কেহো, আনন্দে বিভোর সেহো,
বর মাগে—দেহ প্রেমভক্তি ॥ ১২০ ॥

*tabe saba nijajane, paṛi' tāra śrīcaraṇe,*
*binaẏa-bacane kare stuti |*
*śrīstaba paṛhe keho, ānande bibhora seho,*
*bara māge—deha premabhakti || 120 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe saba nija-jane — then all His own; padi tara shri-charane — falling at His holy feet; vinaya-vachane kare stuti — offer praise with humble words; shri-stava padhe keho — someone recites the Sri-stava; anande vibhora seho — he, lost in bliss; bara mage — asks a boon; deha prema-bhakti — give prema-bhakti

**120.** Then all His own, falling at His holy feet,
offer praise with humble words;
someone recites the Sri-stava and, lost in bliss,
asks a boon: "Give prema-bhakti!"

সর্বজন স্তব করে, শুনি' সেই সেইকালে,
আদ্যাশক্তি পড়ি' গেল মনে ।
সেই ত আবেশ ধরে, সর্বজন চমৎকারে,
স্তব পঢ়ে কত সুরগণে ॥ ১২১ ॥

*sarbajana staba kare, śuni' sei seikāle,*
*ādyāśakti paṛi' gela mane |*
*sei ta ābeśa dhare, sarbajana camatkāre,*
*staba paṛhe kata suragaṇe || 121 ||*

*Word for word:* sarvajana stava kare — all offer praise; shuni sei seikale — hearing it, at that very moment; adya-shakti padi gela mane — He thought of the primal Shakti; sei ta avesha dhare — takes on that very bhava; sarvajana chamatkare — all are amazed; stava padhe kata sura-gane — recite many hymns of the gods

**121.** All offer praise; hearing it, at that very moment
He thought of the primal Shakti
and took on that very bhava; all are amazed
and recite many hymns composed by the gods.[^34-16]

তবে স্তব কৈল সভে, সুরকৃত মহাস্তবে,
তুষ্ট হঞা বোলে আদ্যাশক্তি ।
দেবতা-আসনে বসি', কহে লহু লহু হাসি',
দেখিবারে আইলুঁ প্রেমভক্তি ॥ ১২২ ॥

*tabe staba kaila sabhe, surakṛta mahāstabe,*
*tuṣṭa hañā bole ādyāśakti |*
*debatā-āsane basi', kahe lahu lahu hāsi',*
*dekhibāre āiluṁ premabhakti || 122 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe stava kaila sabhe — when all had offered praise; sura-krita maha-stave — with great hymns composed by the gods; tushta haña bole adya-shakti — pleased, the primal Shakti says; devata-asane vasi — seated on the Deity's seat; kahe lahu lahu hasi — says with a soft smile; dekhibare ailun prema-bhakti — I have come to see prema-bhakti

**122.** When all had offered praise with the great hymns of the gods,
the primal Shakti, pleased, speaks;
seated on the Deity's seat, She says with a soft smile:
"I have come to see [your] prema-bhakti.

তো-সভার নৃত্যগীতে, আইলুঁ দেখিবার চিতে,
কহিলুঁ আপন অভিলাষ ।
এ বোল শুনিঞা পুন, কহে সেই সব জন,
নিজভক্তি কর পরকাশ ॥ ১২৩ ॥

*to-sabhāra nṛtyagīte, āiluṁ dekhibāra cite,*
*kahiluṁ āpana abhilāṣa |*
*e bola śuniñā puna, kahe sei saba jana,*
*nijabhakti kara parakāśa || 123 ||*

*Word for word:* to-sabhara nritya-gite — your dancing and singing; ailun dekhibara chite — I came wishing to see; kahilun apana abhilasha — I have told My desire; e bola shuniña puna — hearing this, again; kahe sei saba jana — all those people say; nija-bhakti kara parakasha — reveal devotion to Yourself

**123.** I have come wishing to see your dancing and singing —
I have told you My desire."
Hearing this, all those people say again:
"Reveal [in us] devotion to You."

এ বর মাগিল যবে, আদ্যাশক্তি বোলে তবে,
শুন শুন শুন সর্বজনে ।
আমি চণ্ডী পরচণ্ড, তোমারও হবে দণ্ড,
এই বর দিল সর্বজনে ॥ ১২৪ ॥

*e bara māgila yabe, ādyāśakti bole tabe,*
*śuna śuna śuna sarbajane |*
*āmi caṇḍī paracaṇḍa, tomārao habe daṇḍa,*
*ei bara dila sarbajane || 124 ||*

*Word for word:* e bara magila yabe — when they asked this boon; adya-shakti bole tabe — then the primal Shakti says; shuna shuna shuna sarvajane — listen, listen, listen, all; ami chandi parachanda — I am Chandi, the fierce; tomaro habe danda — you too shall have the rod; ei bara dila sarvajane — this boon She gave to all

**124.** When they asked this boon, the primal Shakti said:
"Listen, listen, listen, all!
I am Chandi, the fierce: you too shall have the rod!" —
such was the boon She gave to all.[^34-17]

এ বোল শুনিঞা তবে, পরণাম করে সভে,
দণ্ডবত ভূমিতে পড়িয়া ।
তবে সেই ঈশ্বরী, হরিদাস-করে ধরি',
কোলে বসাইল সে হাসিয়া ॥ ১২৫ ॥

*e bola śuniñā tabe, paraṇāma kare sabhe,*
*daṇḍabata bhūmite paṛiẏā |*
*tabe sei īśbarī, haridāsa-kare dhari',*
*kole basāila se hāsiẏā || 125 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuniña tabe — hearing this; paranama kare sabhe — all bow down; dandavata bhumite padiya — falling to the ground like a stick; tabe sei ishvari — then that Mistress; haridasa-kare dhari — taking Haridasa by the hand; kole vasaila se hasiya — smiling, seated him on Her lap

**125.** Hearing this, all bow down,
falling to the ground like a stick.
Then that Mistress, taking Haridasa by the hand,
smiling, seated him on Her lap.

বসিয়া তাহার কোলে, হরিদাস ঘন দোলে,
পাঁচ-বরিষের যেন শিশু ।
আশ্চর্য দেখিয়া মনে, আনন্দিত সর্বজনে,
হরিষ পাইল পক্ষী পশু ॥ ১২৬ ॥

*basiẏā tāhāra kole, haridāsa ghana dole,*
*pāṁca-bariṣera yena śiśu |*
*āścarya dekhiẏā mane, ānandita sarbajane,*
*hariṣa pāila pakṣī paśu || 126 ||*

*Word for word:* vasiya tahara kole — sitting on Her lap; haridasa ghana dole — Haridasa rocks to and fro; pancha-barishera yena shishu — like a child of five; ashcharya dekhiya mane — seeing the marvel; anandita sarvajane — all rejoiced at heart; harisha paila pakshi pashu — birds and beasts were glad

**126.** Sitting on Her lap, Haridasa rocks to and fro
like a child of five.
Seeing this marvel, all rejoiced at heart;
even the birds and beasts were glad.

এইক্ষণে একজন, কহেন এই বচন,
মুরারিকে চাহ দয়া-দিঠি ।
এ তোমার নিজদাস, এ বোল শুনিঞা হাস,
অমিয়া-অধিক লহু মিঠি ॥ ১২৭ ॥

*eikṣaṇe ekajana, kahena ei bacana,*
*murārike cāha daẏā-diṭhi |*
*e tomāra nijadāsa, e bola śuniñā hāsa,*
*amiẏā-adhika lahu miṭhi || 127 ||*

*Word for word:* eikshane ekajana — at that moment someone; kahena ei vachana — speaks these words; murarike chaha daya-dithi — look on Murari with a merciful glance; e tomara nija-dasa — he is Your own servant; e bola shuniña hasa — hearing this, a smile; amiya-adhika lahu mithi — soft, sweeter than nectar

**127.** At that moment someone spoke these words:
"Cast a merciful glance on Murari:
he is Your own servant." Hearing this, [She] smiled
softly, sweeter than nectar.

নয়ান করুণাজলে, প্রেম ছলছল করে,
করুণ অরুণ মুখচন্দ্র ।
হেনকালে শচীদেবী, আপনে শ্রীপাদ সেবি',
প্রেমানন্দে ভেল পরতন্ত্র ॥ ১২৮ ॥

*naẏāna karuṇājale, prema chalachala kare,*
*karuṇa aruṇa mukhacandra |*
*henakāle śacīdebī, āpane śrīpāda sebi',*
*premānande bhela paratantra || 128 ||*

*Word for word:* nayana karuna-jale — the eyes in tears of compassion; prema chhalachhala kare — brim with prema; karuna aruna mukha-chandra — the tender moon of the face grew red; henakale shachi-devi — at that hour Shachi-devi; apane shri-pada sevi — herself serving the holy feet; premanande bhela paratantra — was overcome by the bliss of prema

**128.** Her eyes are full of tears of compassion, brimming with prema,
the tender moon of Her face grew red.
At that hour Shachi-devi, herself serving [His] holy feet,
was overcome by the bliss of prema.

তবে সেই কাত্যায়নী, সর্বজন কাছে আনি',
নিজ সুত করি' হেন মানে ।
মাতৃস্নেহ করে লোকে, সর্বজন দেখি' তাকে,
প্রেমজলে ভরে দুনয়ানে ॥ ১২৯ ॥

*tabe sei kātyāẏanī, sarbajana kāche āni',*
*nija suta kari' hena māne |*
*mātṛsneha kare loke, sarbajana dekhi' tāke,*
*premajale bhare dunaẏāne || 129 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe sei katyayani — then that Katyayani; sarvajana kachhe ani — drawing all near; nija suta kari hena mane — regards them as Her sons; matri-sneha kare loke — shows the people a mother's tenderness; sarvajana dekhi take — all, looking at Her; prema-jale bhare dunayane — fill their eyes with tears of prema

**129.** Then that Katyayani, drawing all near,
regards them as Her own sons;
She shows the people a mother's tenderness, and all, looking at Her,
fill their eyes with tears of prema.[^34-18]

হেনকালে সেইক্ষণে, আসি' এক ব্রাহ্মণে,
প্রভু বলি' ডাকে উচ্চনাদে ।
আর্তজন-আর্তি দেখি', ছলছল করে আঁখি,
ভই গেল ঈশ্বর-উন্মাদে ॥ ১৩০ ॥

*henakāle seikṣaṇe, āsi' eka brāhmaṇe,*
*prabhu bali' ḍāke uccanāde |*
*ārtajana-ārti dekhi', chalachala kare āṁkhi,*
*bhai gela īśbara-unmāde || 130 ||*

*Word for word:* henakale seikshane — at that hour, at that moment; asi eka brahmane — a brahmana came; prabhu bali dake uchchanade — called loudly "Prabhu!"; arta-jana-arti dekhi — seeing the suffering of the sufferer; chhalachhala kare ankhi — the eyes filled with tears; bhai gela ishvara-unmade — He entered the rapture of Ishvara

**130.** At that hour, at that very moment, a brahmana came
and loudly called: "Prabhu!"
Seeing the suffering of the sufferer, His eyes filled with tears,
and He entered the rapture [of the bhava] of Ishvara.

আপনি ঈশ্বর হঞা, নিজপ্রেম প্রকাশিঞা,
নিজগুণে করে ঠাকুরাল ।
সর্বজন বেড়ি বেড়ি, দণ্ড-পরণাম করি',
দেখি' ঈশ্বর-আবেশ পুনর্বার ॥ ১৩১ ॥

*āpani īśbara hañā, nijaprema prakāśiñā,*
*nijaguṇe kare ṭhākurāla |*
*sarbajana beṛi beṛi, daṇḍa-paraṇāma kari',*
*dekhi' īśbara-ābeśa punarbāra || 131 ||*

*Word for word:* apani ishvara haña — becoming Ishvara Himself; nija-prema prakashiña — revealing His prema; nija-gune kare thakurala — shows His lordship by His qualities; sarvajana bedi bedi — all, surrounding Him; danda-paranama kari — prostrating; dekhi ishvara-avesha punarbara — seeing again the bhava of Ishvara

**131.** Becoming Ishvara Himself, revealing His prema,
He shows His lordship by His own qualities.
All, surrounding Him, prostrated themselves,
seeing again [in Him] the bhava of Ishvara.

এইমতে সব নিশে, গোঙাইয়া রসাবেশে,
প্রভাতে চলিলা নিজঘরে ।
যত জন সঙ্গে যায়, দেখে যেন গোরারায়,
কেবল প্রচণ্ড দণ্ড ধরে ॥ ১৩২ ॥

*eimate saba niśe, goṅāiẏā rasābeśe,*
*prabhāte calilā nijaghare |*
*yata jana saṅge yāẏa, dekhe yena gorārāẏa,*
*kebala pracaṇḍa daṇḍa dhare || 132 ||*

*Word for word:* ei-mate saba nishe — thus the whole night; gonaiya rasaveshe — spending in the rapture of rasa; prabhate chalila nija-ghare — at dawn He went home; yata jana sange yaya — all who go with Him; dekhe yena goraraya — see as if Gora-raya; kevala prachanda danda dhare — holds a fierce rod

**132.** Thus, spending the whole night in the rapture of rasa,
at dawn He went home.
All who went with Him saw Gora-raya
as if holding a fierce rod.[^34-19]

হেনমতে গৌরহরি, করুণা প্রকাশ করি',
অখিল ভুবনে এককর্তা ।
করুণা-কারণ আসি', দীনভাব পরকাশি',
আপে করে পৃথিবীর চিন্তা ॥ ১৩৩ ॥

*henamate gaurahari, karuṇā prakāśa kari',*
*akhila bhubane ekakartā |*
*karuṇā-kāraṇa āsi', dīnabhāba parakāśi',*
*āpe kare pṛthibīra cintā || 133 ||*

*Word for word:* henamate gaurahari — thus Gaurahari; karuna prakasha kari — revealing mercy; akhila bhuvane eka-karta — the one Maker in all the worlds; karuna-karana asi — coming for mercy's sake; dina-bhava parakashi — showing humility; ape kare prithivira chinta — Himself cares for the earth

**133.** Thus Gaurahari, the one Maker of all the worlds,
revealed His mercy;
having come for mercy's sake and showing humility,
He Himself cares for the earth.

হেন অপরূপ কথা, শুনিঞা সংসার-ব্যথা,
না ঘুচয়ে যাহার অন্তরে ।
না ঘুচিব কোনকালে, যে ইথি সংশয় ধরে,
তারে ধিক নাহিক পামরে ॥ ১৩৪ ॥

*hena aparūpa kathā, śuniñā saṃsāra-byathā,*
*nā ghucaẏe yāhāra antare |*
*nā ghuciba konakāle, ye ithi saṃśaẏa dhare,*
*tāre dhika nāhika pāmare || 134 ||*

*Word for word:* hena aparupa katha — such a wondrous story; shuniña — hearing; samsara-vyatha — the pain of samsara; na ghuchaye yahara antare — is not removed from whose heart; na ghuchiba konakale — will never be removed; ye ithi samshaya dhare — whoever doubts this; tare dhika — shame on him; nahika pamare — no [worse] wretch

**134.** If anyone, hearing so wondrous a story, is not freed
in his heart from the pain of samsara —
he will never be freed from it; and whoever doubts this —
shame on him: there is no worse wretch.

যুক্তি অনুভব শাস্ত্র, তিনে কহে এইমাত্র,
সাক্ষাতে না দেখি পরচার ।
বিচার না করে ইহা, না ছিল সে হৈল সিয়া,
কেমনে তার হইব নিস্তার ॥ ১৩৫ ॥

*yukti anubhaba śāstra, tine kahe eimātra,*
*sākṣāte nā dekhi paracāra |*
*bicāra nā kare ihā, nā chila se haila siẏā,*
*kemane tāra haiba nistāra || 135 ||*

*Word for word:* yukti anubhava shastra — reason, experience and scripture; tine kahe ei-matra — the three say just this; sakshate na dekhi parachara — one does not see it openly proclaimed; vichara na kare iha — who does not ponder this; na chhila se haila siya (?) — what was not has come to be; kemane tara haiba nistara — how will he be delivered

**135.** Reason, experience and scripture — all three say just this,
though one does not see it openly proclaimed;
whoever does not ponder this — that what never was has come to be —
how will such a one be delivered?[^34-20]

গোরা-অবতার হেন, করুণা প্রকাশ যেন,
নাহি হয় না হইব আর ।
যে বলু সে বলু লোকে, অনুভব কহি তাকে,
মনে মনে করুক বিচার ॥ ১৩৬ ॥

*gorā-abatāra hena, karuṇā prakāśa yena,*
*nāhi haẏa nā haiba āra |*
*ye balu se balu loke, anubhaba kahi tāke,*
*mane mane karuka bicāra || 136 ||*

*Word for word:* gora-avatara hena — such an avatara as Gora; karuna prakasha yena — such a revelation of mercy; nahi haya na haiba ara — is not and will not be again; ye balu se balu loke — let people say what they will; anubhava kahi take — I tell them what I have realised; mane mane karuka vichara — let them reflect within

**136.** Such an avatara as Gora, such a revelation of mercy,
has never been and never will be.
Let people say what they will — I tell them what I have realised:
let them reflect on it within themselves.

এইমাত্র মোর চিন্তা, অন্তরে অন্তর-ব্যথা,
হেন অবতার যায় পাছে ।
তা লাগি' কান্দয়ে হিয়া, কাহারে কহিব ইহা,
গুণ গায় এ লোচন দাসে ॥ ১৩৭ ॥

*eimātra mora cintā, antare antara-byathā,*
*hena abatāra yāẏa pāche |*
*tā lāgi' kāndaẏe hiẏā, kāhāre kahiba ihā,*
*guṇa gāẏa e locana dāse || 137 ||*

*Word for word:* ei-matra mora chinta — this alone is my care; antare antara-vyatha — a pain deep in the heart; hena avatara yaya pachhe — lest such an avatara pass by; ta lagi kandaye hiya — for this the heart weeps; kahare kahiba iha — to whom shall I tell this; guna gaya e lochana dase — this Lochana Dasa sings the qualities

**137.** One care I have, a pain deep in my heart:
lest such an avatara pass [people] by.
For this my heart weeps — to whom shall I tell it?
This Lochana Dasa sings [Gora's] qualities.

[^34-1]: Cf. Bhagavata 11.5.32: in the age of Kali the intelligent worship the Lord by a yajna consisting chiefly of sankirtana. Bhaktisiddhanta's summary of these pastimes is at the head of the section (en/33).
[^34-2]: The "fifth Veda" usually means the itihasas and puranas (Bhagavata 1.4.20); Lochana Dasa gives this name to the sung word, the Veda "in the form of song" (v. 80) revealed in the Kali age. "With five mouths" is a play on words: Shiva has five faces.
