[^34-3]: Kirtana is described as a yajna: the sacrificial pit (kunda), the ladle (sruva) with which ghee is poured into the fire, and the ghee itself.
[^34-4]: The pure devotees do not accept the five kinds of liberation (salokya, sarupya and so on) if they contain no service to the Lord (Bhagavata 3.29.13).
[^34-5]: The image is that of a Vedic yajna, which the master (yajamana) performs together with his wife. Nityananda is the giver of prema; Gadadhara Pandita is, in the Gaudiya Vaishnava understanding, Sri Radha (en/25, note 7), whose prema this is.
[^34-6]: Advaita Acharya (Maha-Vishnu, en/27, note 8) brought the Lord down into this world by His calls.
[^34-7]: Chandrashekhara Acharya (Acharyaratna) is the husband of Shachi's sister, the Lord's aunt. The play in his house: Murari 2.15.7–19, 2.16; Chaitanya-bhagavata, Madhya 18 (where the Lord appears in the bhava of Rukmini and of the primal Shakti, Gadadhara as Her companion, Haridasa as a watchman with a staff, Srivasa as Narada). Bhaktisiddhanta's summary is at the head of the section (en/33).
[^34-8]: According to the Gaura-ganoddesha-dipika, Srivasa is Narada. The gopi's dress and the bhavas of a gopi, of Lakshmi and of the primal Shakti which the Lord shows in this play are His own lila: the shakti is non-different from the Possessor of shakti, and He reveals the bhavas of His shaktis. This is no worldly dressing-up or play-acting.
[^34-9]: The gopis' love for Krishna is pure prema, above all worldly duties; their "husbands" are a mere appearance created by yogamaya (Bhagavata 10.33.37). There is nothing worldly here.
[^34-10]: Prakriti here means Krishna's shakti, His internal energy, not material nature (the pradhana of Sankhya). Gadadhara Pandita is Sri Radha (en/25, note 7). In A this stanza is printed under two numbers, 101 and 102 (one per half-stanza); in the 1983 edition it is a single stanza (9). We follow A's numbering; next, A misprints "100" for 103.
[^34-11]: That is, the Lord, longing for Radha's love, has Himself put on a gopi's dress — a hint at the secret of Gaura's appearance, in which He took Radha's bhava and complexion (Chaitanya-charitamrita, Adi 1.5–6).
[^34-12]: Cf. Murari 2.16.1. In the Chaitanya-bhagavata (Madhya 18) Haridasa in this play is a watchman-herald with a staff.
[^34-13]: Advaita Acharya is Maha-Vishnu (en/27, note 8); the word "portion" does not diminish Him. Cf. Murari 2.16.3–4.
[^34-14]: Cf. Murari 2.16.7–8.
[^34-15]: Cf. Murari 2.16.11–13. The half-closed eyes, half-steps and veil are the feminine modesty of Lakshmi, whose bhava the Lord reveals.
[^34-16]: The primal Shakti (Adya-shakti) — in Lochana Dasa she is also Chandi and Katyayani (vv. 124, 129). In the Gaudiya Vaishnava understanding the Lord's primal shakti is His internal energy (yogamaya); Durga, who rules the material world, is her shadow and the Lord's servant (Brahma-samhita 5.44). The Lord reveals the bhava of His own shakti, non-different from Him (cf. Murari 2.16.15 and note 8 above); this is neither possession nor the worship of another deity.
[^34-17]: The rod (danda) is a sign of power and fierce might; the 1983 edition has "you will all become fierce". In Murari (2.16.17–18) the Goddess jokes that people will take Her devotees for worshippers of Chandi. Cf. also v. 132.
[^34-18]: According to Murari (2.16.20–21) and the Chaitanya-bhagavata (Madhya 18), the Lord in this bhava gave the devotees milk from His breast, like a mother.
[^34-19]: Cf. Murari 2.16.23: the Lord, as if holding a staff in His hand, seemed to the people like the flame of the blazing sun.
[^34-20]: Gaura is the hidden (channa) avatara: the scriptures speak of Him covertly (Bhagavata 7.9.38; 11.5.32). The line "না ছিল সে হৈল সিয়া" is unclear in all witnesses; we translate by sense.

---

# Madhya-khanda, part 12 (portion 35)

*The section "Before Sannyasa": seven days of radiance in Chandrashekhara's house; Srivasa asks about the dharmas of the yugas, and the Lord proclaims sankirtana; the Lord's longing for Vrindavana and Murari's persuasion; the dream of the sannyasa mantra; the arrival of Keshava Bharati; Mukunda reveals the Lord's resolve to the devotees; the devotees' lament and the Lord's answer: He is burning in separation from Krishna*

## Before Sannyasa

> *Summary by Srila Bhaktisiddhanta Sarasvati.* In answer to Srivasa Pandita's question Sriman Mahaprabhu told of the dharmas of the four yugas [and revealed that] in the Kali age [the best dharma] is the sankirtana of the name; [then,] in the bhava of Radha, He became agitated, [crying,] "Where is Vrindavana? Where is Lalita? Where is Govardhana?" Then, at Murari's words, Sriman Mahaprabhu grew calm and [again] gave Himself fully to [kirtana] with the Vaishnavas, and one day He told [His mother] that He had received the sannyasa mantra in a dream. Some days later Keshava Bharati came to Sriman Mahaprabhu's house, and the Lord received him fittingly. [At the sight of the sannyasi] Sriman Mahaprabhu's separation from Krishna became unbearable. Learning that Mahaprabhu would take sannyasa, the devotees, in fear of the coming separation from Him, began to lament bitterly, and the Lord, telling them [of the pain of separation from Krishna and of the nature of samsara], consoled them.[^35-1]

*Raga varadi; refrain: "My life is Gorachand!"*

কহিব অপূর্ব কথা লোক-অগোচর ।
কভু নাহি দেখি শুনি জগত-ভিতর ॥ ১ ॥

*kahiba apūrba kathā loka-agocara |*
*kabhu nāhi dekhi śuni jagata-bhitara || 1 ||*

*Word for word:* kahiba apurva katha — I shall tell a wondrous story; loka-agochara — unknown to the world; kabhu nahi dekhi shuni — never seen or heard; jagata-bhitara — in the world

**1.** I shall tell a wondrous story, unknown to the world —
never seen or heard of anywhere on earth.

তিলেক সন্দেহ কেহো না কর জানি' চিতে ।
প্রকাশ করিল প্রভু সব-লোক-হিতে ॥ ২ ॥

*tileka sandeha keho nā kara jāni' cite |*
*prakāśa karila prabhu saba-loka-hite || 2 ||*

*Word for word:* tileka sandeha — the least doubt; keho na kara jani chite — let no one hold in his heart; prakasha karila prabhu — the Lord revealed [this]; saba-loka-hite — for the good of all people

**2.** Let no one doubt it for a moment in his heart:
the Lord revealed this for the good of all people.

চন্দ্রশেখরের বাড়ী নাচিয়া গাহিয়া ।
ঘরেতে আইলা প্রভু আনন্দিত হৈয়া ॥ ৩ ॥

*candraśekharera bāṛī nāciẏā gāhiẏā |*
*gharete āilā prabhu ānandita haiẏā || 3 ||*

*Word for word:* chandrashekharera badi — at Chandrashekhara's house; nachiya gahiya — having danced and sung; gharete aila prabhu — the Lord came home; anandita haiya — joyful

**3.** Having danced and sung His fill in Chandrashekhara's house,
the Lord returned home in joy.

আনন্দিত শ্রীচন্দ্রশেখর ভট্টাচার্য ।
তাহার বাড়ীর কথা কহিব আশ্চর্য ॥ ৪ ॥

*ānandita śrīcandraśekhara bhaṭṭācārya |*
*tāhāra bāṛīra kathā kahiba āścarya || 4 ||*

*Word for word:* anandita — rejoices; shri-chandrashekhara bhattacharya — Sri Chandrashekhara Bhattacharya; tahara badira katha — about his house; kahiba ashcharya — I shall tell a marvel

**4.** Sri Chandrashekhara Bhattacharya rejoices —
I shall tell of the marvel in his house.

নাচিয়া আইল প্রভু তাহার ছটাকে ।
উদয় করিল যেন চান্দ লাখে লাখে ॥ ৫ ॥

*nāciẏā āila prabhu tāhāra chaṭāke |*
*udaẏa karila yena cānda lākhe lākhe || 5 ||*

*Word for word:* nachiya aila prabhu — the Lord came to dance; tahara chhatake — by His radiance; udaya karila yena — as if there rose; chanda lakhe lakhe — moons by hundreds of thousands

**5.** The Lord had come there to dance, and from His radiance
it was as if moons had risen — hundreds of thousands of moons.[^35-2]

অদ্ভুত শীতল শোভা অমৃত অধিক ।
চাহিতে না পারি যেন চৌদিকে তড়িত ॥ ৬ ॥

*adbhuta śītala śobhā amṛta adhika |*
*cāhite nā pāri yena caudike taṛita || 6 ||*

*Word for word:* adbhuta shitala shobha — a wondrous cool light; amrita adhika — more than nectar; chahite na pari — we cannot look; yena chaudike tadita — as if lightning on all sides

**6.** A wondrous, cool light, more delightful than nectar;
one cannot look at it — as if lightning flashed on all four sides.

হৃদয়-আহ্লাদ করে দেখি' হেন সাধ ।
আঁখি মেলিবারে নারি তেজে করে বাধ ॥ ৭ ॥

*hṛdaẏa-āhlāda kare dekhi' hena sādha |*
*āṁkhi melibāre nāri teje kare bādha || 7 ||*

*Word for word:* hridaya-ahlada kare — it gladdens the heart; dekhi hena sadha — such a longing to look; ankhi melibare nari — we cannot open our eyes; teje kare badha — the brilliance prevents

**7.** It gladdens the heart — one longs to look,
but one cannot open one's eyes: the brilliance prevents it.

চমক লাগিল সে নদিয়াপুর-জনে ।
কিবা অপরূপ সে দেখিল এতদিনে ॥ ৮ ॥

*camaka lāgila se nadiẏāpura-jane |*
*kibā aparūpa se dekhila etadine || 8 ||*

*Word for word:* chamaka lagila — were astonished; se nadiyapura-jane — the people of the town of Nadia; kiba aparupa se dekhila — what a marvel they saw; etadine — in these days

**8.** The people of the town of Nadia were astonished:
what a marvel they had seen in these days!

আসিয়া বৈষ্ণবজনে পুছে সর্বজন ।
কি জান সন্দর্ভ-কথা কহ না কথন ॥ ৯ ॥

*āsiẏā baiṣṇabajane puche sarbajana |*
*ki jāna sandarbha-kathā kaha nā kathana || 9 ||*

*Word for word:* asiya — coming; vaishnava-jane puchhe sarvajana — all ask the Vaishnavas; ki jana sandarbha-katha — do you know what this is about; kaha na kathana — do tell us

**9.** Coming there, everyone asks the Vaishnavas:
"Do you know what this means? Tell us, then!"

সকল বৈষ্ণব বোলে—আমরা কি জানি ।
নাচিয়া আইলা বিশ্বম্ভর গুণমণি ॥ ১০ ॥

*sakala baiṣṇaba bole—āmarā ki jāni |*
*nāciẏā āilā biśbambhara guṇamaṇi || 10 ||*

*Word for word:* sakala vaishnava bole — all the Vaishnavas say; amara ki jani — what do we know; nachiya aila — came to dance; vishvambhara guna-mani — Vishvambhara, the jewel of qualities

**10.** All the Vaishnavas answer: "What do we know?
Vishvambhara, the jewel of qualities, came here to dance —

এই মাত্র জানি, কিছু না জানিয়ে আর ।
লোক-বেদ-অগোচর চরিত্র তাহার ॥ ১১ ॥

*ei mātra jāni, kichu nā jāniẏe āra |*
*loka-beda-agocara caritra tāhāra || 11 ||*

*Word for word:* ei matra jani — this alone we know; kichhu na janiye ara — we know nothing more; loka-veda-agochara — unknown to the world and the Vedas; charitra tahara — are His deeds

**11.** this alone we know, and nothing more:
His deeds are unknown to the world and to the Vedas."

সাত দিন অবিচ্ছিন্ন ছিল তেজোরাশি ।
তেজের ছটায় নাহি জানি দিবানিশি ॥ ১২ ॥

*sāta dina abicchinna chila tejorāśi |*
*tejera chaṭāẏa nāhi jāni dibāniśi || 12 ||*

*Word for word:* sata dina avichchhinna — seven days unbroken; chhila tejo-rashi — was the mass of radiance; tejera chhataya — for the brilliance; nahi jani divanishi — no one knew day from night

**12.** For seven days this sea of radiance did not break;
for its brilliance no one could tell day from night.

নিত্যই নূতন অতি আনন্দের কর্ম ।
প্রকাশয়ে শচীসুত করুণার ধর্ম ॥ ১৩ ॥

*nityai nūtana ati ānandera karma |*
*prakāśaẏe śacīsuta karuṇāra dharma || 13 ||*

*Word for word:* nityai nutana — ever new; ati anandera karma — most joyful deeds; prakashaye shachi-suta — the son of Shachi reveals; karunara dharma — the dharma of mercy

**13.** Ever new, ever more joyful deeds
the son of Shachi reveals — the dharma of mercy.

তার-পর-দিনে শ্রীনিবাস দ্বিজবর ।
পুছয়ে ঠাকুর-আগে হৃদয়-উত্তর ॥ ১৪ ॥

*tāra-para-dine śrīnibāsa dbijabara |*
*puchaẏe ṭhākura-āge hṛdaẏa-uttara || 14 ||*

*Word for word:* tara-para-dine — on the next day; shrinivasa dvijabara — Srinivasa, the best of brahmanas; puchhaye thakura-age — asks before the Thakura; hridaya-uttara — the answer to what is in his heart

**14.** The next day Srinivasa, the best of brahmanas,
asks the Thakura about what was in his heart:

কলিযুগে হরিনাম-গুণ-সংকীর্তন ।
পূর্ণ ফল বোলে কেনে আর যুগে ন্যূন ॥ ১৫ ॥

*kaliyuge harināma-guṇa-saṃkīrtana |*
*pūrṇa phala bole kene āra yuge nyūna || 15 ||*

*Word for word:* kali-yuge — in the Kali age; hari-nama-guna-sankirtana — the sankirtana of Hari's name and qualities; purna phala bole kene — why is it called the full fruit; ara yuge nyuna — and in other ages less

**15.** "In the Kali age the sankirtana of Hari's name and qualities —
why is it said to give the full fruit, and [the ways of] the other yugas less?"

শুনিঞা ঠাকুর কহে—শুন শ্রীনিবাস ।
ভাল কথা শুধাইলে, কহিব বিশেষ ॥ ১৬ ॥

*śuniñā ṭhākura kahe—śuna śrīnibāsa |*
*bhāla kathā śudhāile, kahiba biśeṣa || 16 ||*

*Word for word:* shuniña thakura kahe — hearing, the Thakura says; shuna shrinivasa — listen, Srinivasa; bhala katha shudhaile — you asked a good thing; kahiba vishesha — I shall explain in detail

**16.** Hearing this, the Thakura says: "Listen, Srinivasa:
you have asked a good question — I shall explain in detail.

সত্যযুগে পূর্ণধর্ম ধ্যানমাত্র সাধি' ।
ত্রেতায় সাধয়ে যজ্ঞধর্ম উদারধী ॥ ১৭ ॥

*satyayuge pūrṇadharma dhyānamātra sādhi' |*
*tretāẏa sādhaẏe yajñadharma udāradhī || 17 ||*

*Word for word:* satya-yuge purna-dharma — in the Satya age, dharma complete; dhyana-matra sadhi — attaining by meditation alone; tretaya sadhaye — in the Treta practise; yajna-dharma — the dharma of yajna; udara-dhi — the generous-minded

**17.** In the Satya age, when dharma was complete, they attained by meditation alone;
in the Treta age the generous-minded practise the dharma of yajna;

দ্বাপরে কৃষ্ণের পূজা কহিল এ মর্ম ।
কলিযুগে শক্ত কেহো নহে এই কর্ম ॥ ১৮ ॥

*dbāpare kṛṣṇera pūjā kahila e marma |*
*kaliyuge śakta keho nahe ei karma || 18 ||*

*Word for word:* dvapare krishnera puja — in the Dvapara the worship of Krishna; kahila e marma — is called the essence; kali-yuge shakta keho nahe — in the Kali age no one is able; ei karma — for these works

**18.** in the Dvapara, it is said, the essence [of dharma] is the worship of Krishna;
but in the Kali age no one is capable of these works.

আপনে ঠাকুর নামরূপী ভগবান্ ।
কলিযুগে সর্বশক্তিময় হরিনাম ॥ ১৯ ॥

*āpane ṭhākura nāmarūpī bhagabān |*
*kaliyuge sarbaśaktimaẏa harināma || 19 ||*

*Word for word:* apane thakura — the Thakura Himself; nama-rupi bhagavan — is Bhagavan in the form of the name; kali-yuge — in the Kali age; sarva-shakti-maya hari-nama — the name of Hari is full of all powers

**19.** The Thakura Himself is Bhagavan in the form of the name:
in the Kali age the name of Hari is endowed with all powers.

সত্য আদি তিন যুগে যত মহাজন ।
ধ্যান-যজ্ঞার্চনাবিধি সেবে নারায়ণ ॥ ২০ ॥

*satya ādi tina yuge yata mahājana |*
*dhyāna-yajñārcanābidhi sebe nārāẏaṇa || 20 ||*

*Word for word:* satya adi tina yuge — in the three ages beginning with Satya; yata maha-jana — all the great souls; dhyana-yajna-archana-vidhi — by meditation, yajna and worship by rule; seve narayana — served Narayana

**20.** In the three ages beginning with Satya, all the great souls
served Narayana by meditation, yajna and worship according to rule.

পাপ কলিযুগে লোক দুরন্তচরিত ।
এই ত কারণে দয়া ভেল বিপরীত ॥ ২১ ॥

*pāpa kaliyuge loka durantacarita |*
*ei ta kāraṇe daẏā bhela biparīta || 21 ||*

*Word for word:* papa kali-yuge — in the sinful Kali age; loka duranta-charita — people of wicked conduct; ei ta karane — for this very reason; daya bhela viparita — mercy has turned the other way

**21.** In the sinful Kali age people's conduct is wicked —
and for this very reason mercy has turned the other way.[^35-3]

আপনে ঠাকুর নিজ-সংকীর্তনরূপে ।
অনায়াসে সর্বসিদ্ধি সাধি' কলিযুগে ॥ ২২ ॥

*āpane ṭhākura nija-saṃkīrtanarūpe |*
*anāẏāse sarbasiddhi sādhi' kaliyuge || 22 ||*

*Word for word:* apane thakura — the Thakura Himself; nija-sankirtana-rupe — in His own form of sankirtana; anayase sarva-siddhi — effortlessly all perfections; sadhi kali-yuge — are attained in the Kali age

**22.** The Thakura Himself is in His own form of sankirtana —
and in the Kali age all perfections are attained without effort.

সত্য আদি যুগে যাহা সাধি' মহাদুখে ।
প্রভুর কৃপাতে সুখে সাধি কলিযুগে ॥ ২৩ ॥

*satya ādi yuge yāhā sādhi' mahādukhe |*
*prabhura kṛpāte sukhe sādhi kaliyuge || 23 ||*

*Word for word:* satya adi yuge — in Satya and the other ages; yaha sadhi maha-dukhe — what is attained with great hardship; prabhura kripate — by the Lord's mercy; sukhe sadhi kali-yuge — is attained with ease in the Kali age

**23.** What in Satya and the other ages is attained with great hardship,
by the Lord's mercy is attained with ease in the Kali age."[^35-4]

নরহরি-পাদপদ্ম করি' শিরোপরি ।
কহয়ে লোচনদাস গৌরাঙ্গ-মাধুরী ॥ ২৪ ॥

*narahari-pādapadma kari' śiropari |*
*kahaẏe locanadāsa gaurāṅga-mādhurī || 24 ||*

*Word for word:* narahari-pada-padma — the lotus feet of Narahari; kari shiropari — placing on the head; kahaye lochanadasa — Lochana Dasa tells; gauranga-madhuri — of Gauranga's sweetness

**24.** Placing the lotus feet of Narahari on my head,
Lochana Dasa tells of the sweetness of Gauranga.

এইমতে আনন্দে সানন্দে দিন যায় ।
আচম্বিতে খেদ উঠে প্রভুর হিয়ায় ॥ ২৫ ॥

*eimate ānande sānande dina yāẏa |*
*ācambite kheda uṭhe prabhura hiẏāẏa || 25 ||*

*Word for word:* ei-mate — thus; anande sanande dina yaya — in joy and gladness the days go by; achambite — suddenly; kheda uthe prabhura hiyaya — sorrow rises in the Lord's heart

**25.** Thus in joy and gladness the days go by —
and suddenly sorrow rises in the Lord's heart:

নারিল নারিল এথা থাকিবারে আমি ।
দেখিবারে যাব আমি বৃন্দাবন-ভূমি ॥ ২৬ ॥

*nārila nārila ethā thākibāre āmi |*
*dekhibāre yāba āmi bṛndābana-bhūmi || 26 ||*

*Word for word:* narila narila — I cannot, I cannot; etha thakibare ami — stay here; dekhibare yaba ami — I shall go to see; vrindavana-bhumi — the land of Vrindavana

**26.** "I cannot, I cannot stay here —
I shall go to see the land of Vrindavana!

কতি মোর কালিন্দী যমুনা বৃন্দাবন ।
কতি মোর বহুলা ভাণ্ডীর গোবর্ধন ॥ ২৭ ॥

*kati mora kālindī yamunā bṛndābana |*
*kati mora bahulā bhāṇḍīra gobardhana || 27 ||*

*Word for word:* kati mora — where are My; kalindi yamuna vrindavana — Kalindi, the Yamuna, Vrindavana; kati mora — where are My; bahula bhandira govardhana — Bahula, Bhandira, Govardhana

**27.** Where is My Kalindi, the Yamuna, Vrindavana?
Where are My Bahula, Bhandira, Govardhana?

কতি গেলা আরে মোর ললিতাদি রাধা ।
কতি গেলা আরে মোর এ নন্দ যশোদা ॥ ২৮ ॥

*kati gelā āre mora lalitādi rādhā |*
*kati gelā āre mora e nanda yaśodā || 28 ||*

*Word for word:* kati gela are mora — where have gone My; lalitadi radha — Radha, Lalita and the others; kati gela are mora — where have gone My; e nanda yashoda — Nanda and Yashoda

**28.** Where have My Radha, Lalita and the others gone?
Where have My Nanda and Yashoda gone?

শ্রীদাম সুদাম মোর রহিলা কোথায় ।
ধবলী শাঙলী বলি' অনুরাগে ধায় ॥ ২৯ ॥

*śrīdāma sudāma mora rahilā kothāẏa |*
*dhabalī śāṅalī bali' anurāge dhāẏa || 29 ||*

*Word for word:* shridama sudama mora — My Shridama and Sudama; rahila kothaya — where have they stayed; dhavali shangali bali — calling "Dhavali! Shangali!"; anurage dhaya — runs in longing

**29.** Where have My Shridama and Sudama stayed?" —
and calling "Dhavali! Shangali!" He runs in longing.[^35-5]

ক্ষণে দন্তে তৃণ ধরি' করুণা করিয়া ।
ফুকরি ফুকরি কান্দে চৌদিগে চাহিয়া ॥ ৩০ ॥

*kṣaṇe dante tṛṇa dhari' karuṇā kariẏā |*
*phukari phukari kānde caudige cāhiẏā || 30 ||*

*Word for word:* kshane dante trina dhari — now holding a straw in His teeth; karuna kariya — piteously; phukari phukari kande — sobs aloud; chaudige chahiya — looking on all sides

**30.** Now, holding a straw between His teeth, piteously
He sobs aloud, looking round on every side:

এ ভব-সংসার আমি কেমনে ছাড়িব ।
সে নন্দনন্দন-পদ কোথা গেলে পাব ॥ ৩১ ॥

*e bhaba-saṃsāra āmi kemane chāṛiba |*
*se nandanandana-pada kothā gele pāba || 31 ||*

*Word for word:* e bhava-samsara — this round of worldly existence; ami kemane chhadiba — how shall I leave; se nanda-nandana-pada — the feet of Nanda's son; kotha gele paba — where shall I go to attain

**31.** "How shall I leave this round of worldly existence?
Where shall I go to attain the feet of Nanda's son?"

ইহা বলি' ছিণ্ডিল গলার উপবীত ।
কৃষ্ণের বিরহে দুঃখ ভেল বিপরীত ॥ ৩২ ॥

*ihā bali' chiṇḍila galāra upabīta |*
*kṛṣṇera birahe duḥkha bhela biparīta || 32 ||*

*Word for word:* iha bali — saying this; chhindila galara upavita — tore the sacred thread from His neck; krishnera virahe — in separation from Krishna; duhkha bhela viparita — the grief became unbearable

**32.** Saying this, He tore the sacred thread from His neck —
so unbearable had the grief of separation from Krishna become.[^35-6]

হরি হরি বলি' ডাকে ছাড়য়ে নিঃশ্বাস ।
অশ্রুধারা গলে, কিছু না কহে বিশেষ ॥ ৩৩ ॥

*hari hari bali' ḍāke chāṛaẏe niḥśbāsa |*
*aśrudhārā gale, kichu nā kahe biśeṣa || 33 ||*

*Word for word:* hari hari bali dake — calls "Hari, Hari!"; chhadaye nihshvasa — heaves sighs; ashru-dhara gale — tears pour in streams; kichhu na kahe vishesha — says nothing distinct

**33.** Calling "Hari, Hari!" He heaves deep sighs;
tears pour down in streams, but He says nothing distinct.

পুলকে পূরিত অঙ্গ অরুণ বরণ ।
দেখিয়া মুরারি কিছু কহয়ে বচন ॥ ৩৪ ॥

*pulake pūrita aṅga aruṇa baraṇa |*
*dekhiẏā murāri kichu kahaẏe bacana || 34 ||*

*Word for word:* pulake purita anga — the body full of thrill; aruna barana — the complexion reddened; dekhiya murari — seeing [this], Murari; kichhu kahaye vachana — speaks some words

**34.** His body thrills, His face has grown red;
seeing this, Murari speaks these words to Him:

শুন শুন মহাপ্রভু গৌর ভগবান্ ।
তোমারে অশক্য কিছু নাহি, কহি পরিণাম ॥ ৩৫ ॥

*śuna śuna mahāprabhu gaura bhagabān |*
*tomāre aśakya kichu nāhi, kahi pariṇāma || 35 ||*

*Word for word:* shuna shuna mahaprabhu — listen, listen, Mahaprabhu; gaura bhagavan — Gaura Bhagavan; tomare ashakya kichhu nahi — nothing is impossible for You; kahi parinama — I tell the consequences

**35.** "Listen, listen, Mahaprabhu, Gaura Bhagavan:
nothing is impossible for You — [but] I shall speak of the consequences.

থাকিতে চলিতে তুমি পারহ সর্বথা ।
তথাপি আমার বোলে না দিবে অন্যথা ॥ ৩৬ ॥

*thākite calite tumi pāraha sarbathā |*
*tathāpi āmāra bole nā dibe anyathā || 36 ||*

*Word for word:* thakite chalite — to stay and to go; tumi paraha sarvatha — You are fully able; tathapi — and yet; amara bole na dibe anyatha — do not set my words aside

**36.** You are free both to stay and to go —
and yet do not disregard my words.

তুমি যদি এখনে চলিবে দেশান্তর ।
স্বতন্ত্র হইব সব বৈষ্ণব-অন্তর ॥ ৩৭ ॥

*tumi yadi ekhane calibe deśāntara |*
*sbatantra haiba saba baiṣṇaba-antara || 37 ||*

*Word for word:* tumi yadi ekhane — if You now; chalibe deshantara — go to distant lands; svatantra haiba — will become self-willed; saba vaishnava-antara — the hearts of all Vaishnavas

**37.** If You now leave for distant lands,
all the Vaishnavas will grow self-willed at heart;

স্বতন্ত্রে করিব কার্য যার মনে লয় ।
পুনঃ প্রবেশিব সভে সংসার-আলয় ॥ ৩৮ ॥

*sbatantre kariba kārya yāra mane laẏa |*
*punaḥ prabeśiba sabhe saṃsāra-ālaẏa || 38 ||*

*Word for word:* svatantre kariba karya — they will act self-willed; yara mane laya — as each pleases; punah praveshiba sabhe — all will enter again; samsara-alaya — the house of samsara

**38.** self-willed, they will do whatever they please,
and all will enter again the house of samsara.

যতেক করিলে নাথ কিছুই না হৈল ।
নিশ্চয় করিয়া এই তোমারে কহিল ॥ ৩৯ ॥

*yateka karile nātha kichui nā haila |*
*niścaẏa kariẏā ei tomāre kahila || 39 ||*

*Word for word:* yateka karile natha — all that You have done, Lord; kichhui na haila — comes to nothing; nishchaya kariya — for certain; ei tomare kahila — this I tell You

**39.** All that You have done, Lord, will come to nothing —
this I tell You for certain."[^35-7]

এ বোল শুনিয়া প্রভু নিঃশব্দে রহিল ।
খণ্ডিতে নারিলেন মুরারি যাহা কহিল ॥ ৪০ ॥

*e bola śuniẏā prabhu niḥśabde rahila |*
*khaṇḍite nārilena murāri yāhā kahila || 40 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuniya — hearing this; prabhu nihshabde rahila — the Lord fell silent; khandite narilena — could not refute; murari yaha kahila — what Murari had said

**40.** Hearing this, the Lord fell silent:
He could not refute what Murari had said.

তবে আর কথোদিন গেল ত কৌতুকে ।
নয়ান ভরিয়া দেখে নদিয়ার লোকে ॥ ৪১ ॥

*tabe āra kathodina gela ta kautuke |*
*naẏāna bhariẏā dekhe nadiẏāra loke || 41 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe ara kathodina — thus some more days; gela ta kautuke — passed in merriment; nayana bhariya dekhe — gaze their eyes' fill; nadiyara loke — the people of Nadia

**41.** Thus several more days passed in merriment;
the people of Nadia could not look their fill of Him.

জননীর হৃদয় নয়ন স্নিগ্ধ করি' ।
বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া-সঙ্গে ক্রীড়া করে গৌরহরি ॥ ৪২ ॥

*jananīra hṛdaẏa naẏana snigdha kari' |*
*biṣṇupriẏā-saṅge krīṛā kare gaurahari || 42 ||*

*Word for word:* jananira hridaya nayana — the mother's heart and eyes; snigdha kari — gladdening; vishnupriya-sange — with Vishnupriya; krida kare gaurahari — Gaurahari plays

**42.** Gladdening His mother's heart and eyes,
Gaurahari passes His time in play with Vishnupriya.[^35-8]

স্বজন-বান্ধব-সঙ্গে আছে মহাসুখে ।
সভারে সন্তোষে যত আছে নবদ্বীপে ॥ ৪৩ ॥

*sbajana-bāndhaba-saṅge āche mahāsukhe |*
*sabhāre santoṣe yata āche nabadbīpe || 43 ||*

*Word for word:* svajana-bandhava-sange — with kinsmen and friends; achhe maha-sukhe — lives in great happiness; sabhare santoshe — delights all; yata achhe navadvipe — who are in Navadvipa

**43.** With kinsmen and friends He lives in great happiness
and delights everyone in Navadvipa.

সব বৈষ্ণব-সনে কীর্তন-বিলাস ।
পুরনারীগণ দেখি' করয়ে হুতাশ ॥ ৪৪ ॥

*saba baiṣṇaba-sane kīrtana-bilāsa |*
*puranārīgaṇa dekhi' karaẏe hutāśa || 44 ||*

*Word for word:* saba vaishnava-sane — with the Vaishnavas; kirtana-vilasa — the pastimes of kirtana; pura-nari-gana dekhi — the ladies of the town, seeing; karaye hutasha — sigh with longing

**44.** With the Vaishnavas — the pastimes of kirtana;
the ladies of the town, looking at Him, sigh with longing.[^35-9]

ত্রৈলোক্য-অদ্ভুত রূপ তাহে নাগরিমা ।
বিনোদ-বিলাস-লীলা লাবণ্যের সীমা ॥ ৪৫ ॥

*trailokya-adbhuta rūpa tāhe nāgarimā |*
*binoda-bilāsa-līlā lābaṇyera sīmā || 45 ||*

*Word for word:* trailokya-adbhuta rupa — a form that is the wonder of the three worlds; tahe nagarima — in it the charm of a nagara; vinoda-vilasa-lila — playful grace and pastimes; lavanyera sima — the limit of loveliness

**45.** His form is the wonder of the three worlds, and in it is the charm of a nagara,
the very limit of playful grace, rasa and loveliness.

আর তাহে ঝলমল আভরণ-শোভা ।
অংস-বিলম্বিত কেশে মালতীর আভা ॥ ৪৬ ॥

*āra tāhe jhalamala ābharaṇa-śobhā |*
*aṃsa-bilambita keśe mālatīra ābhā || 46 ||*

*Word for word:* ara tahe jhalamala — and on Him sparkle; abharana-shobha — beautiful ornaments; amsa-vilambita keshe — in the hair falling to the shoulders; malatira abha — the gleam of malati

**46.** And on Him beautiful ornaments sparkle;
in the hair falling to His shoulders malati flowers gleam.

চন্দন-তিলক-পরিপাটী মনোহর ।
রক্তপ্রান্ত বাস-বেশ ত্রৈলোক্য-সুন্দর ॥ ৪৭ ॥

*candana-tilaka-paripāṭī manohara |*
*raktaprānta bāsa-beśa trailokya-sundara || 47 ||*

*Word for word:* chandana-tilaka-paripati — the sandal tilaka is drawn; manohara — charmingly; rakta-pranta basa-besha — attire of cloth with a red border; trailokya-sundara — the loveliest in the three worlds

**47.** The sandal tilaka is drawn charmingly;
His cloth has a red border — the loveliest attire in the three worlds.

নিজ-পরিজন আর পুরজন সব ।
সবে সে দেখয়ে যার যেই অনুভব ॥ ৪৮ ॥

*nija-parijana āra purajana saba |*
*sabe se dekhaẏe yāra yei anubhaba || 48 ||*

*Word for word:* nija-parijana — His own people; ara purajana saba — and all the townsfolk; sabe se dekhaye — each sees [Him]; yara yei anubhava — according to his own feeling

**48.** His own people and all the townsfolk —
each sees Him according to his own feeling.

হেনমতে নিজজন-সঙ্গে আছে পঁহু ।
স্বপ্ন কহে সভাকারে হাসি' লহু লহু ॥ ৪৯ ॥

*henamate nijajana-saṅge āche paṁhu |*
*sbapna kahe sabhākāre hāsi' lahu lahu || 49 ||*

*Word for word:* henamate — thus; nijajana-sange achhe panhu — the Lord being with His own; svapna kahe sabhakare — tells all a dream; hasi lahu lahu — smiling softly

**49.** And so, being with His own, the Lord
with a soft smile tells them all a dream:

শুন সর্বজন, স্বপ্ন দেখিল রজনী ।
আচম্বিতে মোর ঠাঞি আইলা দ্বিজমণি ॥ ৫০ ॥

*śuna sarbajana, sbapna dekhila rajanī |*
*ācambite mora ṭhāñi āilā dbijamaṇi || 50 ||*

*Word for word:* shuna sarvajana — listen, all; svapna dekhila rajani — I saw a dream last night; achambite — suddenly; mora thani aila dvija-mani — a jewel of a brahmana came to Me

**50.** "Listen, all: I saw a dream last night:
suddenly a jewel of a brahmana came to Me

মোর কর্ণে কহিল সন্ন্যাস-মন্ত্র এক ।
এখন আমার মনে আছে পরতেক ॥ ৫১ ॥

*mora karṇe kahila sannyāsa-mantra eka |*
*ekhana āmāra mane āche parateka || 51 ||*

*Word for word:* mora karne kahila — spoke into My ear; sannyasa-mantra eka — a certain sannyasa mantra; ekhana amara mane — even now in My mind; achhe parateka — it is vivid

**51.** and spoke into My ear a certain mantra of sannyasa;
even now it is vivid in My mind.

যাবত আমার কর্ণে প্রবেশিল মন্ত্র ।
সে অবধি মোর হিয়া না হয় স্বতন্ত্র ॥ ৫২ ॥

*yābata āmāra karṇe prabeśila mantra |*
*se abadhi mora hiẏā nā haẏa sbatantra || 52 ||*

*Word for word:* yavata amara karne — since into My ear; praveshila mantra — the mantra entered; se avadhi — from that time; mora hiya na haya svatantra — My heart is not My own

**52.** Since the mantra entered My ear,
My heart has not been My own.

কেমনে ছাড়িব আমি প্রিয় প্রাণনাথ ।
তাহারে ছাড়িয়া বা সাধিব কোন্ কাজ ॥ ৫৩ ॥

*kemane chāṛiba āmi priẏa prāṇanātha |*
*tāhāre chāṛiẏā bā sādhiba kon kāja || 53 ||*

*Word for word:* kemane chhadiba ami — how shall I leave; priya prananatha — My beloved Lord of life; tahare chhadiya va — and leaving Him; sadhiba kon kaja — what work shall I do

**53.** How shall I leave My beloved Lord of life?
Leaving Him, what work would I do?

ইন্দ্রনীলমণি জিনি' পরম সুন্দর ।
মোর বক্ষঃস্থলে বসি' হাসে নিরন্তর ॥ ৫৪ ॥

*indranīlamaṇi jini' parama sundara |*
*mora bakṣaḥsthale basi' hāse nirantara || 54 ||*

*Word for word:* indranila-mani jini — surpassing the sapphire; parama sundara — supremely beautiful; mora vakshah-sthale vasi — sitting on My breast; hase nirantara — smiles without cease

**54.** More beautiful than a sapphire, supremely beautiful,
He sits on My breast and smiles without cease."

শুনিঞা মুরারি গুপ্ত কহিল উত্তর ।
সে মন্ত্রের ষষ্ঠী-সমাস তুমি কর ॥ ৫৫ ॥

*śuniñā murāri gupta kahila uttara |*
*se mantrera ṣaṣṭhī-samāsa tumi kara || 55 ||*

*Word for word:* shuniña murari gupta — hearing, Murari Gupta; kahila uttara — replied; se mantrera — of that mantra; shashthi-samasa tumi kara — make it a genitive compound

**55.** Hearing this, Murari Gupta replied:
"Take that mantra as a compound with the genitive case."[^35-10]

এ বোল শুনিয়া প্রভু কহিল বচন ।
তোমার বচনে মোর স্থির নহে মন ॥ ৫৬ ॥

*e bola śuniẏā prabhu kahila bacana |*
*tomāra bacane mora sthira nahe mana || 56 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuniya — hearing this; prabhu kahila vachana — the Lord said; tomara vachane — by your words; mora sthira nahe mana — My mind is not steadied

**56.** Hearing this, the Lord said:
"Your words do not steady My mind.

যত স্থির করি, তত উঠয়ে রোদন ।
না বলিহ মোরে কিছু, শুনহ বচন ॥ ৫৭ ॥

*yata sthira kari, tata uṭhaẏe rodana |*
*nā baliha more kichu, śunaha bacana || 57 ||*

*Word for word:* yata sthira kari — the more I steady Myself; tata uthaye rodana — the more weeping rises; na baliha more kichhu — say nothing to Me; shunaha vachana — hear [My] words

**57.** The more I restrain Myself, the more the tears rise;
say nothing to Me — listen to Me:

শব্দশক্তি করে হেন, কি করিব আমি ।
লঙ্ঘিতে না পারি পুনঃ যত কহ তুমি ॥ ৫৮ ॥

*śabdaśakti kare hena, ki kariba āmi |*
*laṅghite nā pāri punaḥ yata kaha tumi || 58 ||*

*Word for word:* shabda-shakti kare hena — the power of words acts so; ki kariba ami — what shall I do; langhite na pari — I cannot transgress; punah yata kaha tumi — whatever you say

**58.** such is the power of the words — what can I do?
I cannot transgress it, whatever you may say."

এ বোল শুনিঞা সভে অন্তরে চিন্তিত ।
কহয়ে লোচনদাস হৃদয়-ব্যথিত ॥ ৫৯ ॥

*e bola śuniñā sabhe antare cintita |*
*kahaẏe locanadāsa hṛdaẏa-byathita || 59 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuniña — hearing this; sabhe antare chintita — all were troubled at heart; kahaye lochanadasa — says Lochana Dasa; hridaya-vyathita — pained at heart

**59.** Hearing this, all were troubled at heart —
says Lochana Dasa, with pain in his heart.

আর কথোদিনে শ্রীকেশবভারতী ।
আইলা সন্ন্যাসিবর অতি শুদ্ধমতি ॥ ৬০ ॥

*āra kathodine śrīkeśababhāratī |*
*āilā sannyāsibara ati śuddhamati || 60 ||*

*Word for word:* ara kathodine — after some more days; shri-keshava-bharati — Sri Keshava Bharati; aila sannyasi-bara — came, the best of sannyasis; ati shuddha-mati — of utterly pure mind

**60.** Some days later Sri Keshava Bharati came,
the best of sannyasis, of utterly pure mind —

মহাতেজ ন্যাসিবর মহাভাগবত ।
পূর্বজন্মার্জিত কত পুণ্যের পর্বত ॥ ৬১ ॥

*mahāteja nyāsibara mahābhāgabata |*
*pūrbajanmārjita kata puṇyera parbata || 61 ||*

*Word for word:* maha-teja — of great splendour; nyasi-bara — the best of renunciants; maha-bhagavata — a maha-bhagavata; purva-janma-arjita — gathered in former births; kata punyera parvata — a mountain of merits

**61.** full of great splendour, the best of renunciants, a maha-bhagavata,
a mountain of merit gathered in former births.

আচম্বিতে আসিয়া দেখিল বিশ্বম্ভর ।
বিশ্বম্ভর দেখি' হৃষ্ট হৈলা ন্যাসিবর ॥ ৬২ ॥

*ācambite āsiẏā dekhila biśbambhara |*
*biśbambhara dekhi' hṛṣṭa hailā nyāsibara || 62 ||*

*Word for word:* achambite asiya — arriving unexpectedly; dekhila vishvambhara — he saw Vishvambhara; vishvambhara dekhi — seeing Vishvambhara; hrishta haila nyasi-bara — the best of sannyasis rejoiced

**62.** Arriving unexpectedly, he saw Vishvambhara;
seeing Vishvambhara, the best of sannyasis rejoiced.

উঠিয়া ঠাকুর কৈল চরণ-বন্দন ।
সন্ন্যাসী দেখিয়া প্রেমে ঝরে দুনয়ন ॥ ৬৩ ॥

*uṭhiẏā ṭhākura kaila caraṇa-bandana |*
*sannyāsī dekhiẏā preme jhare dunaẏana || 63 ||*

*Word for word:* uthiya thakura — the Thakura, rising; kaila charana-vandana — bowed at [his] feet; sannyasi dekhiya — seeing the sannyasi; preme jhare dunayana — His eyes stream with prema

**63.** The Thakura rose and bowed at his feet;
at the sight of the sannyasi tears of prema streamed from His eyes.

প্রভু-অঙ্গ নিরখয়ে সেই ন্যাসিরাজ ।
মহাবুদ্ধি ন্যাসিবর বুঝিলেন কাজ ॥ ৬৪ ॥

*prabhu-aṅga nirakhaẏe sei nyāsirāja |*
*mahābuddhi nyāsibara bujhilena kāja || 64 ||*

*Word for word:* prabhu-anga nirikhaye — gazes at the Lord; sei nyasi-raja — that king of sannyasis; maha-buddhi nyasi-bara — the best of sannyasis, of great understanding; bujhilena kaja — grasped the matter

**64.** That king of sannyasis gazes intently at the Lord:
the best of sannyasis, of great understanding, grasped how matters stood.

কেশবভারতী-গোসাঞি কহিল বচন ।
তুমি শুক প্রহ্লাদ কি, হেন লয় মন ॥ ৬৫ ॥

*keśababhāratī-gosāñi kahila bacana |*
*tumi śuka prahlāda ki, hena laẏa mana || 65 ||*

*Word for word:* keshava-bharati-gosani — Keshava Bharati Gosani; kahila vachana — said; tumi shuka prahlada ki — are You Shuka or Prahlada; hena laya mana — so my mind thinks

**65.** Keshava Bharati Gosani said:
"Are You not Shuka, or Prahlada? — so it seems to me."

এ বোল শুনিঞা পুন প্রভু বিশ্বম্ভর ।
কান্দয়ে দ্বিগুণ ঝরে নয়নের জল ॥ ৬৬ ॥

*e bola śuniñā puna prabhu biśbambhara |*
*kāndaẏe dbiguṇa jhare naẏanera jala || 66 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuniña — hearing this; puna prabhu vishvambhara — Lord Vishvambhara; kandaye dviguna — weeps twice as much; jhare nayanera jala — tears stream from His eyes

**66.** Hearing this, Lord Vishvambhara
wept twice as hard — tears pour from His eyes.

তবে পুনঃ কহে ন্যাসী বিস্মিত হইয়া ।
অনুমান করি' মনে নিশ্চয় করিয়া ॥ ৬৭ ॥

*tabe punaḥ kahe nyāsī bismita haiẏā |*
*anumāna kari' mane niścaẏa kariẏā || 67 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe punah kahe nyasi — then the sannyasi speaks again; vismita haiya — amazed; anumana kari mane — reflecting in his mind; nishchaya kariya — becoming certain

**67.** Then the sannyasi, amazed, speaks again,
having reflected and become certain in his mind:

তুমি প্রভু ভগবান্—জানিল নিশ্চয় ।
সর্বলোক-প্রাণ তুমি—নাহিক সংশয় ॥ ৬৮ ॥

*tumi prabhu bhagabān—jānila niścaẏa |*
*sarbaloka-prāṇa tumi—nāhika saṃśaẏa || 68 ||*

*Word for word:* tumi prabhu bhagavan — You are the Lord, Bhagavan; janila nishchaya — I know for certain; sarva-loka-prana tumi — You are the life of all people; nahika samshaya — there is no doubt

**68.** "You are the Lord, Bhagavan — I know it for certain;
You are the life of all people, there is no doubt."

এ বোল শুনিঞা প্রভু করয়ে রোদন ।
কতদিনে পাব আমি কৃষ্ণের চরণ ॥ ৬৯ ॥

*e bola śuniñā prabhu karaẏe rodana |*
*katadine pāba āmi kṛṣṇera caraṇa || 69 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuniña — hearing this; prabhu karaye rodana — the Lord weeps; katadine paba ami — when shall I attain; krishnera charana — Krishna's feet

**69.** Hearing this, the Lord wept:
"When shall I attain Krishna's feet?

তোর কৃষ্ণে অনুরাগ অতি বড় হয় ।
তে-কারণে যথা-তথা দেখ কৃষ্ণময় ॥ ৭০ ॥

*tora kṛṣṇe anurāga ati baṛa haẏa |*
*te-kāraṇe yathā-tathā dekha kṛṣṇamaẏa || 70 ||*

*Word for word:* tora krishne anuraga — your love for Krishna; ati bada haya — is very great; te-karane — therefore; yatha-tatha dekha krishna-maya — you see everything full of Krishna

**70.** Your love for Krishna is so great
that you see Krishna everywhere.[^35-11]

কতদিনে কৃষ্ণ মুঞি দেখিবারে পাব ।
তোমার এমন বেশ কবে মোর হব ॥ ৭১ ॥

*katadine kṛṣṇa muñi dekhibāre pāba |*
*tomāra emana beśa kabe mora haba || 71 ||*

*Word for word:* katadine krishna munni — when shall I Krishna; dekhibare paba — be able to see; tomara emana besha — such garb as yours; kabe mora haba — when shall I have

**71.** When shall I be able to see Krishna?
When shall I have such garb as yours?

কৃষ্ণের উদ্দেশে মুঞি দেশে দেশে যাব ।
কোথা গেলে প্রাণনাথ কৃষ্ণ মুঞি পাব ॥ ৭২ ॥

*kṛṣṇera uddeśe muñi deśe deśe yāba |*
*kothā gele prāṇanātha kṛṣṇa muñi pāba || 72 ||*

*Word for word:* krishnera uddeshe — in search of Krishna; munni deshe deshe yaba — I shall go from land to land; kotha gele — going where; prananatha krishna munni paba — shall I find Krishna, Lord of My life

**72.** In search of Krishna I shall go from land to land:
where shall I go to find Krishna, the Lord of My life?"

সন্ন্যাসীরে বেদ্য কথা কহি' বিশ্বম্ভর ।
দণ্ডবত হঞা প্রভু যান নিজঘর ॥ ৭৩ ॥

*sannyāsīre bedya kathā kahi' biśbambhara |*
*daṇḍabata hañā prabhu yāna nijaghara || 73 ||*

*Word for word:* sannyasire vedya katha — to the sannyasi what was to be told; kahi vishvambhara — having told, Vishvambhara; dandavata haña prabhu — the Lord, bowing to the ground; yana nija-ghara — goes home

**73.** Having told the sannyasi [what lay in His heart], Vishvambhara,
the Lord, bowed to him to the ground and goes home.

শ্রীবাসে দেখিয়া প্রভু কহিল উত্তর ।
সন্ন্যাসীরে লঞা তুমি যাহ নিজঘর ॥ ৭৪ ॥

*śrībāse dekhiẏā prabhu kahila uttara |*
*sannyāsīre lañā tumi yāha nijaghara || 74 ||*

*Word for word:* shrivase dekhiya — seeing Srivasa; prabhu kahila uttara — the Lord said; sannyasire laña — taking the sannyasi; tumi yaha nija-ghara — go to your house

**74.** Seeing Srivasa, the Lord said:
"Take the sannyasi to your house."

প্রভুর বচন শুনি' শ্রীবাস ঠাকুর ।
সন্ন্যাসী লইয়া ভিক্ষা দিলেন প্রচুর ॥ ৭৫ ॥

*prabhura bacana śuni' śrībāsa ṭhākura |*
*sannyāsī laiẏā bhikṣā dilena pracura || 75 ||*

*Word for word:* prabhura vachana shuni — hearing the Lord's words; shrivasa thakura — Srivasa Thakura; sannyasi laiya — taking the sannyasi; bhiksha dilena prachura — gave him abundant alms-food

**75.** Hearing the Lord's words, Srivasa Thakura
took the sannyasi home and fed him abundantly.

ভিক্ষা করি' সে-দিন বঞ্চিয়া ন্যাসিবর ।
যথাস্থানে প্রভাতে চলিলা যতীশ্বর ॥ ৭৬ ॥

*bhikṣā kari' se-dina bañciẏā nyāsibara |*
*yathāsthāne prabhāte calilā yatīśbara || 76 ||*

*Word for word:* bhiksha kari — having taken his meal; se-dina banchiya — having spent that day; nyasi-bara — the best of sannyasis; yathasthane prabhate — at dawn on his way; chalila yatishvara — the lord of renunciants left

**76.** Having taken his meal and spent that day there,
the best of renunciants went his way at dawn.[^35-12]

প্রাতঃকালে শ্রীনিবাস প্রভুর নিকটে ।
সন্ন্যাসি-বিজয়-কথা কহে করপুটে ॥ ৭৭ ॥

*prātaḥkāle śrīnibāsa prabhura nikaṭe |*
*sannyāsi-bijaẏa-kathā kahe karapuṭe || 77 ||*

*Word for word:* pratah-kale — in the morning; shrinivasa prabhura nikate — Srinivasa before the Lord; sannyasi-vijaya-katha — the news of the sannyasi's departure; kahe karapute — tells with folded hands

**77.** In the morning Srinivasa, coming to the Lord,
with folded hands told Him that the sannyasi had left.

এ বোল শুনিঞা প্রভু কাতর-অন্তর ।
সন্ন্যাসীরে মনে করি' গেলা নিজঘর ॥ ৭৮ ॥

*e bola śuniñā prabhu kātara-antara |*
*sannyāsīre mane kari' gelā nijaghara || 78 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuniña — hearing this; prabhu katara-antara — the Lord, anguished at heart; sannyasire mane kari — thinking of the sannyasi; gela nija-ghara — went home

**78.** Hearing this, the Lord, with longing in His heart,
thinking of the sannyasi, went home.

ঘরে গিয়া মনে মনে অনুমান করি' ।
দঢ়াইলা—সন্ন্যাস করিব গৌরহরি ॥ ৭৯ ॥

*ghare giẏā mane mane anumāna kari' |*
*daṛhāilā—sannyāsa kariba gaurahari || 79 ||*

*Word for word:* ghare giya — coming home; mane mane anumana kari — reflecting within; dadhaila — resolved; sannyasa kariba — "I shall take sannyasa"; gaurahari — Gaurahari

**79.** Coming home and reflecting within,
Gaurahari resolved: "I shall take sannyasa."

ইঙ্গিত-আকারে তাহা বুঝিলা মুকুন্দ ।
প্রভু রাখিবারে করে প্রকার-প্রবন্ধ ॥ ৮০ ॥

*iṅgita-ākāre tāhā bujhilā mukunda |*
*prabhu rākhibāre kare prakāra-prabandha || 80 ||*

*Word for word:* ingita-akare — from hints and looks; taha bujhila mukunda — Mukunda understood it; prabhu rakhibare — to keep the Lord; kare prakara-prabandha — makes every kind of plan

**80.** Mukunda understood it from hints and from [the Lord's] look;
to keep the Lord, he sought every possible means.

আইলেন যথা আছে সব ভক্তগণ ।
কান্দিয়া কহিল সব ভক্তের চরণ ॥ ৮১ ॥

*āilena yathā āche saba bhaktagaṇa |*
*kāndiẏā kahila saba bhaktera caraṇa || 81 ||*

*Word for word:* ailena yatha achhe — came where were; saba bhakta-gana — all the devotees; kandiya kahila — weeping, spoke; saba bhaktera charana — [at] the feet of all the devotees

**81.** He came where all the devotees were
and, weeping, spoke, [falling] at the feet of all the devotees:

শুন শুন সর্বজন আমার উত্তর ।
সন্ন্যাস করিব এই প্রভু বিশ্বম্ভর ॥ ৮২ ॥

*śuna śuna sarbajana āmāra uttara |*
*sannyāsa kariba ei prabhu biśbambhara || 82 ||*

*Word for word:* shuna shuna sarvajana — listen, listen, all; amara uttara — to my words; sannyasa kariba — will take sannyasa; ei prabhu vishvambhara — this Lord Vishvambhara

**82.** "Listen, listen, all, to what I say:
this Lord Vishvambhara will take sannyasa.

যাবত থাকয়ে, দেখ নয়ন ভরিয়া ।
শ্রীমুখের কথা শুন শ্রবণ পূরিয়া ॥ ৮৩ ॥

*yābata thākaẏe, dekha naẏana bhariẏā |*
*śrīmukhera kathā śuna śrabaṇa pūriẏā || 83 ||*

*Word for word:* yavata thakaye — while He remains; dekha nayana bhariya — look to your eyes' content; shri-mukhera katha shuna — hear the words of His holy mouth; shravana puriya — to your ears' content

**83.** While He is here, look at Him to your eyes' content;
hear the words of His holy mouth to your ears' content.

ছাড়িয়া যাইব প্রভু নিজ গৃহবাস ।
জননী ছাড়িব আর নিজ সব দাস ॥ ৮৪ ॥

*chāṛiẏā yāiba prabhu nija gṛhabāsa |*
*jananī chāṛiba āra nija saba dāsa || 84 ||*

*Word for word:* chhadiya yaiba prabhu — the Lord will leave; nija griha-vasa — His home; janani chhadiba — will leave His mother; ara nija saba dasa — and all His servants

**84.** The Lord will leave His home,
will leave His mother and all His servants."

এ বোল শুনিঞা সভে ব্যথিত-হিয়ায় ।
যুকতি করিয়া মনে চিন্তয়ে উপায় ॥ ৮৫ ॥

*e bola śuniñā sabhe byathita-hiẏāẏa |*
*yukati kariẏā mane cintaẏe upāẏa || 85 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuniña — hearing this; sabhe vyathita-hiyaya — all with aching hearts; yukati kariya — taking counsel; mane chintaye upaya — ponder a means

**85.** Hearing this, all, with aching hearts,
took counsel together and pondered what to do.

স্বতন্ত্র ঈশ্বর না রহিব কারু বশে ।
ইহা বলি' ভক্ত সব পড়িলা তরাসে ॥ ৮৬ ॥

*sbatantra īśbara nā rahiba kāru baśe |*
*ihā bali' bhakta saba paṛilā tarāse || 86 ||*

*Word for word:* svatantra ishvara — the independent Lord; na rahiba karu bashe — will stay in no one's power; iha bali — saying this; bhakta saba padila tarase — all the devotees fell into dread

**86.** "The independent Lord will stay in no one's power" —
saying this, the devotees fell into dread.

ভূমিতে পড়িয়া কান্দে ধূলায় ধূসর ।
প্রাণনাথ আরে মোর প্রভু বিশ্বম্ভর ॥ ৮৭ ॥

*bhūmite paṛiẏā kānde dhūlāẏa dhūsara |*
*prāṇanātha āre mora prabhu biśbambhara || 87 ||*

*Word for word:* bhumite padiya kande — falling on the ground they weep; dhulaya dhusara — grey with dust; prananatha are mora — O Lord of our life; prabhu vishvambhara — Lord Vishvambhara

**87.** Falling on the ground, covered with dust, they weep:
"O Lord of our life, our Lord Vishvambhara!

হা হা মহাপ্রভু কোথা যাইবে এড়িয়া ।
মো-সভারে কলিসর্পে খাইবে ধরিয়া ॥ ৮৮ ॥

*hā hā mahāprabhu kothā yāibe eṛiẏā |*
*mo-sabhāre kalisarpe khāibe dhariẏā || 88 ||*

*Word for word:* ha ha mahaprabhu — alas, alas, Mahaprabhu; kotha yaibe ediya — where will You go, forsaking [us]; mo-sabhare — all of us; kali-sarpe khaibe dhariya — the serpent of Kali will seize and devour

**88.** Alas, alas, Mahaprabhu! Where are You going, forsaking [us]?
The serpent of Kali will seize and devour us.

কলি-ভয়ে তোর প্রভু লইনু শরণ ।
তোর ভয়ে কলিসর্প না লঙ্ঘে এখন ॥ ৮৯ ॥

*kali-bhaẏe tora prabhu lainu śaraṇa |*
*tora bhaẏe kalisarpa nā laṅghe ekhana || 89 ||*

*Word for word:* kali-bhaye — in fear of Kali; tora prabhu lainu sharana — we took refuge in You, Lord; tora bhaye — in fear of You; kali-sarpa na langhe ekhana — the serpent of Kali does not now cross over

**89.** In fear of Kali we took refuge in You, Lord;
in fear of You the serpent of Kali does not come near us now."

হেনকালে আসি' তথা প্রভু বিশ্বম্ভর ।
শ্রীবাস পণ্ডিত দেখি' কহিল উত্তর ॥ ৯০ ॥

*henakāle āsi' tathā prabhu biśbambhara |*
*śrībāsa paṇḍita dekhi' kahila uttara || 90 ||*

*Word for word:* henakale asi tatha — at that time, coming there; prabhu vishvambhara — Lord Vishvambhara; shrivasa pandita dekhi — seeing Srivasa Pandita; kahila uttara — said

**90.** At that time Lord Vishvambhara came there;
seeing Srivasa Pandita, He said:

শুন শুন ওহে দ্বিজ প্রিয় শ্রীনিবাস ।
এক কথা কহি, যদি না পাও তরাস ॥ ৯১ ॥

*śuna śuna ohe dbija priẏa śrīnibāsa |*
*eka kathā kahi, yadi nā pāo tarāsa || 91 ||*

*Word for word:* shuna shuna ohe dvija — listen, listen, O brahmana; priya shrinivasa — dear Srinivasa; eka katha kahi — I tell one thing; yadi na pao tarasa — if you will not be frightened

**91.** "Listen, listen, O dear brahmana Srinivasa:
I shall tell you one thing, if you will not be frightened.

প্রেম-উপার্জনে আমি যাব দেশান্তর ।
তো-সভারে আনি' দিব, শুন দ্বিজবর ॥ ৯২ ॥

*prema-upārjane āmi yāba deśāntara |*
*to-sabhāre āni' diba, śuna dbijabara || 92 ||*

*Word for word:* prema-uparjane — to earn prema; ami yaba deshantara — I shall go to distant lands; to-sabhare ani diba — I shall bring and give to you; shuna dvijabara — listen, best of brahmanas

**92.** To earn prema I shall go to distant lands,
and then I shall bring it to you — listen, best of brahmanas.

সাধু যেন নৌকা চড়ি' যায় দূরদেশ ।
ধন-উপার্জন লাগি' করে নানা ক্লেশ ॥ ৯৩ ॥

*sādhu yena naukā caṛi' yāẏa dūradeśa |*
*dhana-upārjana lāgi' kare nānā kleśa || 93 ||*

*Word for word:* sadhu yena — as a merchant; nauka chadi — boarding a boat; yaya dura-desha — goes to a far country; dhana-uparjana lagi — to earn wealth; kare nana klesha — endures many hardships

**93.** As a merchant boards a boat and sails to a far country,
enduring all manner of hardships to earn wealth,

আনিঞা বান্ধবগণে করয়ে পোষণ ।
আমিহ এছন আনি' দিব প্রেমধন ॥ ৯৪ ॥

*āniñā bāndhabagaṇe karaẏe poṣaṇa |*
*āmiha echana āni' diba premadhana || 94 ||*

*Word for word:* aniña — bringing it; bandhava-gane karaye poshana — maintains his kinsmen; amiha echhana — so I too; ani diba prema-dhana — shall bring and give the wealth of prema

**94.** and, bringing it home, maintains his kinsmen —
so I too shall bring and give you the wealth of prema."[^35-13]

এ বোল শুনিঞা কহে শ্রীবাস পণ্ডিত ।
তোমা না দেখিয়া প্রভু কি কাজ জীবিত ॥ ৯৫ ॥

*e bola śuniñā kahe śrībāsa paṇḍita |*
*tomā nā dekhiẏā prabhu ki kāja jībita || 95 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuniña — hearing this; kahe shrivasa pandita — Srivasa Pandita says; toma na dekhiya — without seeing You; prabhu ki kaja jivita — Lord, what use is life

**95.** Hearing this, Srivasa Pandita says:
"Lord, what is life if we cannot see You?

জীবিত শরীরে বন্ধু করয়ে পোষণ ।
দেহান্তরে করে তার শ্রাদ্ধ-তর্পণ ॥ ৯৬ ॥

*jībita śarīre bandhu karaẏe poṣaṇa |*
*dehāntare kare tāra śrāddha-tarpaṇa || 96 ||*

*Word for word:* jivita sharire — while the body lives; bandhu karaye poshana — kinsmen maintain [him]; dehantare — after death; kare tara shraddha-tarpana — perform his shraddha and tarpana

**96.** While a man lives, his kinsmen maintain him;
when he has left his body, they perform shraddha and tarpana for him.

যে জীয়ে তাহারে তুমি দিও প্রেমধন ।
তোমা না দেখিলে হবে সভার মরণ ॥ ৯৭ ॥

*ye jīẏe tāhāre tumi dio premadhana |*
*tomā nā dekhile habe sabhāra maraṇa || 97 ||*

*Word for word:* ye jiye — whoever lives; tahare tumi dio prema-dhana — to them give the wealth of prema; toma na dekhile — without seeing You; habe sabhara marana — all will die

**97.** It is to those who live that You will give the wealth of prema —
but without seeing You, all will die."

মুকুন্দ কহয়ে—প্রভু পোড়য়ে শরীর ।
অন্তরে পোড়য়ে প্রাণ, না হয় বাহির ॥ ৯৮ ॥

*mukunda kahaẏe—prabhu poṛaẏe śarīra |*
*antare poṛaẏe prāṇa, nā haẏa bāhira || 98 ||*

*Word for word:* mukunda kahaye — Mukunda says; prabhu podaye sharira — Lord, the body burns; antare podaye prana — within, the life burns; na haya bahira — and does not depart

**98.** Mukunda says: "Lord, the body burns,
within, the life burns — and yet does not depart.

মোরা সব অধম দুরন্ত দুরাচার ।
তুমি শঠ খলমতি—বুঝিল বেভার ॥ ৯৯ ॥

*morā saba adhama duranta durācāra |*
*tumi śaṭha khalamati—bujhila bebhāra || 99 ||*

*Word for word:* mora saba adhama — we are all low; duranta durachara — wicked, ill-behaved; tumi shatha khala-mati — You are a deceiver, crafty-hearted; bujhila bebhara — we understood [Your] ways

**99.** We are all low, wicked and ill-behaved;
and You are a deceiver, crafty-hearted: now we understand Your ways.[^35-14]

অচতুর-গণ মোরা না বুঝিয়া তোরে ।
শরণ লইনু সর্ব ছাড়িয়া সংসারে ॥ ১০০ ॥

*acatura-gaṇa morā nā bujhiẏā tore |*
*śaraṇa lainu sarba chāṛiẏā saṃsāre || 100 ||*

*Word for word:* achatura-gana mora — we simple folk; na bujhiya tore — not understanding You; sharana lainu — took refuge; sarva chhadiya samsare — giving up the whole world

**100.** We simple folk, not understanding You,
took refuge in You, giving up the world;

ধর্ম কর্ম ছাড়ি' তোর পদ কৈনু সারে ।
পতিত করিয়া কেনে ছাড় মো-সভারে ॥ ১০১ ॥

*dharma karma chāṛi' tora pada kainu sāre |*
*patita kariẏā kene chāṛa mo-sabhāre || 101 ||*

*Word for word:* dharma karma chhadi — giving up dharma and karma; tora pada kainu sare — we made Your feet our all; patita kariya — having made outcasts; kene chhada mo-sabhare — why do You forsake us

**101.** giving up dharma and karma, we made Your feet our all —
and You, having made us outcasts, why do You forsake us?

পতিতপাবন তুমি শাস্ত্রেতে জানিঞা ।
শরণ লইনু সর্বধর্মেরে ছাড়িয়া ॥ ১০২ ॥

*patitapābana tumi śāstrete jāniñā |*
*śaraṇa lainu sarbadharmere chāṛiẏā || 102 ||*

*Word for word:* patita-pavana tumi — that You are the Purifier of the fallen; shastrete janiña — knowing from the scriptures; sharana lainu — we took refuge; sarva-dharmere chhadiya — giving up all dharmas

**102.** Knowing from the scriptures that You are the Purifier of the fallen,
we took refuge in You, giving up all dharmas.

এখনে ছাড়িয়া যাহ মো-সভারে তুমি ।
এ নহে উচিত প্রভু—নিবেদিল আমি ॥ ১০৩ ॥

*ekhane chāṛiẏā yāha mo-sabhāre tumi |*
*e nahe ucita prabhu—nibedila āmi || 103 ||*

*Word for word:* ekhane chhadiya yaha — now You go, leaving; mo-sabhare tumi — You, us; e nahe uchita prabhu — this is not right, Lord; nivedila ami — I humbly submit

**103.** And now You are going away, forsaking us —
this is not right, Lord — I humbly say.

খলমতি না বুঝিয়া লইনু শরণ ।
বজর-অন্তর তোর হৃদয় কঠিন ॥ ১০৪ ॥

*khalamati nā bujhiẏā lainu śaraṇa |*
*bajara-antara tora hṛdaẏa kaṭhina || 104 ||*

*Word for word:* khala-mati na bujhiya — not perceiving the crafty mind; lainu sharana — we took refuge; bajara-antara tora — Your heart is a thunderbolt; hridaya kathina — hard

**104.** Not perceiving Your crafty mind, we took refuge in You —
but Your heart is harder than a thunderbolt, cruel.

বাহিরে কমল-রস-সুগন্ধি পাইয়া ।
অন্তরেহ এই মত ছিল মোর হিয়া ॥ ১০৫ ॥

*bāhire kamala-rasa-sugandhi pāiẏā |*
*antareha ei mata chila mora hiẏā || 105 ||*

*Word for word:* bahire — outside; kamala-rasa-sugandhi paiya — catching the fragrance of the lotus's nectar; antareha ei mata — the same within; chhila mora hiya — so my heart thought

**105.** Catching outside the fragrance of the lotus's nectar,
I thought it was the same within — so it was in my heart.

এখন জানিল তোর কঠিন অন্তর ।
বিষকুম্ভ পয় যেন তাহার উপর ॥ ১০৬ ॥

*ekhana jānila tora kaṭhina antara |*
*biṣakumbha paẏa yena tāhāra upara || 106 ||*

*Word for word:* ekhana janila — now I know; tora kathina antara — Your hard heart; vishakumbha — a pot of poison; paya yena tahara upara — with milk, as it were, on top

**106.** Now I know how hard Your heart is:
like a pot of poison with milk on top.

কাষ্ঠের মোদক যেন কর্পূর ছাইয়া ।
গিলিতে না পারে যেন তাহা না বুঝিয়া ॥ ১০৭ ॥

*kāṣṭhera modaka yena karpūra chāiẏā |*
*gilite nā pāre yena tāhā nā bujhiẏā || 107 ||*

*Word for word:* kashthera modaka yena — like a wooden sweetball; karpura chhaiya — dusted with camphor; gilite na pare — one cannot swallow; yena taha na bujhiya — not seeing what it is

**107.** Like a wooden sweetball dusted with camphor:
one cannot swallow it, not seeing what it is.[^35-15]

কুলবতী যেন কামে হৈয়া অচেতনে ।
পিরীতি করয়ে পর-পুরুষের সনে ॥ ১০৭+১ ॥

*kulabatī yena kāme haiẏā acetane |*
*pirīti karaẏe para-puruṣera sane || 107+1 ||*

*Word for word:* kulavati yena — as a wife of good family; kame haiya achetane — blinded by desire; piriti karaye — enters into love; para-purushera sane — with another man

**107+1.** As a wife of good family, blinded by desire,
enters into love with another man[^35-16]

ধর্ম কর্ম লজ্জা ছাড়ি' করয়ে বেভারে ।
কলঙ্কী করিয়া শেষে ছাড়য়ে তাহারে ॥ ১০৭+২ ॥

*dharma karma lajjā chāṛi' karaẏe bebhāre |*
*kalaṅkī kariẏā śeṣe chāṛaẏe tāhāre || 107+2 ||*

*Word for word:* dharma karma lajja chhadi — abandoning dharma, duty and shame; karaye bebhare — acts accordingly; kalanki kariya — having disgraced her; sheshe chhadaye tahare — abandons her in the end

**107+2.** and, abandoning dharma, duty and shame, acts accordingly —
and he, having disgraced her, abandons her in the end;

সে নারী অনাথ শেষে হয় দুই কুলে ।
সেইমত মো-সবারে ভাসাবে অকূলে ॥ ১০৭+৩ ॥

*se nārī anātha śeṣe haẏa dui kule |*
*seimata mo-sabāre bhāsābe akūle || 107+3 ||*

*Word for word:* se nari anatha — that woman without support; sheshe haya dui kule — is left in the end in both families; seimata — so too; mo-sabare bhasabe akule — You will set us all adrift on the shoreless

**107+3.** and that woman is left without support in both families —
so too will You set us all adrift on the shoreless [ocean].

তুমি দেশান্তরে যাবে, কি কাজ জীবনে ।
সভারে নিঠুর তুমি হৈলা কি কারণে ॥ ১০৮ ॥

*tumi deśāntare yābe, ki kāja jībane |*
*sabhāre niṭhura tumi hailā ki kāraṇe || 108 ||*

*Word for word:* tumi deshantare yabe — if You go to distant lands; ki kaja jivane — what use is life; sabhare nithura tumi — cruel to all You; haila ki karane — why have You become

**108.** If You go to distant lands, what use is life?
Why have You become cruel to all?"

তিল এক তোর মুখ না দেখিলে মরি ।
কান্দিতে কান্দিতে কিছু কহয়ে মুরারি ॥ ১০৯ ॥

*tila eka tora mukha nā dekhile mari |*
*kāndite kāndite kichu kahaẏe murāri || 109 ||*

*Word for word:* tila eka — for even a moment; tora mukha na dekhile mari — if I do not see Your face, I die; kandite kandite — weeping and weeping; kichhu kahaye murari — Murari says

**109.** "If I do not see Your face for even a moment, I die!" —
weeping and weeping, Murari says:

শুন শুন বিশ্বম্ভর গৌর ভগবান্ ।
অধম মুরারি বোলে, কর অবধান ॥ ১১০ ॥

*śuna śuna biśbambhara gaura bhagabān |*
*adhama murāri bole, kara abadhāna || 110 ||*

*Word for word:* shuna shuna vishvambhara — listen, listen, Vishvambhara; gaura bhagavan — Gaura Bhagavan; adhama murari bole — unworthy Murari speaks; kara avadhana — pay heed

**110.** "Listen, listen, Vishvambhara, Gaura Bhagavan:
unworthy Murari speaks — pay heed!

রোপিলে অপূর্ব বৃক্ষ অঙ্গুলি ধরিয়া ।
বাঢ়াইলে দিবানিশি সিঞ্চিয়া খুঁড়িয়া ॥ ১১১ ॥

*ropile apūrba bṛkṣa aṅguli dhariẏā |*
*bāṛhāile dibāniśi siñciẏā khuṁṛiẏā || 111 ||*

*Word for word:* ropile apurva vriksha — You planted a wondrous tree; anguli dhariya — holding it with Your fingers; badhaile divanishi — You made it grow day and night; sinchiya khundiya — watering and loosening the soil

**111.** You planted a wondrous tree, holding it with Your fingers,
You made it grow day and night, watering it and loosening the soil;

তিলে তিলে রাখিলে ঢাকিলে বহু যত্নে ।
বান্ধিলে তরুর মূল দিয়া নানা রত্নে ॥ ১১২ ॥

*tile tile rākhile ḍhākile bahu yatne |*
*bāndhile tarura mūla diẏā nānā ratne || 112 ||*

*Word for word:* tile tile rakhile — You tended it moment by moment; dhakile bahu yatne — covered it with great care; bandhile tarura mula — You bound the root of the tree; diya nana ratne — with all kinds of jewels

**112.** moment by moment You tended it, covered it with great care,
and laid all kinds of jewels about the tree's root —

ফল-ফুল-কালে গাছ ফেলাহ কাটিয়া ।
মরিব আমরা সব হৃদয় ফাটিয়া ॥ ১১৩ ॥

*phala-phula-kāle gācha phelāha kāṭiẏā |*
*mariba āmarā saba hṛdaẏa phāṭiẏā || 113 ||*

*Word for word:* phala-phula-kale — at the time of fruit and flower; gachha phelaha katiya — You cut the tree down; mariba amara saba — we shall all die; hridaya phatiya — our hearts bursting

**113.** and now, when the time of flowers and fruit has come, You cut the tree down:
we shall all die, our hearts will burst.

নিরন্তর দিবানিশি আন নাহি জানি ।
স্বপনেহ দেখোঁ তোর চান্দমুখখানি ॥ ১১৪ ॥

*nirantara dibāniśi āna nāhi jāni |*
*sbapaneha dekhoṁ tora cāndamukhakhāni || 114 ||*

*Word for word:* nirantara divanishi — ceaselessly, day and night; ana nahi jani — we know nothing else; svapaneha dekhon — even in dreams I see; tora chanda-mukhakhani — Your moon-like face

**114.** Ceaselessly, day and night, we know nothing else;
even in dreams we see Your moon-like face.

সংসার-বাসনা মোর নিয়ড় না হয় ।
জগত-দুর্লভ তব চরণের বায় ॥ ১১৫ ॥

*saṃsāra-bāsanā mora niẏaṛa nā haẏa |*
*jagata-durlabha taba caraṇera bāẏa || 115 ||*

*Word for word:* samsara-vasana — worldly desires; mora niyada na haya — do not come near me; jagata-durlabha — rare in the world; taba charanera baya — the breeze from Your feet

**115.** Worldly desires do not come near me:
[mine is] the breeze from Your feet, rare in the world.

তুমি দেশান্তরে যাবে সভারে এড়িয়া ।
খাইব সংসার-ব্যাঘ্রে সভারে ধরিয়া ॥ ১১৬ ॥

*tumi deśāntare yābe sabhāre eṛiẏā |*
*khāiba saṃsāra-byāghre sabhāre dhariẏā || 116 ||*

*Word for word:* tumi deshantare yabe — You will go to distant lands; sabhare ediya — leaving all; khaiba samsara-vyaghre — the tiger of samsara will devour; sabhare dhariya — seizing all

**116.** You will go to distant lands, leaving everyone —
and the tiger of samsara will seize and devour us all.

দয়া করি' নিদারুণ হৈলে কি কারণে ।
ইহা বলি' সভে মেলি' পড়িলা চরণে ॥ ১১৭ ॥

*daẏā kari' nidāruṇa haile ki kāraṇe |*
*ihā bali' sabhe meli' paṛilā caraṇe || 117 ||*

*Word for word:* daya kari — having been merciful; nidaruna haile ki karane — why have You become pitiless; iha bali — saying this; sabhe meli padila charane — all together fell at [His] feet

**117.** You were merciful — why have You become pitiless?" —
saying this, they all together fell at [His] feet:

ওহে দীনবন্ধু প্রভু অনাথের নাথ ।
পতিত-তারণ ওহে তুমি জগন্নাথ ॥ ১১৮ ॥

*ohe dīnabandhu prabhu anāthera nātha |*
*patita-tāraṇa ohe tumi jagannātha || 118 ||*

*Word for word:* ohe dinabandhu prabhu — O friend of the poor, Lord; anathera natha — master of the masterless; patita-tarana — Deliverer of the fallen; ohe tumi jagannatha — O You, Lord of the world

**118.** "O friend of the poor, Lord, master of the masterless!
O Deliverer of the fallen, Lord of the world!"

কেহো দন্তে তৃণ ধরি' কাতর বচনে ।
কেহো ঊর্ধ্বে বাহু তুলি' ডাকে ঘনে ঘনে ॥ ১১৯ ॥

*keho dante tṛṇa dhari' kātara bacane |*
*keho ūrdhbe bāhu tuli' ḍāke ghane ghane || 119 ||*

*Word for word:* keho dante trina dhari — some, with straw in their teeth; katara vachane — with piteous words; keho urdhve bahu tuli — some, raising their arms; dake ghane ghane — call again and again

**119.** Some, with straw between their teeth, plead piteously,
some, raising their arms, call again and again.

প্রভু কহে—তোমরা আমার নিজ-দাস ।
তো-সভারে কহি, শুন আপন বিশ্বাস ॥ ১২০ ॥

*prabhu kahe—tomarā āmāra nija-dāsa |*
*to-sabhāre kahi, śuna āpana biśbāsa || 120 ||*

*Word for word:* prabhu kahe — the Lord says; tomara amara nija-dasa — you are My own servants; to-sabhare kahi — I tell you; shuna apana vishvasa — hear My conviction

**120.** The Lord says: "You are My very own servants;
I shall tell you My inmost conviction — listen."

কহিতে আরম্ভমাত্র গদগদ স্বর ।
অরুণ-কমল-আঁখি করে ছলছল ॥ ১২১ ॥

*kahite ārambhamātra gadagada sbara |*
*aruṇa-kamala-āṁkhi kare chalachala || 121 ||*

*Word for word:* kahite arambha-matra — as soon as He began to speak; gadgada svara — the voice broke; aruna-kamala-ankhi — the reddish lotus eyes; kare chhalachhala — brimmed with tears

**121.** As soon as He began to speak, His voice broke,
His reddish lotus eyes filled with tears.

সকরুণ কণ্ঠে আধ-আধ বাণী কহে ।
সম্বরিতে নারে, ক্ষণে নিঃশব্দে রহে ॥ ১২২ ॥

*sakaruṇa kaṇṭhe ādha-ādha bāṇī kahe |*
*sambarite nāre, kṣaṇe niḥśabde rahe || 122 ||*

*Word for word:* sakaruna kanthe — in a piteous voice; adha-adha vani kahe — speaks half-words; sambarite nare — unable to restrain Himself; kshane nihshabde rahe — for a moment falls silent

**122.** In a piteous voice He speaks half-words;
unable to restrain Himself, for a moment He falls silent.

আমার বিচ্ছেদ-ভয়ে তোমরা কাতর ।
মোর কৃষ্ণ-বিরহে ব্যাকুল কলেবর ॥ ১২৩ ॥

*āmāra biccheda-bhaẏe tomarā kātara |*
*mora kṛṣṇa-birahe byākula kalebara || 123 ||*

*Word for word:* amara vichchheda-bhaye — from fear of separation from Me; tomara katara — you are distressed; mora krishna-virahe — in separation from Krishna; vyakula kalebara — My body is in torment

**123.** "You are distressed by fear of separation from Me —
but My body is in torment from separation from Krishna.

আত্মসুখ লাগি' তোরা মোরে দেহ দুখ ।
কেমন পিরীতি কর মোরে তোরা লোক ॥ ১২৪ ॥

*ātmasukha lāgi' torā more deha dukha |*
*kemana pirīti kara more torā loka || 124 ||*

*Word for word:* atma-sukha lagi — for your own happiness; tora more deha dukha — you give Me pain; kemana piriti kara — what love do you have; more tora loka — for Me, you people

**124.** For your own happiness you cause Me pain:
what kind of love is this you have for Me, you people?

কৃষ্ণের বিরহে মোর পোড়য়ে অন্তর ।
দগধ ইন্দ্রিয়, দেহে ভেল মহাজ্বর ॥ ১২৫ ॥

*kṛṣṇera birahe mora poṛaẏe antara |*
*dagadha indriẏa, dehe bhela mahājbara || 125 ||*

*Word for word:* krishnera virahe — in separation from Krishna; mora podaye antara — My heart burns; dagadha indriya — the senses scorched; dehe bhela maha-jvara — a great fever seized the body

**125.** In separation from Krishna My heart burns;
My senses are scorched — a great fever has seized My body.

অগ্নি হেন লাগে মোর সে-হেন জননী ।
বিষ মিশাইল যেন তো-সভার বাণী ॥ ১২৬ ॥

*agni hena lāge mora se-hena jananī |*
*biṣa miśāila yena to-sabhāra bāṇī || 126 ||*

*Word for word:* agni hena lage mora — seems to Me like fire; se-hena janani — even such a mother; visha mishaila yena — as if mixed with poison; to-sabhara vani — are your words

**126.** Even such a [loving] mother seems to Me like fire,
and your words seem mixed with poison.[^35-17]

কৃষ্ণ বিনু জীবন জীবনে নাহি লেখি ।
কি কাজ এছার জীবে, যেন পশু পাখী ॥ ১২৭ ॥

*kṛṣṇa binu jībana jībane nāhi lekhi |*
*ki kāja echāra jībe, yena paśu pākhī || 127 ||*

*Word for word:* krishna vinu jivana — life without Krishna; jivane nahi lekhi — I do not count as life; ki kaja echhara jive — what use is such a life; yena pashu pakhi — like beasts and birds

**127.** Life without Krishna I do not count as life:
what use is such a life — like that of beasts and birds?

মড়ার যে-হেন সর্ব অবয়ব আছে ।
জীবে জীয়ায় যেন লতা পাতা গাছে ॥ ১২৮ ॥

*maṛāra ye-hena sarba abaẏaba āche |*
*jībe jīẏāẏa yena latā pātā gāche || 128 ||*

*Word for word:* madara ye-hena — as a corpse; sarva avayava achhe — has all its limbs; jive jiyaya — live by breath; yena lata pata gachhe — as creepers, leaves, trees

**128.** Like a corpse that has all its limbs;
so creepers, leaves and trees live by their breath.

কৃষ্ণ বিনু ধর্ম কর্ম, দ্বিজ বেদহীন ।
পতি বিনু যুবতী যেন, জল বিনু মীন ॥ ১২৯ ॥

*kṛṣṇa binu dharma karma, dbija bedahīna |*
*pati binu yubatī yena, jala binu mīna || 129 ||*

*Word for word:* krishna vinu dharma karma — dharma and karma without Krishna; dvija veda-hina — [are like] a brahmana without the Vedas; pati vinu yuvati yena — like a young wife without her husband; jala vinu mina — a fish without water

**129.** Dharma and karma without Krishna are like a brahmana without the Vedas,
like a faithful wife without her husband, a fish without water.

ধনহীন গৃহারম্ভে কিছু নাহি কাজ ।
বিদ্যাহীন বৈসে যেন বিদ্বান-সমাজ ॥ ১৩০ ॥

*dhanahīna gṛhārambhe kichu nāhi kāja |*
*bidyāhīna baise yena bidbāna-samāja || 130 ||*

*Word for word:* dhana-hina griharambhe — to set up a household without means; kichhu nahi kaja — is of no use; vidya-hina vaise yena — like an unlearned man sitting; vidvana-samaja — in an assembly of the learned

**130.** There is no point in setting up a household without means;
it is like an unlearned man sitting in an assembly of the learned.

কৃষ্ণের বিরহে মোর ধকধক প্রাণ ।
আর যত বোল, তাহা না সাম্ভায়ে কাণ ॥ ১৩১ ॥

*kṛṣṇera birahe mora dhakadhaka prāṇa |*
*āra yata bola, tāhā nā sāmbhāẏe kāṇa || 131 ||*

*Word for word:* krishnera virahe — in separation from Krishna; mora dhakadhaka prana — My life throbs; ara yata bola — whatever else you say; taha na sambhaye kana — does not enter My ears

**131.** In separation from Krishna My life throbs —
whatever else you may say does not enter My ears.

ধরিয়া যোগীর বেশ যাব দেশে দেশে ।
যথা গেলে পাঙ প্রাণনাথের উদ্দেশ ॥ ১৩২ ॥

*dhariẏā yogīra beśa yāba deśe deśe |*
*yathā gele pāṅa prāṇanāthera uddeśa || 132 ||*

*Word for word:* dhariya yogira besha — putting on a yogi's garb; yaba deshe deshe — I shall go from land to land; yatha gele panga — wherever going I may find; prananathera uddesha — news of the Lord of My life

**132.** Putting on a yogi's garb, I shall go from land to land —
to wherever I may find news of the Lord of My life."

ইহা বলি' কান্দে প্রভু ধরণী পড়িয়া ।
নিজ-অঙ্গ-উপবীত ফেলিল ছিণ্ডিয়া ॥ ১৩৩ ॥

*ihā bali' kānde prabhu dharaṇī paṛiẏā |*
*nija-aṅga-upabīta phelila chiṇḍiẏā || 133 ||*

*Word for word:* iha bali — saying this; kande prabhu — the Lord weeps; dharani padiya — fallen on the ground; nija-anga-upavita — the sacred thread on His body; phelila chhindiya — tore off and cast away

**133.** Saying this, the Lord weeps, fallen on the ground,
and tore the sacred thread from His body.

কৃষ্ণ কৃষ্ণ বলি' ডাকে অতি আর্তনাদে ।
সকরুণ-স্বরে প্রাণনাথ বলি' কান্দে ॥ ১৩৪ ॥

*kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa bali' ḍāke ati ārtanāde |*
*sakaruṇa-sbare prāṇanātha bali' kānde || 134 ||*

*Word for word:* krishna krishna bali dake — calls "Krishna, Krishna!"; ati arta-nade — with an anguished cry; sakaruna-svare — in a piteous voice; prananatha bali kande — weeps: "Lord of My life!"

**134.** "Krishna, Krishna!" He calls with an anguished cry,
and in a piteous voice weeps: "Lord of My life!"

[^35-1]: The OCR of the summary is badly garbled; gaps are filled by sense and from the table of contents in the edition's preface ("the Lord, telling Srivasa of the dharmas of the four yugas, reveals the superiority of sankirtana; in the bhava of Radha, agitation [crying], 'Where is Vrindavana, where is Lalita?'; calmed by Murari's words — kirtana and pastimes; the account to mother Shachi of receiving the sannyasa mantra in a dream; the arrival of Keshava Bharati; the Lord's separation from Krishna; the devotees' grieving words in anxiety about the Lord's sannyasa; the Lord consoles the devotees"). In the poem the Lord tells the dream to all His own (vv. 49–50). In the 1983 edition vv. 1–24 belong to the previous chapter, and the new chapter ("सन्न्यास प्रसङ्ग") begins with v. 25.
[^35-2]: Vv. 1–13 — cf. Murari 2.17.1–4: for seven days the Lord's radiance did not fade in Chandrashekhara's house.
[^35-3]: The more wicked the age, the greater the Lord's mercy: He Himself comes as the holy name and sankirtana.
[^35-4]: Vv. 14–23 — cf. Murari 2.17.5–10; Bhagavata 12.3.52: what was attained by meditation in the Satya age, by yajnas in the Treta and by worship in the Dvapara is attained in the Kali age by the kirtana of Hari.
[^35-5]: Shridama and Sudama are Krishna's cowherd friends; Dhavali and Shangali are His cows. The Lord is in the bhava of separation from Vraja; Bhaktisiddhanta's summary says "in the bhava of Radha".
[^35-6]: Cf. Murari 2.17.12–13. The Lord tears off His thread once more in v. 133.
[^35-7]: Vv. 34–40 — cf. Murari 2.17.14–19: Murari reminds Him that people follow the Lord's example.
[^35-8]: Vishnupriya is the Lord's eternal consort, His shakti; her pastimes with the Lord are not worldly.
[^35-9]: On nagari-bhava see en/09, note 9.
[^35-10]: Cf. Murari 2.18.1–5. The sannyasa mantra in its wording speaks of identity with Brahman ("I am He"); Murari proposes to understand it through the genitive case (shashthi-samasa): not "I am He" but "I am His", that is, the eternal servant of the Lord. The Lord answers that the very power of the words will not let Him rest (v. 58).
[^35-11]: The Lord, playing the part of a devotee, deflects Keshava Bharati's praise and ascribes his vision to his own love for Krishna. Vv. 60–72 — cf. Murari 2.18.7–15.
[^35-12]: Keshava Bharati is the future sannyasa-guru of the Lord at Kantakanagara (Katwa). Vv. 73–79 — cf. Murari 2.18.15–16.
[^35-13]: Cf. Murari 2.18.19–22.
[^35-14]: The words "deceiver", "crafty", "cruel" (vv. 99–108) are reproaches of love (pranaya), like the gopis' reproaches to Krishna, not abuse: Mukunda speaks in the grief of separation.
[^35-15]: Both proverbs are about one who is sweet outside but different within. In A v. 107 is misprinted as "১০৮".
[^35-16]: Vv. 107+1 — 107+3 are found only in the 1983 edition (absent from Bhaktisiddhanta's edition); the 1903 edition has them in the main text. This worldly comparison is the language of loving reproach: the devotees, who for the Lord's sake gave up everything, fear being left without support (cf. the gopis' reproaches to Krishna before His departure for Mathura); the Lord Himself is not being spoken of as a worldly seducer.
[^35-17]: The extreme of separation from Krishna (vipralambha), when everything, even the dearest, burns like fire. Cf. Murari 2.17.12–13.

---

# Madhya-khanda, part 13 (portion 36)

*The section "Before Sannyasa" (end): the Lord speaks of the cruelty of samsara and of how only service to Krishna gives meaning to human birth, and consoles the devotees. The section "Mother Shachi's Grief": Shachi's lament and her pleading; the Lord begins the story of Dhruva — Dhruva's hurt, his mother's counsel, the meeting with Narada, the journey to Madhuvana*

*Raga vibhasa, the taraja tune; disha: "na hare are haya"*

শুন সর্বজন, সংসার দারুণ,
সংশয় করিল মোরে ।
বিষম বিষয়, যেন বিষময়,
গুপতে অন্তর পোড়ে ॥ ১৩৫ ॥

*śuna sarbajana, saṃsāra dāruṇa,*
*saṃśaẏa karila more |*
*biṣama biṣaẏa, yena biṣamaẏa,*
*gupate antara poṛe || 135 ||*

*Word for word:* shuna sarvajana — listen, all; samsara daruna — cruel samsara; samshaya karila more — has put Me in peril; vishama vishaya — dreadful sense-objects; yena vishamaya — as if full of poison; gupate antara pode — secretly burn the heart

**135.** "Listen, all: cruel samsara
has put Me in peril;[^36-1]
the dreadful objects of the senses, as if full of poison,
secretly burn the heart.

যতেক ইন্দ্রিয়গণ, বলিয়ে আপন,
বাসনা না ছাড়ে কেহো ।
নিত্যই নূতন, করাই ভোজন,
তবু না লেউটে সেহো ॥ ১৩৬ ॥

*yateka indriẏagaṇa, baliẏe āpana,*
*bāsanā nā chāṛe keho |*
*nityai nūtana, karāi bhojana,*
*tabu nā leuṭe seho || 136 ||*

*Word for word:* yateka indriya-gana — all the senses; baliye apana — that one calls one's own; vasana na chhade keho — none gives up its craving; nityai nutana — ever new; karai bhojana — I feed them; tabu na leute seho — still they do not turn back

**136.** All the senses one calls one's own —
not one gives up its cravings;
however much one feeds them with ever new things,
they will not turn back.

লোভ মোহ কাম, কেহো নহে ন্যূন,
মদ অভিমান ক্রোধে ।
চিত চুরি করি', আছয়ে সম্বরি',
তিলেক নাহি প্রবোধে ॥ ১৩৭ ॥

*lobha moha kāma, keho nahe nyūna,*
*mada abhimāna krodhe |*
*cita curi kari', āchaẏe sambari',*
*tileka nāhi prabodhe || 137 ||*

*Word for word:* lobha moha kama — greed, delusion, lust; keho nahe nyuna — none is weaker; mada abhimana krodhe — with pride, conceit and anger; chita churi kari — having stolen the mind; achhaye sambari — lie hidden; tileka nahi prabodhe — are never calmed for a moment

**137.** Greed, delusion, lust — none is weaker,
and with them pride, conceit and anger;
having stolen the mind, they lie hidden in it
and are never calmed for a moment.

বাহিরে বান্ধয়ে, ভ্রমাই মায়ায়ে,
আশ্রয় এ জাতি-কুলে ।
কৃষ্ণ পাশরিয়া, বুলয়ে ভ্রমিয়া,
পাপ-দুর্বাসনা-মূলে ॥ ১৩৮ ॥

*bāhire bāndhaẏe, bhramāi māẏāẏe,*
*āśraẏa e jāti-kule |*
*kṛṣṇa pāśariẏā, bulaẏe bhramiẏā,*
*pāpa-durbāsanā-mūle || 138 ||*

*Word for word:* bahire bandhaye — outwardly binds; bhramai mayaye — maya whirls about; ashraya e jati-kule — a footing in caste and lineage; krishna pashariya — forgetting Krishna; bulaye bhramiya — wanders about; papa-durvasana-mule — rooted in sinful desires

**138.** Outwardly maya binds and whirls [the soul] about,
[giving] it a footing in caste and lineage;
forgetting Krishna, it wanders,
rooted in sinful, evil desires.

জগতে যতেক, দেখ অপরূপ,
কৃষ্ণ-আবরক সভে ।
তবহি সার্থক, মানুষ-জনম,
শ্রীকৃষ্ণ ভজিয়ে যবে ॥ ১৩৯ ॥

*jagate yateka, dekha aparūpa,*
*kṛṣṇa-ābaraka sabhe |*
*tabahi sārthaka, mānuṣa-janama,*
*śrīkṛṣṇa bhajiẏe yabe || 139 ||*

*Word for word:* jagate yateka — everything in the world; dekha aparupa — that you see as wondrous; krishna-avaraka sabhe — all of it hides Krishna; tabahi sarthaka — only then meaningful; manusha-janama — is human birth; shri-krishna bhajiye yabe — when one serves Sri Krishna

**139.** Everything wondrous you see in the world —
all of it hides Krishna;
human birth has meaning only then
when one serves Sri Krishna.

মানুষ-জনম, দুর্লভ জানিয়ে,
কৃষ্ণ ভজিবার তরে ।
হেন দেহ পাঞা, শ্রীকৃষ্ণ ছাড়িয়া,
মরিয়ে মিছা-সংসারে ॥ ১৪০ ॥

*mānuṣa-janama, durlabha jāniẏe,*
*kṛṣṇa bhajibāra tare |*
*hena deha pāñā, śrīkṛṣṇa chāṛiẏā,*
*mariẏe michā-saṃsāre || 140 ||*

*Word for word:* manusha-janama — human birth; durlabha janiye — is known to be rare; krishna bhajibara tare — for serving Krishna; hena deha pana — having obtained such a body; shri-krishna chhadiya — abandoning Sri Krishna; mariye michha-samsare — they die in false samsara

**140.** Human birth, as is known, is rare —
[it is given] for serving Krishna;
yet, having obtained such a body, people abandon Sri Krishna
and die in this false samsara.

শুন সর্বজন, কহিলুঁ মরম,
আশীর্বাদ কর মোরে ।
কৃষ্ণে রতি হউ, এ দুঃখ পালাউ,
এ বর মাগোঁ সভারে ॥ ১৪১ ॥

*śuna sarbajana, kahiluṁ marama,*
*āśīrbāda kara more |*
*kṛṣṇe rati hau, e duḥkha pālāu,*
*e bara māgoṁ sabhāre || 141 ||*

*Word for word:* shuna sarvajana — listen, all; kahilun marama — I have told what is in My heart; ashirvada kara more — bless Me; krishne rati hau — let there be love for Krishna; e duhkha palau — let this sorrow flee; e bara magon sabhare — this boon I ask of all

**141.** Listen, all — I have told you what is in My heart:
bless Me,
that I may have love for Krishna and this sorrow may flee —
this boon I ask of everyone.

কৃষ্ণের চরিত, গাঙ অবিরত,
বদনে লাগয়ে সাধে ।
শ্রীমুখ-কমলে, নয়ান-যুগলে,
হিয়া বান্ধোঁ শ্রীপদে ॥ ১৪২ ॥

*kṛṣṇera carita, gāṅa abirata,*
*badane lāgaẏe sādhe |*
*śrīmukha-kamale, naẏāna-yugale,*
*hiẏā bāndhoṁ śrīpade || 142 ||*

*Word for word:* krishnera charita — Krishna's deeds; gaun avirata — to sing unceasingly; badane lagaye sadhe — the lips long; shri-mukha-kamale — on His lotus face; nayana-yugale — the two eyes; hiya bandhon shri-pade — I shall bind My heart to His holy feet

**142.** To sing Krishna's deeds unceasingly —
this is what My lips long for;
My eyes — on His lotus face,
My heart I shall bind to His holy feet.

কি কহিব হিয়া, কৃষ্ণ না দেখিয়া,
মরমে বিরহ-জ্বালা ।
সংসার-সাগরে, পড়িয়া পাথারে,
চিত বেয়াকুল ভেলা ॥ ১৪৩ ॥

*ki kahiba hiẏā, kṛṣṇa nā dekhiẏā,*
*marame biraha-jbālā |*
*saṃsāra-sāgare, paṛiẏā pāthāre,*
*cita beẏākula bhelā || 143 ||*

*Word for word:* ki kahiba hiya — what shall I say of the heart; krishna na dekhiya — not seeing Krishna; marame viraha-jvala — the fire of separation in its depths; samsara-sagare — into the ocean of samsara; padiya pathare — fallen into the deep; chita veyakula bhela — the mind is distraught

**143.** What shall I say of My heart? Not seeing Krishna,
the fire of separation burns in its depths;
fallen into the ocean of samsara, into the deep,
My mind is distraught.

সেই পিতা মাতা, সেই সে দেবতা,
সেই গুরু বন্ধুজনে ।
সেই সে শুনায়ে, কৃষ্ণকথা কহে,
ভজায়ে কৃষ্ণচরণে ॥ ১৪৪ ॥

*sei pitā mātā, sei se debatā,*
*sei guru bandhujane |*
*sei se śunāẏe, kṛṣṇakathā kahe,*
*bhajāẏe kṛṣṇacaraṇe || 144 ||*

*Word for word:* sei pita mata — he is father and mother; sei se devata — he is a deity; sei guru bandhu-jane — he is guru and friend; sei se shunaye — who lets one hear; krishna-katha kahe — tells of Krishna; bhajaye krishna-charane — brings one to serve Krishna's feet

**144.** He alone is father and mother, he alone is a deity,
he alone a guru and friend,
who lets one hear and tells of Krishna,
who brings one to serve Krishna's feet.

তোমরা বান্ধব, পরম বৈষ্ণব,
দয়া না ছাড়িহ চিতে ।
সন্ন্যাস করিব, প্রেম বিথারিব,
সব তো-সভার হিতে ॥ ১৪৫ ॥

*tomarā bāndhaba, parama baiṣṇaba,*
*daẏā nā chāṛiha cite |*
*sannyāsa kariba, prema bithāriba,*
*saba to-sabhāra hite || 145 ||*

*Word for word:* tomara bandhava — you are friends; parama vaishnava — supreme Vaishnavas; daya na chhadiha chite — do not give up mercy in your hearts; sannyasa kariba — I shall take sannyasa; prema vithariba — I shall spread prema; saba to-sabhara hite — all for your good

**145.** You are My friends, supreme Vaishnavas:
do not withdraw your mercy from Me in your hearts.
I shall take sannyasa and spread prema —
all for your own good."

এতেক উত্তর, কহি' বিশ্বম্ভর,
ভূমে গড়াগড়ি বুলে ।
ধূলায় ধূসর, গৌর-কলেবর,
লোটায়ে মুকুল-চুলি ॥ ১৪৬ ॥

*eteka uttara, kahi' biśbambhara,*
*bhūme gaṛāgaṛi bule |*
*dhūlāẏa dhūsara, gaura-kalebara,*
*loṭāẏe mukula-culi || 146 ||*

*Word for word:* eteka uttara kahi — having said this; vishvambhara — Vishvambhara; bhume gadagadi bule — rolls on the ground; dhulaya dhusara — grey with dust; gaura-kalebara — the golden body; lotaye mukula-chuli — the loosened hair sweeps the ground

**146.** Having said this, Vishvambhara
rolls on the ground;
Gaura's golden body is grey with dust,
His loosened hair sweeps the ground.

হরি হরি বোল, ডাকে উতরোল,
সঘন নিশ্বাস নাসা ।
অঙ্গের পুলক, আপাদ-মস্তক,
গদগদ আধ ভাষা ॥ ১৪৭ ॥

*hari hari bola, ḍāke utarola,*
