*saghana niśbāsa nāsā |*
*aṅgera pulaka, āpāda-mastaka,*
*gadagada ādha bhāṣā || 147 ||*

*Word for word:* hari hari bola — "Haribol!"; dake utarola — calls aloud; saghana nishvasa nasa — breathing deep and fast; angera pulaka — the body's thrill; apada-mastaka — from feet to head; gadgada adha bhasha — faltering, half-said words

**147.** "Haribol!" He calls aloud,
breathing deep and fast;
His body thrills from feet to head,
His speech falters, words left half-said.

ক্ষণেক রোদন, ক্ষণেক বেদন,
ক্ষণে চমকিত চাহে ।
ক্ষণে হাপ-ঝাঁপ, কলেবর কাঁপ,
ক্ষণে উঠে কৃষ্ণ-বিরহে ॥ ১৪৮ ॥

*kṣaṇeka rodana, kṣaṇeka bedana,*
*kṣaṇe camakita cāhe |*
*kṣaṇe hāpa-jhāṁpa, kalebara kāṁpa,*
*kṣaṇe uṭhe kṛṣṇa-birahe || 148 ||*

*Word for word:* kshaneka rodana — now weeping; kshaneka vedana — now anguish; kshane chamakita chahe — now He starts and looks about; kshane hapa-jhanpa — now gasping and tossing; kalebara kanpa — the body trembling; kshane uthe krishna-virahe — now He springs up in separation from Krishna

**148.** Now He weeps, now He is in anguish,
now He starts and looks about,
now He gasps and tosses, His whole body trembling,
now He springs up in separation from Krishna.

ক্ষণে উতরোলি, বৃন্দাবন বলি',
ক্ষণে রাধা বলি' ডাকে ।
মালসাট মারি', বোলে হরি হরি,
ক্ষণে হাত মারে বুকে ॥ ১৪৯ ॥

*kṣaṇe utaroli, bṛndābana bali',*
*kṣaṇe rādhā bali' ḍāke |*
*mālasāṭa māri', bole hari hari,*
*kṣaṇe hāta māre buke || 149 ||*

*Word for word:* kshane utaroli — now crying aloud; vrindavana bali — "Vrindavana!"; kshane radha bali dake — now calls "Radha!"; malasata mari — slapping His arms; bole hari hari — says "Hari, Hari"; kshane hata mare buke — now strikes His breast with His hand

**149.** Now He cries aloud: "Vrindavana!"
now He calls: "Radha!"
He slaps His arms like a wrestler, says "Hari, Hari",
now He strikes His breast with His hand.

দেখি' সর্বজন, গুণে মনে মন,
অন্তরে কাতর হঞা ।
কি বলিব আর, দুখের পাথারে,
পড়িল যে-হেন গিয়া ॥ ১৫০ ॥

*dekhi' sarbajana, guṇe mane mana,*
*antare kātara hañā |*
*ki baliba āra, dukhera pāthāre,*
*paṛila ye-hena giẏā || 150 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhi sarvajana — seeing [this], all; gune mane mana — ponder within; antare katara haña — anguished at heart; ki baliba ara — what more to say; dukhera pathare — into an ocean of grief; padila ye-hena giya — as if they had fallen

**150.** Seeing this, all ponder within themselves,
anguished at heart:
what more is there to say? — it was as if they had fallen
into an ocean of grief.

কহয়ে মুরারি, শুন গৌরহরি,
স্বতন্ত্র তুমি সর্বথা ।
লোক বুঝাবারে, করুণা-প্রচারে,
ভাবহ বিরহ-ব্যথা ॥ ১৫১ ॥

*kahaẏe murāri, śuna gaurahari,*
*sbatantra tumi sarbathā |*
*loka bujhābāre, karuṇā-pracāre,*
*bhābaha biraha-byathā || 151 ||*

*Word for word:* kahaye murari — Murari says; shuna gaurahari — listen, Gaurahari; svatantra tumi sarvatha — You are independent in everything; loka bujhabare — to teach people; karuna-prachare — to reveal mercy; bhavaha viraha-vyatha — You take on the bhava of the pain of separation

**151.** Murari says: "Listen, Gaurahari:
You are independent in everything;
to teach people, to reveal mercy,
You take on the bhava of the pain of separation.[^36-2]

তুমি যে করিবে, নিজ-মন-সুখে,
তাহে কি বলিব আনে ।
তুমি সব জান, যে কর বিধান,
কি হয়ে জীব-পরাণে ॥ ১৫২ ॥

*tumi ye karibe, nija-mana-sukhe,*
*tāhe ki baliba āne |*
*tumi saba jāna, ye kara bidhāna,*
*ki haẏe jība-parāṇe || 152 ||*

*Word for word:* tumi ye karibe — whatever You do; nija-mana-sukhe — by Your own heart's will; tahe ki baliba ane — what can others say about it; tumi saba jana — You know everything; ye kara vidhana — whatever You ordain; ki haye jiva-parane — what can poor souls do

**152.** Whatever You do by the will of Your own heart —
what can others say about it?
You know everything; whatever You ordain —
what can poor souls do about it?

মোরা সব জীব, না জানি কি হব,
কীট-পিপীলিকা হেন ।
তুমি দয়াসিন্ধু, সব-লোক-বন্ধু,
বুঝিয়া করহ যেন ॥ ১৫৩ ॥

*morā saba jība, nā jāni ki haba,*
*kīṭa-pipīlikā hena |*
*tumi daẏāsindhu, saba-loka-bandhu,*
*bujhiẏā karaha yena || 153 ||*

*Word for word:* mora saba jiva — we are all jivas; na jani ki haba — we do not know what will be; kita-pipilika hena — like worms and ants; tumi daya-sindhu — You are the ocean of mercy; saba-loka-bandhu — the friend of all people; bujhiya karaha yena — consider and act as is fitting

**153.** We are all jivas, we do not know what will become of us,
we are like worms and ants;
You are the ocean of mercy, the friend of all people:
consider and do what is fitting."

এ বোল শুনিঞা, সে পহুঁ হাসিয়া,
সভারে করিলা কোলে ।
প্রেম প্রকাশিয়া, সভা সম্বোধিয়া,
প্রবোধ-বচনে বোলে ॥ ১৫৪ ॥

*e bola śuniñā, se pahuṁ hāsiẏā,*
*sabhāre karilā kole |*
*prema prakāśiẏā, sabhā sambodhiẏā,*
*prabodha-bacane bole || 154 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuniña — hearing this; se panhu hasiya — the Lord, smiling; sabhare karila kole — embraced all; prema prakashiya — revealing prema; sabha sambodhiya — addressing all; prabodha-vachane bole — speaks words of consolation

**154.** Hearing this, the Lord smiled
and embraced them all;
revealing prema, addressing them all,
He speaks words of consolation:

শুন সর্বজন, কহিয়ে বচন,
সন্দেহ না কর কেহো ।
যথা-তথা যাই, তো-সভার ঠাঞি
আছিয়ে, জানিহ এহো ॥ ১৫৫ ॥

*śuna sarbajana, kahiẏe bacana,*
*sandeha nā kara keho |*
*yathā-tathā yāi, to-sabhāra ṭhāñi*
*āchiẏe, jāniha eho || 155 ||*

*Word for word:* shuna sarvajana — listen, all; kahiye vachana — to what I say; sandeha na kara keho — let no one doubt; yatha-tatha yai — wherever I go; to-sabhara thani achhiye — I remain with you; janiha eho — know this

**155.** "Listen, all, to what I say,
let no one doubt:
wherever I may go, I remain with you —
know this."[^36-3]

তবে বিশ্বম্ভর, গেলা নিজ ঘর,
সভারে বিদায় দিয়া ।
সন্ন্যাস হৃদয়ে, সকল করয়ে,
জননী না জানে ইহা ॥ ১৫৬ ॥

*tabe biśbambhara, gelā nija ghara,*
*sabhāre bidāẏa diẏā |*
*sannyāsa hṛdaẏe, sakala karaẏe,*
*jananī nā jāne ihā || 156 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe vishvambhara — then Vishvambhara; gela nija ghara — went home; sabhare vidaya diya — taking leave of all; sannyasa hridaye — with sannyasa in His heart; sakala karaye — makes all [preparations]; janani na jane iha — His mother does not know of it

**156.** Then Vishvambhara, taking leave of all,
went home;
with sannyasa in His heart He makes every preparation,
but His mother does not know of it.

শচীর অন্তরে, ধকধক করে,
সোয়াথ না পায় চিতে ।
লোচন বোলে হেন, প্রেমার সাগর,
কেমনে চাহে ছাড়িতে ॥ ১৫৭ ॥

*śacīra antare, dhakadhaka kare,*
*soẏātha nā pāẏa cite |*
*locana bole hena, premāra sāgara,*
*kemane cāhe chāṛite || 157 ||*

*Word for word:* shachira antare — in Shachi's heart; dhakadhaka kare — it beats anxiously; soyatha na paya chite — she finds no peace; lochana bole — Lochana says; hena premara sagara — such an ocean of love; kemane chahe chhadite — how can [He] wish to leave

**157.** Shachi's heart beats anxiously,
she finds no peace.
Lochana says: how can He wish
to leave such an ocean of love?

## Mother Shachi's Grief

> *Summary by Srila Bhaktisiddhanta Sarasvati.* Hearing from people that Sriman Mahaprabhu would soon take sannyasa, mother Shachi, beside herself with grief, weeping, earnestly begged the Lord not to take sannyasa in His youth but to keep the dharma of a householder. Then Sriman Mahaprabhu, telling [her the story] of Dhruva and of the instruction his mother gave him — to serve Krishna — [revealed to her] that apart from Krishna the living being has no other refuge; that therefore whoever teaches one to serve Krishna is one's true father, mother, brother and friend; that those intoxicated by the conceit of "I" and "mine" are the greatest fools; and that service to Krishna is the meaning of human life. Having declared this, He instructed her to give up attachment to her son such as souls in the grip of maya have, and vowed that, not like other sons [who bring their mothers] silver, gold and other perishable things, He would bring her the eternal, highest good — prema. Then Gaurahari showed Himself to her in the form of Sri Krishna and dispelled mother Shachi's grief.[^36-4]

*Raga ahiri; disha: "Ah, my son, do not leave me — but for you I have no one in the three worlds!"*

এই মনে অনুমানে জানাজানি কথা ।
সন্ন্যাস করিবে পুত্র শুনে শচীমাতা ॥ ১ ॥

*ei mane anumāne jānājāni kathā |*
*sannyāsa karibe putra śune śacīmātā || 1 ||*

*Word for word:* ei mane anumane — thus by guesses; janajani katha — by rumours; sannyasa karibe putra — that her son will take sannyasa; shune shachi-mata — mother Shachi hears

**1.** Thus, by guesses and rumours,
mother Shachi heard that her son would take sannyasa.

আকাশ ভাঙ্গিয়া পড়ে মস্তক-উপর ।
অচেতন হৈলা শচী মূর্চ্ছিত-অন্তর ॥ ২ ॥

*ākāśa bhāṅgiẏā paṛe mastaka-upara |*
*acetana hailā śacī mūrcchita-antara || 2 ||*

*Word for word:* akasha bhangiya pade — the sky breaks and falls; mastaka-upara — on her head; achetana haila shachi — Shachi lost consciousness; murchchhita-antara — her heart swooned

**2.** It was as if the sky had fallen on her head:
Shachi lost consciousness, her heart swooned.

উন্মতী পাগলী শচী বেড়ায় চৌদিগে ।
যারে দেখে তারে পুছে সব নবদ্বীপে ॥ ৩ ॥

*unmatī pāgalī śacī beṛāẏa caudige |*
*yāre dekhe tāre puche saba nabadbīpe || 3 ||*

*Word for word:* unmati pagali shachi — like a madwoman, Shachi; bedaya chaudige — rushes about on all sides; yare dekhe tare puchhe — whomever she sees she asks; saba navadvipe — all over Navadvipa

**3.** Like a madwoman Shachi rushes about on every side;
whomever she sees she questions — all over Navadvipa.

নিশ্চয় জানিল—পুত্র করিব সন্ন্যাস ।
বিশ্বম্ভরের কাছে গিয়া ছাড়য়ে নিশ্বাস ॥ ৪ ॥

*niścaẏa jānila—putra kariba sannyāsa |*
*biśbambharera kāche giẏā chāṛaẏe niśbāsa || 4 ||*

*Word for word:* nishchaya janila — she knew for certain; putra kariba sannyasa — her son will take sannyasa; vishvambharera kachhe giya — going to Vishvambhara; chhadaye nishvasa — heaves sighs

**4.** Knowing for certain that her son would take sannyasa,
she came to Vishvambhara and heaves deep sighs:

তুমি মাত্র পুত্র মোর, দেহে এক আঁখি ।
তোরে না দেখিলে অন্ধকারময় দেখি ॥ ৫ ॥

*tumi mātra putra mora, dehe eka āṁkhi |*
*tore nā dekhile andhakāramaẏa dekhi || 5 ||*

*Word for word:* tumi matra putra mora — you are my only son; dehe eka ankhi — the one eye in my body; tore na dekhile — when I do not see you; andhakara-maya dekhi — I see all as darkness

**5.** "You are my only son, the one eye in my body:
when I do not see you, I see everything in darkness.

লোকমুখে শুনি বাপু করিবে সন্ন্যাস ।
মোর মুণ্ডে ভাঙ্গি যেন পড়িল আকাশ ॥ ৬ ॥

*lokamukhe śuni bāpu karibe sannyāsa |*
*mora muṇḍe bhāṅgi yena paṛila ākāśa || 6 ||*

*Word for word:* loka-mukhe shuni — I hear from people; bapu karibe sannyasa — my child, you will take sannyasa; mora munde bhangi — breaking over my head; yena padila akasha — as if the sky fell

**6.** I hear from people, my child, that you will take sannyasa —
it is as if the sky had broken over my head.

একাকিনী অনাথিনী, আর কেহো নাহি ।
সকল পাসরি' এক তোর মুখ চাহি ॥ ৭ ॥

*ekākinī anāthinī, āra keho nāhi |*
*sakala pāsari' eka tora mukha cāhi || 7 ||*

*Word for word:* ekakini anathini — alone, unprotected; ara keho nahi — there is no one else; sakala pasari — forgetting everything; eka tora mukha chahi — I look only at your face

**7.** I am alone, unprotected — I have no one else;
forgetting all else, I look only at your face.

নয়নের তারা মোর কুলের প্রদীপ ।
তোমা পুত্রে ভাগ্যবতী বোলে নবদ্বীপ ॥ ৮ ॥

*naẏanera tārā mora kulera pradīpa |*
*tomā putre bhāgyabatī bole nabadbīpa || 8 ||*

*Word for word:* nayanera tara mora — the pupil of my eyes; kulera pradipa — the lamp of the family; toma putre — for a son like you; bhagyavati bole navadvipa — Navadvipa calls [me] fortunate

**8.** You are the pupil of my eyes, the lamp of our family;
for having such a son as you Navadvipa calls me fortunate.

না ঘুচাহ আরে পুত্র মোর অহঙ্কার ।
তুমি না থাকিলে সব হব ছারখার ॥ ৯ ॥

*nā ghucāha āre putra mora ahaṅkāra |*
*tumi nā thākile saba haba chārakhāra || 9 ||*

*Word for word:* na ghuchaha are putra — do not destroy, my son; mora ahankara — my pride; tumi na thakile — if you are not here; saba haba chharakhara — everything will go to ruin

**9.** Do not destroy my pride, my son:
if you are gone, everything will go to ruin.

ভাগ্য মানে যে না জন দেখে মোর মুখ ।
এখন আমারে দেখি' হইব বিমুখ ॥ ১০ ॥

*bhāgya māne ye nā jana dekhe mora mukha |*
*ekhana āmāre dekhi' haiba bimukha || 10 ||*

*Word for word:* bhagya mane — counted it good fortune; ye na jana dekhe mora mukha — the people who saw my face; ekhana amare dekhi — now, seeing me; haiba vimukha — will turn away

**10.** People counted it good fortune to see my face —
now, seeing me, they will turn away.

তুমি হেন পুত্র মোর এ সংসারে ধন্য ।
তোমা না দেখিলে মোর সকলি অরণ্য ॥ ১১ ॥

*tumi hena putra mora e saṃsāre dhanya |*
*tomā nā dekhile mora sakali araṇya || 11 ||*

*Word for word:* tumi hena putra mora — having such a son as you; e samsare dhanya — [I am] blessed in this world; toma na dekhile — not seeing you; mora sakali aranya — all is wilderness to me

**11.** Having such a son as you, I am blessed in this world —
but not seeing you, I see nothing but wilderness around me.

দুখ দিয়া অভাগীরে ছাড়ি' যাবে তুমি ।
গঙ্গায় প্রবেশ করি' মরি' যাব আমি ॥ ১২ ॥

*dukha diẏā abhāgīre chāṛi' yābe tumi |*
*gaṅgāẏa prabeśa kari' mari' yāba āmi || 12 ||*

*Word for word:* dukha diya abhagire — giving grief to the unfortunate one; chhadi yabe tumi — you will go away; gangaya pravesha kari — entering the Ganga; mari yaba ami — I shall die

**12.** Giving grief to this unfortunate woman, you will go away —
and I shall enter the Ganga and die.

এহেন কোমল-পায়ে কেমনে হাঁটিবে ।
ক্ষুধায় তৃষ্ণায় অন্ন কাহারে মাগিবে ॥ ১৩ ॥

*ehena komala-pāẏe kemane hāṁṭibe |*
*kṣudhāẏa tṛṣṇāẏa anna kāhāre māgibe || 13 ||*

*Word for word:* ehena komala-paye — on such tender feet; kemane hantibe — how will you walk; kshudhaya trishnaya — in hunger and thirst; anna kahare magibe — from whom will you beg food

**13.** How will you walk on such tender feet?
Hungry and thirsty — from whom will you beg food?

ননীর পুতলী তনু রৌদ্রেতে মিলায় ।
কেমনে সহিব ইহা এ দুখিনী মায় ॥ ১৪ ॥

*nanīra putalī tanu raudrete milāẏa |*
*kemane sahiba ihā e dukhinī māẏa || 14 ||*

*Word for word:* nanira putali tanu — the body a doll of butter; raudrete milaya — melts in the sun; kemane sahiba iha — how will she bear this; e dukhini maya — this wretched mother

**14.** Your body is like a doll of butter: it will melt in the sun;
how will this wretched mother bear it?

হাপুতির পুত মোর সোণার নিমাই ।
আমারে ছাড়িয়া তুমি যাবে কোন ঠাঞি ॥ ১৫ ॥

*hāputira puta mora soṇāra nimāi |*
*āmāre chāṛiẏā tumi yābe kona ṭhāñi || 15 ||*

*Word for word:* haputira puta mora — son of a mother bereft of children; sonara nimai — my golden Nimai; amare chhadiya tumi — leaving me, you; yabe kona thani — where will you go

**15.** Son of a mother bereft of her children, my golden Nimai!
Leaving me, where will you go?[^36-5]

বিষ খাঞা মরি বাপ তোর বিদ্যমানে ।
তোমার সন্ন্যাস যেন না শুনিয়ে কাণে ॥ ১৬ ॥

*biṣa khāñā mari bāpa tora bidyamāne |*
*tomāra sannyāsa yena nā śuniẏe kāṇe || 16 ||*

*Word for word:* visha khana mari — I shall take poison and die; bapa tora vidyamane — my child, before your eyes; tomara sannyasa — of your sannyasa; yena na shuniye kane — so as not to hear with my ears

**16.** I shall take poison and die before your eyes,
so as not to hear with my ears of your sannyasa.

আমারে মারিয়া বাপু যাইবে বিদেশে ।
আগুনি জ্বালিয়া তাথে করিব প্রবেশে ॥ ১৭ ॥

*āmāre māriẏā bāpu yāibe bideśe |*
*āguni jbāliẏā tāthe kariba prabeśe || 17 ||*

*Word for word:* amare mariya — having killed me; bapu yaibe videshe — my child, you will go abroad; aguni jvaliya — lighting a fire; tathe kariba praveshe — I shall enter it

**17.** Having killed me, my child, you will go to foreign lands —
and I shall light a fire and enter it.

সর্বজীবে দয়া তোর, মোরে অকরুণ ।
না জানি কি লাগি মোরে বিধাতা দারুণ ॥ ১৮ ॥

*sarbajībe daẏā tora, more akaruṇa |*
*nā jāni ki lāgi more bidhātā dāruṇa || 18 ||*

*Word for word:* sarva-jive daya tora — you have mercy for all beings; more akaruna — for me none; na jani ki lagi — I know not why; more vidhata daruna — the Creator is cruel to me

**18.** To all beings you are merciful — but to me merciless;
I do not know why the Creator is so cruel to me.

রূপে গুণে শীলে পুত্র ত্রিজগত-ধন্য ।
কামিনী-মোহন বেশ কেশের লাবণ্য ॥ ১৯ ॥

*rūpe guṇe śīle putra trijagata-dhanya |*
*kāminī-mohana beśa keśera lābaṇya || 19 ||*

*Word for word:* rupe gune shile — in beauty, virtues and nature; putra trijagata-dhanya — my son, you are blessed in the three worlds; kamini-mohana besha — a dress that enchants women; keshera lavanya — the loveliness of your hair

**19.** In beauty, virtues and nature, my son, you are blessed in the three worlds;
your dress enchants women, your hair is lovely.

অংস-বিলম্বিত কেশে মালতী বান্ধিয়া ।
জুড়ায় পরাণ মোর সে বেশ দেখিয়া ॥ ২০ ॥

*aṃsa-bilambita keśe mālatī bāndhiẏā |*
*juṛāẏa parāṇa mora se beśa dekhiẏā || 20 ||*

*Word for word:* amsa-vilambita keshe — in the hair falling to the shoulders; malati bandhiya — tying malati; judaya parana mora — my heart is eased; se besha dekhiya — seeing that attire

**20.** When you weave malati into your hair that falls to your shoulders,
my heart is eased at the sight of that attire.

বয়স্য-বেষ্টিত তুমি চলি' যাহ পথে ।
দেখিয়া জুড়ায় হিয়া, পুঁথি বামহাথে ॥ ২১ ॥

*baẏasya-beṣṭita tumi cali' yāha pathe |*
*dekhiẏā juṛāẏa hiẏā, puṁthi bāmahāthe || 21 ||*

*Word for word:* vayasya-veshtita tumi — you, surrounded by friends; chali yaha pathe — walk along the road; dekhiya judaya hiya — seeing, the heart is glad; punthi vama-hathe — a book in your left hand

**21.** You walk along the road surrounded by friends,
a book in your left hand — and seeing you, my heart is glad.

কেমনে ছাড়িবা বাপু নিজ-সঙ্গিগণ ।
না করিবে তা-সভা-সহিত সংকীর্তন ॥ ২২ ॥

*kemane chāṛibā bāpu nija-saṅgigaṇa |*
*nā karibe tā-sabhā-sahita saṃkīrtana || 22 ||*

*Word for word:* kemane chhadiba bapu — how will you leave, my child; nija-sangi-gana — your companions; na karibe — you will not perform; ta-sabha-sahita sankirtana — sankirtana with them

**22.** How will you leave your companions, my child?
Will you no longer perform sankirtana with them?

সে-হেন সুন্দর বেশে না নাচিবে আর ।
যাহা দেখি' মোহ পায় সকল সংসার ॥ ২৩ ॥

*se-hena sundara beśe nā nācibe āra |*
*yāhā dekhi' moha pāẏa sakala saṃsāra || 23 ||*

*Word for word:* se-hena sundara beshe — in such lovely attire; na nachibe ara — you will dance no more; yaha dekhi — seeing which; moha paya sakala samsara — the whole world is enchanted

**23.** Will you no longer dance in such lovely attire,
at the sight of which the whole world is enchanted?

কেমনে বা জীবে তোর নিজ-প্রিয়জন ।
সভারে মারিয়া তোর সন্ন্যাস-করণ ॥ ২৪ ॥

*kemane bā jībe tora nija-priẏajana |*
*sabhāre māriẏā tora sannyāsa-karaṇa || 24 ||*

*Word for word:* kemane va jive — how will they live; tora nija-priya-jana — your dear ones; sabhare mariya — killing all; tora sannyasa-karana — is your taking sannyasa

**24.** How will your dear ones live?
Your sannyasa will kill them all.

আগে ত মরিব আমি, তবে বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া ।
মরিবে ভকত সব বুক বিদরিয়া ॥ ২৫ ॥

*āge ta mariba āmi, tabe biṣṇupriẏā |*
*maribe bhakata saba buka bidariẏā || 25 ||*

*Word for word:* age ta mariba ami — first I shall die; tabe vishnupriya — then Vishnupriya; maribe bhakata saba — all the devotees will die; buka vidariya — their hearts bursting

**25.** First I shall die, then Vishnupriya;
the devotees will die, their hearts bursting:

মুরারি মুকুন্দ দত্ত আর শ্রীনিবাস ।
অদ্বৈত-আচার্য-আদি আর হরিদাস ॥ ২৬ ॥

*murāri mukunda datta āra śrīnibāsa |*
*adbaita-ācārya-ādi āra haridāsa || 26 ||*

*Word for word:* murari mukunda datta — Murari, Mukunda Datta; ara shrinivasa — and Srinivasa; advaita-acharya-adi — Advaita Acharya and others; ara haridasa — and Haridasa

**26.** Murari, Mukunda Datta and Srinivasa,
Advaita Acharya and others, and Haridasa,

গদাধর নরহরি শ্রীরঘুনন্দন ।
বাসুদেব ঘোষ বক্রেশ্বর শ্রীরাম ॥ ২৭ ॥

*gadādhara narahari śrīraghunandana |*
*bāsudeba ghoṣa bakreśbara śrīrāma || 27 ||*

*Word for word:* gadadhara narahari — Gadadhara, Narahari; shri-raghunandana — Sri Raghunandana; vasudeva ghosha — Vasudeva Ghosha; vakreshvara shrirama — Vakreshvara, Sri Rama

**27.** Gadadhara, Narahari, Sri Raghunandana,
Vasudeva Ghosha, Vakreshvara, Sri Rama —

মরিব সকল লোক না দেখিয়া তোমা ।
এ সব দেখিয়া বাপু চিত্তে দেহ ক্ষমা ॥ ২৮ ॥

*mariba sakala loka nā dekhiẏā tomā |*
*e saba dekhiẏā bāpu citte deha kṣamā || 28 ||*

*Word for word:* mariba sakala loka — all will die; na dekhiya toma — not seeing you; e saba dekhiya — seeing all this; bapu chitte deha kshama — my child, soften your heart

**28.** all will die, not seeing you;
seeing all this, my child, soften your heart.

পিতৃহীন পুত্র তুমি, দিল দুই বিভা ।
অপত্য সন্ততি কিছু না দেখিল ইহা ॥ ২৯ ॥

*pitṛhīna putra tumi, dila dui bibhā |*
*apatya santati kichu nā dekhila ihā || 29 ||*

*Word for word:* pitrihina putra tumi — you are a son without a father; dila dui vibha — [I] married you twice; apatya santati kichhu — any offspring; na dekhila iha — I have not seen from this

**29.** You are a son without a father; I married you twice,
but I have seen no offspring from it.

তরুণ-বয়সে নহে সন্ন্যাসের ধর্ম ।
গৃহস্থ-আশ্রমে থাকি' সাধ সব কর্ম ॥ ৩০ ॥

*taruṇa-baẏase nahe sannyāsera dharma |*
*gṛhastha-āśrame thāki' sādha saba karma || 30 ||*

*Word for word:* taruna-bayase — in youth; nahe sannyasera dharma — sannyasa is not dharma; grihastha-ashrame thaki — living in the householder's ashrama; sadha saba karma — fulfil all duties

**30.** Sannyasa in youth is not dharma;
live in the householder's ashrama and fulfil all your duties.

কাম ক্রোধ লোভ মোহ যৌবনে প্রবল ।
সন্ন্যাস কেমনে তোর হইবে সফল ॥ ৩১ ॥

*kāma krodha lobha moha yaubane prabala |*
*sannyāsa kemane tora haibe saphala || 31 ||*

*Word for word:* kama krodha lobha moha — lust, anger, greed, delusion; yauvane prabala — are strong in youth; sannyasa kemane tora — how will your sannyasa; haibe saphala — succeed

**31.** In youth lust, anger, greed and delusion are strong —
how will your sannyasa succeed?

মনের নিবৃত্তি কলিকালে নাহি হয় ।
মনের চাঞ্চল্যে সন্ন্যাসের ধর্মক্ষয় ॥ ৩২ ॥

*manera nibṛtti kalikāle nāhi haẏa |*
*manera cāñcalye sannyāsera dharmakṣaẏa || 32 ||*

*Word for word:* manera nivritti — the curbing of the mind; kali-kale nahi haya — is not possible in the Kali age; manera chanchalye — through the mind's unsteadiness; sannyasera dharma-kshaya — the dharma of sannyasa perishes

**32.** In the Kali age the mind cannot be curbed;
through the mind's unsteadiness the dharma of sannyasa perishes.

গৃহিজন মনঃপাপে নাহি হয় বন্ধ ।
সন্ন্যাসীর ধর্ম যায় মনোজ-অশুদ্ধ ॥ ৩৩ ॥

*gṛhijana manaḥpāpe nāhi haẏa bandha |*
*sannyāsīra dharma yāẏa manoja-aśuddha || 33 ||*

*Word for word:* grihi-jana — a householder; manah-pape nahi haya bandha — is not bound by sins of the mind; sannyasira dharma yaya — a sannyasi's dharma is lost; manoja-ashuddha — if defiled by desire

**33.** A householder is not bound by sins of the mind,
but a sannyasi's dharma is lost if his mind is defiled by desire."[^36-6]

এতেক বচন যদি শচীদেবী বৈল ।
শুনিঞা প্রবোধ-বাণী মায়েরে কহিল ॥ ৩৪ ॥

*eteka bacana yadi śacīdebī baila |*
*śuniñā prabodha-bāṇī māẏere kahila || 34 ||*

*Word for word:* eteka vachana — such words; yadi shachi-devi baila — when Shachi-devi had spoken; shuniña — having heard; prabodha-vani mayere kahila — He spoke words of consolation to His mother

**34.** When Shachi-devi had spoken these words,
[the Lord], having heard them, spoke words of consolation to His mother:

নরহরি-পাদপদ্ম শিরের ভূষণ ।
গৌরাঙ্গ-চরিত কহে এ দাস লোচন ॥ ৩৪+১ ॥

*narahari-pādapadma śirera bhūṣaṇa |*
*gaurāṅga-carita kahe e dāsa locana || 34+1 ||*

*Word for word:* narahari-pada-padma — Narahari's lotus feet; shirera bhushana — the ornament of the head; gauranga-charita kahe — tells of Gauranga's deeds; e dasa lochana — this servant Lochana

**34+1.** Narahari's lotus feet are the ornament of my head;
of Gauranga's deeds this servant Lochana tells[^36-7].

*Raga — any; refrain: "The nectar words of the moon-like lips…"[^36-8]*

ধ্রুবেরে বৈষ্ণব কৈল ধ্রুবের জননী ।
কহিয়ে সে রস শুন অপূর্ব কাহিনী ॥ ৩৫ ॥

*dhrubere baiṣṇaba kaila dhrubera jananī |*
*kahiẏe se rasa śuna apūrba kāhinī || 35 ||*

*Word for word:* dhruvere vaishnava kaila — made Dhruva a Vaishnava; dhruvera janani — Dhruva's mother; kahiye se rasa — I tell that rasa; shuna apurva kahini — hear a wondrous tale

**35.** "Dhruva's mother made Dhruva a Vaishnava —
I shall tell that rasa: hear a wondrous tale.[^36-9]

*Thus [in the Padyavali]:*

ব্যাধস্যাচরণং ধ্রুবস্য চ বয়ো বিদ্যা গজেন্দ্রস্য কা
কুব্জায়াঃ কিমু নাম রূপমধিকং কিং তৎ সুদাম্নো ধনম্ ।
বংশঃ কো বিদুরস্য যাদবপতেরুগ্রস্য কিং পৌরুষং
ভক্ত্যা তুষ্যতি কেবলং ন চ গুণৈর্ভক্তিপ্রিয়ো মাধবঃ ॥ ৩৬ ॥

*byādhasyācaraṇaṃ dhrubasya ca baẏo bidyā gajendrasya kā*
*kubjāẏāḥ kimu nāma rūpamadhikaṃ kiṃ tat sudāmno dhanam |*
*baṃśaḥ ko bidurasya yādabapaterugrasya kiṃ pauruṣaṃ*
*bhaktyā tuṣyati kebalaṃ na ca guṇairbhaktipriẏo mādhabaḥ || 36 ||*

*Word for word:* vyadhasya acharanam — the conduct of the hunter; dhruvasya cha vayah — and the age of Dhruva; vidya gajendrasya ka — what the learning of Gajendra; kubjayah kimu nama rupam adhikam — what the name and beauty of Kubja; kim tat sudamnah dhanam — what the wealth of Sudama; vamshah kah vidurasya — what the lineage of Vidura; yadava-pateh ugrasya kim paurusham — what the prowess of Ugrasena, lord of the Yadavas; bhaktya tushyati kevalam — is pleased by devotion alone; na cha gunaih — not by qualities; bhakti-priyah madhavah — Madhava, who loves devotion

**36.** What was the conduct of the hunter, what the age of Dhruva, what the learning of Gajendra, what the name and beauty of Kubja, what the wealth of Sudama,
what the lineage of Vidura, what the prowess of Ugrasena, lord of the Yadavas? Madhava, who loves devotion, is pleased by devotion alone, not by qualities.[^36-10]

শুন মাতা ধ্রুব-কথা এক-মন-চিতে ।
অতি উচ্চ পদ ধ্রুব পাইল যেনমতে ॥ ৩৭ ॥

*śuna mātā dhruba-kathā eka-mana-cite |*
*ati ucca pada dhruba pāila yenamate || 37 ||*

*Word for word:* shuna mata — listen, mother; dhruva-katha — to the story of Dhruva; eka-mana-chite — attentively; ati uchcha pada — the very highest position; dhruva paila yenamate — how Dhruva attained

**37.** Listen, mother, attentively to the story of Dhruva —
how Dhruva attained the very highest position.

ব্রহ্মার মানসপুত্র স্বায়ম্ভুব মনু ।
মহাতেজ পরাক্রম যেন ব্রহ্মতনু ॥ ৩৮ ॥

*brahmāra mānasaputra sbāẏambhuba manu |*
*mahāteja parākrama yena brahmatanu || 38 ||*

*Word for word:* brahmara manasa-putra — the mind-born son of Brahma; svayambhuva manu — Svayambhuva Manu; maha-teja parakrama — of great might and valour; yena brahma-tanu — like Brahma's own body

**38.** The mind-born son of Brahma was Svayambhuva Manu,
of great might and valour, like a second Brahma.

তার দুই পুত্র প্রিয়ব্রত উত্তানপাদ ।
দুহে মহারাজা হৈল ব্রহ্মার প্রসাদ ॥ ৩৯ ॥

*tāra dui putra priẏabrata uttānapāda |*
*duhe mahārājā haila brahmāra prasāda || 39 ||*

*Word for word:* tara dui putra — his two sons; priyavrata uttanapada — Priyavrata and Uttanapada; duhe maharaja haila — both became great kings; brahmara prasada — by Brahma's grace

**39.** He had two sons, Priyavrata and Uttanapada;
both became great kings by Brahma's grace.

উত্তানপাদ মহারাজা দুই বিভা করি' ।
সুরুচি সুনীতি নামে দুই ত সুন্দরী ॥ ৪০ ॥

*uttānapāda mahārājā dui bibhā kari' |*
*suruci sunīti nāme dui ta sundarī || 40 ||*

*Word for word:* uttanapada maharaja — Maharaja Uttanapada; dui vibha kari — married twice; suruchi suniti name — named Suruchi and Suniti; dui ta sundari — two beauties

**40.** Maharaja Uttanapada married twice —
two beauties named Suruchi and Suniti.

উত্তমাদি সাত পুত্র সুরুচির হৈল ।
সুনীতির গর্ভে মাত্র ধ্রুবের জন্ম হৈল ॥ ৪১ ॥

*uttamādi sāta putra surucira haila |*
*sunītira garbhe mātra dhrubera janma haila || 41 ||*

*Word for word:* uttamadi sata putra — seven sons beginning with Uttama; suruchira haila — were born to Suruchi; sunitira garbhe — from Suniti's womb; matra dhruvera janma haila — only Dhruva was born

**41.** Suruchi had seven sons, beginning with Uttama;
from Suniti's womb only Dhruva was born.[^36-11]

স্বামীতে সৌভাগ্য হৈল উত্তমের মাতা ।
ধ্রুবের জননী হৈল স্বামীতে দুর্ভাগা ॥ ৪২ ॥

*sbāmīte saubhāgya haila uttamera mātā |*
*dhrubera jananī haila sbāmīte durbhāgā || 42 ||*

*Word for word:* svamite saubhagya haila — won her husband's favour; uttamera mata — Uttama's mother; dhruvera janani — Dhruva's mother; haila svamite durbhaga — fell out of her husband's favour

**42.** Uttama's mother won her husband's favour,
while Dhruva's mother fell out of favour with her husband.

পাটমহারাণী হৈল সুরুচি সুন্দরী ।
ধ্রুবের জননী গিয়া তার সেবা করি ॥ ৪৩ ॥

*pāṭamahārāṇī haila suruci sundarī |*
*dhrubera jananī giẏā tāra sebā kari || 43 ||*

*Word for word:* pata-maharani haila — became chief queen; suruchi sundari — the beautiful Suruchi; dhruvera janani giya — Dhruva's mother went; tara seva kari — to wait on her

**43.** The beautiful Suruchi became the chief queen,
and Dhruva's mother went to wait on her.

ধ্রুবের মায়ের দুঃখ কহনে না যায় ।
সে দুঃখে পাথর ভাসে, সমুদ্র শুখায় ॥ ৪৪ ॥

*dhrubera māẏera duḥkha kahane nā yāẏa |*
*se duḥkhe pāthara bhāse, samudra śukhāẏa || 44 ||*

*Word for word:* dhruvera mayera duhkha — the grief of Dhruva's mother; kahane na yaya — cannot be told; se duhkhe — at that grief; pathara bhase — stones float; samudra shukhaya — the ocean dries up

**44.** The grief of Dhruva's mother cannot be told:
at such grief stones float and the ocean dries up.

আকাড়া-চাউলের অন্ন আলোণা ব্যঞ্জন ।
ধ্রুবের মায়েরে দেয় করিতে ভোজন ॥ ৪৫ ॥

*ākāṛā-cāulera anna āloṇā byañjana |*
*dhrubera māẏere deẏa karite bhojana || 45 ||*

*Word for word:* akada-chaulera anna — rice of coarse grain; alona vyanjana — unsalted vegetables; dhruvera mayere deya — they gave Dhruva's mother; karite bhojana — to eat

**45.** Rice of coarse grain and unsalted vegetables —
that is what they gave Dhruva's mother to eat.

পাঁচ বৎসর যখন ধ্রুবের বয়স ।
দুঃখী হঞা ধ্রুবের মাতা পায় নানা ক্লেশ ॥ ৪৬ ॥

*pāṁca batsara yakhana dhrubera baẏasa |*
*duḥkhī hañā dhrubera mātā pāẏa nānā kleśa || 46 ||*

*Word for word:* pancha vatsara yakhana — when five years; dhruvera bayasa — was Dhruva's age; duhkhi haña — unhappy; dhruvera mata paya nana klesha — Dhruva's mother suffered many hardships

**46.** When Dhruva was five years old,
Dhruva's unhappy mother suffered all kinds of hardship.

একদিন সুরুচি-সহিত মহারাজ ।
নানারসে আছে উচ্চ সিংহাসন-মাঝ ॥ ৪৭ ॥

*ekadina suruci-sahita mahārāja |*
*nānārase āche ucca siṃhāsana-mājha || 47 ||*

*Word for word:* ekadina — one day; suruchi-sahita maharaja — the Maharaja with Suruchi; nana-rase — in pleasure; achhe uchcha simhasana-majha — sat on a high throne

**47.** One day the Maharaja with Suruchi
sat in pleasure on a high throne.

উত্তমাদি সাত ভাই মা-বাপের সঙ্গে ।
রত্নময়-সিংহাসনে আছে নানারঙ্গে ॥ ৪৮ ॥

*uttamādi sāta bhāi mā-bāpera saṅge |*
*ratnamaẏa-siṃhāsane āche nānāraṅge || 48 ||*

*Word for word:* uttamadi sata bhai — the seven brothers beginning with Uttama; ma-bapera sange — with their mother and father; ratna-maya-simhasane — on the jewelled throne; achhe nana-range — enjoy all kinds of amusements

**48.** The seven brothers, beginning with Uttama, with their father and mother,
were on the jewelled throne, enjoying all kinds of amusements.

পাঁচ-বৎসরের ধ্রুব শিশুগণ-সঙ্গে ।
ধূলায় ধূসর খেলা খেলায় নানারঙ্গে ॥ ৪৯ ॥

*pāṁca-batsarera dhruba śiśugaṇa-saṅge |*
*dhūlāẏa dhūsara khelā khelāẏa nānāraṅge || 49 ||*

*Word for word:* pancha-vatsarera dhruva — five-year-old Dhruva; shishu-gana-sange — with other children; dhulaya dhusara — grey with dust; khela khelaya nana-range — plays all kinds of games

**49.** Five-year-old Dhruva with other children,
grey with dust, was playing all kinds of games.

বাপের কোলে দেখিল ভাই সাতজনে ।
তা দেখিয়া উঠে ধ্রুব রত্নসিংহাসনে ॥ ৫০ ॥

*bāpera kole dekhila bhāi sātajane |*
*tā dekhiẏā uṭhe dhruba ratnasiṃhāsane || 50 ||*

*Word for word:* bapera kole dekhila — he saw on his father's lap; bhai satajane — his seven brothers; ta dekhiya — seeing that; uthe dhruva ratna-simhasane — Dhruva climbs onto the jewelled throne

**50.** Seeing his seven brothers on his father's lap,
Dhruva climbs up onto the jewelled throne.

সিংহাসনে উঠিয়া বাপের কোলে যাইতে ।
ধ্রুবের সতাই ঠেলি' পেলিলেন ভূমিতে ॥ ৫১ ॥

*siṃhāsane uṭhiẏā bāpera kole yāite |*
*dhrubera satāi ṭheli' pelilena bhūmite || 51 ||*

*Word for word:* simhasane uthiya — climbing onto the throne; bapera kole yaite — to get onto his father's lap; dhruvera satai — Dhruva's stepmother; theli pelilena bhumite — pushed him to the ground

**51.** As he climbed onto the throne to get onto his father's lap,
Dhruva's stepmother pushed him down to the ground.

ভূমিতে পড়িয়া ধ্রুব কান্দিতে লাগিল ।
স্ত্রীর বশ হঞা রাজা কিছু না বলিল ॥ ৫২ ॥

*bhūmite paṛiẏā dhruba kāndite lāgila |*
*strīra baśa hañā rājā kichu nā balila || 52 ||*

*Word for word:* bhumite padiya — fallen on the ground; dhruva kandite lagila — Dhruva began to cry; strira basha haña — in his wife's power; raja kichhu na balila — the king said nothing

**52.** Fallen on the ground, Dhruva began to cry;
the king, in his wife's power, said nothing.

ভূমিতে পড়িয়া ধ্রুব কান্দে অভিমানে ।
মা দুর্ভাগা বাপের, ইহা নাহি জানে ॥ ৫৩ ॥

*bhūmite paṛiẏā dhruba kānde abhimāne |*
*mā durbhāgā bāpera, ihā nāhi jāne || 53 ||*

*Word for word:* bhumite padiya — fallen on the ground; dhruva kande abhimane — Dhruva weeps in wounded pride; ma durbhaga bapera — his mother is out of his father's favour; iha nahi jane — this he does not know

**53.** Fallen on the ground, Dhruva weeps in wounded pride:
he does not know that his mother is out of favour with his father.

ধ্রুবের সতাই বোলে—কান্দ অকারণে ।
দাসীর পুত্র হঞা উঠ রত্নসিংহাসনে ॥ ৫৪ ॥

*dhrubera satāi bole—kānda akāraṇe |*
*dāsīra putra hañā uṭha ratnasiṃhāsane || 54 ||*

*Word for word:* dhruvera satai bole — Dhruva's stepmother says; kanda akarane — you cry for nothing; dasira putra haña — being a maidservant's son; utha ratna-simhasane — you climb onto the jewelled throne

**54.** Dhruva's stepmother says: "You cry for nothing:
the son of a maidservant — and you climb onto the jewelled throne!

জন্মে জন্মে তোমার মা কৃষ্ণ নাহি ভজে ।
রত্নময়-সিংহাসনে উঠ কোন্ লাজে ॥ ৫৫ ॥

*janme janme tomāra mā kṛṣṇa nāhi bhaje |*
*ratnamaẏa-siṃhāsane uṭha kon lāje || 55 ||*

*Word for word:* janme janme — birth after birth; tomara ma krishna nahi bhaje — your mother has not served Krishna; ratna-maya-simhasane — onto the jewelled throne; utha kon laje — with what shame do you climb

**55.** Birth after birth your mother has not served Krishna —
have you no shame, climbing onto the jewelled throne?

অভাগীর পুত্র, তোর মা অবৈষ্ণবী ।
রত্নসিংহাসনে কোথা বসিবারে পাবি ॥ ৫৬ ॥

*abhāgīra putra, tora mā abaiṣṇabī |*
*ratnasiṃhāsane kothā basibāre pābi || 56 ||*

*Word for word:* abhagira putra — son of an unfortunate woman; tora ma avaishnavi — your mother is no Vaishnavi; ratna-simhasane — on the jewelled throne; kotha vasibare pabi — where will you get to sit

**56.** Son of an unfortunate woman, your mother is no Vaishnavi:
where will you ever sit on a jewelled throne?"

এতেক কহিল যদি ধ্রুবের সতাই ।
কান্দিতে কান্দিতে ধ্রুব গেল মায়ের ঠাঞি ॥ ৫৭ ॥

*eteka kahila yadi dhrubera satāi |*
*kāndite kāndite dhruba gela māẏera ṭhāñi || 57 ||*

*Word for word:* eteka kahila yadi — when she had said this; dhruvera satai — Dhruva's stepmother; kandite kandite — weeping and weeping; dhruva gela mayera thani — Dhruva went to his mother

**57.** When Dhruva's stepmother had said this,
Dhruva went weeping to his mother.

মায়েরে কহিল—মোরে সতাই মারিল ।
সিংহাসন হৈতে মোরে ঠেলিয়া পেলিল ॥ ৫৮ ॥

*māẏere kahila—more satāi mārila |*
*siṃhāsana haite more ṭheliẏā pelila || 58 ||*

*Word for word:* mayere kahila — he told his mother; more satai marila — stepmother hit me; simhasana haite — from the throne; more theliya pelila — she pushed me down

**58.** He told his mother: "Stepmother hit me,
she pushed me off the throne.

সতাই বোলে—তোর মা কৃষ্ণ নাহি ভজে ।
রত্নময়-সিংহাসনে বৈস কোন্ লাজে ॥ ৫৯ ॥

*satāi bole—tora mā kṛṣṇa nāhi bhaje |*
*ratnamaẏa-siṃhāsane baisa kon lāje || 59 ||*

*Word for word:* satai bole — stepmother says; tora ma krishna nahi bhaje — your mother does not serve Krishna; ratna-maya-simhasane — on the jewelled throne; vaisa kon laje — with what shame do you sit

**59.** Stepmother says: 'Your mother does not serve Krishna —
are you not ashamed to sit on the jewelled throne?'

আর এক অদ্ভুত অভিপ্রায় বাসি ।
এতকাল নাহি জানি—তুমি তার দাসী ॥ ৬০ ॥

*āra eka adbhuta abhiprāẏa bāsi |*
*etakāla nāhi jāni—tumi tāra dāsī || 60 ||*

*Word for word:* ara eka adbhuta abhipraya — and one more strange thing; basi — I heard; etakala nahi jani — all this time I did not know; tumi tara dasi — that you are her maidservant

**60.** And I have heard one more strange thing:
all this time I did not know that you are her maidservant."

এ বোল শুনিয়া কান্দে ধ্রুবের জননী ।
কৃষ্ণ নাহি ভজি বাপু, মুঞি অভাগিনী ॥ ৬১ ॥

*e bola śuniẏā kānde dhrubera jananī |*
*kṛṣṇa nāhi bhaji bāpu, muñi abhāginī || 61 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuniya — hearing this; kande dhruvera janani — Dhruva's mother weeps; krishna nahi bhaji bapu — I did not serve Krishna, my child; munni abhagini — I am unfortunate

**61.** Hearing this, Dhruva's mother weeps:
"I did not serve Krishna, my child — I am unfortunate.

জনমে জনমে আমি কৃষ্ণ নাহি ভাবি ।
কৃষ্ণের সেবক আমি, তাহা নাহি সেবি ॥ ৬২ ॥

*janame janame āmi kṛṣṇa nāhi bhābi |*
*kṛṣṇera sebaka āmi, tāhā nāhi sebi || 62 ||*

*Word for word:* janame janame — birth after birth; ami krishna nahi bhavi — I did not think of Krishna; krishnera sevaka ami — I am Krishna's servant; taha nahi sevi — yet did not serve Him

**62.** Birth after birth I never once thought of Krishna;
I am Krishna's servant, yet I did not serve Him.

না কান্দ না কান্দ বাছা দুর্ভাগীর বেটা ।
দাসীপুত্র বলিয়া সতাই দিল খোঁটা ॥ ৬৩ ॥

*nā kānda nā kānda bāchā durbhāgīra beṭā |*
*dāsīputra baliẏā satāi dila khoṁṭā || 63 ||*

*Word for word:* na kanda na kanda — do not cry, do not cry; bachha durbhagira beta — child, son of an unfortunate woman; dasi-putra baliya — calling you a maidservant's son; satai dila khonta — your stepmother taunted you

**63.** Do not cry, do not cry, child, son of an unfortunate woman:
your stepmother taunts you, calling you a maidservant's son."

ধ্রুবে কান্দি' মায়ে বোলে প্রবোধ-বচন ।
গোরাগুণ গায় সুখে এ দাস লোচন ॥ ৬৪ ॥

*dhrube kāndi' māẏe bole prabodha-bacana |*
*gorāguṇa gāẏa sukhe e dāsa locana || 64 ||*

*Word for word:* dhruve kandi — weeping, to Dhruva; maye bole prabodha-vachana — the mother speaks words of comfort; gora-guna gaya sukhe — happily sings Gora's qualities; e dasa lochana — this Lochana Dasa

**64.** Weeping, the mother speaks words of comfort to Dhruva;
Lochana Dasa happily sings of Gora's qualities.

*Raga sindhura*

অভাগীর উদরে পুত্র, জন্ম হৈল তোর ধ্রুব,
কৃষ্ণসেবা নাহি করি আমি ।
বাপের দুলাল নহ, সিংহাসনে চড়িতে চাহ,
হতভাগা না জন্মিলে তুমি ॥ ৬৫ ॥

*abhāgīra udare putra, janma haila tora dhruba,*
*kṛṣṇasebā nāhi kari āmi |*
*bāpera dulāla naha, siṃhāsane caṛite cāha,*
*hatabhāgā nā janmile tumi || 65 ||*

*Word for word:* abhagira udare — from an unfortunate woman's womb; putra janma haila tora dhruva — my son Dhruva, you were born; krishna-seva nahi kari ami — I did not serve Krishna; bapera dulala naha — you are not your father's darling; simhasane chadite chaha — you want to climb the throne; hatabhaga na janmile tumi — poor child, better you had not been born

**65.** "From the womb of an unfortunate woman, my son Dhruva,
you were born: I did not serve Krishna.
You are not your father's darling, yet you want to climb onto the throne —
poor child, better you had not been born [to me]!

না কান্দ না কান্দ ধ্রুব, তোরে কহি অনুভব,
শুন শুন আমার বচন ।
তোমার সতাই পূর্বে, কৃষ্ণ আরাধিয়াছিল,
সৌভাগ্য হইল তে-কারণ ॥ ৬৬ ॥

*nā kānda nā kānda dhruba, tore kahi anubhaba,*
*śuna śuna āmāra bacana |*
*tomāra satāi pūrbe, kṛṣṇa ārādhiẏāchila,*
*saubhāgya haila te-kāraṇa || 66 ||*

*Word for word:* na kanda na kanda dhruva — do not cry, Dhruva; tore kahi anubhava — I tell you what I know; shuna shuna amara vachana — listen to my words; tomara satai purve — your stepmother once; krishna aradhiyachhila — worshipped Krishna; saubhagya haila te-karana — that is why she became fortunate

**66.** Do not cry, do not cry, Dhruva, I shall tell you what I know —
listen, listen to my words:
your stepmother once worshipped Krishna —
that is why she became fortunate.

কৃষ্ণের চরণ ভজে, সিংহাসন কিসে লাগে,
যাহা চাহ তাহা তুমি পাবে ।
মিছা অভিমান তেজ, কৃষ্ণের চরণ ভজ,
অনায়াসে সব তুমি পাবে ॥ ৬৭ ॥

*kṛṣṇera caraṇa bhaje, siṃhāsana kise lāge,*
*yāhā cāha tāhā tumi pābe |*
*michā abhimāna teja, kṛṣṇera caraṇa bhaja,*
*anāẏāse saba tumi pābe || 67 ||*

*Word for word:* krishnera charana bhaje — if one serves Krishna's feet; simhasana kise lage — what need of a throne; yaha chaha taha tumi pabe — whatever you desire you will obtain; michha abhimana teja — give up empty pride; krishnera charana bhaja — serve Krishna's feet; anayase saba tumi pabe — you will easily obtain everything

**67.** If you serve Krishna's feet, what need have you of the throne?
Whatever you desire, you will obtain.
Give up empty pride, serve Krishna's feet —
and you will easily obtain everything.

তুমি হেন মোর বেটা, সংসার জুড়ে খোঁটা,
কেমনে চড়িবে বাপের কোলে ।
আমি জন্ম অভাগিনী, এ বোল শুনিয়া রাণী,
ভাসিতে লাগিল অশ্রুজলে ॥ ৬৮ ॥

*tumi hena mora beṭā, saṃsāra juṛe khoṁṭā,*
*kemane caṛibe bāpera kole |*
*āmi janma abhāginī, e bola śuniẏā rāṇī,*
*bhāsite lāgila aśrujale || 68 ||*

*Word for word:* tumi hena mora beta — such is my son; samsara jude khonta — the whole world taunts; kemane chadibe bapera kole — how will you climb onto your father's lap; ami janma abhagini — I was born unfortunate; e bola shuniya rani — saying this, the queen; bhasite lagila ashru-jale — was drowned in tears

**68.** Such is my son — and the whole world taunts us —
how will you climb onto your father's lap?
I was born unfortunate" — saying this, the queen
was drowned in tears.

আরে ধ্রুব শুন শুন আমার বচন ।
তোর দুঃখবিমোচন, করিতে না পারে আন,
বিনে এক কমললোচন ॥ ৬৯ ॥

*āre dhruba śuna śuna āmāra bacana |*
*tora duḥkhabimocana, karite nā pāre āna,*
*bine eka kamalalocana || 69 ||*

*Word for word:* are dhruva — O Dhruva; shuna shuna amara vachana — listen to my words; tora duhkha-vimochana — the relief of your grief; karite na pare ana — no one else can bring; vine eka kamala-lochana — but the one Lotus-eyed

**69.** "O Dhruva, listen, listen to my words:
no one else can free you from your grief
but the one Lotus-eyed.

ব্রহ্মা আদি দেব যত, কৃষ্ণসেবা করি' কত,
উচ্চপদ লৈল স্বর্গভূমি ।
তুমি যদি কৃষ্ণ ভজ, সিংহাসন কোন্ পদ,
ত্রৈলোক্যপূজিত হবে তুমি ॥ ৭০ ॥

*brahmā ādi deba yata, kṛṣṇasebā kari' kata,*
*uccapada laila sbargabhūmi |*
*tumi yadi kṛṣṇa bhaja, siṃhāsana kon pada,*
*trailokyapūjita habe tumi || 70 ||*

*Word for word:* brahma adi deva yata — Brahma and all the gods; krishna-seva kari kata — serving Krishna much; uchcha-pada laila svarga-bhumi — obtained high places in heaven; tumi yadi krishna bhaja — if you serve Krishna; simhasana kon pada — what position is a throne; trailokya-pujita habe tumi — you will be honoured in the three worlds

**70.** Brahma and all the gods, by serving Krishna much,
obtained high places in heaven;
if you serve Krishna, what is a throne? —
you will be honoured in the three worlds."

মায়ের বচন শুনি', ধ্রুব মনে মনে গুণি',
কোথা পাব কৃষ্ণের উদ্দেশ ।
মধুবনে কৃষ্ণ পাবে, তথায়ে কেমনে যাবে,
তোরে আমি করি উপদেশ ॥ ৭১ ॥

*māẏera bacana śuni', dhruba mane mane guṇi',*
*kothā pāba kṛṣṇera uddeśa |*
*madhubane kṛṣṇa pābe, tathāẏe kemane yābe,*
*tore āmi kari upadeśa || 71 ||*

*Word for word:* mayera vachana shuni — hearing his mother's words; dhruva mane mane guni — Dhruva ponders within; kotha paba krishnera uddesha — where shall I find Krishna; madhubane krishna pabe — you will find Krishna in Madhuvana; tathaye kemane yabe — how to go there; tore ami kari upadesha — I shall teach you

**71.** Hearing his mother's words, Dhruva ponders within:
"Where shall I find Krishna?"
"You will find Krishna in Madhuvana; how to go there
I shall teach you.

উত্তানপাদের পুত্র, যদি হও তুমি সত্য,
সেই সিংহাসন যদি পাও ।
তবে …… ধরে, তোমাকে সৌভাগ্য করে,
সেই সিংহাসন যদি লেও ॥ ৭২ ॥

*uttānapādera putra, yadi hao tumi satya,*
*sei siṃhāsana yadi pāo |*
*tabe …… dhare, tomāke saubhāgya kare,*
*sei siṃhāsana yadi leo || 72 ||*

*Word for word:* uttanapadera putra — the son of Uttanapada; yadi hao tumi satya — if you truly are; sei simhasana yadi pao — if you would gain that throne; tabe … dhare — then …; tomake saubhagya kare — will make you fortunate; sei simhasana yadi leo — and you will take that throne

**72.** If you are [truly] the son of Uttanapada
and wish to obtain that throne —
then [Krishna] will make you fortunate,
and you will gain that throne."[^36-12]

মায়ের চরণধূলি, শিরেতে ভূষণ করি',
শুভক্ষণে যাত্রা করি' লড়ে ।
শ্রীকৃষ্ণচরণ ধ্যান, মনে করি' অনুমান,
স্বর্গে জয়জয়কার পড়ে ॥ ৭৩ ॥

*māẏera caraṇadhūli, śirete bhūṣaṇa kari',*
*śubhakṣaṇe yātrā kari' laṛe |*
*śrīkṛṣṇacaraṇa dhyāna, mane kari' anumāna,*
*sbarge jaẏajaẏakāra paṛe || 73 ||*

*Word for word:* mayera charana-dhuli — the dust of his mother's feet; shirete bhushana kari — placing on his head as an ornament; shubha-kshane yatra kari lade — at an auspicious hour he sets out; shri-krishna-charana dhyana — meditation on Sri Krishna's feet; mane kari anumana — fixing in his mind; svarge jaya-jayakara pade — cries of victory ring out in heaven

**73.** Placing the dust of his mother's feet on his head as an ornament,
at an auspicious hour he sets out,
fixing his mind on Sri Krishna's feet —
and in heaven cries of "Victory!" ring out.

*Raga suhai; refrain: "Teach me — where shall I go to find news of my dark Friend?"*

আর অপরূপ কথা শুন সর্বজন ।
প্রভু বোলেন—শচীমাতা করেন শ্রবণ ॥ ৭৪ ॥

*āra aparūpa kathā śuna sarbajana |*
*prabhu bolena—śacīmātā karena śrabaṇa || 74 ||*

*Word for word:* ara aparupa katha — another wondrous story; shuna sarvajana — hear, all; prabhu bolena — the Lord tells; shachi-mata karena shravana — mother Shachi listens

**74.** Hear, all of you, another wondrous story:
the Lord tells it, mother Shachi listens.

মায়ের চরণধূলি শিরেতে বন্দিয়া ।
মায়েরে প্রবোধ দেন কান্দিয়া কান্দিয়া ॥ ৭৫ ॥

*māẏera caraṇadhūli śirete bandiẏā |*
*māẏere prabodha dena kāndiẏā kāndiẏā || 75 ||*

*Word for word:* mayera charana-dhuli — the dust of his mother's feet; shirete vandiya — honouring with his head; mayere prabodha dena — he consoles his mother; kandiya kandiya — weeping and weeping

**75.** Honouring with his head the dust of his mother's feet,
weeping and weeping, he consoles his mother.

চলিলেন মধুবন ধ্রুব-মহাশয় ।
কৃষ্ণভক্তি উচ্চপদ করিঞা হৃদয় ॥ ৭৬ ॥

*calilena madhubana dhruba-mahāśaẏa |*
*kṛṣṇabhakti uccapada kariñā hṛdaẏa || 76 ||*

*Word for word:* chalilena madhubana — set out for Madhuvana; dhruva-mahashaya — the great soul Dhruva; krishna-bhakti uchcha-pada — the high position, devotion to Krishna; kariña hridaya — setting his heart on

**76.** The great soul Dhruva set out for Madhuvana,
having set his heart on the high position — devotion to Krishna.

পথশ্রমে ধ্রুব যদি ক্ষুধায় পীড়িত ।
মধুময় পাকা ফল পায় আচম্বিত ॥ ৭৭ ॥

*pathaśrame dhruba yadi kṣudhāẏa pīṛita |*
*madhumaẏa pākā phala pāẏa ācambita || 77 ||*

*Word for word:* patha-shrame — weary from the road; dhruva yadi kshudhaya pidita — when Dhruva suffered from hunger; madhumaya paka phala — sweet ripe fruits; paya achambita — he suddenly found

**77.** When Dhruva, weary from the road, suffered from hunger,
he would suddenly find sweet ripe fruits.

তৃষ্ণায় পীড়িত হঞা ধ্রুব চলি' যায় ।
সুবাসিত গন্ধজল পথমধ্যে পায় ॥ ৭৮ ॥

*tṛṣṇāẏa pīṛita hañā dhruba cali' yāẏa |*
*subāsita gandhajala pathamadhye pāẏa || 78 ||*

*Word for word:* trishnaya pidita haña — tormented by thirst; dhruva chali yaya — Dhruva goes on; suvasita gandha-jala — fragrant water; patha-madhye paya — finds on the way

**78.** When Dhruva went on, tormented by thirst,
he would find fragrant water on the way.

দেখি' সব দেবগণে লাগে চমৎকার ।
না জানি এই ধ্রুব কার লবে অধিকার ॥ ৭৯ ॥

*dekhi' saba debagaṇe lāge camatkāra |*
*nā jāni ei dhruba kāra labe adhikāra || 79 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhi saba deva-gane — seeing this, all the gods; lage chamatkara — are amazed; na jani — we do not know; ei dhruva kara labe adhikara — whose place this Dhruva will take

**79.** Seeing this, all the gods are amazed:
"We do not know whose place this Dhruva will take."[^36-13]

পথে যাইতে নারদ ধ্রুবের লাগি পাইলা ।
মধুরবচনে কিছু কহিতে লাগিলা ॥ ৮০ ॥

*pathe yāite nārada dhrubera lāgi pāilā |*
*madhurabacane kichu kahite lāgilā || 80 ||*

*Word for word:* pathe yaite — on the way; narada dhruvera lagi paila — Narada met Dhruva; madhura-vachane — with sweet words; kichhu kahite lagila — began to speak

**80.** On the way Narada met Dhruva
and began to speak sweet words to him:

খেলার সময় তুমি রাজার নন্দন ।
মান-অভিমান চিত্তে কর অকারণ ॥ ৮১ ॥

*khelāra samaẏa tumi rājāra nandana |*
*māna-abhimāna citte kara akāraṇa || 81 ||*

*Word for word:* khelara samaya — at the age for play; tumi rajara nandana — you, a king's son; mana-abhimana chitte — hurt and pride in your heart; kara akarana — harbour needlessly

**81.** "At the age for play you, a king's son,
needlessly harbour hurt and pride in your heart.

এখন বনবাসে তোমারে নহে বিধি ।
বৃদ্ধকালে ভজিহ গোবিন্দ গুণনিধি ॥ ৮২ ॥

*ekhana banabāse tomāre nahe bidhi |*
*bṛddhakāle bhajiha gobinda guṇanidhi || 82 ||*

*Word for word:* ekhana banavase — now to forest life; tomare nahe vidhi — is not the rule for you; vriddha-kale bhajiha — in old age serve; govinda guna-nidhi — Govinda, the treasury of virtues

**82.** It is not the time for you now to go to the forest;
in old age serve Govinda, the treasury of virtues."

ধ্রুব বোলে—বৃদ্ধকালে কৃষ্ণসেবা যদি ।
যুবাকালে মরিলে কেমন তার বিধি ॥ ৮৩ ॥

*dhruba bole—bṛddhakāle kṛṣṇasebā yadi |*
*yubākāle marile kemana tāra bidhi || 83 ||*

*Word for word:* dhruva bole — Dhruva says; vriddha-kale krishna-seva yadi — if service to Krishna is in old age; yuva-kale marile — if one dies in youth; kemana tara vidhi — what of that rule

**83.** Dhruva answers: "If one is to serve Krishna in old age —
then if one dies in youth, what of that rule?"

ইহা শুনি' মহামুনি হরষিত হৈলা ।
দ্বাদশ-অক্ষর-মন্ত্র ধ্রুবেরে কহিলা ॥ ৮৪ ॥

*ihā śuni' mahāmuni haraṣita hailā |*
*dbādaśa-akṣara-mantra dhrubere kahilā || 84 ||*

*Word for word:* iha shuni — hearing this; maha-muni harashita haila — the great sage rejoiced; dvadasha-akshara-mantra — the twelve-syllable mantra; dhruvere kahila — he imparted to Dhruva

**84.** Hearing this, the great sage rejoiced
and imparted to Dhruva the twelve-syllable mantra.

পূর্বে কৃষ্ণ না ভজিঞা পাইনু এত দুখ ।
সতাইর বাক্যবাণে বিদ্ধ হৈল বুক ॥ ৮৫ ॥

*pūrbe kṛṣṇa nā bhajiñā pāinu eta dukha |*
*satāira bākyabāṇe biddha haila buka || 85 ||*

*Word for word:* purve krishna na bhajiña — not having served Krishna before; painu eta dukha — I got so much grief; sataira vakya-bane — by the arrows of my stepmother's words; viddha haila buka — my heart is pierced

**85.** [Dhruva said:] "Before, I did not serve Krishna — hence so much grief;
my heart is pierced by the arrows of my stepmother's words.

তুমি বড় দয়াবান্, মুঞি অভাগিয়া ।
দুঃখ দূর কর কৃষ্ণ-উপদেশ দিয়া ॥ ৮৬ ॥

*tumi baṛa daẏābān, muñi abhāgiẏā |*
*duḥkha dūra kara kṛṣṇa-upadeśa diẏā || 86 ||*

*Word for word:* tumi bada dayavan — you are most merciful; munni abhagiya — I am unfortunate; duhkha dura kara — remove my grief; krishna-upadesha diya — by instructing me about Krishna

**86.** You are most merciful, and I am unfortunate:
remove my grief by instructing me [in the service] of Krishna.

হেন পদ লৈব কৃষ্ণ-সেবার প্রভাবে ।
যাহা নাহি পায় মোর বাপ বড়বাপে ॥ ৮৭ ॥

*hena pada laiba kṛṣṇa-sebāra prabhābe |*
*yāhā nāhi pāẏa mora bāpa baṛabāpe || 87 ||*

*Word for word:* hena pada laiba — such a place I shall take; krishna-sevara prabhave — by the power of serving Krishna; yaha nahi paya — as was not attained; mora bapa bada-bape — by my father and grandfather

**87.** By the power of serving Krishna I shall gain such a place
as neither my father nor my grandfather attained."

মধুবনে যাহ ধ্রুব কালিন্দীর তীরে ।
সুস্থির আসন করি' বসি' রহ স্থিরে ॥ ৮৮ ॥

*madhubane yāha dhruba kālindīra tīre |*
*susthira āsana kari' basi' raha sthire || 88 ||*

*Word for word:* madhubane yaha dhruva — go, Dhruva, to Madhuvana; kalindira tire — on the bank of the Kalindi; susthira asana kari — making a firm seat; vasi raha sthire — sit and remain unmoving

**88.** [Narada said:] "Go, Dhruva, to Madhuvana, on the bank of the Kalindi;
make a firm seat, sit and remain unmoving.

বীজমন্ত্র মহা তুমি করহ সহায় ।
ওঁ নমো ভগবতে বাসুদেবায় ॥ ৮৯ ॥

*bījamantra mahā tumi karaha sahāẏa |*
*oṁ namo bhagabate bāsudebāẏa || 89 ||*

*Word for word:* bija-mantra maha — the great seed-mantra; tumi karaha sahaya — make your support; om namo bhagavate vasudevaya — "Om, obeisance to Bhagavan Vasudeva"

**89.** Make the great seed-mantra your support:
'Om namo bhagavate vasudevaya'.

এই মন্ত্র সদা তুমি করিহ জপ ।
সাতদিবসের মাঝে পাবে অনুভব ॥ ৯০ ॥

*ei mantra sadā tumi kariha japa |*
*sātadibasera mājhe pābe anubhaba || 90 ||*

*Word for word:* ei mantra sada — this mantra always; tumi kariha japa — do repeat; sata-divasera majhe — within seven days; pabe anubhava — you will have realisation

**90.** Always repeat this mantra —
and within seven days you will have realisation."

দীক্ষা-শিক্ষা পাঞা ধ্রুব হরিষ হইলা ।
প্রণাম করিয়া বৃন্দাবনেরে চলিলা ॥ ৯১ ॥

*dīkṣā-śikṣā pāñā dhruba hariṣa hailā |*
*praṇāma kariẏā bṛndābanere calilā || 91 ||*

*Word for word:* diksha-shiksha pana — receiving initiation and instruction; dhruva harisha haila — Dhruva rejoiced; pranama kariya — bowing; vrindavanere chalila — went to Vrindavana

**91.** Having received initiation and instruction, Dhruva rejoiced
and, bowing, went to Vrindavana.

কথোক দিবসে আসি' মধুবন পাইল ।
কল্পতরু বৃক্ষ দেখি' অবিদ্যা ছাড়িল ॥ ৯২ ॥

*kathoka dibase āsi' madhubana pāila |*
*kalpataru bṛkṣa dekhi' abidyā chāṛila || 92 ||*

*Word for word:* kathoka divase asi — coming after some days; madhubana paila — he reached Madhuvana; kalpataru vriksha dekhi — seeing the wish-fulfilling trees; avidya chhadila — he cast off ignorance

**92.** In some days he reached Madhuvana;
seeing the wish-fulfilling trees, he cast off ignorance.

উত্তানপাদের বেটা মধুবন পায় ।
আনন্দে লোচনদাস গোরাগুণ গায় ॥ ৯৩ ॥

*uttānapādera beṭā madhubana pāẏa |*
*ānande locanadāsa gorāguṇa gāẏa || 93 ||*

*Word for word:* uttanapadera beta — the son of Uttanapada; madhubana paya — reaches Madhuvana; anande lochanadasa — in joy Lochana Dasa; gora-guna gaya — sings Gora's qualities

**93.** The son of Uttanapada reaches Madhuvana —
in joy Lochana Dasa sings of Gora's qualities.

[^36-1]: The Lord speaks in the person of a man, to instruct people: He Himself is not subject to maya; "samsara" and "maya" in vv. 135–140 are the lot of conditioned souls. So Murari too understands it in v. 151.
[^36-2]: That is, the Lord, the independent Master, takes on the bhava of separation from Krishna in order to teach people and bestow His mercy on them.
[^36-3]: Cf. Murari 2.18.23: "I Myself always dwell in your shrine."
[^36-4]: The OCR of the summary is badly garbled (vv. 15–16 of the poem have also strayed into it); gaps are filled by sense and from the table of contents in the edition's preface ("the grief of mother Shachi on hearing that the Lord will take sannyasa, … the request [to keep] the [householder's] dharma; the Lord, telling the story of Dhruva, instructs in the service of Krishna; consoling His mother with various words and showing her the form of Sri Krishna, He dispels her grief"). The summary also covers pastimes told in the next portion. The disha (refrain) is given from the 1903 edition (it is illegible in the OCR of A); the 1983 edition has: "Ah, Nimai, my Nimai, do not leave me — but for you I have no one in all the world."
[^36-5]: Before Vishvarupa's birth Shachi had lost eight daughters, and Vishvarupa had taken sannyasa. In A this couplet and the beginning of the next have strayed into the OCR of the summary; restored from B and C.
[^36-6]: Shachi's arguments are the usual objections to sannyasa in youth and in the Kali age; the Lord answers them below. Shachi is the Lord's eternal mother (Yashoda in Vraja); her grief is the expression of a mother's love (vatsalya-prema).
[^36-7]: V. 34+1 (Lochana Dasa's signature) is found only in the 1983 edition; the 1903 edition has it in the main text, in brackets (as this editor marks lines found not in all manuscripts). In the 1983 edition the chapter ends with it, and the Lord's answer to His mother begins with the next chapter — with en/37, v. 180; the story of Dhruva (v. 35 — en/37, v. 179) is absent there (see note 8).
[^36-8]: The raga and refrain lines in A are badly corrupted ("যথা—রাগ । চান্দ-মুখের বচন অমিয়া । রূপ গল কেমন বিধি দৈরজ ধরিয়া ॥ ধ্রু ॥"); only the beginning is translated. In the 1903 edition these lines and the whole story of Dhruva (vv. 35–93 and beyond) are given in a footnote as an additional reading from one manuscript; the 1983 edition has no story of Dhruva: after v. 34 and the signature (v. 34+1) it goes straight on to the consolation of the mother. In Bhaktisiddhanta's edition the story is in the main text; we translate it but note that it is apparently a later insertion.
[^36-9]: The story of Dhruva is Bhagavata 4.8–9; Lochana Dasa retells it freely, with details not found in the Bhagavata.
[^36-10]: A shloka from Rupa Gosvami's Padyavali; the same as in en/24 (v. 15 of the section). Bhaktisiddhanta's prose rendering of the shloka is not translated.
[^36-11]: In the Bhagavata (4.8.8–9) Suruchi has one son, Uttama.
[^36-12]: The stanza is corrupt in A and in the 1903 edition ("তবে «'ননাম পরেশ তোমাকে মৌভাগ্য করে"; C: "তবে একবমাম ধরে? তোমাকে সৌভাগ্য করে"); translated by sense.
[^36-13]: The gods fear that the ascetic will take the place of one of them (cf. Bhagavata 4.8.80–81).

---

# Madhya-khanda, part 14 (portion 37)

*The section "Mother Shachi's Grief" (end): Dhruva's austerities in Madhuvana and his testing by the gods; Narada with Krishna in Vaikuntha; Krishna grants Dhruva the highest place; Dhruva's return and reign; Shachi wishes to go with her son as a yogini; the Lord instructs His mother, shows her the form of Krishna and promises to come whenever she calls*

*Raga sindhura; disha: "Hari, O great one! I shall take refuge at Govinda's feet: the great sweetness of those crimson feet I have only now come to know."[^37-1]*

মধুবন দেখি' ধ্রুবের আনন্দ বাড়িল ।
তীর্থ-উপবাস করি' রজনী বঞ্চিল ॥ ৯৪ ॥

*madhubana dekhi' dhrubera ānanda bāṛila |*
*tīrtha-upabāsa kari' rajanī bañcila || 94 ||*

*Word for word:* madhubana dekhi — seeing Madhuvana; dhruvera ananda badila — Dhruva's joy grew; tirtha-upavasa kari — keeping the pilgrim's fast; rajani vanchila — he spent the night

**94.** Seeing Madhuvana, Dhruva was filled with joy;
keeping the pilgrim's fast, he spent the night [there].

প্রাতঃস্নান করি' ধ্রুব মন্ত্রজপ করে ।
না পাইল ক্ষুধা-তৃষ্ণা, ভাসে অশ্রুজলে ॥ ৯৫ ॥

*prātaḥsnāna kari' dhruba mantrajapa kare |*
*nā pāila kṣudhā-tṛṣṇā, bhāse aśrujale || 95 ||*

*Word for word:* pratah-snana kari — bathing at dawn; dhruva mantra-japa kare — Dhruva repeats the mantra; na paila kshudha-trishna — felt no hunger or thirst; bhase ashru-jale — floats in tears

**95.** Bathing at dawn, Dhruva repeats the mantra;
he feels neither hunger nor thirst — and is awash in tears.

পাঁচ সাত দিনে এক বদরি-ভক্ষণ ।
পক্ষান্তরে জলবিন্দু তুলসী-স্পর্শন ॥ ৯৬ ॥

*pāṁca sāta dine eka badari-bhakṣaṇa |*
*pakṣāntare jalabindu tulasī-sparśana || 96 ||*

*Word for word:* pancha sata dine — once in five or seven days; eka badari-bhakshana — eating one badari berry; pakshantare — after a fortnight; jala-bindu — a drop of water; tulasi-sparshana — touched by tulasi

**96.** Once in five or seven days he ate a single badari berry,
and after a fortnight — a drop of water touched by tulasi.

একান্ত ত্রিশ ত্রিশ কাল উপবাসে ।
পারণা আহার ধ্রুব করে একমাসে ॥ ৯৭ ॥

*ekānta triśa triśa kāla upabāse |*
*pāraṇā āhāra dhruba kare ekamāse || 97 ||*

*Word for word:* ekanta — continuously; trisha trisha kala upavase — fasting thirty days at a time; parana ahara — the fast-breaking meal; dhruva kare eka-mase — Dhruva takes once a month

**97.** Fasting thirty days at a stretch,
Dhruva broke his fast only once a month.[^37-2]

ঊর্ধ্ববাহু করপুটে একপায়ে ভর ।
মন্ত্রজপ করে ধ্রুব দ্বাদশ-অক্ষর ॥ ৯৮ ॥

*ūrdhbabāhu karapuṭe ekapāẏe bhara |*
*mantrajapa kare dhruba dbādaśa-akṣara || 98 ||*

*Word for word:* urdhva-bahu — arms raised; kara-pute — palms joined; eka-paye bhara — standing on one foot; mantra-japa kare dhruva — Dhruva repeats the mantra; dvadasha-akshara — of twelve syllables

**98.** Arms raised, palms joined, standing on one foot,
Dhruva repeats the twelve-syllable mantra.

কালিন্দীর জলে ঊর্ধ্ব চরণযুগলে ।
গ্রীষ্মে তপ করে চারিদিগে অগ্নি জ্বলে ॥ ৯৯ ॥

*kālindīra jale ūrdhba caraṇayugale |*
*grīṣme tapa kare cāridige agni jbale || 99 ||*

*Word for word:* kalindira jale — in the waters of the Kalindi; urdhva charana-yugale — with both feet upward; grishme tapa kare — in the hot season performs tapas; charidige agni jvale — with fire blazing on four sides

**99.** [Standing] in the waters of the Kalindi, feet upward,[^37-3] [he practised austerity],
and in the hot season he performed tapas amid fires blazing on four sides.

শীতকালে কালিন্দীর জলে পড়ি' রহে ।
বর্ষাতে মঞ্চেতে — তাতে এত দুঃখ সহে ॥ ১০০ ॥

*śītakāle kālindīra jale paṛi' rahe |*
*barṣāte mañcete — tāte eta duḥkha sahe || 100 ||*

*Word for word:* shita-kale — in winter; kalindira jale padi rahe — lies in the waters of the Kalindi; barshate manchete — in the rains on a platform; tate eta duhkha sahe — thus he endures so much hardship

**100.** In winter he lies in the waters of the Kalindi,
in the rains on an open platform: so many hardships he endures.

ভাবিতে ভাবিতে ধ্রুবের লাগিল সমাধি ।
ত্রিভঙ্গ রহিল কৃষ্ণ-দর্শন অবধি ॥ ১০১ ॥

*bhābite bhābite dhrubera lāgila samādhi |*
*tribhaṅga rahila kṛṣṇa-darśana abadhi || 101 ||*

*Word for word:* bhavite bhavite — meditating and meditating; dhruvera lagila samadhi — samadhi came upon Dhruva; tribhanga rahila — Tribhanga remained [in his meditation]; krishna-darshana avadhi — until the sight of Krishna

**101.** Meditating and meditating, Dhruva entered samadhi:
the form of Tribhanga did not leave him until he saw Krishna.[^37-4]

ইন্দ্র-আদি দেবগণে লাগে চমৎকার ।
না জানি এ কার পদ লবে অধিকার ॥ ১০২ ॥

*indra-ādi debagaṇe lāge camatkāra |*
*nā jāni e kāra pada labe adhikāra || 102 ||*

*Word for word:* indra-adi devagane — Indra and the other gods; lage chamatkara — wonder seizes; na jani — we do not know; e kara pada labe adhikara — whose place he will take

**102.** Indra and the other gods were seized with wonder:
"We do not know whose place he will take!"

ব্রহ্মা বোলে — পাছে লয় মোর অধিকার ।
ব্রহ্মপদ লবে ধ্রুব, জানি প্রতিকার ॥ ১০৩ ॥

*brahmā bole — pāche laẏa mora adhikāra |*
*brahmapada labe dhruba, jāni pratikāra || 103 ||*

*Word for word:* brahma bole — Brahma says; pachhe laya mora adhikara — lest he take my place; brahma-pada labe dhruva — Dhruva will take Brahma's seat; jani pratikara — let us find a remedy

**103.** Brahma says: "What if he takes my place?
Dhruva will take Brahma's seat — a remedy must be found."

কুবের বরুণ বোলে — মোর পদ লবে ।
কৃষ্ণ দিবেন ইহা জানি অনুভবে ॥ ১০৪ ॥

*kubera baruṇa bole — mora pada labe |*
*kṛṣṇa dibena ihā jāni anubhabe || 104 ||*

*Word for word:* kuvera baruna bole — Kubera and Varuna say; mora pada labe — he will take my place; krishna dibena iha — Krishna will give it; jani anubhave — we know by intuition

**104.** Kubera and Varuna say: "He will take my place:
Krishna will give it to him — we sense it."

ইন্দ্র বোলেন — ধ্রুব মোর পদ লবে ।
ততক্ষণে কৃষ্ণচন্দ্র কৃপা করি' দিবে ॥ ১০৫ ॥

*indra bolena — dhruba mora pada labe |*
*tatakṣaṇe kṛṣṇacandra kṛpā kari' dibe || 105 ||*

*Word for word:* indra bolena — Indra says; dhruva mora pada labe — Dhruva will take my place; tatakshane — at once; krishnachandra kripa kari dibe — Krishnachandra will mercifully give [it]

**105.** Indra says: "Dhruva will take my place —
Krishnachandra in His mercy will give it to him at once."

ইন্দ্র বোলে — মোর পদ সভার অভিলাষ ।
মোর পদ লবে ধ্রুব করিয়া উদাস ॥ ১০৬ ॥

*indra bole — mora pada sabhāra abhilāṣa |*
*mora pada labe dhruba kariẏā udāsa || 106 ||*

*Word for word:* indra bole — Indra says; mora pada sabhara abhilasha — my place is everyone's desire; mora pada labe dhruva — Dhruva will take my place; kariya udasa — leaving [me] bereft

**106.** Indra says: "My place is what everyone desires —
Dhruva will take it and leave me with nothing."

সর্বদেবগণে বোলে — উচ্চাসনে আমি ।
মোর পদ লবে ধ্রুব বড় পরিশ্রমী ॥ ১০৭ ॥

*sarbadebagaṇe bole — uccāsane āmi |*
*mora pada labe dhruba baṛa pariśramī || 107 ||*

*Word for word:* sarva-devagane bole — all the gods say; uchchasane ami — I am on a high throne; mora pada labe dhruva — Dhruva will take my place; bada parishrami — the great toiler

**107.** All the gods say: "I sit on a high throne;
Dhruva, the great ascetic, will take my place."

ধ্রুবের উৎকট তপ ভঙ্গ করিবারে ।
ব্রহ্মা-আদি দেবগণে নানা যুক্তি করে ॥ ১০৮ ॥

*dhrubera utkaṭa tapa bhaṅga karibāre |*
*brahmā-ādi debagaṇe nānā yukti kare || 108 ||*

*Word for word:* dhruvera utkata tapa — Dhruva's fierce austerity; bhanga karibare — in order to break; brahma-adi devagane — Brahma and the other gods; nana yukti kare — devise various schemes

**108.** To break Dhruva's fierce austerity,
Brahma and the other gods devise various schemes.

ত্রিভঙ্গে আছেন ধ্রুব একমন-চিত্তে ।
ইন্দ্র-আদি লঞা ব্রহ্মা গেলা পরীক্ষিতে ॥ ১০৯ ॥

*tribhaṅge āchena dhruba ekamana-citte |*
*indra-ādi lañā brahmā gelā parīkṣite || 109 ||*

*Word for word:* tribhange achhena dhruva — Dhruva abides in Tribhanga; ekamana-chitte — with one-pointed mind; indra-adi lana — taking Indra and others; brahma gela parikshite — Brahma went to test

**109.** Dhruva abides [in meditation on] Tribhanga with all his mind and heart;
Brahma, with Indra and the others, went to test him.

ধ্রুবের কর্ণমূলে কেহো ডাকে উচ্চ-রোলে —
মরিতে আইলে ধ্রুব মরিবার তরে ॥ ১১০ ॥

*dhrubera karṇamūle keho ḍāke ucca-role —*
*marite āile dhruba maribāra tare || 110 ||*

*Word for word:* dhruvera karna-mule — right at Dhruva's ear; keho dake uchcha-role — someone shouts loudly; marite aile dhruva — you have come to die, Dhruva; maribara tare — to your death

**110.** Right at Dhruva's ear someone shouts loudly:
"You have come here to your death, Dhruva!"

আর কেহো বোলে — ধ্রুব, মৈল তোর বাপ ।
কেহো বোলে — আরে ধ্রুব, যায় কালসাপ ॥ ১১১ ॥

*āra keho bole — dhruba, maila tora bāpa |*
*keho bole — āre dhruba, yāẏa kālasāpa || 111 ||*

*Word for word:* ara keho bole — another says; dhruva, maila tora bapa — Dhruva, your father is dead; keho bole — someone says; are dhruva — hey, Dhruva; yaya kala-sapa — a black cobra goes [by]

**111.** Another shouts: "Dhruva, your father is dead!"
Someone shouts: "Hey, Dhruva, a black cobra is coming!"

আর কেহ বোলে — ধ্রুব, মৈল তোর মা ।
কেহো বোলে — ধ্রুব, ঝাট পলাইয়া যা ॥ ১১২ ॥

*āra keha bole — dhruba, maila tora mā |*
*keho bole — dhruba, jhāṭa palāiẏā yā || 112 ||*

*Word for word:* ara keha bole — another says; dhruva, maila tora ma — Dhruva, your mother is dead; keho bole — someone says; jhata palaiya ya — run away quickly

**112.** Another shouts: "Dhruva, your mother is dead!"
Someone shouts: "Dhruva, run away quickly!"

আর কেহ বোলে — ধ্রুব, দাবাগ্নি আইল ।
কেহো বোলে — অহো, ধ্রুব মইল মইল ॥ ১১৩ ॥

*āra keha bole — dhruba, dābāgni āila |*
*keho bole — aho, dhruba maila maila || 113 ||*

*Word for word:* ara keha bole — another says; dabagni aila — a forest fire has come; keho bole — someone says; aho, dhruva maila maila — ah, Dhruva is dead, dead

**113.** Another shouts: "Dhruva, a forest fire is coming!"
Someone shouts: "Ah, Dhruva is dead, dead!"

ইন্দ্র হস্তী লঞা ধ্রুবের বুকে দিল দাঁত ।
শুণ্ডে বেড়াইয়া আনে ধ্রুবের জীভ ॥ ১১৪ ॥

*indra hastī lañā dhrubera buke dila dāṁta |*
*śuṇḍe beṛāiẏā āne dhrubera jībha || 114 ||*

*Word for word:* indra hasti lana — Indra, bringing an elephant; dhruvera buke dila data — drove tusks into Dhruva's chest; shunde bedaiya — coiling with its trunk; ane dhruvera jibha — pulls Dhruva's tongue

**114.** Indra brought an elephant, and it drove its tusks into Dhruva's chest;
coiling its trunk, it pulls at Dhruva's tongue.[^37-5]

বায়ু অজাগর হঞা ধ্রুবেরে গিলিল ।
সূর্য ব্যাঘ্র-রূপ ধরি' ধ্রুব-রক্ত পিল ॥ ১১৫ ॥

*bāẏu ajāgara hañā dhrubere gilila |*
*sūrya byāghra-rūpa dhari' dhruba-rakta pila || 115 ||*

*Word for word:* vayu ajagara hana — Vayu, becoming a python; dhruvere gilila — swallowed Dhruva; surya vyaghra-rupa dhari — Surya, taking a tiger's form; dhruva-rakta pila — drank Dhruva's blood

**115.** Vayu, becoming a python, swallowed Dhruva;
Surya, taking the form of a tiger, drank Dhruva's blood.

নাগপাশে বান্ধি' ধ্রুবে অনলে ফেলিল ।
চন্দ্র ডুবাইল ধ্রুবে কালিন্দীর জলে ॥ ১১৬ ॥

*nāgapāśe bāndhi' dhrube anale phelila |*
*candra ḍubāila dhrube kālindīra jale || 116 ||*

*Word for word:* naga-pashe bandhi — binding with a serpent-noose; dhruve anale phelila — threw Dhruva into fire; chandra dubaila dhruve — Chandra drowned Dhruva; kalindira jale — in the waters of the Kalindi

**116.** Binding Dhruva with a serpent-noose, they threw him into fire;
Chandra drowned Dhruva in the waters of the Kalindi.

জিহ্বায় কৃষ্ণের নাম রটিল যাহার ।
কোটি-সর্পদংশনে কি করিবে তাহার ॥ ১১৭ ॥

*jihbāẏa kṛṣṇera nāma raṭila yāhāra |*
*koṭi-sarpadaṃśane ki karibe tāhāra || 117 ||*

*Word for word:* jihvaya krishnera nama ratila yahara — on whose tongue Krishna's name resounds; koti-sarpa-damshane — the bites of millions of serpents; ki karibe tahara — what will they do to him

**117.** He on whose tongue the name of Krishna resounds —
what can the bites of countless serpents do to him?

ত্রিভঙ্গ-ধেয়ান কেহ ভাঙ্গিতে নারিয়া ।
ব্রহ্মা-আদি দেবগণ গেল পলাইয়া ॥ ১১৮ ॥

*tribhaṅga-dheẏāna keha bhāṅgite nāriẏā |*
*brahmā-ādi debagaṇa gela palāiẏā || 118 ||*

*Word for word:* tribhanga-dheyana — the meditation on Tribhanga; keha bhangite nariya — none being able to break; brahma-adi devagana — Brahma and the other gods; gela palaiya — fled

**118.** Unable to break his meditation on Tribhanga,
Brahma and the other gods fled.

একমনে ভাবে ধ্রুব প্রভুর চরণ ।
আনন্দে গাইল গুণ এ দাস লোচন ॥ ১১৯ ॥

*ekamane bhābe dhruba prabhura caraṇa |*
*ānande gāila guṇa e dāsa locana || 119 ||*

*Word for word:* ekamane bhave dhruva — with all his mind Dhruva meditates on; prabhura charana — the Lord's feet; anande gaila guna — joyfully sang the qualities; e dasa lochana — this servant Lochana

**119.** With all his mind Dhruva meditates on the Lord's feet;
joyfully this Lochana Dasa sang of [His] qualities.

*Raga — any; disha: "I have taken refuge at the crimson feet, O Gopala, merciful to the lowly."*

তোমার নাম পতিতপাবন ।
জয় রে জয় রে জয় অধমতারণ ॥ ১২০ ॥

*tomāra nāma patitapābana |*
*jaẏa re jaẏa re jaẏa adhamatāraṇa || 120 ||*

*Word for word:* tomara nama patita-pavana — Your name is Purifier of the fallen; jaya re jaya re jaya — glory, glory, glory; adhama-tarana — to the Deliverer of the lowly

**120.** Your name is Purifier of the fallen;
glory, glory, glory to the Deliverer of the lowly!

আর অপরূপ কথা শুন সর্বজন ।
নারদ কৃষ্ণের কিছু কহিব বচন ॥ ১২১ ॥

*āra aparūpa kathā śuna sarbajana |*
*nārada kṛṣṇera kichu kahiba bacana || 121 ||*

*Word for word:* ara aparupa katha — another wondrous tale; shuna sarvajana — listen, all; narada krishnera — of Narada to Krishna; kichhu kahiba bachana — some words I shall tell

**121.** Listen, all, to another wondrous tale:
I shall tell what Narada said to Krishna.

বৈকুণ্ঠে কমলা-সনে রত্নসিংহাসনে ।
নারদের বীণাগীত শুনে তিনজনে ॥ ১২২ ॥

*baikuṇṭhe kamalā-sane ratnasiṃhāsane |*
*nāradera bīṇāgīta śune tinajane || 122 ||*

*Word for word:* vaikunthe — in Vaikuntha; kamala-sane — with Kamala; ratna-simhasane — on a jewelled throne; naradera vina-gita — Narada's song to the vina; shune tinajane — three listen

**122.** In Vaikuntha, on a jewelled throne, [Krishna] with Kamala —
the three listen to Narada's song to the vina.[^37-6]

ঈষৎ হাসিয়া কৃষ্ণ নারদেরে কহে ।
আজি কেনে বীণাগীতে মন নাহি রহে ॥ ১২৩ ॥

*īṣat hāsiẏā kṛṣṇa nāradere kahe |*
*āji kene bīṇāgīte mana nāhi rahe || 123 ||*

*Word for word:* ishat hasiya — smiling gently; krishna naradere kahe — Krishna says to Narada; aji kene — why today; vina-gite mana nahi rahe — the mind does not stay with the vina song

**123.** With a gentle smile Krishna says to Narada:
"Why today is your mind not given to your song to the vina?"

নারদ বোলেন — শুন কমললোচন ।
যে কারণে বীণাগীতে নাহি রহে মন ॥ ১২৪ ॥

*nārada bolena — śuna kamalalocana |*
*ye kāraṇe bīṇāgīte nāhi rahe mana || 124 ||*

*Word for word:* narada bolena — Narada says; shuna kamala-lochana — listen, Lotus-eyed One; ye karane — for what reason; vina-gite nahi rahe mana — the mind does not stay with the vina song

**124.** Narada says: "Listen, Lotus-eyed One,
why my mind does not stay with my song to the vina:

তোমার ভকতে মোর হরি নিল মন ।
মনের দরিদ্র নাথ তুমি সর্বকাল ॥ ১২৫ ॥

*tomāra bhakate mora hari nila mana |*
*manera daridra nātha tumi sarbakāla || 125 ||*

*Word for word:* tomara bhakate — Your devotee; mora hari nila mana — has stolen my mind; monera daridra natha — Lord of the poor in heart (?); tumi sarva-kala — You at all times

**125.** Your devotee has stolen my mind.
You, Lord, at all times are [the refuge] of those who have nothing [but You] in their hearts."[^37-7]

নারদের বোল শুনি' কমললোচন ।
কহ মোরে কোন্ ভক্ত করেন স্মরণ ॥ ১২৬ ॥

*nāradera bola śuni' kamalalocana |*
*kaha more kon bhakta karena smaraṇa || 126 ||*

*Word for word:* naradera bola shuni — hearing Narada's words; kamala-lochana — the Lotus-eyed One; kaha more — tell Me; kon bhakta karena smarana — which devotee remembers

**126.** Hearing Narada's words, the Lotus-eyed One [says]:
"Tell Me, which devotee is remembering [Me]?"

উত্তানপাদের বেটা বড় মহামতি ।
স্বামিতে দুর্ভগা তার মাতা সুনীতি ॥ ১২৭ ॥

*uttānapādera beṭā baṛa mahāmati |*
*sbāmite durbhagā tāra mātā sunīti || 127 ||*

*Word for word:* uttanapadera beta — the son of Uttanapada; bada mahamati — of great mind; svamite durbhaga — out of favour with her husband; tara mata suniti — his mother Suniti

**127.** "The son of Uttanapada, [a boy] of great mind;
his mother Suniti is out of favour with her husband.

ধ্রুবের সতাই তার নাম সুরুচি ।
স্বামিসঙ্গে নানারঙ্গে সিংহাসনে বসি ॥ ১২৮ ॥

*dhrubera satāi tāra nāma suruci |*
*sbāmisaṅge nānāraṅge siṃhāsane basi || 128 ||*

*Word for word:* dhruvera satai — Dhruva's stepmother; tara nama suruchi — her name is Suruchi; svami-sange — with her husband; nana-range — merrily; simhasane vasi — sitting on the throne

**128.** Dhruva's stepmother is named Suruchi;
she sits merrily with her husband on the throne.

উত্তমাদি সাত ভাই মা-বাপের সঙ্গে ।
রত্নসিংহাসনে বসি' হাসে খেলে রঙ্গে ॥ ১২৯ ॥

*uttamādi sāta bhāi mā-bāpera saṅge |*
*ratnasiṃhāsane basi' hāse khele raṅge || 129 ||*

*Word for word:* uttamadi sata bhai — the seven brothers beginning with Uttama; ma-bapera sange — with mother and father; ratna-simhasane vasi — sitting on the jewelled throne; hase khele range — laugh and play merrily

**129.** The seven brothers, beginning with Uttama, with father and mother,
laugh and play merrily on the jewelled throne.

বাপের কোলে দেখিলেন ভাই সাতজনে ।
তা দেখিয়া উঠে ধ্রুব রত্নসিংহাসনে ॥ ১৩০ ॥

*bāpera kole dekhilena bhāi sātajane |*
*tā dekhiẏā uṭhe dhruba ratnasiṃhāsane || 130 ||*

*Word for word:* bapera kole — on the father's lap; dekhilena bhai satajane — he saw the seven brothers; ta dekhiya — seeing that; uthe dhruva ratna-simhasane — Dhruva climbs the jewelled throne

**130.** [Dhruva] saw the seven brothers on their father's lap —
and seeing this, Dhruva climbs onto the jewelled throne.

সিংহাসনে উঠিয়া বাপের কোলে যাইতে ।
ধ্রুবের সতাই ঠেলি' ফেলিল ভূমিতে ॥ ১৩১ ॥

*siṃhāsane uṭhiẏā bāpera kole yāite |*
*dhrubera satāi ṭheli' phelila bhūmite || 131 ||*

*Word for word:* simhasane uthiya — climbing the throne; bapera kole yaite — to go onto the father's lap; dhruvera satai — Dhruva's stepmother; theli phelila bhumite — pushed him down to the ground

**131.** When he climbed the throne to get onto his father's lap,
Dhruva's stepmother pushed him down to the ground.

ভূমিতে পড়িয়া ধ্রুব কান্দিতে লাগিল ।
স্ত্রীর বশ হঞা রাজা কিছু না বলিল ॥ ১৩২ ॥

*bhūmite paṛiẏā dhruba kāndite lāgila |*
*strīra baśa hañā rājā kichu nā balila || 132 ||*

*Word for word:* bhumite padiya — falling to the ground; dhruva kandite lagila — Dhruva began to weep; strira vasha hana — being in his wife's power; raja kichhu na balila — the king said nothing

**132.** Falling to the ground, Dhruva began to weep;
and the king, in his wife's power, said nothing.

সতাইর বোলে ধ্রুব পড়িল সঙ্কটে ।
মধুবনে তপ করে কালিন্দী-নিকটে ॥ ১৩৩ ॥

*satāira bole dhruba paṛila saṅkaṭe |*
*madhubane tapa kare kālindī-nikaṭe || 133 ||*

*Word for word:* sataira bole — by the stepmother's words; dhruva padila sankate — Dhruva fell into distress; madhubane tapa kare — performs austerity in Madhuvana; kalindi-nikate — near the Kalindi

**133.** By his stepmother's words Dhruva fell into distress —
and [now] he performs austerities in Madhuvana, near the Kalindi."

নারদের বোল শুনি' কমললোচন ।
ঈষৎ হাসিয়া বোলে মধুর বচন ॥ ১৩৪ ॥

*nāradera bola śuni' kamalalocana |*
*īṣat hāsiẏā bole madhura bacana || 134 ||*

*Word for word:* naradera bola shuni — hearing Narada's words; kamala-lochana — the Lotus-eyed One; ishat hasiya — smiling gently; bole madhura bachana — speaks sweet words

**134.** Hearing Narada's words, the Lotus-eyed One
with a gentle smile speaks sweet words:

অদীক্ষিত-জনে আমি কৃপা নাহি করি ।
অদীক্ষিত-জনের অপরাধ নাহি হরি ॥ ১৩৫ ॥

*adīkṣita-jane āmi kṛpā nāhi kari |*
*adīkṣita-janera aparādha nāhi hari || 135 ||*

*Word for word:* adikshita-jane — to the uninitiated; ami kripa nahi kari — I do not show mercy; adikshita-janera — of the uninitiated; aparadha nahi hari — the offences I do not remove

**135.** "To the uninitiated I do not show mercy:
the sins of the uninitiated I do not remove.[^37-8]

আমারে ভাবিবে যেবা প্রতিজ্ঞা করিয়া ।
মধুবনে তপ করে মাতা পিতা ছাড়িয়া ॥ ১৩৬ ॥

*āmāre bhābibe yebā pratijñā kariẏā |*
*madhubane tapa kare mātā pitā chāṛiẏā || 136 ||*

*Word for word:* amare bhavibe yeba — he who will meditate on Me; pratijna kariya — having vowed; madhubane tapa kare — performs austerity in Madhuvana; mata pita chhadiya — leaving mother and father

**136.** [But he] who has vowed to meditate on Me
is performing austerities in Madhuvana, having left mother and father.

বৈষ্ণবীর গর্ভে কভু অবৈষ্ণব নহে ।
বৈষ্ণব বৈষ্ণবী হৈলে সব দুঃখ দহে ॥ ১৩৭ ॥

*baiṣṇabīra garbhe kabhu abaiṣṇaba nahe |*
*baiṣṇaba baiṣṇabī haile saba duḥkha dahe || 137 ||*

*Word for word:* vaishnavira garbhe — from a Vaishnavi's womb; kabhu avaishnava nahe — never a non-Vaishnava; vaishnava vaishnavi haile — when [the son] is a Vaishnava and [the mother] a Vaishnavi; saba duhkha dahe — all sorrow burns away

**137.** From a Vaishnavi's womb a non-Vaishnava is never born;
when [the son] is a Vaishnava and [the mother] a Vaishnavi, all sorrow burns away.

বৈষ্ণব-প্রতিজ্ঞা আমি অবশ্য করিব ।
যেই বর চাহে ধ্রুব সেই বর দিব ॥ ১৩৮ ॥

*baiṣṇaba-pratijñā āmi abaśya kariba |*
*yei bara cāhe dhruba sei bara diba || 138 ||*
