*Word for word:* vaishnava-pratijna — a Vaishnava's vow; ami avashya kariba — I shall surely fulfil; yei bara chahe dhruva — whatever boon Dhruva desires; sei bara diba — that boon I shall give

**138.** The vow of a Vaishnava I shall surely fulfil:
whatever boon Dhruva desires, that boon I shall give.

প্রেমভক্তি-ডোরে বান্ধিয়াছে ভক্তজন ।
না পারি রহিতে ভক্ত করিলে স্মরণ ॥ ১৩৯ ॥

*premabhakti-ḍore bāndhiẏāche bhaktajana |*
*nā pāri rahite bhakta karile smaraṇa || 139 ||*

*Word for word:* prema-bhakti-dore — with the rope of prema and bhakti; bandhiyachhe bhakta-jana — the devotees have bound [Me]; na pari rahite — I cannot stay; bhakta karile smarana — when a devotee remembers

**139.** My devotees have bound Me with the rope of prema and bhakti:
when a devotee remembers [Me], I cannot stay [away]."

নারদ বোলেন — ধ্রুব অদীক্ষিত নহে ।
তুমি কৃপা কর গিয়া, দাবানলে দহে ॥ ১৪০ ॥

*nārada bolena — dhruba adīkṣita nahe |*
*tumi kṛpā kara giẏā, dābānale dahe || 140 ||*

*Word for word:* narada bolena — Narada says; dhruva adikshita nahe — Dhruva is not uninitiated; tumi kripa kara giya — go and show mercy; dabanale dahe — he burns in a forest fire

**140.** Narada says: "Dhruva is not without initiation;
go and show him mercy — he is burning as in a forest fire."

নারদের মুখে শুনি' কমললোচন ।
গরুড়ে চড়িয়া আইলা সেই মধুবন ॥ ১৪১ ॥

*nāradera mukhe śuni' kamalalocana |*
*garuṛe caṛiẏā āilā sei madhubana || 141 ||*

*Word for word:* naradera mukhe shuni — hearing from Narada's lips; kamala-lochana — the Lotus-eyed One; garude chadiya — riding on Garuda; aila sei madhubana — came to that Madhuvana

**141.** Hearing [this] from Narada's lips, the Lotus-eyed One
came, riding on Garuda, to that Madhuvana.

ধ্রুবেরে কহিল কৃষ্ণ ঈষৎ হাসিয়া ।
বর দিতে আইলাঙ তোমা' বৈকুণ্ঠ ছাড়িয়া ॥ ১৪২ ॥

*dhrubere kahila kṛṣṇa īṣat hāsiẏā |*
*bara dite āilāṅa tomā' baikuṇṭha chāṛiẏā || 142 ||*

*Word for word:* dhruvere kahila krishna — Krishna said to Dhruva; ishat hasiya — smiling gently; bara dite ailanga toma — I have come to give you a boon; vaikuntha chhadiya — leaving Vaikuntha

**142.** With a gentle smile Krishna said to Dhruva:
"I have left Vaikuntha and come to give you a boon."

শ্রীকৃষ্ণের আজ্ঞা শুনি' আনন্দ বাড়িল ।
ধ্যান ভাঙ্গি' জোড়হস্তে সম্মুখে রহিল ॥ ১৪৩ ॥

*śrīkṛṣṇera ājñā śuni' ānanda bāṛila |*
*dhyāna bhāṅgi' joṛahaste sammukhe rahila || 143 ||*

*Word for word:* sri-krishnera ajna shuni — hearing Sri Krishna's word; ananda badila — joy grew; dhyana bhangi — breaking meditation; joda-haste sammukhe rahila — stood before [Him] with joined palms

**143.** Hearing Sri Krishna's word, [Dhruva] was filled with joy;
coming out of meditation, he stood before Him with joined palms.

ধ্রুব বোলে — মহাপ্রভু, কি বর মাগিব ।
মোরে কৃপা কর — তোমার মহিমা বাড়িব ॥ ১৪৪ ॥

*dhruba bole — mahāprabhu, ki bara māgiba |*
*more kṛpā kara — tomāra mahimā bāṛiba || 144 ||*

*Word for word:* dhruva bole — Dhruva says; mahaprabhu — great Lord; ki bara magiba — what boon shall I ask; more kripa kara — be merciful to me; tomara mahima badiba — Your glory will grow

**144.** Dhruva says: "Great Lord, what boon shall I ask?
Be merciful to me — by that Your glory will grow."

প্রভু বোলে — তোমার কার্য অবশ্য করিব ।
যেই পদ চাহ তুমি সে-ই পদ দিব ॥ ১৪৫ ॥

*prabhu bole — tomāra kārya abaśya kariba |*
*yei pada cāha tumi se-i pada diba || 145 ||*

*Word for word:* prabhu bole — the Lord says; tomara karya avashya kariba — your wish I shall surely fulfil; yei pada chaha tumi — whatever place you desire; sei pada diba — that place I shall give

**145.** The Lord says: "Your wish I shall surely fulfil:
whatever place you desire, that place I shall give.

সম্প্রতি কহ কেনে আইলা মধুবনে ।
সতমাএ বসিতে না দিল সিংহাসনে ॥ ১৪৬ ॥

*samprati kaha kene āilā madhubane |*
*satamāe basite nā dila siṃhāsane || 146 ||*

*Word for word:* samprati kaha — tell now; kene aila madhubane — why you came to Madhuvana; satamae — the stepmother; vasite na dila simhasane — did not let [you] sit on the throne

**146.** Tell Me now, why have you come to Madhuvana?
[Is it because] your stepmother would not let you sit on the throne?

বড় উচ্চপদ যদি তোরে নাহি দিব ।
বাঞ্ছাকল্পতরু নাম কেমনে ধরিব ॥ ১৪৭ ॥

*baṛa uccapada yadi tore nāhi diba |*
*bāñchākalpataru nāma kemane dhariba || 147 ||*

*Word for word:* bada uchcha-pada — the very highest place; yadi tore nahi diba — if I do not give you; vanchha-kalpataru nama — the name "wish-fulfilling Tree"; kemane dhariba — how shall I bear

**147.** If I do not give you the very highest place,
how shall I bear the name 'Tree of Desires'?"

ধ্রুব বোলে — উচ্চপদ তৃণ হেন বাসি ।
তোমার ভক্তি নহিলে সব ভস্মরাশি ॥ ১৪৮ ॥

*dhruba bole — uccapada tṛṇa hena bāsi |*
*tomāra bhakti nahile saba bhasmarāśi || 148 ||*

*Word for word:* dhruva bole — Dhruva says; uchcha-pada trina hena basi — I regard a high place as a straw; tomara bhakti nahile — without devotion to You; saba bhasma-rashi — all is a heap of ashes

**148.** Dhruva says: "A high place I regard as a straw:
without devotion to You all is a heap of ashes."[^37-9]

কৃষ্ণ বোলে — সব সিংহাসন দিব আমি ।
ত্রিজগতে উচ্চপদে থাক গিয়া তুমি ॥ ১৪৯ ॥

*kṛṣṇa bole — saba siṃhāsana diba āmi |*
*trijagate uccapade thāka giẏā tumi || 149 ||*

*Word for word:* krishna bole — Krishna says; saba simhasana diba ami — I shall give [what is above] all thrones; trijagate uchcha-pade — in the highest place in the three worlds; thaka giya tumi — go and abide

**149.** Krishna says: "I shall give you [what is above] all thrones:
go and abide in the highest place in the three worlds.

উত্তানপাদের বেটা, তুমি হবে রাজা ।
আমার মহিমা পাবে তোমার সব প্রজা ॥ ১৫০ ॥

*uttānapādera beṭā, tumi habe rājā |*
*āmāra mahimā pābe tomāra saba prajā || 150 ||*

*Word for word:* uttanapadera beta — son of Uttanapada; tumi habe raja — you will be king; amara mahima pabe — will obtain My glory; tomara saba praja — all your subjects

**150.** Son of Uttanapada, you will be king;
all your subjects will come to know My glory.

সভার উপরে ঋষি-বাসস্থান-মণ্ডল ।
ধ্রুবলোক বসে যেন — কহিল সকল ॥ ১৫১ ॥

*sabhāra upare ṛṣi-bāsasthāna-maṇḍala |*
*dhrubaloka base yena — kahila sakala || 151 ||*

*Word for word:* sabhara upare — above all; rishi-vasasthana-mandala — the circle of the sages' abodes; dhruva-loka vase yena — how Dhruvaloka will stand; kahila sakala — He told everything

**151.** Above all is the circle of the sages' abodes; [above it]
Dhruvaloka will stand" — so He told of everything.[^37-10]

এই বর দিয়া কৃষ্ণ হৈলা অন্তর্ধান ।
বিশ্বকর্মা ধ্রুবলোক করিল নির্মাণ ॥ ১৫২ ॥

*ei bara diẏā kṛṣṇa hailā antardhāna |*
*biśbakarmā dhrubaloka karila nirmāṇa || 152 ||*

*Word for word:* ei bara diya — giving this boon; krishna haila antardhana — Krishna disappeared; vishvakarma — Vishvakarma; dhruva-loka karila nirmana — built Dhruvaloka

**152.** Having given this boon, Krishna disappeared,
and Vishvakarma built Dhruvaloka.

এই বর পাঞা ধ্রুব করিলা গমন ।
গোরাগুণ গায় সুখে এ দাস লোচন ॥ ১৫৩ ॥

*ei bara pāñā dhruba karilā gamana |*
*gorāguṇa gāẏa sukhe e dāsa locana || 153 ||*

*Word for word:* ei bara pana — receiving this boon; dhruva karila gamana — Dhruva set out; gora-guna gaya sukhe — joyfully sings Gora's qualities; e dasa lochana — this servant Lochana

**153.** Having received this boon, Dhruva set out;
joyfully this Lochana Dasa sings of Gora's qualities.

*Raga — any; disha: "Come, O Gaura-Gopala, my life!"*

কৃষ্ণ-আজ্ঞা শুনি' ধ্রুব দেশেরে চলিল ।
এথা সে উত্তানপাদের বৈরাগ্য বাড়িল ॥ ১৫৪ ॥

*kṛṣṇa-ājñā śuni' dhruba deśere calila |*
*ethā se uttānapādera bairāgya bāṛila || 154 ||*

*Word for word:* krishna-ajna shuni — hearing Krishna's command; dhruva deshere chalila — Dhruva went to his land; etha se — and here; uttanapadera vairagya badila — Uttanapada's detachment grew

**154.** Hearing Krishna's command, Dhruva set out for his homeland;
and here Uttanapada's detachment from the world grew.

ধ্রুবের সতাই কান্দে — ধ্রুব কোথা গেল ।
মুঞি অভাগিনী পুত্রে ঠেলিঞা ফেলিল ॥ ১৫৫ ॥

*dhrubera satāi kānde — dhruba kothā gela |*
*muñi abhāginī putre ṭheliñā phelila || 155 ||*

*Word for word:* dhruvera satai kande — Dhruva's stepmother weeps; dhruva kotha gela — where has Dhruva gone; munni abhagini — I, wretched one; putre theliña phelila — pushed the son down

**155.** Dhruva's stepmother weeps: "Where has Dhruva gone?
I, wretched one, pushed the son [off the throne]!"

রাজা বোলে — ছিল মোর পুত্রবধ লেখা ।
কতদিনে হবে আর ধ্রুব-সনে দেখা ॥ ১৫৬ ॥

*rājā bole — chila mora putrabadha lekhā |*
*katadine habe āra dhruba-sane dekhā || 156 ||*

*Word for word:* raja bole — the king says; chhila mora putra-vadha lekha — it was written for me to destroy my son; katadine habe ara — when will there again be; dhruva-sane dekha — a meeting with Dhruva

**156.** The king says: "It was my fate to destroy my son;
when shall I see Dhruva again?"

রাজা বোলে — ধ্রুবের মা, তুমি পাটরাণী ।
আজি হৈতে তোমার দাসী সকল সতিনী ॥ ১৫৭ ॥

*rājā bole — dhrubera mā, tumi pāṭarāṇī |*
*āji haite tomāra dāsī sakala satinī || 157 ||*

*Word for word:* raja bole — the king says; dhruvera ma — mother of Dhruva; tumi pata-rani — you are the chief queen; aji haite — from today; tomara dasi sakala satini — all co-wives are your maidservants

**157.** The king says: "Mother of Dhruva, you are the chief queen;
from today all your co-wives are your maidservants."

পুত্র না দেখিয়া রাজা বিস্মিত হইয়া ।
ভূমিতে পড়িয়া আছে মূরছিত হঞা ॥ ১৫৮ ॥

*putra nā dekhiẏā rājā bismita haiẏā |*
*bhūmite paṛiẏā āche mūrachita hañā || 158 ||*

*Word for word:* putra na dekhiya — not seeing his son; raja vismita haiya — the king, distraught; bhumite padiya achhe — lies on the ground; murachhita hana — senseless

**158.** Not seeing his son, the king, distraught,
lies senseless on the ground.

হেনকালে নারদ দেখিয়া আচম্বিত ।
উঠিলেন মহারাজ অন্তরে চিন্তিত ॥ ১৫৯ ॥

*henakāle nārada dekhiẏā ācambita |*
*uṭhilena mahārāja antare cintita || 159 ||*

*Word for word:* henakale — at that time; narada dekhiya achambita — suddenly seeing Narada; uthilena maharaja — the maharaja rose; antare chintita — anxious at heart

**159.** Suddenly he saw Narada —
the maharaja rose, anxious at heart.

পাদ্য অর্ঘ্য দিয়া দিল আসন বসিতে ।
আপন অন্তরকথা লাগিল কহিতে ॥ ১৬০ ॥

*pādya arghya diẏā dila āsana basite |*
*āpana antarakathā lāgila kahite || 160 ||*

*Word for word:* padya arghya diya — offering water for the feet and arghya; dila asana vasite — gave a seat; apana antara-katha — what was in his heart; lagila kahite — began to tell

**160.** Offering water for the feet and arghya, he gave [Narada] a seat
and began to tell him what was in his heart:

পাঁচবছরের এক বালক আমার ছিল ।
না জানিএ সে বালক কোথাকারে গেল ॥ ১৬১ ॥

*pāṁcabacharera eka bālaka āmāra chila |*
*nā jānie se bālaka kothākāre gela || 161 ||*

*Word for word:* pancha-bachharera eka balaka — a five-year-old boy; amara chhila — I had; na janie — I do not know; se balaka kothakare gela — where that boy has gone

**161.** "I had a five-year-old boy —
I do not know where that boy has gone."

নারদ বোলেন — ধ্রুবের অনেক সঙ্কট ।
কৃষ্ণভক্তি পাঞা আইল দেশের নিকট ॥ ১৬২ ॥

*nārada bolena — dhrubera aneka saṅkaṭa |*
*kṛṣṇabhakti pāñā āila deśera nikaṭa || 162 ||*

*Word for word:* narada bolena — Narada says; dhruvera aneka sankata — Dhruva had many troubles; krishna-bhakti pana — gaining devotion to Krishna; aila deshera nikata — he has come near the land

**162.** Narada says: "Many troubles befell Dhruva;
having gained devotion to Krishna, he has come near [your] land.

*Thus [in the scriptures]:*

কুলং পবিত্রং জননী কৃতার্থা
বসুন্ধরা বা বসতিশ্চ ধন্যা ।
স্বর্গে স্থিতাস্তৎপিতরোঽপি ধন্যা
যস্যাঃ সুতো বৈষ্ণবনাম লোকে ॥ ১৬৩ ॥

*kulaṃ pabitraṃ jananī kṛtārthā*
*basundharā bā basatiśca dhanyā |*
*sbarge sthitāstatpitaro'pi dhanyā*
*yasyāḥ suto baiṣṇabanāma loke || 163 ||*

*Word for word:* kulam pavitram — the family is holy; janani kritartha — the mother has fulfilled her purpose; vasundhara va vasatih cha dhanya — blessed the earth and the dwelling; svarge sthitah tat-pitarah api dhanyah — blessed too her forefathers abiding in heaven; yasyah suto vaishnava-nama loke — whose son is known in the world as a Vaishnava

**163.** Holy is the family, fulfilled is the mother, blessed is the earth and the place where she dwells, blessed too are her forefathers abiding in heaven — [that mother] whose son is known in the world as a Vaishnava.

যস্যাস্তি বৈষ্ণবঃ পুত্রঃ পুত্রিণী সা বিধীয়তে ।
অবৈষ্ণবশতপুত্রজননী শূকরীসমা ॥ ১৬৪ ॥

*yasyāsti baiṣṇabaḥ putraḥ putriṇī sā bidhīẏate |*
*abaiṣṇabaśataputrajananī śūkarīsamā || 164 ||*

*Word for word:* yasya asti vaishnavah putrah — she who has a Vaishnava son; putrini sa vidhiyate — she is reckoned the mother of a son; avaishnava-shata-putra-janani — the mother of a hundred non-Vaishnava sons; shukari-sama — is like a sow

**164.** She whose son is a Vaishnava is truly called the mother of a son; but the mother of a hundred non-Vaishnava sons is like a sow.[^37-11]

যার বংশে বৈষ্ণব হএ একজনে ।
পিতৃ-মাতৃ-শ্বশুর-কুল উদ্ধারণে ॥ ১৬৫ ॥

*yāra baṃśe baiṣṇaba hae ekajane |*
*pitṛ-mātṛ-śbaśura-kula uddhāraṇe || 165 ||*

*Word for word:* yara vamshe — in whose line; vaishnava hae ekajane — even one Vaishnava is born; pitri-matri-shvashura-kula — the families of father, mother and father-in-law; uddharane — he delivers

**165.** In whose line even one Vaishnava is born,
[he] delivers the families of father, mother and father-in-law.

শ্রীকৃষ্ণ ভজি' আইল তোমার বালক ।
জানিহ সে বংশে তোমার ধ্রুব তিলক ॥ ১৬৬ ॥

*śrīkṛṣṇa bhaji' āila tomāra bālaka |*
*jāniha se baṃśe tomāra dhruba tilaka || 166 ||*

*Word for word:* sri-krishna bhaji — having served Sri Krishna; aila tomara balaka — your boy has come; janiha — know; se vamshe tomara dhruva tilaka — Dhruva is the ornament of your line

**166.** Your boy, having served Sri Krishna, is returning:
know that Dhruva is the ornament of your line."

নারদের বোলে রাজা হরিষ-মনোরথে ।
চুয়া-চন্দনের ছড়া দিল রাজপথে ॥ ১৬৭ ॥

*nāradera bole rājā hariṣa-manorathe |*
*cuẏā-candanera chaṛā dila rājapathe || 167 ||*

*Word for word:* naradera bole — at Narada's words; raja harisha-manorathe — the king, filled with joy; chuya-chandanera chhada — a sprinkling of chuya and sandal; dila raja-pathe — made on the royal road

**167.** At Narada's words the king, filled with joy,
sprinkled the royal road with chuya and sandal.

দধি, মঙ্গল দূর্বা, কুঙ্কুম, কস্তূরী ।
সূক্ষ্ম পুষ্প উজ্জ্বল, দীপ জ্বলে সারি সারি ॥ ১৬৮ ॥

*dadhi, maṅgala dūrbā, kuṅkuma, kastūrī |*
*sūkṣma puṣpa ujjbala, dīpa jbale sāri sāri || 168 ||*

*Word for word:* dadhi — curd; mangala durva — auspicious durva grass; kunkuma — kunkuma; kasturi — musk; sukshma pushpa ujjvala — delicate bright flowers; dipa jvale sari sari — lamps burn in rows

**168.** Curd, auspicious durva grass, kunkuma, musk,
delicate bright flowers; lamps burn in rows.

হারা-উদ্দেশে রাজা অনুব্রজ্যা ধায় ।
কথোদূরে গিয়া তবে ধ্রুবের লাগি পায় ॥ ১৬৯ ॥

*hārā-uddeśe rājā anubrajyā dhāẏa |*
*kathodūre giẏā tabe dhrubera lāgi pāẏa || 169 ||*

*Word for word:* hara-uddeshe — in search of the lost one; raja anuvrajya dhaya — the king hastens to meet him; kathodure giya — going some distance; tabe dhruvera lagi paya — then he reaches Dhruva

**169.** In search of his lost [son] the king hastens to meet him;
having gone some distance, he finds Dhruva.

ধ্রুবেরে দেখিঞা রাজা প্রাণ পাইল বোলে ।
লক্ষ লক্ষ চুম্ব দিয়া পুত্র কৈল কোলে ॥ ১৭০ ॥

*dhrubere dekhiñā rājā prāṇa pāila bole |*
*lakṣa lakṣa cumba diẏā putra kaila kole || 170 ||*

*Word for word:* dhruvere dekhiña — seeing Dhruva; raja prana paila bole — the king as if gained life; laksha laksha chumba diya — giving countless kisses; putra kaila kole — took his son in his arms

**170.** Seeing Dhruva, the king seemed to regain his life;
covering his son with countless kisses, he took him in his arms.

ধ্রুবেরে আনিঞা পুনঃ সভে কৈল রাজা ।
হাতে হাতে সমর্পিল পাত্র আর প্রজা ॥ ১৭১ ॥

*dhrubere āniñā punaḥ sabhe kaila rājā |*
*hāte hāte samarpila pātra āra prajā || 171 ||*

*Word for word:* dhruvere aniña — bringing Dhruva; punah sabhe kaila raja — made him king before all; hate hate samarpila — handed over from hand to hand; patra ara praja — the ministers and subjects

**171.** Bringing Dhruva back, he made him king before all
and from hand to hand gave over to him the ministers and subjects.

ধ্রুবেরে রাজ্য দিঞা রাজা গেল বনে ।
কথো দিন রাজ্য কৈল আনন্দিত মনে ॥ ১৭২ ॥

*dhrubere rājya diñā rājā gela bane |*
*katho dina rājya kaila ānandita mane || 172 ||*

*Word for word:* dhruvere rajya diña — giving the kingdom to Dhruva; raja gela vane — the king went to the forest; katho dina rajya kaila — [Dhruva] ruled for a long time; anandita mane — with a joyful heart

**172.** Giving the kingdom to Dhruva, the king went to the forest;
[and Dhruva] ruled for a long time with a joyful heart.

বলে দাপে নানাদেশ নিল একে একে ।
চল্লিশ বৎসর রাজ্য কৈল নিষ্কণ্টকে ॥ ১৭৩ ॥

*bale dāpe nānādeśa nila eke eke |*
*calliśa batsara rājya kaila niṣkaṇṭake || 173 ||*

*Word for word:* bale dape — by might and power; nana-desha nila eke eke — took many lands one by one; challisha vatsara rajya kaila — ruled forty years; nishkantake — free of enemies

**173.** By might and power he conquered many lands one after another
and ruled forty years free of enemies.[^37-12]

দেব-গন্ধর্ব-মধ্যে নানা বিক্রম করি' ।
মাএ সঙ্গে লঞা ধ্রুব গেলা ধ্রুবপুরী ॥ ১৭৪ ॥

*deba-gandharba-madhye nānā bikrama kari' |*
*māe saṅge lañā dhruba gelā dhrubapurī || 174 ||*

*Word for word:* deva-gandharva-madhye — among the gods and gandharvas; nana vikrama kari — showing much valour; mae sange lana — taking his mother along; dhruva gela dhruvapuri — Dhruva went to Dhruvapuri

**174.** Having shown much valour among the gods and gandharvas,
Dhruva went with his mother to Dhruvapuri."

শচী বোলে — আমিহ যাইব তোমার সঙ্গে ।
থাকিব তোমার সঙ্গে কৃষ্ণকথা-রঙ্গে ॥ ১৭৫ ॥

*śacī bole — āmiha yāiba tomāra saṅge |*
*thākiba tomāra saṅge kṛṣṇakathā-raṅge || 175 ||*

*Word for word:* shachi bole — Shachi says; amiha yaiba tomara sange — I too shall go with you; thakiba tomara sange — I shall stay with you; krishna-katha-range — in the joy of talks about Krishna

**175.** Shachi says: "I too shall go with you,
I shall stay with you — in the joy of talks about Krishna.

তুমি হেন সোণার পুত্র যাবে মুড় মুড়ি' ।
মুঞি মুণ্ড মুড়াইয়া হইমু নাড়ী ॥ ১৭৬ ॥

*tumi hena soṇāra putra yābe muṛa muṛi' |*
*muñi muṇḍa muṛāiẏā haimu nāṛī || 176 ||*

*Word for word:* tumi hena sonara putra — such a golden son as you; yabe muda mudi — will go with shaven head; munni munda mudaiya — I, shaving my head; haimu nadi — shall become shaven-headed

**176.** If such a golden son as you goes away with a shaven head,
I too shall shave my head and become a shaven-headed woman.

রক্তবস্ত্র পরিব, কুণ্ডল দিমু কাণে ।
যোগিনী হইয়া আমি যাব তোমার সনে ॥ ১৭৭ ॥

*raktabastra pariba, kuṇḍala dimu kāṇe |*
*yoginī haiẏā āmi yāba tomāra sane || 177 ||*

*Word for word:* rakta-vastra pariba — I shall wear red cloth; kundala dimu kane — put earrings in my ears; yogini haiya — becoming a yogini; ami yaba tomara sane — I shall go with you

**177.** I shall put on red clothes, put kundala earrings in my ears,
become a yogini and go with you."[^37-13]

মাএর বচনে প্রভু অস্তব্যস্ত হৈলা ।
কি দিব প্রবোধ বলি' চিন্তিতে লাগিলা ॥ ১৭৮ ॥

*māera bacane prabhu astabyasta hailā |*
*ki diba prabodha bali' cintite lāgilā || 178 ||*

*Word for word:* maera bachane — at His mother's words; prabhu astavyasta haila — the Lord was at a loss; ki diba prabodha bali — saying, "What consolation shall I give?"; chintite lagila — began to think

**178.** At His mother's words the Lord was at a loss
and began to think: "How shall I console her?"

সর্বজ্ঞ-শিরোমণি শচীর নন্দন ।
মাএরে প্রবোধ করে, এ দাস লোচন ॥ ১৭৯ ॥

*sarbajña-śiromaṇi śacīra nandana |*
*māere prabodha kare, e dāsa locana || 179 ||*

*Word for word:* sarvajna-shiromani — the crest-jewel of the all-knowing; shachira nandana — Shachi's son; maere prabodha kare — consoles His mother; e dasa lochana — [sings] this servant Lochana

**179.** The crest-jewel of the all-knowing, Shachi's son,
consoles His mother, [sings] this Lochana Dasa.

*Raga varadi; disha: "This wondrous tale is called 'a blessing to the ear': listen to the song of Gora's qualities, Shachi's darling moon!"*

অস্তব্যস্ত নহ — শুন আমার বচন ।
মিছা-কাজে দুঃখ চিত্তে কর কি কারণ ॥ ১৮০ ॥

*astabyasta naha — śuna āmāra bacana |*
*michā-kāje duḥkha citte kara ki kāraṇa || 180 ||*

*Word for word:* astavyasta naha — do not be troubled; shuna amara bachana — listen to My words; michha-kaje — needlessly; duhkha chitte kara ki karana — why do you torment your heart with grief

**180.** "Do not be troubled, listen to My words:
why do you needlessly torment your heart with grief?

বারে বারে কহি তোরে — নাহি অবধানে ।
মিছা কর লোভ, মোহ, ক্রোধ, অভিমানে ॥ ১৮১ ॥

*bāre bāre kahi tore — nāhi abadhāne |*
*michā kara lobha, moha, krodha, abhimāne || 181 ||*

*Word for word:* bare bare kahi tore — again and again I tell you; nahi avadhane — [you] do not heed; michha kara — in vain you give yourself to; lobha, moha, krodha, abhimane — greed, delusion, anger, pride

**181.** Again and again I tell you — and you do not heed:
in vain you [give yourself to] greed, delusion, anger and pride.

কে তুমি, তোমার পুত্র কে বা কার বাপ ।
মিছা 'তোর মোর' করি' কর অনুতাপ ॥ ১৮২ ॥

*ke tumi, tomāra putra ke bā kāra bāpa |*
*michā 'tora mora' kari' kara anutāpa || 182 ||*

*Word for word:* ke tumi — who are you; tomara putra — [who is] your son; ke ba kara bapa — who is whose father; michha tora mora kari — vainly saying "yours, mine"; kara anutapa — you lament

**182.** Who are you, who is your son, who is whose father?
In vain you lament, saying 'yours' and 'mine'.

কি নারী, পুরুষ আর কে বা কার পতি ।
শ্রীকৃষ্ণচরণ বিনু আর নাহি গতি ॥ ১৮৩ ॥

*ki nārī, puruṣa āra ke bā kāra pati |*
*śrīkṛṣṇacaraṇa binu āra nāhi gati || 183 ||*

*Word for word:* ki nari, purusha — what is woman, man; ara ke ba kara pati — and who is whose husband; sri-krishna-charana vinu — apart from Sri Krishna's feet; ara nahi gati — there is no other refuge

**183.** What is woman, what is man, who is whose husband? —
apart from Sri Krishna's feet there is no other refuge.

সে-ই পিতা, সে-ই মাতা, সে-ই বন্ধুজন ।
সে-ই হর্তা, সে-ই কর্তা, সে-ই মাত্র ধন ॥ ১৮৪ ॥

*se-i pitā, se-i mātā, se-i bandhujana |*
*se-i hartā, se-i kartā, se-i mātra dhana || 184 ||*

*Word for word:* sei pita — He is father; sei mata — He is mother; sei bandhu-jana — He is friend and kin; sei harta — He is the destroyer; sei karta — He the creator; sei matra dhana — He the only wealth

**184.** He is father, He is mother, He is friend and kin;
He is the destroyer, He the creator, He the only wealth.

তা বিনু সকল মিছা — কহিল এ তত্ত্ব ।
তা বিনু সকল মিছা যতেক জগত ॥ ১৮৫ ॥

*tā binu sakala michā — kahila e tattba |*
*tā binu sakala michā yateka jagata || 185 ||*

*Word for word:* ta vinu — without Him; sakala michha — all is empty; kahila e tattva — I have told this truth; ta vinu sakala michha — without Him all is empty; yateka jagata — whatever is in the world

**185.** Without Him all is empty — this truth I have told you:
without Him empty is all there is in the world.[^37-14]

বিষ্ণুমায়া-বন্ধে সব লোক সুযন্ত্রিত ।
নিজ মদ অহঙ্কারে কেবল পীড়িত ॥ ১৮৬ ॥

*biṣṇumāẏā-bandhe saba loka suyantrita |*
*nija mada ahaṅkāre kebala pīṛita || 186 ||*

*Word for word:* vishnu-maya-bandhe — by the bonds of Vishnu's maya; saba loka suyantrita — all people are firmly bound; nija mada ahamkare — by their own intoxication and conceit; kevala pidita — they are only afflicted

**186.** All people are firmly bound by the bonds of Vishnu's maya
and suffer only from their own intoxication and conceit.

নিজ ভাল ভাল বলি' যেই করে কর্ম ।
পরকালে বন্দী হয় সেই সব ধর্ম ॥ ১৮৭ ॥

*nija bhāla bhāla bali' yei kare karma |*
*parakāle bandī haẏa sei saba dharma || 187 ||*

*Word for word:* nija bhala bhala bali — calling it "good for me"; yei kare karma — whatever deeds one does; parakale — in the hereafter; bandi haya sei saba dharma — those very dharmas become captivity

**187.** Whatever deeds one does, thinking, 'This is good for me' —
those very dharmas hold one captive in the hereafter.

কর্মসূত্রে বন্দী হৈয়া বুলয়ে ভ্রমিয়া ।
আপনা না জানে মূঢ় কৃষ্ণ পাশরিয়া ॥ ১৮৮ ॥

*karmasūtre bandī haiẏā bulaẏe bhramiẏā |*
*āpanā nā jāne mūṛha kṛṣṇa pāśariẏā || 188 ||*

*Word for word:* karma-sutre bandi haiya — captive on the thread of karma; bulaye bhramiya — he roams, wandering; apana na jane mudha — the fool does not know himself; krishna pashariya — forgetting Krishna

**188.** Captive on the thread of karma, one wanders and roams;
the fool, forgetting Krishna, does not know himself.

চতুর্দশলোক-মধ্যে মনুষ্যের জন্ম ।
দুর্লভ করিয়া জানি — কহিল এ মর্ম ॥ ১৮৯ ॥

*caturdaśaloka-madhye manuṣyera janma |*
*durlabha kariẏā jāni — kahila e marma || 189 ||*

*Word for word:* chaturdasha-loka-madhye — among the fourteen worlds; manushyera janma — human birth; durlabha kariya jani — is known as rare; kahila e marma — I have told this secret

**189.** Among the fourteen worlds birth as a human being
is known to be rare — this secret I have revealed to you.

বিষয়-বিপাক ইথে আছয়ে অপার ।
ক্ষণেক-ভঙ্গুর এই অনিত্য সংসার ॥ ১৯০ ॥

*biṣaẏa-bipāka ithe āchaẏe apāra |*
*kṣaṇeka-bhaṅgura ei anitya saṃsāra || 190 ||*

*Word for word:* vishaya-vipaka — the fruits of sense enjoyment; ithe achhaye apara — in this are boundless; kshaneka-bhangura — crumbling in a moment; ei anitya samsara — this transient samsara

**190.** The fruits of sense enjoyment in this [world] are countless,
and this transient samsara itself crumbles in a moment.

তবু দুর্লভ জানি মনুষ্য-শরীর ।
কৃষ্ণ ভজয়ে যে মায়ায় হৈয়ে স্থির ॥ ১৯১ ॥

*tabu durlabha jāni manuṣya-śarīra |*
*kṛṣṇa bhajaẏe ye māẏāẏa haiẏe sthira || 191 ||*

*Word for word:* tabu durlabha jani — yet known as rare; manushya-sharira — the human body; krishna bhajaye ye — [for one] who serves Krishna; mayaya haiye sthira — standing firm against maya

**191.** And yet the human body is known to be rare
[for one] who serves Krishna, standing firm against maya.

শ্রীকৃষ্ণ-ভজন মাত্র এই সব দেহ ।
মুক্তবন্ধ হয় যদি কৃষ্ণে করে নেহ ॥ ১৯২ ॥

*śrīkṛṣṇa-bhajana mātra ei saba deha |*
*muktabandha haẏa yadi kṛṣṇe kare neha || 192 ||*

*Word for word:* sri-krishna-bhajana matra — only for Sri Krishna's service; ei saba deha — all these bodies; mukta-bandha haya — is freed from bondage; yadi krishne kare neha — if one loves Krishna

**192.** All these bodies are only for the service of Sri Krishna;
he is freed from bondage who loves Krishna.

পুত্রস্নেহে কর মোরে যত বড় ভাব ।
শ্রীকৃষ্ণচরণে হৈলে কত হয় লাভ ॥ ১৯৩ ॥

*putrasnehe kara more yata baṛa bhāba |*
*śrīkṛṣṇacaraṇe haile kata haẏa lābha || 193 ||*

*Word for word:* putra-snehe — with a son's affection; kara more — you have for Me; yata bada bhava — how great a feeling; sri-krishna-charane haile — if it were for Sri Krishna's feet; kata haya labha — how great would be the gain

**193.** With what great tenderness you love Me as a son! —
if [that love] were given to Sri Krishna's feet, how great would be the gain!

সংসারে আরতি করে মরিবার তরে ।
শ্রীকৃষ্ণে আরতি করে ভব তরিবারে ॥ ১৯৪ ॥

*saṃsāre ārati kare maribāra tare |*
*śrīkṛṣṇe ārati kare bhaba taribāre || 194 ||*

*Word for word:* samsare arati kare — one is attached to samsara; maribara tare — [only] to die; sri-krishne arati kare — one is attached to Sri Krishna; bhava taribare — to cross [the ocean of] birth

**194.** Attachment to samsara [leads only] to death,
but attachment to Sri Krishna — to crossing [the ocean of] birth.

সে-ই সে পরম বন্ধু, সে-ই মাতা-পিতা ।
শ্রীকৃষ্ণচরণে যেই প্রেমভক্তি-দাতা ॥ ১৯৫ ॥

*se-i se parama bandhu, se-i mātā-pitā |*
*śrīkṛṣṇacaraṇe yei premabhakti-dātā || 195 ||*

*Word for word:* sei se parama bandhu — he alone is the highest friend; sei mata-pita — he alone mother and father; sri-krishna-charane — for Sri Krishna's feet; yei prema-bhakti-data — who gives prema-bhakti

**195.** He alone is the highest friend, he alone mother and father,
who gives prema-bhakti to Sri Krishna's feet.

কৃষ্ণের বিরহে মোর অন্তর কাতর ।
চরণে পড়িয়া বলি বিনয়-উত্তর ॥ ১৯৬ ॥

*kṛṣṇera birahe mora antara kātara |*
*caraṇe paṛiẏā bali binaẏa-uttara || 196 ||*

*Word for word:* krishnera virahe — in separation from Krishna; mora antara katara — My heart is in anguish; charane padiya — falling at [your] feet; bali vinaya-uttara — I give a humble answer

**196.** My heart is in anguish in separation from Krishna;
falling at your feet, I humbly answer you.

বিস্তর পীরিতি মোরে করিয়াছ তুমি ।
তোমার আজ্ঞায় শুদ্ধচিত্ত হই আমি ॥ ১৯৭ ॥

*bistara pīriti more kariẏācha tumi |*
*tomāra ājñāẏa śuddhacitta hai āmi || 197 ||*

*Word for word:* vistara piriti — boundless love; more kariyachha tumi — you have shown Me; tomara ajnaya — by your command; shuddha-chitta hai ami — I become pure in heart

**197.** You have given Me boundless love;
by your command I purify My heart.

আমার নিস্তার হয় তোর পরিত্রাণ ।
শ্রীকৃষ্ণচরণ ভজ — ছাড় পুত্রজ্ঞান ॥ ১৯৮ ॥

*āmāra nistāra haẏa tora paritrāṇa |*
*śrīkṛṣṇacaraṇa bhaja — chāṛa putrajñāna || 198 ||*

*Word for word:* amara nistara haya — My deliverance is; tora paritrana — your salvation; sri-krishna-charana bhaja — serve Sri Krishna's feet; chhada putra-jnana — give up the thought "he is my son"

**198.** My deliverance is your salvation too:
serve Sri Krishna's feet, give up the thought 'he is my son'.[^37-17]

সন্ন্যাস করিব কৃষ্ণপ্রেমার কারণে ।
দেশে দেশে হৈতে আনি দিব প্রেমধনে ॥ ১৯৯ ॥

*sannyāsa kariba kṛṣṇapremāra kāraṇe |*
*deśe deśe haite āni diba premadhane || 199 ||*

*Word for word:* sannyasa kariba — I shall take sannyasa; krishna-premara karane — for the sake of prema for Krishna; deshe deshe haite — from land after land; ani diba prema-dhane — I shall bring and give the wealth of prema

**199.** I shall take sannyasa for the sake of prema for Krishna —
and from distant lands I shall bring and give you the wealth of prema.

আনের তনয় আনে রজত-সুবর্ণ ।
খাইলে বিনাশ পায় — নহে পরধর্ম ॥ ২০০ ॥

*ānera tanaẏa āne rajata-subarṇa |*
*khāile bināśa pāẏa — nahe paradharma || 200 ||*

*Word for word:* anera tanaya — other people's sons; ane rajata-suvarna — bring silver and gold; khaile vinasha paya — when spent it perishes; nahe paradharma — it is not the highest dharma

**200.** Other people's sons bring silver and gold:
spend it, and it is gone; this is not the highest dharma.

ধন-উপার্জন করি' আনে বড় দুঃখে ।
ধনই যাউক কিবা আপনি মরুক ॥ ২০১ ॥

*dhana-upārjana kari' āne baṛa duḥkhe |*
*dhanai yāuka kibā āpani maruka || 201 ||*

*Word for word:* dhana-uparjana kari — earning wealth; ane bada duhkhe — they bring it with great hardship; dhanai yauka — either the wealth goes; kiba apani maruka — or he himself dies

**201.** They earn wealth and bring it with great hardship —
and then either the wealth goes, or [the earner] himself dies.

আমি আনি দিব কৃষ্ণপ্রেম হেন ধন ।
সকল-সম্পদময় কৃষ্ণের চরণ ॥ ২০২ ॥

*āmi āni diba kṛṣṇaprema hena dhana |*
*sakala-sampadamaẏa kṛṣṇera caraṇa || 202 ||*

*Word for word:* ami ani diba — I shall bring and give; krishna-prema hena dhana — such wealth as prema for Krishna; sakala-sampada-maya — full of all treasures; krishnera charana — are Krishna's feet

**202.** But I shall bring you such wealth as prema for Krishna:
Krishna's feet are the sum of all treasures.

ইহলোকে পরলোকে অবিনাশী প্রেমা ।
আজ্ঞা দেহ বেদনী মা, চিত্তে দেহ ক্ষমা ॥ ২০৩ ॥

*ihaloke paraloke abināśī premā |*
*ājñā deha bedanī mā, citte deha kṣamā || 203 ||*

*Word for word:* ihaloke paraloke — in this world and the next; avinashi prema — prema is imperishable; ajna deha — give leave; vedani (?) ma — mother; chitte deha kshama — calm [the grief] in your heart

**203.** Prema is imperishable in this world and the next.
Give Me leave, mother, and calm [the grief] in your heart.[^37-15]

সকল জনমে পিতা মাতা সভে পায় ।
কৃষ্ণ গুরু নাহি মিলে — বুঝিহ হিয়ায় ॥ ২০৪ ॥

*sakala janame pitā mātā sabhe pāẏa |*
*kṛṣṇa guru nāhi mile — bujhiha hiẏāẏa || 204 ||*

*Word for word:* sakala janame — in every birth; pita mata sabhe paya — all obtain father and mother; krishna guru nahi mile — Krishna and the guru are not found; bujhiha hiyaya — understand in your heart

**204.** Father and mother everyone obtains in every birth,
but Krishna and the guru are not obtained — understand this in your heart.

মনুষ্যজনমে কৃষ্ণ গুরু সভে জানি ।
যেই গুরু নাহি করে পশু পক্ষী মানি ॥ ২০৫ ॥

*manuṣyajaname kṛṣṇa guru sabhe jāni |*
*yei guru nāhi kare paśu pakṣī māni || 205 ||*

*Word for word:* manushya-janame — in human birth; krishna guru sabhe jani — all can know Krishna and the guru; yei guru nahi kare — whoever does not accept a guru; pashu pakshi mani — I regard as beast or bird

**205.** Only in human birth can all come to know Krishna and the guru;
one who does not accept a guru I regard as a beast or a bird."

ইহা শুনি' শচীদেবী বিস্মিত হিয়ায় ।
বিশ্বম্ভর-মুখপদ্ম একদৃষ্টে চায় ॥ ২০৬ ॥

*ihā śuni' śacīdebī bismita hiẏāẏa |*
*biśbambhara-mukhapadma ekadṛṣṭe cāẏa || 206 ||*

*Word for word:* iha shuni — hearing this; shachi-devi vismita hiyaya — Shachi-devi, wonder-struck at heart; vishvambhara-mukha-padma — at Vishvambhara's lotus face; eka-drishte chaya — gazes unblinking

**206.** Hearing this, Shachi-devi, wonder-struck at heart,
gazes unblinking at Vishvambhara's lotus face.

চতুর্দশলোকনাথ মায়া কৈল দূর ।
সর্বজীবে দেখে শচী এক সমতুল ॥ ২০৭ ॥

*caturdaśalokanātha māẏā kaila dūra |*
*sarbajībe dekhe śacī eka samatula || 207 ||*

*Word for word:* chaturdasha-loka-natha — the Lord of the fourteen worlds; maya kaila dura — removed maya; sarva-jive dekhe shachi — Shachi sees all beings; eka samatula — as alike, equal

**207.** The Lord of the fourteen worlds removed maya [from her]:
Shachi sees all beings as alike, equal.

সেইক্ষণে বিশ্বম্ভরে কৃষ্ণবুদ্ধি হৈল ।
'আপন তনয়' বলি' মায়া দূরে গেল ॥ ২০৮ ॥

*seikṣaṇe biśbambhare kṛṣṇabuddhi haila |*
*'āpana tanaẏa' bali' māẏā dūre gela || 208 ||*

*Word for word:* sei-kshane — at that moment; vishvambhare krishna-buddhi haila — she perceived Krishna in Vishvambhara; apana tanaya bali — [the thought] "my own son"; maya dure gela — maya went away

**208.** At that very moment she saw Krishna in Vishvambhara:
maya — [the thought] 'this is my son' — went away.[^37-16]

নবমেঘ জিনি' দ্যুতি শ্যাম-কলেবর ।
ত্রিভঙ্গ, মুরলীধর, বর-পীতাম্বর ॥ ২০৯ ॥

*nabamegha jini' dyuti śyāma-kalebara |*
*tribhaṅga, muralīdhara, bara-pītāmbara || 209 ||*

*Word for word:* nava-megha jini dyuti — with lustre surpassing a fresh cloud; shyama-kalevara — a dark body; tribhanga — thrice-bent; murali-dhara — holding the flute; bara-pitambara — in splendid yellow garments

**209.** His body dark, outshining a fresh cloud,
thrice-bent, holding the flute, in splendid yellow garments —

গোপ, গোপী, গোপালের সনে বৃন্দাবনে ।
দেখিল আপন পুত্র চকিত তখনে ॥ ২১০ ॥

*gopa, gopī, gopālera sane bṛndābane |*
*dekhila āpana putra cakita takhane || 210 ||*

*Word for word:* gopa, gopi, gopalera sane — with cowherds, gopis and cowherd boys; vrindavane — in Vrindavana; dekhila apana putra — she saw her own son; chakita takhane — amazed at that moment

**210.** with cowherds, gopis and cowherd boys in Vrindavana
she then saw her own son — and stood amazed.

দেখি' শচী চমৎকার হইলা অন্তরে ।
পুলকে আকুল অঙ্গ, কম্প কলেবরে ॥ ২১১ ॥

*dekhi' śacī camatkāra hailā antare |*
*pulake ākula aṅga, kampa kalebare || 211 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhi — seeing; shachi chamatkara haila antare — Shachi was astonished at heart; pulake akula anga — her body thrilled; kampa kalevare — trembling in her frame

**211.** Seeing this, Shachi was astonished at heart;
her body thrilled, its hairs on end, her whole frame trembling.

স্নেহে নাহি ছাড়ে শচী আপন সম্বন্ধ ।
কৃষ্ণ হঞা পুত্র হৈলা ভাগ্যের নির্বন্ধ ॥ ২১২ ॥

*snehe nāhi chāṛe śacī āpana sambandha |*
*kṛṣṇa hañā putra hailā bhāgyera nirbandha || 212 ||*

*Word for word:* snehe — in her tenderness; nahi chhade shachi — Shachi does not give up; apana sambandha — her own relation; krishna hana — being Krishna; putra haila — He became [my] son; bhagyera nirbandha — by fortune's decree

**212.** [Yet] in her tenderness Shachi does not give up her own relation [to Him]:
"Krishna has become my son — so my good fortune has decreed.

জগত-দুর্লভ কৃষ্ণ আমার তনয় ।
কারু বশ নহে — মোর শক্ত্যে কিবা হয় ॥ ২১৩ ॥

*jagata-durlabha kṛṣṇa āmāra tanaẏa |*
*kāru baśa nahe — mora śaktye kibā haẏa || 213 ||*

*Word for word:* jagata-durlabha krishna — Krishna, unattainable for the world; amara tanaya — is my son; karu vasha nahe — He is in no one's control; mora shaktye kiba haya — what can my strength do

**213.** Krishna, unattainable for the world, is my son;
He is subject to no one's control — what can my strength do?"

এত অনুমানি' শচী কহিল বচন ।
স্বতন্ত্র ঈশ্বর তুমি পুরুষরতন ॥ ২১৪ ॥

*eta anumāni' śacī kahila bacana |*
*sbatantra īśbara tumi puruṣaratana || 214 ||*

*Word for word:* eta anumani — reasoning thus; shachi kahila bachana — Shachi spoke; svatantra ishvara tumi — You are the independent Lord; purusha-ratana — the jewel among men

**214.** Reasoning thus, Shachi spoke:
"You are the independent Lord, the jewel among men.

মোর ভাগ্যে এতদিন ছিলে মোর বশে ।
এখন আপন-সুখে করহ সন্ন্যাসে ॥ ২১৫ ॥

*mora bhāgye etadina chile mora baśe |*
*ekhana āpana-sukhe karaha sannyāse || 215 ||*

*Word for word:* mora bhagye — by my good fortune; etadina chhile mora vashe — so long You were in my power; ekhana — now; apana-sukhe — as it pleases You; karaha sannyase — take sannyasa

**215.** By my good fortune You were so long in my power —
now, as it pleases You, take sannyasa.

এক নিবেদন মোর আছে তোর ঠাঁই ।
এহেন সম্পদ মোর কি লাগিয়া যায় ॥ ২১৬ ॥

*eka nibedana mora āche tora ṭhāṁi |*
*ehena sampada mora ki lāgiẏā yāẏa || 216 ||*

*Word for word:* eka nivedana mora — one request of mine; achhe tora thai — I have of You; ehena sampada mora — such a treasure of mine; ki lagiya yaya — why does it go away

**216.** I have one request of You:
why is such a treasure of mine going away?"

ইহা বলি' সকরুণ ভেল কণ্ঠস্বর ।
সাত পাঁচ ধারা গলে নয়নের জল ॥ ২১৭ ॥

*ihā bali' sakaruṇa bhela kaṇṭhasbara |*
*sāta pāṁca dhārā gale naẏanera jala || 217 ||*

*Word for word:* iha bali — saying this; sakaruna bhela kantha-svara — her voice became piteous; sata pancha dhara — in streams ("seven or five streams"); gale nayanera jala — tears flow from the eyes

**217.** Saying this, she spoke in a piteous voice;
the tears streamed from her eyes.

ফুকরি' ফুকরি' কান্দে শচী সুচরিতা ।
মায়ের কান্দনে প্রভু হেঁট কৈল মাথা ॥ ২১৮ ॥

*phukari' phukari' kānde śacī sucaritā |*
*māẏera kāndane prabhu heṁṭa kaila māthā || 218 ||*

*Word for word:* phukari phukari — sobbing and sobbing; kande shachi sucharita — virtuous Shachi weeps; mayera kandane — at the mother's weeping; prabhu henta kaila matha — the Lord bowed His head

**218.** Sobbing and sobbing weeps virtuous Shachi;
at His mother's weeping the Lord bowed His head.

পুনরপি মুখ তুলি' কহে বিশ্বম্ভর ।
শুন গো জননী, তুমি আমার উত্তর ॥ ২১৯ ॥

*punarapi mukha tuli' kahe biśbambhara |*
*śuna go jananī, tumi āmāra uttara || 219 ||*

*Word for word:* punarapi mukha tuli — raising His face again; kahe vishvambhara — Vishvambhara says; shuna go janani — listen, mother; tumi amara uttara — you, to My answer

**219.** Then, raising His face again, Vishvambhara says:
"Listen, mother, to My answer:

যে দিন দেখিতে তুমি চাহ অনুরাগে ।
সেইক্ষণে আমা' তুমি দেখিবারে পাবে ॥ ২২০ ॥

*ye dina dekhite tumi cāha anurāge |*
*seikṣaṇe āmā' tumi dekhibāre pābe || 220 ||*

*Word for word:* ye dina — on whatever day; dekhite tumi chaha anurage — you long with love to see; sei-kshane — at that moment; ama tumi dekhibare pabe — you will be able to see Me

**220.** on any day when you long with love to see Me —
at that very moment you will be able to see Me."[^37-18]

এ বোল শুনিঞা শচী সম্বরে ক্রন্দন ।
ব্যথিত-হৃদয়ে কহে এ দাস লোচন ॥ ২২১ ॥

*e bola śuniñā śacī sambare krandana |*
*byathita-hṛdaẏe kahe e dāsa locana || 221 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuniña — hearing these words; shachi sambare krandana — Shachi restrains her weeping; vyathita-hridaye — with an aching heart; kahe e dasa lochana — says this servant Lochana

**221.** Hearing these words, Shachi holds back her tears;
with an aching heart [this] was told by this Lochana Dasa.

[^37-1]: The disha is corrupt in A (OCR: "হরিএ মহাশয় … ও-রাজ।চ্ণের অনেক মাতরী এলে নে জানিলুং") and is restored from the 1903 edition (C). Vv. 94–179 are absent from the 1983 edition (B), and in C they stand in the same footnote as the beginning of the story of Dhruva (see en/36, note 8): apparently a later insertion.
[^37-2]: Lit. "performs parana (the breaking of the fast) once a month". The line is corrupt in A, restored from C.
[^37-3]: So in A and C. Lochana Dasa's account of Dhruva's austerities does not follow the Bhagavata (4.8.71–76), where Dhruva gradually gives up fruits, leaves, water and finally breath, standing on one foot.
[^37-4]: Tribhanga ("thrice-bent") is Krishna of Vrindavana with the flute. In Lochana Dasa Dhruva meditates on this form, while the Lord comes to him from Vaikuntha on Garuda (vv. 141–142); in the Bhagavata Narada teaches Dhruva to meditate on the four-armed form (4.8.44–52). Lochana Dasa calls the Lord of Vaikuntha Krishna: Krishna is the source of all His manifestations.
[^37-5]: The tongue that repeats the mantra (cf. v. 117). The gods' trials are Lochana Dasa's detail; in the Bhagavata the gods only suffocate from Dhruva's austerity and beg the Lord for protection (4.8.80–82).
[^37-6]: Kamala is Lakshmi. The third listener is not named — apparently Bhu-devi, Narayana's other consort.
[^37-7]: The line is obscure ("মনের দরিদ্র নাথ তুমি সর্বকাল", lit. "of the poor in mind Lord You are at all times"); translated by the probable sense: the Lord is the treasure of the humble, who have nothing but Him.
[^37-8]: The second line is corrupt in A and C (A: "অপরাত নহি ঘন", C: "অপরাধ নাহি ধার"); translated by sense. The thought concerns the importance of diksha: Narada answers (v. 140) that Dhruva is initiated (he himself gave him the mantra, en/36, vv. 84–90).
[^37-9]: Cf. Bhagavata 4.9.35: there Dhruva only after seeing the Lord laments that he desired what is transient; in Lochana Dasa he at once places devotion above every station.
[^37-10]: Dhruvaloka is the Pole Star, above the circle of the seven rishis (the Great Bear); cf. Bhagavata 4.9.20–25.
[^37-11]: Two Sanskrit shlokas; Bhaktisiddhanta adds a prose rendering of them (not translated). The second shloka is garbled by the OCR of A; restored from C and from Bhaktisiddhanta's rendering ("she whose son is a Vaishnava is truly the mother of a son").
[^37-12]: In the Bhagavata Dhruva reigns thirty-six thousand years (4.12.13).
[^37-13]: Vv. 175–179 are absent in B; in C they stand in the same footnote as the story of Dhruva. In place of en/36, v. 35 — en/37, v. 179 B has only a signature couplet (en/36, v. 34+1). Red (saffron) clothes and earrings are the garb of wandering yogis. Shachi's words are an outburst of a mother's prema: she cannot conceive of life apart from her son.
[^37-14]: "Michha" (lit. "false") here means "empty, vain": whatever is unconnected with Krishna brings no good. This is not the mayavada doctrine of the world's unreality: the world is real but transient (v. 190), and what is true in it is service to Krishna.
[^37-15]: The word before "মা" ("mother") is unclear (A: "নেদলী", C: "বেধনী", B: "के दो"); translated by sense.
[^37-16]: Maya here is that which hides from Shachi her son's divinity: it is yogamaya, which nourishes her motherly love (vatsalya), not a veil of ignorance — Shachi is the Lord's eternal mother (cf. en/36, note 6). The Lord lifts this covering for a moment, but, as v. 212 says, even after the vision Shachi does not give up her motherly feeling. Cf. Yashoda seeing the universe in Krishna's mouth (Bhagavata 10.8.43–45).
[^37-17]: Vv. 196–198: the Lord speaks in the role of a devotee seeking Krishna (cf. en/36, note 1); He Himself is bound by nothing and needs no purification. "My deliverance (nistara)" — by letting Him go [to sannyasa], His mother will herself attain salvation.
[^37-18]: Cf. the Lord's promise to the devotees (en/36, v. 155) and to Srivasa (Murari 2.18.23).

# Madhya-khanda, part 15 (portion 38)

*The section "Vishnupriya's Lament": Vishnupriya learns of the coming sannyasa and begs the Lord not to leave; the Lord consoles her, instructs her and shows her His four-armed form; Srivasa asks to be taken along; in Murari's house the Lord tells him to worship Advaita. The section "The Consolation of the Devotees" (only in the 1983 edition): the last days at home and the last night with Vishnupriya*

## Vishnupriya's Lament

> *Summary by Srila Bhaktisiddhanta Sarasvati.* [When mother Shachi could not tell] her of this, Vishnupriya-devi, beside herself with grief, wept unceasingly, and [the Lord] asked her the reason for her tears. Vishnupriya-devi laid her grief at the Lord's feet; [He], [learning] the cause of her grief, consoled her with many sweet words and at last, giving her full instruction in the truth — [that it is vain] to see one's husband in a body of blood and flesh [and that the true Lord of the soul's life is Sri Hari], — showed Vishnupriya-devi His four-armed form of Narayana. Then Srivasa, Murari and other devotees, hearing in anxiety the news that the Lord would take sannyasa, came to Him, poured out their grief and asked to go with the Lord; Gaurasundara, giving them instruction in the truth, consoled them.[^38-1]

*Raga varadi, the "dhulakhela" tune*

তবে দেবী শচীরাণী, কহে মন-কাহিনী,
হিয়া-দুঃখে বিরস-বদন ।
মুখে না নিঃসরে বাণী, দু-নয়ানে ঝরে পানী,
দেখি' বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া অচেতন ॥ ১ ॥

*tabe debī śacīrāṇī, kahe mana-kāhinī,*
*hiẏā-duḥkhe birasa-badana |*
*mukhe nā niḥsare bāṇī, du-naẏāne jhare pānī,*
*dekhi' biṣṇupriẏā acetana || 1 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe devi shachi-rani — then queen Shachi-devi; kahe mana-kahini — [would] tell what is in her heart; hiya-duhkhe virasa-vadana — her face wan with grief; mukhe na nihsare vani — no word comes from her lips; du-nayane jhare pani — tears stream from both eyes; dekhi vishnupriya achetana — seeing this, Vishnupriya [falls] senseless

**1.** Then queen Shachi-devi [wishes] to tell what is in her heart —
her face is wan with grief;
but no word comes from her lips, tears stream from her eyes —
seeing this, Vishnupriya fell senseless.

সুধাইতে নারে কথা, অন্তরে মরম-ব্যথা,
লোকমুখে শুনি' ঘানাঘুসা ।
ইঙ্গিতে বুঝিল কাজ, পড়িল অকাল-বাজ,
চেতন হরিল সেই দীনা ॥ ২ ॥

*sudhāite nāre kathā, antare marama-byathā,*
*lokamukhe śuni' ghānāghusā |*
*iṅgite bujhila kāja, paṛila akāla-bāja,*
*cetana harila sei dīnā || 2 ||*

*Word for word:* sudhaite nare katha — she cannot ask; antare marama-vyatha — deep pain in her heart; loka-mukhe shuni ghanaghusa — having heard people's whispers; ingite bujhila kaja — by hints she understood the matter; padila akala-baja — an untimely thunderbolt fell; chetana harila sei dina — the poor one lost her senses

**2.** She cannot ask; deep in her heart is pain;
she had heard people's whispers —
and by hints understood the matter: a thunderbolt fell out of season,
and the poor one lost her senses.

বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া মনে গুণে, প্রভু দিন-অবসানে,
ঘরেতে আইলা ত্বরিতে ।
করিয়া ভোজন-পান, সুখে শয্যায় শয়ান,
বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া আইলা তুরিতে ॥ ৩ ॥

*biṣṇupriẏā mane guṇe, prabhu dina-abasāne,*
*gharete āilā tbarite |*
*kariẏā bhojana-pāna, sukhe śayyāẏa śaẏāna,*
*biṣṇupriẏā āilā turite || 3 ||*

*Word for word:* vishnupriya mane gune — Vishnupriya ponders; prabhu dina-avasane — the Lord at day's end; gharete aila tvarite — came home quickly; kariya bhojana-pana — having eaten and drunk; sukhe shayyaya shayana — lies contentedly on the bed; vishnupriya aila turite — Vishnupriya came quickly

**3.** Vishnupriya ponders in her heart. At the close of day the Lord
came home in haste;
having eaten and drunk, He lay down contentedly on His bed —
and Vishnupriya hurried [to Him].

চরণকমল-পাশে, নিঃশ্বাস ছাড়িয়া বৈসে,
নেহারয়ে কাতর-বয়ান ।
হৃদয়-উপরে থুঞা, বান্ধে ভুজলতা দিয়া,
প্রিয়-প্রাণনাথের চরণ ॥ ৪ ॥

*caraṇakamala-pāśe, niḥśbāsa chāṛiẏā baise,*
*nehāraẏe kātara-baẏāna |*
*hṛdaẏa-upare thuñā, bāndhe bhujalatā diẏā,*
*priẏa-prāṇanāthera caraṇa || 4 ||*

*Word for word:* charana-kamala-pashe — by the lotus feet; nihshvasa chhadiya vaise — sighing, she sits; neharaye katara-bayana — gazes with a sorrowful face; hridaya-upare thuña — placing on her bosom; bandhe bhujalata diya — binds with creeper-arms; priya-prananathera charana — the feet of her beloved Lord of life

**4.** Sighing, she sits by His lotus feet
and gazes [at Him] with a sorrowful face;
laying on her bosom the feet of her beloved Lord of life,
she binds them with her creeper-arms.

দু-নয়ানে বহে নীর, ভিজিল হিয়ার চীর,
চরণ বাহিয়া পড়ে ধারা ।
চেতন পাইয়া চিতে, উঠে প্রভু আচম্বিতে,
প্রিয়ায় পুছে অভিপারা ॥ ৫ ॥

*du-naẏāne bahe nīra, bhijila hiẏāra cīra,*
*caraṇa bāhiẏā paṛe dhārā |*
*cetana pāiẏā cite, uṭhe prabhu ācambite,*
*priẏāẏa puche abhipārā || 5 ||*

*Word for word:* du-nayane vahe nira — tears flow from both eyes; bhijila hiyara chira — the cloth on her bosom is soaked; charana vahiya pade dhara — streams run down the feet; chetana paiya chite — feeling it; uthe prabhu achambite — the Lord suddenly rises; priyaya puchhe abhipara — asks His beloved what is wrong

**5.** Tears flow from both her eyes, the cloth over her bosom is soaked,
streams run down [the Lord's] feet.
Feeling it, the Lord suddenly rises
and asks His beloved what is wrong.[^38-2]

মোর প্রাণপ্রিয়া তুমি, কান্দ কি কারণে জানি,
কহ প্রিয়ে ইহার উত্তর ।
থুইয়া উরুর উপর, চিবুকে দক্ষিণ কর,
পুছে কিছু মধুর অক্ষর ॥ ৬ ॥

*mora prāṇapriẏā tumi, kānda ki kāraṇe jāni,*
*kaha priẏe ihāra uttara |*
*thuiẏā urura upara, cibuke dakṣiṇa kara,*
*puche kichu madhura akṣara || 6 ||*

*Word for word:* mora prana-priya tumi — you are dear to Me as life; kanda ki karane jani — why do you weep, I want to know; kaha priye ihara uttara — answer, beloved; thuiya urura upara — setting on His lap; chibuke dakshina kara — right hand on her chin; puchhe kichhu madhura akshara — asks in sweet words

**6.** "You are dear to Me as life — why do you weep? I want to know:
answer Me, beloved."
Setting her on His lap, taking her chin in His right hand,
He asks in sweet words.

কান্দে দেবী বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া, বিদারিয়া যায় হিয়া,
পুছিতে না কহে কিছু বাণী ।
অন্তরে গুমরে প্রাণ, দেহে নাহি সম্বিধান,
নয়ানে ঝরয়ে মাত্র পানী ॥ ৭ ॥

*kānde debī biṣṇupriẏā, bidāriẏā yāẏa hiẏā,*
*puchite nā kahe kichu bāṇī |*
*antare gumare prāṇa, dehe nāhi sambidhāna,*
*naẏāne jharaẏe mātra pānī || 7 ||*

*Word for word:* kande devi vishnupriya — Vishnupriya-devi weeps; bidariya yaya hiya — her heart bursts; puchhite na kahe kichhu vani — asked, she says no word; antare gumare prana — life smoulders within; dehe nahi samvidhana — the body is senseless; nayane jharaye matra pani — only tears stream from her eyes

**7.** Vishnupriya-devi weeps, her heart is bursting;
when asked, she says not a word;
life smoulders within her, her body is senseless —
only tears stream from her eyes.

পুনঃ পুনঃ পুছে পহুঁ, সুমতি না দেই তভু,
কান্দে মাত্র চরণে ধরিয়া ।
প্রভু সব কলা জানে, পুছে নানা-বিধানে,
অঙ্গবাসে বয়ান মুছিয়া ॥ ৮ ॥

*punaḥ punaḥ puche pahuṁ, sumati nā dei tabhu,*
*kānde mātra caraṇe dhariẏā |*
*prabhu saba kalā jāne, puche nānā-bidhāne,*
*aṅgabāse baẏāna muchiẏā || 8 ||*

*Word for word:* punah punah puchhe pahun — again and again the Lord asks; sumati na dei tabhu — still she gives no answer; kande matra charane dhariya — only weeps, clasping His feet; prabhu saba kala jane — the Lord knows every art; puchhe nana-vidhane — asks in many ways; anga-vase bayana muchhiya — wiping her face with His cloth

**8.** Again and again the Lord asks — and still she does not answer,
but only weeps, clasping His feet.
The Lord, who knows every art, asks in many ways,
wiping her face with the edge of His cloth.

নানারঙ্গ পরথাব, করিয়া বাঢ়ায় ভাব,
যে কথায় পাষাণ মুঞ্জরে ।
প্রভুর ব্যগ্রতা দেখি', বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া চন্দ্রমুখী,
কহে কিছু গদ্গদ-স্বরে ॥ ৯ ॥

*nānāraṅga parathāba, kariẏā bāṛhāẏa bhāba,*
*ye kathāẏa pāṣāṇa muñjare |*
*prabhura byagratā dekhi', biṣṇupriẏā candramukhī,*
*kahe kichu gadgada-sbare || 9 ||*

*Word for word:* nana-ranga parathava — playful talks of many kinds; kariya badhaya bhava — making them, He stirs feeling; ye kathaya pashana munjare — at such words a stone would blossom; prabhura vyagrata dekhi — seeing the Lord's eagerness; vishnupriya chandramukhi — moon-faced Vishnupriya; kahe kichhu gadgada-svare — speaks in a faltering voice

**9.** He begins one playful talk after another, awakening feeling in her —
at such words even a stone would blossom.
Seeing the Lord's eagerness, moon-faced Vishnupriya
spoke in a faltering voice:

শুন শুন প্রাণনাথ, মোর শিরে দেহ হাত,
সন্ন্যাস করিবে নাকি তুমি ।
লোকমুখে শুনি' ইহা, বিদরিতে চাহে হিয়া,
আগুনিতে প্রবেশিব আমি ॥ ১০ ॥

*śuna śuna prāṇanātha, mora śire deha hāta,*
*sannyāsa karibe nāki tumi |*
*lokamukhe śuni' ihā, bidarite cāhe hiẏā,*
*āgunite prabeśiba āmi || 10 ||*

*Word for word:* shuna shuna prananatha — listen, Lord of my life; mora shire deha hata — put Your hand on my head; sannyasa karibe naki tumi — will You really take sannyasa; loka-mukhe shuni iha — hearing this from people; bidarite chahe hiya — my heart would burst; agunite praveshiba ami — I shall enter fire

**10.** "Listen, listen, Lord of my life, put Your hand on my head [and tell the truth]:
are You really going to take sannyasa?
Hearing it from people, I feel my heart will burst —
I shall enter fire.

তোমা লাগি' জীবন-ধন, রূপ নব যৌবন,
বেশ-বিলাস-ভাব-কলা ।
তুমি যবে ছাড়ি' যাবে, কি কাজ এ ছার জীবে,
হিয়া পোড়ে যেন বিষ-জ্বালা ॥ ১১ ॥

*tomā lāgi' jībana-dhana, rūpa naba yaubana,*
*beśa-bilāsa-bhāba-kalā |*
*tumi yabe chāṛi' yābe, ki kāja e chāra jībe,*
*hiẏā poṛe yena biṣa-jbālā || 11 ||*

*Word for word:* toma lagi — for You; jivana-dhana — life and wealth; rupa nava yauvana — beauty, fresh youth; besha-vilasa-bhava-kala — dress, graces, feelings, arts; tumi yabe chhadi yabe — when You go away; ki kaja e chhara jive — what use this wretched life; hiya pode yena visha-jvala — the heart burns as with poison

**11.** For You are my life and wealth, my beauty and youth,
my dress, my graces, feelings and arts;
when You go away, what use is this wretched life? —
my heart burns as with poison.

আমা হেন ভাগ্যবতী, নাহি কোন যুবতী,
তুমি মোর প্রিয় প্রাণনাথ ।
বড় প্রীতি আশা ছিল, নিজ দেহ সমর্পিল,
এ নব যৌবনে দিবা হাত ॥ ১১+১ ॥

*āmā hena bhāgyabatī, nāhi kona yubatī,*
*tumi mora priẏa prāṇanātha |*
*baṛa prīti āśā chila, nija deha samarpila,*
*e naba yaubane dibā hāta || 11+1 ||*

*Word for word:* ama hena bhagyavati — as fortunate as I; nahi kona yuvati — there is no young woman; tumi mora priya prananatha — You are my beloved Lord of life; bada priti asha chhila — great were love and hope; nija deha samarpila — I gave myself; e nava yauvane diba hata — [that] You would give Your hand in this youth

**11+1.** There is no other young woman as fortunate as I:[^38-3]
You are my beloved Lord of life;
great were my love and hope — I gave myself to You,
[trusting] that You would give me Your hand in this youth.

ধিক্ রহু মোর দেহে, এক নিবেদিয়ে তোহে,
কেমনে হাঁটিয়া যাবে পথে ।
শিরীষ-কুসুম যেন, সুকোমল শ্রীচরণ,
পরশিতে ডর লাগে হাথে ॥ ১২ ॥

*dhik rahu mora dehe, eka nibediẏe tohe,*
*kemane hāṁṭiẏā yābe pathe |*
*śirīṣa-kusuma yena, sukomala śrīcaraṇa,*
*paraśite ḍara lāge hāthe || 12 ||*

*Word for word:* dhik rahu mora dehe — shame on my body; eka nivediye tohe — one thing I ask You; kemane hantiya yabe pathe — how will You walk the roads; shirisha-kusuma yena — like shirisha flowers; sukomala sri-charana — the tender holy feet; parashite dara lage hathe — my hand fears to touch

**12.** Shame on my body! One thing I ask You:
how will You walk the roads on foot?
Your feet are tender as shirisha flowers —
my hand is afraid to touch them.

ভূমিতে দাঁড়াও যবে, ডরে প্রাণ হালে তবে,
শিহরিয়া পড়য়ে সব গায় ।
অরণ্য-কণ্টক-বনে, কোথা যাবে কোন্ খানে,
কেমনে হাঁটিবে রাঙা পায় ॥ ১৩ ॥

*bhūmite dāṁṛāo yabe, ḍare prāṇa hāle tabe,*
*śihariẏā paṛaẏe saba gāẏa |*
*araṇya-kaṇṭaka-bane, kothā yābe kon khāne,*
*kemane hāṁṭibe rāṅā pāẏa || 13 ||*

*Word for word:* bhumite danrao yabe — when You stand on the ground; dare prana hale tabe — then my heart quakes with fear; shihariya padaye saba gaya — my whole body shudders; aranya-kantaka-vane — in thorny forests; kotha yabe kon khane — where will You go, to what place; kemane hantibe ranga paya — how will You walk on crimson feet

**13.** When You stand on the ground, my heart quakes with fear
and my whole body shudders;
in the forests, among thorns, where will You go, to what lands?
How will You walk on Your crimson feet?

সুধাময় মুখ-ইন্দু, তাহে ঘর্ম-বিন্দু বিন্দু,
অল্প আয়াস মাত্র দেখি ।
বরিষা-বাদল-বেলা, ক্ষণে বারি ক্ষণে খরা,
সন্ন্যাসে করয়ে মহাদুখী ॥ ১৪ ॥

*sudhāmaẏa mukha-indu, tāhe gharma-bindu bindu,*
*alpa āẏāsa mātra dekhi |*
*bariṣā-bādala-belā, kṣaṇe bāri kṣaṇe kharā,*
*sannyāse karaẏe mahādukhī || 14 ||*

*Word for word:* sudhamaya mukha-indu — the nectarean moon-face; tahe gharma-bindu bindu — drops of sweat on it; alpa ayasa matra dekhi — I see at the slightest effort; barisha-badala-bela — in the rainy season; kshane vari kshane khara — now rain, now heat; sannyase karaye mahadukhi — sannyasa makes one suffer greatly

**14.** On Your nectar moon-face drops of sweat appear
at the slightest effort;
in the rainy season — now downpour, now scorching heat:
sannyasa will bring [You] great suffering.

তোমার চরণ বিনি, আর কিছু নাহি জানি,
আমারে ফেলিহ কার ঠাঁয়ে ।
ধর্ম-ভয় নাহি তোরা, শচী বৃদ্ধা আধমরা,
কেমনে ছাড়িবে হেন মায়ে ॥ ১৫ ॥

*tomāra caraṇa bini, āra kichu nāhi jāni,*
*āmāre pheliha kāra ṭhāṁẏe |*
*dharma-bhaẏa nāhi torā, śacī bṛddhā ādhamarā,*
*kemane chāṛibe hena māẏe || 15 ||*

*Word for word:* tomara charana vini — apart from Your feet; ara kichhu nahi jani — I know nothing else; amare pheliha kara thaye — to whom will You leave me; dharma-bhaya nahi tora — You have no fear of [breaking] dharma; shachi vriddha adhamara — Shachi is old, half-dead; kemane chhadibe hena maye — how will You leave such a mother

**15.** Apart from Your feet I know nothing —
to whom will You leave me?
Have You no fear of [breaking] dharma? Shachi is old and half-dead —
how will You leave such a mother?

মুরারি-মুকুন্দ-দত্ত, হেন সব ভকত,
শ্রীনিবাস আর হরিদাস ।
অদ্বৈত-আচার্য আদি, ছাড়িয়া কি কার্য সাধি',
কেমনে বা করিবে সন্ন্যাস ॥ ১৬ ॥

*murāri-mukunda-datta, hena saba bhakata,*
*śrīnibāsa āra haridāsa |*
*adbaita-ācārya ādi, chāṛiẏā ki kārya sādhi',*
*kemane bā karibe sannyāsa || 16 ||*

*Word for word:* murari-mukunda-datta — Murari, Mukunda Datta; hena saba bhakata — such devotees; srinivasa ara haridasa — Srinivasa and Haridasa; advaita-acharya adi — Advaita Acharya and others; chhadiya ki karya sadhi — leaving them, what will You achieve; kemane va karibe sannyasa — how will You take sannyasa

**16.** Murari, Mukunda Datta — such devotees,
Srinivasa and Haridasa,
Advaita Acharya and the others — leaving them, what will You achieve?
How can You take sannyasa?

তুমি প্রভু প্রেমরাশি, জগজনে হেন বাসি,
বিপরীত চরিত আশয় ।
তুমি দেশান্তরে যাবে, শুনিলে মরিবে সবে,
হবে সব অপযশময় ॥ ১৭ ॥

*tumi prabhu premarāśi, jagajane hena bāsi,*
*biparīta carita āśaẏa |*
*tumi deśāntare yābe, śunile maribe sabe,*
*habe saba apayaśamaẏa || 17 ||*

*Word for word:* tumi prabhu prema-rashi — You, Lord, are a treasury of prema; jagajane hena basi — so the world thinks; viparita charita ashaya — Your deeds and intent are contrary; tumi deshantare yabe — You will go to far lands; shunile maribe sabe — hearing it, all will die; habe saba apayashamaya — all will be full of disgrace

**17.** You, Lord, are a treasury of prema — so the whole world thinks —
yet Your deeds and intentions are the opposite.
You will go to far lands — hearing it, everyone will die,
and all will be covered with disgrace.

কি কহিব মুঞি ছার, মূল তোমার সংসার,
সন্ন্যাস করিবে মোর ডরে ।
তোমার নিছনি লঞা, মরি যাঙ বিষ খাঞা,
সুখে নিবসহ নিজঘরে ॥ ১৮ ॥

*ki kahiba muñi chāra, mūla tomāra saṃsāra,*
*sannyāsa karibe mora ḍare |*
*tomāra nichani lañā, mari yāṅa biṣa khāñā,*
*sukhe nibasaha nijaghare || 18 ||*

*Word for word:* ki kahiba munni chhara — what shall I, worthless, say; mula tomara samsara — [if I am] the root of Your household; sannyasa karibe mora dare — You will take sannyasa because of me; tomara nichhani lana — taking Your misfortunes on myself; mari yana visha khana — let me die by taking poison; sukhe nivasaha nijaghare — live happily in Your home

**18.** What shall I, worthless one, say? If I am the root of Your household life
and You take sannyasa because of me —
let me take Your misfortunes upon myself and die by taking poison,[^38-4]
and You live happily in Your own home.

প্রভু না যাইহ দেশান্তরে, কেহো নাহি এ সংসারে,
বদন চাহিতে পোড়ে হিয়া ।
কহিতে না পারে কথা, অন্তরে মরম-ব্যথা,
কান্দে মাত্র চরণে ধরিয়া ॥ ১৯ ॥

*prabhu nā yāiha deśāntare, keho nāhi e saṃsāre,*
*badana cāhite poṛe hiẏā |*
*kahite nā pāre kathā, antare marama-byathā,*
*kānde mātra caraṇe dhariẏā || 19 ||*

*Word for word:* prabhu na yaiha deshantare — Lord, do not go to far lands; keho nahi e samsare — I have no one in this world; vadana chahite pode hiya — looking at Your face my heart burns; kahite na pare katha — she can say no word; antare marama-vyatha — pain in her heart; kande matra charane dhariya — only weeps, clasping His feet

**19.** Lord, do not go to far lands: I have no one in this world;
when I look at Your face my heart burns."
She can say no more — deep in her heart is pain;
she only weeps, clasping His feet.

শুনি' বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া-বাণী, তবে সেই গৌরমণি,
হাসিয়া তুলিয়া নিল কোলে ।
বসনে মুছিয়া মুখ, করে নানা কৌতুক,
মিছা দুঃখ না ভাবিহ বোলে ॥ ২০ ॥

*śuni' biṣṇupriẏā-bāṇī, tabe sei gauramaṇi,*
*hāsiẏā tuliẏā nila kole |*
*basane muchiẏā mukha, kare nānā kautuka,*
*michā duḥkha nā bhābiha bole || 20 ||*

*Word for word:* shuni vishnupriya-vani — hearing Vishnupriya's words; tabe sei gauramani — then that jewel Gaura; hasiya tuliya nila kole — smiling, took her on His lap; vasane muchhiya mukha — wiping her face with His cloth; kare nana kautuka — jests in many ways; michha duhkha na bhaviha bole — says, "do not dwell on needless grief"

**20.** Hearing Vishnupriya's words, then that jewel Gauranga
smiling, took her onto His lap;
wiping her face with His cloth, He jests in many ways
and says: "Do not dwell on needless grief.

আমি তোরে ছাড়িয়া, সন্ন্যাস করিব গিয়া,
এ কথা বা কে কহিল তোকে ।
যে করি সে করি যবে, তোমারে কহিব তবে,
এখনে না মর মিছা-শোকে ॥ ২১ ॥

*āmi tore chāṛiẏā, sannyāsa kariba giẏā,*
*e kathā bā ke kahila toke |*
*ye kari se kari yabe, tomāre kahiba tabe,*
*ekhane nā mara michā-śoke || 21 ||*

*Word for word:* ami tore chhadiya — that I, leaving you; sannyasa kariba giya — will go and take sannyasa; e katha va ke kahila toke — who told you this; ye kari se kari yabe — whatever I do, when I do it; tomare kahiba tabe — I shall tell you then; ekhane na mara michha-shoke — now do not die of needless sorrow

**21.** That I will leave you and go to take sannyasa —
who ever told you that?
Whatever I do, when I do it, I shall tell you then —
but now do not die of needless sorrow."

ইহা বলি' গৌরহরি, আশ্লেষ-চুম্বন করি',
নানা রস-কৌতুক-বিহারে ।
অনন্ত বিনোদ প্রেমা, লীলা-লাবণ্যের সীমা,
বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া তুষিল প্রকারে ॥ ২২ ॥

*ihā bali' gaurahari, āśleṣa-cumbana kari',*
*nānā rasa-kautuka-bihāre |*
*ananta binoda premā, līlā-lābaṇyera sīmā,*
*biṣṇupriẏā tuṣila prakāre || 22 ||*

*Word for word:* iha bali gaurahari — saying this, Gaurahari; ashlesha-chumbana kari — embracing and kissing; nana rasa-kautuka-vihare — in many sweet playful pastimes; ananta vinoda prema — endless the delights of His prema; lila-lavanyera sima — the limit of grace in lila; vishnupriya tushila prakare — comforted Vishnupriya in every way

**22.** Saying this, Gaurahari embraces and kisses her
in many sweet and playful pastimes;
endless are the delights of His prema, He is the limit of grace in lila —
so in every way He comforted Vishnupriya.[^38-5]

বিনোদ-বিলাস-রসে, ভৈ গেল রজনী-শেষে,
পুনঃ কিছু পুছে বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া ।
হিয়ায় আগুনি আছে, তে-কারণে পুনঃ পুছে,
প্রিয়-প্রাণনাথ-মুখ চাঞা ॥ ২৩ ॥

*binoda-bilāsa-rase, bhai gela rajanī-śeṣe,*
*punaḥ kichu puche biṣṇupriẏā |*
*hiẏāẏa āguni āche, te-kāraṇe punaḥ puche,*
*priẏa-prāṇanātha-mukha cāñā || 23 ||*

*Word for word:* vinoda-vilasa-rase — in joyful play; bhai gela rajani-sheshe — the night came to an end; punah kichhu puchhe vishnupriya — Vishnupriya asks again; hiyaya aguni achhe — there is fire in her heart; te-karane punah puchhe — therefore she asks again; priya-prananatha-mukha chaña — gazing at her beloved Lord's face

**23.** In joyful play the night came to an end,
and Vishnupriya asks again:
there is fire in her heart — that is why she asks again,
gazing at the face of her beloved Lord of life.

প্রভু-কর বুকে দিয়া, পুছে দেবী বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া,
মিছা না কহিও মোর ডরে ।
হেন অনুমান করি, যত কহ সে চাতুরী,
পলাইবে মোর অগোচরে ॥ ২৪ ॥

*prabhu-kara buke diẏā, puche debī biṣṇupriẏā,*
*michā nā kahio mora ḍare |*
*hena anumāna kari, yata kaha se cāturī,*
*palāibe mora agocare || 24 ||*

*Word for word:* prabhu-kara buke diya — pressing the Lord's hand to her breast; puchhe devi vishnupriya — Vishnupriya-devi asks; michha na kahio mora dare — do not lie for fear of me; hena anumana kari — so I suspect; yata kaha se chaturi — all You say is playfulness; palaibe mora agochare — You will flee without my knowing

**24.** Pressing the Lord's hand to her breast, Vishnupriya-devi asks:
"Do not lie to me for fear of me.
This is what I think: all You say is mere playfulness —
You will run away without my knowing.

তুমি নিজবশ প্রভু, পরবশ নহ কভু,
যে করহ আপনার সুখে ।
সন্ন্যাস করিবে তুমি, কি বলিতে পারি আমি,
নিশ্চয় করিয়া কহ মোকে ॥ ২৫ ॥

*tumi nijabaśa prabhu, parabaśa naha kabhu,*
*ye karaha āpanāra sukhe |*
*sannyāsa karibe tumi, ki balite pāri āmi,*
*niścaẏa kariẏā kaha moke || 25 ||*

*Word for word:* tumi nijavasha prabhu — You, Lord, are Your own master; paravasha naha kabhu — never in another's power; ye karaha apanara sukhe — You do what pleases You; sannyasa karibe tumi — if You take sannyasa; ki balite pari ami — what can I say; nishchaya kariya kaha moke — tell me truly

**25.** You, Lord, are Your own master, never in another's power,
and You do what pleases You.
If You will take sannyasa — what can I say?
[Only] tell me the truth."

এ বোল শুনিঞা পহুঁ, মুচকি হাসিয়া লহুঁ,
কহে শুন মোর প্রিয়-প্রিয়া ।
কিছু না করিহ চিতে, যে কহিয়ে তোর হিতে,
সাবধানে শুন মন দিয়া ॥ ২৬ ॥

*e bola śuniñā pahuṁ, mucaki hāsiẏā lahuṁ,*
*kahe śuna mora priẏa-priẏā |*
*kichu nā kariha cite, ye kahiẏe tora hite,*
*sābadhāne śuna mana diẏā || 26 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuniña pahun — hearing these words, the Lord; muchaki hasiya lahun — smiling softly; kahe shuna mora priya-priya — says: listen, My beloved; kichhu na kariha chite — do not grieve at heart; ye kahiye tora hite — what I say for your good; savadhane shuna mana diya — listen attentively

**26.** Hearing these words, the Lord smiled softly
and says: "Listen, My beloved,
do not grieve at all in your heart: what I say for your good
listen to attentively.

জগতে যতেক দেখ, মিছা করি' সব লেখ,
সত্য এক সবে ভগবান্ ।
সত্য আর বৈষ্ণব, তা-বিনে যতেক সব,
মিছা করি' করহ গেয়ান ॥ ২৭ ॥

*jagate yateka dekha, michā kari' saba lekha,*
*satya eka sabe bhagabān |*
*satya āra baiṣṇaba, tā-bine yateka saba,*
*michā kari' karaha geẏāna || 27 ||*

*Word for word:* jagate yateka dekha — all you see in the world; michha kari saba lekha — count as empty; satya eka sabe bhagavan — Bhagavan alone is true; satya ara vaishnava — true also the Vaishnavas; ta-vine yateka saba — all else besides; michha kari karaha geyana — regard as empty

**27.** All that you see in the world count as empty:
Bhagavan alone is true,
and true are the Vaishnavas; all else besides them
count as empty.[^38-6]

মিছা সুত, পতি, নারী, পিতা মাতা যত বলি,
পরিণামে কেবা বা কাহার ।
শ্রীকৃষ্ণচরণ বহি, আর ত কুটুম্ব নাহি,
যত দেখ এ মায়া তাঁহার ॥ ২৮ ॥

*michā suta, pati, nārī, pitā mātā yata bali,*
*pariṇāme kebā bā kāhāra |*
*śrīkṛṣṇacaraṇa bahi, āra ta kuṭumba nāhi,*
*yata dekha e māẏā tāṁhāra || 28 ||*

*Word for word:* michha suta, pati, nari — empty are son, husband, wife; pita mata yata bali — father, mother — all so called; pariname keba va kahara — in the end who is whose; sri-krishna-charana vahi — apart from Sri Krishna's feet; ara ta kutumba nahi — there is no other kin; yata dekha e maya tanhara — all you see is His maya

**28.** Empty are son, husband, wife, father, mother — all that goes by such names:
in the end, who belongs to whom?
Apart from Sri Krishna's feet there is no other kin;
all that you see is His maya.

কিবা নারী, পুরুষ দেখ, সভারি সে আত্মা এক,
মিছা মায়াবন্ধে ভাবে দুই ।
শ্রীকৃষ্ণ সভার পতি, আর সব প্রকৃতি,
এই কথা না বুঝয়ে কোই ॥ ২৯ ॥

*kibā nārī, puruṣa dekha, sabhāri se ātmā eka,*
*michā māẏābandhe bhābe dui |*
*śrīkṛṣṇa sabhāra pati, āra saba prakṛti,*
*ei kathā nā bujhaẏe koi || 29 ||*

*Word for word:* kiba nari, purusha dekha — whether woman or man, see; sabhari se atma eka — the soul of all is one [in nature]; michha maya-bandhe bhave dui — falsely, in maya's bonds, one thinks "two"; sri-krishna sabhara pati — Sri Krishna is the husband of all; ara saba prakriti — all others are prakriti; ei katha na bujhaye koi — this no one understands

**29.** Whether woman or man — see: the soul of all is one [in nature];
only in the bonds of maya does one imagine 'two'.
Sri Krishna is the husband of all, and all others are prakriti:
this no one understands.[^38-7]

রক্ত-রেতঃ-সম্মিলনে, জন্ম বিষ্ঠা-মূত্র-স্থানে,
ভূমে পড়ে হঞা অগেয়ান ।
বাল, যুবা, বৃদ্ধ হঞা, নানা দুঃখে কষ্ট পাঞা,
দেহে গেহে করে অভিমান ॥ ৩০ ॥

*rakta-retaḥ-sammilane, janma biṣṭhā-mūtra-sthāne,*
*bhūme paṛe hañā ageẏāna |*
*bāla, yubā, bṛddha hañā, nānā duḥkhe kaṣṭa pāñā,*
*dehe gehe kare abhimāna || 30 ||*

*Word for word:* rakta-retah-sammilane — from the union of blood and seed; janma vishtha-mutra-sthane — birth in a place of filth; bhume pade hana ageyana — falls to the ground unknowing; bala, yuva, vriddha hana — as child, youth, old man; nana duhkhe kashta pana — suffering many miseries; dehe gehe kare abhimana — takes pride in body and home

**30.** From the union of blood and seed a person is born in a place of filth
and falls to the ground knowing nothing;
as a child, a youth, an old man, he suffers many miseries —
and takes pride in his body and home.

বন্ধু করি' যারে পালি, তারা সব দেই গালি,
অভিমানে বৃদ্ধকাল বঞ্চে ।
শ্রবণ নয়ান আন্ধে, বিষাদ ভাবিয়া কান্দে,
তভু নাহি ভজয়ে গোবিন্দে ॥ ৩১ ॥

*bandhu kari' yāre pāli, tārā saba dei gāli,*
*abhimāne bṛddhakāla bañce |*
*śrabaṇa naẏāna āndhe, biṣāda bhābiẏā kānde,*
*tabhu nāhi bhajaẏe gobinde || 31 ||*

*Word for word:* bandhu kari yare pali — those he raised as his own; tara saba dei gali — they all revile him; abhimane vriddha-kala vanche — in pride he spends old age; shravana nayana andhe — hearing and sight grow dim; vishada bhaviya kande — he weeps thinking of his woes; tabhu nahi bhajaye govinde — still he does not serve Govinda

**31.** Those he raised as his own all revile him;
in pride he lives out his old age;
hearing and sight grow dim, he weeps thinking of his woes —
and still he does not serve Govinda.

কৃষ্ণ ভজিবার তরে, দেহ ধরি' এ সংসারে,
মায়াবন্ধে পাশরে আপনা ।
অহঙ্কারে মত্ত হঞা, নিজপ্রভু পাশরিয়া,
শেষে মরে নরক-যন্ত্রণা ॥ ৩২ ॥

*kṛṣṇa bhajibāra tare, deha dhari' e saṃsāre,*
*māẏābandhe pāśare āpanā |*
*ahaṅkāre matta hañā, nijaprabhu pāśariẏā,*
*śeṣe mare naraka-yantraṇā || 32 ||*

*Word for word:* krishna bhajibara tare — in order to serve Krishna; deha dhari e samsare — taking a body in this world; maya-bandhe pashare apana — in maya's bonds forgets himself; ahamkare matta hana — drunk with conceit; nija-prabhu pashariya — forgetting his own Lord; sheshe mare naraka-yantrana — in the end dies in hell's torments

**32.** He took a body in this world in order to serve Krishna —
yet in the bonds of maya he forgets himself;
drunk with conceit, forgetting his own Lord,
in the end he dies in the torments of hell.

তোর নাম বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া, সার্থক করহ ইহা,
মিছা শোক না করিহ চিতে ।
এ তোরে কহিলুঁ কথা, দূর কর আন-চিন্তা,
মন দেহ কৃষ্ণের চরিতে ॥ ৩৩ ॥

*tora nāma biṣṇupriẏā, sārthaka karaha ihā,*
*michā śoka nā kariha cite |*
*e tore kahiluṁ kathā, dūra kara āna-cintā,*
*mana deha kṛṣṇera carite || 33 ||*

*Word for word:* tora nama vishnupriya — your name is Vishnupriya; sarthaka karaha iha — make it meaningful; michha shoka na kariha chite — keep no needless grief at heart; e tore kahilun katha — I have told you this; dura kara ana-chinta — put away other thoughts; mana deha krishnera charite — give your mind to Krishna's deeds

**33.** Your name is Vishnupriya ('dear to Vishnu'): make it meaningful,
do not keep needless grief in your heart.
I have told you this — put away other thoughts
and give your mind to the deeds of Krishna."

আপনে ঈশ্বর হঞা, দূর করে নিজ-মায়া,
বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া পরসন্ন-চিত ।
দূরে গেল দুঃখ-শোক, আনন্দে ভরল বুক,
চতুর্ভুজ দেখে আচম্বিত ॥ ৩৪ ॥

*āpane īśbara hañā, dūra kare nija-māẏā,*
*biṣṇupriẏā parasanna-cita |*
*dūre gela duḥkha-śoka, ānande bharala buka,*
*caturbhuja dekhe ācambita || 34 ||*

*Word for word:* apane ishvara hana — being Himself the Lord; dura kare nija-maya — removes His own maya; vishnupriya parasanna-chita — Vishnupriya's heart grew clear; dure gela duhkha-shoka — grief and sorrow went away; anande bharala buka — her breast filled with joy; chaturbhuja dekhe achambita — suddenly she sees the four-armed form

**34.** Being Himself the Lord, He removed His own maya,[^38-8] —
and Vishnupriya's heart grew clear:
grief and sorrow went away, her breast filled with joy —
and suddenly she sees [Him] four-armed.

তবে দেবী বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া, চতুর্ভুজ দেখিয়া,
পতিবুদ্ধি নাহি ছাড়ে তভু ।
পড়িয়া চরণতলে, প্রণতি মিনতি করে,
এক নিবেদন শুন প্রভু ॥ ৩৫ ॥

*tabe debī biṣṇupriẏā, caturbhuja dekhiẏā,*
*patibuddhi nāhi chāṛe tabhu |*
*paṛiẏā caraṇatale, praṇati minati kare,*
*eka nibedana śuna prabhu || 35 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe devi vishnupriya — then Vishnupriya-devi; chaturbhuja dekhiya — seeing the four-armed form; pati-buddhi nahi chhade tabhu — still does not give up thinking of Him as husband; padiya charana-tale — falling at His feet; pranati minati kare — bows and pleads; eka nivedana shuna prabhu — hear, Lord, one request

**35.** Yet even seeing the four-armed form,
Vishnupriya-devi does not give up thinking of Him as her husband;
falling at His feet, she bows and pleads:
"Hear, Lord, one request of mine.

মো অতি অধম ছার, জনমিলুঁ এ সংসার,
তুমি মোর প্রিয় প্রাণপতি ।
এহেন সম্পদ মোর, দাসী হৈয়াছিলুঁ তোর,
কি লাগিয়া ভেল অধোগতি ॥ ৩৬ ॥

*mo ati adhama chāra, janamiluṁ e saṃsāra,*
*tumi mora priẏa prāṇapati |*
*ehena sampada mora, dāsī haiẏāchiluṁ tora,*
*ki lāgiẏā bhela adhogati || 36 ||*

*Word for word:* mo ati adhama chhara — I, the lowest and worthless; janamilun e samsara — was born in this world; tumi mora priya pranapati — You are my beloved husband, Lord of my life; ehena sampada mora — such was my fortune; dasi haiyachhilun tora — I had become Your maidservant; ki lagiya bhela adhogati — why such a fall

**36.** I, the lowest and most worthless, was born in this world,
and You are my beloved husband, the Lord of my life;
such was my good fortune — I had become Your maidservant —
why then [now] such a fall?"

ইহা বলি' বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া, কান্দে উতরোলি হঞা,
অধিক বাড়ল পরমাদ ।
প্রিয়জন-আর্তি দেখি', ছল ছল করে আঁখি,
কোলে করি' করিলা প্রসাদ ॥ ৩৭ ॥

*ihā bali' biṣṇupriẏā, kānde utaroli hañā,*
*adhika bāṛala paramāda |*
*priẏajana-ārti dekhi', chala chala kare āṁkhi,*
*kole kari' karilā prasāda || 37 ||*

*Word for word:* iha bali vishnupriya — saying this, Vishnupriya; kande utaroli hana — weeps aloud; adhika badala paramada — the distress grew greater; priyajana-arti dekhi — seeing His beloved's anguish; chhala chhala kare ankhi — His eyes brim with tears; kole kari karila prasada — taking her in His arms, He bestowed grace

**37.** Saying this, Vishnupriya wept aloud,
and her distress grew greater still.
Seeing His beloved's anguish, the Lord, His eyes brimming with tears,
took her in His arms and bestowed His grace:

শুন দেবী বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া, এ তোরে কহিল ইহা,
যখনে যে তুমি মনে কর ।
আমি যথা তথা যাই, আছিয়ে তোমার ঠাঁই,
সত্য সত্য কহিলাম দঢ় ॥ ৩৮ ॥

*śuna debī biṣṇupriẏā, e tore kahila ihā,*
*yakhane ye tumi mane kara |*
*āmi yathā tathā yāi, āchiẏe tomāra ṭhāṁi,*
*satya satya kahilāma daṛha || 38 ||*

*Word for word:* shuna devi vishnupriya — listen, Vishnupriya-devi; e tore kahila iha — this I tell you; yakhane ye tumi mane kara — whenever you think [of Me]; ami yatha tatha yai — wherever I go; achhiye tomara thai — I am with you; satya satya kahilama dadha — truly, truly I say firmly

**38.** "Listen, Vishnupriya-devi, this is what I tell you:
whenever you think of Me —
wherever I may go, I am with you;
truly, truly I tell you firmly."[^38-9]

কৃষ্ণ-আজ্ঞাবাণী শুনি', বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া মনে গুণি',
স্বতন্ত্র ঈশ্বর এই প্রভু ।
নিজসুখে করে কাজ, কে দিবে তাহাতে বাধ,
প্রত্যুত্তর না দিলেক তভু ॥ ৩৯ ॥

*kṛṣṇa-ājñābāṇī śuni', biṣṇupriẏā mane guṇi',*
*sbatantra īśbara ei prabhu |*
*nijasukhe kare kāja, ke dibe tāhāte bādha,*
*pratyuttara nā dileka tabhu || 39 ||*

*Word for word:* krishna-ajna-vani shuni — hearing Krishna's word of command; vishnupriya mane guni — Vishnupriya thought; svatantra ishvara ei prabhu — this Lord is the independent Master; nija-sukhe kare kaja — He does as He pleases; ke dibe tahate badha — who will hinder Him; pratyuttara na dileka tabhu — and she gave no reply

**39.** Hearing the word of Krishna's command, Vishnupriya thought:
"This Lord is the independent Master,
He does what pleases Him — who can stand in His way?" —
and she made no reply.

বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া হেঁটমুখী, ছল ছল করে আঁখি,
দেখি' প্রভু সরস সম্ভাষে ।
প্রভু-আচরণ-কথা, শুনিতে লাগয়ে ব্যথা,
গুণ গায় এ লোচনদাসে ॥ ৪০ ॥

*biṣṇupriẏā heṁṭamukhī, chala chala kare āṁkhi,*
*dekhi' prabhu sarasa sambhāṣe |*
*prabhu-ācaraṇa-kathā, śunite lāgaẏe byathā,*
*guṇa gāẏa e locanadāse || 40 ||*

*Word for word:* vishnupriya hentamukhi — Vishnupriya with lowered face; chhala chhala kare ankhi — her eyes brimming; dekhi prabhu sarasa sambhashe — seeing this, the Lord speaks tenderly; prabhu-acharana-katha — the account of the Lord's deeds; shunite lagaye vyatha — is painful to hear; guna gaya e lochanadase — this Lochana Dasa sings the qualities

**40.** Vishnupriya lowered her face, her eyes brimming with tears;
seeing this, the Lord speaks tender words to her.
It is painful to hear of the Lord's deeds —
this Lochana Dasa sings of [His] qualities.

*Raga varadi; disha: "My life, O moon of the twice-born! The sweetness of the form of Gora, who enchants Madana, ever wakes [in my heart] — I would take that form's misfortunes on myself and die"*

এইমনে অনুমানে দিন-রাত্রি যায় ।
আগুনি জ্বলিল যেন সভার হিয়ায় ॥ ৪১ ॥

*eimane anumāne dina-rātri yāẏa |*
*āguni jbalila yena sabhāra hiẏāẏa || 41 ||*

*Word for word:* eimane anumane — thus, in surmises; dina-ratri yaya — days and nights pass; aguni jvalila yena — as if fire flared up; sabhara hiyaya — in everyone's heart

**41.** Thus, in surmises, days and nights go by —
as if a fire had flared up in everyone's heart.

সকল ভকতগণ একত্র হইয়া ।
গোরা-গুণগাথা কহে মরমে কান্দিয়া ॥ ৪২ ॥

*sakala bhakatagaṇa ekatra haiẏā |*
*gorā-guṇagāthā kahe marame kāndiẏā || 42 ||*

*Word for word:* sakala bhakatagana — all the devotees; ekatra haiya — gathering together; gora-guna-gatha kahe — speak of Gora's qualities; marame kandiya — weeping in their souls

**42.** All the devotees, gathering together,
speak of Gora's qualities, weeping in the depths of their souls.

শচী, বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া দোঁহে কান্দে দিবানিশি ।
দশদিক্ অন্ধকার, শূন্য হেন বাসি ॥ ৪৩ ॥

*śacī, biṣṇupriẏā doṁhe kānde dibāniśi |*
*daśadik andhakāra, śūnya hena bāsi || 43 ||*
