*Word for word:* shachi, vishnupriya donhe — Shachi and Vishnupriya both; kande divanishi — weep day and night; dashadik andhakara — darkness in all directions; shunya hena basi — all seems empty

**43.** Shachi and Vishnupriya both weep day and night:
darkness on every side, all seems empty.

পুরজন পরিজন সোয়াথ না পায় ।
ছটফট করি' সব নগরে বেড়ায় ॥ ৪৪ ॥

*purajana parijana soẏātha nā pāẏa |*
*chaṭaphaṭa kari' saba nagare beṛāẏa || 44 ||*

*Word for word:* purajana parijana — townsfolk and household; soyatha na paya — find no peace; chhataphata kari — restlessly; saba nagare bedaya — all wander about the town

**44.** Townsfolk and household find no peace:
all wander restlessly about the town.

হেনই সময়ে শ্রীনিবাস দ্বিজরায় ।
কাতর-হৃদয়ে কিছু প্রভুরে শুধায় ॥ ৪৫ ॥

*henai samaẏe śrīnibāsa dbijarāẏa |*
*kātara-hṛdaẏe kichu prabhure śudhāẏa || 45 ||*

*Word for word:* henai samaye — at this time; srinivasa dvijaraya — Srinivasa, king of brahmanas; katara-hridaye — with an aching heart; kichhu prabhure shudhaya — asks the Lord

**45.** At this time Srinivasa, king of brahmanas,
with an aching heart asks the Lord:

এক নিবেদন আছে — কহিতে ডরাঙ ।
আজ্ঞা পাইলে প্রভু-সঙ্গে মুঞি চলি যাঙ ॥ ৪৬ ॥

*eka nibedana āche — kahite ḍarāṅa |*
*ājñā pāile prabhu-saṅge muñi cali yāṅa || 46 ||*

*Word for word:* eka nivedana achhe — I have one request; kahite daranga — I fear to say it; ajna paile — if I get leave; prabhu-sange munni chali yanga — I shall go with the Lord

**46.** "I have one request — I am afraid to say it:
if You permit, Lord, I shall go with You.

আর যে বা পারে সেহ সঙ্গে চলি যাউ ।
তোমা না দেখিলে কেহো না রাখিবে জীউ ॥ ৪৭ ॥

*āra ye bā pāre seha saṅge cali yāu |*
*tomā nā dekhile keho nā rākhibe jīu || 47 ||*

*Word for word:* ara ye va pare — and whoever else can; seha sange chali yau — let him go too; toma na dekhile — not seeing You; keho na rakhibe jiu — no one will keep alive

**47.** And whoever else can — let him go with You too:
not seeing You, no one will stay alive.

আগে ত মরিব আমি — শুন বিশ্বম্ভর ।
আপন-অন্তর-কথা কহিল গোচর ॥ ৪৮ ॥

*āge ta mariba āmi — śuna biśbambhara |*
*āpana-antara-kathā kahila gocara || 48 ||*

*Word for word:* age ta mariba ami — I shall die first; shuna vishvambhara — listen, Vishvambhara; apana-antara-katha — what was in his heart; kahila gochara — he laid open

**48.** I shall die first, listen, Vishvambhara" —
and he laid open to [the Lord] what was in his heart.

এ বোল শুনিঞা পহুঁ লহু লহু হাস ।
যে কিছু কহিয়ে তাহা শুন শ্রীনিবাস ॥ ৪৯ ॥

*e bola śuniñā pahuṁ lahu lahu hāsa |*
*ye kichu kahiẏe tāhā śuna śrīnibāsa || 49 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuniña — hearing this; pahun lahu lahu hasa — the Lord laughs softly; ye kichhu kahiye — whatever I say; taha shuna srinivasa — listen to it, Srinivasa

**49.** Hearing this, the Lord laughed softly:
"Listen, Srinivasa, to what I say.

আমার বিচ্ছেদ লাগি' না পাবে তরাস ।
কভু না ছাড়িব আমি তোমা-সভার পাশ ॥ ৫০ ॥

*āmāra biccheda lāgi' nā pābe tarāsa |*
*kabhu nā chāṛiba āmi tomā-sabhāra pāśa || 50 ||*

*Word for word:* amara vichchheda lagi — on account of separation from Me; na pabe tarasa — have no fear; kabhu na chhadiba ami — I shall never leave; toma-sabhara pasha — the company of you all

**50.** Do not fear separation from Me:
I shall never leave you all.

বিশেষে তোমার ঘরে কৃষ্ণের মন্দিরে ।
নিরন্তর আছি আমি — মন কর স্থিরে ॥ ৫১ ॥

*biśeṣe tomāra ghare kṛṣṇera mandire |*
*nirantara āchi āmi — mana kara sthire || 51 ||*

*Word for word:* visheshe — especially; tomara ghare — in your house; krishnera mandire — in Krishna's shrine; nirantara achhi ami — I abide always; mana kara sthire — set your mind at rest

**51.** And especially in your house, in Krishna's shrine,
I abide always: set your mind at rest."[^38-10]

প্রবোধ-বচন বলি' তুষিল তাহারে ।
মুরারিগুপ্তের ঘরে গেলা সন্ধ্যাকালে ॥ ৫২ ॥

*prabodha-bacana bali' tuṣila tāhāre |*
*murāriguptera ghare gelā sandhyākāle || 52 ||*

*Word for word:* prabodha-bachana bali — speaking words of comfort; tushila tahare — He cheered him; murari-guptera ghare — to Murari Gupta's house; gela sandhya-kale — He went in the evening

**52.** Having cheered him with words of comfort,
in the evening He went to the house of Murari Gupta.

হরিদাস সঙ্গে করি' মুরারি-মন্দিরে ।
নিভৃতে কহয়ে তারে দেবতার ঘরে ॥ ৫৩ ॥

*haridāsa saṅge kari' murāri-mandire |*
*nibhṛte kahaẏe tāre debatāra ghare || 53 ||*

*Word for word:* haridasa sange kari — taking Haridasa along; murari-mandire — in Murari's house; nibhrite kahaye tare — speaks to him in private; devatara ghare — in the Deity's room

**53.** Taking Haridasa with Him, [He came] to Murari's house
and speaks to him in private in the Deity's room:

শুনহ মুরারি তুমি আমার বচন ।
মোর প্রিয়-প্রাণ তুমি — কহি তে-কারণ ॥ ৫৪ ॥

*śunaha murāri tumi āmāra bacana |*
*mora priẏa-prāṇa tumi — kahi te-kāraṇa || 54 ||*

*Word for word:* shunaha murari — listen, Murari; tumi amara bachana — to My words; mora priya-prana tumi — you are dear to Me as life; kahi te-karana — therefore I speak

**54.** "Listen, Murari, to My words:
you are dear to Me as life — that is why I speak.

কহিব উত্তম কথা, শুন সাবধানে ।
উপদেশ কহি তোর হিতের কারণে ॥ ৫৫ ॥

*kahiba uttama kathā, śuna sābadhāne |*
*upadeśa kahi tora hitera kāraṇe || 55 ||*

*Word for word:* kahiba uttama katha — I shall say something excellent; shuna savadhane — listen attentively; upadesha kahi — I give instruction; tora hitera karane — for your good

**55.** I shall tell you something excellent — listen attentively:
I give you this instruction for your own good.

অদ্বৈত-আচার্য গোসাঞি ত্রিজগতে ধন্য ।
তাহা-অধিক বন্ধু মোর নাহি আর অন্য ॥ ৫৬ ॥

*adbaita-ācārya gosāñi trijagate dhanya |*
*tāhā-adhika bandhu mora nāhi āra anya || 56 ||*

*Word for word:* advaita-acharya gosani — Advaita Acharya Gosani; trijagate dhanya — is blessed in the three worlds; taha-adhika bandhu mora — a friend dearer than He; nahi ara anya — I have no other

**56.** Advaita Acharya Gosani is blessed in the three worlds;
I have no other friend closer than He.

আপনে ঈশ্বর-অংশ — অখিলের গুরু ।
যে চাহে আপনা হিত তাঁর সেবা করু ॥ ৫৭ ॥

*āpane īśbara-aṃśa — akhilera guru |*
*ye cāhe āpanā hita tāṁra sebā karu || 57 ||*

*Word for word:* apane ishvara-amsha — He Himself is a part of the Lord; akhilera guru — the guru of all; ye chahe apana hita — whoever wants his own good; tanra seva karu — let him serve Him

**57.** He Himself is a part of the Lord, the guru of all:[^38-11]
whoever wishes his own good, let him serve Him.

জগতের হিত সেই বৈষ্ণবের রাজা ।
পরম ভকতি করি' করহ তাঁর পূজা ॥ ৫৮ ॥

*jagatera hita sei baiṣṇabera rājā |*
*parama bhakati kari' karaha tāṁra pūjā || 58 ||*

*Word for word:* jagatera hita sei — He is the good of the world; vaishnavera raja — the king of Vaishnavas; parama bhakati kari — with highest devotion; karaha tanra puja — worship Him

**58.** He is the benefactor of the world, the king of Vaishnavas:
worship Him with the highest devotion.

তাঁর দেহে পূজা পাইলে কৃষ্ণ পূজা পায় ।
নিভৃতে কহিল তোরে — রাখিবে হিয়ায় ॥ ৫৯ ॥

*tāṁra dehe pūjā pāile kṛṣṇa pūjā pāẏa |*
*nibhṛte kahila tore — rākhibe hiẏāẏa || 59 ||*

*Word for word:* tanra dehe puja paile — when His body receives worship; krishna puja paya — Krishna receives worship; nibhrite kahila tore — I told you in private; rakhibe hiyaya — keep it in your heart

**59.** When He receives worship, Krishna receives it.
I have told you this in private — keep it in your heart.

আমি আর গদাধর-পণ্ডিত-গোসাঞি ।
নিত্যানন্দ, অদ্বৈত, শ্রীবাস, রামাই ॥ ৬০ ॥

*āmi āra gadādhara-paṇḍita-gosāñi |*
*nityānanda, adbaita, śrībāsa, rāmāi || 60 ||*

*Word for word:* ami ara gadadhara-pandita-gosani — I and Gadadhara Pandita Gosani; nityananda — Nityananda; advaita — Advaita; srivasa — Srivasa; ramai — Ramai

**60.** I and Gadadhara Pandita Gosani,
Nityananda, Advaita, Srivasa, Ramai —

জানিবে আমার দেহ এ সব সহিতে ।
অন্তর কহিল তোরে রাখিহ হিয়াতে ॥ ৬১ ॥

*jānibe āmāra deha e saba sahite |*
*antara kahila tore rākhiha hiẏāte || 61 ||*

*Word for word:* janibe amara deha — know that My body; e saba sahite — [is one] with all these; antara kahila tore — I have opened My heart to you; rakhiha hiyate — keep it in your heart

**61.** know that My body is one with all of them.[^38-12]
I have opened My heart to you — keep it in your heart."

এ বোল শুনিঞা সে মুরারি বৈদ্যরাজ ।
অন্তরে জানিল প্রভুর অন্তরের কাজ ॥ ৬২ ॥

*e bola śuniñā se murāri baidyarāja |*
*antare jānila prabhura antarera kāja || 62 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuniña — hearing this; se murari vaidyaraja — Murari, king of physicians; antare janila — understood in his heart; prabhura antarera kaja — the purpose in the Lord's heart

**62.** Hearing this, Murari, king of physicians,
understood in his heart what the Lord intended in His.

কান্দিতে কান্দিতে প্রভুর পড়িলা চরণে ।
নিশ্চয় জানিলা প্রভুর সন্ন্যাস-করণে ॥ ৬৩ ॥

*kāndite kāndite prabhura paṛilā caraṇe |*
*niścaẏa jānilā prabhura sannyāsa-karaṇe || 63 ||*

*Word for word:* kandite kandite — weeping and weeping; prabhura padila charane — he fell at the Lord's feet; nishchaya janila — he knew for certain; prabhura sannyasa-karane — of the Lord's taking sannyasa

**63.** Weeping, he fell at the Lord's feet:
he understood that the Lord would surely take sannyasa.

হরিদাস-চরণে করিয়া নমস্কার ।
আত্মসমর্পণ করে বিনয় অপার ॥ ৬৪ ॥

*haridāsa-caraṇe kariẏā namaskāra |*
*ātmasamarpaṇa kare binaẏa apāra || 64 ||*

*Word for word:* haridasa-charane — at Haridasa's feet; kariya namaskara — bowing; atma-samarpana kare — he surrenders himself; vinaya apara — with boundless humility

**64.** Bowing at Haridasa's feet,
he surrenders himself [to the Lord] with boundless humility.

মুরারি-কান্দনা প্রভু শুনিতে কাতর ।
আস্তে-ব্যস্তে উঠি' চলিলা নিজঘর ॥ ৬৫ ॥

*murāri-kāndanā prabhu śunite kātara |*
*āste-byaste uṭhi' calilā nijaghara || 65 ||*

*Word for word:* murari-kandana — Murari's weeping; prabhu shunite katara — the Lord is pained to hear; aste-vyaste uthi — rising hastily; chalila nijaghara — went home

**65.** The Lord cannot bear to hear Murari weep:
He hastily rose and went home.

মুরারিকে প্রবোধ করিলা এই বাণী ।
তোমার নিকটে নিরন্তর আছি আমি ॥ ৬৬ ॥

*murārike prabodha karilā ei bāṇī |*
*tomāra nikaṭe nirantara āchi āmi || 66 ||*

*Word for word:* murarike prabodha karila — He consoled Murari; ei vani — with these words; tomara nikate — near you; nirantara achhi ami — I always abide

**66.** He consoled Murari with these words:
"I am always near you.

সন্ন্যাস করিব — তার আছয়ে বিলম্ব ।
পরিণামে যে কহিল এই অবলম্ব ॥ ৬৭ ॥

*sannyāsa kariba — tāra āchaẏe bilamba |*
*pariṇāme ye kahila ei abalamba || 67 ||*

*Word for word:* sannyasa kariba — I shall take sannyasa; tara achhaye vilamba — that is still some time off; pariname — in the end; ye kahila ei avalamba — what I said is the support

**67.** My sannyasa is still some time off;
and what I have told you will be your support in the end."[^38-13]

এ বোল বলিয়া প্রভু নিজঘরে যায় ।
কাতর-অন্তরে কথা এ লোচন গায় ॥ ৬৮ ॥

*e bola baliẏā prabhu nijaghare yāẏa |*
*kātara-antare kathā e locana gāẏa || 68 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola baliya — saying this; prabhu nijaghare yaya — the Lord goes home; katara-antare — with an aching heart; katha e lochana gaya — this Lochana sings of it

**68.** Saying this, the Lord goes home;
with an aching heart Lochana sings of it.

## The Consolation of the Devotees

*Raga karunashri; disha: "Ah, alas, alas! The Lord at whose remembrance sorrow ends — ah, alas! If He goes, I shall die, O Gauranga; whose face shall I look upon then, O Gauranga?"*

রজনী বঞ্চয়ে প্রভু আনন্দ-হিয়ায় ।
আছিল অধিক করি' পিরীতি বাঢ়ায় ॥ ৬৮+১ ॥

*rajanī bañcaẏe prabhu ānanda-hiẏāẏa |*
*āchila adhika kari' pirīti bāṛhāẏa || 68+1 ||*

*Word for word:* rajani vanchaye prabhu — the Lord spends the night; ananda-hiyaya — with joy in His heart; achhila adhika kari — more than before; piriti badhaya — He increases love

**68+1.** The Lord spends the night with joy in His heart[^38-14]
and increases [His] love [for all] even more than before.

মায়েরে সন্তোষ করে হৃদয় জানিয়া ।
যে কথায় থাকয়ে অন্তর সুস্থ হৈয়া ॥ ৬৮+২ ॥

*māẏere santoṣa kare hṛdaẏa jāniẏā |*
*ye kathāẏa thākaẏe antara sustha haiẏā || 68+2 ||*

*Word for word:* mayere santosha kare — He gladdens His mother; hridaya janiya — knowing her heart; ye kathaya thakaye — with words by which remains; antara sustha haiya — the heart at ease

**68+2.** Knowing His mother's heart, He gladdens her
with such words as set her heart at ease.

পুরজনে পরিজনে যারে যে উচিত ।
এইমনে সভাকারে করয়ে পিরীত ॥ ৬৮+৩ ॥

*purajane parijane yāre ye ucita |*
*eimane sabhākāre karaẏe pirīta || 68+3 ||*

*Word for word:* purajane parijane — to townsfolk and household; yare ye uchita — to each as is fitting; eimane sabhakare — thus to all; karaye pirita — He shows love

**68+3.** With townsfolk and household — with each as is fitting —
thus He shows love to all.

বৈরাগ্য-আবেশ প্রভু পরিত্যাগ করি' ।
ঘরে ঘরে নিজ প্রেম পরকাশ করি ॥ ৬৮+৪ ॥

*bairāgya-ābeśa prabhu parityāga kari' |*
*ghare ghare nija prema parakāśa kari || 68+4 ||*

*Word for word:* vairagya-avesha — absorption in renunciation; prabhu parityaga kari — the Lord laying aside; ghare ghare — in every house; nija prema parakasha kari — reveals His love

**68+4.** Laying aside [His] absorption in renunciation,
the Lord reveals His love in every house.

কারু ঘরে হাস্য-পরিহাস-কথা কহে ।
যার যেন হিয়া তেনমতে সভে মোহে ॥ ৬৮+৫ ॥

*kāru ghare hāsya-parihāsa-kathā kahe |*
*yāra yena hiẏā tenamate sabhe mohe || 68+5 ||*

*Word for word:* karu ghare — in someone's house; hasya-parihasa-katha kahe — He jests and laughs; yara yena hiya — as each heart is; tenamate sabhe mohe — so He charms all

**68+5.** In one house He jests and laughs —
He finds the way to each heart and charms everyone.

আছিলা গুপত-বেশে যারা সঙ্গে যাইতে ।
মায়ার প্রভাবে তারা আইলা ঘরেতে ॥ ৬৮+৬ ॥

*āchilā gupata-beśe yārā saṅge yāite |*
*māẏāra prabhābe tārā āilā gharete || 68+6 ||*

*Word for word:* achhila gupata-beshe — had been in secret disguise; yara sange yaite — those [ready] to go with [Him]; mayara prabhave — by the power of maya; tara aila gharete — they came home

**68+6.** Those who had been [ready] in secret, in disguise, to go with Him —
by the power of [His] maya returned home.[^38-15]

নানা আভরণ পরে, শ্রীঅঙ্গে চন্দন ।
হাস-বিলাস-রসময় অনুক্ষণ ॥ ৬৮+৭ ॥

*nānā ābharaṇa pare, śrīaṅge candana |*
*hāsa-bilāsa-rasamaẏa anukṣaṇa || 68+7 ||*

*Word for word:* nana abharana pare — He wears various ornaments; sri-ange chandana — sandal on His holy body; hasa-vilasa-rasamaya — full of laughter, play and rasa; anukshana — every moment

**68+7.** He wears various ornaments, sandal paste on His holy body,
and every moment He is full of laughter, play and rasa.

সব লোকে জানিলেক — না হবে সন্ন্যাস ।
স্বচ্ছন্দ হইল সব লোক নিজ-বাস ॥ ৬৮+৮ ॥

*saba loke jānileka — nā habe sannyāsa |*
*sbacchanda haila saba loka nija-bāsa || 68+8 ||*

*Word for word:* saba loke janileka — everyone concluded; na habe sannyasa — there will be no sannyasa; svachchhanda haila — were at ease; saba loka nija-vasa — all the people [went] home

**68+8.** Everyone concluded there would be no sannyasa,
and all the people [went] home at ease.[^38-16]

শয়ন-মন্দিরে প্রভু শয়ন করিলা ।
তাম্বূল-স্তবক-করে বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া আইলা ॥ ৬৮+৯ ॥

*śaẏana-mandire prabhu śaẏana karilā |*
*tāmbūla-stabaka-kare biṣṇupriẏā āilā || 68+9 ||*

*Word for word:* shayana-mandire — in the bedchamber; prabhu shayana karila — the Lord lay down; tambula-stavaka-kare — with betel in hand; vishnupriya aila — Vishnupriya came

**68+9.** The Lord lay down in His chamber,
and Vishnupriya came with a bunch of betel in her hand.

হাসিয়া সন্তোষে প্রভু আইস আইস বোলে ।
পরম পিরীতি করি' বসাইল কোলে ॥ ৬৮+১০ ॥

*hāsiẏā santoṣe prabhu āisa āisa bole |*
*parama pirīti kari' basāila kole || 68+10 ||*

*Word for word:* hasiya santoshe — smiling with delight; prabhu aisa aisa bole — the Lord says, come, come; parama piriti kari — with great tenderness; vasaila kole — seated her on His lap

**68+10.** Smiling with delight, the Lord says, "Come, come!" —
and with great tenderness seated her on His lap.

বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া প্রভু-অঙ্গে চন্দন লেপিল ।
অগুরু কস্তূরী গন্ধে তিলক রচিল ॥ ৬৮+১১ ॥

*biṣṇupriẏā prabhu-aṅge candana lepila |*
*aguru kastūrī gandhe tilaka racila || 68+11 ||*

*Word for word:* vishnupriya prabhu-ange — Vishnupriya on the Lord's body; chandana lepila — smeared sandal; aguru kasturi gandhe — with fragrant aguru and musk; tilaka rachila — drew a tilaka

**68+11.** Vishnupriya anointed the Lord's body with sandal
and drew a tilaka with fragrant aguru and musk,

দিব্য মালতীর মালা দিল গোরা-অঙ্গে ।
শ্রীমুখে তাম্বূল তুলি' দিল নানা রঙ্গে ॥ ৬৮+১২ ॥

*dibya mālatīra mālā dila gorā-aṅge |*
*śrīmukhe tāmbūla tuli' dila nānā raṅge || 68+12 ||*

*Word for word:* divya malatira mala — a divine malati garland; dila gora-ange — put on Gora's body; sri-mukhe tambula tuli dila — placed betel in His holy mouth; nana range — playfully

**68+12.** put a divine garland of malati on Gora's body
and with tender jests placed betel in His holy mouth.

তবে মহাপ্রভু সে রসিক-শিরোমণি ।
বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া-অঙ্গে বেশ করেন আপনি ॥ ৬৮+১৩ ॥

*tabe mahāprabhu se rasika-śiromaṇi |*
*biṣṇupriẏā-aṅge beśa karena āpani || 68+13 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe mahaprabhu — then Mahaprabhu; se rasika-shiromani — the crown of rasikas; vishnupriya-ange besha — Vishnupriya's adornment; karena apani — does Himself

**68+13.** Then Mahaprabhu, the crown of connoisseurs of rasa,
Himself began to adorn Vishnupriya.

দীর্ঘ কেশ কামের চামর জিনি' আভা ।
কবরী বান্ধিয়া দিল মালতীর আভা ॥ ৬৮+১৪ ॥

*dīrgha keśa kāmera cāmara jini' ābhā |*
*kabarī bāndhiẏā dila mālatīra ābhā || 68+14 ||*

*Word for word:* dirgha kesha — the long hair; kamera chamara jini abha — outshining Kama's whisk; kabari bandhiya dila — He braided it; malatira abha — with the gleam of malati

**68+14.** Her long hair, whose lustre surpasses Kama's whisk,
He braided and decked with malati flowers —

মেঘ বন্দী হৈল যেন চাঁদের কলাতে ।
কিবা উগারিয়া গিলে না পারি বুঝিতে ॥ ৬৮+১৫ ॥

*megha bandī haila yena cāṁdera kalāte |*
*kibā ugāriẏā gile nā pāri bujhite || 68+15 ||*

*Word for word:* megha bandi haila — a cloud was captured; yena chandera kalate — as if by the crescent moon; kiba ugariya gile — or does it swallow and return it; na pari bujhite — one cannot tell

**68+15.** as if the crescent moon had captured a cloud —
or is [the moon] swallowing it and giving it back? — one cannot tell.

সুন্দর ললাটে দিল সিন্দূরের বিন্দু ।
দিবাকর কোলে যেন রহিয়াছে ইন্দু ॥ ৬৮+১৬ ॥

*sundara lalāṭe dila sindūrera bindu |*
*dibākara kole yena rahiẏāche indu || 68+16 ||*

*Word for word:* sundara lalate — on the lovely forehead; dila sindurera bindu — He placed a dot of sindura; divakara kole — the sun on the lap; yena rahiyachhe indu — as if of the moon

**68+16.** On her lovely forehead He placed a dot of sindura —
as if the moon had taken the sun onto its lap.

সিন্দূরের চৌদিকে চন্দন-বিন্দু আর ।
রাশি কোলে সূর্য যেন ধায় দেখিবার ॥ ৬৮+১৭ ॥

*sindūrera caudike candana-bindu āra |*
*rāśi kole sūrya yena dhāẏa dekhibāra || 68+17 ||*

*Word for word:* sindurera chaudike — around the sindura; chandana-bindu ara — and dots of sandal; rashi kole surya — a host, the sun in the lap; yena dhaya dekhibara — as if running to see

**68+17.** And around the sindura, dots of sandal,
as if a host [of stars] had rushed to see the sun in the moon's lap.[^38-17]

খঞ্জন-নয়ানে দিল অঞ্জনের রেখ ।
ভুরু কাম-কামানের গুণ করিলেক ॥ ৬৮+১৮ ॥

*khañjana-naẏāne dila añjanera rekha |*
*bhuru kāma-kāmānera guṇa karileka || 68+18 ||*

*Word for word:* khanjana-nayane — on the wagtail eyes; dila anjanera rekha — drew a line of collyrium; bhuru kama-kamanera guna — the brows the string of Kama's bow; karileka — He made

**68+18.** On her eyes, restless as wagtails, He drew lines of collyrium
and made her brows the string of Kama's bow.

অগুরু কস্তূরী গন্ধ কুচোপরি লেপে ।
দিব্য বস্ত্রে রচিল কাঁচলি পরতেকে ॥ ৬৮+১৯ ॥

*aguru kastūrī gandha kucopari lepe |*
*dibya bastre racila kāṁcali parateke || 68+19 ||*

*Word for word:* aguru kasturi gandha — fragrant aguru and musk; kuchopari lepe — He smears on her bosom; divya vastre — of divine cloth; rachila kanchali parateke — fashioned a bodice

**68+19.** He anointed her bosom with fragrant aguru and musk
and fitted her a bodice of divine cloth.

নানা অলঙ্কারে অঙ্গ ভূষিল তাহার ।
তাম্বূল হাসির সঙ্গে বিহরে অপার ॥ ৬৮+২০ ॥

*nānā alaṅkāre aṅga bhūṣila tāhāra |*
*tāmbūla hāsira saṅge bihare apāra || 68+20 ||*

*Word for word:* nana alankare — with various ornaments; anga bhushila tahara — adorned her body; tambula hasira sange — with betel and laughter; vihare apara — plays without end

**68+20.** He adorned her with various ornaments —
and plays [with her] endlessly, laughing and offering betel.

ত্রৈলোক্য-অদ্ভুত রূপ নিরখে বদন ।
অধর বান্ধুলী সাধে করয়ে চুম্বন ॥ ৬৮+২১ ॥

*trailokya-adbhuta rūpa nirakhe badana |*
*adhara bāndhulī sādhe karaẏe cumbana || 68+21 ||*

*Word for word:* trailokya-adbhuta rupa — beauty wondrous in the three worlds; nirakhe vadana — He gazes at her face; adhara bandhuli — lips [red as] bandhuli; sadhe karaye chumbana — lovingly kisses

**68+21.** He gazes at her face, whose beauty is a wonder of the three worlds,
and lovingly kisses her lips, red as the bandhuli flower.

ক্ষণে ভুজলতা বেড়ি' আলিঙ্গন করে ।
নব কমলিনী যেন করিবর-কোরে ॥ ৬৮+২২ ॥

*kṣaṇe bhujalatā beṛi' āliṅgana kare |*
*naba kamalinī yena karibara-kore || 68+22 ||*

*Word for word:* kshane bhujalata bedi — now enfolding with creeper-arms; alingana kare — embraces; nava kamalini yena — like a young lotus; karivara-kore — in a lordly elephant's grasp

**68+22.** Now He enfolds her in His creeper-arms and embraces her —
like a young lotus in the trunk of a lordly elephant.

নানা রস বিথারয়ে বিনোদ-নাগর ।
আনের কি কাজ — কাম-অগোচর ॥ ৬৮+২৩ ॥

*nānā rasa bithāraẏe binoda-nāgara |*
*ānera ki kāja — kāma-agocara || 68+23 ||*

*Word for word:* nana rasa vitharaye — unfolds many rasas; vinoda-nagara — the playful Nagara; anera ki kaja — what of others; kama-agochara — beyond the reach of Kama

**68+23.** Many rasas the playful Nagara unfolds —
what of others: this is beyond the reach of Kama.[^38-18]

সুমেরুর কোলে যেন বিজুরী প্রকাশ ।
মদন মুগধে দেখি' রতির বিলাস ॥ ৬৮+২৪ ॥

*sumerura kole yena bijurī prakāśa |*
*madana mugadhe dekhi' ratira bilāsa || 68+24 ||*

*Word for word:* sumerura kole — in the lap of Sumeru; yena bijuri prakasha — as if lightning flashed; madana mugadhe — Madana is bewildered; dekhi ratira vilasa — seeing the play of love

**68+24.** Like lightning flashing in the lap of Sumeru:
Madana himself is bewildered seeing this play of love.

হৃদয়-উপরে থোয় — না শোয়ায় শয্যায় ।
পাশ পালটিতে নারে — দোঁহে এক মজ্জা ॥ ৬৮+২৫ ॥

*hṛdaẏa-upare thoẏa — nā śoẏāẏa śayyāẏa |*
*pāśa pālaṭite nāre — doṁhe eka majjā || 68+25 ||*

*Word for word:* hridaya-upare thoya — He keeps her on His breast; na shoyaya shayyaya — does not lay her on the bed; pasha palatite nare — they cannot turn aside; donhe eka majja — the two are one being

**68+25.** He holds her on His breast and does not lay her on the bed;
they cannot turn from each other — the two are as one being.

বুকে বুকে মুখে মুখে রজনী গোঙায় ।
রস-অবসাদে দোঁহে সুখে নিদ্রা যায় ॥ ৬৮+২৬ ॥

*buke buke mukhe mukhe rajanī goṅāẏa |*
*rasa-abasāde doṁhe sukhe nidrā yāẏa || 68+26 ||*

*Word for word:* buke buke mukhe mukhe — breast to breast, face to face; rajani gongaya — they pass the night; rasa-avasade — in the languor of rasa; donhe sukhe nidra yaya — both fall blissfully asleep

**68+26.** Breast to breast, face to face they pass the night;
in the languor of rasa both fall blissfully asleep.

রজনীর শেষে প্রভু উঠিলা সত্বর ।
বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া নিদ্রা যায় অতি ঘোরতর ॥ ৬৮+২৭ ॥

*rajanīra śeṣe prabhu uṭhilā satbara |*
*biṣṇupriẏā nidrā yāẏa ati ghoratara || 68+27 ||*

*Word for word:* rajanira sheshe — at the end of the night; prabhu uthila satvara — the Lord rose quickly; vishnupriya nidra yaya — Vishnupriya sleeps; ati ghoratara — very deeply

**68+27.** At the end of the night the Lord rose quickly;
Vishnupriya sleeps a deep sleep.

বৈরাগ্য-সময়ে প্রেমা উথারে অধিক ।
সন্ন্যাস করিব বলি' উনমত চিত ॥ ৬৮+২৮ ॥

*bairāgya-samaẏe premā uthāre adhika |*
*sannyāsa kariba bali' unamata cita || 68+28 ||*

*Word for word:* vairagya-samaye — at the time of renunciation; prema uthare adhika — prema surges higher; sannyasa kariba bali — thinking, "I shall take sannyasa"; unamata chita — His heart is as if maddened

**68+28.** At the time of renunciation His prema surges higher still;
with the thought "I shall take sannyasa" His heart is as if maddened.

এ সময়ে বিথারয়ে রঙ্গ-রস-ভাব ।
ইহার কারণ কিছু শুন লাভালাভ ॥ ৬৮+২৯ ॥

*e samaẏe bithāraẏe raṅga-rasa-bhāba |*
*ihāra kāraṇa kichu śuna lābhālābha || 68+29 ||*

*Word for word:* e samaye — at such a time; vitharaye ranga-rasa-bhava — He unfolds play, rasa and bhava; ihara karana kichhu — the reason for this; shuna labhalabha — hear what is gained

**68+29.** Why at such a time He unfolds play, rasa and bhava —
hear the reason, and what is gained by it.

যে জন যেমনে ভজে তারে তেন প্রভু ।
ভজন অধিক ন্যূন না করয়ে কভু ॥ ৬৮+৩০ ॥

*ye jana yemane bhaje tāre tena prabhu |*
*bhajana adhika nyūna nā karaẏe kabhu || 68+30 ||*

*Word for word:* ye jana yemane bhaje — as a person serves; tare tena prabhu — so the Lord [responds] to him; bhajana adhika nyuna — more or less than the service; na karaye kabhu — He never gives

**68+30.** As one serves, so the Lord responds to him:
He never repays service with more or with less.[^38-19]

তাহাতে বিশেষ আছে অধিকারী-ভেদ ।
অমায়া সমায়া ভক্তি সবেদ নির্বেদ ॥ ৬৮+৩১ ॥

*tāhāte biśeṣa āche adhikārī-bheda |*
*amāẏā samāẏā bhakti sabeda nirbeda || 68+31 ||*

*Word for word:* tahate vishesha achhe — in this there is a special; adhikari-bheda — distinction of qualification; amaya samaya bhakti — devotion without and with guile; saveda nirveda — with knowledge and with detachment (?)

**68+31.** But here there is a special distinction according to [the devotees'] qualification:
devotion is without guile and with guile, with knowledge and with detachment.[^38-20]

ভক্তি বিনু কৃষ্ণ ভজিবারে নারে কেহো ।
অমায়া নিশ্চলা ভক্তি হয় সেহো ॥ ৬৮+৩২ ॥

*bhakti binu kṛṣṇa bhajibāre nāre keho |*
*amāẏā niścalā bhakti haẏa seho || 68+32 ||*

*Word for word:* bhakti vinu — without bhakti; krishna bhajibare nare keho — no one can serve Krishna; amaya nishchala bhakti — bhakti without guile and unwavering; haya seho — that is it

**68+32.** Without bhakti no one can serve Krishna;
[the highest] bhakti is that which is without guile and unwavering.

বিনি অনুরাগে প্রেমভক্তি হয় যবে ।
কৃষ্ণে বন্দী করিবারে নারে কেহো তবে ॥ ৬৮+৩৩ ॥

*bini anurāge premabhakti haẏa yabe |*
*kṛṣṇe bandī karibāre nāre keho tabe || 68+33 ||*

*Word for word:* vini anurage — without anuraga; prema-bhakti haya yabe — when there is prema-bhakti; krishne bandi karibare — to capture Krishna; nare keho tabe — then no one can

**68+33.** And when prema-bhakti is without anuraga,
no one can capture Krishna.

ঐছন ঠাকুর গৌর করুণার সিন্ধু ।
অনুরাগে প্রেমার ভিখারী দীনবন্ধু ॥ ৬৮+৩৪ ॥

*aichana ṭhākura gaura karuṇāra sindhu |*
*anurāge premāra bhikhārī dīnabandhu || 68+34 ||*

*Word for word:* aichhana thakura gaura — such is Thakura Gaura; karunara sindhu — the ocean of mercy; anurage premara bhikhari — a beggar for prema with anuraga; dinabandhu — the friend of the lowly

**68+34.** Such is Thakura Gaura, the ocean of mercy:
the friend of the lowly, He Himself begs for prema with anuraga.

করুণায় প্রকাশয়ে নিজ অনুরাগ ।
বিচ্ছেদে হৃদয়ে যেন বাড়ে তার ভাব ॥ ৬৮+৩৫ ॥

*karuṇāẏa prakāśaẏe nija anurāga |*
*bicchede hṛdaẏe yena bāṛe tāra bhāba || 68+35 ||*

*Word for word:* karunaya prakashaye — in mercy He reveals; nija anuraga — His own anuraga; vichchhede hridaye — in separation, in the heart; yena badhe tara bhava — so that her bhava may grow

**68+35.** In mercy He reveals His own anuraga,
so that in separation her bhava may grow in her heart.

ভাবসঙ্গে যে জন দেখয়ে মোর অঙ্গ ।
তার সহ মোর ভাব কভু নহে ভঙ্গ ॥ ৬৮+৩৬ ॥

*bhābasaṅge ye jana dekhaẏe mora aṅga |*
*tāra saha mora bhāba kabhu nahe bhaṅga || 68+36 ||*

*Word for word:* bhava-sange — with bhava; ye jana dekhaye mora anga — whoever sees My body; tara saha mora bhava — My bhava with him; kabhu nahe bhanga — is never broken

**68+36.** "Whoever sees My body with bhava —
with him My bhava is never broken."

এহেন করুণানিধি আছে আর কে ।
আপনা বান্ধিতে প্রেম-অনুরাগ দে ॥ ৬৮+৩৭ ॥

*ehena karuṇānidhi āche āra ke |*
*āpanā bāndhite prema-anurāga de || 68+37 ||*

*Word for word:* ehena karuna-nidhi — such a treasury of mercy; achhe ara ke — who else is there; apana bandhite — to bind Himself; prema-anuraga de — gives prema and anuraga

**68+37.** Who else is such a treasury of mercy,
who gives prema and anuraga so as to bind His very Self?

এই সে কারণে বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়াকে প্রসাদ ।
ইহা জানি' মনে কেহো না কর প্রমাদ ॥ ৬৮+৩৮ ॥

*ei se kāraṇe biṣṇupriẏāke prasāda |*
*ihā jāni' mane keho nā kara pramāda || 68+38 ||*

*Word for word:* ei se karane — this is why; vishnupriyake prasada — grace to Vishnupriya; iha jani — knowing this; mane keho na kara pramada — let no one err in mind

**68+38.** This is why [He showed] grace to Vishnupriya —
knowing this, let no one go astray in mind.[^38-21]

এ প্রেমভক্তি প্রভু করিব প্রকাশ ।
আনন্দ-হৃদয়ে কহে এ লোচন দাস ॥ ৬৮+৩৯ ॥

*e premabhakti prabhu kariba prakāśa |*
*ānanda-hṛdaẏe kahe e locana dāsa || 68+39 ||*

*Word for word:* e prema-bhakti — this prema-bhakti; prabhu kariba prakasha — the Lord will reveal; ananda-hridaye — with joy in his heart; kahe e lochana dasa — says this Lochana Dasa

**68+39.** This prema-bhakti the Lord will reveal —
with joy in his heart says this Lochana Dasa.

[^38-1]: The OCR of the summary is badly garbled; gaps are filled by sense and from the table of contents in the edition's preface ("Vishnupriya-devi's grief; the Lord consoles her with many sweet words and, after instructing her in the truth, shows the four-armed form of Narayana; the coming of Srinivasa, Murari and other devotees; the Lord consoles them"). Before v. 1 B (the 1983 edition) has the disha "Gauranga, oh, why did You come to Nadia? O Gauranga, Gauranga!"; A lacks it.
[^38-2]: The end of the line is unclear (A and B: "অভিপারা"); translated by sense.
[^38-3]: Stanza 11+1 is found only in the 1983 edition (not in Bhaktisiddhanta's edition or the 1903 edition). From here B's numbering is one higher than A's.
[^38-4]: Lit. "taking Your nichhani" — the rite in which a lover takes the beloved's misfortunes upon herself. The beginning of the stanza is corrupt in A and B; restored by sense.
[^38-5]: Vishnupriya is the Lord's eternal consort, His Bhu-shakti (en/21, note 9); her pastimes with the Lord are not mundane (en/35, note 8).
[^38-6]: "Empty" (মিছা, "false") in the sense of vain, transient; not the mayavada doctrine of the world's unreality (cf. en/37, note 14).
[^38-7]: Not monism: souls are one in nature (all are the Lord's energy, His prakriti) and in themselves neither male nor female; the imagined "two" is identification with the body. The one Purusha, the enjoyer, is Krishna.
[^38-8]: That is, the yogamaya that hid His divinity from Vishnupriya (cf. en/37, note 16).
[^38-9]: Cf. the promise to Shachi (en/37, v. 220).
[^38-10]: Cf. en/36, v. 155; Murari 2.18.19–23.
[^38-11]: Advaita is Maha-Vishnu (en/27, note 8); cf. Murari 2.18.29: "a part of the Lord". Vv. 52–61 — cf. Murari 2.18.25–30.
[^38-12]: Ramai is Sri Rama Pandita, Srivasa's brother. In the 1903 edition vv. 60–61 are bracketed as the reading of some manuscripts.
[^38-13]: In A v. 63 is misprinted "৬২", and the numbers of vv. 47 and 50 are not printed; restored from the neighbours. V. 66 is corrupt in A and restored from B and C.
[^38-14]: This section is not in Bhaktisiddhanta's edition (1922); it is translated from Haridasa Shastri's edition (1983), where it comes under the heading "The Consolation of the Devotees" (भक्तगणे प्रबोध) right after v. 68. The 1903 edition has it in the main text (some couplets bracketed as readings of some manuscripts). Bhaktisiddhanta apparently deliberately left out this description of the Lord's night with Vishnupriya, written in the spirit of nagari-bhava (cf. en/09, note 9): Gaudiya Vaishnavas, following Vrindavana Dasa, see in the Gaura of Navadvipa a model of the strict propriety of a brahmana householder. We translate it under the rule on the additions of the 1983 edition; Lochana Dasa himself explains the meaning of this pastime in vv. 68+29–68+38.
[^38-15]: Maya here is the Lord's lila-shakti (yogamaya), which conceals His intention for the sake of the lila.
[^38-16]: So in C ("না হবে সন্ন্যাস"); B has "লহিব সন্ন্যাস" ("will take sannyasa"), which contradicts the sense.
[^38-17]: The forehead is the moon, the dot of sindura the sun, the dots of sandal the stars. The end of the line is corrupt in B ("রাশি কোলে"); one manuscript of the 1903 edition has "like stars in the lap of the sun".
[^38-18]: The reading is unclear (B: "আহক অনের কাজ", C: "অস্ুক আনের কাখ"); the sense is that what in others would be a matter of lust is here "beyond the reach of Kama": the love of the Lord and His shakti transcends mundane desire (cf. v. 68+38).
[^38-19]: Cf. Bhagavad-gita 4.11.
[^38-20]: The couplet is obscure ("অমায়া সমায়া ভক্তি সবেদ নির্বেদ"; C: "এ বেদ নির্বেদ"); translated by the probable sense.
[^38-21]: That is, let no one think that the Lord's night with Vishnupriya before sannyasa is mundane love: it is a grace by which the Lord deepens her prema in separation (v. 68+35).

---

# Madhya-khanda, part 16 (portion 39)

*The section "The Lord's Sannyasa" (beginning): at dawn the Lord leaves Navadvipa and swims across the Ganga; the lament of Shachi, Vishnupriya and the devotees; Nityananda with Chandrashekhara and others follows the Lord; the Lord in Kantakanagara with Keshava Bharati; Bharati hesitates to give Him sannyasa, and the Lord whispers the sannyasa mantra into his ear; the grief of the people of Kantakanagara; the Lord asks for their blessing*

## The Lord's Sannyasa

> *Summary by Srila Bhaktisiddhanta Sarasvati.* [Sri Gaurasundara, having consoled the devotees] with instruction in the truth, [left home] and, in order to take sannyasa, crossed the Ganga and came to Katwa, to Keshava Bharati. [Mother Shachi and] Vishnupriya [were overwhelmed] in separation from the Lord; Nityananda Prabhu, consoling them, came with Chandrashekhara Acharya, Damodara Pandita and other devotees to the Lord in Kantakanagara. The Lord asked Keshava Bharati for sannyasa, but he would not agree to give Him sannyasa. Then Bhagavan Himself, [wishing to receive] the sannyasa mantra and knowing what was in Bharati's heart, on some pretext first spoke the sannyasa mantra into Keshava Bharati's ear, and then Bharati agreed to give Him sannyasa. All the inhabitants of Kantakanagara — children, old people, youths, women and men — lamented bitterly on seeing the Lord's sannyasa; Sri Gaurachandra consoled them and, [bearing Himself] as a devotee, asked them for [the blessing of] devotion to Krishna. [A voice from the sky proclaimed the name "Sri Krishna Chaitanya": the Lord] awakened [all to Krishna] — therefore His name in sannyasa became "Sri Krishna Chaitanya". Then, having taken sannyasa, Sriman Mahaprabhu, absorbed in prema, wandered for three days in Radha-desha.[^39-1]

*Raga karunashri; disha: "O Lord, O Gora, alas! O Gorachand, alas!"*

প্রাতঃকালে উঠি' প্রভু প্রাতঃক্রিয়া করি' ।
'সন্ন্যাস করিব' দঢ়াইল গৌরহরি ॥ ১ ॥

*prātaḥkāle uṭhi' prabhu prātaḥkriẏā kari' |*
*'sannyāsa kariba' daṛhāila gaurahari || 1 ||*

*Word for word:* pratahkale uthi — rising at dawn; prabhu pratah-kriya kari — the Lord, doing the morning duties; sannyasa kariba — "I shall take sannyasa"; dadhaila gaurahari — Gaurahari resolved

**1.** Rising at dawn and performing His morning duties,
Gaurahari settled His resolve: "I shall take sannyasa."

কণ্টকনগরে আছে ভারতী গোসাঞি ।
সন্ন্যাস করিব তথা পণ্ডিত নিমাই ॥ ২ ॥

*kaṇṭakanagare āche bhāratī gosāñi |*
*sannyāsa kariba tathā paṇḍita nimāi || 2 ||*

*Word for word:* kantaka-nagare achhe — in Kantakanagara lives; bharati gosani — Bharati Gosani; sannyasa kariba tatha — there will take sannyasa; pandita nimai — Pandita Nimai

**2.** "In Kantakanagara lives Bharati Gosani —
there Pandita Nimai will take sannyasa."[^39-2]

একান্ত করিয়া মনে কৈল বিশ্বম্ভর ।
যাত্রাকালে লইল দক্ষিণ নাসার স্বর ॥ ৩ ॥

*ekānta kariẏā mane kaila biśbambhara |*
*yātrākāle laila dakṣiṇa nāsāra sbara || 3 ||*

*Word for word:* ekanta kariya mane — fixing it wholly in His mind; kaila vishvambhara — Vishvambhara resolved; yatra-kale — at setting out; laila dakshina nasara svara — took [as omen] the breath of the right nostril

**3.** Vishvambhara fixed this with all His heart
and, setting out, noted that His breath was flowing through the right nostril.[^39-3]

চলিলা ত মহাপ্রভু গঙ্গার সমীপে ।
গঙ্গা সাঁতারিয়া গেলা ছাড়ি' নবদ্বীপে ॥ ৪ ॥

*calilā ta mahāprabhu gaṅgāra samīpe |*
*gaṅgā sāṁtāriẏā gelā chāṛi' nabadbīpe || 4 ||*

*Word for word:* chalila ta mahaprabhu — Mahaprabhu went; gangara samipe — to the Ganga; ganga santariya — swimming across the Ganga; gela chhadi navadvipe — went away leaving Navadvipa

**4.** Mahaprabhu went to the Ganga;
swimming across the Ganga, He went away, leaving Navadvipa.[^39-4]

গঙ্গা নমস্করি' নবদ্বীপ ছাড়ি' যায় ।
বজর পড়িল যেন সভার মাথায় ॥ ৫ ॥

*gaṅgā namaskari' nabadbīpa chāṛi' yāẏa |*
*bajara paṛila yena sabhāra māthāẏa || 5 ||*

*Word for word:* ganga namaskari — bowing to the Ganga; navadvipa chhadi yaya — He leaves Navadvipa; bajara padila yena — as if a thunderbolt fell; sabhara mathaya — on everyone's head

**5.** Bowing to the Ganga, He leaves Navadvipa —
as if a thunderbolt struck everyone on the head.

কিবা দিন-মাঝে রবি যেন লুকাইল ।
সরোবর ছাড়ি' হংসগণ কোথা গেল ॥ ৬ ॥

*kibā dina-mājhe rabi yena lukāila |*
*sarobara chāṛi' haṃsagaṇa kothā gela || 6 ||*

*Word for word:* kiba dina-majhe — as if in midday; ravi yena lukaila — the sun hid; sarovara chhadi — leaving the lake; hamsagana kotha gela — where did the swans go

**6.** As if the sun had hidden in the middle of the day,
as if the swans had left the lake — where have they gone?

কিবা দেহ ছাড়ি' প্রাণ গেল আচম্বিতে ।
ভ্রমরা ছাড়িল যেন পদ্মের পিরীতে ॥ ৭ ॥

*kibā deha chāṛi' prāṇa gela ācambite |*
*bhramarā chāṛila yena padmera pirīte || 7 ||*

*Word for word:* kiba deha chhadi — as if leaving the body; prana gela achambite — life suddenly departed; bhramara chhadila yena — as if the bee forsook; padmera pirite — its love for the lotus

**7.** As if life had suddenly left the body,
as if the bee had forsaken its love for the lotus.

বিচ্ছেদ-বিয়োগময় হৈল নবদ্বীপে ।
শোকের পর্বত যেন সভাকারে চাপে ॥ ৮ ॥

*biccheda-biẏogamaẏa haila nabadbīpe |*
*śokera parbata yena sabhākāre cāpe || 8 ||*

*Word for word:* vichchheda-viyogamaya — full of the grief of separation; haila navadvipe — Navadvipa became; shokera parvata yena — as if a mountain of sorrow; sabhakare chape — crushes everyone

**8.** Navadvipa was filled with the grief of separation:
a mountain of sorrow seemed to crush everyone.

পরিজন পুরজন শচী বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া ।
মূর্ছিত হইয়া পড়ে অঙ্গ আছাড়িয়া ॥ ৯ ॥

*parijana purajana śacī biṣṇupriẏā |*
*mūrchita haiẏā paṛe aṅga āchāṛiẏā || 9 ||*

*Word for word:* parijana purajana — household, townsfolk; shachi vishnupriya — Shachi, Vishnupriya; murchhita haiya pade — fall senseless; anga achhadiya — throwing themselves down

**9.** Household and townsfolk, Shachi and Vishnupriya
fall senseless, throwing themselves on the ground.

শচীদেবী কান্দে কোলে করি' বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া ।
বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া মরা যেন রহিল পড়িয়া ॥ ১০ ॥

*śacīdebī kānde kole kari' biṣṇupriẏā |*
*biṣṇupriẏā marā yena rahila paṛiẏā || 10 ||*

*Word for word:* shachi-devi kande — Shachi-devi weeps; kole kari vishnupriya — holding Vishnupriya on her lap; vishnupriya mara yena — Vishnupriya as if dead; rahila padiya — lies

**10.** Shachi-devi weeps, holding Vishnupriya on her lap —
and Vishnupriya lies as if dead:

অবয়ব আছে — প্রাণ গেল ত ছাড়িয়া ।
শচী-বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া কান্দে ভূমি লোটাইয়া ॥ ১১ ॥

*abaẏaba āche — prāṇa gela ta chāṛiẏā |*
*śacī-biṣṇupriẏā kānde bhūmi loṭāiẏā || 11 ||*

*Word for word:* avayava achhe — the body is there; prana gela ta chhadiya — life has left it; shachi-vishnupriya kande — Shachi and Vishnupriya weep; bhumi lotaiya — rolling on the ground

**11.** the body is there, but life has left it.
Shachi and Vishnupriya weep, rolling on the ground.

শচীদেবী কান্দে, ডাকে নিমাই বলিয়া ।
আগুনে পুড়িল যেন ধক্ধক্ হিয়া ॥ ১২ ॥

*śacīdebī kānde, ḍāke nimāi baliẏā |*
*āgune puṛila yena dhakdhak hiẏā || 12 ||*

*Word for word:* shachi-devi kande — Shachi-devi weeps; dake nimai baliya — calls "Nimai!"; agune pudila yena — as if burning in fire; dhakdhak hiya — her blazing heart

**12.** Shachi-devi weeps and calls: "Nimai!" —
her heart blazes as if on fire:

দশদিক্ শূন্য হৈল অন্ধকারময় ।
কেমনে বঞ্চিব মুঞি ঘর ঘোরময় ॥ ১৩ ॥

*daśadik śūnya haila andhakāramaẏa |*
*kemane bañciba muñi ghara ghoramaẏa || 13 ||*

*Word for word:* dashadik shunya haila — all directions are empty; andhakaramaya — all is darkness; kemane vanchiba munni — how shall I live; ghara ghoramaya — in this dreadful house

**13.** "All around is empty, all is shrouded in darkness —
how shall I live in this dreadful house?

গিলিবারে আইসে মোরে এ ঘরকরণ ।
বিষ যেন লাগে ইষ্ট-কুটুম্ব-বচন ॥ ১৪ ॥

*gilibāre āise more e gharakaraṇa |*
*biṣa yena lāge iṣṭa-kuṭumba-bacana || 14 ||*

*Word for word:* gilibare aise more — comes to swallow me; e gharakarana — this household; visha yena lage — feel like poison; ishta-kutumba-bachana — the words of friends and kin

**14.** This house comes to swallow me;
the words of friends and kin are like poison.

মা বলিয়া আর মোরে না ডাকিবে কেহ ।
আমারে নাহিক যম — পাশরিল সেহো ॥ ১৫ ॥

*mā baliẏā āra more nā ḍākibe keha |*
*āmāre nāhika yama — pāśarila seho || 15 ||*

*Word for word:* ma baliya — "mother"; ara more na dakibe keha — no one will call me any more; amare nahika yama — Yama does not take me; pasharila seho — he too has forgotten

**15.** No one will call me 'mother' any more;
even Yama will not take me — he too has forgotten me.

কিবা দুঃখ পাই, পুত্র ছাড়িল আমারে ।
হাপুতি করিয়া মোরে গেলা কোথাকারে ॥ ১৬ ॥

*kibā duḥkha pāi, putra chāṛila āmāre |*
*hāputi kariẏā more gelā kothākāre || 16 ||*

*Word for word:* kiba duhkha pai — what sorrow I suffer; putra chhadila amare — my son has left me; haputi kariya more — making me bereft of children; gela kothakare — where has he gone

**16.** What sorrow has befallen me — my son has left me!
Making me a mother bereft of children, where has he gone?

হায় হায় নিদারুণ নিমাই হইয়া ।
কোন্ দেশে গেলা, বাছা, কে দিবে আনিয়া ॥ ১৭ ॥

*hāẏa hāẏa nidāruṇa nimāi haiẏā |*
*kon deśe gelā, bāchā, ke dibe āniẏā || 17 ||*

*Word for word:* haya haya — alas, alas; nidaruna nimai haiya — Nimai, becoming pitiless; kon deshe gela — to what land have you gone; bachha — child; ke dibe aniya — who will bring you back

**17.** Alas, alas, Nimai, you have become pitiless!
To what lands have you gone, my child? Who will bring you back?

বুক ফাটে, বাপ, তোর সোঙরি' মাধুরী ।
মা বলিয়া আর না ডাকিবা গৌরহরি ॥ ১৮ ॥

*buka phāṭe, bāpa, tora soṅari' mādhurī |*
*mā baliẏā āra nā ḍākibā gaurahari || 18 ||*

*Word for word:* buka phate — my heart breaks; bapa — my son; tora songari madhuri — remembering your sweetness; ma baliya ara na dakiba — you will no more call "mother"; gaurahari — Gaurahari

**18.** My heart breaks, my son, remembering your sweetness:
never again will you call me 'mother', Gaurahari!

অনাথিনী করিয়া কোথা রে গেলে বাপ ।
মনে ছিল — জননীরে দিবে তুমি তাপ ॥ ১৯ ॥

*anāthinī kariẏā kothā re gele bāpa |*
*mane chila — jananīre dibe tumi tāpa || 19 ||*

*Word for word:* anathini kariya — making me helpless; kotha re gele bapa — where have you gone, son; mane chhila — it was in your mind; jananire dibe tumi tapa — to give your mother pain

**19.** Leaving me helpless, where have you gone, my son?
It must have been in your mind to give your mother pain.

পড়িয়া শুনিঞা পুত্র ইহাই শিখিলা ।
অনাথিনী অভাগিনী মায়েরে করিলা ॥ ২০ ॥

*paṛiẏā śuniñā putra ihāi śikhilā |*
*anāthinī abhāginī māẏere karilā || 20 ||*

*Word for word:* padiya shuniya — studying and hearing; putra ihai shikhila — the son learned this; anathini abhagini — helpless, wretched; mayere karila — he made his mother

**20.** You studied, you heard [the scriptures], my son — and this is what you learned:
to make your mother helpless and wretched!

কোথা বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া এড়ি' পলাইয়া গেলা ।
ভকত-সভার প্রেম কিছু না গণিলা ॥ ২১ ॥

*kothā biṣṇupriẏā eṛi' palāiẏā gelā |*
*bhakata-sabhāra prema kichu nā gaṇilā || 21 ||*

*Word for word:* kotha — where; vishnupriya edi — abandoning Vishnupriya; palaiya gela — have you fled; bhakata-sabhara prema — the love of all the devotees; kichhu na ganila — counted as nothing

**21.** Where have you fled, abandoning Vishnupriya?
The love of all the devotees you counted as nothing!"

বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া কান্দে, হিয়া নাহিক সম্বিত ।
ক্ষণে উঠে, ক্ষণে পড়ে — উনমত চিত ॥ ২২ ॥

*biṣṇupriẏā kānde, hiẏā nāhika sambita |*
*kṣaṇe uṭhe, kṣaṇe paṛe — unamata cita || 22 ||*

*Word for word:* vishnupriya kande — Vishnupriya weeps; hiya nahika samvita — her heart is senseless; kshane uthe kshane pade — now rises, now falls; unamata chita — her mind distracted

**22.** Vishnupriya weeps, her heart senseless;
now she rises, now she falls — her mind distracted.

বসন না দেয় গায়ে, না বান্ধয়ে চুলি ।
হাকান্দ কান্দন কান্দে উনমতি পাগলী ॥ ২৩ ॥

*basana nā deẏa gāẏe, nā bāndhaẏe culi |*
*hākānda kāndana kānde unamati pāgalī || 23 ||*

*Word for word:* vasana na deya gaye — puts no cloth on her body; na bandhaye chuli — does not bind her hair; hakanda kandana kande — sobs aloud; unamati pagali — like a madwoman

**23.** She puts on no clothes, does not bind her hair,
she sobs aloud like a madwoman.

প্রভুর অঙ্গের মালা হৃদয়ে করিয়া ।
জ্বালহ আগুনি, তাথে মরিব পুড়িয়া ॥ ২৪ ॥

*prabhura aṅgera mālā hṛdaẏe kariẏā |*
*jbālaha āguni, tāthe mariba puṛiẏā || 24 ||*

*Word for word:* prabhura angera mala — the garland from the Lord's body; hridaye kariya — holding to her bosom; jvalaha aguni — light a fire; tathe mariba pudiya — I shall burn in it and die

**24.** Pressing to her bosom the garland from the Lord's body, [she says]:
"Light a fire — I shall burn in it and die."

গুণ বিনাইতে নারে — মরয়ে মরমে ।
সবে এক বোল বোলে — যে ছিল করমে ॥ ২৫ ॥

*guṇa bināite nāre — maraẏe marame |*
*sabe eka bola bole — ye chila karame || 25 ||*

*Word for word:* guna vinaite nare — cannot recount His qualities; maraye marame — dies within; sabe eka bola bole — says only one thing; ye chhila karame — what was in my karma

**25.** She cannot recount His qualities — she dies in the depths of her soul
and repeats only one thing: "What was in my fate [has come to pass]."

অমিয়া-অধিক প্রভু তোর যত গুণ ।
এখনে সকল সেই ভৈ গেল আগুন ॥ ২৬ ॥

*amiẏā-adhika prabhu tora yata guṇa |*
*ekhane sakala sei bhai gela āguna || 26 ||*

*Word for word:* amiya-adhika — sweeter than nectar; prabhu tora yata guna — Lord, all Your qualities; ekhane sakala sei — now all that; bhai gela aguna — has turned to fire

**26.** "Lord, all Your qualities are sweeter than nectar —
and now all of it has turned to fire."

রহস্য-বিনোদ-কথা কহিবারে নারে ।
হিয়ার পোড়নে কান্দে অতি-আর্ত-স্বরে ॥ ২৭ ॥

*rahasya-binoda-kathā kahibāre nāre |*
*hiẏāra poṛane kānde ati-ārta-sbare || 27 ||*

*Word for word:* rahasya-vinoda-katha — of intimate joys; kahibare nare — she cannot speak; hiyara podane kande — weeps from the burning of her heart; ati-arta-svare — in a most piteous voice

**27.** Of their intimate joys she cannot even speak —
her heart burns, and she weeps in a piercing voice.

চৌদিগে ভকত মরে অন্তর-যন্ত্রণা ।
কি কহিব — সম্বরিতে না পারে আপনা ॥ ২৮ ॥

*caudige bhakata mare antara-yantraṇā |*
*ki kahiba — sambarite nā pāre āpanā || 28 ||*

*Word for word:* chaudige bhakata mare — around her the devotees are dying; antara-yantrana — of inner anguish; ki kahiba — what shall I say; sambarite na pare apana — they cannot restrain themselves

**28.** Around her the devotees are dying of anguish within —
what can be said? they cannot restrain themselves.

অনেক শকতি সভে বোলে ধীরে ধীরে ।
কি দিব প্রবোধ তোরে — প্রাণ কর স্থিরে ॥ ২৯ ॥

*aneka śakati sabhe bole dhīre dhīre |*
*ki diba prabodha tore — prāṇa kara sthire || 29 ||*

*Word for word:* aneka shakati — with great effort; sabhe bole dhire dhire — all speak softly; ki diba prabodha tore — what consolation can we give you; prana kara sthire — steady your life

**29.** Gathering all their strength, they say to her softly, softly:
"How can we console you? Steady your life.

যে দেখিলে যে শুনিলে এতকাল ধরি' ।
প্রাণ স্থির কর সেই সব মনে করি' ॥ ৩০ ॥

*ye dekhile ye śunile etakāla dhari' |*
*prāṇa sthira kara sei saba mane kari' || 30 ||*

*Word for word:* ye dekhile ye shunile — what you saw and heard; etakala dhari — all this time; prana sthira kara — steady your life; sei saba mane kari — remembering all that

**30.** What you have seen, what you have heard all this time —
remember all that and steady your life.

কি জানহ — ভগবান্ কার আপনার ।
শুনিয়াছ যত যত পূর্ব অবতার ॥ ৩১ ॥

*ki jānaha — bhagabān kāra āpanāra |*
*śuniẏācha yata yata pūrba abatāra || 31 ||*

*Word for word:* ki janaha — do you know; bhagavan kara apanara — whose own Bhagavan is; shuniyachha — you have heard; yata yata purva avatara — of all the former avataras

**31.** Do you know whose He is — Bhagavan?
You have heard of all the former avataras.

লোক-বেদ-অগোচর চরিত্র তাঁহার ।
বড় ভাগ্যে নাম ধর সম্বন্ধ তোমার ॥ ৩২ ॥

*loka-beda-agocara caritra tāṁhāra |*
*baṛa bhāgye nāma dhara sambandha tomāra || 32 ||*

*Word for word:* loka-veda-agochara — beyond the world and the Vedas; charitra tanhara — are His deeds; bada bhagye — by great fortune; nama dhara sambandha tomara — you bear the name of His kin

**32.** His deeds are beyond the reach of the world and the Vedas;
by great fortune you bear the name of His kin.

যারে যেই আজ্ঞা কৈলা — থাক সেইমতে ।
সেই আজ্ঞা পালন করহ দৃঢ়চিতে ॥ ৩৩ ॥

*yāre yei ājñā kailā — thāka seimate |*
*sei ājñā pālana karaha dṛṛhacite || 33 ||*

*Word for word:* yare yei ajna kaila — whatever He bade each; thaka seimate — live accordingly; sei ajna palana karaha — carry out that command; dridha-chite — with a firm heart

**33.** Whatever He commanded each of us — so let us live:
carry out that command with a firm heart."

এতেক বচন যবে বৈল ভক্তগণ ।
শুনিঞা কাতর হিয়া সম্বরে ক্রন্দন ॥ ৩৪ ॥

*eteka bacana yabe baila bhaktagaṇa |*
*śuniñā kātara hiẏā sambare krandana || 34 ||*

*Word for word:* eteka bachana yabe — when such words; vaila bhaktagana — the devotees spoke; shuniña katara hiya — hearing, aching at heart; sambare krandana — she holds back her weeping

**34.** When the devotees spoke such words,
she listened and, aching at heart, held back her weeping.

তবে নিত্যানন্দ লঞা সব ভক্তগণ ।
যুক্তি করে — কোথা গেলে পাব দরশন ॥ ৩৫ ॥

*tabe nityānanda lañā saba bhaktagaṇa |*
*yukti kare — kothā gele pāba daraśana || 35 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe nityananda — then Nityananda; lana saba bhaktagana — with all the devotees; yukti kare — takes counsel; kotha gele paba darashana — where shall we go to see Him

**35.** Then Nityananda, gathering all the devotees,
takes counsel: "Where shall we go to see Him?"

কেহো বোলে — যত তীর্থ করিব গমন ।
যথা গেলে গোরাচাঁদের পাব দরশন ॥ ৩৬ ॥

*keho bole — yata tīrtha kariba gamana |*
*yathā gele gorācāṁdera pāba daraśana || 36 ||*

*Word for word:* keho bole — someone says; yata tirtha kariba gamana — we shall go to all the holy places; yatha gele — going wherever; gorachandera paba darashana — we shall see Gorachand

**36.** Someone says: "Let us go round all the holy places —
somewhere we shall see Gorachand."

কেহো বোলে — বৃন্দাবন যাব বারাণসী ।
নীলাচলে যাব যথা থাকয়ে সন্ন্যাসী ॥ ৩৭ ॥

*keho bole — bṛndābana yāba bārāṇasī |*
*nīlācale yāba yathā thākaẏe sannyāsī || 37 ||*

*Word for word:* keho bole — someone says; vrindavana yaba varanasi — we shall go to Vrindavana, Varanasi; nilachale yaba — we shall go to Nilachala; yatha thakaye sannyasi — where sannyasis live

**37.** Someone says: "Let us go to Vrindavana, to Varanasi,
let us go to Nilachala, where the sannyasis live."

কাঞ্চননগরে আছে ভারতী গোসাঞি ।
সন্ন্যাস করিব তথা পণ্ডিত নিমাই ॥ ৩৮ ॥

*kāñcananagare āche bhāratī gosāñi |*
*sannyāsa kariba tathā paṇḍita nimāi || 38 ||*

*Word for word:* kanchana-nagare achhe — in Kanchananagara lives; bharati gosani — Bharati Gosani; sannyasa kariba tatha — there will take sannyasa; pandita nimai — Pandita Nimai

**38.** [Nityananda says:] "In Kanchananagara lives Bharati Gosani —
there Pandita Nimai will take sannyasa.

এই বাক্য কভু প্রভুর মুখে শুনিয়াছি ।
সত্য করি' এই বাক্য দৃঢ় নাহি বুঝি ॥ ৩৯ ॥

*ei bākya kabhu prabhura mukhe śuniẏāchi |*
*satya kari' ei bākya dṛṛha nāhi bujhi || 39 ||*

*Word for word:* ei vakya kabhu — these words once; prabhura mukhe shuniyachhi — I heard from the Lord's lips; satya kari — as true; ei vakya dridha nahi bujhi — I am not sure of them

**39.** These words I once heard from the Lord's lips,
but I am not sure they are true.

মিথ্যা-বাক্যে সব লোক ধাইবে তথারে ।
আগে আমি তত্ত্ব জানি' কহিব সভারে ॥ ৪০ ॥

*mithyā-bākye saba loka dhāibe tathāre |*
*āge āmi tattba jāni' kahiba sabhāre || 40 ||*

*Word for word:* mithya-vakye — on a false report; saba loka dhaibe tathare — everyone will rush there; age ami tattva jani — first I, learning the truth; kahiba sabhare — shall tell all

**40.** If on a false report everyone rushes there, [it will be bad];
first I shall learn the truth and tell everyone.

ধীর ভক্তজন কথো দেহ মোর সঙ্গে ।
ধরিয়া আনিব মোর প্রভু সে গৌরাঙ্গে ॥ ৪১ ॥

*dhīra bhaktajana katho deha mora saṅge |*
*dhariẏā āniba mora prabhu se gaurāṅge || 41 ||*

*Word for word:* dhira bhaktajana katho — a few steadfast devotees; deha mora sange — give me as companions; dhariya aniba — I shall seize and bring back; mora prabhu se gaurange — my Lord Gauranga

**41.** Give me a few steadfast devotees to go with me —
I shall seize my Lord Gauranga and bring Him back."

তবে সব ভক্তগণ মনে অনুমানে ।
মুখ্য মুখ্য জন কথো দিল তাঁর সনে ॥ ৪২ ॥

*tabe saba bhaktagaṇa mane anumāne |*
*mukhya mukhya jana katho dila tāṁra sane || 42 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe saba bhaktagana — then all the devotees; mane anumane — considering; mukhya mukhya jana katho — several of the foremost; dila tanra sane — gave to go with Him

**42.** Then all the devotees, considering,
gave Him several of the foremost as companions.

শ্রীচন্দ্রশেখরাচার্য, পণ্ডিত দামোদর ।
বক্রেশ্বর-আদি করি' চলিলা সত্বর ॥ ৪৩ ॥

*śrīcandraśekharācārya, paṇḍita dāmodara |*
*bakreśbara-ādi kari' calilā satbara || 43 ||*

*Word for word:* sri-chandrashekharacharya — Sri Chandrashekhara Acharya; pandita damodara — Pandita Damodara; vakreshvara-adi kari — Vakreshvara and others; chalila satvara — set out in haste

**43.** Sri Chandrashekhara Acharya, Pandita Damodara,
Vakreshvara and others set out in haste.

এই সব লঞা নিত্যানন্দ চলি' যায় ।
প্রবোধিয়া শচী-বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়ার হৃদয় ॥ ৪৪ ॥

*ei saba lañā nityānanda cali' yāẏa |*
*prabodhiẏā śacī-biṣṇupriẏāra hṛdaẏa || 44 ||*

*Word for word:* ei saba lana — taking them; nityananda chali yaya — Nityananda goes; prabodhiya — having consoled; shachi-vishnupriyara hridaya — the hearts of Shachi and Vishnupriya

**44.** With them Nityananda departs,
having consoled the hearts of Shachi and Vishnupriya.

এথা গৌরহরি শীঘ্র চলিলা সত্বর ।
কোটি-কুঞ্জর মত্ত গমন সুন্দর ॥ ৪৫ ॥

*ethā gaurahari śīghra calilā satbara |*
*koṭi-kuñjara matta gamana sundara || 45 ||*

*Word for word:* etha gaurahari — meanwhile Gaurahari; shighra chalila satvara — went on swiftly; koti-kunjara matta — [like] a myriad maddened elephants; gamana sundara — with beautiful gait

**45.** Meanwhile Gaurahari pressed swiftly on
with a beautiful gait, like a myriad maddened elephants.

ঝর ঝর নয়নে ঝরয়ে প্রেমধারা ।
পুলকে আকুল অঙ্গ সোণার কিশোরা ॥ ৪৬ ॥

*jhara jhara naẏane jharaẏe premadhārā |*
*pulake ākula aṅga soṇāra kiśorā || 46 ||*

*Word for word:* jhara jhara nayane — from the eyes stream; jharaye prema-dhara — torrents of prema; pulake akula anga — the body thrilling; sonara kishora — of the golden youth

**46.** Streams of prema pour from His eyes,
the golden youth's body thrills, its hairs on end.

ঊর্ধ্ববাসে কেশ প্রভু করিয়া বন্ধন ।
মথুরার মল্ল যেন করিবে গমন ॥ ৪৭ ॥

*ūrdhbabāse keśa prabhu kariẏā bandhana |*
*mathurāra malla yena karibe gamana || 47 ||*

*Word for word:* urdhva-vase — with His upper cloth; kesha prabhu kariya bandhana — the Lord binding His hair; mathurara malla — to the wrestlers of Mathura; yena karibe gamana — as if going

**47.** Binding His hair with His upper cloth, the Lord
[goes] as if [Krishna] to fight the wrestlers of Mathura.[^39-5]

রাধার বিরহ-ভাবে হইয়া আকুল ।
কোথা রাধা, গেল মোর কোথায় গোকুল ॥ ৪৮ ॥

*rādhāra biraha-bhābe haiẏā ākula |*
*kothā rādhā, gela mora kothāẏa gokula || 48 ||*

*Word for word:* radhara viraha-bhave — in the bhava of separation from Radha; haiya akula — overwhelmed; kotha radha — where is Radha; gela mora kothaya gokula — where has my Gokula gone

**48.** Overwhelmed by the bhava of separation from Radha, [He cries]:
"Where is Radha? Where has my Gokula gone?"[^39-6]

সে গমন ক্ষণে ক্ষণে মন্থর হইয়া ।
মালসাট মারে ক্ষণে চৌদিগে চাহিয়া ॥ ৪৯ ॥

*se gamana kṣaṇe kṣaṇe manthara haiẏā |*
*mālasāṭa māre kṣaṇe caudige cāhiẏā || 49 ||*

*Word for word:* se gamana — that gait; kshane kshane manthara haiya — now and then slowing; malasata mare kshane — now He slaps His arms; chaudige chahiya — looking around

**49.** Now His pace slows,
now He slaps His arms, looking around on all sides.

এইমতে প্রেমাবেশে চলি' যায় পথে ।
অখিলের গুরু মোর প্রভু জগন্নাথে ॥ ৫০ ॥

*eimate premābeśe cali' yāẏa pathe |*
*akhilera guru mora prabhu jagannāthe || 50 ||*

*Word for word:* eimate premaveshe — thus, absorbed in prema; chali yaya pathe — goes along the road; akhilera guru — the guru of all; mora prabhu jagannathe — my Lord Jagannatha

**50.** Thus, absorbed in prema, goes along the road
my Lord Jagannatha, the guru of all.

কাঞ্চননগরে আইলা প্রভু বিশ্বম্ভর ।
যথা আছে কেশব-ভারতী ন্যাসিবর ॥ ৫১ ॥

*kāñcananagare āilā prabhu biśbambhara |*
*yathā āche keśaba-bhāratī nyāsibara || 51 ||*

*Word for word:* kanchana-nagare aila — came to Kanchananagara; prabhu vishvambhara — the Lord Vishvambhara; yatha achhe — where lives; keshava-bharati nyasivara — Keshava Bharati, best of sannyasis

**51.** The Lord Vishvambhara came to Kanchananagara,
where lived Keshava Bharati, the best of sannyasis.

পরম ভকতি করি' প্রণাম করে ।
উঠিয়া সম্ভ্রমে ন্যাসী নারায়ণ স্মরে ॥ ৫২ ॥

*parama bhakati kari' praṇāma kare |*
*uṭhiẏā sambhrame nyāsī nārāẏaṇa smare || 52 ||*

*Word for word:* parama bhakati kari — with highest devotion; pranama kare — He bows; uthiya sambhrame — rising respectfully; nyasi narayana smare — the sannyasi utters "Narayana"

**52.** With the highest devotion He bows [to him],
and the sannyasi, rising respectfully, utters: "Narayana!"[^39-7]

বড় ভাগ্য মানি' দোঁহে সরস সম্ভাষ ।
বিশ্বম্ভর বোলে — মোরে করাহ সন্ন্যাস ॥ ৫৩ ॥

*baṛa bhāgya māni' doṁhe sarasa sambhāṣa |*
*biśbambhara bole — more karāha sannyāsa || 53 ||*

*Word for word:* bada bhagya mani — deeming it great fortune; donhe sarasa sambhasha — both converse warmly; vishvambhara bole — Vishvambhara says; more karaha sannyasa — give Me sannyasa

**53.** Both deem [the meeting] great good fortune and converse warmly;
Vishvambhara says: "Give Me sannyasa."

এইমনে দুইজনে আছে এককালে ।
আইলা নিত্যানন্দ চন্দ্রশেখরাদি-মেলে ॥ ৫৪ ॥

*eimane duijane āche ekakāle |*
*āilā nityānanda candraśekharādi-mele || 54 ||*

*Word for word:* eimane duijane achhe — while the two were thus; eka-kale — at that time; aila nityananda — Nityananda came; chandrashekharadi-mele — with Chandrashekhara and others

**54.** While the two were thus together,
Nityananda arrived with Chandrashekhara and the others.

সন্ন্যাসীকে নমস্করি' প্রভু নমস্করে ।
হাসিয়া কহয়ে প্রভু — ভাল হৈল আইলে ॥ ৫৫ ॥

*sannyāsīke namaskari' prabhu namaskare |*
*hāsiẏā kahaẏe prabhu — bhāla haila āile || 55 ||*

*Word for word:* sannyasike namaskari — bowing to the sannyasi; prabhu namaskare — they bow to the Lord; hasiya kahaye prabhu — the Lord says smiling; bhala haila aile — it is good you came

**55.** Bowing to the sannyasi, they bow to the Lord;
the Lord, smiling, says: "It is good that you have come.

তোমার গমনে মোর সকলি মঙ্গল ।
সন্ন্যাস হইব, মোর জনম সফল ॥ ৫৬ ॥

*tomāra gamane mora sakali maṅgala |*
*sannyāsa haiba, mora janama saphala || 56 ||*

*Word for word:* tomara gamane — with your coming; mora sakali mangala — all is auspicious for Me; sannyasa haiba — I shall take sannyasa; mora janama saphala — My life will be fulfilled

**56.** With your coming all is auspicious for Me:
I shall take sannyasa — and My life will be fulfilled."

এ বোল বলিয়া পুনঃ ভারতী সম্ভাষে ।
প্রণতি মিনতি করে সন্ন্যাসের আশে ॥ ৫৭ ॥

*e bola baliẏā punaḥ bhāratī sambhāṣe |*
*praṇati minati kare sannyāsera āśe || 57 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola baliya — saying this; punah bharati sambhashe — again addresses Bharati; pranati minati kare — bows and pleads; sannyasera ashe — hoping for sannyasa

**57.** Saying this, He again addresses Bharati,
bowing and pleading for sannyasa.

ভারতী কহয়ে — শুন শুন বিশ্বম্ভর ।
তোমারে সন্ন্যাস দিতে কাঁপয়ে অন্তর ॥ ৫৮ ॥

*bhāratī kahaẏe — śuna śuna biśbambhara |*
*tomāre sannyāsa dite kāṁpaẏe antara || 58 ||*

*Word for word:* bharati kahaye — Bharati says; shuna shuna vishvambhara — listen, Vishvambhara; tomare sannyasa dite — to give You sannyasa; kanpaye antara — my heart trembles

**58.** Bharati says: "Listen, listen, Vishvambhara:
my heart trembles at giving You sannyasa.

এহেন সুন্দর তনু, তরুণ বয়স ।
জনম অবধি নাহি জান দুঃখ-ক্লেশ ॥ ৫৯ ॥

*ehena sundara tanu, taruṇa baẏasa |*
*janama abadhi nāhi jāna duḥkha-kleśa || 59 ||*

*Word for word:* ehena sundara tanu — such a lovely body; taruna bayasa — young age; janama avadhi — since birth; nahi jana duhkha-klesha — You have known no sorrow or hardship

**59.** Such a beautiful body, such young years —
since birth You have known no sorrow or hardship.

অপত্য-সন্ততি নাহি হয়ে ত তোমার ।
তোমারে সন্ন্যাস দিতে না হয় আমার ॥ ৬০ ॥

*apatya-santati nāhi haẏe ta tomāra |*
*tomāre sannyāsa dite nā haẏa āmāra || 60 ||*

*Word for word:* apatya-santati — offspring; nahi haye ta tomara — You do not have; tomare sannyasa dite — to give You sannyasa; na haya amara — is not for me

**60.** You do not even have offspring —
it is not for me to give You sannyasa.

পঞ্চাশের ঊর্ধ্ব হৈলে রাগের নিবৃত্তি ।
তবে সে সন্ন্যাস দিতে তোরে হয় যুক্তি ॥ ৬১ ॥

*pañcāśera ūrdhba haile rāgera nibṛtti |*
*tabe se sannyāsa dite tore haẏa yukti || 61 ||*

*Word for word:* panchashera urdhva haile — when past fifty; ragera nivritti — passions subside; tabe se sannyasa dite — then to give sannyasa; tore haya yukti — to You is reasonable

**61.** When You are past fifty and the passions subside,
then it will be reasonable to give You sannyasa."[^39-8]

এ বোল শুনিঞা প্রভু কহে লহু বাণী ।
তোমার সাক্ষাতে আমি কি বলিতে জানি ॥ ৬২ ॥

*e bola śuniñā prabhu kahe lahu bāṇī |*
*tomāra sākṣāte āmi ki balite jāni || 62 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuniña — hearing this; prabhu kahe lahu vani — the Lord speaks softly; tomara sakshate — in your presence; ami ki balite jani — what can I say

**62.** Hearing this, the Lord says softly:
"What can I say in your presence?

মায়া না করিহ মোরে, শুন ন্যাসিমণি ।
ধর্মাধর্ম-তত্ত্ব কেবা জানে তোমা বিনি ॥ ৬৩ ॥

*māẏā nā kariha more, śuna nyāsimaṇi |*
*dharmādharma-tattba kebā jāne tomā bini || 63 ||*

*Word for word:* maya na kariha more — do not dissemble with Me; shuna nyasimani — listen, jewel of sannyasis; dharmadharma-tattva — the truth of dharma and adharma; keba jane toma vini — who knows but you

**63.** Do not dissemble with Me, jewel among sannyasis:[^39-9]
who but you knows the truth of dharma and adharma?

সংসারে দুর্লভ এই মানুষের জন্ম ।
তাহাতে দুর্লভ কৃষ্ণভক্তি পরধর্ম ॥ ৬৪ ॥

*saṃsāre durlabha ei mānuṣera janma |*
*tāhāte durlabha kṛṣṇabhakti paradharma || 64 ||*

*Word for word:* samsare durlabha — rare in samsara; ei manushera janma — is this human birth; tahate durlabha — rare in it; krishna-bhakti paradharma — devotion to Krishna, the highest dharma

**64.** In samsara this birth as a human being is rare,
and in it rare is devotion to Krishna, the highest dharma.

বড়ই দুর্লভ তাহে ভক্তজন-সঙ্গ ।
মানুষের এ দেহ তিলেকে হয় ভঙ্গ ॥ ৬৫ ॥

*baṛai durlabha tāhe bhaktajana-saṅga |*
*mānuṣera e deha tileke haẏa bhaṅga || 65 ||*

*Word for word:* badai durlabha tahe — rarer still in it; bhaktajana-sanga — the company of devotees; manushera e deha — this human body; tileke haya bhanga — perishes in a moment

**65.** And rarer still the company of devotees;
and the human body perishes in a moment.

বিলম্ব করিতে এই দেহ যায় যবে ।
তবে আর বৈষ্ণবের সঙ্গ হবে কবে ॥ ৬৬ ॥

*bilamba karite ei deha yāẏa yabe |*
*tabe āra baiṣṇabera saṅga habe kabe || 66 ||*

*Word for word:* vilamba karite — while delaying; ei deha yaya yabe — if this body passes; tabe ara — then again; vaishnavera sanga habe kabe — when will there be the company of Vaishnavas

**66.** If, while I delay, this body passes away —
when then shall I have the company of Vaishnavas?

মায়া না করিহ মোরে, করাহ সন্ন্যাস ।
তোর পরসাদে মুঞি হঙ কৃষ্ণদাস ॥ ৬৭ ॥

*māẏā nā kariha more, karāha sannyāsa |*
*tora parasāde muñi haṅa kṛṣṇadāsa || 67 ||*

*Word for word:* maya na kariha more — do not dissemble with Me; karaha sannyasa — give sannyasa; tora parasade — by your grace; munni hana krishnadasa — may I become Krishna's servant

**67.** Do not dissemble with Me — give Me sannyasa:
by your grace may I become a servant of Krishna."

ইহা বলি' করুণ-অরুণ দু-নয়ান ।
ছল ছল করে অশ্রু, কাতর বয়ান ॥ ৬৮ ॥

*ihā bali' karuṇa-aruṇa du-naẏāna |*
*chala chala kare aśru, kātara baẏāna || 68 ||*

*Word for word:* iha bali — saying this; karuna-aruna du-nayana — His merciful eyes reddened; chhala chhala kare ashru — brimming with tears; katara bayana — His face anguished

**68.** Saying this, [He stands]: His merciful eyes reddened,
brimming with tears, His face full of anguish.

হুঙ্কার-গর্জন সিংহ জিনি' পরাক্রম ।
ভাবময় সব দেহ অতি সুলক্ষণ ॥ ৬৯ ॥

*huṅkāra-garjana siṃha jini' parākrama |*
*bhābamaẏa saba deha ati sulakṣaṇa || 69 ||*

*Word for word:* hunkara-garjana — roaring; simha jini parakrama — surpassing a lion in might; bhavamaya saba deha — His whole body full of bhava; ati sulakshana — most auspiciously marked

**69.** Roaring, He surpasses a lion in might;
His whole body is bhava itself, marked with every auspicious sign.

হরি হরি বলি' ডাকে মেঘের গর্জনে ।
অবিরাম প্রেমবারি ঝরে দু-নয়নে ॥ ৭০ ॥

*hari hari bali' ḍāke meghera garjane |*
*abirāma premabāri jhare du-naẏane || 70 ||*

*Word for word:* hari hari bali dake — He calls "Hari, Hari"; meghera garjane — with the thunder of a cloud; avirama prema-vari — ceaselessly tears of prema; jhare du-nayane — flow from His eyes

**70.** "Hari, Hari!" He calls with the thunder of a cloud,
tears of prema flow ceaselessly from His eyes.

ত্রিভঙ্গ হইয়া 'বংশী বংশী' বলি' ডাকে ।
ক্ষণে 'রাসমণ্ডলী' বলিয়া অঙ্গ বাঁকে ॥ ৭১ ॥

*tribhaṅga haiẏā 'baṃśī baṃśī' bali' ḍāke |*
*kṣaṇe 'rāsamaṇḍalī' baliẏā aṅga bāṁke || 71 ||*

*Word for word:* tribhanga haiya — standing thrice-bent; vamshi vamshi bali dake — calls "flute, flute"; kshane rasamandali baliya — now, saying "circle of the rasa"; anga banke — bends His body

**71.** Standing thrice-bent, He calls: "The flute, the flute!";
now, crying "The circle of the rasa!", He bends His body.

গোবর্ধন, রাধাকুণ্ড বলি' ডাকে হাসে ।
চমৎকার হৈল ন্যাসী অন্তর-তরাসে ॥ ৭২ ॥

*gobardhana, rādhākuṇḍa bali' ḍāke hāse |*
*camatkāra haila nyāsī antara-tarāse || 72 ||*

*Word for word:* govardhana radhakunda bali — saying "Govardhana, Radha-kunda"; dake hase — He calls and laughs; chamatkara haila nyasi — the sannyasi was astonished; antara-tarase — trembling at heart

**72.** He calls "Govardhana! Radha-kunda!" and laughs;
the sannyasi was astonished, trembling at heart.

অন্তরে চিন্তিয়া কিছু বোলে ন্যাসিরাজ ।
অন্তরে জানিল — মোর ভাল নহে কাজ ॥ ৭৩ ॥

*antare cintiẏā kichu bole nyāsirāja |*
*antare jānila — mora bhāla nahe kāja || 73 ||*

*Word for word:* antare chintiya — reflecting; kichhu bole nyasiraja — the king of sannyasis speaks; antare janila — understood within; mora bhala nahe kaja — this is not a good deed for me

**73.** Reflecting in his heart, the king of sannyasis speaks —
he understood within: "This is not a good deed for me.

জগতের গুরু এই জগতের নাথ ।
'গুরু' বলি' আমারে করিবে জোড়-হাত ॥ ৭৪ ॥

*jagatera guru ei jagatera nātha |*
*'guru' bali' āmāre karibe joṛa-hāta || 74 ||*

*Word for word:* jagatera guru ei — He is the guru of the world; jagatera natha — the Lord of the world; guru bali — calling me guru; amare karibe joda-hata — will join His palms to me

**74.** He is the guru of the world, the Lord of the world —
and He will bow to me with joined palms, calling me guru."

এত অনুমানি' ন্যাসী কহিল উত্তর ।
সন্ন্যাস করিবে যদি, যাহ নিজ-ঘর ॥ ৭৫ ॥

*eta anumāni' nyāsī kahila uttara |*
*sannyāsa karibe yadi, yāha nija-ghara || 75 ||*

*Word for word:* eta anumani — reasoning thus; nyasi kahila uttara — the sannyasi answered; sannyasa karibe yadi — if You will take sannyasa; yaha nija-ghara — go home

**75.** Reasoning thus, the sannyasi answered:
"If You want to take sannyasa, go home.

সাক্ষাতে জননী-ঠাঞি হইবে বিদায় ।
তোর পত্নী সুচরিতা — যাবে তার ঠাঁয় ॥ ৭৬ ॥

*sākṣāte jananī-ṭhāñi haibe bidāẏa |*
*tora patnī sucaritā — yābe tāra ṭhāṁẏa || 76 ||*

*Word for word:* sakshate — in person; janani-thani haibe vidaya — take leave of Your mother; tora patni sucharita — Your virtuous wife; yabe tara thanya — go to her

**76.** Take leave of Your mother in person;
and Your virtuous wife — go to her.

সাক্ষাতে সভার ঠাঞি বিদায় হইয়া ।
আসিবে আমার ঠাঁই সভারে বুঝাঞা ॥ ৭৭ ॥

*sākṣāte sabhāra ṭhāñi bidāẏa haiẏā |*
*āsibe āmāra ṭhāṁi sabhāre bujhāñā || 77 ||*

*Word for word:* sakshate sabhara thani — in person with everyone; vidaya haiya — taking leave; asibe amara thai — come to me; sabhare bujhaña — making everyone understand

**77.** Having taken leave of everyone in person
and made everyone understand, come to me."

মনে আছে — গোরাচাঁদে করিয়া বিদায় ।
আসন ছাড়িয়া আমি যাব অন্য ঠাঁয় ॥ ৭৮ ॥

*mane āche — gorācāṁde kariẏā bidāẏa |*
*āsana chāṛiẏā āmi yāba anya ṭhāṁẏa || 78 ||*

*Word for word:* mane achhe — in his mind; gorachande kariya vidaya — having sent Gorachand away; asana chhadiya — leaving my seat; ami yaba anya thanya — I shall go elsewhere

**78.** But in his mind: "Having sent Gorachand away,
I shall leave my seat and go elsewhere."

অন্তর্যামী ভগবান্ এ মন জানিঞা ।
পালিব তোমার আজ্ঞা, বলিল হাসিয়া ॥ ৭৯ ॥

*antaryāmī bhagabān e mana jāniñā |*
*pāliba tomāra ājñā, balila hāsiẏā || 79 ||*

*Word for word:* antaryami bhagavan — Bhagavan, the Knower of hearts; e mana janiña — knowing this intention; paliba tomara ajna — I shall carry out your command; balila hasiya — said smiling

**79.** Bhagavan, the Knower of hearts, understood this intention
and said with a smile: "I shall carry out your command."

চলিলেন মহাপ্রভু নবদ্বীপ-পুরে ।
দেখিয়া ভাবিল ন্যাসী আপন অন্তরে ॥ ৮০ ॥

*calilena mahāprabhu nabadbīpa-pure |*
*dekhiẏā bhābila nyāsī āpana antare || 80 ||*

*Word for word:* chalilena mahaprabhu — Mahaprabhu set out; navadvipa-pure — for Navadvipa; dekhiya bhavila nyasi — seeing this, the sannyasi thought; apana antare — to himself

**80.** Mahaprabhu set out for Navadvipa;
watching Him, the sannyasi thought to himself:

যাঁর লোমকূপে ব্রহ্মাণ্ডের গণ বৈসে ।
তাঁরে পলাইয়া আমি যাব কোন্ দেশে ॥ ৮১ ॥

*yāṁra lomakūpe brahmāṇḍera gaṇa baise |*
*tāṁre palāiẏā āmi yāba kon deśe || 81 ||*

*Word for word:* yanra lomakupe — in whose pores; brahmandera gana vaise — hosts of universes dwell; tanre palaiya — fleeing from Him; ami yaba kon deshe — to what land shall I go

**81.** "He in whose pores hosts of universes dwell —
where, to what land, shall I flee from Him?

ভ্রান্তমতি আমি কিছু দেখিয়া না দেখি ।
সভার জীবন এই, সর্বজন-সাখী ॥ ৮২ ॥

*bhrāntamati āmi kichu dekhiẏā nā dekhi |*
*sabhāra jībana ei, sarbajana-sākhī || 82 ||*

*Word for word:* bhrantamati ami — I, deluded; kichhu dekhiya na dekhi — look and do not see; sabhara jivana ei — He is the life of all; sarvajana-sakhi — the witness of all

**82.** Deluded in mind, I look and do not see:
He is the life of all, the witness of all."

ইহা ভাবি' সন্ন্যাসী ডাকিয়া গৌরহরি ।
বলিতে লাগিল কিছু অনুনয় করি' ॥ ৮৩ ॥

*ihā bhābi' sannyāsī ḍākiẏā gaurahari |*
*balite lāgila kichu anunaẏa kari' || 83 ||*

*Word for word:* iha bhavi — thinking thus; sannyasi dakiya gaurahari — the sannyasi, calling Gaurahari; balite lagila kichhu — began to speak; anunaya kari — entreating

**83.** Thinking thus, the sannyasi called Gaurahari
and began to speak, entreating Him:

আর এক বোল বোলোঁ, শুন বিশ্বম্ভর ।
তোমারে সন্ন্যাস দিতে বড় লাগে ডর ॥ ৮৪ ॥

*āra eka bola boloṁ, śuna biśbambhara |*
*tomāre sannyāsa dite baṛa lāge ḍara || 84 ||*

*Word for word:* ara eka bola bolon — I shall say one more word; shuna vishvambhara — listen, Vishvambhara; tomare sannyasa dite — to give You sannyasa; bada lage dara — I am much afraid

**84.** "I shall say one more word, listen, Vishvambhara:
I am very much afraid to give You sannyasa.

তুমি জগতের গুরু — কে গুরু তোমার ।
মিছা বিড়ম্বনা কেনে করহ আমার ॥ ৮৫ ॥

*tumi jagatera guru — ke guru tomāra |*
*michā biṛambanā kene karaha āmāra || 85 ||*

*Word for word:* tumi jagatera guru — You are the guru of the world; ke guru tomara — who is Your guru; michha vidambana — a needless embarrassment; kene karaha amara — why do You make for me

**85.** You are the guru of the world: who is Your guru?
Why do You needlessly put me in a false position?"

এ বোল শুনিয়া কান্দে বিশ্বম্ভর রায় ।
আরতি করিয়া ধরে সন্ন্যাসীর পায় ॥ ৮৬ ॥

*e bola śuniẏā kānde biśbambhara rāẏa |*
*ārati kariẏā dhare sannyāsīra pāẏa || 86 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuniya — hearing this; kande vishvambhara raya — Vishvambhara Raya weeps; arati kariya — in longing; dhare sannyasira paya — clasps the sannyasi's feet

**86.** Hearing this, Vishvambhara Raya wept
and in longing clasped the sannyasi's feet:

প্রণত-জনেরে কেনে বোল দুর্বচন ।
মরিলে কি ছাড়ি আমি তোমার চরণ ॥ ৮৭ ॥

*praṇata-janere kene bola durbacana |*
*marile ki chāṛi āmi tomāra caraṇa || 87 ||*

*Word for word:* pranata-janere — to one who bows down; kene bola durbachana — why do you speak harsh words; marile ki chhadi ami — even dying would I leave; tomara charana — your feet

**87.** "Why do you speak harsh words to one who bows before you?
Even dying I shall not let go of your feet.

মোরে যত বোল — মোর বুঝিবার মন ।
এক নিবেদন আছে — শুনহ বচন ॥ ৮৮ ॥

*more yata bola — mora bujhibāra mana |*
*eka nibedana āche — śunaha bacana || 88 ||*

*Word for word:* more yata bola — all you say to Me; mora bujhibara mana — is to test My mind; eka nivedana achhe — I have one request; shunaha bachana — hear My words

**88.** All that you say to Me is to test My mind.
I have one request — hear My words.

একদিন রাত্রিশেষে দেখিলুঁ স্বপন ।
সন্ন্যাসের মন্ত্র মোরে কহিল ব্রাহ্মণ ॥ ৮৯ ॥

*ekadina rātriśeṣe dekhiluṁ sbapana |*
*sannyāsera mantra more kahila brāhmaṇa || 89 ||*

*Word for word:* ekadina ratri-sheshe — one day at the end of night; dekhilun svapana — I saw a dream; sannyasera mantra — the sannyasa mantra; more kahila brahmana — a brahmana told Me

**89.** One day at the end of the night I had a dream:
a brahmana told Me the sannyasa mantra.

দেখ দেখি, এই বটে হয় কিবা নহে ।
ইহা বলি' ভারতীর কর্ণে মন্ত্র কহে ॥ ৯০ ॥

*dekha dekhi, ei baṭe haẏa kibā nahe |*
*ihā bali' bhāratīra karṇe mantra kahe || 90 ||*

*Word for word:* dekha dekhi — see now; ei bate haya kiba nahe — is it this or not; iha bali — saying this; bharatira karne mantra kahe — speaks the mantra into Bharati's ear

**90.** See now — is it this or not?" —
and saying this, He speaks the mantra into Bharati's ear.

ইহা বলি' সন্ন্যাসীর কর্ণে কহে মন্ত্র ।
প্রকারে হইলা গুরু আপনি স্বতন্ত্র ॥ ৯১ ॥

*ihā bali' sannyāsīra karṇe kahe mantra |*
*prakāre hailā guru āpani sbatantra || 91 ||*

*Word for word:* iha bali — thus; sannyasira karne kahe mantra — speaks the mantra into the sannyasi's ear; prakare haila guru — on a pretext became guru; apani svatantra — the Independent One Himself

**91.** Thus He spoke the mantra into the sannyasi's ear:
on a plausible pretext the independent [Lord] Himself became the guru.[^39-10]

মন্ত্র শুনি' ন্যাসিবর হইলা প্রেমময় ।
কম্প পুলকিত অশ্রু, রাধাকৃষ্ণ কয় ॥ ৯১+১ ॥

*mantra śuni' nyāsibara hailā premamaẏa |*
*kampa pulakita aśru, rādhākṛṣṇa kaẏa || 91+1 ||*

*Word for word:* mantra shuni — hearing the mantra; nyasivara haila premamaya — the best of sannyasis was filled with prema; kampa pulakita ashru — trembling, thrilling, tears; radha-krishna kaya — he says "Radha-Krishna"

**91+1.** Hearing the mantra, the best of sannyasis was filled with prema:[^39-11]
trembling, thrilling, in tears, he says, "Radha-Krishna!"

বৃন্দাবন যমুনা ফুকারে ঘনে ঘন ।
বুঝিল — এই সে কৃষ্ণ শচীর নন্দন ॥ ৯১+২ ॥

*bṛndābana yamunā phukāre ghane ghana |*
*bujhila — ei se kṛṣṇa śacīra nandana || 91+2 ||*

*Word for word:* vrindavana yamuna — "Vrindavana! Yamuna!"; phukare ghane ghana — he cries again and again; bujhila — he understood; ei se krishna shachira nandana — this is Krishna Himself, Shachi's son

**91+2.** Again and again he cries out: "Vrindavana! Yamuna!" —
he understood: "This is Krishna Himself, the son of Shachi.

ইঁহারে পিরীতি সেই ভাগ্য সর্বোত্তম ।
কৃষ্ণে প্রীতিহীন ধর্ম হয় ত অধম ॥ ৯১+৩ ॥

*iṁhāre pirīti sei bhāgya sarbottama |*
*kṛṣṇe prītihīna dharma haẏa ta adhama || 91+3 ||*

*Word for word:* inhare piriti — love for Him; sei bhagya sarvottama — is the highest fortune; krishne pritihina dharma — dharma without love for Krishna; haya ta adhama — is base

**91+3.** Love for Him is the highest fortune;
dharma without love for Krishna is base."

বুঝিল সকল কাজ ভারতী গোসাঞি ।
সন্ন্যাস করাব তোরে — শুনহ নিমাঞি ॥ ৯২ ॥

*bujhila sakala kāja bhāratī gosāñi |*
*sannyāsa karāba tore — śunaha nimāñi || 92 ||*

*Word for word:* bujhila sakala kaja — understood everything; bharati gosani — Bharati Gosani; sannyasa karaba tore — I shall give You sannyasa; shunaha nimani — listen, Nimai

**92.** Bharati Gosani understood everything:
"I shall give You sannyasa, listen, Nimai."

এ বোল শুনিয়া প্রভু নাচয়ে আনন্দে ।
'হরি হরি' বোলয়ে গম্ভীর মেঘনাদে ॥ ৯৩ ॥

*e bola śuniẏā prabhu nācaẏe ānande |*
*'hari hari' bolaẏe gambhīra meghanāde || 93 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuniya — hearing this; prabhu nachaye anande — the Lord dances in joy; hari hari bolaye — cries "Hari, Hari"; gambhira meghanade — in a deep thundering voice

**93.** Hearing this, the Lord dances in joy
and cries "Hari, Hari!" in a deep voice like thunder.

গৌর-শরীরে ভেল পুলক সারি সারি ।
অমিয়া পসারে যেন অঙ্গের মাধুরী ॥ ৯৪ ॥

*gaura-śarīre bhela pulaka sāri sāri |*
*amiẏā pasāre yena aṅgera mādhurī || 94 ||*

*Word for word:* gaura-sharire — on Gaura's body; bhela pulaka sari sari — the hairs stood on end in rows; amiya pasare yena — as if spreading out a market of nectar; angera madhuri — the sweetness of His limbs

**94.** On Gaura's golden body the hairs stood on end in rows —
the sweetness of His body seemed to spread out a market of nectar.

অরুণ-নয়নে জল ঝরে অনিবার ।
দেখিয়া সকল লোক করে হাহাকার ॥ ৯৫ ॥

*aruṇa-naẏane jala jhare anibāra |*
*dekhiẏā sakala loka kare hāhākāra || 95 ||*

*Word for word:* aruna-nayane — from reddened eyes; jala jhare anivara — tears flow ceaselessly; dekhiya sakala loka — seeing this, all the people; kare hahakara — cry out in grief

**95.** From His reddened eyes tears flow ceaselessly;
seeing this, all the people cry out in grief.

নবদ্বীপ হৈতে গদাধর নরহরি ।
আসিয়া মিলিলা তারা বলি' হরি হরি ॥ ৯৫+১ ॥

*nabadbīpa haite gadādhara narahari |*
*āsiẏā mililā tārā bali' hari hari || 95+1 ||*
