*Word for word:* navadvipa haite — from Navadvipa; gadadhara narahari — Gadadhara and Narahari; asiya milila tara — came and joined; bali hari hari — crying "Hari, Hari"

**95+1.** From Navadvipa came Gadadhara and Narahari[^39-12]
and joined [them], crying "Hari, Hari!"

দণ্ডবত প্রণতি করিলা বহুতর ।
হাসিয়া করিলা কোলে শচীর কোঙর ॥ ৯৫+২ ॥

*daṇḍabata praṇati karilā bahutara |*
*hāsiẏā karilā kole śacīra koṅara || 95+2 ||*

*Word for word:* dandavata pranati — prostrations; karila bahutara — they made many times; hasiya karila kole — smiling, embraced; shachira kongara — Shachi's son

**95+2.** Many times they prostrated themselves [before the Lord],
and Shachi's son, smiling, embraced them.

প্রভু কহে — ভাল হৈল তোমরা আইলা ।
কৃষ্ণ-অনুগ্রহ-হেতু তোমরা মিলিলা ॥ ৯৫+৩ ॥

*prabhu kahe — bhāla haila tomarā āilā |*
*kṛṣṇa-anugraha-hetu tomarā mililā || 95+3 ||*

*Word for word:* prabhu kahe — the Lord says; bhala haila tomara aila — it is good you came; krishna-anugraha-hetu — by Krishna's grace; tomara milila — you have met [Me]

**95+3.** The Lord says: "It is good that you have come:
by Krishna's grace you have met [with Me].

আদ্যোপান্ত তোরা দুই সঙ্গী মোর সঙ্গে ।
তোদের দেখিয়া চিত্তে হয় বড় রঙ্গে ॥ ৯৫+৪ ॥

*ādyopānta torā dui saṅgī mora saṅge |*
*todera dekhiẏā citte haẏa baṛa raṅge || 95+4 ||*

*Word for word:* adyopanta — from beginning to end; tora dui sangi mora sange — you two are My companions; todera dekhiya — seeing you; chitte haya bada range — My heart rejoices

**95+4.** You two are My companions from beginning to end;
seeing you, My heart rejoices."

গৌর-মুখ দেখি' কান্দে দুই মহাশয় ।
ডাহিন বামেতে দোঁহে নিশ্চল রহয় ॥ ৯৫+৫ ॥

*gaura-mukha dekhi' kānde dui mahāśaẏa |*
*ḍāhina bāmete doṁhe niścala rahaẏa || 95+5 ||*

*Word for word:* gaura-mukha dekhi — looking at Gaura's face; kande dui mahashaya — the two great souls weep; dahina bamete — on the right and left; donhe nishchala rahaya — both stand motionless

**95+5.** Looking at Gaura's face, the two great souls weep;
both stand motionless to His right and left.

কাঞ্চননগরের লোক দেখিবারে ধায় ।
যে দেখয়ে — তার হিয়া-নয়ন জুড়ায় ॥ ৯৬ ॥

*kāñcananagarera loka dekhibāre dhāẏa |*
*ye dekhaẏe — tāra hiẏā-naẏana juṛāẏa || 96 ||*

*Word for word:* kanchana-nagarera loka — the people of Kanchananagara; dekhibare dhaya — run to see; ye dekhaye — whoever sees; tara hiya-nayana judaya — his heart and eyes are refreshed

**96.** The people of Kanchananagara run to see;
whoever sees [Him] — his heart and eyes are refreshed.

কিবা বৃদ্ধ, কিবা অন্ধ, কি নারী, পুরুষ ।
কিবা সে পণ্ডিতজন, এ গণ্ড-মুরুখ ॥ ৯৭ ॥

*kibā bṛddha, kibā andha, ki nārī, puruṣa |*
*kibā se paṇḍitajana, e gaṇḍa-murukha || 97 ||*

*Word for word:* kiba vriddha kiba andha — old people, the blind; ki nari purusha — women, men; kiba se panditajana — the learned; e ganda-murukha — and utter fools

**97.** Old people, the blind, women, men,
the learned and utter fools;

শিশুগণ ধায় আর কুলের যুবতী ।
নিজ ছায়া নাহি চিনে হেন রূপবতী ॥ ৯৮ ॥

*śiśugaṇa dhāẏa āra kulera yubatī |*
*nija chāẏā nāhi cine hena rūpabatī || 98 ||*

*Word for word:* shishugana dhaya — children run; ara kulera yuvati — and young women of noble families; nija chhaya nahi chine — who do not know their own shadow; hena rupavati — such beauties

**98.** children run, and young women of noble families —
so secluded they had never seen even their own shadow.[^39-13]

কাঁখে কুম্ভ করি' কেহো দাঁড়াইয়া চাহে ।
নড়িতে না পারে সেহ লড়ি ধরি' ধায়ে ॥ ৯৯ ॥

*kāṁkhe kumbha kari' keho dāṁṛāiẏā cāhe |*
*naṛite nā pāre seha laṛi dhari' dhāẏe || 99 ||*

*Word for word:* kankhe kumbha kari — with a pitcher on her hip; keho danraiya chahe — one stops and stares; nadite na pare — one who cannot walk; seha ladi dhari dhaye — hurries leaning on a stick

**99.** One, with a pitcher on her hip, has stopped and stares;
one who cannot walk hurries along leaning on a stick.

পঙ্গু সে আতুর কিবা গর্ভবতী নারী ।
শ্রীঅঙ্গ দেখিয়া সন্ন্যাসীরে পাড়ে গালি ॥ ১০০ ॥

*paṅgu se ātura kibā garbhabatī nārī |*
*śrīaṅga dekhiẏā sannyāsīre pāṛe gāli || 100 ||*

*Word for word:* pangu se atura — the lame, the infirm; kiba garbhavati nari — pregnant women; sri-anga dekhiya — seeing the holy body; sannyasire pade gali — revile the sannyasi

**100.** The lame, the infirm, pregnant women —
seeing His holy body, they revile the sannyasi.

এমন বালকে কেহো করায় সন্ন্যাস ।
সন্ন্যাসীর ধর্ম নহে, লোকে উপহাস ॥ ১০০+১ ॥

*emana bālake keho karāẏa sannyāsa |*
*sannyāsīra dharma nahe, loke upahāsa || 100+1 ||*

*Word for word:* emana balake — to such a boy; keho karaya sannyasa — who gives sannyasa; sannyasira dharma nahe — it is not a sannyasi's dharma; loke upahasa — people will mock

**100+1.** "Who gives sannyasa to such a boy?[^39-14]
It does not befit a sannyasi — people will laugh.

কঠিন অন্তর ইহার — দয়াহীন জন ।
নগরে না রাখি ইহায় — কহিল কথন ॥ ১০০+২ ॥

*kaṭhina antara ihāra — daẏāhīna jana |*
*nagare nā rākhi ihāẏa — kahila kathana || 100+2 ||*

*Word for word:* kathina antara ihara — hard is his heart; dayahina jana — a pitiless man; nagare na rakhi ihaya — let us not keep him in the town; kahila kathana — so they said

**100+2.** Hard is his heart, a pitiless man:
let us not keep him in the town!" — so they said.

সন্ন্যাসীরে সবে নিন্দা করে বারবার ।
গোরা-মুখ দেখি' সভার আনন্দ অপার ॥ ১০০+৩ ॥

*sannyāsīre sabe nindā kare bārabāra |*
*gorā-mukha dekhi' sabhāra ānanda apāra || 100+3 ||*

*Word for word:* sannyasire sabe ninda kare — all revile the sannyasi; bara-bara — again and again; gora-mukha dekhi — looking at Gora's face; sabhara ananda apara — all are in boundless joy

**100+3.** All revile the sannyasi again and again,
yet looking at Gora's face, all are in boundless joy.

ধন্য ধন্য করি' লোক বাখানয়ে রূপ ।
এতকালে দেখিল এ অতি অপরূপ ॥ ১০১ ॥

*dhanya dhanya kari' loka bākhānaẏe rūpa |*
*etakāle dekhila e ati aparūpa || 101 ||*

*Word for word:* dhanya dhanya kari — saying "blessed"; loka vakhanaye rupa — the people extol His beauty; etakale dekhila — at last we have seen; e ati aparupa — something so wondrous

**101.** "Blessed, blessed!" people say, extolling His beauty:
"At last we have seen something so wondrous!

ধন্য ধন্য জননী — ধরিল পুত্র গর্ভে ।
দেবকী-সমান সেই, শুনিয়াছি পূর্বে ॥ ১০২ ॥

*dhanya dhanya jananī — dharila putra garbhe |*
*debakī-samāna sei, śuniẏāchi pūrbe || 102 ||*

*Word for word:* dhanya dhanya janani — blessed is the mother; dharila putra garbhe — who bore the son in her womb; devaki-samana sei — she is like Devaki; shuniyachhi purve — of whom we heard of old

**102.** Blessed, blessed is the mother who bore [such] a son in her womb:
she is like Devaki, of whom we have heard of old.

কোন্ ভাগ্যবতী হেন পাইয়াছিল পতি ।
ত্রৈলোক্যে তাহার সম নাহি ভাগ্যবতী ॥ ১০৩ ॥

*kon bhāgyabatī hena pāiẏāchila pati |*
*trailokye tāhāra sama nāhi bhāgyabatī || 103 ||*

*Word for word:* kon bhagyavati — what fortunate woman; hena paiyachhila pati — obtained such a husband; trailokye tahara sama — in the three worlds her equal; nahi bhagyavati — in fortune there is none

**103.** What fortunate woman obtained such a husband?
In the three worlds there is none her equal in fortune.

রূপ দেখি' নিজ আঁখি পালটিতে নারি ।
ইঁহার সন্ন্যাস কিবা সহিবারে পারি ॥ ১০৪ ॥

*rūpa dekhi' nija āṁkhi pālaṭite nāri |*
*iṁhāra sannyāsa kibā sahibāre pāri || 104 ||*

*Word for word:* rupa dekhi — seeing the beauty; nija ankhi palatite nari — we cannot turn our eyes away; inhara sannyasa — His sannyasa; kiba sahibare pari — how can we bear

**104.** Seeing His beauty, we cannot turn our eyes away —
how shall we bear His sannyasa?

কেমনে বা জীবে সেই ইঁহার জননী ।
এ কথা শুনিলে মাত্র মরিবে রমণী ॥ ১০৫ ॥

*kemane bā jībe sei iṁhāra jananī |*
*e kathā śunile mātra maribe ramaṇī || 105 ||*

*Word for word:* kemane va jive — how will she live; sei inhara janani — His mother; e katha shunile matra — as soon as she hears this; maribe ramani — the woman will die

**105.** How will His mother live?
Hearing of this, she will die at once.

হেন বুঝি — মাতা পিতা নাহিক ইঁহার ।
ইঁহো সে অচ্যুতানন্দ সর্ব-বেদ-সার ॥ ১০৫+১ ॥

*hena bujhi — mātā pitā nāhika iṁhāra |*
*iṁho se acyutānanda sarba-beda-sāra || 105+1 ||*

*Word for word:* hena bujhi — so we think; mata pita nahika inhara — He has neither mother nor father; inho se achyutananda — He is unfailing bliss itself; sarva-veda-sara — the essence of all the Vedas

**105+1.** We think He has neither mother nor father:[^39-15]
He is Himself unfailing bliss (Achyuta-ananda), the essence of all the Vedas.

বৃন্দাবন-মাঝে কিবা রাধা হারাইয়া ।
তার অন্বেষণে বুলে কান্দিয়া কান্দিয়া ॥ ১০৫+২ ॥

*bṛndābana-mājhe kibā rādhā hārāiẏā |*
*tāra anbeṣaṇe bule kāndiẏā kāndiẏā || 105+2 ||*

*Word for word:* vrindavana-majhe — in Vrindavana; kiba radha haraiya — having perhaps lost Radha; tara anveshane — in search of Her; bule kandiya kandiya — He wanders weeping and weeping

**105+2.** Has He perhaps lost Radha in Vrindavana?
Searching for Her, He wanders weeping and weeping.

সে বিরহে ভেল ইঁহার সন্ন্যাস-করণ ।
নিশ্চয় জানিল — এই নন্দের নন্দন ॥ ১০৫+৩ ॥

*se birahe bhela iṁhāra sannyāsa-karaṇa |*
*niścaẏa jānila — ei nandera nandana || 105+3 ||*

*Word for word:* se virahe — from that separation; bhela inhara sannyasa-karana — He is taking sannyasa; nishchaya janila — we know for certain; ei nandera nandana — this is Nanda's son

**105+3.** Because of that separation He is taking sannyasa:
we know for certain — this is the son of Nanda."

এত অনুমান করি' কান্দে সব লোক ।
ডাকিয়া কহয়ে প্রভু — না করিহ শোক ॥ ১০৬ ॥

*eta anumāna kari' kānde saba loka |*
*ḍākiẏā kahaẏe prabhu — nā kariha śoka || 106 ||*

*Word for word:* eta anumana kari — thinking thus; kande saba loka — all the people weep; dakiya kahaye prabhu — the Lord calls and says; na kariha shoka — do not grieve

**106.** Thinking thus, all the people weep.
The Lord calls them and says: "Do not grieve.

আশীর্বাদ কর মোরে — শুন মাতা পিতা ।
সাধ লাগে কৃষ্ণের চরণে দেঙ মাথা ॥ ১০৭ ॥

*āśīrbāda kara more — śuna mātā pitā |*
*sādha lāge kṛṣṇera caraṇe deṅa māthā || 107 ||*

*Word for word:* ashirvada kara more — bless Me; shuna mata pita — mothers and fathers; sadha lage — I long; krishnera charane denga matha — to lay My head at Krishna's feet

**107.** Bless Me, mothers and fathers:
I long to lay My head at Krishna's feet.

যার যেই নিজ পতি সেই তাহা চাহে ।
তার চিত্ত বান্ধিবারে করয়ে উপায়ে ॥ ১০৮ ॥

*yāra yei nija pati sei tāhā cāhe |*
*tāra citta bāndhibāre karaẏe upāẏe || 108 ||*

*Word for word:* yara yei nija pati — she who has her own husband; sei taha chahe — longs for him; tara chitta bandhibare — to bind his heart; karaye upaye — seeks means

**108.** She who has her own husband longs for him
and seeks means to bind his heart.

রূপ, যৌবন যত এ রস-লাবণ্য ।
নিজ পতি ভজিলে সে সব হয় ধন্য ॥ ১০৯ ॥

*rūpa, yaubana yata e rasa-lābaṇya |*
*nija pati bhajile se saba haẏa dhanya || 109 ||*

*Word for word:* rupa yauvana yata — beauty, youth, all; e rasa-lavanya — this rasa and loveliness; nija pati bhajile — in serving one's own husband; se saba haya dhanya — all becomes blessed

**109.** Beauty, youth, all this rasa and loveliness —
all is blessed when it serves one's own husband.

মনে মনে কর এ সভার অনুভব ।
পতি বিনু যুবতীর মিছা হয় সব ॥ ১১০ ॥

*mane mane kara e sabhāra anubhaba |*
*pati binu yubatīra michā haẏa saba || 110 ||*

*Word for word:* mane mane kara — consider in your hearts; e sabhara anubhava — all of you, this; pati vinu — without a husband; yuvatira michha haya saba — all a young woman has is vain

**110.** Consider this, all of you, in your hearts:
without a husband, all a young woman has is in vain.

কৃষ্ণপদ বিনু মোর নাহি অন্য গতি ।
নিজ অঙ্গ দিয়া মুঞি ভজিব প্রাণপতি ॥ ১১১ ॥

*kṛṣṇapada binu mora nāhi anya gati |*
*nija aṅga diẏā muñi bhajiba prāṇapati || 111 ||*

*Word for word:* krishna-pada vinu — apart from Krishna's feet; mora nahi anya gati — I have no other refuge; nija anga diya — giving My whole Self; munni bhajiba pranapati — I shall serve the Lord of My life

**111.** Apart from Krishna's feet I have no other refuge:
giving My whole Self, I shall serve the Lord of My life."[^39-16]

ইহা বলি' মহাপ্রভু করিয়ে রোদন ।
ক্ষণেক অন্তরে সব কৈল সম্বরণ ॥ ১১২ ॥

*ihā bali' mahāprabhu kariẏe rodana |*
*kṣaṇeka antare saba kaila sambaraṇa || 112 ||*

*Word for word:* iha bali — saying this; mahaprabhu kariye rodana — Mahaprabhu wept; kshaneka antare — after a moment; saba kaila samvarana — He held everything back

**112.** Saying this, Mahaprabhu wept,
but in a moment He held everything back [within Himself].

[^39-1]: The OCR of the summary is badly garbled; gaps are filled by sense and from the table of contents in the edition's preface (ch. 13: "consolation of the devotees by instruction in the truth; leaving home, the Lord goes to Kantakanagara, to Keshava Bharati; Nityananda Prabhu consoles Shachi and Vishnupriya; Nityananda's coming to Kantakanagara with Chandrashekhara Acharya, Damodara Pandita and other devotees; the Lord's request for the sannyasa mantra, Bharati's refusal and consent; the Lord speaks the sannyasa mantra into Bharati's ear; the grief of the villagers; the Lord consoles them and, as a devotee, asks for devotion to Krishna; the Lord's sannyasa name — Sri Krishna Chaitanya; after sannyasa, wandering in Radha-desha absorbed in prema"). The summary runs ahead: the end of the section is in the next portion. In the 1983 edition the disha is longer: "Why have You become like this, Gauranga, why? Why have You given up the dress of the best of dancers? Stand just a moment on the bank of the Ganga, Nimai, let me gaze at Your moon-face — and then go. If You will keep one word of mine, Nimai — no need of sannyasa, stay at home. Do not become a sannyasi, Nimai, do not become a vairagi, do not leave Your unfortunate mother. Your mother calls: stay, O Gauranga; do not go leaving Your mother, O Gauranga!"
[^39-2]: Kantakanagara is Katwa, on the west bank of the Ganga. Below (vv. 38, 51, 96) Lochana Dasa calls it Kanchananagara; the 1983 edition has that name here too.
[^39-3]: According to svara-shastra, setting out when the breath flows through the right nostril is a good omen.
[^39-4]: Cf. Murari 3.1.7: "Bhagavan crossed the divine river and went away."
[^39-5]: That is, like Krishna entering the arena against Kamsa's wrestlers in Mathura.
[^39-6]: Lochana Dasa here depicts the Lord in the mood of Krishna pining for Radha; according to the teaching of the Gaudiya Vaishnavas (Krishnadasa Kaviraja, Bhaktisiddhanta), Gaura is Krishna in the bhava of Radha, tasting Her love for Krishna; so Bhaktisiddhanta also interprets a similar passage above (en/35, note 5).
[^39-7]: "Narayana!" is the customary greeting of sannyasis.
[^39-8]: Bharati speaks by the general rule of sannyasa, that with age the senses grow calm. Worldly passions have no bearing on the Lord, whose body and senses are spiritual; in the lila Bharati speaks to Him as to a young brahmana.
[^39-9]: Maya here means "dissembling, pretence": the Lord asks Bharati not to evade Him with plausible excuses. So also in v. 67.
[^39-10]: Cf. Murari 3.2.7–9: "Thus the one Lord of the worlds… on a plausible pretext gave initiation to His own guru." On the meaning of the sannyasa mantra see en/35, note 10. In the lila Keshava Bharati is the Lord's sannyasa-guru; the Lord, the guru of the world, Himself accepts him as guru in order to establish reverence for the guru.
[^39-11]: Vv. 91+1 — 91+3 are found only in the 1983 edition; in the 1903 edition they are in a footnote, as an additional reading of one manuscript (with one more couplet).
[^39-12]: Vv. 95+1 — 95+5 are found only in the 1983 edition; in the 1903 edition they are in a footnote, as an additional reading of one manuscript. Narahari Sarakara is Lochana Dasa's guru. The Chaitanya-bhagavata (Madhya 28) also speaks of Gadadhara at Katwa.
[^39-13]: Lit. "so beautiful that they do not recognise their own shadow" — that is, they live in seclusion and never go out in public.
[^39-14]: Vv. 100+1 — 100+3 are found only in the 1983 edition; in the 1903 edition they are in a footnote, as an additional reading of one manuscript.
[^39-15]: Vv. 105+1 — 105+3 are found only in the 1983 edition; in the 1903 edition they are in a footnote, as an additional reading of one manuscript. Vv. 96–107 — cf. Murari 3.1.10–18 and 3.2.2.
[^39-16]: The Lord speaks in the mood of a gopi: Krishna is the one husband of all souls (cf. en/38, note 7).

---

# Madhya-khanda, part 17 (portion 40)

*The section "The Lord's Sannyasa" (conclusion): the Lord has His head shaved and receives the sannyasa mantra from Keshava Bharati; a voice from the sky names Him Sri Krishna Chaitanya; night kirtana with the guru; farewell to Bharati; three days absorbed in prema in Radha-desha; the Lord sends Chandrashekhara back to Navadvipa*

পুনরপি ন্যাসিবরে করয়ে প্রণাম ।
আপন অন্তরকথা মাগয়ে বিধান ॥ ১১৩ ॥

*punarapi nyāsibare karaẏe praṇāma |*
*āpana antarakathā māgaẏe bidhāna || 113 ||*

*Word for word:* punarapi — again; nyasivare karaye pranama — He bows to the best of sannyasis; apana antara-katha — [telling] what is in His heart; magaye vidhana — asks for the prescribed procedure

**113.** Again He bows to the best of sannyasis,
opens His heart to him and asks to be instructed in the rite.

তার পর-দিনে প্রভু গুরু-আজ্ঞা লঞা ।
সন্ন্যাস-বিধান-কর্ম করয়ে হাসিয়া ॥ ১১৪ ॥

*tāra para-dine prabhu guru-ājñā lañā |*
*sannyāsa-bidhāna-karma karaẏe hāsiẏā || 114 ||*

*Word for word:* tara para-dine — on the next day; prabhu guru-ajna lanya — the Lord, taking the guru's leave; sannyasa-vidhana-karma — the rites prescribed for sannyasa; karaye hasiya — performs smiling

**114.** The next day the Lord, taking the guru's leave,
smilingly performs the rites prescribed for sannyasa.

করিল সকল কর্ম যে ছিল বিহিত ।
'সন্ন্যাস করিব' বলি' আনন্দিত চিত ॥ ১১৫ ॥

*karila sakala karma ye chila bihita |*
*'sannyāsa kariba' bali' ānandita cita || 115 ||*

*Word for word:* karila sakala karma — He performed all the rites; ye chhila vihita — that were prescribed; sannyasa kariba bali — saying "I shall take sannyasa"; anandita chita — with a joyful heart

**115.** He performed all the prescribed rites,
His heart rejoicing: "I shall take sannyasa!"

আপনে আচার্যরত্ন কৃষ্ণপূজা করে ।
চৌদিগে বৈষ্ণব সব হরি হরি বোলে ॥ ১১৬ ॥

*āpane ācāryaratna kṛṣṇapūjā kare |*
*caudige baiṣṇaba saba hari hari bole || 116 ||*

*Word for word:* apane acharyaratna — Acharyaratna himself; krishna-puja kare — performs the worship of Krishna; chaudige vaishnava saba — all around, the Vaishnavas; hari hari bole — say "Hari, Hari!"

**116.** Acharyaratna himself performs the worship of Krishna,[^40-1]
and all around the Vaishnavas cry, "Hari, Hari!"

গুরুর সম্মুখে রহে পুটাঞ্জলি করি' ।
মাগয়ে সন্ন্যাস-মন্ত্র প্রণাম করি' ॥ ১১৭ ॥

*gurura sammukhe rahe puṭāñjali kari' |*
*māgaẏe sannyāsa-mantra praṇāma kari' || 117 ||*

*Word for word:* gurura sammukhe rahe — He stands before the guru; putanjali kari — with joined palms; magaye sannyasa-mantra — asks for the sannyasa mantra; pranama kari — bowing

**117.** With joined palms [the Lord] stands before the guru
and, bowing, asks for the sannyasa mantra.

মুণ্ডন করিল প্রভু — শুন তার কথা ।
যা শুনিলে সভার হৃদয়ে লাগে ব্যথা ॥ ১১৮ ॥

*muṇḍana karila prabhu — śuna tāra kathā |*
*yā śunile sabhāra hṛdaẏe lāge byathā || 118 ||*

*Word for word:* mundana karila prabhu — the Lord had His head shaved; shuna tara katha — hear the account of it; ya shunile — hearing which; sabhara hridaye lage vyatha — everyone's heart aches

**118.** The Lord had His head shaved — hear of it:
the heart of everyone who hears it aches.

সকল বৈষ্ণবজনে লাগে হিয়া-কাঁপ ।
মুণ্ডনের কালে বস্ত্রে মুখে দেই ঝাঁপ ॥ ১১৯ ॥

*sakala baiṣṇabajane lāge hiẏā-kāṁpa |*
*muṇḍanera kāle bastre mukhe dei jhāṁpa || 119 ||*

*Word for word:* sakala vaishnava-jane — in all the Vaishnavas; lage hiya-kanpa — the heart trembles; mundanera kale — at the time of shaving; vastre mukhe dei jhanpa — they cover their faces with cloth

**119.** The hearts of all the Vaishnavas trembled:
while He was being shaved, they covered their faces with cloth.

কমলা-লালিত কেশ ত্রৈলোক্যসুন্দর ।
মালার সহিত নাম্বে এ গজকন্ধর ॥ ১২০ ॥

*kamalā-lālita keśa trailokyasundara |*
*mālāra sahita nāmbe e gajakandhara || 120 ||*

*Word for word:* kamala-lalita kesha — the hair cherished by Kamala (Lakshmi); trailokya-sundara — the most beautiful in the three worlds; malara sahita — together with the garland; nambe e gaja-kandhara — flowing down to these elephant-like shoulders

**120.** The hair cherished by Kamala, the most beautiful in the three worlds,
which with the garland flowed down to His shoulders, mighty as an elephant's;

পূরুবে চূড়ার বেশে মোহিল জগত ।
যাহার ধেয়ানে জীয়ে সকল ভকত ॥ ১২১ ॥

*pūrube cūṛāra beśe mohila jagata |*
*yāhāra dheẏāne jīẏe sakala bhakata || 121 ||*

*Word for word:* purube — formerly; chudara veshe — dressed in a chuda (topknot with peacock feather); mohila jagata — enchanted the world; yahara dheyane — by meditation on which; jiye sakala bhakata — all devotees live

**121.** which once, dressed in a chuda, enchanted the world,[^40-2] —
by meditating on it all the devotees live;

গোপবধূ যাহা লাগি' ছাড়িলেক লাজ ।
জাতি-কুল-শীল-ভয়ে পাড়িলেক বাজ ॥ ১২২ ॥

*gopabadhū yāhā lāgi' chāṛileka lāja |*
*jāti-kula-śīla-bhaẏe pāṛileka bāja || 122 ||*

*Word for word:* gopa-vadhu yaha lagi — for whose sake the cowherd wives; chhadileka laja — gave up shyness; jati-kula-shila-bhaye — on the fear of caste, family and conduct; padileka baja — brought down a thunderbolt (cast it off)

**122.** for its sake the cowherd wives gave up their modesty
and shattered, as with a thunderbolt, their fear for caste, family and good name;

যার গুণগানে শিব, বিরিঞ্চি, নারদ ।
আপনারে ধন্য মানে — সকল সম্পদ ॥ ১২৩ ॥

*yāra guṇagāne śiba, biriñci, nārada |*
*āpanāre dhanya māne — sakala sampada || 123 ||*

*Word for word:* yara guna-gane — in singing their glory; shiva virinchi narada — Shiva, Brahma, Narada; apanare dhanya mane — consider themselves blessed; sakala sampada — [it is] all their wealth

**123.** singing its glory, Shiva, Brahma and Narada
count themselves blessed — it is all their wealth.

হেন কেশ মুণ্ডন করিতে চাহে পহুঁ ।
কান্দয়ে সকল লোক — না তুলয়ে মুহুঁ ॥ ১২৪ ॥

*hena keśa muṇḍana karite cāhe pahuṁ |*
*kāndaẏe sakala loka — nā tulaẏe muhuṁ || 124 ||*

*Word for word:* hena kesha — such hair; mundana karite chahe pahun — the Lord wishes to shave off; kandaye sakala loka — all the people weep; na tulaye muhun — they do not raise their faces

**124.** Such hair the Lord wishes to shave off, —
all the people weep and do not raise their faces.

নাপিত আনিয়া বৈল বচন বিনয় ।
কৃষ্ণ ভজি' তুমি মোর হও ত সহায় ॥ ১২৪+১ ॥

*nāpita āniẏā baila bacana binaẏa |*
*kṛṣṇa bhaji' tumi mora hao ta sahāẏa || 124+1 ||*

*Word for word:* napita aniya — bringing a barber; baila bachana vinaya — He spoke humble words; krishna bhaji — in worshipping Krishna; tumi mora hao ta sahaya — be My helper

**124+1.** Calling a barber, [the Lord] spoke to him humbly:[^40-3]
"Help Me in the service of Krishna.

আমি ত সন্ন্যাসী হৈয়া কৃষ্ণের হইব ।
মস্তক মুণ্ডন কর — তোর ভাগ্য হব ॥ ১২৪+২ ॥

*āmi ta sannyāsī haiẏā kṛṣṇera haiba |*
*mastaka muṇḍana kara — tora bhāgya haba || 124+2 ||*

*Word for word:* ami ta sannyasi haiya — I, becoming a sannyasi; krishnera haiba — shall become Krishna's; mastaka mundana kara — shave My head; tora bhagya haba — it will be your good fortune

**124+2.** Becoming a sannyasi, I shall belong to Krishna:
shave My head — it will be your good fortune."

নাপিত না দেই হাথ শিরের উপরে ।
তরাসে তাহার অঙ্গ করে থরথরে ॥ ১২৫ ॥

*nāpita nā dei hātha śirera upare |*
*tarāse tāhāra aṅga kare tharathare || 125 ||*

*Word for word:* napita na dei hatha — the barber does not put his hand; shirera upare — on the head; tarase — out of fear; tahara anga kare tharathare — his body trembles

**125.** The barber does not put his hand on His head:
his whole body trembles with fear.

মোর ভাগ্য নাই প্রভু, যাই সর্বথায় ।
কেমনে বা হাত দিব তোমার মাথায় ॥ ১২৫+১ ॥

*mora bhāgya nāi prabhu, yāi sarbathāẏa |*
*kemane bā hāta diba tomāra māthāẏa || 125+1 ||*

*Word for word:* mora bhagya nai prabhu — I have no fortune, Lord; yai sarvathaya — I am utterly lost; kemane va hata diba — how shall I put my hand; tomara mathaya — on Your head

**125+1.** "I have no such fortune, Lord, — I am utterly lost:[^40-4]
how can I put my hand on Your head?

যদি মোর কুষ্ঠ হই' গলুক সব অঙ্গ ।
কংসে নরকে যাই — শুনহ গৌরাঙ্গ ॥ ১২৫+২ ॥

*yadi mora kuṣṭha hai' galuka saba aṅga |*
*kaṃse narake yāi — śunaha gaurāṅga || 125+2 ||*

*Word for word:* yadi mora kushtha hai — even if I get leprosy; galuka saba anga — let all my limbs rot; kamse narake yai — let me go to hell like Kamsa; shunaha gauranga — hear, Gauranga

**125+2.** Let me get leprosy and all my body rot away,
let me go to hell like Kamsa, — hear me, Gauranga, —

তথাপি তোমার শিরে হাত দিতে নারি ।
বিনয় করিয়া বলি — শুন গৌরহরি ॥ ১২৫+৩ ॥

*tathāpi tomāra śire hāta dite nāri |*
*binaẏa kariẏā bali — śuna gaurahari || 125+3 ||*

*Word for word:* tathapi — even so; tomara shire hata dite nari — I cannot put my hand on Your head; vinaya kariya bali — I say humbly; shuna gaurahari — hear, Gaurahari

**125+3.** still I cannot put my hand on Your head:
humbly I tell You, hear me, Gaurahari."

কণ্টকনগরের লোক এ নারী-পুরুষে ।
ফুকরি' ফুকরি' কান্দে সকরুণ ভাষে ॥ ১২৬ ॥

*kaṇṭakanagarera loka e nārī-puruṣe |*
*phukari' phukari' kānde sakaruṇa bhāṣe || 126 ||*

*Word for word:* kantaka-nagarera loka — the people of Kantakanagara; e nari-purushe — women and men; phukari phukari kande — weep aloud; sakaruna bhashe — in piteous voices

**126.** The people of Kantakanagara, women and men,
weep aloud in piteous voices.

নাপিত কহয়ে — প্রভু, নিবেদি চরণে ।
তোর শিরে হাথ দিব কাহার পরাণে ॥ ১২৭ ॥

*nāpita kahaẏe — prabhu, nibedi caraṇe |*
*tora śire hātha diba kāhāra parāṇe || 127 ||*

*Word for word:* napita kahaye — the barber says; prabhu nivedi charane — Lord, I submit at Your feet; tora shire hatha diba — to put my hand on Your head; kahara parane — with whose heart (how could I dare)

**127.** The barber says: "Lord, I pray at Your feet:
how could I dare to put my hand on Your head?

আমার শকতি নাহি করিতে মুণ্ডন ।
সুন্দর কুঞ্চিত কেশ ত্রৈলোক্য-মোহন ॥ ১২৮ ॥

*āmāra śakati nāhi karite muṇḍana |*
*sundara kuñcita keśa trailokya-mohana || 128 ||*

*Word for word:* amara shakati nahi — I have no power; karite mundana — to shave; sundara kunchita kesha — the beautiful curling hair; trailokya-mohana — enchanting the three worlds

**128.** I have no strength to shave off
this beautiful curling hair that enchants the three worlds.

দেখিতে শীতল হয় হৃদয়-নয়ন ।
যে কর সে কর প্রভু, না কর মুণ্ডন ॥ ১২৯ ॥

*dekhite śītala haẏa hṛdaẏa-naẏana |*
*ye kara se kara prabhu, nā kara muṇḍana || 129 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhite — on seeing [it]; shitala haya hridaya-nayana — heart and eyes are cooled; ye kara se kara prabhu — do what You will, Lord; na kara mundana — do not shave

**129.** One look at it brings coolness to heart and eyes.
Do whatever You will, Lord, only do not shave it.

এরূপ মানুষ নাই জগত-ভিতর ।
তুমি সর্বলোকনাথ — জানিল অন্তর ॥ ১৩০ ॥

*erūpa mānuṣa nāi jagata-bhitara |*
*tumi sarbalokanātha — jānila antara || 130 ||*

*Word for word:* e-rupa manusha nai — there is no such man; jagata-bhitara — in the world; tumi sarvaloka-natha — You are the Lord of all worlds; janila antara — my heart has understood

**130.** There is no one in the world like You:
You are the Lord of all the worlds — my heart has understood."

এ বোল শুনিঞা প্রভু অসন্তোষ পায় ।
বুঝিয়া নাপিত কাজ অন্তরে ডরায় ॥ ১৩১ ॥

*e bola śuniñā prabhu asantoṣa pāẏa |*
*bujhiẏā nāpita kāja antare ḍarāẏa || 131 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuninya — hearing these words; prabhu asantosha paya — the Lord is displeased; bujhiya napita kaja — the barber, understanding this; antare daraya — is frightened at heart

**131.** Hearing these words, the Lord is displeased;
seeing this, the barber grows afraid at heart

পুনঃ নিবেদন করে অন্তরে কাতর ।
কেমনে বা হাথ দিব এ শির-উপর ॥ ১৩২ ॥

*punaḥ nibedana kare antare kātara |*
*kemane bā hātha diba e śira-upara || 132 ||*

*Word for word:* punah nivedana kare — again he pleads; antare katara — distressed at heart; kemane va hatha diba — how shall I put my hand; e shira-upara — on this head

**132.** and pleads again, distressed within:
"How shall I put my hand on this head?

অপরাধ লাগি' মোর ডরে হালে গা ।
তোর শিরে হাথ দিয়া ছোঁব কার পা ॥ ১৩৩ ॥

*aparādha lāgi' mora ḍare hāle gā |*
*tora śire hātha diẏā choṁba kāra pā || 133 ||*

*Word for word:* aparadha lagi — for fear of offence; mora dare hale ga — my body shakes with fear; tora shire hatha diya — having touched Your head; chhonba kara pa — whose feet shall I touch

**133.** I fear to offend — my body shakes with fear:
having touched Your head, whose feet shall I touch afterwards?[^40-5]

কার পায় হাথ দিয়া করিব নিজবৃত্তি ।
অধম নাপিত মুঞি হঙ ছার জাতি ॥ ১৩৪ ॥

*kāra pāẏa hātha diẏā kariba nijabṛtti |*
*adhama nāpita muñi haṅa chāra jāti || 134 ||*

*Word for word:* kara paya hatha diya — touching whose feet; kariba nija-vritti — shall I ply my trade; adhama napita munni — I am a lowly barber; hanga chhara jati — of a wretched caste

**134.** Touching whose feet shall I ply my trade?
I am a lowly barber, of a wretched caste."

এ বোল শুনিঞা প্রভু সদয়-হৃদয় ।
না করিহ বৃত্তি তুমি — ঠাকুর কহয় ॥ ১৩৫ ॥

*e bola śuniñā prabhu sadaẏa-hṛdaẏa |*
*nā kariha bṛtti tumi — ṭhākura kahaẏa || 135 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuninya — hearing this; prabhu sadaya-hridaya — the Lord, compassionate at heart; na kariha vritti tumi — do not ply your trade; thakura kahaya — says the Lord

**135.** Hearing this, the compassionate Lord
says: "Ply your trade no more."

প্রভু বলে — শুন রে নাপিত হরিদাস ।
মুণ্ডন করহ, আমি করিব সন্ন্যাস ॥ ১৩৫+১ ॥

*prabhu bale — śuna re nāpita haridāsa |*
*muṇḍana karaha, āmi kariba sannyāsa || 135+1 ||*

*Word for word:* prabhu bale — the Lord says; shuna re napita haridasa — listen, Haridasa the barber; mundana karaha — shave [Me]; ami kariba sannyasa — I shall take sannyasa

**135+1.** The Lord says:[^40-6] "Listen, Haridasa the barber:
shave Me — I shall take sannyasa.

কৃষ্ণের প্রসাদে জন্ম সুখে গোঙাইবে ।
অন্তকালে বাস তোর মোর লোকে হবে ॥ ১৩৬ ॥

*kṛṣṇera prasāde janma sukhe goṅāibe |*
*antakāle bāsa tora mora loke habe || 136 ||*

*Word for word:* krishnera prasade — by Krishna's grace; janma sukhe gongaibe — you will pass your life happily; anta-kale — at the end; vasa tora mora loke habe — your dwelling will be in My abode

**136.** By Krishna's grace you will pass your life happily,
and at the end your dwelling will be in My abode.

আমার মুণ্ডন করি' যত অস্ত্রগণ ।
গঙ্গাজল-মাঝে লৈয়া কর সমর্পণ ॥ ১৩৬+১ ॥

*āmāra muṇḍana kari' yata astragaṇa |*
*gaṅgājala-mājhe laiẏā kara samarpaṇa || 136+1 ||*

*Word for word:* amara mundana kari — having shaved Me; yata astragana — all the instruments; ganga-jala-majhe laiya — taking them into the Ganga's waters; kara samarpana — consign them

**136+1.** Having shaved Me, take all the instruments[^40-7]
and give them over to the waters of the Ganga."

শুনি' হরিদাস মনে ভাবিতে লাগিল ।
আমার মঙ্গল কর্ম কভু না হইল ॥ ১৩৬+২ ॥

*śuni' haridāsa mane bhābite lāgila |*
*āmāra maṅgala karma kabhu nā haila || 136+2 ||*

*Word for word:* shuni haridasa — hearing, Haridasa; mane bhavite lagila — began to think; amara mangala karma — an auspicious deed for me; kabhu na haila — has never come

**136+2.** Hearing this, Haridasa began to think:
"No good lot ever falls to me:

মুণ্ডন করিয়া যদি তবুহ বিনাশ ।
মুণ্ডন না কৈলেও মোর হবে সর্বনাশ ॥ ১৩৬+৩ ॥

*muṇḍana kariẏā yadi tabuha bināśa |*
*muṇḍana nā kaileo mora habe sarbanāśa || 136+3 ||*

*Word for word:* mundana kariya yadi — if I shave; tabuha vinasha — still ruin; mundana na kaileo — and if I do not shave; mora habe sarvanasha — I shall be utterly ruined

**136+3.** if I shave Him — ruin all the same,
and if I do not shave Him — I am undone.

ইঁহারে পিরীতি করি' — যে হয় সে হোক ।
ধর্মাধর্ম-পরমাত্মা এই পরতেক ॥ ১৩৬+৪ ॥

*iṁhāre pirīti kari' — ye haẏa se hoka |*
*dharmādharma-paramātmā ei parateka || 136+4 ||*

*Word for word:* inhare piriti kari — out of love for Him; ye haya se hoka — come what may; dharmadharma-paramatma — the Supreme Self, [arbiter of] dharma and adharma; ei parateka — here He is, manifest

**136+4.** I will do it out of love for Him — come what may:
here He is before my eyes — the Supreme Self, who rules dharma and adharma."

মুণ্ডনের কালে সে নাপিতে বর পায় ।
কাতর-হৃদয়ে এ লোচন দাস গায় ॥ ১৩৭ ॥

*muṇḍanera kāle se nāpite bara pāẏa |*
*kātara-hṛdaẏe e locana dāsa gāẏa || 137 ||*

*Word for word:* mundanera kale — at the time of shaving; se napite vara paya — that barber receives a boon; katara-hridaye — with a stricken heart; e lochana dasa gaya — this Lochana Dasa sings

**137.** At the time of the shaving that barber received a blessing;
with a stricken heart Lochana Dasa sings of it.

*Raga purabi-sindhura*

মুণ্ডন করিল প্রভু দেখি' শুভক্ষণে ।
সন্ন্যাস করয়ে শুভদিনে সংক্রমণে ॥ ১৩৮ ॥

*muṇḍana karila prabhu dekhi' śubhakṣaṇe |*
*sannyāsa karaẏe śubhadine saṃkramaṇe || 138 ||*

*Word for word:* mundana karila prabhu — the Lord had His head shaved; dekhi shubha-kshane — choosing an auspicious moment; sannyasa karaye — takes sannyasa; shubha-dine sankramane — on the auspicious day of the sankranti (the sun's transit)

**138.** Choosing an auspicious moment, the Lord had His head shaved
and takes sannyasa on the auspicious day of the sankranti.

মকর লেউটে কুম্ভ আইসে হেন বেলে ।
সন্ন্যাসের মন্ত্র গুরু কহে হেনকালে ॥ ১৩৯ ॥

*makara leuṭe kumbha āise hena bele |*
*sannyāsera mantra guru kahe henakāle || 139 ||*

*Word for word:* makara leute — [when the sun] turns from Makara (Capricorn); kumbha aise — and enters Kumbha (Aquarius); hena bele — at such an hour; sannyasera mantra guru kahe — the guru speaks the sannyasa mantra; hena-kale — at that time

**139.** At the hour when [the sun] leaves Makara and enters Kumbha,[^40-8]
the guru speaks the sannyasa mantra.

চৌদিগে বৈষ্ণবগণ করে সংকীর্তনে ।
মন্ত্র কহে ন্যাসী বিশ্বম্ভরের শ্রবণে ॥ ১৪০ ॥

*caudige baiṣṇabagaṇa kare saṃkīrtane |*
*mantra kahe nyāsī biśbambharera śrabaṇe || 140 ||*

*Word for word:* chaudige vaishnava-gana — all around the Vaishnavas; kare sankirtane — perform sankirtana; mantra kahe nyasi — the sannyasi speaks the mantra; vishvambharera shravane — into Vishvambhara's ear

**140.** All around, the Vaishnavas perform sankirtana,
and the sannyasi speaks the mantra into Vishvambhara's ear.

মন্ত্র পাঞা বিশ্বম্ভর পুলকিত-অঙ্গ ।
শতগুণ বাঢ়ে কৃষ্ণপ্রেমার তরঙ্গ ॥ ১৪১ ॥

*mantra pāñā biśbambhara pulakita-aṅga |*
*śataguṇa bāṛhe kṛṣṇapremāra taraṅga || 141 ||*

*Word for word:* mantra panya — receiving the mantra; vishvambhara pulakita-anga — Vishvambhara's body thrills; shataguna badhe — swell a hundredfold; krishna-premara taranga — the waves of love for Krishna

**141.** Receiving the mantra, Vishvambhara thrilled all over:
the waves of love for Krishna swelled a hundredfold.

অরুণ-নয়নে জল ঝরে অনিবার ।
ক্ষণে মালসাট মারে, ছাড়ে হুহুঙ্কার ॥ ১৪২ ॥

*aruṇa-naẏane jala jhare anibāra |*
*kṣaṇe mālasāṭa māre, chāṛe huhuṅkāra || 142 ||*

*Word for word:* aruna-nayane — from the reddened eyes; jala jhare anivara — tears flow ceaselessly; kshane malasata mare — now He slaps His arms; chhade huhunkara — lets out a roar

**142.** From His reddened eyes tears flow ceaselessly;
now He slaps His arms, now He lets out a roar.

'সন্ন্যাস করিল' ইহা বলিয়া উল্লাস ।
পুনঃ পুনঃ প্রেমানন্দে অট্ট-অট্ট হাস ॥ ১৪৩ ॥

*'sannyāsa karila' ihā baliẏā ullāsa |*
*punaḥ punaḥ premānande aṭṭa-aṭṭa hāsa || 143 ||*

*Word for word:* sannyasa karila — "I have taken sannyasa!"; iha baliya ullasa — saying this, He exults; punah punah premanande — again and again in the bliss of prema; atta-atta hasa — laughs aloud

**143.** "I have taken sannyasa!" He says, exulting,
and again and again laughs aloud in the bliss of prema.[^40-9]

কাঞ্চননগরের সে রূপ দেখিয়া ।
নিশ্চয় জানিল এই রাসবিনোদিয়া ॥ ১৪৩+১ ॥

*kāñcananagarera se rūpa dekhiẏā |*
*niścaẏa jānila ei rāsabinodiẏā || 143+1 ||*

*Word for word:* kanchana-nagarera — [the people] of Kanchananagara; se rupa dekhiya — seeing that beauty; nishchaya janila — knew for certain; ei rasa-vinodiya — this is He who delights in the rasa dance

**143+1.** [The people] of Kanchananagara, seeing that beauty,[^40-10]
knew for certain: this is He who delights in the rasa dance.

ভক্তগণ মুখ হেরি' নাচয়ে আনন্দে ।
আপনে ঠাকুর নাচে, নাচে নিত্যানন্দে ॥ ১৪৩+২ ॥

*bhaktagaṇa mukha heri' nācaẏe ānande |*
*āpane ṭhākura nāce, nāce nityānande || 143+2 ||*

*Word for word:* bhakta-gana mukha heri — the devotees, gazing at [His] face; nachaye anande — dance in bliss; apane thakura nache — the Lord Himself dances; nache nityanande — Nityananda dances

**143+2.** Gazing at His face, the devotees dance in bliss;
the Lord Himself dances, Nityananda dances.

করতাল মৃদঙ্গ আর কীর্তনের রোল ।
চৌদিগে সকল লোক বলে হরিবোল ॥ ১৪৩+৩ ॥

*karatāla mṛdaṅga āra kīrtanera rola |*
*caudige sakala loka bale haribola || 143+3 ||*

*Word for word:* karatala mridanga — cymbals, mridangas; ara kirtanera rola — and the roar of kirtana; chaudige sakala loka — all around, all the people; bale haribola — cry "Haribol!"

**143+3.** Cymbals ring, mridangas sound, the kirtana roars,
and all the people around cry, "Haribol!"

নটবর-শেখর সুঘড় সহচর ।
রাধাকৃষ্ণ-গুণগান প্রেমায় বিহ্বল ॥ ১৪৩+৪ ॥

*naṭabara-śekhara sughaṛa sahacara |*
*rādhākṛṣṇa-guṇagāna premāẏa bihbala || 143+4 ||*

*Word for word:* natavara-shekhara — the crest-jewel of dancers; sughada sahachara — [with] skilful companions; radha-krishna-guna-gana — singing the glories of Radha and Krishna; premaya vihvala — overwhelmed by prema

**143+4.** The crest-jewel of dancers, with His skilful companions,
sings the glories of Radha and Krishna, overwhelmed with prema.

হেনই সময়ে কহে ভারতী-গোসাঞি ।
কি নাম তোমার হবে — শুনহ নিমাঞি ॥ ১৪৪ ॥

*henai samaẏe kahe bhāratī-gosāñi |*
*ki nāma tomāra habe — śunaha nimāñi || 144 ||*

*Word for word:* henai samaye — at that very time; kahe bharati-gosani — Bharati Gosani says; ki nama tomara habe — what will Your name be; shunaha nimanni — listen, Nimai

**144.** At that very time Bharati Gosani says:
"What will Your name be? Listen, Nimai."

যতেক বৈষ্ণবগণ ছিল সেইখানে ।
সভে মিলি' ন্যাসিবর করে অনুমানে ॥ ১৪৫ ॥

*yateka baiṣṇabagaṇa chila seikhāne |*
*sabhe mili' nyāsibara kare anumāne || 145 ||*

*Word for word:* yateka vaishnava-gana — all the Vaishnavas; chhila sei-khane — who were there; sabhe mili nyasivara — all together with the best of sannyasis; kare anumane — deliberate

**145.** All the Vaishnavas who were there,
together with the best of sannyasis, began to deliberate;

বুদ্ধি-অনুসারে কহে যার যেই মনে ।
হেনকালে শুভবাণী উঠিল গগনে ॥ ১৪৬ ॥

*buddhi-anusāre kahe yāra yei mane |*
*henakāle śubhabāṇī uṭhila gagane || 146 ||*

*Word for word:* buddhi-anusare kahe — each speaks according to his understanding; yara yei mane — whatever is in his mind; hena-kale — at that time; shubha-vani uthila gagane — an auspicious voice arose in the sky

**146.** each speaks according to his understanding, whatever is in his mind, —
and then an auspicious voice arose in the sky.

ধ্বনি শুনি' সর্বলোক হৈল চমৎকার ।
'শ্রীকৃষ্ণচৈতন্য' নাম করহ ইঁহার ॥ ১৪৭ ॥

*dhbani śuni' sarbaloka haila camatkāra |*
*'śrīkṛṣṇacaitanya' nāma karaha iṁhāra || 147 ||*

*Word for word:* dhvani shuni — hearing the voice; sarvaloka haila chamatkara — everyone was amazed; shri-krishna-chaitanya — "Sri Krishna Chaitanya"; nama karaha inhara — make His name

**147.** Hearing it, everyone was amazed:
"Give Him the name 'Sri Krishna Chaitanya.'"

নিদ্রারূপা মহামায়া দেবী ভগবতী ।
আচ্ছাদিল সর্বজন — ছন্ন ভেল মতি ॥ ১৪৮ ॥

*nidrārūpā mahāmāẏā debī bhagabatī |*
*ācchādila sarbajana — channa bhela mati || 148 ||*

*Word for word:* nidra-rupa — in the form of sleep; mahamaya devi bhagavati — Mahamaya, the goddess Bhagavati; achchhadila sarvajana — covered all people; chhanna bhela mati — their minds were clouded

**148.** Mahamaya, the goddess Bhagavati, in the form of sleep,
has enveloped all people — their minds are clouded;

যতেক করয়ে সব নিঁদের স্বপনে ।
আপনে ঠাকুর সভার করায় চেতনে ॥ ১৪৯ ॥

*yateka karaẏe saba niṁdera sbapane |*
*āpane ṭhākura sabhāra karāẏa cetane || 149 ||*

*Word for word:* yateka karaye saba — all that they do; nindera svapane — [is as] in a dream of sleep; apane thakura — the Lord Himself; sabhara karaya chetane — awakens all

**149.** all that they do is [as] in a dream.
The Lord Himself awakens everyone;

আপনেই কৃষ্ণ — কৃষ্ণ বুঝায় সভারে ।
'শ্রীকৃষ্ণচৈতন্য' তেঞি বলিয়ে ইঁহারে ॥ ১৫০ ॥

*āpanei kṛṣṇa — kṛṣṇa bujhāẏa sabhāre |*
*'śrīkṛṣṇacaitanya' teñi baliẏe iṁhāre || 150 ||*

*Word for word:* apanei krishna — Himself Krishna; krishna bujhaya sabhare — He makes all understand Krishna; shri-krishna-chaitanya — "Sri Krishna Chaitanya"; tenni baliye inhare — therefore He is called

**150.** being Himself Krishna, He reveals Krishna to all —
therefore He is called "Sri Krishna Chaitanya."[^40-11]

এতেক বচন যবে দৈবমুখে শুনি ।
আনন্দিত সর্বলোক করে হরিধ্বনি ॥ ১৫১ ॥

*eteka bacana yabe daibamukhe śuni |*
*ānandita sarbaloka kare haridhbani || 151 ||*

*Word for word:* eteka bachana — these words; yabe daiva-mukhe shuni — when they heard from the mouth of heaven; anandita sarvaloka — all the people, joyful; kare hari-dhvani — raise the cry of "Hari"

**151.** When all heard these words from the mouth of heaven,
the people joyfully raised the cry of Hari's name.

আনন্দ-হৃদয়ে প্রভু বলে হরিবোল ।
'শ্রীকৃষ্ণচৈতন্য নাম আজি হৈতে মোর' ॥ ১৫১+১ ॥

*ānanda-hṛdaẏe prabhu bale haribola |*
*'śrīkṛṣṇacaitanya nāma āji haite mora' || 151+1 ||*

*Word for word:* ananda-hridaye — with a joyful heart; prabhu bale haribola — the Lord cries "Haribol!"; shri-krishna-chaitanya nama — the name "Sri Krishna Chaitanya"; aji haite mora — is Mine from today

**151+1.** With a joyful heart the Lord cries, "Haribol!":[^40-12]
"From today My name is Sri Krishna Chaitanya."

গুরুর চরণে করি' প্রণতি বিস্তর ।
প্রদক্ষিণ করিয়া চলয়ে বিশ্বম্ভর ॥ ১৫১+২ ॥

*gurura caraṇe kari' praṇati bistara |*
*pradakṣiṇa kariẏā calaẏe biśbambhara || 151+2 ||*

*Word for word:* gurura charane kari — making at the guru's feet; pranati vistara — many obeisances; pradakshina kariya — circumambulating [him]; chalaye vishvambhara — Vishvambhara sets out

**151+2.** Bowing many times at the guru's feet,
Vishvambhara circumambulated him and set out.

গমন-উদ্যম দেখি' সেই ন্যাসিরাজ ।
ডাকে — হের, ধর দণ্ড, না করহ ব্যাজ ॥ ১৫১+৩ ॥

*gamana-udyama dekhi' sei nyāsirāja |*
*ḍāke — hera, dhara daṇḍa, nā karaha byāja || 151+3 ||*

*Word for word:* gamana-udyama dekhi — seeing Him setting off; sei nyasiraja — that king of sannyasis; dake — calls; hera dhara danda — here, take the staff; na karaha byaja — do not delay

**151+3.** Seeing Him leaving, the king of sannyasis
calls: "Here, take the staff, do not delay!"

গুরুর বচন শুনি' লেউটিয়া আসি' ।
গুরু-ঠাঁই দণ্ড পাইয়া লহু লহু হাসি ॥ ১৫১+৪ ॥

*gurura bacana śuni' leuṭiẏā āsi' |*
*guru-ṭhāṁi daṇḍa pāiẏā lahu lahu hāsi || 151+4 ||*

*Word for word:* gurura bachana shuni — hearing the guru's words; leutiya asi — coming back; guru-thani danda paiya — receiving the staff from the guru; lahu lahu hasi — smiling gently

**151+4.** Hearing the guru's word, [the Lord] came back
and, smiling gently, received the staff from the guru.

সাদরে লৈল প্রভু গুরুর সে দণ্ড ।
প্রণতি করয়ে বহু ভকতি প্রচণ্ড ॥ ১৫১+৫ ॥

*sādare laila prabhu gurura se daṇḍa |*
*praṇati karaẏe bahu bhakati pracaṇḍa || 151+5 ||*

*Word for word:* sadare laila prabhu — the Lord reverently took; gurura se danda — that staff of the guru; pranati karaye bahu — bows many times; bhakati prachanda — with intense devotion

**151+5.** The Lord reverently accepted the guru's staff
and bowed to him many times with fervent devotion.

তবে সেই মহাপ্রভু বলে হরিবোল ।
উথলিয়া পড়ে মহাপ্রেমার হিল্লোল ॥ ১৫১+৬ ॥

*tabe sei mahāprabhu bale haribola |*
*uthaliẏā paṛe mahāpremāra hillola || 151+6 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe sei mahaprabhu — then Mahaprabhu; bale haribola — cries "Haribol!"; uthaliya pade — surge up; maha-premara hillola — the waves of great prema

**151+6.** Then Mahaprabhu cries, "Haribol!" —
and the waves of great prema surge up.

গুরুর আজ্ঞায় প্রভু সেদিন তথাই ।
গুরুভক্তি করি' সুখে বঞ্চিলা গোসাঞি ॥ ১৫২ ॥

*gurura ājñāẏa prabhu sedina tathāi |*
*gurubhakti kari' sukhe bañcilā gosāñi || 152 ||*

*Word for word:* gurura ajnaya — by the guru's order; prabhu sedina tathai — the Lord, that day, right there; guru-bhakti kari — serving the guru; sukhe vanchila gosani — Gosani passed [the time] happily

**152.** By the guru's order the Lord stayed there that day
and spent it happily in service to the guru.

রজনী বৈষ্ণব মিলে করে সংকীর্তন ।
গুরুর সংহতি নৃত্য করয়ে মোহন ॥ ১৫৩ ॥

*rajanī baiṣṇaba mile kare saṃkīrtana |*
*gurura saṃhati nṛtya karaẏe mohana || 153 ||*

*Word for word:* rajani — at night; vaishnava mile — the Vaishnavas together; kare sankirtana — perform sankirtana; gurura samhati — together with the guru; nritya karaye mohana — [the Lord] dances enchantingly

**153.** At night the Vaishnavas together perform sankirtana;
together with the guru [the Lord] dances enchantingly.

কেশবভারতী নাচে প্রেমানন্দ-সুখে ।
ঠাকুর নাচয়ে, হরি বোলে সর্বলোকে ॥ ১৫৪ ॥

*keśababhāratī nāce premānanda-sukhe |*
*ṭhākura nācaẏe, hari bole sarbaloke || 154 ||*

*Word for word:* keshava-bharati nache — Keshava Bharati dances; premananda-sukhe — in the joy of prema's bliss; thakura nachaye — the Lord dances; hari bole sarvaloke — everyone cries "Hari!"

**154.** Keshava Bharati dances in the joy of prema's bliss,
the Lord dances, and all the people cry, "Hari!"

প্রেমানন্দে পূর্ণ দোঁহে পাশরে আপনা ।
ব্রহ্মসুখ অল্প করি' মানয়ে দু'জনা ॥ ১৫৫ ॥

*premānande pūrṇa doṁhe pāśare āpanā |*
*brahmasukha alpa kari' mānaẏe du'janā || 155 ||*

*Word for word:* premanande purna donhe — both, filled with the bliss of prema; pashare apana — forget themselves; brahma-sukha alpa kari — the happiness of Brahman as paltry; manaye du-jana — both regard

**155.** Both, filled with the bliss of prema, forgot themselves;
both regard the happiness of Brahman as paltry.[^40-13]

এইমতে কতক্ষণে নৃত্য-অবসানে ।
বসিয়া কহয়ে ন্যাসী, বিশ্বম্ভর শুনে ॥ ১৫৫+১ ॥

*eimate katakṣaṇe nṛtya-abasāne |*
*basiẏā kahaẏe nyāsī, biśbambhara śune || 155+1 ||*

*Word for word:* eimate katakshane — thus after a while; nritya-avasane — when the dancing ended; basiya kahaye nyasi — the sannyasi, sitting down, speaks; vishvambhara shune — Vishvambhara listens

**155+1.** Thus after a while, when the dancing ended,[^40-14]
the sannyasi sat down and spoke, and Vishvambhara listened:

মোর হাথ হৈতে দণ্ড কে নিল আমার ।
দণ্ডাগ্র পরশি' পুন চাহি নাচিবার ॥ ১৫৫+২ ॥

*mora hātha haite daṇḍa ke nila āmāra |*
*daṇḍāgra paraśi' puna cāhi nācibāra || 155+2 ||*

*Word for word:* mora hatha haite — from my hand; danda ke nila amara — who took my staff; dandagra parashi — touching the tip of the staff; puna chahi nachibara — I want to dance again

**155+2.** "Who took the staff from my hand?
Touching the tip of the staff, I want to dance again!"

ইহা বলি' বিহ্বল হইয়া নৃত্য করে ।
অতি অপরূপ নাচে প্রেমানন্দ-ভরে ॥ ১৫৫+৩ ॥

*ihā bali' bihbala haiẏā nṛtya kare |*
*ati aparūpa nāce premānanda-bhare || 155+3 ||*

*Word for word:* iha bali — saying this; vihvala haiya — beside himself; nritya kare — he dances; ati aparupa nache — dances wondrously; premananda-bhare — brimming with the bliss of prema

**155+3.** Saying this, he dances, beside himself —
dances wondrously, brimming with the bliss of prema.

আনন্দে বৈষ্ণব সব নাচয়ে কৌতুকে ।
হরি হরি বলে সব লোক চতুর্দিকে ॥ ১৫৫+৪ ॥

*ānande baiṣṇaba saba nācaẏe kautuke |*
*hari hari bale saba loka caturdike || 155+4 ||*

*Word for word:* anande vaishnava saba — all the Vaishnavas in bliss; nachaye kautuke — dance joyfully; hari hari bale — cry "Hari, Hari!"; saba loka chaturdike — all the people all around

**155+4.** In bliss all the Vaishnavas dance joyfully,
and all the people around cry, "Hari, Hari!"

এইমতে আনন্দে-সানন্দে রাত্রি যায় ।
প্রভাতে উঠিয়া প্রভু মাগেন বিদায় ॥ ১৫৬ ॥

*eimate ānande-sānande rātri yāẏa |*
*prabhāte uṭhiẏā prabhu māgena bidāẏa || 156 ||*

*Word for word:* eimate anande-sanande — thus in joy and delight; ratri yaya — the night passes; prabhate uthiya — rising at dawn; prabhu magena vidaya — the Lord asks leave to go

**156.** Thus in joy and delight the night passes;
rising at dawn, the Lord asks leave to go.

গুরু প্রদক্ষিণ করি' করয়ে প্রণাম ।
নীলাচল যাই — যদি পাই সম্বিধান ॥ ১৫৭ ॥

*guru pradakṣiṇa kari' karaẏe praṇāma |*
*nīlācala yāi — yadi pāi sambidhāna || 157 ||*

*Word for word:* guru pradakshina kari — circumambulating the guru; karaye pranama — He bows; nilachala yai — I shall go to Nilachala; yadi pai samvidhana — if I receive [your] sanction

**157.** Circumambulating the guru, He bows:
"I shall go to Nilachala, if I have your sanction."

গুরুর চরণে আজ্ঞা মাগয়ে ঠাকুর ।
কেশবভারতীর হিয়া করে দুরদুর ॥ ১৫৮ ॥

*gurura caraṇe ājñā māgaẏe ṭhākura |*
*keśababhāratīra hiẏā kare duradura || 158 ||*

*Word for word:* gurura charane — at the guru's feet; ajna magaye thakura — the Lord asks permission; keshava-bharatira hiya — Keshava Bharati's heart; kare duradura — throbs

**158.** The Lord asks permission at the guru's feet, —
and Keshava Bharati's heart throbs.

ছলছল করে আঁখি করুণার জলে ।
বিদায়-সময়ে গোরাচাঁদে করে কোলে ॥ ১৫৯ ॥

*chalachala kare āṁkhi karuṇāra jale |*
*bidāẏa-samaẏe gorācāṁde kare kole || 159 ||*

*Word for word:* chhalachhala kare ankhi — his eyes brim; karunara jale — with tears of compassion; vidaya-samaye — at the time of parting; gorachande kare kole — he embraces Gorachand

**159.** His eyes brim with tears of compassion;
at parting he embraces Gorachand:

স্বতন্ত্র ঈশ্বর তুমি আপনার সুখে ।
করুণা-কারণে পদব্রজে বুল লোকে ॥ ১৬০ ॥

*sbatantra īśbara tumi āpanāra sukhe |*
*karuṇā-kāraṇe padabraje bula loke || 160 ||*

*Word for word:* svatantra ishvara tumi — You are the independent Lord; apanara sukhe — in Your own bliss; karuna-karane — out of compassion; padavraje bula loke — You walk on foot among people

**160.** "You are the independent Lord, [abiding] in Your own bliss;
out of compassion You walk on foot among people.

গুরুভক্তি লওয়াবারে কর বিধিকর্ম ।
সংস্থাপন করিবারে সংকীর্তন-ধর্ম ॥ ১৬১ ॥

*gurubhakti laoẏābāre kara bidhikarma |*
*saṃsthāpana karibāre saṃkīrtana-dharma || 161 ||*

*Word for word:* guru-bhakti laoyabare — to make people take up devotion to the guru; kara vidhi-karma — You perform the prescribed rites; samsthapana karibare — to establish; sankirtana-dharma — the dharma of sankirtana

**161.** To teach [people] devotion to the guru You perform the prescribed rites,
to establish the dharma of sankirtana.

সর্বলোক নিস্তারিতে করুণা প্রকাশ ।
আমা বিড়ম্বিতে কৈলে এই ত সন্ন্যাস ॥ ১৬২ ॥

*sarbaloka nistārite karuṇā prakāśa |*
*āmā biṛambite kaile ei ta sannyāsa || 162 ||*

*Word for word:* sarvaloka nistarite — to deliver all people; karuna prakasha — You have shown mercy; ama vidambite — to put me in an awkward place; kaile ei ta sannyasa — You have taken this sannyasa

**162.** To deliver all people You have shown mercy,
and to put me in an awkward place You have taken this sannyasa.[^40-15]

আমার নিস্তার যেন হয় বিশ্বম্ভর ।
এই মোর বাক্য তুমি পালিহ অন্তর ॥ ১৬৩ ॥

*āmāra nistāra yena haẏa biśbambhara |*
*ei mora bākya tumi pāliha antara || 163 ||*

*Word for word:* amara nistara yena haya — that I too may be delivered; vishvambhara — Vishvambhara; ei mora vakya — this word of mine; tumi paliha antara — keep in Your heart

**163.** That I too may be delivered, Vishvambhara —
this is my plea; keep it in Your heart."

আজ্ঞা দিল — চল নীলাচল-গিরিরাজে ।
কিছু না বলিল গৌরচন্দ্র আর লাজে ॥ ১৬৩+১ ॥

*ājñā dila — cala nīlācala-girirāje |*
*kichu nā balila gauracandra āra lāje || 163+1 ||*

*Word for word:* ajna dila — [Bharati] gave leave; chala nilachala-giriraje — go to Nilachala, the king of mountains; kichhu na balila gaurachandra — Gaurachandra said nothing; ara laje — further, out of modesty

**163+1.** [Bharati] gave leave: "Go to Nilachala, the king of mountains,"[^40-16]
and Gaurachandra, out of modesty, said nothing more.

চরণ পরশ করি' চলিল ঠাকুর ।
পথে যাইতে প্রেমানন্দ বাঢ়িল প্রচুর ॥ ১৬৪ ॥

*caraṇa paraśa kari' calila ṭhākura |*
*pathe yāite premānanda bāṛhila pracura || 164 ||*

*Word for word:* charana parasha kari — touching [his] feet; chalila thakura — the Lord set out; pathe yaite — as He went on the road; premananda badhila prachura — the bliss of prema grew abundantly

**164.** Touching his feet, the Lord set out;
on the road the bliss of prema grew beyond measure.

কৃষ্ণ কৃষ্ণ বলি' ডাকে প্রেমার উল্লাস ।
ক্ষণেকে রোদন, ক্ষণে অট্ট-অট্ট হাস ॥ ১৬৫ ॥

*kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa bali' ḍāke premāra ullāsa |*
*kṣaṇeke rodana, kṣaṇe aṭṭa-aṭṭa hāsa || 165 ||*

*Word for word:* krishna krishna bali dake — He calls "Krishna, Krishna!"; premara ullasa — in the exultation of prema; kshaneke rodana — now weeping; kshane atta-atta hasa — now loud laughter

**165.** In the exultation of prema He calls, "Krishna, Krishna!" —
now He weeps, now He laughs aloud.

বুক বাঞা পড়ে ধারা নয়নের জলে ।
সুরনদী-ধারা যেন সুমেরু-শিখরে ॥ ১৬৬ ॥

*buka bāñā paṛe dhārā naẏanera jale |*
*suranadī-dhārā yena sumeru-śikhare || 166 ||*

*Word for word:* buka vanya pade dhara — streams run down His chest; nayanera jale — of tears from His eyes; sura-nadi-dhara yena — like the stream of the celestial river; sumeru-shikhare — on the peak of Sumeru

**166.** Streams of tears run down His chest —
like the stream of the celestial river down the peak of Sumeru.

কদম্ব-কেশর জিনি' বিপুল পুলক ।
কণ্টকিত সর্ব অঙ্গ আপাদমস্তক ॥ ১৬৭ ॥

*kadamba-keśara jini' bipula pulaka |*
*kaṇṭakita sarba aṅga āpādamastaka || 167 ||*

*Word for word:* kadamba-keshara jini — surpassing the filaments of the kadamba; vipula pulaka — abundant thrill; kantakita sarva anga — His whole body bristles; apada-mastaka — from feet to head

**167.** His abundant thrill surpasses the filaments of the kadamba:
His whole body bristles from head to foot.

মত্ত করিবর যেন রঙ্গে চলি' যায় ।
নির্ভর প্রেমায় ক্ষণে কৃষ্ণ বলি' গায় ॥ ১৬৮ ॥

*matta karibara yena raṅge cali' yāẏa |*
*nirbhara premāẏa kṣaṇe kṛṣṇa bali' gāẏa || 168 ||*

*Word for word:* matta karivara yena — like an intoxicated elephant; range chali yaya — He moves along playfully; nirbhara premaya — in boundless prema; kshane krishna bali gaya — now He sings "Krishna!"

**168.** He moves along playfully like an intoxicated elephant;
in boundless prema now He sings "Krishna!",

ক্ষণেকে পড়য়ে ভূমি রহে স্তব্ধ হঞা ।
ক্ষণে লম্ফ দিয়া উঠে হরিবোল বলিয়া ॥ ১৬৯ ॥

*kṣaṇeke paṛaẏe bhūmi rahe stabdha hañā |*
*kṣaṇe lampha diẏā uṭhe haribola baliẏā || 169 ||*

*Word for word:* kshaneke padaye bhumi — now He falls to the ground; rahe stabdha hanya — and lies stunned; kshane lampha diya uthe — now He springs up; haribola baliya — crying "Haribol!"

**169.** now He falls to the ground and lies stunned,
now He springs up crying, "Haribol!"

ক্ষণে গোপিকার ভাব, ক্ষণে দাস্যভাব ।
ক্ষণে ধীরে ধীরে চলে, ক্ষণে শীঘ্র ধাব ॥ ১৭০ ॥

*kṣaṇe gopikāra bhāba, kṣaṇe dāsyabhāba |*
*kṣaṇe dhīre dhīre cale, kṣaṇe śīghra dhāba || 170 ||*

*Word for word:* kshane gopikara bhava — now the bhava of a gopi; kshane dasya-bhava — now the bhava of a servant; kshane dhire dhire chale — now He walks slowly; kshane shighra dhava — now He runs swiftly

**170.** Now the bhava of a gopi is in Him, now the bhava of a servant;[^40-17]
now He walks slowly, now He runs swiftly.

এইমতে দিবারাত্রি না জানে আনন্দে ।
রাঢ়দেশে না শুনিল কৃষ্ণনাম-গন্ধে ॥ ১৭১ ॥

*eimate dibārātri nā jāne ānande |*
*rāṛhadeśe nā śunila kṛṣṇanāma-gandhe || 171 ||*

*Word for word:* eimate — thus; divaratri na jane anande — in bliss He knows neither day nor night; radha-deshe — in Radha-desha; na shunila krishna-nama-gandhe — He did not hear even a trace of Krishna's name

**171.** Thus in bliss He knows neither day nor night.
In Radha-desha He did not hear even a trace of Krishna's name,[^40-18]

কৃষ্ণনাম না শুনিঞা খেদ উঠে চিতে ।
নিশ্চয় করিল জলে প্রবেশ করিতে ॥ ১৭২ ॥

*kṛṣṇanāma nā śuniñā kheda uṭhe cite |*
*niścaẏa karila jale prabeśa karite || 172 ||*

*Word for word:* krishna-nama na shuninya — not hearing Krishna's name; kheda uthe chite — grief arose in His heart; nishchaya karila — He resolved; jale pravesha karite — to enter the water

**172.** and, not hearing Krishna's name, He was filled with grief
and resolved to enter the water.[^40-19]

দেখি' সব ভক্তগণ করে অনুতাপ ।
গৌরাঙ্গ গোলোকে যায় — কি হবে রে বাপ ॥ ১৭৩ ॥

*dekhi' saba bhaktagaṇa kare anutāpa |*
*gaurāṅga goloke yāẏa — ki habe re bāpa || 173 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhi saba bhakta-gana — seeing this, all the devotees; kare anutapa — lament; gauranga goloke yaya — Gauranga is going to Goloka; ki habe re bapa — alas, what will happen

**173.** Seeing this, all the devotees lament:
"Gauranga is going to Goloka! Alas, what will become of us!"

তবে নিত্যানন্দ প্রভু বোলে বীরদাপে ।
রাখিব চৈতন্য আমি আপন প্রতাপে ॥ ১৭৪ ॥

*tabe nityānanda prabhu bole bīradāpe |*
*rākhiba caitanya āmi āpana pratāpe || 174 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe nityananda prabhu — then Nityananda Prabhu; bole vira-dape — says with a hero's boldness; rakhiba chaitanya ami — I shall keep Chaitanya [here]; apana pratape — by my own power

**174.** Then Nityananda Prabhu says with a hero's boldness:
"By my own power I shall keep Chaitanya here."

সেইখানে শিশুগণ গোধন চরায় ।
নিত্যানন্দ প্রভু তার প্রবেশে হিয়ায় ॥ ১৭৫ ॥

*seikhāne śiśugaṇa godhana carāẏa |*
*nityānanda prabhu tāra prabeśe hiẏāẏa || 175 ||*

*Word for word:* sei-khane shishugana — there some boys; godhana charaya — are grazing cows; nityananda prabhu — Nityananda Prabhu; tara praveshe hiyaya — enters their hearts

**175.** There some boys were grazing cows —
Nityananda Prabhu entered their hearts.

নিশ্চয় করিয়া গেলা জলের সমীপ ।
হরি বলি' এক শিশু ডাকে আচম্বিত ॥ ১৭৬ ॥

*niścaẏa kariẏā gelā jalera samīpa |*
*hari bali' eka śiśu ḍāke ācambita || 176 ||*

*Word for word:* nishchaya kariya — having resolved; gela jalera samipa — [the Lord] went near the water; hari bali — "Hari!"; eka shishu dake achambita — one boy suddenly calls out

**176.** When [the Lord], resolved, went near the water,
one boy suddenly called out, "Hari!"

তাহা শুনি' লেউটি' আইলা গৌরহরি ।
'বোল বোল' বোলে, ডাকে শিশু-হস্ত ধরি' ॥ ১৭৭ ॥

*tāhā śuni' leuṭi' āilā gaurahari |*
*'bola bola' bole, ḍāke śiśu-hasta dhari' || 177 ||*

*Word for word:* taha shuni — hearing this; leuti aila gaurahari — Gaurahari turned back; bola bola bole — says "Say it, say it!"; dake shishu-hasta dhari — calls, holding the boy's hand

**177.** Hearing this, Gaurahari turned back
and, holding the boy's hand, urges him: "Say it, say it [again]!

তোমারে করুন কৃপা প্রভু ভগবান্ ।
কৃতার্থ করিলে শুনাইয়া হরিনাম ॥ ১৭৮ ॥

*tomāre karuna kṛpā prabhu bhagabān |*
*kṛtārtha karile śunāiẏā harināma || 178 ||*

*Word for word:* tomare karuna kripa — may He show you mercy; prabhu bhagavan — the Lord Bhagavan; kritartha karile — you have fulfilled [Me]; shunaiya hari-nama — by letting Me hear the name of Hari

**178.** May the Lord Bhagavan be merciful to you:
you have blessed Me by letting Me hear the name of Hari."

প্রেমানন্দে ভাসে প্রভু আনন্দিত হিয়া ।
ভিক্ষা করিলা প্রভু কথোদূর গিয়া ॥ ১৭৯ ॥

*premānande bhāse prabhu ānandita hiẏā |*
*bhikṣā karilā prabhu kathodūra giẏā || 179 ||*

*Word for word:* premanande bhase prabhu — the Lord floats in the bliss of prema; anandita hiya — with a joyful heart; bhiksha karila prabhu — the Lord took alms; kathodura giya — after going some distance

**179.** The Lord floats in the bliss of prema, His heart rejoicing;
going on a little further, the Lord took alms.

হেনমতে দিবানিশি নাহি জানে সুখে ।
তিন দিন বহি' অন্নজল দিল মুখে ॥ ১৮০ ॥

*henamate dibāniśi nāhi jāne sukhe |*
*tina dina bahi' annajala dila mukhe || 180 ||*

*Word for word:* henamate — thus; divanishi nahi jane sukhe — in bliss He knew neither day nor night; tina dina bahi — only after three days; anna-jala dila mukhe — He put food and water in His mouth

**180.** Thus in bliss He knew neither day nor night —
only after three days did He take food and water.

হেনমতে প্রেমানন্দে দিনরাতি যায় ।
চন্দ্রশেখর-আচার্যে দিলেন বিদায় ॥ ১৮১ ॥

*henamate premānande dinarāti yāẏa |*
*candraśekhara-ācārye dilena bidāẏa || 181 ||*

*Word for word:* henamate — thus; premanande dinarati yaya — days and nights pass in the bliss of prema; chandrashekhara-acharye — Chandrashekhara Acharya; dilena vidaya — He dismissed

**181.** Thus days and nights passed in the bliss of prema.
[Then the Lord] dismissed Chandrashekhara Acharya:

নবদ্বীপবাসী যত আমার লাগিয়া ।
কান্দয়ে ব্যাকুল হৈয়া ডাকিয়া ডাকিয়া ॥ ১৮১+১ ॥

*nabadbīpabāsī yata āmāra lāgiẏā |*
*kāndaẏe byākula haiẏā ḍākiẏā ḍākiẏā || 181+1 ||*

*Word for word:* navadvipa-vasi yata — all the people of Navadvipa; amara lagiya — for Me; kandaye byakula haiya — weep in distress; dakiya dakiya — calling and calling

**181+1.** "All the people of Navadvipa[^40-20]
weep for Me in distress and keep calling Me.

নিশ্চয় না জানে মোর সন্ন্যাস-করণ ।
সভারে জানাহ মোর এই বিবরণ ॥ ১৮১+২ ॥

*niścaẏa nā jāne mora sannyāsa-karaṇa |*
*sabhāre jānāha mora ei bibaraṇa || 181+2 ||*

*Word for word:* nishchaya na jane — they do not know for certain; mora sannyasa-karana — that I have taken sannyasa; sabhare janaha — tell everyone; mora ei vivarana — this account of Mine

**181+2.** They do not know for certain that I have taken sannyasa:
tell them all this account of Me."

কহিল ঠাকুর — পুনঃ হৈব দরশন ।
অচিরে হইবে দেখা, না হও বিমন ॥ ১৮২ ॥

*kahila ṭhākura — punaḥ haiba daraśana |*
*acire haibe dekhā, nā hao bimana || 182 ||*

*Word for word:* kahila thakura — the Lord said; punah haiba darashana — we shall see each other again; achire haibe dekha — soon we shall meet; na hao vimana — do not be downcast

**182.** The Lord said: "We shall see each other again;
soon we shall meet — do not be downcast."

এ বোল বলিয়া প্রভু চলিলা সত্বর ।
কান্দিতে কান্দিতে যায় শ্রীচন্দ্রশেখর ॥ ১৮৩ ॥

*e bola baliẏā prabhu calilā satbara |*
*kāndite kāndite yāẏa śrīcandraśekhara || 183 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola baliya — saying this; prabhu chalila satvara — the Lord went on quickly; kandite kandite yaya — weeping, goes; shri-chandrashekhara — Sri Chandrashekhara

**183.** Saying this, the Lord went on quickly,
and Sri Chandrashekhara goes away weeping:

মরিব মরিব প্রভু তোমা না দেখিয়া ।
মরিব যে নবদ্বীপের শোকার্ণবে পড়িয়া ॥ ১৮৩+১ ॥

*mariba mariba prabhu tomā nā dekhiẏā |*
*mariba ye nabadbīpera śokārṇabe paṛiẏā || 183+1 ||*

*Word for word:* mariba mariba prabhu — I shall die, I shall die, Lord; toma na dekhiya — not seeing You; mariba ye — I shall surely die; navadvipera shokarnave padiya — fallen into Navadvipa's ocean of grief

**183+1.** "I shall die, I shall die, Lord, not seeing You,[^40-21]
I shall die, fallen into Navadvipa's ocean of grief!"

হেথা নবদ্বীপবাসী একমুখে রহে ।
শ্রীচন্দ্রশেখর আসি' কিবা বার্তা কহে ॥ ১৮৪ ॥

*hethā nabadbīpabāsī ekamukhe rahe |*
*śrīcandraśekhara āsi' kibā bārtā kahe || 184 ||*

*Word for word:* hetha navadvipa-vasi — here the people of Navadvipa; ekamukhe rahe — wait, all facing one way; shri-chandrashekhara asi — Sri Chandrashekhara, on coming; kiba varta kahe — what news will he tell

**184.** Meanwhile the people of Navadvipa wait, their eyes fixed on the road:
what news will Sri Chandrashekhara bring when he comes?

কহয়ে লোচন — ইহা কহনে না যায় ।
শ্রীচন্দ্রশেখরাচার্য নবদ্বীপ পায় ॥ ১৮৫ ॥

*kahaẏe locana — ihā kahane nā yāẏa |*
*śrīcandraśekharācārya nabadbīpa pāẏa || 185 ||*

*Word for word:* kahaye lochana — says Lochana; iha kahane na yaya — this cannot be told; shri-chandrashekharacharya — Sri Chandrashekhara Acharya; navadvipa paya — reaches Navadvipa

**185.** Says Lochana: this cannot be told in words.
Sri Chandrashekhara Acharya reaches Navadvipa.

[^40-1]: Acharyaratna is Chandrashekhara Acharya, who came to Kantakanagara with Nityananda (en/39, v. 43). Cf. Murari 3.2.6.
[^40-2]: "Once" — in Krishna's lila in Vraja; a chuda is a topknot adorned with a peacock feather. Lochana Dasa speaks of Gaura's hair as the hair of Krishna Himself.
[^40-3]: Vv. 124+1 — 124+2 are found only in the 1983 edition; in the 1903 edition they are in a footnote, as an additional reading of one manuscript.
[^40-4]: Vv. 125+1 — 125+3 are found only in the 1983 edition; the 1903 edition does not have them. The second line of v. 125+2 is unclear in the 1983 edition; we understand it as "let me go to hell like Kamsa".
[^40-5]: A barber's trade is to shave and pare nails, touching people's feet; having touched the Lord's head, he can no longer touch the feet of others.
[^40-6]: V. 135+1 is found only in the 1983 edition; the 1903 edition does not have it. The barber is called Haridasa here — not to be confused with Haridasa Thakura.
[^40-7]: Vv. 136+1 — 136+4 are found only in the 1983 edition; in the 1903 edition they are in a footnote, as an additional reading of one manuscript (with the lines of v. 136+3 in reverse order).
[^40-8]: That is, at the sun's passage from Capricorn into Aquarius — at the end of the solar month of Magha (January–February). Cf. Murari 3.2.10.
[^40-9]: Cf. Murari 3.2.11. In the 1983 edition a new chapter, "Acceptance of Sannyasa", begins at v. 138; in Bhaktisiddhanta's edition the section continues.
[^40-10]: Vv. 143+1 — 143+4 are found only in the 1983 edition; in the 1903 edition they are in a footnote, as an additional reading of one manuscript (with one more couplet: Gadadhara and Narahari dance beside the Lord, and all the Vaishnavas dance around Gora).
[^40-11]: Chaitanya means "consciousness", "awakening". Mahamaya keeps in oblivion the living beings who have turned away from Krishna; the Lord awakens them to Krishna consciousness. In the Chaitanya-bhagavata (Madhya 28) Keshava Bharati himself gives the Lord this name, with the same explanation; in Lochana Dasa it is proclaimed by a voice from the sky.
[^40-12]: Vv. 151+1 — 151+6 are found only in the 1983 edition; in the 1903 edition vv. 151+1 — 151+5 stand in the main text and v. 151+6 is in a footnote, as part of an additional reading of one manuscript. Cf. Murari 3.2.12: the guru himself puts the staff, together with the cloth, into the Lord's hand.
[^40-13]: Cf. Murari 3.2.13–14.
[^40-14]: Vv. 155+1 — 155+4 are found only in the 1983 edition; in the 1903 edition they stand in the main text. Cf. Murari 3.2.15–18: Bharati relates that someone snatched the staff from his hands and told him to dance.
[^40-15]: In Bhaktisiddhanta's edition v. 162 is misnumbered 161. Bharati speaks in humility: the Lord, the guru of the world, has placed him in the position of His guru (cf. en/39, v. 85).
[^40-16]: V. 163+1 is found only in the 1983 edition; in the 1903 edition it stands in the main text. Nilachala ("the Blue Mountain") is Puri, the abode of Jagannatha.
[^40-17]: Cf. Murari 3.3.17.
[^40-18]: Radha-desha (Rarh) is the region west of the Ganga. Vv. 164–180 — cf. Murari 3.3.1–10, 16–18; Chaitanya-bhagavata, Antya 1.
[^40-19]: As in Murari (3.3.6), the Lord speaks and acts in the mood of a devotee for whom life without the name of Hari is unbearable; this is a manifestation of prema, not the despair of a conditioned soul. The Lord's body is spiritual, and He, the independent one, is free to manifest and withdraw it.
[^40-20]: Vv. 181+1 — 181+2 are found only in the 1983 edition; in the 1903 edition they are in a footnote, as an additional reading of one manuscript. Vv. 181–185 — cf. Murari 3.3.11–14, 19.
[^40-21]: V. 183+1 is found only in the 1983 edition; in the 1903 edition it is in a footnote, as an additional reading of one manuscript (there: "burnt in the fire of Navadvipa's grief").

---

# Madhya-khanda, part 18 (portion 41)

*The section "The Lord's Arrival at Shantipura": the lament of Shachi and Vishnupriya on Chandrashekhara's return; the devotees of Navadvipa chant the Name, and the Lord, bound by it, sends Nityananda for them; Nityananda in Navadvipa; Shachi and all the people of Nadia go to Advaita's house; the Lord comes to Shantipura; the meal and kirtana*

## The Lord's Arrival at Shantipura

> *Summary by Srila Bhaktisiddhanta Sarasvati.* When Chandrashekhara Acharya returned to Nadia, at the sight of him the fire of Shachi's and Vishnupriya's grief blazed up twice as fierce; lamenting bitterly, they began to question the Acharya about Sriman Mahaprabhu. Meanwhile Bhagavan Gaurahari, the Knower of hearts, [seeing] the anguish of the people of Nadia and wishing to show Himself to them, resolved to come to Shantipura and sent them word of it through Sri Nityananda Prabhu. As soon as Nityananda Prabhu arrived in Nadia, at the sight of Him life returned to the bodies of the people of Nadia, who were wasting away in separation. When Shachidevi began to weep, Nityananda Prabhu consoled her and told her of the Lord's coming to Shantipura. Hearing this news, all the people of Nadia in great joy [came] to the house of Sri Advaita [Acharya], to the feet of Sriman Mahaprabhu, and the Lord received them fittingly. Thus that night passed in great bliss.[^41-1]

*Raga karunashri; disha: "Oh, alas, alas!"*

নবদ্বীপে প্রবেশিতে আচার্য-শেখর ।
নয়নে গলয়ে জলধারা নিরন্তর ॥ ১ ॥

*nabadbīpe prabeśite ācārya-śekhara |*
*naẏane galaẏe jaladhārā nirantara || 1 ||*

*Word for word:* navadvipe praveshite — on entering Navadvipa; acharya-shekhara — Acharya Shekhara (Chandrashekhara); nayane galaye — from his eyes flow; jaladhara nirantara — ceaseless streams of tears

**1.** As Acharya Shekhara entered Navadvipa,
tears flowed ceaselessly from his eyes.

নবদ্বীপবাসী যত তাহারে দেখিয়া ।
অন্তরে পোড়য়ে প্রাণ ধকধক হিয়া ॥ ২ ॥

*nabadbīpabāsī yata tāhāre dekhiẏā |*
*antare poṛaẏe prāṇa dhakadhaka hiẏā || 2 ||*

*Word for word:* navadvipa-vasi yata — all the people of Navadvipa; tahare dekhiya — seeing him; antare podaye prana — their life burns within; dhakadhaka hiya — their hearts pound

**2.** All the people of Navadvipa, seeing him,
burn within, their hearts pounding.

সকল বৈষ্ণব আসি' মিলিলা সেখানে ।
সম্বরিতে নারে অশ্রু — কাতর বয়ানে ॥ ৩ ॥

*sakala baiṣṇaba āsi' mililā sekhāne |*
*sambarite nāre aśru — kātara baẏāne || 3 ||*

*Word for word:* sakala vaishnava asi — all the Vaishnavas, coming; milila se-khane — gathered there; samvarite nare ashru — cannot hold back their tears; katara bayane — with stricken faces

**3.** All the Vaishnavas came and gathered there;
unable to hold back their tears, with stricken faces,

পুছিতে না পারে কিছু — মুখে নাহি রায় ।
শুনি' শচীদেবী আউদড়-চুলে ধায় ॥ ৪ ॥

*puchite nā pāre kichu — mukhe nāhi rāẏa |*
*śuni' śacīdebī āudaṛa-cule dhāẏa || 4 ||*

*Word for word:* puchhite na pare kichhu — they cannot ask anything; mukhe nahi raya — no word comes from their lips; shuni shachidevi — hearing, Shachidevi; audara-chule dhaya — runs with dishevelled hair

**4.** they cannot ask anything — no word comes from their lips.
Hearing [of his return], Shachidevi runs with her hair dishevelled.

'আচার্য' বলিয়া ডাকে উন্মতি পাগলী ।
না দেখিয়া গৌরাঙ্গে হইলা উতরোলী ॥ ৫ ॥

*'ācārya' baliẏā ḍāke unmati pāgalī |*
*nā dekhiẏā gaurāṅge hailā utarolī || 5 ||*

*Word for word:* acharya baliya dake — she calls "Acharya!"; unmati pagali — frantic, distraught; na dekhiya gaurange — not seeing Gauranga; haila utaroli — became agitated

**5.** Frantic with grief, she calls, "Acharya!" —
and, not seeing Gauranga, she is thrown into turmoil:

আমার নিমাই কোথা থুঞা আইলে তুমি ।
কেমনে মুড়িলে মাথা কোন্ দেশ-ভূমি ॥ ৬ ॥

*āmāra nimāi kothā thuñā āile tumi |*
*kemane muṛile māthā kon deśa-bhūmi || 6 ||*

*Word for word:* amara nimai kotha thunya — where did you leave my Nimai; aile tumi — and come back; kemane mudile matha — how did He shave His head; kon desha-bhumi — in what land

**6.** "Where have you left my Nimai and come back?
How did He shave His head, in what land?

কোন্ ছার সন্ন্যাসী সে হৃদয় দারুণ ।
বিশ্বম্ভরে মন্ত্র দিতে না হইল করুণ ॥ ৭ ॥

*kon chāra sannyāsī se hṛdaẏa dāruṇa |*
*biśbambhare mantra dite nā haila karuṇa || 7 ||*

*Word for word:* kon chhara sannyasi se — what wretched sannyasi is he; hridaya daruna — hard of heart; vishvambhare mantra dite — in giving the mantra to Vishvambhara; na haila karuna — felt no pity

**7.** What wretched sannyasi with a cruel heart
felt no pity when giving the mantra to Vishvambhara![^41-2]

সে হেন সুন্দর কেশ-লাবণ্য দেখিয়া ।
কোন্ ছার নাপিত সে নিদারুণ হিয়া ॥ ৮ ॥

*se hena sundara keśa-lābaṇya dekhiẏā |*
*kon chāra nāpita se nidāruṇa hiẏā || 8 ||*

*Word for word:* se hena sundara kesha-lavanya — such loveliness of beautiful hair; dekhiya — seeing; kon chhara napita se — what wretched barber is he; nidaruna hiya — with a pitiless heart

**8.** Seeing such loveliness of beautiful hair, —
what wretched barber with a pitiless heart!

কেমন পাপিষ্ঠ তেন কেশে দিল খুর ।
কেমনে বা জীল সে নিদয়া নিঠুর ॥ ৯ ॥

*kemana pāpiṣṭha tena keśe dila khura |*
*kemane bā jīla se nidaẏā niṭhura || 9 ||*

*Word for word:* kemana papishtha — what sinner; tena keshe dila khura — put a razor to such hair; kemane va jila se — how did he survive; nidaya nithura — pitiless and cruel

**9.** What sinner put a razor to such hair?
How did he survive, that pitiless, cruel one?

আমার নিমাই কার ঘরে ভিক্ষা কৈল ।
মস্তক মুড়াঞা বাছা কেমন বা হৈল ॥ ১০ ॥

*āmāra nimāi kāra ghare bhikṣā kaila |*
*mastaka muṛāñā bāchā kemana bā haila || 10 ||*

*Word for word:* amara nimai — my Nimai; kara ghare bhiksha kaila — in whose house did He take alms; mastaka mudanya — having shaved His head; bachha kemana va haila — how does my child look now

**10.** In whose house did my Nimai take alms?
How does my child look with His head shaven?

আর না দেখিব পুত্র বদন তোমার ।
অন্ধকার হৈল মোর সকল সংসার ॥ ১১ ॥

*āra nā dekhiba putra badana tomāra |*
*andhakāra haila mora sakala saṃsāra || 11 ||*

*Word for word:* ara na dekhiba — I shall no more see; putra badana tomara — your face, son; andhakara haila — has become dark; mora sakala samsara — my whole world

**11.** I shall see your face no more, my son:
my whole world has become dark.

রন্ধন করিয়া আর নাহি দিব ভাত ।
সে হেন শ্রীঅঙ্গে আর নাহি দিব হাত ॥ ১২ ॥

*randhana kariẏā āra nāhi diba bhāta |*
*se hena śrīaṅge āra nāhi diba hāta || 12 ||*

*Word for word:* randhana kariya — having cooked; ara nahi diba bhata — I shall no more serve you rice; se hena shri-ange — that beautiful body; ara nahi diba hata — I shall no more touch

**12.** No more shall I cook rice to serve you,
no more shall I touch your beautiful body,

সুন্দর-বদনে চুম্ব না দিব মুঞি আর ।
ক্ষুধার সময় কেবা বুঝিবে তোমার ॥ ১৩ ॥

*sundara-badane cumba nā diba muñi āra |*
*kṣudhāra samaẏa kebā bujhibe tomāra || 13 ||*

*Word for word:* sundara-badane — on the beautiful face; chumba na diba munni ara — I shall kiss no more; kshudhara samaya — when you are hungry; keba bujhibe tomara — who will understand you

**13.** no more shall I kiss your lovely face.
Who will know when you are hungry?"

এতেক বিলাপ যবে শচীদেবী কৈল ।
বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া প্রবোধিতে জন কথো গেল ॥ ১৪ ॥

*eteka bilāpa yabe śacīdebī kaila |*
*biṣṇupriẏā prabodhite jana katho gela || 14 ||*

*Word for word:* eteka vilapa — such lament; yabe shachidevi kaila — when Shachidevi made; vishnupriya prabodhite — to console Vishnupriya; jana katho gela — some people went

**14.** While Shachidevi was lamenting thus,
some people went to console Vishnupriya.

বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া-কান্দনাতে পৃথিবী বিদরে ।
পশু-পক্ষী-লতা-তরু এ পাষাণ ঝুরে ॥ ১৫ ॥

*biṣṇupriẏā-kāndanāte pṛthibī bidare |*
*paśu-pakṣī-latā-taru e pāṣāṇa jhure || 15 ||*

*Word for word:* vishnupriya-kandanate — at Vishnupriya's weeping; prithivi vidare — the earth splits; pashu-pakshi-lata-taru — beasts, birds, creepers, trees; e pashana jhure — [and] these stones weep

**15.** At Vishnupriya's weeping the earth splits;
beasts, birds, creepers, trees — even the stones weep.[^41-3]

হা হা প্রাণনাথ ছাড়ি' গেলে হে নদীয়া ।
অনাথিনী বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়ায় নিঠুর হইয়া ॥ ১৫+১ ॥

*hā hā prāṇanātha chāṛi' gele he nadīẏā |*
*anāthinī biṣṇupriẏāẏa niṭhura haiẏā || 15+1 ||*

*Word for word:* ha ha prananatha — alas, alas, Lord of my life; chhadi gele he nadiya — You have left Nadia; anathini vishnupriyaya — to helpless Vishnupriya; nithura haiya — becoming cruel

**15+1.** "Alas, alas, Lord of my life, You have left Nadia,[^41-4]
cruelly forsaking helpless Vishnupriya!

শ্রীবাসাদি ভক্ত-সঙ্গে কীর্তন-বিহার ।
নয়ন ভরিয়া নৃত্য না দেখিব আর ॥ ১৫+২ ॥

*śrībāsādi bhakta-saṅge kīrtana-bihāra |*
*naẏana bhariẏā nṛtya nā dekhiba āra || 15+2 ||*

*Word for word:* shrivasa-adi bhakta-sange — with Srivasa and the other devotees; kirtana-vihara — the joy of kirtana; nayana bhariya — to my eyes' fill; nritya na dekhiba ara — I shall no more see [Your] dancing

**15+2.** The joy of kirtana with Srivasa and the other devotees,
Your dancing — I shall not see them to my eyes' fill again.

প্রেমাবেশে গদগদ বোল শ্রীবদনে ।
না শুনিয়া অভাগিনী বাঁচিবে কেমনে ॥ ১৫+৩ ॥

*premābeśe gadagada bola śrībadane |*
*nā śuniẏā abhāginī bāṁcibe kemane || 15+3 ||*

*Word for word:* premaveshe gadagada bola — the faltering words in prema's rapture; shri-badane — from [Your] beautiful lips; na shuniya — not hearing; abhagini banchibe kemane — how will the unfortunate one live

**15+3.** Not hearing the words from Your beautiful lips, faltering with prema,
how will this unfortunate one live?

কোন্ দেশে কিরূপে বা আছ প্রাণেশ্বর ।
সোঙরি' সোঙরি' প্রাণ হৈল জরজর ॥ ১৫+৪ ॥

*kon deśe kirūpe bā ācha prāṇeśbara |*
*soṅari' soṅari' prāṇa haila jarajara || 15+4 ||*

*Word for word:* kon deshe kirupe va — in what land and how; achha praneshvara — are You, Lord of my life; songari songari — remembering again and again; prana haila jarajara — my life is worn out

**15+4.** In what land are You, and how, Lord of my life?
I remember and remember — and my life is worn away.

হায় রে কঠিন প্রাণ, না বাহিরাও কেনে ।
জ্বালহ আগুনি — আমি মরিব এখনে ॥ ১৫+৫ ॥

*hāẏa re kaṭhina prāṇa, nā bāhirāo kene |*
*jbālaha āguni — āmi mariba ekhane || 15+5 ||*

*Word for word:* haya re kathina prana — alas, hard life; na bahirao kene — why do you not depart; jvalaha aguni — kindle a fire; ami mariba ekhane — I shall die at once

**15+5.** Alas, hard life, why do you not depart?
Kindle a fire — I shall die at once!

উদ্বেগে দিবস মোর হৈল কোটি যুগ ।
না দেখিয়া প্রাণনাথ তোর বিধুমুখ ॥ ১৫+৬ ॥

*udbege dibasa mora haila koṭi yuga |*
*nā dekhiẏā prāṇanātha tora bidhumukha || 15+6 ||*

*Word for word:* udvege — in anguish; divasa mora haila koti yuga — each day of mine has become millions of yugas; na dekhiya prananatha — not seeing, Lord of my life; tora vidhumukha — Your moon-face

**15+6.** In my anguish each day has become as millions of yugas:
I do not see, Lord of my life, Your moon-like face.

জীবমাত্রে উদ্বেগ না দেয় সাধুজন ।
তোর শোকে শচীমাতা ছাড়য়ে জীবন ॥ ১৫+৭ ॥

*jībamātre udbega nā deẏa sādhujana |*
*tora śoke śacīmātā chāṛaẏe jībana || 15+7 ||*

*Word for word:* jiva-matre — to any living being; udvega na deya sadhu-jana — a saint gives no distress; tora shoke — in grief for You; shachimata chhadaye jivana — Mother Shachi is giving up her life

**15+7.** A saint causes no anguish to any living being, —
yet in grief for You Mother Shachi is giving up her life.

মুঞি অভাগিনী তোমার ভকতি না জানি ।
সেই অপরাধে বুঝি হৈলুঁ অনাথিনী ॥ ১৫+৮ ॥

*muñi abhāginī tomāra bhakati nā jāni |*
*sei aparādhe bujhi hailuṁ anāthinī || 15+8 ||*

*Word for word:* munni abhagini — I, unfortunate; tomara bhakati na jani — do not know how to serve You with devotion; sei aparadhe bujhi — perhaps for that offence; hailun anathini — I have been left forlorn

**15+8.** Unfortunate, I did not know how to serve You with devotion —
surely for that offence I have been left forlorn.

চরণ-নিকটে প্রভু বসিয়া তোমার ।
রূপ হেরি' হেরি' আমি না জুড়াব আর ॥ ১৫+৯ ॥

*caraṇa-nikaṭe prabhu basiẏā tomāra |*
*rūpa heri' heri' āmi nā juṛāba āra || 15+9 ||*
