*Word for word:* charana-nikate prabhu — near the feet, Lord; basiya tomara — sitting at Your; rupa heri heri — gazing and gazing at [Your] beauty; ami na judaba ara — I shall find solace no more

**15+9.** No more shall I find solace, Lord,
sitting at Your feet and gazing and gazing at Your beauty,

বদনে তুলিয়া দিতে কর্পূর-তাম্বূলে ।
দশন-মুকুতা-পাঁতি পরশি' অঙ্গুলে ॥ ১৫+১০ ॥

*badane tuliẏā dite karpūra-tāmbūle |*
*daśana-mukutā-pāṁti paraśi' aṅgule || 15+10 ||*

*Word for word:* badane tuliya dite — raising to [Your] lips; karpura-tambule — betel with camphor; dashana-mukuta-panti — the row of pearl-like teeth; parashi angule — touching with my fingers

**15+10.** raising betel with camphor to Your lips,
touching with my fingers the pearl-like row of Your teeth.

অরুণ-নয়ান-কোণে করুণায় চাইয়া ।
মধুর মধুর কথা বলিতে হাসিয়া ॥ ১৫+১১ ॥

*aruṇa-naẏāna-koṇe karuṇāẏa cāiẏā |*
*madhura madhura kathā balite hāsiẏā || 15+11 ||*

*Word for word:* aruna-nayana-kone — from the corners of reddish eyes; karunaya chaiya — looking tenderly; madhura madhura katha — sweet, sweet words; balite hasiya — You would speak smiling

**15+11.** You would look tenderly from the corners of Your reddish eyes
and, smiling, speak sweet, sweet words.

অধর অরুণ আর তাম্বূলের রাগে ।
দশন-কিরণ মোর হিয়া-মাঝে জাগে ॥ ১৫+১২ ॥

*adhara aruṇa āra tāmbūlera rāge |*
*daśana-kiraṇa mora hiẏā-mājhe jāge || 15+12 ||*

*Word for word:* adhara aruna — lips reddish; ara tambulera rage — and with the colour of betel; dashana-kirana — the gleam of teeth; mora hiya-majhe jage — rises in my heart

**15+12.** The reddish lips, redder still with betel,
the gleam of the teeth — all rise up in my heart,

তাহাতে অমিয়া-মাখা শ্রীমুখের হাস ।
শ্রবণ-নয়ান মোর জীতে সেই আশ ॥ ১৫+১৩ ॥

*tāhāte amiẏā-mākhā śrīmukhera hāsa |*
*śrabaṇa-naẏāna mora jīte sei āśa || 15+13 ||*

*Word for word:* tahate amiya-makha — and on it, steeped in nectar; shri-mukhera hasa — the smile of the beautiful face; shravana-nayana mora — my ears and eyes; jite sei asha — live by that hope

**15+13.** and on the face a smile steeped in nectar:
only by the hope of it do my ears and eyes live.

অমিয়া অধিক প্রভু তোর যত গুণ ।
সোঙরিতে এবে সেই ভেল আগুন ॥ ১৫+১৪ ॥

*amiẏā adhika prabhu tora yata guṇa |*
*soṅarite ebe sei bhela āguna || 15+14 ||*

*Word for word:* amiya adhika — sweeter than nectar; prabhu tora yata guna — Lord, all Your virtues; songarite ebe — now, on remembering; sei bhela aguna — they have turned to fire

**15+14.** All Your virtues, Lord, are sweeter than nectar, —
but now, when I remember them, they have turned to fire.

বিনোদ-বিলাস-রস সুখময় শেজে ।
সে সব সোঙরি' বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া প্রাণ ত্যজে ॥ ১৫+১৫ ॥

*binoda-bilāsa-rasa sukhamaẏa śeje |*
*se saba soṅari' biṣṇupriẏā prāṇa tyaje || 15+15 ||*

*Word for word:* vinoda-vilasa-rasa — the sweetness of delightful pastimes; sukhamaya sheje — on the happy bed; se saba songari — remembering all that; vishnupriya prana tyaje — Vishnupriya gives up her life

**15+15.** Delightful pastimes and their sweetness, the happy bed, —
remembering all this, Vishnupriya is giving up her life.

হায় হায় কিবা দৈব হৈল আমারে ।
গৌর বিনু আমার সকল আন্ধিয়ারে ॥ ১৬ ॥

*hāẏa hāẏa kibā daiba haila āmāre |*
*gaura binu āmāra sakala āndhiẏāre || 16 ||*

*Word for word:* haya haya — alas, alas; kiba daiva haila amare — what fate has befallen me; gaura vinu — without Gaura; amara sakala andhiyare — all is dark for me

**16.** Alas, alas, what fate has befallen me!
Without Gaura all is darkness for me.

সে হাস্য, লাবণ্য দেহ না দেখিব আর ।
না শুনিব বচন-চাতুরী সুধাসার ॥ ১৭ ॥

*se hāsya, lābaṇya deha nā dekhiba āra |*
*nā śuniba bacana-cāturī sudhāsāra || 17 ||*

*Word for word:* se hasya lavanya deha — that smile, the loveliness of the body; na dekhiba ara — I shall see no more; na shuniba — I shall not hear; bachana-chaturi sudhasara — the clever words, essence of nectar

**17.** I shall see that smile, that loveliness of body no more,
I shall not hear the clever words, the essence of nectar.

অনাথিনী করিয়া কোথাকারে গেলা তুমি ।
সোঙরি' তুয়া গুণ নিবেদিয়ে আমি ॥ ১৮ ॥

*anāthinī kariẏā kothākāre gelā tumi |*
*soṅari' tuẏā guṇa nibediẏe āmi || 18 ||*

*Word for word:* anathini kariya — leaving me forlorn; kothakare gela tumi — where have You gone; songari tuya guna — remembering Your virtues; nivediye ami — I pour out [my grief]

**18.** Leaving me forlorn, where have You gone?
I remember Your virtues and pour out my grief.

কোন্ ভাগ্যবতী সে না তোমারে দেখিয়া ।
নিন্দিল কতেক মোরে কান্দিয়া কান্দিয়া ॥ ১৯ ॥

*kon bhāgyabatī se nā tomāre dekhiẏā |*
*nindila kateka more kāndiẏā kāndiẏā || 19 ||*

*Word for word:* kon bhagyavati se na — which fortunate woman did not; tomare dekhiya — who had seen You; nindila kateka more — reproach me so much; kandiya kandiya — weeping and weeping

**19.** What fortunate woman who had seen You
has not reproached me with tears?

কোন্ অভাগিনী-কোল ছাড়িয়া আইলা ।
খণ্ডব্রতী অভাগিনী কেনে না মরিলা ॥ ২০ ॥

*kon abhāginī-kola chāṛiẏā āilā |*
*khaṇḍabratī abhāginī kene nā marilā || 20 ||*

*Word for word:* kon abhagini-kola — from the embrace of what unfortunate woman; chhadiya aila — have You gone; khandavrati abhagini — the unfortunate one whose vow is broken; kene na marila — why did she not die

**20.** From the embrace of what unfortunate woman have You gone?
Why did she not die, the unfortunate one whose vow is broken?[^41-5]

পূজিল তোমার মুখ অনঙ্গ-নয়নে ।
কেমনে ধরিব হিয়া তোমা-অদর্শনে ॥ ২১ ॥

*pūjila tomāra mukha anaṅga-naẏane |*
*kemane dhariba hiẏā tomā-adarśane || 21 ||*

*Word for word:* pujila tomara mukha — I worshipped Your face; ananga-nayane — with loving eyes; kemane dhariba hiya — how shall I hold my heart; toma-adarshane — not seeing You

**21.** I worshipped Your face with loving eyes —
how shall I hold my heart without seeing You?

বিচ্ছেদে মরিল তোর যত বর-নারী ।
আমি অভাগিনী দেহ এত কাল ধরি ॥ ২২ ॥

*bicchede marila tora yata bara-nārī |*
*āmi abhāginī deha eta kāla dhari || 22 ||*

*Word for word:* vichchhede marila — have died in separation; tora yata vara-nari — all Your noble women; ami abhagini — I, unfortunate; deha eta kala dhari — have kept this body so long

**22.** All the noble women who love You are dying in separation,[^41-6]
and I, unfortunate, have kept this body so long.

মরি মরি গৌরাঙ্গসুন্দর কতি গেলা ।
আমি নারী অনাথিনী সহজে অবলা ॥ ২৩ ॥

*mari mari gaurāṅgasundara kati gelā |*
*āmi nārī anāthinī sahaje abalā || 23 ||*

*Word for word:* mari mari — I die, I die; gauranga-sundara kati gela — where has beautiful Gauranga gone; ami nari anathini — I am a forlorn woman; sahaje abala — weak by nature

**23.** I die, I die — where has beautiful Gauranga gone?
I am a woman, forlorn and weak by nature.

কোন্ দেশে যাব — লাগি পাব কোন্ ঠাঞি ।
যাইতে না দিব কেহো — মরিব এথাই ॥ ২৪ ॥

*kon deśe yāba — lāgi pāba kon ṭhāñi |*
*yāite nā diba keho — mariba ethāi || 24 ||*

*Word for word:* kon deshe yaba — to what land shall I go; lagi paba kon thanni — where shall I find [You]; yaite na diba keho — no one will let [me] go; mariba ethai — I shall die right here

**24.** To what land shall I go, where shall I find You?
No one will let me go — I shall die right here.

মায়ে অনাথিনী করি' গেলা কোন্ দেশে ।
কেমনে বঞ্চিব তেঁহ তোমার হুতাশে ॥ ২৫ ॥

*māẏe anāthinī kari' gelā kon deśe |*
*kemane bañciba teṁha tomāra hutāśe || 25 ||*

*Word for word:* maye anathini kari — leaving Your mother forlorn; gela kon deshe — to what land have You gone; kemane vanchiba tenha — how will she live; tomara hutashe — in the fire of grief for You

**25.** Leaving Your mother forlorn, to what land have You gone?
How will she live, burning with longing for You?

পাপিষ্ঠ শরীর মোর প্রাণ নাহি যায় ।
ভূমিতে লোটাঞা দেবী করে হায় হায় ॥ ২৬ ॥

*pāpiṣṭha śarīra mora prāṇa nāhi yāẏa |*
*bhūmite loṭāñā debī kare hāẏa hāẏa || 26 ||*

*Word for word:* papishtha sharira mora — from my sinful body; prana nahi yaya — life does not depart; bhumite lotanya devi — rolling on the ground, the goddess; kare haya haya — cries "Alas, alas!"

**26.** Life will not leave my sinful body!" —
rolling on the ground, the goddess cries, "Alas, alas!"

বিরহ-অনল-শ্বাস বহে অনিবার ।
অধর শুখায়, কম্প হয় কলেবর ॥ ২৭ ॥

*biraha-anala-śbāsa bahe anibāra |*
*adhara śukhāẏa, kampa haẏa kalebara || 27 ||*

*Word for word:* viraha-anala-shvasa — breath hot with the fire of separation; bahe anivara — flows ceaselessly; adhara shukhaya — her lips dry up; kampa haya kalevara — her body trembles

**27.** Breath hot with the fire of separation flows ceaselessly;
her lips dry up, her body trembles.

কেশ বাস না সম্বরে ধূলায় পড়িয়া ।
ক্ষণে ক্ষীণ হয় অঙ্গ, রহে ত ফুলিয়া ॥ ২৮ ॥

*keśa bāsa nā sambare dhūlāẏa paṛiẏā |*
*kṣaṇe kṣīṇa haẏa aṅga, rahe ta phuliẏā || 28 ||*

*Word for word:* kesha vasa na samvare — she tends neither hair nor clothes; dhulaya padiya — lying in the dust; kshane kshina haya anga — now her body grows faint; rahe ta phuliya — now it seems swollen

**28.** Lying in the dust, she tends neither hair nor clothes;
now her body grows faint, now it seems to swell.

ক্ষণে মূর্ছা পায় রাঙ্গা-চরণ-ধেয়ানে ।
সম্বিত সে পায় ক্ষণে অনেক যতনে ॥ ২৯ ॥

*kṣaṇe mūrchā pāẏa rāṅgā-caraṇa-dheẏāne |*
*sambita se pāẏa kṣaṇe aneka yatane || 29 ||*

*Word for word:* kshane murchchha paya — now she swoons; ranga-charana-dheyane — meditating on [His] reddish feet; samvita se paya kshane — now she comes to herself; aneka yatane — with great effort

**29.** Now she swoons, meditating on His reddish feet,
now with great effort she comes to herself.

'প্রভু প্রভু' বলি' ডাকে ক্ষণে আর্তনাদে ।
বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া-কান্দনাতে সর্বজন কান্দে ॥ ৩০ ॥

*'prabhu prabhu' bali' ḍāke kṣaṇe ārtanāde |*
*biṣṇupriẏā-kāndanāte sarbajana kānde || 30 ||*

*Word for word:* prabhu prabhu bali — crying "Lord, Lord!"; dake kshane artanade — now she calls with a wail; vishnupriya-kandanate — at Vishnupriya's weeping; sarvajana kande — everyone weeps

**30.** Now she calls with a wail, "Lord, Lord!" —
and at Vishnupriya's weeping everyone weeps.

প্রবোধ করিতে যেই যেই জন গেল ।
বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া দেখি' হিয়া পুড়িতে লাগিল ॥ ৩১ ॥

*prabodha karite yei yei jana gela |*
*biṣṇupriẏā dekhi' hiẏā puṛite lāgila || 31 ||*

*Word for word:* prabodha karite — to console; yei yei jana gela — whoever went; vishnupriya dekhi — seeing Vishnupriya; hiya pudite lagila — their hearts began to burn

**31.** All who went to console her —
seeing Vishnupriya, their hearts began to burn.

গৌরাঙ্গ গৌরাঙ্গ বলি' ডাকে তার কাণে ।
কতক্ষণে বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া পাইলা চেতনে ॥ ৩১+১ ॥

*gaurāṅga gaurāṅga bali' ḍāke tāra kāṇe |*
*katakṣaṇe biṣṇupriẏā pāilā cetane || 31+1 ||*

*Word for word:* gauranga gauranga bali — "Gauranga, Gauranga!"; dake tara kane — they call into her ear; katakshane — after a while; vishnupriya paila chetane — Vishnupriya regained consciousness

**31+1.** They call into her ear, "Gauranga, Gauranga!"[^41-7] —
and after a while Vishnupriya came to herself.

সর্বজন বোলে — হের শুন বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া ।
কি দিব প্রবোধ তোরে, স্থির কর হিয়া ॥ ৩২ ॥

*sarbajana bole — hera śuna biṣṇupriẏā |*
*ki diba prabodha tore, sthira kara hiẏā || 32 ||*

*Word for word:* sarvajana bole — everyone says; hera shuna vishnupriya — listen, Vishnupriya; ki diba prabodha tore — what consolation can we give you; sthira kara hiya — steady your heart

**32.** Everyone says: "Listen, Vishnupriya,
what consolation can we give you? Steady your heart.

তোর প্রভু তোর আগে কহিয়াছে কথা ।
যথাতথা যাই তোর নিকটে সর্বদা ॥ ৩২+১ ॥

*tora prabhu tora āge kahiẏāche kathā |*
*yathātathā yāi tora nikaṭe sarbadā || 32+1 ||*

*Word for word:* tora prabhu — your Lord; tora age kahiyachhe katha — has told you this; yathatatha yai — wherever I go; tora nikate sarvada — I am always near you

**32+1.** Your Lord told you:[^41-8]
'Wherever I go, I am always near you.'

তোর অগোচর নহে তোর প্রভুর কাজ ।
বুঝিয়া প্রবোধ দেহ নিজ-হিয়া-মাঝ ॥ ৩৩ ॥

*tora agocara nahe tora prabhura kāja |*
*bujhiẏā prabodha deha nija-hiẏā-mājha || 33 ||*

*Word for word:* tora agochara nahe — are not unknown to you; tora prabhura kaja — the doings of your Lord; bujhiya — understanding [this]; prabodha deha nija-hiya-majha — console your own heart

**33.** The doings of your Lord are not unknown to you:
understand this and console your own heart."

প্রবোধিয়া সব ভক্ত একত্র হইয়া ।
বিচার করয়ে গোরাচাঁদের লাগিয়া ॥ ৩৪ ॥

*prabodhiẏā saba bhakta ekatra haiẏā |*
*bicāra karaẏe gorācāṁdera lāgiẏā || 34 ||*

*Word for word:* prabodhiya — having consoled [her]; saba bhakta ekatra haiya — all the devotees, gathering together; vichara karaye — deliberate; gorachandera lagiya — about Gorachand

**34.** Having consoled her, all the devotees gathered together
and took counsel about Gorachand:

সন্ন্যাস করিল মো-সভারে দুঃখ দিয়া ।
এখানে ছাড়িয়া গেল নিদারুণ হৈয়া ॥ ৩৫ ॥

*sannyāsa karila mo-sabhāre duḥkha diẏā |*
*ekhāne chāṛiẏā gela nidāruṇa haiẏā || 35 ||*

*Word for word:* sannyasa karila — He took sannyasa; mo-sabhare duhkha diya — causing grief to us all; ekhane chhadiya gela — He left [us] here; nidaruna haiya — becoming pitiless

**35.** "He has taken sannyasa, causing grief to us all,
and pitilessly left us here.

রহিব কেমনে তাঁরে ছাড়িয়া আমরা ।
নিদারুণ মো-সভারে ছাড়িলেন গোরা ॥ ৩৬ ॥

*rahiba kemane tāṁre chāṛiẏā āmarā |*
*nidāruṇa mo-sabhāre chāṛilena gorā || 36 ||*

*Word for word:* rahiba kemane — how shall we live; tanre chhadiya amara — we, without Him; nidaruna — pitilessly; mo-sabhare chhadilena gora — Gora has left us all

**36.** How shall we live without Him?
Pitilessly Gora has left us all.

তাঁরোধিক দয়াল তাঁহার বড় নাম ।
নাম হৈতে তাঁরে পাই — এই মুখ্য কাম ॥ ৩৭ ॥

*tāṁrodhika daẏāla tāṁhāra baṛa nāma |*
*nāma haite tāṁre pāi — ei mukhya kāma || 37 ||*

*Word for word:* tanradhika dayala — more merciful than He Himself; tanhara bada nama — is His great name; nama haite tanre pai — through the name we shall attain Him; ei mukhya kama — this is the chief thing

**37.** But His great name is more merciful than He Himself:
through the name we shall attain Him — this is the chief thing.[^41-9]

তাঁর বাক্য আছে পূর্বে মো-সভার তরে ।
নাম যেই লয় সে পাইব আমারে ॥ ৩৮ ॥

*tāṁra bākya āche pūrbe mo-sabhāra tare |*
*nāma yei laẏa se pāiba āmāre || 38 ||*

*Word for word:* tanra vakya achhe purve — there is His earlier word; mo-sabhara tare — to all of us; nama yei laya — whoever takes [My] name; se paiba amare — will attain Me

**38.** There is His word, spoken to us before:
'Whoever takes My name will attain Me.'"

এত চিন্তি' নাম লৈতে বসিলা সভাই ।
শচী, বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া আর যত যত যেই ॥ ৩৯ ॥

*eta cinti' nāma laite basilā sabhāi |*
*śacī, biṣṇupriẏā āra yata yata yei || 39 ||*

*Word for word:* eta chinti — thinking thus; nama laite basila sabhai — all sat down to chant the name; shachi vishnupriya — Shachi, Vishnupriya; ara yata yata yei — and all the others

**39.** Thinking thus, all sat down to chant the name —
Shachi, Vishnupriya and all the others,

কি বালক, বৃদ্ধ কিবা, যুবক-যুবতী ।
নাম লৈতে বসিলা গৌরাঙ্গ করি' গতি ॥ ৪০ ॥

*ki bālaka, bṛddha kibā, yubaka-yubatī |*
*nāma laite basilā gaurāṅga kari' gati || 40 ||*

*Word for word:* ki balaka — children; vriddha kiba — and the old; yuvaka-yuvati — young men and women; nama laite basila — sat down to chant the name; gauranga kari gati — taking Gauranga as their refuge

**40.** children and the old, young men and women —
sat down to chant the name, taking Gauranga as their refuge.

নামপাশে বান্ধিল গৌরাঙ্গ মত্তসিংহ ।
দাণ্ডাইলা মহাপ্রভু, গতি হৈল ভঙ্গ ॥ ৪১ ॥

*nāmapāśe bāndhila gaurāṅga mattasiṃha |*
*dāṇḍāilā mahāprabhu, gati haila bhaṅga || 41 ||*

*Word for word:* nama-pashe bandhila — with the noose of the name they bound; gauranga matta-simha — Gauranga, the maddened lion; dandaila mahaprabhu — Mahaprabhu stopped; gati haila bhanga — His going was broken off

**41.** With the noose of the name they bound Gauranga, the maddened lion:
Mahaprabhu stopped, His going was broken off.[^41-10]

নিত্যানন্দ-অঙ্গে হেলিয়া রহিলা ।
অরুণ-নয়নে প্রভু কান্দিতে লাগিলা ॥ ৪২ ॥

*nityānanda-aṅge heliẏā rahilā |*
*aruṇa-naẏane prabhu kāndite lāgilā || 42 ||*

*Word for word:* nityananda-ange heliya — leaning on Nityananda; rahila — He stood; aruna-nayane — with reddened eyes; prabhu kandite lagila — the Lord began to weep

**42.** Leaning on Nityananda, He stood
and wept, His eyes reddened.

যাহ নিত্যানন্দ নবদ্বীপে আজি তুমি ।
শান্তিপুরে সভারে দেখিয়ে যেন আমি ॥ ৪৩ ॥

*yāha nityānanda nabadbīpe āji tumi |*
*śāntipure sabhāre dekhiẏe yena āmi || 43 ||*

*Word for word:* yaha nityananda — go, Nityananda; navadvipe aji tumi — you, today, to Navadvipa; shantipure sabhare — everyone in Shantipura; dekhiye yena ami — so that I may see

**43.** "Go to Navadvipa today, Nityananda,
so that I may see everyone at Shantipura."

শুনি' নিত্যানন্দ মনে আনন্দ হইল ।
দেখা দিব সভাকারে — এই সত্য কৈল ॥ ৪৪ ॥

*śuni' nityānanda mane ānanda haila |*
*dekhā diba sabhākāre — ei satya kaila || 44 ||*

*Word for word:* shuni nityananda — hearing, Nityananda; mane ananda haila — rejoiced at heart; dekha diba sabhakare — "I will show Myself to all"; ei satya kaila — thus [the Lord] gave His word

**44.** Hearing this, Nityananda rejoiced at heart,
and [the Lord] gave His word: "I will show Myself to all."

কহয়ে লোচনদাস কাতর-হিয়ায় ।
তবে প্রভু গোরাচাঁদ করিলা বিজয় ॥ ৪৫ ॥

*kahaẏe locanadāsa kātara-hiẏāẏa |*
*tabe prabhu gorācāṁda karilā bijaẏa || 45 ||*

*Word for word:* kahaye lochanadasa — says Lochana Dasa; katara-hiyaya — with a grieving heart; tabe prabhu gorachanda — then the Lord Gorachand; karila vijaya — set out

**45.** With a grieving heart Lochana Dasa says:
then the Lord Gorachand set out.

শ্রীনিত্যানন্দ প্রভু সঙ্গে চলি' যায় ।
হাসিয়া ঠাকুর তাঁরে দিলেন বিদায় ॥ ৪৬ ॥

*śrīnityānanda prabhu saṅge cali' yāẏa |*
*hāsiẏā ṭhākura tāṁre dilena bidāẏa || 46 ||*

*Word for word:* shri-nityananda prabhu — Sri Nityananda Prabhu; sange chali yaya — goes along [with the Lord]; hasiya thakura — the Lord, smiling; tanre dilena vidaya — sent Him off

**46.** Sri Nityananda Prabhu goes along with Him;[^41-11]
the Lord, smiling, sent Him off:

নবদ্বীপ যাহ তুমি — শুনহ বচন ।
নদিয়ানগরে মোর যত বন্ধুজন ॥ ৪৭ ॥

*nabadbīpa yāha tumi — śunaha bacana |*
*nadiẏānagare mora yata bandhujana || 47 ||*

*Word for word:* navadvipa yaha tumi — go to Navadvipa; shunaha bachana — hear [My] word; nadiya-nagare — in the town of Nadia; mora yata bandhu-jana — all My dear ones

**47.** "Go to Navadvipa, hear My word:
to all My dear ones in the town of Nadia

সভারে কহিও মোর 'নারায়ণ'-বাণী ।
অদ্বৈত-আচার্য-ঘরে উত্তরিব আমি ॥ ৪৮ ॥

*sabhāre kahio mora 'nārāẏaṇa'-bāṇī |*
*adbaita-ācārya-ghare uttariba āmi || 48 ||*

*Word for word:* sabhare kahio — tell everyone; mora narayana-vani — My [greeting] "Narayana"; advaita-acharya-ghare — at Advaita Acharya's house; uttariba ami — I shall stay

**48.** give My greeting, 'Narayana':[^41-12]
I shall stay at the house of Advaita Acharya.

সভারে লইয়া তুমি আইস তথাকারে ।
একত্রে হইবে দেখা আচার্যের ঘরে ॥ ৪৯ ॥

*sabhāre laiẏā tumi āisa tathākāre |*
*ekatre haibe dekhā ācāryera ghare || 49 ||*

*Word for word:* sabhare laiya — bringing everyone; tumi aisa tathakare — come there; ekatre haibe dekha — we shall all meet together; acharyera ghare — at the Acharya's house

**49.** Bring everyone and come there —
we shall all meet together at the Acharya's house."

ইহা বলি' মহাপ্রভু চলিলা সত্বর ।
নিত্যানন্দ যান তবে নদিয়ানগর ॥ ৫০ ॥

*ihā bali' mahāprabhu calilā satbara |*
*nityānanda yāna tabe nadiẏānagara || 50 ||*

*Word for word:* iha bali — saying this; mahaprabhu chalila satvara — Mahaprabhu went on quickly; nityananda yana tabe — and Nityananda then goes; nadiya-nagara — to the town of Nadia

**50.** Saying this, Mahaprabhu went on quickly,
and Nityananda goes to the town of Nadia.

নদিয়ানগরের লোক জীয়ন্তেতে মরা ।
কাটিলে কুটিলে রক্ত-মাংস নাহি তারা ॥ ৫১ ॥

*nadiẏānagarera loka jīẏantete marā |*
*kāṭile kuṭile rakta-māṃsa nāhi tārā || 51 ||*

*Word for word:* nadiya-nagarera loka — the people of the town of Nadia; jiyantete mara — are dead while living; katile kutile — cut them, chop them; rakta-mamsa nahi tara — there is no blood or flesh in them

**51.** The people of the town of Nadia are dead while living:
cut them, chop them — there is no blood or flesh in them;

উদরে নাহিক অন্ন — টলমল তনু ।
সর্ব অন্ধকার তারা গোরাচাঁদ বিনু ॥ ৫২ ॥

*udare nāhika anna — ṭalamala tanu |*
*sarba andhakāra tārā gorācāṁda binu || 52 ||*

*Word for word:* udare nahika anna — no food in their stomachs; talamala tanu — their bodies totter; sarva andhakara tara — all is darkness for them; gorachanda vinu — without Gorachand

**52.** no food in their stomachs, their bodies totter —
without Gorachand all is darkness to them.

আচম্বিতে নিত্যানন্দ নদিয়ানগরে ।
গায়ে বল হৈল — সভে ধাইল সত্বরে ॥ ৫৩ ॥

*ācambite nityānanda nadiẏānagare |*
*gāẏe bala haila — sabhe dhāila satbare || 53 ||*

*Word for word:* achambite nityananda — suddenly Nityananda; nadiya-nagare — in the town of Nadia; gaye bala haila — strength came into their bodies; sabhe dhaila satvare — all ran [to Him] quickly

**53.** Suddenly — Nityananda in the town of Nadia!
Strength came into their bodies, and all ran to Him quickly.

চলিতে না পারে পথে টলমল করে ।
দেখিতে না পায় পথ নয়নের জলে ॥ ৫৪ ॥

*calite nā pāre pathe ṭalamala kare |*
*dekhite nā pāẏa patha naẏanera jale || 54 ||*

*Word for word:* chalite na pare — they cannot walk; pathe talamala kare — they totter on the road; dekhite na paya patha — they cannot see the road; nayanera jale — for the tears in their eyes

**54.** They cannot walk, they totter on the road,
they cannot see the way for their tears.

সকল বৈষ্ণব কান্দে পড়িয়া চরণে ।
পুছিতে না পারে কিছু, নিরখে বদনে ॥ ৫৫ ॥

*sakala baiṣṇaba kānde paṛiẏā caraṇe |*
*puchite nā pāre kichu, nirakhe badane || 55 ||*

*Word for word:* sakala vaishnava kande — all the Vaishnavas weep; padiya charane — falling at [His] feet; puchhite na pare kichhu — they cannot ask anything; nirakhe badane — they gaze at [His] face

**55.** All the Vaishnavas weep, falling at His feet;
they cannot ask anything — they only gaze at His face.

শচী অতি উনমতি ধায় ঊর্ধ্বমুখে ।
এ ভূমি-আকাশ শচীর জুড়িলেক দুঃখে ॥ ৫৬ ॥

*śacī ati unamati dhāẏa ūrdhbamukhe |*
*e bhūmi-ākāśa śacīra juṛileka duḥkhe || 56 ||*

*Word for word:* shachi ati unamati — Shachi, utterly frantic; dhaya urdhvamukhe — runs with her face upturned; e bhumi-akasha — this earth and sky; shachira judileka duhkhe — Shachi's grief filled

**56.** Shachi, utterly frantic, runs with her face turned to the sky;
Shachi's grief filled earth and sky.

আর্তনাদে ডাকে শচী — আরে অবধূত ।
কোথা থুঞা আইলা মোর নিমাই সোনা-সুত ॥ ৫৭ ॥

*ārtanāde ḍāke śacī — āre abadhūta |*
*kothā thuñā āilā mora nimāi sonā-suta || 57 ||*

*Word for word:* artanade dake shachi — Shachi calls with a wail; are avadhuta — O Avadhuta; kotha thunya aila — where have you left and come; mora nimai sona-suta — my Nimai, my golden son

**57.** With a wail Shachi calls: "O Avadhuta,
where have you left my Nimai, my golden son, and come back?"

ইহা বলি' কান্দে শচী বুকে কর হানে ।
টলমল করে, নাহি চাহে পথ-পানে ॥ ৫৮ ॥

*ihā bali' kānde śacī buke kara hāne |*
*ṭalamala kare, nāhi cāhe patha-pāne || 58 ||*

*Word for word:* iha bali kande shachi — saying this, Shachi weeps; buke kara hane — beats her breast; talamala kare — she totters; nahi chahe patha-pane — she does not look to the road

**58.** Saying this, Shachi weeps and beats her breast;
she totters, not looking to the road.

শচী দেখি' অভ্যুত্থান করিলা ঠাকুর ।
শচী কহে — মোর পুত্র আইলে কতদূর ॥ ৫৯ ॥

*śacī dekhi' abhyutthāna karilā ṭhākura |*
*śacī kahe — mora putra āile katadūra || 59 ||*

*Word for word:* shachi dekhi — seeing Shachi; abhyutthana karila thakura — Thakura (Nityananda) rose [to greet her]; shachi kahe — Shachi says; mora putra aile katadura — how far has my son come

**59.** Seeing Shachi, Thakura rose to greet her.[^41-13]
Shachi says: "How far off is my son?"

নিত্যানন্দ কহে — খেদ না করিহ চিতে ।
আমারে পাঠাইল তোমা-সভাকারে নিতে ॥ ৬০ ॥

*nityānanda kahe — kheda nā kariha cite |*
*āmāre pāṭhāila tomā-sabhākāre nite || 60 ||*

*Word for word:* nityananda kahe — Nityananda says; kheda na kariha chite — do not grieve at heart; amare pathaila — He has sent me; toma-sabhakare nite — to bring you all

**60.** Nityananda says: "Do not grieve at heart:
He has sent me to bring you all.

অদ্বৈত-আচার্য-ঘরে রহিব ঠাকুর ।
খেদ না করিহ, দেখা হইব অদূর ॥ ৬১ ॥

*adbaita-ācārya-ghare rahiba ṭhākura |*
*kheda nā kariha, dekhā haiba adūra || 61 ||*

*Word for word:* advaita-acharya-ghare — at Advaita Acharya's house; rahiba thakura — the Lord will stay; kheda na kariha — do not grieve; dekha haiba adura — you will see Him soon

**61.** The Lord will stay at Advaita Acharya's house.
Do not grieve — you will see Him soon.

চলহ সকল লোক প্রভু দেখিবারে ।
সেইমতে সেইক্ষণে সর্বজন চলে ॥ ৬২ ॥

*calaha sakala loka prabhu dekhibāre |*
*seimate seikṣaṇe sarbajana cale || 62 ||*

*Word for word:* chalaha sakala loka — come, everyone; prabhu dekhibare — to see the Lord; seimate seikshane — thus, at that very moment; sarvajana chale — everyone sets out

**62.** Come, everyone, to see the Lord!" —
and at that very moment everyone set out:

আবাল-বৃদ্ধ, যুবতী, মূক, ধীর জন ।
মূর্খ কিবা তপস্বী — চলিলা সর্বজন ॥ ৬৩ ॥

*ābāla-bṛddha, yubatī, mūka, dhīra jana |*
*mūrkha kibā tapasbī — calilā sarbajana || 63 ||*

*Word for word:* abala-vriddha — from children to the old; yuvati muka dhira jana — young women, the mute, the sober; murkha kiba tapasvi — the ignorant and ascetics; chalila sarvajana — everyone set out

**63.** from children to the old, young women, the mute, the sober,
the ignorant and the ascetics — everyone set out.

শচী আগে আগে ধায় গায়ে হৈল বল ।
আনন্দে চলিয়া যায় বৈষ্ণব সকল ॥ ৬৪ ॥

*śacī āge āge dhāẏa gāẏe haila bala |*
*ānande caliẏā yāẏa baiṣṇaba sakala || 64 ||*

*Word for word:* shachi age age dhaya — Shachi runs ahead; gaye haila bala — strength came into her body; anande chaliya yaya — joyfully go; vaishnava sakala — all the Vaishnavas

**64.** Shachi runs ahead — strength has come into her body;
joyfully all the Vaishnavas go along.

অদ্বৈত-আচার্য-ঘরে উত্তরিল গিয়া ।
ভাঙ্গিল কাঁকালি তারা প্রভু না দেখিয়া ॥ ৬৫ ॥

*adbaita-ācārya-ghare uttarila giẏā |*
*bhāṅgila kāṁkāli tārā prabhu nā dekhiẏā || 65 ||*

*Word for word:* advaita-acharya-ghare — at Advaita Acharya's house; uttarila giya — they arrived; bhangila kankali tara — they were crushed (lit. "their backs broke"); prabhu na dekhiya — not seeing the Lord

**65.** Arriving at Advaita Acharya's house
and not seeing the Lord, they lost heart.[^41-14]

অদ্বৈত-আচার্যে কথা পুছে নিত্যানন্দ ।
তোমার আশ্রমে প্রভু করিলা নির্বন্ধ ॥ ৬৬ ॥

*adbaita-ācārye kathā puche nityānanda |*
*tomāra āśrame prabhu karilā nirbandha || 66 ||*

*Word for word:* advaita-acharye katha — with Advaita Acharya; puchhe nityananda — Nityananda speaks; tomara ashrame — at Your abode; prabhu karila nirbandha — the Lord has resolved [to stay]

**66.** Nityananda says to Advaita Acharya:
"The Lord has resolved to stay at Your abode.

আমারে পাঠাঞা দিল এ সভারে নিতে ।
আর কিছু না জানিয়ে কি আছয়ে চিতে ॥ ৬৭ ॥

*āmāre pāṭhāñā dila e sabhāre nite |*
*āra kichu nā jāniẏe ki āchaẏe cite || 67 ||*

*Word for word:* amare pathanya dila — He sent me; e sabhare nite — to bring all these; ara kichhu na janiye — I know nothing more; ki achhaye chite — of what is in His heart

**67.** He sent me to bring all these;
what more is in His heart I do not know."

ইহা বলি' দোঁহে মেলি' করে কোলাকুলি ।
গৌরাঙ্গ-সন্ন্যাস শুনি' অদ্বৈত বিকলি ॥ ৬৮ ॥

*ihā bali' doṁhe meli' kare kolākuli |*
*gaurāṅga-sannyāsa śuni' adbaita bikali || 68 ||*

*Word for word:* iha bali — saying this; donhe meli — the two together; kare kolakuli — embrace; gauranga-sannyasa shuni — hearing of Gauranga's sannyasa; advaita vikali — Advaita is distraught

**68.** Saying this, the two embrace;
hearing of Gauranga's sannyasa, Advaita is distraught:

মুঞি অভাগিয়া সঙ্গ না পাইল তাঁর ।
কবে চাঁদমুখ মুঞি দেখিব আরবার ॥ ৬৯ ॥

*muñi abhāgiẏā saṅga nā pāila tāṁra |*
*kabe cāṁdamukha muñi dekhiba ārabāra || 69 ||*

*Word for word:* munni abhagiya — I, unfortunate; sanga na paila tanra — did not have His company; kabe chandamukha — when [His] moon-face; munni dekhiba arabara — shall I see again

**69.** "Unfortunate that I am, I was not with Him.
When shall I see His moon-like face again?"

শচী উনমতি পুছে তখনি-তখন ।
সর্বজন বোলে — প্রভু আসিব এখন ॥ ৭০ ॥

*śacī unamati puche takhani-takhana |*
*sarbajana bole — prabhu āsiba ekhana || 70 ||*

*Word for word:* shachi unamati — frantic Shachi; puchhe takhani-takhana — asks again and again; sarvajana bole — everyone says; prabhu asiba ekhana — the Lord will come now

**70.** Frantic, Shachi keeps asking again and again,
and everyone says: "The Lord will come any moment."

উৎকণ্ঠা বাঢ়িল সর্বজনার হৃদয় ।
আইলা ত মহাপ্রভু হেনই সময় ॥ ৭১ ॥

*utkaṇṭhā bāṛhila sarbajanāra hṛdaẏa |*
*āilā ta mahāprabhu henai samaẏa || 71 ||*

*Word for word:* utkantha badhila — eagerness grew; sarvajanara hridaya — in everyone's heart; aila ta mahaprabhu — Mahaprabhu came; henai samaya — at that very time

**71.** Eagerness grew in everyone's heart —
and at that very time Mahaprabhu came.[^41-15]

আছিল-অধিক কোটিগুণ দেহ-ছটা ।
আর তাহে উজ্জ্বল চন্দন-দীর্ঘ-ফোঁটা ॥ ৭২ ॥

*āchila-adhika koṭiguṇa deha-chaṭā |*
*āra tāhe ujjbala candana-dīrgha-phoṁṭā || 72 ||*

*Word for word:* achhila-adhika kotiguna — millions of times more than before; deha-chhata — the radiance of His body; ara tahe ujjvala — and on it a bright; chandana-dirgha-phonta — long mark of sandal

**72.** The radiance of His body was millions of times greater than before,
and on it a bright, long mark of sandal.

গোরা-গায়ে অরুণ-বসন উজিয়ার ।
প্রাতঃকালের সূর্য জিনি' বরণ তাহার ॥ ৭৩ ॥

*gorā-gāẏe aruṇa-basana ujiẏāra |*
*prātaḥkālera sūrya jini' baraṇa tāhāra || 73 ||*

*Word for word:* gora-gaye — on the golden body; aruna-vasana ujiyara — the reddish cloth shines; pratah-kalera surya jini — surpassing the morning sun; varana tahara — is its colour

**73.** On the golden body the reddish cloth shines,
surpassing in colour the morning sun.

দণ্ড-করে আইসে প্রভু সিংহের গমনে ।
দেখিয়া সকল লোক পড়িলা চরণে ॥ ৭৪ ॥

*daṇḍa-kare āise prabhu siṃhera gamane |*
*dekhiẏā sakala loka paṛilā caraṇe || 74 ||*

*Word for word:* danda-kare — staff in hand; aise prabhu — the Lord comes; simhera gamane — with a lion's gait; dekhiya sakala loka padila charane — seeing Him, all the people fell at [His] feet

**74.** Staff in hand, the Lord comes with a lion's gait;
seeing Him, all the people fell at His feet.

হিয়া জুড়াইল দেখি' অঙ্গের ছটাক ।
পাশরিল সর্বলোক দুঃখ লাখে লাখ ॥ ৭৫ ॥

*hiẏā juṛāila dekhi' aṅgera chaṭāka |*
*pāśarila sarbaloka duḥkha lākhe lākha || 75 ||*

*Word for word:* hiya judaila — hearts were soothed; dekhi angera chhataka — seeing the radiance of [His] body; pasharila sarvaloka — everyone forgot; duhkha lakhe lakha — hundreds of thousands of sorrows

**75.** Seeing the radiance of His body, their hearts were soothed,
and all forgot hundreds of thousands of sorrows.

আনন্দে ভরল হিয়া, নাহি শোক দুখ ।
একদৃষ্টে চাহে সভে বিশ্বম্ভর-মুখ ॥ ৭৫+১ ॥

*ānande bharala hiẏā, nāhi śoka dukha |*
*ekadṛṣṭe cāhe sabhe biśbambhara-mukha || 75+1 ||*

*Word for word:* anande bharala hiya — hearts filled with joy; nahi shoka dukha — no sorrow or grief; ekadrishte chahe sabhe — all gaze fixedly; vishvambhara-mukha — at Vishvambhara's face

**75+1.** Hearts filled with joy — no sorrow, no grief;[^41-16]
all gaze fixedly at Vishvambhara's face.

প্রাণ হারাইলে যেন প্রাণ পায় জনে ।
ধন হারাইলে যেন ধনী পায় ধনে ॥ ৭৫+২ ॥

*prāṇa hārāile yena prāṇa pāẏa jane |*
*dhana hārāile yena dhanī pāẏa dhane || 75+2 ||*

*Word for word:* prana haraile — having lost life; yena prana paya jane — as a man regains life; dhana haraile — having lost wealth; yena dhani paya dhane — as a rich man regains his wealth

**75+2.** As a man who has lost his life regains life,
as a rich man who has lost his wealth regains his wealth,

পতি হারাইলে যেন পতিব্রতাগণ ।
সুখী যেন পাইয়া পুনর্বার দরশন ॥ ৭৫+৩ ॥

*pati hārāile yena patibratāgaṇa |*
*sukhī yena pāiẏā punarbāra daraśana || 75+3 ||*

*Word for word:* pati haraile — having lost their husbands; yena pativrata-gana — as faithful wives; sukhi yena — are happy, as; paiya punarbara darashana — on seeing them again

**75+3.** as faithful wives who have lost their husbands
are happy to see them again,

জল ছাড়ি' মৎস্য যেন ছটফট করে ।
আচম্বিতে জল পাইলে যেন কুতূহলে ॥ ৭৫+৪ ॥

*jala chāṛi' matsya yena chaṭaphaṭa kare |*
*ācambite jala pāile yena kutūhale || 75+4 ||*

*Word for word:* jala chhadi — out of water; matsya yena chhatphata kare — as a fish struggles; achambite jala paile — and, suddenly finding water; yena kutuhale — how it rejoices

**75+4.** as a fish that struggles out of water
rejoices when suddenly it finds water —

এইমত সব জন গৌরাঙ্গ দেখিয়া ।
পুলকে আকুল অঙ্গ হরষিত হিয়া ॥ ৭৫+৫ ॥

*eimata saba jana gaurāṅga dekhiẏā |*
*pulake ākula aṅga haraṣita hiẏā || 75+5 ||*

*Word for word:* eimata saba jana — thus all the people; gauranga dekhiya — seeing Gauranga; pulake akula anga — bodies thrilling; harashita hiya — hearts rejoicing

**75+5.** so all the people, seeing Gauranga,
thrill in every limb, their hearts rejoicing.

প্রেমায় ভরিল হিয়া — নাহি শোক দুঃখ ।
একদৃষ্টে চাহে শচী বিশ্বম্ভর-মুখ ॥ ৭৬ ॥

*premāẏa bharila hiẏā — nāhi śoka duḥkha |*
*ekadṛṣṭe cāhe śacī biśbambhara-mukha || 76 ||*

*Word for word:* premaya bharila hiya — her heart filled with prema; nahi shoka duhkha — no sorrow or grief; ekadrishte chahe shachi — Shachi gazes fixedly; vishvambhara-mukha — at Vishvambhara's face

**76.** Shachi's heart filled with prema — no sorrow, no grief;
she gazes fixedly at Vishvambhara's face.

আইস আইস বাপ হাপুতীর পুত ।
অনাথিনী করি' কোথা গিয়াছিলা সুত ॥ ৭৬+১ ॥

*āisa āisa bāpa hāputīra puta |*
*anāthinī kari' kothā giẏāchilā suta || 76+1 ||*

*Word for word:* aisa aisa bapa — come, come, my son; haputira puta — son of a mother bereft of her children; anathini kari — leaving [me] forlorn; kotha giyachhila suta — where did you go, son

**76+1.** "Come, come, my son, son of a mother bereft of her children![^41-17]
Leaving me forlorn, where did you go?

ঘরে লৈয়া যাব তোরে রাখিব সম্বরি' ।
সন্ন্যাসের বেশ তোর সব পরিহরি' ॥ ৭৬+২ ॥

*ghare laiẏā yāba tore rākhiba sambari' |*
*sannyāsera beśa tora saba parihari' || 76+2 ||*

*Word for word:* ghare laiya yaba tore — I shall take you home; rakhiba samvari — and keep you safe; sannyasera vesha tora — your sannyasi dress; saba parihari — removing it all

**76+2.** I shall take you home and keep you safe,
removing all your sannyasi dress."

মায়ের কান্দনা দেখি' জগত-ঈশ্বর ।
দণ্ডবত হৈয়া পড়িলা বিশ্বম্ভর ॥ ৭৬+৩ ॥

*māẏera kāndanā dekhi' jagata-īśbara |*
*daṇḍabata haiẏā paṛilā biśbambhara || 76+3 ||*

*Word for word:* mayera kandana dekhi — seeing His mother's weeping; jagata-ishvara — the Lord of the world; dandavata haiya — prostrating like a staff; padila vishvambhara — Vishvambhara fell [at her feet]

**76+3.** Seeing His mother weep, the Lord of the world,
Vishvambhara, fell before her like a staff

মায়েরে কহয় — আর না কান্দহ তুমি ।
তোমার কান্দনায় চিত্তে দুঃখ পাই আমি ॥ ৭৬+৪ ॥

*māẏere kahaẏa — āra nā kāndaha tumi |*
*tomāra kāndanāẏa citte duḥkha pāi āmi || 76+4 ||*

*Word for word:* mayere kahaya — He says to His mother; ara na kandaha tumi — weep no more; tomara kandanaya — at your weeping; chitte duhkha pai ami — My heart is pained

**76+4.** and says to His mother: "Weep no more:
your weeping pains My heart."

ইহা বলি' শোক দূর কৈল ভগবান্ ।
শচীহ আপন শোক কৈল নিবারণ ॥ ৭৬+৫ ॥

*ihā bali' śoka dūra kaila bhagabān |*
*śacīha āpana śoka kaila nibāraṇa || 76+5 ||*

*Word for word:* iha bali — saying this; shoka dura kaila bhagavan — Bhagavan dispelled [her] grief; shachiha apana shoka — and Shachi her own grief; kaila nivarana — checked

**76+5.** Saying this, Bhagavan dispelled her grief,
and Shachi checked her sorrow.

যতেক আছিল দুঃখ কিছু নাহি চিতে ।
অমিয়া সিঞ্চিল মুখ দেখিতে দেখিতে ॥ ৭৭ ॥

*yateka āchila duḥkha kichu nāhi cite |*
*amiẏā siñcila mukha dekhite dekhite || 77 ||*

*Word for word:* yateka achhila duhkha — all the grief there was; kichhu nahi chite — is gone from the heart; amiya sinchila — nectar sprinkled [them]; mukha dekhite dekhite — as they gazed and gazed at [His] face

**77.** All the grief there had been left their hearts:
His face, as they gazed at it, sprinkled them with nectar.

অদ্বৈত-আচার্য-গোসাঞি আনন্দ-হিয়ায় ।
দিব্যাসনে বসাইলা প্রভু গোরারায় ॥ ৭৮ ॥

*adbaita-ācārya-gosāñi ānanda-hiẏāẏa |*
*dibyāsane basāilā prabhu gorārāẏa || 78 ||*

*Word for word:* advaita-acharya-gosani — Advaita Acharya Gosani; ananda-hiyaya — with a joyful heart; divyasane basaila — seated on a splendid seat; prabhu goraraya — the Lord Gora Raya

**78.** Advaita Acharya Gosani, with a joyful heart,
seated the Lord Gora Raya on a splendid seat.

পাদপ্রক্ষালন করি' মুছিয়া বসনে ।
পাদোদক পান কৈল সব নিজজনে ॥ ৭৯ ॥

*pādaprakṣālana kari' muchiẏā basane |*
*pādodaka pāna kaila saba nijajane || 79 ||*

*Word for word:* pada-prakshalana kari — washing [His] feet; muchhiya vasane — wiping them with cloth; padodaka pana kaila — drank the water from [His] feet; saba nijajane — all His own people

**79.** Washing His feet and wiping them with cloth,
all His own people drank the water from His feet.

জয় জয় ধ্বনি শুনি' হরি হরি বোল ।
সকল বৈষ্ণব-হিয়া আনন্দ-হিল্লোল ॥ ৮০ ॥

*jaẏa jaẏa dhbani śuni' hari hari bola |*
*sakala baiṣṇaba-hiẏā ānanda-hillola || 80 ||*

*Word for word:* jaya jaya dhvani shuni — cries of "Jaya, jaya!" are heard; hari hari bola — "Hari, Hari!"; sakala vaishnava-hiya — in all the Vaishnavas' hearts; ananda-hillola — waves of bliss

**80.** Cries of "Jaya, jaya!" and "Hari, Hari!" resound —
waves of bliss in the hearts of all the Vaishnavas.

তেজ দেখি' আনন্দিত হৈলা হরিদাস ।
মুরারি, মুকুন্দ দত্ত আর শ্রীনিবাস ॥ ৮১ ॥

*teja dekhi' ānandita hailā haridāsa |*
*murāri, mukunda datta āra śrīnibāsa || 81 ||*

*Word for word:* teja dekhi — seeing [His] effulgence; anandita haila haridasa — Haridasa rejoiced; murari mukunda datta — Murari, Mukunda Datta; ara shrinivasa — and Srinivasa

**81.** Seeing His effulgence, Haridasa rejoiced,
and Murari, Mukunda Datta and Srinivasa.

দণ্ড-পরণাম করে ভূমিতে পড়িয়া ।
ছলছল করে আঁখি বদন দেখিয়া ॥ ৮২ ॥

*daṇḍa-paraṇāma kare bhūmite paṛiẏā |*
*chalachala kare āṁkhi badana dekhiẏā || 82 ||*

*Word for word:* danda-paranama kare — they prostrate like staffs; bhumite padiya — falling on the ground; chhalachhala kare ankhi — their eyes brim; badana dekhiya — seeing [His] face

**82.** Falling on the ground, they prostrate like staffs;
seeing His face, their eyes brim with tears.

আনন্দ-গদগদ স্বর, অঙ্গ পুলকিত ।
মৈল-শরীরে জীউ আইল আচম্বিত ॥ ৮৩ ॥

*ānanda-gadagada sbara, aṅga pulakita |*
*maila-śarīre jīu āila ācambita || 83 ||*

*Word for word:* ananda-gadagada svara — voices choked with joy; anga pulakita — bodies thrilling; maila-sharire — into dead bodies; jiu aila achambita — life suddenly returned

**83.** Their voices are choked with joy, their bodies thrill:
life suddenly returned to dead bodies.

হেনমতে নিজজনে দেখি' গোরারায় ।
কৃপাদিঠে চাহে — দয়া বাঢ়িল হিয়ায় ॥ ৮৪ ॥

*henamate nijajane dekhi' gorārāẏa |*
*kṛpādiṭhe cāhe — daẏā bāṛhila hiẏāẏa || 84 ||*

*Word for word:* henamate — thus; nijajane dekhi goraraya — Gora Raya, seeing His own; kripa-dithe chahe — looks with a merciful glance; daya badhila hiyaya — compassion swelled in His heart

**84.** Thus Gora Raya, seeing His own,
looks on them with a merciful glance — compassion swells in His heart.

কারে নিজ করে প্রভু পরশন করে ।
হাসিয়া সম্ভাষে, কাহো কোলে চাপি' ধরে ॥ ৮৫ ॥

*kāre nija kare prabhu paraśana kare |*
*hāsiẏā sambhāṣe, kāho kole cāpi' dhare || 85 ||*

*Word for word:* kare nija kare — some with His own hand; prabhu parashana kare — the Lord touches; hasiya sambhashe — He greets smiling; kaho kole chapi dhare — some He clasps to His breast

**85.** Some the Lord touches with His own hand,
some He greets with a smile, some He clasps to His breast —

যার যেই অভিমত করয়ে ঠাকুর ।
সভার অন্তরে প্রেমা বাঢ়িল প্রচুর ॥ ৮৬ ॥

*yāra yei abhimata karaẏe ṭhākura |*
*sabhāra antare premā bāṛhila pracura || 86 ||*

*Word for word:* yara yei abhimata — whatever each one desired; karaye thakura — the Lord does; sabhara antare — in everyone's heart; prema badhila prachura — prema grew abundantly

**86.** the Lord fulfils each one's desire,
and prema grew abundantly in everyone's heart.

হৃষ্ট হৈলা সর্বজন, দূরে গেল শোক ।
আনন্দে মঙ্গলধ্বনি হরি বোলে লোক ॥ ৮৭ ॥

*hṛṣṭa hailā sarbajana, dūre gela śoka |*
*ānande maṅgaladhbani hari bole loka || 87 ||*

*Word for word:* hrishta haila sarvajana — everyone was delighted; dure gela shoka — grief went far away; anande mangala-dhvani — joyfully, auspicious cries; hari bole loka — the people cry "Hari!"

**87.** Everyone was delighted, grief went far away;
joyfully the people raise the auspicious cry of "Hari!"

অদ্বৈত-আচার্য-গোসাঞি ভক্ত সুচতুর ।
তাঁহার আশ্রমে ভিক্ষা করিলা ঠাকুর ॥ ৮৮ ॥

*adbaita-ācārya-gosāñi bhakta sucatura |*
*tāṁhāra āśrame bhikṣā karilā ṭhākura || 88 ||*

*Word for word:* advaita-acharya-gosani — Advaita Acharya Gosani; bhakta suchatura — the wise devotee; tanhara ashrame — at his abode; bhiksha karila thakura — the Lord took His meal

**88.** At the abode of the wise devotee Advaita Acharya Gosani
the Lord took His meal.[^41-18]

পাক কৈল শচীমাতা জগত-জননী ।
আনন্দে ভাসিলা সীতাদেবী নারায়ণী ॥ ৮৮+১ ॥

*pāka kaila śacīmātā jagata-jananī |*
*ānande bhāsilā sītādebī nārāẏaṇī || 88+1 ||*

*Word for word:* paka kaila shachimata — Mother Shachi cooked; jagata-janani — the mother of the world; anande bhasila — floated in bliss; sita-devi narayani — Sita-devi [and] Narayani

**88+1.** Mother Shachi, the mother of the world, cooked;[^41-19]
Sita-devi and Narayani floated in bliss.

ভোজন করায় অদ্বৈত বড় পরিপাটী ।
সকল ব্যঞ্জন পাত্রে দিল মিঠি মিঠি ॥ ৮৮+২ ॥

*bhojana karāẏa adbaita baṛa paripāṭī |*
*sakala byañjana pātre dila miṭhi miṭhi || 88+2 ||*

*Word for word:* bhojana karaya advaita — Advaita serves the meal; bada paripati — with great care; sakala vyanjana — all the dishes; patre dila mithi mithi — He placed on the leaf, sweet and delicious

**88+2.** Advaita serves [the Lord] with great care:
all the dishes, most delicious, He placed on His leaf.

ভোজন করয়ে প্রভু ত্রিদশের রায় ।
দেখিয়া সকল ভক্ত আনন্দ-হিয়ায় ॥ ৮৮+৩ ॥

*bhojana karaẏe prabhu tridaśera rāẏa |*
*dekhiẏā sakala bhakta ānanda-hiẏāẏa || 88+3 ||*

*Word for word:* bhojana karaye prabhu — the Lord eats; tridashera raya — the King of the gods; dekhiya sakala bhakta — seeing this, all the devotees; ananda-hiyaya — rejoice at heart

**88+3.** The Lord, the King of the gods, eats,
and, seeing this, all the devotees rejoice at heart.

আর সব জন — যার যেই অনুরূপ ।
ভোজন করিলা সভে আনন্দ-কৌতুক ॥ ৮৯ ॥

*āra saba jana — yāra yei anurūpa |*
*bhojana karilā sabhe ānanda-kautuka || 89 ||*

*Word for word:* ara saba jana — and all the others; yara yei anurupa — each as befitted him; bhojana karila sabhe — all ate; ananda-kautuka — in joy and merriment

**89.** And all the others, each as befitted him,
ate in joy and merriment.

সন্ন্যাস করিলা প্রভু — কারো নাহি মনে ।
আনন্দে গোঙায় দিনরাতি সংকীর্তনে ॥ ৯০ ॥

*sannyāsa karilā prabhu — kāro nāhi mane |*
*ānande goṅāẏa dinarāti saṃkīrtane || 90 ||*

*Word for word:* sannyasa karila prabhu — that the Lord had taken sannyasa; karo nahi mane — no one remembers; anande gongaya — joyfully they spend; dinarati sankirtane — days and nights in sankirtana

**90.** No one remembers that the Lord has taken sannyasa:
joyfully they spend days and nights in sankirtana.

সংকীর্তনে ভোরা প্রভু নিজ-গুণ গায় ।
আনন্দ-হৃদয়ে আপে নাচিয়ে নাচায় ॥ ৯১ ॥

*saṃkīrtane bhorā prabhu nija-guṇa gāẏa |*
*ānanda-hṛdaẏe āpe nāciẏe nācāẏa || 91 ||*

*Word for word:* sankirtane bhora prabhu — the Lord, absorbed in sankirtana; nija-guna gaya — sings His own glories; ananda-hridaye — with a joyful heart; ape nachiye nachaya — dances Himself and makes others dance

**91.** Absorbed in sankirtana, the Lord sings His own glories;[^41-20]
with a joyful heart He dances Himself and makes others dance.

নাচে নিত্যানন্দ আর নাচে হরিদাস ।
মুরারি মুকুন্দ নাচে আর শ্রীনিবাস ॥ ৯১+১ ॥

*nāce nityānanda āra nāce haridāsa |*
*murāri mukunda nāce āra śrīnibāsa || 91+1 ||*

*Word for word:* nache nityananda — Nityananda dances; ara nache haridasa — and Haridasa dances; murari mukunda nache — Murari and Mukunda dance; ara shrinivasa — and Srinivasa

**91+1.** Nityananda dances, and Haridasa dances,[^41-21]
Murari, Mukunda and Srinivasa dance;

গদাধর নরহরি নাচে তাঁর পাশ ।
বাসুদেব ঘোষ নাচে গদাধর দাস ॥ ৯১+২ ॥

*gadādhara narahari nāce tāṁra pāśa |*
*bāsudeba ghoṣa nāce gadādhara dāsa || 91+2 ||*

*Word for word:* gadadhara narahari — Gadadhara [and] Narahari; nache tanra pasha — dance beside Him; vasudeva ghosha nache — Vasudeva Ghosha dances; gadadhara dasa — [and] Gadadhara Dasa

**91+2.** beside Him Gadadhara and Narahari dance,
Vasudeva Ghosha and Gadadhara Dasa dance.

সব ভক্ত নাচে মোর গৌরাঙ্গ বেড়িয়া ।
গণিতে না পারি তা সভার নাম লৈয়া ॥ ৯১+৩ ॥

*saba bhakta nāce mora gaurāṅga beṛiẏā |*
*gaṇite nā pāri tā sabhāra nāma laiẏā || 91+3 ||*

*Word for word:* saba bhakta nache — all the devotees dance; mora gauranga bediya — surrounding my Gauranga; ganite na pari — I cannot count; ta sabhara nama laiya — naming them all

**91+3.** All the devotees dance around my Gauranga —
I cannot count them, naming them one by one.

অনন্ত গৌরাঙ্গ-সঙ্গী কে কহিতে পারে ।
সভাই বেড়িয়া নাচে প্রভু বিশ্বম্ভরে ॥ ৯১+৪ ॥

*ananta gaurāṅga-saṅgī ke kahite pāre |*
*sabhāi beṛiẏā nāce prabhu biśbambhare || 91+4 ||*

*Word for word:* ananta gauranga-sangi — countless are Gauranga's companions; ke kahite pare — who can name them; sabhai bediya nache — all dance around; prabhu vishvambhare — the Lord Vishvambhara

**91+4.** Countless are Gauranga's companions — who can name them?
All dance around the Lord Vishvambhara.

সর্বভক্তগণ নাচে প্রেম-রস-রঙ্গে ।
অদ্বৈত-আচার্য নাচে নিজপুত্র-সঙ্গে ॥ ৯২ ॥

*sarbabhaktagaṇa nāce prema-rasa-raṅge |*
*adbaita-ācārya nāce nijaputra-saṅge || 92 ||*

*Word for word:* sarva-bhakta-gana nache — all the devotees dance; prema-rasa-range — in the delight of prema's rasa; advaita-acharya nache — Advaita Acharya dances; nija-putra-sange — with His own son

**92.** All the devotees dance in the delight of prema's rasa;
Advaita Acharya dances with His son.[^41-22]

সভার হৃদয়ে প্রেম বাঢ়িল অপার ।
অশ্রু-কম্প-পুলকাদি সাত্ত্বিক-বিকার ॥ ৯৩ ॥

*sabhāra hṛdaẏe prema bāṛhila apāra |*
*aśru-kampa-pulakādi sāttbika-bikāra || 93 ||*

*Word for word:* sabhara hridaye — in everyone's heart; prema badhila apara — prema grew boundlessly; ashru-kampa-pulaka-adi — tears, trembling, thrill and the rest; sattvika-vikara — the sattvika transformations

**93.** In everyone's heart prema grew boundlessly —
tears, trembling, thrill and the other sattvika transformations.

সভার হৃদয়ে ভেল আনন্দ-উল্লাস ।
এত শুনি' সুখী এ লোচনদাস ॥ ৯৪ ॥

*sabhāra hṛdaẏe bhela ānanda-ullāsa |*
*eta śuni' sukhī e locanadāsa || 94 ||*

*Word for word:* sabhara hridaye — in everyone's heart; bhela ananda-ullasa — joy and exultation arose; eta shuni — hearing this; sukhi e lochanadasa — this Lochana Dasa is happy

**94.** In everyone's heart arose joy and exultation.
Hearing this, Lochana Dasa is happy.

[^41-1]: The OCR of the summary is garbled in places; gaps are filled by sense and from the table of contents in the edition's preface (ch. 14: "Chandrashekhara Acharya's coming from Kantakanagara to Nadia; the grief and lament of Mother Shachi and Vishnupriya; Nityananda Prabhu announces Mahaprabhu's coming to Shantipura; Nityananda Prabhu's conversation with Mother Shachi; the people of Nadia come to Advaita's house to see the Lord; Mahaprabhu speaks fittingly with everyone").
[^41-2]: Words of a mother's grief; cf. en/39, vv. 100+1–100+3. In the lila Keshava Bharati is the Lord's revered sannyasa-guru (en/39, note 10).
[^41-3]: Vishnupriya is the Lord's eternal consort, His Bhu-shakti (en/21, note 9); her separation from the Lord is not worldly grief (cf. en/38, note 5).
[^41-4]: Vv. 15+1 — 15+15 are found only in the 1983 edition; the 1903 edition does not have them.
[^41-5]: Lit. "whose vow is broken": Vishnupriya apparently reproaches herself for having failed in the vow of a faithful wife — to keep her husband and serve him.
[^41-6]: Lit. "all Your worthy women" — the women of Nadia devoted to the Lord; cf. en/09, note 9.
[^41-7]: V. 31+1 is found only in the 1983 edition; the 1903 edition does not have it.
[^41-8]: V. 32+1 is found only in the 1983 edition; the 1903 edition does not have it. Cf. en/38 (the Lord consoles Vishnupriya before His sannyasa).
[^41-9]: The Lord's name is not different from Him, yet it is more merciful than He, for it is open to all — a common teaching of the Gaudiya Vaishnavas.
[^41-10]: The independent Lord submits to the love of His devotees and to their chanting of His name.
[^41-11]: In the 1983 edition a new chapter, "Pastimes at Shantipura", begins at v. 46. Vv. 46–64 — cf. Murari 3.4.3–10.
[^41-12]: The customary greeting of sannyasis (en/39, note 7); cf. Murari 3.3.13. The 1983 edition reads "Namo narayanaya".
[^41-13]: Thakura here is Nityananda.
[^41-14]: Lit. "their backs broke". In Bhaktisiddhanta's edition the number of v. 65 is printed as "1"; the numbers of vv. 60 and 85 are missing, and vv. 62 and 92 are printed as 61 and 91 — restored.
[^41-15]: Vv. 71–90 — cf. Murari 3.4.12–23; Chaitanya-charitamrita, Madhya 3.
[^41-16]: Vv. 75+1 — 75+5 are found only in the 1983 edition; in the 1903 edition vv. 75+2 — 75+5 are in a footnote, as an additional reading of one manuscript. V. 75+1 is close to v. 76.
[^41-17]: Vv. 76+1 — 76+5 are found only in the 1983 edition; the 1903 edition does not have them.
[^41-18]: Bhiksha is a sannyasi's meal, taken in a householder's home.
[^41-19]: Vv. 88+1 — 88+3 are found only in the 1983 edition; in the 1903 edition they are in a footnote, as an additional reading of one manuscript. Sita-devi is Advaita's wife; Narayani is probably Srivasa's niece, later the mother of Vrindavana Dasa (possibly also an epithet of Sita). The Chaitanya-charitamrita (Madhya 3) also says that Shachi cooked at Advaita's house.
[^41-20]: The Lord is Himself Krishna; singing of Krishna, He sings of Himself.
[^41-21]: Vv. 91+1 — 91+4 are found only in the 1983 edition; in the 1903 edition they are in a footnote, as an additional reading of one manuscript.
[^41-22]: The 1983 edition has another redaction of this couplet: "Shachi watches happily together with Sita and Narayani; Advaita Acharya dances merrily with His son."

---

# Madhya-khanda, part 19 (portion 42)

*The section "The Lord's Journey to Nilachala; the Broken Staff" (beginning): at Shantipura the Lord takes leave of the devotees and tells them to chant the name of Hari; Haridasa's plea; the devotees' sorrowful speeches; the Lord promises to live in Nilachala and consoles Shachi; Advaita laments that He feels no prema, and the Lord unties the knot of His cloth*

## The Lord's Journey to Nilachala; the Broken Staff

> *Summary by Srila Bhaktisiddhanta Sarasvati.* [Then] Bhagavan, having instructed the devotees to do good to all living beings by ceaseless chanting of the name of Hari, prepared to go to Nilachala; Thakura Haridasa, falling at His feet, poured out a humble and sorrowful plea. When the other devotees, telling of the grief of Shachi and Vishnupriya, began to follow the Lord, [the Lord] consoled them and Shachidevi with sweet words and, absorbed in prema, reciting the verse "Rama Raghava, Rama Raghava, Rama Raghava, protect me" and others, set out for Nilachala. Then, [when, having given His staff to Nityananda,] He was walking absorbed in prema in an excess of bliss, Nityananda Prabhu broke His staff, and Gaurahari showed anger towards Him.[^42-1]

*Raga bhatiyari; disha: "Brothers, O brothers, sing the glory and the virtues of Gora Gosani! (murchha) O brothers, my dear brothers, give up worldly desires: as long as you live in the world, do not leave the feet of Mahaprabhu!"*

এইমতে শুভরাতি সুপ্রভাত হৈল ।
প্রাতঃক্রিয়া করি' প্রভু আসনে বসিল ॥ ১ ॥

*eimate śubharāti suprabhāta haila |*
*prātaḥkriẏā kari' prabhu āsane basila || 1 ||*

*Word for word:* eimate — thus; shubha-rati suprabhata haila — the auspicious night turned to a bright morning; pratah-kriya kari — having done the morning duties; prabhu asane basila — the Lord sat on His seat

**1.** Thus the auspicious night turned to a bright morning;
having done His morning duties, the Lord sat on His seat.

দণ্ড-করে যেন সর্বরাজ্যের ঈশ্বর ।
অরুণ বসন অঙ্গে করে ঝলমল ॥ ২ ॥

*daṇḍa-kare yena sarbarājyera īśbara |*
*aruṇa basana aṅge kare jhalamala || 2 ||*

*Word for word:* danda-kare — staff in hand; yena sarva-rajyera ishvara — like the sovereign of all kingdoms; aruna vasana ange — the reddish cloth on His body; kare jhalamala — glitters

**2.** Staff in hand — like the sovereign of all kingdoms;
the reddish cloth glitters on His body.

যত নিজজন কাছে আছয়ে বসিয়া ।
হাসি' হাসি' কহে প্রভু সভা সম্বোধিয়া ॥ ৩ ॥

*yata nijajana kāche āchaẏe basiẏā |*
*hāsi' hāsi' kahe prabhu sabhā sambodhiẏā || 3 ||*

*Word for word:* yata nijajana — all His own people; kachhe achhaye basiya — are sitting near; hasi hasi kahe prabhu — smiling, the Lord speaks; sabha sambodhiya — addressing all

**3.** To all His own people sitting near Him
the Lord, smiling, speaks thus:

শ্রীনিবাস আদি করি' যত ভক্তগণ ।
আপন আশ্রমে সভে করহ গমন ॥ ৪ ॥

*śrīnibāsa ādi kari' yata bhaktagaṇa |*
*āpana āśrame sabhe karaha gamana || 4 ||*

*Word for word:* shrinivasa adi kari — Srinivasa and the rest; yata bhakta-gana — all the devotees; apana ashrame — to your own homes; sabhe karaha gamana — all of you go

**4.** "Srinivasa and all you devotees,
go, all of you, to your homes.

নীলাচল যাব জগন্নাথ দেখিবারে ।
প্রসন্নবদনে প্রভু যদি দয়া করে ॥ ৫ ॥

*nīlācala yāba jagannātha dekhibāre |*
*prasannabadane prabhu yadi daẏā kare || 5 ||*

*Word for word:* nilachala yaba — I shall go to Nilachala; jagannatha dekhibare — to see Jagannatha; prasanna-badane — with a gracious face; prabhu yadi daya kare — if the Lord shows mercy

**5.** I shall go to Nilachala to see Jagannatha,
if the Lord, with a gracious face, shows Me mercy.[^42-2]

তোমরা থাকিবে, আজ্ঞা করিবে পালন ।
নিরন্তর দিবানিশি করিবে কীর্তন ॥ ৬ ॥

*tomarā thākibe, ājñā karibe pālana |*
*nirantara dibāniśi karibe kīrtana || 6 ||*

*Word for word:* tomara thakibe — you will stay; ajna karibe palana — and carry out [My] order; nirantara divanishi — ceaselessly, day and night; karibe kirtana — you will perform kirtana

**6.** And you stay here and carry out My order:
ceaselessly, day and night, perform kirtana.

হরিনাম, ভক্তসেবা করিবে স্থাপন ।
এই ধর্ম করি' যেন তরে সর্বজন ॥ ৭ ॥

*harināma, bhaktasebā karibe sthāpana |*
*ei dharma kari' yena tare sarbajana || 7 ||*

*Word for word:* hari-nama bhakta-seva — the name of Hari [and] service to devotees; karibe sthapana — you will establish; ei dharma kari — practising this dharma; yena tare sarvajana — so that all people may be delivered

**7.** Establish the name of Hari and service to devotees,
so that, following this dharma, all people may be delivered.

নির্মৎসর-অন্তর হইবে সর্বজন ।
সভে সভাকার মন কর আরাধন ॥ ৮ ॥

*nirmatsara-antara haibe sarbajana |*
*sabhe sabhākāra mana kara ārādhana || 8 ||*

*Word for word:* nirmatsara-antara — free from envy at heart; haibe sarvajana — all shall be; sabhe sabhakara mana — all of you, one another's hearts; kara aradhana — honour

**8.** Let everyone's heart be free from envy;
all of you, honour one another's hearts."

এ বোল বলিয়া প্রভু উঠিলা সত্বরে ।
বাহু বেড়ি' সভাকারে আলিঙ্গন করে ॥ ৯ ॥

*e bola baliẏā prabhu uṭhilā satbare |*
*bāhu beṛi' sabhākāre āliṅgana kare || 9 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola baliya — saying this; prabhu uthila satvare — the Lord rose quickly; bahu bedi — throwing His arms around; sabhakare alingana kare — embraces everyone

**9.** Saying this, the Lord rose quickly
and, opening His arms, embraces everyone.

প্রেমজলে দু-নয়ান করে ছলছল ।
সকরুণ কণ্ঠ ভেল গদগদ স্বর ॥ ১০ ॥

*premajale du-naẏāna kare chalachala |*
*sakaruṇa kaṇṭha bhela gadagada sbara || 10 ||*

*Word for word:* prema-jale — with tears of prema; du-nayana kare chhalachhala — both eyes brim; sakaruna kantha bhela — the throat grew tender; gadagada svara — the voice faltered

**10.** Both His eyes brim with tears of prema,
His throat is tight with tenderness, His voice falters.

হেনই সময়ে সেই প্রভু হরিদাস ।
দন্তে তৃণ ধরি' পড়ে পাদাম্বুজ-পাশ ॥ ১১ ॥

*henai samaẏe sei prabhu haridāsa |*
*dante tṛṇa dhari' paṛe pādāmbuja-pāśa || 11 ||*

*Word for word:* henai samaye — at that very time; sei prabhu haridasa — the venerable Haridasa; dante trina dhari — holding a straw in his teeth; pade padambuja-pasha — falls at [His] lotus feet

**11.** At that very time the venerable Haridasa,
holding a straw between his teeth,[^42-3] falls at His lotus feet.

অতি আর্তনাদে কান্দে সকরুণ স্বরে ।
শুনিতে সকল লোক-হৃদয় বিদরে ॥ ১২ ॥

*ati ārtanāde kānde sakaruṇa sbare |*
*śunite sakala loka-hṛdaẏa bidare || 12 ||*

*Word for word:* ati artanade — with a loud wail; kande sakaruna svare — he weeps in a piteous voice; shunite — hearing it; sakala loka-hridaya vidare — the hearts of all people break

**12.** He weeps with a loud wail, in a piteous voice;
the heart of everyone who hears it breaks.

ব্যথিত হইল প্রভু সজল-নয়ন ।
কাতর-অন্তরে কিছু কহিছে বচন ॥ ১৩ ॥

*byathita haila prabhu sajala-naẏana |*
*kātara-antare kichu kahiche bacana || 13 ||*

*Word for word:* vyathita haila prabhu — the Lord was pained; sajala-nayana — with tearful eyes; katara-antare — with an aching heart; kichhu kahichhe bachana — speaks a few words

**13.** The Lord was pained, His eyes filled with tears;
with an aching heart He speaks:

এইমত ভাগ্য মোর হবে কতদিনে ।
পড়িয়া কান্দিব জগন্নাথের চরণে ॥ ১৪ ॥

*eimata bhāgya mora habe katadine |*
*paṛiẏā kāndiba jagannāthera caraṇe || 14 ||*

*Word for word:* eimata bhagya mora — such good fortune for Me; habe katadine — when will it come; padiya kandiba — falling, I shall weep; jagannathera charane — at Jagannatha's feet

**14.** "When will such good fortune be Mine —
to fall and weep at Jagannatha's feet?

কহিব কাতর কথা পাদাম্বুজ পাঞা ।
সফল করিব আঁখি শ্রীমুখ দেখিয়া ॥ ১৫ ॥

*kahiba kātara kathā pādāmbuja pāñā |*
*saphala kariba āṁkhi śrīmukha dekhiẏā || 15 ||*

*Word for word:* kahiba katara katha — I shall speak words of distress; padambuja panya — on reaching [His] lotus feet; saphala kariba ankhi — I shall make My eyes fruitful; shri-mukha dekhiya — seeing [His] holy face

**15.** Reaching His lotus feet, I shall tell Him of My distress
and, seeing His face, make My eyes fruitful."[^42-4]

এ বোল বলিতে চারিপাশে ভক্তগণ ।
ভূমিতে পড়িয়া সভে করয়ে রোদন ॥ ১৬ ॥

*e bola balite cāripāśe bhaktagaṇa |*
*bhūmite paṛiẏā sabhe karaẏe rodana || 16 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola balite — as He said this; charipashe bhakta-gana — all around the devotees; bhumite padiya — falling on the ground; sabhe karaye rodana — all weep

**16.** As He said this, all the devotees around
fell on the ground and wept.

চেতন হরিল শচী, কান্দিতে না পায় ।
ধরিবারে চাহে নিজ পুত্রের গলায় ॥ ১৭ ॥

*cetana harila śacī, kāndite nā pāẏa |*
*dharibāre cāhe nija putrera galāẏa || 17 ||*

*Word for word:* chetana harila shachi — Shachi lost her senses; kandite na paya — she cannot even weep; dharibare chahe — she wants to clasp; nija putrera galaya — her son's neck

**17.** Shachi lost her senses and cannot even weep —
she only wants to clasp her son by the neck.

কেহো পায়ে ধরি' কান্দে আউদড়-চুলি ।
অনেক যতনে তবে আপনা সম্বরি' ॥ ১৮ ॥

*keho pāẏe dhari' kānde āudaṛa-culi |*
*aneka yatane tabe āpanā sambari' || 18 ||*

*Word for word:* keho paye dhari — some, clasping [His] feet; kande audara-chuli — weep with dishevelled hair; aneka yatane tabe — then with great effort; apana samvari — composing themselves

**18.** Some weep with dishevelled hair, clasping His feet;
then, with great effort composing themselves,

শ্রীনিবাস, হরিদাস, মুরারি, মুকুন্দ ।
প্রভুরে কহিতে কিছু করে অনুবন্ধ ॥ ১৯ ॥

*śrīnibāsa, haridāsa, murāri, mukunda |*
*prabhure kahite kichu kare anubandha || 19 ||*

*Word for word:* shrinivasa haridasa — Srinivasa, Haridasa; murari mukunda — Murari, Mukunda; prabhure kahite kichhu — to say something to the Lord; kare anubandha — make an effort

**19.** Srinivasa, Haridasa, Murari and Mukunda
venture to say to the Lord:

স্বতন্ত্র ঠাকুর তুমি, মো-সব অধীন ।
দীন দুরাচার পাপী, তাহে ভক্তিহীন ॥ ২০ ॥

*sbatantra ṭhākura tumi, mo-saba adhīna |*
*dīna durācāra pāpī, tāhe bhaktihīna || 20 ||*

*Word for word:* svatantra thakura tumi — You are the independent Lord; mo-saba adhina — we are all dependent; dina durachara papi — wretched, wicked, sinful; tahe bhaktihina — and devoid of devotion besides

**20.** "You are the independent Lord, and we are all dependent,
wretched, wicked, sinful, and devoid of devotion besides.

কি বলিতে পারি প্রভু — করিলা সন্ন্যাস ।
এখন ছাড়িয়া যাহ নিজ সব দাস ॥ ২১ ॥

*ki balite pāri prabhu — karilā sannyāsa |*
*ekhana chāṛiẏā yāha nija saba dāsa || 21 ||*

*Word for word:* ki balite pari prabhu — what can we say, Lord; karila sannyasa — You have taken sannyasa; ekhana chhadiya yaha — now You are leaving; nija saba dasa — all Your servants

**21.** What can we say, Lord? You have taken sannyasa
and now You are leaving, forsaking all Your servants.

একেশ্বর কেমনে হাঁটিয়া যাবে পথে ।
ক্ষুধায় তৃষ্ণায় অন্ন চাহিবে কাহাতে ॥ ২২ ॥

*ekeśbara kemane hāṁṭiẏā yābe pathe |*
*kṣudhāẏa tṛṣṇāẏa anna cāhibe kāhāte || 22 ||*

*Word for word:* ekeshvara — all alone; kemane hantiya yabe pathe — how will You walk along the road; kshudhaya trishnaya — in hunger and thirst; anna chahibe kahate — from whom will You ask food

**22.** How will You walk the road all alone?
From whom will You ask food in hunger and thirst?

শচীর দুলাল তুমি দুর্লভ-চরিত ।
দুখানি চরণ বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়ার সেবিত ॥ ২৩ ॥

*śacīra dulāla tumi durlabha-carita |*
*dukhāni caraṇa biṣṇupriẏāra sebita || 23 ||*

*Word for word:* shachira dulala tumi — You are Shachi's darling; durlabha-charita — of rare character; duhani charana — Your two feet; vishnupriyara sevita — were served by Vishnupriya

**23.** You are Shachi's darling, of matchless character;
Vishnupriya served Your feet.

ভক্তজন-নয়ন-অমিয়া-দিঠিপাতে ।
এ দেহে প্রেমার তরু বাঢ়ে হাতে হাতে ॥ ২৪ ॥

*bhaktajana-naẏana-amiẏā-diṭhipāte |*
*e dehe premāra taru bāṛhe hāte hāte || 24 ||*

*Word for word:* bhaktajana-nayana-amiya — nectar to the devotees' eyes; dithipate — by [Your] glance; e dehe premara taru — in this body the tree of prema; badhe hate hate — grew before our eyes

**24.** By Your glance, nectar to the devotees' eyes,
the tree of prema grew in this body before our eyes.

অনেক আছিল প্রেমফল-প্রতি আশে ।
সন্ন্যাস করিয়া শূন্য করাইলা আশে ॥ ২৫ ॥

*aneka āchila premaphala-prati āśe |*
*sannyāsa kariẏā śūnya karāilā āśe || 25 ||*

*Word for word:* aneka achhila — great was; prema-phala-prati ashe — the hope of the fruit of prema; sannyasa kariya — by taking sannyasa; shunya karaila ashe — You have emptied [that] hope

**25.** Great was our hope for the fruit of prema —
and You, taking sannyasa, have emptied that hope.

পাপিষ্ঠ শরীরে প্রাণ না যায় ছাড়িয়া ।
ঘরে চলি' যাব তোরে বিদায় করিয়া ॥ ২৬ ॥

*pāpiṣṭha śarīre prāṇa nā yāẏa chāṛiẏā |*
*ghare cali' yāba tore bidāẏa kariẏā || 26 ||*

*Word for word:* papishtha sharire — from the sinful body; prana na yaya chhadiya — life does not depart; ghare chali yaba — we shall go home; tore vidaya kariya — having seen You off

**26.** Life will not leave our sinful bodies —
and so, having seen You off, we shall go home!

এখনে চলিয়া যাব মো-সব অধম ।
তোর ধর্ম নহে — তুমি পতিতপাবন ॥ ২৭ ॥

*ekhane caliẏā yāba mo-saba adhama |*
*tora dharma nahe — tumi patitapābana || 27 ||*

*Word for word:* ekhane chaliya yaba — are we now to go away; mo-saba adhama — we lowly ones; tora dharma nahe — that is not Your way; tumi patita-pavana — You are the purifier of the fallen

**27.** Are we lowly ones now to go away?
That is not Your way: You are the purifier of the fallen.

করুণা-কর্দমে তনু গড়িয়াছে বিধি ।
বিনোদ-বিলাস-লীলা দিয়া নানা নিধি ॥ ২৮ ॥

*karuṇā-kardame tanu gaṛiẏāche bidhi |*
*binoda-bilāsa-līlā diẏā nānā nidhi || 28 ||*

*Word for word:* karuna-kardame — from the clay of compassion; tanu gadiyachhe vidhi — the Creator has fashioned [Your] body; vinoda-vilasa-lila — delightful pastimes and sports; diya nana nidhi — adding many treasures

**28.** The Creator fashioned Your body from the clay of compassion,
adding the many treasures of delightful pastimes;

কেবল পরম প্রেমা — তাহে জীবন্যাস ।
ত্রৈলোক্য-অদ্ভুত রূপ করিলা প্রকাশ ॥ ২৯ ॥

*kebala parama premā — tāhe jībanyāsa |*
*trailokya-adbhuta rūpa karilā prakāśa || 29 ||*

*Word for word:* kevala parama prema — pure supreme prema; tahe jivanyasa — into it life was infused; trailokya-adbhuta rupa — a form wondrous in the three worlds; karila prakasha — You have manifested

**29.** into pure supreme prema he breathed life —
and You manifested a form wondrous in the three worlds.[^42-5]

উপমা দিবার নাহি ত্রৈলোক্য-ভিতর ।
তোমার নিঠুর বাণী — জগত কাতর ॥ ৩০ ॥

*upamā dibāra nāhi trailokya-bhitara |*
*tomāra niṭhura bāṇī — jagata kātara || 30 ||*

*Word for word:* upama dibara nahi — there is nothing to compare; trailokya-bhitara — in the three worlds; tomara nithura vani — [yet] at Your cruel words; jagata katara — the world is in anguish

**30.** There is none to compare with You in the three worlds, —
yet at Your cruel words the world is in anguish.

এমত করিতে প্রভু না জুয়ায় তোরে ।
আপনে রুইয়া বৃক্ষ কাট' কেনে মূলে ॥ ৩১ ॥

*emata karite prabhu nā juẏāẏa tore |*
*āpane ruiẏā bṛkṣa kāṭa' kene mūle || 31 ||*

*Word for word:* emata karite — to act thus; prabhu na juyaya tore — Lord, does not befit You; apane ruiya vriksha — having planted the tree Yourself; kata kene mule — why do You cut it at the root

**31.** It does not befit You to act thus, Lord:
having planted the tree Yourself, why do You cut it at the root?

যে যায় তাহারে লহ সংহতি করিয়া ।
নহে বা মরিব সভে আগুনে পুড়িয়া ॥ ৩২ ॥

*ye yāẏa tāhāre laha saṃhati kariẏā |*
*nahe bā mariba sabhe āgune puṛiẏā || 32 ||*

*Word for word:* ye yaya — whoever would go; tahare laha samhati kariya — take them with You; nahe va — or else; mariba sabhe agune pudiya — we shall all die, burning in fire

**32.** Whoever would go — take them with You,
or else we shall all die, burning in fire.

হের দেখ তোর মাতা শচী অনাথিনী ।
সহিতে না পারি ইহার বিনাইয়া কান্দনি ॥ ৩৩ ॥

*hera dekha tora mātā śacī anāthinī |*
*sahite nā pāri ihāra bināiẏā kāndani || 33 ||*

*Word for word:* hera dekha — look here; tora mata shachi anathini — at Your mother Shachi, forlorn; sahite na pari — we cannot bear; ihara vinaiya kandani — her plaintive weeping

**33.** Look at Your mother Shachi, forlorn:
we cannot bear her plaintive weeping.

বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়ার কান্দনাতে পৃথিবী বিদরে ।
শূন্য হৈল নবদ্বীপ নগরে বাজারে ॥ ৩৪ ॥

*biṣṇupriẏāra kāndanāte pṛthibī bidare |*
*śūnya haila nabadbīpa nagare bājāre || 34 ||*

*Word for word:* vishnupriyara kandanate — at Vishnupriya's weeping; prithivi vidare — the earth splits; shunya haila navadvipa — Navadvipa has become empty; nagare bajare — in town and market

**34.** At Vishnupriya's weeping the earth splits;
Navadvipa has become empty — town and market alike.

শূন্য যেন লাগে সর্ব বৈষ্ণবের ঘর ।
সভার বাড়ী যেন যোজন-অন্তর ॥ ৩৫ ॥

*śūnya yena lāge sarba baiṣṇabera ghara |*
*sabhāra bāṛī yena yojana-antara || 35 ||*

*Word for word:* shunya yena lage — seem empty; sarva vaishnavera ghara — the houses of all the Vaishnavas; sabhara badi — each other's houses; yena yojana-antara — seem yojanas apart

**35.** The houses of all the Vaishnavas seem empty,
and each other's houses seem yojanas apart.

যেখানে বসিয়া প্রভু কহিলে নিজকথা ।
দেখিলে মরিব — আর নাহি যাব তথা ॥ ৩৬ ॥

*yekhāne basiẏā prabhu kahile nijakathā |*
*dekhile mariba — āra nāhi yāba tathā || 36 ||*

*Word for word:* yekhane basiya — where, sitting; prabhu kahile nija-katha — You, Lord, spoke of Yourself; dekhile mariba — if I see [that place] I shall die; ara nahi yaba tatha — I shall go there no more

**36.** Where You sat, Lord, and spoke of Yourself —
if I see that place I shall die; I shall go there no more.

রহস্য-বিনোদ-কথা না শুনিব আর ।
না দেখিব নৃত্যাবেশ — প্রেমার প্রচার ॥ ৩৭ ॥

*rahasya-binoda-kathā nā śuniba āra |*
*nā dekhiba nṛtyābeśa — premāra pracāra || 37 ||*

*Word for word:* rahasya-vinoda-katha — intimate delightful talks; na shuniba ara — I shall hear no more; na dekhiba nrityavesha — I shall not see the rapture of dancing; premara prachara — [and] the spreading of prema

**37.** I shall hear no more intimate, delightful talks,
I shall not see the rapture of dancing, the spreading of prema.

নাচিবার বেলে আর না করিবে কোলে ।
না দেখিব অরুণ-নয়নে প্রেমজলে ॥ ৩৮ ॥

*nācibāra bele āra nā karibe kole |*
*nā dekhiba aruṇa-naẏane premajale || 38 ||*

*Word for word:* nachibara bele — at the time of dancing; ara na karibe kole — You will embrace [us] no more; na dekhiba — I shall not see; aruna-nayane premajale — tears of prema in the reddish eyes

**38.** At the time of dancing You will embrace us no more;
I shall not see tears of prema in Your reddish eyes.

হুহুঙ্কার-শব্দামৃত না শুনিব আর ।
কে মোর রোধিল কর্ণ-নয়ান-দুয়ার ॥ ৩৯ ॥

*huhuṅkāra-śabdāmṛta nā śuniba āra |*
*ke mora rodhila karṇa-naẏāna-duẏāra || 39 ||*

*Word for word:* huhunkara-shabdamrita — the nectar of [Your] roaring; na shuniba ara — I shall hear no more; ke mora rodhila — who has shut my; karna-nayana-duyara — doors of ears and eyes

**39.** I shall hear no more the nectar of Your roaring:
who has shut the doors of my ears and eyes?

কেমনে না দেখি' জীব তোর মুখচন্দ্র ।
নয়ান থাকিতে কেবা করাইল অন্ধ ॥ ৪০ ॥

*kemane nā dekhi' jība tora mukhacandra |*
*naẏāna thākite kebā karāila andha || 40 ||*

*Word for word:* kemane na dekhi — how, not seeing; jiba tora mukha-chandra — shall I live, Your moon-face; nayana thakite — while I still have eyes; keba karaila andha — who has made [me] blind

**40.** How shall I live without seeing Your moon-like face?
Who has blinded me while I still have eyes?

না দিহ বিদায় প্রভু — যাব তোর সঙ্গে ।
তোমার নিঠুর বাণী পোড়ে সব অঙ্গে ॥ ৪১ ॥

*nā diha bidāẏa prabhu — yāba tora saṅge |*
*tomāra niṭhura bāṇī poṛe saba aṅge || 41 ||*

*Word for word:* na diha vidaya prabhu — do not send [us] away, Lord; yaba tora sange — we shall go with You; tomara nithura vani — Your cruel words; pode saba ange — burn the whole body

**41.** Do not send us away, Lord — we shall go with You:
Your cruel words burn our whole body.

আহেড়ী ঘণ্টার রব যেমন করিয়া ।
কাছে মৃগী আইসে — তারে মারয়ে ধরিয়া ॥ ৪২ ॥

*āheṛī ghaṇṭāra raba yemana kariẏā |*
*kāche mṛgī āise — tāre māraẏe dhariẏā || 42 ||*

*Word for word:* aheri ghantara raba — as a hunter with the sound of a bell; yemana kariya — does; kachhe mrigi aise — [and] the doe comes near; tare maraye dhariya — he seizes and kills her

**42.** As a hunter, with the sound of a bell,
lures a doe near and then seizes and kills her, —

তেমতি তোমার প্রেম বুঝিল এখন ।
লোভ দেখাইয়া পাছে মার' কি-কারণ ॥ ৪৩ ॥

*temati tomāra prema bujhila ekhana |*
*lobha dekhāiẏā pāche māra' ki-kāraṇa || 43 ||*

*Word for word:* temati tomara prema — such is Your love too; bujhila ekhana — we have understood now; lobha dekhaiya — having enticed [us]; pachhe mara ki-karana — why then do You kill [us]

**43.** such, it seems, is Your love too — now we understand.
Why, having enticed us, do You then kill us?

তোমার বিচ্ছেদে ভক্ত সভাই মরিবে ।
ভকত-বৎসল নাম কেমনে ধরিবে ॥ ৪৪ ॥

*tomāra bicchede bhakta sabhāi maribe |*
*bhakata-batsala nāma kemane dharibe || 44 ||*

*Word for word:* tomara vichchhede — in separation from You; bhakta sabhai maribe — all the devotees will die; bhakata-vatsala nama — the name "Affectionate to devotees"; kemane dharibe — how will You bear

**44.** In separation from You all the devotees will die —
how then will You bear the name 'Affectionate to devotees'?

শচীরে বিদায় দিবে করি' কোন্ যুক্তি ।
তাহার সমীপে ইহা কহে কোন্ ব্যক্তি ॥ ৪৫ ॥

*śacīre bidāẏa dibe kari' kon yukti |*
*tāhāra samīpe ihā kahe kon byakti || 45 ||*

*Word for word:* shachire vidaya dibe — how will You take leave of Shachi; kari kon yukti — by what means; tahara samipe — to her; iha kahe kon vyakti — who will tell this

**45.** How will You take leave of Shachi?
Who will tell her this?

বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া মরিব শবদমাত্র শুনি' ।
এ কথার সম্বিধান করহ আপনি ॥ ৪৬ ॥

*biṣṇupriẏā mariba śabadamātra śuni' |*
*e kathāra sambidhāna karaha āpani || 46 ||*

*Word for word:* vishnupriya mariba — Vishnupriya will die; shabada-matra shuni — on merely hearing the word; e kathara samvidhana — the arrangement of this matter; karaha apani — make Yourself

**46.** Vishnupriya will die on merely hearing of it:
settle this matter Yourself."

এতেক বচন যবে ভক্তগণ বৈল ।
অন্তর-করুণ প্রভু কহিতে লাগিল ॥ ৪৭ ॥

*eteka bacana yabe bhaktagaṇa baila |*
*antara-karuṇa prabhu kahite lāgila || 47 ||*

*Word for word:* eteka bachana — these words; yabe bhakta-gana baila — when the devotees spoke; antara-karuna prabhu — the Lord, compassionate at heart; kahite lagila — began to speak

**47.** When the devotees had spoken such words,
the Lord, compassionate at heart, began to speak:

শুনহ সকল ভক্ত বচন প্রচুর ।
কোনকালে তো-সভারে নহিব নিঠুর ॥ ৪৮ ॥

*śunaha sakala bhakta bacana pracura |*
*konakāle to-sabhāre nahiba niṭhura || 48 ||*

*Word for word:* shunaha sakala bhakta — hear, all you devotees; bachana prachura — My full word; konakale — never; to-sabhare nahiba nithura — shall I be cruel to you

**48.** "Hear My word in full, all you devotees:
never shall I be cruel to you.

নীলাচলে বাস আমি করিব সর্বথা ।
সর্বদা আসিবে যাবে — দেখা পাবে তথা ॥ ৪৯ ॥

*nīlācale bāsa āmi kariba sarbathā |*
*sarbadā āsibe yābe — dekhā pābe tathā || 49 ||*

*Word for word:* nilachale vasa — in Nilachala to dwell; ami kariba sarvatha — I shall certainly; sarvada asibe yabe — you will always come and go; dekha pabe tatha — you will see Me there

**49.** I shall surely dwell in Nilachala;
you will always come there and see Me.[^42-6]

আছিল-অধিক প্রেমা বাঢ়িব অপার ।
হরিনাম-সংকীর্তনে ভাসিব সংসার ॥ ৫০ ॥

*āchila-adhika premā bāṛhiba apāra |*
*harināma-saṃkīrtane bhāsiba saṃsāra || 50 ||*

*Word for word:* achhila-adhika — more than before; prema badhiba apara — prema will grow boundlessly; hari-nama-sankirtane — in the sankirtana of Hari's name; bhasiba samsara — the world will float

**50.** Prema will grow boundlessly, more than before;
the world will float in the sankirtana of Hari's name.

কাহারো হৃদয়ে না রাখিব দুঃখ-শোক ।
সংকীর্তন-সমুদ্রে ডুবাব সর্বলোক ॥ ৫১ ॥

*kāhāro hṛdaẏe nā rākhiba duḥkha-śoka |*
*saṃkīrtana-samudre ḍubāba sarbaloka || 51 ||*

*Word for word:* kaharo hridaye — in no one's heart; na rakhiba duhkha-shoka — shall I leave sorrow and grief; sankirtana-samudre — in the ocean of sankirtana; dubaba sarvaloka — I shall immerse all people

**51.** In no one's heart shall I leave sorrow and grief:
I shall immerse all people in the ocean of sankirtana.

কিবা বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া, কিবা মোর মাতা শচী ।
যে ভজয়ে কৃষ্ণ, তার কোলে আমি আছি ॥ ৫২ ॥

*kibā biṣṇupriẏā, kibā mora mātā śacī |*
*ye bhajaẏe kṛṣṇa, tāra kole āmi āchi || 52 ||*

*Word for word:* kiba vishnupriya — be it Vishnupriya; kiba mora mata shachi — be it My mother Shachi; ye bhajaye krishna — whoever worships Krishna; tara kole ami achhi — I am in that one's embrace

**52.** Be it Vishnupriya or My mother Shachi —
whoever worships Krishna, in that one's embrace I abide."

এ বোল শুনিঞা সভে পড়িয়া চরণে ।
সত্য কর প্রভু যেই কহিলা বচনে ॥ ৫৩ ॥

*e bola śuniñā sabhe paṛiẏā caraṇe |*
*satya kara prabhu yei kahilā bacane || 53 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuninya — hearing these words; sabhe padiya charane — all, falling at [His] feet; satya kara prabhu — swear it, Lord; yei kahila bachane — what You have said

**53.** Hearing this, all fell at His feet:
"Swear to it, Lord — to what You have said!"

সত্য সত্য সত্য প্রভু বোলে বারবার ।
নীলাচল-বাস সত্য হইব আমার ॥ ৫৪ ॥

*satya satya satya prabhu bole bārabāra |*
*nīlācala-bāsa satya haiba āmāra || 54 ||*

*Word for word:* satya satya satya — "Truly, truly, truly"; prabhu bole barabara — the Lord says again and again; nilachala-vasa — dwelling in Nilachala; satya haiba amara — truly will be Mine

**54.** "Truly, truly, truly," the Lord repeats again and again,
"truly I shall dwell in Nilachala."

শচীদেবী দাণ্ডাইতে নারে স্থির হৈয়া ।
দাণ্ডাইলা দু-জনার হাথে ত ধরিয়া ॥ ৫৫ ॥

*śacīdebī dāṇḍāite nāre sthira haiẏā |*
*dāṇḍāilā du-janāra hāthe ta dhariẏā || 55 ||*

*Word for word:* shachidevi dandaite nare — Shachidevi cannot stand; sthira haiya — steadily; dandaila — she stood; du-janara hathe ta dhariya — holding on to the hands of two people

**55.** Shachidevi cannot stand steadily on her feet;
she rose, holding on to the hands of two people:

নিদারুণ হৈয়া কোথাকারে যাবে তুমি ।
তোমা না দেখিলে বাপ মরি' যাব আমি ॥ ৫৬ ॥

*nidāruṇa haiẏā kothākāre yābe tumi |*
*tomā nā dekhile bāpa mari' yāba āmi || 56 ||*

*Word for word:* nidaruna haiya — becoming pitiless; kothakare yabe tumi — where will you go; toma na dekhile bapa — not seeing you, my son; mari yaba ami — I shall die

**56.** "Where will you go, having become pitiless?
Not seeing you, my son, I shall die.

সভে তোর বদন দেখিব কতবার ।
আমি অভাগিনী মুখ না দেখিব আর ॥ ৫৭ ॥

*sabhe tora badana dekhiba katabāra |*
*āmi abhāginī mukha nā dekhiba āra || 57 ||*

*Word for word:* sabhe tora badana — all will see your face; dekhiba katabara — many times; ami abhagini — I, unfortunate; mukha na dekhiba ara — shall see [your] face no more

**57.** Everyone else will see your face many times —
but I, unfortunate, shall see it no more.

সভার প্রবোধ বাছা করিলে আপনে ।
আমার প্রবোধ বাপ হইব কেমনে ॥ ৫৮ ॥

*sabhāra prabodha bāchā karile āpane |*
*āmāra prabodha bāpa haiba kemane || 58 ||*

*Word for word:* sabhara prabodha — everyone's consolation; bachha karile apane — you yourself, child, have given; amara prabodha bapa — my consolation, son; haiba kemane — how will it be

**58.** You yourself, child, have consoled everyone —
but who, my son, will console me?

আমার দ্বিতীয় কেহো নাহি এ সংসারে ।
বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া শেলমাত্র বুকের ভিতরে ॥ ৫৯ ॥

*āmāra dbitīẏa keho nāhi e saṃsāre |*
*biṣṇupriẏā śelamātra bukera bhitare || 59 ||*

*Word for word:* amara dvitiya keho nahi — I have no one else; e samsare — in this world; vishnupriya shela-matra — Vishnupriya is but a spear; bukera bhitare — within my breast

**59.** I have no one else in this world,
and Vishnupriya is like a spear lodged in my breast."

হাসিয়া কহেন প্রভু সকরুণ-হিয়া ।
মিছা শোকে মর পূর্বজ্ঞান পাশরিয়া ॥ ৬০ ॥

*hāsiẏā kahena prabhu sakaruṇa-hiẏā |*
*michā śoke mara pūrbajñāna pāśariẏā || 60 ||*

*Word for word:* hasiya kahena prabhu — the Lord says, smiling; sakaruna-hiya — with a compassionate heart; michha shoke mara — you die of vain grief; purva-jnana pashariya — forgetting your former knowledge

**60.** Smiling, with a compassionate heart, the Lord says:
"You are dying of vain grief, forgetting what you knew before.[^42-7]

চলি' যাহ, শোক কিছু না করিহ চিতে ।
নির্মৎসর হই' রহ সভার সহিতে ॥ ৬১ ॥

*cali' yāha, śoka kichu nā kariha cite |*
*nirmatsara hai' raha sabhāra sahite || 61 ||*

*Word for word:* chali yaha — go home; shoka kichhu na kariha chite — keep no grief in your heart; nirmatsara hai — free from envy; raha sabhara sahite — live with everyone

**61.** Go home, keep no grief in your heart,
live with everyone, free from envy."

দণ্ডবত করি' প্রভু মায়ের চরণে ।
প্রবোধ করিল প্রভু কথার বিধানে ॥ ৬২ ॥

*daṇḍabata kari' prabhu māẏera caraṇe |*
*prabodha karila prabhu kathāra bidhāne || 62 ||*

*Word for word:* dandavata kari prabhu — the Lord, prostrating; mayera charane — at His mother's feet; prabodha karila prabhu — the Lord consoled [her]; kathara vidhane — with well-ordered words

**62.** Prostrating at His mother's feet,
the Lord consoled her with well-ordered words.

মায়ে প্রবোধিয়া প্রভু বোলে হরিবোল ।
