সত্বরে চলিলা — উঠে কান্দনের রোল ॥ ৬৩ ॥

*māẏe prabodhiẏā prabhu bole haribola |*
*satbare calilā — uṭhe kāndanera rola || 63 ||*

*Word for word:* maye prabodhiya — having consoled His mother; prabhu bole haribola — the Lord cries "Haribol!"; satvare chalila — He went off quickly; uthe kandanera rola — a loud wailing arises

**63.** Having consoled His mother, the Lord cries "Haribol!"
and goes off quickly — a loud wailing arises.

অদ্বৈত-আচার্য প্রভুর সঙ্গে চলি' যায় ।
দণ্ড-দুই গিয়া প্রভু পাছু-পানে চায় ॥ ৬৪ ॥

*adbaita-ācārya prabhura saṅge cali' yāẏa |*
*daṇḍa-dui giẏā prabhu pāchu-pāne cāẏa || 64 ||*

*Word for word:* advaita-acharya — Advaita Acharya; prabhura sange chali yaya — goes along with the Lord; danda-dui giya — after going two dandas; prabhu pachhu-pane chaya — the Lord looks back

**64.** Advaita Acharya goes along with the Lord;
after going two dandas,[^42-8] the Lord looks back.

দাণ্ডাইলা মহাপ্রভু আচার্য-বিলম্বে ।
উত্তরিলা আচার্য কাঁকালি-অবলম্বে ॥ ৬৫ ॥

*dāṇḍāilā mahāprabhu ācārya-bilambe |*
*uttarilā ācārya kāṁkāli-abalambe || 65 ||*

*Word for word:* dandaila mahaprabhu — Mahaprabhu stopped; acharya-vilambe — as the Acharya lagged behind; uttarila acharya — the Acharya came up; kankali-avalambe — holding His waist

**65.** Mahaprabhu stopped, for the Acharya had fallen behind;
the Acharya came up, holding His waist,

বয়ান বিরস, ঘর্ম বিন্দু বিন্দু তায় ।
কাতর-অন্তরে কিছু প্রভুরে সুধায় ॥ ৬৬ ॥

*baẏāna birasa, gharma bindu bindu tāẏa |*
*kātara-antare kichu prabhure sudhāẏa || 66 ||*

*Word for word:* bayana virasa — His face drawn; gharma bindu bindu taya — drops of sweat on it; katara-antare — with a pained heart; kichhu prabhure sudhaya — He asks the Lord

**66.** His face drawn, beads of sweat upon it,
and with an aching heart He asks the Lord:

তুমি পরদেশে যাবে — এই মোর দুঃখ ।
তাহাতেই আর এক পোড়ে মোর বুক ॥ ৬৭ ॥

*tumi paradeśe yābe — ei mora duḥkha |*
*tāhātei āra eka poṛe mora buka || 67 ||*

*Word for word:* tumi paradeshe yabe — You will go to a foreign land; ei mora duhkha — this is my sorrow; tahatei ara eka — and besides that another; pode mora buka — burns my breast

**67.** "You are going to a foreign land — that is my sorrow;
but besides it another thing burns my breast.

আপন অন্তর-কথা করিয়ে গোচর ।
নিশ্চয় কহিবে প্রভু ইহার উত্তর ॥ ৬৮ ॥

*āpana antara-kathā kariẏe gocara |*
*niścaẏa kahibe prabhu ihāra uttara || 68 ||*

*Word for word:* apana antara-katha — what is in my heart; kariye gochara — I make known; nishchaya kahibe prabhu — surely, Lord, You will give; ihara uttara — the answer to this

**68.** I make known to You what is in my heart —
surely, Lord, You will answer me.

তোর নিজজন যত তোমার বিচ্ছেদে ।
কান্দয়ে কাতর হঞা পদ-অরবিন্দে ॥ ৬৯ ॥

*tora nijajana yata tomāra bicchede |*
*kāndaẏe kātara hañā pada-arabinde || 69 ||*

*Word for word:* tora nijajana yata — all Your own people; tomara vichchhede — in separation from You; kandaye katara hanya — weep in anguish; pada-aravinde — at [Your] lotus feet

**69.** All Your own people, in separation from You,
weep in anguish at Your lotus feet, —

আমার পাপিষ্ঠ হিয়া না দরবে কেনে ।
এ কাঠ-কঠিন, অশ্রু নাহিক নয়ানে ॥ ৭০ ॥

*āmāra pāpiṣṭha hiẏā nā darabe kene |*
*e kāṭha-kaṭhina, aśru nāhika naẏāne || 70 ||*

*Word for word:* amara papishtha hiya — my sinful heart; na darabe kene — why does it not melt; e katha-kathina — it is hard as wood; ashru nahika nayane — there are no tears in my eyes

**70.** why then does my sinful heart not melt?
It is hard as wood; there are no tears in my eyes.

আমার অধিক আর দুরাচার নাহি ।
তোমার বিচ্ছেদে হিয়ায় প্রেমা উঠে নাহি ॥ ৭১ ॥

*āmāra adhika āra durācāra nāhi |*
*tomāra bicchede hiẏāẏa premā uṭhe nāhi || 71 ||*

*Word for word:* amara adhika — worse than me; ara durachara nahi — there is no wicked one; tomara vichchhede — in separation from You; hiyaya prema uthe nahi — no prema rises in my heart

**71.** There is no one more wicked than I:
in separation from You no prema rises in my heart."

এ বোল শুনিঞা প্রভু হাসি' কৈল কোলে ।
কহিব ইহার তত্ত্ব — শুন মোর বোলে ॥ ৭২ ॥

*e bola śuniñā prabhu hāsi' kaila kole |*
*kahiba ihāra tattba — śuna mora bole || 72 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuninya — hearing these words; prabhu hasi kaila kole — the Lord, smiling, embraced [Him]; kahiba ihara tattva — I shall tell You the truth of this; shuna mora bole — hear My words

**72.** Hearing this, the Lord smiled and embraced Him:
"I shall tell You the truth of it — hear My words.

তোমার প্রেমায় আমি ছাড়িতে না পারি ।
তে-কারণে তোর প্রেমা গাঁঠিতে সম্বরি ॥ ৭৩ ॥

*tomāra premāẏa āmi chāṛite nā pāri |*
*te-kāraṇe tora premā gāṁṭhite sambari || 73 ||*

*Word for word:* tomara premaya — because of Your prema; ami chhadite na pari — I could not leave; te-karane — therefore; tora prema ganthite samvari — I keep Your prema tied up in a knot

**73.** Because of Your prema I could not have left —
therefore I keep Your prema tied up in a knot."[^42-9]

ইহা বলি' আউলাইলা বসনের গ্রন্থি ।
প্রেমায় বিভোর সে আচার্য মনে চিন্তি' ॥ ৭৪ ॥

*ihā bali' āulāilā basanera granthi |*
*premāẏa bibhora se ācārya mane cinti' || 74 ||*

*Word for word:* iha bali — saying this; aulaila vasanera granthi — [the Lord] untied the knot of His cloth; premaya vibhora — overwhelmed with prema; se acharya mane chinti — the Acharya, thinking [of Him]

**74.** Saying this, He untied the knot of His cloth, —
and the Acharya, thinking of Him, became intoxicated with prema:

নয়ন-সাগরে বহে সাত পাঁচ ধারা ।
নির্ভর প্রেমায় সম্বেদন নাহি তারা ॥ ৭৫ ॥

*naẏana-sāgare bahe sāta pāṁca dhārā |*
*nirbhara premāẏa sambedana nāhi tārā || 75 ||*

*Word for word:* nayana-sagare — from the ocean of His eyes; bahe sata pancha dhara — five, seven streams flow; nirbhara premaya — in boundless prema; samvedana nahi tara — He lost awareness

**75.** from the ocean of His eyes flowed five, seven streams;
in boundless prema He lost all awareness.

পড়িলা অদ্বৈত প্রভু 'শ্রীচৈতন্য' বলি' ।
চৈতন্য-বিয়োগে গড়াগড়ি যায় ধূলি ॥ ৭৫+১ ॥

*paṛilā adbaita prabhu 'śrīcaitanya' bali' |*
*caitanya-biẏoge gaṛāgaṛi yāẏa dhūli || 75+1 ||*

*Word for word:* padila advaita prabhu — Advaita Prabhu fell; shri-chaitanya bali — crying "Sri Chaitanya!"; chaitanya-viyoge — in separation from Chaitanya; gadagadi yaya dhuli — he rolls in the dust

**75+1.** Advaita Prabhu fell, crying "Sri Chaitanya!"[^42-10]
and rolls in the dust in separation from Chaitanya.

দেখিলেন মহাপ্রভু অদ্বৈত-বিলম্ব ।
পুন গাঁঠি বান্ধে প্রভু — অদ্বৈত সম্বন্ধ ॥ ৭৫+২ ॥

*dekhilena mahāprabhu adbaita-bilamba |*
*puna gāṁṭhi bāndhe prabhu — adbaita sambandha || 75+2 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhilena mahaprabhu — Mahaprabhu saw; advaita-vilamba — that Advaita was held back; puna ganthi bandhe prabhu — the Lord ties the knot again; advaita sambandha — [binding] Advaita's [prema]

**75+2.** Seeing that Advaita could not go on,
the Lord ties the knot again, [binding] His prema.

আস্তেব্যস্তে সম্বরণ করিলা ঠাকুর ।
সম্বরণ কৈল তবে আচার্য চতুর ॥ ৭৬ ॥

*āstebyaste sambaraṇa karilā ṭhākura |*
*sambaraṇa kaila tabe ācārya catura || 76 ||*

*Word for word:* astevyaste — hastily; samvarana karila thakura — the Lord restrained [it]; samvarana kaila tabe — then composed Himself; acharya chatura — the wise Acharya

**76.** Hastily the Lord restrained it,
and then the wise Acharya composed Himself.

এই ত কারণে তোর প্রেমা উঠে নাই ।
তোমার প্রেমায় আমি চলিতে না পাই ॥ ৭৭ ॥

*ei ta kāraṇe tora premā uṭhe nāi |*
*tomāra premāẏa āmi calite nā pāi || 77 ||*

*Word for word:* ei ta karane — for this very reason; tora prema uthe nai — Your prema does not rise; tomara premaya — because of Your prema; ami chalite na pai — I could not go on

**77.** "That is why Your prema does not rise:
because of Your prema I could not go on.

তোর প্রেমার বশ আমি — শুনহ আচার্য ।
পূর্ব সোঙরণ কর, বিচারহ কার্য ॥ ৭৮ ॥

*tora premāra baśa āmi — śunaha ācārya |*
*pūrba soṅaraṇa kara, bicāraha kārya || 78 ||*

*Word for word:* tora premara vasha ami — I am under the sway of Your prema; shunaha acharya — hear, Acharya; purva songarana kara — remember the past; vicharaha karya — and consider [Your] task

**78.** I am under the sway of Your prema — hear, Acharya:
remember the past and consider Your task."[^42-11]

এ বোল বলিয়া প্রভু চলিলা সত্বর ।
সকল বৈষ্ণব গেলা আপনার ঘর ॥ ৭৯ ॥

*e bola baliẏā prabhu calilā satbara |*
*sakala baiṣṇaba gelā āpanāra ghara || 79 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola baliya — saying this; prabhu chalila satvara — the Lord went off quickly; sakala vaishnava gela — all the Vaishnavas went; apanara ghara — to their homes

**79.** Saying this, the Lord went off quickly,
and all the Vaishnavas went to their homes.

কহয়ে লোচনদাস গোরা-ঠাকুরাল ।
সন্ন্যাস নহে ত — বুকে রহি' গেল শাল ॥ ৮০ ॥

*kahaẏe locanadāsa gorā-ṭhākurāla |*
*sannyāsa nahe ta — buke rahi' gela śāla || 80 ||*

*Word for word:* kahaye lochanadasa — Lochana Dasa tells; gora-thakurala — of Gora's lordly ways; sannyasa nahe ta — it is not sannyasa; buke rahi gela shala — [but] a spear left lodged in the breast

**80.** Lochana Dasa tells of Gora's lordly ways:
this is not sannyasa — it is a spear left lodged in the breast.[^42-12]

[^42-1]: The OCR of the summary is badly garbled; gaps are filled by sense and from the table of contents in the edition's preface (ch. 15: "the Lord instructs the devotees to do good to all living beings by chanting the name of Hari; when He prepares to go to Nilachala — Thakura Haridasa's humble words to the Lord; when the devotees begin to follow — He consoles them with the sweetest words and leaves for Nilachala reciting the verse 'Rama Raghava, Rama Raghava, protect me' and others; on the way Nityananda breaks the staff; the Lord shows anger"). The summary runs ahead: the journey to Nilachala and the broken staff are in the next portion.
[^42-2]: "The Lord" here is Jagannatha.
[^42-3]: A sign of utmost humility. Vv. 11–15 — cf. Murari 3.4.28–30.
[^42-4]: The Lord speaks in the mood of a devotee longing for the darshana of Jagannatha.
[^42-5]: A poetic image: the Lord's form is eternal and spiritual, and no one created it; the devotees, in their love, speak of Him as the most beautiful of creations.
[^42-6]: Vv. 47–54 — cf. Murari 3.4.24–26. The Lord kept this promise: the devotees from Bengal came to Him at Puri every year.
[^42-7]: "What you knew before" — that her son is Bhagavan Himself (this is hidden from her by yogamaya, which nourishes her motherly love: en/37, note 16). "Vain" (michha) means "futile", not "unreal" (en/37, note 14).
[^42-8]: A danda is a measure of time, about 24 minutes.
[^42-9]: Cf. Murari 3.4.32–33: Advaita asks why He feels no love on hearing of the Lord's departure, and the Lord replies: "If Your love had shown itself, how could I have left?"
[^42-10]: Vv. 75+1 — 75+2 are found only in the 1983 edition; the 1903 edition does not have them.
[^42-11]: Apparently the Lord reminds Advaita — Maha-Vishnu in the form of a devotee (en/27, note 8) — that it was He who by His prayers called the Lord into the world, and of the work for which the Lord came, the spreading of sankirtana.
[^42-12]: In the 1983 edition chapter 15 ends here; the next chapter, "The Journey to Nilachala", begins with v. 81.

---

# Madhya-khanda, part 20 (portion 43)

*The section "The Lord's Journey to Nilachala; the Broken Staff" (end): the Lord walks with His companions to Nilachala absorbed in prema, singing the verse "Rama Raghava"; toll-collectors release the pilgrims; Nityananda breaks the Lord's staff and answers His anger*

সভারে বিদায় দিয়া চলিলা ঠাকুর ।
শূন্যাকার কৈল সব নবদ্বীপপুর ॥ ৮১ ॥

*sabhāre bidāẏa diẏā calilā ṭhākura |*
*śūnyākāra kaila saba nabadbīpapura || 81 ||*

*Word for word:* sabhare vidaya diya — taking leave of all; chalila thakura — the Thakura set out; shunyakara kaila — made empty; saba navadvipa-pura — the whole town of Navadvipa

**81.** Having taken leave of all, the Thakura set out —
and the whole town of Navadvipa was left empty.[^43-1]

পণ্ডিত শ্রীগদাধর, অবধূতরায় ।
নরহরি-আদি কথোজন সঙ্গে যায় ॥ ৮২ ॥

*paṇḍita śrīgadādhara, abadhūtarāẏa |*
*narahari-ādi kathojana saṅge yāẏa || 82 ||*

*Word for word:* pandita shri-gadadhara — Pandita Sri Gadadhara; avadhuta-raya — the royal Avadhuta; narahari-adi — Narahari and others; kathojana — a few people; sange yaya — go with [Him]

**82.** Pandita Sri Gadadhara, the royal Avadhuta,
Narahari and a few others go with Him;

শ্রীনিবাস, মুরারি, মুকুন্দ, দামোদর ।
এই নিজজন-সঙ্গে চলিলা ঈশ্বর ॥ ৮৩ ॥

*śrīnibāsa, murāri, mukunda, dāmodara |*
*ei nijajana-saṅge calilā īśbara || 83 ||*

*Word for word:* shrinivasa, murari, mukunda, damodara — Srinivasa, Murari, Mukunda, Damodara; ei nijajana-sange — with these His own people; chalila ishvara — the Lord set out

**83.** Srinivasa, Murari, Mukunda, Damodara —
with these His own people the Lord set out.[^43-2]

জগন্নাথ দোলেতে দেখিব মনে করি' ।
সত্বরে চলিলা প্রভু বলি' হরি হরি ॥ ৮৪ ॥

*jagannātha dolete dekhiba mane kari' |*
*satbare calilā prabhu bali' hari hari || 84 ||*

*Word for word:* jagannatha dolete dekhiba — I shall see Jagannatha at the Dola [festival]; mane kari — thinking; satvare chalila prabhu — the Lord set out quickly; bali hari hari — crying "Hari! Hari!"

**84.** "I shall see Jagannatha at the Dola festival," He thought,
and the Lord set off in haste, crying "Hari! Hari!"[^43-3]

প্রেমায় বিভোল প্রভু চলি' যায় পথে ।
টলমল করে তনু না পারে হাঁটিতে ॥ ৮৫ ॥

*premāẏa bibhola prabhu cali' yāẏa pathe |*
*ṭalamala kare tanu nā pāre hāṁṭite || 85 ||*

*Word for word:* premaya bhibhola prabhu — the Lord, overwhelmed with prema; chali yaya pathe — goes along the road; talamala kare tanu — His body sways; na pare hantite — He cannot walk

**85.** Overwhelmed with prema, the Lord walks along the road;
His body sways, He cannot walk.

ক্ষণে শীঘ্রগতি ধায় সিংহপরাক্রমে ।
ক্ষণে হুহুঙ্কার দেই ডাকে হরিনামে ॥ ৮৬ ॥

*kṣaṇe śīghragati dhāẏa siṃhaparākrame |*
*kṣaṇe huhuṅkāra dei ḍāke harināme || 86 ||*

*Word for word:* kshane shighra-gati dhaya — now He rushes swiftly; simha-parakrame — with a lion's might; kshane huhunkara dei — now He roars; dake hari-name — calls out the name of Hari

**86.** Now He rushes swiftly with the might of a lion,
now He roars aloud and calls out the name of Hari;

ক্ষণে নাচে ক্ষণে গায় সকরুণ কান্দে ।
ক্ষণে মালসাট মারে প্রেমার উন্মাদে ॥ ৮৭ ॥

*kṣaṇe nāce kṣaṇe gāẏa sakaruṇa kānde |*
*kṣaṇe mālasāṭa māre premāra unmāde || 87 ||*

*Word for word:* kshane nache — now He dances; kshane gaya — now sings; sakaruna kande — weeps piteously; kshane malasata mare — now slaps His arms; premara unmade — in the madness of prema

**87.** now He dances, now sings, now weeps piteously,
now in the madness of prema He slaps His arms.

অরুণ-নয়ানে জলধারা অনিবার ।
বিপুল-পুলকে সে ঢাকিল কলেবর ॥ ৮৮ ॥

*aruṇa-naẏāne jaladhārā anibāra |*
*bipula-pulake se ḍhākila kalebara || 88 ||*

*Word for word:* aruna-nayane — from the reddish eyes; jaladhara anibara — ceaseless streams of tears; vipula-pulake — with abundant thrill (hair standing on end); se dhakila kalebara — the body was covered

**88.** From His reddish eyes streams of tears flow without cease,
and the hair on His whole body stands on end.

ক্ষণেকে মন্থরগতি অলৌকিক কহে ।
ক্ষণে অট্ট-অট্ট হাসে দাঁড়াইয়া রহে ॥ ৮৯ ॥

*kṣaṇeke mantharagati alaukika kahe |*
*kṣaṇe aṭṭa-aṭṭa hāse dāṁṛāiẏā rahe || 89 ||*

*Word for word:* kshaneke manthara-gati — at times with slow gait; alaukika kahe — speaks unearthly things; kshane atta-atta hase — at times laughs aloud; dandaiya rahe — stands still

**89.** At times He walks slowly and says unearthly things,
at times He stands still and laughs aloud.

যদি বা কখন ভক্ষ্য উপসন্ন হয় ।
'নিবেদিত নহে' বলি' কিছুই না লয় ॥ ৯০ ॥

*yadi bā kakhana bhakṣya upasanna haẏa |*
*'nibedita nahe' bali' kichui nā laẏa || 90 ||*

*Word for word:* yadi va kakhana — if ever; bhakshya upasanna haya — food is brought; nivedita nahe bali — saying "not offered"; kichhui na laya — He takes nothing

**90.** If ever food is brought to Him,
He says, "This is not offered [to Krishna]," and takes nothing.

অনেক যতনে দুই তিনে করে ভিক্ষা ।
লোক-অনুগ্রহে সে প্রকাশে লোকশিক্ষা ॥ ৯১ ॥

*aneka yatane dui tine kare bhikṣā |*
*loka-anugrahe se prakāśe lokaśikṣā || 91 ||*

*Word for word:* aneka yatane — with great effort; dui tine kare bhiksha — accepts alms once in two or three [days]; loka-anugrahe — out of mercy for people; se prakashe loka-shiksha — He shows a lesson to people

**91.** Only with great effort [is He persuaded] to accept alms — once in two or three [days]:
out of mercy for people He shows them a lesson.[^43-4]

সব-নিশি জাগরণ — লয় হরিনাম ।
ডাকিয়া পঢ়য়ে এই শ্লোক গুণধাম ॥ ৯২ ॥

*saba-niśi jāgaraṇa — laẏa harināma |*
*ḍākiẏā paṛhaẏe ei śloka guṇadhāma || 92 ||*

*Word for word:* saba-nishi jagarana — awake all night; laya harinama — He chants the name of Hari; dakiya padhaye — recites aloud; ei shloka gunadhama — this verse, abode of virtues

**92.** All night He stays awake and chants the name of Hari;
aloud He recites this verse, the abode of virtues.

*Thus:*

রাম রাঘব রাম রাঘব রাম রাঘব রক্ষ মাম্ ।
কৃষ্ণ কেশব কৃষ্ণ কেশব কৃষ্ণ কেশব পাহি মাম্ ॥ ৯৩ ॥

*rāma rāghaba rāma rāghaba rāma rāghaba rakṣa mām |*
*kṛṣṇa keśaba kṛṣṇa keśaba kṛṣṇa keśaba pāhi mām || 93 ||*

*Word for word:* rama raghava — Rama, Raghava; raksha mam — protect me; krishna keshava — Krishna, Keshava; pahi mam — save me

**93.** "Rama, Raghava, Rama, Raghava, Rama, Raghava, protect me!
Krishna, Keshava, Krishna, Keshava, Krishna, Keshava, save me!"[^43-5]

এই শ্লোক সুমধুর-স্বরে গায় পঁহু ।
প্রেমার আনন্দে গদগদ ভাষে লহু ॥ ৯৪ ॥

*ei śloka sumadhura-sbare gāẏa paṁhu |*
*premāra ānande gadagada bhāṣe lahu || 94 ||*

*Word for word:* ei shloka — this verse; sumadhura-svare — in the sweetest voice; gaya panhu — the Lord sings; premara anande — in the bliss of prema; gadagada bhashe — in faltering speech; lahu — softly

**94.** This verse the Lord sings in the sweetest voice —
softly, in faltering speech, in the bliss of prema.

দোলে জগন্নাথ দেখিবারে যাত্রিগণ ।
প্রভুসঙ্গে যায় তারা আনন্দিত-মন ॥ ৯৫ ॥

*dole jagannātha dekhibāre yātrigaṇa |*
*prabhusaṅge yāẏa tārā ānandita-mana || 95 ||*

*Word for word:* dole jagannatha dekhibare — to see Jagannatha at the Dola; yatri-gana — the pilgrims; prabhu-sange yaya tara — they go with the Lord; anandita-mana — joyful at heart

**95.** Pilgrims going to see Jagannatha at the Dola festival
walk along with the Lord with joy in their hearts.

এককালে একঠাঞি যাত্রিক-সমূহ ।
পথে রাখিয়াছে দানী পাপিষ্ঠ দুরূহ ॥ ৯৬ ॥

*ekakāle ekaṭhāñi yātrika-samūha |*
*pathe rākhiẏāche dānī pāpiṣṭha durūha || 96 ||*

*Word for word:* ekakale — once; ekathani — at one place; yatrika-samuha — a crowd of pilgrims; pathe rakhiyachhe — has held up on the road; dani — a toll-collector; papishtha duruha — sinful, cruel

**96.** Once, at one place, a crowd of pilgrims
was held up on the road by a toll-collector, sinful and cruel.[^43-6]

অনেক যন্ত্রণা দুঃখ দিছে তা-সভারে ।
আগাইয়াছিলা প্রভু লেউটে সত্বরে ॥ ৯৭ ॥

*aneka yantraṇā duḥkha diche tā-sabhāre |*
*āgāiẏāchilā prabhu leuṭe satbare || 97 ||*

*Word for word:* aneka yantrana duhkha — much torment and grief; dichhe ta-sabhare — he gives them all; agaiyachhila prabhu — the Lord, who had gone ahead; leute satvare — quickly turns back

**97.** He was giving them much torment and grief.
The Lord, who had gone ahead, quickly turns back.

অবধূত গদাধর-পণ্ডিত বিস্ময় ।
কি কারণে পুনঃ লেউটিয়া প্রভু যায় ॥ ৯৮ ॥

*abadhūta gadādhara-paṇḍita bismaẏa |*
*ki kāraṇe punaḥ leuṭiẏā prabhu yāẏa || 98 ||*

*Word for word:* avadhuta gadadhara-pandita — the Avadhuta and Gadadhara Pandita; vismaya — are amazed; ki karane — why; punah leutiya prabhu yaya — the Lord turns back again

**98.** The Avadhuta and Gadadhara Pandita are amazed:
"Why has the Lord turned back again?"

চিন্তিতে চিন্তিতে তারা যায় পাছে পাছে ।
কথোদূরে দেখে দানী যাত্রী বান্ধিয়াছে ॥ ৯৯ ॥

*cintite cintite tārā yāẏa pāche pāche |*
*kathodūre dekhe dānī yātrī bāndhiẏāche || 99 ||*

*Word for word:* chintite chintite — wondering; tara yaya pachhe pachhe — they follow behind; kathodure dekhe — a little way off they see; dani yatri bandhiyachhe — the toll-collector has bound the pilgrims

**99.** Wondering, they follow behind Him
and a little way off they see: the toll-collector has bound the pilgrims.

কারণ দেখিয়া তারা ভেল চমকিত ।
পুলক-ভরল অঙ্গ — অতি আনন্দিত ॥ ১০০ ॥

*kāraṇa dekhiẏā tārā bhela camakita |*
*pulaka-bharala aṅga — ati ānandita || 100 ||*

*Word for word:* karana dekhiya — seeing the reason; tara bhela chamakita — they started; pulaka-bharala anga — their bodies filled with thrill; ati anandita — greatly rejoicing

**100.** Seeing the reason, they started;
their hair stood on end and they were filled with joy.

যাত্রিকে দেখিয়া প্রভু বিরস-বদন ।
ত্বরায়ে চলিলা মত্তসিংহের গমন ॥ ১০১ ॥

*yātrike dekhiẏā prabhu birasa-badana |*
*tbarāẏe calilā mattasiṃhera gamana || 101 ||*

*Word for word:* yatrike dekhiya — seeing the pilgrims; prabhu birasa-badana — the Lord, sad-faced; tvaraye chalila — went quickly; matta-simhera gamana — with the gait of an enraged lion

**101.** Seeing the pilgrims, the Lord's face grew sad,
and He hurried forward with the gait of an enraged lion.

প্রভুকে দেখিয়া যাত্রী কান্দে উভরায় ।
ত্রাস পাঞা শিশু যেন মায়ের কোল পায় ॥ ১০২ ॥

*prabhuke dekhiẏā yātrī kānde ubharāẏa |*
*trāsa pāñā śiśu yena māẏera kola pāẏa || 102 ||*

*Word for word:* prabhuke dekhiya — seeing the Lord; yatri kande ubharaya — the pilgrims weep aloud; trasa panya shishu — a frightened child; yena mayera kola paya — as if reaching its mother's lap

**102.** Seeing the Lord, the pilgrims weep aloud —
like a frightened child that has reached its mother's lap,

দীন বনজন্তু যেন দগ্ধ দাবানলে ।
সন্তপ্ত হইয়া পড়ে জাহ্নবীর জলে ॥ ১০৩ ॥

*dīna banajantu yena dagdha dābānale |*
*santapta haiẏā paṛe jāhnabīra jale || 103 ||*

*Word for word:* dina bana-jantu — wretched forest creatures; yena dagdha davanale — as if scorched by a forest fire; santapta haiya — tormented; pade jahnavira jale — plunge into the waters of the Jahnavi

**103.** like wretched forest creatures scorched by a forest fire
that, tormented, plunge into the waters of the Jahnavi.

প্রভুর চরণে পড়ি' কান্দে যাত্রিগণ ।
দেখিয়া পাপিষ্ঠ দানী গণে মনে মন ॥ ১০৪ ॥

*prabhura caraṇe paṛi' kānde yātrigaṇa |*
*dekhiẏā pāpiṣṭha dānī gaṇe mane mana || 104 ||*

*Word for word:* prabhura charane padi — falling at the Lord's feet; kande yatri-gana — the pilgrims weep; dekhiya — seeing [this]; papishtha dani — the sinful toll-collector; gane mane mana — thinks to himself

**104.** The pilgrims weep, fallen at the Lord's feet;
seeing this, the sinful toll-collector thinks to himself:

এরূপ মানুষ নাহি জগত-ভিতর ।
এই নীলাচলচন্দ্র জানিল অন্তর ॥ ১০৫ ॥

*erūpa mānuṣa nāhi jagata-bhitara |*
*ei nīlācalacandra jānila antara || 105 ||*

*Word for word:* erupa manusha nahi — there is no such man; jagata-bhitara — in the world; ei nilachala-chandra — this is the Moon of Nilachala; janila antara — he knew in his heart

**105.** "There is no such man in the world!"
He understood in his heart: this is the Moon of Nilachala.[^43-7]

ইহা-সভাকারে আমি দিলুঁ এত দুঃখ ।
কি করয়ে জানি' মোর ডরে কাঁপে বুক ॥ ১০৬ ॥

*ihā-sabhākāre āmi diluṁ eta duḥkha |*
*ki karaẏe jāni' mora ḍare kāṁpe buka || 106 ||*

*Word for word:* iha-sabhakare — to all these; ami dilun eta duhkha — I have given so much grief; ki karaye jani — who knows what He will do; mora dare — from fear my; kampe buka — heart trembles

**106.** "I have given them all so much grief —
who knows what He will do? My heart trembles with fear."

এতেক চিন্তিয়া মনে সেই মহাদানী ।
প্রভুর চরণে পড়ি' বোলে কাকু-বাণী ॥ ১০৭ ॥

*eteka cintiẏā mane sei mahādānī |*
*prabhura caraṇe paṛi' bole kāku-bāṇī || 107 ||*

*Word for word:* eteka chintiya mane — thinking thus; sei maha-dani — that great toll-collector; prabhura charane padi — falling at the Lord's feet; bole kaku-bani — speaks piteous words

**107.** Thinking thus, that great toll-collector
fell at the Lord's feet and speaks piteous words:

ছাড়িলুঁ যাত্রিকগণ — না সাধিব দান ।
অন্তরে জানিলুঁ প্রভু — তুমি ভগবান্ ॥ ১০৮ ॥

*chāṛiluṁ yātrikagaṇa — nā sādhiba dāna |*
*antare jāniluṁ prabhu — tumi bhagabān || 108 ||*

*Word for word:* chhadilun yatrika-gana — I have released the pilgrims; na sadhiba dana — I shall not take the toll; antare janilun — I have known in my heart; prabhu — Lord; tumi bhagavan — You are Bhagavan

**108.** "I have released the pilgrims, I shall not take the toll:
I have understood in my heart, Lord — You are Bhagavan."

ইহা বলি' চরণে পড়িয়া সেই কান্দে ।
তাহার মাথাতে দিল চরণারবিন্দে ॥ ১০৯ ॥

*ihā bali' caraṇe paṛiẏā sei kānde |*
*tāhāra māthāte dila caraṇārabinde || 109 ||*

*Word for word:* iha bali — saying this; charane padiya — fallen at His feet; sei kande — he weeps; tahara mathate dila — He placed on his head; charanaravinde — His lotus feet

**109.** Saying this, he weeps, fallen at His feet,
and [the Lord] placed His lotus feet upon his head.

কম্প-গদগদ-স্বরে নানা স্তব করে ।
বিষয়ী বলিয়া ঘৃণা না করিহ মোরে ॥ ১১০ ॥

*kampa-gadagada-sbare nānā staba kare |*
*biṣaẏī baliẏā ghṛṇā nā kariha more || 110 ||*

*Word for word:* kampa-gadagada-svare — trembling, in a choked voice; nana stava kare — offers many praises; vishayi baliya — as a worldly man; ghrina na kariha more — do not despise me

**110.** Trembling, in a choked voice he offers many praises:
"Do not despise me because I am a worldly man."

এ বোল শুনিঞা প্রভু মুচকি হাসিয়া ।
সুখে চলি' যান যাত্রিগণ ছাড়াইয়া ॥ ১১১ ॥

*e bola śuniñā prabhu mucaki hāsiẏā |*
*sukhe cali' yāna yātrigaṇa chāṛāiẏā || 111 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuninya — hearing this; prabhu muchaki hasiya — the Lord, smiling faintly; sukhe chali yana — walks on happily; yatri-gana chhadaiya — having freed the pilgrims

**111.** Hearing this, the Lord smiled faintly
and walks on happily, having set the pilgrims free.

হেনই সময়ে কথোদূরে আর দানী ।
ডাকিতে ডাকিতে আইসে উভ করি' পাণি ॥ ১১২ ॥

*henai samaẏe kathodūre āra dānī |*
*ḍākite ḍākite āise ubha kari' pāṇi || 112 ||*

*Word for word:* henai samaye — just then; kathodure — a little way off; ara dani — another toll-collector; dakite dakite aise — comes calling out; ubha kari pani — with his hand raised

**112.** Just then, a little way off, another toll-collector
comes calling out to them with his hand raised.

দেখিয়া ঠাকুর তাহে উভ কৈল বাই ।
হাথসানে সেই দানী রহে সেই ঠাঞি ॥ ১১৩ ॥

*dekhiẏā ṭhākura tāhe ubha kaila bāi |*
*hāthasāne sei dānī rahe sei ṭhāñi || 113 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhiya thakura — seeing [him], the Thakura; tahe ubha kaila bai — raised His arm to him; hathasane — at the sign of the hand; sei dani rahe — that toll-collector stayed; sei thani — in that place

**113.** Seeing him, the Thakura raised His arm in reply —
and at that sign the toll-collector stopped where he was.

ঝরঝর নয়ন — পুলক কলেবর ।
হরে-কৃষ্ণ-নাম সেই বোলে নিরন্তর ॥ ১১৪ ॥

*jharajhara naẏana — pulaka kalebara |*
*hare-kṛṣṇa-nāma sei bole nirantara || 114 ||*

*Word for word:* jharajhara nayana — tears stream from his eyes; pulaka kalebara — his body thrills; hare-krishna-nama — the name "Hare Krishna"; sei bole nirantara — he says ceaselessly

**114.** Tears stream from his eyes, his hair stands on end;
ceaselessly he chants the name "Hare Krishna."

দেখি' নিত্যানন্দ-গদাধরের উল্লাস ।
গৌরাঙ্গ-চরিত্র কহে এ লোচনদাস ॥ ১১৫ ॥

*dekhi' nityānanda-gadādharera ullāsa |*
*gaurāṅga-caritra kahe e locanadāsa || 115 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhi — seeing; nityananda-gadadharera ullasa — the jubilation of Nityananda and Gadadhara; gauranga-charitra — the deeds of Gauranga; kahe e lochanadasa — this Lochana Dasa tells

**115.** Seeing the jubilation of Nityananda and Gadadhara,
Lochana Dasa tells the deeds of Gauranga.

*Raga sindhura; disha: "Brothers, sing, sing, hear of the virtues of Gora Gosani! (murchha) Aho, aho, aho! Long for the lotus feet of Gauranga. All that you see in the world you count as your own — ho-ho-ho, ho-ho-ho, brothers — yet all of it is vain forever. Brothers, sing, sing, hear of Gora's virtues!"*[^43-8]

এইমতে গোরাচাঁদ চলি' যায় পথে ।
যেখানে যে দেবস্থল দেখিতে দেখিতে ॥ ১১৬ ॥

*eimate gorācāṁda cali' yāẏa pathe |*
*yekhāne ye debasthala dekhite dekhite || 116 ||*

*Word for word:* eimate — thus; gorachanda chali yaya pathe — Gorachand walks along the road; yekhane ye deva-sthala — whatever holy places there are; dekhite dekhite — looking at them

**116.** Thus Gorachand walks along the road,
looking at every holy place He comes upon.

রহি' রহি' যায় প্রভু প্রতি গ্রামে গ্রামে ।
নর্তন করিয়া যায় দেবতার স্থানে ॥ ১১৭ ॥

*rahi' rahi' yāẏa prabhu prati grāme grāme |*
*nartana kariẏā yāẏa debatāra sthāne || 117 ||*

*Word for word:* rahi rahi yaya prabhu — the Lord goes, stopping again and again; prati grame grame — in every village; nartana kariya yaya — dances and goes on; devatara sthane — at the shrines of the gods

**117.** The Lord goes on, stopping in every village,
and dances at the shrines of the gods.

এক অদ্ভুত কথা শুন তার মাঝে ।
যে করিলা নিত্যানন্দ অবধূতরাজে ॥ ১১৮ ॥

*eka adbhuta kathā śuna tāra mājhe |*
*ye karilā nityānanda abadhūtarāje || 118 ||*

*Word for word:* eka adbhuta katha — one wondrous story; shuna tara majhe — hear, in the midst of this; ye karila nityananda — what Nityananda did; avadhuta-raje — the king of avadhutas

**118.** Hear of one wondrous thing on the way —
what Nityananda, the king of avadhutas, did.

নিত্যানন্দ-করে দণ্ড দিয়া গৌরহরি ।
কিছু আগাইলা নিত্যানন্দ পাছু করি' ॥ ১১৯ ॥

*nityānanda-kare daṇḍa diẏā gaurahari |*
*kichu āgāilā nityānanda pāchu kari' || 119 ||*

*Word for word:* nityananda-kare — into Nityananda's hand; danda diya — giving the staff; gaurahari — Gaurahari; kichhu agaila — went somewhat ahead; nityananda pachhu kari — leaving Nityananda behind

**119.** Gaurahari gave His staff into Nityananda's hand
and went somewhat ahead, leaving Nityananda behind.

প্রেমায় বিহ্বল প্রভু যায় মহাবেগে ।
আপনা পাসরে কৃষ্ণপ্রেম-অনুরাগে ॥ ১২০ ॥

*premāẏa bihbala prabhu yāẏa mahābege |*
*āpanā pāsare kṛṣṇaprema-anurāge || 120 ||*

*Word for word:* premaya vihvala prabhu — the Lord, overwhelmed with prema; yaya maha-vege — goes very fast; apana pasare — forgets Himself; krishna-prema-anurage — in passionate love for Krishna

**120.** Overwhelmed with prema, the Lord walks very fast,
forgetting Himself in passionate love for Krishna.

গদাধর-আদি যত গণ সঙ্গে যায় ।
দেখি' নিত্যানন্দ আরো দূরে পাছু হয় ॥ ১২১ ॥

*gadādhara-ādi yata gaṇa saṅge yāẏa |*
*dekhi' nityānanda āro dūre pāchu haẏa || 121 ||*

*Word for word:* gadadhara-adi yata gana — Gadadhara and all the companions; sange yaya — go with [Him]; dekhi nityananda — seeing this, Nityananda; aro dure pachhu haya — falls still farther behind

**121.** Gadadhara and all the companions go with Him;
seeing this, Nityananda falls still farther behind.

গুণিতে গুণিতে প্রভু যায় ধীরে ধীরে ।
মোর বিদ্যমানে প্রভু দণ্ড ধরে করে ॥ ১২২ ॥

*guṇite guṇite prabhu yāẏa dhīre dhīre |*
*mora bidyamāne prabhu daṇḍa dhare kare || 122 ||*

*Word for word:* gunite gunite — pondering; prabhu yaya dhire dhire — Prabhu [Nityananda] walks slowly; mora vidyamane — before my eyes; prabhu danda dhare kare — the Lord holds a staff in His hand

**122.** Pondering, Prabhu [Nityananda] walks slowly:
"Before my eyes the Lord holds a staff in His hand!

সে হেন সুন্দর বাঁশী ত্রৈলোক্যমোহন ।
ছাড়িয়া ধরিল দণ্ড — সহিব কেমন ॥ ১২৩ ॥

*se hena sundara bāṁśī trailokyamohana |*
*chāṛiẏā dharila daṇḍa — sahiba kemana || 123 ||*

*Word for word:* se hena sundara banshi — that beautiful flute; trailokya-mohana — enchanting the three worlds; chhadiya — leaving; dharila danda — He took up a staff; sahiba kemana — how shall I bear it

**123.** Leaving that beautiful flute that enchants the three worlds,
He has taken up a staff — how can I bear it?

সন্ন্যাস করিল প্রভু মুণ্ডাইল মাথা ।
জন্মাবধি রহিল দারুণ এই ব্যথা ॥ ১২৪ ॥

*sannyāsa karila prabhu muṇḍāila māthā |*
*janmābadhi rahila dāruṇa ei byathā || 124 ||*

*Word for word:* sannyasa karila prabhu — the Lord took sannyasa; mundaila matha — shaved His head; janmavadhi rahila — remains for life; daruna ei vyatha — this cruel pain

**124.** The Lord has taken sannyasa and shaved His head —
this cruel pain will stay [with me] all my life."

চিন্তিতে চিন্তিতে দুঃখ বাড়িল বিস্তর ।
ভাঙ্গিলেন থুঞা দণ্ড ঊরুর উপর ॥ ১২৫ ॥

*cintite cintite duḥkha bāṛila bistara |*
*bhāṅgilena thuñā daṇḍa ūrura upara || 125 ||*

*Word for word:* chintite chintite — as He pondered; duhkha badila vistara — the grief grew greatly; bhangilena — He broke; thunya danda — placing the staff; urura upara — across His thigh

**125.** The more He pondered, the more His grief grew,
and, setting the staff across His thigh, He broke it.[^43-9]

ভগ্ন দণ্ড তুলিয়া ফেলিল লঞা জলে ।
প্রভুর তরাসে পাছু ধীরে ধীরে চলে ॥ ১২৬ ॥

*bhagna daṇḍa tuliẏā phelila lañā jale |*
*prabhura tarāse pāchu dhīre dhīre cale || 126 ||*

*Word for word:* bhagna danda tuliya — lifting the broken staff; phelila lanya jale — threw it into the water; prabhura tarase — in fear of the Lord; pachhu dhire dhire chale — walks slowly behind

**126.** Lifting the broken staff, He threw it into the water,
and, afraid of the Lord, walks slowly behind.

কথোক্ষণে একত্র হইলা দুইজনে ।
সুধাইল প্রভু — দণ্ড না দেখিয়ে কেনে ॥ ১২৭ ॥

*kathokṣaṇe ekatra hailā duijane |*
*sudhāila prabhu — daṇḍa nā dekhiẏe kene || 127 ||*

*Word for word:* kathokshane — after a while; ekatra haila duijane — the two came together; sudhaila prabhu — the Lord asked; danda na dekhiye kene — why do I not see the staff

**127.** After a while the two came together,
and the Lord asked, "Why do I not see the staff?"

প্রভুর সঙ্কোচে কিছু না দেয় উত্তর ।
বিস্ময় লাগিল প্রভু চিন্তয়ে অন্তর ॥ ১২৮ ॥

*prabhura saṅkoce kichu nā deẏa uttara |*
*bismaẏa lāgila prabhu cintaẏe antara || 128 ||*

*Word for word:* prabhura sankoche — shrinking before the Lord; kichhu na deya uttara — gives no answer; vismaya lagila — [the Lord] was surprised; prabhu chintaye antara — the Lord pondered within

**128.** Shrinking before the Lord, He gives no answer;
the Lord was surprised and grew thoughtful.

পুনরপি পুছে প্রভু — দণ্ড থুইলে কোথা ।
দণ্ড না দেখিয়া হিয়ায় লাগে বড় ব্যথা ॥ ১২৯ ॥

*punarapi puche prabhu — daṇḍa thuile kothā |*
*daṇḍa nā dekhiẏā hiẏāẏa lāge baṛa byathā || 129 ||*

*Word for word:* punarapi puchhe prabhu — again the Lord asks; danda thuile kotha — where have You put the staff; danda na dekhiya — not seeing the staff; hiyaya lage bada vyatha — the heart feels great pain

**129.** Again the Lord asks, "Where have You put the staff?
Not seeing the staff, I feel great pain in My heart."

এ বোল শুনিঞা কহে নিত্যানন্দরায় ।
তোর করে দণ্ড দেখি' পোড়ে মো-হিয়ায় ॥ ১৩০ ॥

*e bola śuniñā kahe nityānandarāẏa |*
*tora kare daṇḍa dekhi' poṛe mo-hiẏāẏa || 130 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuninya — hearing this; kahe nityananda-raya — Nityananda Raya says; tora kare danda dekhi — seeing the staff in Your hand; pode mo-hiyaya — my heart burns

**130.** Hearing this, Nityananda Raya says:
"Seeing the staff in Your hand, I burn all over.

সন্ন্যাস করিলে একে মুড়াইলে মুড় ।
তাহার অধিক দুঃখ — কান্ধে কর দণ্ড ॥ ১৩১ ॥

*sannyāsa karile eke muṛāile muṛa |*
*tāhāra adhika duḥkha — kāndhe kara daṇḍa || 131 ||*

*Word for word:* sannyasa karile — You took sannyasa; eke mudaile muda — first, You shaved Your head; tahara adhika duhkha — more grievous than that; kandhe kara danda — You carry a staff on Your shoulder

**131.** You took sannyasa — that alone, Your shaving Your head, [was bitter];
and more bitter still, You carry a staff on Your shoulder.

সহিতে না পারি ভাঙ্গি' ফেলাইল জলে ।
যে কর সে কর — গদগদ-ভাষে বোলে ॥ ১৩২ ॥

*sahite nā pāri bhāṅgi' phelāila jale |*
*ye kara se kara — gadagada-bhāṣe bole || 132 ||*

*Word for word:* sahite na pari — unable to bear it; bhangi phelaila jale — breaking it, I threw it into the water; ye kara se kara — do as You will; gadagada-bhashe bole — He says in a faltering voice

**132.** Unable to bear it, I broke it and threw it into the water.
Do as You will," He says in a faltering voice.

এ বোল শুনিঞা প্রভু ভৈগেল দুঃখিত ।
রুষিয়া কহিল — সব কর বিপরীত ॥ ১৩৩ ॥

*e bola śuniñā prabhu bhaigela duḥkhita |*
*ruṣiẏā kahila — saba kara biparīta || 133 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuninya — hearing this; prabhu bhaigela duhkhita — the Lord was grieved; rushiya kahila — said angrily; saba kara viparita — You do everything backwards

**133.** Hearing this, the Lord was grieved
and said angrily, "You do everything backwards!

মোর দণ্ডে বৈসে মোর যত দেবগণ ।
হেন দণ্ড ভাঙ্গি' কি সাধিলে প্রয়োজন ॥ ১৩৪ ॥

*mora daṇḍe baise mora yata debagaṇa |*
*hena daṇḍa bhāṅgi' ki sādhile praẏojana || 134 ||*

*Word for word:* mora dande baise — in My staff abide; mora yata deva-gana — all My gods; hena danda bhangi — breaking such a staff; ki sadhile prayojana — what purpose have You achieved

**134.** In My staff abide all My gods:[^43-10]
what have You gained by breaking such a staff?

তুমি সদা উনমত — বুদ্ধি স্থির নয় ।
বাতুলের প্রায় রীত — বালক আশয় ॥ ১৩৫ ॥

*tumi sadā unamata — buddhi sthira naẏa |*
*bātulera prāẏa rīta — bālaka āśaẏa || 135 ||*

*Word for word:* tumi sada unamata — You are always mad; buddhi sthira naya — Your mind is unsteady; vatulera praya rita — Your ways like a lunatic's; balaka ashaya — Your intentions a child's

**135.** You are always mad, Your mind is unsteady;
Your ways are those of a lunatic, Your intentions a child's.

পাণ্ডিত্য-ধর্মেতে ধর্মী নহ কদাচিত ।
আশ্রম ছাড়াও — কার্য কর বিপরীত ॥ ১৩৬ ॥

*pāṇḍitya-dharmete dharmī naha kadācita |*
*āśrama chāṛāo — kārya kara biparīta || 136 ||*

*Word for word:* panditya-dharmete — in the duty of learning; dharmi naha kadachita — You are never dutiful; ashrama chhadao — You make [Me] abandon the ashrama; karya kara viparita — You act backwards

**136.** Never have You kept the duty that learning requires:
You make [Me] abandon My ashrama — You do everything backwards.

দেবতা-আশ্রম-পীড়া নাহি জান দোষ ।
কিছু যদি বলি তবে কর মহারোষ ॥ ১৩৭ ॥

*debatā-āśrama-pīṛā nāhi jāna doṣa |*
*kichu yadi bali tabe kara mahāroṣa || 137 ||*

*Word for word:* devata-ashrama-pida — offence to the gods and the ashrama; nahi jana dosha — You do not know as a sin; kichhu yadi bali — if I say anything; tabe kara maha-rosha — then You grow very angry

**137.** You see no sin in offending the gods and [violating] the ashrama,
and if I say anything to You, You grow terribly angry."

এ বোল শুনিঞা নিত্যানন্দ পঁহু হাসে ।
প্রভুরে কহয়ে কিছু গদগদ-ভাষে ॥ ১৩৮ ॥

*e bola śuniñā nityānanda paṁhu hāse |*
*prabhure kahaẏe kichu gadagada-bhāṣe || 138 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuninya — hearing this; nityananda panhu hase — Nityananda Prabhu laughs; prabhure kahaye kichhu — says something to the Lord; gadagada-bhashe — in a faltering voice

**138.** Hearing this, Nityananda Prabhu laughs
and answers the Lord in a faltering voice:

দেবতা-আশ্রম-পীড়া নাহি করি আমি ।
ভাল কৈল, মন্দ কৈল, সব জান তুমি ॥ ১৩৯ ॥

*debatā-āśrama-pīṛā nāhi kari āmi |*
*bhāla kaila, manda kaila, saba jāna tumi || 139 ||*

*Word for word:* devata-ashrama-pida — offence to the gods or the ashrama; nahi kari ami — I do not commit; bhala kaila manda kaila — whether I did well or ill; saba jana tumi — You know it all

**139.** "I do not offend the gods or the ashrama;
whether I did well or ill — You know it all.

তোর দণ্ডে বৈসে তোর যত দেবগণ ।
কান্ধে করি' লঞা যাহ — সহিব কেমন ॥ ১৪০ ॥

*tora daṇḍe baise tora yata debagaṇa |*
*kāndhe kari' lañā yāha — sahiba kemana || 140 ||*

*Word for word:* tora dande baise — in Your staff abide; tora yata deva-gana — all Your gods; kandhe kari lanya yaha — You carry them on Your shoulder; sahiba kemana — how shall I bear it

**140.** In Your staff abide all Your gods —
and You carry them on Your shoulder: how can I bear it?

তুমি তার ভাল কর, আমি করি মন্দ ।
কি কারণে তোর সনে করিব আর দ্বন্দ্ব ॥ ১৪১ ॥

*tumi tāra bhāla kara, āmi kari manda |*
*ki kāraṇe tora sane kariba āra dbandba || 141 ||*

*Word for word:* tumi tara bhala kara — You do them good; ami kari manda — I do harm; ki karane — why; tora sane kariba ara dvandva — should I argue with You further

**141.** You do them good and I do them harm;
why should I argue with You any further?

অপরাধ কৈলুঁ — দোষ ক্ষম একবার ।
তোর নামে নিস্তারয়ে সকল সংসার ॥ ১৪২ ॥

*aparādha kailuṁ — doṣa kṣama ekabāra |*
*tora nāme nistāraẏe sakala saṃsāra || 142 ||*

*Word for word:* aparadha kailun — I have offended; dosha kshama ekabara — forgive the fault this once; tora name — by Your name; nistaraye sakala samsara — the whole world is delivered

**142.** I have offended — forgive my fault this once:
by Your name the whole world is delivered.

তোর অধিক পতিত-পাবন নাম তোর ।
এই অপরাধ ক্ষমা করিবেন মোর ॥ ১৪৩ ॥

*tora adhika patita-pābana nāma tora |*
*ei aparādha kṣamā karibena mora || 143 ||*

*Word for word:* tora adhika — more than You; patita-pavana nama tora — Your name purifies the fallen; ei aparadha — this offence; kshama karibena mora — will be forgiven me

**143.** Your name purifies the fallen even more than You Yourself —
so let this offence of mine be forgiven.[^43-11]

নামমাত্র নিস্তারয়ে জগতের লোক ।
সন্ন্যাস করিলে — ভক্তগণে বড় শোক ॥ ১৪৪ ॥

*nāmamātra nistāraẏe jagatera loka |*
*sannyāsa karile — bhaktagaṇe baṛa śoka || 144 ||*

*Word for word:* nama-matra — the name alone; nistaraye jagatera loka — delivers the people of the world; sannyasa karile — You took sannyasa; bhakta-gane bada shoka — the devotees are in great sorrow

**144.** By the name alone the people of the world are delivered —
yet You have taken sannyasa, and the devotees are in great sorrow.

সে হেন বিনোদ-চূড়া মুণ্ডাইলে মাথা ।
ভক্তজন-হৃদয়ে দারুণ এই ব্যথা ॥ ১৪৫ ॥

*se hena binoda-cūṛā muṇḍāile māthā |*
*bhaktajana-hṛdaẏe dāruṇa ei byathā || 145 ||*

*Word for word:* se hena vinoda-chuda — with that lovely hair; mundaile matha — You shaved Your head; bhakta-jana-hridaye — in the hearts of the devotees; daruna ei vyatha — this cruel pain

**145.** You shaved Your head with that lovely hair —
a cruel pain has lodged in the devotees' hearts.

মোর প্রাণ পোড়ে নিরন্তর ইহা দেখি' ।
হয় নয় পুছ — সর্বভক্ত ইহার সাখী ॥ ১৪৬ ॥

*mora prāṇa poṛe nirantara ihā dekhi' |*
*haẏa naẏa pucha — sarbabhakta ihāra sākhī || 146 ||*

*Word for word:* mora prana pode — my heart burns; nirantara iha dekhi — ceaselessly seeing this; haya naya puchha — whether so or not, ask; sarva-bhakta ihara sakhi — all the devotees are witnesses to it

**146.** My heart burns ceaselessly seeing this;
whether it is so or not, ask — all the devotees are witnesses.

ভাঙ্গিয়া ফেলিল দণ্ড ভক্তগণ-দুঃখে ।
দণ্ড নহে — শেল যেন ছিল মোর বুকে ॥ ১৪৭ ॥

*bhāṅgiẏā phelila daṇḍa bhaktagaṇa-duḥkhe |*
*daṇḍa nahe — śela yena chila mora buke || 147 ||*

*Word for word:* bhangiya phelila danda — I broke and threw away the staff; bhakta-gana-duhkhe — for the devotees' grief; danda nahe — not a staff; shela yena chhila mora buke — it was like a spear in my breast

**147.** For the devotees' grief I broke the staff and threw it away:
it was no staff — it was like a spear in my breast."

এ বোল শুনিঞা প্রভু না দিল উত্তর ।
বিরস-বদন — কিছু হরিষ অন্তর ॥ ১৪৮ ॥

*e bola śuniñā prabhu nā dila uttara |*
*birasa-badana — kichu hariṣa antara || 148 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuninya — hearing this; prabhu na dila uttara — the Lord gave no reply; birasa-badana — His face sad; kichhu harisha antara — some joy within

**148.** Hearing this, the Lord gave no reply:
His face was sad, but in His heart there was secret joy.[^43-12]

নিত্যানন্দ মহাপ্রভু সব রস জানে ।
ভাঙ্গিয়া ফেলিল দণ্ড — এ লোচন গানে ॥ ১৪৯ ॥

*nityānanda mahāprabhu saba rasa jāne |*
*bhāṅgiẏā phelila daṇḍa — e locana gāne || 149 ||*

*Word for word:* nityananda mahaprabhu — Nityananda, the great Lord; saba rasa jane — knows all rasas; bhangiya phelila danda — broke and threw away the staff; e lochana gane — sings this Lochana

**149.** Nityananda, the great Lord, knows all rasas:
He broke the staff and threw it away, sings Lochana.

[^43-1]: In the 1983 edition chapter 16, "Sri Nilachala-yatra" ("The Journey to Nilachala"), begins here with new numbering; we follow Bhaktisiddhanta's numbering. Bhaktisiddhanta's summary of this section is at the beginning of en/42. The town is left empty because the Lord has left Bengal for good.
[^43-2]: In Murari (3.5.1) the Lord goes "with Mukunda, Gadadhara and others," putting the Avadhuta in front. According to the Chaitanya-charitamrita (Madhya 3), Advaita sent four with the Lord: Nityananda, Jagadananda, Damodara Pandita and Mukunda Datta; Lochana Dasa names the companions differently.
[^43-3]: The Dola-yatra is the spring swing festival of Krishna on the full moon of the month of Phalguna. According to the Chaitanya-charitamrita (Madhya 7), the Lord came to Nilachala in Phalguna and saw the Dola-yatra.
[^43-4]: Vv. 85–92 — cf. Murari 3.5.2–3. As a sannyasi, the Lord teaches people by His own example (loka-shiksha): to accept only food offered to Krishna and to live on alms.
[^43-5]: The same verse is in Murari (3.5.4–5) and in the Chaitanya-charitamrita (Madhya 7.96). Bhaktisiddhanta also mentions it in his summary (en/42).
[^43-6]: The toll-collector (dani) took payment from travellers on roads and at ferries. Vv. 96–114 — cf. Murari 3.5.7–9; the Chaitanya-bhagavata (Antya 2) also tells of toll-collectors on the way to Puri.
[^43-7]: The Moon of Nilachala is Jagannatha: the toll-collector recognizes in the Lord the Lord of Nilachala Himself.
[^43-8]: "Vain" (michha) means "futile", not "unreal" (en/37, note 14). The 1983 edition reads "the feet of Radha" instead of "the feet of Gauranga."
[^43-9]: The story of the broken staff is told by Murari (3.5.10–21), in the Chaitanya-bhagavata (Antya 2) and in the Chaitanya-charitamrita (Madhya 5): there Nityananda breaks the staff into three pieces and throws it into the river Bhargi. In Murari, Nityananda first excuses Himself by saying he stumbled; in Lochana Dasa He says plainly that he could not bear the sight of the Lord with a sannyasi's staff.
[^43-10]: A sannyasi's staff is held to be the abode of the gods (cf. Murari 3.5.16–17).
[^43-11]: Cf. the teaching that the Lord's name is more merciful than His form (Rupa Gosvami, Namashtaka 6).
[^43-12]: The Lord's anger is lila: in Murari (3.5.18–21) the Lord, setting aside His anger, admits that Nityananda has fulfilled His own intention, and embraces Him; Bhaktisiddhanta, in the edition's table of contents, calls this episode "the manifestation of the pastime of anger" (krodha-lila). Nityananda, the Lord's eternal servant, only carried out His hidden will.

---

# Madhya-khanda, part 21 (portion 44)

*The section "Meeting with Sarvabhauma" (beginning): Tamoluk, Gopala at Remuna, the Vaitarani, Varaha, Yajapura and Viraja; a toll-collector binds Mukunda, and the Lord appears in a dream to his chief; Ekamra (Bhubaneshvara) and the hymn to Shiva; the conversation of Murari and Damodara on the remnants of offerings to Shiva*

## Meeting with Sarvabhauma

> *Summary by Srila Bhaktisiddhanta Sarasvati.* Sriman Mahaprabhu, passing on the way through Tamoluk, bathing in the Brahma-kunda and seeing Sri Madhusudana, came within a few days to Remuna. There, having seen Sri Gopaladeva, installed by Uddhava, He spent that night absorbed in prema in dancing and singing. The next day, having bathed in the Vaitarani and seen Lord Varaha, He came to the village of Yajapura, saw many lingas of Shiva and joyfully beheld Viraja. There the Lord bathed in the Brahma-kunda, [made offerings to the forefathers at] Nabhi-gaya and from there came to a great holy place, the town of Shiva. [There] a toll-collector mistreated Mukunda, and Gaurahari appeared at night in a dream to the chief of the toll-collectors in the form of the One who lies on the Ocean of Milk and rebuked him for mistreating His devotee; he, frightened, surrendered at the Lord's feet. Then the Lord came from there to Ekamra-kanana, saw ten million lingas of Shiva, Mahesha and Parvati, recited many hymns of praise to Shiva and spent that night there. Next, in the conversation of Murari and Damodara, the question whether Shiva's prasada is worthy of a Vaishnava's respect is settled: it is established that the remnants of offerings to Shiva worshipped by non-devotees are not to be accepted. Then, [passing] Kapoteshvara, He came to the river Bhargavi, bathed there, and, going a little farther and seeing the pinnacle of the temple of Sri Jagannathadeva, fainted in prema; on regaining outer consciousness He bathed again and, offering praises and prayers, came to the house of Sarvabhauma. Sarvabhauma, seeing His form and mahabhava, surmised that He was Bhagavan and told his son to take Him to see Jagannatha. The Lord, standing behind the Garuda pillar, beheld Jagannatha and, absorbed in prema, danced and sang with the devotees; then He was brought from there back to Sarvabhauma's house. After this are described: Sarvabhauma's questions about the Lord, the taking of mahaprasada, the glorification of prasada, another darshana of Jagannatha, Sarvabhauma's [concern] for the Lord's [keeping of] sannyasa, the Lord's questions to Sarvabhauma, the showing of the six-armed form to Sarvabhauma, and so on.[^44-1]

*Raga bhatiyari; disha: "Brothers, sing, O sing the glory and the virtues of Gora Gosani! (murchha) O brothers, my dear brothers, harbour no worldly desires: as long as you live in the world, do not leave the feet of Mahaprabhu!"*

তবে সেইমতে প্রভু চলি' যায় পথে ।
তমোলুকে উত্তরিলা মহাপুণ্যক্ষেত্রে ॥ ১ ॥

*tabe seimate prabhu cali' yāẏa pathe |*
*tamoluke uttarilā mahāpuṇyakṣetre || 1 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe seimate — thus; prabhu chali yaya pathe — the Lord goes along the road; tamoluke uttarila — arrived at Tamoluk; maha-punya-kshetre — the great holy place

**1.** Thus the Lord walked along the road
and came to Tamoluk, a great holy place.

ব্রহ্মকুণ্ডে স্নান, দেখি' শ্রীমধুসূদন ।
প্রেমায় অবশ প্রভু আনন্দিত মন ॥ ২ ॥

*brahmakuṇḍe snāna, dekhi' śrīmadhusūdana |*
*premāẏa abaśa prabhu ānandita mana || 2 ||*

*Word for word:* brahma-kunde snana — bathing in the Brahma-kunda; dekhi shri-madhusudana — seeing Sri Madhusudana; premaya abasha prabhu — the Lord overcome with prema; anandita mana — His heart rejoicing

**2.** Having bathed in the Brahma-kunda and seen Sri Madhusudana,
the Lord is overcome with prema, and His heart rejoices.[^44-2]

এইমতে কথোদিন পথে চলি' যায় ।
উত্তরিলা মহাপ্রভু গ্রাম রেমুণায় ॥ ৩ ॥

*eimate kathodina pathe cali' yāẏa |*
*uttarilā mahāprabhu grāma remuṇāẏa || 3 ||*

*Word for word:* eimate — thus; kathodina pathe chali yaya — walks some days on the road; uttarila mahaprabhu — Mahaprabhu arrived; grama remunaya — at the village of Remuna

**3.** Thus He walked for some days
and came, Mahaprabhu, to the village of Remuna.

মহাপুরী-রেমুণাতে আছয়ে গোপাল ।
দেখিবারে যায় প্রভু আনন্দ অপার ॥ ৪ ॥

*mahāpurī-remuṇāte āchaẏe gopāla |*
*dekhibāre yāẏa prabhu ānanda apāra || 4 ||*

*Word for word:* mahapuri-remunate — in the great town of Remuna; achhaye gopala — dwells Gopala; dekhibare yaya prabhu — the Lord goes to see; ananda apara — with boundless joy

**4.** In the great town of Remuna dwells Gopala;
the Lord goes to see Him with boundless joy.

পূর্বে বারাণসী-তীর্থে উদ্ধব-স্থাপিত ।
ব্রাহ্মণেরে কৃপা-ছলে এথা উপনীত ॥ ৫ ॥

*pūrbe bārāṇasī-tīrthe uddhaba-sthāpita |*
*brāhmaṇere kṛpā-chale ethā upanīta || 5 ||*

*Word for word:* purve varanasi-tirthe — formerly in holy Varanasi; uddhava-sthapita — installed by Uddhava; brahmanere kripa-chhale — out of mercy to a brahmana; etha upanita — came here

**5.** Formerly He was installed by Uddhava in holy Varanasi,
and He came here to show mercy to a brahmana.[^44-3]

ইহা বলি' পুনঃ পুনঃ করে নমস্কার ।
'উদ্ধবের প্রভু' বলি' করে হুহুঙ্কার ॥ ৬ ॥

*ihā bali' punaḥ punaḥ kare namaskāra |*
*'uddhabera prabhu' bali' kare huhuṅkāra || 6 ||*

*Word for word:* iha bali — saying this; punah punah kare namaskara — bows again and again; uddhavera prabhu bali — crying "Lord of Uddhava!"; kare huhunkara — roars

**6.** Saying this, [the Lord] bows again and again
and, crying "Lord of Uddhava!", roars aloud.

নয়ন সফল আজি দেখিল ঠাকুর ।
উদ্ধব-সম্বন্ধে প্রেমা বাড়িল প্রচুর ॥ ৭ ॥

*naẏana saphala āji dekhila ṭhākura |*
*uddhaba-sambandhe premā bāṛila pracura || 7 ||*

*Word for word:* nayana saphala aji — today the eyes bore fruit; dekhila thakura — I saw the Lord; uddhava-sambandhe — through the connection with Uddhava; prema badila prachura — prema grew abundantly

**7.** "Today My eyes have borne fruit: I have seen the Lord!"
Through the connection with Uddhava His prema grew immensely.

উদ্ধব উদ্ধব বলি' ডাকে আর্তনাদে ।
প্রেমায় বিহ্বল ক্ষণে ভূমে পড়ি' কান্দে ॥ ৮ ॥

*uddhaba uddhaba bali' ḍāke ārtanāde |*
*premāẏa bihbala kṣaṇe bhūme paṛi' kānde || 8 ||*

*Word for word:* uddhava uddhava bali — saying "Uddhava! Uddhava!"; dake artanade — calls with a cry of anguish; premaya vihvala — overwhelmed with prema; kshane bhume padi kande — now falls to the ground and weeps

**8.** With a cry of anguish He calls, "Uddhava! Uddhava!"
and, overwhelmed with prema, falls again and again to the ground and weeps.

অরুণ-নয়নে নীর ঝরে অনিবার ।
পুলকে পূরিল অঙ্গ কম্প বারে বার ॥ ৯ ॥

*aruṇa-naẏane nīra jhare anibāra |*
*pulake pūrila aṅga kampa bāre bāra || 9 ||*

*Word for word:* aruna-nayane — from reddish eyes; nira jhare anibara — tears flow without cease; pulake purila anga — the body filled with thrill; kampa bare bara — trembling again and again

**9.** From His reddish eyes tears flow without cease,
His body thrills, and trembling seizes Him again and again.

'উদ্ধবের প্রভু' বলি' প্রদক্ষিণ করি' ।
নিজজন-সঙ্গে নাচে বোলে হরি হরি ॥ ১০ ॥

*'uddhabera prabhu' bali' pradakṣiṇa kari' |*
*nijajana-saṅge nāce bole hari hari || 10 ||*

*Word for word:* uddhavera prabhu bali — crying "Lord of Uddhava!"; pradakshina kari — circumambulating; nijajana-sange nache — dances with His own people; bole hari hari — says "Hari! Hari!"

**10.** Crying "Lord of Uddhava!", He walks around [the Deity]
and dances with His own people, chanting "Hari! Hari!"

উথলিল প্রেমানন্দ — বাড়িল উল্লাস ।
প্রেমায় ছাইল জন এ ভূমি-আকাশ ॥ ১১ ॥

*uthalila premānanda — bāṛila ullāsa |*
*premāẏa chāila jana e bhūmi-ākāśa || 11 ||*

*Word for word:* uthalila premananda — the bliss of prema surged; badila ullasa — jubilation grew; premaya chhaila — prema covered; jana e bhumi-akasha — the people, this earth and sky

**11.** The bliss of prema surged, the jubilation grew;
prema flooded the people, this earth and the sky.

আনন্দে দেবতা সব চাহে অন্তরীক্ষে ।
অনিমিখ-আঁখি তারা প্রভুকে নিরীখে ॥ ১২ ॥

*ānande debatā saba cāhe antarīkṣe |*
*animikha-āṁkhi tārā prabhuke nirīkhe || 12 ||*

*Word for word:* anande devata saba — in joy all the gods; chahe antarikshe — look from the sky; animikha-ankhi tara — with unblinking eyes they; prabhuke nirikhe — gaze at the Lord

**12.** In joy all the gods look on from the heavens,
with unblinking eyes they gaze at the Lord.

সহস্র-নয়ানে ইন্দ্র চাহে একদিঠে ।
অমৃত-অধিক গৌরাঙ্গ লাগে মিঠে ॥ ১৩ ॥

*sahasra-naẏāne indra cāhe ekadiṭhe |*
*amṛta-adhika gaurāṅga lāge miṭhe || 13 ||*

*Word for word:* sahasra-nayane — with a thousand eyes; indra chahe eka-dithe — Indra gazes intently; amrita-adhika — more than nectar; gauranga lage mithe — Gauranga seems sweet

**13.** Indra with his thousand eyes gazes intently:
Gauranga seems to him sweeter than nectar.

হেনই সময়ে সেই মুরতি-গোপাল ।
মস্তক-উপরে পুষ্প-মুকুট তাহার ॥ ১৪ ॥

*henai samaẏe sei murati-gopāla |*
*mastaka-upare puṣpa-mukuṭa tāhāra || 14 ||*

*Word for word:* henai samaye — just then; sei murati-gopala — that Deity Gopala; mastaka-upare — upon the head; pushpa-mukuta tahara — His crown of flowers

**14.** At that very time, on the head
of the Deity Gopala there was a crown of flowers.

আচম্বিতে মস্তকের মুকুট খসিতে ।
ভূমিতে পড়িবামাত্র তুলি' লৈল হাতে ॥ ১৫ ॥

*ācambite mastakera mukuṭa khasite |*
*bhūmite paṛibāmātra tuli' laila hāte || 15 ||*

*Word for word:* achambite — suddenly; mastakera mukuta khasite — as the crown slipped from the head; bhumite padibamatra — the moment it fell to the ground; tuli laila hate — [the Lord] picked it up in His hand

**15.** Suddenly the crown slipped from His head,
and, the moment it fell to the ground, [the Lord] picked it up in His hand.[^44-4]

চৌদিগে বৈষ্ণবগণ হরি হরি বোলে ।
আকাশ পরশে হেন প্রেমার হিল্লোলে ॥ ১৬ ॥

*caudige baiṣṇabagaṇa hari hari bole |*
*ākāśa paraśe hena premāra hillole || 16 ||*

*Word for word:* chaudige vaishnava-gana — all around the Vaishnavas; hari hari bole — cry "Hari! Hari!"; akasha parashe hena — as if touching the sky; premara hillole — the waves of prema

**16.** All around, the Vaishnavas cry "Hari! Hari!";
the waves of prema seem to touch the sky.

দেখিলেন দেবরাজ প্রভু বিশ্বম্ভর ।
অদ্ভুত দেখিয়া কান্দে প্রণতকন্ধর ॥ ১৭ ॥

*dekhilena debarāja prabhu biśbambhara |*
*adbhuta dekhiẏā kānde praṇatakandhara || 17 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhilena devaraja — the king of the gods beheld; prabhu vishvambhara — Lord Vishvambhara; adbhuta dekhiya — seeing the wonder; kande pranatakandhara — weeps with bowed head

**17.** The king of the gods beheld Lord Vishvambhara
and, seeing this wonder, weeps with his head bowed.

দিনান্তে নাচয়ে প্রভু নাহিক বিরাম ।
সন্ধ্যার সময়ে হৈল নৃত্য-অবসান ॥ ১৮ ॥

*dinānte nācaẏe prabhu nāhika birāma |*
*sandhyāra samaẏe haila nṛtya-abasāna || 18 ||*

*Word for word:* dinante nachaye prabhu — till day's end the Lord dances; nahika virama — without rest; sandhyara samaye — at evening; haila nritya-avasana — the dancing ended

**18.** Till the end of the day the Lord dances without rest;
only at evening did the dancing cease.

নানা উপহার-দ্রব্য কৃষ্ণে নিবেদিত ।
প্রভুর সম্মুখে বিপ্র কৈল উপনীত ॥ ১৯ ॥

*nānā upahāra-drabya kṛṣṇe nibedita |*
*prabhura sammukhe bipra kaila upanīta || 19 ||*

*Word for word:* nana upahara-dravya — many dishes; krishne nivedita — offered to Krishna; prabhura sammukhe — before the Lord; vipra kaila upanita — a brahmana brought

**19.** Many dishes offered to Krishna
a brahmana brought and set before the Lord.

আনন্দিত মহাপ্রভু লঞা নিজজন ।
সন্তোষে করিল মহাপ্রসাদ-ভোজন ॥ ২০ ॥

*ānandita mahāprabhu lañā nijajana |*
*santoṣe karila mahāprasāda-bhojana || 20 ||*

*Word for word:* anandita mahaprabhu — joyful Mahaprabhu; lanya nijajana — with His own people; santoshe karila — happily did; mahaprasada-bhojana — the eating of mahaprasada

**20.** Joyful, Mahaprabhu with His own people
happily partook of the mahaprasada.

রজনী গোঙায় কৃষ্ণকথার আনন্দে ।
প্রভাতে চলিলা নিজজন লঞা সঙ্গে ॥ ২১ ॥

*rajanī goṅāẏa kṛṣṇakathāra ānande |*
*prabhāte calilā nijajana lañā saṅge || 21 ||*

*Word for word:* rajani gongaya — He spends the night; krishna-kathara anande — in the bliss of talks of Krishna; prabhate chalila — in the morning set out; nijajana lanya sange — taking His own people along

**21.** He spent the night in the bliss of talks about Krishna
and in the morning set out with His own people.

এইমত প্রভু পথে যাইতে যাইতে ।
নদী-বৈতরণী-তটে গেলা আচম্বিতে ॥ ২২ ॥

*eimata prabhu pathe yāite yāite |*
*nadī-baitaraṇī-taṭe gelā ācambite || 22 ||*

*Word for word:* eimata prabhu — thus the Lord; pathe yaite yaite — going along the road; nadi-vaitarani-tate — to the bank of the river Vaitarani; gela achambite — came unexpectedly

**22.** Thus the Lord went along the road
and unexpectedly came to the bank of the river Vaitarani.

স্নান-পানে সেই নদী পতিতপাবনী ।
আর তাহে স্নান কৈল ঠাকুর আপনি ॥ ২৩ ॥

*snāna-pāne sei nadī patitapābanī |*
*āra tāhe snāna kaila ṭhākura āpani || 23 ||*

*Word for word:* snana-pane — by bathing and drinking; sei nadi patita-pavani — that river purifies the fallen; ara tahe snana kaila — and in it bathed; thakura apani — the Thakura Himself

**23.** Bathing in and drinking [the water of] this river purify the fallen —
and in it the Thakura Himself bathed.

তবে চলি' যায় সেই পরম চতুর ।
দেখিবারে বাড়ে সাধ বরাহ-ঠাকুর ॥ ২৪ ॥

*tabe cali' yāẏa sei parama catura |*
*dekhibāre bāṛe sādha barāha-ṭhākura || 24 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe chali yaya — then goes on; sei parama chatura — He, the wisest; dekhibare bade sadha — the wish grows to see; baraha-thakura — Lord Varaha

**24.** Then He, the wisest, goes on:
His wish grows to see Lord Varaha,

যাহা দেখি' সর্বলোক উদ্ধারে দু-কুল ।
তবে চলি' যায় প্রভু গ্রাম যাজপুর ॥ ২৫ ॥

*yāhā dekhi' sarbaloka uddhāre du-kula |*
*tabe cali' yāẏa prabhu grāma yājapura || 25 ||*

*Word for word:* yaha dekhi — seeing whom; sarva-loka uddhare du-kula — all people deliver both sides of their family; tabe chali yaya prabhu — then the Lord goes; grama yajapura — to the village of Yajapura

**25.** seeing whom all people deliver their families on both sides.
Then the Lord goes to the village of Yajapura,

যাহা যজ্ঞ কৈলা ব্রহ্মা লঞা দেবগণ ।
ব্রাহ্মণেরে দিল গ্রাম করিয়া শাসন ॥ ২৬ ॥

*yāhā yajña kailā brahmā lañā debagaṇa |*
*brāhmaṇere dila grāma kariẏā śāsana || 26 ||*

*Word for word:* yaha yajna kaila brahma — where Brahma performed sacrifice; lanya deva-gana — with the gods; brahmanere dila grama — gave the village to the brahmanas; kariya shasana — by charter

**26.** where Brahma with all the gods performed a sacrifice
and gave the village to the brahmanas by charter.

মহাপাপী নর যদি সেই গ্রামে মরে ।
সর্বপাপে মুক্ত হৈয়া শিবরূপ ধরে ॥ ২৭ ॥

*mahāpāpī nara yadi sei grāme mare |*
*sarbapāpe mukta haiẏā śibarūpa dhare || 27 ||*

*Word for word:* mahapapi nara — a great sinner; yadi sei grame mare — if he dies in that village; sarva-pape mukta haiya — freed from all sins; shiva-rupa dhare — takes on the form of Shiva

**27.** Even a great sinner, if he dies in this village,
is freed from all sins and attains the form of Shiva.[^44-5]

শত শত আছে তাহে মহেশের লিঙ্গ ।
তাহা নমস্করি' যায় গৌরগোবিন্দ ॥ ২৮ ॥

*śata śata āche tāhe maheśera liṅga |*
*tāhā namaskari' yāẏa gauragobinda || 28 ||*

*Word for word:* shata shata achhe tahe — there are hundreds there; maheshera linga — of lingas of Mahesha; taha namaskari — bowing to them; yaya gaura-govinda — Gaura-Govinda goes

**28.** There are hundreds of lingas of Mahesha there;
Gaura-Govinda goes on, bowing to them.

আনন্দ-হৃদয়ে যায় বিরজা দেখিতে ।
বিরজা-মহিমা কে বা পারয়ে কহিতে ॥ ২৯ ॥

*ānanda-hṛdaẏe yāẏa birajā dekhite |*
*birajā-mahimā ke bā pāraẏe kahite || 29 ||*

*Word for word:* ananda-hridaye yaya — with joy in His heart He goes; viraja dekhite — to see Viraja; viraja-mahima — the glory of Viraja; ke va paraye kahite — who can describe

**29.** With joy in His heart He goes to see Viraja;
who can describe the glory of Viraja?

কোটি কোটি পাতক নাশয়ে দরশনে ।
বিরজা দেখিল প্রভু হরষিত-মনে ॥ ৩০ ॥

*koṭi koṭi pātaka nāśaẏe daraśane |*
*birajā dekhila prabhu haraṣita-mane || 30 ||*

*Word for word:* koti koti pataka — millions of sins; nashaye darashane — her sight destroys; viraja dekhila prabhu — the Lord saw Viraja; harashita-mane — with a joyful heart

**30.** The sight of her destroys millions of sins;
with a joyful heart the Lord beheld Viraja.

বিরজাকে নমস্করি' কহিল বচন ।
দেহ প্রেমভক্তি মোরে কৃষ্ণের চরণ ॥ ৩১ ॥

*birajāke namaskari' kahila bacana |*
*deha premabhakti more kṛṣṇera caraṇa || 31 ||*

*Word for word:* virajake namaskari — bowing to Viraja; kahila vachana — He spoke; deha prema-bhakti more — give Me prema-bhakti; krishnera charana — [for] Krishna's feet

**31.** Bowing to Viraja, He said:
"Give Me prema-bhakti for the feet of Krishna."[^44-6]

এইমত মহাপ্রভু পথে চলি' যায় ।
পিতৃপিণ্ডদান কৈল এ নাভিগয়ায় ॥ ৩২ ॥

*eimata mahāprabhu pathe cali' yāẏa |*
*pitṛpiṇḍadāna kaila e nābhigaẏāẏa || 32 ||*

*Word for word:* eimata mahaprabhu — thus Mahaprabhu; pathe chali yaya — goes along the road; pitri-pinda-dana kaila — offered pinda to the forefathers; e nabhigayaya — here at Nabhi-gaya

**32.** Thus Mahaprabhu went along the road
and here, at Nabhi-gaya, offered pinda to the forefathers.

ব্রহ্মকুণ্ড-জলে স্নান কৈল হরষিতে ।
দেবকার্য সমাপিয়া চলিলা ত্বরিতে ॥ ৩৩ ॥

*brahmakuṇḍa-jale snāna kaila haraṣite |*
*debakārya samāpiẏā calilā tbarite || 33 ||*

*Word for word:* brahma-kunda-jale — in the waters of the Brahma-kunda; snana kaila harashite — bathed joyfully; deva-karya samapiya — finishing the rites; chalila tvarite — went on quickly

**33.** He bathed joyfully in the waters of the Brahma-kunda
and, having finished the rites, went on quickly.

মহাপুণ্যস্থান সেই শিবের নগর ।
দেখিতে দেখিতে প্রভু ভৈগেল বিভোর ॥ ৩৪ ॥

*mahāpuṇyasthāna sei śibera nagara |*
*dekhite dekhite prabhu bhaigela bibhora || 34 ||*

*Word for word:* maha-punya-sthana — great holy place; sei shivera nagara — that town of Shiva; dekhite dekhite — gazing; prabhu bhaigela vibhora — the Lord was rapt

**34.** That great holy place is the town of Shiva;
gazing at it, the Lord was rapt.

কহিতে না পারি সে নগর-পরিপাটী ।
ত্রিলোচন-আদি করি' আছে লিঙ্গ-কোটি ॥ ৩৫ ॥

*kahite nā pāri se nagara-paripāṭī |*
*trilocana-ādi kari' āche liṅga-koṭi || 35 ||*

*Word for word:* kahite na pari — I cannot describe; se nagara-paripati — the splendour of that town; trilochana-adi kari — headed by Trilochana; achhe linga-koti — there are millions of lingas

**35.** I cannot describe the splendour of that town:
there are millions of lingas, headed by Trilochana.[^44-7]

হেনই সময়ে সেই শ্রীমুকুন্দ দত্ত ।
প্রভুর সাক্ষাতে কহে যে জানয়ে তত্ত্ব ॥ ৩৬ ॥

*henai samaẏe sei śrīmukunda datta |*
*prabhura sākṣāte kahe ye jānaẏe tattba || 36 ||*

*Word for word:* henai samaye — at that time; sei shri-mukunda datta — that Sri Mukunda Datta; prabhura sakshate kahe — says before the Lord; ye janaye tattva — who knew the facts

**36.** At that very time Sri Mukunda Datta,
who knew [the local] ways, says to the Lord:

এই হৈতে দানীকে নাহিক আর ভয় ।
আমি সর্ব জানি দুষ্ট যে যেখানে রয় ॥ ৩৭ ॥

*ei haite dānīke nāhika āra bhaẏa |*
*āmi sarba jāni duṣṭa ye yekhāne raẏa || 37 ||*

*Word for word:* ei haite — from here; danike nahika ara bhaya — there is no more fear of toll-collectors; ami sarva jani — I know all; dushta ye yekhane raya — where each rogue lives

**37.** "From here on there is nothing more to fear from toll-collectors:
I know them all, I know where each rogue lives."

এ বোল শুনিঞা প্রভু মুচকি হাসয়ে ।
কি বলিব তোরে মুঞি তুমি মহাশয়ে ॥ ৩৮ ॥

*e bola śuniñā prabhu mucaki hāsaẏe |*
*ki baliba tore muñi tumi mahāśaẏe || 38 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuninya — hearing this; prabhu muchaki hasaye — the Lord smiles faintly; ki baliba tore munni — what shall I say to you; tumi mahashaye — you are a man of consequence

**38.** Hearing this, the Lord smiled faintly:
"What shall I say to you? You are a man of consequence!

আমি ত সন্ন্যাস-ধর্ম করিয়াছি আশ্রয় ।
দানী কি করিব মোর কহ ত নিশ্চয় ॥ ৩৯ ॥

*āmi ta sannyāsa-dharma kariẏāchi āśraẏa |*
*dānī ki kariba mora kaha ta niścaẏa || 39 ||*

*Word for word:* ami ta sannyasa-dharma — I have the dharma of sannyasa; kariyachhi ashraya — taken up; dani ki kariba mora — what will a toll-collector do to Me; kaha ta nishchaya — tell for certain

**39.** I have taken up the dharma of sannyasa —
what can a toll-collector do to Me? Tell Me truly."

শুনিঞা মুকুন্দ কিছু ভয় না পাইল ।
তবু দুঃখ দেয় প্রভু তোমারে কহিল ॥ ৪০ ॥

*śuniñā mukunda kichu bhaẏa nā pāila |*
*tabu duḥkha deẏa prabhu tomāre kahila || 40 ||*

*Word for word:* shuninya mukunda — hearing, Mukunda; kichhu bhaya na paila — felt no fear at all; tabu duhkha deya — still they cause trouble; prabhu tomare kahila — Lord, I have told You

**40.** Hearing this, Mukunda was not in the least afraid:
"Still, they cause trouble, Lord — I have told You."

শুনিঞা ঠাকুর বোলে — শুনহ মুকুন্দ ।
রাখিবে আমার দেহ সকল কুটুম্ব ॥ ৪১ ॥

*śuniñā ṭhākura bole — śunaha mukunda |*
*rākhibe āmāra deha sakala kuṭumba || 41 ||*

*Word for word:* shuninya thakura bole — hearing, the Thakura says; shunaha mukunda — listen, Mukunda; rakhibe amara deha — will guard My body; sakala kutumba — all [My] kinsfolk

**41.** Hearing this, the Thakura says, "Listen, Mukunda:
My body will be guarded by all My kinsfolk."

*Thus in the Shanti-shataka:*

ধৈর্যং যস্য পিতা ক্ষমা চ জননী শান্তিশ্চিরং গেহিনী
সত্যং সূনুরয়ং দয়া চ ভগিনী ভ্রাতা মনঃসংযমঃ ।
শয্যা ভূমিতলং দিশোঽপি বসনং জ্ঞানামৃতং ভোজনং
যস্যৈতে হি কুটুম্বিনো বদ সখে কস্মাদ্ভয়ং যোগিনঃ ॥ ৪২ ॥

*dhairyaṃ yasya pitā kṣamā ca jananī śāntiściraṃ gehinī*
*satyaṃ sūnuraẏaṃ daẏā ca bhaginī bhrātā manaḥsaṃyamaḥ |*
*śayyā bhūmitalaṃ diśo'pi basanaṃ jñānāmṛtaṃ bhojanaṃ*
*yasyaite hi kuṭumbino bada sakhe kasmādbhaẏaṃ yoginaḥ || 42 ||*

*Word for word:* dhairyam yasya pita — whose father is fortitude; kshama cha janani — whose mother is forbearance; shantih chiram gehini — whose wife is lasting peace; satyam sunuh ayam — whose son is truth; daya cha bhagini — whose sister is compassion; bhrata manah-samyamah — whose brother is control of mind; shayya bhumi-talam — bed the ground; dishah api vasanam — garment the quarters; jnana-amritam bhojanam — food the nectar of knowledge; yasya ete hi kutumbinah — whose kinsfolk are these; vada sakhe — tell, friend; kasmat bhayam yoginah — whence fear for a yogi

**42.** "He whose father is fortitude, whose mother is forbearance, whose wife is lasting peace,
whose son is truth, whose sister is compassion, whose brother is control of the mind,
whose bed is the ground, whose garment the quarters, whose food the nectar of knowledge —
with such kinsfolk, tell me, friend, what has a yogi to fear?"[^44-8]

শুনিঞা মুকুন্দ ভয় না পাইল চিতে ।
কহিল তাহারে প্রভু হাসিতে হাসিতে ॥ ৪৩ ॥

*śuniñā mukunda bhaẏa nā pāila cite |*
*kahila tāhāre prabhu hāsite hāsite || 43 ||*

*Word for word:* shuninya mukunda — hearing, Mukunda; bhaya na paila chite — felt no fear at heart; kahila tahare prabhu — the Lord said to him; hasite hasite — laughing

**43.** Hearing this, Mukunda felt no fear in his heart.
The Lord, laughing, said to him:

এতদূর প্রতিপালি' আনিলে আমারে ।
ইহা বলি' চলি' গেলা ভিক্ষা করিবারে ॥ ৪৪ ॥

*etadūra pratipāli' ānile āmāre |*
*ihā bali' cali' gelā bhikṣā karibāre || 44 ||*

*Word for word:* etadura pratipali — protecting [Me] this far; anile amare — you have brought Me; iha bali — saying this; chali gela bhiksha karibare — He went to beg alms

**44.** "You have looked after Me and brought Me this far!"
and with these words He went to beg alms.

গদাধর-আদি করি' যত সঙ্গিগণ ।
ঠাঞি ঠাঞি গেলা সভে করিবারে ভিক্ষাটন ॥ ৪৫ ॥

*gadādhara-ādi kari' yata saṅgigaṇa |*
*ṭhāñi ṭhāñi gelā sabhe karibāre bhikṣāṭana || 45 ||*

*Word for word:* gadadhara-adi kari — Gadadhara and the rest; yata sangi-gana — all the companions; thani thani gela sabhe — all went to various places; karibare bhikshatana — to go begging

**45.** Gadadhara and all the companions
went off to various places to beg alms.

হেনকালে এক দানী রাখে তা-সভারে ।
মহাক্রোধ করি' দানী বান্ধে মুকুন্দেরে ॥ ৪৬ ॥

*henakāle eka dānī rākhe tā-sabhāre |*
*mahākrodha kari' dānī bāndhe mukundere || 46 ||*

*Word for word:* henakale — then; eka dani rakhe ta-sabhare — a toll-collector held them all; maha-krodha kari — in great anger; dani bandhe mukundere — the toll-collector binds Mukunda

**46.** Then a certain toll-collector held them all up
and in great anger bound Mukunda.

সারাদিন রাখিয়াছে — ক্রোধ নাহি পড়ে ।
অনেক যতনে প্রবোধিল সন্ধ্যাকালে ॥ ৪৭ ॥

*sārādina rākhiẏāche — krodha nāhi paṛe |*
*aneka yatane prabodhila sandhyākāle || 47 ||*

*Word for word:* saradina rakhiyachhe — kept [him] all day; krodha nahi pade — the anger does not abate; aneka yatane — with great effort; prabodhila sandhyakale — [he] was talked round in the evening

**47.** All day he kept him — his anger did not cool;
only in the evening, with great effort, was he talked round.

তা-সভার আছিল কম্বল একখণ্ড ।
কাড়িয়া লইল সেই পাপিষ্ঠ পাষণ্ড ॥ ৪৮ ॥

*tā-sabhāra āchila kambala ekakhaṇḍa |*
*kāṛiẏā laila sei pāpiṣṭha pāṣaṇḍa || 48 ||*

*Word for word:* ta-sabhara achhila — they had; kambala ekakhanda — a single blanket; kadiya laila — snatched away; sei papishtha pashanda — that sinful villain

**48.** They had just one blanket among them —
and that sinful villain snatched it away.

সন্ধ্যাকালে সভে ভিক্ষা করি' স্থানে স্থানে ।
সঙ্কেত-মণ্ডপে সভে আইলা জনে জনে ॥ ৪৯ ॥

*sandhyākāle sabhe bhikṣā kari' sthāne sthāne |*
*saṅketa-maṇḍape sabhe āilā jane jane || 49 ||*

*Word for word:* sandhyakale — in the evening; sabhe bhiksha kari sthane sthane — all, having begged in various places; sanketa-mandape — to the agreed pavilion; sabhe aila jane jane — all came one by one

**49.** In the evening, having begged alms in various places,
they all came one by one to the agreed pavilion.

সেই ত মণ্ডপে আগে আছেন ঠাকুর ।
দেখি' সর্বজন-হিয়া আনন্দ প্রচুর ॥ ৫০ ॥

*sei ta maṇḍape āge āchena ṭhākura |*
*dekhi' sarbajana-hiẏā ānanda pracura || 50 ||*

*Word for word:* sei ta mandape — in that pavilion; age achhena thakura — the Thakura was already; dekhi — seeing [Him]; sarvajana-hiya ananda prachura — great joy in everyone's heart

**50.** The Thakura was already in that pavilion;
seeing Him, all rejoiced greatly.

চরণে পড়িয়া কান্দে শ্রীমুকুন্দ দত্ত ।
আজিহো না জানি প্রভু তোমার মহত্ত্ব ॥ ৫১ ॥

*caraṇe paṛiẏā kānde śrīmukunda datta |*
*ājiho nā jāni prabhu tomāra mahattba || 51 ||*

*Word for word:* charane padiya kande — fallen at His feet, weeps; shri-mukunda datta — Sri Mukunda Datta; ajiho na jani — till today I did not know; prabhu tomara mahattva — Lord, Your greatness

**51.** Sri Mukunda Datta, fallen at His feet, weeps:
"Till today I did not know Your greatness, Lord!

তোমার সম্মুখে বৈল নাহি দানী-ভয় ।
তাহার লাগিয়া মোর এত দুঃখ হয় ॥ ৫২ ॥

*tomāra sammukhe baila nāhi dānī-bhaẏa |*
*tāhāra lāgiẏā mora eta duḥkha haẏa || 52 ||*

*Word for word:* tomara sammukhe baila — before You I said; nahi dani-bhaya — there is no fear of toll-collectors; tahara lagiya — because of that; mora eta duhkha haya — I suffer so much

**52.** Before You I said there was nothing to fear from toll-collectors —
and for that I have suffered so.

জানিয়া না জানে মূঢ় তুমি ভগবান্ ।
তোমার উপরে আর কে সাধিব দান ॥ ৫৩ ॥

*jāniẏā nā jāne mūṛha tumi bhagabān |*
*tomāra upare āra ke sādhiba dāna || 53 ||*

*Word for word:* janiya na jane mudha — the fool knew yet did not know; tumi bhagavan — that You are Bhagavan; tomara upare — from You; ara ke sadhiba dana — who would take toll

**53.** I knew, yet did not know, fool that I am, that You are Bhagavan:
who would take toll from You?

তোমার নাহিক ভয় এ তিন ভুবনে ।
তুমি সর্বেশ্বরেশ্বর কেবা তোমা জানে ॥ ৫৩+১ ॥

*tomāra nāhika bhaẏa e tina bhubane |*
*tumi sarbeśbareśbara kebā tomā jāne || 53+1 ||*

*Word for word:* tomara nahika bhaya — You have no fear; e tina bhuvane — in the three worlds; tumi sarveshvareshvara — You are the Lord of the lords of all; keba toma jane — who knows You

**53+1.** You have no fear in the three worlds:
You are the Lord of the lords of all — who knows You?[^44-9]

তোমারে নির্ভয় করিবারে কহি কথা ।
ভাল হৈল দানী মোর করিল অবস্থা ॥ ৫৪ ॥

*tomāre nirbhaẏa karibāre kahi kathā |*
*bhāla haila dānī mora karila abasthā || 54 ||*

*Word for word:* tomare nirbhaya karibare — to make You fearless; kahi katha — I spoke; bhala haila — it served me right; dani mora karila avastha — that the toll-collector put me in this state

**54.** I said it so that You would be without fear —
and it served me right that the toll-collector did this to me."

এ বোল শুনিঞা প্রভু গদাধরে পুছে ।
প্রত্যক্ষ কহিল দানী যত করিয়াছে ॥ ৫৫ ॥

*e bola śuniñā prabhu gadādhare puche |*
*pratyakṣa kahila dānī yata kariẏāche || 55 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuninya — hearing this; prabhu gadadhare puchhe — the Lord asks Gadadhara; pratyaksha kahila — [he] told plainly; dani yata kariyachhe — all the toll-collector had done

**55.** Hearing this, the Lord asks Gadadhara,
and he told plainly all that the toll-collector had done.

শুনিঞা ঠাকুর বৈল — নহ উতরোল ।
'ভাল হৈব' বলি' মাত্র বৈল এক বোল ॥ ৫৬ ॥

*śuniñā ṭhākura baila — naha utarola |*
*'bhāla haiba' bali' mātra baila eka bola || 56 ||*

*Word for word:* shuninya thakura baila — hearing, the Thakura said; naha utarola — do not be upset; bhala haiba bali — "it will be well"; matra baila eka bola — He spoke just one word

**56.** Hearing it, the Thakura said, "Do not be upset,"
and spoke just one word: "It will be well."

সেই রাত্রে সেই দেশে দানীর ঈশ্বর ।
স্বপ্নে দেখা দিল তারে শচীর কোঙর ॥ ৫৭ ॥

*sei rātre sei deśe dānīra īśbara |*
*sbapne dekhā dila tāre śacīra koṅara || 57 ||*

*Word for word:* sei ratre — that night; sei deshe danira ishvara — to the chief of the toll-collectors in that land; svapne dekha dila tare — appeared to him in a dream; shachira kongara — the son of Shachi

**57.** That very night, to the chief of the toll-collectors of that region
the son of Shachi appeared in a dream.

ক্ষীরোদ-সমুদ্রে দেখে অনন্তশয়নে ।
লক্ষ্মী-সরস্বতী করে চরণ-সেবনে ॥ ৫৮ ॥

*kṣīroda-samudre dekhe anantaśaẏane |*
*lakṣmī-sarasbatī kare caraṇa-sebane || 58 ||*

*Word for word:* kshiroda-samudre dekhe — he sees on the Ocean of Milk; ananta-shayane — lying on Ananta; lakshmi-sarasvati kare — Lakshmi and Sarasvati do; charana-sevane — service to the feet

**58.** He sees [Him] on the Ocean of Milk, lying on Ananta;
Lakshmi and Sarasvati serve His feet;

তাহার অন্তরে দেখে সনকাদি-গণ ।
ব্রহ্মা-আদি দেব দূরে করয়ে স্তবন ॥ ৫৯ ॥

*tāhāra antare dekhe sanakādi-gaṇa |*
*brahmā-ādi deba dūre karaẏe stabana || 59 ||*

*Word for word:* tahara antare dekhe — within he sees; sanakadi-gana — Sanaka and the others; brahma-adi deva — Brahma and the other gods; dure karaye stavana — offer praises from afar

**59.** within he sees Sanaka and the others,
and Brahma and the other gods offer praises from afar.

দেখিয়া দানীর রাজা কাঁপিল অন্তরে ।
ঐশ্বর্য দেখিয়া তিঁহো পড়িলা ফাঁপরে ॥ ৬০ ॥

*dekhiẏā dānīra rājā kāṁpila antare |*
*aiśbarya dekhiẏā tiṁho paṛilā phāṁpare || 60 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhiya danira raja — seeing, the king of the toll-collectors; kampila antare — trembled at heart; aishvarya dekhiya — seeing the majesty; tinho padila phanpare — he was dismayed

**60.** Seeing this, the king of the toll-collectors trembled in his heart:
seeing [such] majesty, he was dismayed.

বিরজা-নিকটে আছি সন্ন্যাসীর বেশে ।
মোর ভক্তে দুঃখ দিল তোর সব দাসে ॥ ৬১ ॥

*birajā-nikaṭe āchi sannyāsīra beśe |*
*mora bhakte duḥkha dila tora saba dāse || 61 ||*

*Word for word:* viraja-nikate achhi — I am near Viraja; sannyasira veshe — in the guise of a sannyasi; mora bhakte duhkha dila — have wronged My devotee; tora saba dase — all your servants

**61.** "I am near Viraja in the guise of a sannyasi;
all your servants have wronged My devotee."

কাঁপিল অন্তরে — ত্রাস পাইল অপার ।
সত্বরে চলিলা যথা শ্রীগৌরগোপাল ॥ ৬২ ॥

*kāṁpila antare — trāsa pāila apāra |*
*satbare calilā yathā śrīgauragopāla || 62 ||*

*Word for word:* kampila antare — trembled at heart; trasa paila apara — was boundlessly afraid; satvare chalila — hurried; yatha shri-gaura-gopala — to where Sri Gaura-Gopala was

**62.** He trembled in his heart, was seized with boundless fear,
and hurried to where Sri Gaura-Gopala was.

কথোক্ষণে সেইখানে সেই দানীশ্বর ।
প্রভু নমস্করি' করে বিনয় বিস্তর ॥ ৬৩ ॥

*kathokṣaṇe seikhāne sei dānīśbara |*
*prabhu namaskari' kare binaẏa bistara || 63 ||*

*Word for word:* kathokshane — after a while; seikhane — there; sei danishvara — that chief of the toll-collectors; prabhu namaskari — bowing to the Lord; kare vinaya vistara — speaks with great humility

**63.** Arriving there shortly, that chief of the toll-collectors
bowed to the Lord and speaks with great humility:

তুমি ভগবান্ ক্ষীরনিধির বিলাস ।
জীব নিস্তারিতে প্রভু করিয়াছ সন্ন্যাস ॥ ৬৪ ॥

*tumi bhagabān kṣīranidhira bilāsa |*
*jība nistārite prabhu kariẏācha sannyāsa || 64 ||*

*Word for word:* tumi bhagavan — You are Bhagavan; kshiranidhira vilasa — who sports in the Ocean of Milk; jiva nistarite — to deliver the jivas; prabhu kariyachha sannyasa — Lord, You have taken sannyasa

**64.** "You are Bhagavan, who sports in the Ocean of Milk;
to deliver the jivas You have taken sannyasa, Lord.

তুমি ভব-ঘোর-অন্ধকারের চন্দ্রিমা ।
তুমি বেদ — বেদের পরমতত্ত্ব-সীমা ॥ ৬৫ ॥

*tumi bhaba-ghora-andhakārera candrimā |*
*tumi beda — bedera paramatattba-sīmā || 65 ||*
