*Word for word:* tumi bhava-ghora-andhakarera chandrima — You are the moon of the dreadful darkness of worldly existence; tumi veda — You are the Veda; vedera parama-tattva-sima — the utmost bound of the Vedas' highest truth

**65.** You are the moon for the dreadful darkness of worldly existence;
You are the Veda and the utmost bound of the Vedas' highest truth."

শুনি' গোরাচাঁদ হাসি' বলিলা তাহারে ।
অচিরাতে কৃষ্ণ কৃপা করুন তোমারে ॥ ৬৬ ॥

*śuni' gorācāṁda hāsi' balilā tāhāre |*
*acirāte kṛṣṇa kṛpā karuna tomāre || 66 ||*

*Word for word:* shuni gorachanda — hearing, Gorachand; hasi balila tahare — said to him with a smile; achirate krishna — soon may Krishna; kripa karuna tomare — show you mercy

**66.** Hearing this, Gorachand said to him with a smile,
"May Krishna soon show you mercy."

ইহা বলি' চরণ ধরিলা তার মাথে ।
প্রেমায় বিভোর হঞা নাচে ঊর্ধ্বহাথে ॥ ৬৭ ॥

*ihā bali' caraṇa dharilā tāra māthe |*
*premāẏa bibhora hañā nāce ūrdhbahāthe || 67 ||*

*Word for word:* iha bali — saying this; charana dharila tara mathe — placed His feet upon his head; premaya vibhora hanya — intoxicated with prema; nache urdhva-hathe — dances with arms raised

**67.** Saying this, He placed His feet upon his head
and, intoxicated with prema, dances with arms raised.

তারে অনুগ্রহ করি' সে দেশে রাখিয়া ।
অধিকার কৃষ্ণভক্তি তারে শিখাইয়া ॥ ৬৮ ॥

*tāre anugraha kari' se deśe rākhiẏā |*
*adhikāra kṛṣṇabhakti tāre śikhāiẏā || 68 ||*

*Word for word:* tare anugraha kari — showing him mercy; se deshe rakhiya — leaving [him] in that land; adhikara krishna-bhakti — the right to devotion to Krishna; tare shikhaiya — teaching him

**68.** Having shown him mercy, [the Lord] left him in that land,
taught him devotion to Krishna and gave him the right to it.[^44-10]

হেনই সময়ে কহে বৈষ্ণব-সকল ।
অনেক অবস্থা কৈল তোমার নফর ॥ ৬৯ ॥

*henai samaẏe kahe baiṣṇaba-sakala |*
*aneka abasthā kaila tomāra naphara || 69 ||*

*Word for word:* henai samaye — at that time; kahe vaishnava-sakala — all the Vaishnavas say; aneka avastha kaila — caused much trouble; tomara naphara — your servant

**69.** At that time all the Vaishnavas say:
"Your servant caused us much trouble —

কাড়িয়া লইল আমা-সভার কম্বল ।
এ বোল শুনিঞা সেই সঙ্কোচ অন্তর ॥ ৭০ ॥

*kāṛiẏā laila āmā-sabhāra kambala |*
*e bola śuniñā sei saṅkoca antara || 70 ||*

*Word for word:* kadiya laila — snatched away; ama-sabhara kambala — our blanket; e bola shuninya — hearing this; sei sankocha antara — he was embarrassed at heart

**70.** he took away our blanket."
Hearing this, he was embarrassed at heart

নোতুন কম্বল দিল দানীর ঈশ্বর ।
সন্তুষ্ট হইল তবে বৈষ্ণব-অন্তর ॥ ৭১ ॥

*notuna kambala dila dānīra īśbara |*
*santuṣṭa haila tabe baiṣṇaba-antara || 71 ||*

*Word for word:* notuna kambala dila — gave a new blanket; danira ishvara — the chief of the toll-collectors; santushta haila tabe — then were satisfied; vaishnava-antara — the Vaishnavas' hearts

**71.** and gave them a new blanket, the chief of the toll-collectors;
then the Vaishnavas' hearts were at peace.

তবে সেই দানীশ্বর পরণাম করি' ।
বিদায় হইয়া গেলা আপনার বাড়ী ॥ ৭২ ॥

*tabe sei dānīśbara paraṇāma kari' |*
*bidāẏa haiẏā gelā āpanāra bāṛī || 72 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe sei danishvara — then that chief of the toll-collectors; paranama kari — bowing down; vidaya haiya — taking leave; gela apanara badi — went to his home

**72.** Then that chief of the toll-collectors, having bowed down,
took his leave and went home.

ঘরে গিয়া কৃষ্ণসেবা করিল আশ্রয় ।
সঙ্কীর্তনে হরিনামে অহর্নিশি রয় ॥ ৭৩ ॥

*ghare giẏā kṛṣṇasebā karila āśraẏa |*
*saṅkīrtane harināme aharniśi raẏa || 73 ||*

*Word for word:* ghare giya — going home; krishna-seva karila ashraya — took refuge in Krishna's service; sankirtane hariname — in the sankirtana of Hari's name; aharnishi raya — remains day and night

**73.** Returning home, he took refuge in the service of Krishna
and stays day and night in the sankirtana of Hari's name.

এইমতে সকল রজনী গেল সুখে ।
প্রাতঃকালে প্রাতঃক্রিয়া করিলা কৌতুকে ॥ ৭৪ ॥

*eimate sakala rajanī gela sukhe |*
*prātaḥkāle prātaḥkriẏā karilā kautuke || 74 ||*

*Word for word:* eimate — thus; sakala rajani gela sukhe — the whole night passed happily; pratah-kale — in the morning; pratah-kriya karila kautuke — He joyfully did the morning rites

**74.** Thus the whole night passed happily,
and in the morning [the Lord] joyfully performed the morning rites.

বিরজা দেখিতে প্রভু যায় আরবার ।
যাহা দেখি' সব লোক তরয়ে সংসার ॥ ৭৫ ॥

*birajā dekhite prabhu yāẏa ārabāra |*
*yāhā dekhi' saba loka taraẏe saṃsāra || 75 ||*

*Word for word:* viraja dekhite — to see Viraja; prabhu yaya arabara — the Lord goes again; yaha dekhi — seeing whom; saba loka taraye samsara — all people cross worldly existence

**75.** The Lord goes once more to see Viraja,
seeing whom all people cross the ocean of worldly existence.

বিরজাকে নমস্করি' চলি' যায় রঙ্গে ।
উঠিল কৃষ্ণের প্রেমা পুলকিত অঙ্গে ॥ ৭৬ ॥

*birajāke namaskari' cali' yāẏa raṅge |*
*uṭhila kṛṣṇera premā pulakita aṅge || 76 ||*

*Word for word:* virajake namaskari — bowing to Viraja; chali yaya range — goes on joyfully; uthila krishnera prema — prema for Krishna arose; pulakita ange — His body thrilling

**76.** Bowing to Viraja, He goes on joyfully;
prema for Krishna rose, His body thrilling.

চলিলা ঠাকুর সেই সিংহ-পরাক্রমে ।
ক্রমে ক্রমে উত্তরিলা একাম্র-গ্রামে ॥ ৭৭ ॥

*calilā ṭhākura sei siṃha-parākrame |*
*krame krame uttarilā ekāmra-grāme || 77 ||*

*Word for word:* chalila thakura — the Thakura went; sei simha-parakrame — with a lion's might; krame krame — little by little; uttarila ekamra-grame — arrived at the village of Ekamra

**77.** The Thakura went on with a lion's might
and little by little came to the village of Ekamra.

সেই গ্রামে আছে শিব পার্বতী-সহিতে ।
দেখিবারে ধায় প্রভু উনমত চিতে ॥ ৭৮ ॥

*sei grāme āche śiba pārbatī-sahite |*
*dekhibāre dhāẏa prabhu unamata cite || 78 ||*

*Word for word:* sei grame achhe shiva — in that village is Shiva; parvati-sahite — with Parvati; dekhibare dhaya prabhu — the Lord hastens to see; unamata chite — beside Himself

**78.** In that village is Shiva with Parvati;
the Lord, beside Himself, hastens to see them.

কথোদূর হৈতে প্রভু দেখিলা দেউল ।
উৎকণ্ঠা বাড়িল চিত্তে প্রেমায় বাউল ॥ ৭৯ ॥

*kathodūra haite prabhu dekhilā deula |*
*utkaṇṭhā bāṛila citte premāẏa bāula || 79 ||*

*Word for word:* kathodura haite — from afar; prabhu dekhila deula — the Lord saw the temple; utkantha badila chitte — longing grew in His heart; premaya baula — mad with prema

**79.** From afar the Lord saw the temple —
His longing grew, He was mad with prema.

দেউল-উপরে শোভে পতাকা সুন্দর ।
শিবলিঙ্গময় সেই একাম্র-নগর ॥ ৮০ ॥

*deula-upare śobhe patākā sundara |*
*śibaliṅgamaẏa sei ekāmra-nagara || 80 ||*

*Word for word:* deula-upare — above the temple; shobhe pataka sundara — a beautiful flag shines; shiva-linga-maya — full of Shiva-lingas; sei ekamra-nagara — that town of Ekamra

**80.** Above the temple a beautiful flag is flying;
the whole town of Ekamra is full of Shiva-lingas.

পতাকা দেখিয়া প্রভু নমস্কার করি' ।
ক্রমে ক্রমে গিয়া প্রবেশিলা শিবপুরী ॥ ৮১ ॥

*patākā dekhiẏā prabhu namaskāra kari' |*
*krame krame giẏā prabeśilā śibapurī || 81 ||*

*Word for word:* pataka dekhiya — seeing the flag; prabhu namaskara kari — the Lord, bowing; krame krame giya — going little by little; praveshila shivapuri — entered the town of Shiva

**81.** Seeing the flag, the Lord bowed down
and little by little entered the town of Shiva.

এককোটি লিঙ্গ আছে একাম্র-নগরে ।
হাঁটিয়া যাইতে প্রাণ হালে কাঁপে ডরে ॥ ৮২ ॥

*ekakoṭi liṅga āche ekāmra-nagare |*
*hāṁṭiẏā yāite prāṇa hāle kāṁpe ḍare || 82 ||*

*Word for word:* eka-koti linga achhe — there are ten million lingas; ekamra-nagare — in the town of Ekamra; hantiya yaite — walking on foot; prana hale kampe dare — the heart shakes and trembles with fear

**82.** Ten million lingas are in the town of Ekamra:
as one walks, the heart trembles with fear.[^44-11]

বিশ্বেশ্বর আদি করি' আছে লিঙ্গ-কোটি ।
দেখিতে সন্দেশ যেন নগরের মাটি ॥ ৮৩ ॥

*biśbeśbara ādi kari' āche liṅga-koṭi |*
*dekhite sandeśa yena nagarera māṭi || 83 ||*

*Word for word:* vishveshvara adi kari — Vishveshvara and the rest; achhe linga-koti — there are millions of lingas; dekhite sandesha yena — looks like sandesh; nagarera mati — the soil of the town

**83.** Vishveshvara and the rest — millions of lingas;
the very soil of the town looks like sandesh.

মহাবিন্দু-সরোবরে সর্বতীর্থ-জলে ।
আর নানা পুণ্যতীর্থ বৈসয়ে নগরে ॥ ৮৪ ॥

*mahābindu-sarobare sarbatīrtha-jale |*
*āra nānā puṇyatīrtha baisaẏe nagare || 84 ||*

*Word for word:* maha-bindu-sarovare — in the Maha-Bindu-sarovara; sarva-tirtha-jale — the water of all tirthas; ara nana punya-tirtha — and many other holy tirthas; baisaye nagare — are in the town

**84.** In the Maha-Bindu-sarovara is the water of all holy places,
and many other holy tirthas are in the town.

পুরী প্রবেশিয়া দেখে পার্বতী-শঙ্কর ।
নমস্কার করি' প্রভু প্রেমায় বিভোর ॥ ৮৫ ॥

*purī prabeśiẏā dekhe pārbatī-śaṅkara |*
*namaskāra kari' prabhu premāẏa bibhora || 85 ||*

*Word for word:* puri praveshiya — entering the town; dekhe parvati-shankara — He sees Parvati and Shankara; namaskara kari — bowing down; prabhu premaya vibhora — the Lord is rapt in prema

**85.** Entering the town, [the Lord] sees Parvati and Shankara
and, bowing down, is rapt in prema.

সর্বজন দেখিল সে পার্বতী-মহেশ ।
লিঙ্গ-দরশনে সভার খণ্ডিলেক ক্লেশ ॥ ৮৬ ॥

*sarbajana dekhila se pārbatī-maheśa |*
*liṅga-daraśane sabhāra khaṇḍileka kleśa || 86 ||*

*Word for word:* sarvajana dekhila — everyone saw; se parvati-mahesha — Parvati and Mahesha; linga-darashane — by the sight of the linga; sabhara khandileka klesha — everyone's afflictions were destroyed

**86.** All beheld Parvati and Mahesha:
the sight of the linga ended everyone's afflictions.

মহেশ দেখিয়া প্রভুর অবশ শরীর ।
টলমল করে তনু নাহি রহে স্থির ॥ ৮৭ ॥

*maheśa dekhiẏā prabhura abaśa śarīra |*
*ṭalamala kare tanu nāhi rahe sthira || 87 ||*

*Word for word:* mahesha dekhiya — seeing Mahesha; prabhura abasha sharira — the Lord's body out of control; talamala kare tanu — the body sways; nahi rahe sthira — does not stay steady

**87.** Seeing Mahesha, the Lord lost control of His body:
His body sways, He cannot stand steady.

অরুণ-নয়নে জল ঝরে অনিবার ।
পুলকিত গণ্ড — স্তব পড়ে বার বার ॥ ৮৮ ॥

*aruṇa-naẏane jala jhare anibāra |*
*pulakita gaṇḍa — staba paṛe bāra bāra || 88 ||*

*Word for word:* aruna-nayane — from reddish eyes; jala jhare anibara — tears flow without cease; pulakita ganda — cheeks thrilling; stava pade bara bara — He recites a hymn again and again

**88.** From His reddish eyes tears flow without cease,
His cheeks thrill — again and again He recites a hymn.

*Thus [the hymn]:*

নমো নমস্তে ত্রিদশেশ্বরায় ভূতাধিনাথায় মৃড়ায় নিত্যং
গঙ্গাতরঙ্গোক্ষিত-বালচন্দ্র-চূড়ায় গৌরীনয়নোৎসবায় ।
সুতপ্তচামীকর-চন্দ্র-নীলপদ্ম-প্রবালাম্বুদ-কান্তিবক্ত্রৈঃ
সুনৃত্যরঙ্গেষ্টবরপ্রদায় কৈবল্যনাথায় বৃষধ্বজায় ॥ ৮৮+১ ॥

*namo namaste tridaśeśbarāẏa bhūtādhināthāẏa mṛṛāẏa nityaṃ*
*gaṅgātaraṅgokṣita-bālacandra-cūṛāẏa gaurīnaẏanotsabāẏa |*
*sutaptacāmīkara-candra-nīlapadma-prabālāmbuda-kāntibaktraiḥ*
*sunṛtyaraṅgeṣṭabarapradāẏa kaibalyanāthāẏa bṛṣadhbajāẏa || 88+1 ||*

*Word for word:* namah namah te — obeisance, obeisance to you; tridasha-ishvaraya — to the lord of the gods; bhuta-adhinathaya — to the master of the bhutas; mridaya — to the Gracious One; nityam — forever; ganga-taranga-ukshita-bala-chandra-chudaya — whose crest is the young moon washed by the Ganga's waves; gauri-nayana-utsavaya — the festival of Gauri's eyes; sutapta-chamikara-chandra-nila-padma-pravala-ambuda-kanti-vaktraih — with faces shining like molten gold, the moon, the blue lotus, coral and the cloud; su-nritya-ranga-ishta-vara-pradaya — who grants desired boons in the arena of the beautiful dance; kaivalya-nathaya — to the lord of kaivalya; vrisha-dhvajaya — whose banner is the bull

**88+1.** "Obeisance, obeisance to you forever — to the lord of the gods, the master of the bhutas, the Gracious One (Mrida), whose crest is the young moon washed by the waves of the Ganga, the festival of Gauri's eyes;
to him whose faces shine like molten gold, the moon, the blue lotus, coral and the rain-cloud, who in the arena of the beautiful dance grants the desired boons — to the lord of kaivalya, whose banner is the bull!"[^44-12]

এইমতে মহাপ্রভু পড়ে শিবস্তব ।
চৌদিগে স্তব পড়ে সকল বৈষ্ণব ॥ ৮৯ ॥

*eimate mahāprabhu paṛe śibastaba |*
*caudige staba paṛe sakala baiṣṇaba || 89 ||*

*Word for word:* eimate — thus; mahaprabhu pade shiva-stava — Mahaprabhu recites a hymn to Shiva; chaudige — all around; stava pade sakala vaishnava — all the Vaishnavas recite hymns

**89.** Thus Mahaprabhu recites a hymn to Shiva,
and all around Him all the Vaishnavas recite hymns.

হেনই সময়ে সেই শিবের সেবকে ।
গন্ধ, চন্দন, মালা দিলেন প্রভুকে ॥ ৯০ ॥

*henai samaẏe sei śibera sebake |*
*gandha, candana, mālā dilena prabhuke || 90 ||*

*Word for word:* henai samaye — at that time; sei shivera sevake — Shiva's servants; gandha, chandana, mala — fragrance, sandal paste, a garland; dilena prabhuke — offered to the Lord

**90.** At that time Shiva's servants
offered the Lord fragrance, sandal paste and a garland.

শিব নমস্করি' প্রভু বাহিরে আসিয়া ।
বিশ্রাম করিলা এক গৃহে প্রবেশিয়া ॥ ৯১ ॥

*śiba namaskari' prabhu bāhire āsiẏā |*
*biśrāma karilā eka gṛhe prabeśiẏā || 91 ||*

*Word for word:* shiva namaskari — bowing to Shiva; prabhu bahire asiya — the Lord, coming outside; vishrama karila — rested; eka grihe praveshiya — entering a house

**91.** Bowing to Shiva, the Lord came outside
and, entering a house, rested.

ভক্ত-নিবেদিত অন্ন ভোজন করিলা ।
পথের আয়াসে নিশি শুতিয়া রহিলা ॥ ৯২ ॥

*bhakta-nibedita anna bhojana karilā |*
*pathera āẏāse niśi śutiẏā rahilā || 92 ||*

*Word for word:* bhakta-nivedita anna — food offered by a devotee; bhojana karila — He ate; pathera ayase — tired from the road; nishi shutiya rahila — lay down for the night

**92.** He ate food offered by a devotee
and, tired from the road, lay down for the night.

শয়ন-সময়ে কৃষ্ণ-পাদাম্বুজ-ধ্যান ।
হেনকালে হৃদয়ে করয়ে অনুমান ॥ ৯২+১ ॥

*śaẏana-samaẏe kṛṣṇa-pādāmbuja-dhyāna |*
*henakāle hṛdaẏe karaẏe anumāna || 92+1 ||*

*Word for word:* shayana-samaye — at the hour of sleep; krishna-padambuja-dhyana — meditation on Krishna's lotus feet; henakale — at that time; hridaye karaye anumana — He thinks in His heart

**92+1.** At the hour of sleep, meditating on the lotus feet of Krishna,
He then thinks in His heart:

শিব-মহাপ্রসাদ পাইয়া ভাগ্যবশে ।
ভক্ষণ করিয়ে হেন আছি প্রতি-আশে ॥ ৯২+২ ॥

*śiba-mahāprasāda pāiẏā bhāgyabaśe |*
*bhakṣaṇa kariẏe hena āchi prati-āśe || 92+2 ||*

*Word for word:* shiva-mahaprasada paiya — receiving Shiva's mahaprasada; bhagyavashe — by good fortune; bhakshana kariye — I would partake; hena achhi prati-ashe — such is My hope

**92+2.** "If by good fortune I were to receive Shiva's mahaprasada,
I would partake of it — such is My hope."[^44-13]

এইমতে মহাপ্রভুর অনুমান-কালে ।
পানা-পরসাদ লহ একজন বলে ॥ ৯২+৩ ॥

*eimate mahāprabhura anumāna-kāle |*
*pānā-parasāda laha ekajana bale || 92+3 ||*

*Word for word:* eimate — thus; mahaprabhura anumana-kale — while Mahaprabhu was thinking; pana-parasada laha — "take the prasada, pana"; ekajana bale — someone says

**92+3.** Just as Mahaprabhu thought this,
someone says, "Take this prasada — pana."

উঠিয়া প্রসাদ পানা লইলা ঠাকুর ।
পানা পান করি' সুখ বাড়িল প্রচুর ॥ ৯২+৪ ॥

*uṭhiẏā prasāda pānā lailā ṭhākura |*
*pānā pāna kari' sukha bāṛila pracura || 92+4 ||*

*Word for word:* uthiya — rising; prasada pana laila thakura — the Thakura took the prasada, the pana; pana pana kari — drinking the pana; sukha badila prachura — His happiness grew greatly

**92+4.** The Thakura rose and took the prasada, the pana;
drinking the pana, He was filled with happiness.

নিজজনে দিল যে আছিল অবশেষ ।
ভক্ষণ করিল সব ভক্ত সবিশেষ ॥ ৯২+৫ ॥

*nijajane dila ye āchila abaśeṣa |*
*bhakṣaṇa karila saba bhakta sabiśeṣa || 92+5 ||*

*Word for word:* nijajane dila — He gave to His own people; ye achhila avashesha — what was left; bhakshana karila — partook; saba bhakta savishesha — all the devotees with special [reverence]

**92+5.** What was left He gave to His own people,
and all the devotees partook of it with special reverence.

এইমতে আনন্দে বঞ্চিল সেই রাতি ।
প্রভাতে উঠিলা প্রভু ত্রিজগত-পতি ॥ ৯৩ ॥

*eimate ānande bañcila sei rāti |*
*prabhāte uṭhilā prabhu trijagata-pati || 93 ||*

*Word for word:* eimate anande — thus in bliss; vanchila sei rati — He spent that night; prabhate uthila prabhu — at dawn the Lord rose; trijagata-pati — the Master of the three worlds

**93.** Thus in bliss He spent that night;
at dawn the Lord rose, the Master of the three worlds.

প্রাতঃক্রিয়া করি' স্নান বিন্দু-সরোবরে ।
চলিলা ঠাকুর নমস্করি' মহেশ্বরে ॥ ৯৪ ॥

*prātaḥkriẏā kari' snāna bindu-sarobare |*
*calilā ṭhākura namaskari' maheśbare || 94 ||*

*Word for word:* pratah-kriya kari — doing the morning rites; snana bindu-sarovare — bathing in the Bindu-sarovara; chalila thakura — the Thakura set out; namaskari maheshvare — bowing to Maheshvara

**94.** Having done the morning rites and bathed in the Bindu-sarovara,
the Thakura set out, bowing to Maheshvara.

প্রভুর সংহতি সে চলিল নিজজন ।
এই প্রসঙ্গে এক কহিব কথন ॥ ৯৫ ॥

*prabhura saṃhati se calila nijajana |*
*ei prasaṅge eka kahiba kathana || 95 ||*

*Word for word:* prabhura samhati — with the Lord; se chalila nijajana — His own people went; ei prasange — in this connection; eka kahiba kathana — I shall tell a story

**95.** His own people went with the Lord.
In this connection I shall tell a story.

মুরারিতে দামোদরে যে হৈল বচন ।
শুন সাবধানে সভে কহিব এখন ॥ ৯৬ ॥

*murārite dāmodare ye haila bacana |*
*śuna sābadhāne sabhe kahiba ekhana || 96 ||*

*Word for word:* murarite damodare — between Murari and Damodara; ye haila vachana — what was said; shuna savadhane sabhe — listen carefully, all; kahiba ekhana — I shall tell now

**96.** What was said between Murari and Damodara —
listen, all of you, carefully: I shall tell it now.

মুরারিকে পুছিলা পণ্ডিত দামোদর ।
শিবের নির্মাল্য কেনে লইলা ঈশ্বর ॥ ৯৭ ॥

*murārike puchilā paṇḍita dāmodara |*
*śibera nirmālya kene lailā īśbara || 97 ||*

*Word for word:* murarike puchhila — asked Murari; pandita damodara — Pandita Damodara; shivera nirmalya — the remnants of offerings to Shiva; kene laila ishvara — why did the Lord accept

**97.** Pandita Damodara asked Murari:
"Why did the Lord accept the remnants of offerings to Shiva?

অগ্রাহ্য শিবের নির্মাল্য ভৃগু-শাপে ।
তবে কেনে পরিগ্রহ কৈল প্রভু আপে ॥ ৯৮ ॥

*agrāhya śibera nirmālya bhṛgu-śāpe |*
*tabe kene parigraha kaila prabhu āpe || 98 ||*

*Word for word:* agrahya shivera nirmalya — the remnants of offerings to Shiva are not to be accepted; bhrigu-shape — because of Bhrigu's curse; tabe kene parigraha kaila — why then did accept; prabhu ape — the Lord Himself

**98.** Because of Bhrigu's curse, the remnants of offerings to Shiva are not to be accepted —
why then did the Lord Himself accept them?

আপনে ব্রহ্মণ্যদেব এই মহাপ্রভু ।
জানিঞা শুনিঞা কেনে লঙ্ঘিবেক তভু ॥ ৯৯ ॥

*āpane brahmaṇyadeba ei mahāprabhu |*
*jāniñā śuniñā kene laṅghibeka tabhu || 99 ||*

*Word for word:* apane brahmanya-deva — Himself Brahmanya-deva; ei mahaprabhu — is this Mahaprabhu; janinya shuninya — knowingly; kene langhibeka tabhu — why then would He transgress

**99.** This Mahaprabhu is Himself Brahmanya-deva:
how could He knowingly transgress [the rule]?"[^44-14]

মুরারি কহয়ে — শুন শুন দামোদর ।
আমি কি জানিয়ে প্রভুর মরম-উত্তর ॥ ১০০ ॥

*murāri kahaẏe — śuna śuna dāmodara |*
*āmi ki jāniẏe prabhura marama-uttara || 100 ||*

*Word for word:* murari kahaye — Murari says; shuna shuna damodara — listen, listen, Damodara; ami ki janiye — what do I know; prabhura marama-uttara — of the Lord's inner answer

**100.** Murari replies, "Listen, listen, Damodara:
what do I know of the Lord's inner answer?

নিজ-বুদ্ধি-অনুমানে যে কহি উত্তর ।
তোর মনে লয় যদি রাখিহ অন্তর ॥ ১০১ ॥

*nija-buddhi-anumāne ye kahi uttara |*
*tora mane laẏa yadi rākhiha antara || 101 ||*

*Word for word:* nija-buddhi-anumane — by the inference of my own mind; ye kahi uttara — the answer I give; tora mane laya yadi — if your mind accepts it; rakhiha antara — keep it in your heart

**101.** I shall answer what I infer by my own understanding —
if your mind accepts it, keep it in your heart.

শিবের সেবক যেই শিব-সেবা করে ।
উচ্ছিষ্ট না লয় — হরি-হরে ভেদ করে ॥ ১০২ ॥

*śibera sebaka yei śiba-sebā kare |*
*ucchiṣṭa nā laẏa — hari-hare bheda kare || 102 ||*

*Word for word:* shivera sevaka yei — the servant of Shiva who; shiva-seva kare — serves Shiva; uchchhishta na laya — does not accept remnants; hari-hare bheda kare — makes a difference between Hari and Hara

**102.** A servant of Shiva who serves Shiva
but does not accept [Hari's] remnants, making a difference between Hari and Hara —

তাহারে ব্রাহ্মণ-শাপ — কহিল এ তত্ত্ব ।
অশুদ্ধ তাহার মতি না জানে মহত্ত্ব ॥ ১০৩ ॥

*tāhāre brāhmaṇa-śāpa — kahila e tattba |*
*aśuddha tāhāra mati nā jāne mahattba || 103 ||*

*Word for word:* tahare brahmana-shapa — on him is the brahmana's curse; kahila e tattva — this is the truth; ashuddha tahara mati — his mind is impure; na jane mahattva — he does not know the greatness

**103.** to him the brahmana's curse applies; this is the point:
his mind is impure, he does not know [Shiva's] greatness.

অভিন্ন করিয়া যেই করয়ে সেবন ।
শিবের নির্মাল্য সেই করয়ে ভক্ষণ ॥ ১০৪ ॥

*abhinna kariẏā yei karaẏe sebana |*
*śibera nirmālya sei karaẏe bhakṣaṇa || 104 ||*

*Word for word:* abhinna kariya — without dividing; yei karaye sevana — whoever serves; shivera nirmalya — the remnants of offerings to Shiva; sei karaye bhakshana — he partakes of

**104.** But one who serves without dividing them
partakes of the remnants of offerings to Shiva.

শিবের নির্মাল্য খায় অভেদ-চরিত ।
সে জনে অধিক হরি-হরের পীরিত ॥ ১০৫ ॥

*śibera nirmālya khāẏa abheda-carita |*
*se jane adhika hari-harera pīrita || 105 ||*

*Word for word:* shivera nirmalya khaya — eats the remnants of offerings to Shiva; abheda-charita — [one whose] conduct makes no division; se jane adhika — in that person more; hari-harera pirita — love for Hari and Hara

**105.** The remnants of offerings to Shiva are eaten by one whose conduct makes no division:
in such a one there is greater love for both Hari and Hara.

মহেশ্বর প্রভু সব বৈষ্ণবের রাজা ।
সেই-ভাবে যেই জন করে তাঁর পূজা ॥ ১০৬ ॥

*maheśbara prabhu saba baiṣṇabera rājā |*
*sei-bhābe yei jana kare tāṁra pūjā || 106 ||*

*Word for word:* maheshvara prabhu — lord Maheshvara; saba vaishnavera raja — king of all Vaishnavas; sei-bhave — in that mood; yei jana kare tanra puja — whoever worships him

**106.** Maheshvara is the king of all Vaishnavas;
whoever worships him seeing him thus —

তাহার হস্তেতে শিব করেন ভোজন ।
সে প্রসাদ খাইলে হয় বন্ধ-বিমোচন ॥ ১০৭ ॥

*tāhāra hastete śiba karena bhojana |*
*se prasāda khāile haẏa bandha-bimocana || 107 ||*

*Word for word:* tahara hastete — from his hand; shiva karena bhojana — Shiva eats; se prasada khaile — eating that prasada; haya bandha-vimochana — there is release from bondage

**107.** from that person's hand Shiva partakes [of the offering];
eat such prasada, and bondage falls away.

বস্তুত সে মহেশ্বর প্রভুর গমনে ।
আতিথ্য করিল সে পরম-হর্ষ-মনে ॥ ১০৮ ॥

*bastuta se maheśbara prabhura gamane |*
*ātithya karila se parama-harṣa-mane || 108 ||*

*Word for word:* vastuta — in truth; se maheshvara — that Maheshvara; prabhura gamane — at the Lord's passing; atithya karila — offered hospitality; parama-harsha-mane — with great joy in his heart

**108.** In truth, that Maheshvara, as the Lord passed by,
offered Him hospitality with great joy in his heart.

শাপ আদি যত শুন বহির্মুখ প্রতি ।
সুহৃদ্ভাবে কৈলে হয় শ্রীকৃষ্ণে পীরিতি ॥ ১০৯ ॥

*śāpa ādi yata śuna bahirmukha prati |*
*suhṛdbhābe kaile haẏa śrīkṛṣṇe pīriti || 109 ||*

*Word for word:* shapa adi yata — curses and the like; shuna — listen; bahirmukha prati — are for those turned away; suhrid-bhave kaile — when done in the mood of a friend; haya shri-krishne piriti — love for Sri Krishna arises

**109.** Curses and the like, listen, are for those turned away [from the Lord];
but when [Shiva] is worshipped as [Hari's] friend, love for Sri Krishna arises.[^44-15]

লোকশিক্ষা-হেতু প্রভু কৈল অবতার ।
দামোদর বোলে — এবে ঘুচিল জঞ্জাল ॥ ১১০ ॥

*lokaśikṣā-hetu prabhu kaila abatāra |*
*dāmodara bole — ebe ghucila jañjāla || 110 ||*

*Word for word:* loka-shiksha-hetu — for the teaching of the people; prabhu kaila avatara — the Lord descended; damodara bole — Damodara says; ebe ghuchila janjala — now the tangle is removed

**110.** The Lord descended to teach the people."
Damodara says, "Now the knot is untied!"

শুনিঞা সকল লোক আনন্দিত-চিত ।
কহয়ে লোচনদাস চৈতন্যচরিত ॥ ১১১ ॥

*śuniñā sakala loka ānandita-cita |*
*kahaẏe locanadāsa caitanyacarita || 111 ||*

*Word for word:* shuninya sakala loka — hearing, all the people; anandita-chita — rejoice at heart; kahaye lochanadasa — Lochana Dasa tells; chaitanya-charita — the deeds of Chaitanya

**111.** Hearing this, all the people rejoice at heart.
Lochana Dasa tells of the deeds of Chaitanya.

[^44-1]: The OCR of the summary is garbled in places; gaps are filled by sense and from the table of contents in the edition's preface (ch. 16). "Concern for the keeping of sannyasa" is a conjectural reading (OCR «অন্গটাস-সংরগণ-চিস্ত।»). The summary covers the whole section, whose end is in en/45. In the 1983 edition this section continues chapter 16 ("Sri Nilachala-yatra"), with new numbering.
[^44-2]: Vv. 1–31 — cf. Murari 3.6. Tamoluk (Tamolipta, Tamralipta) is present-day Tamluk in Bengal.
[^44-3]: So too in Murari (3.6.4): the Gopala of Remuna was once installed in Varanasi by Uddhava and came here to show mercy to a brahmana. In the Chaitanya-charitamrita (Madhya 4) the Deity of Remuna is Gopinatha Kshirachora, while the story of Gopala who followed a brahmana is told of Sakshi-gopala (Madhya 5).
[^44-4]: Cf. Murari 3.6.8–9: the crown fell from the Deity's head, and the Lord caught it.
[^44-5]: So says the mahatmya (glorification) of the holy place; likewise in Murari (3.6.16). For a Vaishnava the highest fruit of pilgrimage is not such rewards but prema — which is what the Lord asks of Viraja (v. 31).
[^44-6]: The Lord, playing the part of a devotee, asks of the goddess only love for Krishna (cf. Murari 3.6.18) — as the gopis prayed to Katyayani for Krishna.
[^44-7]: Trilochana ("the Three-eyed") is a linga of Shiva; the town is compared to Varanasi (cf. Murari 3.6.20). According to Murari this is Yajapura; Ekamra (Bhubaneshvara) comes below, v. 77.
[^44-8]: A verse from the Shanti-shataka. In A it is followed by Bhaktisiddhanta's anvaya and Bengali translation (OCR garbled); the text of the verse is restored from B. Vv. 36–73 — cf. Murari 3.7.
[^44-9]: V. 53+1 is found only in the 1983 edition; the 1903 edition does not have it.
[^44-10]: The dream vision is Lochana Dasa's; in Murari (3.7.12) the chief of the toll-collectors simply comes to the Lord.
[^44-11]: For fear of stepping on a linga.
[^44-12]: V. 88+1 (the hymn to Shiva) is found only in the 1983 edition and in the 1903 edition; Bhaktisiddhanta's edition does not have it. These are verses 3.8.13–14 of Murari Gupta's poem. The Lord, playing the part of a devotee, honours Shiva as the greatest of Vaishnavas and prays to him for love of Hari (Murari 3.8).
[^44-13]: Vv. 92+1 — 92+5 are found only in the 1983 edition and (with variants) in the 1903 edition. Cf. Murari 3.9: the Lord desires Shiva's prasada and, receiving it, partakes of it with reverence. Pana is a sweet cooling drink.
[^44-14]: Brahmanya-deva — "the God who favours brahmanas": He does not break a brahmana's word. Bhrigu's curse on the worshippers of Shiva — Bhagavata Purana 4.2. The conversation follows Murari 3.9 (Murari telling the story to Damodara Pandita).
[^44-15]: "Without division" (abheda) here is not a mayavada identification: Shiva is not worshipped as a separate god independent of Krishna and His rival, but honoured as the best of Vaishnavas (Bhagavata Purana 12.13.16), inseparable from the Lord (cf. Brahma-samhita 5.45: Shambhu is to the Lord as curd is to milk). Bhaktisiddhanta in his summary states the conclusion thus: the remnants of offerings to Shiva worshipped by non-devotees are not to be accepted (cf. vv. 102–103, 109).

---

# Madhya-khanda, part 22 (portion 45)

*The section "Meeting with Sarvabhauma" (end): Kapoteshvara and the Bhargavi; the boy with the flute above the temple; Jagannatha stretches out His hands to the Lord; the Lord at Sarvabhauma's house and the first darshana of Jagannatha; mahaprasada and its glory; Sarvabhauma censures the Lord and offers to teach Him Vedanta; the Lord reveals to him the essence of Vedanta and shows the six-armed form; the author's word; the end of the Madhya-khanda*

*Disha: "Sing the sweet name of Sri Krishna Chaitanya — Gorachand! (murchha) Brothers, there is no other way to be saved: this story is rare in the world. As long as you live in the world, drink it, filling your ears; never give up the songs of His virtues!"*[^45-1]

তবে পুনঃ শুন গোরাচাঁদের চরিত ।
বরিখয়ে প্রভু প্রেমা নূতন অমৃত ॥ ১১২ ॥

*tabe punaḥ śuna gorācāṁdera carita |*
*barikhaẏe prabhu premā nūtana amṛta || 112 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe punah shuna — now hear again; gorachandera charita — of the deeds of Gorachand; barikhaye prabhu — the Lord rains down; prema nutana amrita — prema, new nectar

**112.** Now hear again of the deeds of Gorachand:
the Lord pours down a rain of prema — new nectar.

পথে চলি' যায় প্রভু নিজজন-সঙ্গে ।
দেখিল ত কপোত-ঈশ্বর মহারঙ্গে ॥ ১১৩ ॥

*pathe cali' yāẏa prabhu nijajana-saṅge |*
*dekhila ta kapota-īśbara mahāraṅge || 113 ||*

*Word for word:* pathe chali yaya prabhu — the Lord walks along the road; nijajana-sange — with His own people; dekhila ta — saw; kapota-ishvara — Kapoteshvara; maha-range — with great joy

**113.** The Lord walks along the road with His own people
and with great joy sees Kapoteshvara.

তারে নমস্করি' প্রভু চলি' যায় পথে ।
পুণ্যতীর্থ মহালিঙ্গ দেখিতে দেখিতে ॥ ১১৪ ॥

*tāre namaskari' prabhu cali' yāẏa pathe |*
*puṇyatīrtha mahāliṅga dekhite dekhite || 114 ||*

*Word for word:* tare namaskari — bowing to him; prabhu chali yaya pathe — the Lord walks on; punya-tirtha maha-linga — holy places and great lingas; dekhite dekhite — looking at

**114.** Bowing to him, the Lord walks on,
looking at holy places and great lingas.

তবে সে ভার্গবী নামে নদী ভাগ্যবতী ।
তাথে স্নান কৈল নিজজনের সংহতি ॥ ১১৫ ॥

*tabe se bhārgabī nāme nadī bhāgyabatī |*
*tāthe snāna kaila nijajanera saṃhati || 115 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe se bhargavi name nadi — then the river named Bhargavi; bhagyavati — the blessed; tathe snana kaila — He bathed in it; nijajanera samhati — together with His own people

**115.** Then comes a river named Bhargavi, the blessed;
in it He bathed together with His own people.

স্নান সমাধিয়া প্রভু চলি' যায় পথে ।
জগন্নাথ-মন্দির দেখিল আচম্বিতে ॥ ১১৬ ॥

*snāna samādhiẏā prabhu cali' yāẏa pathe |*
*jagannātha-mandira dekhila ācambite || 116 ||*

*Word for word:* snana samadhiya — finishing the bath; prabhu chali yaya pathe — the Lord walks on; jagannatha-mandira dekhila — saw the temple of Jagannatha; achambite — suddenly

**116.** Having finished His bath, the Lord walks on
and suddenly saw the temple of Jagannatha.[^45-2]

চন্দ্রের কিরণ জিনি' উজ্জ্বল দেউল ।
পবন-চালিত তাথে পতাকা রাতুল ॥ ১১৭ ॥

*candrera kiraṇa jini' ujjbala deula |*
*pabana-cālita tāthe patākā rātula || 117 ||*

*Word for word:* chandrera kirana jini — outshining the rays of the moon; ujjvala deula — the temple shines; pavana-chalita — moved by the wind; tathe pataka ratula — on it a red flag

**117.** The temple shines, outshining the rays of the moon,
and on it a red flag flutters in the wind.

নীলগিরি-মাঝে হরিমন্দির সুন্দর ।
কৈলাস জিনিঞা তেজ অদ্ভুত ধবল ॥ ১১৮ ॥

*nīlagiri-mājhe harimandira sundara |*
*kailāsa jiniñā teja adbhuta dhabala || 118 ||*

*Word for word:* nilagiri-majhe — amid the Blue Hill; hari-mandira sundara — the beautiful temple of Hari; kailasa jininya teja — outshining Kailasa in brilliance; adbhuta dhavala — wondrously white

**118.** In the midst of the Blue Hill is the beautiful temple of Hari:
wondrously white, it outshines Kailasa with its brilliance.

অভিন্ন-অঞ্জন এক বালকের ঠাম ।
দেউল-উপরে প্রভু দেখে বিদ্যমান ॥ ১১৯ ॥

*abhinna-añjana eka bālakera ṭhāma |*
*deula-upare prabhu dekhe bidyamāna || 119 ||*

*Word for word:* abhinna-anjana — dark as collyrium itself; eka balakera thama — the form of a boy; deula-upare — above the temple; prabhu dekhe vidyamana — the Lord sees plainly

**119.** A boy dark as collyrium
the Lord plainly sees above the temple.

স-বসন হস্তে ঘন করয়ে আহ্বান ।
দেখিয়া বিহ্বল তারে করে পরণাম ॥ ১২০ ॥

*sa-basana haste ghana karaẏe āhbāna |*
*dekhiẏā bihbala tāre kare paraṇāma || 120 ||*

*Word for word:* sa-vasana haste — with a hand holding a cloth; ghana karaye ahvana — beckons again and again; dekhiya vihvala — seeing, rapt; tare kare paranama — He bows to Him

**120.** With His hand holding a cloth He beckons Him again and again;
seeing this, the Lord, rapt, bows to Him.

ভূমিতে পড়িলা প্রভু নাহিক সম্বিত ।
নিঃশব্দে রহিলা যেন ছাড়িল জীবিত ॥ ১২১ ॥

*bhūmite paṛilā prabhu nāhika sambita |*
*niḥśabde rahilā yena chāṛila jībita || 121 ||*

*Word for word:* bhumite padila prabhu — the Lord fell to the ground; nahika samvita — unconscious; nihshabde rahila — lay silent; yena chhadila jivita — as if life had left

**121.** The Lord fell to the ground unconscious,
lying silent, as if life had left Him.

দেখিয়া সকল লোক মূর্চ্ছিত-অন্তর ।
প্রভু প্রভু বলি' ডাকে না দেয় উত্তর ॥ ১২২ ॥

*dekhiẏā sakala loka mūrcchita-antara |*
*prabhu prabhu bali' ḍāke nā deẏa uttara || 122 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhiya sakala loka — seeing this, all the people; murchchhita-antara — were stricken at heart; prabhu prabhu bali dake — call "Lord! Lord!"; na deya uttara — He gives no answer

**122.** Seeing this, all the people were stricken at heart;
they call, "Lord! Lord!" — He does not answer.

কি হৈল কি হৈল বলি' চিন্তে গুণে তারা ।
কিছু না নিঃসরে যেন জীয়ন্তেই মরা ॥ ১২৩ ॥

*ki haila ki haila bali' cinte guṇe tārā |*
*kichu nā niḥsare yena jīẏantei marā || 123 ||*

*Word for word:* ki haila ki haila bali — "what has happened, what has happened?"; chinte gune tara — they wonder anxiously; kichhu na nihsare — no sound comes out; yena jiyantei mara — as if dead while alive

**123.** "What has happened? What has happened?" they wonder in alarm,
and no sound comes from them: as if alive, yet dead.

হেনই সময়ে প্রভু উঠিলা সত্বর ।
পুলকিত সব অঙ্গ প্রেমায় বিভোর ॥ ১২৪ ॥

*henai samaẏe prabhu uṭhilā satbara |*
*pulakita saba aṅga premāẏa bibhora || 124 ||*

*Word for word:* henai samaye — at that very moment; prabhu uthila satvara — the Lord quickly rose; pulakita saba anga — His whole body thrilling; premaya vibhora — intoxicated with prema

**124.** At that very moment the Lord quickly rose,
His whole body thrilling, intoxicated with prema.

দেখিয়া সকল লোক জীল পুনর্বার ।
মইল-শরীরে যেন জীউর সঞ্চার ॥ ১২৫ ॥

*dekhiẏā sakala loka jīla punarbāra |*
*maila-śarīre yena jīura sañcāra || 125 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhiya sakala loka — seeing this, all the people; jila punarbara — came back to life; maila-sharire — into a dead body; yena jiura sanchara — as if life had entered

**125.** Seeing this, all the people came back to life —
as if life had returned to a dead body.

তা-সভারে মহাপ্রভু পুছয়ে বচনে ।
দেউল-উপরে কিছু দেখহ নয়নে ॥ ১২৬ ॥

*tā-sabhāre mahāprabhu puchaẏe bacane |*
*deula-upare kichu dekhaha naẏane || 126 ||*

*Word for word:* ta-sabhare — them; mahaprabhu puchhaye vachane — Mahaprabhu asks in words; deula-upare — above the temple; kichhu dekhaha nayane — do you see anything with your eyes

**126.** Mahaprabhu asks them,
"Do you see anything with your eyes above the temple?

নীলমণি-কিরণ বরণ উজিয়ার ।
ত্রৈলোক্যমোহন এক সুন্দর ছাওয়াল ॥ ১২৭ ॥

*nīlamaṇi-kiraṇa baraṇa ujiẏāra |*
*trailokyamohana eka sundara chāoẏāla || 127 ||*

*Word for word:* nilamani-kirana barana — of the colour of a blue gem's rays; ujiyara — radiant; trailokya-mohana — enchanting the three worlds; eka sundara chhaoyala — a beautiful boy

**127.** Radiant as the rays of a blue gem,
a beautiful boy who enchants the three worlds?"

কিছু না দেখিয়া তারা কহয়ে দেখিল ।
পুনঃ মোহ যায় পাছে আশঙ্কা হইল ॥ ১২৮ ॥

*kichu nā dekhiẏā tārā kahaẏe dekhila |*
*punaḥ moha yāẏa pāche āśaṅkā haila || 128 ||*

*Word for word:* kichhu na dekhiya tara — seeing nothing, they; kahaye dekhila — say "we see"; punah moha yaya pachhe — lest He faint again; ashanka haila — fearing

**128.** Seeing nothing, they say, "We see,"
fearing that He might faint again.

পুনঃ তা-সভারে প্রভু কহিছে উত্তর ।
দেউল-ধ্বজায় দেখ বালক সুন্দর ॥ ১২৯ ॥

*punaḥ tā-sabhāre prabhu kahiche uttara |*
*deula-dhbajāẏa dekha bālaka sundara || 129 ||*

*Word for word:* punah ta-sabhare — again to them; prabhu kahichhe uttara — the Lord says in reply; deula-dhvajaya dekha — look on the temple's banner; balaka sundara — a beautiful boy

**129.** Again the Lord says to them,
"Look: on the temple's banner — a beautiful boy!

প্রসন্ন-বদনে পূর্ণামৃত যেন রূপ ।
আলোল অঙ্গুলি করতলে অপরূপ ॥ ১৩০ ॥

*prasanna-badane pūrṇāmṛta yena rūpa |*
*ālola aṅguli karatale aparūpa || 130 ||*

*Word for word:* prasanna-badane — with a gracious face; purnamrita yena rupa — a form like full nectar; alola anguli — moving fingers; karatale aparupa — wondrous on the palms

**130.** His face is gracious, His form like full nectar;
wondrously the fingers of His palms are moving.

আমারে ডাকয়ে কর-কমল-লাবণ্য ।
বামকরে বেণু শোভে ত্রিজগত-ধন্য ॥ ১৩১ ॥

*āmāre ḍākaẏe kara-kamala-lābaṇya |*
*bāmakare beṇu śobhe trijagata-dhanya || 131 ||*

*Word for word:* amare dakaye — beckons Me; kara-kamala-lavanya — with the beauty of His lotus hand; vamakare venu shobhe — in His left hand a flute shines; trijagata-dhanya — the blessing of the three worlds

**131.** He beckons Me with the beauty of His lotus hand;
in His left hand is a flute, the blessing of the three worlds."[^45-3]

এ বোল বলিয়া প্রভু চলিলা সত্বর ।
আনন্দে চলিয়া যায় বৈষ্ণব সকল ॥ ১৩২ ॥

*e bola baliẏā prabhu calilā satbara |*
*ānande caliẏā yāẏa baiṣṇaba sakala || 132 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola baliya — saying this; prabhu chalila satvara — the Lord hurried on; anande chaliya yaya — joyfully go; vaishnava sakala — all the Vaishnavas

**132.** Saying this, the Lord hurried forward,
and all the Vaishnavas follow joyfully.

কোটি ইন্দু জিনিঞা সে গৌর-অঙ্গ-ছটা ।
ঝলমল করে সে চন্দন-দীর্ঘ-ফোঁটা ॥ ১৩৩ ॥

*koṭi indu jiniñā se gaura-aṅga-chaṭā |*
*jhalamala kare se candana-dīrgha-phoṁṭā || 133 ||*

*Word for word:* koti indu jininya — outshining millions of moons; se gaura-anga-chhata — the radiance of Gaura's body; jhalamala kare — gleams; se chandana-dirgha-phonta — the long tilaka of sandal paste

**133.** The radiance of Gaura's body outshines millions of moons;
His long tilaka of sandal paste gleams.

গোরা-গায় অরুণ বসন উজিয়ার ।
প্রাতঃকালে সূর্য জিনি' বরণ তাহার ॥ ১৩৪ ॥

*gorā-gāẏa aruṇa basana ujiẏāra |*
*prātaḥkāle sūrya jini' baraṇa tāhāra || 134 ||*

*Word for word:* gora-gaya — on Gora's body; aruna vasana ujiyara — the reddish cloth glows; pratahkale surya jini — outshining the morning sun; barana tahara — its colour

**134.** On Gora's body the reddish cloth glows bright;
its colour outshines the morning sun.

জগন্নাথ-মন্দির দেখিয়া গোরারায় ।
পুনঃ পুনঃ পরণাম করি' চলি' যায় ॥ ১৩৫ ॥

*jagannātha-mandira dekhiẏā gorārāẏa |*
*punaḥ punaḥ paraṇāma kari' cali' yāẏa || 135 ||*

*Word for word:* jagannatha-mandira dekhiya — seeing the temple of Jagannatha; goraraya — Gora Raya; punah punah paranama kari — bowing again and again; chali yaya — walks on

**135.** Seeing the temple of Jagannatha, Gora Raya
bows again and again and walks on.

নয়নে গলয়ে জল অবিরল ধারে ।
বিপুল পুলকে সে ঢাকিল কলেবরে ॥ ১৩৬ ॥

*naẏane galaẏe jala abirala dhāre |*
*bipula pulake se ḍhākila kalebare || 136 ||*

*Word for word:* nayane galaye jala — tears flow from the eyes; avirala dhare — in unbroken streams; vipula pulake — with abundant thrill; se dhakila kalebare — the body was covered

**136.** Tears flow from His eyes without cease,
and the hair on His whole body stands on end.

প্রেমায় বিহ্বল প্রভু হৃদয় সত্বর ।
উত্তরিলা মহাতীর্থ মার্কণ্ডেয়-সরঃ ॥ ১৩৭ ॥

*premāẏa bihbala prabhu hṛdaẏa satbara |*
*uttarilā mahātīrtha mārkaṇḍeẏa-saraḥ || 137 ||*

*Word for word:* premaya vihvala prabhu — the Lord, overwhelmed with prema; hridaya satvara — with an eager heart; uttarila maha-tirtha — reached the great tirtha; markandeya-sarah — the lake of Markandeya

**137.** Overwhelmed with prema, with an eager heart,
the Lord came to the great tirtha, the lake of Markandeya.

স্নান দান কৈল প্রভু যে বিধি আচার ।
চলিলা সত্বরে তবে করি' নমস্কার ॥ ১৩৮ ॥

*snāna dāna kaila prabhu ye bidhi ācāra |*
*calilā satbare tabe kari' namaskāra || 138 ||*

*Word for word:* snana dana kaila prabhu — the Lord bathed and gave gifts; ye vidhi achara — as custom prescribes; chalila satvare tabe — then hurried on; kari namaskara — having bowed

**138.** Having bathed and given gifts as custom prescribes,
He bowed down and hurried on.

যজ্ঞেশ্বর নমস্করি' অতি-হৃষ্ট-মনে ।
উৎকণ্ঠা-হৃদয়ে যায় সত্বর গমনে ॥ ১৩৯ ॥

*yajñeśbara namaskari' ati-hṛṣṭa-mane |*
*utkaṇṭhā-hṛdaẏe yāẏa satbara gamane || 139 ||*

*Word for word:* yajneshvara namaskari — bowing to Yajneshvara; ati-hrishta-mane — full of joy; utkantha-hridaye — with an eager heart; yaya satvara gamane — goes with quick steps

**139.** Bowing to Yajneshvara, full of joy,
with eagerness in His heart He walks on quickly.

পুনরপি জগন্নাথ-মন্দির দেখিয়া ।
পুনঃ পরণাম করে ভূমিতে পড়িয়া ॥ ১৪০ ॥

*punarapi jagannātha-mandira dekhiẏā |*
*punaḥ paraṇāma kare bhūmite paṛiẏā || 140 ||*

*Word for word:* punarapi — again; jagannatha-mandira dekhiya — seeing the temple of Jagannatha; punah paranama kare — He bows again; bhumite padiya — falling to the ground

**140.** Seeing again the temple of Jagannatha,
He bows again, falling to the ground.

অঝোরে ঝরয়ে দুই নয়নের নীর ।
বিহ্বল হইয়া কান্দে আরতি গভীর ॥ ১৪১ ॥

*ajhore jharaẏe dui naẏanera nīra |*
*bihbala haiẏā kānde ārati gabhīra || 141 ||*

*Word for word:* ajhore jharaye — pour without cease; dui nayanera nira — the tears of both eyes; vihvala haiya kande — rapt, He weeps; arati gabhira — in deep longing

**141.** From both His eyes tears flow without cease;
rapt, He weeps in deep longing.

এইমতে গোরাচাঁদের আরতি দেখিয়া ।
দেখা দিল জগন্নাথ পাণি পসারিয়া ॥ ১৪২ ॥

*eimate gorācāṁdera ārati dekhiẏā |*
*dekhā dila jagannātha pāṇi pasāriẏā || 142 ||*

*Word for word:* eimate — such; gorachandera arati dekhiya — seeing Gorachand's longing; dekha dila jagannatha — Jagannatha appeared; pani pasariya — stretching out His hands

**142.** Seeing such longing in Gorachand,
Jagannatha appeared to Him, stretching out His hands.[^45-4]

আইস আইস বলি' ডাকে ত্রিজগত-রায় ।
দেখিয়া বিহ্বল প্রভু ভূমিতে লোটায় ॥ ১৪৩ ॥

*āisa āisa bali' ḍāke trijagata-rāẏa |*
*dekhiẏā bihbala prabhu bhūmite loṭāẏa || 143 ||*

*Word for word:* aisa aisa bali — "come, come!"; dake trijagata-raya — calls the King of the three worlds; dekhiya vihvala prabhu — seeing, the Lord, rapt; bhumite lotaya — rolls on the ground

**143.** "Come, come!" calls the King of the three worlds;
seeing this, the Lord, rapt, rolls on the ground.

আনন্দে হাসিয়া কিছু কহিল বচন ।
কৃপা কর জগন্নাথ দেখিল চরণ ॥ ১৪৪ ॥

*ānande hāsiẏā kichu kahila bacana |*
*kṛpā kara jagannātha dekhila caraṇa || 144 ||*

*Word for word:* anande hasiya — laughing with joy; kichhu kahila vachana — He spoke; kripa kara jagannatha — be merciful, Jagannatha; dekhila charana — I have seen [Your] feet

**144.** Laughing with joy, He said,
"Be merciful, Jagannatha — I have seen Your feet!"

পুনঃ না দেখিয়া পুনঃ করয়ে রোদন ।
পুনরপি দেখি' অতি উলসিত মন ॥ ১৪৫ ॥

*punaḥ nā dekhiẏā punaḥ karaẏe rodana |*
*punarapi dekhi' ati ulasita mana || 145 ||*

*Word for word:* punah na dekhiya — not seeing again; punah karaye rodana — weeps again; punarapi dekhi — seeing again; ati ulasita mana — His heart greatly exults

**145.** When He no longer sees [Him], He weeps again,
and seeing [Him] again, He is filled with exultation.

কেবল উদ্ভট প্রেম-পুলকিত অঙ্গ ।
হুহুঙ্কার-নাদে প্রেমামিয়া-তরঙ্গ ॥ ১৪৬ ॥

*kebala udbhaṭa prema-pulakita aṅga |*
*huhuṅkāra-nāde premāmiẏā-taraṅga || 146 ||*

*Word for word:* kevala udbhata prema — nothing but wild prema; pulakita anga — the body thrilling; huhunkara-nade — with the sound of roaring; premamiya-taranga — waves of the nectar of prema

**146.** Nothing but wild surges of prema, His body thrilling;
with a thunderous roar the waves of the nectar of prema rise.

তবে সেইমতে প্রভু চলিলা সত্বর ।
উত্তরিলা বাসুদেব-সার্বভৌম-ঘর ॥ ১৪৭ ॥

*tabe seimate prabhu calilā satbara |*
*uttarilā bāsudeba-sārbabhauma-ghara || 147 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe seimate — then in the same way; prabhu chalila satvara — the Lord went quickly; uttarila — arrived; vasudeva-sarvabhauma-ghara — at the house of Vasudeva Sarvabhauma

**147.** Then the Lord went on in the same haste
and came to the house of Vasudeva Sarvabhauma.

সার্বভৌম প্রভুরে দেখিয়া হরষিতে ।
গৃহব্যবহারে দিল আসন বসিতে ॥ ১৪৮ ॥

*sārbabhauma prabhure dekhiẏā haraṣite |*
*gṛhabyabahāre dila āsana basite || 148 ||*

*Word for word:* sarvabhauma prabhure dekhiya — Sarvabhauma, seeing the Lord; harashite — joyfully; griha-vyavahare — by householders' custom; dila asana vasite — offered a seat

**148.** Sarvabhauma, joyfully seeing the Lord,
offered Him a seat as householders' custom requires.

নমো নারায়ণ বলি' কৈল নমস্কার ।
রাধাকৃষ্ণে শীঘ্র মতি হউক তোমার ॥ ১৪৮+১ ॥

*namo nārāẏaṇa bali' kaila namaskāra |*
*rādhākṛṣṇe śīghra mati hauka tomāra || 148+1 ||*

*Word for word:* namo narayana bali — saying "namo narayana"; kaila namaskara — he bowed; radhakrishne shighra mati — soon [your] mind on Radha and Krishna; hauka tomara — may yours be

**148+1.** He bowed, saying "Namo narayanaya";
[the Lord replied,] "May your mind soon turn to Radha and Krishna."[^45-5]

প্রভু-আশীর্বাদ-বাণী শুনি' ভট্টাচার্য ।
বুঝিলেন বৈষ্ণব-সন্ন্যাসী মহাচার্য ॥ ১৪৮+২ ॥

*prabhu-āśīrbāda-bāṇī śuni' bhaṭṭācārya |*
*bujhilena baiṣṇaba-sannyāsī mahācārya || 148+2 ||*

*Word for word:* prabhu-ashirvada-vani — the Lord's words of blessing; shuni bhattacharya — hearing, the Bhattacharya; bujhilena — understood; vaishnava-sannyasi mahacharya — a Vaishnava sannyasi, a great acharya

**148+2.** Hearing the Lord's words of blessing, the Bhattacharya
understood: this is a Vaishnava sannyasi, a great acharya.

সার্বভৌম দেখি' প্রভু কহিল বচন ।
জগন্নাথ দেখিবারে উৎকণ্ঠিত মন ॥ ১৪৯ ॥

*sārbabhauma dekhi' prabhu kahila bacana |*
*jagannātha dekhibāre utkaṇṭhita mana || 149 ||*

*Word for word:* sarvabhauma dekhi — seeing Sarvabhauma; prabhu kahila vachana — the Lord spoke; jagannatha dekhibare — to see Jagannatha; utkanthita mana — the heart longs

**149.** The Lord said to Sarvabhauma,
"I long to see Jagannatha.

কেমনে দেখিব আমি দেব-দেব-রায় ।
সাক্ষাৎ করিতে মোর সম্ভ্রম হিয়ায় ॥ ১৫০ ॥

*kemane dekhiba āmi deba-deba-rāẏa |*
*sākṣāt karite mora sambhrama hiẏāẏa || 150 ||*

*Word for word:* kemane dekhiba ami — how shall I see; deva-deva-raya — the Lord, God of gods; sakshat karite — to meet face to face; mora sambhrama hiyaya — there is awe in My heart

**150.** How shall I see the Lord, the God of gods?
To stand before Him — My heart is in awe."

এ বোল শুনিয়া সার্বভৌম মহাশয় ।
প্রভু-অঙ্গ নিরখিয়ে বিস্মিত-হিয়ায় ॥ ১৫১ ॥

*e bola śuniẏā sārbabhauma mahāśaẏa |*
*prabhu-aṅga nirakhiẏe bismita-hiẏāẏa || 151 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuniya — hearing this; sarvabhauma mahashaya — the venerable Sarvabhauma; prabhu-anga nirakhiye — gazes at the Lord's form; vismita-hiyaya — with an amazed heart

**151.** Hearing this, the venerable Sarvabhauma
gazes in wonder at the Lord's form:

এ তপ্তকাঞ্চন গৌর সুমেরুসুন্দর ।
নয়নচন্দ্রিমা মুখ করে ঝলমল ॥ ১৫২ ॥

*e taptakāñcana gaura sumerusundara |*
*naẏanacandrimā mukha kare jhalamala || 152 ||*

*Word for word:* e tapta-kanchana gaura — He is golden like molten gold; sumeru-sundara — beautiful as Sumeru; nayana-chandrima mukha — the face, a moon with eyes; kare jhalamala — shines

**152.** "He is golden like molten gold, beautiful as Sumeru;
His face, a moon with lovely eyes, is shining.

সিংহগ্রীব, কম্বুকণ্ঠ, সুদীর্ঘলোচন ।
আজানুলম্বিত ভুজ — সব সুলক্ষণ ॥ ১৫৩ ॥

*siṃhagrība, kambukaṇṭha, sudīrghalocana |*
*ājānulambita bhuja — saba sulakṣaṇa || 153 ||*

*Word for word:* simha-griva — a lion's neck; kambu-kantha — a conch-like throat; sudirgha-lochana — long eyes; ajanu-lambita bhuja — arms reaching the knees; saba sulakshana — all auspicious marks

**153.** A lion's neck, a conch-like throat, long eyes,
arms reaching to the knees — all auspicious marks."

উজ্জ্বল কৃষ্ণের প্রেমায় আরতি-বিহ্বল ।
পুলকে আকুল অঙ্গ করে টলমল ॥ ১৫৩+১ ॥

*ujjbala kṛṣṇera premāẏa ārati-bihbala |*
*pulake ākula aṅga kare ṭalamala || 153+1 ||*

*Word for word:* ujjvala krishnera premaya — in bright prema for Krishna; arati-vihvala — overcome with longing; pulake akula anga — the body flooded with thrill; kare talamala — sways

**153+1.** In bright prema for Krishna He is overcome with longing,
thrilling all over, His body sways.[^45-6]

দেখিয়া বিহ্বল সার্বভৌম ভট্টাচার্য ।
গুণিতে লাগিলা দেখি' সকল আশ্চর্য ॥ ১৫৪ ॥

*dekhiẏā bihbala sārbabhauma bhaṭṭācārya |*
*guṇite lāgilā dekhi' sakala āścarya || 154 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhiya vihvala — seeing, overwhelmed; sarvabhauma bhattacharya — Sarvabhauma Bhattacharya; gunite lagila — began to ponder; dekhi sakala ashcharya — seeing all the wonders

**154.** Seeing this, Sarvabhauma Bhattacharya, overwhelmed,
began to ponder, seeing all these wonders:

এরূপ মানুষ নাহি সকল জগতে ।
দেবতা-ভিতরে ইহা না পারি গণিতে ॥ ১৫৫ ॥

*erūpa mānuṣa nāhi sakala jagate |*
*debatā-bhitare ihā nā pāri gaṇite || 155 ||*

*Word for word:* erupa manusha nahi — there is no such man; sakala jagate — in all the world; devata-bhitare — among the gods; iha na pari ganite — I cannot count Him

**155.** "There is no such man in all the world;
not even among the gods can I place Him.

বৈকুণ্ঠনায়ক প্রভু আইলা আপনে ।
এই সেই ভগবান্ বুঝি অনুমানে ॥ ১৫৬ ॥

*baikuṇṭhanāẏaka prabhu āilā āpane |*
*ei sei bhagabān bujhi anumāne || 156 ||*

*Word for word:* vaikuntha-nayaka prabhu — the Lord, master of Vaikuntha; aila apane — has come Himself; ei sei bhagavan — this is that Bhagavan; bujhi anumane — I understand by inference

**156.** The Lord of Vaikuntha has come Himself:
this is that Bhagavan — so I conclude."

এতেক চিন্তিয়া সার্বভৌম মহাজন ।
আপন তনুজ দেখি' কহিছে বচন ॥ ১৫৭ ॥

*eteka cintiẏā sārbabhauma mahājana |*
*āpana tanuja dekhi' kahiche bacana || 157 ||*

*Word for word:* eteka chintiya — thinking thus; sarvabhauma mahajana — the great Sarvabhauma; apana tanuja dekhi — seeing his own son; kahichhe vachana — says

**157.** Thinking thus, the great Sarvabhauma,
seeing his son, says to him:[^45-7]

সত্বরে চলহ তুমি চৈতন্য-সংহতি ।
সাবধানে শুনিবে যে কহে মহামতি ॥ ১৫৮ ॥

*satbare calaha tumi caitanya-saṃhati |*
*sābadhāne śunibe ye kahe mahāmati || 158 ||*

*Word for word:* satvare chalaha tumi — go quickly; chaitanya-samhati — with Chaitanya; savadhane shunibe — listen carefully; ye kahe mahamati — to what the great soul says

**158.** "Go quickly with Chaitanya;
listen carefully to what this great soul says.

শ্রীজগন্নাথ মহাপ্রভু যথা আছে ।
সঙ্গতি-সহিতে ইহায় থোবে তাঁর কাছে ॥ ১৫৯ ॥

*śrījagannātha mahāprabhu yathā āche |*
*saṅgati-sahite ihāẏa thobe tāṁra kāche || 159 ||*

*Word for word:* shri-jagannatha mahaprabhu — Sri Jagannatha Mahaprabhu; yatha achhe — where He is; sangati-sahite — with the companions; ihaya thobe tanra kachhe — place Him near Him

**159.** Where Sri Jagannatha Mahaprabhu dwells —
take Him with His companions there, to Him."

এ বোল শুনিয়া তুষ্ট হৈলা গোরারায় ।
চলিলা ত সার্বভৌম-তনুজ-সহায় ॥ ১৬০ ॥

*e bola śuniẏā tuṣṭa hailā gorārāẏa |*
*calilā ta sārbabhauma-tanuja-sahāẏa || 160 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuniya — hearing this; tushta haila goraraya — Gora Raya was pleased; chalila ta — went; sarvabhauma-tanuja-sahaya — with Sarvabhauma's son as guide

**160.** Hearing this, Gora Raya was pleased
and went, guided by Sarvabhauma's son.

সিংহদ্বারে গিয়া প্রভু তনু টলমল ।
ধরিতে না পারে অঙ্গ প্রেমায় বিহ্বল ॥ ১৬১ ॥

*siṃhadbāre giẏā prabhu tanu ṭalamala |*
*dharite nā pāre aṅga premāẏa bihbala || 161 ||*

*Word for word:* simha-dvare giya — coming to the Lion Gate; prabhu tanu talamala — the Lord's body swayed; dharite na pare anga — cannot hold up His body; premaya vihvala — overwhelmed with prema

**161.** At the Lion Gate the Lord's body swayed:
rapt in prema, He cannot keep on His feet.

থির চলিবারে নারে আউলাইল অঙ্গ ।
সাবধানে কাছে কাছে যায় সব সঙ্গ ॥ ১৬২ ॥

*thira calibāre nāre āulāila aṅga |*
*sābadhāne kāche kāche yāẏa saba saṅga || 162 ||*

*Word for word:* thira chalibare nare — cannot walk steadily; aulaila anga — the limbs went limp; savadhane kachhe kachhe — carefully, close by; yaya saba sanga — all the companions go

**162.** He cannot walk steadily, His limbs have gone limp;
all the companions walk carefully close beside Him.

অনেক যতনে সিংহদ্বারে প্রবেশিলা ।
সেখানে ত্বরিতে নাটমন্দিরে উঠিলা ॥ ১৬৩ ॥

*aneka yatane siṃhadbāre prabeśilā |*
*sekhāne tbarite nāṭamandire uṭhilā || 163 ||*

*Word for word:* aneka yatane — with great effort; simha-dvare praveshila — entered the Lion Gate; sekhane tvarite — there at once; nata-mandire uthila — went up into the Nata-mandira

**163.** With great effort He entered the Lion Gate
and at once hurried up into the Nata-mandira.

গরুড়ের পাছে রহি' থির-দিঠে চায় ।
দেখিল শ্রীমুখচন্দ্র ত্রিজগত-রায় ॥ ১৬৪ ॥

*garuṛera pāche rahi' thira-diṭhe cāẏa |*
*dekhila śrīmukhacandra trijagata-rāẏa || 164 ||*

*Word for word:* garudera pachhe rahi — standing behind Garuda; thira-dithe chaya — gazes steadily; dekhila shri-mukha-chandra — saw the moon-face; trijagata-raya — of the King of the three worlds

**164.** Standing behind Garuda, He gazes intently —
and saw the moon-face of the King of the three worlds.[^45-8]

অতি-উলসিত হিয়া ভরল আনন্দ ।
অঙ্গ আচ্ছাদিল ঘন পুলক-কদম্ব ॥ ১৬৫ ॥

*ati-ulasita hiẏā bharala ānanda |*
*aṅga ācchādila ghana pulaka-kadamba || 165 ||*

*Word for word:* ati-ulasita hiya — the heart leapt up; bharala ananda — filled with bliss; anga achchhadila — covered the body; ghana pulaka-kadamba — dense thrills like kadamba blossoms

**165.** His heart leapt up, filled with bliss;
His body was covered with thrills, like a kadamba blossom.

সাত পাঁচ ধারা বহে নয়নের জল ।
আপনা পাসরে প্রেমানন্দ-পরবল ॥ ১৬৬ ॥

*sāta pāṁca dhārā bahe naẏanera jala |*
*āpanā pāsare premānanda-parabala || 166 ||*

*Word for word:* sata pancha dhara — in seven, five streams; bahe nayanera jala — the tears flow from the eyes; apana pasare — He forgets Himself; premananda-parabala — overpowered by the bliss of prema

**166.** Five, seven streams of tears flow from His eyes;
He forgot Himself, overpowered by the bliss of prema.

ভূমিতে পড়িলা প্রভু অবশ শ্রীঅঙ্গ ।
বাতাসে খসিলা যেন সুমেরুর শৃঙ্গ ॥ ১৬৭ ॥

*bhūmite paṛilā prabhu abaśa śrīaṅga |*
*bātāse khasilā yena sumerura śṛṅga || 167 ||*

*Word for word:* bhumite padila prabhu — the Lord fell to the ground; abasha shri-anga — His body helpless; vatase khasila — toppled by the wind; yena sumerura shringa — like a peak of Sumeru

**167.** The Lord fell to the ground, His body helpless —
as if the wind had toppled a peak of Sumeru.

প্রেমার আবেশে মূর্চ্ছা হৈলা ভগবান্ ।
দুই হস্ত দৃঢ়মুষ্টি মুদ্রিত-নয়ান ॥ ১৬৮ ॥

*premāra ābeśe mūrcchā hailā bhagabān |*
*dui hasta dṛṛhamuṣṭi mudrita-naẏāna || 168 ||*

*Word for word:* premara aveshe — in the rapture of prema; murchchha haila bhagavan — Bhagavan fainted; dui hasta dridha-mushti — both hands tightly clenched; mudrita-nayana — eyes closed

**168.** In the rapture of prema Bhagavan fainted:
both hands clenched tight in fists, eyes closed.

শিথিল বসন ভেল বিবশ শরীরে ।
দেখি' দ্বিজগণ গেলা দেউল-বাহিরে ॥ ১৬৮+১ ॥

*śithila basana bhela bibaśa śarīre |*
*dekhi' dbijagaṇa gelā deula-bāhire || 168+1 ||*

*Word for word:* shithila vasana bhela — the cloth came loose; vibasha sharire — on the senseless body; dekhi dvijagana — seeing this, the brahmanas; gela deula-bahire — went out of the temple

**168+1.** His cloth slipped on His senseless body;
seeing this, the brahmanas went out of the temple.

আসন ছাড়িয়া জগন্নাথ প্রভু তুলি' ।
দোঁহার পরশে দোঁহে ভেল কুতুহলী ॥ ১৬৮+২ ॥

*āsana chāṛiẏā jagannātha prabhu tuli' |*
*doṁhāra paraśe doṁhe bhela kutuhalī || 168+2 ||*

*Word for word:* asana chhadiya — leaving the throne; jagannatha prabhu tuli — Jagannatha, lifting the Lord; donhara parashe — at each other's touch; donhe bhela kutuhali — both were delighted

**168+2.** Leaving His throne, Lord Jagannatha lifted [Him] up;
at each other's touch both were filled with delight.

বাহু বাহু দিয়া সে তখনি কৈল কোলে ।
জগন্নাথ-সম্মুখে নাচয়ে হরিবোলে ॥ ১৬৮+৩ ॥

*bāhu bāhu diẏā se takhani kaila kole |*
*jagannātha-sammukhe nācaẏe haribole || 168+3 ||*

*Word for word:* bahu bahu diya — putting arms around; se takhani kaila kole — at once embraced; jagannatha-sammukhe — before Jagannatha; nachaye haribole — dances crying "Haribol"

**168+3.** Putting His arms around [Him], He at once embraced Him,
and [the Lord] dances before Jagannatha, crying "Haribol!"

গৌরাঙ্গ-পরশে জগন্নাথ প্রেমে ভোরা ।
আসন-উপরে তবে বসাইলা গোরা ॥ ১৬৮+৪ ॥

*gaurāṅga-paraśe jagannātha preme bhorā |*
*āsana-upare tabe basāilā gorā || 168+4 ||*

*Word for word:* gauranga-parashe — at Gauranga's touch; jagannatha preme bhora — Jagannatha intoxicated with prema; asana-upare — on the throne; tabe basaila gora — then seated Gora

**168+4.** At Gauranga's touch Jagannatha, intoxicated with prema,
seated Gora upon His throne.[^45-9]

নাচে হরি বলি' প্রভু শচীর নন্দন ।
প্রবিষ্ট হইলা সভে মন্দিরে তখন ॥ ১৬৯ ॥

*nāce hari bali' prabhu śacīra nandana |*
*prabiṣṭa hailā sabhe mandire takhana || 169 ||*

*Word for word:* nache hari bali — dances crying "Hari"; prabhu shachira nandana — the Lord, the son of Shachi; pravishta haila sabhe — all entered; mandire takhana — the temple then

**169.** The son of Shachi dances, crying "Hari!" —
and then all entered the temple.

গদাধর নাচে, নরহরি, নিত্যানন্দ ।
শ্রীনিবাস, দামোদর, মুরারি, মুকুন্দ ॥ ১৭০ ॥

*gadādhara nāce, narahari, nityānanda |*
*śrīnibāsa, dāmodara, murāri, mukunda || 170 ||*

*Word for word:* gadadhara nache — Gadadhara dances; narahari, nityananda — Narahari, Nityananda; shrinivasa, damodara, murari, mukunda — Srinivasa, Damodara, Murari, Mukunda

**170.** Gadadhara dances, and Narahari, Nityananda,
Srinivasa, Damodara, Murari, Mukunda;

আর সব ভক্তগণ নাচয়ে হরিষে ।
রাধাকানু-গুণগান কীর্তন প্রকাশে ॥ ১৭১ ॥

*āra saba bhaktagaṇa nācaẏe hariṣe |*
*rādhākānu-guṇagāna kīrtana prakāśe || 171 ||*

*Word for word:* ara saba bhakta-gana — and all the other devotees; nachaye harishe — dance in joy; radha-kanu-guna-gana — singing the virtues of Radha and Kanu; kirtana prakashe — manifest in kirtana

**171.** all the other devotees too dance in joy,
making kirtana, singing the virtues of Radha and Kanu.

তবে সভে অনুমানি' সঙ্গী যত জন ।
প্রভু লঞা আইলা সার্বভৌমের আশ্রম ॥ ১৭২ ॥

*tabe sabhe anumāni' saṅgī yata jana |*
*prabhu lañā āilā sārbabhaumera āśrama || 172 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe sabhe anumani — then all, having considered; sangi yata jana — all the companions; prabhu lanya aila — brought the Lord; sarvabhaumera ashrama — to Sarvabhauma's dwelling

**172.** Then all the companions, after deliberating,
brought the Lord to Sarvabhauma's house.[^45-10]

সার্বভৌম-ঘরে প্রভুর সম্বেদন হৈল ।
গুণ-সঙ্কীর্তনে পুনঃ নাচিতে লাগিল ॥ ১৭৩ ॥

*sārbabhauma-ghare prabhura sambedana haila |*
*guṇa-saṅkīrtane punaḥ nācite lāgila || 173 ||*

*Word for word:* sarvabhauma-ghare — in Sarvabhauma's house; prabhura samvedana haila — the Lord regained consciousness; guna-sankirtane — in the kirtana of virtues; punah nachite lagila — began to dance again

**173.** In Sarvabhauma's house the Lord came to Himself
and began to dance again in the kirtana of [Krishna's] virtues.

দেখি' সার্বভৌম বাসুদেব ভট্টাচার্য ।
হৃদয়ে আহ্লাদ মহা দেখিয়া আশ্চর্য ॥ ১৭৪ ॥

*dekhi' sārbabhauma bāsudeba bhaṭṭācārya |*
*hṛdaẏe āhlāda mahā dekhiẏā āścarya || 174 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhi — seeing; sarvabhauma vasudeva bhattacharya — Sarvabhauma Vasudeva Bhattacharya; hridaye ahlada maha — great delight in the heart; dekhiya ashcharya — seeing the wonder

**174.** Seeing this, Sarvabhauma Vasudeva Bhattacharya
felt great delight in his heart, seeing this wonder.

তবে পুনঃ মহাপ্রভু-নৃত্য-অবসানে ।
ভিক্ষা-আমন্ত্রণ তাঁরে দিল সার্বভৌমে ॥ ১৭৫ ॥

*tabe punaḥ mahāprabhu-nṛtya-abasāne |*
*bhikṣā-āmantraṇa tāṁre dila sārbabhaume || 175 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe punah — then; mahaprabhu-nritya-avasane — when Mahaprabhu's dance was over; bhiksha-amantrana tanre dila — invited Him to accept alms; sarvabhaume — Sarvabhauma

**175.** When Mahaprabhu's dancing was over,
Sarvabhauma invited Him to accept alms.

প্রসাদ আনিতে দিল ব্রাহ্মণের গণ ।
প্রভু-সঙ্গে সার্বভৌম করয়ে মিলন ॥ ১৭৬ ॥

*prasāda ānite dila brāhmaṇera gaṇa |*
*prabhu-saṅge sārbabhauma karaẏe milana || 176 ||*

*Word for word:* prasada anite dila — sent to bring prasada; brahmanera gana — the brahmanas; prabhu-sange — with the Lord; sarvabhauma karaye milana — Sarvabhauma converses

**176.** He sent brahmanas to bring prasada,
and he, Sarvabhauma, converses with the Lord.

ইষ্টগোষ্ঠী করে বিদ্যা জানিবার তরে ।
তত্ত্ব জিজ্ঞাসিতে কিছু লাগিল প্রভুরে ॥ ১৭৭ ॥

*iṣṭagoṣṭhī kare bidyā jānibāra tare |*
*tattba jijñāsite kichu lāgila prabhure || 177 ||*

*Word for word:* ishtagoshthi kare — holds friendly talk; vidya janibara tare — to learn [His] learning; tattva jijnasite kichhu — to ask about facts; lagila prabhure — began [to ask] the Lord

**177.** He holds a friendly conversation to learn His learning
and began to ask the Lord something about Himself:

তোর জন্মস্থান কোথা কহিবে আমারে ।
প্রভু কহে যে কহিলে সেই সত্য হয়ে ॥ ১৭৮ ॥

*tora janmasthāna kothā kahibe āmāre |*
*prabhu kahe ye kahile sei satya haẏe || 178 ||*

*Word for word:* tora janmasthana kotha — where is Your birthplace; kahibe amare — tell me; prabhu kahe — the Lord says; ye kahile sei satya haye — what you said is true

**178.** "Where were You born? Tell me."
The Lord says, "What you have said is true."

ভট্টাচার্য কহে তুমি কি কহ কথন ।
এক কহি আর কহ কিসের কারণ ॥ ১৭৯ ॥

*bhaṭṭācārya kahe tumi ki kaha kathana |*
*eka kahi āra kaha kisera kāraṇa || 179 ||*

*Word for word:* bhattacharya kahe — the Bhattacharya says; tumi ki kaha kathana — what are You saying; eka kahi — I say one thing; ara kaha — You say another; kisera karana — why

**179.** The Bhattacharya says, "What are You saying?
I say one thing and You another — why?"

প্রভু মৌনী হই' রহে সমুদ্র-গম্ভীর ।
পুনর্বার প্রভুরে জিজ্ঞাসে বিপ্র ধীর ॥ ১৮০ ॥

*prabhu maunī hai' rahe samudra-gambhīra |*
*punarbāra prabhure jijñāse bipra dhīra || 180 ||*

*Word for word:* prabhu mauni hai rahe — the Lord stays silent; samudra-gambhira — deep as the ocean; punarbara prabhure — again the Lord; jijnase vipra dhira — the grave brahmana asks

**180.** The Lord stays silent, deep as the ocean;
again the grave brahmana asks the Lord:

তোর মাতা পিতা কে বা কহ না আমারে ।
প্রভু কহে সত্য এই তুমি যে কহিলে ॥ ১৮১ ॥

*tora mātā pitā ke bā kaha nā āmāre |*
*prabhu kahe satya ei tumi ye kahile || 181 ||*

*Word for word:* tora mata pita ke va — who are Your mother and father; kaha na amare — do tell me; prabhu kahe — the Lord says; satya ei tumi ye kahile — what you said is true

**181.** "Who are Your mother and father? Tell me."
The Lord says, "What you have said is true."

ভট্টাচার্য পুনর্বার তথাপি জিজ্ঞাসে ।
কহিবে তোমার কোথা হইল সন্ন্যাসে ॥ ১৮২ ॥

*bhaṭṭācārya punarbāra tathāpi jijñāse |*
*kahibe tomāra kothā haila sannyāse || 182 ||*

*Word for word:* bhattacharya punarbara — the Bhattacharya again; tathapi jijnase — still asks; kahibe — tell; tomara kotha haila sannyase — where did You take sannyasa

**182.** The Bhattacharya asks yet again,
"Tell me, where did You take sannyasa?"

প্রভু কহে এই সত্য জানিবে নিশ্চয় ।
শুনি' সার্বভৌম মনে বড়ই বিস্ময় ॥ ১৮৩ ॥

*prabhu kahe ei satya jānibe niścaẏa |*
*śuni' sārbabhauma mane baṛai bismaẏa || 183 ||*

*Word for word:* prabhu kahe — the Lord says; ei satya janibe nishchaya — know for certain this is true; shuni — hearing; sarvabhauma mane badai vismaya — Sarvabhauma was greatly amazed

**183.** The Lord says, "Know for certain: this is true."
Hearing this, Sarvabhauma was greatly amazed.

বুঝিতে নারিল কিছু প্রভুর নির্ণয় ।
কোটি-সরস্বতীকান্ত অখিলের জয় ॥ ১৮৪ ॥

*bujhite nārila kichu prabhura nirṇaẏa |*
*koṭi-sarasbatīkānta akhilera jaẏa || 184 ||*

*Word for word:* bujhite narila kichhu — could not at all understand; prabhura nirnaya — the Lord's resolve; koti-sarasvati-kanta — the Lord of myriad Sarasvatis; akhilera jaya — the victory of all

**184.** He could not at all understand the Lord's resolve —
the Lord of myriad Sarasvatis, the victory of all.[^45-11]

কিবা বা ঈশ্বর কিবা বাতুল-স্বভাব ।
মনে কুণ্ঠা-ক্রোধ মাত্র হৈল তার লাভ ॥ ১৮৫ ॥

*kibā bā īśbara kibā bātula-sbabhāba |*
*mane kuṇṭhā-krodha mātra haila tāra lābha || 185 ||*

*Word for word:* kiba va ishvara — whether God; kiba vatula-svabhava — or of a madman's nature; mane kuntha-krodha — vexation and anger in the mind; matra haila tara labha — was all he gained

**185.** "Is He God — or of a madman's nature?"
Only vexation and anger fell to his lot.

আনাইল ভট্টাচার্য অনেক প্রসাদ ।
উঠিলা প্রসাদ দেখি' প্রেমার উন্মাদ ॥ ১৮৬ ॥

*ānāila bhaṭṭācārya aneka prasāda |*
*uṭhilā prasāda dekhi' premāra unmāda || 186 ||*

*Word for word:* anaila bhattacharya — the Bhattacharya had brought; aneka prasada — much prasada; uthila — arose; prasada dekhi — at the sight of prasada; premara unmada — the madness of prema

**186.** The Bhattacharya had much prasada brought;
at the sight of prasada the madness of prema arose.

জগন্নাথ-অন্ন-মহাপ্রসাদ পাইয়া ।
মস্তকে বন্দিলা প্রভু হাসিয়া হাসিয়া ॥ ১৮৭ ॥

*jagannātha-anna-mahāprasāda pāiẏā |*
*mastake bandilā prabhu hāsiẏā hāsiẏā || 187 ||*

*Word for word:* jagannatha-anna-mahaprasada — Jagannatha's rice mahaprasada; paiya — receiving; mastake bandila prabhu — the Lord honoured it on His head; hasiya hasiya — laughing

**187.** Receiving the mahaprasada — Jagannatha's rice —
the Lord, laughing, reverently raised it to His head.

হুঙ্কার করিল এক গম্ভীর শবদে ।
ব্রহ্মাণ্ড ভরিল সেই প্রভু-সিংহনাদে ॥ ১৮৮ ॥

*huṅkāra karila eka gambhīra śabade |*
*brahmāṇḍa bharila sei prabhu-siṃhanāde || 188 ||*

*Word for word:* hunkara karila eka — gave a roar; gambhira shabade — with a deep sound; brahmanda bharila — filled the universe; sei prabhu-simhanade — that lion's roar of the Lord

**188.** He gave a roar in a deep voice —
that lion's roar of the Lord filled the universe.

দেব, গন্ধর্ব, নর, শৃগাল, কুকুর ।
আইলা গৌরাঙ্গ-কাছে যত নাগকুল ॥ ১৮৯ ॥

*deba, gandharba, nara, śṛgāla, kukura |*
*āilā gaurāṅga-kāche yata nāgakula || 189 ||*

*Word for word:* deva, gandharva, nara — gods, gandharvas, men; shrigala, kukura — jackals, dogs; aila gauranga-kachhe — came to Gauranga; yata nagakula — all the naga clans

**189.** Gods, gandharvas, men, jackals, dogs
and all the clans of the nagas came to Gauranga.

সভার মুখেতে সেই প্রসাদ আনন্দে ।
দেখে গদাধর আদি প্রভু নিত্যানন্দে ॥ ১৯০ ॥

*sabhāra mukhete sei prasāda ānande |*
*dekhe gadādhara ādi prabhu nityānande || 190 ||*

*Word for word:* sabhara mukhete — into the mouths of all; sei prasada anande — that prasada joyfully; dekhe gadadhara adi — Gadadhara and the others see; prabhu nityanande — and Prabhu Nityananda

**190.** [He] joyfully put that prasada into all their mouths —
Gadadhara and the others and Prabhu Nityananda saw it.

কেহো না কহিল কিছু তত্ত্ব সব জানে ।
প্রসাদ পাইল সব লঞা ভক্তগণে ॥ ১৯১ ॥

*keho nā kahila kichu tattba saba jāne |*
*prasāda pāila saba lañā bhaktagaṇe || 191 ||*

*Word for word:* keho na kahila kichhu — no one said anything; tattva saba jane — all know the truth; prasada paila saba — all received prasada; lanya bhakta-gane — with the devotees

**191.** No one said anything: all knew the truth.
All received prasada together with the devotees.

নিজজন-সঙ্গে অল্প করিল ভোজন ।
হেনকালে শ্রীনিবাস কহিল বচন ॥ ১৯২ ॥

*nijajana-saṅge alpa karila bhojana |*
*henakāle śrīnibāsa kahila bacana || 192 ||*

*Word for word:* nijajana-sange — with His own people; alpa karila bhojana — ate a little; henakale — then; shrinivasa kahila vachana — Srinivasa spoke

**192.** He ate a little with His own people;
then Srinivasa spoke:

এক নিবেদিয়ে প্রভু কহিতে ডরাঙ ।
নির্ভয়ে পুছিয়ে প্রভু যদি আজ্ঞা পাঙ ॥ ১৯৩ ॥

*eka nibediẏe prabhu kahite ḍarāṅa |*
*nirbhaẏe puchiẏe prabhu yadi ājñā pāṅa || 193 ||*

*Word for word:* eka nivediye — I have a request; prabhu kahite darang — Lord, I fear to say it; nirbhaye puchhiye — I shall ask without fear; prabhu yadi ajna pang — Lord, if I get leave

**193.** "I have a request, Lord, but I am afraid to say it;
I shall ask without fear, if I have Your leave.

প্রসাদ পাইয়া তুমি হাসিলা যেকালে ।
চকিত দেখিল ইহা কহিবে আমারে ॥ ১৯৪ ॥

*prasāda pāiẏā tumi hāsilā yekāle |*
*cakita dekhila ihā kahibe āmāre || 194 ||*

*Word for word:* prasada paiya — receiving prasada; tumi hasila yekale — when You laughed; chakita dekhila — I was startled to see; iha kahibe amare — tell me about this

**194.** When You received the prasada and laughed,
I was startled to see it. Explain this to me."

এ বোল শুনিঞা প্রভু অধিক উল্লাস ।
কহয়ে অন্তর-কথা করিয়া প্রকাশ ॥ ১৯৫ ॥

*e bola śuniñā prabhu adhika ullāsa |*
*kahaẏe antara-kathā kariẏā prakāśa || 195 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuninya — hearing this; prabhu adhika ullasa — the Lord in great joy; kahaye antara-katha — speaks of the inner matter; kariya prakasha — revealing it

**195.** Hearing this, the Lord, in great joy,
speaks, revealing what is hidden:

কাত্যায়নী-প্রতিজ্ঞায় প্রসাদ হেন ধন ।
শৃগাল কুকুরে খায় শুনহ ব্রাহ্মণ ॥ ১৯৬ ॥

*kātyāẏanī-pratijñāẏa prasāda hena dhana |*
*śṛgāla kukure khāẏa śunaha brāhmaṇa || 196 ||*

*Word for word:* katyayani-pratijnaya — by Katyayani's vow; prasada hena dhana — such a treasure as prasada; shrigala kukure khaya — jackals and dogs eat; shunaha brahmana — listen, brahmana

**196.** "By Katyayani's vow, such a treasure as prasada
is eaten by jackals and dogs — listen, brahmana.[^45-12]

ইন্দ্র, চন্দ্র, গন্ধর্ব কিবা দেবগণে ।
সভার দুর্লভ বস্তু না পায় যতনে ॥ ১৯৭ ॥

*indra, candra, gandharba kibā debagaṇe |*
*sabhāra durlabha bastu nā pāẏa yatane || 197 ||*

*Word for word:* indra, chandra, gandharva — Indra, Chandra, the gandharvas; kiba deva-gane — or the gods; sabhara durlabha vastu — a thing rare for all; na paya yatane — not obtained by effort

**197.** Indra, Chandra, the gandharvas or the gods —
for all it is a rarity: not to be had even by effort.

নারদ-প্রহ্লাদ-শুক-আদি ভক্তগণ ।
তাহার দুর্লভ এই কহিল মরম ॥ ১৯৮ ॥

*nārada-prahlāda-śuka-ādi bhaktagaṇa |*
*tāhāra durlabha ei kahila marama || 198 ||*

*Word for word:* narada-prahlada-shuka-adi — Narada, Prahlada, Shuka and other; bhakta-gana — devotees; tahara durlabha ei — this is rare even for them; kahila marama — I have told the secret

**198.** Narada, Prahlada, Shuka and the other devotees —
even for them it is rare: I have told you the secret.

হেন মহাপ্রসাদ ভুঞ্জয়ে সর্বজনে ।
কহিল মরম-কথা এই মোর মনে ॥ ১৯৯ ॥

*hena mahāprasāda bhuñjaẏe sarbajane |*
*kahila marama-kathā ei mora mane || 199 ||*

*Word for word:* hena mahaprasada — such mahaprasada; bhunjaye sarvajane — all are eating; kahila marama-katha — I have told the secret; ei mora mane — this in My heart

**199.** Such mahaprasada all are eating —
that is the secret I have told you, what was in My heart.

হেন মহাপ্রসাদ পাইয়া যে বা জন ।
অন্নবুদ্ধি করিয়া বা না করে ভক্ষণ ॥ ২০০ ॥

*hena mahāprasāda pāiẏā ye bā jana |*
*annabuddhi kariẏā bā nā kare bhakṣaṇa || 200 ||*

*Word for word:* hena mahaprasada paiya — receiving such mahaprasada; ye va jana — whoever; anna-buddhi kariya va — taking it for ordinary food, or; na kare bhakshana — does not eat it

**200.** Whoever, having received such mahaprasada,
takes it for ordinary food or does not eat it —

পূর্বজন্মার্জিত তার আছিল যে ধর্ম ।
সেহো নষ্ট হয় — সে শূকর-যোনি-জন্ম ॥ ২০১ ॥

*pūrbajanmārjita tāra āchila ye dharma |*
*seho naṣṭa haẏa — se śūkara-yoni-janma || 201 ||*

*Word for word:* purva-janmarjita — earned in former births; tara achhila ye dharma — whatever dharma he had; seho nashta haya — that too perishes; se shukara-yoni-janma — he takes birth from a sow's womb

**201.** even the dharma he gathered in former births perishes,
and he is born from the womb of a sow.

কুকুরের মুখ হৈতে পড়ে যদি তভু ।
পাইলে মাত্র খাবে ইথে দোষ নাহি কভু ॥ ২০২ ॥

*kukurera mukha haite paṛe yadi tabhu |*
*pāile mātra khābe ithe doṣa nāhi kabhu || 202 ||*

*Word for word:* kukurera mukha haite — from a dog's mouth; pade yadi tabhu — even if it falls; paile matra khabe — eat as soon as you get it; ithe dosha nahi kabhu — there is no fault in this at all

**202.** Even if [prasada] falls from a dog's mouth,
eat it as soon as you get it — there is no fault in this at all."[^45-13]

তবে মহাপ্রভু ভিক্ষা করিল সাদরে ।
সন্ধ্যাকালে যায় জগন্নাথ দেখিবারে ॥ ২০৩ ॥

*tabe mahāprabhu bhikṣā karila sādare |*
*sandhyākāle yāẏa jagannātha dekhibāre || 203 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe mahaprabhu — then Mahaprabhu; bhiksha karila sadare — reverently accepted alms; sandhyakale yaya — in the evening goes; jagannatha dekhibare — to see Jagannatha

**203.** Then Mahaprabhu reverently accepted the alms
and in the evening goes to see Jagannatha.

শ্রীমন্দিরে প্রবেশিয়া দেখয়ে শ্রীমুখ ।
ব্রহ্মাণ্ডে না ধরে তার অন্তর-কৌতুক ॥ ২০৪ ॥

*śrīmandire prabeśiẏā dekhaẏe śrīmukha |*
*brahmāṇḍe nā dhare tāra antara-kautuka || 204 ||*

*Word for word:* shri-mandire praveshiya — entering the temple; dekhaye shri-mukha — He sees the beautiful face; brahmande na dhare — the universe cannot hold; tara antara-kautuka — His inner delight

**204.** Entering the temple, He sees the beautiful face;
the universe cannot contain His inner delight.

ধূপ দীপ সুকুসুম মনোহর গন্ধ ।
নিবেদন কৈল বিপ্র দেখিয়া আনন্দ ॥ ২০৪+১ ॥

*dhūpa dīpa sukusuma manohara gandha |*
*nibedana kaila bipra dekhiẏā ānanda || 204+1 ||*

*Word for word:* dhupa dipa sukusuma — incense, lamps, lovely flowers; manohara gandha — enchanting fragrance; nivedana kaila vipra — the brahmana offered; dekhiya ananda — seeing [His] bliss

**204+1.** Incense, lamps, lovely flowers, enchanting fragrance
the brahmana offered, seeing [His] bliss.

ঝলমল তেজ দেখি' অঙ্গের ছটাক ।
একত্র হইল যেন চাঁদ লাখে লাখ ॥ ২০৪+২ ॥

*jhalamala teja dekhi' aṅgera chaṭāka |*
*ekatra haila yena cāṁda lākhe lākha || 204+2 ||*

*Word for word:* jhalamala teja dekhi — seeing the dazzling light; angera chhataka — the splendour of the body; ekatra haila yena — as if gathered together; chanda lakhe lakha — moons by the hundred thousand

**204+2.** Seeing the dazzling splendour of [Jagannatha's] body —
as if moons by the hundred thousand had gathered in one place —[^45-14]

নূতন মেঘের জিনি' অঙ্গের কিরণ ।
তাহে অপরূপ দুই কমললোচন ॥ ২০৫ ॥

*nūtana meghera jini' aṅgera kiraṇa |*
*tāhe aparūpa dui kamalalocana || 205 ||*

*Word for word:* nutana meghera jini — outshining a fresh cloud; angera kirana — the radiance of the body; tahe aparupa — in it wondrous; dui kamala-lochana — two lotus eyes

**205.** the radiance of His body, outshining a fresh cloud,
and in it two wondrous lotus eyes,

দেখিয়া আনন্দ-সিন্ধু ডুবিলা ঠাকুর ।
ভূমিতে লুটায় — প্রেম বাড়িল প্রচুর ॥ ২০৬ ॥

*dekhiẏā ānanda-sindhu ḍubilā ṭhākura |*
*bhūmite luṭāẏa — prema bāṛila pracura || 206 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhiya — seeing; ananda-sindhu dubila thakura — the Thakura plunged into an ocean of bliss; bhumite lutaya — rolls on the ground; prema badila prachura — prema grew immensely

**206.** the Thakura plunged into an ocean of bliss;
He rolls on the ground, His prema grew immensely.

সুমেরু-পর্বত যেন দীঘল শরীর ।
ভূমে গড়াগড়ি যায় আনন্দে অথির ॥ ২০৭ ॥

*sumeru-parbata yena dīghala śarīra |*
*bhūme gaṛāgaṛi yāẏa ānande athira || 207 ||*

*Word for word:* sumeru-parvata yena — like Mount Sumeru; dighala sharira — the long body; bhume gadagadi yaya — rolls on the ground; anande athira — restless with bliss

**207.** His long body, like Mount Sumeru,
rolls on the ground, unable to contain the bliss.

গৌরাঙ্গ-কিরণে জগন্নাথ হৈলা গোরা ।
ভাবময় হৈল দেহ পরম বিভোরা ॥ ২০৮ ॥

*gaurāṅga-kiraṇe jagannātha hailā gorā |*
*bhābamaẏa haila deha parama bibhorā || 208 ||*

*Word for word:* gauranga-kirane — by Gauranga's radiance; jagannatha haila gora — Jagannatha became golden; bhavamaya haila deha — the body became full of bhava; parama vibhora — utterly rapt

**208.** By Gauranga's radiance Jagannatha became golden,
His body filled with bhava, utterly rapt.

গৌরময় বলরাম আর পাণ্ডাগণ ।
ভাবময় দেহ সভার হইল তখন ॥ ২০৯ ॥

*gauramaẏa balarāma āra pāṇḍāgaṇa |*
*bhābamaẏa deha sabhāra haila takhana || 209 ||*

*Word for word:* gauramaya balarama — Balarama became golden; ara panda-gana — and the pandas; bhavamaya deha sabhara — the bodies of all full of bhava; haila takhana — became then

**209.** Balarama too became golden, and the pandas;
the bodies of all were filled with bhava.

গৌরাঙ্গ তুলিয়া পাণ্ডা করিল আরতি ।
অচল-ব্রহ্মের কাছে সচল-মূরতি ॥ ২১০ ॥

*gaurāṅga tuliẏā pāṇḍā karila ārati |*
*acala-brahmera kāche sacala-mūrati || 210 ||*

*Word for word:* gauranga tuliya — lifting Gauranga; panda karila arati — a panda performed arati; achala-brahmera kachhe — beside the unmoving Brahman; sachala-murati — the moving form

**210.** They raised Gauranga up, and a panda performed arati:
beside the unmoving Brahman — the moving form.[^45-15]

জগন্নাথ প্রকাশ হইলা ন্যাসিরূপে ।
হেন অপরূপ না দেখিল কারো বাপে ॥ ২১১ ॥

*jagannātha prakāśa hailā nyāsirūpe |*
*hena aparūpa nā dekhila kāro bāpe || 211 ||*

*Word for word:* jagannatha prakasha haila — Jagannatha appeared; nyasi-rupe — in the form of a sannyasi; hena aparupa — such a wonder; na dekhila karo bape — no one's father ever saw (no one ever saw)

**211.** Jagannatha appeared in the form of a sannyasi —
such a wonder no one had ever seen.

তবে চিত্তে সম্বেদন হৈল কথোক্ষণে ।
আপন আশ্রমে গেলা নিজজন-সনে ॥ ২১২ ॥

*tabe citte sambedana haila kathokṣaṇe |*
*āpana āśrame gelā nijajana-sane || 212 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe chitte samvedana haila — then He regained consciousness; kathokshane — after a while; apana ashrame gela — went to His lodging; nijajana-sane — with His own people

**212.** After a while He came to Himself
and returned to His lodging with His own people.

এইমতে জগন্নাথ দেখি' তিনবার ।
দিবারাত্রি না জানয়ে আনন্দ-পাথার ॥ ২১৩ ॥

*eimate jagannātha dekhi' tinabāra |*
*dibārātri nā jānaẏe ānanda-pāthāra || 213 ||*

*Word for word:* eimate — thus; jagannatha dekhi tinabara — seeing Jagannatha three times; divaratri na janaye — knows not day or night; ananda-pathara — an ocean of bliss

**213.** Thus, seeing Jagannatha three times [a day],
He knows neither day nor night — an ocean of bliss.

হেনমতে নিজজন-সনে কথো দিন ।
কৌতুকে গোঙায় প্রভু প্রেম-প্রবীণ ॥ ২১৪ ॥

*henamate nijajana-sane katho dina |*
*kautuke goṅāẏa prabhu prema-prabīṇa || 214 ||*

*Word for word:* henamate — thus; nijajana-sane — with His own people; katho dina — some days; kautuke gongaya prabhu — the Lord joyfully spends; prema-pravina — expert in prema

**214.** Thus the Lord, expert in prema, spends some days
joyfully with His own people.

হেনই সময়ে কথা শুন সাবধানে ।
পুরুষোত্তমে প্রথম-প্রকাশ যেনমনে ॥ ২১৫ ॥

*henai samaẏe kathā śuna sābadhāne |*
*puruṣottame prathama-prakāśa yenamane || 215 ||*

*Word for word:* henai samaye — now; katha shuna savadhane — hear the story carefully; purushottame — at Purushottama; prathama-prakasha yenamate — how He first revealed Himself

**215.** Now hear carefully the story
of how He first revealed Himself at Purushottama.

লোকশিক্ষা করে প্রভু হঞা অকিঞ্চন ।
না বুঝি' মানুষ-জ্ঞান করে মূঢ়জন ॥ ২১৬ ॥
