*lokaśikṣā kare prabhu hañā akiñcana |*
*nā bujhi' mānuṣa-jñāna kare mūṛhajana || 216 ||*

*Word for word:* loka-shiksha kare prabhu — the Lord teaches the people; hanya akinchana — having become destitute; na bujhi — not understanding; manusha-jnana kare mudha-jana — fools think Him a man

**216.** The Lord teaches the people, having become destitute;
not understanding this, fools take Him for a man.

সমুদ্র-ভিতরে টোটা করি' গৌররায় ।
নিজজন-সঙ্গে তাহাঁ নিজগুণ গায় ॥ ২১৭ ॥

*samudra-bhitare ṭoṭā kari' gaurarāẏa |*
*nijajana-saṅge tāhāṁ nijaguṇa gāẏa || 217 ||*

*Word for word:* samudra-bhitare — by the sea; tota kari gauraraya — Gaura Raya made a garden; nijajana-sange — with His own people; tahan nijaguna gaya — there sings His own virtues

**217.** By the sea Gaura Raya made Himself a garden
and there with His own people sings His own virtues.[^45-16]

বিদ্যা-বিমোহিত-চিত্ত সার্বভৌম ।
প্রভুর পরোক্ষে কিছু কহিল বিভ্রম ॥ ২১৮ ॥

*bidyā-bimohita-citta sārbabhauma |*
*prabhura parokṣe kichu kahila bibhrama || 218 ||*

*Word for word:* vidya-vimohita-chitta — his mind deluded by learning; sarvabhauma — Sarvabhauma; prabhura parokshe — behind the Lord's back; kichhu kahila vibhrama — spoke something mistaken

**218.** Sarvabhauma, his mind deluded by learning,
said something mistaken about the Lord behind His back.

ব্রাহ্মণ-সজ্জন যত সম্পূর্ণ সভায় ।
তার মধ্যে কহে দ্বিজ যে ছিল হিয়ায় ॥ ২১৯ ॥

*brāhmaṇa-sajjana yata sampūrṇa sabhāẏa |*
*tāra madhye kahe dbija ye chila hiẏāẏa || 219 ||*

*Word for word:* brahmana-sajjana yata — brahmanas and worthy men; sampurna sabhaya — in a full assembly; tara madhye — among them; kahe dvija ye chhila hiyaya — the brahmana says what was in his heart

**219.** In an assembly full of brahmanas and worthy men,
that brahmana spoke what was in his heart:

মহাবংশে জন্ম ন্যাসী সুপণ্ডিত জন ।
তরুণ-বয়সে নহে সন্ন্যাস-করণ ॥ ২২০ ॥

*mahābaṃśe janma nyāsī supaṇḍita jana |*
*taruṇa-baẏase nahe sannyāsa-karaṇa || 220 ||*

*Word for word:* maha-vamshe janma — born in a great family; nyasi supandita jana — the sannyasi, a fine scholar; taruna-vayase — at a young age; nahe sannyasa-karana — taking sannyasa is not [proper]

**220.** "This sannyasi is of a noble family, a great scholar;
but it is not proper to take sannyasa at a young age.

এ সময়ে অনুচিত সন্ন্যাসের ধর্ম ।
না বুঝিয়া কৈল দ্বিজ এত বড় কর্ম ॥ ২২১ ॥

*e samaẏe anucita sannyāsera dharma |*
*nā bujhiẏā kaila dbija eta baṛa karma || 221 ||*

*Word for word:* e samaye — at this time; anuchita sannyasera dharma — the dharma of sannyasa is improper; na bujhiya — not understanding; kaila dvija eta bada karma — the brahmana did such a deed

**221.** At this time of life the dharma of sannyasa is unfitting;
not understanding this, the brahmana has done such a thing.

পুনরপি সংস্কার করু আপনার ।
বেদান্ত শিখিয়া করু আশ্রম-আচার ॥ ২২২ ॥

*punarapi saṃskāra karu āpanāra |*
*bedānta śikhiẏā karu āśrama-ācāra || 222 ||*

*Word for word:* punarapi samskara karu — let Him again undergo the purificatory rites; apanara — His own; vedanta shikhiya — having learned Vedanta; karu ashrama-achara — let Him keep the rule of an ashrama

**222.** Let Him undergo His purificatory rites again,
learn Vedanta and keep the rule of an ashrama.

সন্ন্যাসীর ধর্ম নহে কীর্তন-নর্তন ।
বেদান্ত আমার ঠাঞি করুক শ্রবণ ॥ ২২৩ ॥

*sannyāsīra dharma nahe kīrtana-nartana |*
*bedānta āmāra ṭhāñi karuka śrabaṇa || 223 ||*

*Word for word:* sannyasira dharma nahe — it is not a sannyasi's dharma; kirtana-nartana — kirtana and dancing; vedanta amara thani — Vedanta from me; karuka shravana — let Him hear

**223.** Kirtana and dancing are not a sannyasi's dharma;
let Him hear Vedanta from me."[^45-17]

জগন্নাথ যতবার করয়ে ভোজন ।
ততবার সন্ন্যাসী সে করয়ে ভক্ষণ ॥ ২২৩+১ ॥

*jagannātha yatabāra karaẏe bhojana |*
*tatabāra sannyāsī se karaẏe bhakṣaṇa || 223+1 ||*

*Word for word:* jagannatha yatabara — as many times as Jagannatha; karaye bhojana — eats; tatabara sannyasi se — so many times that sannyasi; karaye bhakshana — eats

**223+1.** "As many times as Jagannatha eats,
so many times this sannyasi eats too.

যুবাকালে এত ভক্ষণ যে জন করয় ।
তার কাম-নিবৃত্তি কেমন-মতে হয় ॥ ২২৩+২ ॥

*yubākāle eta bhakṣaṇa ye jana karaẏa |*
*tāra kāma-nibṛtti kemana-mate haẏa || 223+2 ||*

*Word for word:* yubakale — in youth; eta bhakshana ye jana karaya — whoever eats so much; tara kama-nivritti — the cessation of his lust; kemana-mate haya — how can it come about

**223+2.** One who eats so much in youth —
how can his lust ever subside?

ঘর মনে পড়ে তেঞি রাধা বলি' কান্দে ।
বিপাকে পড়িলা ন্যাসী সন্ন্যাসের ফান্দে ॥ ২২৩+৩ ॥

*ghara mane paṛe teñi rādhā bali' kānde |*
*bipāke paṛilā nyāsī sannyāsera phānde || 223+3 ||*

*Word for word:* ghara mane pade — he remembers home; tenni radha bali kande — so he weeps crying "Radha!"; vipake padila nyasi — to his misfortune the sannyasi fell; sannyasera phande — into the noose of sannyasa

**223+3.** He remembers home — and weeps, 'Radha!'
To his misfortune the sannyasi has fallen into the noose of sannyasa."

এথা গোরাচাঁদ আছে নিজজন-সঙ্গে ।
কৃষ্ণকথা-আলাপনে প্রেম-পরসঙ্গে ॥ ২২৩+৪ ॥

*ethā gorācāṁda āche nijajana-saṅge |*
*kṛṣṇakathā-ālāpane prema-parasaṅge || 223+4 ||*

*Word for word:* etha gorachanda achhe — meanwhile Gorachand is; nijajana-sange — with His own people; krishna-katha-alapane — in talks about Krishna; prema-parasange — in conversation on prema

**223+4.** Meanwhile Gorachand was with His own people
in talks about Krishna, in conversation on prema.[^45-18]

আচম্বিতে মুচকি হাসিলা গোরা পঁহু ।
অবিরল-ধারে যেন বরিখয়ে মহু ॥ ২২৪ ॥

*ācambite mucaki hāsilā gorā paṁhu |*
*abirala-dhāre yena barikhaẏe mahu || 224 ||*

*Word for word:* achambite — suddenly; muchaki hasila gora panhu — Gora Panhu smiled faintly; avirala-dhare — in unbroken streams; yena barikhaye mahu — as if honey rained down

**224.** Suddenly Gora Panhu smiled faintly —
as if honey had poured down in unbroken streams.

জানিঞা সকল পঁহু চলিলা তথায় ।
সার্বভৌম বসি' যথা বেদান্ত পঢ়ায় ॥ ২২৫ ॥

*jāniñā sakala paṁhu calilā tathāẏa |*
*sārbabhauma basi' yathā bedānta paṛhāẏa || 225 ||*

*Word for word:* janinya sakala — knowing everything; panhu chalila tathaya — the Lord went there; sarvabhauma basi yatha — where Sarvabhauma sits; vedanta padhaya — teaching Vedanta

**225.** Knowing everything, the Lord went there
where Sarvabhauma sits teaching Vedanta.

নিজজন-সনে সেইখানে উপনীত ।
দেখি' ভট্টাচার্য উঠে চমকিত-চিত ॥ ২২৬ ॥

*nijajana-sane seikhāne upanīta |*
*dekhi' bhaṭṭācārya uṭhe camakita-cita || 226 ||*

*Word for word:* nijajana-sane — with His own people; seikhane upanita — arrived there; dekhi bhattacharya uthe — seeing, the Bhattacharya rises; chamakita-chita — in alarm

**226.** He came there with His own people;
seeing Him, the Bhattacharya rose in alarm.

বসিতে আসন দিল সগৌরব-বাণী ।
ঠাকুর মাগয়ে বিধি — কি করিব আমি ॥ ২২৭ ॥

*basite āsana dila sagauraba-bāṇī |*
*ṭhākura māgaẏe bidhi — ki kariba āmi || 227 ||*

*Word for word:* vasite asana dila — offered a seat; sagaurava-vani — with respectful words; thakura magaye vidhi — the Thakura asks for guidance; ki kariba ami — what should I do

**227.** He offered Him a seat with respectful words,
and the Thakura asks him for guidance: "What should I do?

তুমি সার্বভৌম ভট্টাচার্য সব জান ।
অন্তরে পুছিয়ে তোরে কহ ত বিধান ॥ ২২৮ ॥

*tumi sārbabhauma bhaṭṭācārya saba jāna |*
*antare puchiẏe tore kaha ta bidhāna || 228 ||*

*Word for word:* tumi sarvabhauma bhattacharya — you, Sarvabhauma Bhattacharya; saba jana — know everything; antare puchhiye tore — I ask you from My heart; kaha ta vidhana — tell Me the rule

**228.** You, Sarvabhauma Bhattacharya, know everything;
I ask you from My heart — tell Me the rule.

সন্ন্যাস-আশ্রম-ধর্ম না বুঝিয়ে আমি ।
সন্ন্যাস করিল বিধি বিচারহ তুমি ॥ ২২৯ ॥

*sannyāsa-āśrama-dharma nā bujhiẏe āmi |*
*sannyāsa karila bidhi bicāraha tumi || 229 ||*

*Word for word:* sannyasa-ashrama-dharma — the dharma of the sannyasa ashrama; na bujhiye ami — I do not understand; sannyasa karila — [I] took sannyasa; vidhi vicharaha tumi — you judge by the rule

**229.** I do not understand the dharma of the sannyasa ashrama;
I have taken sannyasa — you judge what the law requires.

তুমি সর্বতত্ত্ববেত্তা বেদান্ত বাখান ।
কি বিধান আছে কিছু পঢ়াহ এখন ॥ ২৩০ ॥

*tumi sarbatattbabettā bedānta bākhāna |*
*ki bidhāna āche kichu paṛhāha ekhana || 230 ||*

*Word for word:* tumi sarva-tattva-vetta — you know all truths; vedanta bakhana — you expound Vedanta; ki vidhana achhe — what rule is there; kichhu padhaha ekhana — teach [Me] now

**230.** You know all truths, you expound Vedanta —
what is the rule? Teach Me now.

তরুণ বয়সে নহে সন্ন্যাসের ধর্ম ।
কি বিধান আছে পুনঃ উপবীত-কর্ম ॥ ২৩১ ॥

*taruṇa baẏase nahe sannyāsera dharma |*
*ki bidhāna āche punaḥ upabīta-karma || 231 ||*

*Word for word:* taruna vayase — at a young age; nahe sannyasera dharma — the dharma of sannyasa is not proper; ki vidhana achhe — what is enjoined; punah upavita-karma — the sacred-thread rite again

**231.** At a young age the dharma of sannyasa is not proper:
what is enjoined — to undergo the sacred-thread rite again?

জগন্নাথ-প্রসাদে মত্ত মোরে করাইল ।
কাম শান্তি করিবারে নারি যুবাকালে ॥ ২৩১+১ ॥

*jagannātha-prasāde matta more karāila |*
*kāma śānti karibāre nāri yubākāle || 231+1 ||*

*Word for word:* jagannatha-prasade — Jagannatha's prasada; matta more karaila — has made Me drunk; kama shanti karibare — to quell lust; nari yubakale — I cannot in youth

**231+1.** Jagannatha's prasada has made Me drunk,
and in youth I cannot quell My lust.

ঘর মনে পড়ে তেঞি কান্দি রাধা বলি' ।
কীর্তনের মাঝে তেঞি হইয়ে বিকলি ॥ ২৩১+২ ॥

*ghara mane paṛe teñi kāndi rādhā bali' |*
*kīrtanera mājhe teñi haiẏe bikali || 231+2 ||*

*Word for word:* ghara mane pade — I remember home; tenni kandi radha bali — so I weep crying "Radha!"; kirtanera majhe — in the midst of kirtana; tenni haiye vikali — so I am beside Myself

**231+2.** I remember home — and weep, saying 'Radha!' —
that is why in the midst of kirtana I am beside Myself."[^45-19]

এ বোল শুনিঞা সার্বভৌম ভট্টাচার্য ।
হৃদয় সঙ্কোচ কিছু গুণয়ে আশ্চর্য ॥ ২৩২ ॥

*e bola śuniñā sārbabhauma bhaṭṭācārya |*
*hṛdaẏa saṅkoca kichu guṇaẏe āścarya || 232 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuninya — hearing this; sarvabhauma bhattacharya — Sarvabhauma Bhattacharya; hridaya sankocha kichhu — somewhat abashed at heart; gunaye ashcharya — wonders

**232.** Hearing this, Sarvabhauma Bhattacharya
was abashed at heart and wonders:

এখনি কহিল কথা নিজশিষ্য-সনে ।
এ কথা সকল ন্যাসী জানিল কেমনে ॥ ২৩৩ ॥

*ekhani kahila kathā nijaśiṣya-sane |*
*e kathā sakala nyāsī jānila kemane || 233 ||*

*Word for word:* ekhani kahila katha — just now I said this; nija-shishya-sane — with my disciples; e katha sakala — all this; nyasi janila kemane — how did the sannyasi know

**233.** "Only just now I said this with my disciples —
how did this sannyasi come to know all this?"

মনে অনুমান করি' লজ্জায় পীড়িত ।
কিছু না কহিল হিয়ায় রহিল বিস্মিত ॥ ২৩৪ ॥

*mane anumāna kari' lajjāẏa pīṛita |*
*kichu nā kahila hiẏāẏa rahila bismita || 234 ||*

*Word for word:* mane anumana kari — guessing in his mind; lajjaya pidita — tormented by shame; kichhu na kahila — said nothing; hiyaya rahila vismita — remained amazed at heart

**234.** Guessing [the truth], tormented by shame,
he said nothing and remained in wonder.

তার পর দিনে প্রভু সার্বভৌম-ঘরে ।
নিজজন-সঙ্গে গেলা তাঁরে দেখিবারে ॥ ২৩৫ ॥

*tāra para dine prabhu sārbabhauma-ghare |*
*nijajana-saṅge gelā tāṁre dekhibāre || 235 ||*

*Word for word:* tara para dine — the next day; prabhu sarvabhauma-ghare — the Lord to Sarvabhauma's house; nijajana-sange gela — went with His own people; tanre dekhibare — to see him

**235.** The next day the Lord went with His own people
to Sarvabhauma's house to see him.

বেদান্ত পঢ়ায় সার্বভৌম ঘরে বসি' ।
বেদান্ত-সিদ্ধান্ত প্রভু পুছে হাসি' হাসি' ॥ ২৩৬ ॥

*bedānta paṛhāẏa sārbabhauma ghare basi' |*
*bedānta-siddhānta prabhu puche hāsi' hāsi' || 236 ||*

*Word for word:* vedanta padhaya — teaches Vedanta; sarvabhauma ghare basi — Sarvabhauma, sitting at home; vedanta-siddhanta — about the conclusions of Vedanta; prabhu puchhe hasi hasi — the Lord asks, smiling

**236.** Sarvabhauma, sitting at home, is teaching Vedanta;
the Lord, smiling, asks about the conclusions of Vedanta.

বেদান্ত-নিগূঢ় কথা পুছিল ঠাকুর ।
কৃষ্ণ-পাদাশ্রয়-কথা অমৃত-অঙ্কুর ॥ ২৩৭ ॥

*bedānta-nigūṛha kathā puchila ṭhākura |*
*kṛṣṇa-pādāśraẏa-kathā amṛta-aṅkura || 237 ||*

*Word for word:* vedanta-nigudha katha — about the hidden meaning of Vedanta; puchhila thakura — the Thakura asked; krishna-padashraya-katha — about refuge at Krishna's feet; amrita-ankura — the sprout of nectar

**237.** The Thakura asked about the hidden meaning of Vedanta —
about refuge at the feet of Krishna, the sprout of nectar.[^45-20]

বেদে নরাকৃতি ব্রহ্ম শাস্ত্রে জানাইলে ।
তুমি তাহা নাহি মান আত্মবুদ্ধি-বলে ॥ ২৩৭+১ ॥

*bede narākṛti brahma śāstre jānāile |*
*tumi tāhā nāhi māna ātmabuddhi-bale || 237+1 ||*

*Word for word:* vede — in the Veda; narakriti brahma — Brahman with a human-like form; shastre janaile — the shastras have declared; tumi taha nahi mana — you do not accept it; atma-buddhi-bale — by the force of your own mind

**237+1.** "The Veda declares that Brahman has a form like a man's —
yet you do not accept this, relying on your own mind.

ব্রহ্মার বচন ব্রহ্মসংহিতাতে কহে ।
সচ্চিদানন্দময় সেই মহৈশ্বর্যময়ে ॥ ২৩৭+২ ॥

*brahmāra bacana brahmasaṃhitāte kahe |*
*saccidānandamaẏa sei mahaiśbaryamaẏe || 237+2 ||*

*Word for word:* brahmara vachana — Brahma's word; brahma-samhitate kahe — says in the Brahma-samhita; sach-chid-ananda-maya — full of being, consciousness and bliss; sei mahaishvarya-maye — He, full of supreme majesty

**237+2.** Brahma's word in the Brahma-samhita says:
He is eternal being, consciousness and bliss, full of supreme majesty;

রসময় দেহ তাঁর শ্যাম কলেবর ।
আর অবতার অংশ কৃষ্ণ পূর্ণবর ॥ ২৩৭+৩ ॥

*rasamaẏa deha tāṁra śyāma kalebara |*
*āra abatāra aṃśa kṛṣṇa pūrṇabara || 237+3 ||*

*Word for word:* rasamaya deha tanra — His body made of rasa; shyama kalebara — a dark form; ara avatara amsha — the other avataras are portions; krishna purnavara — Krishna the complete, the highest

**237+3.** His body is made of rasa, His form is dark;
the other avataras are portions — Krishna is the complete, the highest.

ভাগবতে এই কথা ব্যাস জানাইল ।
তুমি তাহা নষ্ট করি' আর মত বল ॥ ২৩৭+৪ ॥

*bhāgabate ei kathā byāsa jānāila |*
*tumi tāhā naṣṭa kari' āra mata bala || 237+4 ||*

*Word for word:* bhagavate — in the Bhagavata; ei katha vyasa janaila — Vyasa declared this; tumi taha nashta kari — you, rejecting it; ara mata bala — teach another doctrine

**237+4.** Vyasa declared this in the Bhagavata —
yet you reject it and teach another doctrine.

রাধা পূর্ণতত্ত্ববস্তু বরাহসংহিতা কহে ।
আর সব প্রকৃতি তাঁর নখজ্যোতি হয়ে ॥ ২৩৭+৫ ॥

*rādhā pūrṇatattbabastu barāhasaṃhitā kahe |*
*āra saba prakṛti tāṁra nakhajyoti haẏe || 237+5 ||*

*Word for word:* radha purna-tattva-vastu — Radha is the complete truth; varaha-samhita kahe — the Varaha-samhita says; ara saba prakriti — all other prakritis; tanra nakha-jyoti haye — are the radiance of Her nails

**237+5.** The Varaha-samhita says: Radha is the complete truth;
all other prakritis are the radiance of Her toenails.

গৌতমীয়তন্ত্র সনৎকুমারসংহিতা ।
রাধাতত্ত্ব তাহাতেই আছে বিরচিতা ॥ ২৩৭+৬ ॥

*gautamīẏatantra sanatkumārasaṃhitā |*
*rādhātattba tāhātei āche biracitā || 237+6 ||*

*Word for word:* gautamiya-tantra — the Gautamiya-tantra; sanatkumara-samhita — the Sanatkumara-samhita; radha-tattva — the truth of Radha; tahatei achhe virachita — is set forth in them

**237+6.** In the Gautamiya-tantra and the Sanatkumara-samhita
the truth of Radha is set forth.

বেদ-অর্থ শাস্ত্রে লেখে ব্যাস মুনিবর ।
ব্যাসনিন্দা করি' তুমি পাও কিবা ফল ॥ ২৩৭+৭ ॥

*beda-artha śāstre lekhe byāsa munibara |*
*byāsanindā kari' tumi pāo kibā phala || 237+7 ||*

*Word for word:* veda-artha shastre lekhe — wrote the meaning of the Veda in the shastras; vyasa munivara — the sage Vyasa; vyasa-ninda kari — reviling Vyasa; tumi pao kiba phala — what fruit do you get

**237+7.** The sage Vyasa wrote down the meaning of the Veda in the shastras:
what do you gain by reviling Vyasa?

বৃন্দাবন ধাম কৃষ্ণস্থান চিন্তামণি ।
বিহার করেন কৃষ্ণ সঙ্গেতে রমণী ॥ ২৩৭+৮ ॥

*bṛndābana dhāma kṛṣṇasthāna cintāmaṇi |*
*bihāra karena kṛṣṇa saṅgete ramaṇī || 237+8 ||*

*Word for word:* vrindavana dhama — the abode of Vrindavana; krishna-sthana chintamani — Krishna's land of chintamani; vihara karena krishna — Krishna sports; sangete ramani — with His beloveds

**237+8.** The abode of Vrindavana is Krishna's land of chintamani;
there Krishna sports with His beloveds.

রমণীর শিরোমণি রাধা মহাদেবী ।
মহাতত্ত্ব দেব কৃষ্ণ বেদে অনুভবি ॥ ২৩৭+৯ ॥

*ramaṇīra śiromaṇi rādhā mahādebī |*
*mahātattba deba kṛṣṇa bede anubhabi || 237+9 ||*

*Word for word:* ramanira shiromani — the crown of the beloveds; radha mahadevi — Radha, the great goddess; maha-tattva deva krishna — the great truth, Lord Krishna; vede anubhavi — realized in the Vedas

**237+9.** The crown of the beloveds is Radha, the great goddess;
the great truth is Lord Krishna, realized in the Vedas.

দোঁহার কীর্তন গায় যত গোপীগণ ।
সে কীর্তন নিন্দা কর তুমি সে অধম ॥ ২৩৭+১০ ॥

*doṁhāra kīrtana gāẏa yata gopīgaṇa |*
*se kīrtana nindā kara tumi se adhama || 237+10 ||*

*Word for word:* donhara kirtana — the kirtana of the two; gaya yata gopi-gana — all the gopis sing; se kirtana ninda kara — you revile that kirtana; tumi se adhama — you are base

**237+10.** The kirtana of the two is sung by all the gopis —
and you revile that kirtana: you are base.

কীর্তন-মহিমা-কথা ভাগবতে কয় ।
ব্রহ্মহত্যা আদি পাপ সব নষ্ট হয় ॥ ২৩৭+১১ ॥

*kīrtana-mahimā-kathā bhāgabate kaẏa |*
*brahmahatyā ādi pāpa saba naṣṭa haẏa || 237+11 ||*

*Word for word:* kirtana-mahima-katha — of the glory of kirtana; bhagavate kaya — the Bhagavata speaks; brahma-hatya adi papa — the killing of a brahmana and other sins; saba nashta haya — all are destroyed

**237+11.** The Bhagavata speaks of the glory of kirtana:
the killing of a brahmana and other sins — all are destroyed.

তেনমতে নাম বিনাশয় পাপগিরি ।
পাছে কৃষ্ণ পায় চিন্তামণি নাম ধরি' ॥ ২৩৭+১২ ॥

*tenamate nāma bināśaẏa pāpagiri |*
*pāche kṛṣṇa pāẏa cintāmaṇi nāma dhari' || 237+12 ||*

*Word for word:* tenamate — likewise; nama vinashaya papagiri — the name destroys mountains of sin; pachhe krishna paya — afterwards [one] attains Krishna; chintamani nama dhari — [the name] bearing the name chintamani

**237+12.** So the name destroys mountains of sin,
and then [one] attains Krishna: the name is called chintamani.

প্রসাদ পাইলে কোটি কোটি পাপ নাশে ।
তুমি কহ লোভ মোহ কামের প্রকাশে ॥ ২৩৭+১৩ ॥

*prasāda pāile koṭi koṭi pāpa nāśe |*
*tumi kaha lobha moha kāmera prakāśe || 237+13 ||*

*Word for word:* prasada paile — on receiving prasada; koti koti papa nashe — millions of sins are destroyed; tumi kaha — you say; lobha moha kamera prakashe — [it is] a display of greed, delusion and lust

**237+13.** Taste prasada, and millions of sins are destroyed —
yet you call it the display of greed, delusion and lust!

বৈষ্ণব-মহিমা সব শাস্ত্রের প্রমাণে ।
তুমি শাস্ত্র নাহি মান কোন্ শাস্ত্রজ্ঞানে ॥ ২৩৭+১৪ ॥

*baiṣṇaba-mahimā saba śāstrera pramāṇe |*
*tumi śāstra nāhi māna kon śāstrajñāne || 237+14 ||*

*Word for word:* vaishnava-mahima — the glory of the Vaishnavas; saba shastrera pramane — on the evidence of all the shastras; tumi shastra nahi mana — you do not accept the shastras; kon shastra-jnane — with what knowledge of shastra

**237+14.** The glory of the Vaishnavas is proved by all the shastras;
you do not accept the shastras — what knowledge of the shastras do you have?"[^45-21]

শুনি' সার্বভৌম হৈলা বিস্মিত অন্তর ।
বুঝিল মনুষ্য নহে শচীর কোঙর ॥ ২৩৮ ॥

*śuni' sārbabhauma hailā bismita antara |*
*bujhila manuṣya nahe śacīra koṅara || 238 ||*

*Word for word:* shuni — hearing; sarvabhauma haila vismita antara — Sarvabhauma was amazed at heart; bujhila — understood; manushya nahe shachira kongara — the son of Shachi is not a man

**238.** Hearing this, Sarvabhauma was amazed at heart:
he understood that the son of Shachi is not a man.

লজ্জায় পীড়িত হৈলা হৃদয়ে তরাস ।
এতকাল নাহি শুনি এমত নির্যাস ॥ ২৩৯ ॥

*lajjāẏa pīṛita hailā hṛdaẏe tarāsa |*
*etakāla nāhi śuni emata niryāsa || 239 ||*

*Word for word:* lajjaya pidita haila — tormented by shame; hridaye tarasa — fear in his heart; etakala nahi shuni — so long I have not heard; emata niryasa — such an essence

**239.** Shame tormented him, fear was in his heart:
"In all these years I have never heard such an essence!

পড়িল শুনিল যত এতকাল ধরি' ।
পড়াইল শিষ্যগণে অহঙ্কার করি' ॥ ২৪০ ॥

*paṛila śunila yata etakāla dhari' |*
*paṛāila śiṣyagaṇe ahaṅkāra kari' || 240 ||*

*Word for word:* padila shunila yata — all I read and heard; etakala dhari — through so many years; padaila shishya-gane — I taught the disciples; ahankara kari — with pride

**240.** All that I have read and heard through so many years
I have taught my disciples with pride.

এখনে শুনিল এ বেদান্ত-সিদ্ধান্ত ।
এই মহাপ্রভু সেই সরস্বতী-কান্ত ॥ ২৪১ ॥

*ekhane śunila e bedānta-siddhānta |*
*ei mahāprabhu sei sarasbatī-kānta || 241 ||*

*Word for word:* ekhane shunila — now I have heard; e vedanta-siddhanta — this conclusion of Vedanta; ei mahaprabhu — this Mahaprabhu; sei sarasvati-kanta — is that Lord of Sarasvati

**241.** And now I have heard this conclusion of Vedanta:
this Mahaprabhu is the Lord of Sarasvati Himself."

এত অনুমানি' সার্বভৌম দ্বিজরাজ ।
করজোড়ে স্তুতি করে দেখিয়া সে কাজ ॥ ২৪২ ॥

*eta anumāni' sārbabhauma dbijarāja |*
*karajoṛe stuti kare dekhiẏā se kāja || 242 ||*

*Word for word:* eta anumani — concluding thus; sarvabhauma dvijaraja — Sarvabhauma, king of brahmanas; karajode stuti kare — with joined palms offers praises; dekhiya se kaja — seeing this

**242.** Concluding thus, Sarvabhauma, king of brahmanas,
with joined palms offers praises, seeing this.

হেনই সময়ে প্রভু ষড়ভুজ-শরীর ।
দেখি' সার্বভৌম হৈলা আনন্দে অস্থির ॥ ২৪৩ ॥

*henai samaẏe prabhu ṣaṛabhuja-śarīra |*
*dekhi' sārbabhauma hailā ānande asthira || 243 ||*

*Word for word:* henai samaye — at that very moment; prabhu shadbhuja-sharira — the Lord, a six-armed form; dekhi — seeing; sarvabhauma haila anande asthira — Sarvabhauma lost composure in bliss

**243.** At that very moment the Lord [showed] a six-armed form;
seeing it, Sarvabhauma lost all composure in bliss.

ঊর্ধ্ব দুই হাথে ধরে ধনু আর শর ।
মধ্য দুই হাথে ধরে মুরলী অধর ॥ ২৪৪ ॥

*ūrdhba dui hāthe dhare dhanu āra śara |*
*madhya dui hāthe dhare muralī adhara || 244 ||*

*Word for word:* urdhva dui hathe — in the upper two hands; dhare dhanu ara shara — holds bow and arrow; madhya dui hathe — in the middle two hands; dhare murali adhara — holds the flute at the lips

**244.** In the upper two hands He holds bow and arrow,
in the middle two the flute at His lips,

নম্র দুই হাথে ধরে দণ্ড কমণ্ডলু ।
দেখি' সার্বভৌম হৈলা আনন্দে বিহ্বল ॥ ২৪৫ ॥

*namra dui hāthe dhare daṇḍa kamaṇḍalu |*
*dekhi' sārbabhauma hailā ānande bihbala || 245 ||*

*Word for word:* namra dui hathe — in the lower two hands; dhare danda kamandalu — holds staff and kamandalu; dekhi — seeing; sarvabhauma haila anande vihvala — Sarvabhauma was beside himself with bliss

**245.** in the lower two the staff and the kamandalu.
Seeing this, Sarvabhauma was beside himself with bliss.[^45-22]

চরণে পড়িয়া কান্দে বিনয় বিস্তর ।
স্তুতি করে সার্বভৌম গদগদ-স্বর ॥ ২৪৬ ॥

*caraṇe paṛiẏā kānde binaẏa bistara |*
*stuti kare sārbabhauma gadagada-sbara || 246 ||*

*Word for word:* charane padiya kande — fallen at the feet, weeps; vinaya vistara — in great humility; stuti kare sarvabhauma — Sarvabhauma offers praises; gadagada-svara — in a choked voice

**246.** Fallen at His feet, he weeps in great humility;
Sarvabhauma offers praises in a choked voice.

সগদগদ-স্বরে পঢ়ে সহস্রেক স্তব ।
চৈতন্যসহস্র নাম জানে লোক সব ॥ ২৪৭ ॥

*sagadagada-sbare paṛhe sahasreka staba |*
*caitanyasahasra nāma jāne loka saba || 247 ||*

*Word for word:* sagadgada-svare — in a choked voice; padhe sahasreka stava — recites a thousand praises; chaitanya-sahasra nama — "the Thousand Names of Chaitanya"; jane loka saba — all people know

**247.** In a choked voice he recites a thousand praises —
people know them as the "Thousand Names of Chaitanya."[^45-23]

জয় রঘুবীর যদুবীর মহাশয় ।
জয় দ্বিজবীর গৌরসিংহ সর্বাশ্রয় ॥ ২৪৭+১ ॥

*jaẏa raghubīra yadubīra mahāśaẏa |*
*jaẏa dbijabīra gaurasiṃha sarbāśraẏa || 247+1 ||*

*Word for word:* jaya raghuvira — glory to Raghuvira; yaduvira mahashaya — to Yaduvira, the Great One; jaya dvijavira — glory to the hero among brahmanas; gaura-simha sarvashraya — the Lion Gaura, refuge of all

**247+1.** "Glory to Raghuvira, Yaduvira, the Great One!
Glory to the hero among brahmanas, the Lion Gaura, the refuge of all!

বিদ্যামদে মত্ত হৈয়া তোমা নিন্দা কৈনু ।
তোমার অভয় পদে মুঞি বিকাইনু ॥ ২৪৭+২ ॥

*bidyāmade matta haiẏā tomā nindā kainu |*
*tomāra abhaẏa pade muñi bikāinu || 247+2 ||*

*Word for word:* vidya-made matta haiya — drunk with the pride of learning; toma ninda kainu — I reviled You; tomara abhaya pade — to Your fearless feet; muni bikainu — I have sold myself

**247+2.** Drunk with the pride of learning I reviled You —
now I have sold myself to Your feet, which grant fearlessness.

অপরাধ ক্ষমা কর জয় গৌরহরি ।
পরম দয়ালু তুমি সভার উপরি ॥ ২৪৭+৩ ॥

*aparādha kṣamā kara jaẏa gaurahari |*
*parama daẏālu tumi sabhāra upari || 247+3 ||*

*Word for word:* aparadha kshama kara — forgive the offence; jaya gaurahari — glory to Gaurahari; parama dayalu tumi — You are supremely merciful; sabhara upari — to all

**247+3.** Forgive my offence! Glory to Gaurahari!
You are supremely merciful to all."

সার্বভৌমে কৃপা কৈল গৌর মহাসিংহ ।
আনন্দ বাড়িল সব ভক্ত-মহাভৃঙ্গ ॥ ২৪৭+৪ ॥

*sārbabhaume kṛpā kaila gaura mahāsiṃha |*
*ānanda bāṛila saba bhakta-mahābhṛṅga || 247+4 ||*

*Word for word:* sarvabhaume kripa kaila — showed mercy to Sarvabhauma; gaura mahasimha — Gaura, the great lion; ananda badila — bliss grew; saba bhakta-mahabhringa — in all the devotees, great bees

**247+4.** Gaura, the great lion, showed mercy to Sarvabhauma;
the bliss of all the devotees grew — great bees.[^45-24]

বিহ্বল হইয়া পড়ে পাদাম্বুজ-পাশ ।
কহয়ে লোচন সার্বভৌমের প্রকাশ ॥ ২৪৮ ॥

*bihbala haiẏā paṛe pādāmbuja-pāśa |*
*kahaẏe locana sārbabhaumera prakāśa || 248 ||*

*Word for word:* vihvala haiya — rapt; pade padambuja-pasha — falls at the lotus feet; kahaye lochana — Lochana tells; sarvabhaumera prakasha — of the revelation to Sarvabhauma

**248.** Rapt, he falls at the lotus feet.
Lochana tells how [the Lord] revealed Himself to Sarvabhauma.

এইমতে আছে প্রভু আনন্দ-কৌতুকে ।
আনন্দে দেখয়ে নীলাচলবাসী লোকে ॥ ২৪৯ ॥

*eimate āche prabhu ānanda-kautuke |*
*ānande dekhaẏe nīlācalabāsī loke || 249 ||*

*Word for word:* eimate achhe prabhu — thus the Lord stays; ananda-kautuke — in bliss and delight; anande dekhaye — joyfully behold; nilachala-basi loke — the people of Nilachala

**249.** Thus the Lord stays in bliss and delight,
and the people of Nilachala behold Him with joy.

আছিল-অধিক জগন্নাথের প্রকাশ ।
সভার হৃদয়ে সুখ পরশে আকাশ ॥ ২৫০ ॥

*āchila-adhika jagannāthera prakāśa |*
*sabhāra hṛdaẏe sukha paraśe ākāśa || 250 ||*

*Word for word:* achhila-adhika — more than before; jagannathera prakasha — the manifestation of Jagannatha; sabhara hridaye sukha — the happiness in everyone's heart; parashe akasha — touches the sky

**250.** The glory of Jagannatha shone forth more than before;
in everyone's heart happiness touches the sky.

চৈতন্যচরিত-কথা কে কহিতে জানে ।
সম্বরিতে নারি কিছু কহিয়ে বদনে ॥ ২৫১ ॥

*caitanyacarita-kathā ke kahite jāne |*
*sambarite nāri kichu kahiẏe badane || 251 ||*

*Word for word:* chaitanya-charita-katha — the story of Chaitanya's deeds; ke kahite jane — who knows how to tell; sambarite nari — I cannot hold back; kichhu kahiye badane — I tell a little with my lips

**251.** Who knows how to tell the story of Chaitanya?
I cannot hold back — I tell a little with my lips.

শ্রীমুরারিগুপ্ত বেজা ধন্য তিনলোকে ।
পণ্ডিত শ্রীদামোদর পুছিল তাহাকে ॥ ২৫২ ॥

*śrīmurārigupta bejā dhanya tinaloke |*
*paṇḍita śrīdāmodara puchila tāhāke || 252 ||*

*Word for word:* shri-murari-gupta beja — Sri Murari Gupta the vaidya; dhanya tina-loke — blessed in the three worlds; pandita shri-damodara — Pandita Sri Damodara; puchhila tahake — asked him

**252.** Sri Murari Gupta the vaidya, blessed in the three worlds —
Pandita Sri Damodara asked him;

কহিল মুরারিগুপ্ত শ্লোক-প্রবন্ধে ।
যে কিছু শুনিল সেই দোঁহার প্রসাদে ॥ ২৫৩ ॥

*kahila murārigupta śloka-prabandhe |*
*ye kichu śunila sei doṁhāra prasāde || 253 ||*

*Word for word:* kahila murari-gupta — Murari Gupta told; shloka-prabandhe — in a composition of verses; ye kichhu shunila — whatever I heard; sei donhara prasade — is by the grace of both

**253.** Murari Gupta told it in verses —
what I have heard is by the grace of them both.[^45-25]

শুনিঞা মাধুরী-লোভে চিত্ত উতরোলে ।
নিজদোষ না দেখিয়া মন ভোর ভেলে ॥ ২৫৪ ॥

*śuniñā mādhurī-lobhe citta utarole |*
*nijadoṣa nā dekhiẏā mana bhora bhele || 254 ||*

*Word for word:* shuninya — hearing; madhuri-lobhe — in greed for the sweetness; chitta utarole — the heart was stirred; nija-dosha na dekhiya — not seeing my faults; mana bhora bhele — the mind was enraptured

**254.** Hearing it, my heart was stirred with longing for its sweetness,
and, not seeing my own faults, my mind was enraptured.

যে কিছু কহিল নিজবুদ্ধি-অনুরূপ ।
পাঁচালী-প্রবন্ধে কহোঁ মো ছার মুরুখ ॥ ২৫৫ ॥

*ye kichu kahila nijabuddhi-anurūpa |*
*pāṁcālī-prabandhe kahoṁ mo chāra murukha || 255 ||*

*Word for word:* ye kichhu kahila — whatever I told; nija-buddhi-anurupa — according to my own understanding; panchali-prabandhe kahon — I tell in a panchali composition; mo chhara murukha — I, a wretched fool

**255.** What I have told according to my own understanding
I, a wretched fool, tell in a sung panchali.

সূত্রখণ্ড, আদিখণ্ড, মধ্যখণ্ড সায় ।
শেষখণ্ড আছে পুনঃ কহিব কথায় ॥ ২৫৬ ॥

*sūtrakhaṇḍa, ādikhaṇḍa, madhyakhaṇḍa sāẏa |*
*śeṣakhaṇḍa āche punaḥ kahiba kathāẏa || 256 ||*

*Word for word:* sutrakhanda, adikhanda, madhyakhanda saya — the Sutra-, Adi- and Madhya-khanda are ended; sheshakhanda achhe punah — the Shesha-khanda remains; kahiba kathaya — I shall tell it in the story

**256.** The Sutra-khanda, Adi-khanda and Madhya-khanda are ended;
the Shesha-khanda remains — I shall tell it in the story.

চৈতন্যচরিত্র-কথা চৈতন্য-প্রকাশ ।
মধ্যখণ্ড সায় কহে এ লোচনদাস ॥ ২৫৭ ॥

*caitanyacaritra-kathā caitanya-prakāśa |*
*madhyakhaṇḍa sāẏa kahe e locanadāsa || 257 ||*

*Word for word:* chaitanya-charitra-katha — the story of Chaitanya's deeds; chaitanya-prakasha — the manifestation of Chaitanya; madhyakhanda saya — the Madhya-khanda is ended; kahe e lochanadasa — says this Lochana Dasa

**257.** The story of Chaitanya's deeds is the manifestation of Chaitanya.
"The Madhya-khanda is ended," says this Lochana Dasa.

*Thus ends the Madhya-khanda of the Sri Chaitanya-mangala, composed by Sri Lochana Dasa Thakura.*[^45-26]

[^45-1]: The name of the raga is illegible in all the editions. The 1983 edition begins new numbering here (१).
[^45-2]: Vv. 113–146 — cf. Murari 3.10. Kapoteshvara (the Kapota-linga) is a shrine of Shiva on the way from Bhubaneshvara to Puri; the Bhargavi is a river near Puri.
[^45-3]: As in Murari (3.10): above the temple Krishna appears to the Lord as a boy with a flute; His companions do not see Him.
[^45-4]: Cf. Murari 3.10.17–18: Jagannatha mercifully shows the Lord His hand.
[^45-5]: Vv. 148+1 — 148+2 are found only in the 1983 edition; the 1903 edition gives them only in a footnote, as an additional reading of one manuscript. Cf. the Chaitanya-charitamrita (Madhya 6): Sarvabhauma greets the Lord with "namo narayanaya," and the Lord blesses him: "May your mind be fixed on Krishna." The 1983 edition reads v. 147: "Overwhelmed with prema, with an eager heart, the Lord came to the house of Vasudeva Sarvabhauma."
[^45-6]: V. 153+1 is found only in the 1983 edition; the 1903 edition gives it only in a footnote, as an additional reading of two manuscripts.
[^45-7]: In Murari (3.11) it is Sarvabhauma's younger brother who goes with the Lord to the temple; one of the manuscripts of the 1903 edition also reads "younger brother." According to the Chaitanya-charitamrita (Madhya 6), Sarvabhauma himself found the Lord unconscious in the temple and brought Him to his house.
[^45-8]: The Garuda pillar stands in the Nata-mandira (the dancing hall) facing Jagannatha; according to tradition, the Lord always beheld Jagannatha standing behind it.
[^45-9]: Vv. 168+1 — 168+4 are found only in the 1983 edition and in the 1903 edition (in the main text, in brackets); Bhaktisiddhanta's edition does not have them. The other biographies do not tell this: according to the Chaitanya-charitamrita (Madhya 6), the Lord rushed to embrace Jagannatha and fell unconscious.
[^45-10]: So too in Murari (3.11) and the Chaitanya-charitamrita (Madhya 6): the unconscious Lord was carried to Sarvabhauma's house.
[^45-11]: Sarasvati is the goddess of learning and speech; the Lord is the Master of all knowledge (en/17, note 1). The Lord evades questions about Himself, concealing who He is.
[^45-12]: On the vow of Katyayani (Parvati), by which Vishnu's mahaprasada goes to all — see the Sutra-khanda (en/04, vv. 232–272).
[^45-13]: A hyperbole glorifying mahaprasada: nothing can defile its purity. On the glory of mahaprasada cf. Murari 3.11.
[^45-14]: Vv. 204+1 — 204+2 are found only in the 1983 edition and in the 1903 edition; Bhaktisiddhanta's edition does not have them.
[^45-15]: "The unmoving Brahman" is Jagannatha, Daru-brahma (the Supreme in a form of wood), not the impersonal Brahman; Gauranga is the same Jagannatha, but moving. Balarama is Baladeva, Jagannatha's elder brother on the altar; the pandas are the temple priests.
[^45-16]: That is, Krishna's virtues: He Himself is Krishna. The garden (tota) by the sea is apparently the later Tota-Gopinatha.
[^45-17]: Sarvabhauma Bhattacharya, the greatest master of logic and Vedanta of his time, then held the doctrine of advaita (mayavada): for him sannyasa was renunciation for the study of Vedanta, and kirtana and dancing were unworthy of a sannyasi. Lochana Dasa plainly calls this the error of a mind "deluded by learning" (v. 218). Cf. Murari 3.12 (Sarvabhauma wants to perform the sacred-thread rite on the Lord anew and teach Him Vedanta) and the Chaitanya-charitamrita (Madhya 6). Sarvabhauma's conversion from dry knowledge to bhakti is the heart of this lila.
[^45-18]: Vv. 223+1 — 223+4 are found only in the 1983 edition and in the 1903 edition; Bhaktisiddhanta's edition does not have them. This is the slander of the deluded Sarvabhauma, a worldly reading of what is beyond the world: the Lord, Krishna Himself in the mood of Radha, weeps in separation from Krishna; the taking of mahaprasada is not eating for the body. Later Sarvabhauma repents (v. 247+2).
[^45-19]: Vv. 231+1 — 231+2 are found only in the 1983 edition; the 1903 edition gives them only in a footnote, as an additional reading of one manuscript. The Lord ironically repeats Sarvabhauma's words, showing that He knows them.
[^45-20]: As in Murari (3.12): the true, "hidden" meaning of Vedanta is refuge at the feet of Krishna. According to the Chaitanya-charitamrita (Madhya 6), the Lord, after listening silently for seven days to Sarvabhauma's exposition, explained the Vedanta-sutra in its direct sense, rejecting the impersonal interpretation, and revealed the meaning of the atmarama verse.
[^45-21]: Vv. 237+1 — 237+14 are found only in the 1983 edition; the 1903 edition gives them only in a footnote, as an additional reading of one manuscript. Their content agrees with Gaudiya Vaishnava teaching, but they are apparently late: according to the Chaitanya-charitamrita (Madhya 9), the Lord found the Brahma-samhita later, on His pilgrimage in the South. "The name is chintamani" — cf. the Padma Purana: "The name of Krishna is chintamani, Krishna Himself." Chintamani is the wish-fulfilling gem.
[^45-22]: The bow and arrow are Rama's, the flute Krishna's, the staff and kamandalu those of Gaura the sannyasi. Lochana Dasa has described the six-armed form before (en/28, v. 101). According to the Chaitanya-charitamrita (Madhya 6), the Lord showed Sarvabhauma first a four-armed form and then the two-armed form of Krishna with the flute; the six-armed form shown to Sarvabhauma is honoured by tradition.
[^45-23]: A hundred verses in praise of the Lord (the Chaitanya-shataka) are ascribed to Sarvabhauma; two of them are quoted in the Chaitanya-charitamrita (Madhya 6.254–255; cf. Murari 3.12.17–18).
[^45-24]: Vv. 247+1 — 247+4 are found only in the 1983 edition; the 1903 edition gives them only in a footnote, as an additional reading of one manuscript.
[^45-25]: Lochana Dasa names his source: the Sanskrit poem of Murari Gupta, framed as Murari's narration to Damodara Pandita.
[^45-26]: In the 1983 edition chapter 16 and the Madhya-khanda end here.

# Shesha-khanda, part 1 (portion 46)

*The beginning of the Shesha-khanda: the Lord sets out for the South; the brahmanas Kurma and Vasudeva at Kurma-kshetra; at Jiyada-Nrisimha the Lord tells the tale of the cowherd Punda who wounded the Boar, of the Deity rising from the earth as milk was poured, and of the merchant Jiyada, after whose name Nrisimha is called; the meeting with Ramananda Raya at Kanchi: the Lord appears to him in meditation and reveals His form of Krishna*

## The Lord's Journey to the South

> *Summary by Srila Bhaktisiddhanta Sarasvati.* Sriman Mahaprabhu, after staying some time in Puri in the bliss of kirtana together with Sarvabhauma, went to the southern lands to see Setubandha. From there, having shown mercy at Kurma-kshetra to a certain brahmana named Vasudeva and having instructed him that the dharma of the Kali age is the holy name of Sri Hari alone, He arrived at Jiyada-Nrisimha. Here, in the course of the narrative, the author relates the ancient history of Jiyada-Nrisimha.
>
> From Jiyada-Nrisimha Sriman Mahaprabhu came to Kanchi-nagara, to Ramananda, and, having shown him the form of Rasaraja and Mahabhava[^46-1], went by way of the Godavari to Panchavati; there, absorbed in prema, He saw all the places where Ramachandra had performed His various lilas during His exile in the forest, and came to Sri Ranganatha on the bank of the Kaveri. There He showed mercy to Trimalla Bhatta and spent the period of chaturmasya in his house. After that He met Paramananda Puri, the disciple of Madhavendra Puri-pada. Remembering the prophecy about the descent of Sriman Mahaprabhu [that he had heard] from the lips of Madhavendra Puri-pada, Paramananda Puri understood that the Lord was Bhagavan Himself and offered Him many hymns and prayers.

জয় নরহরি-গদাধর-প্রাণনাথ ।
কৃপা করি' কর প্রভু শুভ দৃষ্টিপাত ॥ ১ ॥

*jaẏa narahari-gadādhara-prāṇanātha |*
*kṛpā kari' kara prabhu śubha dṛṣṭipāta || 1 ||*

*Word for word:* jaya — glory; narahari-gadadhara-prananatha — Lord of the life of Narahari and Gadadhara; kripa kari — showing mercy; kara prabhu — cast, O Lord; shubha drishtipata — an auspicious glance

**1.** Glory to You, Lord of the life of Narahari and Gadadhara!
Be merciful, O Lord — cast on us Your auspicious glance[^46-2].

শেষখণ্ড-কথা কহি অমৃতের সার ।
শুনিতে বাঢ়য়ে সুখসাগর-পাথার ॥ ২ ॥

*śeṣakhaṇḍa-kathā kahi amṛtera sāra |*
*śunite bāṛhaẏe sukhasāgara-pāthāra || 2 ||*

*Word for word:* sheshakhanda-katha kahi — I tell the story of the Shesha-khanda; amritera sara — the essence of nectar; shunite — in hearing; badhaye — grows; sukhasagara-pathara — a shoreless ocean of happiness

**2.** I shall tell the story of the Shesha-khanda — the essence of nectar:
in one who hears it a shoreless ocean of happiness grows.

সার্বভৌম-ভট্টাচার্য যে করিল স্তুতি ।
কতোদিন বঞ্চিল কীর্তনে দিবারাতি ॥ ৩ ॥

*sārbabhauma-bhaṭṭācārya ye karila stuti |*
*katodina bañcila kīrtane dibārāti || 3 ||*

*Word for word:* sarvabhauma-bhattacharya — Sarvabhauma Bhattacharya; ye karila stuti — who offered praise; katodina — some days; vanchila — spent; kirtane — in kirtana; divarati — day and night

**3.** Sarvabhauma Bhattacharya offered praises [to the Lord],
and for some days [the Lord] spent day and night in kirtana.

সেতুবন্ধ দেখিবারে চলিলা ঠাকুর ।
কূর্মনামে বিপ্র দেখে কূর্মনামে পুর ॥ ৪ ॥

*setubandha dekhibāre calilā ṭhākura |*
*kūrmanāme bipra dekhe kūrmanāme pura || 4 ||*

*Word for word:* setubandha dekhibare — to see Setubandha; chalila thakura — the Thakura set out; kurma-name vipra dekhe — sees a brahmana named Kurma; kurma-name pura — [in] a town named Kurma

**4.** To see Setubandha the Thakura set out [on His way];
in a town called Kurma He sees a brahmana named Kurma[^46-3].

বাসুদেব-নামে বিপ্র আছে সেই গ্রামে ।
দুইজনা-সঙ্গে দেখা হৈল এক-ঠামে ॥ ৫ ॥

*bāsudeba-nāme bipra āche sei grāme |*
*duijanā-saṅge dekhā haila eka-ṭhāme || 5 ||*

*Word for word:* vasudeva-name vipra — a brahmana named Vasudeva; achhe sei grame — lives in that village; duijana-sange — with both; dekha haila eka-thame — the meeting took place in one spot

**5.** In the same village lives a brahmana named Vasudeva —
He met them both in one place.

প্রভু-দরশনে তারা হইল নির্মল ।
নিরীখয়ে গোরাদেহ প্রেমায় বিহ্বল ॥ ৬ ॥

*prabhu-daraśane tārā haila nirmala |*
*nirīkhaẏe gorādeha premāẏa bihbala || 6 ||*

*Word for word:* prabhu-darashane — by the sight of the Lord; tara haila nirmala — they became pure; nirikhaye — gaze; gora-deha — [at] Gora's body; premaya vihvala — overwhelmed with prema

**6.** By the sight of the Lord they became pure;
they gaze at Gora's body, overwhelmed with prema.

সুমেরু-সুন্দর তনু বাহু জানু-সম ।
সিংহগ্রীব কম্বুকণ্ঠ সুদীর্ঘ-লোচন ॥ ৭ ॥

*sumeru-sundara tanu bāhu jānu-sama |*
*siṃhagrība kambukaṇṭha sudīrgha-locana || 7 ||*

*Word for word:* sumeru-sundara tanu — a body beautiful as Sumeru; bahu janu-sama — arms reaching the knees; simha-griva — a lion's neck; kambu-kantha — a conch-like throat; sudirgha-lochana — long eyes

**7.** His body is beautiful as Sumeru, His arms reach to the knees,
His neck is a lion's, His throat like a conch, His eyes long.

দেখিতে দেখিতে হিয়া-আনন্দ বাড়িল ।
এই কৃষ্ণ গৌরচন্দ্র নিশ্চয় জানিল ॥ ৮ ॥

*dekhite dekhite hiẏā-ānanda bāṛila |*
*ei kṛṣṇa gauracandra niścaẏa jānila || 8 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhite dekhite — while gazing; hiya-ananda barila — the joy of the heart increased; ei krishna gaurachandra — this Gaurachandra is Krishna; nishchaya janila — they knew for certain

**8.** As they gazed, the joy in their hearts kept growing,
and they knew for certain: this Gaurachandra is Krishna.

হা হা মহাপ্রভু বলি' পড়িলা চরণে ।
সর্বলোক কান্দে তার প্রেমার কান্দনে ॥ ৯ ॥

*hā hā mahāprabhu bali' paṛilā caraṇe |*
*sarbaloka kānde tāra premāra kāndane || 9 ||*

*Word for word:* ha ha mahaprabhu bali — crying "O Mahaprabhu!"; padila charane — fell at His feet; sarvaloka kande — all people weep; tara premara kandane — at their weeping of prema

**9.** Crying "O Mahaprabhu!" they fell at His feet;
all the people weep [hearing] their weeping of prema.

তুলিয়া দোঁহারে প্রভু কৈল আলিঙ্গন ।
প্রকাশ করিল কথা মধুর বচন ॥ ১০ ॥

*tuliẏā doṁhāre prabhu kaila āliṅgana |*
*prakāśa karila kathā madhura bacana || 10 ||*

*Word for word:* tuliya donhare — raising both; prabhu kaila alingana — the Lord embraced; prakasha karila katha — revealed speech; madhura vachana — sweet words

**10.** Raising them both, the Lord embraced them
and revealed to them sweet words:

শুন শুন অহে দ্বিজ বচন আমার ।
কি কাজে আইলা মহী কি কর আচার ॥ ১১ ॥

*śuna śuna ahe dbija bacana āmāra |*
*ki kāje āilā mahī ki kara ācāra || 11 ||*

*Word for word:* shuna shuna ahe dvija — listen, listen, O brahmanas; vachana amara — My word; ki kaje aila mahi — for what purpose did you come to earth; ki kara achara — what practice do you follow

**11.** "Listen, listen, O brahmanas, to My word:
for what have you come into the world, what do you follow?

কলিযুগে ধর্ম হরিনাম-সঙ্কীর্তন ।
প্রকাশ করিল কৃষ্ণ নাম-মহাধন ॥ ১২ ॥

*kaliyuge dharma harināma-saṅkīrtana |*
*prakāśa karila kṛṣṇa nāma-mahādhana || 12 ||*

*Word for word:* kaliyuge dharma — in the Kali age the dharma; harinama-sankirtana — the sankirtana of Hari's name; prakasha karila krishna — Krishna revealed; nama-mahadhana — the great treasure of the name

**12.** In the Kali age the dharma is the sankirtana of Hari's name:
Krishna has revealed the great treasure of the name.

নাম-গুণ-সঙ্কীর্তনে করহ আনন্দ ।
নাচহ নাচহ লোক হউ মুক্তবন্ধ ॥ ১৩ ॥

*nāma-guṇa-saṅkīrtane karaha ānanda |*
*nācaha nācaha loka hau muktabandha || 13 ||*

*Word for word:* nama-guna-sankirtane — in singing the names and qualities; karaha ananda — rejoice; nachaha nachaha — dance, dance; loka hau muktabandha — let people be freed from bondage

**13.** Rejoice in singing the names and qualities [of the Lord];
dance, dance — let people be freed from bondage!"[^46-4]

এ বোল বলিয়া প্রভু চলিলা সত্বর ।
আপনাকে আপে তারা হৈলা অগোচর ॥ ১৪ ॥

*e bola baliẏā prabhu calilā satbara |*
*āpanāke āpe tārā hailā agocara || 14 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola baliya — saying these words; prabhu chalila satvara — the Lord went off quickly; apanake ape — to themselves; tara haila agochara — they became imperceptible (lost self-awareness)

**14.** Having said this, the Lord quickly went away,
and they lost all awareness of themselves.

চলিতে না পারে পথে বাড়ে প্রেমরঙ্গ ।
কথোদূর গিয়া দেখে জীয়ড়-নৃসিংহ ॥ ১৫ ॥

*calite nā pāre pathe bāṛe premaraṅga |*
*kathodūra giẏā dekhe jīẏaṛa-nṛsiṃha || 15 ||*

*Word for word:* chalite na pare pathe — cannot walk on the road; bare prema-ranga — the rapture of prema grows; katho-dura giya — going a little way; dekhe jiyada-nrisimha — sees Jiyada-Nrisimha

**15.** He cannot walk along the road, so does the rapture of prema grow;
going on a little, He sees Jiyada-Nrisimha[^46-5].

কহিব পূর্বের কথা অপূর্ব কাহিনী ।
প্রেমায় বিহ্বল কথা কহয়ে আপনি ॥ ১৬ ॥

*kahiba pūrbera kathā apūrba kāhinī |*
*premāẏa bihbala kathā kahaẏe āpani || 16 ||*

*Word for word:* kahiba purvera katha — I shall tell an ancient story; apurva kahini — a wondrous tale; premaya vihvala — overwhelmed with prema; katha kahaye apani — He Himself tells the story

**16.** "I shall tell an ancient story, a wondrous tale," —
so, overwhelmed with prema, He Himself began the account.

শুন শুন সর্বলোক রহস্য আনন্দ ।
যেন মতে অবতার জীয়ড়-নৃসিংহ ॥ ১৭ ॥

*śuna śuna sarbaloka rahasya ānanda |*
*yena mate abatāra jīẏaṛa-nṛsiṃha || 17 ||*

*Word for word:* shuna shuna sarvaloka — listen, all people; rahasya ananda — a joyful secret; yena mate — how; avatara — appeared; jiyada-nrisimha — Jiyada-Nrisimha

**17.** "Listen, all people, to a joyful secret —
how Jiyada-Nrisimha appeared.

স্মরণ হইল মোর পূর্বের কাহিনী ।
একচিত্তে সাবধানে শুন সভে বাণী ॥ ১৮ ॥

*smaraṇa haila mora pūrbera kāhinī |*
*ekacitte sābadhāne śuna sabhe bāṇī || 18 ||*

*Word for word:* smarana haila mora — there came to My mind; purvera kahini — an ancient tale; ekachitte savadhane — with one mind and attention; shuna sabhe bani — all of you hear the words

**18.** An ancient tale has come to My mind;
listen, all, to My words with one-pointed attention.

এখানে আছিল এক পুঁড়্যা গোয়াল ।
কৃষিকর্ম করে পুঁড়া বিহান-বিকাল ॥ ১৯ ॥

*ekhāne āchila eka puṁṛyā goẏāla |*
*kṛṣikarma kare puṁṛā bihāna-bikāla || 19 ||*

*Word for word:* ekhane achhila — here there lived; eka pundya goyala — a cowherd, Punda; krishikarma kare punda — Punda tills the land; bihana-bikala — morning and evening

**19.** There lived here a cowherd [named] Punda;
Punda tilled the land from morning to evening[^46-6].

শসা-নামে খন্দ মহী কৈল উপার্জন ।
হইল মায়াম্বু খন্দ বড়ই সম্পূর্ণ ॥ ২০ ॥

*śasā-nāme khanda mahī kaila upārjana |*
*haila māẏāmbu khanda baṛai sampūrṇa || 20 ||*

*Word for word:* shasa-name khanda — a crop called "shasa"; mahi kaila uparjana — raised on the land; haila mayambu khanda — the mayambu crop became; badai sampurna — very abundant

**20.** On the land he raised a crop called "shasa";
the mayambu crop turned out very abundant.

দিবা-রাত্রি রাখে খন্দ নাহি অবসর ।
না জানি কখন সেই যায় নিজঘর ॥ ২১ ॥

*dibā-rātri rākhe khanda nāhi abasara |*
*nā jāni kakhana sei yāẏa nijaghara || 21 ||*

*Word for word:* diva-ratri — day and night; rakhe khanda — guards the crop; nahi avasara — no rest; na jani kakhana — no one knows when; sei yaya nija-ghara — he goes home

**21.** Day and night he guards the crop — he has no rest;
and no one knows when he [ever] goes home.

একদিন মনে মনে করিল বিচার ।
খন্দ রাখিবারে আমি না আসিব আর ॥ ২২ ॥

*ekadina mane mane karila bicāra |*
*khanda rākhibāre āmi nā āsiba āra || 22 ||*

*Word for word:* ekadina — one day; mane mane — within himself; karila vichara — reflected; khanda rakhibare — to guard the crop; ami na asiba ara — I will come no more

**22.** One day he reflected within himself:
'I will no longer come to guard the crop.'

ভাবিয়া করিল হেন কৃষ্ণে নিয়োজিব ।
তারে নিয়োজিলে আমি অন্য কাজ পাব ॥ ২২+১ ॥

*bhābiẏā karila hena kṛṣṇe niẏojiba |*
*tāre niẏojile āmi anya kāja pāba || 22+1 ||*

*Word for word:* bhaviya karila hena — thinking, he decided thus; krishne niyojiba — I will entrust to Krishna; tare niyojile — if I entrust to Him; ami anya kaja paba — I can turn to other work

**22+1.** Thinking it over, he decided thus: 'I will entrust [it] to Krishna;
if I entrust it to Him, I can turn to other work.'

কৃষ্ণনাম ডাকি খন্দে নিয়োজিল তারে ।
তোমার নামেতে কিছু দিব বৈষ্ণবেরে ॥ ২২+২ ॥

*kṛṣṇanāma ḍāki khande niẏojila tāre |*
*tomāra nāmete kichu diba baiṣṇabere || 22+2 ||*

*Word for word:* krishna-nama daki — calling the name of Krishna; khande niyojila tare — entrusted the crop to Him; tomara namete — in Your name; kichhu diba vaishnavere — I will give something to the Vaishnavas

**22+2.** Calling the name of Krishna, he entrusted the crop to Him:
'In Your name I will give something to the Vaishnavas'[^46-7].

এইমনে আছে পুঁড়া মনের হরিষে ।
আচম্বিতে দেখে খন্দ খাঞা যায় কিসে ॥ ২৩ ॥

*eimane āche puṁṛā manera hariṣe |*
*ācambite dekhe khanda khāñā yāẏa kise || 23 ||*

*Word for word:* ei-mane achhe punda — so Punda lives; manera harishe — with a joyful mind; achambite dekhe — suddenly sees; khanda khanya yaya kise — something is eating the crop

**23.** So Punda lives, rejoicing in his heart —
and suddenly he sees: something is eating the crop.

দেখিয়া গোয়ালা দুঃখ অনেক ভাবিলা ।
কৃষ্ণ তুমি খন্দ মোর সব নষ্ট কৈলা ॥ ২৩+১ ॥

*dekhiẏā goẏālā duḥkha aneka bhābilā |*
*kṛṣṇa tumi khanda mora saba naṣṭa kailā || 23+1 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhiya goyala — seeing, the cowherd; duhkha aneka bhavila — grieved much; krishna tumi — Krishna, You; khanda mora saba nashta kaila — have ruined all my crop

**23+1.** Seeing this, the cowherd grieved and thought:
'Krishna, You have ruined my whole crop!'

কান্দিয়া গোয়ালা বলে শুন নারায়ণ ।
কে মোর খাইল খন্দ দেখিব নয়নে ॥ ২৩+২ ॥

*kāndiẏā goẏālā bale śuna nārāẏaṇa |*
*ke mora khāila khanda dekhiba naẏane || 23+2 ||*

*Word for word:* kandiya goyala bale — weeping, the cowherd says; shuna narayana — listen, Narayana; ke mora khaila khanda — who ate my crop; dekhiba nayane — I will see with my eyes

**23+2.** Weeping, the cowherd said: 'Listen, Narayana!
Who has eaten my crop — I will see with my own eyes.'

ইহা বলি কুঁড়েতে আশ্রয় করি রহে ।
জাগিয়া রহিল সেই খন্দ মহামোহে ॥ ২৩+৩ ॥

*ihā bali kuṁṛete āśraẏa kari rahe |*
*jāgiẏā rahila sei khanda mahāmohe || 23+3 ||*

*Word for word:* iha bali — saying this; kundete ashraya kari rahe — takes shelter in a hut; jagiya rahila sei — he stayed awake; khanda — [guarding] the crop; maha-mohe — in great distress

**23+3.** Saying this, he took shelter in a hut
and stayed awake, guarding the crop, in great distress[^46-8].

আরদিন রাত্রি জাগে তৃতীয় প্রহর ।
আচম্বিতে আইল এক বরাহ ডাগর ॥ ২৪ ॥

*āradina rātri jāge tṛtīẏa prahara |*
*ācambite āila eka barāha ḍāgara || 24 ||*

*Word for word:* ara-dina ratri jage — the next night he keeps awake; tritiya prahara — in the third watch; achambite aila — suddenly came; eka baraha dagara — a huge boar

**24.** The next night he keeps watch — and in the third watch
suddenly there came a huge boar.

দেখিয়া গোয়ালা সেই হৈল সাবধান ।
খন্দ খায় বরাহ সে সারে দুই কাণ ॥ ২৫ ॥

*dekhiẏā goẏālā sei haila sābadhāna |*
*khanda khāẏa barāha se sāre dui kāṇa || 25 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhiya goyala sei — seeing, that cowherd; haila savadhana — was on guard; khanda khaya baraha se — the boar eats the crop; sare dui kana — twitches its two ears

**25.** Seeing it, the cowherd was on his guard:
the boar eats the crop, twitching its ears.

খন্দ খায় লতা ছিঁড়ে আপনার সুখে ।
দেখিয়া গোয়ালা গুণ দিলেক ধনুকে ॥ ২৬ ॥

*khanda khāẏa latā chiṁṛe āpanāra sukhe |*
*dekhiẏā goẏālā guṇa dileka dhanuke || 26 ||*

*Word for word:* khanda khaya — eats the crop; lata chhinde — tears the vines; apanara sukhe — at its pleasure; dekhiya goyala — seeing, the cowherd; guna dileka dhanuke — strung the bow

**26.** It eats the crop, tears the vines to its heart's content —
seeing this, the cowherd strung his bow:

খন্দ খাও লতা ছিঁড় সার দুই কাণ ।
আজি মোর হাতে তুমি হারাবে পরাণ ॥ ২৭ ॥

*khanda khāo latā chiṁṛa sāra dui kāṇa |*
*āji mora hāte tumi hārābe parāṇa || 27 ||*

*Word for word:* khanda khao — eat the crop; lata chhinda — tear the vines; sara dui kana — twitch your ears; aji mora hate — today at my hand; tumi harabe parana — you will lose your life

**27.** 'Eat the crop, tear the vines, twitch your ears —
today at my hand you shall lose your life!'

ইহা বলি' সন্ধান পূরিয়া এড়ে বাণ ।
নির্ভরে বাজিল বরাহ স্মরে রামনাম ॥ ২৮ ॥

*ihā bali' sandhāna pūriẏā eṛe bāṇa |*
*nirbhare bājila barāha smare rāmanāma || 28 ||*

*Word for word:* iha bali — saying this; sandhana puriya — taking aim; ere bana — looses the arrow; nirbhare bajila — it struck deep; baraha smare rama-nama — the boar utters the name of Rama

**28.** Saying this, he took aim and loosed the arrow;
it struck deep — the boar utters the name of Rama[^46-9].

ধাঞা সান্ধাইল পর্বত-গুহার ভিতরে ।
দেখিয়া গোয়ালা পুঁড়া পড়িল ফাঁপরে ॥ ২৯ ॥

*dhāñā sāndhāila parbata-guhāra bhitare |*
*dekhiẏā goẏālā puṁṛā paṛila phāṁpare || 29 ||*

*Word for word:* dhanya sandhaila — running, it slipped; parvata-guhara bhitare — into a mountain cave; dekhiya — seeing; goyala punda — Punda the cowherd; parila phapare — was bewildered

**29.** Running off, it hid inside a mountain cave;
seeing this, Punda the cowherd was bewildered:

বরাহ হইয়া কেনে স্মরে রাম রাম ।
বরাহ না হয় এই সেই ভগবান্ ॥ ৩০ ॥

*barāha haiẏā kene smare rāma rāma |*
*barāha nā haẏa ei sei bhagabān || 30 ||*

*Word for word:* baraha haiya — being a boar; kene smare rama rama — why does it utter "Rama, Rama"; baraha na haya ei — this is not a boar; sei bhagavan — it is Bhagavan

**30.** 'It is a boar — why then does it repeat "Rama, Rama"?
This is no boar — this is Bhagavan Himself!'

এতেক চিন্তিয়া পুঁড়া কাতর-অন্তর ।
গহ্বর-নিকটে যাঞা কহিছে উত্তর ॥ ৩১ ॥

*eteka cintiẏā puṁṛā kātara-antara |*
*gahbara-nikaṭe yāñā kahiche uttara || 31 ||*

*Word for word:* eteka chintiya — thinking thus; punda katara-antara — Punda, pained at heart; gahvara-nikate yanya — going near the cave; kahichhe uttara — calls out for an answer

**31.** Thinking so, Punda, pained at heart,
went up to the cave and calls out [for] an answer.

কে তুমি কে তুমি বোলে উত্তর না পায় ।
তিন উপবাস কৈল কাতর-হিয়ায় ॥ ৩২ ॥

*ke tumi ke tumi bole uttara nā pāẏa |*
*tina upabāsa kaila kātara-hiẏāẏa || 32 ||*

*Word for word:* ke tumi ke tumi bole — says "Who are You? Who are You?"; uttara na paya — gets no answer; tina upavasa kaila — fasted three days; katara-hiyaya — with an anguished heart

**32.** 'Who are You? Who are You?' he says, but gets no answer;
with an anguished heart he fasted three days:

কি কাজ করিনু আমি অধম-দুরন্ত ।
মো-সম পাতকী নাহি পামর-পাষণ্ড ॥ ৩৩ ॥

*ki kāja karinu āmi adhama-duranta |*
*mo-sama pātakī nāhi pāmara-pāṣaṇḍa || 33 ||*

*Word for word:* ki kaja karinu ami — what have I done; adhama-duranta — low wretch; mo-sama pataki nahi — there is no sinner like me; pamara-pashanda — a vile unbeliever

**33.** 'What have I done, low wretch that I am!
There is no sinner like me — a vile unbeliever.'

দয়া উপজিল প্রভু করুণা-নিধান ।
আকাশ-কথায় কহে আমি ভগবান ॥ ৩৪ ॥

*daẏā upajila prabhu karuṇā-nidhāna |*
*ākāśa-kathāẏa kahe āmi bhagabāna || 34 ||*

*Word for word:* daya upajila — mercy arose; prabhu karuna-nidhana — [in] the Lord, treasury of compassion; akasha-kathaya kahe — says with a voice from the sky; ami bhagavana — I am Bhagavan

**34.** Mercy arose in the Lord, the treasury of compassion;
with a voice from the sky He says: 'I am Bhagavan.

আমারে মারিলি তোর কৈল অপচয় ।
চিন্তা না করিহ যাহ আপন আলয় ॥ ৩৫ ॥

*āmāre mārili tora kaila apacaẏa |*
*cintā nā kariha yāha āpana ālaẏa || 35 ||*

*Word for word:* amare marili — you struck Me; tora kaila apachaya — [I] caused you loss; chinta na kariha — do not worry; yaha apana alaya — go to your home

**35.** You wounded Me, and I ruined you —
do not worry, go to your home'[^46-10].

এ বোল শুনিঞা পুঁড়া অধিক কাতর ।
উপবাসে উপবাসে দিমু কলেবর ॥ ৩৬ ॥

*e bola śuniñā puṁṛā adhika kātara |*
*upabāse upabāse dimu kalebara || 36 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuninya — hearing this; punda adhika katara — Punda is more distressed; upavase upavase — fasting and fasting; dimu kalebara — I will give up the body

**36.** Hearing this, Punda was tormented still more:
'Fasting day after day, I will give up this body.'

এইমনে উপবাস করিল অনেক ।
আচম্বিতে গগনে উঠিল ধ্বনি এক ॥ ৩৭ ॥

*eimane upabāsa karila aneka |*
*ācambite gagane uṭhila dhbani eka || 37 ||*

*Word for word:* ei-mane — thus; upavasa karila aneka — fasted much; achambite — suddenly; gagane uthila dhvani eka — a voice arose in the sky

**37.** So he fasted many days;
suddenly a voice arose in the sky:

কেনে রে অবোধ পুঁড়া মর অকারণ ।
অপরাধ নাহি যাহ আপন ভবন ॥ ৩৮ ॥

*kene re abodha puṁṛā mara akāraṇa |*
*aparādha nāhi yāha āpana bhabana || 38 ||*

*Word for word:* kene re abodha punda — why, foolish Punda; mara akarana — do you die without cause; aparadha nahi — there is no fault; yaha apana bhavana — go to your home

**38.** 'Why, foolish Punda, do you die for no reason?
There is no fault [in you] — go to your home.'

পুনরপি বোলে পুঁড়া কাতর-বচনে ।
তোমারে মারিলুঁ বাণ কি কাজ জীবনে ॥ ৩৯ ॥

*punarapi bole puṁṛā kātara-bacane |*
*tomāre māriluṁ bāṇa ki kāja jībane || 39 ||*

*Word for word:* punarapi bole punda — again Punda says; katara-vachane — in a pained voice; tomare marilun bana — I shot an arrow at You; ki kaja jivane — what use is life

**39.** Again Punda speaks in a voice full of pain:
'I shot an arrow at You — what use is my life?

মরিলেহ নাহি ঘুচে এ দোষ আমার ।
এ দোষের উচিত হবে যমের প্রহার ॥ ৪০ ॥

*marileha nāhi ghuce e doṣa āmāra |*
*e doṣera ucita habe yamera prahāra || 40 ||*

*Word for word:* marileha — even if I die; nahi ghuche e dosha amara — this sin of mine is not removed; e doshera uchita habe — fitting for this sin is; yamera prahara — Yama's punishment

**40.** Even if I die, this sin of mine will not be washed away;
for such a sin the punishment of Yama is my due.

শুদ্ধ হইব আর আমি কোন্ প্রতিকারে ।
সবে আমি মাত্র বাণ মারিল তোমারে ॥ ৪১ ॥

*śuddha haiba āra āmi kon pratikāre |*
*sabe āmi mātra bāṇa mārila tomāre || 41 ||*

*Word for word:* shuddha haiba ara ami — shall I be purified; kon pratikare — by what remedy; sabe ami matra — it was I alone; bana marila tomare — who shot an arrow at You

**41.** By what atonement shall I be purified?
For it was I who shot an arrow at You!

এ কোমল গায়ে তোর ব্যথা এত দিল ।
ধিক্ ধিক্ প্রাণ মোর তোমারে মারিল ॥ ৪১+১ ॥

*e komala gāẏe tora byathā eta dila |*
*dhik dhik prāṇa mora tomāre mārila || 41+1 ||*

*Word for word:* e komala gaye tora — to Your tender body; byatha eta dila — gave so much pain; dhik dhik prana mora — shame on my life; tomare marila — it wounded You

**41+1.** On Your tender body I inflicted such pain —
shame, shame on my life: I wounded You!

মোর পিতৃলোক প্রভু গেল নরকেরে ।
আর লোক নরকে যাবে যে দেখিবে মোরে ॥ ৪১+২ ॥

*mora pitṛloka prabhu gela narakere |*
*āra loka narake yābe ye dekhibe more || 41+2 ||*

*Word for word:* mora pitriloka — my forefathers; prabhu — O Lord; gela narakere — went to hell; ara loka narake yabe — and people will go to hell; ye dekhibe more — who see me

**41+2.** My forefathers, Lord, have gone to hell,
and those who see me will go to hell'[^46-11].

এ বোল শুনিঞা বাণী আইল আরবার ।
নাহি অপরাধ তুষ্ট হইল অপার ॥ ৪২ ॥

*e bola śuniñā bāṇī āila ārabāra |*
*nāhi aparādha tuṣṭa haila apāra || 42 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuninya — hearing this; bani aila arabara — the voice came again; nahi aparadha — there is no fault; tushta haila apara — [I] am boundlessly pleased

**42.** Hearing this, the voice came again:
'There is no fault — I am boundlessly pleased.

পূর্বজন্মে যত অপরাধ কৈলে তুমি ।
একই কালে তোর পাপ সব লৈলুঁ আমি ॥ ৪২+১ ॥

*pūrbajanme yata aparādha kaile tumi |*
*ekai kāle tora pāpa saba lailuṁ āmi || 42+1 ||*

*Word for word:* purvajanme — in former births; yata aparadha kaile tumi — all the offences you committed; ekai kale — at once; tora papa saba lailun ami — I have taken all your sins

**42+1.** All the offences you committed in former births —
all your sins I have taken on Myself at once.

তোর দেহ মোর দেহ জানিহ সর্বথা ।
নিশ্চয় আমারে তুমি নাহি দাও ব্যথা ॥ ৪২+২ ॥

*tora deha mora deha jāniha sarbathā |*
*niścaẏa āmāre tumi nāhi dāo byathā || 42+2 ||*

*Word for word:* tora deha mora deha — your body is My body; janiha sarvatha — know in every way; nishchaya — truly; amare tumi nahi dao byatha — you have given Me no pain

**42+2.** Know: your body is My body, in every way;
truly, you have caused Me no pain'[^46-12].

এ বোল শুনিঞা পুঁড়া কহে কর জুড়ি' ।
তোমার আজ্ঞায় মুঞি বোলোঁ ভয় ছাড়ি' ॥ ৪৩ ॥

*e bola śuniñā puṁṛā kahe kara juṛi' |*
*tomāra ājñāẏa muñi boloṁ bhaẏa chāṛi' || 43 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuninya — hearing this; punda kahe kara juri — Punda says with joined palms; tomara ajnaya — by Your command; munyi bolon — I speak; bhaya chhari — setting fear aside

**43.** Hearing this, Punda speaks with joined palms:
'By Your command I speak, setting fear aside:

কেমনে জানিব মোর ঘুচিল এ দোষ ।
পরসাদ সাক্ষী পাইলে হঙ মো সন্তোষ ॥ ৪৪ ॥

*kemane jāniba mora ghucila e doṣa |*
*parasāda sākṣī pāile haṅa mo santoṣa || 44 ||*

*Word for word:* kemane janiba — how shall I know; mora ghuchila e dosha — that this sin of mine is removed; parasada sakshi paile — if I get grace and a witness; hanga mo santosha — I shall be content

**44.** how shall I know that this sin of mine is washed away?
If I receive grace and a witness, I shall be content.

এ কথা কহিব আমি রাজার গোচরে ।
এইমত আজ্ঞা তুমি কহিবে তাহারে ॥ ৪৫ ॥

*e kathā kahiba āmi rājāra gocare |*
*eimata ājñā tumi kahibe tāhāre || 45 ||*

*Word for word:* e katha kahiba ami — this I will tell; rajara gochare — to the king; ei-mata ajna — the same command; tumi kahibe tahare — You will tell him

**45.** I will tell this to the king —
give him too the same command.

তবে সে প্রতীত মুঞি পাঙ হিয়া-সাক্ষী ।
সর্বজন জানে তুমি হৈলে মোরে সুখী ॥ ৪৬ ॥

*tabe se pratīta muñi pāṅa hiẏā-sākṣī |*
*sarbajana jāne tumi haile more sukhī || 46 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe se pratita — then [there will be] belief; munyi panga hiya-sakshi — I get a witness for the heart; sarvajana jane — all people know; tumi haile more sukhi — You have made me happy

**46.** Then I shall believe, having a witness for my heart,
and all people will know that You have made me happy.'

তবে পুনরপি আজ্ঞা করিলা ঈশ্বর ।
যে বলিলা সেই হবে পাইলে তুমি বর ॥ ৪৭ ॥

*tabe punarapi ājñā karilā īśbara |*
*ye balilā sei habe pāile tumi bara || 47 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe punarapi — then again; ajna karila ishvara — the Lord commanded; ye balila sei habe — what you said will be; paile tumi bara — you have obtained the boon

**47.** Then the Lord commanded again:
'As you have said, so it shall be: you have received the boon.'

এ বোল শুনিঞা পুঁড়া হরষিত হঞা ।
মহাবেগে রাজদ্বারে উত্তরিল গিয়া ॥ ৪৮ ॥

*e bola śuniñā puṁṛā haraṣita hañā |*
*mahābege rājadbāre uttarila giẏā || 48 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuninya — hearing this; punda harashita hanya — Punda, rejoicing; maha-vege — with great speed; raja-dvare uttarila giya — arrived at the king's gate

**48.** Hearing this, Punda rejoiced
and in great haste came to the king's gate.

দ্বারীকে কহিল আরে শুন দ্বারিবর ।
যে কিছু কহিয়ে রাজার করহ গোচর ॥ ৪৯ ॥

*dbārīke kahila āre śuna dbāribara |*
*ye kichu kahiẏe rājāra karaha gocara || 49 ||*

*Word for word:* dvarike kahila — said to the gatekeeper; are shuna dvarivara — hey, listen, best of gatekeepers; ye kichhu kahiye — whatever I say; rajara karaha gochara — bring to the king's notice

**49.** He said to the gatekeeper: 'Listen, best of gatekeepers!
Bring to the king's notice all that I shall say.

কহিব অপূর্ব কথা লোকে অবিদিত ।
শুনিঞা আমারে রাজা করিবে পীরিত ॥ ৫০ ॥

*kahiba apūrba kathā loke abidita |*
*śuniñā āmāre rājā karibe pīrita || 50 ||*

*Word for word:* kahiba apurva katha — I will tell a wondrous thing; loke avidita — unknown to people; shuninya — hearing; amare raja karibe pirita — the king will love me

**50.** I shall tell of a wondrous thing, unknown to people;
hearing it, the king will love me.'

এ বোল শুনিঞা দ্বারী রাজারে কহিল ।
রাজার আজ্ঞায় পুঁড়া গোচর হইল ॥ ৫১ ॥

*e bola śuniñā dbārī rājāre kahila |*
*rājāra ājñāẏa puṁṛā gocara haila || 51 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuninya — hearing this; dvari rajare kahila — the gatekeeper told the king; rajara ajnaya — by the king's command; punda gochara haila — Punda came before him

**51.** Hearing this, the gatekeeper told the king,
and at the king's command Punda came before [him].

দণ্ডবত করি' কহে সব বিবরণ ।
আদ্যোপান্ত যত কথা কৈল নিবেদন ॥ ৫২ ॥

*daṇḍabata kari' kahe saba bibaraṇa |*
*ādyopānta yata kathā kaila nibedana || 52 ||*

*Word for word:* dandavata kari — prostrating; kahe saba vivarana — tells all in detail; adyopanta — from beginning to end; yata katha kaila nivedana — related everything

**52.** Falling down like a staff, he tells everything in detail —
he related everything from beginning to end.

শুনিঞা ত মহারাজে বিস্ময় লাগিল ।
নিশ্চয় করিয়া কহ পুঁড়াকে কহিল ॥ ৫৩ ॥

*śuniñā ta mahārāje bismaẏa lāgila |*
*niścaẏa kariẏā kaha puṁṛāke kahila || 53 ||*

*Word for word:* shuninya ta — hearing; maharaje vismaya lagila — the maharaja was amazed; nishchaya kariya kaha — tell it for certain; pundake kahila — he said to Punda

**53.** Hearing it, the maharaja was amazed
and said to Punda: 'Tell it for certain.'

পুনরপি কহে পুঁড়া করিয়া নিশ্চয় ।
সেইখানে চল রাজা ঘুচাও বিস্ময় ॥ ৫৪ ॥

*punarapi kahe puṁṛā kariẏā niścaẏa |*
*seikhāne cala rājā ghucāo bismaẏa || 54 ||*

*Word for word:* punarapi kahe punda — again Punda says; kariya nishchaya — with certainty; seikhane chala raja — come there, O king; ghuchao vismaya — dispel your amazement

**54.** Again Punda speaks with certainty:
'Come there, O king — dispel your amazement.

আমারে যেমত আজ্ঞা করিলা ঠাকুর ।
সেইমত আজ্ঞা তুমি পাইবে অদূর ॥ ৫৫ ॥

*āmāre yemata ājñā karilā ṭhākura |*
*seimata ājñā tumi pāibe adūra || 55 ||*

*Word for word:* amare yemata — as to me; ajna karila thakura — the Thakura commanded; sei-mata ajna — the same command; tumi paibe adura — you will soon receive

**55.** As the Thakura commanded me,
the same command you too will soon receive.'

রাজা বোলে আজ্ঞা যদি করয়ে ঈশ্বর ।
আজন্ম হইব আমি তোমার নফর ॥ ৫৬ ॥

*rājā bole ājñā yadi karaẏe īśbara |*
*ājanma haiba āmi tomāra naphara || 56 ||*

*Word for word:* raja bole — the king says; ajna yadi karaye ishvara — if Ishvara commands; ajanma haiba ami — for life I shall be; tomara naphara — your servant

**56.** The king says: 'If Ishvara commands,
for life I shall be your servant.'

এ বোল বলিয়া রাজা চলিলা সত্বর ।
পদব্রজে গেলা যথা পর্বত-গহ্বর ॥ ৫৭ ॥

*e bola baliẏā rājā calilā satbara |*
*padabraje gelā yathā parbata-gahbara || 57 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola baliya — saying this; raja chalila satvara — the king went quickly; padavraje gela — went on foot; yatha parvata-gahvara — to where the mountain cave was

**57.** Saying this, the king set out in haste,
on foot he went to where the mountain cave was.

পর্বত-গহ্বর-দ্বারে এক-মন-চিতে ।
বিস্তর মিনতি করে লোটাঞা ভূমিতে ॥ ৫৮ ॥

*parbata-gahbara-dbāre eka-mana-cite |*
*bistara minati kare loṭāñā bhūmite || 58 ||*

*Word for word:* parvata-gahvara-dvare — at the mouth of the mountain cave; eka-mana-chite — with one-pointed heart; vistara minati kare — prays at length; lotanya bhumite — rolling on the ground

**58.** At the mouth of the mountain cave, with all his heart,
he prays at length, rolling on the ground.

দ্রবিলা ঠাকুর আজ্ঞা উঠিল গগনে ।
মিথ্যা নহে শুন রাজা পুঁড়ার বচনে ॥ ৫৯ ॥

*drabilā ṭhākura ājñā uṭhila gagane |*
*mithyā nahe śuna rājā puṁṛāra bacane || 59 ||*

*Word for word:* dravila thakura — the Thakura melted; ajna uthila gagane — a command arose in the sky; mithya nahe — not false; shuna raja — listen, O king; pundara vachane — are Punda's words

**59.** The Thakura relented — a command arose in the sky:
'Not false, O king, listen, are Punda's words.

তুমি সাক্ষী হৈলে পুঁড়া হইল আমার ।
ইহারে সে নাহি আর যম-অধিকার ॥ ৫৯+১ ॥

*tumi sākṣī haile puṁṛā haila āmāra |*
*ihāre se nāhi āra yama-adhikāra || 59+1 ||*

*Word for word:* tumi sakshi haile — you have become witness; punda haila amara — Punda has become Mine; ihare se nahi ara — over him there is no more; yama-adhikara — the power of Yama

**59+1.** You are the witness: Punda has become Mine;
over him Yama has power no more.'

এ বোল শুনিয়া রাজা নাচয়ে আনন্দে ।
গোয়ালার চরণ ধরিয়া পড়ি' কান্দে ॥ ৫৯+২ ॥

*e bola śuniẏā rājā nācaẏe ānande |*
*goẏālāra caraṇa dhariẏā paṛi' kānde || 59+2 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuniya — hearing this; raja nachaye anande — the king dances with joy; goyalara charana dhariya — clasping the cowherd's feet; pari kande — falling down, weeps

**59+2.** Hearing this, the king dances with joy,
clasping the cowherd's feet, he weeps:

তুমি মোর গুরু হৈয়া কৃষ্ণ মিলাইলা ।
কৃষ্ণের শ্রীমুখ-কথা তুমি শুনাইলা ॥ ৫৯+৩ ॥

*tumi mora guru haiẏā kṛṣṇa milāilā |*
*kṛṣṇera śrīmukha-kathā tumi śunāilā || 59+3 ||*

*Word for word:* tumi mora guru haiya — you, becoming my guru; krishna milaila — united [me] with Krishna; krishnera shrimukha-katha — words from Krishna's lips; tumi shunaila — you let [me] hear

**59+3.** 'You have become my guru and united me with Krishna,
you have let me hear words from Krishna's own lips!'

গোয়ালার পায়ে পড়ে রাণীগণ সঙ্গে ।
দেখিয়া কৃষ্ণের দয়া উপজিল অঙ্গে ॥ ৫৯+৪ ॥

*goẏālāra pāẏe paṛe rāṇīgaṇa saṅge |*
*dekhiẏā kṛṣṇera daẏā upajila aṅge || 59+4 ||*

*Word for word:* goyalara paye pare — falls at the cowherd's feet; ranigana sange — with the queens; dekhiya — seeing; krishnera daya upajila ange — mercy arose in Krishna

**59+4.** Together with the queens [the king] falls at the cowherd's feet;
seeing this, Krishna was filled with mercy:

মোর ভক্তে জাতি-বুদ্ধি না করিলে তুমি ।
তোরে দেখা দিব রাজা কহিলা ত আমি ॥ ৫৯+৫ ॥

*mora bhakte jāti-buddhi nā karile tumi |*
*tore dekhā diba rājā kahilā ta āmi || 59+5 ||*

*Word for word:* mora bhakte — toward My devotee; jati-buddhi na karile tumi — you did not think in terms of caste; tore dekha diba — I will appear to you; raja — O king; kahila ta ami — I said

**59+5.** 'You did not judge My devotee by caste —
therefore, O king, I said that I would appear to you[^46-13].

দুগ্ধসেচন তুমি কর এইস্থানে ।
দুগ্ধের সেচনে আমা পাবে বিদ্যমানে ॥ ৬০ ॥

*dugdhasecana tumi kara eisthāne |*
*dugdhera secane āmā pābe bidyamāne || 60 ||*

*Word for word:* dugdha-sechana tumi kara — pour milk; ei-sthane — on this place; dugdhera sechane — by the pouring of milk; ama pabe vidyamane — you will find Me before you

**60.** Pour milk on this place:
by the pouring of milk you will see Me before your eyes.'

এ বোল শুনিঞা রাজা হরষিত চিতে ।
ঘোষণা পড়িল রাজ্যে দুগ্ধ যে আনিতে ॥ ৬১ ॥

*e bola śuniñā rājā haraṣita cite |*
*ghoṣaṇā paṛila rājye dugdha ye ānite || 61 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuninya — hearing this; raja harashita chite — the king with a joyful heart; ghoshana parila rajye — a proclamation went through the kingdom; dugdha ye anite — to bring milk

**61.** Hearing this, the king, with a joyful heart,
had it proclaimed through the kingdom that milk be brought.

প্রভুর আজ্ঞায় দুগ্ধ ঢালে সেইখানে ।
আচম্বিতে মাথার চূড়া দেখে বিদ্যমানে ॥ ৬২ ॥

*prabhura ājñāẏa dugdha ḍhāle seikhāne |*
*ācambite māthāra cūṛā dekhe bidyamāne || 62 ||*

*Word for word:* prabhura ajnaya — by the Lord's command; dugdha dhale seikhane — they pour milk there; achambite — suddenly; mathara chura — the crown of the head; dekhe vidyamane — they see before them

**62.** By the Lord's command they pour milk there —
and suddenly they see before their eyes the crown of a head.

নানাবিধ বাদ্য বাজে আনন্দ অপার ।
আনন্দে ভাসয়ে সুখসাগর-পাথার ॥ ৬৩ ॥

*nānābidha bādya bāje ānanda apāra |*
*ānande bhāsaẏe sukhasāgara-pāthāra || 63 ||*

*Word for word:* nanavidha badya baje — many kinds of instruments sound; ananda apara — boundless joy; anande bhasaye — they float in joy; sukhasagara-pathara — [in] a shoreless ocean of happiness

**63.** All kinds of instruments play, the joy is boundless;
[all] float in joy — in a shoreless ocean of happiness.

হরি হরি বোল শুনি' চৌদিগ ভরিয়া ।
নাচয়ে সকল লোক দুবাহু তুলিয়া ॥ ৬৪ ॥

*hari hari bola śuni' caudiga bhariẏā |*
*nācaẏe sakala loka dubāhu tuliẏā || 64 ||*

*Word for word:* hari hari bola shuni — hearing "Hari, Hari!"; chaudiga bhariya — filling all directions; nachaye sakala loka — all people dance; dubahu tuliya — raising both arms

**64.** On every side resounds "Hari! Hari!" —
all the people dance with both arms raised.

যত দুগ্ধ ঢালে তত উঠয়ে শরীর ।
উঠয়ে শরীর দেখে এ নাভি গভীর ॥ ৬৫ ॥

*yata dugdha ḍhāle tata uṭhaẏe śarīra |*
*uṭhaẏe śarīra dekhe e nābhi gabhīra || 65 ||*

*Word for word:* yata dugdha dhale — as much milk as they pour; tata uthaye sharira — so far the body rises; uthaye sharira — the body rises; dekhe e nabhi gabhira — they see the deep navel

**65.** As much milk as they pour — so far the body rises;
the body rises — the deep [hollow of the] navel is seen.

অধিক ঢালয়ে দুগ্ধ মনের হরিষে ।
প্রভু-সব-অবয়ব দেখিবার আশে ॥ ৬৬ ॥

*adhika ḍhālaẏe dugdha manera hariṣe |*
*prabhu-saba-abaẏaba dekhibāra āśe || 66 ||*

*Word for word:* adhika dhalaye dugdha — they pour more milk; manera harishe — with joyful minds; prabhu-saba-avayava — all the Lord's limbs; dekhibara ashe — hoping to see

**66.** With joyful hearts they pour still more milk,
hoping to see all the limbs of the Lord.

উঠিল শরীর জানু দেখে বিদ্যমান ।
না ঢালিহ দুগ্ধ আজ্ঞা ভেল পরিমাণ ॥ ৬৭ ॥

*uṭhila śarīra jānu dekhe bidyamāna |*
*nā ḍhāliha dugdha ājñā bhela parimāṇa || 67 ||*

*Word for word:* uthila sharira — the body rose; janu dekhe vidyamana — they see the knees before them; na dhaliha dugdha — pour no milk; ajna — [was] the command; bhela parimana — the measure is reached

**67.** The body rose — the knees are seen before their eyes.
'Pour no milk' — was the command: the measure is reached.

বহুত ঢালয়ে দুগ্ধ মনের হরিষে ।
পদতল দুইখানি না উঠিল শেষে ॥ ৬৮ ॥

*bahuta ḍhālaẏe dugdha manera hariṣe |*
*padatala duikhāni nā uṭhila śeṣe || 68 ||*

*Word for word:* bahuta dhalaye dugdha — they pour much milk; manera harishe — with joyful minds; padatala duikhani — both soles; na uthila sheshe — did not rise in the end

**68.** Yet with joyful hearts they pour much more milk —
but the soles of the feet did not rise in the end.

হেনকালে আজ্ঞাবাণী উঠিল গগনে ।
না উঠিব পদ আর না করো যতনে ॥ ৬৯ ॥

*henakāle ājñābāṇī uṭhila gagane |*
*nā uṭhiba pada āra nā karo yatane || 69 ||*

*Word for word:* henakale — then; ajna-bani uthila gagane — a voice of command arose in the sky; na uthiba pada — the feet will not rise; ara na karo yatane — strive no more

**69.** Then a command arose in the sky:
'The feet will not rise — strive no more'[^46-14].

এ বোল শুনিঞা রাজা হরিষ-বিষাদ ।
মহামহোৎসব করে পাঞা পরসাদ ॥ ৭০ ॥

*e bola śuniñā rājā hariṣa-biṣāda |*
*mahāmahotsaba kare pāñā parasāda || 70 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuninya — hearing this; raja harisha-vishada — the king [in] joy and sorrow; maha-mahotsava kare — hold a great festival; panya parasada — having received grace

**70.** Hearing this, the king [felt] both joy and sorrow;
having received grace, all hold a great festival.

দেউল-মন্দির দিল নানা ভোগ-রাগ ।
দু-নয়ান ভরি' দেখে হিয়া অনুরাগ ॥ ৭১ ॥

*deula-mandira dila nānā bhoga-rāga |*
*du-naẏāna bhari' dekhe hiẏā anurāga || 71 ||*

*Word for word:* deula-mandira dila — built a temple; nana bhoga-raga — various offerings; du-nayana bhari dekhe — they gaze with full eyes; hiya anuraga — the heart full of love

**71.** He raised a temple and established various offerings;
[all] gaze and cannot gaze enough, their hearts full of love.

পুঁড়ারে কহিল রাজা বিনয় করিয়া ।
তুমি রাজ্যের রাজা হও মোরে কৃপা দিয়া ॥ ৭১+১ ॥

*puṁṛāre kahila rājā binaẏa kariẏā |*
*tumi rājyera rājā hao more kṛpā diẏā || 71+1 ||*

*Word for word:* pundare kahila raja — the king said to Punda; vinaya kariya — humbly; tumi rajyera raja hao — be you king of the kingdom; more kripa diya — showing me mercy

**71+1.** The king humbly said to Punda:
'Be king of this kingdom — show me mercy.'

গোপ বলে অজ্ঞান হইয়া বল কথা ।
রাজ্য নাহি লব মোরে কেন দেহ ব্যথা ॥ ৭১+২ ॥

*gopa bale ajñāna haiẏā bala kathā |*
*rājya nāhi laba more kena deha byathā || 71+2 ||*

*Word for word:* gopa bale — the cowherd says; ajnana haiya bala katha — you speak like an ignorant man; rajya nahi laba — I will not take the kingdom; more kena deha byatha — why do you pain me

**71+2.** The cowherd answers: 'You speak like an ignorant man:
I will not take the kingdom — why do you pain me?

তোতে মোতে কৃষ্ণসেবা করিব আনন্দে ।
কোন্ সুখ রাজ্যে রাজা ছাড়িয়া গোবিন্দে ॥ ৭১+৩ ॥

*tote mote kṛṣṇasebā kariba ānande |*
*kon sukha rājye rājā chāṛiẏā gobinde || 71+3 ||*

*Word for word:* tote mote — you and I; krishna-seva kariba anande — will joyfully serve Krishna; kon sukha rajye — what happiness in a kingdom; raja — O king; chhariya govinde — leaving Govinda

**71+3.** You and I together will joyfully serve Krishna;
what happiness is there in a kingdom, O king, if one leaves Govinda?'

শুনি রাজা বিনয়ে বলিল কর জুড়ি ।
তুমি আমি সেবার হইব অধিকারী ॥ ৭১+৪ ॥

*śuni rājā binaẏe balila kara juṛi |*
*tumi āmi sebāra haiba adhikārī || 71+4 ||*

*Word for word:* shuni raja — hearing, the king; vinaye balila kara juri — humbly said with joined palms; tumi ami — you and I; sevara haiba adhikari — will be entitled to the service

**71+4.** Hearing this, the king humbly said with joined palms:
'You and I — we shall both be entitled to the service'[^46-15].

এইমনে আছে রাজা আনন্দিত-চিতে ।
ডিঙ্গা লঞা এক সাধু আইলা আচম্বিতে ॥ ৭২ ॥

*eimane āche rājā ānandita-cite |*
*ḍiṅgā lañā eka sādhu āilā ācambite || 72 ||*

*Word for word:* ei-mane achhe raja — so the king lives; anandita-chite — with a joyful heart; dinga lanya — with a boat; eka sadhu aila achambite — suddenly a merchant came

**72.** So the king lives with a joyful heart;
suddenly a merchant came in a boat.

তার সঙ্গে দুই স্ত্রী পরমা সুন্দরী ।
সঙ্গে যাইবারে চাহে দেখিতে শ্রীহরি ॥ ৭২+১ ॥

*tāra saṅge dui strī paramā sundarī |*
*saṅge yāibāre cāhe dekhite śrīhari || 72+1 ||*

*Word for word:* tara sange — with him; dui stri — two wives; parama sundari — most beautiful; sange yaibare chahe — want to go along; dekhite shrihari — to see Sri Hari

**72+1.** With him were two wives, most beautiful;
they want to go with him to see Sri Hari.

সাধু নাহি লয় সঙ্গে লজ্জার কারণে ।
দুই স্ত্রী কান্দে ধরি সাধুর চরণে ॥ ৭২+২ ॥

*sādhu nāhi laẏa saṅge lajjāra kāraṇe |*
*dui strī kānde dhari sādhura caraṇe || 72+2 ||*

*Word for word:* sadhu nahi laya sange — the merchant does not take [them] along; lajjara karane — out of shame; dui stri kande — the two wives weep; dhari sadhura charane — clasping the merchant's feet

**72+2.** The merchant will not take them along — he is ashamed;
both wives weep, clasping the merchant's feet:
