তুমি গুরু সঙ্গে করি কৃষ্ণেরে দেখাও ।
মো দোঁহার ভাগ্য নাথ তুমি না ঘুচাও ॥ ৭২+৩ ॥

*tumi guru saṅge kari kṛṣṇere dekhāo |*
*mo doṁhāra bhāgya nātha tumi nā ghucāo || 72+3 ||*

*Word for word:* tumi guru — you are the guru; sange kari — taking [us] along; krishnere dekhao — show [us] Krishna; mo donhara bhagya — the fortune of us two; natha — lord; tumi na ghuchao — do not destroy

**72+3.** 'You are [our] guru — take us with you, show us Krishna,
do not, lord, destroy our good fortune.'

সাধু বলে সঙ্গে নাহি লব তো সবারে ।
প্রসাদ আনিব আমি তোরা থাক ঘরে ॥ ৭২+৪ ॥

*sādhu bale saṅge nāhi laba to sabāre |*
*prasāda āniba āmi torā thāka ghare || 72+4 ||*

*Word for word:* sadhu bale — the merchant says; sange nahi laba to sabare — I will not take you along; prasada aniba ami — I will bring prasada; tora thaka ghare — stay at home

**72+4.** The merchant says: 'I will not take you with me;
I will bring prasada — stay at home.'

তারা বলে তুমি যে কহিলে সেই হয় ।
কৃষ্ণ দেখিবারে সাধ হৈয়াছে নিশ্চয় ॥ ৭২+৫ ॥

*tārā bale tumi ye kahile sei haẏa |*
*kṛṣṇa dekhibāre sādha haiẏāche niścaẏa || 72+5 ||*

*Word for word:* tara bale — they say; tumi ye kahile — what you have said; sei haya — so be it; krishna dekhibare sadha — the desire to see Krishna; haiyachhe nishchaya — has surely arisen

**72+5.** They say: 'What you have said — so be it,
[but] truly the desire to see Krishna has arisen in us.'

তবে সাধু ক্রোধ করি দোঁহারে বলে ।
তোরা কৃষ্ণ দেখ গিয়া আমি থাকি ঘরে ॥ ৭২+৬ ॥

*tabe sādhu krodha kari doṁhāre bale |*
*torā kṛṣṇa dekha giẏā āmi thāki ghare || 72+6 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe sadhu — then the merchant; krodha kari — in anger; donhare bale — says to both; tora krishna dekha giya — go and see Krishna; ami thaki ghare — I stay at home

**72+6.** Then the merchant angrily says to them both:
'Go and see Krishna, and I will stay at home.'

শুনি দুই স্ত্রী হইল দুঃখিত অন্তরে ।
পতি ছাড়ি কৃষ্ণ ভজি এই সে বিচারে ॥ ৭২+৭ ॥

*śuni dui strī haila duḥkhita antare |*
*pati chāṛi kṛṣṇa bhaji ei se bicāre || 72+7 ||*

*Word for word:* shuni — hearing; dui stri haila duhkhita antare — the two wives were sad at heart; pati chhari — leaving the husband; krishna bhaji — let us serve Krishna; ei se vichare — so they resolved

**72+7.** Hearing this, both wives were sad at heart
and resolved: 'We will leave our husband and serve Krishna.'

চলিলা সুন্দরী তারা পতিরে ছাড়িয়া ।
দয়া হৈল গোবিন্দের একান্ত দেখিয়া ॥ ৭২+৮ ॥

*calilā sundarī tārā patire chāṛiẏā |*
*daẏā haila gobindera ekānta dekhiẏā || 72+8 ||*

*Word for word:* chalila sundari tara — those beautiful women went; patire chhariya — leaving the husband; daya haila govindera — Govinda felt mercy; ekanta dekhiya — seeing their exclusive devotion

**72+8.** The beautiful women went, leaving their husband;
Govinda was filled with mercy, seeing their devotion.

সাধুর হৃদয়ে প্রভু সঞ্চারিলা দয়া ।
স্ত্রীয়েরে দেখয়ে সাধু তবে সে আসিয়া ॥ ৭২+৯ ॥

*sādhura hṛdaẏe prabhu sañcārilā daẏā |*
*strīẏere dekhaẏe sādhu tabe se āsiẏā || 72+9 ||*

*Word for word:* sadhura hridaye — in the merchant's heart; prabhu sancharila daya — the Lord infused mercy; striyere dekhaye sadhu — the merchant sees the wives; tabe se asiya — then, coming

**72+9.** The Lord awakened mercy in the merchant's heart,
and the merchant, coming, sees his wives:

ধিক্ ধিক্ আমি ছার পাপিষ্ঠ-হৃদয় ।
হেন স্ত্রীয়ে অসম্মান যুক্তি ভাল নয় ॥ ৭২+১০ ॥

*dhik dhik āmi chāra pāpiṣṭha-hṛdaẏa |*
*hena strīẏe asammāna yukti bhāla naẏa || 72+10 ||*

*Word for word:* dhik dhik — shame, shame; ami chhara — I, worthless; papishtha-hridaya — sinful at heart; hena striye asammana — such dishonour to wives; yukti bhala naya — is not right

**72+10.** 'Shame, shame on me, worthless and sinful at heart!
It is not right to dishonour such wives.'

সাধু বলে চল সঙ্গে লব তো সবারে ।
পরম পবিত্র তোরা পুণ্য-কলেবরে ॥ ৭২+১১ ॥

*sādhu bale cala saṅge laba to sabāre |*
*parama pabitra torā puṇya-kalebare || 72+11 ||*

*Word for word:* sadhu bale — the merchant says; chala — come; sange laba to sabare — I will take you along; parama pavitra tora — you are utterly pure; punya-kalebare — holy in body

**72+11.** The merchant says: 'Come, I will take you with me:
you are utterly pure, your bodies are holy.

স্বামীর সৌভাগ্য যার নারী কৃষ্ণব্রত ।
অখিল-পূজিত সেই পরম মহত্ত্ব ॥ ৭২+১২ ॥

*sbāmīra saubhāgya yāra nārī kṛṣṇabrata |*
*akhila-pūjita sei parama mahattba || 72+12 ||*

*Word for word:* svamira saubhagya — the husband's good fortune; yara nari krishna-vrata — whose wife is vowed to Krishna; akhila-pujita sei — she is honoured by all; parama mahattva — supreme is her worth

**72+12.** If a wife is devoted to Krishna, it is her husband's good fortune:
she is honoured by all, great is her worth'[^46-16].

ঠাকুর দেখিতে সেই আইলা সওদাগর ।
দুই নারী লঞা গেলা মন্দির-ভিতর ॥ ৭৩ ॥

*ṭhākura dekhite sei āilā saodāgara |*
*dui nārī lañā gelā mandira-bhitara || 73 ||*

*Word for word:* thakura dekhite — to see the Thakura; sei aila saodagara — that merchant came; dui nari lanya — with two wives; gela mandira-bhitara — went into the temple

**73.** To see the Thakura that merchant came,
with his two wives he went into the temple.

প্রভু নমস্করি' সাধু ভৈগেল বাহিরে ।
সাধু বাহির হৈল দ্বার লাগিল মন্দিরে ॥ ৭৪ ॥

*prabhu namaskari' sādhu bhaigela bāhire |*
*sādhu bāhira haila dbāra lāgila mandire || 74 ||*

*Word for word:* prabhu namaskari — bowing to the Lord; sadhu bhaigela bahire — the merchant went out; sadhu bahira haila — the merchant came out; dvara lagila mandire — the temple doors closed

**74.** Bowing to the Lord, the merchant went outside;
the merchant went out — and the temple doors closed.

লেউটিয়া দেখে দুই নারী নাই পাশে ।
মন্দির-ভিতরে তারা প্রভুকে সম্ভাষে ॥ ৭৫ ॥

*leuṭiẏā dekhe dui nārī nāi pāśe |*
*mandira-bhitare tārā prabhuke sambhāṣe || 75 ||*

*Word for word:* leutiya dekhe — turning back, he sees; dui nari nai pashe — the two wives are not beside him; mandira-bhitare tara — they are inside the temple; prabhuke sambhashe — speaking with the Lord

**75.** Turning back, he sees — the two wives are not beside him:
they are inside the temple, conversing with the Lord.

বুঝিয়া সে সাধু স্তব করে আর্তনাদে ।
দ্রবিলা ঠাকুর তারে কৈলা পরসাদে ॥ ৭৬ ॥

*bujhiẏā se sādhu staba kare ārtanāde |*
*drabilā ṭhākura tāre kailā parasāde || 76 ||*

*Word for word:* bujhiya se sadhu — understanding, the merchant; stava kare artanade — praises with laments; dravila thakura — the Thakura melted; tare kaila parasade — showed him grace

**76.** Understanding this, the merchant offers praises with laments;
the Thakura relented and showed him grace.

ঘুচিল মন্দির-দ্বার দেখে দুইজন ।
পাষাণ হইয়া প্রভুর পাঞাছে চরণ ॥ ৭৭ ॥

*ghucila mandira-dbāra dekhe duijana |*
*pāṣāṇa haiẏā prabhura pāñāche caraṇa || 77 ||*

*Word for word:* ghuchila mandira-dvara — the temple door opened; dekhe duijana — he sees: the two; pashana haiya — turning to stone; prabhura panyachhe charana — have attained the Lord's feet

**77.** The temple doors opened — he sees: both
have turned to stone and attained the Lord's feet.

পতি ছাড়ি কৃষ্ণপতি লভিবারে গেল ।
সে কারণে কৃষ্ণপতি সুদৃঢ় পাইল ॥ ৭৭+১ ॥

*pati chāṛi kṛṣṇapati labhibāre gela |*
*se kāraṇe kṛṣṇapati sudṛṛha pāila || 77+1 ||*

*Word for word:* pati chhari — leaving the husband; krishna-pati labhibare gela — went to attain Krishna as Husband; se karane — therefore; krishna-pati sudridha paila — attained Krishna as steadfast Husband

**77+1.** They went, leaving their husband, to attain Krishna as Husband —
therefore they attained Krishna as their steadfast Husband[^46-17].

নিজভাগ্য মানি' পায়ে পড়ে সওদাগর ।
পরসাদ করি' প্রভু বোলে মাগ বর ॥ ৭৮ ॥

*nijabhāgya māni' pāẏe paṛe saodāgara |*
*parasāda kari' prabhu bole māga bara || 78 ||*

*Word for word:* nija-bhagya mani — deeming it his fortune; paye pare saodagara — the merchant falls at the feet; parasada kari — showing grace; prabhu bole maga bara — the Lord says: "Ask a boon"

**78.** Deeming this his good fortune, the merchant fell at [the Lord's] feet;
showing grace, the Lord says: 'Ask a boon.'

চরণে পড়িয়া সাধু করে পরণাম ।
বর মাগে মোর নামে হউ তোর নাম ॥ ৭৯ ॥

*caraṇe paṛiẏā sādhu kare paraṇāma |*
*bara māge mora nāme hau tora nāma || 79 ||*

*Word for word:* charane pariya — falling at the feet; sadhu kare paranama — the merchant bows; bara mage — asks a boon; mora name hau tora nama — let Your name be after my name

**79.** Falling at His feet, the merchant bows
and asks a boon: 'Let Your name be after my name.

মা-বাপে থুইল মোর এ নাম জীয়ড় ।
আপনার নামে প্রভু-নাম মাগে বর ॥ ৮০ ॥

*mā-bāpe thuila mora e nāma jīẏaṛa |*
*āpanāra nāme prabhu-nāma māge bara || 80 ||*

*Word for word:* ma-bape thuila — mother and father gave; mora e nama jiyada — me this name "Jiyada"; apanara name — after his own name; prabhu-nama mage bara — asks as a boon a name for the Lord

**80.** My father and mother gave me the name "Jiyada"' —
so after his own name he asks as a boon a name for the Lord.

জীয়ড়-নৃসিংহ নাম তেঞি পরকাশ ।
আনন্দে কহয়ে গুণ এ লোচনদাস ॥ ৮১ ॥

*jīẏaṛa-nṛsiṃha nāma teñi parakāśa |*
*ānande kahaẏe guṇa e locanadāsa || 81 ||*

*Word for word:* jiyada-nrisimha nama — the name "Jiyada-Nrisimha"; tenyi parakasha — therefore became known; anande kahaye guna — joyfully tells the glories; e lochanadasa — this Lochana Dasa

**81.** Therefore the name "Jiyada-Nrisimha" became renowned"[^46-18].
In joy this Lochana Dasa sings [His] glories.

*Raga sindhura*

তবে মহাপ্রভু জীয়ড়-নৃসিংহ দেখিয়া ।
চলিলা ত পরদিনে সে দিন বঞ্চিয়া ॥ ৮২ ॥

*tabe mahāprabhu jīẏaṛa-nṛsiṃha dekhiẏā |*
*calilā ta paradine se dina bañciẏā || 82 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe — then; mahaprabhu — Mahaprabhu; jiyada-nrisimha dekhiya — having seen Jiyada-Nrisimha; chalila ta — set out; paradine — on the next day; se dina vanchiya — having spent that day

**82.** Then Mahaprabhu, having seen Jiyada-Nrisimha
and spent that day there, set out on the next day.

চলি' যায় পথে প্রেম-পরবশ-চিত ।
কাঞ্চী-নগরে প্রভু ভেল উপনীত ॥ ৮৩ ॥

*cali' yāẏa pathe prema-parabaśa-cita |*
*kāñcī-nagare prabhu bhela upanīta || 83 ||*

*Word for word:* chali yaya pathe — goes along the road; prema-parabasha-chita — His heart in the power of prema; kanchi-nagare — to the town of Kanchi; prabhu bhela upanita — the Lord arrived

**83.** He walks along the road, His heart in the power of prema;
the Lord arrived at the town of Kanchi[^46-19].

রত্নময় পুরী সেই কাঞ্চীনগর ।
নগর দেখিয়া তুষ্ট হৈল ন্যাসিবর ॥ ৮৪ ॥

*ratnamaẏa purī sei kāñcīnagara |*
*nagara dekhiẏā tuṣṭa haila nyāsibara || 84 ||*

*Word for word:* ratnamaya puri — a city full of jewels; sei kanchinagara — that Kanchi-nagara; nagara dekhiya — seeing the town; tushta haila — was pleased; nyasivara — the best of sannyasis

**84.** Kanchi-nagara is a town full of jewels;
seeing the town, the best of sannyasis was pleased.

বিষয়ীর মুখ প্রভু নাহি দেখে কভু ।
আচম্বিতে রাজদ্বারে উত্তরিলা প্রভু ॥ ৮৫ ॥

*biṣaẏīra mukha prabhu nāhi dekhe kabhu |*
*ācambite rājadbāre uttarilā prabhu || 85 ||*

*Word for word:* vishayira mukha — the faces of worldly men; prabhu nahi dekhe kabhu — the Lord never looks at; achambite — suddenly; rajadvare uttarila prabhu — the Lord came to the king's gate

**85.** Never does the Lord look on the faces of worldly men —
[and yet] the Lord suddenly came to the king's gate.

রাজা গোদাবরী স্নান করি' বিপ্র সঙ্গে ।
অন্তঃপুরে আসি' কৃষ্ণসেবা করে রঙ্গে ॥ ৮৫+১ ॥

*rājā godābarī snāna kari' bipra saṅge |*
*antaḥpure āsi' kṛṣṇasebā kare raṅge || 85+1 ||*

*Word for word:* raja — the king; godavari snana kari — having bathed in the Godavari; vipra sange — with the brahmanas; antahpure asi — coming to the inner apartments; krishna-seva kare range — joyfully serves Krishna

**85+1.** The king, having bathed in the Godavari with the brahmanas,
came to his inner apartments and joyfully serves Krishna.

প্রভু আসি' হেনকালে দ্বারে আগমন ।
পরম সুন্দর কান্তি মদনমোহন ॥ ৮৫+২ ॥

*prabhu āsi' henakāle dbāre āgamana |*
*parama sundara kānti madanamohana || 85+2 ||*

*Word for word:* prabhu asi — the Lord, coming; henakale — at this time; dvare agamana — arrival at the gate; parama sundara kanti — supremely beautiful radiance; madana-mohana — enchanter of Madana

**85+2.** At that time the Lord came to the gate —
His radiance supremely beautiful, the enchanter of Madana[^46-20].

রাজার দুয়ারে গিয়া দ্বারীকে কহিল ।
রাজপুত্র কোথা আছে নিভৃতে পুছিল ॥ ৮৬ ॥

*rājāra duẏāre giẏā dbārīke kahila |*
*rājaputra kothā āche nibhṛte puchila || 86 ||*

*Word for word:* rajara duyare giya — going to the king's gate; dvarike kahila — spoke to the doorkeeper; rajaputra kotha achhe — where is the prince; nibhrite puchhila — asked quietly

**86.** Coming to the king's gate, He spoke to the doorkeeper
and quietly asked: "Where is the prince?"[^46-21]

প্রভুকে দেখিয়া দ্বারী পরণাম করে ।
এই ভগবান্ হেন মনে মনে বোলে ॥ ৮৭ ॥

*prabhuke dekhiẏā dbārī paraṇāma kare |*
*ei bhagabān hena mane mane bole || 87 ||*

*Word for word:* prabhuke dekhiya — seeing the Lord; dvari paranama kare — the doorkeeper bows; ei bhagavan — this is Bhagavan; hena — thus; mane mane bole — says within himself

**87.** Seeing the Lord, the doorkeeper bows
and says within himself: "This is Bhagavan."

প্রভু কহে রাজপুত্রে জানাহ বচন ।
তাহার নিমিত্তে মোর এথা আগমন ॥ ৮৮ ॥

*prabhu kahe rājaputre jānāha bacana |*
*tāhāra nimitte mora ethā āgamana || 88 ||*

*Word for word:* prabhu kahe — the Lord says; rajaputre janaha vachana — give the prince the message; tahara nimitte — for his sake; mora etha agamana — My coming here

**88.** The Lord says: "Give the prince a message:
it is for his sake that I have come here."

চলিল ত দ্বারী রাজপুত্র যথা আছে ।
নিজ অন্তঃপুরে যথা দেবতা পূজিছে ॥ ৮৯ ॥

*calila ta dbārī rājaputra yathā āche |*
*nija antaḥpure yathā debatā pūjiche || 89 ||*

*Word for word:* chalila ta dvari — the doorkeeper went; rajaputra yatha achhe — where the prince is; nija antahpure — in his own inner apartments; yatha devata pujichhe — where he is worshipping the Deity

**89.** The doorkeeper went to where the prince was —
to his inner apartments, where he was worshipping the Deity.

প্রণাম করি' দ্বারী জানায় বচন ।
এক মহামতি গোসাঞি দ্বারে আগমন ॥ ৯০ ॥

*praṇāma kari' dbārī jānāẏa bacana |*
*eka mahāmati gosāñi dbāre āgamana || 90 ||*

*Word for word:* pranama kari — bowing; dvari janaya vachana — the doorkeeper gives the message; eka mahamati gosani — a gosani of great spirit; dvare agamana — has come to the gate

**90.** Bowing, the doorkeeper gives the message:
"A gosani of great spirit has come to the gate."

এ বোল শুনিঞা রাজা না বলিল কিছু ।
তরাসে দ্বারী সে পলাইয়া যায় পাছু ॥ ৯১ ॥

*e bola śuniñā rājā nā balila kichu |*
*tarāse dbārī se palāiẏā yāẏa pāchu || 91 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuninya — hearing these words; raja na balila kichhu — the king said nothing; tarase — in fear; dvari se palaiya yaya pachhu — the doorkeeper drew back

**91.** Hearing this, the king said nothing,
and the doorkeeper in fear drew back.

দ্বারেতে আসিয়া দ্বারী করে নিবেদন ।
জানাইতে না পারিল তোমার বচন ॥ ৯২ ॥

*dbārete āsiẏā dbārī kare nibedana |*
*jānāite nā pārila tomāra bacana || 92 ||*

*Word for word:* dvarete asiya — coming to the gate; dvari kare nivedana — the doorkeeper reports; janaite na parila — could not deliver; tomara vachana — Your message

**92.** Returning to the gate, the doorkeeper reports:
"I could not deliver Your message.

দেবতা পূজয়ে রাজা নিজ অন্তঃপুরে ।
কাহার শকতি তথা যাইবারে পারে ॥ ৯৩ ॥

*debatā pūjaẏe rājā nija antaḥpure |*
*kāhāra śakati tathā yāibāre pāre || 93 ||*

*Word for word:* devata pujaye raja — the king worships the Deity; nija antahpure — in his inner apartments; kahara shakati — whose power; tatha yaibare pare — can go there

**93.** The king is worshipping the Deity in his inner apartments —
who has the power to go in there?"

এ বোল শুনিয়া প্রভু হাসে মনে মনে ।
যথা পূজা করে তথা চলিলা আপনে ॥ ৯৪ ॥

*e bola śuniẏā prabhu hāse mane mane |*
*yathā pūjā kare tathā calilā āpane || 94 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuniya — hearing this; prabhu hase mane mane — the Lord smiles within Himself; yatha puja kare — where [he] worships; tatha chalila apane — there He went Himself

**94.** Hearing this, the Lord smiles within Himself
and went Himself to where [the king] is worshipping.

এক-অংশে দ্বারে রহে আর অংশে যায় ।
যথা পূজা করে সেই রামানন্দ রায় ॥ ৯৫ ॥

*eka-aṃśe dbāre rahe āra aṃśe yāẏa |*
*yathā pūjā kare sei rāmānanda rāẏa || 95 ||*

*Word for word:* eka-amshe — with one portion; dvare rahe — stays at the gate; ara amshe yaya — with another goes; yatha puja kare — where performs worship; sei ramananda raya — that Ramananda Raya

**95.** With one portion of Himself He stays at the gate, with another He goes
to where Ramananda Raya is worshipping[^46-22].

ধ্যান করয়ে কৃষ্ণ দেখে গৌরচন্দ্র ।
পুনরপি ধ্যান করে জপে মহামন্ত্র ॥ ৯৬ ॥

*dhyāna karaẏe kṛṣṇa dekhe gauracandra |*
*punarapi dhyāna kare jape mahāmantra || 96 ||*

*Word for word:* dhyana karaye krishna — meditates on Krishna; dekhe gaurachandra — sees Gaurachandra; punarapi dhyana kare — again meditates; jape mahamantra — chants the great mantra

**96.** [Ramananda] meditates on Krishna — and sees Gaurachandra;
again he meditates, chanting the great mantra —

পুনরপি সেই গৌর দেখয়ে নয়নে ।
কি হৈল কি হৈল বলি' গুণে মনে মনে ॥ ৯৭ ॥

*punarapi sei gaura dekhaẏe naẏane |*
*ki haila ki haila bali' guṇe mane mane || 97 ||*

*Word for word:* punarapi — again; sei gaura dekhaye nayane — sees that Gaura with his eyes; ki haila ki haila bali — saying "what is this? what is this?"; gune mane mane — ponders within himself

**97.** and again he sees that same Gaura before his eyes.
"What is this? What is this?" he wonders within himself.

পুনরপি ধ্যান করে সুদৃঢ়-হিয়ায় ।
পুনরপি গৌরচন্দ্র হিয়ায় সান্ধায় ॥ ৯৮ ॥

*punarapi dhyāna kare sudṛṛha-hiẏāẏa |*
*punarapi gauracandra hiẏāẏa sāndhāẏa || 98 ||*

*Word for word:* punarapi dhyana kare — again he meditates; sudridha-hiyaya — with a firm heart; punarapi gaurachandra — again Gaurachandra; hiyaya sandhaya — enters the heart

**98.** Again he meditates with a steadfast heart —
and again Gaurachandra enters his heart.

কি কি বলি' আঁখি মেলি' চাহে চারিভিতে ।
গৌরচন্দ্র ন্যাসিবর দেখে আচম্বিতে ॥ ৯৯ ॥

*ki ki bali' āṁkhi meli' cāhe cāribhite |*
*gauracandra nyāsibara dekhe ācambite || 99 ||*

*Word for word:* ki ki bali — saying "what? what?"; ankhi meli — opening his eyes; chahe charibhite — looks all around; gaurachandra nyasivara — Gaurachandra, best of sannyasis; dekhe achambite — suddenly sees

**99.** "What? What?" he says, opens his eyes and looks all around —
and suddenly sees Gaurachandra, the best of sannyasis[^46-23].

সন্ন্যাসী দেখিয়া রাজা উঠিলা সম্ভ্রমে ।
চরণবন্দনা করি' নেহারয়ে ক্রমে ॥ ১০০ ॥

*sannyāsī dekhiẏā rājā uṭhilā sambhrame |*
*caraṇabandanā kari' nehāraẏe krame || 100 ||*

*Word for word:* sannyasi dekhiya — seeing the sannyasi; raja uthila sambhrame — the king rose in awe; charana-vandana kari — bowing to the feet; neharaye krame — gazes unhurriedly

**100.** Seeing the sannyasi, the king rose in awe,
bowed at His feet and gazes at [Him] unhurriedly.

আপাদ-মস্তক প্রভুর নেহারয়ে অঙ্গ ।
গৌর-অঙ্গ দেখি' হিয়ায় উপজিল রঙ্গ ॥ ১০১ ॥

*āpāda-mastaka prabhura nehāraẏe aṅga |*
*gaura-aṅga dekhi' hiẏāẏa upajila raṅga || 101 ||*

*Word for word:* apada-mastaka — from foot to head; prabhura neharaye anga — gazes at the Lord's body; gaura-anga dekhi — seeing the golden body; hiyaya upajila ranga — joy arose in his heart

**101.** From head to foot he gazes at the Lord's body;
seeing the golden body, joy arose in his heart.

বিস্ময় লাগিল ন্যাসী আইলা কেমতে ।
প্রভুরে কহয়ে কিছু হাসিতে হাসিতে ॥ ১০২ ॥

*bismaẏa lāgila nyāsī āilā kemate |*
*prabhure kahaẏe kichu hāsite hāsite || 102 ||*

*Word for word:* vismaya lagila — amazement seized him; nyasi aila kemate — how did the sannyasi come; prabhure kahaye kichhu — says something to the Lord; hasite hasite — smiling

**102.** He was amazed: how did the sannyasi come in?
Smiling, he says to the Lord:

মোর অভ্যন্তরে তুমি আইলা কেমনে ।
বড়ভাগ্যে দেখিলাম তোমার চরণে ॥ ১০৩ ॥

*mora abhyantare tumi āilā kemane |*
*baṛabhāgye dekhilāma tomāra caraṇe || 103 ||*

*Word for word:* mora abhyantare — into my apartments; tumi aila kemane — how did You come; bada-bhagye — by great fortune; dekhilama tomara charane — I have seen Your feet

**103.** "How did You enter my apartments?
By great fortune I have seen Your feet."

প্রভু কহে তুমি কেনে না চিন আপনা ।
আমারে না চিন আমি নিতে আইলুঁ তোমা ॥ ১০৪ ॥

*prabhu kahe tumi kene nā cina āpanā |*
*āmāre nā cina āmi nite āiluṁ tomā || 104 ||*

*Word for word:* prabhu kahe — the Lord says; tumi kene na china apana — why do you not know yourself; amare na china — you do not know Me; ami nite ailun toma — I have come to take you

**104.** The Lord says: "Why do you not know your own self?
You do not recognize Me — and I have come to take you."

এইরূপে বোলে প্রভু মধুর বচনে ।
আমারে না চিন আমি নন্দের নন্দনে ॥ ১০৪+১ ॥

*eirūpe bole prabhu madhura bacane |*
*āmāre nā cina āmi nandera nandane || 104+1 ||*

*Word for word:* ei-rupe — thus; bole prabhu — the Lord speaks; madhura vachane — in sweet words; amare na china — you do not know Me; ami nandera nandane — I am the son of Nanda

**104+1.** Thus the Lord speaks in sweet words:
"You do not recognize Me — I am the son of Nanda."

এ বোল শুনিয়া রাজা ছলছল আঁখি ।
সেইরূপ দেখাও তবে হিয়া পায় সাক্ষী ॥ ১০৪+২ ॥

*e bola śuniẏā rājā chalachala āṁkhi |*
*seirūpa dekhāo tabe hiẏā pāẏa sākṣī || 104+2 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuniya — hearing this; raja chhalachhala ankhi — the king, eyes brimming; seirupa dekhao — show that form; tabe hiya paya sakshi — then the heart will have a witness

**104+2.** Hearing this, the king, his eyes brimming with tears, [says]:
"Then show me that form — so my heart will have a witness"[^46-24].

এ বোল শুনিঞা প্রভু অট্ট অট্ট হাস ।
আপনা চিনায় প্রভু করে পরকাশ ॥ ১০৫ ॥

*e bola śuniñā prabhu aṭṭa aṭṭa hāsa |*
*āpanā cināẏa prabhu kare parakāśa || 105 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuninya — hearing this; prabhu atta atta hasa — the Lord laughed aloud; apana chinaya — makes Himself known; prabhu kare parakasha — the Lord reveals [Himself]

**105.** Hearing this, the Lord laughed aloud;
the Lord makes Himself known and reveals Himself.

যে ছিল সেখানে কৃষ্ণ-শ্বেত-রক্ত-দ্যুতি ।
সকল দেখায় এক গৌর-মূরতি ॥ ১০৬ ॥

*ye chila sekhāne kṛṣṇa-śbeta-rakta-dyuti |*
*sakala dekhāẏa eka gaura-mūrati || 106 ||*

*Word for word:* ye chhila sekhane — whatever was there; krishna-shveta-rakta-dyuti — of dark, white, red hue; sakala dekhaya — all appears; eka gaura-murati — as one golden form

**106.** All that was there — dark, white, red —
everything appears as one golden form.

কষিত এ দশবাণ কাঞ্চন-বরণ ।
তাহা ছাড়ি' হৈলা প্রভু শ্যাম-সুচিক্কণ ॥ ১০৭ ॥

*kaṣita e daśabāṇa kāñcana-baraṇa |*
*tāhā chāṛi' hailā prabhu śyāma-sucikkaṇa || 107 ||*

*Word for word:* kashita — tested [on the touchstone]; e dashabana kanchana-varana — this colour of gold of "ten-fold" purity; taha chhari — leaving it; haila prabhu — the Lord became; shyama-suchikkana — dark and glossy

**107.** That colour of tested, purest gold
the Lord gave up — and became dark and glossy.

কানড়া-কুসুমাকৃতি অঙ্গের বরণ ।
ময়ূর-শিখণ্ড শিরে মুরলীবদন ॥ ১০৮ ॥

*kānaṛā-kusumākṛti aṅgera baraṇa |*
*maẏūra-śikhaṇḍa śire muralībadana || 108 ||*

*Word for word:* kanada-kusumakriti — like the kanada flower; angera varana — the colour of the body; mayura-shikhanda shire — a peacock feather on the head; murali-vadana — a flute at the lips

**108.** His body has the colour of the kanada flower,
a peacock feather on His head, a flute at His lips.

নানা আভরণ অঙ্গে চিকণিয়া কালা ।
পীতবস্ত্র পরিধান গলে বনমালা ॥ ১০৯ ॥

*nānā ābharaṇa aṅge cikaṇiẏā kālā |*
*pītabastra paridhāna gale banamālā || 109 ||*

*Word for word:* nana abharana ange — various ornaments on the body; chikaniya kala — lustrous black; pita-vastra paridhana — dressed in yellow garments; gale vanamala — a forest garland on the neck

**109.** Various ornaments on His body, He is lustrous black,
dressed in yellow garments, a forest garland on His neck.

তাহা দেখি' মহারাজ আনন্দিত মন ।
পুনরপি হৈলা প্রভু গৌরবরণ ॥ ১১০ ॥

*tāhā dekhi' mahārāja ānandita mana |*
*punarapi hailā prabhu gaurabaraṇa || 110 ||*

*Word for word:* taha dekhi — seeing this; maharaja anandita mana — the maharaja rejoices at heart; punarapi — again; haila prabhu gaura-varana — the Lord became golden in colour

**110.** Seeing this, the maharaja rejoiced at heart,
and the Lord became golden once more[^46-25].

পশু পক্ষী বৃক্ষ আর যত লতা পাতা ।
গৌর-অঙ্গ-ছটায় ঝলমল করে তথা ॥ ১১১ ॥

*paśu pakṣī bṛkṣa āra yata latā pātā |*
*gaura-aṅga-chaṭāẏa jhalamala kare tathā || 111 ||*

*Word for word:* pashu pakshi vriksha — beasts, birds, trees; ara yata lata pata — and all creepers and leaves; gaura-anga-chhataya — in the radiance of the golden body; jhalamala kare tatha — glitter there

**111.** Beasts, birds, trees, and all the creepers and leaves
glitter there in the radiance of the golden body.

দেখিয়া জানিল কাজ রামানন্দ রায় ।
প্রেমায় বিহ্বল ধরে নিজ-প্রভু-পায় ॥ ১১২ ॥

*dekhiẏā jānila kāja rāmānanda rāẏa |*
*premāẏa bihbala dhare nija-prabhu-pāẏa || 112 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhiya — seeing; janila kaja — understood the matter; ramananda raya — Ramananda Raya; premaya vihvala — overcome with prema; dhare nija-prabhu-paya — clasps the feet of his Lord

**112.** Seeing this, Ramananda Raya understood what it was:
overcome with prema, he clasped the feet of his Lord.

পুনর্বার হৈলা প্রভু শ্যাম-কলেবর ।
ত্রিভঙ্গ মুরলীমুখ পীতাম্বরধর ॥ ১১২+১ ॥

*punarbāra hailā prabhu śyāma-kalebara |*
*tribhaṅga muralīmukha pītāmbaradhara || 112+1 ||*

*Word for word:* punarvara — again; haila prabhu shyama-kalevara — the Lord took a dark body; tribhanga — thrice-bent; murali-mukha — a flute at His lips; pitambara-dhara — wearing yellow garments

**112+1.** Again the Lord took a dark body —
thrice-bent, a flute at His lips, wearing yellow garments.

রাধা বামে পরমা সুন্দরী মহাজ্যোতি ।
চৌদিকে বেড়িয়া গোপী বরাঙ্গ-যুবতী ॥ ১১২+২ ॥

*rādhā bāme paramā sundarī mahājyoti |*
*caudike beṛiẏā gopī barāṅga-yubatī || 112+2 ||*

*Word for word:* radha vame — Radha on the left; parama sundari — a supreme beauty; maha-jyoti — a great radiance; chaudike bediya — surrounding on all sides; gopi varanga-yuvati — the gopis, young maidens of lovely form

**112+2.** On His left is Radha, a supreme beauty, a great radiance;
all around are the gopis, young maidens of lovely form.

বৃন্দাবনে রতন-মন্দির-সিংহাসনে ।
দেখে রাজা পরম আনন্দ রাধা-সনে ॥ ১১২+৩ ॥

*bṛndābane ratana-mandira-siṃhāsane |*
*dekhe rājā parama ānanda rādhā-sane || 112+3 ||*

*Word for word:* vrindavane — in Vrindavana; ratana-mandira-simhasane — on a throne in a jewelled temple; dekhe raja — the king sees; parama ananda — supreme bliss; radha-sane — with Radha

**112+3.** In Vrindavana, in a temple of jewels, on a throne,
the king sees [Him] — supreme bliss — with Radha.

পুনর্বার হৈলা প্রভু গৌরাঙ্গ-মূরতি ।
অরুণ-অম্বর অঙ্গে যেন মহামতি ॥ ১১২+৪ ॥

*punarbāra hailā prabhu gaurāṅga-mūrati |*
*aruṇa-ambara aṅge yena mahāmati || 112+4 ||*

*Word for word:* punarvara — again; haila prabhu gauranga-murati — the Lord took the golden form; aruna-ambara ange — red garments on the body; yena mahamati — like a great sage

**112+4.** Again the Lord took on His golden form —
red garments on His body, as on a great sage[^46-26].

চরণে পড়িয়া কান্দে অবশ শরীর ।
করে ধরি' লঞা প্রভু ভৈ গেলা বাহির ॥ ১১৩ ॥

*caraṇe paṛiẏā kānde abaśa śarīra |*
*kare dhari' lañā prabhu bhai gelā bāhira || 113 ||*

*Word for word:* charane pariya — falling at the feet; kande — weeps; abasha sharira — body powerless; kare dhari — taking by the hand; lanya prabhu — the Lord, taking [him]; bhai gela bahira — went outside

**113.** Fallen at [His] feet, [Ramananda] weeps, his body powerless;
taking him by the hand, the Lord went outside [with him].

এ প্রকাশ দেখিল সে রাজা আচম্বিত ।
দশদিন ছিল প্রভু রাজার সহিত ॥ ১১৩+১ ॥

*e prakāśa dekhila se rājā ācambita |*
*daśadina chila prabhu rājāra sahita || 113+1 ||*

*Word for word:* e prakasha — this manifestation; dekhila se raja — the king beheld; achambita — unexpectedly; dashadina chhila prabhu — ten days the Lord stayed; rajara sahita — with the king

**113+1.** Such a manifestation the king beheld unexpectedly;
ten days the Lord stayed with the king.

অনেক হৈল কৃষ্ণকথা তার সনে ।
বিস্তারি' কহিতে তাহা অনন্ত না জানে ॥ ১১৩+২ ॥

*aneka haila kṛṣṇakathā tāra sane |*
*bistāri' kahite tāhā ananta nā jāne || 113+2 ||*

*Word for word:* aneka haila krishna-katha — there were many talks about Krishna; tara sane — with him; vistari kahite taha — to tell them in full; ananta na jane — Ananta does not know [how]

**113+2.** Many were their talks about Krishna;
even Ananta does not know how to retell them in full.

অনন্ত চৈতন্যলীলা বেদ-অগোচর ।
কোনো লীলা কোনো ভক্ত করেন বিস্তার ॥ ১১৩+৩ ॥

*ananta caitanyalīlā beda-agocara |*
*kono līlā kono bhakta karena bistāra || 113+3 ||*

*Word for word:* ananta chaitanya-lila — endless are the lilas of Chaitanya; veda-agochara — beyond the reach of the Vedas; kono lila — some lila; kono bhakta karena vistara — some devotee describes at length

**113+3.** Endless are the lilas of Chaitanya, beyond the reach of the Vedas;
some lila one devotee or another describes at length.

আদ্যোপান্ত কহিতে শকতি আছে কার ।
লিখিতে লিখিতে গ্রন্থ হয় ত বিস্তার ॥ ১১৩+৪ ॥

*ādyopānta kahite śakati āche kāra |*
*likhite likhite grantha haẏa ta bistāra || 113+4 ||*

*Word for word:* adyopanta kahite — to tell from beginning to end; shakati achhe kara — who has the power; likhite likhite — as one writes and writes; grantha haya ta vistara — the book grows

**113+4.** Who has the power to tell everything from beginning to end?
As one writes and writes, the book only grows[^46-27].

রায় রামানন্দে আর প্রভুতে মিলন ।
গোরা-গুণগাথা গায় এ দাস লোচন ॥ ১১৪ ॥

*rāẏa rāmānande āra prabhute milana |*
*gorā-guṇagāthā gāẏa e dāsa locana || 114 ||*

*Word for word:* raya ramanande ara prabhute milana — the meeting of Ramananda Raya and the Lord; gora-guna-gatha — the song of Gora's virtues; gaya — sings; e dasa lochana — this Lochana Dasa

**114.** The meeting of Ramananda Raya and the Lord —
a song of the virtues of Gora; this Lochana Dasa sings it.

[^46-1]: Rasaraja ("king of rasa", Krishna) and Mahabhava (Radha) in one form. According to the Chaitanya-charitamrita (Madhya 8), at the end of the talks on the Godavari the Lord showed Ramananda just this form; in Lochana Dasa (vv. 105–110) the Lord shows the form of Krishna, and in the 1983 edition Krishna with Radha.
[^46-2]: On Narahari and Gadadhara see en/24, v. 1. In the 1983 edition the Shesha-khanda is divided into chapters; chapter 1 bears the same title as Bhaktisiddhanta's section: "The Lord's Journey to the South."
[^46-3]: Kurma-kshetra (Shrikurmam) is a shrine of Vishnu in the form of the Tortoise on the coast south of Orissa. Vv. 3–14 — cf. Murari 3.13–3.14.13–20 and the Chaitanya-charitamrita (Madhya 7): the brahmana Kurma receives the Lord at his home, and the leper brahmana Vasudeva is healed by His embrace. Lochana Dasa does not mention leprosy; "became pure" (v. 6) may hint at the healing.
[^46-4]: Cf. Murari 3.14.19 and the Chaitanya-charitamrita (Madhya 7.128): "Whomever you meet, instruct him about Krishna."
[^46-5]: Jiyada-Nrisimha is the Deity of Varaha-Nrisimha at Simhachalam, near Vishakhapatnam. The Lord tells the tale of this Deity (vv. 16–81) also in Murari (3.14.21–32), more briefly; in the Chaitanya-charitamrita (Madhya 8) the Lord only visits Him.
[^46-6]: "Punda" — in Murari (3.14.23) "Pundaya"; it may be not a name but the name of a caste. The words "shasa" (in the 1983 edition "shasha", apparently cucumbers) and "mayambu" (so too in Murari) are unclear; they are given as they read.
[^46-7]: Vv. 22+1 — 22+2 are found only in the 1983 edition; the 1903 edition gives them only in a footnote, as an additional reading of one manuscript. The 1983 edition reads the second line of v. 22: "To whom shall I entrust the guarding of the crop?"
[^46-8]: Vv. 23+1 — 23+3 are found only in the 1983 edition; the 1903 edition gives them only in a footnote, as an additional reading of one manuscript.
[^46-9]: The boar is the Lord Himself in the form of Varaha; by the name of Rama which He utters the cowherd recognizes Bhagavan (v. 30). Cf. Murari 3.14.24–25.
[^46-10]: The sense of the first line is not quite clear; we understand: "you wounded Me, and I ate your crop — we are quits."
[^46-11]: Vv. 41+1 — 41+2 are found only in the 1983 edition; the 1903 edition gives them only in a footnote, as an additional reading of one manuscript.
[^46-12]: Vv. 42+1 — 42+2 are found only in the 1983 edition; the 1903 edition gives them partly in a footnote, as an additional reading of one manuscript. "Your body is My body" are words of the Lord's love for His devotee (cf. Bhagavata 9.4.68: "The sadhus are My heart, and I am their heart"), not a doctrine of the identity of the soul and God.
[^46-13]: Vv. 59+1 — 59+5 are found only in the 1983 edition; the 1903 edition gives them only in a footnote, as an additional reading of one manuscript. The thought that a devotee is not judged by birth is constant in Lochana Dasa and in all Gaudiya Vaishnavas.
[^46-14]: Cf. Murari 3.14.26–28: at the Lord's word the place is sprinkled with milk, and He reveals His form. The body of the Deity rises out of the earth up to the knees; the feet remain hidden.
[^46-15]: Vv. 71+1 — 71+4 are found only in the 1983 edition; the 1903 edition gives them only in a footnote, as an additional reading of one manuscript.
[^46-16]: Vv. 72+1 — 72+12 are found only in the 1983 edition; the 1903 edition gives them only in a footnote, as an additional reading of one manuscript. Cf. the wives of the brahmanas (yajna-patnis) who went to Krishna in spite of their husbands' prohibition (Bhagavata 10.23): devotion to Krishna stands above worldly ties, and a righteous husband accepts it as his good fortune.
[^46-17]: V. 77+1 is found only in the 1983 edition; the 1903 edition gives it only in a footnote, as an additional reading of one manuscript. The tale of the wives who turned to stone at the feet of the Deity is a local legend; in Murari (3.14.29–30) the merchant comes with one wife, and nothing is said of her fate. Attaining Krishna as Husband (pati) is no worldly bond: Krishna is the true Lord and Beloved of every soul.
[^46-18]: So too in Murari (3.14.31–32): the merchant asks that the Lord bear his name — "for Hari is ever subject to His devotees."
[^46-19]: So in A and C and in Murari (3.15.1). The 1983 edition reads Vidyanagara (in v. 84 too), as in the Chaitanya-charitamrita (Madhya 8), where Ramananda is governor of a province on the Godavari under King Prataparudra, and the Lord meets him on the bank of the Godavari. Kanchi (Kanchipuram) lies much farther south; in Lochana Dasa the Lord only afterwards goes "by way of the Godavari" to Panchavati (v. 116).
[^46-20]: Vv. 85+1 — 85+2 are found only in the 1983 edition; the 1903 edition gives them only in a footnote (after v. 86), as an additional reading of one manuscript.
[^46-21]: Ramananda Raya, son of Bhavananda Raya, was a high nobleman of Orissa; Lochana Dasa calls him now "prince" (rajaputra), now "king".
[^46-22]: While remaining at the gate, the Lord at the same time appears to Ramananda in the inner apartments: He can be present in many places at once (cf. Krishna's presence in every palace of Dvaraka, Bhagavata 10.69). "Portion" (amsha) here is not a part cut off from the whole: the Lord is fully present in each of His manifestations.
[^46-23]: Vv. 96–99 — cf. Murari 3.15.2–3: having finished his worship of Krishna, Ramananda contemplates the son of the king of Vraja and three times sees the form of Gauranga, and on opening his eyes he sees Him before him.
[^46-24]: Vv. 104+1 — 104+2 are found only in the 1983 edition; the 1903 edition gives them only in a footnote, as an additional reading of one manuscript and of a printed edition. In Murari (3.15.4) the Lord says: "How is it that you do not remember, O bee at the lotus feet of Sri Radhika?"
[^46-25]: The 1903 edition gives vv. 107–110 only in a footnote, as an additional reading of one manuscript and of a printed edition. The kanada flower is apparently a dark-blue flower (commelina) to which Krishna's colour is compared. According to the Chaitanya-charitamrita (Madhya 8), Ramananda first sees the Lord as a dark cowherd boy, and then the Lord reveals to him the form of Rasaraja and Mahabhava — Krishna and Radha in one body.
[^46-26]: Vv. 112+1 — 112+4 are found only in the 1983 edition; the 1903 edition gives them in a footnote, as an additional reading of one manuscript (with one more couplet about the weeping queens). The vision of Radha and Krishna on a throne in the jewelled temple of Vrindavana is a vision of the eternal, transcendental lila of the Divine Couple. Red garments are the garments of a sannyasi.
[^46-27]: Vv. 113+1 — 113+4 are found only in the 1983 edition; they are absent from the 1903 edition. In the Chaitanya-charitamrita (Madhya 8) the Lord likewise spends several days and nights with Ramananda in talks about Krishna, and Krishnadasa Kaviraja relates these talks in detail.

---

# Shesha-khanda, part 2 (portion 47)

*The end of the section "The Lord's Journey to the South": Panchavati; Ranganatha and Trimalla Bhatta; the meeting with Paramananda Puri and the prophecy of Madhavendra Puri. The section "The Lord Sees Vrindavana": the deliverance of the seven palms, Setubandha, the return to Puri; Nrisimhananda paves a road in his mind; the journey to Mathura through Kashi and Prayaga, the meeting with Rupa and Sanatana; the brahmana Krishnadasa and his account of the twelve forests*

*Raga shri; disha: "He takes away sins, torments and the fear of Yama. Glory to the son of Shachi, glory, glory!"*

তবে মহাপ্রভু সেই আনন্দ-কৌতুকে ।
চলিতে আনন্দ দেহ ভরিল পুলকে ॥ ১১৫ ॥

*tabe mahāprabhu sei ānanda-kautuke |*
*calite ānanda deha bharila pulake || 115 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe — then; mahaprabhu — Mahaprabhu; sei ananda-kautuke — in that joyful play; chalite — as He walks; ananda — in bliss; deha bharila pulake — the body was filled with thrill

**115.** Then Mahaprabhu, in that joyful play,
walks on — and His body in bliss was filled with thrill.

এইমতে ক্রমে ক্রমে পথে চলি' যায় ।
গোদাবরী করি' পঞ্চবটীতে সান্ধায় ॥ ১১৬ ॥

*eimate krame krame pathe cali' yāẏa |*
*godābarī kari' pañcabaṭīte sāndhāẏa || 116 ||*

*Word for word:* eimate — thus; krame krame — step by step; pathe chali yaya — goes along the road; godavari kari — by way of the Godavari; panchavatite sandhaya — enters Panchavati

**116.** Thus, step by step, He walks along the road
and by way of the Godavari enters Panchavati[^47-1].

এই মহা-পুণ্যতীর্থ পঞ্চবটী নাম ।
যাহাতে আছিলা সীতা লক্ষ্মণ শ্রীরাম ॥ ১১৭ ॥

*ei mahā-puṇyatīrtha pañcabaṭī nāma |*
*yāhāte āchilā sītā lakṣmaṇa śrīrāma || 117 ||*

*Word for word:* ei maha-punya-tirtha — this great holy place; panchavati nama — named Panchavati; yahate achhila — where lived; sita lakshmana shrirama — Sita, Lakshmana, Sri Rama

**117.** This great holy place named Panchavati —
there Sita, Lakshmana and Sri Rama lived.

পঞ্চবটী দেখি' প্রভু প্রেমে অচেতন ।
শ্রীরাম লক্ষ্মণ বলি' ডাকে ঘন ঘন ॥ ১১৮ ॥

*pañcabaṭī dekhi' prabhu preme acetana |*
*śrīrāma lakṣmaṇa bali' ḍāke ghana ghana || 118 ||*

*Word for word:* panchavati dekhi — seeing Panchavati; prabhu preme achetana — the Lord senseless in prema; shrirama lakshmana bali — saying "Sri Rama! Lakshmana!"; dake ghana ghana — calls again and again

**118.** Seeing Panchavati, the Lord lost consciousness in prema
and again and again calls: "Sri Rama! Lakshmana!"

এইখানে কুঁড়েঘর বান্ধিলা লক্ষ্মণ ।
মৃগী মারিবারে রাম করিলা গমন ॥ ১১৯ ॥

*eikhāne kuṁṛeghara bāndhilā lakṣmaṇa |*
*mṛgī māribāre rāma karilā gamana || 119 ||*

*Word for word:* eikhane — here; kundeghara bandhila lakshmana — Lakshmana built a hut; mrigi maribare — to kill the deer; rama karila gamana — Rama went

**119.** "Here Lakshmana built a hut;
from here Rama went to kill the deer.

শ্রীরাম-উদ্দেশে পাছে চলিলা লক্ষ্মণ ।
এইখানে সীতা হরি' নিলেক রাবণ ॥ ১২০ ॥

*śrīrāma-uddeśe pāche calilā lakṣmaṇa |*
*eikhāne sītā hari' nileka rābaṇa || 120 ||*

*Word for word:* shrirama-uddeshe — in search of Sri Rama; pachhe chalila lakshmana — Lakshmana went after; eikhane — here; sita hari nileka ravana — Ravana carried off Sita

**120.** After Sri Rama went Lakshmana —
and here Ravana carried off Sita."

ইহা বলি' কান্দে প্রভু প্রেমায় বিহ্বল ।
মার্ মার্ বোলে ক্ষণে বোলে ধর্ ধর্ ॥ ১২১ ॥

*ihā bali' kānde prabhu premāẏa bihbala |*
*mār mār bole kṣaṇe bole dhar dhar || 121 ||*

*Word for word:* iha bali — saying this; kande prabhu — the Lord weeps; premaya vihvala — overcome with prema; mar mar bole — cries "strike, strike"; kshane bole dhar dhar — now cries "seize, seize"

**121.** Saying this, the Lord weeps, overcome with prema;
now He cries: "Strike! Strike!", now He cries: "Seize him! Seize him!"

লক্ষ্মণ লক্ষ্মণ বলি' ডাকে উভরায় ।
সীতা সঙরিয়া কান্দে অবশ-হিয়ায় ॥ ১২২ ॥

*lakṣmaṇa lakṣmaṇa bali' ḍāke ubharāẏa |*
*sītā saṅariẏā kānde abaśa-hiẏāẏa || 122 ||*

*Word for word:* lakshmana lakshmana bali — saying "Lakshmana! Lakshmana!"; dake ubharaya — calls loudly; sita sanariya — remembering Sita; kande abasha-hiyaya — weeps with a fainting heart

**122.** Loudly He calls: "Lakshmana! Lakshmana!" —
and remembering Sita, weeps with a fainting heart[^47-2].

সঙ্গের সঙ্গতিগণ প্রবোধিতে নারে ।
আপনেই মহাপ্রভু আপনা সম্বরে ॥ ১২৩ ॥

*saṅgera saṅgatigaṇa prabodhite nāre |*
*āpanei mahāprabhu āpanā sambare || 123 ||*

*Word for word:* sangera sangatigana — the companions with Him; prabodhite nare — cannot console; apanei mahaprabhu — Mahaprabhu Himself; apana sambare — composes Himself

**123.** The companions who were with Him cannot console Him;
Mahaprabhu Himself regains His composure.

তবে আর দিন পথে চলিলা ঠাকুর ।
ক্রমে ক্রমে উত্তরিলা কাবেরীর তীর ॥ ১২৪ ॥

*tabe āra dina pathe calilā ṭhākura |*
*krame krame uttarilā kāberīra tīra || 124 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe ara dina — then on another day; pathe chalila thakura — the Thakura went along the road; krame krame — little by little; uttarila kaverira tira — reached the bank of the Kaveri

**124.** Then, on another day, the Thakura went along the road
and little by little reached the bank of the Kaveri.

কাবেরীর কূলে দেখে শ্রীরঙ্গনাথ ।
দেখিয়া প্রেমায় নাচে নিজজন-সাথ ॥ ১২৫ ॥

*kāberīra kūle dekhe śrīraṅganātha |*
*dekhiẏā premāẏa nāce nijajana-sātha || 125 ||*

*Word for word:* kaverira kule — on the bank of the Kaveri; dekhe shriranganatha — sees Sri Ranganatha; dekhiya — seeing; premaya nache — dances in prema; nijajana-satha — with His own people

**125.** On the bank of the Kaveri He sees Sri Ranganatha;
seeing Him, He dances in prema with His own people.

তথায় ত্রিমল্ল ভট্ট ঠাকুরে দেখিয়া ।
নিরীখয়ে গৌর-অঙ্গ বিস্মিত হইয়া ॥ ১২৬ ॥

*tathāẏa trimalla bhaṭṭa ṭhākure dekhiẏā |*
*nirīkhaẏe gaura-aṅga bismita haiẏā || 126 ||*

*Word for word:* tathaya — there; trimalla bhatta — Trimalla Bhatta; thakure dekhiya — seeing the Thakura; nirikhaye gaura-anga — gazes at the golden body; vismita haiya — in amazement

**126.** There Trimalla Bhatta, seeing the Thakura,
gazes in amazement at the golden body.

দেহের কিরণ আর প্রেমার আরম্ভ ।
কদম্বকেশর জিনি' পুলক-কদম্ব ॥ ১২৭ ॥

*dehera kiraṇa āra premāra ārambha |*
*kadambakeśara jini' pulaka-kadamba || 127 ||*

*Word for word:* dehera kirana — the radiance of the body; ara premara arambha — and the surges of prema; kadamba-keshara jini — surpassing kadamba filaments; pulaka-kadamba — clusters of hairs standing on end

**127.** The radiance of His body and the surges of prema!
His hairs standing on end in thrill outdo the filaments of the kadamba.

সর্বলোক জিনি' তনু যেহেন সুমেরু ।
প্রেম-ফল-ফুলে ফলিয়াছে কল্পতরু ॥ ১২৮ ॥

*sarbaloka jini' tanu yehena sumeru |*
*prema-phala-phule phaliẏāche kalpataru || 128 ||*

*Word for word:* sarvaloka jini — surpassing all people; tanu yehena sumeru — the body like Sumeru; prema-phala-phule — with fruits and flowers of prema; phaliyachhe kalpataru — the wish-fulfilling tree bears fruit

**128.** His body towers over all people like Sumeru —
a wish-fulfilling tree laden with the fruits and flowers of prema.

হরি হরি বলি' ডাকে অতি উচ্চনাদে ।
দেখিয়া চৌদিগ ভরি' সব লোক কান্দে ॥ ১২৯ ॥

*hari hari bali' ḍāke ati uccanāde |*
*dekhiẏā caudiga bhari' saba loka kānde || 129 ||*

*Word for word:* hari hari bali — saying "Hari! Hari!"; dake ati uchchanade — calls very loudly; dekhiya — seeing; chaudiga bhari — filling all sides; saba loka kande — all the people weep

**129.** "Hari! Hari!" He calls in a loud voice;
seeing this, all the people who crowd round on every side weep.

এছন দেখিয়া সে ত্রিমল্ল ভট্টাচার্য ।
কৌতুকে সকল কথা জানিল আশ্চর্য ॥ ১৩০ ॥

*echana dekhiẏā se trimalla bhaṭṭācārya |*
*kautuke sakala kathā jānila āścarya || 130 ||*

*Word for word:* echhana dekhiya — seeing such things; se trimalla bhattacharya — that Trimalla Bhattacharya; kautuke — in wonder; sakala katha janila — grasped the whole matter; ashcharya — marvellous

**130.** Seeing such things, that Trimalla Bhattacharya
in wonder grasped the whole marvellous matter:

এই সেই ভগবান্ কভু নহে আন ।
নিশ্চয় জানিল এই সর্বজন-প্রাণ ॥ ১৩১ ॥

*ei sei bhagabān kabhu nahe āna |*
*niścaẏa jānila ei sarbajana-prāṇa || 131 ||*

*Word for word:* ei sei bhagavan — this is Bhagavan Himself; kabhu nahe ana — never anyone else; nishchaya janila — he knew for certain; ei sarvajana-prana — this is the life of all

**131.** "This is Bhagavan Himself — no one else!"
He knew for certain: this is the life of all beings.

এতেক জানিয়া সে ত্রিমল্ল-ভট্টরায় ।
আপন আশ্রমে সে প্রভুরে লঞা যায় ॥ ১৩২ ॥

*eteka jāniẏā se trimalla-bhaṭṭarāẏa |*
*āpana āśrame se prabhure lañā yāẏa || 132 ||*

*Word for word:* eteka janiya — knowing this; se trimalla-bhattaraya — that Trimalla Bhatta Raya; apana ashrame — to his own dwelling; se prabhure lanya yaya — takes the Lord

**132.** Knowing this, Trimalla Bhatta Raya
takes the Lord to his own dwelling[^47-3].

তার বাড়ী গেলা প্রভু প্রথম আষাঢ়ে ।
সর্বজীবে কৃষ্ণভক্তি দিনে দিনে বাঢ়ে ॥ ১৩২+১ ॥

*tāra bāṛī gelā prabhu prathama āṣāṛhe |*
*sarbajībe kṛṣṇabhakti dine dine bāṛhe || 132+1 ||*

*Word for word:* tara badi gela prabhu — the Lord went to his house; prathama ashadhe — at the start of Ashadha; sarvajive — in all beings; krishna-bhakti — devotion to Krishna; dine dine badhe — grows day by day

**132+1.** The Lord came to his house at the beginning of [the month of] Ashadha;
in all beings devotion to Krishna grows from day to day.

সেইখানে রথযাত্রা কৈল দরশন ।
রথ-অগ্রে নৃত্য কৈল শ্রীশচীনন্দন ॥ ১৩২+২ ॥

*seikhāne rathayātrā kaila daraśana |*
*ratha-agre nṛtya kaila śrīśacīnandana || 132+2 ||*

*Word for word:* seikhane — there; ratha-yatra kaila darashana — He saw the Ratha-yatra; ratha-agre — before the chariot; nritya kaila — danced; shri-shachinandana — Sri Shachinandana

**132+2.** There He saw the Ratha-yatra,
and Sri Shachinandana danced before the chariot.

শ্রাবণে থাকিয়া প্রভু করিল ঝুলনা ।
নাম-গুণ-সংকীর্তনে নাচে সর্বজনা ॥ ১৩২+৩ ॥

*śrābaṇe thākiẏā prabhu karila jhulanā |*
*nāma-guṇa-saṃkīrtane nāce sarbajanā || 132+3 ||*

*Word for word:* shravane thakiya — staying in Shravana; prabhu karila jhulana — the Lord celebrated the swing festival; nama-guna-sankirtane — in the sankirtana of names and qualities; nache sarvajana — all dance

**132+3.** Staying [there] in Shravana, the Lord celebrated the swing festival;
all dance in the sankirtana of [the Lord's] names and qualities.

ভাদ্রে থাকিয়া কৃষ্ণ-জন্মযাত্রা কৈল ।
গোপবেশে গোরাচাঁদের বহু নৃত্য হৈল ॥ ১৩২+৪ ॥

*bhādre thākiẏā kṛṣṇa-janmayātrā kaila |*
*gopabeśe gorācāṁdera bahu nṛtya haila || 132+4 ||*

*Word for word:* bhadre thakiya — staying in Bhadra; krishna-janma-yatra kaila — celebrated the festival of Krishna's birth; gopa-veshe — in cowherd dress; gorachandera bahu nritya haila — Gorachand danced much

**132+4.** Staying in Bhadra, He celebrated the festival of Krishna's birth:
much did Gorachand dance in the dress of a cowherd.

আশ্বিনে থাকিয়া প্রভু শচীর নন্দন ।
ভক্তগণ লঞা করে নাম-সংকীর্তন ॥ ১৩২+৫ ॥

*āśbine thākiẏā prabhu śacīra nandana |*
*bhaktagaṇa lañā kare nāma-saṃkīrtana || 132+5 ||*

*Word for word:* ashvine thakiya — staying in Ashvina; prabhu shachira nandana — the Lord, Shachi's son; bhaktagana lanya — with the devotees; kare nama-sankirtana — performs sankirtana of the Name

**132+5.** Staying in Ashvina, the Lord, the son of Shachi,
performs sankirtana of the Name with the devotees[^47-4].

তার প্রেমে মহাপ্রভু তার বশ হঞা ।
চাতুর্মাস্য বঞ্চিল পরমপ্রীতি পাঞা ॥ ১৩৩ ॥

*tāra preme mahāprabhu tāra baśa hañā |*
*cāturmāsya bañcila paramaprīti pāñā || 133 ||*

*Word for word:* tara preme — by his love; mahaprabhu tara basha hanya — Mahaprabhu, coming under his sway; chaturmasya vanchila — spent the chaturmasya; parama-priti panya — finding the highest joy

**133.** Conquered by [Trimalla's] love, Mahaprabhu came under his sway
and, filled with the highest joy, spent the chaturmasya [with him].

চাতুর্মাস্য বঞ্চি' প্রভু চলিলা তুরিতে ।
পথে দেখা পরমানন্দপুরীর সহিতে ॥ ১৩৪ ॥

*cāturmāsya bañci' prabhu calilā turite |*
*pathe dekhā paramānandapurīra sahite || 134 ||*

*Word for word:* chaturmasya vanchi — having spent the chaturmasya; prabhu chalila turite — the Lord quickly set out; pathe dekha — on the way a meeting; paramananda-purira sahite — with Paramananda Puri

**134.** Having spent the chaturmasya, the Lord quickly set out [again]
and on the way met Paramananda Puri[^47-5].

দোঁহে দোঁহা দেখি' তুষ্ট হৈলা দুইজন ।
নিরখিতে দোঁহাকার ঝরয়ে নয়ন ॥ ১৩৫ ॥

*doṁhe doṁhā dekhi' tuṣṭa hailā duijana |*
*nirakhite doṁhākāra jharaẏe naẏana || 135 ||*

*Word for word:* donhe donha dekhi — seeing each other; tushta haila duijana — both rejoiced; nirakhite — as they gaze; donhakara jharaye nayana — tears flow from the eyes of both

**135.** Seeing each other, both rejoiced;
they gaze at each other, and tears flow from the eyes of both.

দেখিতে পরমানন্দপুরীর স্মরণে ।
গুরু মাধবেন্দ্রপুরী যে কৈল বচনে ॥ ১৩৬ ॥

*dekhite paramānandapurīra smaraṇe |*
*guru mādhabendrapurī ye kaila bacane || 136 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhite — as he looked; paramananda-purira smarane — Paramananda Puri remembered; guru madhavendra-puri — the guru Madhavendra Puri; ye kaila vachane — what he had said

**136.** Looking [at the Lord], Paramananda Puri remembered
what his guru Madhavendra Puri had said:

কলেঃ প্রথমসন্ধ্যায়াং লক্ষ্মীকান্তো ভবিষ্যতি ।
দারুব্রহ্মসমীপস্থঃ সন্ন্যাসী গৌরবিগ্রহঃ ॥ ১৩৭ ॥

*kaleḥ prathamasandhyāẏāṃ lakṣmīkānto bhabiṣyati |*
*dārubrahmasamīpasthaḥ sannyāsī gaurabigrahaḥ || 137 ||*

*Word for word:* kaleh — of Kali; prathama-sandhyayam — in the first twilight; lakshmi-kantah — the Lord of Lakshmi; bhavishyati — will appear; daru-brahma-samipasthah — dwelling near the Daru-brahman; sannyasi — a sannyasi; gaura-vigrahah — with a golden form

**137.** "In the first twilight of Kali the Lord of Lakshmi will appear —
a sannyasi with a golden body, dwelling near the Daru-brahman"[^47-6].

কলিযুগে সঙ্কীর্তন-ধর্ম রাখিবারে ।
জনমিব কৃষ্ণ প্রথম সন্ধ্যার ভিতরে ॥ ১৩৮ ॥

*kaliyuge saṅkīrtana-dharma rākhibāre |*
*janamiba kṛṣṇa prathama sandhyāra bhitare || 138 ||*

*Word for word:* kaliyuge — in the Kali-yuga; sankirtana-dharma — the dharma of sankirtana; rakhibare — to establish; janamiba krishna — Krishna will be born; prathama sandhyara bhitare — within the first twilight

**138.** "To establish in the Kali-yuga the dharma of sankirtana
Krishna will be born in the first twilight [of this yuga].

গৌর দীর্ঘ-কলেবর বাহু জানুসম ।
সিংহ-গ্রীব গজ-স্কন্ধ কমললোচন ॥ ১৩৯ ॥

*gaura dīrgha-kalebara bāhu jānusama |*
*siṃha-grība gaja-skandha kamalalocana || 139 ||*

*Word for word:* gaura — golden; dirgha-kalevara — tall of body; bahu janusama — arms to the knees; simha-griva — a lion's neck; gaja-skandha — an elephant's shoulders; kamala-lochana — lotus eyes

**139.** Golden, tall of body, arms reaching to the knees,
a neck like a lion's, shoulders like an elephant's, lotus eyes.

করুণাসাগর প্রভু প্রেমার আবাস ।
নিজ করুণায় দয়া করিব প্রকাশ ॥ ১৪০ ॥

*karuṇāsāgara prabhu premāra ābāsa |*
*nija karuṇāẏa daẏā kariba prakāśa || 140 ||*

*Word for word:* karuna-sagara prabhu — the Lord, an ocean of compassion; premara avasa — the abode of prema; nija karunaya — out of His own compassion; daya kariba prakasha — will show mercy

**140.** The Lord, an ocean of compassion, the abode of prema,
out of His own mercy will show grace.

মোর ভাগ্য নাহি মুঞি দেখিব নয়নে ।
তোর দেখা হৈলে মোরে করিহ স্মরণে ॥ ১৪১ ॥

*mora bhāgya nāhi muñi dekhiba naẏane |*
*tora dekhā haile more kariha smaraṇe || 141 ||*

*Word for word:* mora bhagya nahi — I have no fortune; munyi dekhiba nayane — that I should see [Him] with my eyes; tora dekha haile — when you see [Him]; more kariha smarane — remember me

**141.** I have not the fortune to see Him with my own eyes;
when you see Him, remember me."

সেই এই গুরুবাক্য মনেতে পড়িল ।
এই সেই ভগবান্ নিশ্চয় জানিল ॥ ১৪২ ॥

*sei ei gurubākya manete paṛila |*
*ei sei bhagabān niścaẏa jānila || 142 ||*

*Word for word:* sei ei guru-vakya — these words of the guru; manete padila — came to mind; ei sei bhagavan — this is Bhagavan Himself; nishchaya janila — he knew for certain

**142.** These words of his guru came to his mind,
and he knew for certain: this is Bhagavan Himself.

মাধবেন্দ্র বলি' বলি' করিল স্মরণ ।
তবে ত আনন্দ-মনে করয়ে ক্রন্দন ॥ ১৪২+১ ॥

*mādhabendra bali' bali' karila smaraṇa |*
*tabe ta ānanda-mane karaẏe krandana || 142+1 ||*

*Word for word:* madhavendra bali bali — repeating "Madhavendra"; karila smarana — he remembered; tabe ta — then; ananda-mane — with joy at heart; karaye krandana — weeps

**142+1.** "Madhavendra!" he repeated, remembering [his guru],
and wept with joy in his heart.

মাধবেন্দ্র-কীর্তন শুনিয়া প্রভু নাচে ।
হরি হরি বলি' ভক্ত নাচে কাছে কাছে ॥ ১৪২+২ ॥

*mādhabendra-kīrtana śuniẏā prabhu nāce |*
*hari hari bali' bhakta nāce kāche kāche || 142+2 ||*

*Word for word:* madhavendra-kirtana shuniya — hearing the glorification of Madhavendra; prabhu nache — the Lord dances; hari hari bali — saying "Hari! Hari!"; bhakta nache kachhe kachhe — the devotees dance close by

**142+2.** Hearing him glorify Madhavendra, the Lord dances,
and the devotees, crying "Hari! Hari!", dance close by.

ক্ষণে হুহুঙ্কার দেই পরম আনন্দে ।
মাধবেন্দ্র বলি' প্রভু প্রেমানন্দে কান্দে ॥ ১৪২+৩ ॥

*kṣaṇe huhuṅkāra dei parama ānande |*
*mādhabendra bali' prabhu premānande kānde || 142+3 ||*

*Word for word:* kshane — now and again; huhunkara dei — gives loud shouts; parama anande — in supreme bliss; madhavendra bali — saying "Madhavendra"; prabhu premanande kande — the Lord weeps in the bliss of prema

**142+3.** Now and again He gives loud shouts in supreme bliss;
"Madhavendra!" cries the Lord and weeps in the bliss of prema:

এতদিনে মোর সন্ন্যাস সফল হইল ।
মাধবেন্দ্র-ধ্বনি মোর কর্ণে প্রবেশিল ॥ ১৪২+৪ ॥

*etadine mora sannyāsa saphala haila |*
*mādhabendra-dhbani mora karṇe prabeśila || 142+4 ||*

*Word for word:* etadine — today at last; mora sannyasa saphala haila — My sannyasa has borne fruit; madhavendra-dhvani — the sound of Madhavendra's [name]; mora karne praveshila — entered My ears

**142+4.** "Today My sannyasa has borne fruit:
the name of Madhavendra has entered My ears"[^47-7].

দেখি' পরণাম করে পরমানন্দপুরী ।
কি করহ বলি' প্রভু তোলে হাথে ধরি' ॥ ১৪৩ ॥

*dekhi' paraṇāma kare paramānandapurī |*
*ki karaha bali' prabhu tole hāthe dhari' || 143 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhi — seeing; paranama kare paramananda-puri — Paramananda Puri bows; ki karaha bali — saying "what are you doing?"; prabhu tole hathe dhari — the Lord lifts him, taking his hands

**143.** Seeing [this], Paramananda Puri bows;
"What are you doing?" says the Lord and lifts him up by the hands.

গাঢ় আলিঙ্গন কৈল পরমসন্তোষে ।
চলিলা ঠাকুর কহে এ লোচনদাসে ॥ ১৪৪ ॥

*gāṛha āliṅgana kaila paramasantoṣe |*
*calilā ṭhākura kahe e locanadāse || 144 ||*

*Word for word:* gadha alingana kaila — embraced tightly; parama-santoshe — in great joy; chalila thakura — the Thakura went on; kahe e lochanadase — says this Lochana Dasa

**144.** In great joy He embraced him tightly,
and the Thakura went on, says this Lochana Dasa.

## The Lord Sees Vrindavana

> *Summary by Srila Bhaktisiddhanta Sarasvati.* On the way to Setubandha Sriman Mahaprabhu showed the lila of delivering the seven palms. The ancient story of the seven palms [is this]: seven gandharvas, cursed by a sage, became trees; now, by the touch of the Lord, they attained liberation. Arriving at Setubandha, He, absorbed in prema, chanted the names of Rama, Lakshmana, Sita, Hanuman and others; then, having spent the chaturmasya on the bank of the Godavari, He returned again to Utkala, to Alalanatha. There He accepted as His own a devotee named Vishnudasa and, coming [to Purushottama], He stayed there and [spent] several months with the devotees in the bliss of kirtana. After this, setting out to see the Mathura-mandala, He met Rupa and Sanatana. Coming to Mathura, He, together with a devotee named Krishnadasa, absorbed in prema, saw on the eastern and western banks of the Yamuna the twelve forests, the prison of Devaki and Vasudeva, the houses of Kamsa, Ugrasena and others — countless places of Krishna's lilas[^47-8].

*Raga dhanashi; disha: "Gorachand is my life, Gora is my breath!"*

আর অপরূপ কথা শুন সাবধানে ।
পথে চলি' যাইতে সপ্ততাল-বিমোচনে ॥ ১ ॥

*āra aparūpa kathā śuna sābadhāne |*
*pathe cali' yāite saptatāla-bimocane || 1 ||*

*Word for word:* ara aparupa katha — another wondrous story; shuna savadhane — hear attentively; pathe chali yaite — as He went along the road; sapta-tala-vimochane — about the deliverance of the seven palms

**1.** Hear attentively another wondrous story —
of the deliverance of the seven palms, as [the Lord] went along the road.

সপ্ত তালতরু সেই আছে যে পথেতে ।
দেখি' আচম্বিতে প্রভু লাগিলা হাসিতে ॥ ২ ॥

*sapta tālataru sei āche ye pathete |*
*dekhi' ācambite prabhu lāgilā hāsite || 2 ||*

*Word for word:* sapta talataru — seven palm trees; sei achhe ye pathete — stand on that road; dekhi — seeing; achambite — suddenly; prabhu lagila hasite — the Lord began to laugh

**2.** Those seven palms stand on that road;
seeing them, the Lord suddenly began to laugh.

ধাঞা গিয়া সপ্ততাল করিলা পরশে ।
জয় জয় জয়ধ্বনি উঠিল আকাশে ॥ ৩ ॥

*dhāñā giẏā saptatāla karilā paraśe |*
*jaẏa jaẏa jaẏadhbani uṭhila ākāśe || 3 ||*

*Word for word:* dhanya giya — running up; saptatala karila parashe — touched the seven palms; jaya jaya jaya-dhvani — cries of "glory, glory, glory"; uthila akashe — rose in the sky

**3.** Running up, He touched the seven palms —
and in the sky rose cries: "Glory! Glory! Glory!"

মুনিশাপে ছিল সে গন্ধর্ব সাতজন ।
প্রভুর পরশে তারা পাইল মোচন ॥ ৪ ॥

*muniśāpe chila se gandharba sātajana |*
*prabhura paraśe tārā pāila mocana || 4 ||*

*Word for word:* munishape — by a sage's curse; chhila se gandharva satajana — seven gandharvas had dwelt; prabhura parashe — by the Lord's touch; tara paila mochana — they obtained deliverance

**4.** By a sage's curse seven gandharvas had dwelt [in them];
by the Lord's touch they attained deliverance.

জোড়হস্ত করি' তারা দণ্ডবত কৈল ।
দিব্যদেহ পাইয়া সবে বৈকুণ্ঠে চলিল ॥ ৪+১ ॥

*joṛahasta kari' tārā daṇḍabata kaila |*
*dibyadeha pāiẏā sabe baikuṇṭhe calila || 4+1 ||*

*Word for word:* joda-hasta kari — joining their palms; tara dandavata kaila — they prostrated themselves; divya-deha paiya — gaining divine bodies; sabe vaikunthe chalila — all went to Vaikuntha

**4+1.** Joining their palms, they prostrated themselves [before Him]
and, gaining divine bodies, all departed for Vaikuntha.

দেখিয়া সকল লোক করে নমস্কার ।
সবে বলে এই ন্যাসী রাম-অবতার ॥ ৪+২ ॥

*dekhiẏā sakala loka kare namaskāra |*
*sabe bale ei nyāsī rāma-abatāra || 4+2 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhiya — seeing; sakala loka kare namaskara — all the people bow; sabe bale — all say; ei nyasi — this sannyasi; rama-avatara — is the avatara Rama

**4+2.** Seeing this, all the people bow;
all say: "This sannyasi is the avatara Rama"[^47-9].

তবে সেই মহাপ্রভু পথে চলি' যায় ।
আনন্দে বিভোল প্রভু হরিগুণ গায় ॥ ৫ ॥

*tabe sei mahāprabhu pathe cali' yāẏa |*
*ānande bibhola prabhu hariguṇa gāẏa || 5 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe sei mahaprabhu — then Mahaprabhu; pathe chali yaya — goes along the road; anande vibhola prabhu — the Lord, intoxicated with bliss; hari-guna gaya — sings the glories of Hari

**5.** Then Mahaprabhu goes along the road;
intoxicated with bliss, the Lord sings the glories of Hari.

প্রেমার আনন্দে নাহি জানে পথশ্রমে ।
সেতুবন্ধ উত্তরিলা পথে ক্রমে ক্রমে ॥ ৬ ॥

*premāra ānande nāhi jāne pathaśrame |*
*setubandha uttarilā pathe krame krame || 6 ||*

*Word for word:* premara anande — in the bliss of prema; nahi jane patha-shrame — does not feel the toil of the road; setubandha uttarila — reached Setubandha; pathe krame krame — little by little along the road

**6.** In the bliss of prema He does not feel the weariness of the road
and little by little reached Setubandha.

সেতুবন্ধ গিয়া দেখে রামেশ্বর লিঙ্গ ।
আনন্দে নাচয়ে প্রভু যেন মত্ত সিংহ ॥ ৭ ॥

*setubandha giẏā dekhe rāmeśbara liṅga |*
*ānande nācaẏe prabhu yena matta siṃha || 7 ||*

*Word for word:* setubandha giya — coming to Setubandha; dekhe rameshvara linga — sees the linga of Rameshvara; anande nachaye prabhu — the Lord dances in bliss; yena matta simha — like a maddened lion

**7.** Coming to Setubandha, He sees the linga of Rameshvara;
the Lord dances in bliss like a maddened lion.

লিঙ্গ-প্রদক্ষিণ করি' করে নমস্কার ।
সেতুবন্ধ দেখি' হরি বোলে বারে বার ॥ ৮ ॥

*liṅga-pradakṣiṇa kari' kare namaskāra |*
*setubandha dekhi' hari bole bāre bāra || 8 ||*

*Word for word:* linga-pradakshina kari — circumambulating the linga; kare namaskara — bows; setubandha dekhi — seeing Setubandha; hari bole bare bara — cries "Hari" again and again

**8.** Walking round the linga, He bows;
looking at Setubandha, He cries "Hari!" again and again.

অনুরাগে কান্দে ডাকে শ্রীরাম-লক্ষ্মণ ।
কখন আবেশে ডাকে অঙ্গদ হনুমান্ ॥ ৯ ॥

*anurāge kānde ḍāke śrīrāma-lakṣmaṇa |*
*kakhana ābeśe ḍāke aṅgada hanumān || 9 ||*

*Word for word:* anurage kande — weeps in loving longing; dake shrirama-lakshmana — calls Sri Rama and Lakshmana; kakhana aveshe — at times in His bhava; dake angada hanuman — calls Angada and Hanuman

**9.** In loving longing He weeps and calls: "Sri Rama! Lakshmana!";
at times, in His bhava, He calls: "Angada! Hanuman!"

ক্ষণেকে আবেশে ডাকে সুগ্রীব মোর মিত ।
ক্ষণে বিভীষণ বলি' ডাকে বিপরীত ॥ ১০ ॥

*kṣaṇeke ābeśe ḍāke sugrība mora mita |*
*kṣaṇe bibhīṣaṇa bali' ḍāke biparīta || 10 ||*

*Word for word:* kshaneke aveshe dake — now in His bhava He calls; sugriva mora mita — "Sugriva, My friend"; kshane vibhishana bali — now saying "Vibhishana"; dake viparita — calls wildly

**10.** Now in His bhava He calls: "Sugriva, My friend!" —
now in a frenzy He calls: "Vibhishana!"

প্রেমায় বিহ্বল দিগ্‌বিদিগ্ নাহি জানে ।
সেতুবন্ধ দেখি' নাচে সব ভক্ত-সনে ॥ ১১ ॥

*premāẏa bihbala dig‌bidig nāhi jāne |*
*setubandha dekhi' nāce saba bhakta-sane || 11 ||*

*Word for word:* premaya vihvala — overcome with prema; dig-vidig nahi jane — knows not one direction from another; setubandha dekhi — seeing Setubandha; nache saba bhakta-sane — dances with all the devotees

**11.** Overcome with prema, He does not know one direction from another,
and looking at Setubandha He dances with all the devotees[^47-10].

এইমতে দিবানিশি পাসরে আপনা ।
লেউটিতে মহাপ্রভুর বাড়িল করুণা ॥ ১২ ॥

*eimate dibāniśi pāsare āpanā |*
*leuṭite mahāprabhura bāṛila karuṇā || 12 ||*

*Word for word:* eimate — thus; divanishi pasare apana — day and night forgets Himself; leutite — to turn back; mahaprabhura badila karuna — Mahaprabhu's mercy grew

**12.** Thus day and night He forgets Himself;
[at last] Mahaprabhu's mercy grew — to turn back.

এইমতে মহাপ্রভু পথে চলি' আসি' ।
পুনঃ চাতুর্মাস্য গোদাবরী-তীর্থে বসি' ॥ ১৩ ॥

*eimate mahāprabhu pathe cali' āsi' |*
*punaḥ cāturmāsya godābarī-tīrthe basi' || 13 ||*

*Word for word:* eimate mahaprabhu — thus Mahaprabhu; pathe chali asi — coming along the road [back]; punah chaturmasya — again a chaturmasya; godavari-tirthe basi — staying at the holy Godavari

**13.** So Mahaprabhu, going along the road [back],
again spent a chaturmasya, staying at the holy Godavari[^47-11].

পুনরপি উড্রদেশে আইলা ঠাকুর ।
জগন্নাথ-ভাবে প্রেমা বাঢ়িল প্রচুর ॥ ১৪ ॥

*punarapi uḍradeśe āilā ṭhākura |*
*jagannātha-bhābe premā bāṛhila pracura || 14 ||*

*Word for word:* punarapi — again; udradeshe aila thakura — the Thakura came to the land of the Udras; jagannatha-bhave — in the bhava of Jagannatha; prema badhila prachura — prema grew abundantly

**14.** Again the Thakura came to the land of the Udras;
in the bhava [of meeting] Jagannatha His prema grew beyond measure.

তবে ত দেখিল প্রভু শ্রীআলালনাথ ।
বিষ্ণুদাস উড়িয়াকে কৈল আত্মসাথ ॥ ১৫ ॥

*tabe ta dekhila prabhu śrīālālanātha |*
*biṣṇudāsa uṛiẏāke kaila ātmasātha || 15 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe ta — then; dekhila prabhu shri-alalanatha — the Lord saw Sri Alalanatha; vishnudasa udiyake — Vishnudasa the Oriya; kaila atmasatha — made His own

**15.** Then the Lord saw Sri Alalanatha
and made Vishnudasa the Oriya His own[^47-12].

জগন্নাথ দেখি' প্রভু হইলা কুতুহলী ।
সঘনে তুলিয়া বাহু হরি হরি বলি' ॥ ১৬ ॥

*jagannātha dekhi' prabhu hailā kutuhalī |*
*saghane tuliẏā bāhu hari hari bali' || 16 ||*

*Word for word:* jagannatha dekhi — seeing Jagannatha; prabhu haila kutuhali — the Lord was filled with joyful excitement; saghane tuliya bahu — again and again raising His arms; hari hari bali — crying "Hari! Hari!"

**16.** Seeing Jagannatha, the Lord was filled with joyful excitement:
again and again raising His arms, He cries "Hari! Hari!"

পুরুষোত্তমে আসি' প্রভু আছে মহাসুখে ।
কহয়ে লোচন এ আনন্দ বড় লোকে ॥ ১৭ ॥

*puruṣottame āsi' prabhu āche mahāsukhe |*
*kahaẏe locana e ānanda baṛa loke || 17 ||*

*Word for word:* purushottame asi — coming to Purushottama; prabhu achhe maha-sukhe — the Lord stays in great happiness; kahaye lochana — Lochana tells; e ananda bada loke — this is a great joy to people

**17.** Coming to Purushottama, the Lord stays in great happiness;
Lochana tells it — a great joy it is to people.

*Raga varadi; the tune "dhulakhela"*

এখন কহিব কথা, শুন গোরা-গুণগাথা,
ত্রিজগতে অতি অনুপাম ।
মনে মনে বান্ধে আলি, মুকুতা-প্রবাল ঢালি',
সন্ন্যাসী নৃসিংহানন্দ নাম ॥ ১৮ ॥

*ekhana kahiba kathā, śuna gorā-guṇagāthā,*
*trijagate ati anupāma |*
*mane mane bāndhe āli, mukutā-prabāla ḍhāli',*
*sannyāsī nṛsiṃhānanda nāma || 18 ||*

*Word for word:* ekhana kahiba katha — now I shall tell a story; shuna gora-guna-gatha — hear the song of Gora's virtues; trijagate ati anupama — peerless in the three worlds; mane mane bandhe ali — in his mind builds an embankment; mukuta-pravala dhali — strewing pearls and coral; sannyasi nrisimhananda nama — a sannyasi named Nrisimhananda

**18.** Now I shall tell a story — hear the song of the virtues of Gora,
peerless in the three worlds.
In his mind he built an embankment, strewing it with pearls and coral —
a sannyasi named Nrisimhananda.

সুবর্ণ-মণি-মাণিক্যে, দিব্যরত্ন চারিদিগে,
মনে মনে বান্ধিল জাঙ্গাল ।
মথুরা পর্যন্ত দিয়া, কৃষ্ণে সমর্পিব ইহা,
হেনকালে প্রত্যাসন্ন কাল ॥ ১৯ ॥

*subarṇa-maṇi-māṇikye, dibyaratna cāridige,*
*mane mane bāndhila jāṅgāla |*
*mathurā paryanta diẏā, kṛṣṇe samarpiba ihā,*
*henakāle pratyāsanna kāla || 19 ||*

*Word for word:* suvarna-mani-manikye — with gold, gems and rubies; divya-ratna charidige — with divine jewels on all sides; mane mane bandhila jangala — in his mind built a raised road; mathura paryanta diya — laying it as far as Mathura; krishne samarpiba iha — I will offer it to Krishna; henakale — at that time; pratyasanna kala — [his] hour drew near

**19.** With gold, gems and rubies, with divine jewels on every side,
in his mind he built a road.
"Taking it as far as Mathura, I will offer it to Krishna" —
but just then his hour drew near.

না হৈল জাঙ্গাল সায়, দুঃখ রহিল হিয়ায়,
মনে মনে করে অনুতাপ ।
কানাইর নাটশালা পর্যন্ত, হইল জাঙ্গাল অন্ত,
সন্ন্যাসীর বৈকুণ্ঠ হৈল লাভ ॥ ২০ ॥

*nā haila jāṅgāla sāẏa, duḥkha rahila hiẏāẏa,*
*mane mane kare anutāpa |*
*kānāira nāṭaśālā paryanta, haila jāṅgāla anta,*
*sannyāsīra baikuṇṭha haila lābha || 20 ||*

*Word for word:* na haila jangala saya — the road was not completed; duhkha rahila hiyaya — grief remained in the heart; mane mane kare anutapa — he laments within himself; kanaira natashala paryanta — as far as Kanai's Natashala; haila jangala anta — the road came to an end; sannyasira vaikuntha haila labha — the sannyasi attained Vaikuntha

**20.** The road was not finished, and grief remained in his heart;
he lamented within himself.
As far as Kanai's Natashala the road reached, and there it ended —
and the sannyasi attained Vaikuntha[^47-13].

এ কথা আছিল চিতে, চলে প্রভু আচম্বিতে,
না জানি কোথারে চলি' যায় ।
ক্রমে ক্রমে চলি' যাইতে, কানাইর নাটশালা হৈতে,
পুনঃ লেউটিলা গোরারায় ॥ ২১ ॥

*e kathā āchila cite, cale prabhu ācambite,*
*nā jāni kothāre cali' yāẏa |*
*krame krame cali' yāite, kānāira nāṭaśālā haite,*
*punaḥ leuṭilā gorārāẏa || 21 ||*

*Word for word:* e katha achhila chite — this was in his heart; chale prabhu achambite — the Lord suddenly sets out; na jani kothare chali yaya — no one knows where He goes; krame krame chali yaite — going step by step; kanaira natashala haite — from Kanai's Natashala; punah leutila goraraya — Gora Raya turned back again

**21.** This had been in his heart. The Lord suddenly set out —
no one knows where He is going.
Going on step by step, from Kanai's Natashala
Gora Raya turned back again.

এ কথা বেকত নহে, পরমানন্দপুরী কহে,
কহ প্রভু ইহার কারণ ।
আদ্যোপান্ত যত কথা, তাহারে কহিল তথা,
মনঃকথা-সিদ্ধির কারণ ॥ ২২ ॥

*e kathā bekata nahe, paramānandapurī kahe,*
*kaha prabhu ihāra kāraṇa |*
*ādyopānta yata kathā, tāhāre kahila tathā,*
*manaḥkathā-siddhira kāraṇa || 22 ||*

*Word for word:* e katha bekata nahe — this matter is not clear; paramananda-puri kahe — Paramananda Puri says; kaha prabhu ihara karana — tell, Lord, the reason for this; adyopanta yata katha — the whole story from beginning to end; tahare kahila tatha — He told him then; manah-katha-siddhira karana — the reason: fulfilment of a mental wish

**22.** The matter was not understood. Paramananda Puri says:
"Tell us, Lord, the reason for this."
Everything from beginning to end He then told him:
the reason was the fulfilment of a wish of the mind.

পুরুষোত্তম আদি অন্ত, মথুরাপুরী পর্যন্ত,
স্বর্ণ মণি মাণিক্যে দিব আলি ।
সন্ন্যাসীর এমন হিয়া, এ মোর জাঙ্গাল দিয়া,
চলি' যাবে গোরা বনমালী ॥ ২৩ ॥

*puruṣottama ādi anta, mathurāpurī paryanta,*
*sbarṇa maṇi māṇikye diba āli |*
*sannyāsīra emana hiẏā, e mora jāṅgāla diẏā,*
*cali' yābe gorā banamālī || 23 ||*

*Word for word:* purushottama adi anta — from Purushottama to the end; mathurapuri paryanta — as far as Mathura; svarna mani manikye diba ali — I will lay an embankment of gold, gems and rubies; sannyasira emana hiya — such was the sannyasi's heart; e mora jangala diya — along this road of mine; chali yabe gora vanamali — Gora, wearer of the forest garland, will go

**23.** "From Purushottama all the way to Mathura
I will pave an embankment with gold, gems and rubies" —
such was the sannyasi's heart: "Along this road of mine
Gora, who wears the forest garland, will go."

শুন শুন সর্বজন, সাবধানে দিয়া মন,
শ্রীগোরাচাঁদের পরকাশ ।
মনঃকথা নৃসিংহানন্দ, সিদ্ধ কৈল গৌরচন্দ্র,
গুণ গায় এ লোচনদাস ॥ ২৪ ॥

*śuna śuna sarbajana, sābadhāne diẏā mana,*
*śrīgorācāṁdera parakāśa |*
*manaḥkathā nṛsiṃhānanda, siddha kaila gauracandra,*
*guṇa gāẏa e locanadāsa || 24 ||*

*Word for word:* shuna shuna sarvajana — hear, all people; savadhane diya mana — attentively, setting your minds; shri-gorachandera parakasha — the manifestation of Sri Gorachand; manah-katha nrisimhananda — Nrisimhananda's wish of the mind; siddha kaila gaurachandra — Gaurachandra fulfilled; guna gaya e lochanadasa — this Lochana Dasa sings the glories

**24.** Hear, all people, attentively, setting your minds on it,
of the manifestation of Sri Gorachand:
the wish of Nrisimhananda's mind Gaurachandra fulfilled —
of His glories this Lochana Dasa sings[^47-14].

*Raga shri; disha: "Gorachand — oh! — plays in Nilachala"*

তবে নীলাচলে প্রভু ভক্তগণ-সঙ্গে ।
কীর্তন-বিলাস করে আছে নানা-রঙ্গে ॥ ২৫ ॥

*tabe nīlācale prabhu bhaktagaṇa-saṅge |*
*kīrtana-bilāsa kare āche nānā-raṅge || 25 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe nilachale — and so in Nilachala; prabhu bhaktagana-sange — the Lord with the devotees; kirtana-vilasa kare — delights in kirtana; achhe nana-range — stays in various sports

**25.** And so in Nilachala the Lord with the devotees
delights in kirtana and stays in various sports.

অনেক ভকতগণ মিলিলা তথায় ।
প্রেম বিলসয়ে প্রভু নাচয়ে নাচায় ॥ ২৬ ॥

*aneka bhakatagaṇa mililā tathāẏa |*
*prema bilasaẏe prabhu nācaẏe nācāẏa || 26 ||*

*Word for word:* aneka bhakatagana — many devotees; milila tathaya — gathered there; prema vilasaye prabhu — the Lord enjoys prema; nachaye nachaya — dances and makes others dance

**26.** Many devotees gathered there;
the Lord enjoys prema — He dances and makes others dance.

নানাদেশে আছিল যতেক ভক্তগণে ।
ক্রমে ক্রমে মিলিলেন চৈতন্য-চরণে ॥ ২৭ ॥

*nānādeśe āchila yateka bhaktagaṇe |*
*krame krame mililena caitanya-caraṇe || 27 ||*

*Word for word:* nanadeshe achhila — lived in various lands; yateka bhaktagane — all the devotees; krame krame — little by little; mililena chaitanya-charane — came to the feet of Chaitanya

**27.** All the devotees who lived in various lands
little by little came to the feet of Chaitanya.

আনন্দে আছয়ে প্রভু নীলাচল-বাসে ।
কহিব সকল পাছু অনেক প্রকাশে ॥ ২৮ ॥

*ānande āchaẏe prabhu nīlācala-bāse |*
*kahiba sakala pāchu aneka prakāśe || 28 ||*

*Word for word:* anande achhaye prabhu — the Lord stays in bliss; nilachala-vase — dwelling in Nilachala; kahiba sakala pachhu — I will tell everything later; aneka prakashe — in detail

**28.** In bliss the Lord dwells in Nilachala;
of all this I shall tell later in detail.

মথুরা চলিব মনঃকথা আচম্বিত ।
উৎকণ্ঠা বাঢ়িল হিয়া উনমত-চিত ॥ ২৯ ॥

*mathurā caliba manaḥkathā ācambita |*
*utkaṇṭhā bāṛhila hiẏā unamata-cita || 29 ||*

*Word for word:* mathura chaliba — "I will go to Mathura"; manah-katha achambita — suddenly a wish in the mind; utkantha badhila hiya — longing grew in the heart; unamata-chita — the mind maddened

**29.** Suddenly [the Lord] has a wish in His mind: "I will go to Mathura";
longing grew in His heart, His mind as though maddened.

চলিলা মথুরা-পথে চৈতন্য ঠাকুর ।
পথে যাইতে প্রেমানন্দ বাঢ়িল প্রচুর ॥ ৩০ ॥

*calilā mathurā-pathe caitanya ṭhākura |*
*pathe yāite premānanda bāṛhila pracura || 30 ||*

*Word for word:* chalila mathura-pathe — set out on the road to Mathura; chaitanya thakura — Chaitanya Thakura; pathe yaite — on the way; premananda badhila prachura — the bliss of prema grew greatly

**30.** Chaitanya Thakura set out on the road to Mathura;
on the way the bliss of prema grew beyond measure.

অনুরাগে ধায় প্রভু রাঙ্গা দুই আঁখি ।
সিংহের গমনে ধায় দেখিতে না দেখি ॥ ৩১ ॥

*anurāge dhāẏa prabhu rāṅgā dui āṁkhi |*
*siṃhera gamane dhāẏa dekhite nā dekhi || 31 ||*

*Word for word:* anurage dhaya prabhu — the Lord runs in loving longing; ranga dui ankhi — both eyes red; simhera gamane dhaya — runs with a lion's gait; dekhite na dekhi — no sooner seen than gone

**31.** In loving longing the Lord runs, both eyes red;
He runs with a lion's gait — no sooner seen than gone.

সঙ্গের সঙ্গতিগণ না পারে হাঁটিতে ।
কথোদূরে যায় প্রভু ডাকিতে ডাকিতে ॥ ৩২ ॥

*saṅgera saṅgatigaṇa nā pāre hāṁṭite |*
*kathodūre yāẏa prabhu ḍākite ḍākite || 32 ||*

*Word for word:* sangera sangatigana — the companions with Him; na pare hantite — cannot keep pace; kathodure yaya prabhu — the Lord goes far ahead; dakite dakite — calling and calling

**32.** The companions who were with Him cannot keep up;
the Lord goes far ahead, calling [for Krishna].

ঝারিখণ্ড-পথে প্রভু চলিলা সত্বর ।
কান্দাইলা পশু পক্ষী বৃক্ষাদি প্রস্তর ॥ ৩৩ ॥

*jhārikhaṇḍa-pathe prabhu calilā satbara |*
*kāndāilā paśu pakṣī bṛkṣādi prastara || 33 ||*

*Word for word:* jharikhanda-pathe — by the Jharikhanda road; prabhu chalila satvara — the Lord went in haste; kandaila — made weep; pashu pakshi vrikshadi prastara — beasts, birds, trees and stones

**33.** By the road through Jharikhanda the Lord went in haste;
He made beasts, birds, trees, even stones weep.

গৌরাঙ্গ বেড়িয়া মৃগ-ব্যাঘ্রগণ নাচে ।
হিংসা নাহি সবে সুখে নাচে প্রভু-কাছে ॥ ৩৪ ॥

*gaurāṅga beṛiẏā mṛga-byāghragaṇa nāce |*
*hiṃsā nāhi sabe sukhe nāce prabhu-kāche || 34 ||*

*Word for word:* gauranga bediya — surrounding Gauranga; mriga-vyaghragana nache — deer and tigers dance; himsa nahi — there is no violence; sabe sukhe nache — all dance joyfully; prabhu-kachhe — near the Lord

**34.** Surrounding Gauranga, deer and tigers dance;
there is no violence [in them] — all dance joyfully near the Lord.

বনজন্তুগণ সব কৃতার্থ করিয়া ।
চলিলা গৌরাঙ্গ পথে প্রেম-বিনোদিয়া ॥ ৩৫ ॥

*banajantugaṇa saba kṛtārtha kariẏā |*
*calilā gaurāṅga pathe prema-binodiẏā || 35 ||*

*Word for word:* vanajantugana saba — all the forest animals; kritartha kariya — having blessed; chalila gauranga pathe — Gauranga went on His way; prema-vinodiya — delighting in prema

**35.** Having blessed all the forest animals,
Gauranga went on His way, delighting in prema[^47-15].

ক্রমে ক্রমে উত্তরিলা তীর্থ বারাণসী ।
অনেক আছয়ে তথা পরম সন্ন্যাসী ॥ ৩৬ ॥

*krame krame uttarilā tīrtha bārāṇasī |*
*aneka āchaẏe tathā parama sannyāsī || 36 ||*

*Word for word:* krame krame — little by little; uttarila tirtha varanasi — reached holy Varanasi; aneka achhaye tatha — there live many; parama sannyasi — great sannyasis

**36.** Little by little He came to holy Varanasi;
many great sannyasis live there.

বিশ্বেশ্বর নমস্করি' চলি' যায় পথে ।
প্রয়াগে মাধব দেখি' হরষিত চিতে ॥ ৩৭ ॥

*biśbeśbara namaskari' cali' yāẏa pathe |*
*praẏāge mādhaba dekhi' haraṣita cite || 37 ||*

*Word for word:* vishveshvara namaskari — bowing to Vishveshvara; chali yaya pathe — goes along the road; prayage madhava dekhi — at Prayaga seeing Madhava; harashita chite — glad at heart

**37.** Bowing to Vishveshvara, He goes on along the road;
at Prayaga, seeing Madhava, He rejoiced at heart.

রূপ-সনাতন গোসাঞি প্রভুরে মিলিলা ।
অনুগ্রহ করি' তারে শক্তি সঞ্চারিলা ॥ ৩৮ ॥

*rūpa-sanātana gosāñi prabhure mililā |*
*anugraha kari' tāre śakti sañcārilā || 38 ||*

*Word for word:* rupa-sanatana gosani — Rupa and Sanatana Gosani; prabhure milila — met the Lord; anugraha kari — showing grace; tare shakti sancharila — imparted power to them

**38.** Rupa and Sanatana Gosani met the Lord;
showing them grace, He imparted His power to them[^47-16].

তথা বেণী-স্নান করি' দেখি' অক্ষয়বট ।
যমুনাতে পার হৈলা আগরা নিকট ॥ ৩৯ ॥

*tathā beṇī-snāna kari' dekhi' akṣaẏabaṭa |*
*yamunāte pāra hailā āgarā nikaṭa || 39 ||*

*Word for word:* tatha veni-snana kari — there, bathing at the Veni; dekhi akshayavata — seeing the Akshaya-vata; yamunate para haila — crossed the Yamuna; agara nikata — near Agra

**39.** There, bathing at the Veni and seeing the Akshaya-vata,
He crossed the Yamuna near Agra.

দেখিলা অদ্ভুত সে রেণুকা নামে গ্রাম ।
অবতার কৈলা যেই স্থানে পরশুরাম ॥ ৪০ ॥

*dekhilā adbhuta se reṇukā nāme grāma |*
*abatāra kailā yei sthāne paraśurāma || 40 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhila adbhuta — He saw a wondrous; se renuka name grama — village named Renuka; avatara kaila — appeared; yei sthane parashurama — the place where Parashurama

**40.** He saw a wondrous village named Renuka —
the place where Parashurama appeared.

তথা বৃন্দাবন-মুখে যমুনা বিমুখী ।
দেখিয়া বিহ্বল প্রভু প্রেমসুখে সুখী ॥ ৪১ ॥

*tathā bṛndābana-mukhe yamunā bimukhī |*
*dekhiẏā bihbala prabhu premasukhe sukhī || 41 ||*
