*Word for word:* tatha — there; vrindavana-mukhe — facing Vrindavana; yamuna vimukhi — the Yamuna, turned [back]; dekhiya — seeing; vihvala prabhu — the Lord beside Himself; prema-sukhe sukhi — happy with the happiness of prema

**41.** There the Yamuna, turning [back], faces Vrindavana;
seeing this, the Lord, beside Himself, is happy with the happiness of prema[^47-17].

রাজগ্রামে গিয়া পারে দেখয়ে গোকুল ।
সম্বরিতে নারে হিয়া ভৈ গেল আকুল ॥ ৪২ ॥

*rājagrāme giẏā pāre dekhaẏe gokula |*
*sambarite nāre hiẏā bhai gela ākula || 42 ||*

*Word for word:* rajagrame giya — coming to Rajagrama; pare dekhaye gokula — sees Gokula on the far bank; sambarite nare hiya — cannot restrain His heart; bhai gela akula — became distraught

**42.** Coming to Rajagrama, He sees Gokula on the far bank;
unable to restrain His heart, He became distraught.

হিয়া সম্বরিল প্রভু অনেক যতনে ।
আনন্দে বিহ্বল পারে দেখে মহাবনে ॥ ৪৩ ॥

*hiẏā sambarila prabhu aneka yatane |*
*ānande bihbala pāre dekhe mahābane || 43 ||*

*Word for word:* hiya sambarila prabhu — the Lord restrained His heart; aneka yatane — with great effort; anande vihvala — overwhelmed with bliss; pare dekhe mahavane — sees Mahavana on the far bank

**43.** With great effort the Lord restrained His heart;
overwhelmed with bliss, He sees Mahavana on the far bank.

যাইতে যাইতে আর গিয়া কথোদূর ।
সুনিকট হৈল যেই দেখে মধুপুর ॥ ৪৪ ॥

*yāite yāite āra giẏā kathodūra |*
*sunikaṭa haila yei dekhe madhupura || 44 ||*

*Word for word:* yaite yaite — going and going; ara giya kathodura — going some distance more; sunikata haila — He drew near; yei dekhe madhupura — and sees Madhupura

**44.** He went on and on some distance more —
and, drawing near, He sees Madhupura.

মধুপুর দেখি' প্রভু উনমত-চিত ।
প্রেমায় বিহ্বল যেন নাহিক সম্বিত ॥ ৪৫ ॥

*madhupura dekhi' prabhu unamata-cita |*
*premāẏa bihbala yena nāhika sambita || 45 ||*

*Word for word:* madhupura dekhi — seeing Madhupura; prabhu unamata-chita — the Lord mad at heart; premaya vihvala — overcome with prema; yena nahika samvita — as if without consciousness

**45.** Seeing Madhupura, the Lord became mad at heart;
overcome with prema, He seemed to lose consciousness.

অক্রূর অক্রূর বলি' ভূমিতে পড়িলা ।
মাথুর-বিরহ-ভাবে মূর্ছিত হইলা ॥ ৪৬ ॥

*akrūra akrūra bali' bhūmite paṛilā |*
*māthura-biraha-bhābe mūrchita hailā || 46 ||*

*Word for word:* akrura akrura bali — crying "Akrura! Akrura!"; bhumite padila — fell to the ground; mathura-viraha-bhave — in the bhava of separation [when Krishna left for] Mathura; murchhita haila — fainted

**46.** Crying "Akrura! Akrura!", He fell to the ground;
in the bhava of separation, [when Krishna left for] Mathura, He fainted[^47-18].

দিবানিশি নাহি জানে আছে সেইখানে ।
সম্বেদন নাহি প্রভুর ভেল তিন দিনে ॥ ৪৭ ॥

*dibāniśi nāhi jāne āche seikhāne |*
*sambedana nāhi prabhura bhela tina dine || 47 ||*

*Word for word:* divanishi nahi jane — knows not day or night; achhe seikhane — remains there; sambedana nahi prabhura — the Lord had no consciousness; bhela tina dine — for three days

**47.** Not knowing day or night, He remains in that place;
for three days the Lord was without consciousness.

গতাগতি করে লোক দেখয়ে আশ্চর্য ।
কৃষ্ণদাস নামে এক আছে দ্বিজবর্য ॥ ৪৮ ॥

*gatāgati kare loka dekhaẏe āścarya |*
*kṛṣṇadāsa nāme eka āche dbijabarya || 48 ||*

*Word for word:* gatagati kare loka — people come and go; dekhaye ashcharya — see the marvel; krishnadasa name eka — one named Krishnadasa; achhe dvijavarya — there is, a foremost brahmana

**48.** People come and go and look at this marvel.
There lived [there] a foremost brahmana named Krishnadasa.

প্রভুরে দেখিয়া সেই গণে মনে মনে ।
কোথা হৈতে আইল এই পুরুষরতনে ॥ ৪৯ ॥

*prabhure dekhiẏā sei gaṇe mane mane |*
*kothā haite āila ei puruṣaratane || 49 ||*

*Word for word:* prabhure dekhiya — seeing the Lord; sei gane mane mane — he reflects within himself; kotha haite aila — from where has come; ei purusha-ratane — this jewel among men

**49.** Seeing the Lord, he thinks within himself:
"From where has this jewel among men come?

বড় ভাগ্যে দেখিলাম ইহার চরণ ।
এই শুক প্রহ্লাদ কিবা হেন লয় মন ॥ ৫০ ॥

*baṛa bhāgye dekhilāma ihāra caraṇa |*
*ei śuka prahlāda kibā hena laẏa mana || 50 ||*

*Word for word:* bada bhagye — by great fortune; dekhilama ihara charana — I have seen His feet; ei shuka prahlada kiba — is this Shuka or Prahlada; hena laya mana — so my mind takes it

**50.** By great fortune I have seen His feet;
is this Shuka or Prahlada? — so my mind takes it."

প্রেমায় বিহ্বল প্রভু পুছিল তাহারে ।
কি নাম তোমার কহ শুন দ্বিজবরে ॥ ৫১ ॥

*premāẏa bihbala prabhu puchila tāhāre |*
*ki nāma tomāra kaha śuna dbijabare || 51 ||*

*Word for word:* premaya vihvala prabhu — the Lord, overcome with prema; puchhila tahare — asked him; ki nama tomara kaha — tell, what is your name; shuna dvijavare — listen, best of brahmanas

**51.** The Lord, overcome with prema, asked him:
"What is your name? Tell Me — listen, best of brahmanas."

ব্রাহ্মণ কহয়ে শুন শুন ন্যাসিবর ।
কৃষ্ণদাস নাম মোর করিল উত্তর ॥ ৫২ ॥

*brāhmaṇa kahaẏe śuna śuna nyāsibara |*
*kṛṣṇadāsa nāma mora karila uttara || 52 ||*

*Word for word:* brahmana kahaye — the brahmana says; shuna shuna nyasivara — listen, listen, best of sannyasis; krishnadasa nama mora — my name is Krishnadasa; karila uttara — he answered

**52.** The brahmana says: "Listen, listen, best of sannyasis:
my name is Krishnadasa" — so he answered.

এ বোল শুনিঞা প্রভু অট্ট অট্ট হাস ।
কৃষ্ণের সকলি জান তুমি কৃষ্ণদাস ॥ ৫৩ ॥

*e bola śuniñā prabhu aṭṭa aṭṭa hāsa |*
*kṛṣṇera sakali jāna tumi kṛṣṇadāsa || 53 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuninya — hearing this; prabhu atta atta hasa — the Lord laughed aloud; krishnera sakali jana — you know everything of Krishna; tumi krishnadasa — you, Krishnadasa

**53.** Hearing this, the Lord laughed aloud:
"You, Krishnadasa, know everything of Krishna.

জুড়াইল দেহ মোর তোমার সম্ভাষে ।
তুমি দেখাইবে যথা যে আছে বিশেষে ॥ ৫৪ ॥

*juṛāila deha mora tomāra sambhāṣe |*
*tumi dekhāibe yathā ye āche biśeṣe || 54 ||*

*Word for word:* judaila deha mora — refreshed My body; tomara sambhashe — your words; tumi dekhaibe — you will show; yatha ye achhe visheshe — what is where, in detail

**54.** Your words have refreshed My body;
you will show Me all that is anywhere, in every detail.

মথুরামণ্ডল এই কৃষ্ণের অন্তরীণ ।
সকল জানহ তুমি ভকত প্রবীণ ॥ ৫৫ ॥

*mathurāmaṇḍala ei kṛṣṇera antarīṇa |*
*sakala jānaha tumi bhakata prabīṇa || 55 ||*

*Word for word:* mathura-mandala ei — this Mathura-mandala; krishnera antarina — Krishna's inner [abode]; sakala janaha tumi — you know everything; bhakata pravina — an experienced devotee

**55.** This Mathura-mandala is Krishna's inner abode;
you, an experienced devotee, know everything.

যেখানে যে কৈল কৃষ্ণ সব তুমি জান ।
মথুরামণ্ডল মোরে দেখাও স্থানে স্থান ॥ ৫৬ ॥

*yekhāne ye kaila kṛṣṇa saba tumi jāna |*
*mathurāmaṇḍala more dekhāo sthāne sthāna || 56 ||*

*Word for word:* yekhane ye kaila krishna — what Krishna did where; saba tumi jana — you know it all; mathura-mandala more dekhao — show Me the Mathura-mandala; sthane sthana — place by place

**56.** You know what Krishna did and where —
show Me the Mathura-mandala, place by place."

দ্বিজ কহে সব স্থান না জানিয়ে আমি ।
দ্বাদশ বনের স্থান সবে আমি জানি ॥ ৫৭ ॥

*dbija kahe saba sthāna nā jāniẏe āmi |*
*dbādaśa banera sthāna sabe āmi jāni || 57 ||*

*Word for word:* dvija kahe — the brahmana says; saba sthana na janiye ami — I do not know all the places; dvadasha vanera sthana — the places of the twelve forests; sabe ami jani — only these I know

**57.** The brahmana says: "I do not know all the places;
I know only the places of the twelve forests."

এ বোল শুনিঞা প্রভু প্রেমানন্দে হাসে ।
তাহার শরীরে শক্তি করিলা প্রকাশে ॥ ৫৮ ॥

*e bola śuniñā prabhu premānande hāse |*
*tāhāra śarīre śakti karilā prakāśe || 58 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuninya — hearing this; prabhu premanande hase — the Lord laughs in the bliss of prema; tahara sharire — in his body; shakti karila prakashe — manifested power

**58.** Hearing this, the Lord laughs in the bliss of prema
and manifested [His] power in his body.

মহানন্দে বোলে আমি সব দেখাইব ।
কৃষ্ণজন্ম হৈতে কংসবধ শুনাইব ॥ ৫৯ ॥

*mahānande bole āmi saba dekhāiba |*
*kṛṣṇajanma haite kaṃsabadha śunāiba || 59 ||*

*Word for word:* maha-anande bole — says in great bliss; ami saba dekhaiba — I will show everything; krishna-janma haite — from Krishna's birth; kamsa-vadha shunaiba — to the slaying of Kamsa I will tell

**59.** In great bliss [the brahmana] says: "I will show everything;
from Krishna's birth to the slaying of Kamsa — I will tell it all."

দ্বিজ কহে শুন শুন শুন মহাশয় ।
নন্দের নন্দন তুমি জানিল নিশ্চয় ॥ ৬০ ॥

*dbija kahe śuna śuna śuna mahāśaẏa |*
*nandera nandana tumi jānila niścaẏa || 60 ||*

*Word for word:* dvija kahe — the brahmana says; shuna shuna shuna mahashaya — listen, listen, listen, sir; nandera nandana tumi — You are the son of Nanda; janila nishchaya — I know for certain

**60.** The brahmana says: "Listen, listen, listen, sir:
I know for certain — You are the son of Nanda.

তোমার দর্শনে মোর ব্রজ-দরশন ।
আচম্বিতে সব মোর হৈল সঙরণ ॥ ৬১ ॥

*tomāra darśane mora braja-daraśana |*
*ācambite saba mora haila saṅaraṇa || 61 ||*

*Word for word:* tomara darshane — by seeing You; mora vraja-darashana — I have seen Vraja; achambite — suddenly; saba mora haila sanarana — everything came back to my memory

**61.** Seeing You, I have seen Vraja:
suddenly everything came back to my memory.

যেখানে যে জানি আমি স্থানের মরম ।
যেখানে যে ভগবান্ জনম-করম ॥ ৬২ ॥

*yekhāne ye jāni āmi sthānera marama |*
*yekhāne ye bhagabān janama-karama || 62 ||*

*Word for word:* yekhane ye jani ami — whatever I know of where; sthanera marama — the inner meaning of the place; yekhane ye — where and what; bhagavan janama-karama — Bhagavan's birth and deeds

**62.** I [will reveal] the inner meaning of every place I know —
where Bhagavan was born and what He did."

এ বোল শুনিয়া প্রভু হরিষ হিয়ায় ।
কৃষ্ণদাসে কোলে করি' কৃষ্ণ-গুণ গায় ॥ ৬৩ ॥

*e bola śuniẏā prabhu hariṣa hiẏāẏa |*
*kṛṣṇadāse kole kari' kṛṣṇa-guṇa gāẏa || 63 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuniya — hearing this; prabhu harisha hiyaya — the Lord, glad at heart; krishnadase kole kari — embracing Krishnadasa; krishna-guna gaya — sings the glories of Krishna

**63.** Hearing this, the Lord, with joy in His heart,
embraced Krishnadasa and sings the glories of Krishna[^47-19].

সেদিন বঞ্চিলা কৃষ্ণদাসের আলয় ।
মথুরামণ্ডল-কথা সর্বরাত্র কয় ॥ ৬৪ ॥

*sedina bañcilā kṛṣṇadāsera ālaẏa |*
*mathurāmaṇḍala-kathā sarbarātra kaẏa || 64 ||*

*Word for word:* sedina vanchila — that day He spent; krishnadasera alaya — in Krishnadasa's house; mathura-mandala-katha — the account of the Mathura-mandala; sarvaratra kaya — he tells all night

**64.** That day He spent in Krishnadasa's house;
all night [Krishnadasa] tells of the Mathura-mandala:

মথুরামণ্ডল-মধ্যে যমুনা ভাগ্যবতী ।
যাহার দুকূলে কৃষ্ণ বিহরে পীরিতি ॥ ৬৫ ॥

*mathurāmaṇḍala-madhye yamunā bhāgyabatī |*
*yāhāra dukūle kṛṣṇa bihare pīriti || 65 ||*

*Word for word:* mathura-mandala-madhye — in the midst of the Mathura-mandala; yamuna bhagyavati — the blessed Yamuna; yahara dukule — on both banks of which; krishna vihare piriti — Krishna sports in love

**65.** "In the midst of the Mathura-mandala is the blessed Yamuna,
on both banks of which Krishna sports in love.

যমুনার পূর্বকূলে আছে পাঁচ বন ।
পশ্চিমেতে সাত বন কহিব এখন ॥ ৬৬ ॥

*yamunāra pūrbakūle āche pāṁca bana |*
*paścimete sāta bana kahiba ekhana || 66 ||*

*Word for word:* yamunara purvakule — on the eastern bank of the Yamuna; achhe pancha vana — there are five forests; pashchimete sata vana — on the western seven forests; kahiba ekhana — I will tell now

**66.** On the eastern bank of the Yamuna there are five forests,
on the western seven forests; now I shall tell of them.

কৃষ্ণের বিহার এই দ্বাদশ বনে ।
ভক্ত বিনে কেহো ইহার মরম না জানে ॥ ৬৭ ॥

*kṛṣṇera bihāra ei dbādaśa bane |*
*bhakta bine keho ihāra marama nā jāne || 67 ||*

*Word for word:* krishnera vihara — Krishna's pastimes; ei dvadasha vane — in these twelve forests; bhakta vine — apart from devotees; keho ihara marama na jane — no one knows their secret

**67.** In these twelve forests are Krishna's pastimes;
apart from devotees no one knows their secret.

কংসের সদন এই যমুনা-পশ্চিমে ।
তাহার উত্তরে বন বৃন্দাবন নামে ॥ ৬৮ ॥

*kaṃsera sadana ei yamunā-paścime |*
*tāhāra uttare bana bṛndābana nāme || 68 ||*

*Word for word:* kamsera sadana ei — here is Kamsa's palace; yamuna-pashchime — west of the Yamuna; tahara uttare — to the north of it; vana vrindavana name — the forest named Vrindavana

**68.** Here is Kamsa's palace — west of the Yamuna;
to the north of it is the forest named Vrindavana.

মথুরা হইতে সেই যোজনেক পথ ।
অনেক রহস্য কথা কহিব তাহাত ॥ ৬৯ ॥

*mathurā haite sei yojaneka patha |*
*aneka rahasya kathā kahiba tāhāta || 69 ||*

*Word for word:* mathura haite — from Mathura; sei yojaneka patha — it is a yojana's journey; aneka rahasya katha — many secret things; kahiba tahata — I will tell about it

**69.** From Mathura to it is one yojana of road;
of it I shall tell many secret things.

কুমুদ নামে বন আছে তাহার নৈঋতে ।
সওয়া যোজন পথ মথুরা হইতে ॥ ৭০ ॥

*kumuda nāme bana āche tāhāra naiṛte |*
*saoẏā yojana patha mathurā haite || 70 ||*

*Word for word:* kumuda name vana — the forest named Kumuda; achhe tahara nairite — lies south-west of it; saoya yojana patha — a yojana and a quarter's journey; mathura haite — from Mathura

**70.** To the south-west of it is a forest named Kumuda,
one and a quarter yojanas' journey from Mathura.

খদিরবন আছে প্রভু তাহার দক্ষিণে ।
দেড় যোজন পথ মথুরার সনে ॥ ৭১ ॥

*khadirabana āche prabhu tāhāra dakṣiṇe |*
*deṛa yojana patha mathurāra sane || 71 ||*

*Word for word:* khadira-vana achhe prabhu — there is, Lord, the Khadira-vana; tahara dakshine — south of it; deda yojana patha — a yojana and a half's journey; mathurara sane — from Mathura

**71.** South of it, Lord, is the Khadira-vana,
a yojana and a half's journey from Mathura.

তালবন আছে প্রভু দক্ষিণে মথুরার ।
অর্ধ যোজন ভূমি মথুরা তাহার ॥ ৭২ ॥

*tālabana āche prabhu dakṣiṇe mathurāra |*
*ardha yojana bhūmi mathurā tāhāra || 72 ||*

*Word for word:* talavana achhe prabhu — there is, Lord, the Talavana; dakshine mathurara — south of Mathura; ardha yojana bhumi — half a yojana of land; mathura tahara — from Mathura to it

**72.** The Tala-vana, Lord, is south of Mathura:
from Mathura it is half a yojana away.

এক নদী-ধারা আছে মানসগঙ্গা নামে ।
বৃন্দাবন-পশ্চিমে সে মথুরা-ঈশানে ॥ ৭৩ ॥

*eka nadī-dhārā āche mānasagaṅgā nāme |*
*bṛndābana-paścime se mathurā-īśāne || 73 ||*

*Word for word:* eka nadi-dhara achhe — there is a stream; manasaganga name — named Manasa-Ganga; vrindavana-pashchime se — west of Vrindavana; mathura-ishane — north-east of Mathura

**73.** There is a stream — a river named Manasa-Ganga:
west of Vrindavana, north-east of Mathura.

কাম্যকবন হৈতে মধুবনের উদ্দেশ ।
কালীদহ-পশ্চিমে যমুনা পরবেশ ॥ ৭৪ ॥

*kāmyakabana haite madhubanera uddeśa |*
*kālīdaha-paścime yamunā parabeśa || 74 ||*

*Word for word:* kamyaka-vana haite — from the Kamyaka-vana; madhuvanera uddesha — towards Madhuvana; kalidaha-pashchime — west of the Kaliya-daha; yamuna paravesha — entry into the Yamuna

**74.** From the Kamyaka-vana [it flows] towards Madhuvana
and west of the Kaliya-daha enters the Yamuna.

সরস্বতী নামে এক ধারা আছে তাথে ।
মথুরার উত্তরে সে প্রবেশে যমুনাতে ॥ ৭৫ ॥

*sarasbatī nāme eka dhārā āche tāthe |*
*mathurāra uttare se prabeśe yamunāte || 75 ||*

*Word for word:* sarasvati name eka dhara — a stream named Sarasvati; achhe tathe — is there; mathurara uttare — north of Mathura; se praveshe yamunate — it enters the Yamuna

**75.** There is also a stream named Sarasvati there:
north of Mathura it enters the Yamuna.

মথুরা-পশ্চিমে আছে গোবর্ধন-গিরি ।
আউট যোজন সে মথুরা হইতে ধরি' ॥ ৭৬ ॥

*mathurā-paścime āche gobardhana-giri |*
*āuṭa yojana se mathurā haite dhari' || 76 ||*

*Word for word:* mathura-pashchime — west of Mathura; achhe govardhana-giri — is the hill of Govardhana; auta yojana — three and a half yojanas; se mathura haite dhari — reckoning from Mathura

**76.** West of Mathura is the hill of Govardhana,
three and a half yojanas, counting from Mathura.

কহিব কাম্যকবন গোবর্ধন-পশ্চিমে ।
মথুরা হইতে আউট যোজন লোকে গণে ॥ ৭৭ ॥

*kahiba kāmyakabana gobardhana-paścime |*
*mathurā haite āuṭa yojana loke gaṇe || 77 ||*

*Word for word:* kahiba kamyaka-vana — I will tell of the Kamyaka-vana; govardhana-pashchime — west of Govardhana; mathura haite — from Mathura; auta yojana loke gane — three and a half yojanas, as people reckon

**77.** I shall tell of the Kamyaka-vana — west of Govardhana:
from Mathura, as people reckon, three and a half yojanas.

বহুলা নামে বন আছে মথুরা-ঈশানে ।
মানসগঙ্গার পার সে দুই যোজনে ॥ ৭৮ ॥

*bahulā nāme bana āche mathurā-īśāne |*
*mānasagaṅgāra pāra se dui yojane || 78 ||*

*Word for word:* bahula name vana — the forest named Bahula; achhe mathura-ishane — north-east of Mathura; manasagangara para — beyond the Manasa-Ganga; se dui yojane — at two yojanas

**78.** The forest named Bahula is north-east of Mathura,
beyond the Manasa-Ganga, at two yojanas.

এই সাত বন সে পশ্চিমে যমুনার ।
কহিব ত পূর্বকূলে পাঁচ বন আর ॥ ৭৯ ॥

*ei sāta bana se paścime yamunāra |*
*kahiba ta pūrbakūle pāṁca bana āra || 79 ||*

*Word for word:* ei sata vana — these seven forests; se pashchime yamunara — are west of the Yamuna; kahiba ta — I will tell now; purvakule pancha vana ara — of the five other forests on the eastern bank

**79.** These are the seven forests west of the Yamuna;
now I shall tell of the five forests on the eastern bank.

মহাবন নামে বন যমুনা-নিকটে ।
মথুরা হইতে সেই যোজনেক বাটে ॥ ৮০ ॥

*mahābana nāme bana yamunā-nikaṭe |*
*mathurā haite sei yojaneka bāṭe || 80 ||*

*Word for word:* mahavana name vana — the forest named Mahavana; yamuna-nikate — near the Yamuna; mathura haite — from Mathura; sei yojaneka bate — a yojana's way

**80.** The forest named Mahavana is near the Yamuna,
one yojana's journey from Mathura.

বিল্ব নামে বন আছে পশ্চিমে তাহার ।
অর্ধ যোজন সে মথুরা হইতে পার ॥ ৮১ ॥

*bilba nāme bana āche paścime tāhāra |*
*ardha yojana se mathurā haite pāra || 81 ||*

*Word for word:* bilva name vana — the forest named Bilva; achhe pashchime tahara — is west of it; ardha yojana — half a yojana; se mathura haite para — across from Mathura

**81.** To the west of it is the forest named Bilva,
half a yojana from Mathura, on the far bank.

তাহার উত্তরে আছে লোহ নামে বন ।
ভাণ্ডীর নামে বন আছে তাহার ঈশান ॥ ৮২ ॥

*tāhāra uttare āche loha nāme bana |*
*bhāṇḍīra nāme bana āche tāhāra īśāna || 82 ||*

*Word for word:* tahara uttare — north of it; achhe loha name vana — is the forest named Loha; bhandira name vana — the forest named Bhandira; achhe tahara ishana — is north-east of it

**82.** To the north of it is the forest named Loha;
to the north-east of it is the forest named Bhandira.

একত্রই দুই বন যমুনার কূলে ।
মহাবন হৈতে লোকে আউট যোজন বোলে ॥ ৮৩ ॥

*ekatrai dui bana yamunāra kūle |*
*mahābana haite loke āuṭa yojana bole || 83 ||*

*Word for word:* ekatrai dui vana — these two forests together; yamunara kule — on the bank of the Yamuna; mahavana haite — from Mahavana; loke auta yojana bole — people say three and a half yojanas

**83.** These two forests lie together on the bank of the Yamuna;
from Mahavana, people say, three and a half yojanas.

এই দ্বাদশ বন মথুরামণ্ডল ।
কৃষ্ণের বিহার-স্থান দেখাব সকল ॥ ৮৪ ॥

*ei dbādaśa bana mathurāmaṇḍala |*
*kṛṣṇera bihāra-sthāna dekhāba sakala || 84 ||*

*Word for word:* ei dvadasha vana — these twelve forests; mathura-mandala — the Mathura-mandala; krishnera vihara-sthana — the places of Krishna's pastimes; dekhaba sakala — I will show them all

**84.** These are the twelve forests — the Mathura-mandala;
all the places of Krishna's pastimes I will show [You]"[^47-20].

[^47-1]: Panchavati is the forest on the Godavari (near present-day Nasik) where Rama, Sita and Lakshmana lived in exile; cf. Murari 3.15.6.
[^47-2]: The Lord, in the mood of Rama, lives through the abduction of Sita as though it were happening now. Cf. Murari 3.16.3–4 (on the way to Setubandha).
[^47-3]: Shrirangam on the Kaveri; cf. Murari 3.15.7–17. In the Chaitanya-charitamrita (Madhya 9) the Lord spends the chaturmasya in the house of Venkata Bhatta, Trimalla's brother.
[^47-4]: Vv. 132+1 — 132+5 are found only in the 1983 edition; the 1903 edition gives them only in a footnote, as an additional reading of a printed edition. The chaturmasya is the four months of the rains (Ashadha to Ashvina), when sannyasis do not travel.
[^47-5]: Vv. 134–144 — cf. Murari 3.15.19–25. In the Chaitanya-charitamrita (Madhya 9) the Lord meets Paramananda Puri at the Rishabha hill after Shrirangam.
[^47-6]: In the 1983 edition the verse is cited as from the Vayu Purana (in A the heading of the quotation is corrupted by the OCR); the 1903 edition gives it only in a footnote, as an additional reading of a printed edition. Bhaktisiddhanta's prose rendering of the verse is not translated. "The first twilight of Kali" is the opening period of the Kali-yuga; on the Daru-brahman (Jagannatha) see en/45, note 15. Vv. 138–141 are Madhavendra Puri's words, a Bengali paraphrase of this verse.
[^47-7]: Vv. 142+1 — 142+4 are found only in the 1983 edition; the 1903 edition gives them only in a footnote, as an additional reading of one manuscript. Madhavendra Puri is the guru of Ishvara Puri, and so the Lord's "grandfather" in the line of gurus.
[^47-8]: The summary in A is badly corrupted by the OCR in places; gaps are filled from the sense and from Bhaktisiddhanta's table of contents (chapter 2 of the Shesha-khanda). In the 1983 edition chapter 2 ("The Lord Sees Vrindavana") begins later — at v. 18 (the song of Nrisimhananda); vv. 1–17 there close chapter 1.
[^47-9]: Vv. 4+1 — 4+2 are found only in the 1983 edition; the 1903 edition gives them only in a footnote, as an additional reading of a printed edition. Cf. Murari 3.16.1–2 (in Murari, tamala trees). According to the Chaitanya-charitamrita (Madhya 9), the Lord embraced the seven palms and sent them to Vaikuntha; these are the seven palms that Rama pierced with one arrow to convince Sugriva of His strength.
[^47-10]: Cf. Murari 3.16.3–6. The Lord, in the mood of Rama, calls His associates — Lakshmana, Angada, Hanuman, Sugriva, Vibhishana. Rameshvara is the linga of Shiva installed, by tradition, by Rama Himself; for Vaishnavas Shiva is the greatest of devotees.
[^47-11]: A second chaturmasya (on the Godavari) is peculiar to Lochana Dasa's account; according to the Chaitanya-charitamrita (Madhya 9), in the South the Lord spent one chaturmasya — at Shrirangam — and on the way back only met Ramananda again on the Godavari (cf. Murari 3.16.9–11).
[^47-12]: Alalanatha is Vishnu at Brahmagiri, south of Puri. Vishnudasa is in Murari (3.16.12) the brahmana with whom the Lord sees Alalanatha.
[^47-13]: "Attained Vaikuntha" — left this world. Nrisimhananda (Pradyumna Brahmachari) in Murari (3.17.5–8) and in the Chaitanya-charitamrita (Madhya 1) paves in his mind a road for the Lord from Bengal (from Kuliya) to Vrindavana, but cannot take it beyond Kanai's Natashala and therefore foretells that the Lord will turn back from there; in those accounts he does not die and himself tells the devotees about it. Kanai's Natashala is a village on the Ganga near Rajmahal, where the Lord, on His first attempt to go to Vrindavana, turned back.
[^47-14]: In Lochana Dasa the Lord turns back from Kanai's Natashala even before the journey to Mathura told next; of His route through Bengal (Ramakeli, Kuliya) Lochana Dasa says nothing here.
[^47-15]: Cf. the Chaitanya-charitamrita (Madhya 17): going through the forests of Jharikhanda, the Lord makes tigers and deer dance together and chant the name of Krishna. In Murari (4.01) the Lord goes from Puri through Kashi.
[^47-16]: Vv. 36–38 — cf. Murari 4.01–4.02.1. According to the Chaitanya-charitamrita (Madhya 19–20), the Lord meets Rupa at Prayaga and Sanatana at Kashi, on the way back from Vrindavana; Lochana Dasa places the meeting with both on the way to Mathura. "Imparted His power" (shakti-sanchara) — empowered them to reveal to the world the teaching and the lilas of Vraja.
[^47-17]: Vv. 39–45 — cf. Murari 4.02.2–6. The Akshaya-vata is the "imperishable banyan" at Prayaga; the Veni (Triveni) is the confluence of the Ganga, Yamuna and Sarasvati. V. 41 we understand as in Murari (4.02.5): the Yamuna "ever turned towards the forest of Vrinda."
[^47-18]: Akrura took Krishna away from Vraja to Mathura, and the gopis in separation blamed him. Seeing Mathura, the Lord lives through the separation of the gopis (of Radha) from Krishna.
[^47-19]: Vv. 48–63 — cf. Murari 4.02.9–13. The brahmana Krishnadasa, by the Lord's word and power, becomes His guide through the Mathura-mandala.
[^47-20]: Vv. 65–84 — cf. Murari 4.03.3–20 (the account of the twelve forests). Distances: a yojana is about 12–13 km. "Three and a half" (vv. 76, 77, 83) is the 1903 edition's reading ("আউট"); A and B read "আট" ("eight"), apparently a corruption of the same word. Only eleven forests are named; the twelfth in Murari is Bhadra.

---

# Shesha-khanda, part 3 (portion 48)

*The section "The Lord Sees Vrindavana" (continued): Krishnadasa shows the Lord Mathura — the walls, Kamsa's palace, the prison, the "place where He passed water" as an infant, Uddhava's house, the twelve ghats, Kamsa's well; the story of the Setubandha lake; the places of Krishna's infant and childhood lilas in Mahavana and Gokula; Nanda entrusts the Child to Radha in Bilvavana; the cowherds move to Vrindavana; the places of Krishna's sports with the cowherd boys — the Lord in the mood of a friend*

এইমতে কথালাপে প্রভাত হইল ।
যে বিধি আছিল প্রভু প্রাতঃক্রিয়া কৈল ॥ ৮৫ ॥

*eimate kathālāpe prabhāta haila |*
*ye bidhi āchila prabhu prātaḥkriẏā kaila || 85 ||*

*Word for word:* eimate — thus; kathalape — in conversation; prabhata haila — morning came; ye vidhi achhila — as prescribed; prabhu pratah-kriya kaila — the Lord performed the morning rites

**85.** Thus in conversation the morning came;
the Lord performed His morning rites as prescribed.

উৎকণ্ঠা-হৃদয়ে দিল কৃষ্ণদাসে ডাক ।
দেহকে জিনিঞা সে অধিক অনুরাগ ॥ ৮৬ ॥

*utkaṇṭhā-hṛdaẏe dila kṛṣṇadāse ḍāka |*
*dehake jiniñā se adhika anurāga || 86 ||*

*Word for word:* utkantha-hridaye — with a longing heart; dila krishnadase daka — called Krishnadasa; dehake jininya — surpassing the body; se adhika anuraga — that love was greater

**86.** With a longing heart He called Krishnadasa;
His love was more than His body could hold.

দেখিতে চলিলা প্রভু মথুরামণ্ডল ।
আপনে ঈশ্বর কৃষ্ণদাসে করে ছল ॥ ৮৭ ॥

*dekhite calilā prabhu mathurāmaṇḍala |*
*āpane īśbara kṛṣṇadāse kare chala || 87 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhite chalila prabhu — the Lord set out to see; mathura-mandala — the Mathura-mandala; apane ishvara — Ishvara Himself; krishnadase kare chhala — plays a prank on Krishnadasa

**87.** The Lord set out to see the Mathura-mandala;
Ishvara Himself plays a prank on Krishnadasa[^48-1].

কৃষ্ণদাস কহে প্রভু ইথে কর মন ।
পুরীর তিনদিগে দেখ গড়ের পত্তন ॥ ৮৮ ॥

*kṛṣṇadāsa kahe prabhu ithe kara mana |*
*purīra tinadige dekha gaṛera pattana || 88 ||*

*Word for word:* krishnadasa kahe — Krishnadasa says; prabhu ithe kara mana — Lord, turn Your mind here; purira tinadige — on three sides of the city; dekha gadera pattana — see the fortifications

**88.** Krishnadasa says: "Lord, turn Your mind here:
see, on three sides of the city — the fortifications.

পূরবে যমুনা নদী বহে দক্ষিণমুখে ।
উত্তর-দক্ষিণ-দ্বার গড়ের দুইদিগে ॥ ৮৯ ॥

*pūrabe yamunā nadī bahe dakṣiṇamukhe |*
*uttara-dakṣiṇa-dbāra gaṛera duidige || 89 ||*

*Word for word:* purabe — on the east; yamuna nadi bahe dakshina-mukhe — the river Yamuna flows southward; uttara-dakshina-dvara — north and south gates; gadera duidige — on two sides of the fort

**89.** On the east the river Yamuna flows southward;
on two sides of the fortifications are the north and south gates.

কংসের আবাস দেখ পুরীর নৈঋতে ।
পূরবে উত্তরে দুই দুয়ার তাহাতে ॥ ৯০ ॥

*kaṃsera ābāsa dekha purīra naiṛte |*
*pūrabe uttare dui duẏāra tāhāte || 90 ||*

*Word for word:* kamsera avasa dekha — see Kamsa's palace; purira nairite — south-west of the city; purabe uttare — to east and north; dui duyara tahate — two gates in it

**90.** See here Kamsa's palace — south-west of the city;
it has two gates, to the east and to the north.

বসিবার চৌতারা দেখ বাড়ীর উত্তর ।
পুরীর বায়ুকোণে দেখ হের কারাগার ॥ ৯১ ॥

*basibāra cautārā dekha bāṛīra uttara |*
*purīra bāẏukoṇe dekha hera kārāgāra || 91 ||*

*Word for word:* basibara chautara — a platform for sitting; dekha badira uttara — see, north of the palace; purira vayu-kone — in the north-west of the city; dekha hera karagara — see, here is the prison

**91.** See — north of the palace a platform for sitting;
and here, see, in the north-west of the city — the prison.

মূত্রস্থান হের দেখ ইহার দক্ষিণে ।
বিবরি' কহিব কিছু শুন সাবধানে ॥ ৯২ ॥

*mūtrasthāna hera dekha ihāra dakṣiṇe |*
*bibari' kahiba kichu śuna sābadhāne || 92 ||*

*Word for word:* mutra-sthana hera dekha — here, see, the "place where He passed water"; ihara dakshine — south of it; vivari kahiba kichhu — I will tell something in detail; shuna savadhane — listen attentively

**92.** And here, see, south of it — the 'place where He passed water';
I will tell about it in detail — listen attentively.

কংসভয়ে বসুদেব লঞা যায় পুত্র ।
আচম্বিতে কৃষ্ণ তার কোলে কৈল মূত্র ॥ ৯৩ ॥

*kaṃsabhaẏe basudeba lañā yāẏa putra |*
*ācambite kṛṣṇa tāra kole kaila mūtra || 93 ||*

*Word for word:* kamsa-bhaye — in fear of Kamsa; vasudeva lanya yaya putra — Vasudeva carries away his son; achambite — suddenly; krishna tara kole kaila mutra — Krishna passed water in his arms

**93.** In fear of Kamsa, Vasudeva carries away his son;
suddenly Krishna passed water in his arms.

এইখানে বসুদেব বসিলা সত্বর ।
প্রস্রাব করিলা কৃষ্ণ দ্রবিল পাথর ॥ ৯৪ ॥

*eikhāne basudeba basilā satbara |*
*prasrāba karilā kṛṣṇa drabila pāthara || 94 ||*

*Word for word:* eikhane — here; vasudeva basila satvara — Vasudeva quickly sat down; prasrava karila krishna — Krishna passed water; dravila pathara — the stone melted

**94.** Here Vasudeva quickly sat down;
Krishna passed water — and the stone melted.

মূত্রচিহ্ন রহিল এ পাষাণ-উপরে ।
মূত্রস্থান তেঞি লোক বোলয়ে ইহারে ॥ ৯৫ ॥

*mūtracihna rahila e pāṣāṇa-upare |*
*mūtrasthāna teñi loka bolaẏe ihāre || 95 ||*

*Word for word:* mutra-chihna rahila — the mark of the water remained; e pashana-upare — on this stone; mutra-sthana — "the place where He passed water"; tenyi loka bolaye ihare — therefore people call it

**95.** The mark of the water remained on this stone;
therefore people call this place the 'place where He passed water'[^48-2].

ইহার উত্তরে দেখ উদ্ধবের ঘর ।
এ বোল শুনিতে প্রভুর গলে দুই ধার ॥ ৯৬ ॥

*ihāra uttare dekha uddhabera ghara |*
*e bola śunite prabhura gale dui dhāra || 96 ||*

*Word for word:* ihara uttare — north of here; dekha uddhavera ghara — see Uddhava's house; e bola shunite — on hearing this; prabhura gale dui dhara — two streams down the Lord's throat

**96.** North of here, see, is Uddhava's house."
Hearing this, the Lord's tears ran in two streams down His throat.

কণ্টকিত ভেল অঙ্গ আপাদ-মস্তক ।
কদম্বকেশর জিনি' একটি পুলক ॥ ৯৭ ॥

*kaṇṭakita bhela aṅga āpāda-mastaka |*
*kadambakeśara jini' ekaṭi pulaka || 97 ||*

*Word for word:* kantakita bhela anga — the body bristled; apada-mastaka — from foot to head; kadamba-keshara jini — like a kadamba filament; ekati pulaka — each thrilled hair

**97.** His whole body from head to foot thrilled:
each hair stood up like a kadamba filament.

এই উদ্ধবের ঘর মুঞি আইলুঁ এবে ।
এথা যে করিল কৃষ্ণ কহোঁ অনুভবে ॥ ৯৮ ॥

*ei uddhabera ghara muñi āiluṁ ebe |*
*ethā ye karila kṛṣṇa kahoṁ anubhabe || 98 ||*

*Word for word:* ei uddhavera ghara — here is Uddhava's house; munyi ailun ebe — I have come now; etha ye karila krishna — what Krishna did here; kahon anubhave — I tell from experience

**98.** "Here is Uddhava's house — I have come here now;
what Krishna did here I tell from My own experience.

এইখানে কৃষ্ণ আর উদ্ধবের কথা ।
দেখিয়াছি যেন বাসোঁ মনে লাগে ব্যথা ॥ ৯৯ ॥

*eikhāne kṛṣṇa āra uddhabera kathā |*
*dekhiẏāchi yena bāsoṁ mane lāge byathā || 99 ||*

*Word for word:* eikhane — here; krishna ara uddhavera katha — the talk of Krishna and Uddhava; dekhiyachhi yena bason — I feel as if I saw it; mane lage vyatha — pain strikes the heart

**99.** Here took place the talk of Krishna and Uddhava;
I feel as if I saw it — and pain pierces My heart"[^48-3].

এ বোল বলিতে প্রভু চাহে চারিদিগে ।
তবে কহে কৃষ্ণদাস কহে অনুরাগে ॥ ১০০ ॥

*e bola balite prabhu cāhe cāridige |*
*tabe kahe kṛṣṇadāsa kahe anurāge || 100 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola balite — saying this; prabhu chahe charidige — the Lord looks around; tabe kahe krishnadasa — then Krishnadasa speaks; kahe anurage — speaks with love

**100.** Saying this, the Lord looks all around;
then, with love, Krishnadasa speaks:

উদ্ধবের পূর্বে দেখ রজকের ঘর ।
মালাকার-বাস দেখ পূরবে ইহার ॥ ১০১ ॥

*uddhabera pūrbe dekha rajakera ghara |*
*mālākāra-bāsa dekha pūrabe ihāra || 101 ||*

*Word for word:* uddhavera purve — east of Uddhava's; dekha rajakera ghara — see the washerman's house; malakara-vasa dekha — see the garland-maker's dwelling; purabe ihara — east of it

**101.** "East of Uddhava's [house], see, is the washerman's house;
and east of it, see, the dwelling of the garland-maker.

ইহার দক্ষিণে দেখ কুবুজীর ঘর ।
তাহার দক্ষিণে রঙ্গস্থান মনোহর ॥ ১০২ ॥

*ihāra dakṣiṇe dekha kubujīra ghara |*
*tāhāra dakṣiṇe raṅgasthāna manohara || 102 ||*

*Word for word:* ihara dakshine — south of here; dekha kubujira ghara — see Kubja's house; tahara dakshine — south of it; ranga-sthana manohara — the lovely arena

**102.** South of here, see, is Kubja's house;
south of it — the lovely arena.

বসুদেব-আবাস দেখ তার অগ্নিকোণে ।
এ বোল শুনিতে প্রভু হাসে মনে মনে ॥ ১০৩ ॥

*basudeba-ābāsa dekha tāra agnikoṇe |*
*e bola śunite prabhu hāse mane mane || 103 ||*

*Word for word:* vasudeva-avasa dekha — see Vasudeva's house; tara agni-kone — south-east of it; e bola shunite — hearing this; prabhu hase mane mane — the Lord smiles within

**103.** See — south-east of it is Vasudeva's house."
Hearing this, the Lord smiles within Himself,

গদগদ স্বর কিছু অরুণ বদন ।
উগ্রসেন-বাড়ী দেখ তাহার ঈশান ॥ ১০৪ ॥

*gadagada sbara kichu aruṇa badana |*
*ugrasena-bāṛī dekha tāhāra īśāna || 104 ||*

*Word for word:* gadagada svara — the voice faltering; kichhu aruna vadana — the face somewhat flushed; ugrasena-badi dekha — see Ugrasena's house; tahara ishana — north-east of it

**104.** His voice falters, His face flushes a little.
"See — north-east of it is Ugrasena's house.

দেখহ বিশ্রান্তিঘাট দক্ষিণে তাহার ।
গতশ্রম নাম মূর্তি এথা পরচার ॥ ১০৫ ॥

*dekhaha biśrāntighāṭa dakṣiṇe tāhāra |*
*gataśrama nāma mūrti ethā paracāra || 105 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhaha vishranti-ghata — see the Vishranti-ghata; dakshine tahara — south of it; gatashrama nama murti — the Deity named Gatashrama; etha parachara — renowned here

**105.** See — south of it is the Vishranti-ghata;
here the Deity named Gatashrama is renowned[^48-4].

কংস মারি' টানিঞা ফেলিতে হৈল খাল ।
তেঞি কংসখালি ঘাট দক্ষিণে তাহার ॥ ১০৬ ॥

*kaṃsa māri' ṭāniñā phelite haila khāla |*
*teñi kaṃsakhāli ghāṭa dakṣiṇe tāhāra || 106 ||*

*Word for word:* kamsa mari — having killed Kamsa; taninya phelite — in dragging him away; haila khala — a channel was formed; tenyi kamsa-khali ghata — hence the Kamsa-khali ghata; dakshine tahara — south of it

**106.** When Krishna killed Kamsa and dragged him away, a channel was formed —
therefore south of here is the Kamsa-khali ghata.

দেখহ প্রয়াগঘাট তাহার দক্ষিণে ।
তাহার দক্ষিণে ঘাট এ তিন্দুক নামে ॥ ১০৭ ॥

*dekhaha praẏāgaghāṭa tāhāra dakṣiṇe |*
*tāhāra dakṣiṇe ghāṭa e tinduka nāme || 107 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhaha prayaga-ghata — see the Prayaga-ghata; tahara dakshine — south of it; tahara dakshine ghata — south of it a ghata; e tinduka name — named Tinduka

**107.** See — south of it is the Prayaga-ghata;
south of it — the ghata named Tinduka.

সপ্ততীর্থ বলি' ঘাট ইহার দক্ষিণে ।
তাহার দক্ষিণে দেখ ঋষিতীর্থ নামে ॥ ১০৮ ॥

*saptatīrtha bali' ghāṭa ihāra dakṣiṇe |*
*tāhāra dakṣiṇe dekha ṛṣitīrtha nāme || 108 ||*

*Word for word:* sapta-tirtha bali ghata — the ghata called Saptatirtha; ihara dakshine — south of here; tahara dakshine dekha — south of it see; rishitirtha name — the one named Rishitirtha

**108.** South of here is the ghata called Saptatirtha;
south of it, see, [the ghata] named Rishitirtha.

ইহার দক্ষিণে দেখ মোক্ষতীর্থ আর ।
তাহার দক্ষিণে কোটিতীর্থের প্রচার ॥ ১০৯ ॥

*ihāra dakṣiṇe dekha mokṣatīrtha āra |*
*tāhāra dakṣiṇe koṭitīrthera pracāra || 109 ||*

*Word for word:* ihara dakshine dekha — south of here see; moksha-tirtha ara — also Mokshatirtha; tahara dakshine — south of it; koti-tirthera prachara — the renowned Kotitirtha

**109.** South of here, see, is also Mokshatirtha;
south of it — the renowned Kotitirtha.

তাহার দক্ষিণে দেখ বোধিতীর্থ নামে ।
দক্ষিণে গণেশতীর্থ দেখ বিদ্যমানে ॥ ১১০ ॥

*tāhāra dakṣiṇe dekha bodhitīrtha nāme |*
*dakṣiṇe gaṇeśatīrtha dekha bidyamāne || 110 ||*

*Word for word:* tahara dakshine dekha — south of it see; bodhi-tirtha name — the one named Bodhitirtha; dakshine ganesha-tirtha — to the south Ganeshatirtha; dekha vidyamane — see, there it is

**110.** South of it, see, [the ghata] named Bodhitirtha;
to the south — Ganeshatirtha, there it is, see.

এই ত দ্বাদশ ঘাট সর্বতীর্থ-সার ।
পুরীর দক্ষিণে রঙ্গভূমি দেখ আর ॥ ১১১ ॥

*ei ta dbādaśa ghāṭa sarbatīrtha-sāra |*
*purīra dakṣiṇe raṅgabhūmi dekha āra || 111 ||*

*Word for word:* ei ta dvadasha ghata — these are the twelve ghatas; sarva-tirtha-sara — the essence of all holy places; purira dakshine — south of the city; ranga-bhumi dekha ara — see also the arena

**111.** These are the twelve ghatas — the essence of all holy places.
And south of the city, see, there is also the arena.

তাহার দক্ষিণে আর দেখ অপরূপ ।
দুরাশয় কংসরাজা খুদিলেক কূপ ॥ ১১২ ॥

*tāhāra dakṣiṇe āra dekha aparūpa |*
*durāśaẏa kaṃsarājā khudileka kūpa || 112 ||*

*Word for word:* tahara dakshine — south of it; ara dekha aparupa — see another marvel; durashaya kamsaraja — the evil-minded King Kamsa; khudileka kupa — dug a well

**112.** South of it, see, is one more marvel:
the evil-minded King Kamsa dug a well.

কৃষ্ণ মারি' ইহাতে ফেলিব এই কাম ।
কংস খনিল কূপ কংসকূপ নাম ॥ ১১৩ ॥

*kṛṣṇa māri' ihāte pheliba ei kāma |*
*kaṃsa khanila kūpa kaṃsakūpa nāma || 113 ||*

*Word for word:* krishna mari — having killed Krishna; ihate pheliba — I will throw [Him] in here; ei kama — this was the plan; kamsa khanila kupa — Kamsa dug the well; kamsa-kupa nama — the name Kamsa-kupa

**113.** 'Having killed Krishna, I will throw Him in here' — such was his plan;
Kamsa dug the well — [hence] the name Kamsa-kupa.

দেখহ অগস্ত্যকুণ্ড নৈঋতে তাহার ।
সেতুবন্ধ-সরোবর উত্তরে ইহার ॥ ১১৪ ॥

*dekhaha agastyakuṇḍa naiṛte tāhāra |*
*setubandha-sarobara uttare ihāra || 114 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhaha agastya-kunda — see the Agastya-kunda; nairite tahara — south-west of it; setubandha-sarovara — the Setubandha lake; uttare ihara — north of here

**114.** See — south-west of it is the Agastya-kunda;
north of here — the Setubandha lake."

এ বোল শুনিতে প্রভু কি কি বলি' ডাকে ।
অঙ্গ আচ্ছাদিল ঘন অঙ্গের পুলকে ॥ ১১৫ ॥

*e bola śunite prabhu ki ki bali' ḍāke |*
*aṅga ācchādila ghana aṅgera pulake || 115 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shunite — hearing this; prabhu ki ki bali dake — the Lord cries "What? What?"; anga achchhadila — the body was covered; ghana angera pulake — with dense thrill

**115.** Hearing this, the Lord cries: "What? What?" —
and His body was covered all over with thrill.

সেতুবন্ধ-সরোবরের শুন বিবরণ ।
সাবধানে শুন প্রভু হঞা একমন ॥ ১১৬ ॥

*setubandha-sarobarera śuna bibaraṇa |*
*sābadhāne śuna prabhu hañā ekamana || 116 ||*

*Word for word:* setubandha-sarovarera — of the Setubandha lake; shuna vivarana — hear the account; savadhane shuna prabhu — listen attentively, Lord; hanya ekamana — with a collected mind

**116.** "Hear the account of the Setubandha lake;
listen attentively, Lord, with a collected mind.

এককালে আছে কৃষ্ণ গোপীগণ-মেলে ।
রাসক্রীড়া করে এই সরোবর-কূলে ॥ ১১৭ ॥

*ekakāle āche kṛṣṇa gopīgaṇa-mele |*
*rāsakrīṛā kare ei sarobara-kūle || 117 ||*

*Word for word:* ekakale — once; achhe krishna — Krishna was; gopigana-mele — in the company of the gopis; rasa-krida kare — plays the rasa dance; ei sarovara-kule — on the bank of this lake

**117.** Once Krishna, in the company of the gopis,
was playing the rasa dance on the bank of this lake.

রাধাকে কহিল আমি সেই রঘুনাথ ।
রাবণ মারিল আমি বানরের সাথ ॥ ১১৮ ॥

*rādhāke kahila āmi sei raghunātha |*
*rābaṇa mārila āmi bānarera sātha || 118 ||*

*Word for word:* radhake kahila — He said to Radha; ami sei raghunatha — I am that Raghunatha; ravana marila ami — I killed Ravana; vanarera satha — together with the monkeys

**118.** He said to Radha: 'I am that very Raghunatha:
I killed Ravana together with the monkeys.'

এ বোল শুনিঞা রাধা মুচকি হাসয় ।
মিছা কথা কহে কৃষ্ণ এই ত আশয় ॥ ১১৯ ॥

*e bola śuniñā rādhā mucaki hāsaẏa |*
*michā kathā kahe kṛṣṇa ei ta āśaẏa || 119 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuninya — hearing this; radha muchaki hasaya — Radha smiles faintly; michha katha kahe krishna — Krishna tells an untruth; ei ta ashaya — this is the thought

**119.** Hearing this, Radha smiled faintly:
'Krishna is telling an untruth — that is what is on [His] mind.'

দেখিয়া তরস্ত হঞা পুছয়ে রাধারে ।
কি লাগিয়া হাস রাই বোলহ আমারে ॥ ১২০ ॥

*dekhiẏā tarasta hañā puchaẏe rādhāre |*
*ki lāgiẏā hāsa rāi bolaha āmāre || 120 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhiya — seeing; tarasta hanya — perturbed; puchhaye radhare — asks Radha; ki lagiya hasa rai — why do you laugh, Rai; bolaha amare — tell Me

**120.** Seeing this, He, perturbed, asks Radha:
'Why do you laugh, Rai? Tell Me!'

রাধা বোলে মিছা কথা না বলিহ আর ।
তুমি সে কেমনে হৈলে রাম-অবতার ॥ ১২১ ॥

*rādhā bole michā kathā nā baliha āra |*
*tumi se kemane haile rāma-abatāra || 121 ||*

*Word for word:* radha bole — Radha says; michha katha na baliha ara — tell no more untruths; tumi se kemane haile — how did You become; rama-avatara — the avatara Rama

**121.** Radha says: 'Tell no more untruths!
How could You have been the avatara Rama?

মহাজিতেন্দ্রিয় তেঁহো পরম ঈশ্বর ।
তোমাতে সম্ভবে নাহি তাঁর ব্যবহার ॥ ১২২ ॥

*mahājitendriẏa teṁho parama īśbara |*
*tomāte sambhabe nāhi tāṁra byabahāra || 122 ||*

*Word for word:* maha-jitendriya tenho — He is a great master of the senses; parama ishvara — the Supreme Ishvara; tomate sambhave nahi — is not possible in You; tanra vyavahara — His conduct

**122.** He is a great master of the senses, the Supreme Ishvara;
His conduct is not possible for You.

সমুদ্র বান্ধিলা তেঁহো এ গাছ-পাথরে ।
তুমিহ বান্ধহ দেখি এই সরোবরে ॥ ১২৩ ॥

*samudra bāndhilā teṁho e gācha-pāthare |*
*tumiha bāndhaha dekhi ei sarobare || 123 ||*

*Word for word:* samudra bandhila tenho — He dammed the ocean; e gachha-pathare — with these trees and stones; tumiha bandhaha dekhi — let us see You too dam; ei sarovare — this lake

**123.** He dammed the ocean with trees and stones —
let us see You dam this lake!'

এ বোল শুনিঞা প্রভু লহু লহু হাসে ।
আমি জলে থুইলে সে ইটা-পাথর ভাসে ॥ ১২৪ ॥

*e bola śuniñā prabhu lahu lahu hāse |*
*āmi jale thuile se iṭā-pāthara bhāse || 124 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuninya — hearing this; prabhu lahu lahu hase — the Lord (Krishna) smiles gently; ami jale thuile — if I place in the water; se ita-pathara bhase — bricks and stones float

**124.** Hearing this, [Krishna] smiles gently:
'If I place bricks and stones in the water, they will float.'

এ বোল শুনিঞা গোপী বলিছে বচন ।
আনিয়ে পাথর দেখি বান্ধহ এখন ॥ ১২৫ ॥

*e bola śuniñā gopī baliche bacana |*
*āniẏe pāthara dekhi bāndhaha ekhana || 125 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuninya — hearing this; gopi balichhe vachana — the gopis say; aniye pathara — we bring stones; dekhi bandhaha ekhana — let us see, dam it now

**125.** Hearing this, the gopis say:
'We will bring stones — let us see You dam it now!

মিছা গর্ব না করিহ শুনহ কানাই ।
পাথর ভাসয়ে জলে কভু শুনি নাই ॥ ১২৬ ॥

*michā garba nā kariha śunaha kānāi |*
*pāthara bhāsaẏe jale kabhu śuni nāi || 126 ||*

*Word for word:* michha garva na kariha — do not boast in vain; shunaha kanai — listen, Kanai; pathara bhasaye jale — that stones float in water; kabhu shuni nai — we have never heard

**126.** Do not boast in vain, listen, Kanai:
that stones float in water — we have never heard.'

ঠাকুর কহয়ে আন' এ গাছ পাথর ।
পাথরে বান্ধিব আমি এ সরোবর ॥ ১২৭ ॥

*ṭhākura kahaẏe āna' e gācha pāthara |*
*pāthare bāndhiba āmi e sarobara || 127 ||*

*Word for word:* thakura kahaye — the Thakura says; ana e gachha pathara — bring these trees and stones; pathare bandhiba ami — I will dam with stones; e sarovara — this lake

**127.** The Thakura says: 'Bring these trees and stones —
I will dam this lake with stones.'

এ বোল শুনিঞা তারা বহি' আনে ইটা ।
কাষ্ঠ খান-খান আনে পাথর গোটা-গোটা ॥ ১২৮ ॥

*e bola śuniñā tārā bahi' āne iṭā |*
*kāṣṭha khāna-khāna āne pāthara goṭā-goṭā || 128 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuninya — hearing this; tara bahi ane ita — they carry bricks; kashtha khana-khana ane — bring pieces of wood; pathara gota-gota — whole stones

**128.** Hearing this, they carry bricks,
bring pieces of wood and whole stones.

এক কূলে রহি' কৃষ্ণ বান্ধে সরোবর ।
এ কূলে ও কূলে সব লাগিল পাথর ॥ ১২৮+১ ॥

*eka kūle rahi' kṛṣṇa bāndhe sarobara |*
*e kūle o kūle saba lāgila pāthara || 128+1 ||*

*Word for word:* eka kule rahi — standing on one bank; krishna bandhe sarovara — Krishna dams the lake; e kule o kule — from this bank to that; saba lagila pathara — stones were laid everywhere

**128+1.** Standing on one bank, Krishna dams the lake:
from this bank to that, stones were laid everywhere[^48-5].

এ গাছ-পাথরে সরোবর গেল বান্ধা ।
ভাল ভাল বোলে গোপী মুচকি হাসে রাধা ॥ ১২৯ ॥

*e gācha-pāthare sarobara gela bāndhā |*
*bhāla bhāla bole gopī mucaki hāse rādhā || 129 ||*

*Word for word:* e gachha-pathare — with these trees and stones; sarovara gela bandha — the lake was dammed; bhala bhala bole gopi — the gopis say "well done"; muchaki hase radha — Radha smiles faintly

**129.** With these trees and stones the lake was dammed;
'Well done, well done!' say the gopis, and Radha smiles faintly.

রাধার কারণে সরোবরে হৈল সেতু ।
সেতুবন্ধ-সরোবর কহি এই হেতু ॥ ১৩০ ॥

*rādhāra kāraṇe sarobare haila setu |*
*setubandha-sarobara kahi ei hetu || 130 ||*

*Word for word:* radhara karane — for Radha's sake; sarovare haila setu — a dam arose on the lake; setubandha-sarovara kahi — we call it the Setubandha lake; ei hetu — for this reason

**130.** For Radha's sake a dam arose on the lake —
that is why it is called the Setubandha lake"[^48-6].

এ বোল শুনিঞা প্রভু অন্তর উল্লাস ।
গোরাগুণ গায় সুখে এ লোচনদাস ॥ ১৩১ ॥

*e bola śuniñā prabhu antara ullāsa |*
*gorāguṇa gāẏa sukhe e locanadāsa || 131 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuninya — hearing this; prabhu antara ullasa — the Lord rejoiced at heart; gora-guna gaya sukhe — joyfully sings Gora's glories; e lochanadasa — this Lochana Dasa

**131.** Hearing this, the Lord rejoiced at heart;
joyfully this Lochana Dasa sings the glories of Gora.

*Raga pathamanjari*

সপ্তসমুদ্রক-কুণ্ড ইহার উত্তরে ।
দেবকীর সাত পুত্র মারিতে পাথরে ॥ ১৩২ ॥

*saptasamudraka-kuṇḍa ihāra uttare |*
*debakīra sāta putra mārite pāthare || 132 ||*

*Word for word:* sapta-samudraka-kunda — the Saptasamudraka-kunda; ihara uttare — north of here; devakira sata putra — Devaki's seven sons; marite pathare — killing on a stone

**132.** "North of here is the Saptasamudraka-kunda:
[here] Devaki's seven sons [were dashed] against a stone.

ইহার উত্তরে দেখ লিঙ্গ ভূতেশ্বর ।
দেখ সরস্বতী-কুণ্ড পুরীর উত্তর ॥ ১৩৩ ॥

*ihāra uttare dekha liṅga bhūteśbara |*
*dekha sarasbatī-kuṇḍa purīra uttara || 133 ||*

*Word for word:* ihara uttare — north of here; dekha linga bhuteshvara — see the linga of Bhuteshvara; dekha sarasvati-kunda — see the Sarasvati-kunda; purira uttara — north of the city

**133.** North of here, see, is the linga of Bhuteshvara;
see the Sarasvati-kunda to the north of the city.

এইখানে দেখ দশ-অশ্বমেধ-ঘাট ।
ইহার দক্ষিণে সোমতীর্থের এ বাট ॥ ১৩৪ ॥

*eikhāne dekha daśa-aśbamedha-ghāṭa |*
*ihāra dakṣiṇe somatīrthera e bāṭa || 134 ||*

*Word for word:* eikhane dekha — here see; dasha-ashvamedha-ghata — the Dashashvamedha-ghata; ihara dakshine — south of here; soma-tirthera e bata — this way to the Soma-tirtha

**134.** Here, see, is the Dashashvamedha-ghata;
south of here — the way to the Soma-tirtha.

কণ্ঠাভরণ-মজ্জন ইহার দক্ষিণে ।
নাগতীর্থ-ধারা বহে পাতাল-গমনে ॥ ১৩৫ ॥

*kaṇṭhābharaṇa-majjana ihāra dakṣiṇe |*
*nāgatīrtha-dhārā bahe pātāla-gamane || 135 ||*

*Word for word:* kanthabharana-majjana — the Kanthabharana-majjana; ihara dakshine — south of here; naga-tirtha-dhara bahe — the stream of the Naga-tirtha flows; patala-gamane — going down to Patala

**135.** South of here is the Kanthabharana-majjana;
the stream of the Naga-tirtha flows, going down to Patala"[^48-7].

সংযমন-আদি কুণ্ড-ঘাটে গেলা তবে ।
পুরী প্রদক্ষিণ করে নিজ অনুভবে ॥ ১৩৬ ॥

*saṃyamana-ādi kuṇḍa-ghāṭe gelā tabe |*
*purī pradakṣiṇa kare nija anubhabe || 136 ||*

*Word for word:* samyamana-adi kunda-ghate — to Samyamana and other kundas and ghatas; gela tabe — then He went; puri pradakshina kare — walks round the city; nija anubhave — absorbed in His own feelings

**136.** Then He went to Samyamana and the other kundas and ghatas
and walked round the city, absorbed in His own feelings.

এইমতে ভ্রমিতে ভ্রমিতে দিন গেল ।
ভিক্ষা করিয়া প্রভু রজনী বঞ্চিল ॥ ১৩৭ ॥

*eimate bhramite bhramite dina gela |*
*bhikṣā kariẏā prabhu rajanī bañcila || 137 ||*

*Word for word:* eimate — thus; bhramite bhramite — wandering and wandering; dina gela — the day passed; bhiksha kariya — having taken alms; prabhu rajani vanchila — the Lord spent the night

**137.** Thus, wandering, the day passed;
having taken alms, the Lord spent the night.

উৎকণ্ঠায় আকুল দীঘল ভেল রাতি ।
পোহাইল পোহাইল পুছে হিয়ার আরতি ॥ ১৩৮ ॥

*utkaṇṭhāẏa ākula dīghala bhela rāti |*
*pohāila pohāila puche hiẏāra ārati || 138 ||*

*Word for word:* utkanthaya akula — anxious with longing; dighala bhela rati — the night grew long; pohaila pohaila puchhe — "has it dawned? has it dawned?" He asks; hiyara arati — with the heart's pain

**138.** Tormented by longing, the night seemed long to Him;
"Has it dawned? Has it dawned?" He asks, His heart aching.

রজনী প্রভাত হৈল হিয়ার উল্লাস ।
প্রাতঃক্রিয়া করি' বোলে আইস কৃষ্ণদাস ॥ ১৩৯ ॥

*rajanī prabhāta haila hiẏāra ullāsa |*
*prātaḥkriẏā kari' bole āisa kṛṣṇadāsa || 139 ||*

*Word for word:* rajani prabhata haila — the night turned to morning; hiyara ullasa — the heart's delight; pratah-kriya kari — performing the morning rites; bole aisa krishnadasa — He says: "Come, Krishnadasa"

**139.** Night turned to morning — His heart rejoices;
having performed the morning rites, He says: "Come, Krishnadasa!"

কৃষ্ণদাস বোলে প্রভু শুনহ বচন ।
মথুরামণ্ডল-ভূমি একুইশ যোজন ॥ ১৪০ ॥

*kṛṣṇadāsa bole prabhu śunaha bacana |*
*mathurāmaṇḍala-bhūmi ekuiśa yojana || 140 ||*

*Word for word:* krishnadasa bole — Krishnadasa says; prabhu shunaha vachana — Lord, hear the word; mathura-mandala-bhumi — the land of the Mathura-mandala; ekuisha yojana — twenty-one yojanas

**140.** Krishnadasa says: "Lord, hear my word:
the land of the Mathura-mandala is twenty-one yojanas;

দ্বাদশ বন হয় ছয় যোজন-ভিতর ।
যেখানে যে কৈল কৃষ্ণ দেখাব সকল ॥ ১৪১ ॥

*dbādaśa bana haẏa chaẏa yojana-bhitara |*
*yekhāne ye kaila kṛṣṇa dekhāba sakala || 141 ||*

*Word for word:* dvadasha vana haya — the twelve forests lie; chhaya yojana-bhitara — within six yojanas; yekhane ye kaila krishna — what Krishna did where; dekhaba sakala — I will show all

**141.** the twelve forests lie within six yojanas.
What Krishna did and where — I will show [You] everything.

নারদ-বচন কংস শুনে এইখানে ।
বসুদেব-দেবকীরে রাখে এইস্থানে ॥ ১৪২ ॥

*nārada-bacana kaṃsa śune eikhāne |*
*basudeba-debakīre rākhe eisthāne || 142 ||*

*Word for word:* narada-vachana — Narada's words; kamsa shune eikhane — Kamsa hears here; vasudeva-devakire — Vasudeva and Devaki; rakhe eisthane — keeps in this place

**142.** Here Kamsa heard the words of Narada,
here he kept Vasudeva and Devaki.

এইখানে হৈল কৃষ্ণ চতুর্ভুজ দেখি' ।
এথা পরিহার মাগে বসুদেব দেবকী ॥ ১৪৩ ॥

*eikhāne haila kṛṣṇa caturbhuja dekhi' |*
*ethā parihāra māge basudeba debakī || 143 ||*

*Word for word:* eikhane haila krishna — here Krishna appeared; chaturbhuja dekhi — seeing [Him] four-armed; etha parihara mage — here beg for relief ([that He hide the form]); vasudeva devaki — Vasudeva and Devaki

**143.** Here Krishna appeared; seeing Him four-armed,
Vasudeva and Devaki here beg [Him to hide that form].

এইখানে বসুদেব কৃষ্ণ লঞা কোলে ।
নিদ্রায় প্রহরিগণ পড়ি' গেল ভোলে ॥ ১৪৪ ॥

*eikhāne basudeba kṛṣṇa lañā kole |*
*nidrāẏa praharigaṇa paṛi' gela bhole || 144 ||*

*Word for word:* eikhane — from here; vasudeva krishna lanya kole — Vasudeva, taking Krishna in his arms; nidraya praharigana — the guards in sleep; padi gela bhole — lay senseless

**144.** From here Vasudeva [went], taking Krishna in his arms,
while the guards, overcome with sleep, lay senseless.

ফণা-ছত্র ধরিয়া বাসুকি পাছে ধায় ।
যমুনাতে পার হৈতে শৃগালী আগে যায় ॥ ১৪৫ ॥

*phaṇā-chatra dhariẏā bāsuki pāche dhāẏa |*
*yamunāte pāra haite śṛgālī āge yāẏa || 145 ||*

*Word for word:* phana-chhatra dhariya — holding his hoods as an umbrella; vasuki pachhe dhaya — Vasuki hurries behind; yamunate para haite — in crossing the Yamuna; shrigali age yaya — a she-jackal goes ahead

**145.** Vasuki, spreading his hoods as an umbrella, hurries behind;
at the crossing of the Yamuna a she-jackal runs ahead.

এই মহাবনে নন্দঘোষের বসতি ।
নিদে প্রসবিলা কন্যা যশোদা পুণ্যবতী ॥ ১৪৬ ॥

*ei mahābane nandaghoṣera basati |*
*nide prasabilā kanyā yaśodā puṇyabatī || 146 ||*

*Word for word:* ei mahavane — in this Mahavana; nanda-ghoshera vasati — the dwelling of Nanda Ghosha; nide prasavila kanya — in sleep bore a daughter; yashoda punyavati — the virtuous Yashoda

**146.** Here is Mahavana, the dwelling of Nanda Ghosha;
here in her sleep the virtuous Yashoda bore a daughter.

নন্দ-ঘরে পুত্র থুইয়া কন্যারে আনিল ।
দেবকীর কন্যা বলি' কংসেরে ভাণ্ডিল ॥ ১৪৭ ॥

*nanda-ghare putra thuiẏā kanyāre ānila |*
*debakīra kanyā bali' kaṃsere bhāṇḍila || 147 ||*

*Word for word:* nanda-ghare — in Nanda's house; putra thuiya — leaving the son; kanyare anila — brought the daughter; devakira kanya bali — calling her Devaki's daughter; kamsere bhandila — deceived Kamsa

**147.** Leaving the son in Nanda's house, [Vasudeva] took the daughter,
and calling [her] Devaki's daughter they deceived Kamsa.

পাপিষ্ঠ সে কংসরাজ মারিতে কন্যারে ।
বিদ্যুৎ হইয়া তেঁহ গেল আকাশেরে ॥ ১৪৮ ॥

*pāpiṣṭha se kaṃsarāja mārite kanyāre |*
*bidyut haiẏā teṁha gela ākāśere || 148 ||*

*Word for word:* papishtha se kamsaraja — that wicked King Kamsa; marite kanyare — in trying to kill the girl; vidyut haiya — becoming lightning; tenha gela akashere — she went into the sky

**148.** When the wicked King Kamsa tried to kill the girl,
she went up into the sky as lightning.

অপরাদ্ধ কংস স্তুতি করয়ে দোঁহারে ।
গগনে আকাশবাণী শুনে হেনকালে ॥ ১৪৯ ॥

*aparāddha kaṃsa stuti karaẏe doṁhāre |*
*gagane ākāśabāṇī śune henakāle || 149 ||*

*Word for word:* aparaddha kamsa — Kamsa, having done wrong; stuti karaye donhare — praises both; gagane akashavani — a voice from the sky; shune henakale — hears at this time

**149.** Kamsa, having done wrong, praises both [Vasudeva and Devaki];
at that time he hears a voice from the sky.

শুনিঞা সে বাণী ধর্ম হিংসিতে লাগিল ।
নিশ্চয় করিয়া নিজ মরণ জানিল ॥ ১৫০ ॥

*śuniñā se bāṇī dharma hiṃsite lāgila |*
*niścaẏa kariẏā nija maraṇa jānila || 150 ||*

*Word for word:* shuninya se vani — hearing that voice; dharma himsite lagila — began to persecute the righteous; nishchaya kariya — with certainty; nija marana janila — knew his own death

**150.** Hearing that voice, he began to persecute the righteous:
he knew for certain that death [awaited him].

মথুরা আইলা নন্দ পুত্রোৎসব করি' ।
বসুদেব বৈল রাখ শিশুরে আবরি' ॥ ১৫১ ॥

*mathurā āilā nanda putrotsaba kari' |*
*basudeba baila rākha śiśure ābari' || 151 ||*

*Word for word:* mathura aila nanda — Nanda came to Mathura; putrotsava kari — having celebrated the son's festival; vasudeva baila — Vasudeva said; rakha shishure avari — guard the child, keeping Him hidden

**151.** Having celebrated the festival for his son, Nanda came to Mathura;
Vasudeva said: 'Guard the child, keep Him hidden.'

সাতদিবসের কৃষ্ণ পূতনা বধিল ।
মাসেকের কালে শকট ভাঙ্গিয়া ফেলিল ॥ ১৫২ ॥

*sātadibasera kṛṣṇa pūtanā badhila |*
*māsekera kāle śakaṭa bhāṅgiẏā phelila || 152 ||*

*Word for word:* satadivasera krishna — Krishna, seven days old; putana vadhila — killed Putana; masekera kale — at a month old; shakata bhangiya phelila — smashed the cart

**152.** Seven days old, Krishna killed Putana;
at a month old He overturned and smashed the cart.

তৃণাবর্ত মারে কৃষ্ণ হঞা বিশ্বম্ভর ।
জৃম্ভায়ে মায়েরে বিশ্ব দেখাইল উদরে ॥ ১৫৩ ॥

*tṛṇābarta māre kṛṣṇa hañā biśbambhara |*
*jṛmbhāẏe māẏere biśba dekhāila udare || 153 ||*

*Word for word:* trinavarta mare krishna — Krishna kills Trinavarta; hanya vishvambhara — becoming the Bearer of the universe (heavy); jrimbhaye — yawning; mayere vishva dekhaila udare — showed His mother the universe in His belly

**153.** Krishna kills Trinavarta, becoming heavy as the Bearer of the universe;
yawning, He showed His mother the universe in His belly.

ছয় মাসের পরে নামকরণ হইল ।
মৃত্তিকা-ভক্ষণে বিশ্বরূপ দেখাইল ॥ ১৫৪ ॥

*chaẏa māsera pare nāmakaraṇa haila |*
*mṛttikā-bhakṣaṇe biśbarūpa dekhāila || 154 ||*

*Word for word:* chhaya masera pare — after six months; namakarana haila — came the name-giving; mrittika-bhakshane — when eating earth; vishvarupa dekhaila — He showed the universal form

**154.** After six months came the name-giving;
when He ate earth, He showed the universal form.

মন্থনের দণ্ড ধরি' নাচিল এইখানে ।
দুগ্ধ উথলিতে এথা যশোদা-গমনে ॥ ১৫৫ ॥

*manthanera daṇḍa dhari' nācila eikhāne |*
*dugdha uthalite ethā yaśodā-gamane || 155 ||*

*Word for word:* manthanera danda dhari — holding the churning rod; nachila eikhane — danced here; dugdha uthalite — when the milk boiled over; etha yashoda-gamane — here Yashoda went off

**155.** Here He danced, holding on to the churning rod;
here Yashoda went off when the milk boiled over.

উদূখলে চড়ি' শিকার ভাণ্ড ছেদ করি' ।
ঊর্ধ্বমুখে নবনীত পান কৈল হরি ॥ ১৫৬ ॥

*udūkhale caṛi' śikāra bhāṇḍa cheda kari' |*
*ūrdhbamukhe nabanīta pāna kaila hari || 156 ||*

*Word for word:* udukhale chadi — climbing on the mortar; shikara bhanda chheda kari — piercing the pot in the sling; urdhva-mukhe — face turned upward; navanita pana kaila hari — Hari ate butter

**156.** Climbing on a mortar and piercing the pot in its sling,
Hari, His face turned upward, ate butter.

এইখানে চুরি করি' কৃষ্ণ খাইল ননী ।
উদূখলে বান্ধে লৈয়া যশোদা জননী ॥ ১৫৭ ॥

*eikhāne curi kari' kṛṣṇa khāila nanī |*
*udūkhale bāndhe laiẏā yaśodā jananī || 157 ||*

*Word for word:* eikhane churi kari — here stealing; krishna khaila nani — Krishna ate butter; udukhale bandhe — binds to the mortar; laiya yashoda janani — mother Yashoda, taking Him

**157.** Here Krishna stole and ate butter;
here mother Yashoda bound Him to the mortar.

যমল-অর্জুন-ভঙ্গ কৈল এইখানে ।
ধান্য দিয়া ফল খাইল দেব নারায়ণে ॥ ১৫৮ ॥

*yamala-arjuna-bhaṅga kaila eikhāne |*
*dhānya diẏā phala khāila deba nārāẏaṇe || 158 ||*

*Word for word:* yamala-arjuna-bhanga kaila — broke the twin arjuna trees; eikhane — here; dhanya diya — giving grain; phala khaila deva narayane — the God Narayana ate fruit

**158.** Here He broke the twin arjuna trees;
here, giving grain, the God Narayana ate fruit[^48-8].

মহাবন-দক্ষিণে দেখ গোকুল-নগর ।
শিশু-সঙ্গে বৎস রাখে এথা দামোদর ॥ ১৫৯ ॥

*mahābana-dakṣiṇe dekha gokula-nagara |*
*śiśu-saṅge batsa rākhe ethā dāmodara || 159 ||*

*Word for word:* mahavana-dakshine — south of Mahavana; dekha gokula-nagara — see the town of Gokula; shishu-sange — with the boys; vatsa rakhe etha damodara — here Damodara herds calves

**159.** South of Mahavana, see, is the town of Gokula:
here Damodara with the boys herded the calves.

হের দেখ গোপেশ্বর-মূর্তি মনোহর ।
সপ্তসমুদ্রক-কুণ্ড দেখহ সুন্দর ॥ ১৬০ ॥

*hera dekha gopeśbara-mūrti manohara |*
*saptasamudraka-kuṇḍa dekhaha sundara || 160 ||*

*Word for word:* hera dekha — here, see; gopeshvara-murti manohara — the lovely Deity of Gopeshvara; sapta-samudraka-kunda — the Saptasamudraka-kunda; dekhaha sundara — see, beautiful

**160.** Here, see, is the lovely Deity of Gopeshvara;
see how beautiful the Saptasamudraka-kunda is.

আয়ানের ঘর দেখ গ্রামের পশ্চিমে ।
সুন্দরগোপের ঘর তাহার দক্ষিণে ॥ ১৬১ ॥

*āẏānera ghara dekha grāmera paścime |*
*sundaragopera ghara tāhāra dakṣiṇe || 161 ||*

*Word for word:* ayanera ghara — Ayana's house; dekha gramera pashchime — see, west of the village; sundara-gopera ghara — the house of the cowherd Sundara; tahara dakshine — south of it

**161.** See — west of the village is Ayana's house;
south of it — the house of the cowherd Sundara.

উপনন্দের ঘর এই গ্রামের মধ্যখানে ।
পশ্চিমে দেখহ রাবণের তপোবনে ॥ ১৬২ ॥

*upanandera ghara ei grāmera madhyakhāne |*
*paścime dekhaha rābaṇera tapobane || 162 ||*

*Word for word:* upanandera ghara ei — here is Upananda's house; gramera madhyakhane — in the middle of the village; pashchime dekhaha — to the west see; ravanera tapovane — Ravana's forest of austerity

**162.** In the middle of the village — here is Upananda's house;
to the west, see, is Ravana's forest of austerity.

দেখহ দুর্বাসাশ্রম ইহার উত্তর ।
নিকটে দেখহ লোহবন মনোহর ॥ ১৬৩ ॥

*dekhaha durbāsāśrama ihāra uttara |*
*nikaṭe dekhaha lohabana manohara || 163 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhaha durvasashrama — see the ashrama of Durvasa; ihara uttara — north of here; nikate dekhaha — near by see; lohavana manohara — the lovely Lohavana

**163.** See — north of here is the ashrama of Durvasa;
near by, see, is the lovely Lohavana[^48-9].

অপরূপ কহিব এই হের বিল্ববনে ।
কৃষ্ণ কোলে করি' নন্দ আছিলা এখানে ॥ ১৬৪ ॥

*aparūpa kahiba ei hera bilbabane |*
*kṛṣṇa kole kari' nanda āchilā ekhāne || 164 ||*

*Word for word:* aparupa kahiba — I will tell a marvel; ei hera bilvavana — here is Bilvavana; krishna kole kari — holding Krishna in his arms; nanda achhila ekhane — Nanda was here

**164.** I will tell a marvel: here is Bilvavana —
here Nanda was, with Krishna in his arms.

রাধাকে দেখিয়া নন্দ কহিল উত্তর ।
কোলে করি' লেহ কৃষ্ণ থোও লঞা ঘর ॥ ১৬৫ ॥

*rādhāke dekhiẏā nanda kahila uttara |*
*kole kari' leha kṛṣṇa thoo lañā ghara || 165 ||*

*Word for word:* radhake dekhiya — seeing Radha; nanda kahila uttara — Nanda said; kole kari leha krishna — take Krishna in your arms; thoo lanya ghara — carry Him home

**165.** Seeing Radha, Nanda said to Her:
'Take Krishna in your arms, carry Him home.'

নন্দের আদেশে রাধা কৃষ্ণ কৈল কোলে ।
চুম্বন করয়ে বাল্য-আচরণ-ছলে ॥ ১৬৬ ॥

*nandera ādeśe rādhā kṛṣṇa kaila kole |*
*cumbana karaẏe bālya-ācaraṇa-chale || 166 ||*

*Word for word:* nandera adeshe — at Nanda's word; radha krishna kaila kole — Radha took Krishna in Her arms; chumbana karaye — kisses; balya-acharana-chhale — under the guise of childish ways

**166.** At Nanda's word Radha took Krishna in Her arms;
[and He] kisses Her, as if in childish play.

কাজ নাহি বুঝে রাধা লঞা যায় পথে ।
গাঢ়-আলিঙ্গনে কুচ চিরে নখাঘাতে ॥ ১৬৭ ॥

*kāja nāhi bujhe rādhā lañā yāẏa pathe |*
*gāṛha-āliṅgane kuca cire nakhāghāte || 167 ||*

*Word for word:* kaja nahi bujhe radha — Radha does not understand the matter; lanya yaya pathe — carries Him along the road; gadha-alingane — in a tight embrace; kucha chire nakhaghate — marks the breast with His nails

**167.** Not understanding the matter, Radha carries Him along the road;
in a tight embrace He leaves the marks of His nails on Her breast.

দেখিয়া চরিত্র রাধার বিস্ময় লাগিল ।
হিয়া উপজিল প্রেম বেকত না কৈল ॥ ১৬৮ ॥

*dekhiẏā caritra rādhāra bismaẏa lāgila |*
*hiẏā upajila prema bekata nā kaila || 168 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhiya charitra — seeing [such] conduct; radhara vismaya lagila — Radha was amazed; hiya upajila prema — prema arose in Her heart; bekata na kaila — She did not show it

**168.** Seeing such conduct, Radha was amazed;
prema arose in Her heart, but She did not show it[^48-10].

হের আর দেখ পুনঃ কৃষ্ণের চরিত ।
মরয়ে সকল শিশু তৃষ্ণায় পীড়িত ॥ ১৬৯ ॥

*hera āra dekha punaḥ kṛṣṇera carita |*
*maraẏe sakala śiśu tṛṣṇāẏa pīṛita || 169 ||*

*Word for word:* hera ara dekha punah — here, see another; krishnera charita — deed of Krishna; maraye sakala shishu — all the boys are dying; trishnaya pidita — tormented by thirst

**169.** Here, see, is another deed of Krishna:
all the boys, tormented by thirst, are dying —

পাঁচনী খনিল কুণ্ড দেখ বিদ্যমান ।
শুনিমাত্র গৌরচন্দ্র নাহি বাহ্যজ্ঞান ॥ ১৭০ ॥

*pāṁcanī khanila kuṇḍa dekha bidyamāna |*
*śunimātra gauracandra nāhi bāhyajñāna || 170 ||*

*Word for word:* panchani khanila kunda — with a cowherd's stick He dug a pond; dekha vidyamana — see, there it is; shuni-matra — as soon as He heard; gaurachandra nahi bahya-jnana — Gaurachandra had no outer consciousness

**170.** and He dug a pond with a cowherd's stick — there it is, see."
As soon as He heard this, Gaurachandra lost outer consciousness.

কথোক্ষণে গৌরচন্দ্রের হইল ত বাহ্য ।
প্রভু কহে কৃষ্ণদাস কি হইল কার্য ॥ ১৭১ ॥

*kathokṣaṇe gauracandrera haila ta bāhya |*
*prabhu kahe kṛṣṇadāsa ki haila kārya || 171 ||*

*Word for word:* kathokshane — after a while; gaurachandrera haila ta bahya — Gaurachandra regained outer consciousness; prabhu kahe — the Lord says; krishnadasa ki haila karya — Krishnadasa, what happened

**171.** After some time Gaurachandra came back to Himself;
the Lord says: "Krishnadasa, what happened next?"

এইখানে দেখ উপনন্দ-আদি যত ।
যুক্তি করিল সব গোয়ালা-সম্মত ॥ ১৭২ ॥

*eikhāne dekha upananda-ādi yata |*
*yukti karila saba goẏālā-sammata || 172 ||*

*Word for word:* eikhane dekha — here see; upananda-adi yata — Upananda and all the others; yukti karila — held counsel; saba goyala-sammata — with all the cowherds agreeing

**172.** "Here, see, Upananda and all the others
held counsel, and all the cowherds agreed:

অসহ্য এ রাজপীড়া নিত্যই সঙ্কট ।
রজনী-প্রভাতে সভে সাজাইল শকট ॥ ১৭৩ ॥

*asahya e rājapīṛā nityai saṅkaṭa |*
*rajanī-prabhāte sabhe sājāila śakaṭa || 173 ||*

*Word for word:* asahya e rajapida — unbearable this oppression by the king; nityai sankata — danger every day; rajani-prabhate — at daybreak; sabhe sajaila shakata — all made ready the carts

**173.** 'Unbearable is this oppression of the king, every day is danger';
at daybreak they all made ready the carts.

গোপীগণ শকটে করিয়া গোপগণ ।
নিকট বসতি করিবারে বৃন্দাবন ॥ ১৭৪ ॥

*gopīgaṇa śakaṭe kariẏā gopagaṇa |*
*nikaṭa basati karibāre bṛndābana || 174 ||*

*Word for word:* gopigana shakate kariya — seating the gopis in the carts; gopagana — the cowherds; nikata vasati karibare — to settle near by; vrindavana — in Vrindavana

**174.** Seating the gopis in the carts, the cowherds
[set out] to settle near by, in Vrindavana.

হৈ হৈ রবে যায় গোধন চালাইয়া ।
পায়ে বাধা হাতে নড়ি মাথে পাগ দিয়া ॥ ১৭৫ ॥

*hai hai rabe yāẏa godhana cālāiẏā |*
*pāẏe bādhā hāte naṛi māthe pāga diẏā || 175 ||*

*Word for word:* hai hai rave — with cries of "hey, hey"; yaya godhana chalaiya — they go driving the cows; paye badha — wraps on the feet; hate nadi — sticks in hand; mathe paga diya — turbans on the head

**175.** With cries of 'hey, hey!' they go, driving the cows,
wraps on their feet, sticks in their hands, turbans on their heads.

শকটে চড়িয়া যায় কৃষ্ণ বলরাম ।
তার মুখ দেখি' গোপ সুখে চলি' যান ॥ ১৭৫+১ ॥

*śakaṭe caṛiẏā yāẏa kṛṣṇa balarāma |*
*tāra mukha dekhi' gopa sukhe cali' yāna || 175+1 ||*

*Word for word:* shakate chadiya yaya — ride on a cart; krishna balarama — Krishna and Balarama; tara mukha dekhi — looking at Their faces; gopa sukhe chali yana — the cowherds go happily

**175+1.** Krishna and Balarama ride on a cart;
looking at Their faces, the cowherds go happily[^48-11].

ভদ্র-ভাণ্ডীর-বনে ছিলা দুই মাস ।
আনন্দে গায়েন গুণ এ লোচনদাস ॥ ১৭৬ ॥

*bhadra-bhāṇḍīra-bane chilā dui māsa |*
*ānande gāẏena guṇa e locanadāsa || 176 ||*

*Word for word:* bhadra-bhandira-vane — in the Bhadra and Bhandira forests; chhila dui masa — they stayed two months; anande gayena guna — joyfully sings the glories; e lochanadasa — this Lochana Dasa

**176.** Two months they lived in the Bhadra and Bhandira forests"[^48-12].
Joyfully this Lochana Dasa sings [His] glories.

তবে পার হৈলা সে নিকট বৃন্দাবনে ।
অর্ধচন্দ্রাকৃতি শকট রাখিল এইখানে ॥ ১৭৭ ॥

*tabe pāra hailā se nikaṭa bṛndābane |*
*ardhacandrākṛti śakaṭa rākhila eikhāne || 177 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe para haila — then they crossed; se nikata vrindavane — nearer, to Vrindavana; ardhachandrakriti — in a half-moon shape; shakata rakhila eikhane — set the carts here

**177.** "Then they crossed over nearer, to Vrindavana;
here they set the carts in a half-moon.

কপিত্থ-গাছের মূলে বৎসক বধিল ।
পুচ্ছ-পদ ধরি' তারে তুলি' আছাড়িল ॥ ১৭৮ ॥

*kapittha-gāchera mūle batsaka badhila |*
*puccha-pada dhari' tāre tuli' āchāṛila || 178 ||*

*Word for word:* kapittha-gachhera mule — at the root of a kapittha tree; vatsaka vadhila — killed Vatsaka (Vatsasura); puchchha-pada dhari — seizing tail and legs; tare tuli achhadila — lifted and dashed him down

**178.** At the root of a kapittha tree He killed Vatsasura:
seizing him by the tail and legs, He lifted him and dashed him to the ground.

গিলি' উগারিল কৃষ্ণে এথা বকাসুর ।
দুই ঠোঁটে ধরি' চিরি' প্রাণ কৈল দূর ॥ ১৭৯ ॥

*gili' ugārila kṛṣṇe ethā bakāsura |*
*dui ṭhoṁṭe dhari' ciri' prāṇa kaila dūra || 179 ||*

*Word for word:* gili ugarila krishne — swallowed and spat out Krishna; etha bakasura — here Bakasura; dui thonte dhari — seizing both beaks; chiri prana kaila dura — tearing him, took his life

**179.** Here Bakasura swallowed Krishna and spat Him out;
seizing him by both beaks, He tore him apart and took his life.

এই গোঠে বিহরে বালক সব সঙ্গে ।
শিঙ্গা বেণু বেত্র হাথে নানাবিধ রঙ্গে ॥ ১৮০ ॥

*ei goṭhe bihare bālaka saba saṅge |*
*śiṅgā beṇu betra hāthe nānābidha raṅge || 180 ||*

*Word for word:* ei gothe — in this pasture; vihare balaka saba sange — sports with all the boys; shinga venu vetra hathe — horns, flutes, sticks in hand; nanavidha range — in various sports

**180.** In this pasture He plays with all the boys —
horns, flutes, sticks in hand, in various sports.

কেহো কোন জন্তু-ছলে সেই শব্দ করে ।
উড়িতে পক্ষের ছায়া চাহে ধরিবারে ॥ ১৮১ ॥

*keho kona jantu-chale sei śabda kare |*
*uṛite pakṣera chāẏā cāhe dharibāre || 181 ||*

*Word for word:* keho kona jantu-chhale — someone, imitating some animal; sei shabda kare — makes its cry; udite pakshera chhaya — the shadow of a flying bird; chahe dharibare — wants to catch

**181.** Some imitate the cry of some animal,
some want to catch the shadow of a flying bird."

এ বোল শুনিঞা গৌর বিহ্বল হিয়ায় ।
বালকের হেন সেই ইতস্তত ধায় ॥ ১৮২ ॥

*e bola śuniñā gaura bihbala hiẏāẏa |*
*bālakera hena sei itastata dhāẏa || 182 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuninya — hearing this; gaura vihvala hiyaya — Gaura, distraught at heart; balakera hena — like a boy; sei itastata dhaya — runs here and there

**182.** Hearing this, Gaura, distraught at heart,
runs here and there like a boy.

ময়ূরের শব্দ করে ধরয়ে পেখম ।
পুলকে পূরল অঙ্গ অরুণ নয়ন ॥ ১৮৩ ॥

*maẏūrera śabda kare dharaẏe pekhama |*
*pulake pūrala aṅga aruṇa naẏana || 183 ||*

*Word for word:* mayurera shabda kare — cries like a peacock; dharaye pekhama — spreads a tail; pulake purala anga — the body full of thrill; aruna nayana — the eyes red

**183.** He cries like a peacock, spreads [an imagined] tail;
His body is full of thrill, His eyes red.

ভাই ভাই বলি' ডাকে হৈ হৈ বোলে ।
শ্রীদাম সুদাম বলি' গাছ কৈল কোলে ॥ ১৮৪ ॥

*bhāi bhāi bali' ḍāke hai hai bole |*
*śrīdāma sudāma bali' gācha kaila kole || 184 ||*

*Word for word:* bhai bhai bali dake — calls "brother, brother"; hai hai bole — shouts "hey, hey"; shridama sudama bali — crying "Shridama! Sudama!"; gachha kaila kole — embraced a tree

**184.** "Brother, brother!" He calls, shouts: "Hey! Hey!";
"Shridama! Sudama!" He cries and embraces a tree.

সখ্য-ভাবে ব্যাকুল হইয়া গৌররায় ।
প্রেমায় আকুল হঞা চারিদিগে ধায় ॥ ১৮৫ ॥

*sakhya-bhābe byākula haiẏā gaurarāẏa |*
*premāẏa ākula hañā cāridige dhāẏa || 185 ||*

*Word for word:* sakhya-bhave — in the bhava of friendship; vyakula haiya gauraraya — overwhelmed, Gaura Raya; premaya akula hanya — maddened with prema; charidige dhaya — runs in all directions

**185.** Overwhelmed by the bhava of friendship, Gaura Raya,
maddened with prema, runs in all directions.

কালী ধবলী বলি' ডাকে ঘনে ঘন ।
কতি গেল ধেনুকাসুর মারিব এখন ॥ ১৮৬ ॥

*kālī dhabalī bali' ḍāke ghane ghana |*
*kati gela dhenukāsura māriba ekhana || 186 ||*

*Word for word:* kali dhavali bali — crying "Kali! Dhavali!"; dake ghane ghana — calls again and again; kati gela dhenukasura — where has Dhenukasura gone; mariba ekhana — I will kill him now

**186.** "Kali! Dhavali!" He calls again and again. —
"Where has Dhenukasura gone? I will kill him now!"

ইহা বলি' কান্দে বাহ্য নাহিক শরীরে ।
কৃষ্ণদাস বোলে এই সেই যদুবীরে ॥ ১৮৭ ॥

*ihā bali' kānde bāhya nāhika śarīre |*
*kṛṣṇadāsa bole ei sei yadubīre || 187 ||*

*Word for word:* iha bali kande — saying this, He weeps; bahya nahika sharire — no outer awareness in the body; krishnadasa bole — Krishnadasa says; ei sei yaduvire — this is He, the hero of the Yadus

**187.** Saying this, He weeps; His body knows nothing outward.
Krishnadasa says: "This is He — the hero of the Yadus!"

সঙ্গের সঙ্গতিগণ তারাও তেমন ।
গোরা-মুখ নেহারয়ে নাহি সম্বেদন ॥ ১৮৮ ॥

*saṅgera saṅgatigaṇa tārāo temana |*
*gorā-mukha nehāraẏe nāhi sambedana || 188 ||*

*Word for word:* sangera sangatigana — the companions with Him; tarao temana — they too likewise; gora-mukha neharaye — gaze at Gora's face; nahi sambedana — unaware

**188.** And the companions with Him are in the same state:
they gaze at Gora's face, aware of nothing[^48-13].

কথোক্ষণে গৌরচন্দ্রের হইল ত বাহ্য ।
পুনরপি কৃষ্ণদাসে কহে কহ কার্য ॥ ১৮৯ ॥

*kathokṣaṇe gauracandrera haila ta bāhya |*
*punarapi kṛṣṇadāse kahe kaha kārya || 189 ||*

*Word for word:* kathokshane — after a while; gaurachandrera haila ta bahya — Gaurachandra came back to Himself; punarapi krishnadase kahe — again says to Krishnadasa; kaha karya — tell what happened

**189.** After some time Gaurachandra came back to Himself
and again says to Krishnadasa: "Tell Me what happened."

বকের কনিষ্ঠ সর্প নাম অঘাসুর ।
এইখানে কৃষ্ণ তার প্রাণ কৈল দূর ॥ ১৯০ ॥

*bakera kaniṣṭha sarpa nāma aghāsura |*
*eikhāne kṛṣṇa tāra prāṇa kaila dūra || 190 ||*

*Word for word:* bakera kanishtha — Baka's younger brother; sarpa nama aghasura — a serpent named Aghasura; eikhane — here; krishna tara prana kaila dura — Krishna took his life

**190.** "The serpent named Aghasura is Baka's younger brother;
here Krishna took his life.

এইখানে যমুনা ছিল নাহিক এখন ।
এইখানে হরিলা ব্রহ্মা বৎস-শিশুগণ ॥ ১৯১ ॥

*eikhāne yamunā chila nāhika ekhana |*
*eikhāne harilā brahmā batsa-śiśugaṇa || 191 ||*

*Word for word:* eikhane yamuna chhila — here the Yamuna was; nahika ekhana — not now; eikhane harila brahma — here Brahma stole; vatsa-shishugana — the calves and boys

**191.** Here the Yamuna used to be — now it is not;
here Brahma stole the calves and the boys.

বৎসরেক রাখিলা গোবর্ধনের ভিতরে ।
সেই বৎস-শিশু দেখি' ব্রহ্মা স্তব করে ॥ ১৯২ ॥

*batsareka rākhilā gobardhanera bhitare |*
*sei batsa-śiśu dekhi' brahmā staba kare || 192 ||*

*Word for word:* vatsareka rakhila — for a year he kept; govardhanera bhitare — inside Govardhana; sei vatsa-shishu dekhi — seeing those same calves and boys; brahma stava kare — Brahma offers praise

**192.** For a year he kept them in [a cave of] Govardhana;
seeing those same calves and boys, Brahma offered praise.

ধেনুক মারিয়া তাল খাইল বলরাম ।
যমুনাতে দেখ কালীদহ এই ঠাম ॥ ১৯৩ ॥

*dhenuka māriẏā tāla khāila balarāma |*
*yamunāte dekha kālīdaha ei ṭhāma || 193 ||*

*Word for word:* dhenuka mariya — killing Dhenuka; tala khaila balarama — Balarama ate palm fruit; yamunate dekha — on the Yamuna see; kalidaha ei thama — this place, the Kaliya-daha

**193.** [Here] Balarama killed Dhenuka and ate the palm fruits.
See — here on the Yamuna is the place Kaliya-daha.

কদম্বতরু আরোহণ কৈল এইখানে ।
ঝাঁপ দিয়া কৈল কালীনাগের দমনে ॥ ১৯৪ ॥

*kadambataru ārohaṇa kaila eikhāne |*
*jhāṁpa diẏā kaila kālīnāgera damane || 194 ||*

*Word for word:* kadamba-taru arohana kaila — climbed the kadamba tree; eikhane — here; jhanpa diya — leaping; kaila kali-nagera damane — subdued the serpent Kaliya

**194.** Here He climbed the kadamba tree
and, leaping [into the water], subdued the serpent Kaliya.

শীতে আর্ত হঞা কৃষ্ণ এ ঘাটে উঠিলা ।
দ্বাদশ-আদিত্য তবে গগনে উদিলা ॥ ১৯৫ ॥

*śīte ārta hañā kṛṣṇa e ghāṭe uṭhilā |*
*dbādaśa-āditya tabe gagane udilā || 195 ||*

*Word for word:* shite arta hanya — chilled; krishna e ghate uthila — Krishna came up on this ghata; dvadasha-aditya — the twelve suns (Adityas); tabe gagane udila — then rose in the sky

**195.** Chilled through, Krishna came up on this ghata,
and then twelve suns rose in the sky.

দ্বাদশ-আদিত্য-ঘাট তেঞি বোলে লোকে ।
কালীয়দমন-মূর্তি দেখ পরতেখে ॥ ১৯৬ ॥

*dbādaśa-āditya-ghāṭa teñi bole loke |*
*kālīẏadamana-mūrti dekha paratekhe || 196 ||*

*Word for word:* dvadasha-aditya-ghata — the ghata of the Twelve Adityas; tenyi bole loke — therefore people call it; kaliya-damana-murti — the Deity of Kaliya-damana; dekha paratekhe — see before you

**196.** Therefore people call it the ghata of the Twelve Adityas;
see before you the Deity of Kaliya-damana [the Subduer of Kaliya].

এইখানে বালক বৎস পোড়ে দাবানলে ।
দাবানল পান করি' রাখিল সভারে ॥ ১৯৭ ॥

*eikhāne bālaka batsa poṛe dābānale |*
*dābānala pāna kari' rākhila sabhāre || 197 ||*

*Word for word:* eikhane — here; balaka vatsa pode davanale — boys and calves were burning in the forest fire; davanala pana kari — drinking the fire; rakhila sabhare — saved them all

**197.** Here the boys and calves were burning in the forest fire;
drinking up the fire, He saved them all.

শ্রীদামের কান্ধে কৃষ্ণ চড়িলা এখানে ।
প্রলম্ব হারিয়া কান্ধে করে বলরামে ॥ ১৯৮ ॥

*śrīdāmera kāndhe kṛṣṇa caṛilā ekhāne |*
*pralamba hāriẏā kāndhe kare balarāme || 198 ||*

*Word for word:* shridamera kandhe — on Shridama's shoulders; krishna chadila ekhane — Krishna rode here; pralamba hariya — Pralamba, having lost; kandhe kare balarame — carried Balarama on his shoulders

**198.** Here Krishna rode on Shridama's shoulders,
and Pralamba, having lost, carried Balarama on his shoulders.

অসুরের মায়া ব্যক্ত হৈল বলরামে ।
মস্তকে মারিল মুষ্টি ছাড়িল পরাণে ॥ ১৯৯ ॥

*asurera māẏā byakta haila balarāme |*
*mastake mārila muṣṭi chāṛila parāṇe || 199 ||*

*Word for word:* asurera maya — the asura's illusion; vyakta haila balarame — was revealed to Balarama; mastake marila mushti — He struck the head with His fist; chhadila parane — [he] gave up his life

**199.** The asura's illusion was revealed to Balarama:
He struck him on the head with His fist, and he gave up his life.

ভাণ্ডীর-বনেতে অঘাসুরের মরণ ।
নিকটেতে দেখ গোসাঞি হের বৃন্দাবন ॥ ২০০ ॥

*bhāṇḍīra-banete aghāsurera maraṇa |*
*nikaṭete dekha gosāñi hera bṛndābana || 200 ||*

*Word for word:* bhandira-vanete — in the Bhandira forest; aghasurera marana — the death of Aghasura; nikatete dekha — near by see; gosani hera vrindavana — Gosani, here is Vrindavana

**200.** In the Bhandira forest — the death of Aghasura[^48-14].
Near by, see, Gosani, — here is Vrindavana.

ঈষীকা-মুঞ্জাটবী দেখ পরম-মোহন ।
এইখানে আচম্বিতে না দেখে গোধন ॥ ২০১ ॥

*īṣīkā-muñjāṭabī dekha parama-mohana |*
*eikhāne ācambite nā dekhe godhana || 201 ||*
