*Word for word:* ishika-munjatavi — the thickets of ishika and munja reeds; dekha parama-mohana — see, wondrously lovely; eikhane achambite — here suddenly; na dekhe godhana — they do not see the cows

**201.** See — the thickets of ishika and munja reeds, wondrously lovely:
here suddenly [the boys] could not see the cows.

ধেনু না দেখিয়া সে বাঁশীতে দিল ফুঁক ।
ঊর্ধ্ব কাণ করি' ধেনু ধায় আইসে ঊর্ধ্বমুখ ॥ ২০২ ॥

*dhenu nā dekhiẏā se bāṁśīte dila phuṁka |*
*ūrdhba kāṇa kari' dhenu dhāẏa āise ūrdhbamukha || 202 ||*

*Word for word:* dhenu na dekhiya — not seeing the cows; se banshite dila phunka — He blew on the flute; urdhva kana kari — pricking up their ears; dhenu dhaya aise urdhva-mukha — the cows come running, heads raised

**202.** Not seeing the cows, He blew on the flute —
and the cows, pricking up their ears, come running, heads raised.

তৃণমুখে ধেনু ধায় বৎস স্তনমুখী ।
মুরলীর গানেতে মোহিত মৃগ পাখী ॥ ২০৩ ॥

*tṛṇamukhe dhenu dhāẏa batsa stanamukhī |*
*muralīra gānete mohita mṛga pākhī || 203 ||*

*Word for word:* trina-mukhe dhenu dhaya — the cows run with grass in their mouths; vatsa stana-mukhi — the calves to the udders; muralira ganete — by the song of the flute; mohita mriga pakhi — beasts and birds enchanted

**203.** The cows run with grass in their mouths, the calves to the udders;
beasts and birds are enchanted by the song of the flute.

পুনঃ দাবানলে ব্যগ্র ভেল শিশুগণ ।
দাবানল পান শিশু মুদিল নয়ন ॥ ২০৪ ॥

*punaḥ dābānale byagra bhela śiśugaṇa |*
*dābānala pāna śiśu mudila naẏana || 204 ||*

*Word for word:* punah davanale — again by a forest fire; vyagra bhela shishugana — the boys were alarmed; davanala pana — the drinking of the fire; shishu mudila nayana — the boys closed their eyes

**204.** Again the boys were alarmed by a forest fire;
[Krishna] drank up the fire, [while] the boys closed their eyes[^48-15].

এইমতে কৃষ্ণের বিহার স্থানে স্থানে ।
আনন্দে দেখয়ে গৌর কহয়ে লোচনে ॥ ২০৫ ॥

*eimate kṛṣṇera bihāra sthāne sthāne |*
*ānande dekhaẏe gaura kahaẏe locane || 205 ||*

*Word for word:* eimate — thus; krishnera vihara — Krishna's pastimes; sthane sthane — place by place; anande dekhaye gaura — Gaura sees with joy; kahaye lochane — says Lochana

**205.** Thus Krishna's pastimes, place by place,
Gaura sees with joy," says Lochana.

[^48-1]: That is, though He is Krishna Himself, the Lord seems not to know His places and questions Krishnadasa.
[^48-2]: Vv. 88–95 — cf. Murari 4.04. Vasudeva carries the newborn Krishna from the prison to Gokula; the "place where He passed water" (mutra-sthana) is a shrine of Mathura.
[^48-3]: Uddhava is Krishna's friend and counsellor in Mathura; Krishna sent him to Vraja with a message to the gopis (Bhagavata 10.46–47). The Lord speaks as Krishna Himself, from memory.
[^48-4]: The Vishranti-ghata is the "ghata of rest", where Krishna rested after killing Kamsa; Gatashrama ("He whose weariness is gone") is the Deity of Vishnu at this ghata. Vv. 101–114 — cf. Murari 4.04: the houses of the washerman, the garland-maker, Kubja, Vasudeva and Ugrasena, the arena, the twelve ghatas, Kamsa's well.
[^48-5]: V. 128+1 is found only in the 1983 edition; it is absent from the 1903 edition.
[^48-6]: Vv. 116–130 — cf. Murari 4.05. Radha playfully teases Krishna: in the play of love the gopis deliberately refuse to acknowledge His greatness. According to Gaudiya Vaishnava teaching, Krishna is the original Bhagavan, and Rama is His manifestation; in answer to Her mockery He builds the dam. The Setubandha-sarovara is a lake near Kamana (Kamyavana).
[^48-7]: Vv. 132–136 — shrines of Mathura; cf. Murari 4.04. The Saptasamudraka-kunda is the "pond of the seven seas"; by tradition, at this place Kamsa killed Devaki's children. Patala is the underworld.
[^48-8]: Vv. 142–158 are a brief retelling of the Bhagavata (10.1–10.11): Narada's prophecy, Krishna's appearance in four-armed form, Vasudeva carries Him to Gokula, Yogamaya in the form of Yashoda's daughter goes up into the sky, the slaying of Putana, Shakata, Trinavarta, the universe in the Child's mouth, the stealing of butter, the Damodara-lila, the Yamala-arjuna trees, the fruit-seller. The she-jackal showing the ford is a Bengali tradition.
[^48-9]: Gopeshvara is Shiva, who by tradition took the form of a gopi to enter the rasa dance. Ayana (Abhimanyu) is by tradition Radha's husband; Gaudiya Vaishnavas teach that this marriage is only an appearance created by yogamaya for the sake of parakiya-rasa. "The cowherd Sundara" — so in A and C; the 1983 edition reads "Nanda-gopa". On "Ravana's forest of austerity" the 1903 edition gives in a footnote the reading: "where Ravana of Lanka performed austerities."
[^48-10]: Vv. 164–168 — a tradition (known from the Garga-samhita and the Brahma-vaivarta Purana): Nanda entrusts the infant Krishna to Radha in the Bhandira forest (in Lochana Dasa, in Bilvavana). Lochana Dasa tells it briefly and frankly. According to Gaudiya Vaishnava teaching (Bhaktisiddhanta), the love of Radha and Krishna is wholly transcendental (aprakrita): Krishna is ever Radha's Beloved, and His pastimes in the form of a child are not to be measured by worldly standards; these lilas must not be understood after the pattern of worldly relations.
[^48-11]: V. 175+1 is found only in the 1983 edition; it is absent from the 1903 edition.
[^48-12]: Vv. 159–176 — cf. Bhagavata 10.11 (the move to Vrindavana because of the troubles in Gokula). Bhadra and Bhandira are two of the twelve forests.
[^48-13]: The Lord, in the mood of a cowherd friend (sakhya-bhava), calls Shridama and Sudama, and also the cows. In the 1983 edition the cows are Dhavali and Shangali (cf. en/23). "This is He — the hero of the Yadus": Krishnadasa recognizes in the Lord Krishna Himself.
[^48-14]: Vv. 190–200 follow the Bhagavata (10.11–10.20): Aghasura, the stealing of the calves by Brahma, Dhenuka, Kaliya, the forest fire, Pralamba. Pralamba was killed by Balarama in the Bhandira forest; "the death of Aghasura" in v. 200 (so in A and B) is apparently a slip for Pralamba.
[^48-15]: Vv. 201–204 follow the Bhagavata (10.19): the cows strayed into the reed thickets, and a forest fire broke out; Krishna told the boys to close their eyes and swallowed the fire.

---

# Shesha-khanda, part 4 (portion 49)

*The section "The Lord Sees Vrindavana" (continued): Krishnadasa shows the Lord the places of Krishna's pastimes — the stealing of the clothes, Govardhana, the places of the nauka-lila and the dana-lila, the ponds; the ashoka grove blossoms at the Lord's glance; at the place of the rasa the Lord is in ecstasy, and Krishnadasa tells the rasa-lila (with passages found only in the 1983 edition)*

*Raga shri; disha: "Ah, my wondrous Gora! People say: a youth of pure gold"*

গোপকুমারিকা ব্রত কৈল এইখানে ।
কাম্য কৈল—দাসী হব কৃষ্ণের চরণে ॥ ২০৬ ॥

*gopakumārikā brata kaila eikhāne |*
*kāmya kaila—dāsī haba kṛṣṇera caraṇe || 206 ||*

*Word for word:* gopa-kumarika — the cowherd maidens; vrata kaila — kept a vow; eikhane — here; kamya kaila — desired; dasi haba — we shall be maidservants; krishnera charane — at Krishna's feet

**206.** Here the cowherd maidens kept a vow;
they desired: "Let us become maidservants at Krishna's feet"[^49-1].

বস্ত্র আভরণ তারা থুঞা এই ঘাটে ।
জলে নামি' স্নান তারা করয়ে লাঙটে ॥ ২০৭ ॥

*bastra ābharaṇa tārā thuñā ei ghāṭe |*
*jale nāmi' snāna tārā karaẏe lāṅaṭe || 207 ||*

*Word for word:* vastra abharana — clothes and ornaments; tara thunya — they, leaving; ei ghate — at this ghata; jale nami — entering the water; snana tara karaye — they bathe; langte — naked

**207.** Leaving their clothes and ornaments on this ghata,
they entered the water and bathe naked.

আচম্বিতে বস্ত্র-আভরণ লইয়া হরি ।
নীপতরু-পরে উঠি' হাসে ধীরে ধীরে ॥ ২০৮ ॥

*ācambite bastra-ābharaṇa laiẏā hari |*
*nīpataru-pare uṭhi' hāse dhīre dhīre || 208 ||*

*Word for word:* achambite — suddenly; vastra-abharana laiya — taking the clothes and ornaments; hari — Hari; nipa-taru-pare uthi — climbing onto a nipa (kadamba) tree; hase dhire dhire — laughs softly

**208.** Suddenly Hari, taking the clothes and ornaments,
climbed a kadamba tree and laughs softly.

গোপকুমারিকা স্তুতি অনেক যতনে ।
তুষ্ট হঞা দিল তারে বস্ত্র-আভরণে ॥ ২০৯ ॥

*gopakumārikā stuti aneka yatane |*
*tuṣṭa hañā dila tāre bastra-ābharaṇe || 209 ||*

*Word for word:* gopa-kumarika — the cowherd maidens; stuti aneka yatane — [offer] praise with great effort; tushta hanya — being pleased; dila tare — He gave them; vastra-abharane — the clothes and ornaments

**209.** The maidens praise Him with great effort;
pleased, He gave them back their clothes and ornaments.

বৃন্দাবনে প্রশংসয়ে শিশু সম্বোধিয়া ।
যজ্ঞপত্নী-স্থানে অন্ন খাইল মাগিয়া ॥ ২১০ ॥

*bṛndābane praśaṃsaẏe śiśu sambodhiẏā |*
*yajñapatnī-sthāne anna khāila māgiẏā || 210 ||*

*Word for word:* vrindavane prashamsaye — He praises Vrindavana; shishu sambodhiya — addressing the boys; yajna-patni-sthane — from the wives of the sacrificers; anna khaila magiya — He asked for food and ate

**210.** [Here] He praised Vrindavana, addressing the boys;
[here] He asked food of the wives of the sacrificing brahmanas and ate.

কংসের উৎপাতে সব গোপ ভয় পাঞা ।
নন্দীশ্বর-গিরিতে আশ্রয় কৈল গিয়া ॥ ২১১ ॥

*kaṃsera utpāte saba gopa bhaẏa pāñā |*
*nandīśbara-girite āśraẏa kaila giẏā || 211 ||*

*Word for word:* kamsera utpate — through Kamsa's outrages; saba gopa bhaya panya — all the cowherds, being afraid; nandishvara-girite — on the hill Nandishvara; ashraya kaila giya — went and took shelter

**211.** Through Kamsa's outrages all the cowherds, in fear,
went and took shelter on the hill Nandishvara.

বসতি করিল মানসগঙ্গার দু-কূলে ।
বিলাস করিল গোবর্ধনের শিখরে ॥ ২১২ ॥

*basati karila mānasagaṅgāra du-kūle |*
*bilāsa karila gobardhanera śikhare || 212 ||*

*Word for word:* vasati karila — they settled; manasa-gangara du-kule — on both banks of the Manasa-Ganga; vilasa karila — He sported; govardhanera shikhare — on the summit of Govardhana

**212.** They settled on both banks of the Manasa-Ganga,
and He sported on the summit of Govardhana.

ইন্দ্র-সনে বাদ করি' এ পর্বত ধরে ।
তুলিলেক মহাগিরি সপ্তম-বৎসরে ॥ ২১৩ ॥

*indra-sane bāda kari' e parbata dhare |*
*tulileka mahāgiri saptama-batsare || 213 ||*

*Word for word:* indra-sane vada kari — contending with Indra; e parvata dhare — He holds this mountain; tulileka mahagiri — He lifted the great hill; saptama-vatsare — in His seventh year

**213.** Contending with Indra, He holds up this mountain:
the great hill He lifted in His seventh year.

মানসগঙ্গার ধারা পর্বত-ঈশানে ।
স্থল নাহি, পার হৈতে নারে গোপীগণে ॥ ২১৪ ॥

*mānasagaṅgāra dhārā parbata-īśāne |*
*sthala nāhi, pāra haite nāre gopīgaṇe || 214 ||*

*Word for word:* manasa-gangara dhara — the stream of the Manasa-Ganga; parvata-ishane — north-east of the hill; sthala nahi — there is no dry land; para haite nare gopigane — the gopis cannot cross

**214.** The stream of the Manasa-Ganga lies north-east of the hill;
there is no dry land, and the gopis cannot cross.

নৌকা পারাবার করি' বাড়ায় কৌতুক ।
জলে ভাসি' দেহ গোপী দিলেক যৌতুক ॥ ২১৫ ॥

*naukā pārābāra kari' bāṛāẏa kautuka |*
*jale bhāsi' deha gopī dileka yautuka || 215 ||*

*Word for word:* nauka paravara kari — ferrying by boat; badaya kautuka — He increases the fun; jale bhasi — floating on the water; deha gopi dileka yautuka — the gopis gave [their] bodies as a gift

**215.** Ferrying them in a boat, He increases the fun,
and in the midst of the water the gopis gave themselves to Him as a gift[^49-2].

পর্বতের মধ্য দিয়া আছে রাজপথ ।
গোকুল-মথুরার লোক করে গতাগত ॥ ২১৬ ॥

*parbatera madhya diẏā āche rājapatha |*
*gokula-mathurāra loka kare gatāgata || 216 ||*

*Word for word:* parvatera madhya diya — through the hill; achhe rajapatha — there is a highroad; gokula-mathurara loka — the people of Gokula and Mathura; kare gatagata — come and go

**216.** Through the hill runs a highroad:
the people of Gokula and Mathura come and go on it.

পর্বত-উপরে হের দেখ রম্য স্থান ।
এইখানে গোপিকার সাধে মহাদান ॥ ২১৭ ॥

*parbata-upare hera dekha ramya sthāna |*
*eikhāne gopikāra sādhe mahādāna || 217 ||*

*Word for word:* parvata-upare — on the hill; hera dekha — here, see; ramya sthana — a lovely place; eikhane — here; gopikara sadhe mahadana — He exacts the great toll from the gopis

**217.** Here, see, on the hill is a lovely place:
here He exacts the great toll from the gopis.

বসিয়া সাধিত দান এই ত পাষাণে ।
এই দানচৌতারা প্রভু দেখ বিদ্যমানে ॥ ২১৮ ॥

*basiẏā sādhita dāna ei ta pāṣāṇe |*
*ei dānacautārā prabhu dekha bidyamāne || 218 ||*

*Word for word:* basiya sadhita dana — sitting, He exacted the toll; ei ta pashane — on this very rock; ei dana-chautara — this is the toll platform; prabhu dekha vidyamane — Lord, see it before You

**218.** Sitting on this very rock He exacted the toll;
this is the toll-collector's platform, Lord — see it before You"[^49-3].

পাষাণ দেখিয়া প্রভু গদগদ-স্বর ।
অরুণ-বরণ ভেল সব কলেবর ॥ ২১৯ ॥

*pāṣāṇa dekhiẏā prabhu gadagada-sbara |*
*aruṇa-baraṇa bhela saba kalebara || 219 ||*

*Word for word:* pashana dekhiya — seeing the rock; prabhu gadgada-svara — the Lord's voice falters; aruna-varana bhela — became crimson; saba kalevara — His whole body

**219.** Seeing the rock, the Lord spoke in a faltering voice,
and His whole body turned crimson.

নিজ কর দিয়া প্রভু মাজয়ে পাষাণ ।
একদৃষ্টে চাহে প্রভু বসিবার স্থান ॥ ২২০ ॥

*nija kara diẏā prabhu mājaẏe pāṣāṇa |*
*ekadṛṣṭe cāhe prabhu basibāra sthāna || 220 ||*

*Word for word:* nija kara diya — with His own hand; prabhu majaye pashana — the Lord rubs the rock; ekadrishte chahe — gazes fixedly; prabhu basibara sthana — the Lord at the place of sitting

**220.** With His own hand the Lord strokes the rock
and gazes fixedly at the place where [Krishna] sat.

ক্ষণে বুক দেয় ক্ষণে করে নমস্কার ।
ক্ষণে বোলে—রাধা, দান দেহ না আমার ॥ ২২১ ॥

*kṣaṇe buka deẏa kṣaṇe kare namaskāra |*
*kṣaṇe bole—rādhā, dāna deha nā āmāra || 221 ||*

*Word for word:* kshane buka deya — now He presses His chest [to it]; kshane kare namaskara — now He bows; kshane bole — now He says; radha — Radha; dana deha na amara — will you not pay Me My toll

**221.** Now He presses His chest to it, now He bows,
now He says: "Radha, why do you not pay Me My toll?"[^49-4]

অবশ শরীর প্রভু পড়ে ভূমিতলে ।
ক্ষণেতে উঠিয়া সে পাথর করে কোলে ॥ ২২২ ॥

*abaśa śarīra prabhu paṛe bhūmitale |*
*kṣaṇete uṭhiẏā se pāthara kare kole || 222 ||*

*Word for word:* avasha sharira — His body powerless; prabhu pade bhumitale — the Lord falls to the ground; kshanete uthiya — rising at once; se pathara kare kole — He embraces that stone

**222.** His body powerless, the Lord falls to the ground,
then suddenly rises and embraces that stone.

কৃষ্ণদাস বোলে—গোসাঞি, শুন মোর বোল ।
দেখিবে ত সব স্থান, নহ উতরোল ॥ ২২৩ ॥

*kṛṣṇadāsa bole—gosāñi, śuna mora bola |*
*dekhibe ta saba sthāna, naha utarola || 223 ||*

*Word for word:* krishnadasa bole — Krishnadasa says; gosani shuna mora bola — Gosani, hear my word; dekhibe ta saba sthana — You will surely see all the places; naha utarola — do not be agitated

**223.** Krishnadasa says: "Gosani, listen to me:
You will surely see all the places — do not be agitated.

পর্বতের পূর্বে দেখ এ কুসুমবন ।
তাহার দক্ষিণে রাসমণ্ডলের স্থান ॥ ২২৪ ॥

*parbatera pūrbe dekha e kusumabana |*
*tāhāra dakṣiṇe rāsamaṇḍalera sthāna || 224 ||*

*Word for word:* parvatera purve — east of the hill; dekha e kusuma-vana — see this Kusuma-vana (flower grove); tahara dakshine — to its south; rasa-mandalera sthana — the place of the rasa circle

**224.** See, east of the hill is this Kusuma-vana [the flower grove];
to its south is the place of the rasa circle."

এ বোল বলিতে গোরা বোলে—রহ রহ ।
শ্রীরাসমণ্ডল-কথা ভালমতে কহ ॥ ২২৫ ॥

*e bola balite gorā bole—raha raha |*
*śrīrāsamaṇḍala-kathā bhālamate kaha || 225 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola balite — as he said this; gora bole — Gora says; raha raha — stop, stop; sri-rasa-mandala-katha — the account of the holy rasa circle; bhalamate kaha — tell it properly

**225.** As soon as he said this, Gora says: "Stop, stop!
Tell properly about the holy rasa circle."

রাধাকৃষ্ণ রাস কৈল—সেই এই স্থান ।
এ বোল বলিতে গোরার ঝরে দু-নয়ান ॥ ২২৬ ॥

*rādhākṛṣṇa rāsa kaila—sei ei sthāna |*
*e bola balite gorāra jhare du-naẏāna || 226 ||*

*Word for word:* radha-krishna rasa kaila — Radha and Krishna danced the rasa; sei ei sthana — this is that place; e bola balite — as this was said; gorara jhare du-nayana — Gora's two eyes stream

**226.** "Radha and Krishna danced the rasa — this is that very place."
As soon as he said this, tears streamed from Gora's eyes.

হাহা কৃষ্ণ, হাহা রাধা—বোলে বারবার ।
অরুণ-নয়ানে ঝরে সাত-পাঁচ ধার ॥ ২২৭ ॥

*hāhā kṛṣṇa, hāhā rādhā—bole bārabāra |*
*aruṇa-naẏāne jhare sāta-pāṁca dhāra || 227 ||*

*Word for word:* haha krishna haha radha — "O Krishna! O Radha!"; bole barabara — He says again and again; aruna-nayane — from His reddened eyes; jhare sata-pancha dhara — countless streams flow

**227.** "O Krishna! O Radha!" He says again and again;
from His reddened eyes flow countless streams.

শ্রীরাসমণ্ডল বলি' পাড়ে গড়াগড়ি ।
ক্ষণে উভ বাহু তুলি' হুঙ্কার ছাড়ি ॥ ২২৮ ॥

*śrīrāsamaṇḍala bali' pāṛe gaṛāgaṛi |*
*kṣaṇe ubha bāhu tuli' huṅkāra chāṛi || 228 ||*

*Word for word:* sri-rasa-mandala bali — saying "the holy rasa circle"; pade gadagadi — He rolls on the ground; kshane ubha bahu tuli — now raising both arms; hunkara chhadi — letting out loud roars

**228.** Crying "The holy rasa circle!" He rolls on the ground,
now, raising both arms, He lets out loud roars.

জানুর উপরে জানু ত্রিভঙ্গিম রহে ।
শুন শুন বলি' রাধাকৃষ্ণ-কথা কহে ॥ ২২৯ ॥

*jānura upare jānu tribhaṅgima rahe |*
*śuna śuna bali' rādhākṛṣṇa-kathā kahe || 229 ||*

*Word for word:* janura upare janu — knee over knee; tribhangima rahe — He stands thrice-bent; shuna shuna bali — saying "listen, listen"; radha-krishna-katha kahe — He tells of Radha and Krishna

**229.** Placing knee over knee He stands thrice-bent[^49-5],
and, saying "listen, listen," He tells of Radha and Krishna.

পুনঃ কি কহিব বলি' অট্ট-অট্ট হাস ।
এইখানে হয়ে রাধাকৃষ্ণ কৈল রাস ॥ ২৩০ ॥

*punaḥ ki kahiba bali' aṭṭa-aṭṭa hāsa |*
*eikhāne haẏe rādhākṛṣṇa kaila rāsa || 230 ||*

*Word for word:* punah ki kahiba bali — saying "what more shall I say?"; atta-atta hasa — loud laughter; eikhane haye — right here; radha-krishna kaila rasa — Radha and Krishna danced the rasa

**230.** And again: "What more shall I say?" — and He laughs aloud:
"Right here Radha and Krishna danced the rasa!"

বিহ্বল দেখিয়া গৌর, বোলে কৃষ্ণদাস—
পর্বত-উপরে রাধা-কদম্ব-বিলাস ॥ ২৩১ ॥

*bihbala dekhiẏā gaura, bole kṛṣṇadāsa—*
*parbata-upare rādhā-kadamba-bilāsa || 231 ||*

*Word for word:* vihvala dekhiya gaura — seeing Gaura overwhelmed; bole krishnadasa — Krishnadasa says; parvata-upare — on the hill; radha-kadamba-vilasa — the pastime-place of the Radha-kadamba

**231.** Seeing Gaura overwhelmed, Krishnadasa says:
"On the hill is the place of pastimes by the Radha-kadamba[^49-6].

দেখ ইন্দ্র-আরাধন—অন্নকূট-স্থান ।
ইন্দ্রপূজা বাধ কৃষ্ণ কৈল এই স্থান ॥ ২৩২ ॥

*dekha indra-ārādhana—annakūṭa-sthāna |*
*indrapūjā bādha kṛṣṇa kaila ei sthāna || 232 ||*

*Word for word:* dekha — see; indra-aradhana — the worship of Indra; annakuta-sthana — the place of the Annakuta; indra-puja badha — the stopping of Indra's worship; krishna kaila ei sthana — Krishna did at this place

**232.** See — the place of the Annakuta, where [the cowherds] worshipped Indra:
at this place Krishna stopped the worship of Indra.

অভিমানে আপনা পাশরে ইন্দ্ররাজ ।
ঝড় বরিষণ কৈল গোয়ালা-সমাজ ॥ ২৩৩ ॥

*abhimāne āpanā pāśare indrarāja |*
*jhaṛa bariṣaṇa kaila goẏālā-samāja || 233 ||*

*Word for word:* abhimane — in pride; apana pashare — forgets himself; indraraja — King Indra; jhada varishana kaila — sent storm and rain; goyala-samaja — on the cowherd community

**233.** In his pride King Indra forgot himself
and sent storm and rain upon the cowherd community.

সেইরূপ মূর্তি দেখ পর্বত-শিখরে ।
হরিরায় নাম মূর্তি পর্বত-উপরে ॥ ২৩৪ ॥

*seirūpa mūrti dekha parbata-śikhare |*
*harirāẏa nāma mūrti parbata-upare || 234 ||*

*Word for word:* seirupa murti — a Deity of that form; dekha parvata-shikhare — see on the hilltop; hariraya nama murti — the Deity named Hariraya; parvata-upare — on the hill

**234.** See — on the hilltop is a Deity in that very form:
the Deity named Hariraya on the hill.

গোবর্ধন-উপরে দক্ষিণভাগে বাস ।
গোপালরায় নাম, হেথা কৃষ্ণের বিলাস ॥ ২৩৫ ॥

*gobardhana-upare dakṣiṇabhāge bāsa |*
*gopālarāẏa nāma, hethā kṛṣṇera bilāsa || 235 ||*

*Word for word:* govardhana-upare — on Govardhana; dakshina-bhage vasa — dwells on the southern side; gopalaraya nama — named Gopalaraya; hetha krishnera vilasa — here are Krishna's pastimes

**235.** On Govardhana, on the southern side, dwells
[the Deity] named Gopalaraya: here are Krishna's pastimes.

ইন্দ্রদর্প হরি' চড়ে পর্বত-শিখরে ।
এথা ইন্দ্র-অভিষেক রাজরাজেশ্বরে ॥ ২৩৬ ॥

*indradarpa hari' caṛe parbata-śikhare |*
*ethā indra-abhiṣeka rājarājeśbare || 236 ||*

*Word for word:* indra-darpa hari — taking away Indra's pride; chade parvata-shikhare — He climbs the hilltop; etha — here; indra-abhisheka rajarajeshvare — Indra's anointing of the King of kings

**236.** Having crushed Indra's pride, He climbs to the hilltop:
here Indra performed the anointing of the King of kings[^49-7].

সর্বপাপহর কুণ্ড পর্বত-দক্ষিণে ।
তাহার উপরে দেখ শিলা উবটনে ॥ ২৩৭ ॥

*sarbapāpahara kuṇḍa parbata-dakṣiṇe |*
*tāhāra upare dekha śilā ubaṭane || 237 ||*

*Word for word:* sarva-papa-hara kunda — the pond that removes all sins; parvata-dakshine — south of the hill; tahara upare — above it; dekha shila ubatane — see the stone of anointing

**237.** South of the hill is the pond that removes all sins;
above it, see, is the stone of anointing[^49-8].

আর পাঁচ কুণ্ড দেখ পর্বত-উপর ।
ব্রহ্মকুণ্ড, রুদ্রকুণ্ড—সর্বতীর্থসার ॥ ২৩৮ ॥

*āra pāṁca kuṇḍa dekha parbata-upara |*
*brahmakuṇḍa, rudrakuṇḍa—sarbatīrthasāra || 238 ||*

*Word for word:* ara pancha kunda — five more ponds; dekha parvata-upara — see on the hill; brahma-kunda rudra-kunda — the Brahma-kunda, the Rudra-kunda; sarva-tirtha-sara — the essence of all tirthas

**238.** See — on the hill are five more ponds:
the Brahma-kunda and the Rudra-kunda — the essence of all tirthas,

ইন্দ্রকুণ্ড, সূর্যকুণ্ড, মোক্ষকুণ্ড-নামে ।
পৃথিবীতে যত তীর্থ ইহাতে বিশ্রামে ॥ ২৩৯ ॥

*indrakuṇḍa, sūryakuṇḍa, mokṣakuṇḍa-nāme |*
*pṛthibīte yata tīrtha ihāte biśrāme || 239 ||*

*Word for word:* indra-kunda surya-kunda — the Indra-kunda, the Surya-kunda; moksha-kunda-name — named Moksha-kunda; prithivite yata tirtha — all the tirthas on earth; ihate vishrame — rest in them

**239.** [and] the ponds named Indra-kunda, Surya-kunda and Moksha-kunda:
all the tirthas on earth rest in them.

এইখানে দ্বাদশী-পারণা-স্নানকালে ।
বরুণে হরিল নন্দ—কৃষ্ণ দেখিবারে ॥ ২৪০ ॥

*eikhāne dbādaśī-pāraṇā-snānakāle |*
*baruṇe harila nanda—kṛṣṇa dekhibāre || 240 ||*

*Word for word:* eikhane — here; dvadashi-parana-snana-kale — at the bath before breaking the fast on Dvadashi; varune harila nanda — Varuna carried off Nanda; krishna dekhibare — in order to see Krishna

**240.** Here, when [Nanda] bathed before breaking the fast on Dvadashi,
Varuna carried Nanda off in order to see Krishna.

ব্রহ্মকুণ্ড-মজ্জন এই দেখ বৃন্দাবন ।
কৃষ্ণের বিভব শিশু দেখহ নয়ন ॥ ২৪১ ॥

*brahmakuṇḍa-majjana ei dekha bṛndābana |*
*kṛṣṇera bibhaba śiśu dekhaha naẏana || 241 ||*

*Word for word:* brahma-kunda-majjana — the immersion in the Brahma-kunda; ei dekha vrindavana — here, see, Vrindavana; krishnera vibhava — Krishna's glory; shishu dekhaha nayana — the children [of Vraja] see with their eyes

**241.** Here is the Brahma-kunda where [the cowherds] were immersed — see, here is Vrindavana:
[here] the children [of Vraja] saw Krishna's glory with their own eyes[^49-9].

অশোক-বন দেখ এই কুণ্ডের উত্তরে ।
এক আশ্চর্য কথা শুনহ ইহারে ॥ ২৪২ ॥

*aśoka-bana dekha ei kuṇḍera uttare |*
*eka āścarya kathā śunaha ihāre || 242 ||*

*Word for word:* ashoka-vana dekha — see the ashoka grove; ei kundera uttare — north of this pond; eka ashcharya katha — a wonderful account; shunaha ihare — hear about it

**242.** See — north of this pond is an ashoka grove;
hear a wonderful account about it.

কার্তিক-পূর্ণিমা-তিথি দিবসের মাঝে ।
কুসুমিত হয় তরু, দেখে সর্বরাজ্যে ॥ ২৪৩ ॥

*kārtika-pūrṇimā-tithi dibasera mājhe |*
*kusumita haẏa taru, dekhe sarbarājye || 243 ||*

*Word for word:* kartika-purnima-tithi — on the full-moon day of Kartika; divasera majhe — in the middle of the day; kusumita haya taru — the trees burst into flower; dekhe sarva-rajye — the whole land sees

**243.** On the full-moon day of Kartika, in the middle of the day,
the trees [here] burst into flower, and the whole land sees it."

এ বোল শুনিঞা প্রভু নেহারয়ে বন ।
অকালে পুষ্পিত তরু ভৈগেল তখন ॥ ২৪৪ ॥

*e bola śuniñā prabhu nehāraẏe bana |*
*akāle puṣpita taru bhaigela takhana || 244 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuninya — hearing this; prabhu neharaye vana — the Lord gazes at the grove; akale pushpita taru — the trees blossomed out of season; bhaigela takhana — became then

**244.** Hearing this, the Lord gazes at the grove —
and at once the trees blossomed out of season.

মুঞ্জরিত তরু লতা, ফল-ফুল কোলে ।
অদ্ভুত দেখিয়া কৃষ্ণদাস কিছু বোলে ॥ ২৪৫ ॥

*muñjarita taru latā, phala-phula kole |*
*adbhuta dekhiẏā kṛṣṇadāsa kichu bole || 245 ||*

*Word for word:* munjarita taru lata — trees and creepers in blossom; phala-phula kole — holding fruits and flowers; adbhuta dekhiya — seeing the wonder; krishnadasa kichhu bole — Krishnadasa speaks

**245.** Trees and creepers came into blossom, laden with fruit and flowers;
seeing this wonder, Krishnadasa speaks.

অদ্ভুত গন্ধ গোরা-অঙ্গের বাতাস ।
কৃষ্ণদাস বোলে—তোমার কপট সন্ন্যাস ॥ ২৪৬ ॥

*adbhuta gandha gorā-aṅgera bātāsa |*
*kṛṣṇadāsa bole—tomāra kapaṭa sannyāsa || 246 ||*

*Word for word:* adbhuta gandha — a wondrous fragrance; gora-angera batasa — the breeze from Gora's body; krishnadasa bole — Krishnadasa says; tomara kapata sannyasa — Your sannyasa is a disguise

**246.** From Gora's body blows a breeze of wondrous fragrance.
Krishnadasa says: "Your sannyasa is only a disguise"[^49-10].

দণ্ডবত করে ভূমে, স্তব্ধ হঞা রহে ।
কহ কহ কহ—গৌর কৃষ্ণদাসে কহে ॥ ২৪৭ ॥

*daṇḍabata kare bhūme, stabdha hañā rahe |*
*kaha kaha kaha—gaura kṛṣṇadāse kahe || 247 ||*

*Word for word:* dandavata kare bhume — he prostrates on the ground; stabdha hanya rahe — remains motionless; kaha kaha kaha — "speak, speak, speak"; gaura krishnadase kahe — Gaura says to Krishnadasa

**247.** He prostrates on the ground and remains motionless.
"Speak, speak, speak!" Gaura says to Krishnadasa.

কৃষ্ণদাস বোলে—গোসাঞি, শুনহ বচনে ।
রাসক্রীড়া কৈল কৃষ্ণ এই বৃন্দাবনে ॥ ২৪৮ ॥

*kṛṣṇadāsa bole—gosāñi, śunaha bacane |*
*rāsakrīṛā kaila kṛṣṇa ei bṛndābane || 248 ||*

*Word for word:* krishnadasa bole — Krishnadasa says; gosani shunaha vachane — Gosani, hear the word; rasa-krida kaila krishna — Krishna performed the rasa play; ei vrindavane — in this Vrindavana

**248.** Krishnadasa says: "Gosani, listen:
in this Vrindavana Krishna performed the rasa play.

এই কল্পতরু-মূলে পূরে বংশীনাদ ।
ষোলক্রোশ পথে গোপীর ভেল উনমাদ ॥ ২৪৯ ॥

*ei kalpataru-mūle pūre baṃśīnāda |*
*ṣolakrośa pathe gopīra bhela unamāda || 249 ||*

*Word for word:* ei kalpataru-mule — at the foot of this wish-fulfilling tree; pure vamshi-nada — He fills [the air] with the flute's sound; shola-krosha pathe — over sixteen kroshas; gopira bhela unamada — the gopis went mad

**249.** At the foot of this wish-fulfilling tree He played the flute —
and for sixteen kroshas around the gopis went mad.

বিগত-চেতন গোপী কৃষ্ণ-আকর্ষণে ।
উপেখিল কুল-শীল-লাজ-ভয় মানে ॥ ২৫০ ॥

*bigata-cetana gopī kṛṣṇa-ākarṣaṇe |*
*upekhila kula-śīla-lāja-bhaẏa māne || 250 ||*

*Word for word:* vigata-chetana gopi — the gopis, beside themselves; krishna-akarshane — by Krishna's attraction; upekhila — disregarded; kula-shila-laja-bhaya mane — family, good conduct, shame, fear and honour

**250.** Drawn by Krishna, the gopis lost their senses
and disregarded family, good conduct, shame, fear and honour.

ব্যস্ত-বস্ত্র-আভরণ হৈল সভাকার ।
কৃষ্ণগত-চিত্তবৃত্তি মদন-ঝঙ্কার ॥ ২৫১ ॥

*byasta-bastra-ābharaṇa haila sabhākāra |*
*kṛṣṇagata-cittabṛtti madana-jhaṅkāra || 251 ||*

*Word for word:* vyasta-vastra-abharana — clothes and ornaments in disarray; haila sabhakara — were with all of them; krishna-gata-chitta-vritti — their thoughts gone to Krishna; madana-jhankara — the ringing [call] of Madana

**251.** All of them had their clothes and ornaments in disarray,
all their thoughts gone to Krishna, the call of Madana ringing in their hearts.

অপ্রাকৃত-কামেতে মুগধ ব্রজবালা ।
কৃষ্ণের নিকটে আসি' সভাই মিলিলা ॥ ২৫২ ॥

*aprākṛta-kāmete mugadha brajabālā |*
*kṛṣṇera nikaṭe āsi' sabhāi mililā || 252 ||*

*Word for word:* aprakrita-kamete — by transcendental "kama" (love); mugadha vraja-bala — the enchanted maidens of Vraja; krishnera nikate asi — coming to Krishna; sabhai milila — all gathered

**252.** Enchanted by transcendental love[^49-11], the maidens of Vraja
came to Krishna and all gathered together.

এইখানে দেখ বামে এ গোবিন্দরায় ।
শুনিমাত্র গোরাচান্দ বিভোর হিয়ায় ॥ ২৫৩ ॥

*eikhāne dekha bāme e gobindarāẏa |*
*śunimātra gorācānda bibhora hiẏāẏa || 253 ||*

*Word for word:* eikhane dekha vame — here, see, on the left; e govinda-raya — this Govindaraya; shunimatra gorachanda — as soon as He heard, Gorachand; vibhora hiyaya — rapt in heart

**253.** Here, see, on the left — this Govindaraya"[^49-12].
As soon as He heard this, Gorachand was rapt in heart.

হইল আবেশ পুনঃ, পরবশ অঙ্গ ।
এ ভূমি-আকাশ জোড়ে প্রেমের তরঙ্গ ॥ ২৫৪ ॥

*haila ābeśa punaḥ, parabaśa aṅga |*
*e bhūmi-ākāśa joṛe premera taraṅga || 254 ||*

*Word for word:* haila avesha punah — ecstasy came again; paravasha anga — His body overpowered; e bhumi-akasha jode — fill earth and sky; premera taranga — waves of prema

**254.** Ecstasy came again; His body was not His own;
waves of prema fill earth and sky.

হুহুঙ্কার-নাদে রস-অমিয়া বরষে ।
পশু-পক্ষী উনমাদ মদন-হরিষে ॥ ২৫৫ ॥

*huhuṅkāra-nāde rasa-amiẏā baraṣe |*
*paśu-pakṣī unamāda madana-hariṣe || 255 ||*

*Word for word:* huhunkara-nade — with thunderous roars; rasa-amiya varishe — He rains the nectar of rasa; pashu-pakshi unamada — beasts and birds go mad; madana-harishe — in the joy of love

**255.** With thunderous roars He rains the nectar of rasa;
beasts and birds go mad with the joy of love.

অকালে পুষ্পিত ভেল সব তরুবর ।
কোকিল সুস্বর-নাদে, মাতিল ভ্রমর ॥ ২৫৬ ॥

*akāle puṣpita bhela saba tarubara |*
*kokila susbara-nāde, mātila bhramara || 256 ||*

*Word for word:* akale pushpita bhela — blossomed out of season; saba taruvara — all the fine trees; kokila susvara-nade — the cuckoos sing sweetly; matila bhramara — the bees grew intoxicated

**256.** All the trees blossomed out of season,
the cuckoos sing sweetly, the bees grew intoxicated.

বংশী বলি' ডাকে প্রভু রাস প্রশংসিয়া ।
ভালি রে ভালি রে বোলে মুচকি হাসিয়া ॥ ২৫৭ ॥

*baṃśī bali' ḍāke prabhu rāsa praśaṃsiẏā |*
*bhāli re bhāli re bole mucaki hāsiẏā || 257 ||*

*Word for word:* vamshi bali dake — He calls, crying "the flute!"; prabhu — the Lord; rasa prashamsiya — praising the rasa; bhali re bhali re bole — says "splendid, splendid!"; muchaki hasiya — smiling gently

**257.** The Lord calls, crying "The flute!", and, praising the rasa,
says with a gentle smile: "Splendid, splendid!"

কোন গোপী বোলে—তোরা রহ এইখানে ।
কেহো কথা কহে যেন নিদের স্বপনে ॥ ২৫৮ ॥

*kona gopī bole—torā raha eikhāne |*
*keho kathā kahe yena nidera sbapane || 258 ||*

*Word for word:* kona gopi bole — some gopi says; tora raha eikhane — you stay here; keho katha kahe — someone speaks; yena nidera svapane — as if in a dream

**258.** Now, [like] some gopi, He says: "You stay here!" —
now He speaks [like] someone in a dream[^49-13].

ক্ষণেকে চমকি' নিজ অঙ্গ করে কোলে ।
দ্রবময় ভেল দেহ—সব অঙ্গ ঝরে ॥ ২৫৯ ॥

*kṣaṇeke camaki' nija aṅga kare kole |*
*drabamaẏa bhela deha—saba aṅga jhare || 259 ||*

*Word for word:* kshaneke chamaki — suddenly startled; nija anga kare kole — He embraces His own body; drava-maya bhela deha — His body seemed to melt; saba anga jhare — all His limbs stream

**259.** Now, suddenly startled, He embraces His own body;
His body seemed to melt, all His limbs streaming.

ক্ষণে বাল্যাবেশে নাচে অট্ট-অট্ট হাস ।
বিহ্বল চরণে পড়ি' কান্দে কৃষ্ণদাস ॥ ২৬০ ॥

*kṣaṇe bālyābeśe nāce aṭṭa-aṭṭa hāsa |*
*bihbala caraṇe paṛi' kānde kṛṣṇadāsa || 260 ||*

*Word for word:* kshane balya-aveshe — now in a childlike rapture; nache atta-atta hasa — He dances with loud laughter; vihvala charane padi — overwhelmed, falling at His feet; kande krishnadasa — Krishnadasa weeps

**260.** Now in a childlike rapture He dances with loud laughter;
Krishnadasa, overwhelmed, weeps, fallen at His feet:

মোর ভাগ্যে তিনলোকে নাহি কোন জন ।
বড় ভাগ্যে পাইলুঁ মুঞি হারাইলুঁ ধন ॥ ২৬১ ॥

*mora bhāgye tinaloke nāhi kona jana |*
*baṛa bhāgye pāiluṁ muñi hārāiluṁ dhana || 261 ||*

*Word for word:* mora bhagye — with fortune like mine; tina-loke nahi kona jana — there is no one in the three worlds; bada bhagye — by great fortune; pailun munyi — I have found; harailun dhana — my lost treasure

**261.** "There is no one in the three worlds with fortune like mine:
by great fortune I have found my lost treasure!"

এ বোল বলিতে প্রভুর বাহ্য হৈল যবে ।
কহ, কৃষ্ণদাসে পুছে—কি হৈল তবে ॥ ২৬২ ॥

*e bola balite prabhura bāhya haila yabe |*
*kaha, kṛṣṇadāse puche—ki haila tabe || 262 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola balite — as he said this; prabhura bahya haila yabe — when the Lord's outer awareness returned; kaha — tell; krishnadase puchhe — He asks Krishnadasa; ki haila tabe — what happened then

**262.** When at these words the Lord's outer awareness returned,
He asks Krishnadasa: "Tell Me, what happened then?"

এইখানে গোপীকে বুঝায় কুলাচার ।
গোপীর নিগূঢ় ভক্তিভাব বুঝিবার ॥ ২৬৩ ॥

*eikhāne gopīke bujhāẏa kulācāra |*
*gopīra nigūṛha bhaktibhāba bujhibāra || 263 ||*

*Word for word:* eikhane — here; gopike bujhaya kulachara — He explains family duty to the gopis; gopira nigudha bhakti-bhava — the gopis' hidden devotion; bujhibara — in order to discern

**263.** "Here [Krishna] instructs the gopis about duty to family —
to discern the gopis' hidden devotion,

কিম্বা অনুরাগ বৃদ্ধি করিবার তরে ।
রস-পরিপাটী ভাব বাড়ায় অন্তরে ॥ ২৬৪ ॥

*kimbā anurāga bṛddhi karibāra tare |*
*rasa-paripāṭī bhāba bāṛāẏa antare || 264 ||*

*Word for word:* kimva — or else; anuraga vriddhi karibara tare — in order to increase their love; rasa-paripati — in the proper course of rasa; bhava badaya antare — He heightens the bhava in [their] hearts

**264.** or to increase their love:
He heightens the bhava in their hearts in the proper course of rasa[^49-14].

সুমধ্যমাগণ, কেনে রাত্রে কুঞ্জমাঝে ।
ভয় না করিলে, এথা আইলে কোন্ কাজে ॥ ২৬৫ ॥

*sumadhyamāgaṇa, kene rātre kuñjamājhe |*
*bhaẏa nā karile, ethā āile kon kāje || 265 ||*

*Word for word:* sumadhyama-gana — O slender-waisted ones; kene ratre kunja-majhe — why at night into the grove; bhaya na karile — you were not afraid; etha aile kon kaje — for what purpose have you come here

**265.** 'O slender-waisted ones, why are you in the grove at night?
You were not afraid — why have you come here?

পরপতি-লালস-পরাণ হেতু তোরা ।
পরনারী-দরশ-পরশ নাহি মোরা ॥ ২৬৬ ॥

*parapati-lālasa-parāṇa hetu torā |*
*paranārī-daraśa-paraśa nāhi morā || 266 ||*

*Word for word:* para-pati-lalasa-parana — your hearts longing for another's husband; hetu tora — for that you [came]; para-nari-darasha-parasha — looking at and touching others' wives; nahi mora — is not for us

**266.** Your hearts long for another's husband — that is why [you came];
but I do not look at other men's wives or touch them.

আপনার ঘরে গিয়া পতি-সেবা কর ।
নারী নিজপতি ভজে—এই ধর্মসার ॥ ২৬৭ ॥

*āpanāra ghare giẏā pati-sebā kara |*
*nārī nijapati bhaje—ei dharmasāra || 267 ||*

*Word for word:* apanara ghare giya — going to your homes; pati-seva kara — serve your husbands; nari nija-pati bhaje — a woman serves her own husband; ei dharma-sara — this is the essence of dharma

**267.** Go home and serve your husbands:
a wife serves her own husband — this is the essence of dharma.

কিবা রুগ্ন কিবা বৃদ্ধ দরিদ্র কুরূপ ।
নিজপতি-সেবা পরধর্মের স্বরূপ ॥ ২৬৮ ॥

*kibā rugna kibā bṛddha daridra kurūpa |*
*nijapati-sebā paradharmera sbarūpa || 268 ||*

*Word for word:* kiba rugna kiba vriddha — be he sick or old; daridra kurupa — poor or ugly; nija-pati-seva — service to one's own husband; para-dharmera svarupa — the very form of the highest dharma

**268.** Be he sick or old, poor or ugly —
service to one's own husband is the very form of the highest dharma.

চল চল নিজগৃহে, চল ব্রজবালা ।
সতী নাহি করে নিজধর্মে অবহেলা ॥ ২৬৯ ॥

*cala cala nijagṛhe, cala brajabālā |*
*satī nāhi kare nijadharme abahelā || 269 ||*

*Word for word:* chala chala nija-grihe — go, go to your homes; chala vraja-bala — go, maidens of Vraja; sati nahi kare — a chaste wife does not show; nija-dharme avahela — neglect of her own duty

**269.** Go, go home, go, maidens of Vraja:
a chaste wife does not neglect her duty.

আমি মহাধর্ম, কভু না করি অধর্ম ।
না বুঝি' আমার মন কৈলে কোন্ কর্ম ॥ ২৭০ ॥

*āmi mahādharma, kabhu nā kari adharma |*
*nā bujhi' āmāra mana kaile kon karma || 270 ||*

*Word for word:* ami mahadharma — I [keep] the great dharma; kabhu na kari adharma — I never commit unrighteousness; na bujhi amara mana — without understanding My mind; kaile kon karma — what have you done

**270.** I keep the great dharma and never act unrighteously;
not understanding My heart, what have you done?'

শুনিঞা রমণীগণ হৈলা মূর্ছিতে ।
স্তব্ধ হইয়া রহে যেন চিত্র রহে ভিতে ॥ ২৭১ ॥

*śuniñā ramaṇīgaṇa hailā mūrchite |*
*stabdha haiẏā rahe yena citra rahe bhite || 271 ||*

*Word for word:* shuninya — hearing; ramanigana haila murchhite — the women swooned; stabdha haiya rahe — they stand motionless; yena chitra rahe bhite — like pictures on a wall

**271.** Hearing this, the maidens swooned;
they stood motionless, like pictures on a wall.

অল্প অল্প শ্বাস হৈল, বাক্য নাহি কারে ।
মদন-জ্বরেতে জারিলেক কলেবরে ॥ ২৭২ ॥

*alpa alpa śbāsa haila, bākya nāhi kāre |*
*madana-jbarete jārileka kalebare || 272 ||*

*Word for word:* alpa alpa shvasa haila — their breathing grew faint; vakya nahi kare — none had words; madana-jvarete — by the fever of love; jarileka kalevare — their bodies were consumed

**272.** Their breathing grew faint, none had words;
the fever of love consumed their bodies.

কভু ঘন শ্বাস হয় বিরহের তাপে ।
কভু নেত্র ঝরে, কভু সর্ব অঙ্গ কাঁপে ॥ ২৭৩ ॥

*kabhu ghana śbāsa haẏa birahera tāpe |*
*kabhu netra jhare, kabhu sarba aṅga kāṁpe || 273 ||*

*Word for word:* kabhu ghana shvasa haya — now their breath comes fast; virahera tape — from the heat of separation; kabhu netra jhare — now their eyes stream; kabhu sarva anga kanpe — now their whole body trembles

**273.** Now their breath comes fast from the heat of separation,
now their eyes stream, now their whole body trembles.

কভু কভু কৃষ্ণপানে থির-দিঠে চাহে ।
কভু কভু মদন-ভাবেতে থির নহে ॥ ২৭৪ ॥

*kabhu kabhu kṛṣṇapāne thira-diṭhe cāhe |*
*kabhu kabhu madana-bhābete thira nahe || 274 ||*

*Word for word:* kabhu kabhu krishna-pane — sometimes at Krishna; thira-dithe chahe — they gaze with a fixed look; kabhu kabhu madana-bhavete — sometimes from love's emotion; thira nahe — they are not still

**274.** Sometimes they gaze fixedly at Krishna,
sometimes, from love's emotion, they cannot be still.

ভাব-ভরে কি বোল বলিতে কিবা কহে ।
সভার মনের কথা আপনে কহয়ে ॥ ২৭৫ ॥

*bhāba-bhare ki bola balite kibā kahe |*
*sabhāra manera kathā āpane kahaẏe || 275 ||*

*Word for word:* bhava-bhare — overwhelmed by feeling; ki bola balite kiba kahe — meaning to say one thing they say another; sabhara manera katha — what is in all their hearts; apane kahaye — they themselves speak

**275.** Overwhelmed by feeling, meaning to say one thing they say another,
and themselves speak what is in all their hearts:

জগত-মোহন করে যার রূপ-গুণে ।
অবলা ধৈরজ তবে ধরিব কেমনে ॥ ২৭৬ ॥

*jagata-mohana kare yāra rūpa-guṇe |*
*abalā dhairaja tabe dhariba kemane || 276 ||*

*Word for word:* jagata-mohana kare — enchant the world; yara rupa-gune — whose beauty and qualities; abala — [we] weak women; dhairaja tabe dhariba kemane — how then shall we keep our composure

**276.** 'He whose beauty and qualities enchant the world —
how then can we weak women keep our composure?

মোরা কুলবতী—কুলব্রত মাত্র জানি ।
কুলব্রত-ভঙ্গ কৈল মুরলীর ধ্বনি ॥ ২৭৭ ॥

*morā kulabatī—kulabrata mātra jāni |*
*kulabrata-bhaṅga kaila muralīra dhbani || 277 ||*

*Word for word:* mora kulavati — we are women of good families; kulavrata matra jani — we know only the vow of family [fidelity]; kulavrata-bhanga kaila — broke that vow; muralira dhvani — the sound of the flute

**277.** We are women of good families; we know only the vow of fidelity to family;
but the sound of the flute has broken that vow.

তুমি কিছু নাহি জান, মোরা নাহি জানি ।
জগত-মোহন-গুণে আনিলা রমণী ॥ ২৭৮ ॥

*tumi kichu nāhi jāna, morā nāhi jāni |*
*jagata-mohana-guṇe ānilā ramaṇī || 278 ||*

*Word for word:* tumi kichhu nahi jana — You [seem to] know nothing; mora nahi jani — we do not know; jagata-mohana-gune — by Your world-enchanting qualities; anila ramani — You drew the women here

**278.** You seem to know nothing — and we [ourselves] do not know [how we came]:
by Your world-enchanting qualities You have drawn the women here.

পতির পরম পতি—তুমি আত্মারাম ।
তোমারে ছাড়িলে পতি অগতি প্রমাণ ॥ ২৭৯ ॥

*patira parama pati—tumi ātmārāma |*
*tomāre chāṛile pati agati pramāṇa || 279 ||*

*Word for word:* patira parama pati — the supreme Husband of husbands; tumi atmarama — You are the Atmarama; tomare chhadile — if one leaves You; pati agati pramana — a husband is proven to be no refuge

**279.** You are the supreme Husband of [all] husbands, You are the Atmarama;
if one leaves You, a husband is no refuge — this is proven.

মোর আত্মারাম তুমি, রমহ আমাতে ।
তবে পরপতি কোথা দেখিলে ভজিতে ॥ ২৮০ ॥

*mora ātmārāma tumi, ramaha āmāte |*
*tabe parapati kothā dekhile bhajite || 280 ||*

*Word for word:* mora atmarama tumi — You are the delight of our soul; ramaha amate — take Your delight in us; tabe — then; para-pati kotha dekhile bhajite — where did You see [us] serving another's husband

**280.** You are the delight of our soul; take Your delight in us;
where did You see us serving another's husband?[^49-15]

অহে পতি-গতি, পতি সভার আশ্রয় ।
আনন্দ পরমানন্দ সর্বসুখময় ॥ ২৮১ ॥

*ahe pati-gati, pati sabhāra āśraẏa |*
*ānanda paramānanda sarbasukhamaẏa || 281 ||*

*Word for word:* ahe pati-gati — O refuge of husbands; pati sabhara ashraya — Husband, the shelter of all; ananda paramananda — bliss, supreme bliss; sarva-sukha-maya — full of every joy

**281.** O refuge of husbands, Husband, shelter of all,
bliss, supreme bliss, full of every joy!'

ভাব-ভরে ভাবিনীগণ সত্য কহে ।
ভাবকথা শুনি' কৃষ্ণ হৈলা ভাবময়ে ॥ ২৮২ ॥

*bhāba-bhare bhābinīgaṇa satya kahe |*
*bhābakathā śuni' kṛṣṇa hailā bhābamaẏe || 282 ||*

*Word for word:* bhava-bhare — overflowing with feeling; bhavinigana satya kahe — the loving maidens speak the truth; bhava-katha shuni — hearing these words of love; krishna haila bhavamaye — Krishna was filled with feeling

**282.** Overflowing with feeling, the loving maidens speak the truth;
hearing these words of love, Krishna was filled with feeling.

চাহিলা সরস-হাস্যে সব গোপী-পানে ।
যত সুখ গোপী পাইল—কেহো নাহি জানে ॥ ২৮৩ ॥

*cāhilā sarasa-hāsye saba gopī-pāne |*
*yata sukha gopī pāila—keho nāhi jāne || 283 ||*

*Word for word:* chahila sarasa-hasye — He looked with a tender smile; saba gopi-pane — at all the gopis; yata sukha gopi paila — how much joy the gopis found; keho nahi jane — no one knows

**283.** He looked with a tender smile at all the gopis —
how much joy the gopis found no one knows.

বেড়িলেক সব গোপী প্রভু যদুমণি ।
মেঘেতে ঝলকে যেন থির-সৌদামিনী ॥ ২৮৪ ॥

*beṛileka saba gopī prabhu yadumaṇi |*
*meghete jhalake yena thira-saudāminī || 284 ||*

*Word for word:* bedileka saba gopi — all the gopis surrounded; prabhu yadumani — the Lord, jewel of the Yadus; meghete jhalake — flashes in a cloud; yena thira-saudamini — like steady lightning

**284.** All the gopis surrounded the Lord, the jewel of the Yadus,
like steady lightning flashing in a cloud.

এইখানে অপরূপ এ রাসবিহার ।
এক গোপী এক কৃষ্ণ মণ্ডলী তাহার ॥ ২৮৫ ॥

*eikhāne aparūpa e rāsabihāra |*
*eka gopī eka kṛṣṇa maṇḍalī tāhāra || 285 ||*

*Word for word:* eikhane — here; aparupa e rasa-vihara — this wondrous rasa play; eka gopi eka krishna — one gopi, one Krishna; mandali tahara — such was its circle

**285.** Here took place this wondrous rasa play:
one gopi, one Krishna — such was its circle.

কনক-চম্পক আর মরকত-মণি ।
গাঁথিল যেমন মালা, মণ্ডলী তেমনি ॥ ২৮৬ ॥

*kanaka-campaka āra marakata-maṇi |*
*gāṁthila yemana mālā, maṇḍalī temani || 286 ||*

*Word for word:* kanaka-champaka — golden champakas; ara marakata-mani — and emeralds; ganthila yemana mala — like a strung garland; mandali temani — so was the circle

**286.** Like a garland strung of golden champakas and emeralds —
so was the circle.

যত গোপী তত কৃষ্ণ এ রাসমণ্ডলে ।
পড়িল রাসের হাট বৃন্দাবন-স্থলে ॥ ২৮৭ ॥

*yata gopī tata kṛṣṇa e rāsamaṇḍale |*
*paṛila rāsera hāṭa bṛndābana-sthale || 287 ||*

*Word for word:* yata gopi tata krishna — as many gopis, so many Krishnas; e rasa-mandale — in this rasa circle; padila rasera hata — the market of the rasa opened; vrindavana-sthale — on the ground of Vrindavana

**287.** As many gopis, so many Krishnas in this rasa circle:
on the ground of Vrindavana the market of the rasa opened.

কল্পবৃক্ষ-স্থানে রাধাকৃষ্ণ দুইজন ।
গোপীর অংশিনী রাধা রসের কারণ ॥ ২৮৮ ॥

*kalpabṛkṣa-sthāne rādhākṛṣṇa duijana |*
*gopīra aṃśinī rādhā rasera kāraṇa || 288 ||*

*Word for word:* kalpavriksha-sthane — at the wish-fulfilling tree; radha-krishna duijana — the two, Radha and Krishna; gopira amshini radha — Radha, the source of [all] the gopis; rasera karana — the cause of rasa

**288.** At the wish-fulfilling tree are the two, Radha and Krishna:
Radha, the source of [all] the gopis, the cause of rasa[^49-16].

কৃষ্ণ হৈতে কৃষ্ণ তথা হইল অপার ।
যত রাধা তত কৃষ্ণ হৈল এ বিচার ॥ ২৮৯ ॥

*kṛṣṇa haite kṛṣṇa tathā haila apāra |*
*yata rādhā tata kṛṣṇa haila e bicāra || 289 ||*

*Word for word:* krishna haite krishna — Krishna from Krishna; tatha haila apara — appeared there without end; yata radha tata krishna — as many Radhas, so many Krishnas; haila e vichara — such was the arrangement

**289.** From Krishna there appeared Krishnas without end:
as many Radhas, so many Krishnas — such was the arrangement.

রাস-হাট-উপরে পতাকা শশধরে ।
কোকিল কোটাল হঞা জাগায় কামেরে ॥ ২৯০ ॥

*rāsa-hāṭa-upare patākā śaśadhare |*
*kokila koṭāla hañā jāgāẏa kāmere || 290 ||*

*Word for word:* rasa-hata-upare — above the market of the rasa; pataka shashadhare — the moon is the banner; kokila kotala hanya — the cuckoo, as watchman; jagaya kamere — awakens Kama

**290.** Over the market of the rasa the moon is the banner;
the cuckoo, as watchman, awakens Kama.

ভ্রমরা হাটের বাদ্য, পসার যৌবন ।
গ্রাহক রসিকবর মদনমোহন ॥ ২৯১ ॥

*bhramarā hāṭera bādya, pasāra yaubana |*
*grāhaka rasikabara madanamohana || 291 ||*

*Word for word:* bhramara hatera vadya — the bees are the market's music; pasara yauvana — the wares are youth; grahaka — the buyer; rasikavara madana-mohana — the best of connoisseurs of rasa, Madana-mohana

**291.** The bees are the market's music, the wares are youth,
the buyer is the best of connoisseurs of rasa, Madana-mohana.

গোপিকার শুদ্ধ প্রেম জানিঞা শ্রীহরি ।
ভকত-বশ্যতা-গুণ প্রকাশ সে করি' ॥ ২৯২ ॥

*gopikāra śuddha prema jāniñā śrīhari |*
*bhakata-baśyatā-guṇa prakāśa se kari' || 292 ||*

*Word for word:* gopikara shuddha prema — the gopis' pure prema; janinya srihari — knowing, Sri Hari; bhakata-vashyata-guna — His quality of being subject to His devotees; prakasha se kari — revealing

**292.** Knowing the gopis' pure prema, Sri Hari
reveals His quality of being subject to His devotees.

যূথে যূথে পাটোয়ার নটিনী গোপিনী ।
নাটুয়া তাহার মাঝে প্রভু যদুমণি ॥ ২৯৩ ॥

*yūthe yūthe pāṭoẏāra naṭinī gopinī |*
*nāṭuẏā tāhāra mājhe prabhu yadumaṇi || 293 ||*

*Word for word:* yuthe yuthe — in groups; patoyara natini gopini — the gopis are skilled dancers; natuya tahara majhe — the dancer in their midst; prabhu yadumani — the Lord, jewel of the Yadus

**293.** In groups are the gopis, skilled dancers,
and the dancer in their midst is the Lord, the jewel of the Yadus.

বলয়া-নূপুর-মণি-কিঙ্কিণীর রোল ।
মুরলী-মধুরধ্বনি তাহাতে উজোর ॥ ২৯৪ ॥

*balaẏā-nūpura-maṇi-kiṅkiṇīra rola |*
*muralī-madhuradhbani tāhāte ujora || 294 ||*

*Word for word:* valaya-nupura-mani-kinkinira rola — the jingling of bangles, anklets, jewels and belts of bells; murali-madhura-dhvani — the sweet sound of the flute; tahate ujora — rings out bright among them

**294.** Bangles, anklets, jewels and belts of bells jingle;
among them the sweet voice of the flute rings out bright.

রবাব উপাঙ্গ স্বরমণ্ডলের গান ।
মৃদঙ্গ মন্দিরা ডম্ফ পাখোয়াজ সুতান ॥ ২৯৫ ॥

*rabāba upāṅga sbaramaṇḍalera gāna |*
*mṛdaṅga mandirā ḍampha pākhoẏāja sutāna || 295 ||*

*Word for word:* rababa upanga — the rabab, the upanga; svaramandalera gana — the song of the svaramandala; mridanga mandira dampha — mridanga, mandira (cymbals), dampha; pakhoyaja sutana — pakhavaj — sweet melodies

**295.** Rabab, upanga, the song of the svaramandala,
mridanga, mandira cymbals, dampha, pakhavaj — sweet melodies.

আর অপরূপ হের দেখ সেইখানে ।
রাই-রাজা কৈল কৃষ্ণ এই বৃন্দাবনে ॥ ২৯৬ ॥

*āra aparūpa hera dekha seikhāne |*
*rāi-rājā kaila kṛṣṇa ei bṛndābane || 296 ||*

*Word for word:* ara aparupa — another wonder; hera dekha seikhane — here, see, at that place; rai-raja kaila krishna — Krishna made Rai sovereign; ei vrindavane — in this Vrindavana

**296.** And another wonder — here, see, at that place:
in this Vrindavana Krishna made Rai sovereign.

দিব্য চন্দন-মালা দিল রাধার অঙ্গে ।
আপনে করয়ে স্তুতি গোপীগণ-সঙ্গে ॥ ২৯৭ ॥

*dibya candana-mālā dila rādhāra aṅge |*
*āpane karaẏe stuti gopīgaṇa-saṅge || 297 ||*

*Word for word:* divya chandana-mala — divine sandal and garland; dila radhara ange — He placed on Radha; apane karaye stuti — He Himself offers praise; gopigana-sange — together with the gopis

**297.** He placed divine sandal and a garland on Radha
and Himself praises Her together with the gopis.

অভিষেক করি' কহে—শুন গোপীগণে ।
আজি হৈতে রাধা রাজা হৈল বৃন্দাবনে ॥ ২৯৮ ॥

*abhiṣeka kari' kahe—śuna gopīgaṇe |*
*āji haite rādhā rājā haila bṛndābane || 298 ||*

*Word for word:* abhisheka kari — performing the anointing; kahe — He says; shuna gopigane — listen, gopis; aji haite — from today; radha raja haila vrindavane — Radha is sovereign in Vrindavana

**298.** Having anointed Her, He says: 'Listen, gopis:
from today Radha is sovereign in Vrindavana'[^49-17].

হেনমতে রাসে বিহরয়ে যদুরায় ।
আচম্বিতে সব গোপী দেখিতে না পায় ॥ ২৯৯ ॥

*henamate rāse biharaẏe yadurāẏa |*
*ācambite saba gopī dekhite nā pāẏa || 299 ||*

*Word for word:* henamate — thus; rase viharaye yaduraya — the King of the Yadus sports in the rasa; achambite — suddenly; saba gopi dekhite na paya — none of the gopis can see [Him]

**299.** Thus the King of the Yadus sports in the rasa —
and suddenly none of the gopis can see Him.

এক গোপী লঞা গেলা সভারে এড়িয়া ।
কান্দয়ে এখানে গোপী অঙ্গ আছাড়িয়া ॥ ৩০০ ॥

*eka gopī lañā gelā sabhāre eṛiẏā |*
*kāndaẏe ekhāne gopī aṅga āchāṛiẏā || 300 ||*

*Word for word:* eka gopi lanya gela — He went away taking one gopi; sabhare ediya — leaving all; kandaye ekhane gopi — here the gopis weep; anga achhadiya — flinging themselves [down]

**300.** Leaving them all, He went away taking one gopi with Him[^49-18];
here the gopis weep, flinging themselves on the ground.

তুলসী মালতী যূথী, তোমারে সুধাই ।
এ পথে দেখেছ যেতে হলধরের ভাই ॥ ৩০০+১ ॥

*tulasī mālatī yūthī, tomāre sudhāi |*
*e pathe dekhecha yete haladharera bhāi || 300+1 ||*

*Word for word:* tulasi malati yuthi — tulasi, malati, yuthi; tomare sudhai — I ask you; e pathe dekhechha yete — have you seen going by this path; haladharera bhai — the brother of Haladhara

**300+1.** 'Tulasi, malati, yuthi, I ask you:
have you seen Haladhara's brother going by this path?[^49-19]

কৃষ্ণের চরণাশ্রিতা তুলসী কল্যাণী ।
তুমি দেখিয়াছ কৃষ্ণ প্রাণ যদুমণি ॥ ৩০০+২ ॥

*kṛṣṇera caraṇāśritā tulasī kalyāṇī |*
*tumi dekhiẏācha kṛṣṇa prāṇa yadumaṇi || 300+2 ||*

*Word for word:* krishnera charana-ashrita — sheltered at Krishna's feet; tulasi kalyani — auspicious tulasi; tumi dekhiyachha — you have seen; krishna prana yadumani — Krishna, [our] life, the jewel of the Yadus

**300+2.** Auspicious tulasi, sheltered at Krishna's feet,
have you seen Krishna, our life, the jewel of the Yadus?

কে মোর হরিয়া নিল নীলমণি কালা ।
গহন কাননে ফিরে আহীরীর বালা ॥ ৩০০+৩ ॥

*ke mora hariẏā nila nīlamaṇi kālā |*
*gahana kānane phire āhīrīra bālā || 300+3 ||*

*Word for word:* ke mora hariya nila — who has stolen from me; nilamani kala — the dark sapphire; gahana kanane phire — wander in the deep forest; ahirira bala — the cowherd girls

**300+3.** Who has stolen my dark sapphire?' —
the cowherd girls wander in the deep forest.

রামানুজ আমা সবার গর্ব সে জানিয়া ।
মন-হরি কোথা গেলা সবারে ছাড়িয়া ॥ ৩০০+৪ ॥

*rāmānuja āmā sabāra garba se jāniẏā |*
*mana-hari kothā gelā sabāre chāṛiẏā || 300+4 ||*

*Word for word:* ramanuja — Rama's younger brother; ama sabara garva se janiya — knowing the pride of us all; mana-hari — the stealer of hearts; kotha gela sabare chhadiya — where has He gone, leaving us all

**300+4.** 'Rama's younger brother, knowing our pride —
the stealer of hearts — where has He gone, leaving us all?

শুন শুন ওরে তুমি যূথিকা মল্লিকা ।
কদম্ব, দেখেছ কৃষ্ণ?—পুছে গোপিকা ॥ ৩০০+৫ ॥

*śuna śuna ore tumi yūthikā mallikā |*
*kadamba, dekhecha kṛṣṇa?—puche gopikā || 300+5 ||*

*Word for word:* shuna shuna ore tumi — listen, O you; yuthika mallika — yuthika, mallika; kadamba — kadamba; dekhechha krishna — have you seen Krishna?; puchhe gopika — the gopis ask

**300+5.** Listen, O yuthika and mallika!
Kadamba, have you seen Krishna?' the gopis ask.

না পাইয়া লাগি তার যত গোপীগণ ।
কৃষ্ণের যতেক লীলা করয়ে রচন ॥ ৩০০+৬ ॥

*nā pāiẏā lāgi tāra yata gopīgaṇa |*
*kṛṣṇera yateka līlā karaẏe racana || 300+6 ||*

*Word for word:* na paiya — not finding [Him]; lagi tara — for His sake; yata gopigana — all the gopis; krishnera yateka lila — all of Krishna's lilas; karaye rachana — enact

**300+6.** Not finding Him, all the gopis, for His sake,
enact all of Krishna's lilas:

কেহো ত পূতনা হৈলা, কেহো হৈলা কান ।
স্তন পান করি' কেহো বধিল পরাণ ॥ ৩০০+৭ ॥

*keho ta pūtanā hailā, keho hailā kāna |*
*stana pāna kari' keho badhila parāṇa || 300+7 ||*

*Word for word:* keho ta putana haila — one became Putana; keho haila kana — another became Kana (Krishna); stana pana kari — sucking the breast; keho vadhila parana — took [her] life

**300+7.** one became Putana, another became Kana
and, sucking at the breast, took the other's life;

কোনো সখী আইলা শকট-রূপ ধরি' ।
কৃষ্ণ-রূপ ধরি' কেহো তাহারে সংহারি ॥ ৩০০+৮ ॥

*kono sakhī āilā śakaṭa-rūpa dhari' |*
*kṛṣṇa-rūpa dhari' keho tāhāre saṃhāri || 300+8 ||*

*Word for word:* kono sakhi aila — one friend came; shakata-rupa dhari — taking the form of the cart; krishna-rupa dhari — taking Krishna's form; keho tahare samhari — another destroyed her

**300+8.** one friend came in the form of the cart,
and another, taking Krishna's form, destroyed her;

অঘ বক হৈয়া তবে কোনো সখী আইলা ।
কৃষ্ণরূপ হৈয়া কেহো তাহারে মারিলা ॥ ৩০০+৯ ॥

*agha baka haiẏā tabe kono sakhī āilā |*
*kṛṣṇarūpa haiẏā keho tāhāre mārilā || 300+9 ||*

*Word for word:* agha baka haiya — becoming Agha, Baka; tabe kono sakhi aila — then one friend came; krishna-rupa haiya — becoming Krishna; keho tahare marila — another slew her

**300+9.** then one friend came as Agha and Baka,
and another, as Krishna, slew her.

সঙ্গের গোপিকা সেই আদরেই ভর ।
হাসিয়া কহয়ে—মুঞি চলিতে কাতর ॥ ৩০১ ॥

*saṅgera gopikā sei ādarei bhara |*
*hāsiẏā kahaẏe—muñi calite kātara || 301 ||*

*Word for word:* sangera gopika sei — that gopi who was with Him; adarei bhara — leaning on His fondness; hasiya kahaye — says smiling; munyi chalite katara — I am too weary to walk

**301.** And the gopi who was with Him, leaning on His fondness,
says with a smile: 'I am too weary to walk;

যেনমতে পার তেনমতে লহ তুমি ।
কানু কহে—আইস, কান্ধে করি' নিব আমি ॥ ৩০২ ॥

*yenamate pāra tenamate laha tumi |*
*kānu kahe—āisa, kāndhe kari' niba āmi || 302 ||*

*Word for word:* yenamate para — however You can; tenamate laha tumi — so carry [me]; kanu kahe — Kanu says; aisa — come; kandhe kari niba ami — I will carry [you] on My shoulders

**302.** carry me however You can.' Kanu says:
'Come, I will carry you on My shoulders.'

মাতিল পাথার বুকে শীতল বনে ।
টানিয়া কাকালি বান্ধে নেতের বসনে ॥ ৩০২+১ ॥

*mātila pāthāra buke śītala bane |*
*ṭāniẏā kākāli bāndhe netera basane || 302+1 ||*

*Word for word:* matila pathara buke — a sea [of joy] surged in her breast; shitala vane — in the cool forest; taniya — pulling tight; kakali bandhe — she girds her waist; netera vasane — with a silk cloth

**302+1.** In the cool forest a sea [of joy] surged in her breast;
pulling her garment tight, she girds her waist with a silk cloth[^49-20].

কোলে করি' লঞা গেলা আর কথোদূর ।
আচম্বিতে তাহাকেও ভৈগেলা নিঠুর ॥ ৩০৩ ॥

*kole kari' lañā gelā āra kathodūra |*
*ācambite tāhākeo bhaigelā niṭhura || 303 ||*

*Word for word:* kole kari lanya gela — taking her in His arms He carried her; ara kathodura — some distance further; achambite — suddenly; tahakeo bhaigela nithura — He became cruel to her too

**303.** Taking her in His arms, He carried her some distance further —
and suddenly became cruel to her too[^49-21].

যে কালে চাপিবে কৃষ্ণের চূড়ায় দিয়া হাত ।
সেইকালে অন্তর্ধান কৈলা গোপীনাথ ॥ ৩০৩+১ ॥

*ye kāle cāpibe kṛṣṇera cūṛāẏa diẏā hāta |*
*seikāle antardhāna kailā gopīnātha || 303+1 ||*

*Word for word:* ye kale chapibe — at the moment she was about to mount; krishnera chudaya diya hata — placing her hand on Krishna's crest; sei kale — at that very moment; antardhana kaila gopinatha — Gopinatha vanished

**303+1.** At the moment when, placing her hand on Krishna's crest, she was about to mount [His shoulders],
at that very moment Gopinatha vanished.

এইখানে অন্তর্ধান হৈলা তাহারে ।
ব্যাকুলিতা সেই গোপী কান্দে একেশ্বরে ॥ ৩০৪ ॥

*eikhāne antardhāna hailā tāhāre |*
*byākulitā sei gopī kānde ekeśbare || 304 ||*

*Word for word:* eikhane — here; antardhana haila tahare — He vanished from her; vyakulita sei gopi — that gopi, distraught; kande ekeshvare — weeps alone

**304.** Here He vanished from her,
and that gopi, distraught, weeps alone.

কৃষ্ণ হারাইয়া আর গোপী সব যত ।
এইখানে বুলে তারা চকিত উন্মত ॥ ৩০৫ ॥

*kṛṣṇa hārāiẏā āra gopī saba yata |*
*eikhāne bule tārā cakita unmata || 305 ||*

*Word for word:* krishna haraiya — having lost Krishna; ara gopi saba yata — all the other gopis; eikhane bule tara — they wander here; chakita unmata — bewildered and frantic

**305.** Having lost Krishna, all the other gopis
wander here, bewildered and frantic.

বিরহে ব্যাকুল গোপী কান্দে উভরায় ।
এ কথা শুনিতে দুঃখ বাঢ়য়ে হিয়ায় ॥ ৩০৬ ॥

*birahe byākula gopī kānde ubharāẏa |*
*e kathā śunite duḥkha bāṛhaẏe hiẏāẏa || 306 ||*

*Word for word:* virahe vyakula gopi — the gopis, distraught in separation; kande ubharaya — weep aloud; e katha shunite — hearing this account; duhkha badhaye hiyaya — grief swells in the heart

**306.** Distraught in separation, the gopis weep aloud;
hearing of it, grief swells in the heart.

ভ্রমিতে ভ্রমিতে তবে আর গোপীগণ ।
দেখে রাধা প্রিয়সখী করিছে রোদন ॥ ৩০৬+১ ॥

*bhramite bhramite tabe āra gopīgaṇa |*
*dekhe rādhā priẏasakhī kariche rodana || 306+1 ||*

*Word for word:* bhramite bhramite — wandering and wandering; tabe ara gopigana — then the other gopis; dekhe radha priya-sakhi — see Radha, [their] dear friend; karichhe rodana — weeping

**306+1.** Wandering, the other gopis
see their dear friend Radha weeping[^49-22].

রাধা-দরশনে সবার শোক উথলিল ।
মিলি' আছাড়িয়া সবে কান্দিতে লাগিল ॥ ৩০৬+২ ॥

*rādhā-daraśane sabāra śoka uthalila |*
*mili' āchāṛiẏā sabe kāndite lāgila || 306+2 ||*

*Word for word:* radha-darashane — at the sight of Radha; sabara shoka uthalila — the grief of all welled up; mili achhadiya — together flinging themselves [down]; sabe kandite lagila — all began to weep

**306+2.** At the sight of Radha the grief of all welled up,
and all together, flinging themselves down, began to weep;

উনমতী হইলা সবে কাঁদিতে কাঁদিতে ।
মূর্ছিত হইয়া তারা পড়িল ভূমিতে ॥ ৩০৬+৩ ॥

*unamatī hailā sabe kāṁdite kāṁdite |*
*mūrchita haiẏā tārā paṛila bhūmite || 306+3 ||*

*Word for word:* unamati haila sabe — all went mad; kandite kandite — weeping and weeping; murchhita haiya — swooning; tara padila bhumite — they fell to the ground

**306+3.** weeping and weeping, all went mad
and, swooning, fell to the ground.

এইখানে গোপী কৃষ্ণ-চরিতে তন্ময় ।
যেখানে যে কৈল কৃষ্ণ তেনমত হয় ॥ ৩০৭ ॥

*eikhāne gopī kṛṣṇa-carite tanmaẏa |*
*yekhāne ye kaila kṛṣṇa tenamata haẏa || 307 ||*

*Word for word:* eikhane — here; gopi krishna-charite tanmaya — the gopis are absorbed in Krishna's deeds; yekhane ye kaila krishna — whatever Krishna did wherever; tenamata haya — so they become

**307.** Here the gopis are absorbed in Krishna's deeds:
whatever Krishna did wherever, so they do,

সেই অভিনয় করে, সেই সব রীত ।
উনমত গোপী সব কৃষ্ণময়-চিত ॥ ৩০৮ ॥

*sei abhinaẏa kare, sei saba rīta |*
*unamata gopī saba kṛṣṇamaẏa-cita || 308 ||*

*Word for word:* sei abhinaya kare — they act that out; sei saba rita — all those same ways; unamata gopi saba — all the gopis maddened; krishnamaya-chita — their hearts full of Krishna

**308.** acting out the same, all in just the same way —
all the gopis maddened, their hearts full of Krishna.

হেনমতে মূর্ছা যবে পাইল গোপীগণ ।
এইখানে কৃষ্ণ তবে দিল দরশন ॥ ৩০৯ ॥

*henamate mūrchā yabe pāila gopīgaṇa |*
*eikhāne kṛṣṇa tabe dila daraśana || 309 ||*

*Word for word:* henamate — thus; murchha yabe paila gopigana — when the gopis swooned; eikhane — here; krishna tabe dila darashana — Krishna then appeared [to them]

**309.** When the gopis thus swooned,
here Krishna then appeared to them[^49-23].

পুনরপি কৈল তবে এ রাস-বিলাস ।
পুনঃ রাসোৎসবে গোপী-আনন্দ-উল্লাস ॥ ৩১০ ॥

*punarapi kaila tabe e rāsa-bilāsa |*
*punaḥ rāsotsabe gopī-ānanda-ullāsa || 310 ||*

*Word for word:* punarapi kaila tabe — then He again performed; e rasa-vilasa — this rasa play; punah rasotsave — again in the festival of the rasa; gopi-ananda-ullasa — the gopis' joy and delight

**310.** And again He performed this rasa play,
and again, in the festival of the rasa, the gopis' joy and delight.

এইমতে আনন্দ-কৌতুকে রাত্রিশেষ ।
অলসে অবশ অঙ্গ, শ্লথ ভেল বেশ ॥ ৩১১ ॥

*eimate ānanda-kautuke rātriśeṣa |*
*alase abaśa aṅga, ślatha bhela beśa || 311 ||*

*Word for word:* eimate — thus; ananda-kautuke — in joyful play; ratri-shesha — the night ended; alase avasha anga — their bodies limp with languor; shlatha bhela vesha — their attire loosened

**311.** Thus in joyful play the night passed;
their bodies limp with languor, their attire loosened.

যমুনা-পুলিনে গেলা সব গোপী লঞা ।
গোপী-কোলে নিদ্রা যায় শ্রমযুক্ত হঞা ॥ ৩১২ ॥

*yamunā-puline gelā saba gopī lañā |*
*gopī-kole nidrā yāẏa śramayukta hañā || 312 ||*

*Word for word:* yamuna-puline gela — He went to the bank of the Yamuna; saba gopi lanya — taking all the gopis; gopi-kole nidra yaya — He sleeps in the gopis' laps; shrama-yukta hanya — being weary

**312.** Taking all the gopis, He went to the bank of the Yamuna
and, weary, slept in the gopis' laps.

এখানে যমুনাজল, সুশীতল বায় ।
কৃষ্ণ-কোলে সব গোপী সুখে নিদ্রা যায় ॥ ৩১৩ ॥

*ekhāne yamunājala, suśītala bāẏa |*
*kṛṣṇa-kole saba gopī sukhe nidrā yāẏa || 313 ||*

*Word for word:* ekhane yamuna-jala — here the Yamuna's water; sushitala vaya — the cool breeze; krishna-kole saba gopi — all the gopis in Krishna's embrace; sukhe nidra yaya — sleep happily

**313.** Here is the Yamuna's water, the cool breeze —
and all the gopis sleep happily in Krishna's embrace.

এইমতে শুভরাত্রি সুপ্রভাত হৈল ।
প্রণতি করিয়া গোপী নিজঘর গেল ॥ ৩১৪ ॥

*eimate śubharātri suprabhāta haila |*
*praṇati kariẏā gopī nijaghara gela || 314 ||*

*Word for word:* eimate — thus; shubha-ratri — the auspicious night; suprabhata haila — turned into a bright morning; pranati kariya — bowing; gopi nija-ghara gela — the gopis went home

**314.** Thus the auspicious night turned into a bright morning,
and the gopis bowed and went home."

এইমতে স্থানে স্থানে দেখে গোরারায় ।
আনন্দে লোচনদাস গোরাগুণ গায় ॥ ৩১৫ ॥

*eimate sthāne sthāne dekhe gorārāẏa |*
*ānande locanadāsa gorāguṇa gāẏa || 315 ||*

*Word for word:* eimate — thus; sthane sthane — place after place; dekhe goraraya — Goraraya sees; anande lochanadasa — joyfully Lochana Dasa; goraguna gaya — sings Gora's glories

**315.** Thus place after place Goraraya sees;
joyfully Lochana Dasa sings Gora's glories.

[^49-1]: Vv. 206–210 follow the Bhagavata (10.22–10.23): the maidens' vow to the goddess Katyayani, the stealing of the clothes, the praise of Vrindavana's trees, the wives of the brahmanas performing a yajna; cf. Murari 4.07. The stealing of the clothes is a transcendental (aprakrita) lila: Krishna fulfils the maidens' desire to belong to Him (cf. en/48, note 10).
[^49-2]: The nauka-lila — Krishna's boat pastime with the gopis on the Manasa-Ganga (cf. Murari 4.08). "Gave themselves as a gift" refers to the gopis' self-surrender; their love is transcendental (cf. en/48, note 10).
[^49-3]: The dana-lila: Krishna, like a toll-collector, stops the gopis on their way across Govardhana; the "Dana-ghati" and the "toll platform" are holy places of Govardhana.
[^49-4]: The Lord, in Krishna's mood, addresses Radha with the words of the dana-lila.
[^49-5]: Tribhanga — Krishna's pose with the flute, bent in three places.
[^49-6]: "Radha-kadamba" — so in A and B; apparently a kadamba tree on Govardhana associated with Radha's pastimes (C's note gives the variant "Kanu's kadamba").
[^49-7]: Vv. 232–236 follow the Bhagavata (10.24–10.27): Krishna stops the sacrifice to Indra and arranges the worship of Govardhana (Annakuta); Indra sends the deluge; Krishna lifts the hill; the humbled Indra anoints Krishna (Govinda-abhisheka). Hariraya (Hari-deva) and Gopalaraya are Deities on Govardhana; Gopala on Govardhana was revealed by Madhavendra Puri (Chaitanya-charitamrita, Madhya 4).
[^49-8]: "The stone of anointing" (shila ubatane) — the reading is unclear (B: "to its south"); apparently the stone where, by tradition, Krishna was rubbed with fragrant paste.
[^49-9]: Vv. 240–241 follow the Bhagavata (10.28): Varuna's servant carried off Nanda, who had entered the Yamuna before dawn on Dvadashi; Krishna brought him back and then, immersing the cowherds in the Brahma-hrada, showed them His abode.
[^49-10]: Krishnadasa recognises Krishna Himself in the Lord: the sannyasi is only His outward guise (cf. en/48, note 13).
[^49-11]: Vv. 248–252 follow the Bhagavata (10.29.1–8); cf. Murari 4.09. Lochana Dasa himself calls the gopis' "kama" transcendental (aprakrita). In the Gaudiya Vaishnava teaching (Chaitanya-charitamrita, Madhya 8; Bhaktisiddhanta), the gopis' "kama" is pure prema, the desire only to please Krishna, without a trace of worldly lust; Madana here is Krishna Himself, Madana-mohana.
[^49-12]: Govindaraya — the Deity of Govinda in Vrindavana, revealed by Rupa Gosvami.
[^49-13]: The Lord, absorbed in bhava, speaks the words of the participants in the rasa-lila. The 1983 edition reads: "now He says: 'Gopis, stay here!'"
[^49-14]: Vv. 263–270 follow the Bhagavata (10.29.18–27): Krishna tests the gopis. Lochana Dasa himself explains that He speaks of duty in order to reveal their hidden devotion and increase their love.
[^49-15]: Vv. 276–281 — cf. the gopis' reply in the Bhagavata (10.29.31–41): Krishna is the Atmarama, the Soul of all souls and the true Husband of all, so the gopis' love for Him is no breach of dharma in the worldly sense. Gaudiya Vaishnavas (Bhaktisiddhanta) stress that the parakiya-rasa of Vraja is wholly transcendental and is no model for imitation in the world.
[^49-16]: Vv. 285–298 — the rasa-lila (cf. the Bhagavata 10.33; Murari 4.09). Radha is the source from whom all the gopis expand (cf. Chaitanya-charitamrita, Adi 4); the 1983 edition reads: "the gopis are portions of Radha, for the sake of rasa." In v. 289 A and C read "as many Radhas, so many Krishnas," B "as many gopis, so many Krishnas." In the 1983 edition vv. 287–295 stand after v. 310.
[^49-17]: Radha's anointing as sovereign of Vrindavana (Vrindavaneshvari) is a Vraja tradition, told briefly by Lochana Dasa; it is not in the Bhagavata.
[^49-18]: Vv. 299–310 follow the Bhagavata (10.30–10.32): Krishna vanishes from the rasa circle, taking one gopi away; the gopis search for Him, question the trees and enact His lilas; He leaves the chosen gopi too and then appears to all again. In the Gaudiya Vaishnava tradition this chosen gopi is Radha.
[^49-19]: Vv. 300+1 — 300+9 are found only in the 1983 edition (not in Bhaktisiddhanta's edition of 1922); the 1903 edition gives only the first of them, in a different wording, in a footnote as the reading of one manuscript. Cf. the Bhagavata 10.30.4–23. Haladhara is Balarama.
[^49-20]: V. 302+1 is found only in the 1983 edition; it is absent in the 1903 edition. The first line is unclear (B: "मातिल पाथर बुको"); translated by the probable sense.
[^49-21]: In the 1983 edition the first line is worded differently: "The gopi wished to climb onto [His] shoulders"; v. 303+1 is found only there (absent in the 1903 edition). Cf. the Bhagavata 10.30.37–38.
[^49-22]: Vv. 306+1 — 306+3 are found only in the 1983 edition; they are absent in the 1903 edition. Here the chosen gopi is named Radha outright (cf. the Bhagavata 10.30.39–41).
[^49-23]: Cf. the Bhagavata 10.32.1–2. In the 1983 edition vv. 307–308 stand before v. 301.

---

# Shesha-khanda, part 5 (portion 50)

*The section "The Lord Sees Vrindavana" (conclusion): Krishnadasa shows the Lord the Khadira-vana, Kumuda-vana, Ambika-vana and Nandishvara and tells of Akrura, the killing of Kamsa and Krishna's coming to Mathura; the Lord blesses Krishnadasa; the residents of the Mathura-mandala see Krishna in Him; the Lord sets out for Nilachala*

*Raga vibhasa; disha: "O Hari! Just once, only once, have mercy, Goraraya!"*

ইহার ভিতরে দেখ এই খদিরবন ।
দধি-দুগ্ধ বেচিবারে রাধার গমন ॥ ৩১৬ ॥

*ihāra bhitare dekha ei khadirabana |*
*dadhi-dugdha becibāre rādhāra gamana || 316 ||*

*Word for word:* ihara bhitare — within this; dekha ei khadira-vana — see this Khadira-vana; dadhi-dugdha bechibare — to sell curd and milk; radhara gamana — Radha's going

**316.** "See — here within is the Khadira-vana:
[by this way] Radha went to sell curd and milk.

এইখানে শিশু লঞা কৃষ্ণের মন্ত্রণা ।
ডর দরশাহ—রাধা পাউক যন্ত্রণা ॥ ৩১৭ ॥

*eikhāne śiśu lañā kṛṣṇera mantraṇā |*
*ḍara daraśāha—rādhā pāuka yantraṇā || 317 ||*

*Word for word:* eikhane — here; shishu lanya — with the boys; krishnera mantrana — Krishna's plot; dara darashaha — give Her a fright; radha pauka yantrana — let Radha be troubled

**317.** Here Krishna plotted with the boys:
'Give Her a fright — let Radha have a scare.'

বনে লুকাইয়া শিশু মহাশব্দ করে ।
ডরে ডরাইয়া রাধা কৃষ্ণ চাপি' ধরে ॥ ৩১৮ ॥

*bane lukāiẏā śiśu mahāśabda kare |*
*ḍare ḍarāiẏā rādhā kṛṣṇa cāpi' dhare || 318 ||*

*Word for word:* vane lukaiya — hiding in the forest; shishu mahashabda kare — the boys make a great noise; dare daraiya — frightened; radha krishna chapi dhare — Radha clings tightly to Krishna

**318.** Hiding in the forest, the boys raise a fearful noise;
terrified, Radha clings tightly to Krishna.

রাধা কোলে করি' কৃষ্ণ বোলে—হায় হায় ।
চুম্বন করয়ে, প্রিয়বাণীতে বুঝায় ॥ ৩১৯ ॥

*rādhā kole kari' kṛṣṇa bole—hāẏa hāẏa |*
*cumbana karaẏe, priẏabāṇīte bujhāẏa || 319 ||*

*Word for word:* radha kole kari — embracing Radha; krishna bole haya haya — Krishna says "Alas, alas!"; chumbana karaye — kisses Her; priya-vanite bujhaya — soothes Her with loving words

**319.** Embracing Radha, Krishna says, 'Ah, ah!' —
kisses Her and soothes Her with loving words.

কৃষ্ণের পিরীতি পাঞা রাধিকা বিভোর ।
মদন-আলসে রাধা পাশরিল ঘর ॥ ৩২০ ॥

*kṛṣṇera pirīti pāñā rādhikā bibhora |*
*madana-ālase rādhā pāśarila ghara || 320 ||*

*Word for word:* krishnera piriti panya — receiving Krishna's love; radhika vibhora — Radhika is rapt; madana-alase — in love's languor; radha pasharila ghara — Radha forgot Her home

**320.** Receiving Krishna's love, Radhika is rapt:
in love's languor Radha forgot Her home.

এইখানে নিকুঞ্জেতে বিনোদ-বিলাস ।
প্রেমায় মুগধ দোঁহে ভেল মহারাস ॥ ৩২১ ॥

*eikhāne nikuñjete binoda-bilāsa |*
*premāẏa mugadha doṁhe bhela mahārāsa || 321 ||*

*Word for word:* eikhane nikunjete — here in the bower; vinoda-vilasa — delightful pastimes; premaya mugadha donhe — both enchanted by prema; bhela maharasa — there was the great rasa

**321.** Here in the bower are delightful pastimes:
enchanted by prema, both [danced] the great rasa.

এইখানে নাম হৈল মদনগোপাল ।
শুনিঞা আনন্দে গোরা বোলে—ভাল ভাল ॥ ৩২২ ॥

*eikhāne nāma haila madanagopāla |*
*śuniñā ānande gorā bole—bhāla bhāla || 322 ||*

*Word for word:* eikhane — here; nama haila madana-gopala — [He] got the name Madana-gopala; shuninya anande — hearing, joyfully; gora bole bhala bhala — Gora says "Good, good!"

**322.** Here [Krishna] received the name Madana-Gopala"[^50-1].
Hearing this, Gora joyfully says: "Good, good!"

দেখহ কুমুদবনে কৃষ্ণের চরিত ।
এইখানে খেলা খেলে বালক সহিত ॥ ৩২৩ ॥

*dekhaha kumudabane kṛṣṇera carita |*
*eikhāne khelā khele bālaka sahita || 323 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhaha kumuda-vane — see in Kumuda-vana; krishnera charita — Krishna's deeds; eikhane — here; khela khele balaka sahita — He plays games with the boys

**323.** "See — in Kumuda-vana the deeds of Krishna:
here He played games with the boys.

শ্রীদাম সুবল—গোঠে মুখ্য দুইজন ।
বালকে বালকে খেলা, কোন্দল তখন ॥ ৩২৪ ॥

*śrīdāma subala—goṭhe mukhya duijana |*
*bālake bālake khelā, kondala takhana || 324 ||*

*Word for word:* shridama subala — Shridama and Subala; gothe mukhya duijana — the two chief ones in the pasture; balake balake khela — boys playing against boys; kondala takhana — then a quarrel

**324.** Shridama and Subala, the two chief ones in the pasture —
in the boys' game against each other a quarrel arose then;

কোন্দলিয়া নাম স্থান তেঞি ত ইহার ।
কহিল কুমুদ-নাম-বনের বিহার ॥ ৩২৫ ॥

*kondaliẏā nāma sthāna teñi ta ihāra |*
*kahila kumuda-nāma-banera bihāra || 325 ||*

*Word for word:* kondaliya nama sthana — the place named Kondaliya; tenyi ta ihara — that is why it is [so called]; kahila — I have told; kumuda-nama-vanera vihara — the pastimes in the forest named Kumuda

**325.** that is why this place is called Kondaliya [— 'the place of the quarrel'].
I have told of the pastimes in the forest named Kumuda.

অম্বিকার বন দেখ সরস্বতী-তীরে ।
এথা হরগৌরী গোপ-গোপী পূজা করে ॥ ৩২৬ ॥

*ambikāra bana dekha sarasbatī-tīre |*
*ethā haragaurī gopa-gopī pūjā kare || 326 ||*

*Word for word:* ambikara vana dekha — see the forest of Ambika; sarasvati-tire — on the bank of the Sarasvati; etha — here; hara-gauri gopa-gopi puja kare — the cowherd men and women worship Hara and Gauri

**326.** See — the forest of Ambika on the bank of the Sarasvati:
here the cowherd men and women worship Hara and Gauri.

অঙ্গিরা-পুত্রেরে উপহাসের কারণ ।
সর্পদেহ ছিল বিদ্যাধর সুদর্শন ॥ ৩২৭ ॥

*aṅgirā-putrere upahāsera kāraṇa |*
*sarpadeha chila bidyādhara sudarśana || 327 ||*

*Word for word:* angira-putrere — at the sons of Angira; upahasera karana — because of mockery; sarpa-deha chhila — was in a serpent's body; vidyadhara sudarshana — the vidyadhara Sudarshana

**327.** For mocking the sons of Angira
the vidyadhara Sudarshana was in a serpent's body;

শাপান্ত-কারণে সেই নন্দকে গিলিল ।
উগারিল নন্দে, কৃষ্ণ-চরণে ছুঁইল ॥ ৩২৮ ॥

*śāpānta-kāraṇe sei nandake gilila |*
*ugārila nande, kṛṣṇa-caraṇe chuṁila || 328 ||*

*Word for word:* shapanta-karane — to end the curse; sei nandake gilila — he swallowed Nanda; ugarila nande — he disgorged Nanda; krishna-charane chhuila — he touched Krishna's feet

**328.** to end the curse he swallowed Nanda —
[and] disgorged Nanda, touching Krishna's feet.

কুবেরের চর শঙ্খচূড়ের মরণ ।
মাথায় মুষ্টিকাঘাতে মণির গ্রহণ ॥ ৩২৯ ॥

*kuberera cara śaṅkhacūṛera maraṇa |*
*māthāẏa muṣṭikāghāte maṇira grahaṇa || 329 ||*

*Word for word:* kuverera chara — Kuvera's servant; shankhachudera marana — the death of Shankhachuda; mathaya mushtika-ghate — by a blow of the fist on the head; manira grahana — the taking of the jewel

**329.** [Here is] the death of Shankhachuda, Kuvera's servant:
with a blow of the fist on his head [Krishna] took [his] jewel.

অরিষ্ট-বৃষভ-শৃঙ্গ চরণে ধরিয়া ।
মুখে রক্ত তোলে, গোঠে মাইল আছাড়িয়া ॥ ৩৩০ ॥

*ariṣṭa-bṛṣabha-śṛṅga caraṇe dhariẏā |*
*mukhe rakta tole, goṭhe māila āchāṛiẏā || 330 ||*

*Word for word:* arishta-vrishabha-shringa — the bull Arishta by the horns; charane dhariya — and seizing by the legs; mukhe rakta tole — blood gushed from his mouth; gothe maila achhadiya — He killed him in the pasture, dashing him down

**330.** Seizing the bull Arishta by the horns and legs,
[Krishna] dashed him down in the pasture and killed him — blood gushed from his mouth.

নারদ-বচনে কংস চিন্তায়ে বিমন ।
বসুদেব-দেবকীর নিগড়-বন্ধন ॥ ৩৩১ ॥

*nārada-bacane kaṃsa cintāẏe bimana |*
*basudeba-debakīra nigaṛa-bandhana || 331 ||*

*Word for word:* narada-vachane — at Narada's words; kamsa chintaye vimana — Kamsa is troubled; vasudeva-devakira — of Vasudeva and Devaki; nigada-bandhana — binding in fetters

**331.** At Narada's words Kamsa grew troubled
[and] bound Vasudeva and Devaki in fetters.

অশ্বরূপ ধরে কেশী কংস-অনুচর ।
মহাতেজ কৃষ্ণবর্ণ দেখি' লাগে ডর ॥ ৩৩২ ॥

*aśbarūpa dhare keśī kaṃsa-anucara |*
*mahāteja kṛṣṇabarṇa dekhi' lāge ḍara || 332 ||*

*Word for word:* ashva-rupa dhare — takes the form of a horse; keshi kamsa-anuchara — Keshi, Kamsa's follower; mahateja krishna-varna — mighty, black; dekhi lage dara — seeing him, one feels fear

**332.** Keshi, Kamsa's follower, takes the form of a horse —
mighty, black: the sight of him strikes fear.

বায়ু বন্ধ করি' তার মুখে ভরি' হাথ ।
এইখানে কেশি-বধ কৈল গোপীনাথ ॥ ৩৩৩ ॥

*bāẏu bandha kari' tāra mukhe bhari' hātha |*
*eikhāne keśi-badha kaila gopīnātha || 333 ||*

*Word for word:* vayu bandha kari — stopping his breath; tara mukhe bhari hatha — thrusting His arm into his mouth; eikhane — here; keshi-vadha kaila gopinatha — Gopinatha slew Keshi

**333.** Thrusting His arm into his mouth [and] stopping his breath,
here Gopinatha slew Keshi.

মেষরূপে শিশু চুরি করয়ে অসুর ।
পাথর আচ্ছাদি' রাখে পর্বত-গহ্বর ॥ ৩৩৪ ॥

*meṣarūpe śiśu curi karaẏe asura |*
*pāthara ācchādi' rākhe parbata-gahbara || 334 ||*

*Word for word:* mesha-rupe — in the form of a ram; shishu churi karaye asura — the asura steals the boys; pathara achchhadi — covering with a stone; rakhe parvata-gahvara — keeps them in a mountain cave

**334.** An asura in the form of a ram steals the boys
and, closing it with a stone, keeps them in a mountain cave.

আনিলেন শিশু, ব্যোম আছাড়ি' মারিয়া ।
আনন্দে খেলায় খেলা দুষ্ট নিবারিয়া ॥ ৩৩৫ ॥

*ānilena śiśu, byoma āchāṛi' māriẏā |*
*ānande khelāẏa khelā duṣṭa nibāriẏā || 335 ||*

*Word for word:* anilena shishu — He brought back the boys; vyoma achhadi mariya — killing Vyoma by dashing him down; anande khelaya khela — He plays joyfully; dushta nivariya — having removed the villain

**335.** Killing Vyoma by dashing him down, [Krishna] brought back the boys
and, rid of the villain, plays joyfully[^50-2].

তবে ত নন্দের ঘর ছিল নন্দীশ্বর ।
ইহার পশ্চিমে দেখ কাম্যকবন আর ॥ ৩৩৬ ॥

*tabe ta nandera ghara chila nandīśbara |*
*ihāra paścime dekha kāmyakabana āra || 336 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe ta — then; nandera ghara chhila nandishvara — Nanda's house was at Nandishvara; ihara pashchime — west of it; dekha kamyaka-vana ara — see also the Kamyaka-vana

**336.** Then Nanda's house was at Nandishvara;
see — west of here is also the Kamyaka-vana.

পিছলি পাথর দেখ এ গোপ-ছাওয়ালে ।
