পিছলি খেলায় এথা বিহান-বিকালে ॥ ৩৩৭ ॥

*pichali pāthara dekha e gopa-chāoẏāle |*
*pichali khelāẏa ethā bihāna-bikāle || 337 ||*

*Word for word:* pichhali pathara dekha — see the sliding stone; e gopa-chhaoyale — these cowherd boys; pichhali khelaya etha — slide down here in play; vihana-vikale — morning and evening

**337.** See — the sliding stone: these cowherd boys
slide down it here in play morning and evening[^50-3].

পাবন-সরোবর নন্দীশ্বরের উত্তরে ।
চৌদিগে দেখহ খুঁটা বান্ধিতে বাছুরে ॥ ৩৩৮ ॥

*pābana-sarobara nandīśbarera uttare |*
*caudige dekhaha khuṁṭā bāndhite bāchure || 338 ||*

*Word for word:* pavana-sarovara — the Pavana-sarovara; nandishvarera uttare — north of Nandishvara; chaudige dekhaha khunta — see, posts all around; bandhite bachhure — for tying the calves

**338.** North of Nandishvara is the Pavana-sarovara;
see — all around are posts for tying the calves.

মথুরাতে অক্রূরকে কংসের আদেশ ।
সেইখানে সন্ধ্যাকালে নগর-প্রবেশ ॥ ৩৩৯ ॥

*mathurāte akrūrake kaṃsera ādeśa |*
*seikhāne sandhyākāle nagara-prabeśa || 339 ||*

*Word for word:* mathurate — in Mathura; akrurake kamsera adesha — Kamsa's order to Akrura; seikhane — there; sandhya-kale — at dusk; nagara-pravesha — the entry into the village

**339.** In Mathura Kamsa gave his order to Akrura —
and he entered [this] village at dusk[^50-4].

পথেতে আসিতে যত মনঃকথা ছিল ।
পদারবিন্দের চিহ্ন দেখি' সিদ্ধ হৈল ॥ ৩৪০ ॥

*pathete āsite yata manaḥkathā chila |*
*padārabindera cihna dekhi' siddha haila || 340 ||*

*Word for word:* pathete asite — on the way here; yata manah-katha chhila — all the thoughts he had; padaravindera chihna dekhi — seeing the marks of the lotus feet; siddha haila — were fulfilled

**340.** All the thoughts he had on the way here
were fulfilled when he saw the marks of the lotus feet.

এই গোঠে রামকৃষ্ণ দোঁহাকে দেখিয়া ।
দণ্ডবত করে ভূমে চরণে পড়িয়া ॥ ৩৪১ ॥

*ei goṭhe rāmakṛṣṇa doṁhāke dekhiẏā |*
*daṇḍabata kare bhūme caraṇe paṛiẏā || 341 ||*

*Word for word:* ei gothe — in this pasture; rama-krishna donhake dekhiya — seeing both Rama and Krishna; dandavata kare bhume — he prostrates on the ground; charane padiya — falling at their feet

**341.** In this pasture, seeing both Rama and Krishna,
he prostrated on the ground, falling at Their feet.

ঘরে লঞা গেলা তারে করিয়া আদর ।
রজনীতে কংস-মর্ম কহিল সকল ॥ ৩৪২ ॥

*ghare lañā gelā tāre kariẏā ādara |*
*rajanīte kaṃsa-marma kahila sakala || 342 ||*

*Word for word:* ghare lanya gela — they took him home; tare kariya adara — honouring him; rajanite — at night; kamsa-marma kahila sakala — he told all of Kamsa's design

**342.** They took him home with honour,
and at night he told all of Kamsa's design.

প্রভাতে ঘোষণা নন্দ দিলেন সভারে ।
ঘোষণা পড়িল—যাব কংসে ভেটিবারে ॥ ৩৪৩ ॥

*prabhāte ghoṣaṇā nanda dilena sabhāre |*
*ghoṣaṇā paṛila—yāba kaṃse bheṭibāre || 343 ||*

*Word for word:* prabhate — in the morning; ghoshana nanda dilena sabhare — Nanda made a proclamation to all; ghoshana padila — the word went round; yaba kamse bhetibare — we go to present tribute to Kamsa

**343.** In the morning Nanda proclaimed to all —
the word went round: 'Let us go to Kamsa with tribute.'

এইখানে রামকৃষ্ণ চড়িলা ত রথে ।
রাজ-দরশনে চলে অক্রূর সহিতে ॥ ৩৪৪ ॥

*eikhāne rāmakṛṣṇa caṛilā ta rathe |*
*rāja-daraśane cale akrūra sahite || 344 ||*

*Word for word:* eikhane — here; rama-krishna chadila ta rathe — Rama and Krishna mounted the chariot; raja-darashane chale — they go to see the king; akrura sahite — with Akrura

**344.** Here Rama and Krishna mounted the chariot
and go to the king together with Akrura.

এইখানে গোপীগণ মরয়ে কান্দিয়া ।
কৃষ্ণের বিরহে কান্দে অঙ্গ আছাড়িয়া ॥ ৩৪৫ ॥

*eikhāne gopīgaṇa maraẏe kāndiẏā |*
*kṛṣṇera birahe kānde aṅga āchāṛiẏā || 345 ||*

*Word for word:* eikhane — here; gopigana maraye kandiya — the gopis are dying of weeping; krishnera virahe — in separation from Krishna; kande anga achhadiya — they weep, flinging themselves down

**345.** Here the gopis are dying of weeping:
in separation from Krishna they weep, flinging themselves down.

ভূমিতে পড়িয়া কান্দে, আউলাইল কেশ ।
বসন-ভূষণ সব ব্যস্ত, ভেল বেশ ॥ ৩৪৬ ॥

*bhūmite paṛiẏā kānde, āulāila keśa |*
*basana-bhūṣaṇa saba byasta, bhela beśa || 346 ||*

*Word for word:* bhumite padiya kande — fallen on the ground they weep; aulaila kesha — their hair dishevelled; vasana-bhushana saba vyasta — clothes and ornaments all in disarray; bhela vesha — such became their attire

**346.** Fallen on the ground they weep, their hair dishevelled,
clothes and ornaments all in disarray — such became their attire.

তাহার কান্দনা মুখে কহনে না যায় ।
প্রাণহীন দেহ যেন রহে হাথ পায় ॥ ৩৪৭ ॥

*tāhāra kāndanā mukhe kahane nā yāẏa |*
*prāṇahīna deha yena rahe hātha pāẏa || 347 ||*

*Word for word:* tahara kandana — their weeping; mukhe kahane na yaya — cannot be told in words; pranahina deha yena — like a lifeless body; rahe hatha paya — their hands and feet lie still

**347.** Their weeping cannot be told in words:
like a lifeless body, their hands and feet lie still.

দূতদ্বারে কৃষ্ণ সে আপনে শান্ত করে ।
আসিতেছি আমি কথো দিবস ভিতরে ॥ ৩৪৮ ॥

*dūtadbāre kṛṣṇa se āpane śānta kare |*
*āsitechi āmi katho dibasa bhitare || 348 ||*

*Word for word:* duta-dvare — through a messenger; krishna se apane shanta kare — Krishna Himself consoles them; asitechhi ami — I am coming; katho divasa bhitare — within a few days

**348.** Through a messenger Krishna Himself consoles them:
'I shall come within a few days[^50-5].

তোমরা সকলে মোর প্রাণের সমান ।
প্রাণ ছাড়া দেহ রহে—এ নহে প্রমাণ ॥ ৩৪৯ ॥

*tomarā sakale mora prāṇera samāna |*
*prāṇa chāṛā deha rahe—e nahe pramāṇa || 349 ||*

*Word for word:* tomara sakale — all of you; mora pranera samana — are as dear to Me as life; prana chhada deha rahe — that a body lives without its life; e nahe pramana — this is not possible

**349.** All of you are as dear to Me as life —
that a body should live without its life cannot be.

দুষ্টগণ নাশ করি' শীঘ্র সে আসিব ।
দুঃখ না ভাবিহ, জান স্বরূপে এ সব ॥ ৩৫০ ॥

*duṣṭagaṇa nāśa kari' śīghra se āsiba |*
*duḥkha nā bhābiha, jāna sbarūpe e saba || 350 ||*

*Word for word:* dushtagana nasha kari — destroying the wicked; shighra se asiba — I shall come soon; duhkha na bhaviha — do not grieve; jana svarupe e saba — know all this truly

**350.** When I have destroyed the wicked, I shall come soon;
do not grieve; know all this to be true.'

এখানে গোয়ালা সব শকটে চড়িল ।
মানসগঙ্গার ঘাটে সভাই জিরাইল ॥ ৩৫১ ॥

*ekhāne goẏālā saba śakaṭe caṛila |*
*mānasagaṅgāra ghāṭe sabhāi jirāila || 351 ||*

*Word for word:* ekhane — here; goyala saba shakate chadila — all the cowherds mounted the carts; manasa-gangara ghate — at the ghata of the Manasa-Ganga; sabhai jiraila — all rested

**351.** Here all the cowherds mounted the carts
and all rested at the ghata of the Manasa-Ganga.

যমুনার ঘাটে গেলা আড়াই-প্রহর ।
স্নান-ফলাহার কৈলা গোয়ালা সকল ॥ ৩৫২ ॥

*yamunāra ghāṭe gelā āṛāi-prahara |*
*snāna-phalāhāra kailā goẏālā sakala || 352 ||*

*Word for word:* yamunara ghate gela — they reached the Yamuna ghata; adai-prahara — at two and a half praharas; snana-phalahara kaila — bathed and ate fruit; goyala sakala — all the cowherds

**352.** They reached the Yamuna ghata at the middle of the third prahara;
all the cowherds bathed and ate fruit.

অক্রূরের স্নানকালে বিভূতি দেখায় ।
বিকালে নন্দাদি আগে, পাছে কৃষ্ণ যায় ॥ ৩৫৩ ॥

*akrūrera snānakāle bibhūti dekhāẏa |*
*bikāle nandādi āge, pāche kṛṣṇa yāẏa || 353 ||*

*Word for word:* akrurera snana-kale — when Akrura bathed; vibhuti dekhaya — He shows [His] glory; vikale — in the afternoon; nandadi age — Nanda and the rest ahead; pachhe krishna yaya — Krishna goes behind

**353.** When Akrura bathed, [Krishna] showed [him His] glory;
in the afternoon Nanda and the others go ahead, and Krishna behind.

এইখানে হাহাকার কৈল সব লোক ।
এ মল্লের যোগ্য নহে—এ অতি বালক ॥ ৩৫৪ ॥

*eikhāne hāhākāra kaila saba loka |*
*e mallera yogya nahe—e ati bālaka || 354 ||*

*Word for word:* eikhane — here; hahakara kaila saba loka — all the people cried out in dismay; e mallera yogya nahe — He is no match for a wrestler; e ati balaka — He is a mere boy

**354.** Here all the people cried out in dismay:
'He is no match for a wrestler — He is a mere boy!

অযোগ্য করয়ে কংস, করয়ে বিরূপ ।
যার যেন হিয়া, কৃষ্ণে দেখে তেনরূপ ॥ ৩৫৫ ॥

*ayogya karaẏe kaṃsa, karaẏe birūpa |*
*yāra yena hiẏā, kṛṣṇe dekhe tenarūpa || 355 ||*

*Word for word:* ayogya karaye kamsa — Kamsa acts unfittingly; karaye virupa — acts wrongly; yara yena hiya — as each one's heart is; krishne dekhe tenarupa — so he sees Krishna

**355.** Kamsa acts unfittingly, acts wrongly!'
As each one's heart was, so he saw Krishna[^50-6].

চমকিত ভেল কংস, সঘনে ভরম ।
কৃষ্ণ-বলরামে দেখে মূর্তিমন্ত যম ॥ ৩৫৬ ॥

*camakita bhela kaṃsa, saghane bharama |*
*kṛṣṇa-balarāme dekhe mūrtimanta yama || 356 ||*

*Word for word:* chamakita bhela kamsa — Kamsa was startled; saghane bharama — in deep confusion; krishna-balarame dekhe — in Krishna and Balarama he sees; murtimanta yama — Death embodied

**356.** Kamsa was startled, in deep confusion:
in Krishna and Balarama he sees Death embodied.

মল্লগণ দেখে যেন বজ্র-নিরমাণ ।
যোগিগণ দেখে সেই পূর্ণ ভগবান্ ॥ ৩৫৭ ॥

*mallagaṇa dekhe yena bajra-niramāṇa |*
*yogigaṇa dekhe sei pūrṇa bhagabān || 357 ||*

*Word for word:* mallagana dekhe — the wrestlers see; yena vajra-niramana — as if [He] were made of thunderbolt; yogigana dekhe — the yogis see; sei purna bhagavan — Him, the complete Bhagavan

**357.** The wrestlers see Him as if made of thunderbolt,
the yogis see Him as the complete Bhagavan,

যদুগণ দেখে যেন কুলের দেবতা ।
অবিদ্বানগণ দেখে বিরাট বিধাতা ॥ ৩৫৮ ॥

*yadugaṇa dekhe yena kulera debatā |*
*abidbānagaṇa dekhe birāṭa bidhātā || 358 ||*

*Word for word:* yadugana dekhe — the Yadus see; yena kulera devata — as the deity of their clan; avidvana-gana dekhe — the ignorant see; virata vidhata — the universal form, the Creator

**358.** the Yadus see Him as the deity of their clan,
the ignorant as the universal form of the Creator,

গোপগণ দেখে সেই স্বজন-সমান ।
নারীগণ দেখয়ে কন্দর্প মূর্তিমান্ ॥ ৩৫৯ ॥

*gopagaṇa dekhe sei sbajana-samāna |*
*nārīgaṇa dekhaẏe kandarpa mūrtimān || 359 ||*

*Word for word:* gopagana dekhe — the cowherds see; sei svajana-samana — Him as their own kin; narigana dekhaye — the women see; kandarpa murtiman — Kandarpa embodied

**359.** the cowherds see Him as their own kin,
the women see Kandarpa embodied.

রঙ্গস্থলে দাঁড়াইল যে দুই ভাই ।
যার যেই অনুভব দেখিল সে-ঠাঁই ॥ ৩৬০ ॥

*raṅgasthale dāṁṛāila ye dui bhāi |*
*yāra yei anubhaba dekhila se-ṭhāṁi || 360 ||*

*Word for word:* rangasthale — in the arena; dandaila ye dui bhai — when the two brothers stood; yara yei anubhava — according to each one's perception; dekhila se-thani — so he saw there

**360.** When the two brothers stood in the arena,
each one saw there according to his own perception.

চাণুর-মুষ্টিক দুই ভাই করে রণ ।
দেখিয়া চমকে রাজা তখনে তখন ॥ ৩৬১ ॥

*cāṇura-muṣṭika dui bhāi kare raṇa |*
*dekhiẏā camake rājā takhane takhana || 361 ||*

*Word for word:* chanura-mushtika — with Chanura and Mushtika; dui bhai kare rana — the two brothers fight; dekhiya — seeing it; chamake raja takhane takhana — the king starts again and again

**361.** The two brothers fight with Chanura and Mushtika;
seeing it, the king starts again and again.

চাণুর মারিলা কৃষ্ণ—ঘুচিল উৎপাত ।
মুষ্টিক মারিলা রাম—শবদ নির্ঘাত ॥ ৩৬২ ॥

*cāṇura mārilā kṛṣṇa—ghucila utpāta |*
*muṣṭika mārilā rāma—śabada nirghāta || 362 ||*

*Word for word:* chanura marila krishna — Krishna slew Chanura; ghuchila utpata — the menace ended; mushtika marila rama — Rama slew Mushtika; shabada nirghata — a thunderous crash

**362.** Krishna slew Chanura — the menace was ended;
Rama slew Mushtika — a crash like thunder.

পুনঃ আর মুটকিতে কোটি মল্ল মারে ।
শাল নামে মল্ল কৃষ্ণ মারিল আছাড়ে ॥ ৩৬৩ ॥

*punaḥ āra muṭakite koṭi malla māre |*
*śāla nāme malla kṛṣṇa mārila āchāṛe || 363 ||*

*Word for word:* punah ara mutakite — and again with His fists; koti malla mare — He slays countless wrestlers; shala name malla — the wrestler named Shala; krishna marila achhade — Krishna slew, dashing him down

**363.** And again with His fists He slays countless wrestlers;
the wrestler named Shala Krishna slew by dashing him down.

ভাঙ্গিলেন এক মঞ্চ চরণের ঘায়ে ।
কৃষ্ণের বিক্রমে মল্ল চৌদিগে পলায়ে ॥ ৩৬৪ ॥

*bhāṅgilena eka mañca caraṇera ghāẏe |*
*kṛṣṇera bikrame malla caudige palāẏe || 364 ||*

*Word for word:* bhangilena eka mancha — He broke one platform; charanera ghaye — with a kick; krishnera vikrame — at Krishna's might; malla chaudige palaye — the wrestlers flee in all directions

**364.** With a kick He broke one platform;
before Krishna's might the wrestlers flee in all directions.

শীঘ্র আজ্ঞা করে কংস এ সব দেখিয়া ।
রামকৃষ্ণে বাড়ীর বাহির কর নিয়া ॥ ৩৬৫ ॥

*śīghra ājñā kare kaṃsa e saba dekhiẏā |*
*rāmakṛṣṇe bāṛīra bāhira kara niẏā || 365 ||*

*Word for word:* shighra ajna kare kamsa — Kamsa quickly orders; e saba dekhiya — seeing all this; rama-krishne — Rama and Krishna; badira bahira kara niya — throw Them out

**365.** Seeing all this, Kamsa quickly orders:
'Seize Rama and Krishna and throw Them out!

নন্দ-আদি যতেক গোয়ালা বন্দী কর ।
উগ্রসেন-বসুদেব-দেবকীরে মার ॥ ৩৬৬ ॥

*nanda-ādi yateka goẏālā bandī kara |*
*ugrasena-basudeba-debakīre māra || 366 ||*

*Word for word:* nanda-adi yateka goyala — all the cowherds headed by Nanda; bandi kara — imprison; ugrasena-vasudeva-devakire — Ugrasena, Vasudeva and Devaki; mara — kill

**366.** Put all the cowherds headed by Nanda in fetters,
kill Ugrasena, Vasudeva and Devaki!'

হেনকালে কৃষ্ণচন্দ্র সময় বুঝিয়া ।
মহাদর্পে উঠিলা মঞ্চেতে লাফ দিয়া ॥ ৩৬৭ ॥

*henakāle kṛṣṇacandra samaẏa bujhiẏā |*
*mahādarpe uṭhilā mañcete lāpha diẏā || 367 ||*

*Word for word:* henakale — at that moment; krishnachandra samaya bujhiya — Krishnachandra, seeing the time had come; mahadarpe — with great daring; uthila manchete lapha diya — leapt up onto the platform

**367.** At that moment Krishnachandra, seeing the time had come,
with great daring leapt up onto the platform in one bound.

আস্তে-ব্যস্তে কংস খড়্গ ধরিবার কালে ।
হুহুঙ্কার দিয়া কৃষ্ণ ধরে তার চুলে ॥ ৩৬৮ ॥

*āste-byaste kaṃsa khaṛga dharibāra kāle |*
*huhuṅkāra diẏā kṛṣṇa dhare tāra cule || 368 ||*

*Word for word:* aste-vyaste — in haste; kamsa khadga dharibara kale — as Kamsa was seizing his sword; huhunkara diya — with a roar; krishna dhare tara chule — Krishna seizes him by the hair

**368.** As Kamsa was hastily seizing his sword,
Krishna with a roar seized him by the hair.

চুলে ধরি' মঞ্চ হৈতে ফেলিলেন ভূমে ।
বিশ্বরূপ বুকে চড়ে মঞ্চের পশ্চিমে ॥ ৩৬৯ ॥

*cule dhari' mañca haite phelilena bhūme |*
*biśbarūpa buke caṛe mañcera paścime || 369 ||*

*Word for word:* chule dhari — seizing by the hair; mancha haite phelilena bhume — He threw him down from the platform to the ground; vishvarupa buke chade — the Vishvarupa (the Lord whose form is the universe) mounts [his] chest; manchera pashchime — west of the platform

**369.** Seizing him by the hair He threw him from the platform to the ground,
and the Vishvarupa — [the Lord whose form is the universe] — mounted his chest west of the platform.

ছাড়িলেক প্রাণ কংস বিশ্বরূপের ভরে ।
ধন্য কংসরাজ—কৃষ্ণ বুকের উপরে ॥ ৩৭০ ॥

*chāṛileka prāṇa kaṃsa biśbarūpera bhare |*
*dhanya kaṃsarāja—kṛṣṇa bukera upare || 370 ||*

*Word for word:* chhadileka prana kamsa — Kamsa gave up his life; vishvarupera bhare — under the weight of the Vishvarupa; dhanya kamsa-raja — blessed is King Kamsa; krishna bukera upare — Krishna on [his] chest

**370.** Under the weight of the Vishvarupa Kamsa gave up his life.
Blessed is King Kamsa — Krishna is on his chest![^50-7]

কংসবধ কৈলা—লোকে বোলে জয় জয় ।
আনন্দে দেবতা সব পুষ্প বরিষয় ॥ ৩৭১ ॥

*kaṃsabadha kailā—loke bole jaẏa jaẏa |*
*ānande debatā saba puṣpa bariṣaẏa || 371 ||*

*Word for word:* kamsa-vadha kaila — He slew Kamsa; loke bole jaya jaya — the people cry "Victory, victory!"; anande devata saba — joyfully all the gods; pushpa varishaya — rain down flowers

**371.** He slew Kamsa — the people cry: 'Victory, victory!' —
and all the gods joyfully rain down flowers [on Him].

হেঁচুড়ি' আনিল কৃষ্ণ চুলেতে ধরিয়া ।
কথোদূরে ফেলাইলা তুলি' আছাড়িয়া ॥ ৩৭২ ॥

*heṁcuṛi' ānila kṛṣṇa culete dhariẏā |*
*kathodūre phelāilā tuli' āchāṛiẏā || 372 ||*

*Word for word:* henchudi anila krishna — Krishna dragged [him]; chulete dhariya — holding him by the hair; kathodure phelaila — threw him some distance; tuli achhadiya — lifting and dashing him down

**372.** Holding him by the hair, Krishna dragged him along,
lifted him and, dashing him down, threw him some distance away.

কঙ্ক-আদি করি' কংসের অষ্ট সহোদর ।
ভ্রাতৃশোকে উনমত সভে ধরে বল ॥ ৩৭৩ ॥

*kaṅka-ādi kari' kaṃsera aṣṭa sahodara |*
*bhrātṛśoke unamata sabhe dhare bala || 373 ||*

*Word for word:* kanka-adi kari — headed by Kanka; kamsera ashta sahodara — Kamsa's eight brothers; bhratri-shoke unamata — maddened by grief for their brother; sabhe dhare bala — all gathered their strength

**373.** Kamsa's eight brothers, headed by Kanka,
maddened by grief for their brother, gathered all their strength:

রামকৃষ্ণ মারিবারে আইসে সাতজন ।
ভ্রূক্ষেপে মারিলা তাহা একা বলরাম ॥ ৩৭৪ ॥

*rāmakṛṣṇa māribāre āise sātajana |*
*bhrūkṣepe mārilā tāhā ekā balarāma || 374 ||*

*Word for word:* rama-krishna maribare — to kill Rama and Krishna; aise satajana — seven come on; bhrukshepe marila taha — slew them with a mere frown; eka balarama — Balarama alone

**374.** seven come on to kill Rama and Krishna —
Balarama alone slew them with a mere frown.

কংসে হেঁচুড়ি' এই গ্রাম-মধ্য দিয়া ।
কংসখালি বলি' এই—শুন মন দিয়া ॥ ৩৭৫ ॥

*kaṃse heṁcuṛi' ei grāma-madhya diẏā |*
*kaṃsakhāli bali' ei—śuna mana diẏā || 375 ||*

*Word for word:* kamse henchudi — dragging Kamsa; ei grama-madhya diya — through this village; kamsakhali bali ei — this is called Kamsa-khali; shuna mana diya — listen attentively

**375.** Through this village [Krishna] dragged Kamsa;
that is why [the place] is called Kamsa-khali — listen attentively.

শ্রমশান্তি কৈল—সে বিশ্রান্তিঘাট নাম ।
কংসনারী-প্রলাপে প্রবোধে বলরাম ॥ ৩৭৬ ॥

*śramaśānti kaila—se biśrāntighāṭa nāma |*
*kaṃsanārī-pralāpe prabodhe balarāma || 376 ||*

*Word for word:* shrama-shanti kaila — He rested from His fatigue; se vishranti-ghata nama — hence the name Vishranti-ghata; kamsa-nari-pralape — the lamenting wives of Kamsa; prabodhe balarama — Balarama consoles

**376.** [Here] He rested from His fatigue — hence the Vishranti-ghata;
Balarama consoles the lamenting wives of Kamsa[^50-8].

তবে নিজ মাতাপিতা করিল মোক্ষণ ।
আনন্দে বিহ্বল তারা করয়ে চুম্বন ॥ ৩৭৭ ॥

*tabe nija mātāpitā karila mokṣaṇa |*
*ānande bihbala tārā karaẏe cumbana || 377 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe — then; nija mata-pita — His own mother and father; karila mokshana — He set free; anande vihvala tara — they, overwhelmed with joy; karaye chumbana — kiss [Him]

**377.** Then He set free His own mother and father;
overwhelmed with joy, they kiss [Him].

উগ্রসেনে রাজা কৈল, নন্দকে বিদায় ।
এ কথা আমার শক্তে কহনে না যায় ॥ ৩৭৮ ॥

*ugrasene rājā kaila, nandake bidāẏa |*
*e kathā āmāra śakte kahane nā yāẏa || 378 ||*

*Word for word:* ugrasene raja kaila — He made Ugrasena king; nandake vidaya — sent Nanda away; e katha — this account; amara shakte kahane na yaya — is beyond my power to tell

**378.** He made Ugrasena king and sent Nanda away [home] —
this is beyond my power to tell.

কৃষ্ণের নিঠুরপনা শুনিতে তরাস ।
কহিতে মরয়ে, কহে এ লোচনদাস ॥ ৩৭৯ ॥

*kṛṣṇera niṭhurapanā śunite tarāsa |*
*kahite maraẏe, kahe e locanadāsa || 379 ||*

*Word for word:* krishnera nithurapana — Krishna's hardness of heart; shunite tarasa — is dreadful to hear; kahite maraye — in telling it he dies; kahe e lochanadasa — says this Lochana Dasa

**379.** Krishna's hardness of heart is dreadful even to hear of[^50-9]:
in telling it he dies [of grief], says this Lochana Dasa.

*Raga bhatiyali; disha: "Come, come — I will take Kanai and Balai in my arms!"*

তবে বসুদেব পিতা দেবকী জননী ।
এ দোঁহার প্রেমসুখে ভরিল ধরণী ॥ ৩৭৯+১ ॥

*tabe basudeba pitā debakī jananī |*
*e doṁhāra premasukhe bharila dharaṇī || 379+1 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe — then; vasudeva pita devaki janani — the father Vasudeva and the mother Devaki; e donhara prema-sukhe — with the joy of love of these two; bharila dharani — the earth was filled

**379+1.** Then the father Vasudeva and the mother Devaki —
with the joy of the love of these two the earth was filled[^50-10].

পুত্রে উপবীত দিয়া গায়ত্রী শিখায় ।
কতদিন মথুরাতে বিলাসে গোঙায় ॥ ৩৭৯+২ ॥

*putre upabīta diẏā gāẏatrī śikhāẏa |*
*katadina mathurāte bilāse goṅāẏa || 379+2 ||*

*Word for word:* putre upavita diya — giving the sons the sacred thread; gayatri shikhaya — he teaches [them] the gayatri; katadina mathurate — some days in Mathura; vilase gongaya — [They] pass in pastimes

**379+2.** He gave his sons the sacred thread and teaches [them] the gayatri;
for some time [They] pass Their days in pastimes in Mathura.

কহিতে কৃষ্ণের কথা প্রায়ে অপার ।
সম্বরণ নহে, পুঁথি হয়ে ত বিস্তার ॥ ৩৭৯+৩ ॥

*kahite kṛṣṇera kathā prāẏe apāra |*
*sambaraṇa nahe, puṁthi haẏe ta bistāra || 379+3 ||*

*Word for word:* kahite krishnera katha — the telling of Krishna's story; praye apara — is almost boundless; samvarana nahe — there is no restraining it; punthi haye ta vistara — the book grows too long

**379+3.** The tales of Krishna are almost without end;
there is no holding back — and the book grows too long.

অক্রূর যতন করে নিজঘরে নিতে ।
বলিল তাহারে—যাব লেউটি' আসিতে ॥ ৩৮০ ॥

*akrūra yatana kare nijaghare nite |*
*balila tāhāre—yāba leuṭi' āsite || 380 ||*

*Word for word:* akrura yatana kare — Akrura tries; nija-ghare nite — to take [Them] to his house; balila tahare — [Krishna] told him; yaba leuti asite — I shall come on the way back

**380.** Akrura tried to take [Them] to his house;
[Krishna] told him: "I shall come on the way back"[^50-11].

কৃষ্ণের বিলম্বে গোপ মথুরা-নিকটে ।
সরস্বতী-তীরে তথা রাখিল শকটে ॥ ৩৮১ ॥

*kṛṣṇera bilambe gopa mathurā-nikaṭe |*
*sarasbatī-tīre tathā rākhila śakaṭe || 381 ||*

*Word for word:* krishnera vilambe — while Krishna lingered; gopa mathura-nikate — the cowherds near Mathura; sarasvati-tire tatha — there on the bank of the Sarasvati; rakhila shakate — halted the carts

**381.** While Krishna lingered, the cowherds, near Mathura,
halted their carts there on the bank of the Sarasvati.

নন্দ-আদি গোপ যত রাখি' এইখানে ।
আগেতে জানায় কংসে অক্রূর আপনে ॥ ৩৮২ ॥

*nanda-ādi gopa yata rākhi' eikhāne |*
*āgete jānāẏa kaṃse akrūra āpane || 382 ||*

*Word for word:* nanda-adi gopa yata — all the cowherds headed by Nanda; rakhi eikhane — leaving here; agete janaya kamse — informs Kamsa in advance; akrura apane — Akrura himself

**382.** Leaving the cowherds headed by Nanda here,
Akrura himself goes ahead to inform Kamsa.

বুঝি' এইখানে স্থিতি হৈব কথোক্ষণ ।
মথুরা দেখিতে দুই ভাইর গমন ॥ ৩৮৩ ॥

*bujhi' eikhāne sthiti haiba kathokṣaṇa |*
*mathurā dekhite dui bhāira gamana || 383 ||*

*Word for word:* bujhi — understanding; eikhane sthiti haiba kathokshana — that there would be a halt here for a while; mathura dekhite — to see Mathura; dui bhaira gamana — the two brothers went

**383.** Understanding that they would stay here for a while,
the two brothers went to see Mathura.

দেখিল রজক এক, দুর্মুখ তার নাম ।
দেখিয়া কাপড় মাগে কৃষ্ণ-বলরাম ॥ ৩৮৪ ॥

*dekhila rajaka eka, durmukha tāra nāma |*
*dekhiẏā kāpaṛa māge kṛṣṇa-balarāma || 384 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhila rajaka eka — they saw a washerman; durmukha tara nama — named Durmukha; dekhiya — seeing him; kapada mage krishna-balarama — Krishna and Balarama ask for clothes

**384.** They saw a washerman named Durmukha;
seeing him, Krishna and Balarama ask for clothes.

দুর্মুখ পাপিষ্ঠ সেই বোলে দুরক্ষর ।
করাগ্রে কাটিয়া তার ফেলিল কন্ধর ॥ ৩৮৫ ॥

*durmukha pāpiṣṭha sei bole durakṣara |*
*karāgre kāṭiẏā tāra phelila kandhara || 385 ||*

*Word for word:* durmukha papishtha sei — that sinful Durmukha; bole durakshara — speaks harsh words; karagre katiya — cutting with His fingertips; tara phelila kandhara — He struck off his head

**385.** The sinful Durmukha speaks harsh words —
and [Krishna] struck off his head with His fingertips.

সেই দিব্য বস্ত্র পরি' সুখে হরষিতে ।
সুদামা-মালীর ঘরে ভেল উপনীতে ॥ ৩৮৬ ॥

*sei dibya bastra pari' sukhe haraṣite |*
*sudāmā-mālīra ghare bhela upanīte || 386 ||*

*Word for word:* sei divya vastra pari — putting on those fine clothes; sukhe harashite — happy and joyful; sudama-malira ghare — at the house of Sudama the garland-maker; bhela upanite — arrived

**386.** Putting on those fine clothes, happy and joyful,
They arrived at the house of Sudama the garland-maker.

সুদামা উঠিয়া কৈল চরণ-বন্দন ।
দিব্য মালা গলে দিয়া করয়ে স্তবন ॥ ৩৮৭ ॥

*sudāmā uṭhiẏā kaila caraṇa-bandana |*
*dibya mālā gale diẏā karaẏe stabana || 387 ||*

*Word for word:* sudama uthiya — Sudama, rising; kaila charana-vandana — bowed to [Their] feet; divya mala gale diya — placing fine garlands on [Their] necks; karaye stavana — offers praise

**387.** Sudama rose, bowed to Their feet,
placed fine garlands on Their necks and offers praise.

তার পূজা লইয়া চলিলা দুই ভাই ।
ত্রিবক্রা কুবুজী এক দেখিলা তথাই ॥ ৩৮৮ ॥

*tāra pūjā laiẏā calilā dui bhāi |*
*tribakrā kubujī eka dekhilā tathāi || 388 ||*

*Word for word:* tara puja laiya — accepting his worship; chalila dui bhai — the two brothers went on; trivakra kubuji eka — a hunchbacked woman bent in three places; dekhila tathai — they saw there

**388.** Accepting his worship, the two brothers went on
and saw there a hunchbacked woman bent in three places.

ত্রিবক্রা দেখিয়া মনে হাস্য উপজিল ।
উপহাস করি' তারে আইস আইস বৈল ॥ ৩৮৯ ॥

*tribakrā dekhiẏā mane hāsya upajila |*
*upahāsa kari' tāre āisa āisa baila || 389 ||*

*Word for word:* trivakra dekhiya — seeing the bent woman; mane hasya upajila — laughter arose in His mind; upahasa kari — jesting; tare aisa aisa baila — He said to her "Come, come"

**389.** Seeing the bent woman, [Krishna] laughed within
and in jest said to her: "Come, come."

আদরে দোঁহারে কুব্জা নিজঘরে নিল ।
অগুরু-চন্দন-গন্ধ শ্রীঅঙ্গে লেপিল ॥ ৩৯০ ॥

*ādare doṁhāre kubjā nijaghare nila |*
*aguru-candana-gandha śrīaṅge lepila || 390 ||*

*Word for word:* adare donhare — with honour both; kubja nija-ghare nila — Kubja took to her house; aguru-chandana-gandha — fragrant aloe and sandal; sri-ange lepila — she applied to [Their] bodies

**390.** Kubja with honour took both to her house
and anointed Their bodies with fragrant aloe and sandal.

বড় তুষ্ট হঞা কুব্জী সৎকার করিল ।
শ্রীহস্ত-পরশে কুব্জা দিব্যমূর্তি হৈল ॥ ৩৯১ ॥

*baṛa tuṣṭa hañā kubjī satkāra karila |*
*śrīhasta-paraśe kubjā dibyamūrti haila || 391 ||*

*Word for word:* bada tushta hanya — greatly pleased; kubji satkara karila — Kubja paid honour; sri-hasta-parashe — by the touch of the holy hand; kubja divya-murti haila — Kubja gained a beautiful form

**391.** Greatly pleased, Kubja paid Them honour —
and by the touch of the holy hand Kubja gained a beautiful form.

কামে অচেতন কুব্জা চাহে কানু-পানে ।
লজ্জা পরিহরি' কহে বেকত-বদনে ॥ ৩৯২ ॥

*kāme acetana kubjā cāhe kānu-pāne |*
*lajjā parihari' kahe bekata-badane || 392 ||*

*Word for word:* kame achetana kubja — Kubja, senseless with desire; chahe kanu-pane — looks at Kanu; lajja parihari — casting off shame; kahe vekata-vadane — speaks openly

**392.** Senseless with desire, Kubja looks at Kanu
and, casting off shame, speaks openly[^50-12].

আশ্বাস-বচনে তারে তুষ্ট কৈল হরি ।
চলিলা ত দুই ভাই নটবেশ ধরি' ॥ ৩৯৩ ॥

*āśbāsa-bacane tāre tuṣṭa kaila hari |*
*calilā ta dui bhāi naṭabeśa dhari' || 393 ||*

*Word for word:* ashvasa-vachane — with words of assurance; tare tushta kaila hari — Hari pleased her; chalila ta dui bhai — the two brothers went on; natavesha dhari — in the attire of dancers

**393.** With words of assurance Hari pleased her,
and the two brothers went on in the attire of dancers.

তবে ধনুর্যজ্ঞ-স্থানে ধনুক ভাঙ্গিলা ।
কংস-অনুচর যত মারিতে ধাইলা ॥ ৩৯৪ ॥

*tabe dhanuryajña-sthāne dhanuka bhāṅgilā |*
*kaṃsa-anucara yata mārite dhāilā || 394 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe — then; dhanur-yajna-sthane — at the place of the bow sacrifice; dhanuka bhangila — He broke the bow; kamsa-anuchara yata — all Kamsa's men; marite dhaila — rushed to kill [Them]

**394.** Then at the place of the bow sacrifice [Krishna] broke the bow;
all Kamsa's men rushed to kill [Them],

ভগ্নধনু হাতে করি' কংসচর মারি' ।
সন্ধ্যায় চলিলা যথা নন্দ আদি করি' ॥ ৩৯৫ ॥

*bhagnadhanu hāte kari' kaṃsacara māri' |*
*sandhyāẏa calilā yathā nanda ādi kari' || 395 ||*

*Word for word:* bhagna-dhanu hate kari — taking the broken bow in hand; kamsa-chara mari — slaying Kamsa's men; sandhyaya chalila — at dusk they went; yatha nanda adi kari — to where Nanda and the others were

**395.** but, taking the broken bow in hand, [They] slew Kamsa's men
and at dusk went to where Nanda and the others [were].

সেই ত রজনী কংস কুস্বপ্ন দেখিল ।
অতি উচ্চতর করি' এ মঞ্চ বান্ধিল ॥ ৩৯৬ ॥

*sei ta rajanī kaṃsa kusbapna dekhila |*
*ati uccatara kari' e mañca bāndhila || 396 ||*

*Word for word:* sei ta rajani — that very night; kamsa kusvapna dekhila — Kamsa saw evil dreams; ati uchchatara kari — making it very high; e mancha bandhila — he built this platform

**396.** That very night Kamsa had evil dreams;
he built this very high platform.

ইহার দক্ষিণে হের দুই মঞ্চ আর ।
বসুদেব-দেবকীর তরে বসিবার ॥ ৩৯৭ ॥

*ihāra dakṣiṇe hera dui mañca āra |*
*basudeba-debakīra tare basibāra || 397 ||*

*Word for word:* ihara dakshine — south of it; hera dui mancha ara — here are two more platforms; vasudeva-devakira tare — for Vasudeva and Devaki; basibara — to sit on

**397.** Here, south of it, are two more platforms
for Vasudeva and Devaki to sit on:

কালি হেথা রামকৃষ্ণ মরিবে আসিয়া ।
পুত্র-মৃত্যু দেখে যেন এথাতে বসিয়া ॥ ৩৯৮ ॥

*kāli hethā rāmakṛṣṇa maribe āsiẏā |*
*putra-mṛtyu dekhe yena ethāte basiẏā || 398 ||*

*Word for word:* kali hetha — tomorrow here; rama-krishna maribe asiya — Rama and Krishna will come and die; putra-mrityu dekhe yena — let them see their sons' death; ethate basiya — sitting here

**398.** "Tomorrow Rama and Krishna will come here and die —
let them sit here and see their sons' death!"

চৌদিগে পাত্র-মিত্র সভে কৈল মঞ্চ ।
অবিকল মল্লযুদ্ধ দেখিতে সুসঞ্চ ॥ ৩৯৯ ॥

*caudige pātra-mitra sabhe kaila mañca |*
*abikala mallayuddha dekhite susañca || 399 ||*

*Word for word:* chaudige — all around; patra-mitra sabhe kaila mancha — all the ministers and friends set up platforms; avikala mallayuddha dekhite — to see the wrestling in every detail; susancha — well arranged

**399.** All around, all the ministers and friends set up platforms,
well arranged, to watch the wrestling in every detail.

পশ্চিমে খনিল কূপ সেই ত পামরে ।
দুই ভাই মারি' তাথে ফেলিবার তরে ॥ ৪০০ ॥

*paścime khanila kūpa sei ta pāmare |*
*dui bhāi māri' tāthe phelibāra tare || 400 ||*

*Word for word:* pashchime — to the west; khanila kupa sei ta pamare — that villain dug a well; dui bhai mari — killing the two brothers; tathe phelibara tare — to throw Them in it

**400.** To the west that villain dug a well,
to kill the two brothers and throw Them in it[^50-13].

প্রভাতে উঠিয়া মঞ্চে বৈসে কংসরাজ ।
আনহ গোয়ালা সব—দেউক রাজ-কাজ ॥ ৪০১ ॥

*prabhāte uṭhiẏā mañce baise kaṃsarāja |*
*ānaha goẏālā saba—deuka rāja-kāja || 401 ||*

*Word for word:* prabhate uthiya — rising in the morning; manche baise kamsaraja — King Kamsa sits on the platform; anaha goyala saba — bring all the cowherds; deuka raja-kaja — let them pay the royal dues

**401.** Rising in the morning, King Kamsa sits on the platform:
"Bring all the cowherds — let them pay the royal dues!

তার দুই পুত্র আন—কৃষ্ণ-বলরাম ।
ভাল শুনিঞাছি, তার দেখিব সংগ্রাম ॥ ৪০২ ॥

*tāra dui putra āna—kṛṣṇa-balarāma |*
*bhāla śuniñāchi, tāra dekhiba saṃgrāma || 402 ||*

*Word for word:* tara dui putra ana — bring his two sons; krishna-balarama — Krishna and Balarama; bhala shuninyachhi — I have heard much; tara dekhiba sangrama — I will watch Them fight

**402.** Bring his two sons, Krishna and Balarama:
I have heard much of Them; I will watch Them fight."

ধাইল সে ধাওয়া সব রাজার আজ্ঞায় ।
সংগ্রামের শব্দ শুনি' রামকৃষ্ণ ধায় ॥ ৪০৩ ॥

*dhāila se dhāoẏā saba rājāra ājñāẏa |*
*saṃgrāmera śabda śuni' rāmakṛṣṇa dhāẏa || 403 ||*

*Word for word:* dhaila se dhaoya saba — all the runners ran; rajara ajnaya — at the king's order; sangramera shabda shuni — hearing the din of the contest; rama-krishna dhaya — Rama and Krishna hasten

**403.** At the king's order all the runners ran;
hearing the din of the contest, Rama and Krishna hasten [there].

সত্বরে চলিয়া গেলা গড়ের দুয়ার ।
গড়দ্বারে গজ আছে পর্বত-আকার ॥ ৪০৪ ॥

*satbare caliẏā gelā gaṛera duẏāra |*
*gaṛadbāre gaja āche parbata-ākāra || 404 ||*

*Word for word:* satvare chaliya gela — they quickly went; gadera duyara — to the gate of the fort; gada-dvare — at the fort gate; gaja achhe parvata-akara — stands an elephant the size of a mountain

**404.** They quickly went to the gate of the fort —
and at the gate of the fort stands an elephant the size of a mountain.

রামকৃষ্ণ দেখি' রুষি' আইসে মারিবার ।
রুষিয়া রহিলা কৃষ্ণ সম্মুখে তাহার ॥ ৪০৫ ॥

*rāmakṛṣṇa dekhi' ruṣi' āise māribāra |*
*ruṣiẏā rahilā kṛṣṇa sammukhe tāhāra || 405 ||*

*Word for word:* rama-krishna dekhi — seeing Rama and Krishna; rushi aise maribara — it charges in fury to kill [Them]; rushiya rahila krishna — angered, Krishna stood; sammukhe tahara — before it

**405.** Seeing Rama and Krishna, it charges in fury to kill [Them];
angered, Krishna stood before it.

শুণ্ডে ধরি' ঠেলাঠেলি চড়ে তার কান্ধে ।
মাহুত মারিয়া টান দিল গজদন্তে ॥ ৪০৬ ॥

*śuṇḍe dhari' ṭhelāṭheli caṛe tāra kāndhe |*
*māhuta māriẏā ṭāna dila gajadante || 406 ||*

*Word for word:* shunde dhari — seizing the trunk; thelatheli — in the struggle; chade tara kandhe — He climbs onto its neck; mahuta mariya — killing the driver; tana dila gaja-dante — He wrenched the elephant's tusks

**406.** Seizing its trunk, in the struggle [He] climbs onto its neck,
kills the driver and wrenches the elephant's tusks.

দন্ত উপাড়িয়া পুচ্ছ ধরিয়া ঘুরায় ।
আকাশে তুলিয়া চারি-যোজন ফেলায় ॥ ৪০৭ ॥

*danta upāṛiẏā puccha dhariẏā ghurāẏa |*
*ākāśe tuliẏā cāri-yojana phelāẏa || 407 ||*

*Word for word:* danta upadiya — tearing out the tusks; puchchha dhariya ghuraya — seizing the tail, He whirls it; akashe tuliya — lifting it into the air; chari-yojana phelaya — He hurls it four yojanas away

**407.** Tearing out the tusks, He seizes it by the tail, whirls it round,
lifts it into the air and hurls it four yojanas away.

পড়িল ত মহাগজ—শুনে কংসরায় ।
কাঁপিতে লাগিল অঙ্গ, তরাস হিয়ায় ॥ ৪০৮ ॥

*paṛila ta mahāgaja—śune kaṃsarāẏa |*
*kāṁpite lāgila aṅga, tarāsa hiẏāẏa || 408 ||*

*Word for word:* padila ta mahagaja — the great elephant has fallen; shune kamsaraya — King Kamsa hears; kanpite lagila anga — his body began to tremble; tarasa hiyaya — fear in his heart

**408.** "The great elephant has fallen!" — King Kamsa hears;
his body began to tremble, fear in his heart.

তবে রামকৃষ্ণ গেলা রাজার সম্মুখে ।
তরাসে গোয়ালা সব কাঁপি' হালে বুকে ॥ ৪০৯ ॥

*tabe rāmakṛṣṇa gelā rājāra sammukhe |*
*tarāse goẏālā saba kāṁpi' hāle buke || 409 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe rama-krishna — then Rama and Krishna; gela rajara sammukhe — went before the king; tarase goyala saba — all the cowherds in fear; kanpi hale buke — tremble, their hearts pounding

**409.** Then Rama and Krishna went before the king;
all the cowherds tremble in fear, their hearts pounding.

চাণুর-মুষ্টিকে বোলে কংসের বচন ।
মল্লযুদ্ধ দেখিবারে ভেল মোর মন ॥ ৪১০ ॥

*cāṇura-muṣṭike bole kaṃsera bacana |*
*mallayuddha dekhibāre bhela mora mana || 410 ||*

*Word for word:* chanura-mushtike — to Chanura and Mushtika; bole kamsera vachana — Kamsa speaks; mallayuddha dekhibare — to see a wrestling match; bhela mora mana — I have a mind

**410.** Kamsa says to Chanura and Mushtika:
"I have a mind to watch a wrestling match."

এইখানে মল্লযুদ্ধ ভেল মহারণে ।
চাণুর সহিতে কৃষ্ণ, মুষ্টিক বলরামে ॥ ৪১১ ॥

*eikhāne mallayuddha bhela mahāraṇe |*
*cāṇura sahite kṛṣṇa, muṣṭika balarāme || 411 ||*

*Word for word:* eikhane — here; mallayuddha bhela maharane — the wrestling took place in great combat; chanura sahite krishna — Krishna with Chanura; mushtika balarame — Mushtika with Balarama

**411.** Here took place the great combat of the wrestlers:
Krishna with Chanura, Balarama with Mushtika.

সেই বৃন্দাবন-পুরন্দর কলিযুগে ।
তখনে যে কৈল গাথা—কহি, শুন এবে ॥ ৪১২ ॥

*sei bṛndābana-purandara kaliyuge |*
*takhane ye kaila gāthā—kahi, śuna ebe || 412 ||*

*Word for word:* sei vrindavana-purandara — that Lord of Vrindavana; kaliyuge — in the Kali age; takhane ye kaila gatha — the story of what He did then; kahi shuna ebe — I tell, hear now

**412.** That Lord of Vrindavana [appeared] in the Kali age;
what He did then I shall tell — hear now[^50-14].

প্রদক্ষিণ কৈল গোরা মথুরামণ্ডল ।
মহাজন কৃষ্ণদাস জানাইলা সকল ॥ ৪১৩ ॥

*pradakṣiṇa kaila gorā mathurāmaṇḍala |*
*mahājana kṛṣṇadāsa jānāilā sakala || 413 ||*

*Word for word:* pradakshina kaila gora — Gora circumambulated; mathura-mandala — the Mathura-mandala; mahajana krishnadasa — the great Krishnadasa; janaila sakala — made everything known

**413.** Gora circumambulated the Mathura-mandala;
the great Krishnadasa made everything known to Him.

প্রভুরে বিনয় করে চরণে পড়িয়া ।
মো অতি কাতর—মোরে না যাহ ভাঁড়িয়া ॥ ৪১৪ ॥

*prabhure binaẏa kare caraṇe paṛiẏā |*
*mo ati kātara—more nā yāha bhāṁṛiẏā || 414 ||*

*Word for word:* prabhure vinaya kare — he humbly entreats the Lord; charane padiya — falling at His feet; mo ati katara — I am in great distress; more na yaha bhandiya — do not go away deceiving me

**414.** He humbly entreats the Lord, falling at His feet:
"I am in great distress — do not go away, deceiving me!

তুমি সেই কৃষ্ণ—এই জানিলুঁ নিশ্চয় ।
প্রসাদ কর মোরে, শুন গোরারায় ॥ ৪১৫ ॥

*tumi sei kṛṣṇa—ei jāniluṁ niścaẏa |*
*prasāda kara more, śuna gorārāẏa || 415 ||*

*Word for word:* tumi sei krishna — You are that Krishna; ei janilun nishchaya — this I have known for certain; prasada kara more — show me grace; shuna goraraya — hear, Goraraya

**415.** You are that very Krishna — this I have known for certain;
show me grace, hear me, Goraraya!"

এ বোল শুনিয়া প্রভু বোলয়ে বচন ।
তোর পরসাদে মোর শুদ্ধ হৈল মন ॥ ৪১৬ ॥

*e bola śuniẏā prabhu bolaẏe bacana |*
*tora parasāde mora śuddha haila mana || 416 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuniya — hearing this; prabhu bolaye vachana — the Lord speaks; tora parasade — by your grace; mora shuddha haila mana — My mind has been purified

**416.** Hearing this, the Lord speaks:
"By your grace My mind has been purified.

মথুরা দেখিব বলি' বড় ছিল সাধ ।
দেখিলুঁ রহস্য-স্থান তোর পরসাদ ॥ ৪১৭ ॥

*mathurā dekhiba bali' baṛa chila sādha |*
*dekhiluṁ rahasya-sthāna tora parasāda || 417 ||*

*Word for word:* mathura dekhiba bali — to see Mathura; bada chhila sadha — was My great desire; dekhilun rahasya-sthana — I have seen the secret places; tora parasada — by your grace

**417.** I had a great desire to see Mathura —
by your grace I have seen the secret places.

আমার যেমন হিয়া হইল উল্লাস ।
কৃষ্ণ পরসন্ন তোরে হউ, কৃষ্ণদাস ॥ ৪১৮ ॥

*āmāra yemana hiẏā haila ullāsa |*
*kṛṣṇa parasanna tore hau, kṛṣṇadāsa || 418 ||*

*Word for word:* amara yemana hiya — as My heart; haila ullasa — has rejoiced; krishna parasanna tore hau — may Krishna be pleased with you; krishnadasa — Krishnadasa

**418.** As My heart has rejoiced,
[so] may Krishna be gracious to you, Krishnadasa!"

মথুরামণ্ডলবাসী যত সর্বলোক ।
গৌরচন্দ্র দেখিবারে ভেল একমুখ ॥ ৪১৯ ॥

*mathurāmaṇḍalabāsī yata sarbaloka |*
*gauracandra dekhibāre bhela ekamukha || 419 ||*

*Word for word:* mathura-mandala-vasi — the residents of the Mathura-mandala; yata sarvaloka — all the people; gaurachandra dekhibare — to see Gaurachandra; bhela ekamukha — all turned one way

**419.** All the residents of the Mathura-mandala
all turned one way — to see Gaurachandra.

বারেক দেখয়ে যেই নারে পাসরিতে ।
প্রেমায় বিহ্বল সেই নারে সম্বরিতে ॥ ৪২০ ॥

*bāreka dekhaẏe yei nāre pāsarite |*
*premāẏa bihbala sei nāre sambarite || 420 ||*

*Word for word:* bareka dekhaye yei — whoever sees [Him] once; nare pasarite — cannot forget; premaya vihvala sei — he, overwhelmed with prema; nare samvarite — cannot contain himself

**420.** Whoever sees Him once cannot forget Him;
overwhelmed with prema, he cannot contain himself.

বাল বৃদ্ধ কিবা যুবা এ নারী পুরুখ ।
কৃষ্ণ এই, কৃষ্ণ এই—বোলয়ে মুরুখ ॥ ৪২১ ॥

*bāla bṛddha kibā yubā e nārī purukha |*
*kṛṣṇa ei, kṛṣṇa ei—bolaẏe murukha || 421 ||*

*Word for word:* bala vriddha kiba yuva — children, old and young; e nari purukha — women and men; krishna ei krishna ei — this is Krishna, this is Krishna; bolaye murukha — even the unlettered say

**421.** Children, old and young, women and men —
even the unlettered — say: "This is Krishna, this is Krishna!

এতদিনে কৃষ্ণ পুনঃ আইলা মথুরারে ।
পুরুব-রহস্য-স্থান দেখিবার তরে ॥ ৪২২ ॥

*etadine kṛṣṇa punaḥ āilā mathurāre |*
*puruba-rahasya-sthāna dekhibāra tare || 422 ||*

*Word for word:* etadine — at last; krishna punah aila mathurare — Krishna has come to Mathura again; puruba-rahasya-sthana — the secret places of old; dekhibara tare — in order to see

**422.** At last Krishna has come to Mathura again
to see the secret places of His former [pastimes]."

কেহো বোলে—ত্রিভঙ্গ হইয়া কেনে থাকে ।
কানাই না হৈলে কেনে রাধা বলি' ডাকে ॥ ৪২৩ ॥

*keho bole—tribhaṅga haiẏā kene thāke |*
*kānāi nā haile kene rādhā bali' ḍāke || 423 ||*

*Word for word:* keho bole — someone says; tribhanga haiya kene thake — why does He stand thrice-bent; kanai na haile — if He is not Kanai; kene radha bali dake — why does He call "Radha!"

**423.** Someone says: "Why does He stand thrice-bent?
If He is not Kanai, why does He call 'Radha!'?"[^50-15]

রাত্রি দিবা থাকে লোক, না ছাড়য়ে কাছ ।
একে একে দেখে প্রভু বৃন্দাবনের গাছ ॥ ৪২৪ ॥

*rātri dibā thāke loka, nā chāṛaẏe kācha |*
*eke eke dekhe prabhu bṛndābanera gācha || 424 ||*

*Word for word:* ratri diva thake loka — people stay day and night; na chhadaye kachha — they do not leave His side; eke eke dekhe prabhu — one by one the Lord sees; vrindavanera gachha — the trees of Vrindavana

**424.** People stay with Him day and night and do not leave His side;
one by one the Lord looks at the trees of Vrindavana.

একে একে সব স্থান নিরীখে ঠাকুর ।
এইখানে বনে সব প্রেম পরিপূর ॥ ৪২৫ ॥

*eke eke saba sthāna nirīkhe ṭhākura |*
*eikhāne bane saba prema paripūra || 425 ||*

*Word for word:* eke eke saba sthana — one by one all the places; nirikhe thakura — the Thakura beholds; eikhane vane — here in the forests; saba prema paripura — all is filled with prema

**425.** One by one the Thakura beholds all the places:
here, in the forests, all is filled with prema.

মথুরামণ্ডলে ঘরে ঘরে পরকাশ ।
কেহো শিশু দেখে, কেহো যুবক-বিলাস ॥ ৪২৬ ॥

*mathurāmaṇḍale ghare ghare parakāśa |*
*keho śiśu dekhe, keho yubaka-bilāsa || 426 ||*

*Word for word:* mathura-mandale — in the Mathura-mandala; ghare ghare parakasha — [He] is manifest in every house; keho shishu dekhe — some see a Child; keho yuvaka-vilasa — some the pastimes of a Youth

**426.** In the Mathura-mandala He is manifest in every house:
some see a Child, some the pastimes of a Youth.

কেহো আচম্বিতে ঘরে শুনে বংশীনাদ ।
কারু স্বামি-কোলে কৃষ্ণরসের উন্মাদ ॥ ৪২৭ ॥

*keho ācambite ghare śune baṃśīnāda |*
*kāru sbāmi-kole kṛṣṇarasera unmāda || 427 ||*

*Word for word:* keho achambite — someone suddenly; ghare shune vamshi-nada — hears at home the sound of the flute; karu svami-kole — for one, in her husband's embrace; krishna-rasera unmada — the madness of Krishna-rasa

**427.** Someone at home suddenly hears the sound of the flute;
for one, in her husband's embrace — the madness of Krishna-rasa[^50-16].

কারু পর-বুদ্ধি নাহি, সভে বোলে নিজ ।
সভার হৃদয়ে উপজিল প্রেমবীজ ॥ ৪২৮ ॥

*kāru para-buddhi nāhi, sabhe bole nija |*
*sabhāra hṛdaẏe upajila premabīja || 428 ||*

*Word for word:* karu para-buddhi nahi — no one thinks [Him] a stranger; sabhe bole nija — all say "[He is] our own"; sabhara hridaye — in the hearts of all; upajila prema-bija — the seed of prema sprouted

**428.** No one thinks Him a stranger — all say: "[He is] our own";
in the hearts of all the seed of prema sprouted.

বন বেড়াইতে বনে প্রভু যায় যবে ।
সে বনের তরু-লতা ভাসে প্রেম-দ্রবে ॥ ৪২৯ ॥

*bana beṛāite bane prabhu yāẏa yabe |*
*se banera taru-latā bhāse prema-drabe || 429 ||*

*Word for word:* vana bedaite — to roam the forests; vane prabhu yaya yabe — when the Lord goes into a forest; se vanera taru-lata — the trees and creepers of that forest; bhase prema-drave — float in the flood of prema

**429.** When the Lord goes roaming in the forests,
the trees and creepers of that forest float in the flood of prema.

কোকিল ভ্রমর ময়ূর বুলে মাঠে গোঠে ।
ধাওয়াধাই আইসে, রহে প্রভুর নিকটে ॥ ৪৩০ ॥

*kokila bhramara maẏūra bule māṭhe goṭhe |*
*dhāoẏādhāi āise, rahe prabhura nikaṭe || 430 ||*

*Word for word:* kokila bhramara mayura — cuckoos, bees, peacocks; bule mathe gothe — roaming fields and pastures; dhaoyadhai aise — come racing; rahe prabhura nikate — stay near the Lord

**430.** Cuckoos, bees, peacocks that roam the fields and pastures
come racing and stay near the Lord.

ঊর্ধ্বমুখে সর্বজন প্রভুমুখ দেখি' ।
সভারে সমান স্নেহ—প্রেমময় আঁখি ॥ ৪৩১ ॥

*ūrdhbamukhe sarbajana prabhumukha dekhi' |*
*sabhāre samāna sneha—premamaẏa āṁkhi || 431 ||*

*Word for word:* urdhva-mukhe sarvajana — all with upturned faces; prabhu-mukha dekhi — looking at the Lord's face; sabhare samana sneha — equal tenderness for all; premamaya ankhi — eyes full of prema

**431.** All, with upturned faces, look at the Lord's face;
equal tenderness for all, eyes full of prema.

সর্বজন জানিল—এ কপট-সন্ন্যাসী ।
চলিলা ত মহাপ্রভু নীলাচলবাসী ॥ ৪৩২ ॥

*sarbajana jānila—e kapaṭa-sannyāsī |*
*calilā ta mahāprabhu nīlācalabāsī || 432 ||*

*Word for word:* sarvajana janila — all knew; e kapata-sannyasi — He is a sannyasi only in disguise; chalila ta mahaprabhu — Mahaprabhu set out; nilachala-vasi — the dweller of Nilachala

**432.** All knew: He is a sannyasi only in disguise.
And Mahaprabhu, the dweller of Nilachala, set out on His way.

মথুরামণ্ডল-কথা কহিল এ সায় ।
আনন্দে লোচনদাস গোরাগুণ গায় ॥ ৪৩৩ ॥

*mathurāmaṇḍala-kathā kahila e sāẏa |*
*ānande locanadāsa gorāguṇa gāẏa || 433 ||*

*Word for word:* mathura-mandala-katha — the account of the Mathura-mandala; kahila e saya — is here concluded; anande lochanadasa — joyfully Lochana Dasa; goraguna gaya — sings Gora's glories

**433.** Here the account of the Mathura-mandala is concluded;
joyfully Lochana Dasa sings Gora's glories.

[^50-1]: Vv. 316–322 follow a Vraja tradition about the Khadira-vana. Madana-Gopala — "the Gopala [who conquers] Madana," the Deity of Krishna in Vrindavana (Madana-mohana). The love of Radha and Krishna is transcendental (aprakrita); cf. en/48, note 10.
[^50-2]: Vv. 323–335 follow the Bhagavata (10.34–10.37): the deliverance of the vidyadhara Sudarshana, who swallowed Nanda in Ambika-vana; the killing of Shankhachuda, Arishta, Keshi and Vyomasura; Narada reveals to Kamsa the secret of Krishna's birth. Cf. Murari 4.10.
[^50-3]: The "sliding stone" (phisalani-shila) is a holy place of Kamyavana; the Pavana-sarovara is a pond at Nandagrama (Nandishvara).
[^50-4]: Vv. 339–353 follow the Bhagavata (10.38–10.39): Akrura comes to Vraja on Kamsa's order, sees the marks of Krishna's feet, at night tells of Kamsa's design; Krishna and Balarama leave for Mathura; the gopis lament; in the waters of the Yamuna Akrura sees Vishnu on Ananta. Cf. Murari 4.11.
[^50-5]: Cf. the Bhagavata 10.39.35 and 10.46–10.47 (the message sent with Uddhava).
[^50-6]: Vv. 354–360 follow the Bhagavata (10.43.17): each one sees Krishna in the arena according to his own disposition. Vv. 356–360 are absent in the 1983 edition; the 1903 edition gives them in a footnote as an additional reading of one manuscript. In the 1983 edition vv. 380–411 (the way to Mathura, the washerman, Kubja, the bow, the elephant) stand before v. 354, which is more consistent; we keep Bhaktisiddhanta's order. Cf. Murari 4.12.
[^50-7]: According to the Bhagavata (10.44.39), Kamsa, who thought of Krishna incessantly, though in fear and enmity, attained liberation. Gaudiya Vaishnavas explain that enemies slain by the Lord receive liberation, but not prema.
[^50-8]: In the Bhagavata (10.44) it is Krishna who consoles Kamsa's wives.
[^50-9]: That is, that Krishna sent Nanda and the cowherds back to Vraja and Himself remained in Mathura (Bhagavata 10.45): for the Vaishnava poet Vraja's separation from Krishna is the bitterest thing of all.
[^50-10]: Vv. 379+1 — 379+3 are absent in Bhaktisiddhanta's edition (1922); they are found in the 1903 edition (here, after v. 379, with a new raga) and in the 1983 edition (before v. 412, since vv. 380–411 are moved earlier there). Cf. the Bhagavata 10.45 (Vasudeva performs the sacred-thread ceremony for his sons).
[^50-11]: Vv. 380–411 go back to the arrival of Krishna and Balarama in Mathura (Bhagavata 10.41–10.43): the washerman, Sudama the garland-maker, Kubja, the bow, the elephant Kuvalayapida, the challenge to the wrestling; cf. Murari 4.12. The washerman's name (Durmukha) is not given in the Bhagavata.
[^50-12]: Lochana Dasa speaks plainly of Kubja's desire. Gaudiya Vaishnavas (following Rupa Gosvami) distinguish Kubja's love, which contains a desire for her own pleasure (sadharani-rati), from the selfless love of the gopis (samartha-rati); cf. en/49, note 11.
[^50-13]: Vv. 396–400 (Kamsa's high platform, the platforms for Vasudeva and Devaki, the well) are details not found in the Bhagavata; cf. the Bhagavata 10.42.26–38 (evil omens, the preparation of the arena).
[^50-14]: Lochana Dasa returns to the story of Gaura: that same Krishna, the Lord of Vrindavana, appeared in the Kali age as Gaura.
[^50-15]: V. 423 is absent in the 1983 edition; the 1903 edition puts it in brackets as the reading of some manuscripts.
[^50-16]: A spiritual experience is meant (the Lord revealing Himself in the heart), not a worldly feeling: the residents of the Mathura-mandala, seeing Gaura, experience Krishna's lilas — one sees the Child, another the Youth, another hears the flute.

# Shesha-khanda, part 6 (portion 51)

*The section "The Lord's Return to Nilachala" (ch. 3): mercy to the cowherd; the Lord at Kulia and Navadvipa — Shachi's lament and the Lord's instruction; kirtana at Advaita's house in Shantipura; by way of Tamoluk to Puri; mercy to King Prataparudra: the sannyasi in Jagannatha's place, the six-armed form, the instruction to the king*

## The Lord's Return to Nilachala

> *Summary by Srila Bhaktisiddhanta Sarasvati.* Having seen the places of Sri Krishna's lilas in the Mathura-mandala, Sriman Mahaprabhu wished to return to Nilachala. On the way He walked so fast that His companions could not keep up with Him and fell behind. The Lord was going alone along a forest path; meeting a cowherd boy on the way, He asked him for some buttermilk and, telling him to take the price of the buttermilk from the people coming behind, set off again. A little later the companions arrived there; the cowherd boy told them how the Lord had drunk the buttermilk and asked for payment — but the very next moment he saw that his pot was full of priceless treasure. Thus Sriman Mahaprabhu, as if for the sake of the buttermilk, showed mercy to this cowherd boy and, continuing on His way, came to Navadvipa. The people of Navadvipa ran like madmen to see the Lord. Mother Shachi came to the Lord weeping and began to tell Him the grief of separation. Then Mahaprabhu said to Mother Shachi: "I abide near whoever serves Krishna," and, instructing her in the service of Krishna, spent a day in the bliss of kirtana in the house of Acharya Gosani at Shantipura, and then by way of Tamoluk reached Nilachala and showed mercy to King Prataparudra.

*Raga suhai*

নীলাচলে চলে প্রভু হরিষ-হিয়ায় ।
হাহা জগন্নাথ বলি' অনুরাগে ধায় ॥ ১ ॥

*nīlācale cale prabhu hariṣa-hiẏāẏa |*
*hāhā jagannātha bali' anurāge dhāẏa || 1 ||*

*Word for word:* nilachale chale prabhu — the Lord goes to Nilachala; harisha-hiyaya — with a joyful heart; haha jagannatha bali — crying "O Jagannatha!"; anurage dhaya — He hastens in love

**1.** With a joyful heart the Lord goes to Nilachala;
crying "O Jagannatha!" He hastens [there] in love[^51-1].

প্রেমানন্দে চলে প্রভু সিংহের গমনে ।
সংহতি চলিতে নারে সঙ্গের যত জনে ॥ ২ ॥

*premānande cale prabhu siṃhera gamane |*
*saṃhati calite nāre saṅgera yata jane || 2 ||*

*Word for word:* premanande chale prabhu — the Lord goes in the bliss of prema; simhera gamane — with a lion's gait; samhati chalite nare — cannot keep pace; sangera yata jane — all who are with Him

**2.** The Lord goes in the bliss of prema with a lion's gait;
all who are with Him cannot keep pace.

সঙ্গে যাইতে নারে, সঙ্গী দূরে পাছু আইল ।
অরণ্য-ভিতরে প্রভু একলা চলিল ॥ ৩ ॥

*saṅge yāite nāre, saṅgī dūre pāchu āila |*
*araṇya-bhitare prabhu ekalā calila || 3 ||*

*Word for word:* sange yaite nare — they cannot go along; sangi dure pachhu aila — the companions came far behind; aranya-bhitare — through the forest; prabhu ekala chalila — the Lord went alone

**3.** Unable to keep up, the companions fell far behind,
and the Lord went on alone through the forest.

অরণ্য-ভিতরে এক আছয়ে নগর ।
ঘোল বেচিবারে যায় গোয়ালা-কোঙর ॥ ৪ ॥

*araṇya-bhitare eka āchaẏe nagara |*
*ghola becibāre yāẏa goẏālā-koṅara || 4 ||*

*Word for word:* aranya-bhitare — in the forest; eka achhaye nagara — there is a village; ghola bechibare yaya — goes to sell buttermilk; goyala-kongara — a cowherd youth

**4.** In the forest there is a village;
a cowherd youth is going to sell buttermilk.

ঠাকুর দেখিল তারে, আবেশে তিয়াস ।
ঘোল দেহ গোপ—মোর লাগিল পিয়াস ॥ ৫ ॥

*ṭhākura dekhila tāre, ābeśe tiẏāsa |*
*ghola deha gopa—mora lāgila piẏāsa || 5 ||*

*Word for word:* thakura dekhila tare — the Thakura saw him; aveshe tiyasa — thirsty in His ecstasy; ghola deha gopa — give buttermilk, cowherd; mora lagila piyasa — I am thirsty

**5.** The Thakura saw him — in His ecstasy He was thirsty:
"Give Me buttermilk, cowherd, I am thirsty."

এ বোল শুনিঞা গোপ পড়িল চরণে ।
লেহ ঘোল—খাও গোসাঞি, যত লয় মনে ॥ ৬ ॥

*e bola śuniñā gopa paṛila caraṇe |*
*leha ghola—khāo gosāñi, yata laẏa mane || 6 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuninya — hearing this; gopa padila charane — the cowherd fell at His feet; leha ghola — take the buttermilk; khao gosani — drink, Gosani; yata laya mane — as much as You like

**6.** Hearing this, the cowherd fell at His feet:
"Take the buttermilk — drink, Gosani, as much as You like."

ঘোল পান কৈল—হৈল শূন্য কলসী ।
ঘোল খাঞা চলি' যায় কপট-সন্ন্যাসী ॥ ৭ ॥

*ghola pāna kaila—haila śūnya kalasī |*
*ghola khāñā cali' yāẏa kapaṭa-sannyāsī || 7 ||*

*Word for word:* ghola pana kaila — He drank the buttermilk; haila shunya kalasi — the jar became empty; ghola khanya — having drunk the buttermilk; chali yaya kapata-sannyasi — the sannyasi-in-disguise walks on

**7.** He drank the buttermilk — the jar was empty;
having drunk the buttermilk, the sannyasi — a sannyasi only in guise — walks on.

গোয়ালাকে বৈল—তুমি থাক এইখানে ।
পাছু যে আইসে, কড়ি নিহ তার স্থানে ॥ ৮ ॥

*goẏālāke baila—tumi thāka eikhāne |*
*pāchu ye āise, kaṛi niha tāra sthāne || 8 ||*

*Word for word:* goyalake baila — He told the cowherd; tumi thaka eikhane — you stay here; pachhu ye aise — those who come behind; kadi niha tara sthane — take the money from them

**8.** He told the cowherd: "Wait here:
take the money from those who come behind."

এ বোল বলিয়া প্রভু চলিলা সত্বর ।
সেইখানে রহি' গোপ চিন্তয়ে অন্তর ॥ ৯ ॥

*e bola baliẏā prabhu calilā satbara |*
*seikhāne rahi' gopa cintaẏe antara || 9 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola baliya — saying this; prabhu chalila satvara — the Lord went off quickly; seikhane rahi — staying there; gopa chintaye antara — the cowherd ponders within

**9.** Saying this, the Lord went off quickly,
and the cowherd, staying there, ponders within.

গোপ ভাবে—মিথ্যাকথা কহিল সন্ন্যাসী ।
এই মনে করি' গোপ মনে কত বাছি ॥ ৯+১ ॥

*gopa bhābe—mithyākathā kahila sannyāsī |*
*ei mane kari' gopa mane kata bāchi || 9+1 ||*

*Word for word:* gopa bhave — the cowherd thinks; mithya-katha kahila sannyasi — the sannyasi has told a lie; ei mane kari — thinking so; gopa mane kata bachhi — the cowherd ponders long

**9+1.** The cowherd thinks: "The sannyasi has told a lie," —
thinking so, the cowherd ponders long[^51-2]:

ঘরে গিয়া কি বলিব নিজ পরিজনে ।
মিথ্যাকথা কহি' ন্যাসী করিল গমনে ॥ ৯+২ ॥

*ghare giẏā ki baliba nija parijane |*
*mithyākathā kahi' nyāsī karila gamane || 9+2 ||*

*Word for word:* ghare giya — going home; ki baliba nija parijane — what shall I tell my family; mithya-katha kahi — telling a lie; nyasi karila gamane — the sannyasi went away

**9+2.** "When I go home, what shall I tell my family?
The sannyasi told a lie and went away."

কথোক্ষণে সন্ন্যাসীর সঙ্গী যত জন ।
সেই পথে আইসে তারা প্রভুগত-মন ॥ ১০ ॥

*kathokṣaṇe sannyāsīra saṅgī yata jana |*
*sei pathe āise tārā prabhugata-mana || 10 ||*

*Word for word:* kathokshane — after a while; sannyasira sangi yata jana — all the sannyasi's companions; sei pathe aise tara — come by that road; prabhu-gata-mana — their minds absorbed in the Lord

**10.** After a while all the sannyasi's companions
come along that road, their minds absorbed in the Lord.

পুছিল—গোয়ালা, পথে দেখিলে সন্ন্যাসী ?
গোপ কহে—ঘোল খাইল একটা কলসী ॥ ১১ ॥

*puchila—goẏālā, pathe dekhile sannyāsī ?*
*gopa kahe—ghola khāila ekaṭā kalasī || 11 ||*

*Word for word:* puchhila — they asked; goyala — cowherd; pathe dekhile sannyasi — did you see a sannyasi on the road?; gopa kahe — the cowherd says; ghola khaila ekta kalasi — He drank a whole jar of buttermilk

**11.** They asked: "Cowherd, did you see a sannyasi on the road?"
The cowherd says: "He drank a whole jar of buttermilk

কড়ি নিতে বৈল মোরে তোমা-সভার ঠাঞি ।
যুয়ায় ত কড়ি দেহ—আমি ঘরে যাই ॥ ১২ ॥

*kaṛi nite baila more tomā-sabhāra ṭhāñi |*
*yuẏāẏa ta kaṛi deha—āmi ghare yāi || 12 ||*

*Word for word:* kadi nite baila more — He told me to take the money; toma-sabhara thanyi — from you all; yuyaya ta kadi deha — give the proper money; ami ghare yai — and I will go home

**12.** and told me to take the money from you.
Give what is proper, and I will go home."

এ বোল শুনিয়া সভে সভা-পানে চায় ।
সভে কহে—কড়ি কোথা আমা সভার ঠাঁয় ॥ ১৩ ॥

*e bola śuniẏā sabhe sabhā-pāne cāẏa |*
*sabhe kahe—kaṛi kothā āmā sabhāra ṭhāṁẏa || 13 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuniya — hearing this; sabhe sabha-pane chaya — all look at one another; sabhe kahe — all say; kadi kotha ama sabhara thaya — where would we have money

**13.** Hearing this, all look at one another;
all say: "Where would we have money?

জলপাত্র নাহি সঙ্গে, নাহি বহির্বাস ।
অঞ্জলিতে খাই জল লাগিলে পিয়াস ॥ ১৩+১ ॥

*jalapātra nāhi saṅge, nāhi bahirbāsa |*
*añjalite khāi jala lāgile piẏāsa || 13+1 ||*

*Word for word:* jala-patra nahi sange — we have no water-pot with us; nahi bahirvasa — no outer cloth; anjalite khai jala — we drink water from cupped hands; lagile piyasa — when we are thirsty

**13+1.** We have with us neither a water-pot nor an outer cloth:
when we are thirsty, we drink water from cupped hands"[^51-3].

গোয়ালা কহিল—চল, তবে নাহি দায় ।
মোর সেবা জানাইবা সন্ন্যাসীর পায় ॥ ১৪ ॥

*goẏālā kahila—cala, tabe nāhi dāẏa |*
*mora sebā jānāibā sannyāsīra pāẏa || 14 ||*

*Word for word:* goyala kahila — the cowherd said; chala — go on; tabe nahi daya — then there is no debt; mora seva janaiba — convey my service; sannyasira paya — to the sannyasi's feet

**14.** The cowherd said: "Go on, then there is no debt;
convey my obeisance to the sannyasi's feet."

এ বোল বলিয়া সে কলসী করে হাথে ।
ভারি বড় কলসী—তুলিতে নারে মাথে ॥ ১৫ ॥

*e bola baliẏā se kalasī kare hāthe |*
*bhāri baṛa kalasī—tulite nāre māthe || 15 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola baliya — saying this; se kalasi kare hathe — he takes the jar in his hands; bhari bada kalasi — the jar is very heavy; tulite nare mathe — he cannot lift it onto his head

**15.** Saying this, he takes the jar in his hands —
but the jar is very heavy; he cannot lift it onto his head.

ঢাকনা ঘুচাইয়া—রত্ন এক যে কলসী ।
ধাইয়া চলিল হাহা করিয়া সন্ন্যাসী ॥ ১৬ ॥

*ḍhākanā ghucāiẏā—ratna eka ye kalasī |*
*dhāiẏā calila hāhā kariẏā sannyāsī || 16 ||*

*Word for word:* dhakana ghuchaiya — removing the lid; ratna eka ye kalasi — [sees] the jar full of jewels; dhaiya chalila — he ran off; haha kariya sannyasi — crying "O sannyasi!"

**16.** Removing the lid, [he sees:] the jar is full of jewels —
and he ran off, crying "O sannyasi!"

কথোদূরে সঙ্গীর বিলম্বে আছে পঁহু ।
গোয়ালা দেখিয়া সে মুচকি হাসে লহু ॥ ১৭ ॥

*kathodūre saṅgīra bilambe āche paṁhu |*
*goẏālā dekhiẏā se mucaki hāse lahu || 17 ||*

*Word for word:* kathodure — a little way on; sangira vilambe — waiting for the lagging companions; achhe panhu — the Lord stands; goyala dekhiya — seeing the cowherd; se muchaki hase lahu — He smiles softly

**17.** A little way on, waiting for His lagging companions, stands the Lord;
seeing the cowherd, He smiles softly.

সঙ্গের যতেক জন আইল তখন ।
দেখিলা—গোয়ালা প্রভুর পাঞাছে চরণ ॥ ১৮ ॥

*saṅgera yateka jana āila takhana |*
*dekhilā—goẏālā prabhura pāñāche caraṇa || 18 ||*

*Word for word:* sangera yateka jana — all the companions; aila takhana — came then; dekhila — they saw; goyala prabhura panyachhe charana — the cowherd had attained the Lord's feet

**18.** Then all the companions came up
and saw: the cowherd had attained the Lord's feet.

প্রভু বোলে—গোপ, তুমি চলি' যাহ ঘর ।
তোরে অনুগ্রহ কৃষ্ণ কৈল—পাইলে বর ॥ ১৯ ॥

*prabhu bole—gopa, tumi cali' yāha ghara |*
*tore anugraha kṛṣṇa kaila—pāile bara || 19 ||*

*Word for word:* prabhu bole — the Lord says; gopa tumi chali yaha ghara — cowherd, go home; tore anugraha krishna kaila — Krishna has shown you grace; paile vara — you have received a boon

**19.** The Lord says: "Cowherd, go home:
Krishna has shown you grace; you have received a boon."

লেউটি' আসিতে গোপ পাইল পরসাদ ।
নাচিয়া বুলয়ে গোপ প্রেমার উন্মাদ ॥ ২০ ॥

*leuṭi' āsite gopa pāila parasāda |*
*nāciẏā bulaẏe gopa premāra unmāda || 20 ||*

*Word for word:* leuti asite — on his way back; gopa paila parasada — the cowherd received grace; nachiya bulaye gopa — the cowherd goes about dancing; premara unmada — in the madness of prema

**20.** On his way back the cowherd received grace:
the cowherd goes about dancing in the madness of prema.

গোয়ালা দেখিয়া সভার বাঢ়িল উল্লাস ।
গোরাগুণ গায় সুখে এ লোচনদাস ॥ ২১ ॥

*goẏālā dekhiẏā sabhāra bāṛhila ullāsa |*
*gorāguṇa gāẏa sukhe e locanadāsa || 21 ||*

*Word for word:* goyala dekhiya — seeing the cowherd; sabhara badhila ullasa — the joy of all increased; goraguna gaya sukhe — happily sings Gora's glories; e lochanadasa — this Lochana Dasa

**21.** Seeing the cowherd, the joy of all increased;
happily this Lochana Dasa sings Gora's glories.

*Raga shyamagada; disha: "Ah, my, ah, my Gauranga-sundara! Under the weight of youthful prema He cannot walk"*

এইমতে ক্রমে ক্রমে পথে চলি' আইসে ।
সংহতি-সহিত উত্তরিলা গৌড়দেশে ॥ ২২ ॥

*eimate krame krame pathe cali' āise |*
*saṃhati-sahita uttarilā gauṛadeśe || 22 ||*

*Word for word:* eimate krame krame — thus gradually; pathe chali aise — He comes along the road; samhati-sahita — together with His companions; uttarila gauda-deshe — He arrived in Gauda

**22.** Thus step by step He comes along the road
and with His companions arrived in Gauda[^51-4].

গঙ্গাস্নান করি' প্রভু রাঢ়দেশ দিয়া ।
ক্রমে ক্রমে উত্তরিলা নগর কুলিয়া ॥ ২৩ ॥

*gaṅgāsnāna kari' prabhu rāṛhadeśa diẏā |*
*krame krame uttarilā nagara kuliẏā || 23 ||*

*Word for word:* ganga-snana kari — bathing in the Ganga; prabhu radha-desha diya — the Lord, by way of Radha-desha; krame krame uttarila — gradually arrived; nagara kuliya — at the town of Kulia

**23.** Bathing in the Ganga, the Lord, by way of Radha-desha,
gradually arrived at the town of Kulia.

পূর্বাশ্রম দেখিব—এ সন্ন্যাসীর ধর্ম ।
নবদ্বীপ-নিকটে গেলা—এই তার মর্ম ॥ ২৪ ॥

*pūrbāśrama dekhiba—e sannyāsīra dharma |*
*nabadbīpa-nikaṭe gelā—ei tāra marma || 24 ||*

*Word for word:* purvashrama dekhiba — to see [the place of] one's former ashrama; e sannyasira dharma — this is a sannyasi's duty; navadvipa-nikate gela — He went near Navadvipa; ei tara marma — this is its meaning

**24.** To see [the place of] one's former ashrama is a sannyasi's duty:
this is why He came near Navadvipa.

প্রভু-আগমন শুনি' নবদ্বীপের লোক ।
পুনঃ লেউটিলা সভে, পাশরিল শোক ॥ ২৫ ॥

*prabhu-āgamana śuni' nabadbīpera loka |*
*punaḥ leuṭilā sabhe, pāśarila śoka || 25 ||*

*Word for word:* prabhu-agamana shuni — hearing of the Lord's coming; navadvipera loka — the people of Navadvipa; punah leutila sabhe — all came back to life, as it were; pasharila shoka — forgot their grief

**25.** Hearing of the Lord's coming, the people of Navadvipa
came back to life, as it were, and forgot their grief.

হাহা গোরাচাঁদ বলি' অনুরাগে ধায় ।
কুলবধূ ধায়—তারা পাছ নাহি চায় ॥ ২৬ ॥

*hāhā gorācāṁda bali' anurāge dhāẏa |*
*kulabadhū dhāẏa—tārā pācha nāhi cāẏa || 26 ||*

*Word for word:* haha gorachanda bali — crying "O Gorachand!"; anurage dhaya — they run in love; kulavadhu dhaya — the ladies of good families run; tara pachha nahi chaya — they do not look back

**26.** Crying "O Gorachand!" they run [to Him] in love;
the ladies of good families run too, without looking back.

বিহ্বল-চেতন শচী ধায় ঊর্ধ্বমুখে ।
আউলাইল কেশ, বস্ত্র নাহি দেয় বুকে ॥ ২৭ ॥

*bihbala-cetana śacī dhāẏa ūrdhbamukhe |*
*āulāila keśa, bastra nāhi deẏa buke || 27 ||*

*Word for word:* vihvala-chetana shachi — Shachi, beside herself; dhaya urdhva-mukhe — runs with upturned face; aulaila kesha — her hair dishevelled; vastra nahi deya buke — she does not draw her cloth over her breast

**27.** Shachi, beside herself, runs with upturned face,
her hair dishevelled, her cloth not drawn over her breast.

কোথা মোর বিশ্বম্ভর—দেখাও মো নয়ানে ।
পুনঃ চুম্ব দিব সেই সুন্দর-বদনে ॥ ২৮ ॥

*kothā mora biśbambhara—dekhāo mo naẏāne |*
*punaḥ cumba diba sei sundara-badane || 28 ||*

*Word for word:* kotha mora vishvambhara — where is my Vishvambhara; dekhao mo nayane — show him to my eyes; punah chumba diba — again I will kiss; sei sundara-vadane — that beautiful face

**28.** "Where is my Vishvambhara? Show him to my eyes!
I will kiss that beautiful face again.

নদিয়া-নগরে আইল আমার নিমাই ।
ধরিয়া রাখহ লোক—কিছু দোষ নাই ॥ ২৯ ॥

*nadiẏā-nagare āila āmāra nimāi |*
*dhariẏā rākhaha loka—kichu doṣa nāi || 29 ||*

*Word for word:* nadiya-nagare aila — to the town of Nadia has come; amara nimai — my Nimai; dhariya rakhaha loka — people, seize and keep him; kichhu dosha nai — there is no wrong in it

**29.** My Nimai has come to Nadia!
People, seize him and keep him — there is no wrong in it.

সভাকার প্রাণ সেই—সেই মাত্র জীউ ।
প্রাণ বিনা ধর্ম রক্ষা কোন্ রীতে হউ ॥ ৩০ ॥

*sabhākāra prāṇa sei—sei mātra jīu |*
*prāṇa binā dharma rakṣā kon rīte hau || 30 ||*

*Word for word:* sabhakara prana sei — he is the life of all; sei matra jiu — he alone is the soul; prana vina — without life; dharma raksha kon rite hau — how can dharma be kept

**30.** He is the life of all; he alone is the soul:
without life, how can dharma be kept?"

এইমতে কহিতে কহিতে গেলা তথা ।
দেখিল সে গৌরচন্দ্র বসি' আছে যথা ॥ ৩১ ॥

*eimate kahite kahite gelā tathā |*
*dekhila se gauracandra basi' āche yathā || 31 ||*

*Word for word:* eimate kahite kahite — saying such things; gela tatha — she went there; dekhila se — she saw; gaurachandra basi achhe yatha — where Gaurachandra was sitting

**31.** Saying such things she came there
and saw where Gaurachandra was sitting.

প্রভুরে দেখিয়া বোলে—শুন রে নিমাই ।
ঘরে চল—আমার সন্ন্যাসে কাজ নাই ॥ ৩২ ॥

*prabhure dekhiẏā bole—śuna re nimāi |*
*ghare cala—āmāra sannyāse kāja nāi || 32 ||*

*Word for word:* prabhure dekhiya — seeing the Lord; bole — she says; shuna re nimai — listen, Nimai; ghare chala — come home; amara sannyase kaja nai — I have no use for [your] sannyasa

**32.** Seeing the Lord, she says: "Listen, Nimai!
Come home — I have no use for [your] sannyasa.

সন্ন্যাস করিয়া ধর্ম রাখিবি তো পাছু ।
মোর বধ আগে লাগে—আর সব পাছু ॥ ৩৩ ॥

*sannyāsa kariẏā dharma rākhibi to pāchu |*
*mora badha āge lāge—āra saba pāchu || 33 ||*

*Word for word:* sannyasa kariya — taking sannyasa; dharma rakhibi to pachhu — you will keep dharma later; mora vadha age lage — first the [sin of] my death clings [to you]; ara saba pachhu — all else afterwards

**33.** By sannyasa you will keep dharma later,
but first the [sin of] my death will cling to you — everything else after."

বিহ্বল-চেতন শচী কান্দে উভরায় ।
সকল শরীরখানি একদৃষ্টে চায় ॥ ৩৪ ॥

*bihbala-cetana śacī kānde ubharāẏa |*
*sakala śarīrakhāni ekadṛṣṭe cāẏa || 34 ||*

*Word for word:* vihvala-chetana shachi — Shachi, beside herself; kande ubharaya — weeps aloud; sakala sharira-khani — at His whole body; ekadrishte chaya — she gazes fixedly

**34.** Shachi, beside herself, weeps aloud
and gazes fixedly at His whole body.

বাপু বাপু বলি' অঙ্গ পরশিতে চায় ।
আর সব থাকু, বাপ—হাথ দেয় গায় ॥ ৩৫ ॥

*bāpu bāpu bali' aṅga paraśite cāẏa |*
*āra saba thāku, bāpa—hātha deẏa gāẏa || 35 ||*

*Word for word:* bapu bapu bali — saying "my son, my son"; anga parashite chaya — she wants to touch His body; ara saba thaku bapa — let all else be, my son; hatha deya gaya — she lays her hand on His body

**35.** Saying "My son, my son!" she wants to touch His body:
"Let all else be, my son," — and she lays her hand on Him.

শ্রীঅঙ্গে লেগেছে ধূলা—ফেলাঙ ঝাড়িয়া ।
এ বোল বলিয়া পড়ে অঙ্গ আছাড়িয়া ॥ ৩৬ ॥

*śrīaṅge legeche dhūlā—phelāṅa jhāṛiẏā |*
*e bola baliẏā paṛe aṅga āchāṛiẏā || 36 ||*

*Word for word:* sri-ange legechhe dhula — dust has clung to His holy body; phelanga jhadiya — let me brush it off; e bola baliya — saying this; pade anga achhadiya — she falls, flinging herself down

**36.** "Dust has clung to the holy body — let me brush it off" —
saying this, she falls, flinging herself down.

পুনঃ উঠি' বলে—বাপু, শুন মোর বোল ।
মিটাউ হিয়ার সাধ—ধরি' দেও কোল ॥ ৩৭ ॥

*punaḥ uṭhi' bale—bāpu, śuna mora bola |*
*miṭāu hiẏāra sādha—dhari' deo kola || 37 ||*

*Word for word:* punah uthi bale — rising again she says; bapu shuna mora bola — my son, hear my word; mitau hiyara sadha — let me fulfil my heart's longing; dhari deo kola — let me hold you in my arms

**37.** And again, rising, she says: "My son, listen to me:
fulfil my heart's longing — let me hold you in my arms."

শচীর কান্দনা দেখি' পৃথিবী বিদরে ।
আছুক মানুষের কাজ, এ পাষাণ ঝুরে ॥ ৩৮ ॥

*śacīra kāndanā dekhi' pṛthibī bidare |*
*āchuka mānuṣera kāja, e pāṣāṇa jhure || 38 ||*

*Word for word:* shachira kandana dekhi — seeing Shachi's weeping; prithivi vidare — the earth splits; achhuka manushera kaja — let alone people; e pashana jhure — even stones weep

**38.** At the sight of Shachi's weeping the earth splits;
let alone people — even stones weep.

চৌদিগে সকল লোক কান্দিয়া ফাঁপর ।
কাছ না ছাড়য়ে কেহো—পাশরিল ঘর ॥ ৩৯ ॥

*caudige sakala loka kāndiẏā phāṁpara |*
*kācha nā chāṛaẏe keho—pāśarila ghara || 39 ||*

*Word for word:* chaudige sakala loka — all the people around; kandiya phanpara — are distraught with weeping; kachha na chhadaye keho — no one leaves His side; pasharila ghara — they forgot their homes

**39.** All the people around are distraught with weeping;
no one leaves His side; all have forgotten their homes.

লোকের কান্দনা দেখি' মায়ের ব্যগ্রতা ।
মনে অনুমানে প্রভু—কি কহিব কথা ॥ ৪০ ॥

*lokera kāndanā dekhi' māẏera byagratā |*
*mane anumāne prabhu—ki kahiba kathā || 40 ||*

*Word for word:* lokera kandana dekhi — seeing the people's weeping; mayera vyagrata — [and] His mother's distress; mane anumane prabhu — the Lord considers in His mind; ki kahiba katha — what to say

**40.** Seeing the people weeping and His mother's distress,
the Lord considers: "What shall I say?"

মায়ে প্রবোধিতে প্রভু মনে মনে গুণে ।
না কান্দ না কান্দ বোলে মধুর বচনে ॥ ৪১ ॥

*māẏe prabodhite prabhu mane mane guṇe |*
*nā kānda nā kānda bole madhura bacane || 41 ||*

*Word for word:* maye prabodhite — how to console His mother; prabhu mane mane gune — the Lord ponders within; na kanda na kanda bole — He says "do not weep, do not weep"; madhura vachane — with sweet words

**41.** Pondering within how to console His mother,
the Lord says sweetly: "Do not weep, do not weep!

সন্ন্যাস করিতে আজ্ঞা করিলা আপনে ।
এখন বিহ্বল হঞা কান্দ কি কারণে ॥ ৪২ ॥

*sannyāsa karite ājñā karilā āpane |*
*ekhana bihbala hañā kānda ki kāraṇe || 42 ||*

*Word for word:* sannyasa karite — to take sannyasa; ajna karila apane — you yourself gave permission; ekhana vihvala hanya — now, overwhelmed; kanda ki karane — why do you weep

**42.** You yourself gave permission to take sannyasa —
why then, overwhelmed, do you weep now?

পুত্র বলি' মিছা মায়া না ঘুচিল তোর ।
এছন দুস্ত্যজ মায়া এ সংসার-ঘোর ॥ ৪৩ ॥

*putra bali' michā māẏā nā ghucila tora |*
*echana dustyaja māẏā e saṃsāra-ghora || 43 ||*

*Word for word:* putra bali — [attachment] as to a son; michha maya — vain maya; na ghuchila tora — has not left you; echhana dustyaja maya — so hard to cast off is the maya; e samsara-ghora — of this dreadful samsara

**43.** The vain maya — [attachment to Me] as to a son — has not left you:
so hard to cast off is the maya of this dreadful samsara![^51-5]

ঘুচিলে না ঘুচে মায়া এছন দারুণ ।
শচী বোলে—মোর বোল শুন নিকরুণ ॥ ৪৪ ॥

*ghucile nā ghuce māẏā echana dāruṇa |*
*śacī bole—mora bola śuna nikaruṇa || 44 ||*

*Word for word:* ghuchile na ghuche — though driven away it does not go; maya echhana daruna — so cruel is maya; shachi bole — Shachi says; mora bola shuna nikaruna — hear my word, pitiless one

**44.** Driven away, it does not go: so cruel is maya."
Shachi says: "Hear me, pitiless one!

মোর পুত্র বলি' জন্ম লৈলে পৃথিবীতে ।
জগতের লোক মোরে কৈল পূজিতে ॥ ৪৫ ॥

*mora putra bali' janma laile pṛthibīte |*
*jagatera loka more kaila pūjite || 45 ||*

*Word for word:* mora putra bali — as my son; janma laile prithivite — you took birth on earth; jagatera loka — the people of the world; more kaila pujite — you made them honour me

**45.** You took birth on earth as my son
and made the people of the world honour me.

তুমি সব-লোকবন্ধু, ত্রিজগতে পূজি ।
তোমার সে স্নেহ-মায়া শাস্ত্রে ভাল বুঝি ॥ ৪৬ ॥

*tumi saba-lokabandhu, trijagate pūji |*
*tomāra se sneha-māẏā śāstre bhāla bujhi || 46 ||*

*Word for word:* tumi saba-loka-bandhu — You are the friend of all people; tri-jagate puji — worshipped in the three worlds; tomara se sneha-maya — this "maya" of Your affection; shastre bhala bujhi — I understand well from the scriptures

**46.** You are the friend of all, worshipped in the three worlds;
this 'maya' of Your affection I understand well from the scriptures.

যে হউ সে হউ মোর, তুমি হও পুত্র ।
জন্মে জন্মে রহু মোর এই কর্মসূত্র ॥ ৪৭ ॥

*ye hau se hau mora, tumi hao putra |*
*janme janme rahu mora ei karmasūtra || 47 ||*

*Word for word:* ye hau se hau mora — whatever happens to me; tumi hao putra — be my son; janme janme rahu — birth after birth may there remain; mora ei karma-sutra — this thread of my destiny

**47.** Whatever becomes of me — be my son:
birth after birth may this thread of destiny remain mine."

মায়ের বচনে প্রভু আস্তব্যস্ত হঞা ।
মায়ায়ে জিনিতে নারে, উভরায়ে দয়া ॥ ৪৮ ॥

*māẏera bacane prabhu āstabyasta hañā |*
*māẏāẏe jinite nāre, ubharāẏe daẏā || 48 ||*

*Word for word:* mayera vachane — at His mother's words; prabhu astavyasta hanya — the Lord, perturbed; mayaye jinite nare — cannot overcome [her] "maya"; ubharaye daya — compassion overflows

**48.** At His mother's words the Lord was perturbed:
He cannot overcome her 'maya'; compassion overflows in Him[^51-6].

যে তোর আছয়ে ইচ্ছা, কর নিজ-সুখে ।
একমাত্র শেষ আমি নিবেদিনু তোকে ॥ ৪৯ ॥

*ye tora āchaẏe icchā, kara nija-sukhe |*
*ekamātra śeṣa āmi nibedinu toke || 49 ||*

*Word for word:* ye tora achhaye ichchha — whatever wish you have; kara nija-sukhe — do as pleases you; ekamatra shesha — only one last thing; ami nivedinu toke — I have put before you

**49.** "Whatever you wish, do as pleases you;
I have told you only one last thing."

শচী বোলে—নবদ্বীপ ছাড়ি' যাহ তুমি ।
নবদ্বীপে দুঃখী বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া আর আমি ॥ ৫০ ॥

*śacī bole—nabadbīpa chāṛi' yāha tumi |*
*nabadbīpe duḥkhī biṣṇupriẏā āra āmi || 50 ||*

*Word for word:* shachi bole — Shachi says; navadvipa chhadi yaha tumi — you go, leaving Navadvipa; navadvipe duhkhi — in Navadvipa grieving; vishnupriya ara ami — are Vishnupriya and I

**50.** Shachi says: "You are going away, leaving Navadvipa —
and in Navadvipa Vishnupriya and I are grieving."

মায়ের বচনে পুনঃ গেলা নবদ্বীপ ।
বারকোণা-ঘাট নিজ-বাড়ীর সমীপ ॥ ৫১ ॥

*māẏera bacane punaḥ gelā nabadbīpa |*
*bārakoṇā-ghāṭa nija-bāṛīra samīpa || 51 ||*

*Word for word:* mayera vachane — at His mother's word; punah gela navadvipa — He went again to Navadvipa; barakona-ghata — the Barakona-ghata; nija-badira samipa — near His own house

**51.** At His mother's word He went again to Navadvipa,
to the Barakona-ghata, near His own house.

শুক্লাম্বর-ব্রহ্মচারি-ঘরে ভিক্ষা কৈল ।
মায়ে নমস্করি' প্রভু প্রভাতে চলিল ॥ ৫২ ॥

*śuklāmbara-brahmacāri-ghare bhikṣā kaila |*
*māẏe namaskari' prabhu prabhāte calila || 52 ||*

*Word for word:* shuklambara-brahmachari-ghare — at the house of Shuklambara Brahmachari; bhiksha kaila — He took alms; maye namaskari — bowing to His mother; prabhu prabhate chalila — the Lord left in the morning

**52.** He took alms in the house of Shuklambara Brahmachari
and in the morning, bowing to His mother, departed.

মায়েরে কহিল—মুঞি বন্দী তোর গুণে ।
পুরুব-রহস্য-কথা পাশরিলে কেনে ॥ ৫৩ ॥

*māẏere kahila—muñi bandī tora guṇe |*
*puruba-rahasya-kathā pāśarile kene || 53 ||*

*Word for word:* mayere kahila — He told His mother; munyi bandi tora gune — I am captive to your virtues; puruba-rahasya-katha — the secret of the past; pasharile kene — why have you forgotten

**53.** He told His mother: "I am captive to your virtues;
why have you forgotten the secret of the past?

রাম কৃষ্ণ বামন কপিল আদি আমি ।
সর্বজন্ম দেখ সব বিচারিয়া তুমি ॥ ৫৩+১ ॥

*rāma kṛṣṇa bāmana kapila ādi āmi |*
*sarbajanma dekha saba bicāriẏā tumi || 53+1 ||*

*Word for word:* rama krishna vamana kapila adi ami — I am Rama, Krishna, Vamana, Kapila and the rest; sarva-janma dekha — look at all the births; saba vichariya tumi — considering everything

**53+1.** I am Rama, Krishna, Vamana, Kapila and the rest:
look at all the births, considering everything[^51-7].

সর্বকাল আমার সে এইমত কর্ম ।
তোমার নিকটে আছি—জান এই মর্ম ॥ ৫৩+২ ॥

*sarbakāla āmāra se eimata karma |*
*tomāra nikaṭe āchi—jāna ei marma || 53+2 ||*

*Word for word:* sarvakala amara se — at all times My; eimata karma — such is the way; tomara nikate achhi — I am near you; jana ei marma — know this truth

**53+2.** At all times such is My way:
I am near you — know this truth.

এবে ত ভকতি-রসে মোর অবতার ।
কৃষ্ণচন্দ্র বহি কিছু না ভজিব আর ॥ ৫৩+৩ ॥

*ebe ta bhakati-rase mora abatāra |*
*kṛṣṇacandra bahi kichu nā bhajiba āra || 53+3 ||*

*Word for word:* ebe ta bhakati-rase — now for the rasa of devotion; mora avatara — is My descent; krishnachandra bahi — except Krishnachandra; kichhu na bhajiba ara — I shall worship nothing else

**53+3.** Now My descent is for the rasa of devotion:
except Krishnachandra, I shall worship nothing.

কিবা ভক্ত কিবা বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া কিবা তুমি ।
যে ভজয়ে কৃষ্ণ—তার কোলে আছি আমি ॥ ৫৪ ॥

*kibā bhakta kibā biṣṇupriẏā kibā tumi |*
*ye bhajaẏe kṛṣṇa—tāra kole āchi āmi || 54 ||*

*Word for word:* kiba bhakta — be it a devotee; kiba vishnupriya — be it Vishnupriya; kiba tumi — be it you; ye bhajaye krishna — whoever worships Krishna; tara kole achhi ami — I am in that one's embrace

**54.** Be it a devotee, be it Vishnupriya, be it you —
whoever worships Krishna, I am in that one's embrace"[^51-8].

মায়ে নমস্করি' প্রভু বোলে বার বার ।
না ছাড়িহ কৃষ্ণ, না ভজিহ এ সংসার ॥ ৫৫ ॥

*māẏe namaskari' prabhu bole bāra bāra |*
*nā chāṛiha kṛṣṇa, nā bhajiha e saṃsāra || 55 ||*

*Word for word:* maye namaskari — bowing to His mother; prabhu bole bara bara — the Lord says again and again; na chhadiha krishna — do not abandon Krishna; na bhajiha e samsara — do not serve this samsara
