**55.** Bowing to His mother, the Lord says again and again:
"Do not abandon Krishna; do not serve this samsara."

শচীর অন্তর-হিয়া করে দপ দপ ।
চলিল ঠাকুর, পাছে ধায় ভক্ত সব ॥ ৫৬ ॥

*śacīra antara-hiẏā kare dapa dapa |*
*calila ṭhākura, pāche dhāẏa bhakta saba || 56 ||*

*Word for word:* shachira antara-hiya — Shachi's inmost heart; kare dapa dapa — throbs; chalila thakura — the Thakura went; pachhe dhaya bhakta saba — all the devotees run behind

**56.** Shachi's heart throbs;
the Thakura went; all the devotees run behind.

শান্তিপুরে গেলা আচার্যের ঘর ।
কীর্তন-বিলাসে গেল সে অষ্টপ্রহর ॥ ৫৭ ॥

*śāntipure gelā ācāryera ghara |*
*kīrtana-bilāse gela se aṣṭaprahara || 57 ||*

*Word for word:* shantipure gela — He went to Shantipura; acharyera ghara — to the Acharya's house; kirtana-vilase — in the joy of kirtana; gela se ashta-prahara — passed a day and a night (eight praharas)

**57.** He went to Shantipura, to the Acharya's house;
in the joy of kirtana a day and a night passed.

পুনঃ পরভাতে প্রভু চলিলা সত্বরে ।
উৎকণ্ঠা বাঢ়িল জগন্নাথ দেখিবারে ॥ ৫৮ ॥

*punaḥ parabhāte prabhu calilā satbare |*
*utkaṇṭhā bāṛhila jagannātha dekhibāre || 58 ||*

*Word for word:* punah parabhate — again in the morning; prabhu chalila satvare — the Lord set out quickly; utkantha badhila — His longing grew; jagannatha dekhibare — to see Jagannatha

**58.** Next morning the Lord again set out quickly:
His longing to see Jagannatha grew.

সভারে কহিলা প্রভু—সভে যাহ ঘর ।
নীলাচলে আছি আমি—কহিল উত্তর ॥ ৫৯ ॥

*sabhāre kahilā prabhu—sabhe yāha ghara |*
*nīlācale āchi āmi—kahila uttara || 59 ||*

*Word for word:* sabhare kahila prabhu — the Lord told everyone; sabhe yaha ghara — all of you go home; nilachale achhi ami — I am in Nilachala; kahila uttara — so He answered

**59.** The Lord told everyone: "All of you go home;
I am in Nilachala" — so He answered.

যে যায় তথায় জগন্নাথ দেখিবারে ।
তথায় আমার দেখা হৈব সভারে ॥ ৬০ ॥

*ye yāẏa tathāẏa jagannātha dekhibāre |*
*tathāẏa āmāra dekhā haiba sabhāre || 60 ||*

*Word for word:* ye yaya tathaya — whoever goes there; jagannatha dekhibare — to see Jagannatha; tathaya amara dekha — there a meeting with Me; haiba sabhare — all will have

**60.** "Whoever goes there to see Jagannatha —
there all will meet Me."

এ বোল বলিয়া প্রভু বোলে হরিবোল ।
চলিলা ঠাকুর—উঠে কান্দনের রোল ॥ ৬১ ॥

*e bola baliẏā prabhu bole haribola |*
*calilā ṭhākura—uṭhe kāndanera rola || 61 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola baliya — saying this; prabhu bole hari-bola — the Lord cries "Hari-bol!"; chalila thakura — the Thakura went; uthe kandanera rola — a sound of weeping rises

**61.** Saying this, the Lord cries "Hari-bol!"
The Thakura went — a sound of weeping rises.

ক্রমে ক্রমে তমোলুকে উত্তরিলা গিয়া ।
যে পথে আসিয়াছেন পূর্বে সেই পথ দিয়া ॥ ৬২ ॥

*krame krame tamoluke uttarilā giẏā |*
*ye pathe āsiẏāchena pūrbe sei patha diẏā || 62 ||*

*Word for word:* krame krame — gradually; tamoluke uttarila giya — He reached Tamoluk; ye pathe asiyachhena purve — by the way He came before; sei patha diya — by that same way

**62.** Step by step He came to Tamoluk,
by the same way as He had come before.

পথে চলি' যায় প্রভু প্রেমানন্দ-সুখে ।
প্রেম-বরিষণে ভাসে সে পথের লোকে ॥ ৬৩ ॥

*pathe cali' yāẏa prabhu premānanda-sukhe |*
*prema-bariṣaṇe bhāse se pathera loke || 63 ||*

*Word for word:* pathe chali yaya prabhu — the Lord goes along the road; premananda-sukhe — in the joy of prema's bliss; prema-varishane bhase — float in the rain of prema; se pathera loke — the people along that road

**63.** The Lord goes along the road in the joy of prema's bliss;
the people along that road float in the rain of prema.

হাসিতে খেলিতে যায়, নাহি পথশ্রমে ।
পুরুষোত্তমে উত্তরিলা পথ ক্রমে ক্রমে ॥ ৬৪ ॥

*hāsite khelite yāẏa, nāhi pathaśrame |*
*puruṣottame uttarilā patha krame krame || 64 ||*

*Word for word:* hasite khelite yaya — He goes laughing and playing; nahi patha-shrame — without the fatigue of the road; purushottame uttarila — He reached Purushottama; patha krame krame — step by step

**64.** He goes laughing and playing, without the fatigue of the road,
and step by step reached Purushottama.

দেখিব ত জগন্নাথ নীলাচলরায় ।
হাহা জগন্নাথ বলি' অনুরাগে ধায় ॥ ৬৫ ॥

*dekhiba ta jagannātha nīlācalarāẏa |*
*hāhā jagannātha bali' anurāge dhāẏa || 65 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhiba ta jagannatha — I shall see Jagannatha; nilachala-raya — the King of Nilachala; haha jagannatha bali — crying "O Jagannatha!"; anurage dhaya — He hastens in love

**65.** "I shall see Jagannatha, the King of Nilachala!" —
crying "O Jagannatha!" He hastens in love.

সিংহদ্বারে গিয়া প্রভু ছাড়ে হুহুঙ্কার ।
পাইল সকল লোক আনন্দ অপার ॥ ৬৬ ॥

*siṃhadbāre giẏā prabhu chāṛe huhuṅkāra |*
*pāila sakala loka ānanda apāra || 66 ||*

*Word for word:* simha-dvare giya — coming to the Lion Gate; prabhu chhade huhunkara — the Lord lets out a roar; paila sakala loka — all the people found; ananda apara — boundless joy

**66.** Coming to the Lion Gate, the Lord lets out a roar;
all the people found boundless joy.

জগন্নাথ দেখি' তুষ্ট হৈলা গোরারায় ।
তাঁহারে দেখিয়া লোক বড় সুখ পায় ॥ ৬৭ ॥

*jagannātha dekhi' tuṣṭa hailā gorārāẏa |*
*tāṁhāre dekhiẏā loka baṛa sukha pāẏa || 67 ||*

*Word for word:* jagannatha dekhi — seeing Jagannatha; tushta haila goraraya — Goraraya was delighted; tanhare dekhiya — seeing Him; loka bada sukha paya — the people find great happiness

**67.** Seeing Jagannatha, Goraraya was delighted;
seeing Him, the people find great happiness.

হরি হরি বোলে লোক উচ্চ উচ্চ-রায় ।
আনন্দিত দিবা-নিশি হরিগুণ গায় ॥ ৬৮ ॥

*hari hari bole loka ucca ucca-rāẏa |*
*ānandita dibā-niśi hariguṇa gāẏa || 68 ||*

*Word for word:* hari hari bole loka — the people cry "Hari, Hari!"; uchcha uchcha-raya — with loud voices; anandita diva-nishi — joyful day and night; hari-guna gaya — they sing Hari's glories

**68.** The people cry with loud voices: "Hari, Hari!"
and joyfully sing Hari's glories day and night.

রাত্রি দিন করে প্রভু কীর্তন-বিলাস ।
গোরাগুণ গায় সুখে এ লোচনদাস ॥ ৬৯ ॥

*rātri dina kare prabhu kīrtana-bilāsa |*
*gorāguṇa gāẏa sukhe e locanadāsa || 69 ||*

*Word for word:* ratri dina — night and day; kare prabhu kirtana-vilasa — the Lord delights in kirtana; goraguna gaya sukhe — happily sings Gora's glories; e lochanadasa — this Lochana Dasa

**69.** Night and day the Lord delights in kirtana;
happily this Lochana Dasa sings Gora's glories.

*Raga lalita; disha: "Sing, sing of Gora's glories — the blessing of the whole world!"*

আনন্দিত মহাপ্রভু আছে নীলাচলে ।
হরিগুণ-সঙ্কীর্তন করে ভক্তমেলে ॥ ৭০ ॥

*ānandita mahāprabhu āche nīlācale |*
*hariguṇa-saṅkīrtana kare bhaktamele || 70 ||*

*Word for word:* anandita mahaprabhu — joyful Mahaprabhu; achhe nilachale — stays in Nilachala; hari-guna-sankirtana — the sankirtana of Hari's glories; kare bhakta-mele — He performs among the devotees

**70.** Joyful Mahaprabhu stays in Nilachala
and among the devotees performs the sankirtana of Hari's glories.

অনেক ভকতগণ মিলিলা তথায় ।
নিত্যই নূতন প্রকাশয়ে গোরারায় ॥ ৭১ ॥

*aneka bhakatagaṇa mililā tathāẏa |*
*nityai nūtana prakāśaẏe gorārāẏa || 71 ||*

*Word for word:* aneka bhakatagana — many devotees; milila tathaya — gathered there; nityai nutana — ever new each day; prakashaye goraraya — Goraraya reveals [Himself]

**71.** Many devotees gathered there;
every day Goraraya reveals Himself anew.

হেনই সময়ে কথা কহিব এখনে ।
প্রতাপরুদ্রেরে কৃপা কৈল যেন মনে ॥ ৭২ ॥

*henai samaẏe kathā kahiba ekhane |*
*pratāparudrere kṛpā kaila yena mane || 72 ||*

*Word for word:* henai samaye — at that time; katha kahiba ekhane — I shall now tell; prataparudrere — to Prataparudra; kripa kaila yena mane — how [He] showed mercy as He willed

**72.** Now I shall tell how at that time
He, as He willed, showed mercy to Prataparudra[^51-9].

লোকমুখে শুনি' রাজা মহাপ্রভুর গুণ ।
আশ্চর্য মানয়ে, সে না কহে কিছু পুনঃ ॥ ৭৩ ॥

*lokamukhe śuni' rājā mahāprabhura guṇa |*
*āścarya mānaẏe, se nā kahe kichu punaḥ || 73 ||*

*Word for word:* loka-mukhe shuni — hearing from people; raja mahaprabhura guna — the king, of Mahaprabhu's glories; ashcharya manaye — marvels; se na kahe kichhu punah — but says nothing

**73.** Hearing from people of Mahaprabhu's glories,
the king marvels but says nothing.

একদিন গেলা জগন্নাথ দেখিবারে ।
জগন্নাথ না দেখয়ে—দেখে ন্যাসিবরে ॥ ৭৪ ॥

*ekadina gelā jagannātha dekhibāre |*
*jagannātha nā dekhaẏe—dekhe nyāsibare || 74 ||*

*Word for word:* ekadina gela — one day he went; jagannatha dekhibare — to see Jagannatha; jagannatha na dekhaye — he does not see Jagannatha; dekhe nyasivare — he sees the best of sannyasis

**74.** One day he went to see Jagannatha —
and does not see Jagannatha, but sees the best of sannyasis.

কি কি বলি' মনে গুণে বিস্মিত হিয়ায় ।
পড়িছাকে পুছে রাজা—কি দেখহ রায় ॥ ৭৫ ॥

*ki ki bali' mane guṇe bismita hiẏāẏa |*
*paṛichāke puche rājā—ki dekhaha rāẏa || 75 ||*

*Word for word:* ki ki bali — "what, what [is this]?"; mane gune — he ponders; vismita hiyaya — with an astonished heart; padichhake puchhe raja — the king asks the padichha; ki dekhaha raya — what do you see, sir

**75.** "What is this, what?" he ponders with an astonished heart
and asks the padichha: "What do you see, sir?"

পড়িছা কহয়ে—দেব জগন্নাথ দেখি ।
রাজা কহে—তো-সভাকে ব্যর্থ আমি রাখি ॥ ৭৬ ॥

*paṛichā kahaẏe—deba jagannātha dekhi |*
*rājā kahe—to-sabhāke byartha āmi rākhi || 76 ||*

*Word for word:* padichha kahaye — the padichha says; deva jagannatha dekhi — I see Lord Jagannatha; raja kahe — the king says; to-sabhake vyartha ami rakhi — I keep you all in vain

**76.** The padichha says: "I see Lord Jagannatha."
The king says: "I keep you all in vain!

জগন্নাথ-স্থানে ন্যাসী বসি' আছে হের ।
মোর দণ্ড-ভয়ে কিছু না দেখিয়ে বোল ॥ ৭৭ ॥

*jagannātha-sthāne nyāsī basi' āche hera |*
*mora daṇḍa-bhaẏe kichu nā dekhiẏe bola || 77 ||*

*Word for word:* jagannatha-sthane — in Jagannatha's place; nyasi basi achhe hera — here sits a sannyasi; mora danda-bhaye — in fear of my punishment; kichhu na dekhiye bola — you say you see nothing [else]

**77.** Look, in Jagannatha's place sits a sannyasi —
and you, for fear of my punishment, say you see nothing [else].

আঁখি ভাঁড়িমু যেন—হেন নহে কভু ।
নহে বা কি দেখ সত্য করি' কহ তভু ॥ ৭৮ ॥

*āṁkhi bhāṁṛimu yena—hena nahe kabhu |*
*nahe bā ki dekha satya kari' kaha tabhu || 78 ||*

*Word for word:* ankhi bhandimu yena — as if my eyes deceived me; hena nahe kabhu — that is never so; nahe va ki dekha — or else what do you see; satya kari kaha tabhu — tell the truth then

**78.** As if my eyes deceived me — that is never so!
Or else — what do you see? Tell the truth."

এ বোল শুনিঞা পড়িছা বোলে পুনর্বার ।
জগন্নাথ বহি মোরা নাহি দেখি আর ॥ ৭৯ ॥

*e bola śuniñā paṛichā bole punarbāra |*
*jagannātha bahi morā nāhi dekhi āra || 79 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuninya — hearing this; padichha bole punarvara — the padichha says again; jagannatha bahi — except Jagannatha; mora nahi dekhi ara — we see nothing else

**79.** Hearing this, the padichha says again:
"Except Jagannatha we see nothing"[^51-10].

তবে ত প্রতাপরুদ্র গুণে মনে মনে ।
সন্ন্যাসীকে কেনে দেখি আমার নয়নে ॥ ৮০ ॥

*tabe ta pratāparudra guṇe mane mane |*
*sannyāsīke kene dekhi āmāra naẏane || 80 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe ta prataparudra — then Prataparudra; gune mane mane — ponders within; sannyasike kene dekhi — why do I see the sannyasi; amara nayane — with my eyes

**80.** Then Prataparudra ponders within:
"Why then do I see the sannyasi with my own eyes?

শুনিয়াছি সন্ন্যাসীর মহিমা অপার ।
ইহার কারণ তবে করিব বিচার ॥ ৮১ ॥

*śuniẏāchi sannyāsīra mahimā apāra |*
*ihāra kāraṇa tabe kariba bicāra || 81 ||*

*Word for word:* shuniyachhi — I have heard; sannyasira mahima apara — the sannyasi's greatness is boundless; ihara karana — the cause of this; tabe kariba vichara — I shall then look into

**81.** I have heard that this sannyasi's greatness is boundless;
I must look into the cause of this."

এতেক গুণিয়া রাজা চলিল সত্বর ।
আপনি চলিলা যথা আছে ন্যাসিবর ॥ ৮২ ॥

*eteka guṇiẏā rājā calila satbara |*
*āpani calilā yathā āche nyāsibara || 82 ||*

*Word for word:* eteka guniya — having thought thus; raja chalila satvara — the king went quickly; apani chalila — he went himself; yatha achhe nyasivara — to where the best of sannyasis was

**82.** Having thought thus, the king went quickly —
went himself to where the best of sannyasis was.

দেখিল টোটায়ে ন্যাসী আছে নিজ-মেলে ।
বৃন্দাবন-কথা কহে, হরি হরি বোলে ॥ ৮৩ ॥

*dekhila ṭoṭāẏe nyāsī āche nija-mele |*
*bṛndābana-kathā kahe, hari hari bole || 83 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhila totaye — he saw in the garden; nyasi achhe nija-mele — the sannyasi among His own; vrindavana-katha kahe — He tells of Vrindavana; hari hari bole — He cries "Hari, Hari!"

**83.** He saw: in the garden the sannyasi, among His own,
tells of Vrindavana and cries: "Hari, Hari!"

পুনরপি জগন্নাথ দেখি' আরবার ।
দেখিল সন্ন্যাসী সেই সুমেরু-আকার ॥ ৮৪ ॥

*punarapi jagannātha dekhi' ārabāra |*
*dekhila sannyāsī sei sumeru-ākāra || 84 ||*

*Word for word:* punarapi — again; jagannatha dekhi arabara — looking at Jagannatha once more; dekhila sannyasi sei — he saw that sannyasi; sumeru-akara — as vast as Sumeru

**84.** Again, looking at Jagannatha once more,
he saw that sannyasi, as vast as Mount Sumeru.

দেখিয়া রাজার ভেল হিয়া চমৎকার ।
এই জগন্নাথ—সেই ন্যাসি-অবতার ॥ ৮৫ ॥

*dekhiẏā rājāra bhela hiẏā camatkāra |*
*ei jagannātha—sei nyāsi-abatāra || 85 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhiya — seeing this; rajara bhela hiya chamatkara — the king's heart was amazed; ei jagannatha — this Jagannatha; sei nyasi-avatara — is that sannyasi-avatara

**85.** Seeing this, the king was amazed at heart:
"This Jagannatha is that very sannyasi-avatara!"

প্রতাপরুদ্রের মনে বাঢ়ে অনুরাগ ।
সত্বরে চলিলা যথা আছে মহাভাগ ॥ ৮৬ ॥

*pratāparudrera mane bāṛhe anurāga |*
*satbare calilā yathā āche mahābhāga || 86 ||*

*Word for word:* prataparudrera mane — in Prataparudra's heart; badhe anuraga — love grows; satvare chalila — he went quickly; yatha achhe mahabhaga — to where the Glorious One was

**86.** Love grows in Prataparudra's heart,
and he went quickly to where the Glorious One was.

টোটায় নাহিক কেহো—ভাঙ্গিল দেওয়ান ।
গোবিন্দেরে কহে রাজা কাতর-বয়ান ॥ ৮৭ ॥

*ṭoṭāẏa nāhika keho—bhāṅgila deoẏāna |*
*gobindere kahe rājā kātara-baẏāna || 87 ||*

*Word for word:* totaya nahika keho — there is no one in the garden; bhangila deoyana — the gathering has broken up; govindere kahe raja — the king says to Govinda; katara-bayana — in a pleading voice

**87.** There is no one in the garden — the gathering has broken up;
the king pleadingly says to Govinda[^51-11]:

কোন মতে দেখোঁ মুঞি গোসাঞির চরণ ।
ইহার উপায় মোরে কহ মহাজন ॥ ৮৮ ॥

*kona mate dekhoṁ muñi gosāñira caraṇa |*
*ihāra upāẏa more kaha mahājana || 88 ||*

*Word for word:* kona mate dekhon munyi — how may I see; gosanira charana — the Gosani's feet; ihara upaya — the means for it; more kaha mahajana — tell me, great one

**88.** "How may I see the Gosani's feet?
Tell me the means for it, great one."

গোবিন্দ কহয়ে—রাজা, না হও কাতর ।
এখানে না পাবে দেখা—হৈল অনবসর ॥ ৮৯ ॥

*gobinda kahaẏe—rājā, nā hao kātara |*
*ekhāne nā pābe dekhā—haila anabasara || 89 ||*

*Word for word:* govinda kahaye — Govinda says; raja na hao katara — king, do not be distressed; ekhane na pabe dekha — you will not see [Him] here; haila anavasara — it is not the time

**89.** Govinda says: "King, do not be distressed:
you will not see Him here — now is not the time."

কখন আসিব মুঞি কহ মহাভাগ ।
কাতর-বয়ান রাজা, বাঢ়ে অনুরাগ ॥ ৯০ ॥

*kakhana āsiba muñi kaha mahābhāga |*
*kātara-baẏāna rājā, bāṛhe anurāga || 90 ||*

*Word for word:* kakhana asiba munyi — when shall I come; kaha mahabhaga — tell me, fortunate one; katara-bayana raja — the king speaks pleadingly; badhe anuraga — his love grows

**90.** "When shall I come, tell me, fortunate one?" —
the king speaks pleadingly, and his love grows.

সেদিন রহিল রাজা সেই ত নগরে ।
সঙ্গিগণ দেখি' কাকু করয়ে সভারে ॥ ৯১ ॥

*sedina rahila rājā sei ta nagare |*
*saṅgigaṇa dekhi' kāku karaẏe sabhāre || 91 ||*

*Word for word:* sedina rahila raja — that day the king stayed; sei ta nagare — in that town; sangigana dekhi — seeing [the Lord's] companions; kaku karaye sabhare — he implores them all

**91.** That day the king stayed in that town
and, seeing [the Lord's] companions, implores them all.

পুরী-গোসাঞি আদি করি' যত ভক্তগণ ।
গোসাঞির গোচর করিবারে হৈল মন ॥ ৯২ ॥

*purī-gosāñi ādi kari' yata bhaktagaṇa |*
*gosāñira gocara karibāre haila mana || 92 ||*

*Word for word:* puri-gosani adi kari — headed by Puri Gosani; yata bhaktagana — all the devotees; gosanira gochara karibare — to bring it to the Gosani's notice; haila mana — resolved

**92.** All the devotees, headed by Puri Gosani,
resolved to bring this to the Gosani's notice.

এইমতে দিন দুই-চারি গেল যবে ।
কাশীমিশ্র-ঘরেতে একত্র হৈলা সভে ॥ ৯৩ ॥

*eimate dina dui-cāri gela yabe |*
*kāśīmiśra-gharete ekatra hailā sabhe || 93 ||*

*Word for word:* eimate — thus; dina dui-chari gela yabe — when two or four days had passed; kashimishra-gharete — in the house of Kashi Mishra; ekatra haila sabhe — all gathered together

**93.** When two or four days had passed thus,
they all gathered together in the house of Kashi Mishra.

সকল ভকত মেলি' যুকতি করিল ।
সভে মেলি' গোচরিব—এই যুক্তি কৈল ॥ ৯৪ ॥

*sakala bhakata meli' yukati karila |*
*sabhe meli' gocariba—ei yukti kaila || 94 ||*

*Word for word:* sakala bhakata meli — all the devotees together; yukati karila — took counsel; sabhe meli gochariba — we shall tell [Him] all together; ei yukti kaila — so they resolved

**94.** All the devotees took counsel together
and resolved: "We shall tell Him all together."

আর দিন মহাপ্রভু কাশীমিশ্র-ঘরে ।
আচম্বিতে সে আছে নিজ-ভক্ত-মেলে ॥ ৯৫ ॥

*āra dina mahāprabhu kāśīmiśra-ghare |*
*ācambite se āche nija-bhakta-mele || 95 ||*

*Word for word:* ara dina — the next day; mahaprabhu kashimishra-ghare — Mahaprabhu at Kashi Mishra's house; achambite — as it happened; se achhe nija-bhakta-mele — He was among His devotees

**95.** The next day Mahaprabhu, as it happened,
was in Kashi Mishra's house among His devotees.

রাজার ব্যগ্রতায় সভার কাতর অন্তর ।
পুরী-গোসাঞি কহিল সে প্রভুর গোচর ॥ ৯৬ ॥

*rājāra byagratāẏa sabhāra kātara antara |*
*purī-gosāñi kahila se prabhura gocara || 96 ||*

*Word for word:* rajara vyagrataya — at the king's anxiety; sabhara katara antara — all were heavy at heart; puri-gosani kahila — Puri Gosani spoke; se prabhura gochara — before the Lord

**96.** The king's anxiety weighed on all their hearts,
and Puri Gosani addressed the Lord:

এক নিবেদন গোসাঞি কহিতে ডরাঙ ।
নির্ভয়ে কহিয়ে তবে যদি আজ্ঞা পাঙ ॥ ৯৭ ॥

*eka nibedana gosāñi kahite ḍarāṅa |*
*nirbhaẏe kahiẏe tabe yadi ājñā pāṅa || 97 ||*

*Word for word:* eka nivedana — one request; gosani — Gosani; kahite darana — I fear to tell; nirbhaye kahiye tabe — then I will speak without fear; yadi ajna pana — if I get permission

**97.** "I have one request, Gosani, but fear to say it;
I will speak without fear if I have permission."

ঠাকুর কহয়ে—শুন পুরী-গোসাঞি ।
মোর ঠাঞি তোর ডর কোন কালে নাঞি ॥ ৯৮ ॥

*ṭhākura kahaẏe—śuna purī-gosāñi |*
*mora ṭhāñi tora ḍara kona kāle nāñi || 98 ||*

*Word for word:* thakura kahaye — the Thakura says; shuna puri-gosani — listen, Puri Gosani; mora thanyi — before Me; tora dara kona kale nanyi — you need never have fear

**98.** The Thakura says: "Listen, Puri Gosani:
before Me you need never be afraid.

কি কহিবে কহ, শুনি' হৃদয় তোমার ।
পুরী-গোসাঞি বোলে—বোল রাখিবে আমার ॥ ৯৯ ॥

*ki kahibe kaha, śuni' hṛdaẏa tomāra |*
*purī-gosāñi bole—bola rākhibe āmāra || 99 ||*

*Word for word:* ki kahibe kaha — say what you would say; shuni hridaya tomara — I will hear your heart; puri-gosani bole — Puri Gosani says; bola rakhibe amara — will You grant my word

**99.** Say what you would say — I will hear your heart."
Puri Gosani says: "Will You grant my request?

কাশীমিশ্র-আদি করি' যত ভক্তগণ ।
সভার বচনে মুঞি বলি এ বচন ॥ ১০০ ॥

*kāśīmiśra-ādi kari' yata bhaktagaṇa |*
*sabhāra bacane muñi bali e bacana || 100 ||*

*Word for word:* kashimishra-adi kari — headed by Kashi Mishra; yata bhaktagana — all the devotees; sabhara vachane — on behalf of all; munyi bali e vachana — I say these words

**100.** On behalf of all the devotees headed by Kashi Mishra
I say these words:

শ্রীজগন্নাথদেব নীলাচলে বাস ।
প্রতাপরুদ্র রাজা হয় তাঁর নিজ দাস ॥ ১০১ ॥

*śrījagannāthadeba nīlācale bāsa |*
*pratāparudra rājā haẏa tāṁra nija dāsa || 101 ||*

*Word for word:* sri-jagannatha-deva — Sri Jagannatha-deva; nilachale vasa — dwells in Nilachala; prataparudra raja — King Prataparudra; haya tanra nija dasa — is His own servant

**101.** Sri Jagannatha-deva dwells in Nilachala,
and King Prataparudra is His own servant.

তোর পদ দেখিবারে সাধে মো-সভারে ।
আজ্ঞা পাইলে হয় সেই চরণ-গোচরে ॥ ১০২ ॥

*tora pada dekhibāre sādhe mo-sabhāre |*
*ājñā pāile haẏa sei caraṇa-gocare || 102 ||*

*Word for word:* tora pada dekhibare — to see Your feet; sadhe mo-sabhare — he entreats us all; ajna paile — if he gets permission; haya sei charana-gochare — he will come before those feet

**102.** He entreats us all in order to see Your feet:
if he has permission, he will come before those feet."

প্রভু বোলে—সর্বজন, শুনহ বচন ।
সন্ন্যাসীর ধর্ম নহে রাজ-দরশন ॥ ১০৩ ॥

*prabhu bole—sarbajana, śunaha bacana |*
*sannyāsīra dharma nahe rāja-daraśana || 103 ||*

*Word for word:* prabhu bole — the Lord says; sarvajana shunaha vachana — everyone, hear My word; sannyasira dharma nahe — it is not a sannyasi's dharma; raja-darashana — to see a king

**103.** The Lord says: "Everyone, hear My word:
it is not a sannyasi's dharma to see a king.

আমি ত সন্ন্যাসী, সেই হয় মহারাজ ।
দোঁহার দর্শনে দোঁহার কিছু নাহি কাজ ॥ ১০৪ ॥

*āmi ta sannyāsī, sei haẏa mahārāja |*
*doṁhāra darśane doṁhāra kichu nāhi kāja || 104 ||*

*Word for word:* ami ta sannyasi — I am a sannyasi; sei haya maharaja — he is a great king; donhara darshane — in the two meeting; donhara kichhu nahi kaja — neither has any purpose

**104.** I am a sannyasi, and he is a great king:
neither of us has any purpose in meeting."

পুরী-গোসাঞি বোলে—প্রভু, কর অবধান ।
এ বোল শুনিলে রাজা হারিবে গেয়ান ॥ ১০৫ ॥

*purī-gosāñi bole—prabhu, kara abadhāna |*
*e bola śunile rājā hāribe geẏāna || 105 ||*

*Word for word:* puri-gosani bole — Puri Gosani says; prabhu kara avadhana — Lord, hear me; e bola shunile — if he hears this; raja haribe geyana — the king will lose his senses

**105.** Puri Gosani says: "Lord, hear me:
if the king hears this, he will lose his senses.

যে দেখিল আমরা তাহার অনুরাগ ।
এ কথা শুনিলে জীউ ছাড়িবে মহাভাগ ॥ ১০৬ ॥

*ye dekhila āmarā tāhāra anurāga |*
*e kathā śunile jīu chāṛibe mahābhāga || 106 ||*

*Word for word:* ye dekhila amara — such as we have seen; tahara anuraga — his love; e katha shunile — if he hears this; jiu chhadibe mahabhaga — he will give up his life, O Glorious One

**106.** We have seen what his love is like:
if he hears such words, he will give up his life, O Glorious One.

আজি ত হইল রাজার দশ উপবাস ।
সব ছাড়ি' পড়ি' আছে চরণ-প্রত্যাশ ॥ ১০৭ ॥

*āji ta haila rājāra daśa upabāsa |*
*saba chāṛi' paṛi' āche caraṇa-pratyāśa || 107 ||*

*Word for word:* aji ta haila — today has come; rajara dasha upavasa — the king's tenth day of fasting; saba chhadi padi achhe — leaving all he lies [at the door]; charana-pratyasha — hoping for [Your] feet

**107.** Today is already the king's tenth day of fasting:
leaving everything, he lies [at the door] in hope of [Your] feet."

কাতর হইয়া পুনঃ বোলে সর্বজন ।
রাজার ব্যগ্রতা দেখি' করিয়ে যতন ॥ ১০৮ ॥

*kātara haiẏā punaḥ bole sarbajana |*
*rājāra byagratā dekhi' kariẏe yatana || 108 ||*

*Word for word:* katara haiya — pleadingly; punah bole sarvajana — all speak again; rajara vyagrata dekhi — seeing the king's anxiety; kariye yatana — we make this effort

**108.** And again all say pleadingly:
"Seeing the king's anxiety, we are asking."

এ বোল শুনিয়া প্রভু কহিছে বচন ।
আনহ রাজারে—মুঞি হইনু পরসন্ন ॥ ১০৯ ॥

*e bola śuniẏā prabhu kahiche bacana |*
*ānaha rājāre—muñi hainu parasanna || 109 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuniya — hearing this; prabhu kahichhe vachana — the Lord speaks; anaha rajare — bring the king; munyi hainu parasanna — I am pleased

**109.** Hearing this, the Lord says:
"Bring the king — I am pleased with him."

এ বোল শুনিঞা সভার ভেল উল্লাস ।
আনিল রাজারে—প্রভু করে পরকাশ ॥ ১১০ ॥

*e bola śuniñā sabhāra bhela ullāsa |*
*ānila rājāre—prabhu kare parakāśa || 110 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuninya — hearing this; sabhara bhela ullasa — all rejoiced; anila rajare — they brought the king; prabhu kare parakasha — the Lord reveals [Himself]

**110.** Hearing this, all rejoiced;
they brought the king — and the Lord reveals Himself.

প্রভুরে দেখিয়া রাজা পরণাম করে ।
প্রেমায় বিহ্বল রাজা আপনা পাশরে ॥ ১১১ ॥

*prabhure dekhiẏā rājā paraṇāma kare |*
*premāẏa bihbala rājā āpanā pāśare || 111 ||*

*Word for word:* prabhure dekhiya — seeing the Lord; raja paranama kare — the king bows; premaya vihvala raja — the king, overwhelmed with prema; apana pashare — forgets himself

**111.** Seeing the Lord, the king bows;
overwhelmed with prema, the king forgets himself.

পুলকে ভরিল অঙ্গ, ছল ছল আঁখি ।
প্রেমে গর গর ভেল গোরা-অঙ্গ দেখি' ॥ ১১২ ॥

*pulake bharila aṅga, chala chala āṁkhi |*
*preme gara gara bhela gorā-aṅga dekhi' || 112 ||*

*Word for word:* pulake bharila anga — his body filled with thrills; chhala chhala ankhi — his eyes brimming; preme gara gara bhela — he was steeped in prema; gora-anga dekhi — seeing Gora's form

**112.** His body filled with thrills, his eyes brimming;
seeing Gora, he was steeped in prema.

রাজারে দেখিয়া প্রভু লহু লহু হাস ।
ষড়ভুজ শরীর রাজা দেখে পরকাশ ॥ ১১৩ ॥

*rājāre dekhiẏā prabhu lahu lahu hāsa |*
*ṣaṛabhuja śarīra rājā dekhe parakāśa || 113 ||*

*Word for word:* rajare dekhiya — seeing the king; prabhu lahu lahu hasa — the Lord smiles gently; shadbhuja sharira — a six-armed form; raja dekhe parakasha — the king sees revealed

**113.** Seeing the king, the Lord smiles gently,
and the king sees the six-armed form [He] reveals[^51-12].

ষড়ভুজ দেখিয়া দণ্ড-পরণাম করে ।
টলমল করে অঙ্গ অনুরাগ-ভরে ॥ ১১৪ ॥

*ṣaṛabhuja dekhiẏā daṇḍa-paraṇāma kare |*
*ṭalamala kare aṅga anurāga-bhare || 114 ||*

*Word for word:* shadbhuja dekhiya — seeing the Six-armed One; danda-paranama kare — he prostrates; talamala kare anga — his body sways; anuraga-bhare — under the weight of love

**114.** Seeing the Six-armed One, he prostrates;
under the weight of love his body sways.

অবশ শরীর, নীর ঝরে দু-নয়নে ।
চৌদিগে হরিধ্বনি পরশে গগনে ॥ ১১৫ ॥

*abaśa śarīra, nīra jhare du-naẏane |*
*caudige haridhbani paraśe gagane || 115 ||*

*Word for word:* avasha sharira — his body powerless; nira jhare du-nayane — tears stream from both eyes; chaudige haridhvani — all around the sound of Hari's name; parashe gagane — touches the sky

**115.** His body is powerless, tears stream from both eyes;
all around, the name of Hari resounds, touching the sky.

ষড়ভুজ শরীর দেখি' শ্রীপ্রতাপরুদ্র ।
আনন্দে বিহ্বল, ভাসে প্রেমার সমুদ্র ॥ ১১৬ ॥

*ṣaṛabhuja śarīra dekhi' śrīpratāparudra |*
*ānande bihbala, bhāse premāra samudra || 116 ||*

*Word for word:* shadbhuja sharira dekhi — seeing the six-armed form; sri-prataparudra — Sri Prataparudra; anande vihvala — overwhelmed with bliss; bhase premara samudra — floats in the ocean of prema

**116.** Seeing the six-armed form, Sri Prataparudra,
overwhelmed with bliss, floats in the ocean of prema.

কণ্টকিত সব অঙ্গ আপাদ-মস্তকে ।
গদগদ ভাবে প্রভু প্রভু বলি' ডাকে ॥ ১১৭ ॥

*kaṇṭakita saba aṅga āpāda-mastake |*
*gadagada bhābe prabhu prabhu bali' ḍāke || 117 ||*

*Word for word:* kantakita saba anga — his whole body bristling; apada-mastake — from head to foot; gadgada bhave — in a faltering voice; prabhu prabhu bali dake — he calls "Lord, Lord!"

**117.** His whole body bristles from head to foot;
in a faltering voice he calls: "Lord, Lord!"

ঊর্ধ্ব বাহু করি' নাচে, বোলে হরিবোল ।
জনম সফল—প্রভু পরসন্ন মোর ॥ ১১৮ ॥

*ūrdhba bāhu kari' nāce, bole haribola |*
*janama saphala—prabhu parasanna mora || 118 ||*

*Word for word:* urdhva bahu kari nache — raising his arms he dances; bole hari-bola — he cries "Hari-bol!"; janama saphala — my birth is fulfilled; prabhu parasanna mora — the Lord is pleased with me

**118.** Raising his arms he dances and cries: "Hari-bol!
My life is fulfilled — the Lord is pleased with me!"

আনন্দে ভাসয়ে চৌদিগে ভক্তজন ।
প্রভু বোলে—রাজা, হের শুনহ বচন ॥ ১১৯ ॥

*ānande bhāsaẏe caudige bhaktajana |*
*prabhu bole—rājā, hera śunaha bacana || 119 ||*

*Word for word:* anande bhasaye — float in bliss; chaudige bhaktajana — the devotees all around; prabhu bole — the Lord says; raja hera shunaha vachana — king, hear now My word

**119.** The devotees all around float in bliss.
The Lord says: "King, hear My word:

প্রজার পালন তোর এই বড় ধর্ম ।
প্রজা পুত্র, রাজা পিতা—কহিল এ মর্ম ॥ ১২০ ॥

*prajāra pālana tora ei baṛa dharma |*
*prajā putra, rājā pitā—kahila e marma || 120 ||*

*Word for word:* prajara palana — protecting the subjects; tora ei bada dharma — this is your great dharma; praja putra raja pita — the subjects are sons, the king is father; kahila e marma — I have told you its meaning

**120.** to protect your subjects is your great dharma:
the subjects are sons, the king is father — such is the essence.

কৃষ্ণের কেবল দয়া সম সর্বজীবে ।
দেহের স্বভাব নিজ জানি অনুভবে ॥ ১২১ ॥

*kṛṣṇera kebala daẏā sama sarbajībe |*
*dehera sbabhāba nija jāni anubhabe || 121 ||*

*Word for word:* krishnera kevala daya — Krishna's mercy alone; sama sarva-jive — is equal to all beings; dehera svabhava nija — the nature of one's own body; jani anubhave — knowing by experience

**121.** Only Krishna's mercy is equal to all living beings;
know by experience the nature of your own body:

কিবা রাজা কিবা প্রজা সম সুখ-দুঃখ ।
কর্ম-অনুসারে জীব হয় গৌণ-মুখ্য ॥ ১২২ ॥

*kibā rājā kibā prajā sama sukha-duḥkha |*
*karma-anusāre jība haẏa gauṇa-mukhya || 122 ||*

*Word for word:* kiba raja kiba praja — be it king or subject; sama sukha-duhkha — joy and sorrow are the same; karma-anusare — according to karma; jiva haya gauna-mukhya — a living being becomes lesser or greater

**122.** be it king or subject, joy and sorrow are the same for all;
only by karma does a living being become lesser or greater.

নিজ-অনুমান করি' যে জানে সভারে ।
সেই সে কৃষ্ণের দাস—কহিল তোমারে ॥ ১২৩ ॥

*nija-anumāna kari' ye jāne sabhāre |*
*sei se kṛṣṇera dāsa—kahila tomāre || 123 ||*

*Word for word:* nija-anumana kari — judging by himself; ye jane sabhare — who understands all others; sei se krishnera dasa — he indeed is Krishna's servant; kahila tomare — I tell you

**123.** Whoever, judging by himself, understands all others —
he indeed is Krishna's servant, I tell you"[^51-13].

এতেক উত্তর প্রভু কৈল উপদেশ ।
পরণাম করে রাজা আনন্দ-বিশেষ ॥ ১২৪ ॥

*eteka uttara prabhu kaila upadeśa |*
*paraṇāma kare rājā ānanda-biśeṣa || 124 ||*

*Word for word:* eteka uttara — such an answer; prabhu kaila upadesha — the Lord gave as instruction; paranama kare raja — the king bows; ananda-vishesha — in exceptional bliss

**124.** Such an answer the Lord gave as instruction;
the king bows in exceptional bliss.

শুন সর্বজন গোরাচাঁদের প্রকাশ ।
আনন্দে কহয়ে গুণ এ লোচনদাস ॥ ১২৫ ॥

*śuna sarbajana gorācāṁdera prakāśa |*
*ānande kahaẏe guṇa e locanadāsa || 125 ||*

*Word for word:* shuna sarvajana — hear, everyone; gorachandera prakasha — the manifestation of Gorachand; anande kahaye guna — joyfully tells [His] glories; e lochanadasa — this Lochana Dasa

**125.** Hear, everyone, of Gorachand's manifestation;
joyfully this Lochana Dasa tells His glories.

[^51-1]: Vv. 1–21 — cf. Murari 4.13 ("Mercy to the Cowherd"). In Lochana Dasa, as in Murari (4.14–4.15), the Lord goes from Vrindavana through Bengal (Kulia, Navadvipa, Shantipura) to Puri; according to the Chaitanya-charitamrita (Madhya 16–18, 25), the Lord visited Kulia and Shantipura on the way to Vrindavana and returned from Vrindavana by way of Prayaga and Kashi.
[^51-2]: Vv. 9+1 — 9+2 are found only in the 1983 edition; they are absent in the 1903 edition. The end of v. 9+1 is unclear; translated by the sense.
[^51-3]: V. 13+1 is found only in the 1983 edition; the 1903 edition gives it in a footnote as an additional reading of one printed edition.
[^51-4]: Vv. 22–69 — cf. Murari 4.14–4.15 (Kulia, the meeting with Shachi, Advaita's house, the return to Puri).
[^51-5]: "Vain" (michha) — cf. en/37, note 14. The Lord speaks as a sannyasi-teacher, addressing the whole world through His mother. Shachi's love itself is no worldly attachment: in the Gaudiya Vaishnava teaching Shachi is the Lord's eternal associate (Yashoda), and her motherly love (vatsalya-prema) is spiritual; Shachi herself answers that she knows this "maya of affection" of the Lord from the scriptures (v. 46), and the Lord admits that He is "captive to her virtues" (v. 53).
[^51-6]: "Maya" here is Shachi's motherly love, to which the Lord Himself submits (cf. v. 46).
[^51-7]: Vv. 53+1 — 53+3 are found only in the 1983 edition; the 1903 edition gives them in a footnote as an additional reading of a printed edition. The Lord reminds Shachi that she is His mother in many descents (as Kaushalya, Devaki and Yashoda, Aditi, Devahuti); in the Gaudiya Vaishnava teaching all avataras come from Krishna, who has appeared as Gaura.
[^51-8]: Cf. the Lord's farewell to Shachi in Murari (4.14).
[^51-9]: Vv. 70–125 — the mercy to Prataparudra; cf. Murari 4.16 (the king sees Gaura and Nityananda in kirtana and then, in dreams, as Krishna and Balarama). According to the Chaitanya-charitamrita (Madhya 11–14), the Lord long refused to meet the king, saying that a sannyasi should not see a king (cf. vv. 103–104), and received him during the Ratha-yatra, when the king, dressed as a simple Vaishnava, recited the Gopi-gita. Lochana Dasa's account is different.
[^51-10]: The padichha is the superintendent of the Jagannatha temple. The king sees Gaura in Jagannatha's place: Gaura is non-different from Jagannatha (cf. en/45, note 15, on the Daru-brahman; below, v. 85: "This Jagannatha is that very sannyasi-avatara").
[^51-11]: The garden (tota) is the Lord's residence in Puri; Govinda is His servant; Puri Gosani (v. 92) is Paramananda Puri. In the 1983 edition vv. 87–88 are in a different wording, one couplet longer: "There is no one in the garden… The king, beside himself, lost his senses. The king pleadingly says to Govinda: 'How may I see the Gosani's feet? Tell me the means for it, great one,' — so he says again and again."
[^51-12]: The six-armed form (shadbhuja) — by tradition, with the arms of Rama (bow and arrow), Krishna (flute) and the sannyasi (staff and water-pot). By tradition, the Lord also revealed the six-armed form to Sarvabhauma (en/45, vv. 243–245 and note 22).
[^51-13]: That is, whoever sees in others what he sees in himself — their joy and sorrow — is a true servant of Krishna.

---

# Shesha-khanda, part 7 (portion 52)

*The section "The Final Pastimes": the poor brahmana from Dravida and Vibhishana — the end of the text in Bhaktisiddhanta's edition. Chapter 4 (only in the 1983 edition): the concealment of the Lord — He enters into Jagannatha; the devotees' grief; Lochana Dasa's closing word about himself*

## The Final Pastimes (Shesha-lila)

> *Summary by Srila Bhaktisiddhanta Sarasvati.* Shortly before Sriman Mahaprabhu withdrew [from mundane sight], a poor brahmana from Dravida, tormented by want, came to Purushottama and fasted seven days to obtain the mercy of Sri Jagannatha-deva; not obtaining it, he resolved to give up his life in the ocean. Then, on the ocean shore, by providence he met Vibhishana, and Vibhishana, instructing him: "A living being experiences joy and sorrow according to the fruits of his karma; therefore one should worship Jagannatha-deva, remaining indifferent to joy and sorrow," went on his way; but the brahmana did not leave him and together with Vibhishana came to Sriman Mahaprabhu. [Mahaprabhu, having granted him wealth through Vibhishana,] instructed him in [the service of] Krishna and showed him mercy.

*Raga varadi*

আর অপরূপ কথা কহিব এখন ।
গৌরচন্দ্র-গুণগাথা নিত্যই নূতন ॥ ১ ॥

*āra aparūpa kathā kahiba ekhana |*
*gauracandra-guṇagāthā nityai nūtana || 1 ||*

*Word for word:* ara aparupa katha — another wondrous account; kahiba ekhana — I shall tell now; gaurachandra-guna-gatha — the tale of Gaurachandra's glories; nityai nutana — is ever new

**1.** I shall now tell another wondrous account:
the tale of Gaurachandra's glories is ever new[^52-1].

কহিব নিগূঢ় কথা শুন একচিত্তে ।
অধম জনের মনে না হয় প্রতীতে ॥ ২ ॥

*kahiba nigūṛha kathā śuna ekacitte |*
*adhama janera mane nā haẏa pratīte || 2 ||*

*Word for word:* kahiba nigudha katha — I shall tell a hidden account; shuna ekachitte — listen with one mind; adhama janera mane — in the minds of low people; na haya pratite — there is no belief

**2.** I shall tell something hidden — listen with one mind:
in the minds of low people there is no belief [in it],

বৈষ্ণবজনের মনে পরম উল্লাস ।
পরম নিগূঢ় গৌরচন্দ্রের প্রকাশ ॥ ৩ ॥

*baiṣṇabajanera mane parama ullāsa |*
*parama nigūṛha gauracandrera prakāśa || 3 ||*

*Word for word:* vaishnava-janera mane — in the hearts of Vaishnavas; parama ullasa — supreme joy; parama nigudha — most hidden; gaurachandrera prakasha — the manifestation of Gaurachandra

**3.** but in the hearts of Vaishnavas — supreme joy:
it is a most hidden manifestation of Gaurachandra.

দ্রাবিড়ে ব্রাহ্মণ এক আছে রাম নাম ।
পরম দুঃখিত—অঙ্গে অস্থি আর চাম ॥ ৪ ॥

*drābiṛe brāhmaṇa eka āche rāma nāma |*
*parama duḥkhita—aṅge asthi āra cāma || 4 ||*

*Word for word:* dravide brahmana eka — in Dravida a brahmana; achhe rama nama — named Rama; parama duhkhita — utterly wretched; ange asthi ara chama — on his body [only] bones and skin

**4.** In Dravida there was a brahmana named Rama,
utterly wretched: on his body only bones and skin.

অন্নকষ্টে দগ্ধ সেই জঠর-অনলে ।
রক্ত-মাংস নাহি তার শুষ্ক কলেবরে ॥ ৫ ॥

*annakaṣṭe dagdha sei jaṭhara-anale |*
*rakta-māṃsa nāhi tāra śuṣka kalebare || 5 ||*

*Word for word:* anna-kashte — through want of food; dagdha sei jathara-anale — he is burnt by the fire of hunger; rakta-mamsa nahi tara — he has no blood or flesh; shushka kalevare — in his withered body

**5.** Wasted by hunger, he is burnt by the fire of hunger;
there is no blood or flesh in his withered body.

দুরন্ত দারিদ্র্য-দুঃখ কত সহা যায় ।
মনে মনে চিন্তে বিপ্র তরণ-উপায় ॥ ৬ ॥

*duranta dāridrya-duḥkha kata sahā yāẏa |*
*mane mane cinte bipra taraṇa-upāẏa || 6 ||*

*Word for word:* duranta daridrya-duhkha — the cruel misery of poverty; kata saha yaya — how much can be borne; mane mane chinte vipra — the brahmana ponders within; tarana-upaya — a means of deliverance

**6.** How much can the cruel misery of poverty be borne?
The brahmana ponders within on a means of deliverance:

পূর্বজন্মে কৈলুঁ মুঞি অনেক অধর্ম ।
দরিদ্র হইলুঁ মুঞি সেই সব কর্ম ॥ ৭ ॥

*pūrbajanme kailuṁ muñi aneka adharma |*
*daridra hailuṁ muñi sei saba karma || 7 ||*

*Word for word:* purvajanme kailun munyi — in a former birth I did; aneka adharma — much wrong; daridra hailun munyi — I have become poor; sei saba karma — through all those deeds

**7.** "In a former birth I did much wrong —
through all those deeds I have become poor.

না ভুঞ্জিলে নাহি ঘুচে অদৃষ্ট-লিখন ।
দুরন্ত যন্ত্রণা-দুঃখ ঘুচয়ে কেমন ॥ ৮ ॥

*nā bhuñjile nāhi ghuce adṛṣṭa-likhana |*
*duranta yantraṇā-duḥkha ghucaẏe kemana || 8 ||*

*Word for word:* na bhunjile — without undergoing [the fruits]; nahi ghuche adrishta-likhana — the writing of fate is not erased; duranta yantrana-duhkha — cruel torment and misery; ghuchaye kemana — how can they end

**8.** Without undergoing [the fruits], the writing of fate is not erased —
how then can this cruel torment and misery end?"

চিন্তিতে চিন্তিতে বিপ্র পাইল প্রতিকার ।
প্রভু বিনা নারে কেহো কর্ম ঘুচাবার ॥ ৯ ॥

*cintite cintite bipra pāila pratikāra |*
*prabhu binā nāre keho karma ghucābāra || 9 ||*

*Word for word:* chintite chintite — pondering and pondering; vipra paila pratikara — the brahmana found a remedy; prabhu vina — except the Lord; nare keho karma ghuchabara — no one can remove karma

**9.** Pondering and pondering, the brahmana found a remedy:
"Except the Lord, no one can remove karma.

জগন্নাথ নীলাচলে আছয়ে সাক্ষাতে ।
তাঁর ঠাঞি যাঙ মুঞি যাচ্ঞা করিতে ॥ ১০ ॥

*jagannātha nīlācale āchaẏe sākṣāte |*
*tāṁra ṭhāñi yāṅa muñi yācñā karite || 10 ||*

*Word for word:* jagannatha nilachale — Jagannatha in Nilachala; achhaye sakshate — is present in person; tanra thanyi yanga munyi — I will go to Him; yachnya karite — to beg

**10.** Jagannatha is present in person in Nilachala —
I will go to Him to beg.

অন্নকষ্টে মরোঁ মুঞি ব্রাহ্মণ-শরীর ।
বিপ্রপ্রিয় বলি' তাঁরে বোলে সব ধীর ॥ ১১ ॥

*annakaṣṭe maroṁ muñi brāhmaṇa-śarīra |*
*biprapriẏa bali' tāṁre bole saba dhīra || 11 ||*

*Word for word:* anna-kashte maron munyi — I am dying of hunger; brahmana-sharira — in a brahmana's body; vipra-priya bali — as "fond of brahmanas"; tanre bole saba dhira — all the wise speak of Him

**11.** I, in a brahmana's body, am dying of hunger —
and all the wise call Him fond of brahmanas.

মোর দোষে মোরে যদি না করে অবধান ।
তাঁহার উপরে বধ—ত্যজিব পরাণ ॥ ১২ ॥

*mora doṣe more yadi nā kare abadhāna |*
*tāṁhāra upare badha—tyajiba parāṇa || 12 ||*

*Word for word:* mora doshe — for my fault; more yadi na kare avadhana — if He pays me no heed; tanhara upare vadha — the [sin of] killing on Him; tyajiba parana — I will give up my life

**12.** If for my fault He pays me no heed,
the [sin of] killing [a brahmana] will be on Him — I shall give up my life"[^52-2].

এইমতে অনুমানি' চলিলা ব্রাহ্মণ ।
ক্রমে ক্রমে গেলা যথা কমললোচন ॥ ১৩ ॥

*eimate anumāni' calilā brāhmaṇa |*
*krame krame gelā yathā kamalalocana || 13 ||*

*Word for word:* eimate anumani — reasoning thus; chalila brahmana — the brahmana set out; krame krame gela — gradually came; yatha kamala-lochana — to where the Lotus-eyed One is

**13.** Reasoning thus, the brahmana set out
and step by step came to where the Lotus-eyed One is.

জগন্নাথ দেখি' করে নিজ-নিবেদন ।
অন্নকষ্টে মরোঁ মুঞি দরিদ্র ব্রাহ্মণ ॥ ১৪ ॥

*jagannātha dekhi' kare nija-nibedana |*
*annakaṣṭe maroṁ muñi daridra brāhmaṇa || 14 ||*

*Word for word:* jagannatha dekhi — seeing Jagannatha; kare nija-nivedana — he makes his plea; anna-kashte maron munyi — I am dying of hunger; daridra brahmana — a poor brahmana

**14.** Seeing Jagannatha, he makes his plea:
"I, a poor brahmana, am dying of hunger.

তো বিনু নাহিক কেহো, রাখহ জীবন ।
ঘুচাও দারিদ্র্য-জ্বালা, দেহ মোরে ধন ॥ ১৫ ॥

*to binu nāhika keho, rākhaha jībana |*
*ghucāo dāridrya-jbālā, deha more dhana || 15 ||*

*Word for word:* to vinu nahika keho — there is no one but You; rakhaha jivana — save my life; ghuchao daridrya-jvala — remove the burning of poverty; deha more dhana — give me wealth

**15.** There is no one but You — save my life:
remove the burning of poverty, give me wealth."

ইহা বলি' সেদিন আছিলা সেই মনে ।
ভিক্ষায় পাইল যাহা করিল ভোজনে ॥ ১৬ ॥

*ihā bali' sedina āchilā sei mane |*
*bhikṣāẏa pāila yāhā karila bhojane || 16 ||*

*Word for word:* iha bali — saying this; sedina achhila sei mane — that day he remained in that mind; bhikshaya paila yaha — what he got as alms; karila bhojane — he ate

**16.** Saying this, he remained all that day in that mind
and ate what he received as alms.

তার পর-দিন পুনঃ করে নিবেদন ।
ঘুচাও দারিদ্র্য প্রভু, মরয়ে ব্রাহ্মণ ॥ ১৭ ॥

*tāra para-dina punaḥ kare nibedana |*
*ghucāo dāridrya prabhu, maraẏe brāhmaṇa || 17 ||*

*Word for word:* tara para-dina — on the next day; punah kare nivedana — again he pleads; ghuchao daridrya prabhu — remove my poverty, Lord; maraye brahmana — a brahmana is dying

**17.** On the next day he pleads again:
"Remove my poverty, Lord — a brahmana is dying!

প্রচুর করিয়া ধন দেহ ত আমারে ।
এ দুঃখ না পাঙ যেন আজন্ম-ভিতরে ॥ ১৮ ॥

*pracura kariẏā dhana deha ta āmāre |*
*e duḥkha nā pāṅa yena ājanma-bhitare || 18 ||*

*Word for word:* prachura kariya — in abundance; dhana deha ta amare — give me wealth; e duhkha na panga yena — that I may not suffer this misery; ajanma-bhitare — for the rest of my life

**18.** Give me wealth in abundance,
that I may not know this misery for the rest of my life.

ধন-বর মাগোঁ প্রভু, না হও বিমুখ ।
নহিলে জীবন দিব তোমার সম্মুখ ॥ ১৯ ॥

*dhana-bara māgoṁ prabhu, nā hao bimukha |*
*nahile jībana diba tomāra sammukha || 19 ||*

*Word for word:* dhana-vara magon — I beg the boon of wealth; prabhu na hao vimukha — Lord, do not turn away; nahile — otherwise; jivana diba tomara sammukha — I will give up my life before You

**19.** I beg the boon of wealth, Lord — do not turn away,
or else I will give up my life before You."

ইহা বলি' উপবাস কৈল অনুবন্ধ ।
এথা নিজ-মেলে আছে প্রভু গৌরচন্দ্র ॥ ২০ ॥

*ihā bali' upabāsa kaila anubandha |*
*ethā nija-mele āche prabhu gauracandra || 20 ||*

*Word for word:* iha bali — saying this; upavasa kaila anubandha — he began an unbroken fast; etha — meanwhile here; nija-mele achhe — among His own is; prabhu gaurachandra — Lord Gaurachandra

**20.** Saying this, he began an unbroken fast.
And here, among His own, is Lord Gaurachandra.

নিজজন-সঙ্গে বৃন্দাবন-গুণ গায় ।
আচম্বিতে খেদ উঠে প্রভুর হিয়ায় ॥ ২১ ॥

*nijajana-saṅge bṛndābana-guṇa gāẏa |*
*ācambite kheda uṭhe prabhura hiẏāẏa || 21 ||*

*Word for word:* nijajana-sange — with His own; vrindavana-guna gaya — He sings the glories of Vrindavana; achambite — suddenly; kheda uthe prabhura hiyaya — sorrow rises in the Lord's heart

**21.** With His own He sings the glories of Vrindavana —
and suddenly sorrow rises in the Lord's heart.

বিস্মিত হইয়া রহে—হিয়া ভেল আন ।
যে রসে আছিলা তাহা কৈল সমাধান ॥ ২২ ॥

*bismita haiẏā rahe—hiẏā bhela āna |*
*ye rase āchilā tāhā kaila samādhāna || 22 ||*

*Word for word:* vismita haiya rahe — He remains astonished; hiya bhela ana — His heart became otherwise; ye rase achhila — the rasa He was in; taha kaila samadhana — He brought to an end

**22.** He remains in astonishment — His heart has become otherwise;
the rasa He was in He left off.

সভার হৃদয়ে দুঃখ বিস্ময় লাগিল ।
আচম্বিতে প্রভু কেনে আনমন হৈল ॥ ২৩ ॥

*sabhāra hṛdaẏe duḥkha bismaẏa lāgila |*
*ācambite prabhu kene ānamana haila || 23 ||*

*Word for word:* sabhara hridaye — in the hearts of all; duhkha vismaya lagila — sorrow and wonder arose; achambite prabhu — why suddenly the Lord; kene anamana haila — became absent-minded

**23.** In the hearts of all — sorrow and wonder:
why has the Lord suddenly become absent-minded?

এথা তিন উপবাস করিল ব্রাহ্মণ ।
জগন্নাথ-স্থানে কিছু না পায় বচন ॥ ২৪ ॥

*ethā tina upabāsa karila brāhmaṇa |*
*jagannātha-sthāne kichu nā pāẏa bacana || 24 ||*

*Word for word:* etha — meanwhile; tina upavasa karila brahmana — the brahmana fasted three days; jagannatha-sthane — from Jagannatha; kichhu na paya vachana — he receives no word

**24.** Meanwhile the brahmana fasted three days —
and receives no word from Jagannatha.

তবে ত ব্রাহ্মণ কৈল সাত উপবাস ।
জগন্নাথদেব কিছু না করে আশ্বাস ॥ ২৫ ॥

*tabe ta brāhmaṇa kaila sāta upabāsa |*
*jagannāthadeba kichu nā kare āśbāsa || 25 ||*

*Word for word:* tabe ta brahmana — then the brahmana; kaila sata upavasa — fasted seven days; jagannatha-deva — Jagannatha-deva; kichhu na kare ashvasa — gives no assurance

**25.** Then the brahmana fasted seven days —
Jagannatha-deva gives him no comfort.

দুর্বল হইল বিপ্র ক্ষীণ উপবাসে ।
সমুদ্রে মরিব বলি' দঢ়াইল শেষে ॥ ২৬ ॥

*durbala haila bipra kṣīṇa upabāse |*
*samudre mariba bali' daṛhāila śeṣe || 26 ||*

*Word for word:* durbala haila vipra — the brahmana grew weak; kshina upavase — wasted by fasting; samudre mariba bali — "I shall die in the ocean"; dadhaila sheshe — he resolved at last

**26.** The brahmana grew weak, wasted by fasting,
and at last resolved: "I shall die in the ocean."

সমুদ্রের কূলে বিপ্র গেলা ধীরি ধীরি ।
স্থান দেহ, সমুদ্রেরে বোলে নমস্করি' ॥ ২৭ ॥

*samudrera kūle bipra gelā dhīri dhīri |*
*sthāna deha, samudrere bole namaskari' || 27 ||*

*Word for word:* samudrera kule — to the ocean shore; vipra gela dhiri dhiri — the brahmana went slowly; sthana deha — "give me a place"; samudrere bole namaskari — he says to the ocean, bowing

**27.** Slowly the brahmana went to the ocean shore
and, bowing to the ocean, says: "Give me a place."

হেনকালে দেখে এক পুরুষ বিশাল ।
সমুদ্রের মধ্যে আইসে পর্বত-আকার ॥ ২৮ ॥

*henakāle dekhe eka puruṣa biśāla |*
*samudrera madhye āise parbata-ākāra || 28 ||*

*Word for word:* henakale — at that moment; dekhe eka purusha vishala — he sees a huge person; samudrera madhye aise — coming through the midst of the ocean; parvata-akara — the size of a mountain

**28.** At that moment he sees a huge person,
the size of a mountain, coming through the midst of the ocean.

দেখিয়া ব্রাহ্মণ মনে চিন্তিতে লাগিল ।
সমুদ্রের মাঝ দিয়া এ কেবা আইল ॥ ২৯ ॥

*dekhiẏā brāhmaṇa mane cintite lāgila |*
*samudrera mājha diẏā e kebā āila || 29 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhiya — seeing; brahmana mane chintite lagila — the brahmana began to ponder; samudrera majha diya — through the midst of the ocean; e keba aila — who is this that has come

**29.** Seeing this, the brahmana began to ponder:
"Who is this coming through the midst of the ocean?"

সমুদ্রের মাঝে তার এক হাঁটু পানি ।
এই সব দেখি' বিপ্র মনে মনে গণি ॥ ২৯+১ ॥

*samudrera mājhe tāra eka hāṁṭu pāni |*
*ei saba dekhi' bipra mane mane gaṇi || 29+1 ||*

*Word for word:* samudrera majhe — in the midst of the ocean; tara eka hantu pani — the water is knee-deep for him; ei saba dekhi — seeing all this; vipra mane mane gani — the brahmana reflects within

**29+1.** In the midst of the ocean the water is knee-deep for him —
seeing all this, the brahmana reflects within[^52-3].

দেখিতে দেখিতে কূলে দেখে সেই জন ।
সামান্য মানুষ যেন হইল তখন ॥ ৩০ ॥

*dekhite dekhite kūle dekhe sei jana |*
*sāmānya mānuṣa yena haila takhana || 30 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhite dekhite — even as he looked; kule dekhe sei jana — he sees that person on the shore; samanya manusha yena — like an ordinary man; haila takhana — he became then

**30.** Even as he looked, he sees that person on the shore:
he became like an ordinary man.

বিপ্র বোলে—এই জগন্নাথ বিদ্যমান ।
সমুদ্রের মাঝে আর কাহার পয়াণ ॥ ৩১ ॥

*bipra bole—ei jagannātha bidyamāna |*
*samudrera mājhe āra kāhāra paẏāṇa || 31 ||*

*Word for word:* vipra bole — the brahmana says; ei jagannatha vidyamana — this is Jagannatha in person; samudrera majhe — through the midst of the ocean; ara kahara payana — whose else [could be] the passage

**31.** The brahmana says: "This is Jagannatha Himself in person!
Who else could pass through the midst of the ocean?"

ইহা বলি' তার পাছু গোড়াইয়া যায় ।
কথোদূর গিয়া পাছু চাহে মহাশয় ॥ ৩২ ॥

*ihā bali' tāra pāchu goṛāiẏā yāẏa |*
*kathodūra giẏā pāchu cāhe mahāśaẏa || 32 ||*

*Word for word:* iha bali — saying so; tara pachhu goraiya yaya — he runs after him; kathodura giya — after going some way; pachhu chahe mahashaya — the great one looks back

**32.** Saying so, he runs after him;
after going some way, the great one looks back

দেখিল—ব্রাহ্মণ সেই আইসে পাছে পাছে ।
কোথা যাবে বলিয়া বিপ্রেরে কিছু পুছে ॥ ৩৩ ॥

*dekhila—brāhmaṇa sei āise pāche pāche |*
*kothā yābe baliẏā biprere kichu puche || 33 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhila — he saw; brahmana sei aise pachhe pachhe — that brahmana coming behind; kotha yabe baliya — "where are you going?"; viprere kichhu puchhe — he asks the brahmana

**33.** and sees that brahmana following him.
"Where are you going?" he asks the brahmana.

ব্রাহ্মণ কহয়ে—শুন শুন মহাশয় ।
কে তুমি, কোথারে যাবে—কহ না নিশ্চয় ॥ ৩৪ ॥

*brāhmaṇa kahaẏe—śuna śuna mahāśaẏa |*
*ke tumi, kothāre yābe—kaha nā niścaẏa || 34 ||*

*Word for word:* brahmana kahaye — the brahmana says; shuna shuna mahashaya — listen, listen, great one; ke tumi — who are you; kothare yabe — where are you going; kaha na nishchaya — tell me truly

**34.** The brahmana says: "Listen, listen, great one!
Who are you, where are you going? Tell me truly.

সাত-উপবাসী আমি ব্রাহ্মণ দুর্বল ।
তোমারে দেখিনু আজি, জনম সফল ॥ ৩৫ ॥

*sāta-upabāsī āmi brāhmaṇa durbala |*
*tomāre dekhinu āji, janama saphala || 35 ||*

*Word for word:* sata-upavasi ami — I have fasted seven days; brahmana durbala — a weakened brahmana; tomare dekhinu aji — today I have seen you; janama saphala — my life is fulfilled

**35.** I am a weakened brahmana; I have fasted seven days;
today I have seen you — my life is fulfilled.

নিশ্চয় করিয়া কহ, না ভাঁড়িহ মোরে ।
নহে বা ব্রাহ্মণ-বধ লাগিব তোমারে ॥ ৩৬ ॥

*niścaẏa kariẏā kaha, nā bhāṁṛiha more |*
*nahe bā brāhmaṇa-badha lāgiba tomāre || 36 ||*

*Word for word:* nishchaya kariya kaha — tell me for certain; na bhandiha more — do not deceive me; nahe va — or else; brahmana-vadha lagiba tomare — the [sin of] killing a brahmana will cling to you

**36.** Tell me for certain, do not deceive me,
or else the [sin of] killing a brahmana will be on you."

এ বোল শুনিঞা তবে বোলে মহাজন ।
আমা জানিবারে তোমার কি কাজ যতন ॥ ৩৭ ॥

*e bola śuniñā tabe bole mahājana |*
*āmā jānibāre tomāra ki kāja yatana || 37 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuninya — hearing this; tabe bole mahajana — then the great one says; ama janibare — to know me; tomara ki kaja yatana — what need have you to strive

**37.** Hearing this, the great one says:
"What need have you to strive to know me?

যে হই সে হই আমি, তোর কিবা দায় ।
কেনে উপবাসী মর দুরন্ত হিয়ায় ॥ ৩৮ ॥

*ye hai se hai āmi, tora kibā dāẏa |*
*kene upabāsī mara duranta hiẏāẏa || 38 ||*

*Word for word:* ye hai se hai ami — whoever I may be; tora kiba daya — what concern is it of yours; kene upavasi mara — why do you die fasting; duranta hiyaya — with a desperate heart

**38.** Whoever I may be — what concern is it of yours?
Why do you die fasting with a desperate heart?"

ব্রাহ্মণ কহয়ে—দুঃখ-দারিদ্র্যের জ্বরে ।
জর্জর করিল মোর সব কলেবরে ॥ ৩৯ ॥

*brāhmaṇa kahaẏe—duḥkha-dāridryera jbare |*
*jarjara karila mora saba kalebare || 39 ||*

*Word for word:* brahmana kahaye — the brahmana says; duhkha-daridryera jvare — the fever of misery and poverty; jarjara karila — has wasted; mora saba kalevare — my whole body

**39.** The brahmana says: "The fever of misery and poverty
has wasted my whole body.

ব্রাহ্মণের ধরম নাহিক আমা ছারে ।
এ দিবা-রজনী যায় অন্ন-হাহাকারে ॥ ৪০ ॥

*brāhmaṇera dharama nāhika āmā chāre |*
*e dibā-rajanī yāẏa anna-hāhākāre || 40 ||*

*Word for word:* brahmanera dharama — a brahmana's duties; nahika ama chhare — wretched me cannot keep; e diva-rajani yaya — day and night pass; anna-hahakare — in wailing for food

**40.** A brahmana's duties wretched me cannot keep:
day and night pass in wailing for food.

নিজকুলে আদর নাহিক কোনখানে ।
না জানিয়ে কোন্ ঠাঞি নাহি অপমানে ॥ ৪১ ॥

*nijakule ādara nāhika konakhāne |*
*nā jāniẏe kon ṭhāñi nāhi apamāne || 41 ||*

*Word for word:* nija-kule adara nahika — in my own family there is no regard; konakhane — anywhere; na janiye kon thanyi — I know no place; nahi apamane — where there is no insult

**41.** In my own family I find no regard anywhere;
I know no place where I am not insulted.

জীবন-অধিক সে মরণ ভালবাসি ।
কহিল তোমারে তেঞি মরোঁ উপবাসী ॥ ৪২ ॥

*jībana-adhika se maraṇa bhālabāsi |*
*kahila tomāre teñi maroṁ upabāsī || 42 ||*

*Word for word:* jivana-adhika — more than life; se marana bhalabasi — I love death; kahila tomare — I tell you; tenyi maron upavasi — that is why I die fasting

**42.** I love death more than life —
I tell you: that is why I am dying by fasting."

এ বোল শুনিঞা চিত্ত দ্রবে মহাজন ।
বিভীষণ নাম মোর—শুনহ ব্রাহ্মণ ॥ ৪৩ ॥

*e bola śuniñā citta drabe mahājana |*
*bibhīṣaṇa nāma mora—śunaha brāhmaṇa || 43 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuninya — hearing this; chitta drave mahajana — the great one's heart melts; vibhishana nama mora — my name is Vibhishana; shunaha brahmana — listen, brahmana

**43.** Hearing this, the great one's heart melted:
"My name is Vibhishana; listen, brahmana.

দেখিবারে যাই জগন্নাথের চরণ ।
কর্মদোষে দুঃখ পাও, শুনহ ব্রাহ্মণ ॥ ৪৪ ॥

*dekhibāre yāi jagannāthera caraṇa |*
*karmadoṣe duḥkha pāo, śunaha brāhmaṇa || 44 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhibare yai — I go to see; jagannathera charana — Jagannatha's feet; karma-doshe duhkha pao — you suffer through the fault of karma; shunaha brahmana — listen, brahmana

**44.** I am going to see Jagannatha's feet.
You suffer through the fault of your karma; listen, brahmana.

কর্মবন্ধে বন্দী লোক সুখ-দুঃখ লাভ ।
ভুঞ্জিলে সে ঘুচে সেই কর্ম-পুণ্য-পাপ ॥ ৪৫ ॥

*karmabandhe bandī loka sukha-duḥkha lābha |*
*bhuñjile se ghuce sei karma-puṇya-pāpa || 45 ||*

*Word for word:* karma-bandhe bandi loka — people bound in the fetters of karma; sukha-duhkha labha — receive joy and sorrow; bhunjile se ghuche — only by undergoing it is ended; sei karma-punya-papa — that karma, pious and sinful

**45.** People bound in the fetters of karma receive joy and sorrow;
only by undergoing them is that karma, pious and sinful, ended.

জগন্নাথ-মুখ দেখ করিয়া পিরীত ।
জন্মান্তরে নহে যেন দুঃখ-উপনীত ॥ ৪৬ ॥

*jagannātha-mukha dekha kariẏā pirīta |*
*janmāntare nahe yena duḥkha-upanīta || 46 ||*

*Word for word:* jagannatha-mukha dekha — look on Jagannatha's face; kariya pirita — with love; janmantare nahe yena — that in another birth there may not be; duhkha-upanita — misery coming upon you

**46.** Look with love on Jagannatha's face,
that in another birth too misery may not befall you."

ইহা বলি' চলিলেন রাজা বিভীষণ ।
পাছে পাছে যায় তবু দরিদ্র ব্রাহ্মণ ॥ ৪৭ ॥

*ihā bali' calilena rājā bibhīṣaṇa |*
*pāche pāche yāẏa tabu daridra brāhmaṇa || 47 ||*

*Word for word:* iha bali — saying this; chalilena raja vibhishana — King Vibhishana went on; pachhe pachhe yaya tabu — yet behind him goes; daridra brahmana — the poor brahmana

**47.** Saying this, King Vibhishana went on,
yet the poor brahmana still follows behind him.

বসি' আছে গোরাচাঁদ নিজজন-মেলে ।
দুয়ারে কে আছে দেখ, গোবিন্দেরে বোলে ॥ ৪৮ ॥

*basi' āche gorācāṁda nijajana-mele |*
*duẏāre ke āche dekha, gobindere bole || 48 ||*

*Word for word:* basi achhe gorachanda — Gorachand is sitting; nijajana-mele — among His own; duyare ke achhe dekha — see who is at the door; govindere bole — He says to Govinda

**48.** Gorachand is sitting among His own;
He says to Govinda: "See who is at the door."

দুয়ারে দাঁড়াঞা আছে বিভীষণ রায় ।
ব্রাহ্মণ দেখিয়া অঙ্গুলি দিল নাসিকায় ॥ ৪৯ ॥

*duẏāre dāṁṛāñā āche bibhīṣaṇa rāẏa |*
*brāhmaṇa dekhiẏā aṅguli dila nāsikāẏa || 49 ||*

*Word for word:* duyare dadanya achhe — at the door stands; vibhishana raya — King Vibhishana; brahmana dekhiya — seeing the brahmana; anguli dila nasikaya — he put a finger to his nose

**49.** At the door stands King Vibhishana;
seeing the brahmana, he put a finger to his nose[^52-4].

হেনকালে গেলা গোবিন্দ টোটার দুয়ার ।
দেখিল দুয়ারে দুই ব্রাহ্মণ-কুমার ॥ ৫০ ॥

*henakāle gelā gobinda ṭoṭāra duẏāra |*
*dekhila duẏāre dui brāhmaṇa-kumāra || 50 ||*

*Word for word:* henakale — at that moment; gela govinda totara duyara — Govinda went to the garden gate; dekhila duyare — he saw at the gate; dui brahmana-kumara — two young brahmanas

**50.** At that moment Govinda went to the garden gate
and saw at the gate two young brahmanas.

দেখিয়া গোবিন্দ গেলা প্রভু-বিদ্যমান ।
কিছু না কহিতে ডাকে ব্রাহ্মণ দুইজন ॥ ৫১ ॥

*dekhiẏā gobinda gelā prabhu-bidyamāna |*
*kichu nā kahite ḍāke brāhmaṇa duijana || 51 ||*

*Word for word:* dekhiya — seeing them; govinda gela prabhu-vidyamana — Govinda went before the Lord; kichhu na kahite — before he said anything; dake brahmana duijana — [the Lord] calls the two brahmanas

**51.** Seeing them, Govinda went to the Lord,
but before he could say anything, [the Lord] calls the two brahmanas.

আইস আইস বলি' হাসি' সম্ভাষে ঠাকুর ।
একে বসাইল পাশে, আর রহে দূর ॥ ৫২ ॥

*āisa āisa bali' hāsi' sambhāṣe ṭhākura |*
*eke basāila pāśe, āra rahe dūra || 52 ||*

*Word for word:* aisa aisa bali — saying "come, come"; hasi sambhashe thakura — the Thakura greets them smiling; eke basaila pashe — He seated one beside Him; ara rahe dura — the other stays at a distance

**52.** "Come in, come in!" the Thakura greets them with a smile;
He seated one beside Him, while the other stays at a distance.

সব ছাড়ি' প্রভু তারে সম্ভাষে আদরে ।
কাছে যত ছিল বিস্ময় লাগিল সভারে ॥ ৫৩ ॥

*saba chāṛi' prabhu tāre sambhāṣe ādare |*
*kāche yata chila bismaẏa lāgila sabhāre || 53 ||*

*Word for word:* saba chhadi — leaving everything; prabhu tare sambhashe adare — the Lord converses with him with honour; kachhe yata chhila — all who were near; vismaya lagila sabhare — all were amazed

**53.** Leaving everything, the Lord converses with him with honour;
all who were near were amazed.

ঠাকুর কহয়ে—চিরদিনে দরশন ।
অনুরাগে দোঁহাকার ঝরয়ে নয়ন ॥ ৫৪ ॥

*ṭhākura kahaẏe—ciradine daraśana |*
*anurāge doṁhākāra jharaẏe naẏana || 54 ||*

*Word for word:* thakura kahaye — the Thakura says; chiradine darashana — we meet after a long time; anurage — in love; donhakara jharaye nayana — tears flow from the eyes of both

**54.** The Thakura says: "We meet after a long time!" —
and tears of love flow from the eyes of both.

হস্ত দিয়া অঙ্গ পরশয়ে তাহার ।
কুশল কুশল পুছে ইঙ্গিত-আকার ॥ ৫৫ ॥

*hasta diẏā aṅga paraśaẏe tāhāra |*
*kuśala kuśala puche iṅgita-ākāra || 55 ||*

*Word for word:* hasta diya — with His hand; anga parashaye tahara — He touches his body; kushala kushala puchhe — He asks "are you well?"; ingita-akara — by signs and looks

**55.** He touches his body with His hand
and by signs asks: "Are you well?"

সে দোঁহার কথা আর না বুঝয়ে কেহো ।
গৌরচন্দ্র বোলে—বিপ্র দুঃখিত বড় এহো ॥ ৫৬ ॥

*se doṁhāra kathā āra nā bujhaẏe keho |*
*gauracandra bole—bipra duḥkhita baṛa eho || 56 ||*

*Word for word:* se donhara katha — the talk of those two; ara na bujhaye keho — no one else understands; gaurachandra bole — Gaurachandra says; vipra duhkhita bada eho — this brahmana is very wretched

**56.** No one else understands the talk of those two.
Gaurachandra says: "This brahmana is very wretched.

দারিদ্র্য-জ্বালায় জ্ঞান হরিল ইহার ।
জগন্নাথ-উপরে এ করয়ে প্রহার ॥ ৫৭ ॥

*dāridrya-jbālāẏa jñāna harila ihāra |*
*jagannātha-upare e karaẏe prahāra || 57 ||*

*Word for word:* daridrya-jvalaya — the burning of poverty; jnana harila ihara — has robbed him of reason; jagannatha-upare — on Jagannatha; e karaye prahara — he makes an attack

**57.** The burning of poverty has robbed him of reason:
he is attacking Jagannatha.

আপনার দোষ জীব না দেখয়ে কিছু ।
আপনি করিয়া দোষ প্রভুরে দোষে পাছু ॥ ৫৮ ॥

*āpanāra doṣa jība nā dekhaẏe kichu |*
*āpani kariẏā doṣa prabhure doṣe pāchu || 58 ||*

*Word for word:* apanara dosha — its own fault; jiva na dekhaye kichhu — the living being does not see at all; apani kariya dosha — having itself done wrong; prabhure doshe pachhu — afterwards blames the Lord

**58.** A living being does not see its own fault at all:
having done wrong itself, it afterwards blames the Lord.

আপনে করয়ে নিজ ভাল-মন্দ বলি' ।
ভুঞ্জিবার বেলে দোষ প্রভুর উপরি ॥ ৫৯ ॥

*āpane karaẏe nija bhāla-manda bali' |*
*bhuñjibāra bele doṣa prabhura upari || 59 ||*

*Word for word:* apane karaye — it does itself; nija bhala-manda bali — its own good and evil; bhunjibara bele — when the time comes to reap; dosha prabhura upari — the blame is on the Lord

**59.** It does its own good and evil itself —
and when the time comes to reap, it blames the Lord.

সুখ সে ভুঞ্জিতে গুণ কহে আপনার ।
প্রভুরে দোষয়ে দোষ-দুঃখ ভুঞ্জিবার ॥ ৬০ ॥

*sukha se bhuñjite guṇa kahe āpanāra |*
*prabhure doṣaẏe doṣa-duḥkha bhuñjibāra || 60 ||*

*Word for word:* sukha se bhunjite — when enjoying happiness; guna kahe apanara — it speaks of its own merit; prabhure doshaye — it blames the Lord; dosha-duhkha bhunjibara — when reaping evil and sorrow

**60.** When enjoying happiness, it speaks of its own merit,
but when reaping evil and sorrow, it blames the Lord.

সাত-উপবাসে বিপ্র মৃত্যু কৈল সার ।
বিপ্রপ্রিয় জগন্নাথ কি করিব আর ॥ ৬১ ॥

*sāta-upabāse bipra mṛtyu kaila sāra |*
*biprapriẏa jagannātha ki kariba āra || 61 ||*

*Word for word:* sata-upavase — by a seven-day fast; vipra mrityu kaila sara — the brahmana made death his choice; vipra-priya jagannatha — Jagannatha, fond of brahmanas; ki kariba ara — what else could He do

**61.** By a seven-day fast the brahmana chose death —
what else could Jagannatha, fond of brahmanas, do?

তোমার দর্শনে ইহার ঘুচিল দারিদ্র্য ।
ধন দেহ—যেন হয় ধনের সমুদ্র ॥ ৬২ ॥

*tomāra darśane ihāra ghucila dāridrya |*
*dhana deha—yena haẏa dhanera samudra || 62 ||*

*Word for word:* tomara darshane — by seeing you; ihara ghuchila daridrya — his poverty is ended; dhana deha — give [him] wealth; yena haya dhanera samudra — so that it becomes an ocean of riches

**62.** By seeing you his poverty is ended:
give him wealth — let it become an ocean of riches."

ভাল ভাল বলি' তেঁহো উঠিলা সত্বর ।
যে ছিল সেখানে সবে পড়িলা ফাঁপর ॥ ৬৩ ॥

*bhāla bhāla bali' teṁho uṭhilā satbara |*
*ye chila sekhāne sabe paṛilā phāṁpara || 63 ||*

*Word for word:* bhala bhala bali — saying "good, good"; tenho uthila satvara — he quickly rose; ye chhila sekhane — all who were there; sabe padila phanpara — were bewildered

**63.** "Good, good," he said and quickly rose;
all who were there were bewildered.

দণ্ডবত করি' তারা চলে দুইজন ।
পথে যাইতে বিভীষণে পুছয়ে ব্রাহ্মণ ॥ ৬৪ ॥

*daṇḍabata kari' tārā cale duijana |*
*pathe yāite bibhīṣaṇe puchaẏe brāhmaṇa || 64 ||*

*Word for word:* dandavata kari — bowing down; tara chale duijana — the two go off; pathe yaite — on the way; vibhishane puchhaye brahmana — the brahmana asks Vibhishana

**64.** Bowing down, the two go off;
on the way the brahmana asks Vibhishana:

তুমি বোল—আমি সেই রাজা বিভীষণ ।
সন্ন্যাসীরে নমস্করি' চলিলা এখন ॥ ৬৫ ॥

*tumi bola—āmi sei rājā bibhīṣaṇa |*
*sannyāsīre namaskari' calilā ekhana || 65 ||*

*Word for word:* tumi bola — you say; ami sei raja vibhishana — "I am that King Vibhishana"; sannyasire namaskari — bowing to the sannyasi; chalila ekhana — you are now leaving

**65.** "You say: 'I am that King Vibhishana,' —
and now you are leaving, having bowed to a sannyasi.

জগন্নাথদেব তুমি না দেখিলে কেনে ।
স্বরূপ করিয়া কহ দুঃখিত ব্রাহ্মণে ॥ ৬৬ ॥

*jagannāthadeba tumi nā dekhile kene |*
*sbarūpa kariẏā kaha duḥkhita brāhmaṇe || 66 ||*

*Word for word:* jagannatha-deva — Jagannatha-deva; tumi na dekhile kene — why did you not see; svarupa kariya kaha — tell the truth; duhkhita brahmane — to the wretched brahmana

**66.** Why did you not see Jagannatha-deva?
Tell the truth to a wretched brahmana.

সন্ন্যাসীর আজ্ঞা তুমি কৈলে শিরঃপরি ।
সন্ন্যাসী বা কে বা, কহ—না কর চাতুরী ॥ ৬৭ ॥

*sannyāsīra ājñā tumi kaile śiraḥpari |*
*sannyāsī bā ke bā, kaha—nā kara cāturī || 67 ||*

*Word for word:* sannyasira ajna — the sannyasi's order; tumi kaile shirah-pari — you placed on your head (obeyed); sannyasi va ke va kaha — tell me, who is this sannyasi; na kara chaturi — do not be clever

**67.** You placed the sannyasi's order on your head —
tell me, who is this sannyasi? Do not be clever."

রাজা কহে—শুন আরে অবোধ ব্রাহ্মণ ।
জগন্নাথ দেখ এই সাক্ষাৎ নয়ন ॥ ৬৮ ॥

*rājā kahe—śuna āre abodha brāhmaṇa |*
*jagannātha dekha ei sākṣāt naẏana || 68 ||*

*Word for word:* raja kahe — the king says; shuna are abodha brahmana — listen, you foolish brahmana; jagannatha dekha — you have seen Jagannatha; ei sakshat nayana — here, with your own eyes

**68.** The king says: "Listen, foolish brahmana:
you have seen Jagannatha with your own eyes.

তোমার অভীষ্ট সিদ্ধ, ধন পাইলে তুমি ।
দ্রাবিড়ে তোমারে ধন দিব লঞা আমি ॥ ৬৯ ॥

*tomāra abhīṣṭa siddha, dhana pāile tumi |*
*drābiṛe tomāre dhana diba lañā āmi || 69 ||*

*Word for word:* tomara abhishta siddha — your desire is fulfilled; dhana paile tumi — you have received wealth; dravide tomare — in Dravida to you; dhana diba lanya ami — I will bring and give the wealth

**69.** Your desire is fulfilled — you have received wealth:
I shall bring you the wealth in Dravida."

এ বোল শুনিঞা বিপ্র শিরে হানে ঘা ।
আরতি করিয়া ধরে বিভীষণের পা ॥ ৭০ ॥

*e bola śuniñā bipra śire hāne ghā |*
*ārati kariẏā dhare bibhīṣaṇera pā || 70 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuninya — hearing this; vipra shire hane gha — the brahmana strikes his head; arati kariya — in anguish; dhare vibhishanera pa — he clasps Vibhishana's feet

**70.** Hearing this, the brahmana strikes his head
and in anguish clasps Vibhishana's feet:

পুনঃ চল যাই সেই প্রভু-বরাবরে ।
অজ্ঞান ব্রাহ্মণ মুঞি, কহোঁ মো তোমারে ॥ ৭১ ॥

*punaḥ cala yāi sei prabhu-barābare |*
*ajñāna brāhmaṇa muñi, kahoṁ mo tomāre || 71 ||*

*Word for word:* punah chala yai — let us go again; sei prabhu-barabare — before that Lord; ajnana brahmana munyi — I am an ignorant brahmana; kahon mo tomare — I tell you

**71.** "Let us go again before that Lord!
I am an ignorant brahmana — I tell you."

অনেক যতন কৈল এড়াইতে নারি ।
পুনঃ লেউটিয়া যায় প্রভু-বরাবরি ॥ ৭২ ॥

*aneka yatana kaila eṛāite nāri |*
*punaḥ leuṭiẏā yāẏa prabhu-barābari || 72 ||*

*Word for word:* aneka yatana kaila — [Vibhishana] tried hard; edaite nari — but could not get away; punah leutiya yaya — they go back again; prabhu-barabari — to the Lord

**72.** [Vibhishana] tried hard but could not get away from him,
and they go back again to the Lord.

প্রভুর সম্মুখে গেলা অন্তরে তরাস ।
পুনঃ দোঁহা দেখি' প্রভুর উপজিল হাস ॥ ৭৩ ॥

*prabhura sammukhe gelā antare tarāsa |*
*punaḥ doṁhā dekhi' prabhura upajila hāsa || 73 ||*

*Word for word:* prabhura sammukhe gela — they came before the Lord; antare tarasa — with fear at heart; punah donha dekhi — seeing the two again; prabhura upajila hasa — the Lord laughed

**73.** With fear at heart they came before the Lord;
seeing the two again, the Lord laughed.

প্রভু বোলে—লেউটিয়া আইলা কি কারণে ।
রাজা কহে—যে কারণ পুছহ ব্রাহ্মণে ॥ ৭৪ ॥

*prabhu bole—leuṭiẏā āilā ki kāraṇe |*
*rājā kahe—ye kāraṇa puchaha brāhmaṇe || 74 ||*

*Word for word:* prabhu bole — the Lord says; leutiya aila ki karane — why have you come back; raja kahe — the king says; ye karana puchhaha brahmane — ask the brahmana the reason

**74.** The Lord says: "Why have you come back?"
The king says: "Ask the brahmana the reason."

ব্রাহ্মণ কহয়ে—গোসাঞি, আমি ত অবুধ ।
কত কত জীব আছে অর্বুদ অর্বুদ ॥ ৭৫ ॥

*brāhmaṇa kahaẏe—gosāñi, āmi ta abudha |*
*kata kata jība āche arbuda arbuda || 75 ||*

*Word for word:* brahmana kahaye — the brahmana says; gosani ami ta abudha — Gosani, I am ignorant; kata kata jiva achhe — how many living beings there are; arbuda arbuda — countless millions

**75.** The brahmana says: "Gosani, I am ignorant.
How many living beings there are — countless millions —

সভাকার প্রাণ তুমি সভাকার নাথ ।
তো বহি নাহিক কেহো—তুমি জগন্নাথ ॥ ৭৬ ॥

*sabhākāra prāṇa tumi sabhākāra nātha |*
*to bahi nāhika keho—tumi jagannātha || 76 ||*

*Word for word:* sabhakara prana tumi — You are the life of all; sabhakara natha — the Lord of all; to bahi nahika keho — there is no one but You; tumi jagannatha — You are Jagannatha

**76.** You are the life of all, You are the Lord of all,
there is no one but You: You are Jagannatha.

আমি মহাধম ছার মহা-অপরাধী ।
নিজকর্ম-দোষে মোর দারিদ্র্য-রোগ-ব্যাধি ॥ ৭৭ ॥

*āmi mahādhama chāra mahā-aparādhī |*
*nijakarma-doṣe mora dāridrya-roga-byādhi || 77 ||*

*Word for word:* ami mahadhama chhara — I am the lowest, wretched; maha-aparadhi — a great offender; nija-karma-doshe — through the fault of my own karma; mora daridrya-roga-vyadhi — I have the disease of poverty

**77.** I am the lowest of the low, wretched, a great offender:
through the fault of my karma I have the disease of poverty.

ব্যাধি-পীড়ায়ে মো কুপথ্যে করোঁ আশা ।
ঔষধ না রুচে মুখে, কুপথ্যে প্রত্যাশা ॥ ৭৮ ॥

*byādhi-pīṛāẏe mo kupathye karoṁ āśā |*
*auṣadha nā ruce mukhe, kupathye pratyāśā || 78 ||*

*Word for word:* vyadhi-pidaye — tormented by the disease; mo kupathye karon asha — I long for harmful food; aushadha na ruche mukhe — the medicine is not to my taste; kupathye pratyasha — I crave the harmful

**78.** Tormented by the disease, I long for harmful food:
the medicine is not to my taste; I crave what is harmful.

বুঝিয়া ঔষধ দেহ, তুমি ধন্বন্তরি ।
কর্মদোষে ভব-ব্যাধে আমি ছার মরি ॥ ৭৯ ॥

*bujhiẏā auṣadha deha, tumi dhanbantari |*
*karmadoṣe bhaba-byādhe āmi chāra mari || 79 ||*

*Word for word:* bujhiya aushadha deha — give the medicine with understanding; tumi dhanvantari — You are Dhanvantari; karma-doshe — through the fault of karma; bhava-vyadhe ami chhara mari — wretched I am dying of the disease of worldly existence

**79.** Give me the medicine with understanding — You are Dhanvantari:
through the fault of karma, wretched I am dying of the disease of worldly existence."

এ বোল শুনিয়া প্রভু হাসিতে লাগিলা ।
জগন্নাথদেব তোমার সব ভাল কৈলা ॥ ৮০ ॥

*e bola śuniẏā prabhu hāsite lāgilā |*
*jagannāthadeba tomāra saba bhāla kailā || 80 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuniya — hearing this; prabhu hasite lagila — the Lord began to laugh; jagannatha-deva — Jagannatha-deva; tomara saba bhala kaila — has made all well for you

**80.** Hearing this, the Lord began to laugh:
"Jagannatha-deva has made all well for you.

আগে ত ঈপ্সিত তুমি ভুঞ্জিবে এখন ।
শেষকালে পাবে জগন্নাথের চরণ ॥ ৮১ ॥

*āge ta īpsita tumi bhuñjibe ekhana |*
*śeṣakāle pābe jagannāthera caraṇa || 81 ||*

*Word for word:* age ta ipsita — first what you desired; tumi bhunjibe ekhana — you will enjoy now; shesha-kale — at the end; pabe jagannathera charana — you will attain Jagannatha's feet

**81.** First you will now enjoy what you desired,
and at the end you will attain Jagannatha's feet"[^52-5].

এ বোল বলিতে বিপ্র দণ্ডবত করে ।
চৌদিগে সকল লোক হরি হরি বোলে ॥ ৮২ ॥

*e bola balite bipra daṇḍabata kare |*
*caudige sakala loka hari hari bole || 82 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola balite — as this was said; vipra dandavata kare — the brahmana prostrates; chaudige sakala loka — all the people around; hari hari bole — cry "Hari, Hari!"

**82.** As this was said, the brahmana prostrates;
all the people around cry: "Hari, Hari!"

শুন সর্বজন হের অপূর্ব কথন ।
বর পাঞা চলি' গেলা দরিদ্র ব্রাহ্মণ ॥ ৮৩ ॥

*śuna sarbajana hera apūrba kathana |*
*bara pāñā cali' gelā daridra brāhmaṇa || 83 ||*

*Word for word:* shuna sarvajana — hear, everyone; hera apurva kathana — this wonderful account; vara panya — receiving the boon; chali gela daridra brahmana — the poor brahmana went away

**83.** Hear, everyone, this wonderful account:
having received the boon, the poor brahmana went away.

হরিষে হইলা দোঁহে বাড়ীর বাহির ।
ভক্তজন প্রভুরে পুছয়ে ধীরে ধীর ॥ ৮৪ ॥

*hariṣe hailā doṁhe bāṛīra bāhira |*
*bhaktajana prabhure puchaẏe dhīre dhīra || 84 ||*

*Word for word:* harishe haila donhe — joyfully the two went; badira bahira — out of the house; bhaktajana prabhure — the devotees the Lord; puchhaye dhire dhira — ask softly

**84.** Joyfully the two went out of the house;
the devotees softly question the Lord.

পুরীগোসাঞি বোলে—প্রভু, দয়া কর যদি ।
ইহার কারণ কহ, সভে কর শুদ্ধি ॥ ৮৫ ॥

*purīgosāñi bole—prabhu, daẏā kara yadi |*
*ihāra kāraṇa kaha, sabhe kara śuddhi || 85 ||*

*Word for word:* puri-gosani bole — Puri Gosani says; prabhu daya kara yadi — Lord, if You are kind; ihara karana kaha — tell us the meaning of this; sabhe kara shuddhi — purify us all

**85.** Puri Gosani says: "Lord, if You are kind,
tell us the meaning of this; purify us all."

সুধাইতে নারে কেহো, মনে বড় ইচ্ছা ।
সাহস করিয়া মুঞি সুধাইল পিছা ॥ ৮৬ ॥

*sudhāite nāre keho, mane baṛa icchā |*
*sāhasa kariẏā muñi sudhāila pichā || 86 ||*

*Word for word:* sudhaite nare keho — no one dares to ask; mane bada ichchha — though the desire is great; sahasa kariya munyi — daring, I; sudhaila pichha — asked afterwards

**86.** No one dares to ask, though the desire is great —
and I, daring, asked afterwards[^52-6].

ঠাকুর কহয়ে—শুন শুনহ গোসাঞি ।
এ কথা তোমরা সভে কিছু বুঝ নাঞি ॥ ৮৭ ॥

*ṭhākura kahaẏe—śuna śunaha gosāñi |*
*e kathā tomarā sabhe kichu bujha nāñi || 87 ||*

*Word for word:* thakura kahaye — the Thakura says; shuna shunaha gosani — listen, listen, Gosani; e katha tomara sabhe — this matter you all; kichhu bujha nanyi — have not understood at all

**87.** The Thakura says: "Listen, listen, Gosani:
none of you has understood this at all.

দ্রাবিড়ে আছিল এই দরিদ্র ব্রাহ্মণ ।
অনেক যন্ত্রণা-দুঃখ পাঞাছে তখন ॥ ৮৮ ॥

*drābiṛe āchila ei daridra brāhmaṇa |*
*aneka yantraṇā-duḥkha pāñāche takhana || 88 ||*

*Word for word:* dravide achhila — there lived in Dravida; ei daridra brahmana — this poor brahmana; aneka yantrana-duhkha — much torment and misery; panyachhe takhana — he suffered then

**88.** This poor brahmana lived in Dravida
and suffered much torment and misery there.

দারিদ্র্য-জ্বালায় দগ্ধ আইল এই দেশে ।
জগন্নাথ-উপরে প্রহার করে শেষে ॥ ৮৯ ॥

*dāridrya-jbālāẏa dagdha āila ei deśe |*
*jagannātha-upare prahāra kare śeṣe || 89 ||*

*Word for word:* daridrya-jvalaya dagdha — burnt by the fire of poverty; aila ei deshe — he came to this land; jagannatha-upare — on Jagannatha; prahara kare sheshe — at last he made an attack

**89.** Burnt by the fire of poverty he came to this land
and at last attacked Jagannatha.

দুঃখিত দেখিয়া তুষ্ট হৈলা জগন্নাথ ।
আচম্বিতে বিভীষণ-সনে হৈল সাথ ॥ ৯০ ॥

*duḥkhita dekhiẏā tuṣṭa hailā jagannātha |*
*ācambite bibhīṣaṇa-sane haila sātha || 90 ||*

*Word for word:* duhkhita dekhiya — seeing [him] wretched; tushta haila jagannatha — Jagannatha was gracious; achambite — unexpectedly; vibhishana-sane haila satha — [he] met with Vibhishana

**90.** Seeing him wretched, Jagannatha was gracious —
and unexpectedly he met with Vibhishana.

বিভীষণ এই যে বসিল মোর পাশে ।
ধন-দান কৈল তেঁহো ব্রাহ্মণ-সন্তোষে ॥ ৯১ ॥

*bibhīṣaṇa ei ye basila mora pāśe |*
*dhana-dāna kaila teṁho brāhmaṇa-santoṣe || 91 ||*

*Word for word:* vibhishana ei ye — this is Vibhishana, who; basila mora pashe — sat beside Me; dhana-dana kaila tenho — he gave wealth; brahmana-santoshe — to the brahmana's satisfaction

**91.** It was Vibhishana who sat beside Me:
he gave the wealth, to the brahmana's satisfaction."

এ বোল শুনিয়া সর্বজনের উল্লাস ।
প্রেমায় ভাসিল সব এ ভূমি-আকাশ ॥ ৯২ ॥

*e bola śuniẏā sarbajanera ullāsa |*
*premāẏa bhāsila saba e bhūmi-ākāśa || 92 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuniya — hearing this; sarvajanera ullasa — all rejoiced; premaya bhasila — were flooded with prema; saba e bhumi-akasha — all this earth and sky

**92.** Hearing this, all rejoiced;
all this earth and sky were flooded with prema.

সর্বজন নাচে, সভে বোলে হরিবোল ।
আনন্দে সভাই সভে ধরি' দেই কোল ॥ ৯৩ ॥

*sarbajana nāce, sabhe bole haribola |*
*ānande sabhāi sabhe dhari' dei kola || 93 ||*

*Word for word:* sarvajana nache — all dance; sabhe bole hari-bola — all cry "Hari-bol!"; anande sabhai sabhe — in joy all one another; dhari dei kola — embrace

**93.** All dance, all cry: "Hari-bol!" —
and in joy all embrace one another.

শুন সর্বজন গোরাচাঁদের প্রকাশ ।
শেষখণ্ড সায় কহে এ লোচনদাস ॥ ৯৪ ॥

*śuna sarbajana gorācāṁdera prakāśa |*
*śeṣakhaṇḍa sāẏa kahe e locanadāsa || 94 ||*

*Word for word:* shuna sarvajana — hear, everyone; gorachandera prakasha — the manifestation of Gorachand; shesha-khanda saya — [thus] ends the Shesha-khanda; kahe e lochanadasa — says this Lochana Dasa

**94.** Hear, everyone, of Gorachand's manifestation;
thus ends the Shesha-khanda, says this Lochana Dasa[^52-7].

## The Concealment of the Lord (chapter 4)

*Raga dhanashi; disha: "O Lord, glory, glory to Gaurangachand! He has caught the minds of living beings in the net of prema"*

অবনিমণ্ডলে গোরা রূপের অবধি ।
বিলাইলা প্রেমধন আচণ্ডাল আদি ॥ ৯৪+১ ॥

*abanimaṇḍale gorā rūpera abadhi |*
*bilāilā premadhana ācaṇḍāla ādi || 94+1 ||*

*Word for word:* avani-mandale — on the circle of the earth; gora rupera avadhi — Gora, the utmost of beauty; vilaila prema-dhana — gave away the treasure of prema; achandala adi — [to all,] down to the chandalas

**94+1.** Gora, the utmost of beauty on the circle of the earth,
gave away the treasure of prema to all, down to the chandalas[^52-8].

বাচাল করয়ে গোরা-গুণে মূক জনে ।
পঙ্গু গিরি লঙ্ঘে, অন্ধে দেখে তারাগণে ॥ ৯৪+২ ॥

*bācāla karaẏe gorā-guṇe mūka jane |*
*paṅgu giri laṅghe, andhe dekhe tārāgaṇe || 94+2 ||*

*Word for word:* vachala karaye — makes eloquent; gora-gune muka jane — the mute, through Gora's glories; pangu giri langhe — the lame leaps over mountains; andhe dekhe taragane — the blind sees the stars

**94+2.** Gora's glories make the mute eloquent:
