the lame leaps over mountains, the blind sees the stars.

কহিতে কহিতে নাহি জানি নিজ-পর ।
যে উঠয়ে তাহা বলি, না করয়ে ডর ॥ ৯৪+৩ ॥

*kahite kahite nāhi jāni nija-para |*
*ye uṭhaẏe tāhā bali, nā karaẏe ḍara || 94+3 ||*

*Word for word:* kahite kahite — as I tell; nahi jani nija-para — I do not know mine from another's; ye uthaye taha bali — what rises I say; na karaye dara — without fear

**94+3.** As I tell it, I do not know mine from another's:
whatever comes [to mind], I say without fear.

সর্ব-অবতার-সার চৈতন্য গোসাঞি ।
এহেন করুণানিধি আর হৈতে নাই ॥ ৯৪+৪ ॥

*sarba-abatāra-sāra caitanya gosāñi |*
*ehena karuṇānidhi āra haite nāi || 94+4 ||*

*Word for word:* sarva-avatara-sara — the essence of all avataras; chaitanya gosani — Chaitanya Gosani; ehena karunanidhi — such a treasury of mercy; ara haite nai — there will never be again

**94+4.** Chaitanya Gosani is the essence of all avataras:
such a treasury of mercy there will never be again.

কৃষ্ণ বহি আর কেহো নাহিক ঈশ্বর ।
সত্য কিবা ত্রেতা আর এ কলি দ্বাপর ॥ ৯৪+৫ ॥

*kṛṣṇa bahi āra keho nāhika īśbara |*
*satya kibā tretā āra e kali dbāpara || 94+5 ||*

*Word for word:* krishna bahi — except Krishna; ara keho nahika ishvara — there is no other Ishvara; satya kiba treta — in Satya or Treta; ara e kali dvapara — and in Kali and Dvapara

**94+5.** There is no Ishvara but Krishna —
not in Satya, nor Treta, nor Kali, nor Dvapara.

একমাত্র প্রভু সেই, নাম করে ভেদ ।
লোকে বুঝাবারে করে নানামত ভেদ ॥ ৯৪+৬ ॥

*ekamātra prabhu sei, nāma kare bheda |*
*loke bujhābāre kare nānāmata bheda || 94+6 ||*

*Word for word:* ekamatra prabhu sei — the Lord is one alone; nama kare bheda — [only] the names differ; loke bujhabare — to make people understand; kare nanamata bheda — He shows various distinctions

**94+6.** The Lord is one; only the names differ:
to make people understand, He shows various forms.

যত যত অবতার সেই সব যুগে ।
করুণা-কারণ ছোট বড় বলে লোকে ॥ ৯৪+৭ ॥

*yata yata abatāra sei saba yuge |*
*karuṇā-kāraṇa choṭa baṛa bale loke || 94+7 ||*

*Word for word:* yata yata avatara — all the avataras; sei saba yuge — in all those ages; karuna-karana — according to [their] mercy; chhota bada bale loke — people call lesser and greater

**94+7.** All the avataras in all those ages
people call lesser and greater according to their mercy.

চৈতন্য গোসাঞি এই করুণাতে বড় ।
তেঞি বলি অবতার-শিরোমণি দঢ় ॥ ৯৪+৮ ॥

*caitanya gosāñi ei karuṇāte baṛa |*
*teñi bali abatāra-śiromaṇi daṛha || 94+8 ||*

*Word for word:* chaitanya gosani — Chaitanya Gosani; ei karunate bada — is great in this mercy; tenyi bali — therefore I say; avatara-shiromani dadha — firmly, [He is] the crown of avataras

**94+8.** Chaitanya Gosani is great precisely in this mercy —
therefore I firmly say: He is the crown of avataras.

হেন অবতার কেহো না বুঝয়ে লোকে ।
অমৃত ঢাকিয়া যেন রাখে ক্ষুদ্র পোকে ॥ ৯৪+৯ ॥

*hena abatāra keho nā bujhaẏe loke |*
*amṛta ḍhākiẏā yena rākhe kṣudra poke || 94+9 ||*

*Word for word:* hena avatara — such an avatara; keho na bujhaye loke — people do not recognise; amrita dhakiya yena — as if covering nectar; rakhe kshudra poke — small insects keep it

**94+9.** Such an avatara people do not recognise:
as if small insects had covered the nectar [and hidden it].

হেন অবতার-কথা কহিল অলোক ।
হেন গোরাচাঁদ পহুঁ ভজ ছাড়ি' শোক ॥ ৯৪+১০ ॥

*hena abatāra-kathā kahila aloka |*
*hena gorācāṁda pahuṁ bhaja chāṛi' śoka || 94+10 ||*

*Word for word:* hena avatara-katha — the account of such an avatara; kahila aloka — I have told (wondrous); hena gorachanda panhu — such a Lord Gorachand; bhaja chhadi shoka — worship, leaving sorrow

**94+10.** I have told of so wondrous a descent:
worship such a Lord, Gorachand, leaving sorrow.

করুণাসাগর প্রভু প্রেমে উনমত ।
ভক্তসঙ্গে বৃন্দাবন-লীলা অবিরত ॥ ৯৪+১১ ॥

*karuṇāsāgara prabhu preme unamata |*
*bhaktasaṅge bṛndābana-līlā abirata || 94+11 ||*

*Word for word:* karuna-sagara prabhu — the Lord, an ocean of mercy; preme unamata — mad with prema; bhakta-sange — with the devotees; vrindavana-lila avirata — ceaselessly [absorbed] in the lilas of Vrindavana

**94+11.** The Lord, an ocean of mercy, mad with prema,
is ceaselessly [absorbed] with His devotees in the lilas of Vrindavana.

এইমতে মহাপ্রভুর উৎকল-বিহার ।
উৎকল-বিহার-কথা অনেক বিস্তার ॥ ৯৪+১২ ॥

*eimate mahāprabhura utkala-bihāra |*
*utkala-bihāra-kathā aneka bistāra || 94+12 ||*

*Word for word:* eimate — such were; mahaprabhura utkala-vihara — Mahaprabhu's pastimes in Utkala; utkala-vihara-katha — the account of the Utkala pastimes; aneka vistara — is very extensive

**94+12.** Such were Mahaprabhu's pastimes in Utkala;
the account of the Utkala pastimes is very extensive.

বিস্তারিতে পুস্তক সে হয় ত অনেক ।
সংক্ষেপে কহিল কথা শুন সর্বলোক ॥ ৯৪+১৩ ॥

*bistārite pustaka se haẏa ta aneka |*
*saṃkṣepe kahila kathā śuna sarbaloka || 94+13 ||*

*Word for word:* vistarite — if told at length; pustaka se haya ta aneka — the book would be very large; sankshepe kahila katha — I have told it briefly; shuna sarvaloka — hear, everyone

**94+13.** If told at length, the book would be enormous;
I have told it briefly — hear, everyone.

হেনকালে মহাপ্রভু কাশীমিশ্র-ঘরে ।
বৃন্দাবন-কথা কহে ব্যথিত অন্তরে ॥ ৯৪+১৪ ॥

*henakāle mahāprabhu kāśīmiśra-ghare |*
*bṛndābana-kathā kahe byathita antare || 94+14 ||*

*Word for word:* henakale — at that time; mahaprabhu kashimishra-ghare — Mahaprabhu in Kashi Mishra's house; vrindavana-katha kahe — speaks of Vrindavana; vyathita antare — with an aching heart

**94+14.** At that time Mahaprabhu, in Kashi Mishra's house,
speaks of Vrindavana with an aching heart.

নিশ্বাস ছাড়িয়া সে বলিলা মহাপ্রভু ।
এমত ভকত-সঙ্গ নাহি দেখি কভু ॥ ৯৪+১৫ ॥

*niśbāsa chāṛiẏā se balilā mahāprabhu |*
*emata bhakata-saṅga nāhi dekhi kabhu || 94+15 ||*

*Word for word:* nishvasa chhadiya — sighing; se balila mahaprabhu — Mahaprabhu said; emata bhakata-sanga — such company of devotees; nahi dekhi kabhu — I have never seen

**94+15.** Sighing, Mahaprabhu said:
"Never have I seen such a company of devotees."

সম্ভ্রমে উঠিলা জগন্নাথ দেখিবারে ।
ক্রমে ক্রমে উত্তরিলা গিয়া সিংহদ্বারে ॥ ৯৪+১৬ ॥

*sambhrame uṭhilā jagannātha dekhibāre |*
*krame krame uttarilā giẏā siṃhadbāre || 94+16 ||*

*Word for word:* sambhrame uthila — He rose in haste; jagannatha dekhibare — to see Jagannatha; krame krame — step by step; uttarila giya simha-dvare — He came to the Lion Gate

**94+16.** He rose in haste to see Jagannatha
and step by step came to the Lion Gate.

সঙ্গে নিজজন যত তেমতি চলিল ।
সত্বরে চলিয়া গেল মন্দির-ভিতর ॥ ৯৪+১৭ ॥

*saṅge nijajana yata temati calila |*
*satbare caliẏā gela mandira-bhitara || 94+17 ||*

*Word for word:* sange nijajana yata — all His companions; temati chalila — went likewise; satvare chaliya gela — He quickly went; mandira-bhitara — inside the temple

**94+17.** All His companions went with Him,
and He quickly went inside the temple.

নিরখে বদন প্রভু, দেখিতে না পায় ।
সেইখানে মনে প্রভু চিন্তিল উপায় ॥ ৯৪+১৮ ॥

*nirakhe badana prabhu, dekhite nā pāẏa |*
*seikhāne mane prabhu cintila upāẏa || 94+18 ||*

*Word for word:* nirakhe vadana prabhu — the Lord gazes at the face; dekhite na paya — [but] cannot see; seikhane — there; mane prabhu chintila upaya — the Lord thought of a means in His mind

**94+18.** The Lord gazes at [Jagannatha's] face — and cannot see;
then the Lord thought of a means in His mind[^52-9].

তখনে দুয়ারে নিজ লাগিল কপাট ।
সত্বরে চলিয়া গেল অন্তরে উচাট ॥ ৯৪+১৯ ॥

*takhane duẏāre nija lāgila kapāṭa |*
*satbare caliẏā gela antare ucāṭa || 94+19 ||*

*Word for word:* takhane — then; duyare nija lagila kapata — the doors closed of themselves; satvare chaliya gela — He went quickly [within]; antare uchata — with longing in His heart

**94+19.** Then the doors closed of themselves,
and He quickly went [within] with longing in His heart.

আষাঢ় মাসের তিথি সপ্তমী দিবসে ।
নিবেদন করে প্রভু ছাড়িয়া নিশ্বাসে ॥ ৯৪+২০ ॥

*āṣāṛha māsera tithi saptamī dibase |*
*nibedana kare prabhu chāṛiẏā niśbāse || 94+20 ||*

*Word for word:* ashadha masera tithi — in the month of Ashadha, on the lunar day; saptami divase — the seventh; nivedana kare prabhu — the Lord makes a plea; chhadiya nishvase — with a sigh

**94+20.** In the month of Ashadha, on the seventh lunar day,
the Lord, sighing, makes His plea:

সত্য ত্রেতা দ্বাপর সে কলিযুগ আর ।
বিশেষতঃ কলিযুগে সংকীর্তন সার ॥ ৯৪+২১ ॥

*satya tretā dbāpara se kaliyuga āra |*
*biśeṣataḥ kaliyuge saṃkīrtana sāra || 94+21 ||*

*Word for word:* satya treta dvapara — Satya, Treta, Dvapara; se kaliyuga ara — and the Kali-yuga; visheshatah kaliyuge — especially in the Kali-yuga; sankirtana sara — sankirtana is the essence

**94+21.** "Satya, Treta, Dvapara and the Kali-yuga —
and especially in the Kali-yuga the essence is sankirtana.

কৃপা কর জগন্নাথ পতিত-পাবন ।
কলিযুগ আইল—এই দেহ ত শরণ ॥ ৯৪+২২ ॥

*kṛpā kara jagannātha patita-pābana |*
*kaliyuga āila—ei deha ta śaraṇa || 94+22 ||*

*Word for word:* kripa kara jagannatha — have mercy, Jagannatha; patita-pavana — purifier of the fallen; kaliyuga aila — the Kali-yuga has come; ei deha ta sharana — give shelter now

**94+22.** Have mercy, Jagannatha, purifier of the fallen:
the Kali-yuga has come — give shelter now!"

এ বোল বলিয়া সেই ত্রিজগত-রায় ।
বাহু ভিড়ি' আলিঙ্গন তুলিল হিয়ায় ॥ ৯৪+২৩ ॥

*e bola baliẏā sei trijagata-rāẏa |*
*bāhu bhiṛi' āliṅgana tulila hiẏāẏa || 94+23 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola baliya — saying this; sei trijagata-raya — that Lord of the three worlds; bahu bhidi — clasping with His arms; alingana tulila hiyaya — took [Him] in an embrace to His heart

**94+23.** Saying this, that Lord of the three worlds
clasped [Him] in His arms, pressing Him to His heart.

তৃতীয় প্রহর বেলা রবিবার দিনে ।
জগন্নাথে লীন প্রভু হইলা আপনে ॥ ৯৪+২৪ ॥

*tṛtīẏa prahara belā rabibāra dine |*
*jagannāthe līna prabhu hailā āpane || 94+24 ||*

*Word for word:* tritiya prahara bela — in the third prahara of the day; ravibara dine — on a Sunday; jagannathe lina — merged into Jagannatha; prabhu haila apane — the Lord Himself became

**94+24.** In the third prahara of the day, on a Sunday,
the Lord Himself entered into Jagannatha[^52-10].

গুঞ্জাবাড়ীতে ছিল পাণ্ডা যে ব্রাহ্মণ ।
কি কি বলি' সত্বরে সে আইল তখন ॥ ৯৪+২৫ ॥

*guñjābāṛīte chila pāṇḍā ye brāhmaṇa |*
*ki ki bali' satbare se āila takhana || 94+25 ||*

*Word for word:* gunjabadite chhila — in the Gunjabadi there was; panda ye brahmana — a brahmana panda; ki ki bali — crying "what, what?"; satvare se aila takhana — he came quickly then

**94+25.** A brahmana panda who was in the Gunjabadi,
crying "What, what?", came hurrying at once[^52-11].

বিপ্রে দেখি' ভক্ত কহে—শুনহ পড়িছা ।
ঘুচাও কপাট, প্রভু দেখি বড় ইচ্ছা ॥ ৯৪+২৬ ॥

*bipre dekhi' bhakta kahe—śunaha paṛichā |*
*ghucāo kapāṭa, prabhu dekhi baṛa icchā || 94+26 ||*

*Word for word:* vipre dekhi — seeing the brahmana; bhakta kahe — the devotees say; shunaha padichha — listen, padichha; ghuchao kapata — open the doors; prabhu dekhi bada ichchha — we long to see the Lord

**94+26.** Seeing the brahmana, the devotees say: "Listen, padichha,
open the doors — we long to see the Lord!"

ভক্ত-আর্তি দেখি' পড়িছা কহয়ে কথন ।
গুঞ্জাবাড়ীর মধ্যে প্রভুর হৈল অদর্শন ॥ ৯৪+২৭ ॥

*bhakta-ārti dekhi' paṛichā kahaẏe kathana |*
*guñjābāṛīra madhye prabhura haila adarśana || 94+27 ||*

*Word for word:* bhakta-arti dekhi — seeing the devotees' distress; padichha kahaye kathana — the padichha speaks; gunjabadira madhye — within the Gunjabadi; prabhura haila adarshana — the Lord disappeared from sight

**94+27.** Seeing the devotees' distress, the padichha says:
"In the Gunjabadi the Lord disappeared from sight.

সাক্ষাতে দেখিল গৌর প্রভুর মিলন ।
নিশ্চয় করিয়া কহি শুন সর্বজন ॥ ৯৪+২৮ ॥

*sākṣāte dekhila gaura prabhura milana |*
*niścaẏa kariẏā kahi śuna sarbajana || 94+28 ||*

*Word for word:* sakshate dekhila — I saw with my own eyes; gaura prabhura milana — the union of Gaura with the Lord [Jagannatha]; nishchaya kariya kahi — I say for certain; shuna sarvajana — hear, everyone

**94+28.** With my own eyes I saw Gaura unite with the Lord [Jagannatha] —
I say it for certain; hear, everyone."

এ বোল শুনিয়া ভক্ত করে হাহাকার ।
শ্রীমুখ-চন্দ্রিমা প্রভুর না দেখিব আর ॥ ৯৪+২৯ ॥

*e bola śuniẏā bhakta kare hāhākāra |*
*śrīmukha-candrimā prabhura nā dekhiba āra || 94+29 ||*

*Word for word:* e bola shuniya — hearing this; bhakta kare hahakara — the devotees cried out in grief; sri-mukha-chandrima prabhura — the moonlike face of the Lord; na dekhiba ara — we shall see no more

**94+29.** Hearing this, the devotees cried out in grief:
"We shall see the Lord's moonlike face no more!"

শ্রীবাস পণ্ডিত আর দত্ত যে মুকুন্দ ।
গৌরীদাস বাসুদত্ত আর শ্রীগোবিন্দ ॥ ৯৪+৩০ ॥

*śrībāsa paṇḍita āra datta ye mukunda |*
*gaurīdāsa bāsudatta āra śrīgobinda || 94+30 ||*

*Word for word:* srivasa pandita — Srivasa Pandita; ara datta ye mukunda — and Mukunda Datta; gauridasa vasudatta — Gauridasa, Vasu Datta; ara sri-govinda — and Sri Govinda

**94+30.** Srivasa Pandita and Mukunda Datta,
Gauridasa, Vasu Datta and Sri Govinda,

কাশীমিশ্র সনাতন আর হরিদাস ।
উৎকলের সবে কান্দে ছাড়িয়া নিশ্বাস ॥ ৯৪+৩১ ॥

*kāśīmiśra sanātana āra haridāsa |*
*utkalera sabe kānde chāṛiẏā niśbāsa || 94+31 ||*

*Word for word:* kashimishra sanatana — Kashi Mishra, Sanatana; ara haridasa — and Haridasa; utkalera sabe — all the people of Utkala; kande chhadiya nishvasa — weep, sighing deeply

**94+31.** Kashi Mishra, Sanatana and Haridasa —
all the people of Utkala weep, sighing deeply[^52-12].

শ্রীপ্রতাপরুদ্র রাজা শুনিল শ্রবণে ।
পরিবার-সহ রাজা হরিল চেতনে ॥ ৯৪+৩২ ॥

*śrīpratāparudra rājā śunila śrabaṇe |*
*paribāra-saha rājā harila cetane || 94+32 ||*

*Word for word:* sri-prataparudra raja — King Sri Prataparudra; shunila shravane — heard with his own ears; parivara-saha raja — the king with his family; harila chetane — lost consciousness

**94+32.** King Sri Prataparudra heard [the news]
and together with his family lost consciousness.

সার্বভৌম ভট্টাচার্য তনুজ-সহায় ।
প্রভু প্রভু ডাকে, বলে—শুন গৌররায় ॥ ৯৪+৩৩ ॥

*sārbabhauma bhaṭṭācārya tanuja-sahāẏa |*
*prabhu prabhu ḍāke, bale—śuna gaurarāẏa || 94+33 ||*

*Word for word:* sarvabhauma bhattacharya — Sarvabhauma Bhattacharya; tanuja-sahaya — together with his son; prabhu prabhu dake — calls "Lord, Lord!"; bale shuna gauraraya — says "Hear, Gauraraya!"

**94+33.** Sarvabhauma Bhattacharya, together with his son,
calls: "Lord, Lord! Hear us, Gauraraya!"

অনেক রোদন কৈল সব ভক্তগণ ।
ইহা বা লিখিব কত মো অধম জন ॥ ৯৪+৩৪ ॥

*aneka rodana kaila saba bhaktagaṇa |*
*ihā bā likhiba kata mo adhama jana || 94+34 ||*

*Word for word:* aneka rodana kaila — wept much; saba bhaktagana — all the devotees; iha va likhiba kata — how much of this can I write; mo adhama jana — I, a low person

**94+34.** All the devotees wept bitterly —
how much of this can I, a low person, write?

অশেষ প্রভুর গুণ—গণনা হয় বিস্তার ।
এবে না দেখিয়া মোর হৈল অন্ধকার ॥ ৯৪+৩৫ ॥

*aśeṣa prabhura guṇa—gaṇanā haẏa bistāra |*
*ebe nā dekhiẏā mora haila andhakāra || 94+35 ||*

*Word for word:* ashesha prabhura guna — the Lord's qualities are endless; ganana haya vistara — their counting is vast; ebe na dekhiya — now, not seeing [Him]; mora haila andhakara — darkness has come over me

**94+35.** The Lord's qualities are endless — they cannot be counted;
now that I do not see Him, darkness has come over me.

মিনতি করিয়া বলি শুন সব জন ।
দিবানিশি ভজ ভাই গৌরাঙ্গ-চরণ ॥ ৯৪+৩৬ ॥

*minati kariẏā bali śuna saba jana |*
*dibāniśi bhaja bhāi gaurāṅga-caraṇa || 94+36 ||*

*Word for word:* minati kariya bali — I say imploringly; shuna saba jana — hear, all; divanishi bhaja bhai — day and night worship, brothers; gauranga-charana — the feet of Gauranga

**94+36.** I say imploringly: hear, all,
day and night worship, brothers, the feet of Gauranga.

নির্মল হইয়া সভে শুন গোরাগুণ ।
ভবব্যাধি নাশিবারে এই সে কারণ ॥ ৯৪+৩৭ ॥

*nirmala haiẏā sabhe śuna gorāguṇa |*
*bhababyādhi nāśibāre ei se kāraṇa || 94+37 ||*

*Word for word:* nirmala haiya — becoming pure; sabhe shuna goraguna — all hear Gora's glories; bhava-vyadhi nashibare — to destroy the disease of worldly existence; ei se karana — this is the means

**94+37.** Becoming pure, all hear Gora's glories:
this is the means to destroy the disease of worldly existence.

এত শোকে বিলপন করয়ে লোচন ।
শেষখণ্ড সায় হৈল প্রভুর কীর্তন ॥ ৯৪+৩৮ ॥

*eta śoke bilapana karaẏe locana |*
*śeṣakhaṇḍa sāẏa haila prabhura kīrtana || 94+38 ||*

*Word for word:* eta shoke — in such grief; vilapana karaye lochana — Lochana laments; shesha-khanda saya haila — the Shesha-khanda is concluded; prabhura kirtana — of the Lord's glorification

**94+38.** In such grief Lochana laments:
the Shesha-khanda, the glorification of the Lord, is concluded.

## Lochana Dasa's Word about Himself

গৃহ-ব্যবহার-কথা শুন সর্বজন ।
হেনই সময়ে করো শ্রীহরি-স্মরণ ॥ ৯৪+৩৯ ॥

*gṛha-byabahāra-kathā śuna sarbajana |*
*henai samaẏe karo śrīhari-smaraṇa || 94+39 ||*

*Word for word:* griha-vyavahara-katha — the account of my household; shuna sarvajana — hear, everyone; henai samaye — at this time; karo sri-hari-smarana — remember Sri Hari

**94+39.** Hear, everyone, about my home and family,
and at the same time remember Sri Hari[^52-13].

সভাকারে করোঁ মুঞি এই নিবেদন ।
সত্য করি' জানিহ শ্রীবৈষ্ণব-চরণ ॥ ৯৪+৪০ ॥

*sabhākāre karoṁ muñi ei nibedana |*
*satya kari' jāniha śrībaiṣṇaba-caraṇa || 94+40 ||*

*Word for word:* sabhakare karon munyi — to all I make; ei nivedana — this request; satya kari janiha — know as true; sri-vaishnava-charana — the feet of the Vaishnavas

**94+40.** To all I make one request:
know as true the feet of the Vaishnavas.

গৌরপদ-কমলে মো করিয়ে প্রণতি ।
তিলেক করুণা-দিঠে কর অবগতি ॥ ৯৪+৪১ ॥

*gaurapada-kamale mo kariẏe praṇati |*
*tileka karuṇā-diṭhe kara abagati || 94+41 ||*

*Word for word:* gaura-pada-kamale — to Gaura's lotus feet; mo kariye pranati — I bow; tileka karuna-dithe — for a moment with a merciful glance; kara avagati — regard [me]

**94+41.** I bow to Gaura's lotus feet:
for a moment regard [me] with a merciful glance.

বৈষ্ণব-প্রসাদে কিছু যে জানি প্রকাশ ।
প্রাণের ঠাকুর মোর নরহরি দাস ॥ ৯৪+৪২ ॥

*baiṣṇaba-prasāde kichu ye jāni prakāśa |*
*prāṇera ṭhākura mora narahari dāsa || 94+42 ||*

*Word for word:* vaishnava-prasade — by the Vaishnavas' grace; kichhu ye jani prakasha — the little I know and set forth; pranera thakura mora — the Thakura of my life; narahari dasa — Narahari Dasa

**94+42.** The little I know and set forth is by the Vaishnavas' grace;
the Thakura of my life is Narahari Dasa.

তাঁর পদ-প্রসাদে এ পথের প্রতি আশ ।
গোরাগুণ কহিবারে কৈলুঁ অভিলাষ ॥ ৯৪+৪৩ ॥

*tāṁra pada-prasāde e pathera prati āśa |*
*gorāguṇa kahibāre kailuṁ abhilāṣa || 94+43 ||*

*Word for word:* tanra pada-prasade — by the grace of his feet; e pathera prati asha — hope in this path; goraguna kahibare — to tell Gora's glories; kailun abhilasha — I conceived the desire

**94+43.** By the grace of his feet I gained hope in this path
and conceived the desire to tell Gora's glories.

শ্রীমুরারি গুপ্ত বেজা প্রভুর অন্তরীণ ।
সকল জানয়ে সেই ভকত প্রবীণ ॥ ৯৪+৪৪ ॥

*śrīmurāri gupta bejā prabhura antarīṇa |*
*sakala jānaẏe sei bhakata prabīṇa || 94+44 ||*

*Word for word:* sri-murari gupta beja — Sri Murari Gupta the vaidya; prabhura antarina — the Lord's intimate; sakala janaye — knows everything; sei bhakata pravina — that seasoned devotee

**94+44.** Sri Murari Gupta the vaidya, the Lord's intimate,
knows everything — that seasoned devotee.

লোক নিস্তারিতে কৈল চৈতন্য-চরিত্র ।
তাঁহার প্রসাদে হৈল সংসার পবিত্র ॥ ৯৪+৪৫ ॥

*loka nistārite kaila caitanya-caritra |*
*tāṁhāra prasāde haila saṃsāra pabitra || 94+45 ||*

*Word for word:* loka nistarite — to deliver the people; kaila chaitanya-charitra — he composed the life of Chaitanya; tanhara prasade — by his grace; haila samsara pavitra — the world was purified

**94+45.** To deliver the people he composed the life of Chaitanya;
by his grace the world was purified.

শ্লোকবন্ধে কৈল গৌরগুণের কবিত্ব ।
তাহাই হইল এবে সকলের সূত্র ॥ ৯৪+৪৬ ॥

*ślokabandhe kaila gauraguṇera kabitba |*
*tāhāi haila ebe sakalera sūtra || 94+46 ||*

*Word for word:* shloka-bandhe — in verses; kaila gaura-gunera kavitva — he composed a poem on Gaura's glories; tahai haila ebe — that has now become; sakalera sutra — the thread (basis) for all

**94+46.** He composed in verses a poem on Gaura's glories —
it has now become the basis for all[^52-14].

শুনিয়া মাধুরী-লোভে চিত উতরোল ।
নিজ দোষ না দেখিলুঁ, মন হৈল ভোল ॥ ৯৪+৪৭ ॥

*śuniẏā mādhurī-lobhe cita utarola |*
*nija doṣa nā dekhiluṁ, mana haila bhola || 94+47 ||*

*Word for word:* shuniya — hearing it; madhuri-lobhe — in greed for its sweetness; chita utarola — my heart was stirred; nija dosha na dekhilun — I did not look at my own faults; mana haila bhola — my mind forgot itself

**94+47.** Hearing it, in greed for its sweetness my heart was stirred:
I did not look at my own faults — my mind forgot itself.

পাঁচালী-প্রবন্ধে আমি রচিল এখন ।
দোষ না লইবে কেহো, মো অতি অধম ॥ ৯৪+৪৮ ॥

*pāṁcālī-prabandhe āmi racila ekhana |*
*doṣa nā laibe keho, mo ati adhama || 94+48 ||*

*Word for word:* panchali-prabandhe — in panchali form; ami rachila ekhana — I have now composed; dosha na laibe keho — let no one take offence; mo ati adhama — I am most low

**94+48.** Now I have composed [this account] in panchali form —
let no one judge harshly: I am most low.

অধিকারী নাহি তবু করিলুঁ সাহস ।
বৈষ্ণব-করুণা দেখি' মনের ভরস ॥ ৯৪+৪৯ ॥

*adhikārī nāhi tabu kariluṁ sāhasa |*
*baiṣṇaba-karuṇā dekhi' manera bharasa || 94+49 ||*

*Word for word:* adhikari nahi — I am not qualified; tabu karilun sahasa — yet I dared; vaishnava-karuna dekhi — seeing the Vaishnavas' mercy; manera bharasa — my heart's confidence

**94+49.** I am not qualified, and yet I dared:
seeing the Vaishnavas' mercy, I took heart.

চারিখণ্ড পুঁথি হৈল বৈষ্ণব-কৃপায় ।
সমাধা করিতে ব্যথা লাগয়ে হিয়ায় ॥ ৯৪+৫০ ॥

*cārikhaṇḍa puṁthi haila baiṣṇaba-kṛpāẏa |*
*samādhā karite byathā lāgaẏe hiẏāẏa || 94+50 ||*

*Word for word:* chari-khanda punthi haila — the book in four parts came to be; vaishnava-kripaya — by the Vaishnavas' mercy; samadha karite — in finishing it; vyatha lagaye hiyaya — my heart aches

**94+50.** By the Vaishnavas' mercy the book in four parts came to be;
in finishing it, my heart aches.

সূত্রখণ্ডে আদ্য কথা অমৃতের খণ্ড ।
জন্মাদি-রহস্য-কথা কহিল আদ্যখণ্ড ॥ ৯৪+৫১ ॥

*sūtrakhaṇḍe ādya kathā amṛtera khaṇḍa |*
*janmādi-rahasya-kathā kahila ādyakhaṇḍa || 94+51 ||*

*Word for word:* sutra-khande adya katha — in the Sutra-khanda the opening account; amritera khanda — a portion of nectar; janmadi-rahasya-katha — the secrets of the birth and the rest; kahila adya-khanda — the Adi-khanda told

**94+51.** In the Sutra-khanda is the opening account, a portion of nectar;
the secrets of the birth and the rest the Adi-khanda told.

মধ্যখণ্ড-কথা তাই করুণার ঘর ।
শেষখণ্ড-কথা সে তিন খণ্ডের পর ॥ ৯৪+৫২ ॥

*madhyakhaṇḍa-kathā tāi karuṇāra ghara |*
*śeṣakhaṇḍa-kathā se tina khaṇḍera para || 94+52 ||*

*Word for word:* madhya-khanda-katha — the account of the Madhya-khanda; tai karunara ghara — is an abode of mercy; shesha-khanda-katha — the account of the Shesha-khanda; se tina khandera para — after the three parts

**94+52.** The account of the Madhya-khanda is an abode of mercy;
the account of the Shesha-khanda comes after the three parts.

চারিখণ্ড-কথা হৈল বৈষ্ণব-কৃপায় ।
সমাধা করিতে ব্যথা লাগয়ে হিয়ায় ॥ ৯৪+৫৩ ॥

*cārikhaṇḍa-kathā haila baiṣṇaba-kṛpāẏa |*
*samādhā karite byathā lāgaẏe hiẏāẏa || 94+53 ||*

*Word for word:* chari-khanda-katha haila — the account in four parts came to be; vaishnava-kripaya — by the Vaishnavas' mercy; samadha karite — in finishing; vyatha lagaye hiyaya — my heart aches

**94+53.** By the Vaishnavas' mercy the account in four parts came to be;
in finishing it, my heart aches.

গৌরগুণ-কথা এই অমৃত-সমুদ্র ।
কহিতে না পারে প্রভু প্রজাপতি রুদ্র ॥ ৯৪+৫৪ ॥

*gauraguṇa-kathā ei amṛta-samudra |*
*kahite nā pāre prabhu prajāpati rudra || 94+54 ||*

*Word for word:* gaura-guna-katha ei — this account of Gaura's glories; amrita-samudra — is an ocean of nectar; kahite na pare — cannot tell it; prabhu prajapati rudra — even the lords Prajapati and Rudra

**94+54.** This account of Gaura's glories is an ocean of nectar:
even the lords Prajapati and Rudra cannot tell it.

আমি কি কহিব গুণ, কি জানি কতেক ।
বৈষ্ণব-কৃপার বলে বলিল যতেক ॥ ৯৪+৫৫ ॥

*āmi ki kahiba guṇa, ki jāni kateka |*
*baiṣṇaba-kṛpāra bale balila yateka || 94+55 ||*

*Word for word:* ami ki kahiba guna — what can I tell of [His] glories; ki jani kateka — how much do I know; vaishnava-kripara bale — by the strength of the Vaishnavas' mercy; balila yateka — I have said whatever I said

**94+55.** What can I tell of His glories, how much do I know?
All that I have said is by the strength of the Vaishnavas' mercy.

করজোড় করি' বলোঁ কাতর-বয়ানে ।
আত্মনিবেদিনু মুঞি বৈষ্ণব-চরণে ॥ ৯৪+৫৬ ॥

*karajoṛa kari' baloṁ kātara-baẏāne |*
*ātmanibedinu muñi baiṣṇaba-caraṇe || 94+56 ||*

*Word for word:* karajoda kari — with joined palms; balon katara-bayane — I speak imploringly; atma-nivedinu munyi — I have offered myself; vaishnava-charane — at the feet of the Vaishnavas

**94+56.** With joined palms I speak imploringly:
I have offered myself at the feet of the Vaishnavas.

মো অধিক অধম নাহিক মহী-মাঝ ।
বৈষ্ণব-কৃপার বলে সিদ্ধ হৈল কাজ ॥ ৯৪+৫৭ ॥

*mo adhika adhama nāhika mahī-mājha |*
*baiṣṇaba-kṛpāra bale siddha haila kāja || 94+57 ||*

*Word for word:* mo adhika adhama — lower than I; nahika mahi-majha — there is none on earth; vaishnava-kripara bale — by the strength of the Vaishnavas' mercy; siddha haila kaja — the work is accomplished

**94+57.** There is no one on earth lower than I —
by the strength of the Vaishnavas' mercy the work is accomplished.

চৈতন্যচরিত-কথা কে কহিতে জানে ।
সম্বরিতে নারি, কিছু কহিনু বদনে ॥ ৯৪+৫৮ ॥

*caitanyacarita-kathā ke kahite jāne |*
*sambarite nāri, kichu kahinu badane || 94+58 ||*

*Word for word:* chaitanya-charita-katha — the story of Chaitanya; ke kahite jane — who knows how to tell; samvarite nari — unable to restrain myself; kichhu kahinu vadane — I have spoken a little

**94+58.** Who knows how to tell the story of Chaitanya's life?
Unable to restrain myself, I have spoken a little.

চারিখণ্ড-কথা সায় করিল প্রকাশ ।
বৈদ্যকুলে জন্ম মোর, কোগ্রামে নিবাস ॥ ৯৪+৫৯ ॥

*cārikhaṇḍa-kathā sāẏa karila prakāśa |*
*baidyakule janma mora, kogrāme nibāsa || 94+59 ||*

*Word for word:* chari-khanda-katha — the account in four parts; saya karila prakasha — I have completed and made known; vaidya-kule janma mora — I was born in the vaidya caste; ko-grame nivasa — I live in Kogram

**94+59.** Having completed the account in four parts, I have made it known.
I was born in the vaidya caste and live in Kogram.

মাতা মোর পুণ্যবতী সদানন্দী নাম ।
যাঁহার উদরে জন্মি' করি কৃষ্ণকাম ॥ ৯৪+৬০ ॥

*mātā mora puṇyabatī sadānandī nāma |*
*yāṁhāra udare janmi' kari kṛṣṇakāma || 94+60 ||*

*Word for word:* mata mora punyavati — my pious mother; sadanandi nama — named Sadanandi; yanhara udare janmi — born from whose womb; kari krishna-kama — I long for Krishna

**94+60.** My pious mother is named Sadanandi:
born from her womb, I long for Krishna.

কমলাকর দাস মোর পিতা জন্মদাতা ।
যাঁহার প্রসাদে কহি গোরাগুণগাথা ॥ ৯৪+৬১ ॥

*kamalākara dāsa mora pitā janmadātā |*
*yāṁhāra prasāde kahi gorāguṇagāthā || 94+61 ||*

*Word for word:* kamalakara dasa — Kamalakara Dasa; mora pita janmadata — my father who gave me birth; yanhara prasade — by whose grace; kahi goraguna-gatha — I tell the tale of Gora's glories

**94+61.** My father who gave me birth is Kamalakara Dasa:
by his grace I tell the tale of Gora's glories.

মাতৃকুল পিতৃকুল বৈসে এক গ্রামে ।
ধন্য মাতামহী সে অভয়া দাসী নামে ॥ ৯৪+৬২ ॥

*mātṛkula pitṛkula baise eka grāme |*
*dhanya mātāmahī se abhaẏā dāsī nāme || 94+62 ||*

*Word for word:* matrikula pitrikula — the mother's family and the father's family; baise eka grame — live in one village; dhanya matamahi — blessed is my grandmother; se abhaya dasi name — named Abhaya Dasi

**94+62.** My mother's family and my father's family live in one village;
blessed is my grandmother, named Abhaya Dasi.

মাতামহের নাম শ্রীপুরুষোত্তম গুপ্ত ।
নানাতীর্থপূত তেঁহ, তপস্যায় তৃপ্ত ॥ ৯৪+৬৩ ॥

*mātāmahera nāma śrīpuruṣottama gupta |*
*nānātīrthapūta teṁha, tapasyāẏa tṛpta || 94+63 ||*

*Word for word:* matamahera nama — the name of my maternal grandfather; sri-purushottama gupta — Sri Purushottama Gupta; nana-tirtha-puta tenha — he was purified by many tirthas; tapasyaya tripta — content in austerity

**94+63.** The name of my maternal grandfather is Sri Purushottama Gupta:
he was purified by many tirthas and content in austerity.

মাতৃকুলে পিতৃকুলে আমি মাত্র পুত্র ।
সহোদর নাহি, নাহি মাতামহের সূত্র ॥ ৯৪+৬৪ ॥

*mātṛkule pitṛkule āmi mātra putra |*
*sahodara nāhi, nāhi mātāmahera sūtra || 94+64 ||*

*Word for word:* matrikule pitrikule — in the mother's and father's families; ami matra putra — I am the only son; sahodara nahi — there are no brothers; nahi matamahera sutra — no [other] line of my grandfather

**94+64.** In my mother's family and my father's I am the only son:
I have no brothers, and my grandfather has no [other] line.

যথা তথা যাই, সে দুলালি' করে মোরে ।
দুলাল লাগিয়া কেহো পড়াইতে নারে ॥ ৯৪+৬৫ ॥

*yathā tathā yāi, se dulāli' kare more |*
*dulāla lāgiẏā keho paṛāite nāre || 94+65 ||*

*Word for word:* yatha tatha yai — wherever I went; se dulali kare more — they petted me; dulala lagiya — because I was a darling; keho padaite nare — no one could teach me

**94+65.** Wherever I went, they petted me:
because I was a spoiled darling, no one could teach me.

মারিয়া ধরিয়া মোরে শিখাইল আখর ।
ধন্য পুরুষোত্তম গুপ্ত, চরিত্র তাঁহার ॥ ৯৪+৬৬ ॥

*māriẏā dhariẏā more śikhāila ākhara |*
*dhanya puruṣottama gupta, caritra tāṁhāra || 94+66 ||*

*Word for word:* mariya dhariya — with beating and restraint; more shikhaila akhara — he taught me letters; dhanya purushottama gupta — blessed is Purushottama Gupta; charitra tanhara — and his character

**94+66.** [But he,] by beating and strictness, taught me letters —
blessed is Purushottama Gupta and his character!

তাঁহার চরণে মুঞি করোঁ নমস্কার ।
চৈতন্যচরিত লিখি প্রসাদে যাঁহার ॥ ৯৪+৬৭ ॥

*tāṁhāra caraṇe muñi karoṁ namaskāra |*
*caitanyacarita likhi prasāde yāṁhāra || 94+67 ||*

*Word for word:* tanhara charane — at his feet; munyi karon namaskara — I bow; chaitanya-charita likhi — I write the life of Chaitanya; prasade yanhara — by whose grace

**94+67.** I bow at his feet:
by his grace I write the life of Chaitanya.

মাতৃকুল পিতৃকুল কহিল মো কথা ।
নরহরি দাস মোর প্রেমভক্তি-দাতা ॥ ৯৪+৬৮ ॥

*mātṛkula pitṛkula kahila mo kathā |*
*narahari dāsa mora premabhakti-dātā || 94+68 ||*

*Word for word:* matrikula pitrikula — of my mother's and father's families; kahila mo katha — I have told; narahari dasa — Narahari Dasa; mora prema-bhakti-data — is the giver of prema-bhakti to me

**94+68.** I have told of my mother's and my father's families.
Narahari Dasa is the giver of prema-bhakti to me.

তাঁহার প্রসাদে যেবা করিল প্রকাশ ।
পুস্তক করিল সায় এ লোচনদাস ॥ ৯৪+৬৯ ॥

*tāṁhāra prasāde yebā karila prakāśa |*
*pustaka karila sāẏa e locanadāsa || 94+69 ||*

*Word for word:* tanhara prasade — by his grace; yeba karila prakasha — what [I] have set forth; pustaka karila saya — has completed the book; e lochanadasa — this Lochana Dasa

**94+69.** By his grace is all that I have set forth:
[thus] this Lochana Dasa has completed the book.

*Thus ends the Shesha-khanda of the "Sri Chaitanya-mangala," composed by Sri Lochana Dasa Thakura. The "Sri Chaitanya-mangala" is complete*[^52-15].

[^52-1]: Vv. 1–94 — cf. Murari 4.21 (the poor brahmana from Dravida and Vibhishana at Gaura's feet). Vibhishana is Ravana's brother, a devotee of Rama, by tradition immortal (chiranjivi); in Puri it is said that he comes to see Jagannatha.
[^52-2]: The brahmana threatens to die at the Deity's door, so that the sin of killing a brahmana would fall on the Lord Himself. Lochana Dasa himself below (vv. 57–61), through the Lord's words, censures this disposition — blaming the Lord for the fruits of one's own karma.
[^52-3]: V. 29+1 is found only in the 1983 edition; it is absent in the 1903 edition.
[^52-4]: A finger to the nose is a gesture of astonishment: Vibhishana is surprised that the brahmana is still following him. At the gate Govinda sees "two young brahmanas" (v. 50): Vibhishana appears in the guise of a brahmana.
[^52-5]: Cf. the Chaitanya-charitamrita (Madhya 22): even when He is worshipped for other desires, Krishna grants the petitioner His feet, and in time that person gives up other desires.
[^52-6]: V. 86 is spoken by Puri Gosani (Paramananda Puri), who tells how he ventured to ask.
[^52-7]: Here the text in Bhaktisiddhanta's edition ends; what follows is a chapter found only in the 1983 edition (in the 1903 edition, in a footnote).
[^52-8]: This chapter is absent in Bhaktisiddhanta's edition (1922): his text ends with v. 94 of the section "The Final Pastimes" and the colophon (see the end of this portion). The chapter is translated from Haridasa Shastri's edition (1983), where it stands as chapter 4 of the Shesha-khanda (we have transcribed its text from Devanagari into Bengali script, see bn/52). The 1903 edition gives it not in the main text but in a footnote after v. 94, with the editor's remarks on the sources, with variant readings and several additional lines (these, being absent in the 1983 edition, we do not translate). The numbering continues that of the section: 94+1, 94+2…
[^52-9]: The sense of the couplet is unclear: apparently the Lord, in separation, cannot be satisfied with seeing Jagannatha and resolves to unite with Him for ever.
[^52-10]: Lochana Dasa writes that the Lord "entered into Jagannatha" (literally, "became lina," "merged"). In the Gaudiya Vaishnava understanding (Srila Bhaktisiddhanta Sarasvati), the Lord's departure is antardhana-lila: He only withdrew from mundane sight, just as He appeared by His own will; His body is sach-chid-ananda, not material, and there is no death for Him. The "merging" here is not the impersonal dissolution of a jiva in Brahman: the Lord re-enters His own form — the Deity of Jagannatha, non-different from Him (cf. en/45, note 15, on the Daru-brahman and en/51, v. 85). Other traditions tell of the departure differently: Jayananda (Chaitanya-mangala) speaks of a wound to the foot from a brick during the Ratha-yatra; according to another tradition the Lord disappeared in the temple of Tota-Gopinatha; the Chaitanya-charitamrita gives no account of the Lord's departure. The traditional date is 1533 (Shaka 1455).
[^52-11]: The Gunjabadi is apparently a room or courtyard in the Jagannatha temple; the exact meaning is unclear. The padichha is the temple superintendent (cf. en/51, v. 75).
[^52-12]: The list is poetic: according to the Chaitanya-charitamrita, Haridasa Thakura departed before the Lord (Antya 11), and Sanatana Gosvami lived in Vrindavana. Gauridasa is apparently Gauridasa Pandita of Ambika (Kalna); Govinda is the Lord's servant (or Govinda Ghosha).
[^52-13]: Vv. 94+39 — 94+69 are Lochana Dasa's closing word; they are found only in the 1983 edition (in the 1903 edition, in the same footnote, with variant readings and with additional lines on Narahari Sarakara, Raghunandana and others that are absent in the 1983 edition). Lochana Dasa was a vaidya and lived in Kogram (now in Purba Bardhaman district, West Bengal); his mother was Sadanandi, his father Kamalakara Dasa; his maternal grandfather Purushottama Gupta, his grandmother Abhaya Dasi; his guru Narahari Sarakara Thakura of Shrikhanda.
[^52-14]: Murari Gupta is the author of the Sanskrit poem Sri Krishna-chaitanya-charitamrita (Murari's "Kadcha"), on which Lochana Dasa relies (see our translation in murari-gupta/).
[^52-15]: The colophon of Bhaktisiddhanta's edition — there it stands directly after v. 94 of "The Final Pastimes." In the 1983 edition, after chapter 4: "Thus ends the Shesha-khanda of the book 'Sri Chaitanya-mangala.'"
